The tests are impossible-pure memorization. It requires a good amount of work. She's also a hard grader on papers. Although there is a lot of reading, you can get by without it. Her lectures aren't too informative and she just basically repeats students comments. Although the class isn't that hard with effort, tests are terrible.
What a jerk.  I couldn't stand her.  The class wasn't overally hard, but she is Professor Umbridge's twin.

enthusiastic, but corny. i don't really like humanities and she didnt make me like it anymore or dislike it anymore... the class is a little obnoxious becuase it requires a good amount of reading and the tests include nothing but memorization, so if you liek to memorize and you like teachers who treat you like middle schoolers, go for it.

This class and Professor Leavitt are both awesome. I would definitely take it again, it was very manageable, and everything is explained very clearly.
Overall, great Professor and class. Took it online, and it was fairly easy to fall behind but also easy to keep up.

Great professor and class. I met with her a lot to discuss questions on topics I had and she was very understanding and knowledgeable. Probably the class I will remember and apply the most from in college.

Amazing professor. Loved her class and everything she taught; it helped me out so much in my own relationship.

This class was really helpful in preparing for a future marriage but also being aware of yourself in why you do what you do.

This professor is AMAZING! She is so caring and offers very inspiring thoughts. I have learned a lot in the class and hope to improve my relationships because of it.

Dr. Leavitt is amazing at what she does. She is extremely knowledgable about the content and has a passion for it. I learned a lot of useful things, and have recommended this class to all my friends. A few larger assignments throughout the semester, but a very manageable class.

This was a great class and Professor Leavitt really cares about what she is teaching. There is good content in the lectures and it is an easy A as long as you do all the assignments. I really liked the online setup of the class as well.

Professor Leavitt is an amazing professor! Her lectures are so inspirational! There are a lot of assignments and a lot of work compared to other marriage prep courses but it is worth it.

Very good professor and I really enjoyed her class. Really easy to get an A the only thing that will bring your grade down is the tests so study for them. Would definitely take again.

This class was amazing! So many good, applicable life skills-- not just for marriage. Professor Leavitt is amazing! She is very knowledgeable and provides many great insights that inspired me. I learned a lot from her.

Great teacher, really cares about you and your learning. Not a hard class & super important stuff to learn about.

Professor Leavitt is the best! I needed three electives my senior year and had never taken a marriage prep class, so I signed up to take this class and loved it. I learned SO much beyond just marriage prep. The weekly load is totally reasonable. You will love it! Highly reccomend!
professor Leavitt is amazing, and I really enjoyed this class.

she's amazing!! I learned so much from her!!

This class was amazing! I really enjoyed it and was excited for each class. It helped me feel prepared for the future and I learned about myself too. Professor Leavitt is awesome! She has given me and amazing perspective on marriage and self-development. She delivers information in a respectful and easy to process way.

Doctor Leavitt was amazing! Her lectures were very interesting. She had great videos, and readings in her lectures. This course was very helpful, and I would recommend it to anyone who wants to get married in the future.

Dr Leavitt has amazing lectures and so much knowledge! I absolutely recommend this class! It was full of interesting stuff. Even if you aren't getting married yet, this class was amazing for becoming a better person and preparing yourself for a serious relationship and marriage.

This was an awesome class! Very in depth and fun!

Amazing professor! Would 100% recommend this class for anyone. Learned so much and was inspired by Dr. Leavitt's knowledge.

Professor Leavitt explains things so well and does a great job combining secular sources and the gospel to teach about marriage. This class was very informational and is very applicable to life. The professor is super sweet. There is a lot of time spent watching videos and doing papers. They are easy, just time consuming.

This professor did a great job for a fully online class. There was a good amount of reading and video watching each week, so be ready for that. She is amazing and so is this class, it provides you with so much information that is useful for all types of relationships and her lectures are so easy to watch and understand. I love love her and I wish I could take more classes from her, she has a big heart!

I highly recommend this class to anyone! The only downside was that the tests were somewhat challenging, as they consisted mostly of free-response questions, and the TAs were strict graders. Professor Leavitt is incredible! Her lectures were so enlightening, and this has been my favorite course at BYU so far. If you have a heavy class load but want an easy and intellectually enlarging, then sign Marriage Prep with Professor Leavitt!
This class was amazing! The readings are so interesting and applicable to life. She barely had any busy work and wants you to focus more on changing your life. Definitely take a class from her!

Dr, Leavitt is an amazing teacher with great content in her courses. I enjoyed this class and would definatly recommend to other students. Dr. Leavitt cares deeply about her students and I gained so much insight from just one semester! I would definitely recommend her whether it be online or in person.
One of my favorite classes I've taken at BYU
Dr. Leavitt was amazing! I learned so much from her lectures & I loved that she always helped us apply what we learned.

I enjoyed the online marriage prep class. It was well-structured and the assignments were thought-provoking and enjoyable. The online lectures were really interesting and applicable to real life.

Dr. Leavitt's lectures were so interesting that I was excited to watch them every week! I felt like all the information was useful and relevant, and all the assignments had purpose behind them. This class was so fun and interesting! If you are looking for an easy class that is all online this would be a really good option.
This class was awesome, it was very intellectually enlarging. Everything we learned applied to life, all assignments were of value and applied clearly to what we learn in class.

I loved this course! Online courses are sometimes hard for me but I appreciated Dr. Leavitt and the TA's being so willing to help and making the lectures interesting and helpful to apply to every day life.
Great professor. Tests are fair and easy if you watch the lectures. Assignments were reasonable and you learn so much.
Dr. Leavitt was a great professor! She taught clearly and simply. Assignments were not too hard but you still learn. Really enjoyed

This class was extremely insightful and applicable. I believe difficult topics were navigated with consideration and respect. I loved this class!
Dr. Leavitt is extremely talented and I thought the class was very well organized and put together. Readings and lectures were always interesting and applicable.
I didn't expect to gain as much from this class as I did, but I learned a lot that will be valuable for my whole life! As long as you stay on top of things, the class is fairly easy!
I did not get the textbook but the online materials covered the subjects on the exam.

This class was easy as long as you did your work and turned it in on time. Watching the videos sometimes took long but as long as you put it on 2x speed it's very bearable. Super kind professor and taught me a lot I will use for the rest of my life! Would definitely recommend it for someone wanting an easy online class that is actually beneficial!
Great professor! She shared a lot of insights that helped prepare us for marriage, whether we are single, dating, engaged, or already married. The class teaches to anyone at any stage.

Dr. Leavitt is the best professor I have ever had and I would recommend any class with her. She has an incredible way of teaching. For this class in particular, it does require a lot of effort. Even though I am already married, this class was enjoyable, and almost everything still applied to me. Despite it being an online course, the professor made her lecture videos interesting and engaging. I learned a lot from her teaching style and the examples she gave us for the curriculum. I was hesitant to take this class but ended up loving it.Super inspirational and educational class! I am not engaged or dating anyone but still learned a lot about myself in this course. TAKE IT even if you aren't preparing for marriage rn.

Dr. Leavitt gives great lectures and she cares a lot about what she teaches.

Dr. Leavitt really knows the material and cares a lot about this class. Overall, she is such a great professor!

Everyone should take this class. Be diligent about studying and get things done before the due dates! Great professor! This is my 2nd class I've taken since I love her so much. Really teaches things in an applicable way and wants you to be able to better your life because of the material. Go to lectures!! They are so fascinating to listen to!

This class was so helpful and gave amazing advice on how to improve your relationships with others and how to be a better person. I feel like the lectures were very informational. Not too many assignments and each one helped in your learning. I would definitely take this class again.

Professor Leavitt is great - super caring and knowledgeable. The class has a decent workload but it's manageable if you stay on top of things. Unstuck study was a lifesaver for exam prep.

She was awesome! I had some struggles during the term and she helped me out a ton! Super forgiving and caring! We had 3 tests and some medium sized assignments on top of the small discussion posts (by video). I would just recommend staying on top of everything!

Dr Leavitt is awesome!! She is a really kind and caring professor. There are a decent amount of assignments so if you're looking for something that is just easy, probably don't do this one. It was a great class. Chelom Leavitt is an awesome professor with lots of experience and knowledge. I learned a lot about how to have a successful relationship as well as how to develop individually. She has great lectures and is willing to help students!

This course was enlightening and given in the perfect way. Dr. Leavitt has the most incredible insights and if you do the work, you will get so much in return. It is definitely a class of self-progression, so come as you are but don't expect to stay as you are!
Professor Levitt is the best! Her course was pretty straightforward and she graded fairly. The TAs were also amazing!
Dr Leavitt is the best. She genuinely cares for her students and gives great advice. I learned so much from her!

Dr. Leavitt knows her stuff and gives a great marriage preparation course. Dr. Leavitt is a wonderful researcher! There is a lot of content to read through and great resources she provides. Dr. Leavitt was soo good and I learned so much from her and this class. I loved how although it was completely online, she had an opening social and I could tell that she cared for her students still! Would recommend taking this class from Dr. Leavitt!!

Good class for anyone to take! It's a self-improvement as well as relationship-improvement class. Maybe because I took it in spring term, but I felt like there were a lot of little assignments to keep track of. Overall, it was a good class and I thought the material was good and helpful.

Dr. Leavitt is the absolute best. I loved her class and felt like I learned so much. The workload was totally manageable and I felt like all of the content was applicable. Dr. Leavitt was amazing! I loved her insights on preparing for marriage and for building the life that will help you to become the best version of yourself. Dr Leavitt is the best professor that BYU has to offer. She is a powerhouse of a person. I would take every class offered if she was the one who taught it.

Amazing lectures. She really cares about her students and makes sure your understanding of the material goes beyond just the grades but also something you can apply to better your life. Great class and I recommend to anyone even if they aren't necessarily looking to marry (great self-improvement class).

This class was an amazing religion credit at BYU, and was so easy and fun, yet I learned so much!

Dr. Leavitt is a great professor! She is open minded and caring about very sensitive topics, and she gives great advice and I really feel like she lives that advice! Dr. Leavitt is an amazing professor! I really enjoyed taking this online class, and I learned so much. This is the best course I have taken at BYU! Would highly recommend to anyone and everyone (married or not)! The professor gives personal examples and many opportunities to interact with classmates and herself. I would take the course again.

This class was amazing. She is very open and honest with her own experiences and made it a very safe environment!

I really enjoyed this class and Dr. Leavitt. I took it over the spring term and think I would have enjoyed it a lot more over a semester-length, but overall I really enjoyed it and it was very manageable online.

She is so sweet and awesome. I really liked her lectures. Usually online lectures can be hard to watch and pay attention but hers are very interesting and good!

One of my favorite classes I have ever taken and Professor Leavitt is awesome! Super applicable to real life and everyone should take this class!

Professor Leavitt is the best!! She teaches such good concepts that help you feel not only more prepared for marriage but feel better about having healthy relationships with anybody. She's awesome! Take her!

Professor Leavitt was great! She was very involved with the class and made it easy to participate. I really loved the structure of this class and how involved she was as a professor. This class was the most you can get out of an online class!

Dr Leavitt was awesome! I took this class with my fiance and we learned a lot leading up to our wedding. It's also a great class for anyone wanting to learn more about themselves and their relationships with others. I would recommend this class to anyone, single, dating, or engaged.

Super easy. Online version was very chill.

Nice lady, easy to get an A but requires a fair amount of diligence (3-6 assignments per week)
Dr Leavitt was really good.  Lots of busy work but I also took away a lot of important things from her class.

Dr Leavitt has no problem teaching, she really knows her stuff, especially the research relating to marriage concerns. Dr. Leavitt was an amazing professor and I learned so much! This class is great to fill an academic requirement but also just to learn life skills. This class has really impacted my life. She is a great professor and communicated quickly with me when I had questions or concerns.
It was great online class if your really busy the format of the class is very well organized and the ta's are super helpful if you ever need anything.

Dr. Leavitt made this a great class! Whether you are married or have a significant other or not, this class will help you improve as a person and gives great tools to handle relationships. Leavitt is inspiring and helped me so much in understanding how to date and look for a good guy to marry. My favorite thing is that it was online and super consistent in how canva was setup.

Such a great class, so informative and educational. Professor Leavitt is such a great teacher and answers questions so kindly and wants to help each student. Dr. Leavitt is amazing. Her lectures are engaging and necessary for all students who want to get married someday, are dating/engaged, or are already married. You will learn so much in this class. Also, if you do the activities she invites you to do, you will even become a better person! She is a caring and dedicated professor.

Overall, a generally easy class. Topics were mostly relevant to single individuals rather than engaged or married couples.. at least for most of the course. Exams were very straightforward but required quite a bit of writing so be prepared for that.

Overall a great and manageable class! Busy work assignments, but they aren't that difficult. The tests are mostly written response and can take a second to complete, but there are test reviews and overall they are pretty easy to get a good grade on. Class is recorded lectures and posting a response video once a week. Take the class!
She is very good at teaching and clearly cares about her students. Some of her assignments are busy work, but most are helpful!

I don't feel like there was much to gain from this class, not sure how it's a whole university course. Chelom is kind and cares about what she does/her students. Tests were memorization heavy and the content isn't anything you couldn't find on a mom blog or pop psychology article. The long "personal development" assignments felt more like busywork
Dr. Leavitt's course is very organized and easy to navigate. She teaches in a very applicable and uplifting way. Her course has helped so much with the beginnings of marriage.

Professor Leavitt was awesome! the class was online and super well organized. The homework is pretty easy and if you turn it in on time you'll be fine. The tests are a little hard and you need to make sure you actually do the module readings to do well on them.

This class is a must take for everyone! You learn a lot and the lectures are applicable to life. This semester Professor Leavitt changed the paper assignment to a project where you make a slideshow over a research question and it was much better/easier. The tests are a decent part of your grade but I found the study guide accurately prepares you.

Professor Leavitt makes this class enjoyable, easy and life changing. I took the online course and found it really easy to manage/follow. You have a weekly discussion due and then a few fun projects throughout the semester that have descriptive outlines. Most of your time spent for this class will be watching fun videos and listening to lectures.

Dr. Leavitt is incredibly kind and smart. Her lectures are engaging and informative. I have loved this class, even though it was sometimes hard as a single person. Still, I learned so much valuable information about personal growth and would recommend anyone to take this class regardless of marital status and DEFINITELY take it from Dr. Leavitt!

This was a good course, but the tests were very hard. There is a workbook you do along with lecture videos, but it seemed like the tests were all about memorizing things from the videos. It was hard to keep up with. I think the course itself is great marriage prep, but the tests kind of ruined it for me because I was always stressing about them.

Dr. Leavitt is a really good professor! She is super passionate and I believe that every student loves what she teaches. The only thing that I would say is that the class has a lot of tedious work and it takes a lot of time. Also, I felt like the TA's were rather strict on assignments. The class is a great class, but be prepared to work for it!!

Amazing professor. Obvisouly this class is on demand so interatcted with TAs mostly. This was one of the easiest classes ive taken, but still learned a lot and really helpful. Chelom is very knowledgable about this topic. I would recommend taking this class.

Dr. Leavitt is amazing! I took her online course, and it was very strait forward. She teaches clearly, and the TA's do a review before midterms that basically outline the test. You do use a textbook and read from it for each module, but it is very instructive. I would 100% recommend her class!! Shes super easy to get ahold of and so sweet.

Dr. Leavitt is one of my heroes - she is a compassionate fountain of knowledge. The actual workload of the class is super manageable - the assignments were doable, and the TAs basically cover everything on the exams in review sessions. If you just do the assignments and go to test reviews before the exam, you'll get an A.

Dr Leavitt is an amazing teacher and this is an amazing course! She teaches very clearly and powerfully through her lectures, and she provides her students with great reading material. Don't take her class if you are not willing to be humble and engage in a growth mindset :)

Dr. Leavitt is very knowledgeable in this subject, but I felt like the course overall was not super enlightening. There was a lot of busy work that I felt like didn't really add to the experience and I also felt like I didn't really learn that much from this class, overall. If I could go back and do it again, I would take SFL 376 instead.

Dr. Leavitt is awesome. She is authentic and unique and I loved her class. I took it with my husband. It was a generally easy class, but there was a lot of work. I really enjoyed her lectures, the Spirit was invited if you let it be and took it seriously. You get out of the class what you put into it.

Dr Leavitt is an amazing teacher. She has a lot of insights into life and how to better function in your relationships. The class took little time each week and the tests are fairly easy. Whether you are married or not I think you would definitely benefit and learn from this class!
She's great!!
She is sincere and so passionate about what she teaches. She is an awesome teacher and her course is organized to help you learn, not make you work.

Professor Leavitt is a very kind person who cares deeply for her students. She always has your best interest in mind and wants you to succeed. Professor Leavitt is also very very knowledgeable and a great teacher!
This class is interesting and really not that difficult. Definitely worth taking.
She cares so much about her students and strives to get to know you on an individual basis. She is super organized, I was never confused about what was expected or what assignments were coming up.

I absolutely loved this class! Super applicable to everyone regardless of their relationship status. Structure: weekly lecture videos, journaling, simple unit activities. The class is fun and activities are simple! Exams are heavy in short answers and 45% grade but you'll do fine if you review with TAs and memorize. I highly recommend this class!
Great professor! She is very knowledgable and kind and wants all of her students to succeed!

It was a really solid course, especially for an online class. You learn a lot of good things related to self-improvement and building relationships. Would highly recommend if you're engaged or just want to improve the quality of your future relationships. As long as you do all the assignments and put forth a good amount of effort, you'll do well.

The online section of this class was really awesome! I felt like there wasn't too much expected, but it still kept me busy enough. The class is very interactive and the projects aren't hard, especially if you work on them throughout the semester like is suggested. Tests were also super easy which was nice.

Regardless of however difficult this class is, you need to take it. Let this review be the one to change your mind so you add this class. Take it over any other marriage or relationship class offered. Chelom is kind, engaging, funny, laughs and cries with you, has a great classroom environment, and every lecture and reading is life changing.

This class was life changing for me. Tips: Use the rubrics, submit your assignments on time, watch and take notes for the TA reviews! If you do those things, you will probably get an A!

This class is very well organized and the lectures are applicable for people at any stage of life whether you are single, dating, or married.

This class focuses on the more emotional and relational side of sexuality which made the tests kind of difficult and hard to study for. I personally thought that the tests were overly hard and wished there were at least some extra credit. She does say that the tests are hard. Shes a really nice lady.

Dr. Leavitt is incredible and cares about her students. This class was a lot of work and tests were pretty difficult. But you learn a lot and she is willing to help you if needed! Overall, I loved this class and found it super interesting as long as you put in the work, you'll be fine.

Coursework wasn't challenging; grades hinge on three exams requiring specific memorization. Despite attending every exam review on Zoom, I found little help. The TA advised studying notes and powerpoints, leaving my questions unanswered. While the class has potential, this semester was ultimately disappointing.

While Dr.Leavitt is great, this class was disappointing. I would recommend auditing. There isn't enough material to cover a full semester & the test prep is very misleading & the final paper is graded too harshly & inconsistently for a class that is supposed to be available to people outside of the SFL major. But the content is good.

This class is INCREDIBLE! Tests are not the easiest because they are worth a big percentage of your grade, but Professor Leavitt is so understanding and really trying to help students improve! I would recommend this class to anyone and everyone.

Dr Leavitt is the most influential professor on my life of my entire four years of college. 

Her lectures address timely and difficult topics with grace and sensitivity. She expanded my thinking on the importance of emotional intimacy and the relationship between emotional intimacy and a happy life.

Chelom knows her stuff and cares about her students. She was always available to talk outside of class. She made tough ideas interesting. I needed help with the paper and she helped me find just the right research studies.
This class helped me think through how I needed to develop as an individual. IT will definitely help me be ready for future relationships and marriage.
This class really challenged my own behaviors and attitudes. Dr. Leavitt cared for my learning and development and she showed genuine concern for students in the class. LOVED THIS CLASS!!

If you want to grow and develop as a person take this class. Dr. Leavitt expects you to read and think about the material. If you don't, you probably won't get much, but is you do this class is transformative. Take this class!
Loved this class. Fun information and activities. Dr. Leavitt is a interesting researcher and know her stuff.
Great course! Great lectures. I always felt hear and learn important concepts.

The tests are short answers and weirdly specific, but the TAs are transparent about it. There is little contact with the actual professors and the tests were too specific. Take from a different professor if you actually want to get anything from the class.

Tests have very broad short answer questions and unless you quote the slides exactly expect to loose some points every time. I also was not fond of her putting up statistics from her research and then when questioned about it she acted like she did not know her OWN research. Do yourself a favor and take this class from someone else

I had really high hopes for this class but was thoroughly disappointed. She is very opinionated and if you don't necessarily agree with her opinions you better get used to lying on papers and exams because she puts those opinions in the test. TONS OF MEMORIZATION. It is more the amount of randomly specific things that are hard than the content.

Her "textbook" and lectures are basically a bunch of quotes that she finds inspirational mixed with a few scriptures or general conference talk summaries and a bunch of word vomit about what mommy bloggers have to say about marriage. Make sure you memorize all her long lists of opinions if you want to pass the exams.

This class was way more stressful than it needed to be. She was great in her lectures and I felt inspired, but the slides were rarely helpful for exams. There was almost no content and all fluff. The free response on exams were based on exact memorization and were graded harshly. I was excited for this class, but the stress made it hard to enjoy.
She is a good professor and shares a lot of good information. The lectures and concepts can be a bit repetitive. She is great about answer people's questions and keeping it appropriate.

Her lectures were truly incredible and she is great at answering everyone's questions and making sure that people understand what's going on. The tests ARE pretty challenging, but if you pay attention in lecture and take decent notes, you'll be fine.

I took this class as a joke and ended up LOVING it. Dr. Leavitt was very insightful and made the content feel relevant even for those of us who are not married or engaged. There is a lot of work, but it's fun activities and super manageable assignments.

Doctor Leavitt is clearly well known and knows what she's talking about. The tests were sometimes a little bit vague, but if you talked with her about it after the test or after class, she was always very helpful and understanding. There are a few pretty big projects that you need to keep up on as well.

Great teacher, knows her stuff, good lectures. Tests are ridiculous though. The majority of the test is free response-usually 20+ free responses questions. She says she wants feedback to make changes but often doesn't apply student's feedback. Lots of little quizzes and busy work outside of class. Good class just didn't love the structure.

This class taught me so much! I could not be more grateful that I took this course from Dr. Leavitt. The final grades were very text-heavy, but once you figure out how the exams work, it gets easier as you go. I would suggest everyone takes this class because this is the kind of knowledge you will want to take with you for the rest of your life!

dr leavitt is very nice and passionate about the subject material and I honestly really looked forward to her lectures. The class was mostly about becoming a good, happy, well-rounded person and how marriage will fall into place after that which surprised me but makes sense. The tests were straight memorization so that was annoying.

TAKE THIS CLASS. Chelom is one of the most caring and genuine people I've ever met. She teaches this material in such a beautiful way. I didn't think the tests were too hard and you can get a great grade on the essay just make sure that you are taking advantage of the TA's! Hands down the best and the most important class I've taken at BYU.

This class is amazing, and she does a fantastic job teaching it. She is SO passionate and knows her stuff. Learn about this class!! However, the tests are really hard and if you dont memorize everything from the slide youll have a hard time. The concepts themselves arent hard to understand, its just her way of testing that is hard.

Dr. Leavitt is phenomenal! Every class left me wanting to shout praises. My only regret was not having a gap between classes to let things sit after our lectures. She is so passionate about what she teaches and is willing to sit down with you to discuss anything. Readings were interesting and insightful; she definitely uses them in her lectures.

Easily the best class I have ever taken at BYU! Dr. Leavitt structures the course so that ideas build on each other in meaningful ways. Our classroom was a safe environment where we could ask questions and Dr. Leavitt provided meaningful and kind answers and direction. Dr. Leavitt is funny, kind, caring and real with her students. Take this class!

Professor Leavitt is very qualified to teach this class, a great person, and extremely caring. She truly wants the best for every student. However, the class was very disorganized in so many ways. The exams were almost impossible because of vague questions with extremely specific answers from seemingly unimportant material discussed for one second.

Very disorganized class, messy lectures, hard quizzes and tests, and a difficult paper. You basically need to memorize everything to do well...seriously. Not inspiring at all. TA's not very helpful. I was extremely disappointed. Take it with someone else.

I honestly did not enjoy Marriage Prep. The lectures were not well prepared, the content was fluffy, tests were based on memorization, there is very little communication about assignments, no involvement of TAs besides grading, and the course itself was overall very disorganized. I would not recommend taking this class.

She is proficient in her subject, grades and teaches clearly, and encourages participation. The class is organized by daily readings, fun assignments, 2 exams + final, and a book report of 6 pages. Exams are not bad: go to class, do the readings, and study. She creates a respectful and wholesome environment to learn about marriage and sexuality.

Dr. Leavitt makes this class way harder than it needs to be. The tests are mostly free response, and if they're not perfect and word-for-word what she said in lecture, your score will suffer. There is also a ridiculously long 8+ page book report. My advice, do not take this course from her.

I think this is an essential class that everyone should take at BYU. Professor Leavitt does a great job explaining concepts and answering questions. The class's grade is basically 1 paper and 3 exams. The exams are hard and there is a lot of memorization. Make sure to memorize lists and basically everything else on the slides.

Don't get me wrong, this wasn't an easy class, but it IS possible to do well. Her tests are largely based on memorization, so if you can memorize, you will succeed. She is a great lecturer and is very passionate about the topic. However, if you have already studied a lot about sex, this likely won't be an earth shattering class for you.

This was her first semester teaching marriage prep. It was obvious. The multiple choice tests were too specific. Study guides need to be refined and help you know what you actually need to know. Could become a great class in the future. I did learn a lot that is actually applicable to everyday life. It was eye opening in many ways.

I took this class because I just got married and did not picture it being very hard. I was wrong. She is a great speaker/researcher and I did learn some cool things. However, the tests are as if you are playing guess what's in her head. I studied hard and did the heaps of readings but was still getting docked points on EVERYTHING. Class avg is a B

She is a great lecturer, her classes are interesting and she is a good person... But her tests are awful and she gives horrible preparation for them. No matter how much you read, how frequently you attend class, or how hard you study, the short answer section on her tests will doom your grade. Do not take this from her if you can.

Definitely one of the more difficult SFL electives. Learned some cool stuff but i spent more time doing readings for this class than I did my accounting homework. She is a very nice teacher and cares a lot about what she teaches. The class however feels a little over taken with TAs that are very strict graders that give underwhelming test reviews.

She is a great lecturer, but her tests are about splitting hairs- so if your answer is correct but not her exact words, you don't get credit. Also, for both tests so far this semester, she has heavily stressed things (even said, "make sure you know this for the essay questions on the test!") and then those things are not even mentioned on the exam.

Dr. Leavitt's class is the most worthwhile class I have ever taken at BYU. I audited the class while my husband took it for credit and it was extremely beneficial for all aspects of life. The workload was not too overwhelming and help is accessible. If you want a blow your mind kind of class that develops you as a person, this is the class to take.

This class changed my life. Not only did my experiences in class lower my anxiety surrounding the topic of sex, but it increased my self-esteem and relationships with myself, others, and God. This class is great for both single and married students. Dr. Leavitt is passionate about her research and teaching. She cares about her students.
This was my favorite class I have ever taken at BYU. Dr. Leavitt is an incredible teacher and the material was life changing. Everyone should take this class!
SUCH a good class. Probably the most helpful and inspirational classes I've taken. The class is work and also helps you change unhealthy attitudes. I think every BYU student should take this class.

Dr. Leavitt is my favorite professor and this class literally changed my life! She is very knowledgable about the subject and believes that there are no bad questions. She handles sensitive topics well and is very willing to help out any student who reaches out to her. Plus, her TAs are awesome! Tests are challenging but rewarding. Take this class!

Dr. Leavitt is an incredible professor! She teaches from the heart, and you can tell. She's very understanding when life doesn't go right and is willing to help get your grade back up. This class changed my life, and I think everyone should take it!

Professor Leavitt is the best. Her lectures are clear, and she's very mindful of the way she teaches sensitive issues. Her teaching style is very open, and no question gets scorned. She lays out how to approach healthy relationships step by step, making it easy to learn. She's also very accommodating to students in difficult circumstances.

TAKE THIS CLASS! Probably my favorite at BYU, and one of my favorite professors. The class isn't very difficult and the grading criteria is pretty clear, and it's just such an impactful class that you'll remember for the rest of your life. Just make sure to show up to class and study consistently (there are small quizzes most days).

She is an amazing professor! She knows what she is talking about and is so willing to answer student questions. She is also accessible outside of class. However, she is a little vague about paper requirements. The tests are also very specific and the study guide is not very helpful, essentially just a list of the readings.

Dr. Leavitt has high standards and unrealistic expectations. What makes that worse is she does not give clear or sufficient information about assignments (specifically papers); even when asked for more details. Study guides are vague and tests include things that seem unimportant because they are passed over quickly to never be mentioned again.

This class was INCREDIBLE! In my opinion it should be a GE. Dr. Leavitt teaches in a very open and impressive way. The curriculum will inspire you to make changes in how you view sexuality and how you will teach your future children about it. I would 10/10 recommend this class.
She's awesome and knows her stuff. Class is fun and the lectures are greats. It is not an automatic A but I learned SO much!

She is such a kind and approachable person! Yet her tests were some of the hardest I've taken so far as a SFL major. I was also not very studious this semester. She will become a better professor as time goes by (she's a lawyer and therapist). The class content is incredible--I recommend SFL 376 to anyone who feels mature enough to learn about sex!

Dr. Leavitt cares for her students and is passionate about the material. She is a tough grader & slides aren't posted online so attendance is critical. 2 midterms, 2 papers including a final paper rather than final exam. She is very accessible outside class for questions & additional help with papers, presentations, etc. Motivational & empowering!

Dr. Leavitt is incredible! She's one of my all time favorite professors at BYU. She's very knowledgeable, especially regarding healthy sexuality. She constantly referenced relevant research. It may have been a bit of a tough class, but I think it pushed us to dive deeper into an important topic. I'd honestly take any class from her!! She's awesome!

Amazing class! Everyone should take this class if they can. Dr. Leavitt is an amazing teacher who knows what she is talking about. She treats this like a college class so you have to be prepared to study. But overall it was an amazing class and I'm glad I got to be in it!

I think this class would have been perfect for me if I had not taken it for a grade. The lectures were amazing, and the readings she provided were so helpful in real life application. As a class though, it wasn't my favorite, and the professor made it that way. Take from another professor if you can, because the material is great!!
Shes great! Lectures are great! But it's definitely not an easy A.

This was my last semester at BYU, and this class was my all-time favorite. I think this class should be required for everyone. All teachings are based on research. You learn things that have real-life application that can bless your life. 100% recommend taking this class from Dr. Leavitt, a quality professor and shows great respect for the subject.

Great class with lots of good lectures! There is one research paper, weekly pop quizzes, attendance responses, tough tests, fair amount of reading! I really like the class, but was not expecting it to be so tough. Dr. Leavitt is a tough grader overall.

Dr. Leavitt is one of my favorite professors! She is so intelligent and encourages great class discussions. She is also very willing to meet with students and is understanding. The class had a fair amount of reading, but it was always fairly interesting.

She's a nice enough person, but honestly the worst teacher I've had at BYU. She's all over the place with her teaching, she gives you these handouts at the beginning of class that you're suppose to fill in with her as she teaches, but she skips half of it. what she teaches doesn't really reflect the homework or test. Just read the online book.

This was the easiest class I have ever taken. It was like I was back in high school. Dr. Romney is an amazing professor who makes the class very interesting, and she is super funny. She is easily the most entertaining professor I have ever had. I would recommend her to anyone for any class.

Best class you will ever take!! You must do homework and study hard for the quizzes, but the way it's set up it is super easy to learn the material in her class and there are NO TESTS!! She is also hilarious and super fun! You have to attend class but you will enjoy it!

Dr. Romney is awesome & very passionate! Semester is basically focused on a group project about social prescription. Interesting but didn't learn anything else about hlth psych. Lectures I didn't really learn anything. Participation points for coming to class/in-class activities. Weekly online quizzes (open note) & weekly wrtg assignments. No exams

Dr. Romney is great! She is so excited about her work and teaching. This class was a bit disorganized. Grading criteria wasn't always clear. Sometimes I didn't understand the point of the lectures. Very group discussion and group work based. No exams. Weekly quizzes. Lots of research and writing assignments.

Dr Romney is a great professor and her course is really straight forward. She is extremely passionate about psychology and it was fun to listen to her expressing her passion for it. She has great stories and is funny and engaging. We did a book club and it was easily my favorite part of the semester. Look no further for your psych professor.

She's literally probably my favorite professor. She made stats interesting, I never thought that it could be. She makes lectures fun, engaging and applicable. She is very personable and was not afraid to talk about religion which I loved. She did such a great job keeping everyone engaged and had great TAs to help. There were no tests.

Loved Dr. Romney! She was skilled at teaching students at their level and making her course as user friendly as possible. I learned not only the material but also how it applies in real life. I was overwhelmed by the amount of work and assignments the classed seemed to be at the beginning but it was not bad at all. Would take again!

Attendance not mandatory but some things said in the lectures are included on tests. 3 exams and a final that are very easy if you review the lecture slides posted online. Prof Romney is caring, makes the class very doable and organized, and listens to student feedback, but I thought her lectures were pretty bland at times and not very engaging.

Professor Romney made lectures fun and entertaining. I looked forward to going to class because she is so passionate about what she teaches. She listens to feedback and is willing to make changes. There are TA reviews before the tests, and study guides that help prepare for the tests. The reading from the textbook was long but interesting.

I wish I could take every one of classes from Dr. Romney! She comes to class everyday engaged and excited to teach. It generally makes coming to class so fun. She is super understanding and willing to change things about the course that are not working for her students. I learned so much and will definitely take more classes from her!

Professor Romney is great! Lectures were so engaging-- I genuinely looked forward to class. Plus, it was not difficult to get an A. I definitely learned a lot, but it didn't feel like I had to put in a lot of effort to do so because she was so good at explaining the material. I never had to read from the textbook. Exams were not hard, either.

I loved my Psych 111 class from Dr. Romney. The class structure has changed since I took it, with the addition of quizzes and mandatory textbook reading, but Dr. Romney is fun and engaging and I would still recommend the class to anyone.

I took her psych 308 class and it was great. don't know if she restructured her class, but there wasn't a final, rather weekly quizzes. Went to the first 5 lectures and then just self taught my way through the rest cause all resources are online. The 5 that I went to were clear and she is very well versed in stats. The class gets hard in the end
Great professor, TBH never went to class, just watched the TA reviews and had the easiest time.

OBSESSED with Dr. Romney! I took her for PSYCH 306 and loved it. She is so caring and passionate about what she does and teaches content well! We write 2 page analyses each week on our chapter,  and a final paper, but no tests! She did a great job presenting difficult topics and creating a safe space to learn and express opinions.

LOVED HER!! Such an engaging lecturer, so funny and good at teaching content. Really respectful of questions and helped apply content to everyday life. You are graded on in-class participation, but she gives an option of submitting thoughts in writing instead if you aren't comfortable :) Would recommend if you want to learn interesting content!

One of the best professors I've had. She is clearly passionate about psychology and cares deeply about her students. You will be more than fine if you participate in class and do each of the assignments. Her tests are all mcq and you can easily pass if you study well. Really really loved her

She is so good. Super good at teaching and always looking for ways to improve. Lectures were great. The tests are straightforward and you know what to expect. I've never been the best test taker but did really well on her tests because she taught us so well. She's the best professor I've had so far at BYU.

The best professor at BYU. Super knowledgable and cares about each student. What impressed me most was she had everyone fill out a midcourse evaluation and provide feedback and then changed some aspects of her course that were more of what the students wanted. A professor who actually listens to students and tries to make the class better. 10/10

I've never wanted to avoid a class more than this one. Her demeanor and comments made many of us feel uncomfortable. The lectures felt excruciating, boring, and repetitive. She tended to get defensive when students had differing opinions. She also told us at the start of the semester that there wouldn't be a final, then later went back on that.

She was really sweet, and always listened to everyone's views. Her class is fairly easy with only a few readings each week. There were a few assignments that weren't clear, but if asked about it she would explain deeper! Just become her friend, and this class will be a blast.

Professor Cole talks to you like a child. If your opinion is different then hers, you are most likely wrong because she is convinced only hers can be right.The work is very confusing and mostly busy work. You have reading checks too that have nothing to do with the class or coursework.

This is the easiest class I've taken at BYU. Prof Romney is really nice and engaged. The content is interesting, but a lot of the learning happens with the textbook, which is no good. She's a good lecturer, book club is easy, the tests are simple, and if you just do what you're supposed to, you're guaranteed an A.

Dr. Romney is hilarious! She makes learning interesting and interactive. Reading the textbook for the quizzes is a decent part of your grade. The tests were pretty straightforward and book clubs were really fun.
I loved Dr. Romney! She's so funny and taught all the material very clearly. The test questions come from lectures, so make sure you go to class. I will hopefully be taking more classes from her.

I loved Dr. Romney! Super funny and engaging. Tests were purely on her lecture slides, so don't bother reading or purchasing a textbook-- if you want, check it out at the library. I would 100 percent take another class from her. She made psych so interesting!

Dr. Romney is a really great professor. She is super intelligent, but she's also so funny and cares about her students. Her lectures were engaging and encouraged my interest in psychology. This was a really great class and I highly recommend that you take Psych 111 from Dr. Romney.

Dr. Romney is the best! Her lectures are funny, engaging, and clear. She doesn't give exams and she and the TAs are always willing to help with homework. One of the two days a week is just a lab where you can complete homework with TA help. As long as you put in the effort to do the work, it's about as easy as a stats class could possibly be!

She would talk on x3 speed the entire lecture, gave you no time to take notes or internalize the content before going to the next point, then said good luck and left, leaving the TAs to do damage control. I think she was trying to leave class as fast as possible to go pick up her daughter. Walked away with a good grade, but hardly learned anything.

Professor Romney is the best! Super funny, super upbeat, always full of energy. Her lectures are engaging and she always makes the class enjoyable and not mind-numbingly frustrating, which is really saying something because I HATE stats. Really cares about the students and is always willing to work with us. 10/10

Dr. Romney is awesome! Her love for psychology makes class super engaging. Her lectures are enjoyable, she answers questions really well, & the lecture slides are the best study resource. Her exams are straightforward, she isn't trying to trick you. There's also a book you read with a book club. Also don't need to buy the textbook! Dr. Romney=GOAT

She is a great professor who is very passionate about her field. She is a young mom who teaches really engaging lectures and is very funny. Only really tests you on the things she teaches you, and gives you absolutely everything you need to get a hundred on each one if you wanted. Weekly quizzes can be tough, but they don't really affect your grade

I really loved Dr. Romney, she is so funny and engaging. Her tests are pretty short, but you have to know how to apply her concepts to situations. She goes off on tangents during class, but you can tell she wants her students to succeed. Her class was super interesting and insightful, and I would absolutely take it again.

I absolutely LOVED professor romney. The class is an easy A, the only reason I got a B is because I never went to the book club (I don't like group projects). She's super funny and cares so much about her students and I would 100% take another class from her!!

Dr. Romney was so nice and funny during lectures which were always super interesting. She lets you ask so many questions and is so passionate about her woek. She is super understanding about personal issues. Tests are completely based on class slides so GO. I also loved how she did an in-class review for every exam

She's a great lecturer! She will answer any question and makes the lectures applicable to real life so it's more interesting. You have to do a weekly book club but it's not bad at all. Overall I really liked this class and would definitely recommend taking it with Romney!

Dr. Romney is the best! Her class is very interesting and it's fairly easy to get an A as long as you stay on top of things. As part of the class, you get to join a book club and apply what you're learning in class. Weekly in class labs also help you apply what you're learning beyond the textbook. I loved this class!

Pretty easy class, but very interesting and you learn a lot. The assignments are pretty easy except for a 150-page textbook reading + quiz every week, which you can usually skim. Loved this class and professor, she is super loving and caring, one of my favorite teachers/professors I have ever had.

I loved Professor Romney! She is a brilliant woman who is very passionate and intellectual. She often has several exam questions about things we discussed in class, so in-class participation is necessary. Her lectures are often more discussion-based. Overall the class was relatively easy to get an A, as long as you participate and study hard!

Dr. Romney was so nice and a super engaging lecturer. She uses her knowledge of psychology not only to teach it but to help students understand material. My roommates also took psych 111 at the same time from other professors and really struggled with bad lectures and heavy workloads. Take this class from Romney she's the best!!

honestly VERY inspirational teacher, I feel like I learned so much but never felt stressed about the assignments or anything. you don't need to buy the textbook bc that content is only on quizzes, not the test, but you definately want to review what the textbook covered so you don't completely bomb all the quizzes

I feel like as a psych prof she knew exactly how to teach to help us remember and do well. She puts everything into this class, she does everything she can for her students to succeed. She even remembered my name lol. It's always an interesting and engaging day with her!

I felt that a lot of times my opinion was belittled, while others were celebrated. Mainly because I had christian values. A lot of hard topics are covered and most of the things taught did not correlate with church beliefs. The textbook used contradicts church doctrine and Prof. Romney chooses to focus on those topics. Avoid her classes entirely.

I switched into Professor Romney's class just in time and am SO glad I did! I LOVED her so much! Lectures were super interesting, I learned so much, and her excitement was contagious. The tests were over lecture material and were easy if you went to the TA reviews.

I loved PSYCH111 with Dr. Romney! This was the first psychology class I've ever taken, and it made me fall more in love with my major. Her lectures were always engaging, and she always asked for our participation. There is a lot of reading in regard to the textbook chapters and the book clubs outside of class, but they are all worth it!

I LOVE Dr Romney. This class was so much fun and interesting because of her. She is so sweet and hilarious that going to class was never a chore. There are weekly book clubs that were sort of boring, but I'm glad I read that book to see real-world application of psychology. Dr Romney is definitely one of my top 3 favorite professors.

I absolutely LOVED Dr. Romney! She had the most interesting lectures, they were honestly more of a group discussion. She always answers questions from the class and listens to everyone's different opinions. Three exams and a final, but they really weren't too difficult. Just go to the TA reviews and take good notes in class and you'll be fine.

Dr. Romney gave great, engaging lectures on psychology. Great labs to keep the class engaged on Fridays. Her tests are all multiple choice and quite short (roughly 20 questions). Missing 2 or 3 questions drops your test grade a lot and tests account for about 70% of your grade. Study vocabulary and you should be good in the class.

Dr. Romney is one of the best professors I've had. I haven't had another class experience like the one I had taking this class during spring semester. She cares for her students and because it was a smaller class than normal, so we got to know her personally. Read the textbook, get help from the TA's, take good notes in class and you'll do fine.

No tests. Easy class if you've taken AP Stats or Stats 121. Its 4 credits but felt like 1. She's legit so funny and just wants good ratings (lol she told us that) so she does whatever the students want, but she also helps you learn a ton. Very applicable stuff for MCAT or GRE. I can't express how refreshing she was for a female professor.

Took this for a GE and it was what a GE should be! Class was very straightforward but I still enjoyed the lectures. She is very entertaining which helped my 9 am class be more enjoyable. TA reviews were absolute life savers, literally covered everything you needed to know.

Dr Romney is the BEST! The class is made so so easy and everyone can pass! TAs are there to help with homework every week during lab and you just have weekly assignments that are open book. Dr Romney was always so happy and caring. She genuinely loves her students. Don't be scared of the 4 credit class! Take it from Dr Romney!!

Dr. Romney is great! She is so excited about her work and teaching. This class was a bit disorganized. Grading criteria wasn't always clear. Sometimes I didn't understand the point of the lectures. Very group discussion and group work based. No exams. Weekly quizzes. Lots of research and writing assignments.

If you're going to take Psych Stats, take it from Prof. Romney. It's just homework, review, and quizzes. Everything is open note. Lectures and lab are very helpful, but some people didn't even need to go. Prof. Romney is hilarious, caring, and makes an effort to let her students know what's going on around campus.

Prof. Romney is one of the kindest professors I have had at BYU. She is so caring and gets to know each of her students. She is passionate about what she teaches and is always willing to help. With that said, this class felt like a lot of busy work and was repetitive. Easy class. No tests, only weekly quizzes that were open note/book.

Dr. Romney is INCREDIBLE. She cares so much not just about each student but about the content that she teaches. She gives everything 100% of her energy and it brings out the best in the students. Classes are full of some of the most enlightening conversations. If you're not sure who to take 306 from, take it from her!!!

Overall a good class, I really enjoyed being in her class! I loved our book club groups she had us do because it made everyone in the class be very close friends! The tests were difficult for me but I think that was a personal problem because I had one of the lowest grades in the class.

I loved this class! It was super interesting and engaging. Although lectures are not mandatory you need to go to every class in order to do well on the midterms/final. Take good notes based on her slides and other things she talks about in class and you will do great!

You aren't graded on attendance but you don't ever want to miss this class! She is so caring and facilitates amazing discussions, you will think in a way you never have! She is respectful and creates a safe place for everyone. No final- just a semester long project, great class, even better professor!

I LOVE pro Romney. She is so fun, has great energy, and the class content is awesome. You do have to read quite a bit, but homework is super doable and she clearly explains everything. Definitely studying for exams is key to success, but you are totally prepared especially if you go to TA test reviews. 10/10 recommend this class with pro Romney.

She was super understanding and tries to answers all questions, but Dr. Romney does get off topic often. Sometimes definitions for things weren't very clear, same on the study guides. Homework assignments were not bad or time consuming.

The class is super easy but the entire class is group discussion and if you're quiet/don't share (like me), you're basically just listening to opinions from other students for half the class. If she doesn't agree, your point is ignored. You eventually just learn to suck it up because this class is an easy A if you show up and do the homework.

Dr. Romney is incredible!! She explains concepts in an easy way. There are NO TESTS, and the homework actually makes it so you learn how to really do statistics without the stress of cramming for the tests. Easily one of my favorite classes and I've learned more in this class than in any of my other classes I've had so far.

Dr. Romney IS AMAZING. I loved this class with my whole heart. There is little to none homework and her lectures are amazing!! She posts all her slides and so you can take notes on your own pace, also if you have to miss a day of class, no stress! She also is very caring towards her students and is always looking for their feedback to improve.

100/10! Take this class with Romney trust me! She is such a likeable professor and lectures were super interesting. Class was clearly structured and super easy. I only came to class three times and never read the textbook and still got an A. Just memorize and understand all the information on the Powerpoint slides and class will be cake!

The best professor at BYU. Super knowledgable and cares about each student. What impressed me most was she had everyone fill out a midcourse evaluation and provide feedback and then changed some aspects of her course that were more of what the students wanted. A professor who actually listens to students and tries to make the class better. 10/10

This class was super easy. The TA exam reviews were so good, I did nothing else to study besides attend those. I thought that class was a bit boring at times, what with students discussing things for long periods of time, but I'd rather have a boring class than a super difficult one.

Professor Romney definitely knows her stuff, and the curriculum and content were well organized. The class was mostly discussion based, and often got wildly off-topic, students overshared, etc. If I was a freshman I would've loved this class, but now I just used the slides and skipped. Maybe it got better after the first 4 or so weeks?
I LOVED DOCTOR ROMNEY! Her lectures were always amazing, and you can tell she knows her stuff! She clearly cares about her students. Exams have very clear study guides.

Romney is one of my favorite professors I have had. Her lectures were fun and involved lots of participation. Everything we learned, she made intriguing. She's super approachable and the TAs very accessible. Exam reviews are fairly thorough, and should do a good enough job to prepare you well. Organized, simple, easy. But still learned so much.

Professor Romney is one of my favorite teachers. She puts a lot of effort into building relationships with her students and makes sure her students are given all resources they need. You're only really graded on online discussion participation, exams, and papers (easily graded). As long as you stay engaged you'll do well.

Professor Romney is the BEST! Psych 111 was my favorite class of the semester because she made it so interesting. She knows a ton about what she teaches, and can answer specific questions (and is not afraid to say if she does not know the answer!). She is so caring, accommodating, and really funny. 12/10 would recommend taking a class from her!
Great setup for class and seriously inspirational lectures. The tests are straightforward and she is very clear about what she wants you to know and how you can succeed in the class.

She's okay. I felt like I didn't learn very much, but that may have been because the course was half online. Dr. Romney does get distracted and off topic fairly easily.  Tests were easy. Required seven small papers over the semester. If you put in a little effort, easy A.

Professor Romney was one of the best professors I've had. Her lectures were always engaging and she made adjustments based off of feedback from the students. If you have to take psychology, take it from Dr Romney, it was my favorite class!
Dr. Romney was such an engaging professor. She improved the course throughout the semester based on student feedback and was very knowledgeable and has done really interesting research.

This class was the best! It was pass/fail but that's because it's 1 credit. Dr. Romney helped me feel more prepared for grad school. She made sure to always answer questions and I liked that the assignments were set up so that you really only needed to complete assignments that were relevant to you. Great class if you are planning on grad school.

Cheri is kind and a decent professor. She's easy to get a hold of and is flexible with extensions. However, she's a very tangential in lectures and I never got a lot out of her class. If you just want to be held accountable for writing consistently, this class is great. But if you're looking for writing guidance, Cheri isn't the professor for you.

Such a chill class. I'd even go to say easiest GE on campus. Cheri is the GOAT. She is kind, very personable, and cares for her students. Class is pretty much discussion based which is awesome. You  read the books, and the articles, talk it out and get your A.

Doing Inscape is a great way to get ENGL+ credit! I got great experience, and there was very little homework outside of class. The class was made up of a really short lecture or discussion with Cheri, then a writing workshop with a small group, then the rest of the time was spent working on Inscape with the rest of the staff. Super fun!

Cheri, as she prefers to go by, is a great professor. Grades are mostly based on in-class group discussions on textbooks, with the rest made up of open-book quizzes and a 500-word final essay. There's a lot of reading, but lectures and discussions are engaging. She's easy to work with outside class and genuinely cares about her students' success.

Prof Earl is my favorite english teacher I've ever had. Her class is graded almost entirely on participation, so attendance is required but you can miss 2 times with no questions ask. She is funny and helpful in explaining difficult topics, I wish I could have taken all of my english classes from her. There are no exams either.
I loved this professor and how she structured this class. I genuinely feel like I learned and grew as a person from the course content. She's also hilarious and relatable. Totally recommend.

Cheri is a WONDERFUL professor. I took the class for the GE and really enjoyed it. Lots of reading, but it is genuinely all good. Grade is almost all from your discussion cards, there are a few easy quizzes and the final is a very short paper. Mandatory attendance. Take this class if you can it's super lit!

I loved Professor Earl! Her class is one of the best classes that I've taken at BYU so far. I loved going to class and talking about what we read about. We did a note card for every class period and then had quizzes for each unit which are easy if you are engaged in class and do the readings. I would highly recommend this class!!

I absolutely recommend taking class from Cheri. She is the reason I decided to become an English major. Classes were so engaging and I was genuinely sad to leave. Class felt like a glorified book club, and was low stress. there are quizzes, but if you do the reading you will be fine. The final is a short paper on the book you read.

This class is pretty simple and prof Earl is great. She's funny and a nice lady. You can expect a few group writing projects and a group video as well as a 10-12 page lit review. Instructions can be hard to find and understand at times but shes always willing to help out. The work load was usually pretty bearable. Overall, pretty good class.

The entire class is basically group project after group project. Instructions for the projects are never very clear and they way the class is set up basically forces you into a few hours a week of group work. It was frustrating to navigate the class with group members. Overall not difficult but a lot of annoying hoops to jump through.

There is definitely a lot to read, but it's an English class so it makes sense. I really enjoyed the way class was "taught." It's mostly class discussion with other students (graded) and you learn a lot from other's points of view and opinions. She's super sweet and funny. No midterms and just a final paper. Your reading notes are graded too.

You need to write about a topic from mentored research or something professors in your field are studying. Not just a topic you're interested in. Your paper needs to be "useful". Course material is complexly organized (ex. the schedule was in the contents tab of LS). She is very sarcastic.

Her assignment criteria is pretty confusing and difficult to find, and the assignments are long and tough to complete on time. However, the good news is that Cheri is a very generous grader. If you do your work she will almost always give you full credit. Pretty much everyone in the class gets an A.

Dr. Earl was by far my favorite professor I've had at BYU. She's funny, relatable, and really cares about her students. She understands when things come up and isn't one of those professors who gets on a power trip. She gives great feedback on writing and really wants to help her students be the best they can be.

Cheri was awesome. I really liked her as a person, but since I strongly dislike writing, I didn't enjoy going to class much. Cheri is a good choice if you're just trying to get the credit because it's easy to get an A, but I didn't like the papers we wrote and I didn't feel like I improved as a writer. Final group paper and presentation was fun!
Favorite professor I have ever had! Cheri genuinely cares for her students. If you get the chance you HAVE to take a class from her.

Cheri made ENG316 a very enjoyable experience. She gives phenomenal feedback. For our major project, the literature review, she broke down due date for each section, thereby making the courseload doable. Lenient grading--participation. If you turn in assignments late or miss class, your grade lowers. Attend class and do your work, and you are set.

Made a required class I was dreading tons of fun. Cheri gives all students plenty of time to finish assignments as well as multiple chances to edit papers before getting graded. Hard not to get a good grade unless you don't show up for class and submit assignments on time (but she often pushed the deadlines back so you had plenty of time)

Writing 150 with Cheri Earl was amazing! I loved this class. The workload is very reasonable and definitely interesting. The class was challenging at times, but was certainly nothing unmanageable. Cheri puts a lot of effort into giving helpful and personal feedback! She is very willing to work with students based on their personal needs.

Ive never liked wtg classes, but loved wtg 150 with Cheri. Its a tough class, but she doesn't assign pointless assignments. She puts an outstanding effort into giving you personal feedback on each assignment and changes each class according to students needs. Grading is fair and largely based on effort (only 2 grades in section lower than an A-).

Cheri was the best WRTG 150 teacher ever! All of my friends who took this course by other teachers really struggled and felt as if they didnt learn anything but she will slow down the course and the assignments to make sure you can write a good essay. She was so helpful every time I would talk to her she would give great advice. Super helpful!

Cheri Earl is an amazing professor! She takes in to account the needs of the class as a whole a adjusts her curriculum accordingly. She prioritizes understanding and growth rather than quantity and deadlines. She will challenge you, but will simultaneously provide great feedback, helping you become a better writer. 10/10 would take again.

I had Cheri for WTRG 150, you learn some good lessons, but she was just too scattered and unfocused for me. We would turn in our paper and she would think about something else she would want done on it, have us redraft, and repeat. We did at least 7 drafts on one paper, so if you like that, she is the teacher for you.

I love Sister Earl. I added her Literature of the LDS class last-minute during the add/drop deadline because I needed to fill a GE and a different class didn't work out. It was the best last-minute add I've ever had. Small class size, fun teacher, interesting material, what more do you want out of a GE? Her personality is wonderful. Take her class!

Seriously DO NOT TAKE WRTG 150 from Cheri. She claims that everything is an argument and that you can take whatever perspective you want on an essay, but it's clear that she has a desired point of view for you to take, and if you don't take it she simply will not accept your paper, or your point of view on an issue. Good person, Bad teacher
Sister Earl is funny and really connects with students. I only had a one week class with her, but I totally plan to visit her and take more of her classes. She knows how to help students do well.

Sister Earl is fabulous. I don't usually use that word, but it fits here. She is a real teacher--challenging at times but totally worth the life-changing insight and deep empathy for humanity that can be gained through experiencing her classes.
I want to grow up to be Sister Earl. Read and participate and you will do great! A few quizzes and some short papers.

Sister Earl is incredible! She leads the Insight Magazine class really well and makes it a positive experience for everyone! The magazine is really very student directed, and Sister Earl is the perfect mentor--stepping in to help guide us students when needed. This class is incredible and so rewarding. Take it!

Awesome class and awesome teacher. Sister Earl is very helpful, funny, and keeps the class engaged. You do read a lot for this class and write several short essays (Historical Context responses), but I thought I learned a lot from the reading and essays. Just keep up with the reading and you'll be good.

Fantastic teacher, excellent class. I would take her every semester if I could. She is helpful and offers lots of interesting discussions in her class. Really makes you think. Reading and papers, and some quizzes.
Sister Earl is fabulous. She loves what she does and she does it extremely well! Take a class from her - you will love it.
Prof. Earl is simply awesome.  Her class was one of my most enjoyable.  She's very friendly and willing to help - and she's hilarious.  Any class taught by her is sure to be the best.
Sis. Earl is fantastic! She really made the class enjoyable, and I feel like I grew as a person because of the essays I wrote for the class.

She's a great teacher, very fun, approachable, and intelligent. Her freshman seminar class had a light-hearted  atmosphere but we discussed some deep topics. Be prepared--it's more work than you'd expect for a 2 credit class. But the work is enjoyable. Good class.

Excellent class from an excellent professor.  She focuses on learning not busywork.  I learned a lot about myself from this class (something I was not expecting).  I would take another class from her anytime.  She cares about her students, and was extremely helpful.

FAN-TAS-TIC!  I am sad that class is ending--I wish I could take it continuously for my entire college career!  Sis. Earl is a fun teacher and she really helps you to get inside your own brain to find your voice and realize what it is you want to say.  TAKE THIS CLASS.
Great teacher. Really gets you involved in what you're doing.
I agree with the others, that she is helpful out of class, gets along very well with students. Class was once held outside in 2003 and my roommate used to home teach her. We both got A's...

She is a really fun teacher, and has a funny "that's life" attitude.  I took a class where she team taught with Elizabeth Crowe, and I enjoyed it.  She definitely knows what she is doing.  Don't procrastinate on essays.  The class is a little time consuming.

You won't regret taking this class, Sister Earl is great! She's funny, spunky, and fun, with a hint of sarcasm here and there. This is a light and fun class. Not a heavy workload. Just quizes and response papers.

Very helpful, very funny, and very knowledgeable about writing. This class was confusing the first week, but I'm glad I stuck with it. Cheri really helped me improve my writing. She has a fun personality.

She is wonderful, she pushes you to work, but the job is up to you.  She sets deadlines, is there to help and the peer review helps a lot.  If you are writing your thesis- TAKE THIS CLASS!!! You will be glad you did guaranteed
She runs a very happy, fun classroom. The workload was light, and we explored literary concepts I'd never known anything about before. One of the kindest people I've ever met.

Sister Earl does a great job teaching this class. she is very willing to help students with their papers and gives good revisions. she wants you to succeed and become a better writer.  the writing workshops that she does are extremely helpful. the class isn't really easy but what you get out of it is worth the work. she's funny too.

Everyone is saying how HARD her class was, but I took her course when she taught with Julie Swallow back in the day.  It was the FUNNEST class ever and I laughed so hard during it.  It was just like going to watch 'Regis & Kelly' twice a week.  LOVED IT! She is the coolest. I highly recommend her course--I got an A!

Sister Earl's class was awesome.  She was very demanding and expected a lot but she helped you achieve what she wanted if you took the time to try.  Overall the discussions were very interesting and i would take a class by her anytime.

She is an excellent professor but you will have to work hard in her class. There are two papers that must be heavily researched. The entire class is writing papers. Even the final is a paper. I would strongly recommend this class.

very hard...she is very critical with what she wants in a paper and what she does not want.  very funny, great sense of humor.  keep up with your writing assignments or you will be screwed.  she is hilarious
I loved this class and felt I learned to write better because of her teaching.  She is always willing to help students with their papers outside of class and it was fun!
