It is a very easy class and if you show up and pay attention (which isn't hard because he makes his lectures really engaging) you will get an A. He blew my mind with new insights about the Book of Mormon every class period, it was amazing!

He is an amazing lecturer. He's very passionate about the gospel. However, the tests were all based on what memorizing what happened in which chapters. If you're good a memorization, then you'll do fine. By the end of this class, I felt like I was being graded on my testimony, which is the opposite of what a religion class should be.

Obviously he's a great lecturer, awesome guy, passionate about the gospel and cares about his students. The tests are really tough though and pretty much history-based, so if history is not your thing you'll struggle. He and his TA were rough graders. Kinda inappropriate to assign a "testimony paper" as the final project AND grade so harshly on it

Professor Smith is knowledgeable, inspiring, and funny. The structure of the class is great, I think all religion classes should be like this. Moderately sized scripture readings, biweekly scripture journals, grade your own attendance, one big paper/project. Prepares you super well for exams, they aren't difficult if you pay attention in class.

He shows you a test review page at the beginning of each class and will saying things like "so on the test i might as you ___". Write what he says then!!! Don't worry about memorizing the entire page, just memorize what he says while he's showing it. I recorded the 5 minutes of each class that he said and it gave me a ton of the test answers.

I don't think I can really add anything onto what everyone else has said. He's an amazing lecturer and he cares about his students! Some may find the content he has you memorize for the tests a little tedious, but he has a purpose behind all of it. You will come away understanding the context of the scriptures so much better.

You already know Hank Smith. He is incredible. If you miss a lecture you are the one missing out not him. He gave out most of the exam answers in class. He has a great TA. Overall, my favorite BYU class ever.

Hank is the best religion teacher I've ever had. He gives you review slides each class that tell you exactly what will and won't be on the tests so you don't have to stress about taking notes. The TA is also very accessible and gives a review before each test. If you want to smile and laugh while learning about the gospel then take his class!
Love brother Smith! Lectures are great, learned a lot that was really interesting, tests were reasonable, and he's hilarious! Have him tell you his cactus story on the last day of class.

If you can, TAKE THIS CLASS FROM BROTHER SMITH. He is an incredible professor, his lectures are hilarious but also so meaningful. He gives a review slide with all the information from the previous class so you don't have to take notes, and the class is so well organized. If you go to the review sessions you'll ace the tests. 11/10 recommend.

Hank Smith is an inspirational professor that can make the gospel relatable. But I will honestly say this class did not strengthen my testimony of my Savior Jesus Christ at all. I felt like all I was doing was memorizing dates, quotes, and scriptures. It was harder and more memorize heavy than my history class I took in the same semester.

THE BEST TEACHER! Brother Smith is an awesome guy who teaches such cool things about the gospel. He is so funny, kind, and friendly. He goes over everything that will be on the tests in class, and the TA review sessions before the tests are crucial. Most people in my class got an A on his tests. Take his class!

Professor Smith is an INCREDIBLE teacher. He is extremely knowledgeable, and provides a lot of historical/cultural context for gospel topics. He will help you think of the gospel in new ways. He's always willing to help outside of class and cares a lot about students. He'll give you test answers/good reviews as well!
This class was freaking awesome. I absolutely loved it and it really helped me build my testimony. He's so funny and cares deeply about the gospel and his students. Can't recommend this class enough.

Brother Smith's lectures are funny and engaging. Make sure to attend class - he gives a lot of help with tests in class. He is arguably one of the best religion teachers on campus. I learned so much and was pretty mind-blown in every lecture. Reading assignments are not too time-consuming. You only have one big paper that is easy. 10/10 recommend

I LOVE Brother Smith so much. He makes class fun and interesting (but if you don't want a religion class where your professor cracks jokes this class is not for you) and he explains the history and principles behind certain scriptures and teachings. If I could take all my religion classes from him I would.

This class was deceivingly difficult, but you will learn so much! Brother Smith is probably the best teacher/professor I've ever had and I really loved this class. Just be ready to work. Make sure and attend all the lectures because that's where he gives a lot of tips for the final/midterm:)

Brother Smith is spiritually edifying and straight up super funny. You learn a lot in this class. It's also really really easy even if you put in just a tiny bit of effort. No one should be getting lower than like a B+ in this class if I'm being honest. The tests are very forgiving. One large paper but it's fun! Only good things to say about Hank.

I absolutely loved Hank Smith's class! He really helped me understand the scriptures better! His class was a joy to attend every week. His tests can be hard; however, he gives you plenty of options to do well on the test. He will literally give you test questions if you come to class. Additionally, the TA will tell you what to study

Brother Smith is such an amazing person and I absolutely loved his lectures. However, we did have to do a lot of readings and a journal entry of 300 words every class. Additionally, the tests took a lot of studying if you wanted to do well on them. But he does give you several answers ahead of time, and review slides at the beginning of each class.
Professor Smith is great! His lessons are informational and he leaves the spiritual part to your personal study. He's a knowledgable professor and very funny. I would recommend him to anyone.

This class is called Christ and the Everlasting Gospel. Yet the class is not Christ centered at all. Honestly sad. Would not take from Professor Smith unless you want to spend a ton of time on busy work and memorizing weird facts instead of focusing on Him and His life.
Don't need to say much about Hank Smith; he's just awesome. You'll probably love his class no matter what. He's super funny and wants you to succeed.
So funny. Comedy show. Very engaging. Gives exam answers if you come to class. Average exam score was 95%. Guaranteed A if you show up and do two weekly journal entries. Take from Hank.

Smith is a great teacher, but his tests are incredibly hard. You have to memorize so many dates and quotes that I feel are irrelevant to the course. I'd rather get tested on details of parables or the doctrine than the date a certain battle happened. In addition to the multiple-choice final, a 10-page essay was assigned. Prepare for lots of work!!

Brother Smith is a great lecturer and a great religious scholar. This will not be a emontional experiance for most, at least it wasn't for me. But, the study of The Book of Mormon elevated my spirituality through intelectual channels. His tests were really easy. You have to study for them, but if you go the the reveiw and study its a cake walk

Brother Smith completely changed my perspective on the Gospel. I've taken a few of his classes now and every time I hear Brother Smith's perspectives, I feel like I know the Lord better. Bro Smith is hilarious and approachable and he makes Christ feel that way too. His exams can be tricky but I'm so glad that we learned about the Gospel rigorously!

Hank Smith is such an amazing professor! He is so knowledgeable and shares the best insight! You can tell that he truly cares about his students and genuinely wants them to succeed. His lectures are very entertaining and he teaches the gospel in ways that his students understand. If I could I would have him teach all the classes that I take at BYU!

Hands down best professor at BYU. My favorite religion class. I learned so much about the Bible and about Jesus. Every single lecture was inspiring. If you think his tests were hard, you either didn't attend or you haven't taken many religion classes at BYU yet. He flat out tells you the questions and the answers on the exams.

SUPER HARD TESTS! Had to memorize soooo many dates and tiny quotes. The test questions are very detail oriented and hard. His lectures are really funny and he doesn't take anything very seriously. The readings take TONS of time. Felt hard to get an A- in a religion class....

Prof Smith's lectures are 10/10. The guy is hilarious, and he knows so much about the gospel. I learned so much in this class and gained a greater appreciation of the Bible from it. I didn't think the exams were hard but I can understand why some people did. There was a ten page paper, but it was really framed as more of a journal than anything.

I loved this class! Brother Smith is so funny and you can tell he absolutely loves and cares about his students. He constantly asked us how we were and what was going on in our lives. He had some really great insights about the New Testament and Christ, and my testimony really grew in this class. Take from Brother Smith! :)

I loved this class! Attendance is mandatory for most of the semester, but Brother Smith does a fantastic job. He has opened my understanding of The New Testament and changed the way I think about things I have been taught my whole life. The class really is not that difficult and if you do the homework, you'll be fine!

This class is awesome!! Brother Smith is great at connecting with his students and making his lectures interesting! Super easy class as well, as he literally gives you everything you need to know for the tests. I never scored under a 90 on any tests and studied for maybe a few hours each time. He is a little full of himself, but a good guy!

I don't know why there are so many negative reviews on here, Hank Smith is the best! He teaches in a way that makes it easy to understand and where you want to learn. I understand the Book of Mormon so much more now! I will say, his tests are a little difficult, but as long as you study and read the assigned readings, you'll do fine.

Amazing at explaining the BoM!! Have never understood it before like I do now! I learned SO much. Gives you all you need to know for the tests, and TA reviews. Tests actually arent the worst and are a good reflection of your understanding of the BoM and what weve been learning.

I loved having Professor Smith as a religion teacher! He is so funny and sincere. If you want to have a great time in class and not stress about tests because his slides give you all the answers then take this class you will not regret it!

I really loved learning from Professor Smith. Great teacher, really funny, and keeps you engaged. There are three tests and 1 paper but there are TA reviews before each test that help a lot and the paper is pretty simple. Overall really good experience and I felt the spirit in class a lot!

I've taken several religion classes before, but this is the first one I've actually thoroughly enjoyed. The lectures were informative but also so inspiring! There was a lot of reading, but, for the first time, they were actually applicable to what we discussed in class. The tests really aren't hard, unless you're a freshman or you've never studied.

His class was perfect because he is so real and so funny, but you learn SO much. He changed how I read the BoM. Not sure why people hate his tests because I just went to his TA review session and memorized his review slides and didn't struggle at all. If you like to laugh and have entertaining lectures, he is the perfect teacher. I loved his class!
The lectures were always entertaining and Brother Smith is very knowledgeable. The readings were a lot but manageable and the tests were pretty hard for a two-credit religion class.

Hank is awesome!! Very entertaining lectures!!! People don't talk enough about really how hard the tests can be. I  have received the lowest test score in college from his tests. His finals are very tricky as well.

Brother Smith's lectures are always engaging and entertaining and make the scriptures feel very real. He's got a lot of knowledge of the historical context and original languages of the scriptures, so if you want to you'll become both faithful and competent. He acknowledges that his tests are hard but he gives you plenty of resources to succeed.

Brother Smith is an awesome religion professor. His humor really helped me to learn about the nature of Christ, the historical context of Christ's times, and his class really bolstered my testimony. There were a few times that his humor went too far for my liking, but overall I enjoyed his class. Manageable workload and easy final paper.

I love Hank Smith, he is a really great guy, super caring, and he does a good job making the lectures interesting. However, the tests are super difficult and extremely specific. If I didn't go to the test reviews with his TA definitely wouldn't have done as well.

Excellent lectures, take this class if you have a good memory and have good attendance goals. His tests are consistently hard, but rarely have material that isn't on the lecture slides. 
Very energetic and enthusiastic, all in all a good professor!

I wanted to love Bro Smith but this class was a letdown. Tests were way too difficult and 80% of class time was spent answering random questions rather than lecturing. When he was actually teaching the class was great. For a 2 credit class though, the amount of time and energy spent on it wasn't worth it.

Great lectures that are inspiring, insightful, engaging, and humorous and times. But his tests are ridiculous. Imagine the most specific, pump-and-dump memorization questions you could think of in a BYU religion class 10 page paper due at the end of the semester, one TA to grade 300 papers so the chance of a grade reflective on quality is low

I LOVED this class!!! It's not too hard as long as you go to class (and TA reviews) and do the readings!! Brother Smith tells you everything you need for the midterm/final and is so fun and engaging!!
Lots of reading but it all was needed! Lectures were incredible and I came way closer to Christ!

Great professor, reputation precedes him. Great, dynamic lectures that were posted twice a week. Term paper that is really easy. Typical self-reporting quizzes for reading/attendance like most religion classes. Really fun class and would definitely take him again for any other religion class I could.

Hank Smith is an incredible person and professor and I learned a lot from him. However, his tests are WAY too hard. They are so detail-based and tricky. His tests are pure memorization. I agree with another student's review that said if you can listen to his podcasts for free, do that instead of taking a class from him that could hurt your GPA.

Hank is legendary for good reason. His lectures are spiritual, hilarious, and factual. I feel like I actually KNOW the Book of Mormon. Exams are not easy; you do have to study, but I felt like that was good. My only issue is that Hank is relaxed and easily distracted (lol), so he would go off on extended tangents forever. Drove me nuts sometimes.

I loved taking Book of Mormon from Brother Smith. You can tell he cares about his students and wants them to succeed. At the beginning of each class he shows a slide with things that you'll need to know for the exams, so make sure you show up to every class to see that. His lectures are hilarious, and I went to each class looking forward them.

Bro Smith is hilarious and truly amazing! Readings and journal entry before each class (you grade yourself on these each week), three exams, and a 10-page paper. Review slides with info to know for the test given at the beginning of each class, but you must attend to get those. Tests are a little hard, but I still did fine. Take this class!!

Brother Smith was absolutely amazing to learn from. The workload wasn't too bad for this class either. We had readings and journals (300 words) to complete before each class. At the beginning of each class, he gave us a slide with information that we could expect to see on exams. There were a total of three exams and one 7 page final paper.

Brother Smith helped me a lot this semester, I looked forward to his lectures every Tuesday and Thrusday. The class isn't super well organized but the expectations and clear and you will grow in knowledge of the Book of Mormon for sure. Easy A if you show up to class, read the chapters and pay attention.

He is a great man, but I was drawn in by his fame to take the class haha. He is hilarious and makes class captivating. His tests though are extremely intense. And class isn't very spiritual because it is more content of the Book of Mormon based instead of what it can teach us type vibe. I think for some people he would be perfect, but not for me.

This class was an absolute joy; I would not have changed a single thing about it. Professor Smith was hilarious while still inviting the Spirit, and homework was not bad at all. Obviously, it's a Book of Mormon class, so you have to read the book, but beyond that, we had weekly journals and attendance records, and that's it. Would 100% recommend.

HIs lectures are some of the best you can find at BYU. I don't really get how people complain about his tests being hard when he literally gives you all the information that he will use on the tests. Class average is usually like 88%, they really are not that bad. Worth it to have to study a little bit for his amazing and funny lectures.

Brother Smith is the best Book of Mormon professor. His lectures were always funny, engaging, and spiritual at the same time. He makes things simple. Read the chapters, show up to class, and you can get an easy A. If you are taking Book of Mormon, 100% take it from him.

I loved going to lectures and this was my favorite class this semester. The tests were a little more difficult than I anticipated, but the review guides tell you exactly what is going to be on the exams.

Hank Smith is an amazing professor. If you want to understand the Book of Mormon a little deeper, then you will love his class. If you want a good laugh, you will also love his class. All that said, his tests are kind of hard. They are very specific, but if you study the review slides you will be fine.

Excellent teacher. A lot of reading, but his lectures are worth it. My only con is he tends to shut down people whose opinions on non-essential matters (like was Jesus married?) don't match his own. Doesn't happen often, but it happened to me. Tests are pretty tough, so if you're looking for an easy A, this isn't it. But it is an easy B/B+.

I highly recommend taking a class from Hank Smith!! His lectures are so interesting and entertaining and I learned so much about the gospel! Some people say his tests are hard, but If you study for the tests, you'll get an A. Just make a quizlet from the reviews and you'll be fine!

Hank is an amazing teacher and the only real class I was excited to go to just to hear his lectures. HW is easy and you have the whole schedule right from day 1. The large paper towards the end of the semester is the only thing that makes the class remotely challenging.
Hank Smith is AMAZING, but his paper was harder than it needed to be. Also the tests are TOUGH. MAKE SURE you go to TA reviews. The only way I passed was because of those reviews.

Hank is so loving, funny, and genuine. This class has strengthened my relationship with Christ and increased the presence of the spirit in my life SO MUCH. Lots of reading, but it's worth it. I know the four gospels way better than I did before. If you listen in class and study straight from the review slides, you'll do well on the tests!
He's awesome!

I have loved all my religion professors but I have learned the most from Brother Smith. I had him for Book of Mormon and Christ and the Everlasting Gospel and it changed my life. HIGHLY recommend taking at least one class from him. He tells you what will be on the test but you still have to put in the work to study. He truly wants you to learn.

Incredible teacher and a great class! You won't want to miss the lectures because they are amazing and he clearly tells you everything you need to know for the tests. It was a super interesting study topic. I am 100% trying to take a class with Brother Smith again.

Hank Smith is one of the best people ever. He is so loving and thoughtful, and still portrays that over video. He is amazing at teaching gospel concepts and making you think about things. He is the best teacher I've had at BYU. Thank you Brother Smith!

Great lecturer. You'll learn useful info and your testimony of the Savior will grow. However, it's a bit more work than your average religion class. Required 8-10 page paper, and he tests on very specific random facts. If you want a spiritual experience and are willing to do the work, take his class. If you want a chill, easier class, keep looking.

I love Hank so much!!! His lectures were so worthwhile. HOWEVER, his tests are the hardest religion tests I've ever taken. Closed not closed book, and so many things to memorize! I love Hank, but seeing that I can listen to his podcasts and not get tested on it, probably wouldn't take him again.

Bro. Smith is such a wonderful teacher! His lectures always brought the spirit in such a wonderful way. Passing the class was not hard b/c the week's work consisted of a few readings and 2 journal entries. He was so dedicated to his students and has such a strong testimony. Really made me feel prepared to go on a mission. Don't take anyone else!!

His tests are crazy specific and his lectures weren't my style. You pretty much have to memorize the 4 gospels to do well on his test. someone once told me to never take celebrity professors because they get a big head about their classes, and I find that true with Prof. Smith.

I learned more about Christ's life and the New Testament than I ever could have imagined in Dr. Smith's class. He was really a gem. Although the class was all online and the lectures were pre-recorded, you can really tell that he loves and cares for his students.

Brother Smith has been the best professor ever! He has had amazing lectures that have made me rethink the way I think about Christ and the atonement. This class has been the single most impactful thing on my faith and I will always be grateful for that. Taking classes from him has been a great experience and I would definitely do it again. 10/10.

I loved the class, may be my favorite I've taken at BYU. There was a good amount of reading. You know what to study for the exams. I felt like I knew the 4 gospels really well for the first time ever. I felt like I knew my Savior more personally. I don't know if I have ever looked forward to and missed a class more.

Brother Smith is one of the best religion professors I have ever had . I took this class online and regardless of his family issues during the semester, he made the class hopeful and enjoyable. His lectures are super interesting and engaging and there isn't too much work for the class. He gives you sample test questions in every lecture but study!

Prof. Smith's insights are really special and relevant. I always enjoyed his lectures and often laughed while watching them. The assignments are pretty standard. The exams are specific, but he provides really detailed review slides that the TA also goes over.

Brother Smith is the absolute best! He's so funny and makes the scriptures incredibly relatable. The class was easy enough, no quizzes or anything just a few journal entries each week and one big paper at the end of the year. The tests are difficult so make sure to look at the TA's review slides since it has all the info you will need to know

Brother Smith is a great lecturer; he gives the best insights and does not stray away from hard topics. He really humanizes your scripture heroes. The class itself was pretty easy, especially online. Most of your points come from self-evaluations. The tests are pretty difficult so be prepared to study (know the people and where they are found).

Brother Smith is the best! He is very understanding and wants you to succeed. He offered a big extra credit assignment to raise our scores. For the exams, go to the TA reviews and study the notes Brother Smith tells you to write in class. The class did have a lot of readings, but its worth it for his lectures.

Brother Smith is the best! He absolutely loves the gospel and loves his students! He has the best sense of humor and knows how to balance it with spirituality. You'll learn a lot from him and do well if you pay attention to the lectures and do the readings.

Brother Smith is so good! He is super understanding and very clear about what assignments will be. My testimony was definitely strengthened and I would take this class every semester if I could! The review slides give you everything you could need for tests and homework each week is super simple.

All the awesome reviews about Br. Smith are true. He is very funny and thoughtful. I rated this a 3.0 on difficulty because the homework is very simple, but tests are a little tricky, just make sure you study the review slides! While Br. Smiths class may be a little bit more difficult than other BOM classes, it is an AMAZING experience! 10/10!!

BROTHER SMITH IS AMAZING!!!!!!!! The TA, Danica, was amazing too!!! I loved his class so much! If you see any negative reviews, you can ignore them!!! His life was crazy this semester, and his family had to take priority, but he always made sure our grades were fair! I do think assignments could've been shown on learning suite more ahead of time.

This class is really great, but don't take it as an "easy religion class". The tests are pretty hard, (especially the final). Seriously, you will need to study a ton. It almost feels like a three credit class. But other than that, it is amazing. The lectures are amazing and the grading criteria is clear. Just don't fall behind.

Professor Smith is an excellent teacher. He relates very well to his students. There is always a bit of reading to do prior to each lecture accompanied with a journal entry and a short participation quiz. Outside of that we wrote like easy paper and took 2 midterms and a final. Easy class and not a big work load for 2 credits.

Brother Smith is such a genuine teacher. You can tell that he truly cares about his students and the gospel. The only downside to this class is that you cannot use your Book of Mormon on tests. I didn't think that was too big of a deal as long as you attend the TA test review. Brother Smith is one of the best teachers at BYU!
Tests contain random specifics, but the review slides and TA reviews are very helpful.

Brother Smith's care and intention foster my ideal learning environment. He balances original scholarship with simple truths, and he's entertaining while he does it. His tests and assignments are reasonable--with a Quizlet of his review slides, you can get both an A and a stronger testimony.

He is a fantastic teacher. Although his class does require more work then a 2 credit religion class should, he has fantastic lectures and will help you strengthen your testimony if you put in the work.

Professor Smith is amazing! This is the second class I have taken from him. I am planning to take another class from him. He is funny and teaches things about the scriptures that I have never thought about.

He gives great lectures and brought a lot of spiritual insight to the class. However, I had this class on demand-remote and it was awful. Everything was so disorganized: lectures never posted on time (days late) and no schedule posted on Learning Suite. Tests were too specific and don't focus much on the truly important stuff. Pretty disappointing.

Wonderful teacher! All of his lectures were very uplifting and entertaining. However, some of his test questions were difficult and covered things that I believe aren't important to know (i.e. what chapter of the BOM contains this quote from Isaiah?). He only tests on things from class, but I put a lot of time into memorizing unnecessary things.
I loved this class! It was by far my favorite class of the semester. Prof. Smith is one of the most caring and inspirational professors I've ever had. 10/10 recommend.

I LOVE Brother Smith! His lectures are amazing and his class isn't hard. He really wants you to have a spiritual experience in the classroom while learning about the life of Christ. I would take this class again.

So so engaging! Immensely so. One of the biggest highlights of my young adult life, up there with special mission moments. He doesn't want your attention to be on note-taking, so he lets you take pictures of a couple of note slides at the beginning of class so you can soak it up. Bring your personal notebook and soak it all in!! Life-changing.

You MUST take Hank Smith. Best teacher I've had at BYU. So fun and easy. There's 1 paper (8-10 pages), 2 midterms and a final (but he gives you literally everything you need to know in class), bi-weekly journal entries with readings required before each class, and a weekly report asking if you did those 2 things and went to class. 100% recommend.

Professor Smith gives great, inspirational lectures, but his tests focus a lot on things we barely talk about (e.g. Which Gospel author was the only one to give X parable?) instead of the focuses of the lecture. Some of his test questions read like a game show entitled, "Matthew... Luke... or John?!" Great lectures, not so great tests.

Best decision I made this semester was to take his class. Seriously. He is hysterical, yet his lectures contain such a strong Spirit and leave you hungry for more when the bell rings. Lots of reading and journal entries, and an 8-page paper, but so worth it: honestly my fav experience of the semester; so spiritual and enriching. Take his class!

Bro Smith is the best! He really cares about his students and asks us how we're doing. His lectures are amazing and I have a new perspective on the BoM. Make sure you study for the tests, they were hard for me and I've been a member all my life and served a full-time mission. He has you do 300 word responses before each class, but it was easy.

This was my 3rd class with him because he's that great. Very clear what we need to do, easy to get an A if you put in effort. I learned a lot, he has awesome insights about the New Testament and makes it understandable. Only complaint is how long the readings are. They would take hours everytime and I didn't even do an in depth study, so beware.

I love Brother Smith's classes and was super excited to take another class from him and it did not disappoint! His tests for Book of Mormon tend to be a bit more challenging than his tests for New Testament, but they're totally doable as long as you're willing to study! His lectures are always engaging and I feel spiritually uplifted every time!

Hank Smith is an incredible religion professor at BYU. In past religion classes, I did what I needed to get an easy A. Hank Smith makes you work harder for your grade and requires you read the whole half of the Book of Mormon. Though I had to work harder for a good grade, my testimony grew a lot more in this class than in any other religion class.

I was nervous about Rel 250 because I heard it was reading-heavy and the tests were hard. I also heard that the more well-known religion professors were overrated and bad at teaching. My experience could not have been more different. Bro Smith is truly a gem, extremely clear about what would be tested, and helped me actually enjoy a religion class.

There is a lot of reading but nothing is too hard about it. His way of teaching wasn't exactly my style but most people like him. He tells you exactly what is going to be on the tests but you still have to study. Class kind of got disorganized when we went online for coronavirus

I took both BOM 121 and 122 with him this year. Brother Smith is awesome. He definitely cares about all of his students a ton. Towards the end of the year it started to bug me a little bit how little of the material we went over in class, but I still love this man. Would definitely reccomend taking a class from him!!!

Honestly, he's a good guy and really entertaining. I took his class for two semesters because the day to day was so easy and it was easy to make up work if you missed a class. He put everything you need to know in one slide the next class. HIS TESTS ARE HARD. if you do all your weekly report every time and get 75% on all the tests you'll get an A-
Hank Smith is one of my favorite professors I have ever had the pleasure of learning from. I wish there was a Hank Smith major where I could take his classes all the time. TAKE HIS CLASSES!

Need I say more than has been said? Bro. Smith is da best! Wants you to just show up and enjoy lectures, so he gives you review slides with everything you need to know for the test. Study those well, easy As on exams. So you can just sit back, relax, and laugh a ton during his incredible lectures. Grade  Weekly journals/reports, 3 tests, 1 paper.

Brother Smith has been my favorite religion professor at BYU! He can keep the class engaging and entertaining even throughout Covid-19 online school. Need extra light in your life? Take a class from Hank Smith. No regrets.
This is my favorite religion class at BYU .

Hank is awesome. Warning, if you are sensitive to gospel jokes, don't take this class, he can be irreverent at times, but it didn't bother me. His lectures are very engaging and applicable to today. The 10 page paper is more like a talk you'd write for church so don't stress about it. Lots of reading sometimes but always informative
Incredible teacher. Prepares you for the tests very well and you will LOVE his lectures.

He's honestly one of my favorite professors as evident by me currently taking his class again. I didn't do as well as I hoped when I took his class before but he was honestly so helpful that I took the class again. The biggest things besides finals that you get graded on is weekly reports and a 300 page report that you have to do before each class

Taking this class was the best decision I made all semester. Brother Smith knows and LOVES what he teaches, and it makes for an engaging, enlightening, and enjoyable class experience. Posts review slide before each class; tests cover the review slides. Easy. You will learn, your testimony will grow, and it will be the highlight of your semester.

Brother Smith is seriously the funniest guy and his lessons are amazing. Easily the best class I've taken at BYU. Before every class, he puts up a review slide from the previous class and the tests cover those review slides. There's also quite a bit of reading. It's a lot but totally worth it - if you study and go to class, you'll be fine
Loved this class

Hank is an absolutely amazing professor. He really knows what he is teaching and is passionate about it. He also really really cares about his students. His tests were a lot more difficult than I thought they would be, but don't let that scare you from taking a class from Hank. He rocks.

Brother Smith is one of the best religion professors I have had at BYU. No idea why so many people seem to struggle so hard with his tests. Studying the review slides for a bit was always sufficient. Hilarious and educational lectures. Really cares about students. Fair warning though if you can't handle any jokes in a religion class don't take his

Personally, I would never take from Professor Smith again. Yes, he provides review slides that "have everything you need to know for the test" on them- but they only provide maybe 60% of the material on the test, and the tests are extremely specific and stupidly hard for a religion credit, this coming from a premed student who got an A in ochem.

As a student whos taking Professor Smiths Book of Mormon Class, he is a good choice overall. The workload is only a couple hours to do. His lectures are engaging. However, while he doesnt say anything inappropriate, he is lighthearted. If you like serious lectures, he may not be right for you. Otherwise, you should take Professor Smiths class.
Brother Smith is by far the most entertaining professor I've ever had.

This is a great class! Definitely a bit more work than some other religion classes I've taken, but totally worth it because I learned so much more than I thought I could about the gospel. Brother Smith is also hilarious and so much fun to learn from. Everyone should take at least one class from him!

Professor Smith is one of the best professors I've ever taken. He's absolutely hilarious and helped me to see the New Testament in a new light. He is very engaging and cares about his students and gives great insights. Please take his class if you have the chance! He's amazing!

Brother Smith is the man. His reputation precedes him. I really don't think you could find a better religion professor at BYU. Just tough enough to make you care, but never stressful. Take a class from Hank at all costs.

The lectures are amazing: hilarious, mind-blowing, fast-paced. The readings are an unnecessary overkill. Preparing for the exams can be a headache, but we at least have condensed resources (questions are taken from review slides given, but you have to basically memorize them). You will seriously be disappointed every time the bell rings.

I loved him. I did not attend all of the lectures and I couldn't regret it more. However, there is only one paper, and three tests. They literally tell you what you need to study for in the lectures on slides, and he is funny and spiritual. 100% recommend.

Brother Smith is awesome. There is way too much reading compared to what is actually discussed and lectures seemed shortened by announcements and answering questions, but he is an incredible teacher. He is hilarious and you will always feel the Spirit and be uplifted. I enjoyed the class and learned a lot. Tests can be hard if you aren't prepared.

Hank Smith is a gem. One of my favorite religion professors at BYU. Can't say enough nice things about him. His class is spiritual, uplifting, and humorous. He has the best sense of humor. He is very inspirational and I learned something new everyday. His class is a LOT of work for a religion class, but it's so worth it. Take from him please!!!

Bro. Smith requires a lot of reading for his class and there is a 10 page paper, but it's so worth it for his lectures. He gives you exactly what's on the test and doesn't require you to take notes in his class, he gives them to you. Entertaining lectures and very spiritual at times as well.

His New Testament class is amazing. Journal entries and a 10-page very doable if you don't procrastinate. His lectures are very funny, spiritual, and memorable, which helps with the tests. The tests are not hard if you study from class notes. I learned a lot from attending lectures and doing homework reading assignments on my own as well.

He is seriously incredible. I was worried about fitting this class into my schedule this semester but I'm so glad I did. The tests are not hard, just study the review slides. Attendance is mandatory, but it's hard to want to miss. The 10-page paper and journal entries seemed a little excessive, but I learned a lot from them, so it worked out.

The tests are very difficult (lots of memorizing) and there is a lot of reading and journaling, along with 1 8 page paper (pretty easy), so this class is not an easy A but it is definitely worth taking. Bro. Smith is hilarious and my testimony grew a ton! He gives you notes every day in class, so that's nice because you can just pay attention.
Take Brother Smith! There is work, but it isn't difficult (reading and journal entries). He also has you write a minimum 8 page paper, but it's not hard at all. I loved this class!

I love Brother Smith. This man will change your life I tell you. I learned so much about Jesus Christ from him and my perspective of life changed drastically. I loved his lectures, every day I learned something new that changed the way I thought of my Savior. He also tells the best stories and he is such a relate able and reliable teacher.

The amount of reading for this class is ridiculous. It's more than I've had for all of my classes in a semester before. The tests are really tough if you are a concept person like me and not a memorization spewer. Lectures were great though.

I've said it before, but this is one of the best classes at BYU besides Professor Sweat's REL C 225 and Dr. Pope's CL CV 110. He will change your life with each lecture. His love is evident every time, he will make you laugh so hard, but will be up front with you about difficult things. Please, please take this class from him!!!!

Holy cow, I love this man. Hank is a beast and if you learn from humor, this is the class for you. Not necessarily suuuuper spiritual, but still hecka grew my testimony. I laughed so hard every class; I never wanted it to end. He gives you review slides and tests you over those, so it's really fair. Highly highly recommend!!!!!!

Bro. Smith is hilarious and makes class enjoyable. My only complaint is that he makes his tests unnecessarily difficult. Additionally, he'll make you also write a 8-10 pg essay. He's a great teacher, but if your looking for a religion teacher that won't make your work for your grade, then don't take Bro. Smith's class.

The best religion professor at BYU! I leave class so inspired & my testimony strengthened. He assigns weekly journals, and you grade yourself on attendance and if you did the readings. Theres one main paper assignment that is basically your testimony. The tests are easy if you come to class. He gives you questions from the test & study guides.

Bro Smith is the best Professor I've had at BYU! His lectures are so good and hilarious. You have to read a few passages and write a journal entry before class, but other than that the only assignment is one paper that is basically your testimony of Christ. He gives you notes from every class and pulls his test questions right off the notes.

HANK IS LITERALLY THE BEST PROFESSOR AT BYU!! I loved his class so much. I learned so much about Christ and was so spiritually strengthened everyday in class. I would recommend this class to everyone! He is so hilarious and I laughed everyday
Brother Smith is very entertaining and helped me better understand the New Testament. I learned so much in this class that I had never heard before. I would definitely recommend Brother Smith.

Hank is hilarious! I laughed every day in his class. The homework isnt hard, you just have to read a set of scriptures and/or bible dictionary entries and write a short journal entry before each class. If you study the review slides he gives, youll do great on the tests.

I learned more about Christ and the roots of His teachings in this class than in any other class I've had here at BYU. Bro Smith is hilarious, informational, and inspired me to seriously change my approach to the gospel and to life. Minimal assignments, daily reading/journal and one 10-page paper. Tests are doable IF YOU ATTEND THE REVIEWS.

Brother Smith is honestly my favorite professor at BYU. The reading assignments are very reasonable, only one (long-ish but personal in nature so it's not too bad) paper, and he gives you everything that will be on the tests. His lectures are amazing and (dare I say??) life changing!! He does joke, so if you're sensitive to that, be aware!
Great class. Not difficult; it's pretty straight-forward to do well. Just know the review slides, and you'll nail the test. I always enjoyed lecture!

Great guy. Really funny. If you don't like borderline offensive LDS jokes dont take his class. Everything he puts on the test is taken from a review slide that he presents each class period from the previous lecture. One 8-10 page paper at the end of the semester, but its entirely testimony so it's a breeze. Really cares about you. Take his class!

Brother Smith is a fantastic religion professor. He knows a lot about the scriptures and provides interesting background on the New Testament. During class, he makes lots of jokes but also knows when to be serious. His class is inspiring, interesting and educational, but easy to do well in if you come to class and pay attention.

He has the best lectures. His tests are tricky but manageable if you memorize his review slides. 1 paper- not bad. Quite a bit of reading due each class but it's worth it. Class isn't mandatory but it would be in your best interest to go so you can do well on the tests and just because he is an awesome guy. 10/10 guy. 8/10 class.
literally the coolest guy you'll meet
Make sure you go to his test reviews, If you don't you will not pass the test.

Phenomenal. His lectures and insights blew me away. I started my days of class with him and I'm so grateful I did because it got me energized for the rest of the day. The exams are tough, but if you go to the review sessions, you'll be pretty well off. Hardest religion class I have taken so far, but by no means is it too much to handle.

Brother Smith is the absolute best. He's SO funny and I really felt the Spirit and learned a ton in his class. There's a fair amount of reading before each lecture (usually 3-4 chapters from the NT and a handful of bible dictionary entries, with the occasional video or conf. talk) but I didn't think it was too bad. There's one paper, tests are easy

Brother Smith is hilarious. His tests can be difficult, but he and the TA give you what you need to study. Even with more difficult tests, his lectures make it worth it. You don't want to miss them because he's amazing.

Very glad I took this class! This would be a great class to prepare for a mission because you learn about Jesus Christ himself. You absolutely can't miss lectures - but there are very specific review slides of what you need to know for exams. Don't underestimate the tests but if you know the lectures well you're fine. I would definitely recommend!!

Hank Smith is maybe my favorite professor at BYU. I've taken REL A 122 and 250 from him, and if I can I'll take more too! His lectures are great, and while he does make you work a little (600 words a week in journals and one long paper) his class is very doable and definitely worth it. He loves his students and does everything he can to help.

WOW! One of the best religion professors here. Most of his points come from assigned reading and journal entries as well as two mid terms, a paper, and an exam. He is such an amazing professor. If you want to be inspired, learn a ton, and feel the spirit, take New Testament from Brother Smith.

Brother Smith truly cares about the wellbeing of his students. honestly the funniest teacher I've ever had! also, if you take his class you HAVE TO ask him to tell you "the cactus story", you won't regret it. He'll understand what you mean. Spiritually the class increased my testimony and gave me a deeper understanding/appreciation of Christ.

I've taken a couple classes from Hank, and I think he's made them a little bit more difficult, but that being said they're still pretty easy. Pay attention during the Review Slides, and then sit back and enjoy some of the most uplifting/hilarious lectures you'll hear in all of college. Seriously, he's a Mormon celebrity for a reason.

Brother Smith is by far the most inspiring professor I have had. He cares for your individual success in a class of 200+, and teaches the New Testament in such an engaging and incredible way. Take him! There's a reason he's so popular, because it's life-changing. Please, please take New Testament from him!!!

Brother Smith found the perfect balance between spirituality and humor without ever coming close to crossing the line. I liked his focus on the application of gospel principles rather than NT history. Tests are a bit more difficult than other religion classes I've taken, but he makes it very clear what material will be covered. Great class.
If I could vote who the next prophet would be, Hank would be my vote. He is the best teacher at BYU. I love Hank with all of my heart.

Hank Smith is by far my favorite religion professor at BYU. Very spiritual and life changing, but he throws in enough comedy to make the class really interesting and relatable. He grades on just a few things: daily journals/reading, tests and 1 10 page paper. If you take his class, you will not regret it :)

Oh Hank. If only all religion teachers could have his balance between making their classes academic yet spiritual and applicable. I've taken multiple classes from him, and they've all changed my life. You need to take a class from him during your time at BYU. HILARIOUS & inspiring. For an A: come 2 class, go to TA Review &Study the review slides.

Don't be deterred by the fact that Hank Smith is a popular professor. His class is a relatively easy A and is SO beneficial. This was an incredible religion class. I'm luck to have had Hank Smith as my professor.

My favorite religion class at BYU. I love his perspective on note taking in his class. Tests can be a little tough, but just make sure you get the review slides and go to the TA review and you'll be just fine. I feel like I learned a lot about the Gospel during this class and didn't just learn how to get an A in the class.

Bro. Smith's class has just the right mixture of spiritual meat and humor for me. Seriously hilarious dude!!! If you're permanently attached to your sensitive sweater, maybe take the class from someone else though. Tests are a little tricky; study hard and read the questions carefully! In sum, highly enjoyable and spiritually uplifting. Five stars.

Hank Smith is the John Green of the LDS Community. He gives great lectures and sets up his classes very well, but he's also intimidating because he's so extroverted. Some of the things he says and tweets are quotes I have definitely heard before, but he makes it seem like it's his ideas. I would definitely recommend him for a class, just be ready.
Best professor I have ever had! So much fun. Just come to class, go to the TA reviews and you're golden.

Great class! Bro Smith has a great sense of humor and teaches about Christ well. All the readings -- which there aren't a lot -- he gives are pertinent and not tedious. I've learned a lot and grown closer to my Savior. His tests aren't bad at all, and there is only one paper. Highly recommend this class.
Life changing experience. I want Brother Smith to teach all my classes. 100/10 would recommend.

Brother Smith is the best religion teacher I've ever had. He is hilarious and engaging. If he taught more religion classes I would totally take all of them! You won't regret taking this class. His tests aren't too bad if you set aside some time to study for them.
Funniest professor! He was able to explain the New Testament and Christ's ministry in a way that I've never experienced before. A MUST TAKE!

Hank is amazing. I love going to his lectures because he gives you a slide of whats important from last class at the start of each day. Then you can just pay attention and not have to worry about taking notes. He is SO funny, but also so inspirational. Follow him on Twitter. Take Hanks class. Structured like most other religion classes.

Looking for a chill and easy religion class/professor for the semester? I'd say him and Bro Dorius are the best with regards to actually making religion class actually worth 2 credits. Also, Bro Smith is funny and engaging. Has weekly journal entries you submit, 1 paper, 2 midterms & final. No note-taking, just listen and learn. Register quickly!
Hank is an awesome professor! His class is very straight forward and easy to get a good grade if you do the small and simple things. Honestly you should take no one else.

LISTEN TO ME: Take any class from him you can. He is so funny and genuinely cares about each and every one of his students. His classes are not at all too hard, just come and listen and revel in his amazing lectures, and then you just need to study the review slides he gives you for the exams. Seriously one of the best professors I've ever had.

He is the best religion teacher I have ever had! He doesn't care if you take notes in class because he gives a review slide the beginning of every class about the last lecture. If it's not on the review slide it's not on the test. He cares about all his students and is very engaging in lectures. Loves to hear our ideas and thoughts! TAKE HIS CLASS

Bro Smith is hands down the best professor I've ever had. Inspiring, kind, smart, and genuinely wants us to succeed. Super easy assignments, one paper (kinda long but super do-able), and a few tests. His class changed my life. I plan on taking every class he teaches because he's THAT amazing.

I never missed class, even the day I was running a really high fever and had almost thrown up in the shower that morning. We learned about the Atonement. It was totally worth it. I wouldn't have come to class for any other professor. 10/10, I'm already planning next semester's schedule around another of his classes.

Hank Smith is a good guy and is a great lecturer. He's one of those religion professors who focuses on the applicable lessons we can learn instead of the history of the book. I learned a lot about the BOM but felt that his tests were a bit too specific. Overall he's a good professor and the class was about average difficulty for a religion class

Great lessons I learned so much! He was a great guy! But me and many other people always failed his tests. EXTREMELY hard tests because its all matching and multiple choice with choices there to purposely mess you up.

Brother Smith is one of the most amazing people and professors I have ever met. I loved ever little piece of his class. The reading is really heavy, but it's also really awesome if you take the time to read it. I typically hate BYU religion classes, but this one was flawless. The perfect balance of academic and spiritual. This class changed my life

He is awesome! He's hilarious, his classes are enjoyable, and he cares about his students. A few times he had to miss class at the scheduled time, but he does everything he can to re-schedule class to make sure students can attend, or posts a recording on learning suite. He has a way to interpret the NT in a way to make it applicable and enjoyable.

Brother Smith is an absolute legend. He does a great job at teaching in a way that keeps his audience engaged and laughing. He's so real and knows SO much about the scriptures. Weekly attendance quizzes that ask if you went to class and did the reading, a midterm, a 10 page devotional paper (double spaced, really not bad), and final. TAKE HIS CLASS

Brother Smith is the GOAT. Ridiculously engaging; you will learn the Gospels easily if you want to. Go to review sessions and always attend class, and you will do fine on tests. If you have any sense of humor at all, you will laugh AT LEAST once a class, probably more. He strikes an unforeseen balance between humor, genuineness, and spirituality.
Hank Smith is the absolute best thing ever. You won't be sorry you took his class.

I took BoM from Bro Smith my freshman year and loved it so I decided to take NT from him. The class is great! Bro Smith uses a lot of information from biblical scholars to help you learn the most about Christ. You have to go to the TA review before each test and study those slides to do well on the tests. I just wish he taught more classes
His class is very straightforward in what you have to do for an A. If you read and go to class, you easily will get an A. He is hilarious and his lectures are enjoyable.

Smith is hilarious and inspirational. He provides a lot of intriguing insight into the New Testament. He wants you to pay attention in class and not try to cram notes so he provides a review slide at the being of each class. The weekly journals are easy and the tests aren't too strenuous.

I've never felt like I knew the Book of Mormon as well as I do now. For his class you have to know what events occur in specific ranges of chapters. It's a little hard but I'm honestly so grateful. I feel like it's really preparing me for my mission. I wish he taught every religion course, because I would love to take every class possible from him.

His classes are large and yet somehow he can make each and every individual feel cared for. That takes a special kind of person. Hank Smith is amazing. I felt inspired by his lectures but they also don't get too heavy because of his amazing sense of humor. I've taken several classes from him and he's definitely one of my favorite professors.

A lot of people complain about his tests but I think they're very fair. You definitely have to study for them. But he basically takes notes for you and gives them to you at the beginning of every class. Study those like no other and you'll do just fine. The one paper is actually a great experience, spend a good amount of time on it. He's awesome!

My third class with Hank Smith because he is AMAZING. He literally gives you everything you need to succeed. I feel like he gives a new perspective on the scriptures, and I really appreciate it. He's not afraid to incorporate humor with any and all gospel topics. If you don't like that then stay away. But I think he's really inspiring and fun.

This was my third class with hank Smith. Take him. he is absolutely hilarious and loves teaching and his students. He has such an amazing perspective on the gospel that is SO applicable to college students. how to do well: come to class, PAY attention- he emphasizes what's on the test, study his review slides, and go to TA reviews

Brother Smith truly helps you love the New Testament. Hilarious jokes. There are tedious weekly attendance reports and a weekly journal submission. Never forget any of them as tests can be somewhat challenging. There is 1 very long paper you have to do in the class. About 10 pages long. It was somewhat enjoyable to write though.

Okay I LOVED Brother Smith. He's hilarious and inspiring. But I HATED the tests. I did terribly on them. It's definitely a me problem, but there were also a lot of way overly specific questions, like "Who did Jesus say this to?" The bad grade I got was probably worth actually being in the class though so idk what I'm trying to say.

Hank Smith is AWESOME!!! Favorite teacher freshman year! He's hilarious! He's also ridiculously insightful. His class will change the way you read The Book of Mormon. If you attend his class and study his review slides you'll get an A in his class. If you're easily offended when people infuse humor into the gospel don't take his class.

I WANT TO TAKE EVERY CLASS FROM HIM. His lectures are the perfect combination of funny and spiritual. I felt like I got to know the Savior on a personal level that I never had before. The tests are hard and every little grade matters, so MAKE SURE YOU TURN IN YOUR WEEKLY REPORTS. As long as you do your work on time, you'll be fine. TAKE HIS CLASS!!

Brother Smith is awesome! I love his sense of humor (if you don't like funny gospel stuff, don't take the class), and how he made the New Testament relate to my life. He does expect you to remember specific information and quotes for the test, but as long as you study, you should be fine. All the homework is meaningful, and I loved his class!
Hes a really good professor! His tests are really specific and difficult so study really hard for those! His other assignments are easy. If you just dont put in work then you wont pass his tests.

Brother Smith is such a great teacher. He makes lectures enjoyable with jokes and personal stories. He teaches the Book of Mormon by telling the story, and then applying the concepts to our lives. Tests are really hard and specific, so go to class. Besides, you wouldn't want to miss his lectures anyways.

Okay, folks. Listen up. TAKE BROTHER SMITH! Holy heck my life has changed because of this class. I cried when it was over because it changed my perspective on certain things. And, the actual courseload is extremely easy. Study Bro. Smith's review slides carefully, and I promise you will do well in the class. I wish I could take this class again!

Hank Smith was one of my favorite teachers I've ever had. He is so funny and his lectures manage to be entertaining and spiritual at the same time. However, I didn't end up with as high of a grade as I would have liked because the tests were pretty hard for me (tons of memorization). But I loved his class! Everyone should take a class from him!

I recommend bro Smith!!Read, go to class/take pictures of the review slides, & go 2 review and u will be fine. Honestly my testimony struggled before, during, & after this class, but I definitely understand this part of the BOM better than ever. Sometimes he had different interpretations of scripture but he is good at making them relatable 2 today!

I love Hank! My favorite professor ever. Lectures are amazing and hilarious- I didn't miss once, and I cried when the semester ended. I learned a lot about the NT, AND it strengthened my testimony- perfect balance. It changed my life. He clearly cares about his students. I recommend him to everyone & wish I could take every religion class from him!

I loved this class. Only one paper throughout the semester and the daily homework assignments were easy. If you go to class his lectures are incredible! I would definitely take another class from him!

I really really loved this class. Yes, the tests are hard, but if you go over the review slides and go to the TA review sessions, it is a lot easier. I took 121 and 122 from Bro. Smith and these classes definitely strengthened my testimony and taught me a ton about the Book of Mormon! I would definitely recommend taking from Bro. Smith!

I LOVE HANK SMITH!!! This class was definitely a life-changer. He has great thoughts to share and is also so funny. I always knew that he really cares for his students and wants them to succeed. The reading was always really interesting and I think it was just the right amount for this class. If you take NT, take it from Hank!!

Brother Smith is awesome!! Super great insights about the Book of Mormon. Really helped me learn about it more in depth. Very easy, you just have to do the work and you are solid! TA reviews are also SO helpful!!

I loved his Rel 121 and 122 classes! I took both classes and would take this class over and over again! I learned so much from him about the Book of Mormon and the author's of the Book of Mormon! He is really funny and has the coolest and enlightening comments and insights.

Brother Smith is honestly the best teacher I have ever had. He knows so much and he presents it in a way that is accessible to each person individually and that keeps your attention. He is so funny. Tests are kind of hard, but if you attend class, he does a review of the previous class lecture and that review is all he tests on. Best class ever.

I highly recommend Brother Smith to anyone taking Book of Mormon. The tests are taken straight off the review slides which you can only get by going to class and the TA review session. If you don't appreciate humor being mixed with the gospel then this probably isn't the class for you... The workload is super easy.

Dr. Hank Smith is a down-to-earth, well-humored, solid teacher. He's able to take the scriptures and put them in real life context, and I felt like I understood the New Testament so much better. Don't forget weekly submissions, start the paper early, and you'll love this class. Quite do-able with a heavy workload.

I LOVE HANK SMITH. He is amazing!!! I LOVE his classes, if you can take from him do it! He teaches in a way that is interesting and enlightening. I have learned SO much from him and I actually enjoy studying for his tests. Honestly, take from him, this man deserves a raise.

He helped me to gain a testimony of the Book of Mormon. He is really funny and sarcastic so if you want a more serious environment, he is not your guy. Go to the reviews and you will do well on the tests. Definitely taking more classes from him in the future, 10/10 recommend!

He's an amazing professor, but his tests are really difficult that requires a lot of studying and memorizing quotes, chapters, etc. Study really hard, and put in effort. His papers aren't too bad and he has weekly reports that's easy! Super inspirational and there are a lot of great discussions!

Brother Smith is easily my favorite professor. Hes so funny but still provides a lot of insight on the scriptures. Short journals on reading due each week. One paper, not graded harshly. Go to class and study the review slides for the tests. If you are having trouble (with anything), he will meet with you. He genuinely cares about his students!

Hank Smith is an amazing teacher and he's really good at explaining scriptural events in ways that relate to the present, which is way nice! I loved his class but I'll admit that his tests are really hard and specific. It seems like some of the questions are nearly impossible.

Brother Smith's class is very straight forward. He tells you at the beginning what to expect, and if you keep up on the weekly readings you will do just fine in the class. Be sure to go to the reviews before the tests! The TA's are really good about giving you the info you will need.

HANK SMITH IS THE BEST. Anyone who says the tests are hard DID NOT go to class, listen, or study like they were supposed to! I came to class, listened every time, did my readings, & studied an hour before the test and got A's on every test! He also provides you with slides w all the info you need. He is so funny and so spiritual. He cares so much!
His lectures are really uplifting and inspirational. He is always really funny and sarcastic. His tests require you to know what happens in each chapter of scripture, and are somewhat challenging.

Brother Smith is INCREDIBLE. It is so clear that he cares about each student individually. His classes are centered around you developing not just a knowledge of the scripture, but a testimony of the doctrine. 3 tests, an essay, regular reading, overall not bad. He's hilarious, kind, and so passionate about the gospel. LOVE LOVE LOVE!

I loved this teacher. His lessons were amazing. At the end of the semester, I got too tired and didn't go to any of the lectures. I ended up struggling on the tests because tests use lecture material. His TA reviews before each test are super helpful and tell you everything you need to know. If you go, pay attention, and try, you'll get an A.

Literally my favorite professor, and not just that, but friend. He is SO funny, very sassy, not afraid to say what he thinks. So insightful and fun. I love being in his lectures and if you do the assignments and study, you can easily get a good grade. Basically just the perfect balance, perfect class. love him to death!!
this is the easiest class. just go to class and reviews and you're set. on top of that, professor is very engaging and refreshing. i actually enjoyed going to lectures

Hank Smith everyday made my day 10x better. He was funny, spiritually uplifting, and you could tell he truly cared for us. He was willing to work with students who's grade was bad based on special circumstances. He's open for you to go talk to him one on one in his office. One of my favorite professors.

You will have to do some reading and writing in this class, but you learn more because it requires more. Hank Smith is straight amazing! I would take him every semester if I could. It really will be a life changing experience, do it!!

Hank is great at being personable and inspirational! I think his grading is fair for the importance and value of the class. Attendance/participation(just doing the readings and watching the videos and paying attention in class) was about 34% of the grade. I wouldnt have gotten As on exams without all the reviews. Tests were 50%.
He is awesome! I learned a ton in this class.
He's not only spiritual, he makes learning fun and interesting! Most of the time religion classes can be a bore, but this teacher honestly made it worth the time to come to class.

Hank is the funniest person ever. His lectures are honestly so eye opening because he's not afraid to tackle typically taboo mormon topics and questions. He sometimes does insert his own opinions into his lectures, but he tells you when he's saying what he thinks and when it's real doctrine. His stories are THE BEST (ask about the cactus story)

Bro. Smith is super insightful and really wants you to succeed. I got more out of this class than I ever expected, and was looking forward to class by the end of the semester. Definitely will take another class from him.

Loved taking Book of Mormon with bro smith, he was hilarious and made coming to class enjoyable. The tests were tough for me because it's hard to remember scripture stories, but literally, make flashcards from the review slides and you can do well.

You grade your own attendance and submit journals for weekly reading, one paper. I took the class from him because everyone seems to love him. Yeah, he's pretty cool, but I wasn't a fan of the class. Tests are hard. Class is rushed. It's entertaining, but lacks spiritual impact. Also, it really irked me how packed the class was. I like my space.

Legitimately one of the best people I've met in my entire life. His lectures are amazing, and you don't have to be worried about getting bogged down taking notes the entire class. He tells you exactly what will be on the tests, and if you study that you'll do great. Extremely funny, and extremely uplifting. Great spiritually and academically.

Brother Smith is absolutely hilarious and cares for each one of his students. He helps you understand the Book of Mormon in a different light but makes it clear. Content is clear to understand and test questions come straight from review slides in class. Hes fantastic!
Brother Smith's lectures are super spiritual and entertaining.

He is the funniest professor of all time. He also made me see the New Testament in a completely different light. It should be required to take his class to graduate. He understands the NT and doesn't dilute it with opinions. He says the tests all come from the review slides but actually probably about 80% of questions do.
Bro. Smith is the best religion teacher ever! He makes everything so fun and gave us a new spin on gospel topics. I would 100% take him again!

I LOVE this class. Bro. Smith is my favorite professor. I have learned SO much about the Book of Mormon this semester. Journals due every week- just write on what you learned from readings, one 5 page essay on any chapter in the BOM, and go to the TA reviews (Tess if you read this we LOVE you sm). But seriously Hank is hilarious take from him!

Hank Smith is the best!! His lectures are so fun and the homework is very easy and inspirational. He really cares about his students and makes you feel loved. The TA's will tell you 90% of what's on the test. He really wants his students to succeed and makes that very doable.
Brother Smith is the best lecturer. He's funny and insightful. There is bit of writing involved with his class but it's definitely manageable.

Hank Smith is the most engaging lecturer I've ever had. He demands your attention from day one. I've never had a professor who combines humor with education so well. Tests aren't bad, and there's a 8-10 page paper that isn't as bad as you would think. Everyone should take a class from him at least once during their time at BYU.

Brother Smith is seriously the greatest! He is hilarious & his lectures are phenomenal! His tests are pretty detailed, but he gives you a review slide every day with everything that will be on the exam. Only had one essay & it was super fun to write. He is extremely knowledgable. He really helped me dig deeper into the scriptures & I learned a ton!

Brother Smith is amazing. His lectures are equal parts hilarious, enlightening, and spiritual. Now, he doesn't teach a seminary class. If you are looking for a pick-me-up during the week, this is not the professor for you. I feel far more equipped to answer the hard questions in life than I ever have before.

Brother Smith is really great but beware he might not be your style. He is fun and energetic and gives great new insights about the Book of Mormon! He does review slides every day from the last lecture so you don't take notes. Tests are hard, make sure you practically memorize the review slides for the tests. Also, TA reviews are very helpful!

hank smiths lectures are funny, entertaining, and informing. The tests are hard. he says to not take notes during class (we take pics of the review slides in the beginning of class as notes) however the tests are tricky. it really depends on your TA. usually they give you exact questions from the test. no quizzes; 600 word journals and 1 paper.

You can tell Hank Smith really cares about each and every one of his students, which is hard to do for such a large class. He is hilarious and helps you see a new perspective of the scriptures. His tests are slightly difficult, but very fair; he gives you everything you need to succeed. Just one paper and a weekly journal. He is the BEST.

I love this religion class more than any I've ever taken. Hank is a pill, and you shouldn't take him if you don't like to laugh. He makes a lot of things light-hearted and is very sarcastic, but also knows when to bring it down. He offers a lot of insight into the Book of Mormon, as well as his own opinions& encourages us to ask difficult questions

I LOVED this class! Hank Smith is such an amazing teacher, and he's so funny!! I took his 9 a.m. New Testament class and it was the best decision! I never had problems with the class being so early because they were so entertaining! The tests were not bad as long as you read the material and went to exam reviews with your TA.

This class changed my life. I wish I could say I was being dramatic, but it's the truth. I left class everyday having laughed at least 10 times and been spiritually and intellectually edified. Go to the TA reviews for the tests and you'll get 95% of the answers to the test. Brother Smith is the funniest guy and his amount of knowledge is crazy.

I have been listening to/reading Hank Smith's work for some time and I was so excited to be able to take a class from him. He did not disappoint. He has not only helped me learn about the New Testament and understand it better, but I have grown so much closer to Christ through this class. My favorite professor ever.

He is so funny that you actually want to go to class! He tells you not to take notes (he shows a review slide of all the info you need to know from the previous class), so that you can really focus and engage in the discussion. There are 2 midterms, 1 final, and a paper. 600 words a week for journal entries and a weekly quiz report.

Fun guy Requires you to show up, do the reading, and pay attention, but he also gives you the review slides if you show up to class. As long as you pay attention and read the review slides you will pass easily.

Brother Smith is literally the best professor on BYU campus. He taught at my high school seminary, and now I try to take every class he teaches. He makes sure he knows you and is your friend. Take any/all of his classes. You will not regret it. Also ask him about how he met his wife. The story will have you rolling on the floor.

Bro Smith is a hoot. He's hilarious but he knows his stuff. Kind of irreverent but its refreshing. You have to write journal entries before each class based off what you read - I thought it would be a pain but I actually enjoyed the opportunity to reflect on what I learned. His tests aren't too bad, questions are taken right off his review slides.

Love Brother Smith!!! By far the best professor I've had. I loved coming to his class (even though it was at the crack of dawn). Sometimes discussing this topic can get a bit boring or repeated, but his lectures are amazing! I wish he taught more classes!

Prof Smith uses a little too much sarcasm for my taste, which interfered or made light of the subject matter.  I felt he was more concerned about us knowing exactly what happened in each of the Book of Mormon chapters than growing spiritually from having understood and applied what was learned.  Also, my paper was docked points without explanation.

Brother Smith remains my favorite professor at BYU. He really focuses on the the spiritual aspect of his class rather than making the class impossible. He cares about you and your performance. His class was always the highlight of my day.

This was my second semester w/ Prof Smith. I liked his New Testament class more, but BOM was still amazing. Very knowledgeable and passionate. Clear about what he expects. If you go to the reviews and do your weekly reports, the class is a breeze. Finish your essay early and take it to the TA for specific instructions on how to make an A.

Brother Smith is still one of my favorite professors of all time. He always made class super entertaining while keeping the Spirit there. It's smart to go to class because he makes test questions directly from lecture material, but if you have to miss class it's okay. Just make sure you get the lecture slides from someone.

Brother Smith is a great balance of spiritual and entertaining. His doctrinal application is very meaningful and lectures and interesting. Favorite religion teacher so far. I highly recommend taking a class from him! Class structure: twice a week reading assignments and journal entries, points for attendance, one paper, manageable tests
In my opinion, the ideal religion class setup. You learn a lot but it's an easy A if you put in a little effort. You'll love his lectures too, funny guy. Would highly recommend

I loved taking New Testament from Professor Smith. He is a positive easy going gentleman that you can learn lots from. He made the topic exciting fun and  interesting. I would recommend you attend class and listen carefully because he will tell you whats on the exam. Exams can be very tricky so make sure you study the content. Gospel paper is easy.

I loved Brother Smith's class. I learned a ton about the Book of Mormon. He was super funny as well and I always looked forward to his lectures. There at 3 tests and a paper and daily reading and journals. Overall really easy. Tests were not too bad as long as you went to the TA reviews. I would totally recommend Brother Smith to anyone!

Brother Smith is amazing! I took it in the morning and his lectures were actually able to keep me awake so that's saying something! The lectures give great gospel insights and and help you get a greater testimony of the Book of Mormon. His TA reviews give you 90% of the material for the tests and help a lot!

Such a solid religion professor. Leaves you spiritually uplifted but also are interesting, plus he is so funny! You need to read and go to class because there are participation points.
