Make sure to go to the test reviews and study a couple hours before the test. I was able to learn a lot and gain a stronger testimony this semester from his class.
If you are looking for a spiritually uplifting class on the Book of Mormon take it from someone else. It's a lot of facts and a little doctrine, and lots of jokes and very little feeling the spirit
He is incredible. If you study at BYU, you should take his course! But this class is not easy. I did really well. I assume that many of my classmates couldn't get A.

Great teacher and fun class! Pay attention in class, go to the review session and you'll do great. Don't forget to do the weekly report or it can really hurt your grade. Overall great religion teacher compared to the rest i have taken.

Professor Smith is such an amazing professor and obviously puts a lot of time and effort into making the course a very personal experience. He explains and expounds the scriptures better than any other teacher I've met. His TA was also FANTASTIC!!!

If you don't take a religion course from Bro. Smith during your time at BYU, you are missing out. He is absolutely incredible and inspiration. His lectures, while ridiculously funny, are filled with doctrinal truths and he brings a new flavour to the scriptures that most wouldn't consider. Taking his class is a must.
I LOVED THIS CLASS. FAVORITE CLASS IVE TAKEN AT BYU. HANK SMITH IS AMAZING. I WOULD TAKE THIS CLASS TEN MORE TIMES.
I enjoyed Hank Smith's class. There is only one paper and two midterms. The test reviews give you 90% of the test material. Only thing is that you need a 95% to get an A.
Brother Smith is the best religion professor out there so if you have the opportunity, take his class!
He is an awesome guy and loves his students!  Also his TA is amazing!

Hank Smith is a great guy and really helps us understand the material. I would love to take seminary or institute from him. That being said, this class was really hard. The tests are incredibly hard if you haven't memorised every word in the New Testament; just knowing the main ideas and concepts will only get you about 50%. Also, his TA sucked.

Dr. Smith is a nice guy, he's just is too concerned with being funny and not concerned enough with teaching doctrine. His tests are incredibly nitpicky. On the tests, he will give you a passage of scripture and you have to pick out the exact word that is off from the scripture. The word could be "of" or "and" like that is how nitpicky the tests are

Love this man! His class is really straight forward and simple. He makes learning about the Gospel super fun and he is hilarious. You are basically graded on whether you read and show up and he tells you exactly what to study for the tests! Take this guy!

He's good with names and is really funny an entertaining, but his tests can be hard, and he requires a lot of reading and journals.  Overall pretty good for a religion teacher at BYU.

Brother Smith is amazing and super caring about his students!! I would go to him about a problem even if it wasn't for class. He knows everyone's names and treats everyone like they're important. He cares about his students as much as he cares about the Gospel.  Don't take him if you don't like to talk or participate in class.

Brother Smith is a straight up cool guy. He teaches you the doctrine and helps you understand the Book of Momon. Obviously you actually have to read the book to do well in the class. He's really funny too! You'll love him. P.S. He ended class two minutes early today and was like "now I'm going to get good ratings on RMP" So yeah :)
This guy is an awesome teacher. Balances being serious with being funny very well.
Definitely me favourite teacher ever! He keeps his lessons very fun but insightful. Very spiritually uplifting. I wish he would teach every subject as they'd be the best classes ever!!

Brother Smith was a really great teacher! He really wants his students to succeed, and does everything he can to make that possible. The tests were moderately difficult, but definetly doable as long as you study. He's a really funny, spritual, and just overall great guy!

If you go to his office hours and ask what the test will be like and right down what he says, the test is easy. Some people think its hard because they don't read and expect it to be primary answers. I honestly didn't do any of the reading but the office hours got me A's on all my tests
Great teacher.  Look up "Hank Smith" for more reviews.
Brother Smith is awesome! He's an EFY speaker and is so entertaining! He makes you laugh and cry with the spirit all in the same lesson. He is really kind and easy to talk to.

Awesome teacher! Really got to know everyone in class. You only have to write one paper and it isn't that bad. 2 midterms and final are multiple choice. It's a class that you will actually look forward to going to.

Brother Smith is the best professor at BYU. His class is fun and easy, but you learn so much it is amazing. He is such a great guy and really gets to know the students. He keeps class entertaining and you can't wait for his class. Take  as many classes from him as you can!!!

Best teacher at BYU! Smith is Funny, smart, and spiritual. It's never a boring class, and you WILL laugh your head off every day. You learn so much in his easy class and he is willing to help with anything! He knows his stuff doctrinally and you will agree that he is the best professor you will have at BYU! Take Brother Smith!
BROTHER SMITH IS AWESOME.

I absolutely loved Brother Smith and his class. He helps you to really understand the storyline as well as the principles. He is genuinely interested in helping his students and actually gets to know you. He is all around the perfect professor!

Bro. Smith is one of the most understanding and easy-going teachers I've had. He's also the best religion teacher I've had at BYU (out of 5 others). No one brings the Spirit yet also makes class entertaining like he does. He's easy to work with if you have extenuating circumstances. Take religion from him when at all possible!

He is such a great professor. He is hilarious and I actually looked forward to going to this class. It is pretty easy as long as you study for the tests and keep up with the reading. I would definately recommend him!
He is the best professor in BYU. He is really willing to help his students. Take B.O.M from him!

Brother Smith is the best professor I have ever had at BYU. He is hilarious and tells great stories, but has the ability to bring the spirit and teach deep doctrine. His tests are pretty easy as long as you do the reading and attend class, but don't worry, he'll make you want to go to class (:

REL A 122. Brother Smith truly cares about his students, and understands them. He does not want to make life harder or less enjoyable. He has a passion for what he teaches. I am currently taking the class right now. He had us fill out anonymous evaluations of the class and after reading them he is making changes according to the comments we made.
Best religion professor ever.  If you want a great teacher that doesn't turn the Book of Mormon into a text book full of useless and soon to be forgotten facts, take brother Smith. Way spiritual.

Bro. Smith is arguably the easiest teacher at BYU. He literally gives you the answers to the exams during his review. Super easy. Definitely recommended in comparison to others.

I'm in love with Brother Smith. In the least creepy way possible, because at the same time I wish he was my dad/my best friend. Seriously the coolest, smartest, funniest guy EVER! And it's true, he LOVES MONDAYS!!!!

Bro. Smith is incredible. He teaches clearly, and is extremely reasonable with tests. Do the reading and one-page weekly journals; you grade yourself on those. Okay so Bro Smith is Pretty Good. Pretty easy class. I hate religion classes and I thought it was enjoyable. Sometimes it felt more like EFY than college.

Bro Smith is the BEST teacher around. Super cool/fun guy. Classes are good and tests are easy. He gives you a study guide that covers EVERYTHING you will need to know. Okay seriously, Brother Smith is THE BEST teacher ever. He is hilarious, super helpful, and brings the spirit to class. He makes an effort to know all of his students individually. HE IS THE MAN!!!! His class was seriously the greatest thing ever. I looked forward to it everyday. Good teacher, great stories, hilarious class. TAKE IT!!!!
BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!! shut up and take him. he's easy if you go to class and do study guide. very entertaining, will learn a lot!

Brother Smith is my favorite teacher at BYU by far. He cares about his students and what he teaches. Class discussions are always fascinating and you leave with a great spirit. His tests are based on the study guides he gives you. I wish I could take every religion class with him.

He's a really funny guy. and HE LOVES MONDAYS!! I feel like I have learned a lot about the Book of Mormon from him.

Bro Smith is the best religion teacher. He is soooooo funny but manages to bring the Spirit to class still. He really cares about his students is soo willing to help. Take class from bro smith. He is the kindest guy.  He truly cares about his students.  He works with you and always helps you.  I have learned so much in his class and I always feel the spirit. Its amazing!!! Take as many classes as you can from him!! He's my favorite at BYU!
Brother Smith is awesome. He knows his students and he cares about them. He is so knowledgeable and he's very approachable. I wish I could take more classes from him.

Love him! My favorite professor so far at BYU. He works hard to get to know everyone and tells the best stories! He has great insight and makes you want to come to class. No huge reading assignments and tests are easy if you come to class and read the study guide.

Bro. Smith is awesome and so funny! Overall, the class is pretty easy. Just look at his study guide and you will be fine for tests. A very helpful teacher that cares for his students and always fair when grading tests. GREAT TEACHER AND HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Genuinely cares about his students. It was difficult test-wise, but class was always enjoyable. He worked hard to get to know his students, and also to teach in a real-world manner. Bro. Smith is really an incredible guy and teacher, I would take from him again for sure.

i just have to say he rocked. the class was fun, it was spiritual, and i wish i hadn't taken New Testimant yet so i could take it from him next semester! ah well, tis life. i highly recomment this teacher for any student jsut starting our in college.

He is sooo nice, he gave me money for bandaids! He really will help anyone! I highly recommend him!
Funniest guy, tells great stories, and relates The Book of Mormon to real life experiences. HIGHLY recommended.

One of the most German people I have ever met. He has a heart of gold and he loves all of his students. There is a lot of Homework and papers but if you know German it is easy. Dr. Kelling is very caring and eager to help with everything. You have to spend time on his courses but not overly much is required. The class's difficulty level is very reasonable. I hadn't used German for 2 years before taking the class and by the end I remembered everything I learned previously.

Professor Kelling made a group of students without any German ancestry be ready to travel to Germany. There were two pop quizzes and the group project is a big part of the grade! Best German Professor!

GERM 330 is a must-take for RMs, but be ready to read! The lectures are fun, and Dr. Kelling is a great guy, but the tests were SO hard. I have never taken a class with harder tests before. Our class applauded (literally, stood and clapped) Dr. Kelling just because our final was multiple choice.

Dr. Kelling is solely responsible for the great experience I had taking German classes at BYU. He does his very best to be of as much assistance as possible, and his assignments are challenging, but not very hard. I finished the class being far more proficient at German than I was at the start of the semester.

I took 2 literature classes and I thought they had a very reasonable work load (1 2=page essay each week, no big paper at the end, no midterm, no real final). He did not expect super philosophical essays, which was nice. He expects you to read the literary texts and be ready to talk about them in class. My favorite German professor!

Now that It's been a year or so since I took the class, I can really appreciate all that was taught. Tests are a nightmare and the workload is large, however I would say that I've learned more in this class than any other. Kelling is German and has a very German perspective on a lot of things. Good luck getting back points on your tests!
The nicest professor ever!
Great guy, incredible insights on periods of Modern German history-WWII, Nazi Germany, etc. He is very helpful and funny. Challenging but extremely rewarding course.

He is a really great professor and quite possibly the nicest man on earth. His tests are beastly though and I found the text rather difficult. Professor Kelling is one of my favorite teachers of all time. Every day you walk out of his class wanting to be a better person. Professor Kelling genuinely cares about his classes and his students.  Yes, he is hard, but if you want to learn German well, you need to put in a lot of time & effort. Very hard, but very interesting class. The tests and quizes were hard, but if you do the reading you will pass them. He is a very interesting teacher, and the class covers very interesting things. It is a ton of work though.
A lot of work

Shows love for the German language and the people.

Super easy class and an amazing professor, very kind, personal, and always great at reaching out and supporting students
The class was organized well and easy to complete
She's awesome and very understanding and accommodating. Quick grader and responds to emails quickly, just communicate and you'll be ok!!

Great class and professor! I would recommend!

Very approachable and remembers what you have submitted in the past. Is very kind and attentive for online classes. I feel like I really built a relationship with her that helped me develop as a student.
There are not a lot of heavy assignments in this class and it really helped me see and understand the different ways and directions I can go with different careers. Would take this class again.
Good class for freshmen who are looking for potential majors and career paths.

Professor Jensen's class was very helpful into helping you to try and navigate all of the many paths you can take to receiving a BYU education. She provides great feedback, and grading times for major assignments are good. Some assignments can be a lot, but she does a great job giving reminders so you have time to prep. Her teaching style is organized and she communicates expectations well. I felt like I learned valuable skills in this course, especially related to my career path.
She is great! She gave great feedback when grading and helped me do well in this class

I enjoyed this professors class. She was always happy to reach out to her students or answer any questions that I had through email. The assignments are all meant to help you become aware of future careers available and skills necessary to succeed within a chosen career.

Professor Jensen is great. She makes expectations very clear and is great at answering questions or providing access to resources when asked. It was easy to get in contact with both her and her TA. Professor Jensen is amazing! She is so caring, and even though the course is online, she makes you feel respected and seen. I highly recommend taking this class from her! She is so awesome!
This was a very easy class, and Professor Jensen made the assignments and projects easy to do and interesting. Least stressful class I've taken so far, good amount of work, but it's more than doable.

My Linkdin looks a lot better than it used to as well as my resume.

Great professor! She quickly responds to emails and is super helpful. The class itself is great and helped me a lot.

Good professor overall and definitely cares about students.

Hayley Jensen is an amazing teacher!! I would definitely take her again! There were a lot of assignments that took a lot of time and effort throughout each week but they were worth it because I learned so much. She is always available and answers emails immediately. Take this class from her!!

For being an online class, I was impressed by how much the professor interacted with students through video and emails. This class really helped me pick a major and network. It got me out and trying new things. I would recommend for anyone trying to figure out what they want to do.
This class was not an easy A or something to take for 2 easy credits. It was way more work than a 2 credit 117 level class should be. Be prepared to do lots of work every week for this class.

Career Exploration is a good and simple class. It helped me a lot with figuring out what I want in my future career without a super heavy work load. This online class was something that was simple in my schedule and was always easy to maintain.

This class is very chill and a great class to take when you don't know what to major in. I am undecided and took this my first semester. The work load is very easy as long as you stay on top of it, and they give you a bunch of great resources.
MY DIVA. LOVE HER. Actually best singer to ever grace my eardrums and the nicest woman alive.

Dr. Pierce is wonderful. Her class is very well organized and she covers the material with care and depth. Best class at BYU fr. The content has changed the way I view the world SO MUCH and Prof Pierce is so lovely.
