Hinckley was fine but lame he charges so much for the textbook he wrote. If you dont have music experience, highly suggest dont take class. He expects u to know 500 terms and concepts each exam, be able to identify by ear the composer, genre, and time period for 14 music pieces, identify 30 different instruments by ear. So freaking hard for a GE!

Didn't expect to like this class, but Professor Hinckley was epic. He made the course enjoyable, and kept it easy enough that this class never got in the way of my others. If you keep up on listening assignments then review them once right before taking the exams, you'll find everything easy. Loved this class!
Prof. Hinckley made classical music history as fun as it could be.
Literally the easiest A. I never went to class and passed with an A.

Honestly never went to this class and still pulled out a good grade. I think the class is not exactly my choice subject, but Professor Hinckley is super funny and teaches great concepts about music. This is a great GE. There is also only a few assignments, but the tests can be hard if you're not paying attention or at least study good before.

Professor Hinckley was awesome. I took this class as my art credit/music minor. The lectures were super fun, and the class was pretty low-pressure. Got me to go to concerts, learned a lot, and overall feel like a more well-rounded person. Professor Hinckley was awesome and a seriously great person! Tests are online, not in the testing center:)
He is the BEST! Literally such a great class. So entertaining and useful and Im a business major. He is so humble, intelligent, and kind. I would take him every semester if I could.

Professor Hinckley is amazing. He understands that the majority of the students taking this class are only there for the art credit, and teaches accordingly. His assignments are really easy, and his tests are fair. You can tell that he is passionate about music and that he genuinely cares about his students. Take this class!

Dr. Hinckley is seriously amazing. His lectures match the reading assignments, and the homework is not time consuming at all. He does a great job helping the class prepare for the exams (there are 3 of them). I myself am not a good test taker but trust me, do you homework and studying and this is an easy A class! He wants you to succeed.

Professor Hinckley is so awesome!! I am not a musical person, but he has made this class enjoyable. He is hilarious and such an honest man. There are 3 exams and he does not try to trick you!! I would 100% recommend him.

I took this 3 credit Music class in an accelerated format in just 6 weeks. There were 3 exams, a few assignments, and 6 concert attendances required. If you know music at all this class will be a breeze. If you pay attention and learn about different genres and types of music, it will also be a breeze. Fantastic professor, and gives clear feedback.

One of the most useless and pointless classes taken so far. I attended the lecture once and self-studied by reading the textbook for the rest of the term. This class disappointed me -- I expected to learn more music history and appreciation than only the music pieces and dry musicians. Easy A, though.

Prof Hinckley is such an amazing professor. This was seriously one of my favorite classes at BYU. Make sure you do the readings and listening assignments and pay attention in class but that's pretty much all you need to do well. Anyone who says his instructions for assignments weren't clear was probably just not paying attention!

Professor Hinkley is so kind. He is very genuine and cares a lot about the subject. The class is enjoyable, relaxing, and easy. Just memorize those tracks, use his study guide, and you're set. Nicest guy.

Literally the best dude ever who is such a total nerd about music but its so cool and funny. He makes the class easy for everyone and as long as you show up for class you really should have no problem getting a high grade. But he literally is the coolest teacher ever

A super easy general class if you're looking for that art requirement. Dr. Hinkley is a really nice guy with a fairly easy class if you just do the reading or pay attention in class. There were 3 major exams (all online) and a few other assignments that didn't take a lot of extra time.

Prof. Hinckley did a fantastic job! Even if you don't like music I'm sure you would enjoy this class! He is a fantastic professor with clear grading expectations and wants you to succeed in becoming more educated about music and where it came from! Definitely would recommend this class to anyone who needs an art credit!

Prof. Hinckley is a great choice for this class. As long as you show up to every class, especially the test reviews, and take notes based on what he says, you'll do well on the tests and assignments. He basically tells you what you'll need to know for the tests while still teaching you and reinforcing the concepts through assignments. He's great.

I loved this class. He is an awesome professor who is funny and nice. He had the same structure for every class, so it was easy to follow and you knew what to expect. He said the things you need to know for the tests, and the other assignments are easy but informative.
Perfect option to complete arts requirement general. Tests were a breeze.

Take the sweetest and kindest man you could ever imagine, then give him an undying love for classical/romantic music--you get Dr. Hinckley. He's seriously such a good professor and as someone who didn't love those two formerly mentioned genres, I came out of this class feeling differently. Great sense of humor, nice and easy class. Take from him!

Honestly a really great professor. This is the only review I've ever given, but wanted to say I really enjoyed this class. He is clear about what will be on tests and if you can just memorize one key element from each song for the tests you will be fine. Easy A, interesting tidbits of music history, and a really nice guy. Plus extra credit!
Dr. Hinkley was a really nice guy. If you do the readings and listening assignments there is not much else to class. He does his best to make the lectures fun.
A doable class if you did the homework, especially if you have any previous music knowledge

Good class and professor! Some parts were hard, especially with the more obscure parts of music history, but he gave extra credit that helped to end up with an A. He's caring and overall it was a good class for my art credit.

Dr. Hinckley's Music 101 class is honestly the easiest GE class you could ever take! He has his own textbook, kinda expensive, but it is straight to the point, so readings are very short. He knows how to teach well and understands we are not experts in music. He clearly preparers for exams, assignments, and grades easily. Some memorization needed.

100% the best professor I have ever had. He is very funny, caring, and a skilled lecturer. He knows how to teach and how students learn the best. The reading doesn't take that long, listen to his lecture, do the assignments and listening, and you will be good. I really appreciated his personality too.

Music 101 at BYU is probably one of the most straightforward classes you'll have as far as GE's go. The course was On-Demand, yet Prof. Hinckley did present lectures via zoom if students wanted to attend. Class grading was straightforward; concert reports and tests being the majority of points in terms of grades. Overall, I would recommend him!

The class lectures were not helpful and the grading criteria was unclear at best for the assignments. All you need to do is listen to the music he assigns and you'll be ready for the tests, but it take a lot of time and is not enjoyable. Professor Hinckley was willing to answer questions but his answers weren't very helpful.

Would love to take another class from him. He gives super fun lectures especially towards the end of the semester. This is the first time I've laughed while taking tests because some of the questions are actually really funny.

Dr. Hinckley is a great professor and he is very passionate in helping his students understand music even though they might not have music backgrounds. His lectures are fun and very informative. The amount of pre-class readings is just about right. Everything is great in his class.
Excellent teacher! You can tell he cares about both the material and the students, so its really a wonderful class and he is a wonderful teacher

There was a lot of listening to music, but if you like learning about and hearing different types of music then it is super fun. I really enjoyed his lectures which were super helpful for the exams and reading the textbook is also really helpful. Overall, I really enjoyed this class and Professor Hinckley was a great teacher!

Super fun class, makes it interesting and applicable. Explains material well enough that even someone who's never played music or knows how to read it can pass!! Lectures were fun and engaging even though it was on-demand.

I took this class to fill a requirement, but it ended up being my favorite! You can really tell Dr. Hinckley loves what he's teaching, which was so fun. The tests aren't very hard, and he reviews what you need to know in class. The only slightly difficult thing was the listening examples, but they aren't even that bad. Definitely take this class!

Professor Hinckley actually liked teaching us! It was a miracle!! A professor who was so interested in his students and the subject that he taught was a rare sight to behold. He always answered our questions in great detail. Do what he says (he gives specific instructions) and you will get an A.

Dr. Hickley is such a great professor! I genuinely enjoyed all of his lectures and have learned so much over the past term. He makes every class so interesting and he is so funny! The hardest part about the class is memorizing the title, composer, and genre of 18-24 songs for every test but it was not too bad. Great class!!

This was an amazing class. I was hesitant to take this but as long as you read the book, take notes, and pay attention to lectures, he gives you all you need to good in the class. The only thing that was slightly harder but still easy was the listening parts of the exam. Professor Hinckley is awesome!

Dr. Hinckley makes learning music fun. I thought I knew all there is to know about music, but nope :) I loved this class and genuinely learned a lot! Dr. Hinckley teaches in such a fun but productive way. I looked forward going to class and I always left with a smile. The homework wasn't bad at all and the few projects we had were easy.

Professor Hinckley is an awesome teacher. He understands that MUSIC101 is a Gen Ed for most students, so he treats it that way! There was light reading, and everything he teaches in lectures is just review for the test. He's got a quirky sense of humor, and the tests aren't hard at all. BEWARE: There is a lot of listening to classical music! A LOT!

I took the online class. He's super caring & provides clear grading criteria such that you can succeed if you put in the work. Despite all the memorization required to ace the tests I actually enjoyed them. Great class for those even slightly passionate about music. I actually learned useful things in this class. Take MUSIC 101 from Dr. Hinckley!

Dr. Hinckley is the SWEETEST!!! I genuinely enjoyed his lectures and he was very interactive with the Zoom chat. The readings take like 2 minutes and aren't essential. There are about 20 songs you need to know for each of the 3 tests. You have to listen to them a lot but it's honestly not that bad. This was a super easy class!

I really liked taking this class from Prof Hinckley. He answers questions very thoroughly. Listen to all the recordings (obsessively if you can) and take notes on the readings and lectures. Studying is essential for the exams. And start early on the assignments! They arent difficult but they arent designed to be done last minute.
Dr Hinckley is a solid choice, you have to study a lot and memorize the song lists for the tests. If you only memorize the definitions of the terms, you will fail the test.

Brother Hinckley is a great professor & very passionate about music & has great lectures. Its a great online option & even better that you can take it for half the semester. I know NOTHING about music so I really struggled, & would not recommend for someone like me. But if your familiar with music, how to read it, & etc.. youll be fine.

I took Music 101 from Dr. Hinckley as an on demand class during a 6 week term. He is an amazing professor and is just super sweet. I loved his lectures but because it was a 6 week course, the lectures were very long. Overall a very easy class if you have a background in Music. I highly recommend him, because he genuinely cares about his students.

By far my favorite class this semester. Amazing professor! He wants you to do well in his class; he does not try to trick you on tests. He is very clear on expectations. It was a bit of work because I took it as a term class. Usually 1 assignment and reading per lecture. More difficult if you do not play an instrument. Extra Credit opportunities.

If you have played an instrument and can recognize instruments in an orchestra this is an easy class to pass. Very little studying required other than memorizing a few songs for each test, but even then he informs you of exactly what he wants. Clear and concise.

The class is fairly memorization heavy but the content isn't too difficult. Lectures are not required but strongly recommended as it isn't always clear what you need to remember from the textbook. There's also some music attendance assignments but they aren't too difficult or long (I was able to do 4 of the required 6 in a week). Would take again.
Very easy class even if you don't know anything about music. Do the listening assignments, it's a big part of the test, but it's easy if you're prepared.

Prof. Hinckley is a great teacher. He loves the course material and tries to help his students love it too. He understands that his class is a GE so he doesn't expect you to spend all of your time on his class. Memorize the terms on the study guide (focus on listening examples, their genres, and composers) and attend class and you'll do well.

Pretty easy class, not a for sure A, but still easy enough. Don't buy the textbook because you don't need it. Also, he says that you can't cram for the tests, but you totally can. Google docs group study guides really helped me out in this class, so I would advise using them. Just go to the concerts, cram for the tests, and you'll be fine.
This class is for people who like classical music. If you don't care for it don't take the class. Not nearly as easy as everyone on this said. Lots of memorization and very boring class periods.

I loved this class and the prof and it was an easy A+, but if you don't have experience in or a love for classical music, YOU WILL BE BORED AND HATE CLASS. This class really is what you make it. There's enough overlap between text and lectures though so you will def survive if you skip lectures here and there. Easy extra credit opportunities.

I recommend this class to all my friends who need an art credit. Super easy if you go to lecture and read all the material. Lectures aren't mandatory but are very helpful and pretty fun. Graded on 3 tests and a few short supplemental assignments. Easy A for sure, especially if you have music experience.

Class was mostly just going over what we were supposed to have read in the textbook (which I rarely did). Textbook was needed for extra credit though. Assignments were pretty simple, and you could always get his help. Tests weren't bad, but you should study for them, and make sure you know the works he's gone over.

Avoid taking Music 101 from Hinckley if you can. I took the class to fulfill the Arts Gen Ed requirement, and I really regret doing so. Everything you learn is taken from the textbook (which he wrote) and the lectures are bland and provide little insight. The class wasn't difficult, but it wasn't as easy as everyone said either.

We STAN Jaren. This class was a very easy GE, especially for people who have a background in music. He is funny and there is no required homework, just reading if you need it. You have to attend six concerts and you have to be able to audibly recognize pieces for the tests. I can understand the difficulty if you don't have any musical experience.

Professor Hinckley is kind. But if you don't feel you could memorize 30-45 minutes of classical music per test-knowing meters, genres, classical music time periods and all that goes on musically each time period, then don't take this class. It really has been a tough class for me. This is hands down the most work I've put into a 100 level class.

Prof. Hinckley makes sure that you know what is required of you, and the tests were very, very doable. He is very good at answering questions and his quirky humor is pretty endearing. Whenever I was stressed about my other classes, I would walk into this one and calm down.

Great teacher. Very organized. I never read the textbook and just learned everything I needed to know from attending class. If you study for the tests and memorize the song list, you will do well. I really enjoyed this class.

Dr. Hinckley was amazing. His textbook is clear and to-the-point, so you only have to learn what you really need to know. He makes every form, genre, and technique interesting and clear with explanations and audio examples. Plus, he is funny and makes the lectures entertaining. Extra credit is available, tests are easy, and assignments are simple.

EASY!!! You do not need to show up and this was honestly my napping class. I do not know anything about music and I got an A. Just listen to the assigned music and you'll be fine. All music on Apple Music and Spotify. As long as you follow the grading rubric, you will get 100% on all the assignments. I recommend taking this for an easy art credit.
Straightforward class. Light workload, great lectures, and easy grading criteria. He also updates grades within a few hours of your submitted assignment, which is nice.

Prof. Hinckley is AMAZING. Such a simple class, and I learned a ton. Be ready to go to 6 concerts during the semester, and definitely don't procrastinate. Also, be sure to do the listening assignments. He gives straightforward tests (w/ good study guides) and is very fair when grading assignments. If you are taking a music class, take it from him!

This class was fairly easy and I really appreciated how Prof. Hinckley didn't try to trick us on tests. He was very clear about what we needed to know and what he expected from assignments. There is a decent amount of memorization and you do need to attend some concerts, but that's really all. Readings are short, and Prof. Hinckley is super funny!

Professor Hinckley is great. This is probably the easiest class I've taken at BYU. His extra credit opportunities are really easy and he reminds everyone about the assignments coming up before most classtimes. His tests are easy if you use the study guides he provides. Keep up with the concert attendance and music listening and you'll be golden.

Would take again in a heartbeat. Very clear and makes it interesting. He basically tells you everything that will be on the tests so studying is simple. His tests are clear, honest, and have hints of humor. It's not often I've had to stifle a laugh in the testing center, but some of his sarcastic answers and fake concert programs have gotten to me.

The class was one term and when it was over I was genuinely sad! Jaren is extremely passionate about music but you don't need to know anything about music to do well in the class. Lectures are very very helpful, but I fell asleep half the time, didn't do the readings and just studied for a few hours before taking the tests and aced them

I didn't open the textbook once and got an A. The class isn't about music theory knowledge after the first test. It might not always be the most engaging, but he'll listen to questions and things. You have to go to 6 art (classical) music concerts outside of class. You also have to recognize piece, composer, genre from an audio file on the tests.

Consider taking a different GE. Professor Hinckley is so over-the-top about this stuff that if you're not pursuing music as your major, this class is so boring. There isn't really any in-class prep for the tests, and it was hard to see how everything connected. Disjointed, boring, and subpar experience in this class.

THE WORST!! Avoid Hinckley at all costs. He teaches this course as if music is everyone's passion. The tests and material are all pointless material that make me no better of a person or contributor to society for knowing them. Absolute waste of time coming to his lectures, as it seemed like just an excuse for him to play classical music he liked.

Awesome guy! Funny lectures and he makes them interesting. All the information is laid out in the lectures so while you can skip them, I would highly recommend going. The test aren't too hard but you do need to study.
Great professor. If you stay on top of your concert attendance and are good at memorizing, the class isnt too hard.
He's awesome! Very passionate about music and kind. He's an approachable guy. I wish he taught more classes. His exams are his study guides.

If you're just looking to complete your GE requirement, this is a great option. Tests are very straightforward - just follow the study guide and do the listening assignments you'll do great. He gives a few simple assignments, and requires attendance at 6 concerts outside of class, but those are easy to do. Overall, great guy and a pretty easy class

Easy to understand textbook, which he then provides great examples for in class. Great class for fall and winter. Best 101 teacher. He's fair and fun. Six concerts with simple write ups, a couple other assignments, and interesting exams using the chrome books in the testing center. It's a very wholesome class, bland at times, but very worth it.

Not a lot to say, kind of a middle-of-the-road class that I won't remember in a year. Just put the work in and get an A. I did learn a lot of useful/cool stuff and the class had a pretty light work load. Hinckley did a good job teaching the material. You don't need to be a music person to do just fine.

Professor Hinckley was great. His class isn't easy but if you read and show up to class you will do well. I have no musical talent and know virtually nothing about music. However, if you do all the assignments and study for the tests, you will get the grade you study for. Make sure you are proficient in the listening portion!

I've played piano for a while and have sung in Chamber choir, but musical terms don't come easy to me, so it was a bit hard at times because the terminology can be confusing even to people with a background. He's really helpful; make sure you get a study group together to fill out the study guides for exams. Spend time on the listening assignments!

Lectures were always interesting and you can tell that he puts a lot of time into them. Assignments are generally easy and it is always very clear what you have to do on them to get an A. The tests require quite a bit of studying (to memorize the pieces you have to listen to), but the average score on them is always quite high.

Professor Hinckley is incredible at what he does. He is so organized in his material and makes it simple to get the grade you want. The readings take 10 minutes and the listening can be done while doing other things. He offers plenty of extra credit, and is very helpful if you reach out to him. Take this class if you need a low stress art credit.

Get ready to work your butt off all semester just to be one point off and not get the A you worked for as he absolutely refuses to help students grades. He makes his tests so unnecessarily hard for a 100 level class, especially when most if not all students are taking it for a GE. His lectures are very boring and you wont remember anything.

His exams made me laugh in the testing center. The proctors looked at me a little weird, but at least I can say I enjoyed the tests. Dr. Hinckley tries really hard to make class interesting and funny. I think even if you don't know classical music very well you can still learn to appreciate the story of how music evolved.

He's a fantastic professor! I took it as a term class that only met twice a week, so each class was 2.5 hours long. I was dreading music 101, but he makes it fun. He teaches with a flair and it's just a good class. He's reasonable and the grades are really easy. I'd definitely recommend!

Awesome class, loved the professor, easy extra credit and super interesting. Lectures cover the readings so one or the other but make sure to do all the assignments early as they can definitely creep up. TAKE THIS CLASS

Dr. Hinckley is awesome! He gives tons of extra credit. Even if you're not familiar with music, you can succeed because he teaches so well. If you play any instrument or sing, this class is a no brainer. The only downside is that you have to attend around 6 concerts and write about them, which takes a lot of time. Other than that, great class.

Professor Hinckley is a great music teacher! He is a good choice if you need an A for this general education class, and you will also learn so much about music from him! You will never listen to music the same way after this class.

Dr. Hinckley was very helpful in this class. He graded assignments shortly after you would submit them. He is very passionate about music and you can see that when he teaches. I highly recommend this class it was very doable. It is challenging that you do have to memorize pieces of music but he gives you opportunities to do extra credit

Look everyone says this class is easy but if you have NO MUSICAL background then it is tough. I just heard I needed to know all the songs. I am not kidding I knew all the songs perfectly and I would get solid 75% on the test. I'm not an idiot either...

The class was easy. Very easy to fall asleep so beware. He is very kind and very clear. The biggest thing is memorizing the songs for the test. If you do, you'll get an A. If you don't, easily a B or lower. Easy assignments. Remember, just make sure to memorize all the songs for the tests! That is the test! I recommend him for the GE.

This is the easiest class you will ever take. I stopped going to class after the first week and just made sure I memorized the pieces we were supposed to recognize for the test and got an A in the class.

If you have a background in music, this class will be a breeze. If not, it may be a more serious undertaking. Dr. Hinckley is a great guy who you can tell loves what he does. He wants his students to succeed and gives you the tools to do so (most organized Learning Suite I have ever seen!). It's an easy A, but also very rewarding if you let it be.

Professor Hinckley is a really great person and is very passionate about Music. He truly cares for each and every one of his students. However, if you do not have a solid background with Music, then you will spend many hours studying for each of the tests. Reasonable grading system, but it seems like a lot of time is lost in class.

Okay, I don't know how all these people got easy A's. If you don't enjoy listening to classical music and opera for hours and hours trying to remember certain composers, genres, and other stuff, dont take this class. It's a pain and unless you major in art it will not benefit you in any way. Studied for 5 hours for the first midterm and got 67%.

Professor Hinckley was one of the easiest professors that I have ever had. He gives you study guides for the test and as long as you know the selected music to be memorized, you're golden. 11/10 would recommend.

Dr. Hinckley is the perfect teacher for this class. He's so passionate about music history and is excellent at explaining stylistic changes from different eras. Going to class is optional because the book is pretty good; however, his lectures clarify really any questions you might have. Also, there are lots of opportunities to receive extra credit.

LOVE DR HINCKLEY! TAKE THIS CLASS!! Easiest A you will ever get. He is so clear in his teaching and grading, and 100% willing to help or discuss grades, etc. Tests are super easy and you always know exactly what to study. Lots of extra credit opportunities. I took it just 2nd term and it was a breeze so a semester would be literally nothing. DO IT!

Hinckley is amazing. Absolutely must take this class from him. Super accessible, not trying to trick anyone, and great instructor. I had an A but still considered dropping the class just so I could take it again. He's one-of-a-kind. And I learned a ton about music

Music 101 is dry for anyone except people obsessed with music history. Dr. Hinckley made it as interesting as it can be. I laughed a few times, fell asleep a lot of times, and got annoyed by his extra story telling about once a week. Fine class, easy A, average professor.
I LOVED THIS CLASS AND TEACHER!!! This class helped me develop a deep appreciation and passion for music, as well as the development of it. I will keep this textbook forever.

I am not a musical person but this class with Hinckley was incredible. I took it Spring semester, and finished the semester with a 101%. He gives three tests (2 mid terms and 1 final). Grading is fair, and you know exactly what to study for and how to complete assignments! You're required to memorize musical pieces and composers-just listen daily.
Holy easy class all you have to do is go to 6 concerts throughout the semester and study the study guide for the test. I stopped going to class after the first midterm. Easy A
Hinckley is THE MAN. Enough said. He was the clearest, and most fair professor I've had my entire time at BYU. Take him to fill the GE or if you're a music major. You won't regret it.

Professor Hinckley is the best professor I've had so far! His lectures and even the exams are very funny. You don't have to do much work, just keep up with the reading, and go to concerts.  The reading is just a couple pages for each class. The only semi-difficult part is the music recognition on tests if you're not good at discerning between music
Professor Hinckley made music 101 enjoyable! Do the listening assignments and go to the concerts, and you'll get an A for sure.

Honestly, you don't really need to go to class because he teaches directly from the textbook. However, go every once in a while just because he's funny and has good lectures. Don't wait until the day before the test to do all the listenings. I did that all semester and still got an A, but it was a pain. Overall had a good experience in his class!

Easiest A and I didn't even read a sentence out of the textbook, so don't buy it.  Dr. Hinckley is always so well prepared for his classes and he is good at keeping lectures very interesting.  I thoroughly enjoyed this class, and I took it as a term class.  He gives breaks in between the long lectures so it's not bad at all.  Take this class!!

I loved Dr. Hinckley's class! For people with no music knowledge, this class is great! You don't have to read the textbook; he explains everything in class. I read it anyways because it takes (at most) four minutes. YOU MUST DO REQUIRED LISTENING FREQUENTLY; this is most of his exam. Attend six concerts as well.
This class requires that we listen to music on Naxos. Naxos is very unreliable and buggy, and you can expect your grades to suffer when you can't get it to work throughout the semester.

Dr. Hinckley is great! You use his textbook for all of the course readings and his lectures are mostly pictures of his travels, so you only have to read the book and do the recorded listening assignments to get a decent grade. Extra credit assignments are easy--do them!! If you're looking for an easy arts credit, this is a great option.
A good, funny, and kind professor. 2 1/2 hr long lectures can drag a bit, but he manages to keep things interesting. Solid choice.

Prof Hinckley is a SOLID CHOICE. I took this class for a GE credit, and I don't regret any part of it. The only thing is I wouldn't take it as a term class because 2.5 hour lectures get pretty boring. Also, prior music knowledge isn't necessary, and the tests and mini-projects aren't bad. 11/10, def recommend

Dr. Hinckley is hilarious, kind, and exciting to listen to. This is an easy A, especially if you have ANY music background. You are required to attend 6 concerts and write a short paragraph about them.  There is one recorded music project (took me 10 minutes), EXTRA CREDIT OPPORTUNIT, 2/3 midterms and a final.  He only teaches this class, so do it!

Looking for an easier GE that you can fit in with your harder classes? This is it! Dr Hinckley knows his stuff and is very passionate about it. You will learn a lot without being overwhelmed. Tests are very straightforward if you do the reading and listening. 6outside concerts with 3 requiring 1-3 sentences  of reporting.  Highly recommended class!
One of the best professor I met in my life. Lectures are great and hilarious. Exams are not hard, just read the textbook and do the listening assignment and you'll do well.
Doctor Hinckley genuinely cares about all of his students, and he absolutely loves the material he teaches. He is very clear about the course requirements and the tests. His test reviews are amazing!

Hinckley was my favorite teacher last year. He was one of the most entertaining teachers I ever had. You spend the entire class period just listening to good music. You can't go wrong there. It is easy to get an A. Definitely would recommend.

He is so funny. He's one of those cool music nerds who knows a lot of random facts that are actually interesting. The grading criteria is clear as crystal on the syllabus. Read it. If you don't follow the instructions exactly for a concert report you will get a 0. Listen to the music samples and follow the study guide for tests and you'll do fine.

Professor Hinckley is a really funny guy.  Attending lecture is not mandatory to do well on the tests.  I just read through the textbook and study guide before each exam and got an easy A.  Make sure you study a lot for the listening portion too! He also offers extra credit and the assignments are super easy/ straight forward.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU DONT LIKE MUSIC.  If you don't know how to read music, then you will struggle with terminology and with the homework.  he just talks about his trips across Europe, this makes lectures boring and feels worthless. the tests are hard. study.  it's hard to take notes due to lack of powerpoints with a clear objective.

If you're going to take Music 101, take it from Dr. Hinckley. He loves what he does, his class is a safe environment, and he always answers emails and questions kindly and makes sure you get it. His tests are straight forward, a little bit of work, but nothing you can't handle. Not a class you need to worry about consuming all your time.
You really need to keep up on the homework. There are listening assignments which are pretty time-consuming.

Professor Hinckley always gave the best lectures. You don't have to read the textbook before class, he explains everything in lecture. Tests are moderately difficult, but nothing you can't get an A on.

This class is a great choice to fill a general. You just have to do the readings and go to concerts. Listenings are harder than you think but if you put in the time, you'll do fine. Prof Hinckley is quirky and fun and made this class enjoyable.
Awesome guy. His Music 101 class is pretty easy. If you attend class and pay attention, you won't need to study much for the tests in order to get a good grade.

I don't have a lot of musical experience, but I thought this class was pretty easy. Going to class was helpful for me because he showed examples of musical techniques in the textbook. If you're musically inclined,  you don't need to go to class. Just do the listening assignments and attend the concerts, and this class will be a breeze!

Hinckley really cares about the material and about making music more a part of our lives. If you are musically inclined, you'll love this class. It will be an easy A as long as you do the listening and attend the concerts. If not, it might be a lot to take in right at the beginning.

This class is one of the easiest classes I have ever taken. He wrote the textbook so everything he talks about in class is in the book. Going to class is interesting and fun but you don't really need to go. I knew nothing about music before and simply skimmed the textbook to study for the test. The hardest part is that he makes you go to 6 concerts

Even if you know music, like me, this class is still super hard. Dr. Hinckley really knows a ton about music, but he didn't realize that in Music 101 a lot of students don't. He should not have been teaching an intro class. His tests are super hard and even though I never missed a class I had to study like crazy before every test.

Dr. Hinckley's class was very clear. If you stay on top of the listening (you listen to music for 10-20 mins a day) and you stay on top of the readings, you'll do well. This class was pretty easy and if I had to I would take this again.

Dr. Hinckley is awesome. He is very clear on what you need to know to receive an A. As long as you learn what he outlines, tests will be a breeze. Lectures are entertaining and insightful. Overall, I really enjoyed this class.
I loved this class. Dr. Hinckley genuinely cares about his students and is very helpful. I learned a lot! If you're willing to do the work (there isn't much) you can definitely get an A.
Dr. Hinckley is a good professor that is very clear and easy to understand. Funny too. Highly recommend.

Easy A. Many people don't attend class and they do just fine, however lectures are interesting. He has a lot of passion for what he teaches and helps you understand. I found the class enjoyable because it gave me a new appreciate for music. Good GE class!

Professor Hinckley's lectures are very interesting! Although probably not mandatory for passing the class. Either read the book or go to class, if you do one or the other you should be fine. There are only a few tests but they are more difficult than you would expect for a 101 class. Make sure to do listenings and watch the videos.

This class was really easy. He says class attendance is important, but his lectures cover the exact same thing the reading assignments do and has all the information you need. I rarely ever attended class and did very well just by doing the assignments and reading on my own.

Professor Hinckley gives long lectures about the lives of each composer during the class instead of focusing on the music itself and it's progression through history. All of his tests focus on if you can recognize the music being played and there isn't anything about the lives of the composers.

Professor Hinckley is amazing. His lectures are engaging and interesting. I hated music history before his class. Getting good grades is easy; listening sections on tests are a little challenging but doable if you study. The extra credit is super helpful and is quick and easy to do. 10/10 would take again.

Listening to "listening assignments" is essential to pass exams. Really nice guy. Has clear grading criteria and is very strict about following the criteria. The times I talked to him personally was a little uncomfortable, but I might have just caught him at a bad time because he is always upbeat during lectures. Easy class. Good lectures. Take it.

This class is boring, but easy. I missed some classes & still did well. (Do attend enough to stay connected, though.) Do the reading, listen to the music (KNOW IT WELL), take the tests and quizzes, and attend the concerts. The music is pleasant, and Professor Hinckley is fine. It's just a very large class, so it's not engaging. It works as a GE.

Dr Hinckley is a gem. I learned so many things in this class that I never would have learned otherwise, and I'm grateful I took this class. He can be a little smug, but he's an interesting guy. Class isn't mandatory, but it helps a lot.

I think doctor Hinckley is super funny. Going to class helps but you can get away with doing the readings and listening assignments diligently and still get an A while not going to class. Just make sure you do the listenings when you are supposed to and go to your concerts early.

This class was pretty easy. I don't have a musical ear and was really worried about the listening parts of the test. I still ended up with a high A in the class just because you basically get full credit on every assignment and he has extra credit opportunities.

This was one of my favorite classes this semester.  Brother Hinkley taught me all sorts of things about music.  I'd recommend this class to anyone.  This class gave me a new appreciation for symphonic music
Dr. Hinckley is awesome and funny. The class was a breeze and I learned a lot. Probably could have missed a lot of class and still got an A. Loved the class.

Great professor. He knows his stuff. Also, just a really fun class. Every test really was easy.  Of course you have to study, but as long as you follow and study the things on the study guide you will get a 100. The class was huge, so I never really got to talk with him or work close with him, but  that's pretty normal for these huge GE classes.

This class is a great GE. Super easy. Professor Hinckley is not the most friendly professor, but his grading criteria is very clear and it is all based on a point system. If you listen to the music, do the reading, and turn all the assignments in on time then you'll be fine. Class was pretty boring, but it's obvious he loves it so that helps it.
So boring. He dims the lights and then plays classical music. I got a decent amount of sleep for the first time in college. Sweet.

Professor Hinckley is great! He has this dry sense of humor (I liked it), and that makes his class much more entertaining. He is pretty much obsessed with composer puns. I LOVED the music for the class (some iTunes downloads were made). I studied pretty hard for the tests- especially the listening portions- and did ok. Not too much reading.

Hinckley lets you know exactly what he expects and it's up to you to do it. Don't do the assignments late and expect leniency. Keep up with the quizzes (you only have 1 day to do them but can take them twice) and concerts, do the extra credit for easy points. Get to 404 points on the semester and you earn an A. I liked how Hinckley does this class.

Fantastic professor. I took the music 101 as a block course instead of a semester course. With the decreased amount of time the class sessions had to be longer, but even though this was the case I really enjoyed it. This professor is fantastic.

Great teacher and a really great class. It went over a lot of composers during the different musical periods. Tests were easy if you study the study guide that he gives to you. Quizzes were all open book. All in all it was a good and easy class.

Dr. Hinckley is very clear and easy to understand. It's really a music history class so you aren't expected to read music or anything. You'll learn about composers and music genres, the lectures are really interesting. The homework is very manageable and it's easy to get an A if you don't procrastinate. Go to all 6 concerts as early as you can.

I loved Dr. Hinckley! He knows his stuff and he is so passionate about it, which made learning from him fun. There are 5 or so online quizzes that are open note open book and a midterm and a final. I imagine tests would be pretty hard if you don't study, just look at the study guide and DO THE LISTENINGS!!

I've always wanted to take a basic music history class, so his music 101 was perfect. I could skip when I wanted and not miss anything! But his lectures were great because he took the chance to tell a lot of stories. I just made sure to go to the concerts and spend a couple hours reviewing the music and material before each test, and I was fine.

I loved this class! Not only was it super easy, but I actually ended up learning a lot. Dr. Hinkcley is super funny and the lectures were a lot of fun. Homework consisted of reading (only a few paragraphs at a time), listening assignments, and concert attendance. There was one midterm, and the final wasn't comprehensive. Take this class!!

This class is good and the day-to-day stuff is really easy! Keep up on the homework and listening assignments because the tests can be pretty tricky! Do all the "bonus points" and attend concerts, and you will be sure to get an A!

Prof. Hinkley is a great professor! Attendance isn't mandatory, but it helps with the tests, and his lectures are usually pretty enjoyable if you're interested in learning about music. There are only 2 tests, and if you study for them they are easy to pass, plus they are pretty funny! Take MUSIC 101 from him, you won't regret it!

Loved Music 101. Prof. Hinckley is so funny! Class isn't mandatory (although helps a lot with tests), and it is actually interesting if you like music. Tests need to be studied for but aren't too difficult. The textbook (written by him) if also funny and very easy to understandfollow. Tests have funny questions--laughed out loud in testing center.

His lectures are quite entertaining, I never dreaded coming to Music 101! I learned a lot in this class! He's pretty strict on his rules; there's not a lot of wiggle room if you don't follow directions precisely. Overall would recommend. He's a nice guy but seems to have a bit of an ego, which turns away some but I found that it was bearable. (:

Very passionate about his subject. I thought he was funny and found a way to make something i had no interest in somewhat entertaining.  Class isn't hard if you do the homework. This class made me sorta like classical music, and some background basics for music.

HInckley comes across as condescending and uses large words for no reason. That being said, he is a nice guy and his testsquizzes are pretty straightforward. Not my favorite class ever, but he is fairly easy. 1 midterm1 final, both 100 questions. Overall, I'd recommend him.

Dr. Hinckley is extremely intelligent, and he helps you appreciate music more. I recommend this professor if you are just trying to fill your Arts credit. You have to go to six concerts throughout the semester, so go to the concerts early in the semester! There is not too much work in this class, only two tests, and the tests are fairly easy.

I loved this class. Dr. Hinckley is really funny and gives great lectures. Assignment due dates tend to sneak up on you, so make sure to get them done early. Make sure you read the textbook and listen to the assigned music.

Boring Lectures, He talks about his travels to Europe. There are no assignments throughout the semester except for 6 concerts and a few open book quizzes online. He has a dry sense of humor. Lectures are not mandatory, he just teaches the same thing that is in his textbook.
Professor Hinckley has a major ego and speaks condescendingly to his students. Lectures are boring and mostly cover material that is irrelevant. Everything you need to know is in the textbook.

First off, this class should be called History of Music 101. For some reason I was expecting something a little different. He knows a LOT about music and classes can be interesting. I would say it would be really helpful to do the readings. You have to go to 6 concerts and you definitely have to study for the exams. Attendance is not mandatory.

If you like any type of music, take this class. Don't listen to the students below. This class is not hard. I got above a 91% on both tests and i knew nothing about music before this class.  I have never learned so much in a GE class or had so much fun preparing for tests-listening to beautiful music. Bro Hinkcley is a great teacher.

I took Hinckley for Music 101 block class and it sucked. Do NOT take his class as a block class. He might have been better if it wasn't a 2-hour class three times a week, but probably not. Boring lectures that didn't help with the test at all.

Every body gave Hinckley good reviews so I thought I'd take   his class for my art credit but let's be real, unless you're already into music, the class sucks. He is condescending and the midterm and final are pretty hard. I'd take intro to film for my art credit if I could do it again.

I took this class after reading the good reviews about this class and how easy it was. It was not at all what people said. Sure you can get by with very little effort during the year and be ok but the tests were incredibly hard and that is what your grade is based on. I'd say take another class to meet the requirement

This class was a lot of fun & one of easiest I've taken. 1st half of semester I stressed a bit, but once I got to 1st test, I was like "Oh, was that it?" Then I just enjoyed myself for the rest of the class. So do study, but don't stress. His new textbook (he wrote) is great, b/c it is like having a copy of his class notes, very concise & helpful.

This professor simply regurgitated what was in his textbook each class period. Listening portions on the tests were not always the listening pieces he gave beforehand. And upon specific questions about grading, he simply replied, "Everything is exactly as it should be."

LOVED this class. I thought I knew a lot about music before I took it, yet I learned a TON. Dr. Hinckley is a great professor; you don't really need to attend class but I enjoyed lectures enough I did. There is a midterm and a final with 5 short online open-book quizzes, and extra credit available. If you study, an A is very doable.

I LOVE THIS PROFESSOR! He's hilarious. His tests are funny, his lectures are interesting, and he's just a cool guy in general. I would recommend taking the full semester class rather than the block class, though. You have a certain number of concerts to go to throughout the course, and it's harder to get them in  during a month and a half.

LOVED this class. You could get away with skipping the lectures if you do the reading assignments and study hard for tests but I never missed one because they were enjoyable. Homework rarely exceeds the daily reading assignments that are very short & not even necessary if you pay attention in lecture. This class was easy, fun, and I learned a lot.

I stopped coming to this class after I took the first test. I have to admit that I studied pretty hard for the first test and got an 88%. There is 25 extra credit points that Dr. Hinckley offers so if you do well on the first test you really don't have to do well on the final to get an A in the class. The tests aren't easy so be prepared!

Dr. Hinckley is great, his class is fun and interesting. You can really learn a lot if you pay attention. He pretty much goes over what you read in class and shows examples of the concepts. Probably need to study a decent amount for the tests especially the listening portions. With all the assignments and extra credit its an easy A

Dr. Hinckley is AMAZING. He makes the class interesting while learning a lot. There is homework after every class but not a lot. He knows a ton about music and shared a lot of personal experiences, pictures and perspective. He runs the class very well and prepares you for the test extremely well. I would highly recommend Dr. Hinckley for music 101.

Dr. Hinckley genuinely cares about his students and tries to keep them interested all semester long. The course is pretty easy if you do your part, and Dr. Hinckley tries to make it as fun as possible. He's a great guy, and will always find a way to help all of his students out.
Dr. Hinckley is great.  I enjoyed this class as a time to relax and listen to good music. Just do the small amount of work he asks you to and you'll do great.

Professor Hinckley is amazing. An A in his class is easy if you're willing to put in some effort. Professor Hinckley is very helpful and understanding. One of the things I loved about his class is how he clearly loved the subject he was teaching. Music is clearly cool to him, so it helps the subject be cool to the students. Take this class!!!!
Go to class, take notes, listen to the music, and study a little every week, you'll be golden.

Easiest GE class! Plus he is a great teacher who makes the lectures interesting. He really cares about his students and wants them to do well. You have one midterm and then the final (gives study guides for both). Also, quizzes are open book/note! Take from Dr. Hinckley!
If you need an arts credit, take music 101 from HInckley. Ridiculously easy and he actually makes class interesting.

Great professor! Knew the material very well but didn't overcomplicate it. Tests weren't very hard if you know the listening examples. Very fair with the grading on concerts, etc. HIGHLY recommend this class!

I'm pretty sure I slept through every single lecture but still managed to do really well. His lectures really weren't that boring-I was just sleep deprived. He was really funny and fair. He was always willing to work with students and I highly recommend taking this class from him.

Hinckley is awesome! He is really funny and makes the lectures really fun and interesting. I would definitely take another class from him. The tests are slightly difficult but you will do well as long as you study the listening examples!
GREAT professor. I have no interest in this subject, but I actually really loved this class. It is extremely easy if you go to class and use the study guide. So glad I took this class!

Hinckley is one of the coolest guys at BYU. He knows his stuff, but he doesn't make music more complicated than it needs to be. Pay attention in class and/or read the books/do the listenings and all will be well. Tests aren't hard at all. But class is fun and interesting. Hinckley is the greatest!
Hinckley is the man. He helped me appreciate so many types of music and was super funny in the process. Take this class!

Easy class, easy A.  I personally did WAY poorly in the tests (including the final).  But I still got an A for doing my homework and finishing the fun and easy assignments of the class.  At first I was scared with the entire schedule.  But Dr. Hinckley is well structured and he does NOT want you to miss the A.  The class is fun, relaxing and EASY.

Everything that was on the tests were in his lectures and/or the textbook. He gave out very useful study guides. Sometimes he would tell personal stories in class which could make it feel like a waste of time OR could allow you to better connect to the composer on whom he was lecturing. Overall, good lecturer, organized, class came together nicely
Dr. Hinckley is really knowledgeable and easy. He is writing the 101 textbook for next year. I definitely recommend him for an easy GE class.

Dr. Hinckley is definitely the best choice for taking Music 101. He knows his stuff and is passionate about it as well. He also is not afraid of embarrassing himself which makes the class much more fun.
I think I went to class seven times the whole semester, and still had an A. Music 101 a super easy GE, take it from Dr. Hinckley.

Classical music appreciation made easy. Very informative and interesting, even to beginners. Spotify and iTunes cheaply replace the textbook & CD's. Go to class, the reviews, and drill yourself on the listening examples he gives (much less painful than it sounds), and you'll do fine. (If taking block class, attend as many concerts as you can ASAP.)

This class was awesome! I took it for as a GE and I loved it. Dr. Hinckley was an awesome professor. If he taught more GE classes I would take another one from him. He was funny and interesting. Tests are relatively easy as long as you fill out study the study guides before the tests. Overall, I would take this class again if I could. Take him!!

Professor Hinckley is one of the best teachers I have ever had. He is passionate and knowledgeable about his subject, and transfers that interest to his students. I've played piano for 15 years and still learned a lot, but even if you have no musical background, it's easy and fascinating. I would highly recommend it to anyone and everyone.

I am NOT musically inclined at all but I like this class.  Just crammed for tests learned the music examples and I got an A in the class. Hinckley is great.  Explains things very well.  Class was fun.  I would recommend it.  Nightly reading is not necessary.

Dr. Hinckley is a great professor.  He appears to have strong musical knowledge and an interest in his students' well-being.  His two tests were very easy after about an hour of study.  He requires students to attend six concerts.  It's best to complete these well before their due dates.  This has been one of my easiest and most enjoyable classes.

This class was great!  I loved Professor Hinckley.  He is funny and way nice. This class is fairly easy, which was nice because all of my other classes were hard.  Everything you do in the class is beneficial. I loved what I learned!
great teacher!

Best Music 101 teacher.  He knows and loves this material, and tells a lot of interesting and fun historical stories to keep the material alive.  His tests emphasize what he says in class more than what is in the textbook (though very similar), so I recommend going to class everyday so you don't miss an answer to a test question.

Dr. Hinckley's Music 101 class was amazing.  I took it in Fall 2010 as a block class, and even though the classes were in the evening, I enjoyed every one of them.  Dr. Hinckley is very knowledgeable and passionate about music, and that comes through in his teaching.  Do the homework and use the study guides, and you should do well on the test.

Loved this class. Dr. Hinckley is funny as heck some days, and his lectures are always interesting and informative. I developed a much greater appreciation for music in this class. Tests were easy if you went to lecture and did the reading/listening. This was easily my favorite class of the semester and one of the best I've had at BYU.
Dr. Hinckley is awesome! This class was super easy and super fun, and I enjoyed it very much. As long as you attend the lectures and do the assignments, you will do well.

Dr. Hinckley is great! Going to class was enjoyable as his lectures were filled with things about music that I had never known before. He takes interest in his students, even though there's hundreds of us, and he grades quite fairly. Go to the T.A. reviews, take good notes in class, do the assignments, and you will surely get an A.

Very nice, straightforward, easy enough. Listen to the songs like they're your new favorites! He'll tell you what songs will be on the test, so practice recognizing them, their composer, and knowing what they exemplify for that time period. Take good notes. the concerts weren't so bad, I used lots of student recitals-they're FREE.

Six concert assignments, a mystery music assignment, two exams, and a recorded music assignment is what is due. Go to the concerts on time! Easy class as long as you do the simple work. Hinckley is a hilarious professor who you can learn a lot from! Take this class from him!
Easy A if you complete all of the assignments (which is not hard) and study for the tests. Basically everything you need to know is on the study guide. He is really funny!

Dr. Hinckley is a good professor... when he's actually talking this class is somewhat interesting. If you don't like classical music, you'll be bored out of your mind when he's not talking (i.e., you're listening to music) but you can still do well in the class. It's not hard and Dr. Hinckley is very fair and very helpful considering the class size

Dr. Hinckley is hilarious and makes this class really fun! I enjoyed going to class. He keeps it interesting. The tests are not bad at all if you take good notes in class. The material is actually really interesting. Take this from Hinckley!
Hinckley is hilarious! I loved his Music 101 class. He reminds me of Will Ferrell a bit! He's a great guy and a great teacher. Easy course. Gaurenteed A with little effort.

This class was way easy.  You pretty much just have to go to a few concerts and you're set.  The tests are a piece of cake if you go to Melissa's review sessions.  They're way helpful.  Hinkley is a really fun professor and I actually learned a lot
take this class from him - easy, entertaining, informative.  go to melissa's ta reviews.

Good professor.  He posts study guides for his tests online which are very accurate descriptions of what you need to know for his tests.  He's got a great sense of humor, too.  Whatever you do, don't take the block class because the 2 and a half hours , twice a week will bore you to tears.  In one hour increments your attention span will fail you.

Dr. Hinckley is fantastic. :) A very interesting class, and a fun teacher. I learned a lot about music, but had fun doing it too. Tests are not bad, he prepares you well, as long as you do the reading/listening you'll do fine on them.

I absolutely loved this class! Dr. Hinckley is great! You can tell he loves teaching and wants his students to do well. Loved going to class, but even if I missed it was easy to get caught up. Just do the reading and listen to all the examples and you'll do really well. Everyone should take this class and take it from Dr. Hinckley!

I LOVED THIS CLASS! I wasn't very interested in classical music before I took this class, now I love it. This class is easy if you attend every class period. There are only 2 tests - midterm and final, and also you are required to go to a certain number of concerts, which was fun. If you need to take this class, I highly recommend this teacher!

This class was so much fun! When you take notes during lectures and listen to the examples that he gives you way before the exam, you'll do great in this class. His lectures were never boring because he makes so many jokes. The exam prep sessions with his TA were VERY helpful!!! So, go to these sessions!
Easy class as long as you memorize the vocab before each test and listen to the examples he lists online. Go to the concerts early in the semester so you don't get behind.
Super easy class and tests as long as you go to class and know the vocab words he taught. Dr. Hinkley is really funny and easy to talk to if you need help.

Dr. Hinckley is great! The classes are fun and very informative. I was in a huge class of about 300 people, but I still felt comfortable approaching him and asking questions. If you can, definitely take Music 101 from him. It was one of my favorite classes this semester.

I highly recommend Hinckley for Music 101. He was funny, entertaining, and his class was pretty easy. I laughed out loud in the testing center on several tests. Go to class and listen and you'll get an A.

Take this class!!! Easy, but I feel like I learned a ton and now I appreciate classical music.  Tests are a breeze, just go to class and study lecture notes. Hinckley is so funny and his lectures aren't boring even though he uses powerpoint.
Loved this class. Professor Hinckley is funny, knowledgeable, and fairly easy. Tests are wholly based on lecture, and very reasonable. Completely worth your time.

Professor Hinckley is the EVER. I just loved his class. I have never had music classes, and it was harder for me then for the rest of the class and I still managed to get an A-. I could have easily gotten an A. He is the funniest person Ever. I loved this class.I`m sure it would be boring in any other case,but he knows when to be funny,it was great

Easiest 3-credit GE at BYU.  Don't let the syllabus and the first day intimidate you, this class is cake.  Hinckley makes lecture interesting and I acquired a greater respect for classical music.  Half of the test questions come from listening samples, and he even tells you beforehand what pieces to listen to. My least stressful class ever at BYU.
Dr. Hinckley is the best! Just take notes in class and listen to the listening that he assigns for his exams and you will ace this class. This class is really easy and very enjoyable.

Alright. I know "music history" might sound a little boring at first, but it's really not. Hinckley always manages to keep it interesting, and you don't really have to do the reading. If you just listen to the examples he lists and go over your notes before the test, you'll get an A. Yeah, you have to go to 8 concerts, but it's really not that bad.

If you have a background in music this course will be cake for you. The lectures were a little boring but I liked Dr. Hinckley's taste in classical music. There are 8 concerts you have to go to but they're no longer than an hour and a half an hour, they won't kill your social life. I never cracked the textbook open once and I aced this course.
Great class. Easy as pie...just make sure you know the songs, their author, and genre. I made 90-98% on every test. If you pay attention in class you really don't have to study. TAKE IT FROM HIM!

Hinckley is so awesome. Great, funny guy, interesting classes, really flexible with deadlines if you just talk with him in person. There are 8 concerts you need to attend as it's a huge part of the grade, but I ended up enjoying the concerts. Tests are essentially straight out of the book. Study hard the day of, take the occasional note, get an A.

Dr. Hinckley was an exceptional professor. He was very knowledgeable and did an outstanding job explaining concepts that were difficult to understand. Take good notes and listen to the music that he says you need to know for exam and you will get an A

This guy is awesome.. exams are easy and are all structured the same way. He is very chill on missing deadline dates and if you know the concepts he discusses in class you will get near 100% every time.

I love Prof. Hinkley and I love this class! 8 concerts required, but this professor is the greatest! Definitely recommend him! Tests are fine if you go to class and study a little before. He is just an awesome teacher and I enjoyed this class everyday!

I freaking love Dr. Hinckley. This was my favorite class this semester. You can just read the book and do fine on the test, but don't because the lectures are really good. He's so funny and makes the topic really interesting and fun. Even though I have a music background, I still learned tons in this class. Definitely the best GE I've ever taken.

This was possibly one of my favorite classes. Prof. Hinckley did a wonderful job at keeping our 2.5 hour night class entertaining. Tests were easy if you just came to class and listened to the assigned music. Most people got this class confused with the Music 190 class, which is the notes, chords, etc. in music. Wonderful class, wonderful teacher!
This class was really easy but at the same time really pointless.  Don't read the book. Class attendance isn't mandatory if you just cram right before the test for an hour.

This class should be titled "History of Music."  Subject matter is very boring and irrelevant.  If you are looking for a music class where you actually learn about notes and written music, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.  I just studied for an hour before the test and got A's.  I never read the book.  I hated this class because the subject matter is stupid
very fun class. tests are very fair. even during a 3 hour night class, hinckley was able to keep it interesting and i learned a lot.

Awesome teacher, lots of fun if you just laugh along with his jokes. You either read the book or go to class, but not both. He'll take questions like you're in high school still. Review sessions are not necessary. Just have fun. Love Jaren.

He's great. He's funny, clever, introduces the material in a clear, interesting, and fun way. You don't have to understand music before hand to get a good grade in the class. I wouldn't take the night class though- too much information for once a week. Do the readings, study the music excerpts and you'll get an A. Fun class!

Music 101 was one of the best classes I have ever taken. Hinckley's class great because it was quite easy but very interesting at the same time. Hickley is a really friendly guy - he memorized my name in a block class with over 100 students

Brother Hinckley is a great teacher. He makes class interesting and fun and he has a funny sense of humor. He tells lots of interesting and weird stories that keep class entertaining. As long as you do all the readings and listen to the music examples the class is fairly easy.

This class is very useful and easy, however the actual classes are rather boring.  Tests are not tricky whatsoever, simply tests knowledge.  Not a lot of busy-work, although the eight concerts we have to go to are a pain.  Hinkley is witty and entertaining.
not terribly difficult, but class is a waste of time

This is a great class and a great teacher. There is a lot of knowledge gained about music, and it is a very easy class. Tests are easy, concerts are great. Just go to class and take notes. Dr. Hinckley is very willing to help students
Great teacher! He really knows how to interest the students in the subject. His tests were great, and I loved attending his lectures.
Take this class from Dr. Hinckley! Very informative, made it fun! Study pretty hard for exams, but other than that your homework is listening to music. It doesn't get better than that!

This class is really easy, especially if you have ANY background at all in music.  He makes lectures entertaining by telling crazy stories about composer's lives.  Know the listening examples very well, otherwise the exams are pretty easy, since he goes over and over the tested material in class.

This class is easy and fun. Dr. Hinckley does an excellent job at teaching. The tests are really easy. and the final is the last test of the class. Just study the terms from the syllabus and listen to the music a lot. You have to attend 8 concerts and those are really easy. Easy A.

I cannot relate how easy this course is IF you attend each class, take meticulous notes, attend the concerts, memorize the terms he gives you for each exam, and cram 3-4 hours before exams. And there are so many hot girls in the class; be sure to talk to them at the concerts you go to because it's an easy way to get dates!
He's a great teacher.  The class is potentially hard, but do the listening exercises and go to lecture and it should be good.

Tests are ridiculously hard. You have to memorize a bunch of songs then he plays a tiny snippet of some of them and expects u to know the name, title, composer. Most songs sound exactly the same. Even if u heard it before, he wont play the main theme, so u wont recognize it in the snippet on test. The rest of his tests are just trivia from class.

This guy is great! There were several times I just broke out laughing at his questions on the test. This is a potentially hard class and he teaches it with with crystal clarity. Just pay attention in class and do the listening examples. You probably will not find a better teacher in the music program. Great sense of humor.

He is a good teacher because he gets really into the music and the concepts and the history. He makes it so interesting and intriguing. There is a lot of reading and the tests are kind of hard because you have to memorize the song, title, and composer. Have to attend concerts and report on them but only 1 paragraph. He makes it soo interesting!

This was one of the funnest classes I've ever taken.  If you put forth just a little bit of effort you will do just fine in the class and still learn so much.  He was really funny too--has some hysterical questions on his tests.  Highly recommend taking Music 101 from Prof. Hinckley!

Easy class!!! All you really need to do is study the vocab on the list he gives you(the one with the last name assignments), show up to class, and know the title, composer, genre, and concept that applies to each listening example. Great class! Highly recommended!

You don't need to read at all.  He only goes over the bold words in the text.  He'll go over every definition during class, and that's what is on your test. Study the listening examples thoroughly. He's nice and funny too.  I learned so much

I enjoyed this class. Class time is slow, bring your textbook and do the reading then. The tests were easy, he never tested on composers' life story, which helps you skip about 1/4 the reading in the book. The 8 concerts is annoying, he changed the deadlines for our class and that made it easier. Nice guy, loves his subject and teaches it well.
Really easy class. Basically if you do the reading (not too bad), go to class, listen to the songs, know the genres, and know a little detail about the genre you will ace everything.

Professor Hinckley makes Music 101 fun and interesting. He has extremely clear and fair tests and grading policies. If you know the vocab and listening examples for the tests and go to all 8 concerts, you will get an A for sure. Definitely take this class!

Love music but I absolutely hated this class. You sit there and only listen to the kind of music that he likes. The tests are far too dificult for a 100 level class & unless you listen to the music weeks ahead of time you won't pass the test. Have to attend 8 concerts, which is extremely difficult unless you have no life beyond this class.
Really easy unless you dont have a musical background.  In that case the class is very difficult unless you do the reading, which is a lot. Funny guy tho and makes the class fun

Dr. Hinckley is so great.  He is a great teacher whether you care about classical music or not.  One of those few guys who understands that his class may not be the most important thing in the world to his students, but does an awesome job in case it is important to you.
This is a great class. It is fun and you learn a lot of stuff~!The class is overally easy but you still have to put considerable amount of time to study.However, if you study,an A is yours.....

Awesome teacher! I loved his class; it's very fun and easy if you show up to lectures and pay attention. He makes the class fun with tons of examples, and he's a funny guy. Highly recommended for a fun class and super easy A.

Very fun class! I actually learned quite a bit and the classical music grew on me as the semester went on. I really enjoyed the lectures. This class is definitely a class you can get an A in as long as you get to the 8 concerts you have to go to.
Super easy, super boring class.

Awesome guy. I did bad on the first test, because I didn't know the listening examples. The rest of the tests, I made sure to get the listening examples down, and I went to one review session. I was in the 90's every test after that. Just go to concerts and know the listening examples. Easy A if you put in just a TEENY bit of time.

This was a great way to fill up the GE.  Hinckley was awesome and made class pretty fun.  There were 4 midterms, and one final - tests were very practical and actually measured knowledge you had gained rather than if you could understand the question (a novelty at BYU).  You also need to attend 8 concerts during the semester.  Overall, great class.

Dr. Hinkcley's class is pretty easy and an A is definitely achievable.  I rarely go to class and have gotten 90% on all the tests.  His lectures are pretty laid back and fun, and he plays a couple songs and music clips each day.  Fun class

Easy class! I hardly went to class. I just skimmed the reading and memorized the bold terms/listening examples and got A's on all the tests. Once you get used to him the class can be pretty fun. You will never use this information again though.
Memorized the bold terms for the test and you'll get an A. Easy class.

One of my all-time favorite classes.  I didn't actually enjoy "art music" before this class, but now I actually appreciate it.  The concerts are fun if you can find people to go with, and the work load is a piece of cake, just read the book, do the listening, go to class and enjoy!  Dr. Hinckley doesn't throw any surprises at you.
Professor Hinckley is by far my favorite professor.  I love going to class beacuse it is entertaining and relaxing.  i highly recommend it!

Easy A.  But class is really boring.  Just cause you like music doesn't mean you will like this class.  I will never use one thing I learned in that class ever again.  Totally pointless and boring, but an easy A.  Don't expect to listen to great music, although some might like it.

Great teacher! Really enjoyed his class. Funny because he's dorky, so class if fun. Know the listening examples, know terms & applications. Pretty easy, just attend some concerts and a few relatively easy tests that each cover a music time period.

If you want an easy A, take this class! The tests are super easy, plus it is really interesting. I learned a lot, and Prof. Hinckley is really interesting to listen to. If you even like music a little bit, you will enjoy this class.
I absolutely love Dr. Hinckley- he's an amazing teacher.  As long as you attend the concerts and keep up with the reading, you're pretty much garanteed a good grade.
Going to class isn't really necessary, just reading the book and going to concerts is enough.  Just remember to pick up your concerts when they're returned.
Great class--not very difficult.  He is a FABULOUS teacher who really cares and is really interesting.  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

This is not a hard class.  Do the readings before class if possible--they're usually pretty short.  Lectures are helpful.  You have to go to eight concerts and write a short paragraph about four of them--not hard.  I actually like classical music, even opera, now.

I really enjoyed this class.  Dr. Hinckley was great- very entertaining, and the class was not hard to do well in.  Just make sure you attend the concerts and turn in the concert reports on time.  Do that and study the listening examples and you'll do great.

Really Good Teacher.  Class is very interesting.  Very funny.  An easy class.  If you go to class and don't read the book you will probably get a B+ if you go to class and do the readings, which are not hard, you should get an A.

With this class, you either had to go to class or do the reading...i don't believe both was necessary to pass with a good grade.  Honestly, going to class was fun, even if you have a musical background, and it sure beat reading!  Tests weren't bad at all...came straight from his lectures.  I highly recommend this class.

This class is great if you're Molly Mormon and love to laugh at jokes that are so corny and hollow that they should be against the law.  Hinckley spent half the class trying to get his dumb iPod to play the songs and even then, unless you've beenplaying the piano your whole life you wouldn't understand him.  I'll puke if I ever his jokes again.
Dr. Hinckley makes his class fun (but not necessary) to be at. it is very easy, and there is little work to be done for it. study the listening examples closely for the tests and you will ace them.

super easy class.  quizzes at the very beginning on BB but then that's it. 5 exams total..final exam is not cummulative.  each exam is on a different era. no need to go every class, rambles about composer's lives a lot. have to memorize 9 songs for each exam & need to know composer and title. no quizzes except for the 2 at the beginning. easy A
