Jim Brau has been my favorite professor at BYU so far. He is super spiritual and really cares about the well-being of his students. He pays for a great TA team to assist students throughout the semester that are very accessible. Taking notes on his lectures is extremely easy. Just make sure you study hard for the tests.

Professor Brau was great! He gives great entertaining lectures. The textbook really helps you learn how to do the problems, but his notes from class help you learn some specifics you need to know from the tests. Getting good grades on the tests are not hard if you do all the practice problems in the textbook and the practice exam.

Dr. Brau is the best! He bases your grade on tests only (4 midterms, one dropped, and the final), but tests are very fair and straightforward to prepare for. It can be a hard class, but Dr. Brau knows his stuff and how to teach it. Records all the lectures on YouTube. Bonus points for his support of the LGBTQ+ community-- he cares about everyone!

He's probably one of my favorite professors I've ever had. The class really isn't hard if you pay attention in class. All the exam material is straight off his lectures and some out of the book problems. I honestly didn't study at all until the day of the exam and then crammed for about 6 hours straight and always got A's.

Bro Brau is an awesome professor, the grade is literally only your test scores so there's that, but I really enjoyed going to lecture and if you do the readings and study the notes you'll do just fine.
Hes awesome and hilarious, fires you up To do well in his class

Brother Brau is awesome, and he really knows how to teach the material. The only hard part about this class is how they write the tests. They are multiple choice, but they put almost right answers as the other options, making it very easy to think you got the right answer and actually be wrong. Doing practice problems is a must to be prepared.

Dr. Brau is passionate about his work and finance. I took this class for my minor (so I'm not trying to get into the business school and that makes a big difference. If you just want to learn about finance but not necessarily major in it, this is a tough and very intense class, highly structured for those wanting to get in the major.
Professor Brau is a great professor. Lectures are fun and enjoyable. You have to come to class and you have to do the reading to pass the class. The only thing in your grade will be your test scores.

Brau definitely pushes you. He has a super intense personality and is always talking about how hard his tests are and how people struggle with them which wasn't compatible with me and stressed me out. Honestly one of my biggest motivations to get a good grade in his class was to prove him wrong haha. You will really learn Finance from him though.

Brau is an awesome teacher! For those who struggle with finance and accounting, this class can be really tough, but he teaches in a way to help you understand. Don't skip class, you'll need the lectures. And do the reading! Otherwise you'll be up a creek

This is my second time in Fin 201, and it definitely made more sense with Bro. Brau. Your whole grade is based on 4 midterms and the final, but if you study the material, pay attention to lectures, and work practice problems it isn't necessarily difficult. It takes effort and good test taking.

Brau structures his class with 100% tests. No assignments, no attendance, nothing but tests. Not a good structure for my learning personally, but he still teaches well and has a TON of passion for it.
Love brother Brau. He really cares for his students and is passionate about what he does.

Brau is awesome! He is an inspirational and hilarious lecturer and he cares about the students. I may have been more spiritually uplifted in his class than my religion classes. I figured out after the first test that if I would do a ton of practice problems I would get a good grade on the tests. MUSCLE MEMORY!!! Put it in steroid mode!!!!

The best professor I've had at BYU, bar none. He's super uplifting spiritually and very inspiring as a person and will help anyone. the only grades are the tests. I learned more in this class both about the topic and spiritually than I have in almost any other class. Definitely take Brau's class - it's tough, but you won't have to deal with any BS.

Great professor. He'll teach you what you need to know not just for the tests, but for real world Finance stuff. Grade is 100% tests. 4 midterms and a final, but will drop your lowest midterm. If your final is better than your average score he will take that. So, no homework! But you need to take the initiative to work hard to learn the material.

His lectures are very entertaining and he sometimes will cover some things that will help you choose a career. I found his personal finance chapter very applicable. If you listen to every one of his lectures on youtube and make detailed notes, read over the textbook and make notes, and then do all the practice problems, you will get an A.

Brau was legit. I never went to class but I always watched his YouTube videos which was nice. Whole class based on tests. Honestly I crammed for them and got by pretty well. Pay attention to conceptual.

Brother Brau's class was awesome. I took his class as a prerequisite for the Marriott School and I would HIGHLY recommend him for FIN201. Your whole grade is made up of 5 tests but he drops one of the midterms. He literally gives you everything you need to ace the tests (his test is based off of his notes that he gives you during lecture).

Jim Brau, what a guy. This is one of the most value added classes that I've taken. I'm so much more well versed in money matters that I actually feel confident I can 1. have an intelligent conversation about finance and 2. I can take control of my personal finances. It's very difficult, so I've had to work hard. Inspirational and motivational

Bro Brau is a legend. He's a spiritual giant with strong desire to help all students. He will try to scare you into thinking his class is super tough on the first day, but if you just show up to class, read the textbook, and go to the exam reviews you'll get an A no problem. Your final grade is 100% based off of tests, so no fluff work.
Defiantly get ready for a math intensive, new vocabulary experience. You need to know your stuff to get a passing grade in this class. Good luck

Lots of people like Brother Brau. He wasn't bad. He has a very strong personality and kind of in your face, which I didn't like very much. I did really like his spiritual thoughts. I would not recommend taking this class unless it's the only real class in your semester. It is crazy hard. It made calc 2 look like a piece of cake. Just be prepared.
Great professor! It was a class that challenged me but definitely worth it!
Best class I have ever taken at BYU. If you are going to take finance it has to be from Brau.

Professor Brau is a great guy! Very enthusiastic and keeps your attention. He is super great at explaining difficult concepts. Also YouTube's all his classes so if you miss a day for something don't sweat it. Just make sure to actually go back and watch the lecture.

Brother Brau teaches finance very clearly and thoroughly. He gave me a great foundational understanding of finance. His tests are very fair and cover exactly what he goes over in the class lectures plus some addtional content from the textbook. Above all, Brother Brau will inspire you to be a better person!

Dr. Brau is passionate about Finance. His class is solely based on 5 tests. Review his notes and lectures, that is the best way to do well in his class. This was the hardest class I have taken at BYU. So buckle up and prepare to work really hard!

The material is complex, but doable. Take Accounting before this class. Lectures are posted online, along with the TA Reviews. There is a myEducator book which isn't required (not graded) but you will fail without the practice problems and reading from it. Only graded on tests- 1 is dropped. Brau is probably the most woke professor at BYU.

Professor Brau is an amazing professor! The course material is hard and you have to put in the work to do well, but he provides everything for you to succeed. His lectures are inspirational and engaging and he cares a lot about his students. I would definitely recommend taking FIN 201 from Brau!
Brother Brau is a very entertaining professor indeed. Studying for his tests, however, is quite the headache. Compared to the other pre-business classes this one gave me the most ulcers.

Jim Brau is an awesome professor. What he teaches in class and writes in his notes is what he tests on so make sure to be there. His spiritual thoughts are very uplifting. Definitely a lot of work but the concepts themselves aren't too difficult.
Great guy but tough class

Professor Brau is an awesome professor. His class is really challenging and the tests are hard but he does an awesome job of teaching the material clearly and makes sure that here are lots of TA's available to help. This is a really tough class and you are responsible to really learn the material in order to apply it on the tests.

Jim Brau is without a doubt my favorite professor at BYU. I'm not even a finance major and have been a TA for two professors in my program. I really enjoyed his class, it wasn't a cake walk but it was a great class. He really cares about all of his students and is always willing to help. Also, probably the most spiritually minded professor at BYU.
I took Holmes them prof Brau. Both are good but I was able to follow along. Im a fan that my grade was 100% tests, I dont like busy work.

Brau is an awesome teacher, his lectures are great and he gets so excited about finance. The class is very test heavy however. You are only graded on tests, but if you do the readings, pay attention in class, study and go to the TA lab for help you can be successful.
Love Brau! Just put in the work and you should be okay. Your grade is 100% based on the tests, so dont forget to study!
Brother Brau is a great guy and truly cares about his students. Read the book and study hard becasue the tests aren't easy and your grade is made up soely on the tests.

Class isn't required, but you really want to go. Not only are lectures amazing, but that is where you learn the information. He records them, but let's be honest the likelihood of watching the video is significantly less than the chance you'll go to class.

Wonderful choice if you want to actually learn Finance. He tells you exactly what you need to do to get a good grade in the class, and the rest is up to you. This is not an easy class, but this is also a class that will change your experience at BYU. Not for the lighthearted. If you are willing to work for it, you will enjoy this course.

Brother Brau is a decent professor. Love his energy and enthusiasm but isn't good at explaining difficult concepts. His tests have some weird conceptual questions that can trap you sometimes but they're manageable.

One of my favorite classes at BYU. Brau is awesome. His lectures are on point and taught very clearly. Gives both a spiritual thought and advice for professional development EVERY class. Super inspiring. He has been teaching this class for YEARS and knows how to teach it WELL! He gives 2 whole lectures on personal FIN that other professors dont do!
Fun, energetic, reasonable, and inspiring.

This class is challenging but very rewarding intellectually. Make sure to keep up with topic because it's very easy to get behind. Professor Brau really makes you feel valued as a student which is impressive given sections of 400+.
Fun. Always full of energy.
The class is based on 5 tests. If you do not do the reading before class then you will get lost.
Great professor who really does care about his students! Do the reading, attend the TA reviews, and you should be totally fine.

If you can put up with his personality that to some would come off as arrogant and prideful, then take FIN201 from Brau. He is the best professor for this class and helps his students really understand the material, if you're willing to put in the work to study lots outside of class.

Professor Brau is one of the realest professors out there. What I appreciated most is his 100% investment as a teacher. He gives his best, and expects you to do the same. His tests are fair, but there are no other assignments. One test is dropped, so you're grade is the composite of your best three midterms and the final.

Professor Brau is a great guy. You can tell he is really sincere and wants everyone in the class to succeed. Sometimes he goes a bit fast in class and I felt like it would've been better to just watch some youtube videos to cover the content. However, he does give very good spiritual thoughts in class which makes going to class worth it.

Bro. Brau does a great job applying the material to the real world. He really wants you to internalize the material by having an intuitive approach. He does a great job keeping the whole class of 500+ engaged the entire class period. He gives concrete examples through practice problems & real world examples. He really cares about the students.
Has really hard to read handwriting so you might want to go to the lab and see if you can get a copy of his TA notes.

Brau is a genius when it comes to Finance. Sometimes he can come across as intimidating, but he just has a really strong character and is really good at seeings things as they really are. Personal effort in learning the material is crucial, so just get ready to both work your tail off and be pep-talked every other day :)

Bro. Brau is awesome! His class is structured so that the only things that count in your grade are the 4 midterms and the final which is a little nerve-racking, but he gives you an opportunity to drop your lowest midterm grade. The concepts he teaches can be difficult, but he does great explaining them and gives you detailed notes during class.
Brau is a great guy. Very fun professor. Lectures are very fast and info heavy. Enjoyed this class.

I can easily say that Brother Brau has been my favorite teacher. His spiritual thoughts every class have really helped me make this semester my best. If you study the notes from class really well, attend the reviews, and do the reading before you go to class you should do great. Take Brother Brau, he's the best.

He is very difficult, but fair. His spiritual thoughts were sometimes better than my religion class. Though he doesn't take attendance, you better be there if you want a good grade. The class is fast paced but if you read the book, pay attention in class, take METICULOUS AND COMPLETE notes, and do the practice problems, you will do great.
I learned a lot from this class because Jim is a great professor. However, his handwriting is pretty bad so you might have a hard time writing the lectures down.
Only take this class if you're good at tests. Don't skip class or else you'll miss even more questions on his tests. He does put his class online on youtube, which was great.
Professor Brau's lecture notes are super helpful and he can make some of the boring parts of this course pretty interesting!

Many of my friends recommended Bro. Brau for Fin 201 and I'm glad I took their recommendation. Bro. Brau is passionate about his subject and his students. His lectures are really clear and his tests are really straightforward. Your entire grade is based on the 5 exams you take, but he gives you the option to drop the lowest one.

Brother Brau is an amazing professor! His tests are very difficult but he gives you the material to study for them. His lectures are inspirational! If you take really good notes and practice, practice, practice, you will succeed.

Jim is a great teacher and a great person, he lets you know that he is there for you if you ever need to talk several times each class. He gives great spiritual thoughts and entertaining lectures. Great guy and is a solid Finance 201 teacher.

Brau is a really good professor both academically and spiritually. He is really good at explaining a lot of the more difficult concepts in a really easy to understand way. However, the only thing that I really dislike about him is that his test is 100% test based. So if you don't take tests well, take Finance another semester!

Brau's class was my favorite class this semester. Finance is hard, but he writes his tests exactly from the class notes and tells you that. He's transparent and prepares you well, you just have to go to the lectures. Also, you'll want to go because his stories are amazing and he's an all-around great and funny guy. Would highly recommend.

This is definitely a tough class, but it is also an inspirational class. I would advise you to do more than take good notes. Work practice problems, read the book, and actually try to understand what he is teaching. It has made a difference. This is my second time taking it.

The only thing that I didn't like about this class is that the homework was not graded! I learned very quickly from the tests that I needed to do them in order to get a good grade, but there wasn't any motivation besides that so I spent more time on homework in other classes that had due dates. Tests are 100% of the grade. Take it if you like that.

Bro Brau is a very genuine, high energy guy that wants the best for his students. The class is very straightforward. If you study class notes to understand the intuition, and then do practice problems, the exams are pretty straightforward. Not an easy subject, but easy to do well in if you are willing to work hard. His spiritual thoughts are great!
Great professor. The class was tough but definitely doable if you put in the effort. Bro Brau is very intense but definitely the better choice of professor for this class.

Professor Brau was a very passionate and energetic professor. My major complaint with the course was the inconsistency between what was discussed in class and what was on the tests. Prof Brau was very adamant that all you needed to do in preparation for tests was master his in class notes. I disagree, I got more out of myeducater.
Professor Brau was great. Make sure to practice the problems regularly to prepare for tests.

Covers all the material that you will be tested on in class, and explains in more detail some concepts from the book. No complaints at all, teaches the material that needs to be covered, just make sure you take notes and pay attention during class.
Make sure that you go back and watch lectures on YouTube, the test questions try to trick you!
n/a

Jim Brau is one of the most inspirational professors at BYU. I walked out of every class feeling motivated and ready to take on any challenge that came my way. I loved the class and Fin201 was a significant learning experience for me. Although it takes a bit of work and the only grades are the exams, it's a great class and you learn a lot. Got an A

He is a man of passion. He is passionate about finance; he is passionate about the Gospel; and he is passionate about seeing his students succeed. Don't expect an easy "A" taking his class but expect to learn a lot of finance and to feel a lot of power from his testimony. I would definitely take his class again.

I loved this class. Prof Brau is super real. He breaks down hard concepts very simply. He gives a spiritual thought every day, which is honestly the best part of the class. You have to work hard in this class, but your efforts are rewarded.

Do the readings, go to the TA Reviews, work practice problems and you'll be fine. Jim Brau is awesome; he really cares about the students and he cares about his faith. He is awesome to listen to. You won't remember the finance, but you'll remember his lectures.

Brau is an amazing man. His classes are entertaining and gives amazing spiritual thoughts and motivational messages. He teaches clearly but be sure to go to class and pay attention because he will test you on things he has said! I would definitely recommend him. His class is not that hard if you put in the work.
He's an awesome spiritual professor. However, I felt like I was not effectively taught the very fundamentals of finance. I had to study from external sources to learn what was required to succeed.

I loved Brau's class! He is very clear and helpful. He works to help his students succeed. You CAN get an A in his class if you put some serious work in. Grades only on test scores with a curve on the final. What a guy!
Jim Brau is a great teacher! He's super hyped up on energy every class and his teaching style is great. The only items in the grade book are the tests so make sure to study and do the practice exams.

I loved Brother Brau. He did a really good job at making what can be a boring subject fun. He always has a professional development moment and a spiritual thought which are awesome. He can seem a little stern at first when talking to him but if you make an honest attempt to have a conversation he is a great guy.

Brau is the man. He is the most engaging professor I have had, probably ever. He is very clear as to what he expects of the students, especially if you want to do well in his class. When he tells you how you should approach his course, LISTEN; otherwise, you will be disappointed in the outcome. Stellar teacher, all things considered!!

Brau is incredibly loving. He cares a lot about all of his students and will meet with anyone one-on-one. He gives you things straight up in class, so you need to be ready. You HAVE to go to class to succeed in his class because that's what a lot of the exams are based off of. It's a tough class, but I would definitely recommend taking Brau.
he is awesome! you will learn so much!!

Very inspirational professor, takes time every class period to give a short spiritual thought as a break from the lesson for the day, which I enjoyed a lot. Tests are based off of the notes, so it's important to be in class.
Brau is the bomb. He's intense from the beginning until the end. Class isn't mandatory but if you miss, you're toast.

Brother Brau was great. He is pretty intense and he loves to shout, but overall I had a good experience in his class. Your entire grade is based on 4 midterms and the final, which is scary but definitely doable. I would reccomend.
Practice problems and reviewing notes will help you do well on his tests. You'll want to do well on the tests since that's all you're graded on.

Prof. Brau is a great guy, he cares and is motivating. I enjoyed the class and learned some great things, especially in the personal finance chapter. He expects a lot from you, and you will have to put in a lot of time for an A, but if you put in the work you will get a good grade. There are only 4 graded tests and one final, so each score matters.

Brau is pretty cool. If you rate him you get extra points on the final. His lectures are entertaining. If you're applying to the business school, he makes you feel kind of like an idiot unless you've had like 6 internships and years of professional experience before applying. But he's a chill dude. Super fair and straight forward. V funny.

It's is a pretty straightforward class because he teaches to the test. If you're willing to put in the work you can get a solid grade. He is an overall nice guy, but sometimes I thought his spiritual thoughts were overly negative or critical of his students.

Brau is a great teacher and a great guy. Your grade is based on tests alone. You can learn everything you need in class, but the textbook can help if you are confused. Gives spiritual thoughts every class, which are a nice way to break up the long class period. Know your notes, go to the reviews, and do practice problems. Brau is a great choice!

Brau keeps the classes interesting, but it is a LOT of material. Not an easy A if you ask me. Attendance is not graded, however I definitely recommend attending as many classes as possible, read, do the work, and go to reviews! Work problems as early as possible before the exams. Only grades by 4 exams and the final.
Brau has good energy. He gives uplifting spiritual thoughts. Focus first on understanding the concepts and notes and then drill practice problems. You got this!

Bro Brau is amazing! I felt like he taught the material very well as well as focusing on what was immediately important to us. Just a little warning do NOT take Fin 201 from anyone without having taken Accounting 200. That being said Bro Brau also gives the most inspirational spiritual thoughts every class period, I never left lecture disappointed.

Brau is great! He talks fast so read before coming and use Study groups! Grade is made up of 4 midterms and the final but you can get the lowest midterm dropped. Each midterm day has no class. Only 2 days open to take the tests. Gives great spiritual thoughts every class!

Brau's classes are pretty packed full of information. I didn't end up going to class after the first test, because it early in the morning, but because he posts the lectures online, I didn't need to. The only thing to beware about is when viewing the lectures online, the camera resolution isn't great, so it's kind of hard to see some of the slides.

I loved taking Finance from Brau. He is the best one to take it from! The class is a sum total of just tests. It's nice because you don't have a lot of busy work. If you show up to class and do the readings you'll be fine. He dumbs things down in class making it easy to understand. His spiritual thoughts are amazing!!

Professor Brau is awesome! I really enjoyed his class but his tests are killer. You better know his review sheets by heart or you will bomb the test. Re-watch his lectures to be prepared for the tests. Pay attention in class and take really good notes. Work hard and it will pay off.

This class is not for the faint of heart, but it's doable if you're willing to put in the time. Brother Brau is invested in the success of all of his students and he gives you the information you need. You HAVE to come to class prepared having read the chapter. Loved the class overall. Always ties in the gospel to his energetic, inspiring lessons.
He is great at inspiring students and focuses on the aims of BYU and building the kingdom of God. He only grades on tests.
I loved taking Bro Brau's FIN 201 class. It was definitely a ton of work but it's worth it.

Professor Brau really cares about his students. Even though I learned a lot about finance, which is great, I would say the most important things I learned from him had to do more with developing integrity, character, and hard work. You can tell he lives what he preaches and he wants to help out his students in any way he can. Definitely recommend!

Brau is an amazing professor, one of the best I have ever had at BYU. This class is HARD and the grade is based 100% on 4 midterms and the final exam. That being said, he is the best professor to take this class from. The TA's are generally pretty good, and Brau will inspire you. You learn a lot about finance, but more about being a good person.

Loved this class! Tests are basically based off of the notes that he gives during class, but if you don't make it to class, he posts the lecture on YouTube. He gives amazing spiritual thoughts every class, and the class goes by really quick. The class set up is really nice, and all study material is posted. Would definitely take from Brau again!

Get ready to grind every single day. You must really know the formulas as no formula sheet is given. I think Brau is a great teacher, however for me, I think taking a different professor would have been nice as he raises the minimum for an A and do not provide a formula sheet.

Professor Brau always strives to make the lectures applicable and personal which is appreciated. His breaks in lecture for inspirational thoughts and professional development is also very appreciated! He puts lots of pressure on doing well on the exams because they're the only thing keeping your grade afloat. Be prepared to learn a lot!!!

Brau is funny and inspirational. He is a bit of a loose cannon but it keeps things entertaining. His lectures are very helpful. He records them and puts them on YouTube in case you miss one. Take good notes and do the practice problems and you will do well on the tests, which are the whole grade.

Brau is a good professor but gets really off topic in lectures telling stories. The tests are really fair. You can do well in this class if you actually read, study, and work the problems. Watch the TA reviews if you can. Hes a good guy and wants the best for his students overall.

Brau is so fun! He really made the 8am class enjoyable. The only grade you get is from tests (4 midterms and a final), but his tests are pretty easy - just put in good time studying. He's super willing to help and is just a fun professor!

Braus way of teaching was not right for me. I walked out of the class multiple times being more confused than when I went in. Very frustrating to learn more in the TA reviews than the actual class with him. Grades are based solely on test scores. Challenging class over all.

Brau is a good professor. His teaching style doesnt work for everybody, but he cares. He tells you exactly how to get an A, and if you follow his suggestions itll go well for you. Otherwise youll be super lost.

Jim Brau is an amazing professor. We learned so much. His class is intense and there are 4 midterms PLUS the final, do get ready to study your butt off. It's an intense class and the material is difficult, but Brau does everything he can to help you succeed. He even records his lectures and the reviews so you can go back and review them.
Be aware that the grade is based entirely off of the test. Also his tests dont include formulas like most other finance professors. Intense guy but super loving and caring.

Always loved coming to this class! Would not hesitate to take a class from Brau again! He's awesome. Gives great lectures, explains principles of Finance very clearly, and tells you exactly what you need to know for the exams. Tests can be challenging if you don't study, but if you put in the work to study what he tells you, it is not that bad.
He's super passionate which helps make the class interesting. Stay on your toes, he moves fast!

Brother Brau's class was challenging, and I'm not remotely interested in finance (but needed it for the business minor). However, Brau was so engaging! Not an easy A, but you'll definitely get out what you put in. Your grade is 100% decided by 4 exams and a midterm. Get him to talk about the South as much as you can because his accent is killer.

This class pushed me but I felt like Professor Brau gave us all the tools to be successful. The tests are your entire grade, and its important to read the chapters, attend class, and go to the TA reviews. He goes suuper fast in class so be ready

Brau is definitely one of my favorite teachers at BYU. The class is hard but so interesting! I loved to be able to talk to him if needed and to see how much the class has influenced and changed my life and my decisions. His spiritual thoughts are awesome and inspirational. He is smart and will make you really understand finance. 10/10 recommend

Brau is such an incredible professor! He is straight forward about what will be on the test and keeps his lectures entertaining. He is brilliant and talks super fast, so pay attention. He records all the lectures so you can view them afterward on YouTube. Definitely would recommend him. Lessons learned will stay with me forever.

Do readings and as many practice problems as possible. Go to class and take notes. Use the TAs. Keep on top of things without cramming for tests and youll do fine. Hes the type of guy that will change your life!
Prof. Brau is great! Do your reading, go to class and do the practice tests. You'll do fine.
Good class. Brau cares about his students personal growth. The content can be difficult at first, but becomes more interesting than difficult.

Bro Brau is an awesome teacher, but be prepared to work! His lectures are interesting and very helpful. You can tell he actually cares about the students. Your grade is based ONLY on tests, so if you aren't a good test taker maybe consider a different teacher. This class requires lots of reading and studying so be prepared to work for your grade!
All the grade it tests, but he is fair and works through problems during class. I took it before and had a much better experience with Brau.
Bro Brau is super high paced in class. He will try and scare you out of his class, but its honestly not that hard. Just make sure you know how to do all the practice exams before you take the tests.

This class is super hard but easygoing at the same time because there is no homework or quizzes, it's 4 midterms and a final. If aren't too disicplined to study on your own time then you will struggle. Brother Brau is great but his lectures really are wicked fast.

Great teacher! He cares a lot about his students. Brau is very high energy and it makes for an interesting class. The actual class is fairly easy as it is basic finance. Some people struggle a lot. If you do the readings and go to class then you should get an A. He alludes to almost every test question directly in class and again in the reviews.

Take this class if you are good at learning from an online textbook. If you dont understand something you will fall behind. Brau goes a million miles an hour in class and there isnt much material in lectures, just pounding out problems. If you need a flexible schedule this class is good because the homework is not required and lectures are online

Prof. Brau is an amazing guy who loves his job and his students. His lectures, however, move at lightspeed and can be very difficult to understand. If you want to do well study vocab extensively before class and lean on the readings to understand basic concepts. Tests are tough because they are focused on unclear details mentioned in class.

Brau is awesome! I loved his lectures and although the only grades are tests, the tests are straight forward and the TA lab and reviews are very helpful. Although the reading isnt mandatory it is super helpful too!

Brau is super enthusiastic about finance. He teaches SUPER fast, so you can bank on not understanding anything unless you do the reading. Your grade is based only on the tests which has been kind of a bust for me. His explanation of complex concepts is kind of confusing.
The only grades are four tests and the final. What's great about his class is that he records it and uploads it to Youtube. So if you need to miss class, you can easily watch his lectures on Youtube.
Professor Brau is straight-forward and loves finance. His spiritual thoughts are amazing and he explains the content very applicably and clearly.

Brother Brau is the most pumped professor I've ever taken. He has a huge passion for finance and makes lectures interesting and fun. Not only does he want his students to succeed in his class but also wants them to succeed in life. He tells things straight up as they are. This class is based only on tests so study hard but def recommend taking him!

Completely test based. There is NO other points in the whole class. I'm not a huge fan of that, but some people like that. The important part is the Prof. Brau is AWESOME! All of his classes are recorded on Youtube so you never actually have to go to class, but you will NEED to watch every lecture if you want to do well on the tests.
Great guy, sometimes doesn't explain formulas well or what the purpose of each equation is but overall great class

If you are a good test taker and read every section of the online book he assigns, take notes on things he mentions in the lectures but aren't in the book (you can just watch his lectures on youtube at 2x speed), and do all of the practice tests, you will get very close to a 100% in the class. What you are expected to know and do is very clear.

I never went to class and just watched the youtube videos which was awesome. Jim is a good guy and does a good job preparing you for the exams. only 4 exams and thats your grade and all are very straightforward.

Brau has 4 midterms and a final. You can drop the lowest midterm, and if you score higher on your final, it masks your grade. He's a great professor, and you get to see how your lectures and readings apply in the real world. He really cares about the material and about the students as well. Great guy!

Brother Brau is the best. Take Finance from him! Your whole grade is based off 4 midterms and a comprehensive final. You can drop one midterm though. He does review sessions before every test which are helpful. Go to class, his notes are very helpful and will prepare you for each test. If you pay attention and take good notes you will do just fine.

Brother Brau is honestly one of the best professors I've had. His class is difficult, I can't emphasize the importance of staying on track with homework enough. He films every lecture, so you can go back and watch it if you miss things. Spiritually strengthening FOR SURE. The class is solely based on exam scores, so be prepared for that.

Take Finance from Brother Brau. You have to memorize the formulas for his class but it isn't that hard. Read the book, go the class and the test reviews (you can watch both on YouTube) and you should do just fine. Watch out for the qualitative questions though!

Professor Brau is really an impressive professor. He does talk and write really fast in lectures which can make taking notes and listening very hard. The only graded assignments are 4 tests and a final. The lowest is dropped with surveys. The best prep for tests is definitely to review his notes and do the practice tests at the end of the chapters.

Brau is one of the weirdest guys I've ever had the pleasure to meet. If nothing else, his class is a hoot, because he makes connections to really odd things. He also has an unhealthy obsession with this website (yes, I know you're reading this, Brau). But he cares as much as he can for such a massive class, and he focuses in on making an impact.
This class is graded purely on an average of 4 midterms and a cumulative final.

This class taught me a lot, even though it was stressful just having the 4 tests and the final as the grades. He does drop one, and the book, lectures, and TA lab are really helpful as well. I loved his spiritual thoughts and how he applied and taught everything to help prepare for life, and not just for the test! Great class and professor!
Loved this class! Just read the chapters and pay attention in the lectures.

Brother Brau is great! Most of his class is based around reading the assigned chapter in the textbook and then attending class for reinforcement and practice problems. He works hard to keep his lectures interesting and he's an all around funny guy. There is no homework, so grading comes from exams only.

Your grade in the class consists for 4 exams and 1 final. He records his lectures so you can watch them on YouTube if you cant come to class. He always give time for a spiritual thought and professional development.

His strong personality might be off-putting to some, but I personally loved his course structure, the text book itself, and the way he formatted his lectures. I thought it was extremely condusive to actually learning the material. You have to do a lot of work, but it's all taught so well that the work is well worth it.

Brother Brau is a good guy who genuinely cares about his students and is really passionate about finance, but the structure of his class is done poorly. There are only four tests and a cumulative final... And test number four is a week before the final. I thought that was a little messed up.

Be prepared for what you're signing up for. This class weeds out who's ready for the financial program and/or business program. Jim Brau is great lecturer and teacher. This class heavily requires you to do your part into knowing the equations and concepts without memorizing. You can't afford to fall behind. This is real insightful class to learn.
Honestly my favorite professor that Ive had at BYU.

Great person, pretty strong personality but hes a good professor. The grade is entirely based on exams, which leaves it entirely up to you to learn the material outside of lecture. Lectures arent required but if you skip youll miss material.
Fantastic professor. I was always excited to attend lecture as he made them very interesting and uplifting. He was clear and concise in his explanations. Great guy who cares about his students.

Great Professor, wouldn't recommend any other Finance professor. Really did a great job at explaining complex concepts. You have to be really specific on the notes you take. Do the practice quizzes before the test and you'll be golden. Really loved this class and Brau's spiritual thoughts.

The class is definitely passable, but I was a little dissapointed with the lectures given. Professor Brau does not teach the material very clearly, and often goes off on irrelevant tangents. I learned most of the information on my own reading the textbook, and from the reviews.

Class attendance is necessary for understanding the material presented in the textbook. If you want to succeed in this class, come prepared, read the assigned readings, and follow his advice for success in the syllabus. Brau is an inspiring lecturer who really does want his students to succeed, and his spiritual thoughts are inspiring as well.

Bro Brau knows his stuff and does a great job teaching it. His lectures are clear and he does a good job telling you what you need to do to be successful on his tests. Your entire grade is just your midterms and final, which can be a good or bad thing depending on what kind of student you are. Lectures are super crucial.

Yes, Fin 201 can be a hard class and concepts are always going to be challenging so you are going to have to put in the work. Grades are based strictly off tests. Take Bro. Brau simply out of the fact he cares more about you than finance. Spiritual thoughts and career development breaks are a daily occurrence.
He really cares for his students. He is hilarious and his lectures aren't boring at all. Read, do the practice drills, watch the youtube videos and you'll do good!
Solid guy. Cares about his students a lot.
Paying attention in class, taking good notes, & taking advantage of his YouTube lectures are the keys to doing well in this class.

Prof. Brau is very direct and says it how it is especially when giving his spiritual thoughts (which are amazing) so if you don't like that style he might come across as rude, but he is a really nice guy. Your grade only comes from 4 midterms (he drops the worst one if you do his short research surveys) and the final so make sure you study well.

Brau is the BEST. His lecture are pretty easy to follow when you read the material before hand. The tests are straight from the lecture too. Class doesn't seem so long either because he's hilarious and gives amazing spiritual thoughts to break up the class. Take finance from Brau!!!

You won't find a more passionate professor than Brau. Brau films his lectures and puts them on Youtube, so you don't HAVE to go class, but I recommend only doing this once or twice a semester. His tests are hard and they're the only thing your grades are based on. If you study hard, you should do decent, but don't expect your GPA to stay the same.

I like Brau, except he often talks about himself. He isn't very available for help unless you have personal issues he just tells you to get help from the TA's. He doesn't do a ton of practice problems in class so use learning suite helps as well as the textbook problems. Tests aren't bad except for a few specific random questions about concepts.

Your grade is based only on tests. There are 4 midterms and a final, but you can drop a midterm by participating in a couple of surveys throughout the semester. Take notes during lecture. I don't feel like he taught concepts or calculations very well. He teaches the class like you already have a foundation of finance.

Tests are all that's on your grade: 3 midterms and the final, each weighted 25%. I highly recommend doing the textbook reading and practice problems before each lecture. Lectures are posted on YouTube if you ever can't make it. The tests come straight from the lecture and required studying but weren't too bad. Great class! I learned a ton!

Brother Brau is passionate about what he does and gives us what we need to succeed. He is a very fair teacher and I really looked forward coming to his lectures on a consistent basis. He is a hard worker and is an example to me.
If you don't test well, be smarter than I was and DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. The tests are the only source of points.

You have to put in the work for this class. Make sure to take good notes in class, go get help from the TAs and do every single practice problems and keep up in your chapters. This is not an easy class! The only grades you get are your test scores so it's up to you to learn the material and do well!
Make sure to come to class prepared by reading through the text. You will then be able to understand things better and remembering material will be easier. Grades based only on tests.
Such a stud of a professor. The class is difficult by nature but he makes it worth going to class. Pay attention to his notes, read the text, work the problems and you'll do great.

Brau is an amazing professor who obviously cares about the Spirit in the classroom and about his student's well being. I will admit, Finance totally kicked my butt, however that was certainly not Brau's fault. He goes through it all really fast, and the material is tough, but stick with him and use the resources provided and you will do just fine!

Bro. Brau is an amazing professor, but most importantly he is a good guy. I really appreciate the fact that lectures are posted online because it's hard to attend every class. Also, it was helpful when studying for exams. I wish the class was not entirely based on exams. Bro Brau's spiritual thoughts were awesome!!
Best professor I have ever had! Grades are only based off of tests so you have to study a lot! Bro Brau changed my life, I love his class!

You can tell Brau cares about teaching this class. I definitely learned some good tidbits about finance. This class is a pre-req for admittance into the Marriott School so expect it to be tough and require a lot of your time (10-15 hrs a week) if you want to pass with an admitting grade. If you're doing the minor attend class and read the e-book.

A true king!! Finance is by no means an easy class, but Bro. Brau tells you exactly what you need to know for the tests. He's not trying to trick you. His class is probably the most important class I'll ever take. He really cares about his students, and most important, he wants students to walk away from his class as a better person. Take his class
Teaches in a way that is easy to understand whether you are good at finance or not.

Professor Brau is an amazing professor. His lectures are fast-paced, inspirational, and worth while. I found myself enjoying attending this class. Because the grade in this class was solely based on the exams I found myself cramming for the tests. The practice tests are helpful, do those and youll do fine in the class.

Brother Brau has been one of my favorite professors at BYU. He is very straight up about his grading criteria, and even though your grade is solely based on tests, he makes it very doable. I also loved his spiritual thoughts that he gave in each class, and he really taught so much more than just finance. Such a great guy!!
Brau is good at giving you exactly what you need to know for the class. It is by no means easy, but Finance 201 is completely doable! And Brau keeps you awake for sure.

My favorite professor at BYU thus far. He's incredibly fair and straightforward and shares some great spiritual thoughts. This class is tough, yet incredibly simple. ADVICE: Read the chapter & memorize the equations for that chapter before lecture. Write down his notes exactly. If you do this and the practice tests... you'll be golden pony boy.

Brau is the man. He lays it out clear. If you want it go and get it! The man made me want to prove I could hack it and I did. Great class. Loved his spiritual thoughts. He cares about us as students and the school he represents.

Okay, let's be honest. Finance is pretty hard. But Brother Brau literally is such a great teacher and explains everything so well! Tests are hard but if you follow his advice, you'll do just fine. Inspirational and an amazing person and friend to his students. If you have to take finance, take it from Brau!!!
Brau is awesome!!! Such a fun class but it is hard and you have to put in a lot of work!!
Great class and extremely well organized! He is a really hard working guy which can make you feel like you aren't doing enough in life but it also inspires you.
Brau is awesome! Really good at teaching tough concepts. Your grad is made up of 4 midterms and a final. That's it. But if you work hard, you can succeed.

Professor Brau is a great teacher. The grade in this class is completely based on test scores, so preparing for the exams is vital to getting a good grade. That said, the test questions are not always easy to predict, and the information you are expected to know for the conceptual questions is often very arbitrary. Definitely read the textbook.
great guy!

Bro Brau is awesome. He can come off as cocky and opinionated sometimes, but he is well-intentioned and truly cares about his students and their success. Grades based only on tests. Doesn't provide any formula sheets and says everything is based on intuition, but it's easy for a professor who's been teaching it for years. Good overall though.
he is very fair. The class is somewhat difficult, but if you utilize the practice tests and the test reviews, nothing will be a surprise. good class, and a reasonable and caring teacher.

Brother Brau is very energetic, and his lectures are entertaining. Your only grades will be from midterms and the final. He posts all of his lectures on YouTube. He gives life advice and very genuine spiritual thoughts in each lecture.
Brau makes a boring class into an exciting spiritual learning environment!!!

The four midterms and final make up 100% of the grade. One of the midterms can be dropped if you participate in research studies. Lectures are recorded and posted on YouTube. 99% of the tests come from lectures. Professor Brau comes off as prideful when giving his spiritual thoughts. I personally thought they were annoying and not inspirational.

Professor Brau is a great teacher because he is energetic and passionate about Finance! The class is not to difficult as long as you listen in class and take good notes. He uses different color pens when he takes notes and I think It is a good idea to buy some colored pens and just write down exactly what he writes.
He's a good teacher who helps us learn not only about finance, but life.

Brau is an awesome professor, but his class in FIN 201 is a beast to overcome for sure! With 100% of your grade based on exams, you really need to feel comfortable testing on the material. Very inspirational, Spiritual, and he is good at explaining concepts. But make sure you read the assigned reading before class!
If you decide not to go to class, just read and watch the videos!

If you don't need this class, don't take it. I took it for fun and just didn't have enough time or effort that's required. He does give really good spiritual thoughts and that made the class worth it.

Brau is the man. To get an A in the class, all I had to do was do the practice tests over and over again until I stopped missing gate same problems and figured all the little things out that I had to remember. As long as you keep up with the readings you'll be good.
I enjoyed this class because he really tied fiance to real life examples. I enjoyed a lot fo the spiritual thoughts he gave. This class was more spiritually enhancing compared to my religion class.

Brau is a LEGEND. Loved taking finance from him. People say he's tough - the reality is the content just takes a steep learning curve to get to. Brau gets you hyped up, laughing, and focused all lectures. He puts recordings of EVERY class on YouTube, so even if you miss a class you can watch. 4 midterms, drop lowest. No homework or other grades.
Awesome teacher! Highly Recommend.

Brother Brau is a good Professor overall. He has a very distinctive style that I don't think will suit everyone. It took me some time to get used to him, but he is a good professor and knows how to help his students. He's very energetic and unique so he keeps you engaged in the class. All the grades are on tests though, so be aware of that.

Brau is a good man who does well in inspiring his students. He does move very quickly through the material which can cause some to get left behind if they dont do the reading before class. His tests are pretty challenging but if you study as he directs in his syllabus you will do fine.

Professor Brau cares a lot about his class and his students. If you are a bad test taker though you won't pass. The whole grade is based on 4 tests and the final and they aren't easy tests. If you cram for the tests you won't do well on the final. Good thing is that he records all of his lectures so if you miss class you can watch the lecture later

Brother Brau is one of my favorite professors at BYU so far! He's spiritual, hilarious, and explains concepts very well. I was very intimidated by him at the start of the semester, but finance 201 has become my favorite class! Grades are only based on midterms and the final, but Brau's tests are VERY fair. Take this class!!!
There is no excuse to blame this professor if you get a bad grade in this class. He provides the student with everything they need to pass and leaves nothing to chance. Best teacher I've had at BYU.

Brau is awesome. He cares more about you than he does about his career as a teacher. He wants you to be successful both in school and in your personal life. I didn't attend class much, learned most everything from the book, but I watched the lectures he posted online for fun because I liked his insights.

Brother Brau is a great guy. He is very traditional in all of his methods. He likes to be open and share who he is. Sometimes I feel like he pushes his opinions on us and acts as if it were doctrine. Good at teaching finance, although a little set in his steps!

He is a great teacher, really teaches exactly what you need to know to pass his tests. He also has good spiritual thoughts and has great energy when teaching. Although his tests often have random facts from the lectures, basically to test if you were paying attention in class. This is the guy to take finance from though.

Professor Brau is great! He does a great job at breaking up lectures to keep the content interesting. Your grade in this class is based entirely on your test scores, so if you don't test well, I don't recommend it. Professor Brau makes finance easy to understand and fun. Great spiritual thoughts every class.

The grade in the class comes only from tests, but the professor is very clear about what to expect on the exams. There are practice exams for each chapter, so he gives students chances to practice problems. He explains concepts very well, so if you pay attention, do the readings, and write down the notes he does in class, it's a manageable class.

Good: Extremely smart and intelligent guy Amazing spiritual thoughts each class He puts his lectures and reviews on youtube Bad: He's very prideful and opinionated so he could rub you wrong It felt like he over complicated some concepts Refuses to use powerpoints or let you take notes electronically so sometimes the notes get messy and confusing

Brother Brau is awesome! His class is one youll need to work for, but its the best class Ive taken at BYU. I love how he mixes in spiritual thoughts with the usual class material. Take this class from him!
Great class, grades can be tough (the gradebook only includes midterms and a final), but he does let you drop his lowest exam. Super funny and inspirational guy. Very loud.
He is also able to work with you outside of class. The spiritual thoughts are amazing, but make sure you do everything he says to study for the tests and you will do well.

Fin 201 was a moderate level course. I did really well on the 2nd and 3rd midterm I attended his class for about the 1st half of the semester and then watched the YouTube recordings of his class on double speed instead of attending class. I suggest doing the reading and all the practice problems multiple times.

Honestly, his personality kinda rubbed me the wrong way, but I know many people who loved him and his teaching methods. He was just a little strong opinionated me me. The concepts don't quite seem to makes sense or relate to each other in class, but when I studied outside of class I was able to grasp how everything worked together.

This guy is nuts, but I loved him at the end. He is super motivational and pushes you to improve in all aspects of yourself. He is fast paced and only put tests on your grade so make sure you're good with that going in. I thrived with him as a professor but it just depends on how you learn best.

Great teacher. All of his tests are based off of his class notes. Do well on his tests and he'll drop your lowest score. Pretty passionate about everything. Sometimes too much so, but don't take it personally.
Great professor, not what you might imagine a finance professor to be. Definitely has his quirks, but overall feel like he was a good choice.

I loved Professor Brau, but I didn't love his class. Most of the learning was done through the textbook. In fact, I stopped going to class and started actually doing better on tests. His teaching can sometimes be really confusing, as he throws out a lot of acronyms and charts and graphs that don't make a lot of sense, and he goes fast.

Brau is a good professor. He is always excited and energetic during class. His tests are basically about the notes he goes over in class every day. The tests are worth your whole grade and there are no other assignments.

Brother Brau is extremely high wired, so if that makes you anxious, don't take his class. Definitely read the chapter associated with class before going. Otherwise, everything will go right over your head due to his fast pace. I did not find his lecturing helpful, so I ended up teaching myself most of the material using the textbook and the TA's.

Jim Brau is the freaking man. He's so hyped about everything in the whole universe and I love it. His lectures are very fast paced and a bit hard to keep up with, there's zero assignments and your grades are 100% tests so you have to be pretty self motivated to study and learn, but there's plenty of resources to succeed.

I have loved taking finance from Brau. He is very enthusiastic and explains everything really well. He also has great spiritual thoughts every lesson. The only downside is tests make up your whole grade, so make sure you study hard for them.

Brother Brau is a great Professor. He really cares about each of his students individually. He is always open to talk with students about anything they need. He also is very knowledgeable about his subject. He has great TA's available and so many other great resources as well. However, tests are the only grade and you will have to put in the work.
It's a tough class, but I loved Bro Brau. He doesn't hide what will be on the exams, so it's very transparent what you will be encountering on the exams, just be ready for them.

BRAU IS THE MAN. Most Christlike professor. FIN201 is a difficult class, but brau is very straightforward with his teaching and gives lot of materials to succeed. Attend lectures, take notes, and do practice problems. Youll leave this class spiritually uplifted and PUMPED bc brau is always so hyped up man

Professor Brau is one of the best professors at BYU. He cares deeply about his students and makes the content of FIN 201 applicable and interesting. His exams are fair if you pay attention in class and study the review materials. He is an excellent man.

Best professor Ive ever had and best class Ive taken. He has awesome spiritual thoughts. His grades are based solely on tests, but if you do the readings, go to class, and do all the practice problems you will do very well on the tests.

This is tough material to learn, but he does a great job of teaching it and making it doable. You definitely have to put in the time to study outside of class and work through practice problems, but if you put in the work, there's no reason why you can't get a good grade. He is a very intense individual but manages a large lecture very well.

Overall I enjoyed the class. 100% of the grade is from the tests so you have to stay on top of studying. I found some of the test questions to be a bit unrelated, this made me somewhat upset sometimes. I enjoyed the class and he relates things to the real world. It was easy to pay attention in class due to his stories and spiritual thought!

Br. Brau is an incredible teacher. He does a good job with teaching a difficult subject. He also does a great job with bringing the Spirit everyday by having quick spiritual thoughts. This is a class I'm actually going to miss. Your grade is based on your test scores, so make sure you do the readings and go to class and you should do just fine.
He is such a great professor and his classes are entertaining. I took his 8 AM class and I wanted to be there everyday. His spiritual messages are very uplifting and inspiring.
Brau himself is a really great guy. You can tell he really wants students to succeed and he loves finance. He only grades off of tests which can be extremely tricky.

Brau is super high energy so class interesting for the whole time. His lectures are super important for the test, but he records and posts all lectures on youtube if you miss class. The only grades in the class are tests so you are spending your time studying for tests instead of doing assignments. Overall great professor. I'm glad I took from him.

Brau is awesome. Prepares you well for tests which are your only grade. Great lectures that are inspiring. Sometimes the tests seem a bit picky only because it's difficult to tell what someone is emphasizing when they are amped out of their minds every minute of every lecture. Very opinionated but also very passionate about what he teaches.
Brother Brau is awesome! It's a tough class, but he makes it worth it.

Great Professor. Very blunt and sometimes his opinion can be very controversial. Otherwise, be aware your grade is solely based on a comprehensive research paper and a difficult finance group project.

Brau Rocks. I love him, I got the best dose of finance, the spirit, and a good laugh in his class. He's kind of like my dad which is weird but pretty cool I guess. He is so accepting and loving of others. I would definitely take another course from him.

I really liked Brother Brau, I thought his class was great, but my learning style did not go well with his teaching style. He would go really fast to cover a lot of material in class which was good, but it was also hard sometimes because the concepts build on each other so if you missed something small it would be hard to recover.

Brau's class worked for me! There isn't any homework and it's very test heavy. If you read the book and study well you can do well in the class. He records all of the lectures and lets you drop your lowest test score if you do well on the final. He does a spiritual thought every class and they're great. His high energy makes class fun.

Out of all my classes at BYU, Finance 201 with Professor Jim Brau was the most spiritual classes I have taken. He is the only professor that regularly schedules time in his lecture to give spiritual thoughts that pertain to students. Professor Brau teaches the material effectively so that I could understand.

Bro. Brau is very knowledgeable about the course material and makes it simple and easy to understand. I am not applying to the Finance program, but I do feel like I have gained a solid base understanding of finance from this class. Take it from Brau if you want to be spiritually uplifted, but also be aware that it will be a challenge.

Bro Brau is really one of the awesome professors of BYU. He most definitely gives students the resources needed for them to find success in his class and he really does make his material engaging and even interesting. A must take for Fin 201!!!!

Youll have the most success if you attend class even though all lectures are recorded. Amazing spiritual thoughts. Only graded on tests but lowest midterm dropped. Take a different teacher if you want to be graded on more than tests. Amazing class overall

Professor Brau is one of the best teachers I've ever had. His style of writing the notes down with you is incredibly helpful. He brings tons of energy to every class, and he is super inspirational. He also just a super cool guy to talk to, not even about finance.

Jim Brou is a great guy. He is funny, gives really good spiritual thoughts, and he is ready and willing to help students understand the material that he is teaching. That being said, this class grade is only based on tests, which I am not good at taking, so it was challenging for me.
Great proffesor

This class was so fetching hard and Brau does a fantastic job of making sure you know that. He is EXTREMELY passionate about finance, but as a result of that, he can make you feel stupid and likes to scare students into studying. Your grade is compiled of 4 tests and that's it! He keeps class spiritually edifying and he truly cares about students
Brau is such a good teacher. His notes are very helpful for tests! He is such a caring teacher and really wants you to succeed in life, not just in his finance class.

Really great guy! Wants students to succeed inside and outside the class, so he shares spiritual messages and teaches you how to apply stuff to your life. That being said, grades come solely from exams, so make sure you're ready to really study and know the material!

This is a very challenging course, but he gives you all the materials that you need to succeed. His lectures are great, easy to follow, and inspirational. Don't get behind and you will be fine. Final grade based entirely on tests.
great professor with great life lessons. if you have the chance to take brother brau do it. it is hard, but worth it
Grades are 100% tests so be careful there. Overall however this is a great class and professor Brau is a great professor.
Great professor! The class is definitely a lot of work, but Brother Brau gives you the tools you need to succeed.
Great teacher. Never get bored in his class. Would recommend studying hard for his tests and you will do great. Great guy who really cares about you. Grade is based strictly on tests and final.

Br. Brau has an excellent class set up. He teaches on several chapters for each test. The tests are tough, but if you know the material you cant do it. His lectures consist of finance, life principles, and fun. He is an awesome dude who loves to help and serve.

The class is graded only on exams. If you read the assigned chapters, do the practice problems, and pay attention in class, you'll do fine. Professor Brau is a great lecturer and tries to break up class time with inspirational thoughts and announcements.

Jim Brau is amazing. He tells you exactly how to study. LISTEN TO WHAT HE SAYS! Watch the lectures on Youtube before the exams and you will do great. His spiritual thoughts make his class incredible. His exams are not easy but just study smart.
Amazing Teacher. He makes the class so much fun and the hour and 15 minutes pass by super quick! pretty straight forward and very caring. I love him. would definitely take any other classes from him!

Brother Brau is amazing. He is passionate about Finance and good at applying it to the real world for non-Finance majors. He gives a sincere, uplifting spiritual thought during each lecture. And he organizes the class to help students both learn the content and have a high chance to succeed. Great experience.

Brother Brau is awesome! This class is pretty tough because it is only graded on 3 mid-terms and a final! He is very helpful to everyone and will answer any question that you might think is stupid with lots of kindness and understanding. He is also very spiritually aware. Love this guy.

Professor Brau is AMAZING! Very spiritual lectures and works hard to help his students succeed. Every lecture and exam review is put on YouTube which is very helpful. It is all based on tests, so study during the semester, but he explains things well and an A is definitely doable.

Brother Brau really wants his students to learn, both academically and spiritually. He always gives amazing spiritual thoughts. The class is hard because it is only graded on the midterms and final. Which is difficult when you dont test well. You need to prepare before you take them, however he gives you loads or practice problems to work on.

Amazing grading system if you like tests and dislike busywork. His enthusiasm and planning make the lectures very enjoyable. Brau is amazing at making every possible resource available and he is incredible when it comes to working with students.

So my brother told me that I was only allowed to take FIN201 from Brau. Boy was he right! Brau is literally the best finance teacher there is! At first, I'll admit I was terrified of failing his class. After I got a 97 on the first midterm though, all that fear disappeared. Not going to lie super ez class if you show up and listen! Brau for FIN201!

Professor Brau is an amazing professor who really cares about his students. His spiritual thoughts and professional developments go beyond the scope of this class. Dr. Brau comes off as very intense, almost to the point that you just have to laugh at him; however, he is a fantastic teacher. Intense, but fantastic. Brau is a great! He's very enthusiastic and spiritual which makes his classes more engaging. TAKE THIS CLASS!! Bro Brau is amazing and hilarious and made 8am class bearable. He gives such good lectures and spiritual thoughts that you will actually remember. If you put in the work and study hard for the tests they aren't that bad. Go to class and take good notes and you will be just fine.

He is a good teacher, although his tests can be a bit tricky and annoying. All you have are 4 midterms and a final. Brother Brau is amazing! I haven't had a more spiritual class than his, and I have taken all my religion credits. You'll need to work for your grade but it is very doable. Brau really cares about his students which is awesome. Sometimes when he would try to get spiritual, I felt like he was getting up in our faces a little bit too much... not so spiritual
Professor Brau is amazing!
He is a very fun teacher, he is always pumped. If you don't keep up with the class and actually learn what is being taught you will not do well. Also if you don't test well it could be a hard class.

Really enjoyed Fin 201 with Brau. Don't miss class! You can watch the youtube in your PJ's, but it's better to be there where the screen is not blurry and you can focus! Professor Brau was such a great finance professor! I feel like his lectures were always beneficial and easy to pay attention in! He gives you great examples and resources to do well on the tests!

Brother Brau is one of my favorite professors at BYU. In Fin 201 the grade is based solely on your test scores which sounds scary but it's actually pretty great. Professor Brau is an incredible teacher! He tells you exactly what you need to know on the test, and you can feel that he really values each student. A great class, very inspirational. A difficult class but that's nothing to do with Brau, just the nature of the course.

Really enjoyed this semester in Brau's class. He really is passionate about this stuff, and is passionate about life. Awesome teacher. Super inspirational and respectful to students. Records all of his lectures on Youtube which is super nice. Professor Brau is the best!! Great lectures and overall great teacher

Brother Brau is a super cool person and teacher. He gives such great devotionals and is super interesting. I took Fin201 with Bro. Brau. He is an awesome teacher. Although the class is long, he separates the class by sharing spiritual thoughts and professional development announcements. Great teacher, you can watch and rewatch lectures online.

Perfect person to learn finance from. Makes it so easy to understand. Just make sure you study on your own and practice the problems before the test! Your grade will reflect how much you practice outside of class but he gives you soooo many tools to help study.

Brau is such a great professor. Your grade is made up of tests, but if you study super hard, then you should do fine. Brau is super inspirational and has a little spiritual thought every class. Go to the TA lab a ton and you'll do well.
Really good professor. He can be really intense sometimes, but it really helps everyone to pay closer attention in class. Definitely need to put the work in to get an A in this class.

One of my favorite professors ever - textbook reading/attendance is optional, but if you don't do it you'll fall behind. Bro. Brau is the most energetic person I've ever met. Brother Brau is an awesome teacher. I really like the way that the course was set up. He does a great job at bringing spiritual topics into finance which I appreciated. Brother Brau is an AMAZING professor. He's a bit full of himself, but he works extremely hard and has overcome a lot. His lectures are great! He gives great spiritual thoughts and is really ready to help all his students. Everything you need to know for exams is very clear.

Great professor to take finance from. Clear in his teachings and records lectures to allow you to go back and rewatch. To get good grades on his test I watch every lecture twice cause so much of the test comes from what he shares in class. Getting an A is extremely difficult as you can only miss 1 question on each test. learned tons. should Take.
It's easy to not keep up on the topics, but if you focus on consistently practicing and preparing then the exams aren't too bad. Finance takes a little bit of new thinking, but it isn't bad at all.

Brau explains things in a clear way that helps you understand the material especially when you have read. Tests were challenging but VERY fair. There's a lot of material so know your notes, concepts, and "intuition" behind it & you will do fine. Work hard & the class is manageable. Spiritual thoughts are life changing. Only thing on grade is tests

Overall this class isn't too bad. The lectures are straightforward and so are the tests. You are given all the content you need for the tests through lecture and the book. I highly recommend utilizing the practice tests to prepare for exams, they were usually just a touch more difficult than the exam and perfectly prepared me.
Took it for my business minor. Enjoyed his energy and teaching style. Very kind test questions.

He posts all of his videos online, so if you don't go to class, you can watch it online. You are only graded by 4 midterms and a final. So if you are a good test taker, the class isn't too bad. The tests are fair. There are no curve balls or things that you shouldn't be prepared for if you study.

He is so entertaining during lecture, which is awesome because 90% of the class is based off of his lectures. You only have tests in this class, no homework or papers or quizzes, so make sure you don't put studying off to the last minute because you'll get hosed. He does drop one test if you do these surveys he sends out. Put in the study time.

Professor Brau is a good professor. He cares about his students and gives great lectures. You'll need to study to pass the class though, and the tests are hard, but in a completely fair way. Sometimes you will need to take a few minutes to solve a problem, only to find out you have made a mistake. You can never study too much.
Brother Brau is a solid man. Inspirational to say the least. Class is good, but depending on who you are the material can be pretty challenging. Pay attention in class and take good notes.

Very respectable man and very straightforward. I came to find out real quick that Finance does not come as easily to me as accounting or other numerical sciences. He's very big on "intuition" and he knows his stuff. Where I struggled is that he talked as if you knew exactly what he was talking about. But if you're pursuing finance, this is your man

Amazing lectures. He is very high energy and knows how to keep 600+ students interested and engaged no matter what the topic. The only grades are your tests, but they are spaced out and you have the ability to do well on them if you study and go to class. Great guy that really cares and a great teacher.

As someone who isn't too mathmatically minded this class was a challenge(x1000) for me. However, Brau and his TA's do their best to help you understand, and I appreciate how everything is weighted on the tests. Brau was really amazing and isn't afraid to push you hard and help you learn to set high expectations for yourself. Loved this class!

Absolutely love Bro. Brau and finance, even though I am not a finance major. Listen to his lectures and he will give you hints for the test. Use the TAs and go to the reviews and do the practice problems and you will do good on the tests. Just take it seriously and you will succeed.

Professor Brau is awesome. Definitely take this class. You are only graded on tests, but you are able to drop one. He tells you everything you need to succeed. Read the textbook and attend class because that is where all the test questions come from.

Go to lectures and focus on what concepts he emphasizes. His mid-class breaks such as spiritual thoughts and professional development are very stress relieving. He is straight forward and a great teacher because he emphasizes on the intuition behind every concept. To get a good grade: understand the intuition and don't just memorize equations.
Great professor! Take good notes, do the readings, you'll be fine.

Bro. Brau is an amazing professor. I admit- his tests scare the crap out me, and I think I spent about 10 hours of pure studying for each test. Do ALL the practice problems and use the TAs. His spiritual thoughts may be the best thing I take from this class- and I really appreciate all he did for me academically and spiritually.

Bro. Brau is probably the best lecturer I've ever had. There's a good mix of intellectual, spiritual, and fun in every class. He's always in "steroid mode" and just pumped to be teaching finance. Keep it up Jimmy!

Brother Brau is an awesome finance teacher! It was honestly one of my favorite classes, and I'm not a finance major. His class is difficult, but definitely manageable. He records all his lectures, so you don't need to go to class, but I would recommend it. Make a study group and go to the TA labs and reviews and you'll be able to succeed!

I liked Brau's lectures. It is a fast paced class and is graded solely on tests. I honestly crammed before every test and did fine. It's important to go to class because the word problems are mostly taken from the notes.
