Brau has been the best professor I've had in BYU so far. The class itself is pretty demanding. The secret to do good is to read and do exercises on the topic BEFORE going to class. That will give you a lead. The class is pretty straight forward. Make sure your write down good notes, as his tests will contain questions about the class.
No homework. Graded only by tests. Study his textbook, lectures, notes, and practice problems and you should be good. I like finance so I enjoyed his class. May be harder if this isn't your thing.

Great lecturer, and you don't have to show up if you watch the lectures on 2x speed on YouTube. To get 100% on exams: be able to work everything from the drill problems and practice exams, and read every chapter at least once (some concept questions come from the text and not lecture). Cares deeply about students and following Christ.

Brau is a good lecturer and his tests are an accurate representation of what he teaches in lecture and the reading from the textbook. You can tell he cares about his students and wants them to succeed.

Brau cares a lot about his students. Lectures are amazing and he gives amazing spiritual thoughts each class. The grade is based on your best 3/4 midterms and a final. There are no other assignments, but he provides lots of resources to help you succeed. Lectures are posted on youtube, there are TA reviews, and practice exams.

I love Jim Brau. I am not into finance but this is my FAVORITE class Ive ever taken. Braus only grades are tests. 4 midterms and he drops your lowest. Brau gives SO much prep material for his exams. He even records lectures and puts them on Youtube. Lots of work but if you work through all the material under Content, you WILL do well on tests.

He uses my educator and if you read and so all the practice problems then you will do fine on the test. Your grade is only based on your 4 midterms and the final. But he will drop your lowest midterm. He is great at explaining the material and provides many ways for you to learn it. I love his spiritual thoughts during every class.

Professor Brau has been by far my favorite teacher at BYU! Fin 201 is set up where your grade is solely tests but I loved that because then I felt I was only doing work that I needed (no busy work). Its hard but just do all he says. He makes his class a safe space for all students. He especially makes it a safe place for LGTBQ students.

I loved Jim Brau's class. I am not a business major but I genuinely think that this class helped me with not only my future at college but in my personal life as well. The daily spiritual thoughts were inspiring and helped me make changes in my life. Study the text, do ALL the practice problems available, and talk to TAs and you'll be great!

Bro Brau is a phenomenal professor that definitely loves his students and Finance. Every lecture was enjoyable and stretching. He gives a lot of new information that you absolutely NEED to write down, especially the conceptual points. Everything on the test is given in his lectures, and if you take good notes, you'll do great! Take practice tests!

Brother Brau is the best option to take for FIN 201. The material can be very hard to understand, but he teaches it in a very clear way and is very respectful to everyone during class. I have loved taking the class from him. Be sure to pay attention in class and take the practice exams if you want to do well in his class.

Brau is my FAVORITE teacher at BYU. It is a hard class, and your grade is only based on tests... BUT it is the best class at BYU. He makes studying for the tests easy and well outlined. Each test is only over 3 chapters and he drops your lowest score. Brau does a good job of incorporating spiritual thoughts into every class.

It was fast-paced class with a lot to remember, which can be overwhelming. The class requires a lot of preparation and time outside class if you want to get an A. Prof. Brau is a nice, but very hyper guy, who really cares about the well-being of his students. The class material is interesting and it's not impossible to grasp.

I LOVE BROTHER BRAU. He is an amazing person who cares for his students. His class is very hard don't get me wrong. If you put in the work, it's doable and he DOES want you to succeed. I loved that fact that he youtubed his lectures so you could watch them again.

I like his teaching style- working problems together on the overhead projector and no Powerpoints. He has really strong opinions, some of which I really disagree with. Take what he says with a grain of salt and don't let him scare you out of this class it is not as hard as he makes it sound. Do the readings and the practice exams and you'll be fine
Dr. Brau is an incredibly inspiring and engaging lecturer. His course is designed to catalyze conscientious learning through personal responsibility, instead of freebies and attendance points.

I really enjoyed finance with Brau. The only grades in the class are your midterms and the final. The class covers a ton of information, which can make studying pretty tiring. Go to class. Then rewatch his lectures. Read the textbook. Do as many practice problems as you can. You have to work hard for your grade but it's worth it.

Brau is a good guy and he cares about making BYU a better place for everyone, especially LGBT people and minorities. I found his personality a little obnoxious sometimes, but he is very straightforward with his expectations and if you study hard and study smart you won't have a problem doing well in his class.
I loved his class. I love how we were graded on tests and we didn't have lots of busy work.

Brother Brau is by far one of my favorite professors at BYU. I love his lecture layout and how clear he is. NOW. This is coming from a guy who is taking the class for the second time! THE LECTURES ARE ALL YOU NEED. Don't focus on the book so much, just watch and rewatch his lectures because he records them. PRACTICE PRACTICE PRACTICE. Practice Prob

Brother Brau did a really great job covering the material and I loved that he took notes with us so we didn't have to wonder what we needed to write down. A lot of the test questions were based on class discussions but he posts all the lectures on youtube so you can watch them if you miss class. He made the 75 min go really fast! No homework ever!!

Jim Brau was amazing! His lectures are very engaging and he cares about his students. The spiritual thoughts and career moments were also very useful and very uplifting. He is VERY clear on what will be on the tests and gives you the tools to succeed in the class. Wouldn't take FIN from anyone else!
Great teacher. Get ready to study A LOT.

Professor Brau is an awesome professor. He teaches using practice problems and helping understand the intuition behind all of the principles. This class is graded only by exams so keep that in mind. I enjoyed the class, but it was one of my more difficult classes I've taken.
All of your grade is determined by tests
He is an awesome guy, hard class, but you learn a lot.

His class isn't that hard if you do the readings and practice tests, but his lectures are unorganized (he spends a large portion of the time on tangents unrelated to finance). He is a good man, but I would not recommend taking finance from him.
Great guy and a great teacher. However, your grade is made up of tests only. He does drop your lowest test score, which is very helpful.

Brau is an incredible professor and gives amazing lectures. He breaks up class with spiritual thoughts & professional development which is a nice way to give periodic breaks. His class is all test grades and nothing else, so the key: PRACTICE EXAMS. if you nail the practice exams, you will nail the real exams.

Jim Brau knows his stuff. He is great at explaining the material and he motivates you to be a better human being as well. However, this is a way tough class. Take good notes and study them. Make sure to use the TA lab as well if you want to do well in the class. It's only tests that go on your grade so you got to bring your A game.

Brother Brau is an amazing professor. He cares about his students and really wants them to succeed. His curriculum is difficult and requires a lot of work, but I have definitely learned a lot in his class.

Dr. Brau is one of the most inspirational professors I have ever taken. He teaches finance in a way that is easy to understand, and he teaches valuable life skills. I highly recommend this class. To do well, know the class notes by heart (what Dr. Brau writes in class -- you can find it on youtube if you don't go to lectures) and do the pre-exams.

Brau is the literal best! His course is very fair and well organized - if you put in the work, you'll do well! Not only does he make learning finance exciting, but he inspires students to work hard and reach their potential in life. He is an incredible example of a true disciple of Jesus Christ. You'll always leave class feeling lifted!
This class is great. It is very hard and I am not interested in Finance but compared to accounting, this class is a breeze. Bro Brau makes waking up at 8am bearable.

Great professor. He always shares spiritual thoughts and motivational stories. Your final grade is determined by 4 midterms and the final, so it is a test based class. The tests are very manageable though.

Jim Brau is phenomenal. He is by far my favorite professor I've had. Attendance isn't mandatory but is really helpful. You're only graded on 4 tests and a final. He drops your lowest test grade if you do extra credit. His lectures are super amazing and the class is only hard if you don't keep up with the work or do the practice problems.

Not the best professor-100% of the grade are your tests. That's not the problem, there are quite ridiculous questions on the tests most times about random material that he mentioned in class once (that usually the TA's aren't even sure if he mentioned.) These questions aren't finance related - just random class- mentioned phrases.
He was one of my best professors. He cares about the students and does all he can to ensure your success in the class.

Jim Brau is by far the best teacher I have had at BYU. His lectures are great: 1. he teaches super well 2. he engages the class and makes lectures fun/interesting and 3. gives awesome spiritual thoughts every class. Tests are easy if you take good notes during the lectures. I wish Brau taught more classes because I'd love to take more from him.

This is a big class with around 600 students, but Professor Brau does a good job keeping everyone alert and interested in the lecture. He does a good job explaining difficult concepts. The only grade in class comes from 4 exams and a final. Get ready to study!
It was a very informational class that moves super quick. If you dont do the readings you wont pass. His spiritual thoughts are inspiring.
Jim Brau is life changing professor who will try his hardest to teach you about both Finance and living a great life. I recommend this class to anyone regardless of their major.

Although I performed terribly in this class, I learned a lot from Bro. Brau and felt inspired by his teachings. He's not your average professor and really wants you to apply financial principles into your real life. If you want to go into finance, take his class. If you are a non-major, I'd recommend someone else.

Bro B is honestly one of the best professors I have been able to have in my college career. He's super inspirational and teaches clearly and well. Don't be fooled by no homework in the class, your only grade is the midterms and finals. Always come to class and read the textbook beforehand and you'll do well.

This class is hard you if are a big procrastinator. I found a study partner early on, and we would meet often through out the week. This saved me in this class, with out it I would of done a lot worse. He is clear in grading and what is expected, and made lectures really interesting, and easy to follow.

Prof. Brau is a great lecturer and does as much as he can to keep the class interesting. It's weighted solely on tests, one of which he'll drop if you compete some surveys for the department. The test-only weight is my only gripe. They're really hard, but possible. He's got pretty good TA's and is probably the prof I've respected the most here.

Obviously the grades are based only on tests which makes it hard if you arent the best test taker, but I learned a ton from him. He is definitely your classic provo bro which can be very annoying (like come on dude, get off your pride stool), but he has a good heart and is really good at explaining concepts. Overall an excellent teacher.
I really enjoyed this class but you need to work hard
Bro Brau is the man. He makes lectures interesting and helps apply them to real life. Do all practice problems in the book and know your notes and youll do fine!
He is a very energetic dude. Helps you get passionate about Finance. The tests are only thing on your grade though which kind of sucks. If you don't do well on one though, the lowest test is dropped.
Great class. You do not have to go to class to get a good grade. You get a good grade if you know how to do finance which is nice. Read the online material and do the practice tests.

Brother Brau is one of the best professors I have had! He is very good at explaining the material, and cares a lot about all of his students! You have to work hard in the class but it is so rewarding once you understand the material!

He's a great teacher, if you do what he says and study the way he says, then you'll do fine. He doesn't have any homework, it is all tests, so if you don't study you're done for. Basically, he teaches the material well, but you're responsible for you grade 100%

Dr. Brau is an amazing lecturer. His class is well organized, and the tests are very fair. Just do the reading, study the chapters, do the pretest practice, and you will do great. Contrary to other reviews there are not pop-quizzes... or are there?? Oh man I don't know! Most beneficial class I have taken at BYU. Sit up front. Be nice to the TA's.

Brau is an excellent professor. He teaches the material well, and there are no surprises on his midterms. Your score is 100% reflective of the work you put into studying. Practice is key to doing well. It is a very fair course. I would highly recommend him to anyone interested in a business major. Also, he does do pop quizzes. They are hard.

Brau is a very clear professor and really funny. You are able to stay awake in his class, but he makes you work for a good grade. His spiritual thoughts are good. Stay on top of the readings and practice practice practice those problems!

Difficult class and your grade is 100% based on the tests, you have to really put in the work to study and learn (not just cram) to do well. Brau is very spiritual and likes to connect with his students. He's usually a pretty clear teacher and is good at teaching large classes. Don't get behind! Study well in advance.
He is a great teacher and does a good job focusing on more than just your grades. He does make you work for your grades but it is worth it.

Brau's a good guy but it definitely on the crazy side. His lectures are interesting enough and he also posts them all online. I stopped going to class and just watched the lectures online at x2 speed with subtitles, saved me a boat load of time. Easy class would recommend.

Professor Brau is phenomenal. He is passionate about what he teaches which in my opinion makes learning easier. He is eager to help students, he gives meaningful spiritual thoughts each class. One of the best professors I've had. The class isn't easy but it's doable if you work. All classes are posted on youtube which is nice if you are at 8AM.

Bro/Dr/Professor Brau has a big heart, loves the Lord and loves education. He is as real as it can get. The class is heavily waited on exams because that IS all that effects your grade. If you struggle with testing, this class is not for you.

All class lectures are put online so going to class is optional but if you don't listen to the lectures you will miss test questions. I loved the flexibility his class offered. No graded homework but reading was required to do well on tests. He is an amazing man and teacher. One of my favorites at BYU.

Brau is an amazing teacher! However, his class is really hard because it is all test based and he doesn't give you homework to practice in between tests. You have to be really self-motivated and set aside time to practice finance because the final is comprehensive and you can't just cram it. I wouldn't take Brau unless you are self-motivated.

If you don't take FIN201 from Bro. Brau you are CRAZY. Best professor I've had in my whole life. His lectures are amazing, his spiritual thoughts are incredible, and the TA's are really helpful. The grade is composed of 4 midterms (he drops the lowest one) and a final, all weighted equally.

Brau is a great! He takes hard topics and makes it interesting and applicable. He is great about teaching things slow and clear. Pay attention in class, he'll mention what might be on the test. Do ALL the practice and drill problems he puts up. They're super useful, and grades are only test-based, so its worth it. For sure take fin 201 from him!

Bro Brau is one of the most dynamic teachers you'll ever have. He has great intentions to care for his students and wants your success. He is VERY proud of his academic accomplishments and faithfulness in the church, which can be distracting. You have to put in the work outside of class to get an A. Taking accounting 200 before taking this class

Okay so here is how this class works. Read the book before class, put sufficient time into it every day, and you will get a good grade. It was hard for me not having any homework and just having tests, because you have to work problems on your own. If you like that you'll love this class. He is a great teacher, super inspirational, so work hard.

Brau is awesome! Loves finance and teaches clearly. Best part of lectures are his spiritual thoughts and professional development thoughts. Tests have a lot of details from his lectures, so just review them on youtube before taking the test.

Dr. Brau is easily one of the best professors I've ever had. He's passionate about his class and his desire for each of his students to succeed and become the absolute best they can be in every aspect of life possible. His grading is tough (only 4 exams and the final) but the tests are fair so if you keep up with the material an A is very possible!

This guy is the best, honestly just take down his notes that he writes in class and read the textbook chapters with the practice questions, you will destroy the exams. Also has some interesting things to say gospel wise, really follows the vision of BYU.

Honestly I think Bro Brau is a great professor and teaches it well if you put the work in. I didn't read the textbook before class and that cost me. You NEED to read the textbook before coming to class. Also tests are 100% of the grade so you need to be disciplined enough to practice without a homework assignment.

I really respect Jim. He is a really great guy and it seems like he cares a lot about the well being of his students. I felt like he was actually teaching us to be prepared for the workforce rather than just trying to cover a required curriculum.

Jim Brau is great. Overall I feel that the key in this class is its amazing organization and access to practice problems and solutions guides. It is organized so well that you could figure out the entire class and do well on the test just by working problems and reading the book.

Jim Brau is the MOST CARING TEACHER. He really cares about his students. He is a great teacher and he uploads a video of each class to Youtube. I always went to class and then when I was preparing for exams I would rewatch the classes online and do practice problems. Brau is inspiring. His class takes some work but he makes it doable.

I would definitely recommend this professor! His lectures are very entertaining and the class is very easy. He posts his lectures on YouTube, so don't bother going to class and instead watch the YouTube at double speed and skip the boring stuff liKe his "spiritual thoughts". Our third midterm 170+ people got 100%. Take it if you want an easy A!

At the first of the semester I thought I made a bad choice by choosing Bro. Brau. I did horrible on the first exam but luckily you get to drop 1 out of the 5 tests, excluding the final. I got used to his teaching, then Holmes subbed, and I decided I like Brau better. But holy crap dude, a little less pre-workout might be smart.

Dr. Brau is very inspirational, very helpful, and very caring. He has genuine interest in his students. The class is graded only on midterms and a final. Know everything that happens in every lecture, study the pre-exams, do practice problems, and memorize what you need to memorize. The class is very straightforward and well taught.

Take Finance 201 from Brau. Trust me. I had Holmes last semester and dropped his class due to the difficulty of his tests. Although your grade in Brau's class is entirely based on exams, half of each exam is based on things discussed in the class notes. I find his tests more doable. I got great score on all of his exams. Do have to put in the work.
Brau is the bomb. Funny. Caring. Energetic. I was scared for his class because your grade is based on 100% tests, but if you put in the work you get the grade you deserve. 10/10 would recommend.

Brau is a great professor. No funny business with this guy. If you watch(youtube)/go to the lectures, and take diligent notes, you can get an A. This guy isn't out to trick you. If you understand the formulas and concepts in lecture, you will get an A.

Only graded on tests and final exams. Has it's pros and cons but no busy work! Brau makes the topic of finance entertaining. In order to get a decent grade you need to read the textbook before class, pay attention in class (or watch the lecture online if you skipped), and do all the practice exams. The lab for me was not super useful.

I liked this class a lot! There's only 4 midterms and the final. Some students don't like this, but for me that meant no busy work and I could work at my own pace. You learn a lot of good skills. Pro. Brau is awesome and super funny (even at 8am). He sometimes doesn't explain things in a clear way (uses his own lingo). Gives good, fast feedback.

Taking Bro Brau's class will help you learn about the basics of Finance. You will also be inspired his professional development and spiritual thoughts. Get ready to study hard and look for every detail in preparation for his four tests and a final.

Jim makes this class strait forward and to the point. Study the lecture material, go to the TA lab, put in the time and you will get an A no problem. However, I did not enjoy Jim as a person. He was very opinionated, often derogatory about other business majors, and shared a lot of personal opinions about various topics as "spiritual thoughts".

Professor Brau is great, but very intense. If you can handle an intense, no nonsense, lecture, then you'll like him. You're grade is based off of 4 midterms and a final, which is kind of nice because then you don't have to worry about quizzes throughout the semester. Great professor, but sometimes shares hard opinions that can be offensive.
Awesome! I would recommend to anyone taking FIN 201 that they do so from him.
All lectures posted online. Finance is hard but Brau IS THE BEST. Gives spiritual thoughts halfway through class, to break it up a bit. If you have to take Fin 200 take it from him.

Brau is awesome, but the whole class is only tests. You have to push yourself to study and quiz yourself. Your learning is pretty much your own responsibility. He teaches VERY clearly and thoroughly, and the tests are super fair. But, youve gotta push yourself to do the learning part. 10/10 would recommend

Professor Brau is hands down the best professor I have ever had at BYU. He's a solid finance teacher who really knows his stuff. He teaches difficult material in a way that anyone can understand if they put forth effort. He not only prepares you for the exams, but also for life. Each day in class he taught valuable life lessons along with finance.

Favorite class this semester! I'm not a natural test taker (onlytests are graded)and the subjects we covered weren't intuitive, but I was given every opportunity to succeed. His lectures are thorough & he gives enough practice problems to be confident in the material. The tests aren't difficult if you pay attention, do the reading, & put in effort.

Brother Brau is an awesome guy. The class is tough and it takes work, but you can definitely succeed if you try. The grade is only from the 5 tests, but you can drop one midterm. Read the textbook, come to class (or watch the videos of class that are posted on youtube), do all the practice questions, and you can definitely succeed in his class.

Bro Brau teaches well. His class has fair expectations and a reasonable workload. He uses a ton of superlatives which can be a bit deterring but as long as you can get over that, he's a nice guy who knows his stuff and wants you to succeed.

He is a really great and passionate teacher but the grade is based 100 percent off the tests which are fairly difficult. But he is a really great teacher and helps you prepare for the tests pretty well.

Super good. the way he explains the other teachers way of teaching TAKE HIM. your grade is your tests but you can work as hard as you want, you read online and a bunch of practice tests online. I did the practice tests 4x and got As on them all so not a ton of work but gotta study for tests
He is a good teacher. Pay attention to the concepts in class and be able to work the problems on the practice exam and you'll do well

Brau is an excellent Professor. He knows what he is doing and does a good job teaching it to his students. Just 4 midterms and a final. Overall the class wasn't difficult, you just had to pay attention to the lectures and practice the problems for the test. He also put all his lectures on youtube.
He's great. He really understands Finance and he was entertaining as well as informational. Just make sure you do the reading and you know how to work problems and you'll be great.

I love bro Brau! No electronics allowed in class, he writes the notes on paper through a projector. He's kind of a redneck guy with a great sense of humor and knowledge of the gospel. Only graded on exams, but you can drop one at the end. Very clear what he wants you to know for the test. Every class has a spiritual thought break in the middle!

Brau is a good teacher who prepares you well for the tests, as long as you put the work in. My personality doesn't match his at all, however, so he annoyed me A LOT. He does post lectures on YouTube, so that was very helpful and I didn't have to go to class. Pay close attention to lectures, do the reading and practice problems and you'll be good.
Your grade is determined by four tests, but Professor Brau does an excellent job preparing you with great lectures. I would definitely recommend his class over any other finance professor.

Professor Brau is a solid choice for FIN201. It is a hard class since your grade is only based on tests, so if you are a rough tough taker, study hard. Go to class, read the textbook, do review questions daily and you should do fine.

The only grades come from the exams, but luckily the exams really do cover what was taught in class. When you read, understand the chapter, and do the practice questions, the lectures will be very helpful and the tests will be clear. Professor Brau is respectful of students' questions and concerns and he keeps the environment uplifting.

Brau is a funny guy. He pauses lecture to give spiritual thoughts, which is a nice break. His class is challenging and the grade is entirely test-based. He makes you memorize formulas but he teaches well and is very helpful.

Brau was a good teacher. I havent taken the final yet but the midterms werent too bad if you dedicate like 7-10 hours the week b4 studying. I have heard his final is much harder but idk yet. He is loud but funny and the whole grade is tests. Not too challenging but you need to work for it.

Fin201 is difficult. However, if you put in the effort, it is achievable. I have listened to other professors and what I appreciate about Jim Brau is that he is very clear and easy to understand. I am only a business minor, so if you work on all the practice problems, rewatch the lectures, and review your notes you'll do well. Exams are everything.

This was not an easy class for me, but I wouldn't have wanted to take it from anyone else. Not only is Prof. Brau great at explaining difficult concepts, but he is also a breath of fresh air at BYU. As a minority, he is one of the few professors I feel created a welcoming and supportive environment for ALL students. Take finance from him!!

It is a pretty easy class if you are good at taking tests. He is good about making real life applications. This was a very useful class and Brother Brau teaches with enough energy to make an 8:00 am class somewhat enjoyable. The only downside to the course is that there is no graded homework so one must be disciplined to learn the material.

Awesome teacher, the class is semi-difficult but if you follow his notes and review for his exams the class is more than doable. His spiritual thoughts were awesome and he really cares for his students.
Grade is fully based on 5 exams, but if you review his notes and do all the practice problems and practice exams you'll do good on his exams.

Easy class. Grades entirely test based and tests entirely note based. Lectures are entertaining and informative. Plus they upload all the lectures on youtube so if you can't make a class period you can just go to youtube and watch it afterwards. Just make sure you take good notes and do the practice problems and you'll be fine.

Brau teaches in a very different way, but he makes sure you get the material. He teaches exactly to his tests, and makes it very clear what you need to know. There are only tests in this class, so if you don't test well, take it from someone else.

Brau is a decent teacher. I went to almost ever lecture, but he posts his lectures on youtube. So, you don't need to attend. He is fair about telling you how to study for his tests, but he goes really fast through some things. I took it winter semester and it was rough, count on this being a time consuming / hard class.
Brau is amazing! The class is a little more difficult than other classes, mostly because the only grades are tests, but this professor is the way to go!

He records all of his lectures and puts them on youtube, but attending lecture is SO HELPFUL. I usually go in feeling unsure about the material I studied for the lecture, but I leave feeling motivated and excited about the class and the material. He always works practice problems with us in class.
Good guy. Attend every lecture, do all the Drill Problem Sets and Practice Exams (and if you miss something, figure out how to do it), and you'll get an A.

Bro Brau truly cares about his students. Your final grade is based on exams which can be tough but just practice, practice, practice! The content might be tough but a normal amount for a 200 class. I came to his office seeking his advice in a personal issue and he listened and gave his best advice. I would definitely take a class from him again

I looked forward to this class every time. Jimmy Brau creates a low-stress, high-learning environment. He's an incredibly engaging professor. You have to work to get the grade, but if you do the readings before class (which are not graded), you'll have good context for what's going on and be pleasantly surprised with how much you learn.

Quality Professor, He cares about you, but he makes you work for it. 4 midterm exams, 1 final. If you participate in surveys, you get your lowest midterm dropped. If your final is greater than your overall grade, you get the higher grade.

Honestly Finance isn't for me, but there's a difference between Brau and something not being for you. He teaches at such a fast clip. The other thing, his tests are super hard, and are 100% of your grade. If you aren't a test taker, don't take this class! The final also had nothing to do with what you've learned in the class, so good luck!

I've had Holmes-fall and Brau-winter in this class. Holmes: more boring, teaches fine, gives awesome practice tests, way more prepared for test. Brau: hilarious, feel spiritually uplifted every day, study really hard, horrifying shock when you see your test grade. If you want a good grade, take Holmes. If you want a funner professor, take Brau.
Brother Brau cares about his students while still being able to scale his class (make it a good experience for everyone). Also, check the class videos on youtube for extra help.

He is a great professor! He really cares about his students and helping everyone to become the best versions of themselves. He has a spiritual thought and a professional development moment every class. I found these quite refreshing during his lectures. Grade based entirely on tests (lowest dropped). Do the reading before class though! So helpful!

Read. Really know what he teaches you in class because the tests are exactly what we go over in class. ZERO assignments. Your whole grade is based off your tests scores. Brother Brau is a character. He cracked me up. I also liked the spiritual part of his lesson every day.

The class is based entirely on your test grades, midterms and the final. Most of the questions are from the notes, and the ones that aren't are from the book and are mentioned during the lecture. He lays everything out clearly in the notes, and posts the lectures online for review. If you knw the class material and formulas, you'll pass
Usually the only grades are from 4 tests throughout the semester and the final exam.

He is an extremely good teacher with a very clear curriculum. With that being said, it is a very difficult class and I honestly cannot say I put the effort required for a good grade. I will need to retake this class and would love to have him as my teacher again.

One of the best attitudes of any teacher I've ever had. The matetial was really complicated and fast paced but Brau did a great job of explaining it. By the end I was doing some serious financial jujitsu just like he promised.

I liked Professor Brau but his class was rough. It's stressful, as he'll say one thing in class that's not in the book at all and then ask like 3 questions about it on the exam. I studied my butt off, went to TA hours, reviews, rewatched lectures and would scrape out a 70% on each midterm. It was very frustrating.

This is a difficult class, however, if you do what he tells you to do you can pass easily. I don't know anyone that did all the (non-mandatory) practice problems that had any sort of serious problem in this class. Don't expect him to be personal, he teaches like 1000 students, but he is clear about what you need to do to pass.

Brother Brau was one of the best teachers I have had in the past few years at BYU. He is engaging, positive, real, awesome, and very spiritual. Your grade is determined by the tests, but if you attend the lectures and do the readings you'll do fine.

Bro. Brau is an excellent teacher. All of the teaching is done through lectures and online textbook. If you do the reading and pay attention in class the concepts aren't that difficult. Tests are the entirety of the grade.

Probably one of the easiest classes I have ever taken. Brau is super clear about what you need to do to succeed. As long as you keep up with the MyEducator course (i.e. doing the practice questions/test), you'll be golden. Class was always pretty entertaining too.

Brau is an awesome guy and a solid teacher. However I had a hard time deeply understanding the material until after I taught it to myself or talked 1 on 1 with a friend. It's hard to teach to a huge group.

Great guy. Midterms are tough but doable. You need to do the textbook practices to do well. THE FINAL BLINDSIDED US. NOT SIMILAR TO MIDTERMS AT ALL. FAR MORE DIFFICULT! Be warned that there is a requirement for GPA that needs to be reached.

Professor Brau is an awful professor. He doesn't teach, he goes on tangents the whole period. If you want to pass, rely completely on the readings. He doesn't care about the individual students; I tried reaching out to him, and he's been rude.

Brau is the ONLY person to take Fin 201 from. All the others pale in comparison. He focuses on FINANCE and REAL WORLD applications of it. No busywork, problem of the week BShe does it like a real professor. He cares, is passionate and though Im not going into finance, I learned to love it. BRO BRAU IS THE ONLY WAY TO DO IT.

Everything was based off of midterms and the final exam. He drops one midterm which is helpful, but taking 4 during one semester is a lot. He's an awesome teacher teaching a difficult subject, but he's really great at explaining material and helping you know what is important. He's also a really awesome person & cares sooo much about his students.

He's an amazing educator. To pass the class or get a high enough grade to get into the business school (two completely different things), it requires 2-3 hours EVERYDAY of studying the online material, retaking the quizzes that don't count, & re-watching the lectures. Despite keeping up during the semester, I was not prepared for the final.
He is really entertaining, but the material is difficult. He will do his best to help, but there is work you'll have to do too.

This was definitely a hard class, but I found it easier than accounting 200. It was nice that we could drop one midterm, and Brau is a really good teacher. He is very spiritual and doesn't waste any time in class talking about random stuff.
Good teacher. Weird individual.

I give him a B. Okay teacher. You can tell he likes to live the gospel to feel that he is better than others. He also really likes to talk about himself. He says that he lifts with his TA whom is a girl that is in college and I find that weird... You could honestly just skip class and all of his blab and do well in his class.
If you put effort on it, you will get an A. Read all materials before class.

His lectures are fast paced and very straightforward. Make sure to do all practice problems more than once, and stay fresh with material from early in the semester. It's all about practicing the skills he teaches, because the tests can be tricky. He is very inspirational and has obviously accumulated a lot of experience over the years. Great class.
I enjoyed the class. He is passionate and fun to be around! Just make sure to take great notes and do end of chapter practice exams and youll be fine!

Professor Brau is awesome! He really cares about his students. He tailors the class to students from all majors, so Finance is easier to understand. Plus, he gives incredible spiritual thoughts in the middle of the class. Prepare to work hard and take good notes. Studying all he writes in his notes is the best way to prepare for the tests.

This was one of my most favorite classes at BYU next to Kearl's Econ 110. Aside from being an excellent man, Bro. Brau is a great teacher. It is clear what needs to be studied for an A. I had to put in a lot of hours before each test for sure. Take great class notes and read the online textbook. Do drill problem sets and online math quizzes.
hard class good teacher

Finance isn't my thing and I had to work really hard in this class to do well. That being said, I think Professor Brau did a great job at making the material accessible and I learned a lot in his class. You have to work hard but you can do well even if you're not a finance person.

Brau is good, but he doesn't explain things all the way through. A lot of things just felt like it was learn it for the test and as someone who had no prior finance experience it felt like I has no idea why we were learning what we were the first time around. Literally all you have to do to pass the tests is youtube his lectures again b4 the test

Brau is probably the best professor at BYU, and that's not hyperbole speaking. Class is a party and Brau is the life of it. The subject can be difficult if you don't put in real effort, but the class is very straight forward. Do what Brau says and an A is definitely possible. I wouldn't take it from anyone else.
Brother Brau is great. Finance 201 is going to be a hard class no matter who you take it from, but he's one of, if not the best teacher to get for it. Read the book and practice a ton!

Great Professor. There aren't any tricks on the exams. Your entire grade are the 5 exams. You can drop your lowest midterm. Make sure to study the notes and do practice problems in Myeducator. If you go to class, pay attention and practice outside of class this isn't a very hard class.

In Brau's class, he uses only tests for your grade. This has pros and cons to it. Going to class is essential, in my opinion, in order to fully understand the material, but there is no attendance taken so it's not mandatory. Always has a spiritual thought that he prays about for the class. Very energetic and gives great lectures.

Brau is a great guy. He is VERY clear on what you need to study for tests and doesn't throw any curve balls at you like every other class at BYU seems to. If you study for his tests you will pass. His lectures are great and he posts them on Youtube if you have to miss. I rewatched all of them to study for test. Probs my fav professor at BYU tbh

Prof. Brau is an amazing lecturer and explains the material really well. While attendance is not recorded, it is absolutely mandatory to do well in this class. Really enjoyable and challenging course of which I loved every chapter. Highly recommended.

He is a great professor. There is only 4 midterms and a final. The final is fully comprehensive but it was nice not to have a lot of homework. If you study from his notes you'll get a good grade. Don't miss class.

Bro Brau is an awesome teacher and an awesome guy, I really loved his spiritual thoughts. I learned a lot about finance and its very applicable to your life. I do wish I was more prepared for the final, it was much harder than the other tests.

To succeed in Brau's class do ALL of the practice problems provided, and then do them all again. Brau does a good job teaching lots of material in shorts amounts of time but that makes it so you'll have to learn a lot on your own. TESTS ARE TAKEN 100% FROM HIS IN CLASS NOTES & LECTURES. Only buy the textbook if you think you'll need the extra help.

Brau is a fantastic professor! His spiritual thoughts were always so inspirational, and he wants his students to succeed. His tests are hard, and your only grades are the four midterms and the final, but his TAs are great, and he gives great study and review materials.

Class is only graded on tests but they are very easy. The median on each midterm was about 90%.. He also drops one of the midterms. The final is a lot harder but still manageable. From what I saw on LS at end of year, about 2/3 of class got at least a B+ in this class. Also, if you miss class, don't stress. Every lecture is posted on youtube.
Brau is a great professor who knows his stuff. Hes super intense.

academically? GREAT PROFESSOR!!! However, he does have very interesting "spiritual thoughts". They seemed more like commandments based on his personal opinions rather than attempts to feel the spirit during class, so beware of that.

This class can be really challenging, especially since he only uses test scores for grades. However, if you are diligent and work hard, it isn't impossible to get a good grade. I had never taken finance before in my life and it was like learning a new language. I was happy with getting a B in his class.

Brau is a great professor and a great option for Fin201. His class is tough but very doable if you read the textbook and pay attention in class. His test questions come directly from his lectures, which he mentions basically every day. The only thing that you are graded on is tests so make sure you study!

That was my favorite class ever! Bro B showed that he really cares for us. I didn't only learned Finance but also got inspired to do great things in my life. It was an amazing mix of knowledge, motivation, spirituality. If you ever have a chance to take this class from him, just do it!

Brother Brau is a great guy that cares more about his students than getting them through a required pre-req. That being said, he is very good at teaching the intuition behind finance, which is great for such an abstract subject. I'd definitely say that Brau is a good choice for finance.

Brother Brau focuses on primary material that will be needed on exams. His promise is at least a B+ straight from the material in class. His lectures are filled with teaching, spiritual experiences, and opportunities with careers. Class is essential for your success, but with Brother Brau you don't want miss out on the experience. Put the work in.
It's a good class, challenging but you really learn the material. It's entirely based on test scores so make sure you study well for exams and put forth the effort.

Brau is an AWESOME professor. Is really passionate about the material and makes a boring subject somewhat interesting. If you REALLY know the in-class notes and do the drill problems, you'll get at least a B+. I knew NOTHING about finance and never read the textbook and I did good on the midterms just doing that. Final is tough though.

Professor Brau is a great teacher and teaches everything you need to know for his tests. The class is only graded on tests, but if you prepare well, you will get a good grade. The class is difficult because of the material, but manageable if you put the time in effort into doing well.
I liked the professor but hated the class.

Jim Brau is a fantastic professor, and a very fair one. You get what you put in the effort for. He goes fast sometimes though, so you may need to rewatch his lectures to make sure you actually understand them. Very test heavy, but he also gives you plenty of room to handle poor tests, and gives great feedback and help, even for life. What a man.

Prof. Brau is an excellent instructor. He handles a huge class with amazing clarity, purpose, and style. The course content can be challenging, but very manageable. Read the online material before class in order to 3x your learning experience. No homework, just four exams and a final (sweet deal!). Exams are exactly per the class discussions.
Study the notes he has you take and youll do fine. Go to class

Professor Brau is a great professor. The class is hard because of the content, but he does an awesome job teaching it. I wouldn't take Fin201 from any other professor. 4 tests and the final and you are able to drop 1 if do some surveys. Not only taught the content clearly, but took breaks to give some spiritual and life insights. Highly recommend.

Professor Brau is a great teacher. Knows his stuff and makes finance applicable to a lot of fields and majors. Class is probably one of the more difficult ones I've taken at BYU. Make sure to do all the practice questions and assessments in order to stay caught up.

Finance 201 is hard. Brau does an incredible job teaching though. There is a lot of matter to cover, but Brau tells you exactly how to study for his tests. (the only grades in the class come from the four exams and the final, but he provides an option to drop one.) He is very accessible, thoughtful, and spiritual. All lectures are put on youtube.

This class was tough but one of the best classes at BYU. Brau is passionate about finance and genuinely wants the best for his students. The class took a lot of dedication but was one of the best classes of my college career. Take finance 201 from Brau, no doubt.

There are four tests and a final and thats your entire grade. He usually offers a way for you to drop your lowest test score. If you take good notes in class and do all the topic quizzes for the chapters on MyEducator you should be able to 100 on every test (or at least an A). Hes a cool guy and always has a spiritual thought to share too.

Brau is a solid guy. He is really inspiring and funny. Very spiritual, I enjoyed his spiritual moments. His tests are easy to prepare for, just watch the review videos, and practice a lot of problems! Know his notes!

Awesome teacher. The material isn't easy, but he does a good job clearly explaining it. When I was in the class, I would go to lectures and take notes that helped me understand the individual equations and concepts, but it was crucial to get the big picture. I did this by watching the recorded lectures at 2x speed before the exam.
He is a good professor who cares a lot about his students. Attend class, study the notes, and practice the problems on my educator and you'll get a good grade.
Great teacher, you won't go into tests unprepared if you follow his steps for studying and go to class. He picks great TAs who have really helpful review sessions.

I was nervous at the beginning of the class knowing that TESTS ARE THE ONLY GRADE IN THE CLASS. There is no homework, there are no assignments. There is only the textbooks and the lectures. With that said, he coveres every bit of material that will need to be known in the lectures. Take really good notes, understand the concepts, get an A.

He is very spiritual which is helpful when the class starts getting difficult. Your grade is only based off of your Test scores so if you are like me and you aren't a good tester you might want to think about taking it from someone else.

Brother Brau is the best! He truly cares about his students. I felt like he was pretty clear on what to expect out of his class and his tests. You will definitely need to put in a good bit of work outside of class, but it's doable.
He is a great Professor. Understanding the class vocabulary was the hardest part for me.
Class is not required but it is necessary to be there. Exams based of class notes.

Super cool guy. Not a fan of his tests; I think he focuses too much on what he calls "softball" questions. They end up being the hardest questions because they're not that applicable to the material and they are just random things he says in class. I would take him again purely for the entertainment of his classes.

Good teacher, teaches the material clearly. Its a hard class and he only grades the tests so you have to study a lot in order to do well. He posts all his lectures on YouTube which is helpful. He really cares about his students and wants to see them succeed not only in the classroom but in life.

This class is really very helpful and Professor Brau is a good teacher. However I was always really stressed because there was nothing but test grades. Everything depends on test grades and if you get behind it is really hard to catch up. This is a good class though just get ready to work for it if you want an A.
It is a challenging course but you get out what you put in.
The class was overall clear and straightforward. The tests were fair, but the in-class lectures weren't terribly great. Had to learn a lot of the material on my own.

I really appreciated the set up of this class. I loved not having required homework. As a result, it made doing the practice problems more enjoyable because I could do them at my own pace. The only reason I did well in this class was because of the option to watch the lectures over. There's a lot of information in a short period so that was helpful

Brau is a fantastic professor. I actually looked forward to his class! The only thing you are graded on is your exams, but if you go to class and study the notes, they really aren't that bad. He gives great lectures and just makes you want to be a better person.
Tough class, amazing professor!

Bro. Brau is the bomb! He is a great teacher and mentor. He cares about the success of his students in his class, but more importantly in life. His lectures are entertaining, informative, and inspirational. In order to do well in his class, you must complete the readings, do lots of practice problems, and pay attention in class. I highly recommend!
I loved this class. Brau is super energertic so it makes staying awake easy. Make sure to not get behind since there is no HW, only exams.

Love Bro Brau! He's both a life mentor and a professor. I didn't work too hard in the class but I'm expecting an A in the class. The work is definitely reasonable but KNOW the notes. It's not the math that makes finance challenging but vocab. I thought it introduced me to finance in business well. You can take this class and then work in finance
Brau is awesome! Loved his class and learned a lot!

He doesn't assign homework, your whole grade is determined by 4 midterms and a final. You get to drop one of the midterms. Awesome lectures! You don't have to attend, he records all of his lectures on Youtube.

He is a great teacher. He spends a lot of time helping you understand the concepts behind the math required in the class. Its hard, but if you study, understand what he teaches, and take great notes, you will do well. I appreciated that he took time to share spiritual thoughts and other helpful insights for real life in class.
Awesome guy. Very inspirational. The class is all based on tests so that can mess you up real quick if you do bad.

He is an amazing teacher who is very spiritual when he wants to. Kinda reminds me of my highschool football coach, but a really smart version of him. There are only 4 grades the whole semester, 4 exams, and the final is HARD. Brau is the best finance teacher at BYU, but just be ready for hours upon hours of studying and preparation.

Bro. Brau is a great teacher! He only scores tests though so if you aren't a good test taker beware. He really is a good teacher though, he always has an awesome spiritual thought and is way funny. Makes class fun.

This is not a class for the faint of heart. If you are wanting to go into Finance he is the professor for you, if you are just doing this for a minor I would recommend someone who does tests and is less strenuous. He is an absolute stud of a teacher though!

Be aware that your whole grade comes from tests. Class attendance isn't mandatory (or monitored), but its very helpful. Professor Brau makes himself available if you happen to have a difficulty he can help you with - especially those in the LGBTQ community. He gives good feedback/advice that goes beyond passing an exam or getting a grade.

Brau really cares about his students and is a great teacher. His lectures are great because he wants you to build the intuition not just learn formulas and pass the test. He spells out his expectations and how to do well in his class very clearly. So if you do what he tells you then you'll do well in his class.

Brau really knows finance and he explains it pretty well. If you don't go to class you'll probably struggle but the online textbook (myeducator) is really straight forward. I loved the structure of the class, NO HOMEWORK, NO QUIZZES, NO PAPERS, NO BUSY WORK. just 4 midterms and a final exam. The tests were pretty easy!
all on exams! Just stay on top of the material. Do the reading before class.
Great teacher. Be sure to get help in the lab if you're struggling.

Brau is one of my favorite professors! He cares about his students, gives great spiritual thoughts/life advice in every class, and really helps you internalize the information if you're willing to do your share of the work. His grading is very clear, though it is 100% based on tests. If you don't like to stress over tests, he might not be for you.
Very straight forward. Teaches in a very simple way. Actually teaches instead of just going through power point slides.

I really enjoyed Brother Brau. His teaching style is in the best interest of the students as he explains thing thoroughly, allows you to ask questions, and is lighthearted in class! He also posts his lectures on YouTube which is a HUGE help as the key to doing well on the tests is to study his notes. If you're taking Fin 201, TAKE IT FROM BRAU!

Brau is the best! Skim the textbook readings before class, write down the notes he takes during class, and review his lectures right before the test and this class is extremely doable. No trick questions, it's all clear-cut. Grade only based on tests, no hassle with homework! Amazing spiritual thoughts. Definitely brings the heat. TAKE 201 FROM HIM

The best thing about Brau is really does care, just generally. He cares about teaching, he cares about the material, and you can really feel that he cares about the students. His lectures style may not be your cup of tea, but for most it is. Great guy.
Your whole grade is based on your tests. Do well, and the class isn't too bad. You have to memorize a lot of formulas, but stick with it because it gets easier.
Great professor, but it's a really hard class. If you study hard and make sure not to underestimate the exams, you'll be fine. Hopefully.

Brau is a fine professor. I the way he teaches didn't help me understand the material a bunch. The way I did well in his class was through the textbook and learning from all the examples he has there.

Professor Brau is amazing. Although he doesn't take attendance, it is important that you are there every day to learn. You won't regret going to his lectures, they are amazing. Professor Brau does an amazing job at teaching this topic in a very simple way.

There are concepts that are difficult to understand but if you do the reading he will clarify everything in class. He does not waste anytime and explains everything you need to know for each test. The grading system is fairly simple but can bring down your grade if you do not at least read to understand what is discussed in class and take notes.
Great guy, very concerned with his students, and their academic and spiritual success. Very accessible and kind. Sometimes he doesn't do the best job at making things super clear though.
He is filled with enthusiasm so he is entertaining, but he also explains the material very simply and so that it is learner-focused.

Although it was a fairly difficult course, I quite enjoyed it. I would say its definitely important to put in time outside of class to master the concepts, especially since he will test you in-depth on things he only covers briefly in class. Part of what made this such a great class was the spiritual thoughts, which are always uplifting.

The class is based on 4 mid terms and then a final. If you show up, really seek to learn the concepts and practice them, you'll do great! He takes time for spiritual thoughts and professional development, that stuff makes the class fantastic. This was one of my favorites at BYU, especially because of bro brau!

Bro Brau is a 10/10. Inspirational, clear grading criteria, records all the lectures so you can go back to reference, and is life coach. I feel like I'm in the gym during class - pumped and ready to tackle anything. Take it from Brau for a real good time and low stress. Just make sure you understand what he does in class and your gold.
He cares about all his students and is very clear with what he expects in the class. It's a hard class but Brau does a good job of teaching it and clearly outlines what will be on the tests.

Professor Brau is a GREAT guy! You definitely have to work for your grade but it is doable. I bombed the first test but pulled my grade up after. His test has a lot of questions from his lectures so even if you can't go make sure you watch the YouTube videos and make note cards. Overall, loved the class. It's a good challenge if you like numbers!
Come to class. Try not to be intimidated, and you'll do fine.

4 midterms and a final, and that's your whole grade. That sounds stressful, but he teaches to the test and never tries to trick you. He's on the students' side. He was also inspirational, sharing spiritual thoughts every lecture. Prepare for class each day and you'll do fine.
Great Class. Be ready to study for your tests because that is all you are graded on. The lectures are very good and if you read the book before class they are easy to follow and remember.

The semester that I did it, he only graded off of tests. When I didn't constantly review throughout a unit, the test was hard. When I kept up on the material, it made it a lot more manageable. This is why I felt like the difficulty was a 3. He gives you all the resources you need to get really good at the material.
Brau is a phenomenal teacher. He gives incredible lectures and he really knows what he is talking about. If there is one class at BYU that everyone should take, it is Finance 201.

Dr. Brau is a great teacher. He makes sure to cover ALL the material on the tests. We only took tests in his class, no homework or participation. He takes breaks during class for things that are applicable to most, if not all, students. He also teaches you a lot spiritually. Do the readings, study the notes, listen to what he says, You'll do fine.

I'm a terrible test taker so I wish I could have taken this all test based course from someone who grades a little bit more balanced. He gets off topic and political in his lectures that could make it hard to follow. Not the class for me but I could see others liking it okay.
Jim Brau is awesome. HE expects you to work hard. The grade is solely dependent on Test Scores which makes it a little difficult. All in all He explains the material super well.

Fair class, great instructor, if you miss class make sure to watch the youtube videos on the class or else you will not do well on the test. You are tested one both in class understanding as well as material from the book.

Brau was a good guy, a bit on the "me" side. talks about himself and the gym and going ham. He says need to be in class or youre going to be automatically way behind. I had a hard time staying awake in his class and would often sleep through. He tries his best to be one with the age group. STUDY for the tests! every question actually matters.

Jim Brau is the best! The lectures were incredible. A note about difficulty. The material isn't actually that hard in my opinion (probably 3), but your grade is entirely based on exams. The midterms were only 30 questions so you miss 3 questions and thats a 90, A-. The grading system makes it hard to get an A on the class because there's no leeway.

Its all test based... Brau will explain super easy topics in a simple way, but doesnt take the time to explain more complex things. Another problem is he makes everything an acronym, which makes this class as hard as learning a foreign language.

Prof Brau is great. Expect to put in your share of effort working problems and making sure you understand the material, but if you know how to work the problems and you've gone over the lecture notes, the exams are a breeze. So many resources are available - TA lab, recorded lectures, lots of extra practice problems. Grade is based only on exams.

Jim is a great professor who really cares about his students. He tells you exactly how he makes the test which helps you get the best grade possible. You take four mid-terms and one final exam. There is no other required homework.

Best class I have ever taken. He actually cares about his students and their success. He isn't there to trick or make exams harder than content, he is there to be your friend and mentor. I would taken it again and again.
Puts all of his classes recorded on youtube which is nice so that you don't have to attend class. Difficult information and difficult tests.
Read, take notes in class, watch the YouTube videos and take more notes, You'll do great.

Professor Brau's a great guy. Very clear on what you need to know for the test, records his lectures so you can watch them again if you don't get it or if you miss class. Don't recommend missing too many classes though, or it gets a little hard to catch up. Would recommend taking FIN 201 from him.

Professor Brau is a good professor, just a little intense. The grade is soley based off of tests, there are 4 midterms and a final. If tests aren't your thing, take it from someone else. 80% of the test comes from the lecture, so go to class!

Really enjoyed his lectures but you want to pass, be ready to put in a LOT of outside class time for studying. Tests are 100% of the grades so if youre not a good tester, do not take from him. Really great guy, super funny and helpful!
One of the best teachers I have had at BYU
He is a great professor that explains everything well but tests are 100% of your grade.

Brau has a dynamic personality, so his lectures are all very intense. That said, he doesn't plow through without giving you time to take notes. He manages his TA's well, and they roam around helping whoever needs it. He doesn't give homework, the only grades in the class are 4 midterms and a final, because he grades your learning, not participation
Professor Brau is a good Professor. He tells you how to do well, so if you listen to him, you'll be fine.

Dr. Brau is an awesome professor who really strives to help his students understand the content. I loved that there was no busy work, only tests to determine my grade. That motivated me a lot to learn and understand the material. He's funny, charismatic, and dedicated to creating a spiritually-enriching environment in the classroom.

Dr. Brau has been one of my favorite professors. I love his spiritual thoughts. He can yell a lot, but its great in a 8am morning class, and often times just hilarious. He doesn't take attendance,but if you don't go to class you will fail. He posts his lectures online too if you need to go back and review.

Dr. Brau is a clear lecturer and explains concepts well. All lectures and reviews are available via youtube which is helpful. The book is really good as well. You are graded only on 4 tests, each worth 25%: the 3 highest midterm scores out of 4 with your lowest score being dropped and a cumulative final.

Brother Brau is an awesome finance professor! He really cares about his students and teaches in a very clear and direct way. He videos class so you can go back and watch is lectures while studying. His spiritual thoughts every class are very heartfelt and were honestly the best spiritually uplifting and inspiring parts of my whole semester!

Many find him difficult but it is simply because he requires you to learn what is in his lectures. Lectures are on Youtube. I skipped class for three weeks watched the lectures on youtube the night before and then got a 100 on the final. You can pass his class.

Tells you exactly what you have to do to get in an A in his class and is upfront about what is going to be on his exams. You have to work hard and know the material extremely well but the class is well worth taking. Brau is a great teacher and is always keeping things simple while also teaching real world application.

Great teacher, knows his stuff. Finance is just a fast paced class so you've got to keep up. He doesn't take attendance, so that's on you. The grades are all from 4 tests and a final. There are other teachers who take into account attendance and quizzes. I took fall semester too. Brau is a better teacher, but harder to get a better grade in IMO.

Bro. Brau is a good guy and really knows his stuff. He can go really fast at times and he does get off track at times with random things. He does have a spiritual thought in each lesson to help break it up and refocus which is always nice. No homework. Grade based off of tests only. Makes it difficult but easy to keep track.
Honestly, it was hard paying attention to him because of how full of himself he is as a person. It's a huge distractor from the material and his lectures are hard to pay attention to.

Dr. Brau is honestly one of the most amazing teachers I've taken here at BYU. That doesn't mean he was the easiest. I had to work so hard for my grade. He is so inspirational and explains concepts so easily. Not an easy class to pass, but if you have to take Finance, I'd recommend him.
difficult class, completely graded on tests. Do not take if you are credit heavy.

This class was so hard but Brau is really awesome. I probably would have done better in the class if I had taken from one of the other teachers because your grade isn't solely based on tests, but if I had the choice I'd probably take it from Brau again because his professional development and spiritual thoughts really impacted me. Take it from him!

Does a terrible job of applying and connecting the content. Grade is just four tests, all of which are pretty difficult. Makes it his thing to be all spiritual and humble but he almost comes across as prideful doing it.... I'd probably get roasted by everyone for saying that...

Best class I have ever taken in my two year here at BYU. I think the other reviews do Bro Brau justice. I would say you'd be a fool to take this class before or at the same time as Accounting 200. Pretty easy class if you enjoy business. Grade is based on tests only, but I haven't done any of the reading and have a 97% heading into the test.

Brau is a great professor. The material in FIN201 is pretty rigorous. Be prepared to work for your grade. This is definitely not a "show up and get an A" type of class. Your grade is calculated based upon the average of 3/4 midterms, and the final (in total four tests, each weighted equally).

Brau is an awesome professor! He was very specific in lecture on things that you would need to know for exams and the exams were very true to lecture. Brau was awesome about giving meaningful spiritual thoughts everyday and made class worth going to!!

The most insightful, respectful, caring, and intellectually challenging professor I have taken a class with during my time at BYU. He takes the time to give some of the greatest and most powerful spiritual thoughts I have ever heard. Even if you dont like Finance, it will still be your favorite class to attend. Bro B is the GOAT!

Brother Brau's class was great. He told you what you needed to do to get a good grade, and you could even miss a couple of classes and still learn the material via my educator or watch the youtube videos of the class (he records every class). His spiritual thoughts and career development speeches were inspirational and helpful.
I liked the way that the class was structured. 4 midterms and a final with the lowest midterm dropped. Not too bad if you keep up on the readings.

Professor Brau is great. He cares about his students, and if you pay attention in class you'll not only be inspired but learn finance. Your grade is entirely based on tests so that's something to be aware of.

Professor Brau is incredibly passionate and energized about everything, finance included. He brings alot of energy to class and shares fantastic spiritual thoughts ever class. He moves fast so if you haven't studied beforehand you wont know whats going on. Grade is only tests, 4 exams and 1 final. No homework, so its up to student to stay ahead

Brau is super awesome! He breaks up lecture with a spiritual thought every day and does his best to keep everyone interested. The class is graded solely on tests, but you can drop one midterm. No homework other than studying! but make sure you study.
Bro. Brau is a great teacher. The class is difficult, but watch his You Tubed classes and you'll learn everything you need to.
Take FIN 201 from Bro. Brau.

Bro. Brau is a great teacher for a variety of reasons: - you learn the material. Got to lectures and pay attention. Then review them. - his lectures are highly entertaining - his lectures are uplifting - he makes a conscious effort to be accepting and thoughtful - what you see and hear is what you get. He's very much himself.
Great professor, gives awesome lectures and really wants his students to succeed.

Professor Brau is one of the best professors hands down. He is not the easiest professor, but he seriously gives you all of the tools and chances you need to be successful. Go to the lectures, rewatch the lectures and study!
Jim is so great. He has really great lectures. Just study what he talks about in class and you will do fine.

great teacher. i loved that you could go back and watch the class again on youtube and watch him make his own notes. the tests were hard but i enjoyed studying for them and taking them. fun class. he is funny and explains things very well.

Bro. Brau is great and very enthusiastic. The grade is based on 4 midterms and a final (lowest midterm is dropped). The tests were challenging but doable if you put the work in. Read the textbook before class, pay attention, do the online topic quizzes and drill problems and then re-watch the lectures before the test and you will do fine.

The dude is a spiritual giant. He is super funny and gives great lectures. He tells you exactly what to know and what to study for. If you put in the work and learn it, this class can be relatively easy.
You know exactly what youll be graded on. His notes ARE the test. Finance is hard in general, but come to class, copy the notes, watch the reviews, and youll get a solid grade.
The class is hard but he is very clear with what you need to do to get a good grade.

Brau is a very great instructor. He does not allow you to take notes on a computer or have any electronics out. He gives better spiritual thoughts than most religions professors. He makes you work hard. The grade was based entirely on tests, no assignments to give any wiggle room. He probably uses "bro" a little to much.

Brau honestly cares for his students. Despite being in a class of over 800 other students he is more than willing to meet with students individually. You will get what you put into this class. Know the notes and you will do well on his exams.
Fantastic teacher who inspires you to be better within the class and within the gospel. A+
Fantastic Teacher. Super entusiastic. I really liked his lectures because he kept them interesting. I feel like I've got a great grasp on what Finance is after taking this test.

Bro. Brau is AMAZING!!!!! Not only is he the best at teaching finance clearly and energetically, the energy he brings to each and every class is so great! He is hilarious, but straight to the point. He is serious about what he does, but he also has the biggest hearts and care for each and every student. Do not take Finance 201 from anyone else!! :)

Brau is amazing. He is uplifting, motivating, and inspirational. The class is hard but he makes the lectures and expectations for tests very clear. If you put in the time, you will get a good grade. Very fun and upbeat class. Definitely a teacher you want to take finance 201 from!

Lots of math, but better than Acc 200. Make sure you know how to do the drill problems for his tests. He has 5 tests including the final and your top 3 midterms and final are what will determine your grade. So make sure to do well on the midterms!

Your grade is based on your tests. If you study the material effectively and attend class, you should do fine. I wouldn't recommend taking this class with a heavy semester load though. You will want to take time to understand the material because a lot of it builds off other lectures.
Fantastic teacher, just know that entire class is graded on exams.
The final is so hard that even I, who had an A going into the final, struggled through it. He really doesnt prepare you for the final. So you better had good scores in your midterms.

Dude's a boss. Has an alpha presence that blasts you with energy. Has a phenomenal balance between personal development moments in class, actually meaningful spiritual insights, and raw finance information. Class is similar to econ110 in terms of difficulty (with a greater emphasis on number crunching that concepts).
Prof Brau was great. His class was difficult but I learned a lot and the course expectations were very clear.
Professor Brau gives you the tools you need to succeed. It is a tough class, but if you study the way he tells you to, you will succeed. Very spiritual guy too. Funny and a good lecturer.

Brau is awesome. The content isn't too bad, but there is a lot of it. Grade is 100% tests. Don't know what the other finance professors are like, but an A is definitely attainable here if you put the work in.
You must put in the work to get the grade you want. Prof. Brau does a great job at explaining the intuition, but you will need to practice problems on your own in order to survive on the exam.

This class can be pretty hard for a lot of people, but Brau makes it bearable. He's hilarious and his lectures really make you want to attend class. The only grades are 4 midterms (he'll drop your lowest, though) and a final, so you have a lot of pressure to do well. But no annoying homework. If you study well enough, you'll do fine.
Best professor for Finance 201. Don't take it from anyone else if possible

Brau really cares about his students. He wants the best for them spiritually and emotionally. However he was not the best professor at easily explaining concepts. Reading outside of class is a must and you have to learn about 50% on your own. His test are very fair if you study.

He is super passionate about finance, business, and the spiritual and academic success of your students. If you pay attention in class and take notes then study them, the exams are not so bad. I am going to really miss this class. Brother Brau rocks!

You are gonna walk in, and have some guy scream at you for a bit until you realize that he won't stop yelling. You'll get used to it, and in fact it will kind of grow on you. Jim Brau tests you on exactly what he says he will test you on. TAKE NOTES DURING CLASS and you will be just fine. His spiritual thoughts were incredible. Strongly recommend
Taking this class is the closest thing I've experienced to being hit by a semi-truck while crawling across hot coals while being swarmed by an angry nest of hornets. But at least Brau is a funny guy.

Brau is the man! Hes probably is one of the best professors Ive ever had and works really hard to create an awesome learning experience. He does away with pointless busy work, only grading in test performance, but covers the material that is actually important. If youre going to take finance, take it from brau!

For a course with as much content as Fin 201 Brau does an exceptional job teaching in a way that helps you understand and comprehend the material. He also inspires you to become a better person, and to improve yourself. Just know that this course requires a TON of work regardless of who you take it from. Brau just makes it interesting.,

Jim Brau is an amazing professor! My fav thing about the class is that he posts ALL lectures on YouTube. I never went to class, but watched all the videos at double speed and did really well in the class. First test was the hardest, but if you purely study the notes and do practice problems, you'll do really well on all his tests. Use the TAs!

He is high-energy, as people say. Class is a whirlwind of hilarious experiences and a LOT of content. The (non-graded) reading preps you to understand what he says in class. The CLASS content, NOT the reading, is what you are tested on. So, when studying for the test, go over the notes/YouTubes/Problems from each CLASS. Really awesome man.
