Sometimes maybe Bro Brau has a lot to cover in class and he will rush through some concepts, so if you didn't read the text or are a slow note taker you will feel kinda lost. Sometimes I wrote down stuff but had no idea what it means. Loved Bro Brau's stories and spiritual thoughts though. Good breaks for the brain.

Finance is difficult but Professor Brau does his best to help you to understand the concepts and calculations. His doesn't have homework and you can access his lectures on youtube. Very engaging during lectures. Make sure you ask for help and clarification.

Professor Brau cares about his students a ton, and there is always help available if you want it. All assignments are optional, so there is absolutely no busy work, which I love. Just study the things you don't understand and pay attention in class. Don't take this class if you aren't a self-starter, other than that is's a great course.

I really loved professor Brau and how he made his classes exciting, however for someone who is not great at taking tests this class is not for you. There are no grades other than tests, and they are difficult. If you have a heavy class-load/work load I don't recommend taking this class.

Brau really cares about the students and what they think of him. Much of the lecture time is wasted on personal stories and tangents. If you cannot learn from reading the textbook then don't take this class.

Brau really cares about students. His lectures are entertaining and keeps you awake. His whole grading system is based upon 4 midterms and a final, so make sure to study for those. If you show up to class and take good notes, it's doable.
Prof. Brau is a really good teacher and guy. He's funny and keeps class entertaining. Your grade is 100% how you do on exams, though, so if you have test anxiety beware.

Dr. Brau is a cool guy. I think that he is a good teacher, though you can often get lost in all of the acronyms that he throws up, because he doesn't always make a solid connection to the definitions. This is why it's critical to do the reading before class. I think that I would have liked homework too, as it would have prepared us more.

Brau is a great teacher, but this class is hard. Don't expect to do the bare minimum and still get a good grade. You are only graded on tests and nothing else. Listen to everything Brau says in lectures and take good notes and you'll do fine on the tests. Also make sure to listen to his study tips. If you apply yourself you will do well.
He is the man. Definitely take finance from him. The fact that your entire grade is based off of a few exams is rough, but the class is awesome.
Good teacher. I wish there were more opportunities to be graded. I am a horrible test taker and the only grades in this class are tests so if you don't do well on the test then thats just to bad.

I absolutely loved FIN201 from Brother Brau. He made class super interesting and fun. Even if Finance is not your major, he did the best he could to make it applicable to you. Your grade is depended upon 4 midterms and 1 final. However, your lowest midterm may be dropped if you do the surveys he sends out. Great class!!

There is no busy work in this class, just 4 midterms and a final. As long as you study the in class notes you can easily get an A or A-. He posts his lectures on YouTube so right before every midterm I would do a quick review of the lectures and that was a life saver for me. If you put in the time you should be okay.
I had a great time listening to his lectures, he kept me alert and ready to learn.

Awesome professor. This class is structured well and easy to follow. The grade consists of only 4 exams but he drops one if you complete these surveys that he sends out. He makes class very entertaining and memorable. I would love to take another class from him.
He is an awesome professor but if you don't study really hard and thoroughly you will get destroyed.

Brau is great for an 8 am class, he has tons of energy and knows how to keep things interesting. there us no formula sheet for the tests, but he teaches in a way where you learn the material really well! class is youtubed, so if its hard to get out of bed you can always watch it later.

Bro Brau is one of the best teachers at BYU. His tests are very lecture-based and the class is entirely graded on 4 midterms and a final exam. He posts all of his lectures and exam review sessions on YouTube, which is helpful if you miss a day or want to review for the exam. Tests are hard, but if you put in the work you'll be fine.

Bro. Brau is VERY enthusiastic about what he teaches, which helped me be excited to learn about finance. He shares a spiritual thought every class and isn't just focused on the grade, but wants you to learn the material. This class takes effort if you want to do well, but attending every lecture is basically crucial even though it's not required.
He is an amazing teacher. Honestly just a great guy who is super helpful and passionate about what he teaches.
Very inspirational man. His spiritual thoughts are fire! tough class but you learn a lot. very doable if you put in the time and effort. Take good notes.f

Bro. Brau was awesome! He was so helpful and engaging in class. Attendance is not mandatory at all but I would highly recommend going to class every day. Class will be really hard if you do not attend class. Bro Brau knows his stuff and is great at helping with questions.

Professor Brau is one of the best professors I have had at BYU. He is energetic, funny, and spiritual. Grades only come from exams which means there is no homework. 75% midterms, 25% final. Attend the lectures in order to do well on the exams. Read the chapters before class to understand the lectures.
Professor Brau is great! He is extremely clear on what to study for on the test and how to succeed in his class.

Take this class if you are good at getting info from the textbook and like motivational classes. Do the topic quizzes. Bookmark the difficult questions, And study those relentlessly for the final. Take Verbatum notes for what he says in class and study those multiple times- this is where he gets his test questions. Wish I studied more often.

Brau was really great. Your entire grade is based on 3 midterms and the final so that's a little nerve wracking. Other than that, it's not bad. If you come to class and take notes you're guaranteed to pass the tests. Make sure to do the readings before you come to class so you're not lost.

I'm not a math or business person but I am doing pretty well. I skipped class a bunch towards the end because his lectures were online. But don't let that get you complacent. I still worked my butt off and watched his lectrues

Professor Brau teaches the material extremely well. However, he wasn't very accessible outside of class. The TA's are great at answering questions but it would have been helpful for him to be available for questions.
Your grade is simply 4 tests and a final nothing else.

Clear grading criteria. There are some questions on the test from class, but class is pretty much just the book regurgitated with a few things added in. I understood the book a lot easier. He does move fairly quickly in class and he includes some good spiritual thoughts. Great personal finance days.
Brau is a great teacher. The class takes a lot of time but there are a lot of resources and is doable if you are willing to put in the time.

Overall great professor. The only grades are the tests though, so he doesn't make you come to class and all practice problems are optional but if you don't take the time to do them it will hurt you. He also gives great lectures and is probably the most spiritual class outside of religion classes that you will find.
He is a great teacher who loves what he teaches, he lets you study as much or as little as you want!

Brau does a good job of explaining complicated material. The TA's are helpful if you go to the Lab. The material is difficult, but if you follow the Brau's tips, you will be able to succeed. He has spiritual thoughts everyday which are uplifting. All around a great class that is intellectually and spiritually strengthening.

The only bad thing about this class is the textbook. It is online and the quizzes are awful. Some of them are keyed incorrectly and none of them provide adequate explanations to answers. Bro Brau is awesome!
Great man! Really cares about his students and wants you to succeed. All grade based on 5 tests, you can drop one of them. Study HARD for tests and you will do well.
You definitely have to put in the work, but it's definitely worth it. You learn a lot!

Brau is a phenomenal teacher and I would highly recommend his class. The final grade is based on four exams which may seem intimidating at first, but the concepts covered on the exam are explained very well both in class, in the textbook, and during the review sessions. Plus, all sessions are recorder on youtube so you can review them.

Your grade is based on four exams. The lowest out of five exams, excluding the final, is dropped. As he says, tests are heavily weighted on in-class material. Take good notes in class, work hard and you will do well. Classes are recorded on YouTube so you can rewatch them in preparation for the exam. Very entertaining, enthusiastic and spiritual.

You're grade will consist of only test scores. No HW or quiz grades. Material is straightforward and Brau is very specific with what he wants you to know. The class lectures are youtube'd so attendance in class is not necessary.

A great guy that means well, but he goes off on a lot of tangents and personal stories that distract from the lecture. I felt like only about half of the class time was beneficial to my finance learning which made it hard to pay attention in class. Wants to help the students be successful. Study the lecture notes and you'll get an A.
Good Guy!

Brau is the best!!! Seriously he is always telling funny stories and keeping the class interesting. Finance isn't a class everybody loves, but he makes it enjoyable. He really cares about all of his students and is willing to talk to anyone who needs help whether that is socially or educationally.

Your entire grade is based off of three midterms and a final which makes it extremely hard to get a good grade in the class. He doesn't do the best job at explaining what exactly you are finding, more just how to get an answer. I would study for about 10 hours and would go to the TAs for each test and still struggled on every test.

Brau is a really a great professor and an overall stand-up guy. He always took time out of class to share something spiritual and something about the class in the real world, yet he always covered everything about the chapter in class. If you listen to what he tells you to do, you'll get an A.

I really enjoyed taking this class this semester. I believe that Brau is a caring guy that wants you succeed in many aspects of your life-not just finance. Your grade are based off of tests but the tests are not anything crazy. Another plus is that he does not have you do any busywork. Funny and energetic guy too which makes class a lot better!

Professor Brau has been one of my favorite teachers at BYU. He teaches difficult concepts very simply so most everyone is able to understand. He doesn't give you a bunch of pointless assignments either. Do well on the tests, you do well in the class. I would take another Finance class from him if I needed to.

Brother Brau is an awesome guy. He has a very open door policy for his office and is willing to talk about more than grades and finance. He has hilarious comments in class and inspirational thoughts. Tests are your whole grade so make sure to know the material he teaches in the notes.

For the first unit, I went to class at 8 am and didn't do well on the midterm. After that, I didn't go to class once. Professor Brau puts every lecture online and I was able to take notes, play, pause, and 1.5x speed at my leisure. I was able to learn much better this way and my exam scores reflected likewise. I appreciated this.

Jim Brau is an incredible professor and cares more about his students than nearly any teacher I have ever had; he is always going out of his way to help students individually, despite his large class sizes. There is no homework and your entire grade is based off of 4 midterms and a final, which I liked, but don't take it if that's not for you.

Brau is everything a BYU professor should be. Fin 201 is hard though. The class under Brau is all tests 4 tests and 1 final each worth 25% of your grade (He drops the Lowest one only hw you have is to study). The subject material is rather challenging but it is seriously one of the best classes I have ever taken. If you need fin201 take Brau.

There is no assigned homework and your grade is completely based on your test scores. If you attend class and right down everything he does and then just memorize those notes you can get an easy B. His spiritual thought and personal development each class make his class one of my favorite this semester. It was more spiritual than my religion class.

Lots of tests make up the entirety of the grade. Tests aren't bad as long as you have a full understanding of the material being tested and take good notes from his lectures. His lectures are entertaining, hilarious, inspirational, and are can't miss.
Good lectures, won't waste your time.

Brau is a bro, but he cares so much. He's very clear with what he expects of us and how we can succeed in his class. Go to class, write down everything he writes down and make sure you know that for the exam. 4 exams and a final but he drops one midterm. no homework either so that's nice.

Bro. Brau has to be the coolest professor at BYU. Take his early morning section cause his pre-workout hasn't worn off yet and he'll wake you up and get you pumped for the day! If you pay attention in class and go steroid mode doing practice problems before tests you should get an A. Spiritual thoughts alone make the class worth it. Such a bro!

Be sure to practice the drill problems provided by Bro. Brau. I went from getting 73s because I was studying the textbook to getting 97s on the exams. He's super energetic and his professional development and spiritual thoughts every class made this a fun class to attend. He also uploads all lectures onto Youtube if you do happen to skip class.

Dr. Brau is exactly what I wanted in a professor at BYU. His lectures are incredibly engaging and he covers all of the material he expects you to know. His class is based entirely on exams, so if you aren't a good test taker, I wouldn't recommend him. However, he tells you exactly what to do to perform well. His spiritual thoughts are phenomenal.
He tells you what he wants. He has great spiritual thoughts. The class itself is hard but he teaches it well.
Brau is an amazing Professor! My favorite at BYU so far! Tests are fairly easy. Do the end of topic quiz's and study class notes. Lectures are posted of Youtube if you can't attend.
Brother Brau is awesome! I really got a lot out of his class. He has great lectures that are very engaging and really prepare you for the exams.
Brother Brau has been one of my favorite professors. He has a great sense of humor so his lectures are engaging. It is a challenging class, but if you put in effort you can get the grade you want.
Class grade is made up of all tests. Take good notes, and do practice problems and you will do well.
Really cool guy, gives lots of resources to help students but still a really hard course.

Brau is the best teacher to take for Finance. He's chill, his tests are easy, and his spiritual thoughts are on point. He tends to over-hype his tests ("steroid mode bro"), to the point where I was annoyed that I studied so much bc it wasn't necessary. The MyEducator textbook is super helpful.

Finance 201 is a very difficult class, and so it requires a lot of studying, but Brau gives no homework, so you have to try to keep up on the material by pacing yourself. The lectures are so important, most of the tests come from class. DON'T MISS CLASS. He records his lectures and uploads them to YouTube so you can rewatch.
Great professor! Really cares for his students. Just pay attention to the lectures. This is KEY.

Bro B is a great teacher! He is very funny and his spiritual thoughts are great! The class is tough. 4 midterms (lowest dropped) and a final make up all your grade. Your biggest benefit is reading the text before his lecture. His tests are hard, but straightforward. You get what you put in in this class.
He has great lectures, very funny, and intense. He always includes a spiritual thought and they are some of the best parts of class.

Honestly, the best professor I've ever had in college. He is very aware of his students, is available outside of class, breaks up the class with professional development announcements and spiritual thoughts. His lectures are straight forward and thorough to help you prepare for his exams. VERY spiritually inspiring.
Everything is dependent on his lectures.
He is such a great professor, loved every minute of class.
Awesome professor! Really cares about his students. Love going to class. No assignments just exams.

Prof. Brau is the best. He records all his classes so you can watch them online if you have to miss class. Grades only on test scores. His tests come straight from the lectures, so if you are familiar with that material, you should do just fine. He gives inspirational spiritual thoughts and really cares about the overall well-being of his students.

Brau is a great teacher. He genuinely cares that his student actually learn the material, not just memorize it for a test. You have to go to class and it is lecture heavy so you have to study and put in the work outside of class in order to fully understand. But if you do put in the work you will do well in the class.

FIN 201 itself is a beast, but I actually wanted to go to class because Bro. Brau is worth it. He genuinely cares about all his students and is good at holding attention even at 8 AM. It's stressful that your grade is based only on your test scores, but he's right that it does force you to really learn the material. One of the best profs here.

Brau is a overall good teacher, the only hang-up is your entire grade is based off of the 4 midterms and final you take. He does not give any busy work, so if you want to learn you NEED to go to class and read the book. If you do those things, the content become manageable.
Bro. Brau is a great teacher, he is very passionate about the subject and he goes thr things pretty fast. Rewatching lecture has been really helpful for me to prepare for exams.

Brau is the man. He has his lesson planned out and if you show up to class, take the notes that he write, read your textbook, do the practice problems, you'll end up with at least a B+. Brau makes his class great. One thing is I wish Brau did a more in depth review of the final exam, but besides that it was great.

Bro Brah is awesome. He cares about his students and wants them to succeed. His exams can be difficult if you don't study for them in the way he outlined in the syllabus. You will love his spiritual thoughts.

Brau is the man. He teaches so that you understand finance. In order to succeed in his class, you have to put in the time, but it is totally doable to get an A. I have gotten 100 on three of the midterms. Take the class! He gives you everything you need to succeed.

I really enjoyed this class. Professor Brau gives incredible spiritual thoughts and the course material is not too difficult to understand. Make sure to study his notes before every exam and you'll be set.

I loved Brother Brau! I had FIN201 at 8 am and he made it so exciting and easy to stay awake. There are no assignments or quizzes, so your grade is totally based off of your 4 midterms and final (he drops a midterm if you complete two surveys). If you are willing to put forth effort, take this class! It was the best!

Bro. Brau is an excellent and enthusiastic professor! Super fun guy with a powerful testimony that he shares each class period. All his lectures are recorded and posted on youtube so you don't have to go. 100% of your grade is based on test scores. 90% of the answers come directly from class. Highly recommend him!
Absolutely no required homework. Only tests count toward your grade.
Professor Brau is smart and entertaining. Read the chapter, go to class, understand the info and it won't be too difficult.

great professor I have only been at BYU for two years now and he has been my favorite professor so far, but he does make you work for it. His class is not a walk in the park. You only get graded on 4 midterms and a test so you have to be prepared. His lectures are great. He is very energetic, probably because he is drinking pre-workout in class.

Professor Brau does a great job at being very thorough in his lectures and making sure that you are able to understand the material. His class is very test heavy though so you gotta make sure you understand the material that is taught.
Great guy that really cares

Really cares about his students and is a very uplifting teacher. Grades are solely based on test scores, which can make getting an A pretty tough. Lectures are fast paced and sometimes he would give formulas without much explanation as to how they related to the bigger picture. Overall tough class, but great teacher.

Professor Brau is an amazing teacher. He knows what he is talking about and how to apply everything we learn to the real world. My favorite parts of his lecture was his inspirational thoughts. He has an amazing testimony! Go talk to him in office hours if you need a pick me up!

Great teacher. Makes Finance interesting and gives great messages. But man, the class was brutal. Never have I studied so much for a final. I really am just praying to pass. See ya later business school.

Brother Brau is a great professor who truly embodies what a BYU faculty member and professor is meant to be. Some of the best effort I have seen personally in a professor here at BYU. In terms of the course, its very test heavy. 4 tests and one midterm. Tests are made tricky on purpose, they can trip you up. Simple course.

He makes you know your material. Only test no other grades so be prepared to study. 4 test and final drops lowest test if you do the optional surveys (5 minutes total) Will replace over all grade with your final grade if you do better than your average. Be prepared for a lot of spiritual talk... as a non mormon at BYU it did get a little much.
Brau was great, taught really well and made class enjoyable. Class is a lot of material but if you study totally feasable.

Bro. Brau is bomb. He teaches enthusiastically, and he is very clear about his expectations. Literally do what he tells you to, and you'll do fine. Be lazy and think you know best, and you probably won't do too hot.

Bro B. is awesome. He is really passionate about learning, and he cares about his students. The class itself is difficult but definitely not impossible. Bro B does a great job of teaching exactly what you need to know for exams in class. His class is super dependent on good note taking, but he guides you through it. Make sure you practice!

Brau is a good professor! However, if you are an international student like me, be prepared to teach yourself! The in class lecture is good to give you a solid overview, but you'll need to do much more than only attend his lectures. Know the notes! Watch the youtube videos again and again! There is no homework only 4 midterms and a final

Professor Brau is one of my favorite teachers at BYU. It is obvious he cares a lot about all of his students. The only grades in the class are the tests, but Brau tells you exactly what to study and how to be prepared for each test. His spiritual thoughts are awesome as well, great guy. Would highly recconmend taking Fin 201 from Brau.

I'd take finance from a different professor. Brau is entertaining, but I didn't like the structure of his class. Your grade is based solely off of 3 tests and the final, and the tests are only 30 questions so you can only miss one to get an A (the final is 50 questions). If you're trying to get good grades to get into a program, take someone else.

Brother Brau is the man. Class breakdown: 4 midterms, 1 final. No other grades. Here's how to get an A in his class: 1) Copy EXACTLY what he writes in class 2) Rewatch the class youtube videos and also write down what he SAYS 3) Watch the TA reviews on youtube + do the drill problems on Learning Suite 3) Read the book + work the practice problems

Dr. Brau is a great professor. He knows his stuff and makes class fun and exciting and also spiritual. There is no HW, just four midterms and the final, and if you take the surveys you can drop one of the midterms. It's important to read the material before class because he can go fast. Work hard and utilize the TA's, they're happy to help too.
Good teacher. Go to class, read the book, and do practice problems and it's not bad at all. Straightforward, though you do need to study hard.

Br. Brau is an awesome teacher. He shows a ton of energy in front of such a large class. Not only did I learn a lot of Finance, but I learned a ton about just being a good person. I found his class more uplifting than my religion class. This class is a lot of material, but if you study the way he tells you to it will not be that hard. Great class!
Wonderful professor. Funny, inspiring, and a good teacher. Highly recommend.
Class grade is made up solely from 5 exams. Puts lectures on Youtube. Study well and you are guaranteed for success.

I really enjoyed these lectures. Professor Brau is a great teacher and I loved his spiritual thought each class. He only grades tests, no homework assignments, which can be stressful. He does put his classes on youtube which is super helpful! Make sure to copy his notes and do plenty of practice problems!

I have loved Professor Brau! He really knows his stuff and really wants the students to succeed. Your whole grade for the class is based on 4 midterms and a final, so if tests aren't your thing then take it from someone else. I personally found it very nice that I didn't have to ace a bunch of other busy work.

As far as coursework goes, there are only 3 midterms and 1 cumulative final. I felt like the tests really aren't that bad but you have to put countless hours into studying if you want to do well. The tests are basically his lectures. He seems pretty fair but you'll have to work your tail off if you want an A. Material wasn't all that intuitive.

Great Professor. Great in class and very helpful when I emailed him and met with him outside of class. Grade is all based on tests, but they are very straightforward if you attend class, read, and study. Always begins with a prayer and give a spiritual thought in class. Very practical teaching style. Would highly recommend this class!!

Professor Brau was one of the best professors I have ever had. period. There really isn't much more to say other than he is such a great teacher and visionary. Thank you Brau for all the meaningful lessons on finance and life.
I really enjoyed this class. Although it was challenging, it was worth taking. Dr. Brau is a really good teacher. He wants us to succeed, but also challenges us.

Brau is awesome. He teaches the class like he is teaching to all non-business majors, so it's your own fault if you don't get something out of this class. He is very understanding, but has very clear expectations. He bases a lot of his tests on the notes from class. Your only grades are 4 midterms and a final. Take his class (taught in the winter)!
Brau is fun. His class is fairly difficult. He has his system worked out.

Great teacher, although he is kind of crazy. He has a lot of energy, especially early in the morning. Your grade is contingent upon midterms and a final only. There is a ton of memorizing and practicing you will need to do to get a decent grade. After taking this class from this professor I decided I do not like finance and I'd hate to major in it.
Jim Brau is the best professor at BYU. He is clear in what he expects. He shares inspirational spiritual thoughts every class. Do the drill problems and study lecture notes and you'll get an A.

I highly recommend taking finance from Bro. Brau but be aware that you do have to put in your own work. Make sure to do the readings to best understand the material. Your grade is based solely on tests. Classes are energetic and he really cares about his students.

Brau is awesome! His class was one I looked forward to everyday. His grades are based completley of test scores, but he is passionate about the topic and really takes time to explain it. Another thing to be aware of is he does not allow tech in the class. I really did enjoy my time in the class.

Finance 201 is a tough class, but Brau makes the concepts clear and wants students to succeed. There are 4 midterms+final, and your grade is based solely off of them which is tough if you don't test well. In general, Brau is a great professor and I loved his lectures! My one complaint is I wish that he provided more practice problems like the test

Jim Brau is one of the best professors I've had at BYU. His class is only graded on tests, which can make tests more stressful, but he does an excellent job preparing his students for the test. He also makes his class enjoyable. I had it at 8 am, and chose to go to class even when he posted his lectures on YouTube.

Professor Brau is a great professor! He gives an inspirational thought every day part-way through the lecture to give you a break. You also work a lot of problems in class so it doesn't feel like a super-long lecture. You will have 4 midterms and a final and he drops the lowest midterm and then each exam is worth 25% of your final grade.

Brau is the best option if you need to take Fin 201. This class is just hard in general and his class is only based on 5 tests. However, he gives great lecture, has great TA's and gives awesome spiritual thoughts during class. If you go to class,do the my educator reading and take really good notes you will have all the tools to get a good in class

Prof. Brau is inspirational and caring. Personally, I really liked having grades only based off tests. In my Econ 101 class we had some homework that did not help at all for preparing for the tests, so I ended up doing much more work. In this class, I can focus solely on preparing for tests at my pace, with as little or as much practice as needed.

Bro Brau's Fin 201 class is graded purely on tests. There are 4 midterms and 1 final. You have the option to drop one midterm or to keep your score on the final as your final grade if its higher than your average test scores. If you do the reading and go to class you can get a decent grade, but you'll probably have to study pretty hard for an A.

Dr. Brau is great! His class is very organized and super interesting! He really cares about his students and loves Finance. His spiritual thoughts and professional development moments were very inspirational and helpful. I hope to take more classes from him in the future.

Great guy. You will learn a lot more than just finance in this class! Study the notes and you should do okay. He definitely makes sure to test on whether you just memorized everything or if you actually know it.
Not a fan of this class. Test are pretty doable but if you are taking this class for your minor your better off taking it from someone else.

Professor Brau is the best! He brings energy into class every day which is great. Your grade only depends on tests, so if you do not perform well on tests this might not be the class for you. That being said, everything we do in class is essentially test prep and there are always great practice problems to go over.
Solid Professor. Loved his class. Very accessible and willing to help. His lectures are enjoyable. Pay attention and take good notes and youll do great.

Brother Brau is honestly one of the best teachers i've ever had. He really does care about his students. His class is graded completely off tests which for this class turns out really fair. The class is not that hard if you study enough to learn the concepts rather than just memorizing the formulas.
Brau is the man. Take his class seriously. Put in the time because everything depends on your test scores.
Brau is awesome. The class is pretty challenging. No homework, all tests (four midterms and a final). Even if you don't want to take the class you should go listen to his spiritual thoughts.

Brother Brau obviously cares about his students. That being said, this class is all about the tests, so if you are not confident in your test taking abilities, take Finance from someone else. All of the material taught is extremely useful. There is plenty of opportunity to do well in his class.

Bro Brau has been teaching Finance for so many years he has developed a core understanding of what he thinks is important, and knows exactly where students tend to mess up. He is extremely clear during class about highlighting essential information. All of his classes from this semester were uploaded to YouTube which made reviewing for tests easy

Bro. Brau is one of my favorite professors so far at BYU. He explains the material very clearly, using real life examples so we can understand the intuition behind the formulas. DO NOT TRY TO MEMORIZE THE MATERIAL. The entire grade is test scores. No HW or quizzes. If you understand the material, the tests aren't bad. Also the best interview prep!!

Brother Brau is one of, if not the best professor I've had at BYU. From the beginning of the semester he is incredibly clear on how to be successful in his class. The concepts can be tricky at times but if you rewatch the lectures online you'll understand it better. Amazing spiritual thoughts that will leave you feeling the Spirit after every class

Only uses tests for grade. But, gives a very clear outline of what to expect on the test. If you go to class and take notes than you will succeed. He was a great professor and really wants everyone to succeed.

Professor Brau is a good teacher. He has a clear grading criteria, and tries to prepare students the best he can. I think he sometimes gets ahead of himself, and teaches material the way that it makes sense to him, and not to a room full of new finance students. It could be that those sections he just doesnt have the time to cover material.

Great teacher. His lectures are posted online which really helped to learn it quicker on my own time. If you watch the lectures at 2x speed, take really good notes, do a bunch of practice problems and you'll easily get an A. That's about 4 hours per week.

The only grades are exams. This is great because there are no homework or busy work assignments. This is bad because if you don't test well you are screwed. There are lots of ways to practice and have the material mastered for the test. Brau is a very engaging lecturer and many of the questions are based off his lecture materials.

Brother Brau is one of my favorite teachers! He always has a spiritual thought, prayer, & personal development resources. Though I've never spoken to the guy, I can tell he cares about all his students! He respects our feedback. Your gradeyour test scores, but he prepares us well. There's a TA lab that rocks & he records all lectures for re-watch

Bro. Brau is a great professor. His classes are fun and inspiring. The material isn't always easy for everyone and I personally would recommend taking accounting 200 before Finance 201 because it requires an understanding of balance sheet and income statement accounts.

To be successful in Brother Brau's class, you'll have to come in with an open mind as he does things a little differently than most other professors. He is against using technology in the classroom. This was annoying at first, but when you get past that he explains the concepts very clearly and if you pay attention and work, it isn't hardtosucceed

Awesome professor, and a great course. The only grades were 4 midterms and a final, so if you do not stay on top of studying you wont do well. He really cares about his students, and always has uplifting class periods. He teaches very simply and clearly.

No homework, and lectures are optional. The entire grade is based on midterms and the final, so if you are not motivated to stay on top of things, it will not go well. He's a great lecturer and keeps you awake. No busy work, and the class is very interesting.

This is an awesome class. Brau makes learning finance interesting! Even though this class is pretty hard, I can honestly say i've enjoyed his lectures. I would recommend reading the online textbook and doing the practice problems, repetition is the key to getting these things down.

Brother Brau is a great professor. He is very inspirational and teaches the material in a clear way. I really enjoyed the class and thought that it wasn't very hard. The class was easy but be aware that there are only five grades, four midterms ( you can drop one if you participate in a survey) and the final. He is also pretty PC in class.

The whole grade is based off of tests. At first.i was nervous that there wouldn't be any extra cushion but he does a really good job at making sure we are prepared for them and not surprised by anything on them. He loves finance, and goes out of his way to make the class meaningful

I really appreciated Brother Braus enthusiasm and charisma. He seems to have found the perfect balance between engaging and entertaining students. Even though this is BYU, Brother Brau was the only one to share his testimony or speak freely about the gospel. Take FIN 201 from Brau.

Great teacher, hardest class. Maybe not for some, if you're already financially inclined, but the class takes a lot of dedication, especially because everything Brau says is paramount (and sometimes the things he implies and doesn't say). You will have to go to the help desk for some things, you will have to put in a lot of the work yourself.

Your whole grade is based on 4 exams and a final, and you need a 94% for an A. Just be aware that if test taking isn't your strength, you might want to take a different section. That aside, I've really enjoyed this class. I had an 8 am section, but Brother Brau is good at keeping people awake, and I enjoyed his lectures.

I love Brau!! He's the coolest! He breaks down the class very well. If you want to do well, do what he says. There is a lot of help available to you, take advantage of it. I love how sincere he is in sharing his testimony and personal life experiences. He is very inspiring. Take his challenges, they will change your life. One of the best at BYU.
Great Class. GO TO CLASS. study the material and work the problems.

Brother Brau is one of my favorite teachers I have ever had at BYU. He is inspirational and sets time out of class to do a spiritual thought. If you miss class you will struggle getting caught up but the classes are filmed and put on Youtube in case you have to miss. Your grade is based solely on tests, if you do good on your final it'll replace it

Bro Brau is an energetic teacher. The only graded assignments are the four midterms and the final. If you do some extra credit, he drops the lowest midterm. The tests require that you study, so if you put forth the time, you'll be able to succeed. He explains the material pretty well

Professor Brau is an awesome professor. His class is pretty difficult, so you will have to work for it. Your entire grade is based off of 4 midterms and a final. Class and textbook reading are optional, but I would encourage it. Brau loves what he does and the passion he has for finance helped me to find the motivation to go to class.
Brau will keep you entertained during class. It can be tough, but studying the notes and watching the lectures on Youtube before the tests will ensure you do well.

Brother Brau is a great professor. I love his lectures, especially the spiritual thoughts! The class is a little hard for me because I'm not a very good test taker and our grades are solely based on 4 midterms and 1 final, he does drop the lowest midterm if you do the surveys that he sends out. If you study like he asked, you will do great!

A few tips for success: Always keep up on the lectures, which he posts to YouTube as well and is super helpful. Don't miss the test reviews and always do the in-class problems and MyEducator textbook practice exams before each test. You'll do great if you do ;)

The grade is completely based on your test grade but he prepares you for it. Something I like about him is he tells you the tests are hard and for the most part, people study so hard that they do extremely well on the test. His lectures are great because of his spiritual thoughts. The spirit is always super strong. Phenomenal teacher & standup guy.

Brother Brau is a wonderful professor--he explains financial concepts very simply and orderly and his exams align entirely with the material taught in class. The spiritual shares and professional development insights shared each class promote lifelong learning and are certainly helpful for developing life skills.
Great teacher but moves super fast and makes you work hard

I enjoyed his class. The first unit was pretty difficult, so people tend to drop out as time goes on, but the rest of his class is pretty easy. 100% test based. Pretty easy if you put in the time to review outside of class.

Pros: his tests are a lot easier than the other FIN201 teacher. His tests are mostly based off his lectures so you know you'll never be tested on things not covered in class and his lectures are on youtube Cons: grade is based on the test and there are no other points. Tests require a lot of memorization. Overall a great teacher!

Your entire grade in the class is based off of your tests. The tests are difficult, but manageable. The average on almost every test was around a B. He's an awesome and fair teacher, would recommend to anyone.

Brother Brau was a fantastic teacher. Really inspiring, and he teaches with the spirit. It is a hard class though, and he goes very quickly. He only grades on his tests so test grades are really important. If you follow what he says to do you will succeed.
Very good professor. He is awesome, very spiritual, and very motivational. He's a convert and has strong opinions on many things, but is very respecting of others.

Brau is a wonderful teacher. I love how he structures his class! He tells you what will be on the test and it is actually what is on the test! The things you learn are applicable to anyone not just finance majors. I wish all my classes were structured like this! He also cares for individual students and makes time to meet with you if you want.

Grade is decided by the average of 3 midterms and final. Class has 4 midterms in total and the lowest grade is dropped. Brau is super caring and motivational. BE PREPARED TO WORK HARD. But if you put in the time and study your notes form class, you will get good grades on the tests.

Prof Brau is an acquired taste. He is super high energy, and is extremely passionate about finance. At first I was a little hesitant about him but by the end of the semester I absolutely loved him! He is super efficient with him time, and always takes a moment during class to add a spiritual thought. Highly recommend him!

Brau is the best teacher I've had ever! His class is hard, but if you work hard it's totally possible to get a good grade. Your grade is based off of four exams and the final. No homework or quizzes. The best part of the class is the spiritual thoughts. It's obvious Brau cares about his students and makes himself available to help.

Bro Brau is a great professor. His classes are very helpful. The only grades come from tests, which is good or bad, depending on your test taking skills. All the tests are only 30 questions too. He says everything on his tests come from his lectures and the book, which is true, but some details are somewhat obscure. Watch the youtubed lectures.

Professor Brau is one of the most passionate teachers that I've ever had in my BYU experience. He's super dedicated to his work and really wants you to truly understand all of the concepts. The class is completely graded and based on tests, but if you study well the material you will do well.

As long as you take really good notes and practice the problems, you'll be fine. (I did better in the class when I started watching the recordings instead of attending class, but that's not true for everyone.) There is no graded homework, just the tests. So, if putting that much pressure on tests stresses you out, take from someone else.

My experience in Professor Brau's class was amazing. Professor Brau has his class setup to help you to become someone, not just simply to get a grade. The lectures were both interesting and inspiring. Professor Brau is really easy to relate to and you can tell he cares about you as an individual and only wants what is best for you.
He is awesome! just get ready to work for your grade
The YouTube videos will be your best friend. Watch those and read before class and youll do fine. Class wasnt too bad! Lectures are enjoyed.

Great spiritual messages. Your grade is based entirely off of the tests. If you want some assignments to cushion your grade, take this class from someone else. I took this class after accounting 310, which helped a lot. I wouldn't take this before at least taking accounting 200. I rarely did the reading, practice problems are key!!!

His class is only based off test scores. You take 4 midterms and a final. He will drop your lowest midterm. He is intense and loving. In class he inspires you to get gains and make something of yourself, while at the same time makes it clear that not everyone will succeed. You are not given a formula sheet on the tests.

He's a good guy. Make sure you get a study group before the first test, preferably with people who have taken other business classes- I always got good help from their experience. He gives good material to study for the tests on Learning Suite and the TA reviews are helpful (you can watch them on youtube if you can't make it to them in person).
Awesome teacher. Tough class. Learned a lot.

Professor Brau is one of my favorite professors I have taken at BYU. Finance has not come easy to me in general, especially with the fact that the only grades in the class come from the exams. Study hard and pay close attention to the things he says multiple times in class. He is willing to help out.

Brau knows what he is talking about, I just found that it was difficult to grasp all the concepts he goes over. The online text book is practically useless because all the tests are based off of his notes. Luckily, he records all the class lectures so you can go back and watch them. This class was a rough one for me, but he is very inspirational.

Brau is the coolest, most fun finance teacher you could possibly get. He will keep you engaged in class and really cover all of the material. He doesn't give you any busy work, he just expects you to know your stuff. He may seem hard or intense but if you do what he says, you'll do well in the class.
He only grades on the 4 midterms and the final. Make sure to take good notes from the lecture!!! He asks straight from them.
Great class. I learned a ton this semester. This class requires a lot of studying and your grade is based only on your test scores, but is overall a good class.

Brother Brau is a great professor for Fin201! He is clear about what he will test you on and lets you know how to study to do well on his exams. Tests are the only thing that count on your grade, so if you aren't a great test-taker then you will want to take this class from another professor. Overall a great class.

Brother Brau is a great professor. Finance can be a tricky subject but if you go to lectures, take good notes, and really try to master the concepts you'll do just fine. He tells you the exact way that you should study for his tests and you should definitely follow his advice! Engaging, funny, and spiritually uplifting lectures. Brau is great!

Professor Brau made finance a great class. He didn't make it easy, but he told you everything you needed to get an A on the exams. It was a lot of hard work to adequately study for exams and it was stressful because the exams are the only thing in the gradebook. That being said Jim is a great teacher and tries his best for everyone to succeed

Bro Brau is a really great teacher. He cares a lot about his students. This class is crazy hard but if you go to the lectures and the reviews, you will do decently on your tests. Bro Brau is a great guy and one of my favorite professors in the Marriott School. I felt like I learned so much about finance but I also learned spiritually from him.
Hard class, professor isn't the most considerate, but very clear on what to learn
Brau was awesome. Finance came pretty easily to me, but he explained it very well and was very explicit about how to do well in his class. Study the notes!

I loved Bro. Brau's class. His teaching style is direct and to the point and you know exactly what you need to do in his class to learn the material and receive a good grade. He is the most inspirational teacher I have had at BYU. I would recommend his class without a doubt.

Professor Brau really cares about his students! Even though I was in a class of 400+, I felt like he really cared about me and my success. Be prepared to work hard! The material is useful and necessary, but there is a lot of it. The downside of Brau's class is that your grade is determined by just 4 tests.

Very engaging teaching style. Refreshing to have a class with a man who has a holistic perspective on his class. The course is entirely exam based. If you are not very independent or proactive, this is not the class for you. Understand his expectations quickly! Talk with a friend or something and then take the class!
Great professor. Grades based on midterms and final only. No homework, quizzes, or projects.

Study the lecture notes like mad! The first test I did every single practice problem but hardly went over the notes, and I got a 80%. The next test I spent more time on the lecture notes and got a 93%. The last two tests (not any easier) I spent most of my time of the lecture notes and got 100% on both. Make sure you understand the equations!

This guy is a ball of energy. He's real, he is amazing at applying every lecture to things used in every-day life, and he cuts the crap and tells it how it is. Awesome teacher but its a course you've gotta put the time in to do well!

Brother Brau is, in my opinion, one of the best business professors at BYU. This class is super hard, though! Honestly probably the hardest business pre-req for me. He's super good at lectures and explains everything so you understand it, but I would HIGHLY recommend watching each lecture at least twice and doing ALL of the drill problems.

Brau is dope! If you write down all the notes he puts on the projector and can memorize them, you shouldn't get below a 90 on a test. Your grade comes from 3 tests (4 total, but one is dropped) and the final. No graded homework. He's always jacked up on pre-workout, so you won't get bored. Very spiritual and supportive of LGBT+ community

Brau is, by far, the best professor at BYU, especially for finance. He teaches the concepts intuitively and is the most caring professor that I've had in 4.5 years. He will lose sleep for you and go to the ends of the earth to help you out with basically anything. His spiritual thoughts literally changed my life. Only grades  tests, so study hard.

Brother Brau is hands down the best professor I have had at BYU. Homework, quizzes and practice exams are not graded and really give the student a chance to learn the material and not fear failure of losing points. He is extremely relatable and is very real with his students. I took his 8:00am class and didn't fall asleep once. He is a motivator!

Don't believe the haters when they say Brother Brau isn't a good teacher. First of all he has a great accent, secondly he teaches concepts clearly and covers all the basics and lastly he actually helps you develop as a person and helps you learn useful finance skills that actually help you in the real world.
If you can put in the time you can get an A, it's a relatively tough class but he is clear about what is expected for an A, so it comes down to how much you practice the concepts.

Great professor. He cares about his students and puts lots of energy into teaching. Grade is based on 3 highest midterms plus the final. Would recommend going to lecture though they are put on Youtube. His notes system is organized and helpful. Would recommend going to TAs for help if needed. Practice problems online help with test preparation.
