Professor Brau was a great finance teacher! All classes are put on YouTube so attendance is not mandatory. Your grade is based purely off of four tests and the final. He drops your lowest midterm and if you score higher on the final than your actual grade, you get that grade. Finance is just plain hard material, but Pro Brau is a fabulous teacher.
Great class, just make sure to study hard for the exams.
Super cool guy, great teacher if you have mental illnesses
Brau is awesome.  Highly recommend the class.  If you take the class, find a study group and work through the practice exams every week.  You'll be golden if you do that.
Brau is always wanting to improve and is always wiling to hear your input.  He works his classes so that students can stay awake.  No technology is allowed in class.
Tough to find an fin professor more invested in you. Class was as inspirational and spiritually edifying as a class can be. He's there for you. Not an easy class--but you knew that already.

Brother Brau is a great man, but a frustrating teacher. The text book taught the class material far better than he would even try to. The motive to go to class for the year was purely for the 3 or 4 random fun facts intentionally excluded from the textbook to make you come, and his spiritual thoughts. Frustrating. He complicated concepts.
Great Professor that wants you to succeed.  Lots of work, but does what he can to keep you involved in the lectures to prepare you for the tests.
Vey has class. I basically had to teach myself everything from the book.

So overall he was pretty good I just didn't understand the way he taught. He moved very fast through the material. Also, we were only graded on our exam scores which made exams stressful. He cares about his students and does a lot to help them but the informal way that he teaches just made it difficult for me to understand.
This was a hard class.  Bro Brau records all of his classes so you can watch them later on youtube which is awesome.  Great class, great teacher.  Really hard.

Overall good professor, tries to make the topic interesting.  Be ready to have a heavy equation based class.  He does well to explain them, but you'll be somewhat lost unless you actually read the chapters online.  His inspirational messages are frequent, but some really hit the point.  Overall a down-to-earth and makes finance feel worth learning.
He's awesome. We had youtube videos of the class to go over the material as much as we wanted.
Test based, literally no other assignments, so that sucks. Classes on YouTube

Brother Brau is awesome! Super nice guy. However, the class was very difficult. Your only scores come from four midterms and a final exam. The material isn't incredibly difficult, but there is a ton of material to remember.
Spiritual thoughts great!

Dr. Brau is a good guy. You can tell that he genuinely cares about his students. The only grades are from test; there is no homework. The best way to prepare is to do the reading and take the practice tests. Going to class is definitely helpful but I guess his teaching style didn't click with me so I mostly learned by the reading and doing practice
Super spiritual. Super intelligent. The class itself is set up terribly. The class is too big to actually learn anything. It's also too condensed and its hard to learn anything from the lectures.

Great guy. Loved his daily spiritual thoughts. Though physical class attendance isn't mandatory, at least watch the videos of class he posts on YouTube. He adds a lot of things that are not in the textbook.  But if you read the textbook, take notes in class, and do the practice exams you'll be fine.
Great class, be prepared to work!
It is important to read very carefully the text, and take all the practice exams. He is an amazing guy and expects alot of his students to do well in his class.

This class is insanely hard if you miss a lecture but he does post lectures to YouTube just in case you miss. He is hilarious and easy to understand but if you fall behind it's almost impossible to catch back up. The only grades you get are from tests but he lets you drop your lowest grade.

Professor Brau is one of my favorite professors I have ever taken a class from. He knows his stuff! His lectures are always entertaining and full of great material. The tests are hard, but that should be expected when taking a finance course. I would take another class from Professor Brau in a heartbeat!

Brau is awesome. My favorite professor. He makes lectures interesting and they are super good prep for exams. Attendance isn't mandatory and he posts his lectures online. The grade was 100% exams so study hard and do the practice problems. Final was brutal but not impossible. Took what could be a very dry class and made it interesting.
The teacher was incredible, but the textbook didn't always prepare you for the tests, you need to do the practice quizzes to pass

Professor Brau is the most caring, motivating and spiritually inspiring business professor that I have had at BYU, and I have had several. His class and tests are very rigorous, just as any Finance 201 class is. The downside of this class is your whole grade is based solely off the exams. Take this class if you want to become a better person!

He is a great professor, he explains things well in class. Though sometimes it felt like as soon as I had to go do it on my own, I would get completely lost. It was a hard class. The review materials weren't very helpful for me and how I like to study for tests, but that is more of a personal thing.
Do what Brau tells you to do and you will do well
Professor Brau is an inspiring teacher.  Classes move slower so everyone can keep up, which is helpful.  Each class is recorded so you can go back and not miss anything.  No homework only tests.

Brother Brau is an excellent choice as a finance professor. He manages the large class size well by engaging us with clear teaching, real-world examples, and spiritual thoughts. There is no homework, so if you are unmotivated to do the highly recommended class reading and practice problems,  you will struggle in the class.

Professor Brau is an awesome teacher! He's passionate about what he teaches and tries to help everyone succeed. It's a tough class that has hard tests that will kick your butt if you're not prepared. VERY DOABLE if you work hard, read the text, attend class and form study groups.
Tests were challenging however if you keep up in class and do lots of practice problems you will make it. His spiritual thoughts are crazy inspiring and he really knows how to motivate.

Very down to earth grading policy of only scoring exams (5 of them) (do the practice exams) He wants you to have real understanding of finance.  I missed school for a month due to a skiing accident it was awesome to have all lectures on youtube but I WOULD NOT recommend that to anyone, keep up in the class

Although his class is difficult, he equips you with what you need to succeed on your own. You'll need to put in a lot of hours outside of class to understand the concepts though. His classes are great and spiritually uplifting. I really like the balance he strikes between business and religion.

Overall he is a great teacher and tries to make it a spiritually uplifting class. I don't think he explains many of the concepts very well.  He kind of expects you to know something's that the book doesn't cover. Sometime he wouldn't cover the math behind a problem so I would go to the book and the book didn't even explain it very well.

Bro Brau is AWESOME! He will  make you work for an A, but he prepares those who are willing to work with the materials to succeed. Grade is based off of 4 tests and a Final. He truly wants greatness from his students and is willing to work with you one on one for any personal issues.

Brau is a great professor. Sometimes he is a bit scatter-brained, but he always makes sure that he covers what he needs to during class. His tests are hard, but if you work for it, you can get a good grade.

Super good guy. Grade is based on 5 tests and some don't have many problems so small mistakes can cost you a lot. Be sure to read the chapter before hand. His lectures didn't get super detailed and he would move quick and mainly do practice problems. I wouldn't recommend unless you're planning on a business major.

Great professor! He doesn't just care about lecturing us on the material, but he keeps it real and talks to us students about spiritual things and struggles we could be facing. Explains things in class; if you don't do the reading beforehand, you will be lost. The sections in the curriculum really build on each other--don't fall  behind.

If you like being tricked, you'll like this class. Brother Brau bases a large part of his exam on details he discusses on the lectures. Taking notes with him is difficult, and the grade is based on 4 difficult exams and a final. Just reading the text will not get you an A-- going through every  lecture (on YouTube) on your own will help most.

Brau is a great guy and I really enjoyed his lectures and spiritual thoughts, but this class is not easy. You HAVE to put in the work and study for tests the way he suggests in the syllabus. Your grade is 100% exams.

Jim Brau is a rare find, and a great lecturer. He'll even keep you awake at 8:00 AM. He tends to upload all his lectures to Youtube these days, but you have to discipline yourself to make sure you really put in the study or to view the class lectures. You're only graded by tests, so give yourself the time to properly study, and you'll do just fine.
He is a good teacher. He is very straight-forward with what will be tested. Lectures are more important than reading the textbook, but you can mostly get by by doing one or the other.
Great Professor. I tool both Holmes and Brau, but enjoyed Brau's more. Better spiritual share and the temp of the material was more comprehensive.

Prof Brau is a great guy and does a great job of incorporating a spiritual aspect to his lectures. However, his class isn't for everyone. There are 3 midterms and a final, and those are the only grades. If you are not a good test taker like me, do not take this class from Brau. His lectures are ok, but he spends a lot of time on non-essential stuff

His TA's teach more understandably than he does. If you want to hear stories unrelated to the subject matter then his lectures are just perfect for you. If I could go back in time I would not attend his lectures and spend that time in the textbook or at the TA lab.

Great lectures, but you need to prepare before class because he goes pretty fast through the material. If you didn't read before class, you have no idea what he is talking about. He records his lectures and puts them on youtube- helps when you can pause the video to work through problems or take time to understand what's going on.
Great professor. Passionate and knowledgable.

If you put in the effort, then you can be successful in his class. Lectures are really only good for the questions on the test that are straight from class, as everything else is learned from the book. But his spiritual thoughts were enjoyable, and I especially appreciated the ones about respecting LGBTQ.
Hope you can take tests well. Your grade depends on it.

Brother Brau has been one of the best professors I've had at BYU. It's been said over and over again but it's true. His main goal is for us to build the kingdom of God and thats pretty great. The course itself was very challenging for me. Business is not my forte but every class, Brau made it clear how beneficial it could be in my life some day.
You need to be an independent student to do well in his class.

One of my favorite classes I have taken at BYU.  Lectures were always entertaining and he explained things clearly.  The only grades in the class were 4 midterms and a final so if you struggle taking tests beware.

You don't even have to go to class, just watch it on YouTube and teach yourself the material like he always reminds us to do. He doesn't even try to teach everything, tests on things that are not even relevant and just mentioned in the book once, just to prove that he is a difficult teacher who graduated from Westpoint and that finance is hard

Brau is a good professor but if you fall behind it is hard to pick it back up. He posts all the classes on YouTube though so you shouldn't miss anything. There is no cushion of homework or quizzes. Your grade is only made up of three midterms and a final so you have to be on top of the material. This is a challenging class but Brau is great.

One of the most genuine professor's i've ever taken from. There's no doubt about it though, the course is TOUGH. Everyone acts like they know what's up and it no big deal, but anyone and everyone who takes this course will have to work for the A. Find a study group and meet weekly; you'll be fine.
The class is all based on tests, however the professor really want to help you pass.

Honestly Brau is one of my favorite teachers during my entire time here at BYU, he's freaking hilarious and very inspirational. He just knows what's up. Take this class if you want to have an awesome class and take advantage of his life one on ones in the gym, they're phenomenal

Brother Brau is an amazing professor. You will stay entertained in his class, and he puts all the lectures online, so that helps a lot with studying, especially if you miss class. He really cares about his students and his spiritual thoughts are on point. You will have to work hard and do well on tests to do well in the class.

Professor Brau's lectures helped me apply what I was able to get from the readings. His tests are based on lectures,so DONT SKIP CLASS. The class is easy if you do what you should: go to class, read the chapters before going to class like he asks, and do the practice problems from each chapter. Loved this class!!

Good guy, but learned everything out of the book. A few questions on the test were "you had to be there" questions, besides that the class seemed pointless. Talks a lot about Vasa and stretches a class that could be 50 mins into 1 hr 15 mins. Not too bad of a class if you read and do the practice probs.

I really like how this professor tries to cater how he teaches to his students needs. He tried to give us a lot of resources: the Teaching Assistants had tons of hours, he posted all of his lectures on YouTube, he took suggestions and then set a goal to apply them. He also was definitely not a boring teacher! Some times tests on small details.

He's a very rational teacher. He asks for feedback, then changes his class. ie,  how he films each class period, then posts it to Youtube.  The only grades were tests. To me, that was perfect. I was able to put in the minimum time to learn the material,  then ace the tests. I really liked it! But other people really struggled with the tests.
Attend  class, do the practice problems, make sure you understand(do not memorize formulas) and you'll do great !
Professor  Brau made me want to be a better person. He's an incredible man and an incredible teacher. The tests are challenging,  but you are given the tools to succeed.

Bro. Brau is so awesome. He gives great spiritual thoughts in class and is a very inspirational guy. Honestly, I think most of the learning in this class comes out of class, not in class. However, make sure to go to class so you can be more exposed to the material and know some specific examples that Bro. Brau shares in class. I recommend him 100%.
I felt that I wasn't really ever able to follow his teaching style during lecture. Most of the way I learned was through the book. I didn't go to class most of the time.

Bro Brau is a great professor. He gives a spiritual thought each day in class and they are very inspiring and motivating. The entire grade was based off of 4 midterms and 1 final, so there were no quizzes or assignments. I honestly wish he would've given us weekly quizzes because it would've helped my grade and helped me internalize the concepts.

Brother Brau is a great guy, able to incorporate Finance and the gospel better than any teacher I have ever had. He really cares about his students and their spiritual and temporal lives. Finance though, tough stuff. Grades this semester were entirely dependent upon 5 test grades, no homework at all. May sound nice, but the tests are difficult.

Jim Brau is a fantastic professor! Grading is super clear. If you go to every lecture or get good notes, & do the drill problems, you will ace the class. What gets people is they get behind and miss class. He ALWAYS has questions on tests that are only from class, and not from the book. If you are there, he will tell you. If not, you won't know.

Brother Brau is by far one of the best professors I have had while attending BYU. He spends countless hours meeting with students in order to try and best help them to understand the material and what they want to do with their careers. This class definitely requires a lot of outside studying but you learn so much that is applicable to real life
I honestly didn't learn much in class.  I learned the most by doing the practice problems and drill problems outside of class.
Brau is my favorite, I plan on applying to the finance program after taking this class. It's hard work but all of it is applicable in business

He is a super nice guy and does a great job bringing religion into the classroom. Test questions are nothing like what you do in class so you have to teach yourself the material from the practice test. All in all, the teaching style just didn't work for me but could with others. Test are your grade, nothing else counts towards it.

I really enjoyed this class Pro. Brau really is straight forward in what you need to do. Prepare for the class, read the section you are studying that week, and get help from the TA's and you will do great.
Brau is amazing! Finance is a hard subject, but doable if you put in the effort and pay attention in class.

Brau does a great job at making the class entertaining, but it's impossible to do this class without doing Accounting first, or having a strong background in business vocabulary. I am frankly not sure why ACC 200 is not a prerequisite for the class. Brau conducts the class with the assumption that you know most all basic business vocab terminology.

Brother Brau is a great professor!  He really knows his stuff.  The class is very hard and the only assignments that count on your grade are the exams.  I wish there was homework to help me learn the criteria better and buffer my grade.  I did enjoy the class and the lectures are really important.

He was a good professor overall.  Being a person who tends to struggle test wise I felt like having all my grade be based on tests was a little much. He has great lectures and I can tell he really likes the subject and cares about his students. especially because he does listen to suggestions to improve.

Prof. Brau is great! He uploads all his lectures on Youtube so I barely showed up to the 8am class. However, I heard that he might do that next semester. 4 Midterms and a Final. No homework or attendance. Also, we got a formula sheet for the tests but that won't be continued next semester either.

Great professor. He loves what he teaches so it translates well to understand. He gives great insights to the world of finance and makes it applicable. Grades only come from tests so be ready for them.

Brother Brau is honestly one of my favorite professors I have every had! His spiritual thoughts are amazing! Of course finance is difficult, but he not only prepares you for the exams but also for the real world! If you want an easier class, take it from Holmes - he gives you a cheat sheet on all the exams, but if you want to be successful-- BRAU

Professor Brau is a practical professor who teaches the concepts in a clear manner. Additionally, the textbook contains nearly all the information discussed in class, so it is possible to ace the class without going. However, every once in a while he will cover something in class that is not in the textbook. Review the exam breakdowns.

Brau is one of my favorite professors. The course material is relatively difficult but he is effective at explaining difficult concepts. Your grade is entirely based on four test scores, but if you study you can do well on the tests. I really enjoyed his spiritual thoughts and the fact that he added "commercial breaks" to make class more enjoyable.

Finance isn't really my subject, but Bro. Brau is a hilarious professor who really cares about how his students are doing. If he was teaching a different subject, I would totally take him again. Make sure you know how to use the formulas, and I highly recommend doing the readings and a few practice problems for each topic before going to lecture.

Brother Brau has been so inspirational, although this class is pretty hard and it's not my first choice of interest or career, I really enjoyed his teaching style and his incorporation of spiritual thoughts into the lessons. He's very passionate about what he teaches and what he believes and he inspires students to their best! He's great! Recommend
Great teacher, great man, super hard class. The only grades are the four exams and the final.

Professor Brau is extremely enthusiastic and he shows a lot of care towards students. On a personal level he was great. Coursework was very organized. The online material wasn't as much (typos, unrelated material). You must attend class or the youtube recordings! the online material doesn't cover everything! Whole grade depends on 4 tests.

Brau was an awesome guy, super opinionated but he really cares. His class was super simple, 4 midterms and a final, drop the lowest midterm and average the scores and that is your grade. Also, if you did better on the final then you could have that score. Didn't have to go to lecture but reading the book was key.

I'm impressed by his ability to inspire. He made me want to be a better person. He gives spiritual thoughts that are relevant and break up the sometimes monotonous class lectures. He is an ex-army ranger, and I respect the military for the kind of people they create.
Great teacher, be careful cause his lectures are not the same as the book sometimes and he will test on both.
Professor Brau is a great professor who cares about his students. He has a genuine interest for them and wants them to succeed. He teaches in a great way and does his part to prepare students.

Awesome teacher. Study hard and read the material BEFORE CLASS. If you spend quality time on this class EVERY DAY then you will pass with an A. It was something that I didn't do, but in retrospect wish I would have done.

An awesome professor. Read the book well and spend quality time everyday on this class and you will pass with an A. That was definitely something I didn't do and regret because of it. He also gives amazing spiritual thoughts. STUD

Bro. Brau is a great professor! He absolutely loves teaching finance and he loves the students. He takes all feedback/suggestions on how to improve seriously. He is a funny guy and also gives some of the best spiritual thoughts I have ever heard part way through each lecture. The exams are hard, but as long as you study it's not too bad.
All the lectures are recorded which is nice. Your entire grade is based on 4 tests(you can drop one of your mid-terms). He is an awesome inspirational teacher.

Bro. Brau was a great teacher. I honestly really did enjoy his class and I personally think he did a really great job of teaching such a huge class.  The tests are challenging but if you attend every class, do all the reading, and do all of the practice tests then you should be able to get good grades. Those three things were the key to this class
Brau is great at helping his students understand difficult topics. I found it helpful to read the material before class so I could further understand what he was talking about during his lecture.

Professor Brau is a great teacher. He cares about the students and has clear lectures. Should do the chapter reading AND attend class or watch the youtube videos. If you only do one and not the other it will be difficult. Straightforward class, and gives excellent spiritual thoughts.

He is amazing! His spiritual messages are the reasons I get up in the morning. But, if you struggle with tests, this is not the class for you. grades are based solely on tests. I walked into every test knowing my stuff and walked out traumatized. I can't take a test to save my life, plus, these tests are hard. Study hard and don't fall behind!

Brau does his best to prepare you for tests. Class lectures are great. Studying the practice tests are essential for getting A's on the test. As a mechanical engineering major, I found the math to be very easy. Biggest challenge is knowing how to use the equations. Overall great class.
Too many materials to understand the "intuition." If you are not a Finance major or you have a life, take from someone else.

Brau does a good job of teaching the material. Be sure to attend class or watch the youtube videos. Stay on top of the reading and go to the TA's for help. Honestly, I did not find the TA lab to be that helpful, due to a lack of consistency in schedule. But I do think it could potentially be a good resource.

You can't get away with just learning from him in class. He will test on minutia from the textbook as well. He will also help you live your life in a better way, which is a amazing for how big his class size is. Very devoted to his discipline, and a spiritual leader worth paying attention to.
Dr. Brau is a great guy. One of the hardest classes I've ever taken but Dr. Brau made it enjoyable.

Prof Brau was a very good teacher. He was very good at explaining financial topics but my favorite part about him is that he let students know resources where they can be help with internships and other things beside just class work. Only thing I didn't like is that he got off track a little in his lectures.

Dr. Brau is an amazing Professor. I feel lucky to have taken him this semester. With the  in class lectures and the youtube Video along with the text reading and preparation, you will surely do decent. To get an A, make sure you do the preparation prior to class for the next lecture materials. He is an awesome person. Enjoyed being in class.

Brother Brau is so great! He's funny, keeps your attention during lectures, and is super passionate about what he teaches.  However, the only thing he grades you on are the tests, so if you don't feel confident about test-taking then probably he's not for you.  I had a really hard time in this class even though I thought he was great.

Professor Brau knows what he is talking about and he is really good at explaining concepts and answering questions. I really felt like the class was aimed to help me learn rather than memorize for a test. Also Professor Brau is hilarious and high energy. You won't be bored in his lecture.
Prof. Brau is amazing! He loves what he teaches and he loves his students. You're only graded on the midterms/exams. He gives amazing spiritual thoughts in class.

Bro. Brau was an awesome teacher. Read the chapters before class and go back over the concepts after class. The tests can be difficult (and were the only things on our grades) but he tells you exactly how to study for them, and goes over everything in class. His spiritual thoughts are great and he's super inspirational!

Brother Brau is an amazing teacher. He gives the students everything necessary to be successful in his class. I've honestly never felt that a teacher cared for his students as much I feel that Brother Brau cares.
Professor Brau is a great teacher. I am retaking this class with a different professor, and I can tell you that the professor has made all the difference this time around.

Bro. Brau was a solid professor, he taught concepts clearly (most of the time). Make sure you do the reading before class or some of the lectures will go over your head. Your entire grade is based on midterms and the final, which was fine for me but could be a terrible thing for others. His spiritual thoughts were amazing
Grade came only from tests. Very challenging class if you're not interested in finance/getting into the business school.
Some people get it and some people don't. Great class though.

Brother Brau is one of the best professors at BYU. He keeps his classes engaged with uplifting messages and plenty of humor. I wish there were more in-depth/specific discussions about the situations that these financial concepts are actually used. For those of us who have never had a finance before, it would be nice to have a little more context.

Brother Brau is great! I really enjoyed the atmosphere of the class he kind of acts hyper all the time switching between tangents super fast. The class was really good though grading is very straightforward and I loved his spiritual thoughts.

This class material is a beast! For some it clicks and for others it takes more work but don't get scared. Professor Brau will teach exceptionally well.  Just be in class and review after because he goes super fast.  There is NO more an equation sheet for the tests so work to memorize those.  He cares a lot, inspires everyone, and is funny.

Brau is a great professor. His lectures are insightful and he really helps explain the material. He always takes time for fun or spiritual moments. There is no homework besides reading the textbook and attending lecture (or watching it on youtube), and he does a lot for his students. Be warned though, no homework means that grades come from tests.

Brother Brau is one of the best professors at BYU. It's a little tough to get an A just because the grade is only based on test scores, but it's worth it. Study hard and do all the practice tests and you'll do well. He puts all of his lectures on youtube which is a huge plus! Brau's spiritual thoughts are more spiritual than any religion class!
Really good class and professor
SUCH a great guy. He loves finance, love the gospel and loooves his students.

Professor Brau is a great person who cares deeply about his students but, at least in my experience, was a mediocre  professor. He knows his stuff and gives great financial advice however his lectures are sporadic at best. OCD AND ADD seem to be best way to describe his lectures but they are very spiritual. He is awesome when it comes to the gospel
Smart. Funny. Gives you a lot of resources to prepare for the exam. If you put in the time and do what Brother Brau says you will do well in his class.
Super good man, that was obvious. Have a lot of respect for Brother Brau. Great class from a great guy. Highly reccomend

Brother Brau cares for his students and he is willing to do whatever to help you out. As for teaching skills, he is good. He knows what he is talking about, but some explanations are not easily understood. All grades are tests to prevent grading a lot which lacks feedback and in my opinion is kind of lazy. Gives great spiritual thoughts though.

40% of this class is a review of ACC 200 and ACC 310,  just presented in a slightly different way so this class was cake for me, though I know the class was hard for others. He's a GREAT lecturer though, and I loved his spiritual thought "commercials" throughout his lectures. Truly cares about students and wants everyone to succeed.

Bro Brau is such a great teacher! He explains things clearly and is so willing to work with students. The class is all exam based, so you have to do well on them to do well in the class. But, he prepares you well, and with your own hard work you'll do great in his class! He wants to help everyone succeed however he can. Great teacher!

The lectures were great! Engaging and with breaks to recapture your attention. He offers them on youtube to rewatch for studying (helps if you cant' make it to class too). Whether or not I did as well as I wanted in the class, I respect him a lot as a professor. He notices it is a lot harder for some to grasp than others.

Professor Brau knows his stuff, and he is willing to change how he teaches the lectures to fit the feel of the students. Feel free to comment or ask questions in class, and make sure to keep up with what is going on in the class. It's not easy, but you can handle it if you give the right amount of time.

Inspiration to learn from. He doesn't mess around. Sometimes lectures can be kind of confusing, but it really inspires personal responsibility in preparing for class. Brau is someone who is so passionate about what he does and cares about that it shines through.

Great guy. Really gives lectures worth going to. Fun guy to be around. Can be a tough class. It's worth using the study guide lists.. didn't see those til the last test. Use the TA's well and you'll be able to make it.   If you want a professor that you can look up to, Brau is your guy!

Professor Brau is one of my favorite professors that I have had. I have always struggled paying attention in lectures, so the fact that he posts his on Youtube after class made a world of difference for me. I was able to go back and review easily. He knows his stuff and if you read the book and go to/watch his lectures, his tests are not tough.

One of the best professors at BYU. This guy really gets it. He's very passionate about what he does and can come off as intense or almost mean, but he really cares about the students. Not an easy class, but by far the most organized and straightforward class I have taken to date, at any school.

Bro Brau is amazing. This is a hard class; your grade consists of 4 tests. He gives you all the tools you need to succeed and is the most caring professor at BYU. He gives a spiritual thought every class and cares a lot about his students. His lectures are hilarious. Love this guy!

Dr. Brau is an inspirational professor. I enjoyed his lectures & took good notes, but I never felt like I knew what was going on until I did the practice exams and taught myself. He grades only on exams, which made an A very difficult especially since I never knew what to expect. I wish he would've spent more class time on long difficult problems.

Over all a pretty good class. Pretty hard if you don't do the reading.  I love how Professor Brau is constantly taking in feedback from students to improve his class. I enjoy the "commercial breaks" and think they are valuable (especially the spiritual thoughts) but I wish that sometimes he would make them shorter and do more practice problems.

Excellent teacher and so accessible to students. The course is set up well, but I wasn't impressed with the online text book. It doesn't always have the most useful information. But then again, it is your number one study help, so that's nice.

His lectures were fantastic! They were well prepared and he always includes a spiritual thought. The grade is completely based on your test scores but the material is covered extremely well in class and in the online text book. If I had taken this class from anyone else I probably would have fallen asleep, but Bro Brau is so fun, I really enjoyed his lectures, even though they were at times confusing. Mostly you will be teaching yourself through reading and studying for the tests. Find a good group of friends and take it together, then get ready to work really hard.

If you want to take a class where the teacher only talks about vasa and westpoint Brau is your man! If you actually want a class where they talk about finance brau is not your man. Class was completly worthless but hey his office hours are at vasa! could you ask more from life!?  #getjacked

Great course! If you want to get an A in the class then you need to be willing to put in the time to do extra practice. He is great at posting all the practice material and assistance that you will need to do well. If you put in the time then you will be fine. Not very accessible outside of class unless you are in some sort of crisis.
I loved his spiritual thoughts every class - 95% of why I went! Otherwise concepts were a bit hard to follow. Expect to learn a new language - finance.

Loved this class. The difficult part is that you get your final grade based off of tests alone and you need to prepare yourself well for those tests. You need to really put in effort to get an A in this class but it's an awesome experience.
This class is hard. Brother Brau helped students to understand the material well. They stopped doing Exam reviews, which I think would of been beneficial to keep. He is a great teacher.
Not my favorite class. Easy, but didn't learn much from him at all. Be ready to teach yourself. A LOT of tangents in class that are irrelevant to learning.

Bro Brau's lectures are a pleasure to attend, and the material covered in lectures are vital to your grade. Since the grade is all tests, you really have to be self-motivated to make your grade what you want it to be.

Brother Brau is an awesome guy. I didn't like his teaching style very much, it sometimes seemed like he was more interested in getting through the material than helping us to understand it. However, it was worth it to take this class from him because he really does care about his students and is an amazing role model to have. Gives good life advice
Great teacher, tough material

Professor Brau is a great individual! His class is very hard. But he does the best he can considering he is tasked to teach over a thousand students. For me, a large portion of the class was self-taught and self-motivated. The course work is purely your test grades so it's up to you to do the extra assignments to learn the material.
Great spiritual thoughts. Must read the text book before class to understand in-class material. Tests are our whole grade- there are no quiz "buffers".

One of the best professors I've ever had. He's funny, a great guy, and a great teacher. Finance would've bored me with a different professor, but with Brother Brau I loved it! I never knew I could enjoy an 8:00 AM class so much.
It's A tough class, but he has a way to break down the concepts. He makes it clear what you need to do to get an A and gives you all the resources you need.

Jim Brau is a great guy, but when I went to class I felt like 90% of what he says is completely irrelevant to finance. He makes school feel like a game that has to be played instead of encouraging actual learning.

Brother Brau said that he is going to require his students to memorize the 11 finance equations. Don't worry, he gives you plenty of time to do it. The grades are all on tests. Reading the textbook helps. He wants you to learn and remember the key information.

I'm not a business major, but this class was incredible. Brau helped to show why this stuff is important and how it is the big picture of the business world (which we are all affected by--whether you're an engineer, doctor, etc.) He also did an excellent job at including a spiritual side to the class.

When I took this class your whole grade was based on the exams, that's it. I wish he would have required homework because I would have had more motivation to do the readings and it would be better for those who studied really hard, but didn't do well on the exams. Do readings/practice problems before class because I didn't and was very confused

Professor Brau is one of the most invested professors I've ever taken a class from.  He cares about helping you succeed in life, not just in learning the finance material.  He has great advice about career plans and personal finance.  Your grade depends solely on the tests, but if you study hard and master the practice problems, you'll do great!

Brau is awesome! I highly recommend taking FIN201 from him. Personally, I find finance difficult, but Brau made it a lot easier to understand. He cares a lot about his students and wants everyone to succeed. The only thing I didn't like about the class is that your grade is solely based on 4 midterms and the final. Choose Brau- you won't regret it!

Your grade is 100% based off your test scores; there are no other graded assignments, which makes it easy not to do practice problems and then to cram before the exams. He doesn't have you do problems much in class, it's all up to you to do on your own time/you have to take a lot of initiative to be successful in this class.

He is a great lecturer and works hard to keep students engaged. He's also very personable and he wants his students to succeed. The class is pretty difficult though, at least for non-finance majors like me, because there's so much material. There are no graded assignments so you're only graded on the tests, but you can drop your lowest one.
He is great, fun music, love him!

Br. Brau is an amazing professor, and person. I've loved going to his class and learning more about finance, and also loved how much he cares for his students. You only get graded on Tests, so be prepared! I highly recommend his class to everyone!

Professor Brau is one of the best professors at BYU. The class is hard but very doable if you are ready to put in the work. If you show up to class as study for the tests like he says to you will be fine.
Any finance class at BYU will be tough, tons of studying and work to get a good grade. Brau is an alright teacher, he tries to keep you entertained but there's still nothing as boring as finance.

I can't stand the fact that the only grades throughout the semester are tests. But, Bro. Brau does a decent job  of preparing his students for them. The tests really aren't that hard. Bro. Brau brightens his students' days, though. He really encompasses the BYU spirit and helps everyone to feel engaged and welcome.

Professor Brau's teaching style is unique. I love how he takes breaks each class period, because it helps keep students engaged and focused. The class is very test heavy (that's all that your grade is) so for someone who does not test well, it's incredibly stressful and difficult.
Great teacher and great personality. Fun to listen to and I would take this class again.
Bro Brau is very enthusiastic in teaching and always excited about finance. He cares about his students. He is funny too.

Bro Brau is the best finance teacher at BYU. He's really motivated to help his students succeed in finance and in life. He gives inspiring spiritual thoughts every class  on top of the finance material. I felt like he was hyped up on energy drinks every class and that made it more interesting and enjoyable. I would definitely recommend Bro Brau.

Brother Brau is the best professor/teacher I've ever had. His class is rough but is doable with hard work! This was my first business class (i.e. hadn't taken ACC 200 yet) and I was still able to do very well. Study groups are a must as 100% of your grade is tests.

Jim Brau is inspiring, well practiced, extremely knowledgeable, and seriously loving of his students. I think I have met maybe one other professor on the level of Jim Brau in my entire college career.

Professor Brau has a fun, laid-back attitude. He's very understanding. In lectures, he'll do "commercial breaks" and has a spiritual thought to break up the lecture so it's easier to pay attention. Lectures are also recorded so that if you're sick, you're not worried about missing too much.
Profesor Brau was great! I have no complaints! I wish that I could take all of my financial classes from him!
Brau does a great job at trying to make 800+ students learn something hard.  He's pretty specific and to the point, but it does help to do the pre-reading so you know what's going on in class

Rough around the edges, but truly an inspiring professor.  Regardless of how much passion he has for the topic, he cares for the students more.  Every class, he gives spiritual thoughts and career development ideas.  By the tone of it, you can tell he thinks about us often.  Hardest class this semester, but my best grade; he motivates like that.
He is a great guy who cares that you learn and grow instead of just trying to force course materials down your throat.

It will really help you understand his lectures if you do your readings before class. You have 4 tests (over three units each) and then a final that is comprehensive, and that is your grade. He lets you drop a test if you take a research survey.  Go to class because he covers things in class that aren't in the book and are tested.

I thought Bro Brau was an amazing professor. He really takes the time to prepare and teach concepts clearly, and is always open to student suggestions for improving the course. He cares about each of us students and is willing to help you succeed. His spiritual thoughts were the most inspiring thing to me at BYU thus far. Definitely choose him

Brau is a good professor and teaches well. If you can't make it to class, he records every lecture and then puts it on Youtube so don't worry about attendance. Just make sure to stay on top of things. Also, your grade is solely based on your test scores. So if you don't test well, this class may be very difficult.

Bro. Brau was an excellent professor. Great lectures every class period, he even includes very inspirational spiritual thoughts. He takes a lot of interest in his students and our success, not only in the class but in life. The class and content is tough NOT Brau, he does a great job teaching.

Professor Brau's lectures are very hard to follow if you have not  done the reading before class.  There were multiple times that I didn't have time to do the readings before class and I always felt very confused on those days.  Besides this he is a good Professor that is fair and cares about the success of his students in all areas of their lives.

Definitely a solid choice for FIN201.  The semester I took it he recorded all of his lectures and put them on youtube, but if you didn't bother to watch them you'd miss stuff on the test.  It was usually stuff that if you thought really hard about what you read you could probably figure out, but at the same time that seems to take more effort.

Professor Brau is a great professor who really cares about his students. He's very open to feedback, and wants you to succeed. The class is not easy, and he goes pretty quickly through lectures, so be sure you do the readings before class and have a good grasp of the topics. The final is comprehensive, so keep up on everything throughout.

Brother Brau has easily been my favorite professor at BYU so far. Every one of his lectures has left me feeling both intellectually enlightened and spiritually refreshed. The content isn't easy-breezy but if you read the text and either show up to class or watch the youtubes he puts up, you're more than likely to pass. Thank you Bro Brau!

Awesome teacher, has incredibly inspiring lectures.  Learned a ton in this class that i think will translate well to the real world.  Treats you like an equal, but also expects you to act like an adult.  If you're gonna be immature, be ready to hate this class.  Otherwise, probably one of the best classes I've taken.
Listen to his lectures and do the practice exams with the TAs. If he keeps youtubing his lectures, you can watch them on 2x speed instead of going to lecture. Cuts class time in half :)

His class is amazing and inspiring! Every lecture he adds a spiritual thought and is willing to answer every question. He teaches around the needs of his students and wants every student to be successful. His class only has five grades - four tests and a final. However, he allows you to drop the lowest test score.

Dr. Brau is an awesome guy - really fun and easy to sit in his class. He tries to do a lot to make the class more exciting. However, it is a VERY intense course and if you don't keep up on the readings, you will be left behind and the workload will build up. Only tests were graded but he drops the worst score. Love his spiritual thoughts in class.
Professor Brau was a great professor. I do wish he had dome more challenging examples to prepare us for the tests, but there are practice exams so you can practice the more difficult problems.
His class is extremely well organized. He has more than enough resources available to understand the material and do well on the tests.
Makes class fun and engaging while still covering material.

This class is fast paced and he only grades tests. The readings are extensive and have a lot of material per chapter. You need to do all the reading before the class, because Bro B spends little time defining the abbreviations or explaining the equations

Your whole grade depends on four midterms and the final so if you don't want to you don't have to do anything for most weeks of the semester but make sure you're prepared for the tests! The practice tests are good preparation.

Bro Brau is amazing. He has a passion for life and for finance. He loves the Lord. His tests are fairly difficult, and the class is totally based on tests (4 midterms and 1 final exam). One midterm can be dropped. I loved his lectures, but they are not mandatory.

Professor Brau is an amazing religious speaker (you'll see). When it came to Finance though, I felt like didn't really know how to teach beginning students. He goes pretty fast & kind of just assumes you understand all his abbreviations/vocab. There were no quizzes or homework the semester I took him, so my entire grade was based off his tests.
It was a great class and a great teacher. I learned quite a bit.

Professor Brau has a passion for teaching. He really seeks to make his classroom a place of good feelings and mentorship. He writes down all of the principles that he is teaching as he goes. This makes it possible to take notes, unlike in a class where a power-point is clicked through. If you want an uplifting, useful class, this is it!

Brother Brau is a super nice guy.  He really cares about his students and will do whatever it takes to please all of us.  His class covers hard material but the tests are very straight forward if you study well for them.

Brau is one of my favorite professors ever. His lectures are super interesting and he really cares about his students. Attendance is optional but I would definitely go to class! The material is difficult but he teaches it very clearly and works through lots of example problems together with the class. I would highly recommend taking fin201 from him

Professor Brau is amazing. He is probably the best professor I've had so far at BYU, even though I think Finance is boring. He is a fair grader, he teaches the concepts well, and he is very willing to help students who need it. He also gives spiritual thoughts every class to break up the boring parts, and his spiritual thoughts are really great.

Brau is a passionate professor who cares about his students and their experience as far as one can in a lecture hall of 800ish students. The way he presents equations are more intuitive than the standardized versions of them. If you want to feel inspired about life, as well as finance, Brother Brau is the way to go.

Brother B. Is one of the most caring, helpful professors I've had. His spiritual thoughts that he shares are amazing, and if you are struggling with things outside of school (mental health, sexuality, career choices) he really makes himself available. He is thee only teacher I've had that posts his lectures online, which is AWESOME and very helpful

Professor Brau is seriously awesome.  I enjoyed his lectures, not only because he is incredible at teaching Finance, but also because of his awesome spiritual thoughts and his fun personality.  He gives you every opportunity to succeed, BUT if you don't do the reading and don't attend or watch the lectures, you'll fail guaranteed.
Brau is great applying the principles he teaches to real life situations.

Good ol Florida boy. Graded on only your 4 midterms and the final. Requires lots of studying. I would study around 10 hours for each midterm. My only complaint with Brau is that he uses lots of specific vocabulary and expects everyone to understand it; he's not one to look at the big picture and break it down.

Brau is a great professor. He lets you sign up to visit him in his office, which is VASA. I went with him, and he gave me a lot of good advice. He makes you work for the grade in the class, because the only thing that is graded are the tests, and they are hard. Just study hard for the tests and you'll be fine.

I was super scared to take Fin 201, but I felt like the class was well-organized and provided everything I needed to be successful. I thought Brother Brau tried his best to be transparent and clear about expectations. His lectures didn't seem too long because he tried to pace it well so that we could pay attention for an hour and fifteen minutes.

Dr. Brau is the best! He knows his stuff and expects a lot from his students. The class is hard work, but also manageable. Brau is super spiritual and will always bring a spiritual thought to class. The only assignments that make up your grade are 4 midterms and one cumulative final. Just read the textbook and write down every thing he writes!

He is just a really good guy who cares about teaching Finance, but cares more about helping his students grow spiritually and in awareness of what is around them. He is a really fun teacher. Loved taking this class.

Finance isn't an easy subject for me. The big difference between Brau and the other professor is that Brau doesn't like to give his students a formula sheet on the tests, but because of that his test questions are a bit more simple. Brau is a great guy but tends to ramble on in class to much. He is super funny, posts lectures online too!
Great Professor, I learned so much about finance.

Great professor. DO THE PRACTICE EXAMS--they will save your grade.  Make sure to do lots practice problems because the only things on your grade are tests.  Luckily you can drop one midterm.  Very inspirational--the spiritual aspect of class was one of my key takeaways.

Brother Brau was one of my favorite professors at BYU. He is funny and really knows his stuff. Gives amazing spiritual thoughts everyday. The concepts in this class are hard to grasp, and the tests were pretty difficult. However, I felt that I learned a lot from Brother Brau.

Really knows the material and has a great knowledge of real world application, and imparts that knowledge if you ask.  Has good lectures but sometimes it is difficult to understand the concepts .  Read the text and also us the interweb to better understand the material.

Brother Brau is an amazing teacher because his class is unique.  Most business classes are the same old thing.  Brother Brau applies what we are learning to the real world and he always shares amazing spiritual thoughts. He is extremely funny and he is open to feedbackif his students don't like the way that he is teaching, then he will change it.
Great professor. Solely graded on 3 mid terms and a final. Tough tests. Clear expectations though.
i hate finance, but brau made learning about it both an entertaining and uplifting experience. i looked forward to class.

Brother Brau is super cool. He is a totally military guy and can yell like a sergeant but is also one of the most caring teachers I have ever had. The entire grade was based on 5 tests scores and was hard work, but I learned valuable life finance. You have to stay on top of the reading, nothing is due but if you don't you will die test week.

Brother Brau was one of my favorite professors at BYU. Incredibly caring and dedicated to making you successful. His class is only graded on the tests which are difficult, but not impossible. Better than the other finance professors.

I think Jim Brau is an excellent professor. He is an expert at finance. I wish the business program only required pre-Finance and pre-Accounting Majors to take this class. I am not a finance guy nor do I ever want to major in it. I wish there was another course that was a little less intense. The class is only tests (2017). The tests are difficult.

The material was difficult for me at times, but he puts all his lectures on youtube so you can watch it back to try and understand it better. The entire grade was based on 4 midterms and final. You can drop lowest midterm which was nice. Study more for the tests than you think you need to. A lot of questions come straight from class discussion.

Brau is an awesome guy. He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to suceed. Having said that, his class is tough. The only grades given are tests, and they are rough. He prepares us pretty well for class, but the bad thing is that he doesn't write his tests. Apart from that, study, study, study and you'll be fine.
Professor Brau  is an awesome Professor. He really does everything possible to help his students learn and understand the material. Highly recommend having him as your professor.
Best class I've taken at BYU so far. He gives you everything you need to succeed in this class. The youtubes of all the lectures are the best thing.

Prof. Brau is great but sometimes not the clearest.  Some of what he thinks is intuitive is not and so you can get lost very easily. I had to spend multiple hours each week reading and re-reading the text book to try and understand. His tests are hard and have a lot of trick answers/are worded iffy.
This was my favorite class this semester. Come for the finance, stay for Brau.

Your grade depends completely on doing well on tests. Brother Brau is a great person and I loved his spiritual thoughts in every class, but I felt like his teaching style didn't work for me. You read the online textbook and then run through things quickly in class. I don't learn well from just reading. To each their own.

Tough class for me, but it wasn't because of Brother Brau. I wasn't a huge fan of his lectures, but you do get the information that you need out of them. He is a great guy that cares a lot about his students. Makes it clear what is necessary to do well on tests.
Great teacher. I would take this class even if I wasn't a business major or minor. Just awesome!

Does a great job in class explaining the intuition behind the subjects, but when it came to exams I often times felt like I was left to work out the most difficult concepts on my own. Exams are designed to "trick" you into selecting the wrong choice but if you really really really know the material you should be okay. Solid choice. Beware of exams.

He is a great professor that really cares about his students. However, this past semester he used a different professor's tests, but taught how he always had. It was difficult to adjust to the different material on the tests. Also, the tests are the only thing that goes on the grade, so it makes it harder.

Brother Brau is awesome.  He knows his stuff super well and he's  avery good teacher.  The class moves VERY quickly, and so does he.  If you get behind it is extremely difficult to catch up and therefore to pass the tests, which is all he grades for your final grade.  Super good guy and great professor, but the course is super challenging.

Brother Brau made this finance class bearable. Without his energy, wit, and sense of humor, I probably would've suffered in this class. He really cares about his students, and I learned a lot of things from him not only about finance, but about the Gospel, too. He doesn't slack when it comes to his students. Be ready to put in some time, though.

Brau is a good teacher. He simplifies some complicated stuff in a way that helps you understand it. You have to put in time outside of class to do well, even then there's no promise you'll do well. 4 midterms and a final, he drops the lowest midterm. Study material before class like he asks you to do and you will do fine.

He is a fantastic Professor! He is a great teacher and cares about his students. The class has four midterms and a final. He drops the lowest midterm and if you do super well on the final, he will make your grade on the final your course grade. He is super kind and friendly! I would highly recommend this class to all!
Bro. Brau! He's a stud! Super energetic and willing to do whatever is necessary to help his students succeed. Take his class, you won't regret it!
Very test heavy class. Great guy & funny.
Everything relies on the tests. There are no other assignments. Also, be prepared to memorize a bunch of formulas, whereas Holmes allows a formula sheet.

Take a class from Professor Brau before you leave BYU. Not only does he teach the material well, he is incredibly inspirational and caring about his students. Really a great guy. Class is tough but there are plenty of resources to help you succeed if you are serious about it. Put in the time and you will do well.
Really great teacher who cares about his students. Sometimes I felt like he went a little too fast, but has a suggestion box where he will try and do what he can to make the class better.
Good professor and will explain things well. He gives spiritual thoughts and makes that an important part of the class.

Good professor and will explain things well. He gives spiritual thoughts and makes that an important part of the class. He is willing to help in any way he can but remember he's a business professor...

He cares about students as a whole but our entire grade was based solely off of tests.  The reading wasn't too bad, but the material is difficult and fast paced if you don't have very much experience with math. Life lessons and principles were added in to every lecture and, for me, that was great.

I loved Bro Brau . He has some of the most interesting lectures, however if you are a bad test taker, do not take this class. He only graded us on tests, no papers, no quizzes, just tests. But if thats your great at test then this is the class for you. If how he graded changed I would take him again in a heart beat.
Great and super nice, but his class is hard! Just cause there's so much material and the class size is insane

Prof. Brau does a good job making sure you understand the intuition behind the financial formulas and processes. Once I understood the intuition and the "why" behind the formulas, then it was simply a matter of working through lots of practice problems on his practice exams. Very inspiring. He takes time during class for spiritual development.

Bro. Brau is a solid teacher who cares a ton about the students. Usually, I'm not a big fan of spiritual thoughts but his are great! The class is tough, like most of the business prereqs, but if you come to class, read the text, and make sure you have a really solid understanding of the practice exams you won't find anything surprising on the test.

Bro Brau is awesome, he does EVERYTHING he possibly can for his students. spiritual thoughts, recording his lectures on YouTube...  always accepts feedback and tries to make his course better and better. He does commercial breaks in class so it's not just a straight 75 minutes of finances. However, FIN 201 was the hardest class ever. So get ready!

He made most of his lectures enjoyable. We were only grades on the 4 midterms and the final that we took in his class, so you will need to study and know the material to get an A. I would recommend doing practice problems for  each chapter because he doesn't do a lot of practice problems in class. Overall I thought he was a good professor.

Professor Brau sets up this class so that you have to work hard for your grade, but you have all of the resources you need to succeed, like the opportunity to meet with him and many practice exams, practice problems, vocabulary lists, and formula sheets. This class takes work, but is totally manageable.

Brother Brau is an awesome man. He cares about the spiritual and emotional well being of his students. Because the class is so large, he designated personal course help to his TA's, which sometimes know what's going on. His lectures cover the basics, but if you use MyEducator as well, you'll get a good grade.

He's a real person, very concerned about our success. My learning style doesn't really match his teaching style, but he teaches clearly and makes a considerable effort to help the class understand difficult concepts.

I'm a senior and finance was a particularly hard subject for me, but if I didn't understand how the book explained it, I would normally get it in lecture. Lectures this semester were recorded and put on YouTube which was great for my crazy schedule. It takes a long time to get through the chapters and questions. I worked hard, I think I'll get a C.

I really enjoyed Professor Brau's class. He definitely knows his finance and does a good job presenting it. If you stay on top of your reading, attend lectures and review the YouTube videos, you will do just fine. I loved his spiritual thoughts and professional development moments. He really cares about his students and wants them to succeed.
Amazing professor.
The only grades in the class are the tests, so study. You need to do your reading and put the time in if you want an A

He knows finance! But I think he forgets we know it... he talks to much about spiritual stuff and professional development. It's nice and all but I signed up for a finance class.... if it really was just like 5 minutes of class that would be cool, but the stuff not related to finance takes up about 30 minutes of the hour and 15 minute lecture.

Brother Jim Brau is a man among men! He gave lectures that kept me engaged and awake which doesn't normally happen when my professors lecture. Gave powerful spiritual thoughts. His office hours are at Vasa which I think is pretty cool. Just a solid guy all around who really cares about his students and wants them to succeed in all aspects of life.

He gets off on tangents, "reviews" are just telling you to rewatch class lectures on You Tube and read the book, tests on little things he briefly mentioned in class, and if he gets negative feedback he just ignores it because you "can't please everyone." Nice person but he's just going for the required department 3.0 avg , not overall success.

Dr. Brau is really energetic and will keep you awake in class.  All of the test questions are designed to trick you, so you have to make sure you know the material backwards and forwards.  Take advantage of all of the practice exams and drill problems.  The more practice you get, the less likely it will be that he will trick you.

Bro. Brau was great! He did his best to keep lectures interesting and relevant to real life (i.e. personal finance, careers, interviewing). Tests were the only things that went towards the grade, and they were tough. There were a lot of details to know, but he tells you how to do well on exams and succeed in the class.

He's very excited about the topic, which is good because it's not the most exciting material.  The whole grade is based is tests, which for me meant I was cramming the day before and not studying throughout the unit, but this might be better for some people
Brau was a great professor. Inspirational and he knows is stuff. He teaches for industry and life, not just academics. I'd definitely recommend his class.

I liked that the material was available in videos as well. It makes studying and learning a lot more effective. Its not always  possible to remember everything but you can go back and find out EXACTLY what was said and taught through the videos.

Amazing lectures! Class is set up really well! Review the lectures on Youtube and then do the practice exams on Learning Suite. You will be fine if you do this. It is good to read the chapter, but I only read it when I needed to reinforce a subject. Everything you need to know is mentioned in his lecture.

Brau is a great teacher.  I wish I had spent more time on this class but I had a heavy semester.  He has a solid testimony.  I wish that we had done more practice problems in class.  One thing that I hated was the department level exams.  They try & trick you on every question which I don't think is fair because the majority of us are new to this.

Only graded by tests which I don't love, but he is a great professor. Shares spiritual thoughts and I really appreciated that. Not all the professors here do that and so I really looked forward to hearing his. The tests can be fairly difficult. He's a nice guy and really tries to make his lectures interesting.

You don't have to go to class if you watch the youtube videos posted for each lecture. He does cover some things in class that aren't in the online text book, be sure to know those things. If you haven't already taken accounting, one of the tests will be more difficult. Concepts aren't very difficult, math is easy. Great professor.
He was a really cool guy. Kind of all over the place so it was a bit hard to follow him when he taught

Brau is a really good teacher and you can tell that he has been able to refine his skills. He tries different things in each semester, so the actual difficulty could differ depending on what he does. Your grade only consists of midterms and the final, so make sure and study a lot before the tests.
The entire grade is tests.

Brother Brau is a stud. He constantly keeps you engaged with humor and spiritual messages. DEFINITELY do the practice exams over and over and over preparing for the exams. Your grade is based on 5 exams (including the final) thats it.

Brau is a great teacher and his lectures are awesome!  He posts his lectures on YouTube so if you can't make it to class then you can just watch the YouTube video later and still get the same stuff.  Awesome professor!
Good class, but your entire grade is based on tests.  Bro Brau is a great guy, and tries make class interesting.

Great class, It was difficult for me though. He did a great job teaching the material. If you attend the lectures you WILL do better on the tests because a large part of what he teaches/test material is on the lecture rather than the reading. Great guy, keeps the class entertained and refreshed.
Bro Brau is very energetic and wants you to learn. Sometimes he strays off topic but also helps you understand the why of things not just the how.

Based all on department level tests. Just my opinion, but I felt that he didn't like that we were doing that and would make comments about it more than he should. Class has interesting things to learn but it is a difficult class. Make sure to stay on top of everything! Do the readings and go to class! I did like his spiritual thoughts.
Great Professor. Highly recommend. Get ready to learn!

Brau is a very inspirational teacher. The class is only graded on four midterms and the final. There are no other assignments. You need to go to class and do the readings in the book. Some things covered in class are not in the book and some in the book are not covered in class, but the tests will cover all the material and there is a lot of it.

Brau is a great professor, he knows what he's talking about and does a great job of explaining. He breaks up lectures with spiritual thoughts that are solid. Grades are based on exams, which you really need to study for. Brau provides everything necessary for success. You need to put work in to get a good grade in the class.
Amazing teacher. really hard class though but he is extremely willing to help his students out.

Professor Brau is a hoot! I loved his class, and I love his heart. There are practice problems and tests that prepare you for tests. Just one thing to those who are completely unfamiliar with finance.  He moves through material and talks pretty fast sometimes. He's great if you're relatively familiar with finance, but doesn't always dumb it down.

Brau is extremely passionate about Finance and channels that emotion to help his students. He's very direct with what principles need to be understood for the exams. Even though class attendance and reading is not required, it is a VERY good idea to do both -- you will not understand the material otherwise. Solid professor.
There really is no class structure. Besides that no complaints.

Prof Brau does a lot of things well: engaging lectures, clear expectations, etc. My problem with this course is that Prof Brau's teaching style did NOT work for me. Most of the time I could do the reading and be fine, but sometimes he tests things not in the book, only taught in class. Since he cowrote the book, why couldn't he add it to the book?

The class is very straightforward. Attendance isn't necessary but it is recommended. Also, there is no homework. I found it extremely useful to complete all of the assigned readings before class, because you will understand the material a lot more. Solid class, solid professor.

Brau is a really swell guy who teaches with a lot of energy. I didn't attend the class very often because he uploads all of his lectures on youtube, and attendance isn't required, but I still feel like I was able to understand most of what was going on. You are taught mainly from reading the online text, and in class you review it.

Bro Brau LOVES finance and his students. He is so knowledgeable and applies finance to the real world, as he explains other aspects of business. He is spiritually and professionally inspiring. This semester our grade was tests only, which was kind of intense. You have to study for the tests. Bro Brau is accessible, and relates well to the students.

For a GE intro to Finance it was a great class and you learn a lot. However, the tests are challenging. He will test you on things never talked about in class and only in the book. Other questions can be based completely off lectures and not in the text. So, you must study everything.

Great professor. Grades are made up of 4 tests. No hw. No assigments. I barely went to class, and passed with flying colors. Taking accounting 200 before this class helps a lot. Also for accounting kids, I recommend taking this concurrently with ACC310. Lots and lots of overlap. Never had to read for this class, learned everything in ACC310.

Tests are mostly based on lectures and reviews not reading. There is a lot of material to study from for tests but in class and drill problems are the most useful. Dr Brau is a funny and good guy who wants the best for each student no matter their creed.

I absolutely LOVE professor Brau. He is an amazing person, with a POWERFUL testimony. I love how he takes the time to share spiritual thoughts every single class. He is a Finance genius, and can answer all of your questions. I found the course really challenging because of the GIANT class size and the lack of graded homework, but I did learn a lot.

Professor Brau is a really energetic guy. He has a good grasp on what's important for students to learn from an introductory finance course and doesn't make you do any pointless assignments. With a few exceptions, his test questions are fair. Beware of the textbook though. There were tons of errors in practice problems and they can be inconsistent.
Good class. Good Professor. Let's you know what he expects from day 1. Do what he recommends and you will do fine.
Real good dude, great class. All around a fun giggly time.

Bro. Brau knows his stuff and works hard to make sure he effectively communicates concepts to his students. He genuinely cares about the kids in his classes. You have got to put the work in on your own for this class - read the chapters before coming to class, work drill problems and study hard for exams. YOUR GRADE IS BASED ONLY ON TESTS.

I loved Professor Brau! My favorite part was the fact that he put his lectures up on youtube. If there was a concept you couldn't quite grasp, then you could always review it on youtube. Loved his spiritual thoughts, really genuine guy who wants you to be successful.

I loved that he posted his lectures on youtube.  My wife just had our fourth child on the 28th of December and she broke her 3 weeks before that.  I work full-time, so my time constrains were greater than usual.  I was very grateful that I could watch class without attending. It allowed me to achieve an A.

Brother Brau is a great guy, and a good teacher. He's a super intense guy. Your grade consists entirely upon how well you do on his tests. While a good number of people consistently got 100%, for some reason the material never clicked with me. I studied constantly, and still couldn't get a good grade on tests. Just be prepared and go to class.

Brother Brau is highly reputable. His class is easy once you understand the concepts. For those who are a little less inclined to finance like myself, plan on dedicating an honest 2 hours outside of class for every hour in class if you want an A. He is very invested in his students. If you want his help, do your work, he's pretty straightforward.

Brau is enthusiastic and passionate about the class. It's easy to fall behind if you start missing classes. Very stressful b/c all grades depend on 4 exams. Terrible class if you do not test well. I would rather have had weekly assignments. He youtubes every class.
He cares about your quality of education and all the lectures tie into each other.

Professor Brau is a great professor. He does a good job making the course material relevant. I also like that he takes time to focus on professional development because if you're not a business student, that's not something that you get a lot of. Course structured to learn new concepts through reading and do practice problems in class.
I highly recommend Dr. Brau for Finance 201! I really enjoyed his class!

Bro Brau is a great teacher. His class is only made up of 5 grades which are exams. If you do a survey the lowest one gets dropped. He records his lectures which are helpful. If you want a formula sheet don't take it from him. There is a lot of information in this class but he always tries to apply it to the real world. He does spiritual thoughts.
It's really fast paced but if you stay ahead with readings and really dedicate time you will be okay. Accounting isn't required as a prerec but would have been really helpful for this class.

Professor Brau is one of my favorites. The class itself was difficult but I loved Brau's teaching style of notes and good examples. He moves fast through the material so be ready to go back and review your notes. Do the example problems before the test! You won't regret it! Put in the effort and you'll be fine
He is great professor and hilarious. Get ready to textbook and read the materials before class. There are a lot of information that you have to know.

Brother Brau is a great teacher. He really cares about his students and wants them to succeed. That said, he expects you to work. If you do the readings and practice problems, you'll do fine. His lectures are really good, and he youtubes them if you aren't able to make it. His spiritual thoughts are awesome. Great class! 10/10 would recommend

Bro Brau is a good guy and I would recommend him to someone else taking the class.  Tests are all that matters in his class which can be difficult.  I don't think he does a great job explaining the concepts honestly. He kindof just throws out the formulas but doesn't give a lot of context. Overall a great teacher though who is passionate about fin

Bro. Brau is real, he knows what he is talking about, he keeps you engaged by throwing in breaks and on point spiritual thoughts. He is great at combining spirituality and learning without feeling forced because he is just real with you. Probably my favorite professor. Be sure to focus on getting time value of money down!

Professor Brau was an awesome instructor. The only grades in the class were tests but they are not overly difficult and he prepares you well for them.
