He also is probably the most willing of all my teachers to help the individual student. Wants you to succeed. Just do the readings before class and you'll be fine.

Brother Brau is a good choice. His energy and excitement about finance and life naturally get passed on to his students. The class is hard because the only grades are the midterms and the final, but at least there's no busy work. I'd take it from Brau again.

Professor Brau is an awesome guy! His class can be a bit challenging if you are new to the finance world. Make sure you study the material given and really understand the basics such as TVM, WACC, and others. One of my favorite parts of his lectures were his spiritual thoughts. He is a real fire and brimstone type of guy, but he is really motivatio

He's a great person, which makes for a good professor. He said he'll change this, but classes are mandatory and he recorded each lecture and posted it on YouTube. I only ever did all the readings and the practice exams and I averaged a B on every exam. He covers some stuff in lecture that's not in the book so I suggest going to class - worth it.

As a person Brau is amazing, he inspires his students to be better! As a teacher... I probably wouldn't take this class again with him. I felt like I had to learn things on my own, he goes through things really fast in class expecting you to already know what he is teaching. Your grade comes from you tests and that's it. He is a good guy.

Brau is a great man. He is a great motivator, and is clear in his expectations. he told us from day one that his final is one of the hardest tests we would take. The online textbook is a must-read and lectures in class are critical. Everything is fair game in this class, so be ready to pay attention and take good notes.

Professor Brau is an incredible man. His class can be hard, but if you put in the hours consistently, it is a rewarding class. I do think that he misses the boat on explaining high-level concepts some of the time, but overall, he does a great job making the material relatable. His spiritual thoughts are powerful. You know he loves his students!

Brau is the man. He's straightforward, tells you exactly how things are, and doesn't put up with nonsense, but is still funny. He's great at teaching the concepts, but you will definitely have to put in the work to master the concepts. Reading the book is important because it goes into other concepts that the lecture doesn't have time to cover.

Brau is great! Read the chapters before class or else you will get lost. There is a ton of material and it takes a lot of practice to master, but he gives plenty of study material and practice problems so that you're prepared for tests. I love that Brother Brau takes advantage of being able to share spiritual thoughts in class, they're so good!

Bro B is a fantastic teacher, but his class is hard. Make sure you have taken Acc 200 before you take FIN 201!! Your grade is based tests only, so be prepared- the tests are not easy. Bro b keeps class interesting and explains concepts very well. DO THE PRACTICE QUIZZES. Really one of my favorite teachers at BYU, strongly recommend!

He's very clear of what the expectations are for this class and creates a competitive atmosphere that makes you want to work hard. If you're trying to figure out if you're cut out for Business School, particularly to be in the Finance Major, this class is for you. I myself struggled and found the tests hard, but good professor and enjoyable.

Goes over concepts, but assumes you know more than you actually do. Sometimes he makes you feel  dumb. He hates electronics, so no phones or laptops allowed. Gives spiritual thoughts everyday in class, which is nice, sometimes they are intense.
Tough class, the entire grade is test based.  You have to work hard, but if you work at it you can get a good grade.  Really a great guy and tries to do whats best for his students.

He is a really good teacher, he tells you exactly what is expected of you, which is a lot! Very hard class that takes a lot of time but he really does everything he can to help you. Take finance from Brau.

I like how he is very personable and really student-oriented by truly caring for their needs. Using an opinion box that allows students to voice out their feelings towards the class also helps students to feel like part of the class too!
I love how he is able to accommodate students' needs by allowing students to voice out their opinions by writing things on the opinion box.

Brother Brau is the man. He is everything that you want in a teacher. You can tell that he really cares about his students and he is passionate about Finance. This course makes you work for it as there aren't any assignments, only tests count for our grades. He has told us that there won't be a formula sheet on his tests going forward.
This was a great class. It is by no means an easy class, but if you put in the time and effort you will succeed. Professor Brau gives you tips for success and if you follow those you will be fine.

Brother Brau is a good professor that cares a lot. I know this semester was a bit different but the entire grade went off a few tests that were much harder than given study materials. He tries to help and he gives awesome emotional feedback and spiritual thoughts,  but the class is just way too difficult to do on your own.

The tough thing about the class is that tests are the ONLY things that go on your grade. His tests are pretty tough, but if you put in the time, you should be fine. He prepares you well for the tests.
Loved Professor Brau and highly recommend taking FIN 201 from him you will laugh your head off.

The only grades you have in the class are the 4 tests and the final which can be a good thing.  His spiritual thoughts and commercial breaks help the flow of class and add a distinct character to him that I liked.

Great Guy.  One of the only on campus that is from the south a proud of it. His spiritual thoughts are always inspirational, the passion for teaching is clear, and he cares for students, even in a big lecture class.  This class will KICK YOUR TAIL. No joke,  hardest class of my career. If you are a math guy, a breeze. For the rest: bloody murder.
Brau is a great man.  He is always reaching out to students in need both academically and emotionally. The class was great.

In order to fully learn the material for this class it is very important to read each chapter and work on the study problems in the book.  His lectures are helpful, but should not be the primary source of learning the material.  His lectures help solidify what is taught in the book and are meant to speak about the intuition behind the math.
He only grades on tests, so it requires a lot of self discipline to stay on top of the material
Doesnt really teach us all that much. You learn most by yourself reading the online textbook. He thinks hes funny

This is a weeder class for the business school. He expects you to know a lot about finance beforehand and there's a lot of intuition that you should just know. For those who have to take this but don't want to apply to the Marriott School, it's very hard and not applicable to my own major.

Awesome professor. Probably the hardest class of my college career, but it was finance and I'm terrible with numbers, so I credit Brau for making it manageable. Great guy who cares about each student.

This guy is crazy!  (in a good way).. he has lots of energy and enthusiasm for what he teaches. He truly cares about his students and makes time for them all.  Smart, and knows how to describe the material so that everyone can understand.

This is one of those classes where you either get it or you don't. The only grades you get are for 4 midterms and the final exam. He teaches with equations, expecting you to follow along at all times and understand his rhetoric. Absolutely hated the class and teaching style. Will probably retake from another professor, cause Brau is the worst.
Great teacher. His spiritual messages are awesome. Just be ready to move fast. He moves fast and sometimes doesn't realize that no one is keeping up. Don't be afraid to tell him or ask questions.
Gives good lectures.  Keeps you entertained.   Has inspiring spiritual thoughts.

Professor Brau is one of the best professors at BYU! He is such a spiritual guy and truly cares about his students. His spiritual messages are super uplifting. It is a difficult class, but if you stay on top of the work, you will do well.
Gives good lectures.  Keeps you entertained.

Professor Brau is great! He cares a lot about his students and he does a lot of extra things to give back. He shares spiritual thoughts every class which are always extremely uplifting and will rival the spirituality of your religion classes. Great guy and a great class. Finance can be a difficult topic but just stay up on it and you will do well.

I would recommend taking Fin 201 from Brother Brau. He truly cares about his students and the subject. I would utilize the TA help desk hours as much as possible. They prepared me most for the tests. Also the after chapter quizzes were very helpful. Make sure you pay attention in class because some test questions come straight from lectures.

Professor Brau, was so fun. Such a Bro, which is why I loved him. He was fun and also spiritual at the same time. As far as the teaching went, he was happy to give advice and help in anyway he could. Not the easiest stuff to learn, but he made it fun learning it.

Brother Brau is one of the most spiritual professors I've had.  This class was very difficult for me but some breezed through.  Exams can be difficult.  Study guides don't always help.  He doesn't always fully explain concepts and expects you to just get it.
Brau is a nice guy but his tests were difficult!  This wasn't too enjoyable when that is all the final grade is made up of.
It was great!

Good teacher, funny guy that always has a story. Would YouTube all his lectures but not sure if he plans that anymore due to decreasing Class sizes. Would take again, not extremely difficult but not boring either.
Bro. Brau made Finance exciting.  I would recommend taking it from him.

Professor Brau does a great job at teaching you all about finance, the only tough part is that your whole grade are the midterms and the final! So there really isn't room to bs his class. Attend the lectures, do the chapters before class, and get ready study your butt off. He's a great teacher though, very inspirational!

Pretty funny and spiritual guy, but in my opinion wasn't the best teacher. I felt I had to teach myself the material because in class he would either go off on tangents that lasted way too long, or when he did teach, he was disorganized and occasionally forgot to tell us things, and he would later have to backtrack, making it confusing.
Great guy with a lot of enthusiasm in class.  Sometimes difficult to follow during lectures.
awesome

I like Professor Brau. He has a lot of energy and enthusiasm, which can be really helpful for 8 am lectures, but it can also be a lot at times. Your grade is completely made up of tests,  so you need to be a good test taker. Brau says anything in the textbook is fair game, but I felt the tests were mainly based on what he covers in lecture.
He has spiritual thoughts every class that are great. For class, just stay on top of it and do what he tells you. Trust him.

Jim Brau is one of the greatest professors that I have had at Brigham Young University. His class is challenging & requires that students give a full effort in order to come out w/ a full grasp of the material, but his execution as a Professor is on point.

Great guy. I really respect him for who he is and the passion that he teaches with. He really tries to leave a lasting influence on his students. He doesn't explain stuff very clearly for the layman, and I often found myself confused about some of the concepts that he was teaching. I got most of my understanding from reading the online textbook.

Brother Brau was fantastic! His class was definitely a challenge, but in a good way.  At the end of it, it's like you just climbed a really steep mountain and you look out and think "wow I just did that" and feel very proud of yourself.  I've learned so much this semester and now have a very solid financial base that I can continue to build upon.

Sometimes I got more out of Brau's spiritual thoughts than I did from religion courses. He's real and authentic and helps you keep the big picture in mind. In terms of finance, he's a whiz but sometimes gets caught up in jargon and if you miss a class or get behind in the reading you'll be up a creek without a paddle pretty quick.

Bro Brau is a super nice dude with an awesome heart! Love his spiritual thoughts and everything he does to actually help his students progress in life. Unfortunately, I found the class very difficult. He spends most of his lectures explaining the "intuition" but doesn't do many example problems. I NEED example problems and lots of them.

I absolutely love Brau. Total gym bro(drinks pre-workout, talks like a bro, and even has office hours at the gym). You can tell he really cares for his students and they are a huge part of his life. Im not going to life one of the hardest classes i've taken, but ive learned so much. Best part of his class are the spiritual moments.
He's difficult but not unfair

Brother Brau is awesome, he gives some great life and gospel instruction as well. He really knows his stuff and is very animated. If you work through the practice problems the tests aren't that bad. Overall this class wasn't that bad - as long as you study well for the tests it's pretty nice.
Definitely would recommend taking finance from Brau. He keeps lectures interesting and engaging. He's really funny. Also teaches the content really well.

Professor Brau is a great teacher. He is inspirational and does a great job of teaching. If you follow the syllabus you will do well. Your grade comes from essentially 4 tests. It's a challenging but also enjoyable class. Take good notes, do the practice tests. Ask yourself which question was the hardest to do because that one will be on the test.

Professor Brau, or Bro B. as he tells us to call him, is a wonderful man and professor. He is extremely caring of his students and he is very passionate about his subject. He does a spiritual thought as part of every lecture which is always amazing. Tests comprise your whole grade. I am very glad I took Fin 201 from Brau.
Only grades are the tests... not bad... not my favorite...
Good guy, I liked the class.

Good class, gives you a lot of real world applications for finance. The tests are tough but the study material is very good at preparing you. Occasionally, he rushes through things too fast, and other times he can really drag out a section. He occasionally will mention things way above your level of understanding as well.

Brother Brau is one of the best professors on campus.  He has the best spiritual thoughts and really cares about his students success.  He records his lectures and puts them on Youtube.  You are going to have work really hard, read the textbook, and spend lots of time preparing for tests, but if you work hard you will do well.  I loved this class.

This class is very straightforward but can be difficult. Tests are doable but studying is a must. Brother Brau is a great lecturer; he takes questions before, during, and after lecture, and he is fantastic at making class interesting and entertaining.

Prof. Brau is one of my favorite teachers, both in character and quality of teaching. He took a subject that I knew nothing about and in a semester made me fluent in the language of finance. The class requires you to pay attention, but if you do the reading beforehand and study, his tests are always fair. But he's no longer using a formula sheet!

Bro. Brau is easily the most energetic professor I've ever taken a class from. Even at 8am, he kept everyone awake. This semester our grade was only determined by midterm scores (though supposedly that was new). The tests were hard, but if you study you can do well. He posts all his lectures on YouTube, so missing class isn't the end of the world.
Brau is super dope!
Great teacher! Very passionate about Finance and helping his students. No homework. You are only graded on the tests. You have 4 midterms and a final but one of the midterms is dropped.

Brau's a good professor and an awesome guy. His class is difficult, but he lets you know that up front. If you study like he tells you to and you work consistently, you'll do alright... if you don't, YOU WON'T. My only complaint is that he's  intense and he can come across SUPER  condescending in his teaching style, but he has good intentions.

Professor Brau is a great guy. Very thorough class, really tailored to those going into the finance and business majors. He films and posts all of his lectures online, which is really nice. Would take again.
Tests are very hard. Make sure to study a lot and know how to do all the problems in myeducator and practice exams.

He's a great guy and a fun professor to take this class from. He recorded lectures and put them up on YouTube, but he said this was the last semester he's doing it. Otherwise, you want to come to class or you won't do good on the tests
Great teacher. Pay attention in class or watch the youtubes. The material is tough but he does a great job teaching

Jim Brau is a great teacher. He was entertaining and really went out of his way to make class spiritual and effective. I learned best by reading the chapters and re-reading them before the tests. It will require time, but you can do well in the class and apply it in your future finances. Great overall class!

Brother Brau is a pretty great guy and his finance class is manageable if you put in the time and effort required. This year we were graded only on our exam scores (no homework, no quizzes, etc)  which was a good thing for me, since I did fairly decent on all the exams. Overall good class.

Brau is SO GREAT! He really knows his stuff and he cares about all of his students and his classes are always entertaining. Sometimes he goes through the material a little fast, but he records his lectures so you can go back and review and there are lots of TAs to help.
Brau has a genuine care for his students. Have to study quite a bit but is a great class.

Professor Brau is the most amazing professor I've ever had. He cares about the students and is always trying to help their students get a good grade. He shares incredibly uplifting spiritual thoughts in every lecture. If you want to get an A in this class, make sure you don't procrastinate and start doing what he suggests from the very beginning

Brau is probably one of the best teachers I have ever had because he truly cares about his students, explains things thoroughly, and makes himself available for support. The class itself is a bit of a screening class if you ask me, because it is definitely much more challenging than any other 200-level class I've had. Get ready to work HARD though.
Brau really cares about the students, and he may not do this in the future, but he films his lectures and puts them on YouTube, so you can watch them later if you miss class.

You need to read before coming to classes. He summarizes everything so you need to read before so you understand better.  His lectures are like a review if you read it before. He teaches really fast so if you are a slow learner you need to read before. Do all the exercises in my educator it will help you a lot. For the test, 60% book and 40% class.

Bro Brau is an absolute stud. His class is difficult if you don't pay attention in class, or do the homework readings. With that said, if you put in the time you will succeed. Bro Brau is the most fair Professor I have had in college.
Great professor. Inspiring as all heck. However, ya best be studyin' consistently to get dat A.

Bro. Brau is a great teacher. His spiritual thoughts are always uplifting and inspire you to be better. Tests are 100% your grade. There are 4 midterms (Each covers 3 chapters) and then 1 comprehensive final. Class attendance isn't necessary because he records each class and puts it on YouTube. That was nice. Great class and awesome teacher!

He kind of lets his ego get the better of him during stories but he sincerely wants to help his students. He wants all of his students to succeed and puts his neck out to do what he can. That is rare in a lot of professors. He records and posts every lecture on youtube which is an absolute lifesaver.

Jim Brau is definitely one of the great professors at BYU . Uplifts the class with great spiritual thoughts. A tough class for a 200 level class. No homework, quizzes or projects. Grade is based 100% on tests. Be prepared to give it time and effort. Acc200 helpful if taken. Read and work out problems at Myeducator prior to class/YouTube post.

This guy is the man,  he knows how to make class an effective learning environment and still makes it fun, inspirational, and spiritual. His class is definitely pretty difficult but if you do exactly what he says you can make it.  His grades are based solely on test which can be a little stressful but you can drop one and he  makes it fair.
Bro Brau is one of the best teachers on campus

Brau is a great guy. I would have liked him to be a bit more professional sometimes, but his laid-back teaching style made him more approachable. You win some, you lose some. Class was hard. Questions on the test were not in lecture, so do the reading. Grades were 100% tests which I did not like.

Finance is HARD. Brau definitely knows his stuff, but sometimes I think struggles to explain it in simple terms to non finance majors. He'll drop one test, but your whole grade is determined by the 5 tests. Hard material so study all the tricks. I recommend a study group. Brau has the best spiritual thoughts and always wants to improve the class.

We have a hot dog at the school's restaurant The Wall named after him. That's how good he is. Passionate about what he teaches. Explains things clearly. Inspirational. Loves his family. You really do need to put effort into studying, but I mean, of course you need to! It's a class; of course you NEED to work hard.
Bro. Brau loves his students, talks a lot, and gives great spiritual thoughts. I learned the material through the practice problems rather than from lecture.
Great professor. Good balance of material and spiritual thoughts. He is a really great guy and a good teacher as well. However, you will have to pay attention if you want to do well in the class.

He is so PASSIONATE about the things that he talks about. Also he is very entertaining. The class structure is such that your entire grade is midterms and the final. For me, this was difficult because I found all my other classes took up my time until the week of the test. I tried to cram, but it wasn't good enough. You need to practice a LOT!
Super great professor!

This was a very good class. Professor Brau does a great job at organizing the class and being very clear about what is expected in order to get a good grade and succeed. He is extremely entertaining and class is never boring and totally worth going to! Great course material also. A lot of tests but he clarifies what you need to know fairly well.

Brother Brau was awesome. He was a great professor and was always very spiritual. He uploaded all of his lectures online so if you miss a day it was easy to go back and check what you missed. I'm not majoring in finance, but he made finance interesting for me.

DO NOT take this class unless you're a whiz at Finance, or if it's required for your major. That being said, Brau is the best professor I've ever had. I've never felt so cared of by a professor, even in a class of 800. He shares spiritual thoughts every class, and takes notes on an overhead in front of us, which makes taking notes easier.
I loved Brother Brau. They way he taught by including spiritual thoughts was really inspiring and made me enjoy his class. I would definitely recommend him.

Word to the wise: Bro Brau's lectures are usually speedy fast, which means that reading through the assigned chapter before class helps a lot to not feel totally overwhelmed. Do the practice exams before taking the exams, and study the notes you take in class (just like he says to do!!) and you can do it! Lots of great spiritual thoughts every day.
As long as you read and pay attention to the lectures it's a fairly easy class.

The class is like a plant. If you plant the seed and water it all semester long (putting in the hours of reading, notes, and practice questions) then you will reap the effective effort you put into it. Cramming bites back at ya and leaves you haggling over quantitive problems that are a real struggle.
Brau is an amazing lecturer. He sometimes skips over fundamentals, but if you read the textbook thoroughly, you'll be fine. One thing is for sure- you won't be bored in class!
He's a good guy who is a little too into himself. Only tests but if you study enough you can do fine

This class was hard for me because there were no quizzes or assignments other than the midterms and final exam. If you self-discipline yourself to really learn as you go instead of cramming right before the tests you should be golden! Professor Brau is a fun professor and does an awesome job at motivating students spiritually and intellectually.
Great class. I really learned how to apply finance to my professional aspect of life, and to the personal side of my life.

If having a great professor is important to you Brother Brau is your guy. FIN 201 is a hard class, but his class is a blast. He Youtubes each class so if you miss you can always go back and review it! Brau's  class won't get to use a formula sheet like Holmes, but I'm 100% you'll learn the material more in Braus class. Only grades are 4 test.
Bro Brau is a bruh. Finance is hard but he makes it learnable. You study, you know it, you pass.
The grade is all tests.

Your overall class grade is based off exam scores only so you have to do good on them, but the tests are definitely fair.  Brother Brau does an awesome job of teaching the concepts and preparing you for the exams so just do everything that he suggests and you'll do fine.  Brau is 100% the man to take Finance 201 from!!!

Awesome class, even better professor. Knows his stuff and he brings the spirit to class. Grades are based off tests but if you put forth the effort they aren't too bad. If you have to take finance 201, take it from him!!!!
I had a hard time following his teaching style. He knows what he's talking about though. Of all my teachers he gave the most solid, consistent, and inspirational spiritual thoughts.
Good class, grades based entirely off tests. No formula sheet's will be included going forward so be ready to memorize. Fair tests though.

He's pretty much a motivator.  Most of the learning came from doing practice tests and reading the online textbook.  Is very open to help students if you approach him.  Tries to help students not only to pass the class, but to be successful in their futures.
He's a motivating and an inspiring professor.

Brau is an enthusiastic guy with a lot of opinion. He does a good job taking into consideration of students wants even though it is a big class. He has a lot of heart and really cares about the things he teaches. He is mostly interested in making his students succeed in life

Brau is bro. He is a great professor with lots of energy which is something I really appreciated. I liked his spiritual thoughts and you can tell he really wants to improve his teaching by always asking for suggestions.

Awesome dude! Keep up with the reading. Make sure you do the practice problems. If you don't put in work, you won't succeed. I love that he posts his classes on YouTube because you can re-watch lectures to better understand the material. The key to an A in this class is repetition. Do problems over and over until you know them perfectly.

Although many say that Brau isn't fair in his tests because they are too hard (which I do somewhat agree with), if you study for the exams THE WAY HE TELLS YOU TO, you will at least get at B+.  This isn't an easy class by any means but I felt that he has been a professor that sincerely cares about me and I would 10/10 recommend to anyone.
Great class. Makes finance relatable and understandable.  You have to want to learn the material, but he makes it enjoyabe.

He puts his lectures on YouTube which was a total blessing for me. If you're willing to put in the time, you'll do well. You MUST read the text before attending class or watching the YouTube lecture. It is straightforward. Do ALL of the practice problems as many times as you can. Overall, I know he loves his students.

He is an amazing professor with an outstanding knowledge of finance. If you want to understand the foundation of finance in a fun and spiritual way, definitely take it from Brau. He cares for his students and does everything he can for them succeed in his class. He has a strong testimony of the gospel which makes class extra spiritual!
Awesome profesor. The class is challenging but the requirements are clear and effective. The principles learned can be applied throughout your whole lives. Take this profesor and you won't regret it.
He is very clear about everything and does a great job explaining what will be on the test.

I really didn't like how the whole grade was based off of just tests. So take Brau if you are very confident in your testing skills! Be sure to stay on top of the work, because it starts connecting near the end and if you originally didn't understand, it gets rough.  He was a cool guy though, but a huge class so you don't get to interact much.

Really good guy, loves to bring the gospel into his lectures which i really like. Thank being said it is a hard class, a lot of time spent out side of class. The hardest thing is your whole grade is four tests that are only offered for on day with a late day. you miss them and you are out of luck.

Brother Brau gives you a real, down-to-Earth take on finance. Great class if you're thinking of becoming a finance major, but other people can benefit greatly too. Your grade is entirely determined by tests, which can be good or a bad thing--depends who you are. Solid guy though. Spiritual in-class thoughts were awesome.

Bro Brau is a great guy. He really tries to help his students and be a good teacher. That being said, this class is not for beginners. If you have no background in finance or accounting, then you have no business being in this class. He knows his stuff, but has a hard time teaching the fundamentals of the material and you'll get left behind.

Bro. Brau is awesome, but his class is tough. Your grade is based 100% off your test scores, so be prepared to study. He has a lot of resources online to help you study, and I would recommend taking the practice exams before each test. He gives great spiritual thoughts during every lecture, and you can really tell that he cares about his students!

Brother Brau is an awesome guy and really cares about his students. The class is very competitive so it requires a lot of work to be at the top. If you have no finance/accounting/economics background than this class will be tough, but Brau gives plenty of learning materials so if you study and do practice problems you will be able to do well.

Jim Brau is a fantastic professor. My 5 favorite things about him are: 1.) He's clear and concise 2.) He is considerate to all students 3.) He ademently wants you to succeed 4.) He keeps you up to date and is punctual.  (but you better have good study and reading habits!!) 5.) He give ample study material.

He is a professor with good intentions. He wants to be there for students whatever the problem may be (except class stuff - I feel like we have to just go to the TA's for that).  I don't like relying too heavily on tests but that is what this class was. Don't get behind on reading and think you can catch up. Quizzes aren't graded, do them anyway.
His spiritual thoughts during class are excellent. Also, if you're not a fan of attending class, all of his lectures are posted on YouTube. I found it a lot easier to watch them on my own time.

The entire grade is made up of tests, if you put in the time to study the material you will do just fine. Review the practice problems and watch the lectures over and over again. He posts the lectures on Youtube so it is super helpful.

Professor Brau is a decent professor, this class is entirely test based. If you are not good at taking tests this is not the class for you. One recommendation is to take his advice on finding a tutor for this class from the free tutors. Also DO the MyEducator materials. Also review the class videos he posts they are useful when studying.

Bro. Brau is the professor version of a Provo all-star. Your grade is based on your midterms and final test scores, which makes getting a good grade difficult if you aren't a good test taker. It's easy to fall behind, and I found this to be far more difficult than I expected. My learning style and his teaching methods didn't mesh well.

Brother Brau is a great professor! He teaches complex ideas in a simple way to understand. The class isn't bad if you're willing to put in your part. Attendance isn't required since they record the class and post it on youtube. I  found i did better with those than being in class, but that depends on each person.

Definitely one of the most spiritually uplifting professors I've had here at BYU. His spiritual thoughts are spot on, he's always in a great mood. I took this class with a very full schedule, so I struggled at times, but as long as you have the time to do all of the readings and quizzes you'll be fine. Great guy!

Brau is the man! Honestly everyday he made class enjoyable, and he really cares about his students.  This is not the easiest class though, he makes you put in the work, but if you do the readings and pay attention, study hard for tests, you'll do well.

Brother Brau rocks! It's abundantly obvious that he really cares about his students. He wants us to be successful, not only in our academic and professional lives, but also in other aspects of our lives. His lectures are captivating, engaging, and inspiring. He is a phenomenal teacher. One downside: he used exam questions written by other professor

Professor Brau is a good professor! However, you get out of Finance 201 what you put into it. If you want to understand it and like it and be able to use it in your future, have a good attitude and work for it. It wasn't my favorite class but I'm not majoring in business, and I definitely could have put more effort into learning the material.
Cool guy. Good at teaching the basics of material. have to do your part to do well

Great Professor, you can tell he really cares about his students. I liked how the classes were posted on YouTube, but I wish we were graded on more than just the exams. I'd recommend not taking this class with a heavy schedule so you have time to do the readings and prepare for class.
Great professor. He tells you exactly what you need to do and know to be successful in the class. He gives a spiritual thought each lecture and you know he cares about his students.

Brother Brau is one of the best professors I've had at BYU. He's an amazing lecturer, very clear, and yet always invites the spirit to class. Your grade is based only on tests. They're difficult, but not too hard to get an A. You do have to put in the time necessary for the class. Go to his lectures, take notes, do the readings, problems, and exams

Great lecturer and explains the topics very well. Grade is a compilation of four midterms and the final, so no grade boosting there. His spiritual thoughts are great and he talks about topics that are in the shadows and need to be brought up. Sometimes he make a his opinion appear as fact, but overall very sincere and a very good professor.

This is a tough class. Your grade only consists of 4 tough midterms (3, with 1 dropped) and the final. However, I learned SO much from Brau, and not just about finance. He gave awesome spiritual thoughts and you can tell he really cares about his students. Review the Youtube lectures, your notes, and practice like crazy to do well on tests.

Even though the class was not absolutely necessary to attend I enjoyed the energy and the spirit that he brought to his lectures.  He get you excited about the subject and makes you want to learn more.  Even though the class was completely based on tests he teaches you to use intuition and not just memorize random information.

Brau cares about his students. He teaches quickly and tests are the only thing graded. Read before class, if not you'll fall behind and get really confused. This was a hard class for me but more because of subject, not because of Brau. He puts his lectures on YouTube and you DON'T get the formula sheet on tests (helpful if finance is your career)
Bro Brau is amazing. So passionate about what he does. Everything he does is 200mph so come prepared to class!
Awesome professor! Very clear teacher and enthusiastic about the course material.

Taking Prof. Brau's class was a blessing. He does a masterful job of mixing the academic with the spiritual. He always has an upbeat attitude and really says things as they are, but encourages everyone in a positive manner. In addition he really cares about each student and is always available to give advice. If you work hard you will do well.

Great class, awesome professor! Grading is stressful because it's only tests, drops a midterm. Hard tests, require a lot of work and study. Great professor, really cares, wants whats best for students. Class time is so worthwhile, if you can't attend, youtube videos are very helpful, also helpful in studying for tests. Highly recommend Bro Brau!

Awesome professor. Gets straight to the point and is very clear. Youtube's the class so it's nice to study things you missed in class. Overall, the class wasn't as horrible as I thought it was going to be. Take Brau he is the best.

I honestly had a hard time in this class, but not just because the material was challenging. Bro. Brau's teaching style works for some students, but  I feel like information is thrown out without much guided practice. However, he is very open to talking to students, especially about gospel things, which is nice.

Prof. Brau was one of my most favorite professors this semester! He truly cares about his students' lives beyond the classroom. He finds ways to apply everything to real life and to help us be "life-long learners." You won't regret choosing Brau!

If you are expecting any help out side of lecture or the MyEducator meterial, DON'T.  The Only way you will get a good grae in this class is if you are naturally good at finance.  He spends more class time bragging about the finance department and telling storries than he does teaching.
I am a freshman that has never taken a business class. You seriously should be fine if you have taken accounting, but without it this is stinking hard.

Brau is an awesome teacher! Debatably one of the best I've had at BYU. Personally, I also felt that the class was the hardest I've had at BYU, although that isn't necessarily Brau's fault. He teaches really well, but for some reason finance just doesn't click for me. Luckily it's my last semester and all I need is a D- haha

Bro. Brau is so awesome! He shares great spiritual thoughts and career development moments in each lecture! There are no graded homework assignments or quizzes. Your entire grade is based on 4 midterms and a final. He will drop your lowest midterm score! Take this class from Bro. Brau! One of my favorite teachers ever!!

Great professor and great class. It was challenging, but if you do what Brother Brau says to prepare for the tests, you will do just fine. I really learned a lot and enjoyed this class. Brother Brau is wonderful!
Fantastic teacher. Knows the material very well and teaches it with passion. Nothing but midterms go on your grade, so study hard. Brau cares about his students and is not afraid to share the gospel.

Great professor but the class was just 5 tests and you drop one.  The final will replace your grade if you do better than the average you already have.  Loved him as a person but lectures were sometimes hard to follow. If you dont read before class you will be lost and not understand anything.

I like Brother Brau as a person. But the course is graded off of nothing but exams and attendance is not mandatory so there's very little motivation to go to class. He's a super nice guy, but spends a lot of class time talking about non-related subjects.

Prof. Brau is such a passionate, brilliant man. He knows his stuff concerning all things finance and business, as well as how to bring the Spirit into his classroom. I was really touched by his love for learning, his family, and God, but I didn't learn from him well. Lectures went over my head. You have to do the homework problems and study hard.

I was skeptical going into this class with Brau.  He is a little aggressive & he does have a big ego, but it'll give you a little laugh here and there. It was nice to have his lectures on youtube. No required quizzes. Your whole score is the average of your test scores. We were given a formula sheet on the tests but he wont do that again. Good luck

Brother Brau is one of the most spiritual and inspiring human beings you will ever meet. He's very clear with his grading criteria and explains concepts the best he can. He has a "suggestion box" to get input from students to better his teaching skills. He takes those seriously. Be prepared to memorize important finance formulas. Study group is key

Fin 201 -  Great class, really enjoyed it. You have to test well to perform well in this class. It helps to have taken accounting and stats already, but not necessary. Brau is a great lecturer, and you can tell he loves what he does. Great guy.

Great prof who is passionate about what he does! Has a solid testimony and lets you know it every class period through his spiritual thoughts. They're powerful! I'm not a fan of all the reading. You have to read a lot if you want to understand what is going on in class. Lectures sometimes are hard to follow due to all the finance terms & equations.

Jim Brau is a great teacher who is an even more outstanding person. He really tries hard to care about his students and seeks to be relaxed and approachable. The class isn't easy, and it is very exam-heavy, but the work is rewarding and you definitely learn a lot.
You can tell that he cares and wants his students to succeed. The exams were difficult so you really need to study!

Class  4 exams and 1 final and they are all very hard. I loved his lectures, but I wish there were at least a little bit of cushion from quizzes or other assignments to help out those that aren't the best test takers at BYU.

Professor Brau was really captivating and clearly knows the material; he commands the attention and respect of the class. As far as teaching quality, he was phenomenal. Still, every student learns differently-the class was difficult for me, and I may need to retake it. If I do, I believe I will take it from another professor to see the difference.

Brau is an amazing professor, but his class was very very difficult, mainly because the entire grade is based solely on tests. If you do not read the material, attend every single class, and study a lot before tests then you will struggle in this class. Very time demanding, TONS of formulas, and sometimes his lectures were hard to follow.

Brau is the man. His lectures are super interesting, and his spiritual thoughts are incredible. Unfortunately the class is 100% based on exams so you really need to study and keep up with the class. If you skip lecture, make sure you watch the youtube videos because he loves to ask questions from what he specifically talks about in class.

Great class, great professor. Go over the class lecture more than the myeducator because he adds questions from our lectures that you won't know unless you go to class or watch the YouTubes. The tests are very, very tricky. You think you know everything from the Practice Tests, but the tests are more tricky. Be prepared.
READ BEFORE YOU GO TO CLASS!!

Brau is a solid guy that has an awesome testimony, which he shares every day in class.  His teaching style confused me, so I never went to class. I watched his class on youtube in 2x speed, which was crazy, because that guy has lots of energy. Do the practice tests on My Educator, and you'll be fine.  A few questions come from the lecture.

Bro Brau is one of my favorite professors at BYU. His lectures were amazing and I loved going to class. He is hilarious and gives the best spiritual thoughts each class period. His class is hard but he drops a test if you do a survey and your grade will reflect the amount of time you put into it. Best professor hands down for Finance.

Good professor for a hard class. Most of the learning for this class is done outside of class hours and then you basically review what you read in class. Brau is very enthusiastic and entertaining and has been fair whenever I've contacted him personally. It is a hard class but Brau makes it doable.

Bro. Brau is AWESOME! His class changed my whole semester. Lots of people shy away from his class because it is tough but his spiritual thoughts and his personality totally make up for that. I would take any class from him again in a heartbeat. Great class.
Brau is great. I hated my class because it was exam-only grading. But Brau is great. Some people don't like his spiritual thoughts, but I really enjoyed them!

Brau's style of teaching is entertaining. You definitely won't fall asleep during his classes and you will gain much more than just financial knowledge. He brings a certain spirit and energy that will keep you going for the whole day. Apart from that... it's a hard course that was focused purely on test scores so you have to know your stuff

This class was really difficult and I didn't always understand what we were learning. However, Brau provides lots of resources and works hard to help the students, not only academically but also spiritually and emotionally. He's definitely an inspiring guy and I would love to become a professor like him one day!

Finance 201 was legit the hardest thing ever. Hated the material. BUT I still looked forward going to class because of brother Brau. He is real, funny, interesting, and always a spiritual uplift. I would never take this from anyone but him. Still awful material because, well, its finance. But taking it from Brau was the best decision I made.

Great teacher teaching a tough class. Knows his stuff and does a great job answering questions. Cares about the students and his spiritual moments each class are perfect, loving and really inspirational. IF YOU ARE READING REVIEWS OF THE WINTER 2017 SEMESTER: he did things a little different for us he wont do 4 u(4 department tests & formula sheet)

Professor Brau really cares about his students. He goes out of his way to give you help and make sure you have resources for all your problems, even if not finance related. His class is tough and you definitely need to practice often but it he is a good teacher

Awesome professor who cares about his students. The class is hard because the whole grade is based off of the test scores.  If you don't show up to class and take good notes, you are not going to do well in this class. I really liked the class overall, and he is really good at what he teaches! You just have to be willing to put in the time!

Brau is the best professor I've ever had. I was in his Finance 201 class where I'm one of 300 students. Highlights: - every 15 min he has comercial breaks that break up the class so you don't fall asleep and one of them is a spiritual thought.  - the class depends on tests only so you don't have to worry about quizes  - Brau should be REQUIRED!
Brau is awesome! So enthusiastic! Very caring of our success. Very difficult but necessary.

NO SUPPORT for students going into healthcare. Very test heavy. Not a great lecturer. Mostly a nice guy. Many students on here mistake his charisma for being a good teacher though. He doesn't convey things very clearly

The class is very structured. The key to the class is being able to do well on the practice exams beforehand and remember what he talks about in class for the test. He is very genuine, always has a great spiritual thought.

Professor Brau is a great teacher who loves the subject and his students. The grades are based entirely off of midterm exams which are difficult. There's a ton of online material to help you study. All lectures and reviews are recorded and posted online. Great sense of humor and adds a spiritual thought to every class. Really enjoyable class!

While you can learn a lot from the book, there are questions on tests that come only from his lectures. You will get class help from the TA's as there's 1000+ students per semester in his classes, but for personal matters Dr. Brau is very approachable.
Very test heavy.

I LOVED this Finance class. You have to work extremely hard to do well on the exams, but it's totally worth it. He is hilarious, passionate and really cares about his students. You don't have to go to class because he records and posts all of his lectures online (super helpful).

Jim Brau is an amazing man! he has inspired thousands. He has been my favorite professor ever. If you want to do well in the class, read the chapter everytime before class and it will all make sense, do the practice quizzes and rewatch lectures or review lecture notes and you'll easily get an A or A-. Brau is the best teacher at byu in my book.

Fantastic class whether you are a going to be a business major or not! Teaches more like a conversation as opposed to a formal math class. He tries to make it even applicable for those that will not take another finance class in their life! One of them most caring professors I have ever had. Makes himself available for any personal issue.

Attendance was never taken, but if you would like to pass the class, you better show up to lectures and take killer notes. There are enough things on the tests that  are not in the textbook that it is well worth the time.

Brother Brau is incredible. Don't take finance from anyone else. His enthusiasm for life and for finance is infectious, and I've never had a professor who is so genuinely concerned with helping his students succeed. He offers to meet with you outside of class to talk about anything you're going through in your life--even if it's at the gym.

Professor Brau is a great teacher and really cares about his students. His class is pretty difficult and your entire grade is based off of the tests. However, if you read, go to class (or watch the lectures on youtube), and then study for two days straight for every midterm you'll do fine.

Finance is not to be taken lightly. Especially if you are trying to apply to the business school, everyone is required to take this class. The grade is only determined by four midterms and a test. Make sure that you do ALL the reading a practice tests on your own and on time. You are held accountable for doing it so it's up to you to stay up on it.

He's honestly great. I would recommend watching the class YouTube's the week of the test and watch his review on YouTube before the tests and you'll get all the qualitative q's. Do the topic quizzes at the end of the chapter (Don't bother with the other ones throughout the chapter) for exam practice. The exams are most like the topic quizzes.

It is a difficult class with a lot of material, but if you stay on top of the material and the reading you should be able to do well. Your grade is only based on tests so if you do not test well it may be a difficult class, but if you test well then this is your class. The spiritual thoughts are definitely the high of the class!

Nice guy. He does a great job of being spiritual and respected students, but he really should consider something other than just tests. Our entire grade was characterized by FOUR midterms and a final. That's it. He's a nice guy teaching a crappy subject. But don't take my word for it, maybe for me finance just isn't life...
He was great!

Bro. Brau definitely knows what he is talking about when it comes to finance. Due to the nature of the course, definitely be prepared to put in the hours in order to learn the concepts. In his syllabus he basically explains up front how to get an A in the class. (definitely have to work for it though) Spiritual thoughts also broke up lessons.
He's great. Good times. Good class. But study and you will be fine.

While attendance isn't part of your grade, I highly suggest you show up!!! He's a great professor, albeit prone to side tangents that are hilarious even if they have nothing to do with Finance.  He shares a daily spiritual thought and offers professional development time in class as well.

Bro. Brau was the best professor I've had at BYU, hands down. Be forewarned, though: finance isn't an easy subject. Brau does great explaining everything and I loved the resources available, but it's hard. The hardest part of the class was honestly myself. I took this my last semester for my minor, and it was super hard for me in that aspect.
He's very enthusiastic and cares a lot about the students, but he does a poor job of explaining tough concepts in a clear manner.

I always walked out of this class feeling inspired. Brother Brau always has a spiritual message and professional development "commercials" that help to break up the fast pace of the class. Reading the book is a must. It goes over everything you need to know super well and makes the class lectures more meaningful.

Brau offers to let you drop a test and he posts his lectures on Youtube for every class. This tricks people into thinking they can skip or not study at all, which is definitely not true. If you read the chapters, go to class, and do the practice tests you'll do really well. If you don't you'll probably struggle.
He is a really great teacher. The class is hard, but as long as you are willing to put in the work it is doable.

I really enjoyed Brau as a teacher. He is a pretty funny dude and his comments always made me laugh.  He does a great job of sharing a spiritual thought every class which is really powerful. You only have 4 tests and a final, no quizzes or assignments. He will drop your lowest mid term which is nice.  Really great class. Not too hard.

Brau is a great teacher, however, his grading scale is purely on tests... so make sure you know your stuff. He is very inspirational and he shares a spiritual moment in class, which are usually very helpful. Overall great teacher, but plan on spending 15 to 20 hours a week to know the material.

Brau keeps the class very straightforward and lets you know exactly what he expects on tests. He is SUPER intense, especially if you see him drinking pre-workout, so class is never dull. The real value in his class is the professional and spiritual development. His class helped me spiritually more than some of my religion classes.

Bro Brau is really inspirational and hilarious, he does go off on a lot of tangents though. He only grades tests and the final, there is no HW but there is online reading. If you know how to do everything in the practice tests and his study guide you'll do fine on the test.
He's test heavy but helps you in the real world situation.

Jim Brau runs FIN 201 well. He is very interested in his students success and gives them the tools to succeed. However, the class is very difficult as the course covers a very large amount of material and Prof. Brau runs through it very quickly. Lots of numbers involved, but if your sufficiently left-brained you should be fine.

I would say Brau is best characterized by his t shirts, gym work outs, and spiritually uplifting lectures. He makes a real effort to inspire the class members to be good people, while teaching  a subject that is quite complex. All his lectures go on YouTube where you can watch them 2x the speed to reduce "class time". Good, quality teacher.

Bro Brau is the man! He is the kind of professor that you would feel comfortable hanging out with, but is inspirational, sincere, and really knows what he is talking about. This class isn't easy... but that's how it has to be I guess! Watch the lectures on YouTube, attend class and read the book!

Bro. Brau brings energy to the class every day to engage students in learning and encourage professional development. While I do feel like this course was challenging, it's definitely possible to do well!

Some of the equations and formulas might be hard to grasp at first, but he does a phenomenal job of walking you through the logical process of how it's derived, so not only can you think of it again, but you know why it matters. Very distinct and clear on definitions, and gives incredibly inspiring life advice and spiritual thoughts.

All test scores make up your final grade that is it! He is a good teacher and puts up lectures on youtube. The material dives deep and fast so hold on and don't fall behind unless you are good at soaking up things last minute. Readings help a ton especially before class.

Brau is an awesome guy! The class is tough just like any other BYU business class and requires a lot of work outside of class. He is inspirational and very professional in his teaching of Finance. The class will be the same no matter where you go but I would highly recommend Brau!

This semester, he tested eliminating all busy work, and the only things affecting our grades were tests.  That meant less work, but you got a lot more stressed in studying.  He's unorthodox, but a good instructor. He teaches a class of hundreds, and has the perfect larger-than-life personality for it.  I would recommend taking his class.
Grades are just 5 tests. Nothing else.
Brau is an AMAZING teacher!  Not just for how he teaches his class, but for how much he really cares about his students.  He wants everyone to do well, not just in his class, but in life.
He's great
He is a good professor, but he is really tough. He makes you work for your grade, but overall he is a good teacher

Professor Brau is an amazing guy and an excellent teacher, he made coming to class worth it. Grading was only determined by four midterm exams and the final, no other assignments factored in to the final grade. Overall an extremely manageable class if you attended the lectures and put in the time.

He is a good professor. His lectures match the required textbook reading almost exactly.  The class was a little boring, but the professor worked hard to keep everyone engaged. He gave great spiritual thoughts.

Going to lectures may not be required for a grade, but definitely attend them! He will go over some things that are not in the reading that are testable. Plus, he gives killer spiritual thoughts and has some great, life-applicable stories.

Brau is different than any professor that I have ever had before. He is genuinely concerned with each student--not just their grades but their overall well being! It really helps to feel like a professor cares!

Brau is entertaining for sure. He tries his best to keep class interesting. The biggest problem I had with him was with clarity of lecture. He talks very fast and expects everyone to understand a certain vocabulary and to understand it the first time he says it.
Dr. Brau is an excellent professor. His tests are difficult but if you study with the practice exams online you'll be just fine.
He's great, make sure to pay attention in class.

Bro Brau is one of the best professors I've had at BYU. So funny, and he is very down to earth. He is very approachable and loved his spiritual thoughts. As long as you know how to do the practice exams on myeducator (the online textbook) you will do fine. Tough class, but if you put in the work it isn't difficult to get a good grade.

Brau has been one of my favorite professors. His way of teaching is old school. He writes on a piece of paper that is projected on the screen. For me the teaching was super clear.
