Bro Brau is very clear and helpful. He wants everyone to get an A in his class. The class is a lot of work but that's just the course in general. If you do the reading before class, take notes in lecture, you will get an A. Also, he records his lectures so you can go back and watch whenever. Very clear and helpful class. Help is available if needed

Professor Brau was fantastic for this class. If I had to take it again, I would definitely take it from him. Highly recommended. He puts all of his lectures on Youtube, so that really helps in reviewing the material. If you only practice the math, you will do poorly in the class. You have to learn to understand the concepts behind the material.
Class was good and funny. Tests use a lot of definitions as well as the math. Spends a lot of class time on things not specific to test material.

I've learned more in this class by doing extra homework problems and getting together with a group than I have through the book and class. The book is somewhat confusing, and class is difficult to focus in sometimes, (I went at 8:00 a.m.) He does a good job of trying to make it interesting though.

I had the the morning class, but he keeps it upbeat. Attendance isn't mandatory, but it's essential if you want a good grade. Keep up with the readings and relatively EZ math to do well. Loved his spiritual thoughts and professional developments. He said the class will get harder due to this semesters high performance, but I'd really recommend him.

Brother Brau is an awesome professor.  His spiritual thought that he does every day is my favorite part of the class. The finance material is difficult, but you take two days in class to cover each chapter. You have to study if you want to do well on his test. Overall, I think he's a good professor to take this class from.
"Steroid Mode"   Great spiritual thought every class period Youtube videos of every class so you don't even have to go to class to see the lecture.
He gets crazy when he lectures. It's a hoot. He really wants you to succeed just work hard and study up for tests. LECTURES ARE PARAMOUNT.

While the material of the class is difficult, he is really helpful in helping students to have ample opportunity to learn all material. All classes are recorded and put on youtube, as well as the test review sessions put on by the TAs. Study the outline he gives you for each test

Brau is great! You can tell that he really cares about his students. I really appreciated that he gave a spiritual thought every day and kept things in the right perspective. He also really wants you to succeed in life, not just in Finance. I didn't think the class was too hard if you study the way he tells you to and read the chapters beforehand.
Good teacher.

The subject material isn't super easy, but I feel like Bro Brau taught the material super well. You need to really study hard for the exams but you can do well. I had never taken a business class and got A's on the two midterms. He puts the lectures on youtube which is nice if you need to miss class or review material for the exams. Take Brau!

This was a good class, it taught you a lot of real life skills. I appreciated that all the lectures went up onto Youtube after the class so you could miss and still keep up with the course work. It also helped a lot when it came to test time, you could go back and watch all the lectures if you needed to.

Professor Brau's "softball" questions often times tripped us up because of how ambiguous the wording in the test questions were. Overall, he loves the class and wants everyone to succeed. Definitely a rascal.

Finance is a demanding class and sometimes doesn't make any sense. But, Brother Brau made the lectures one of my favorite to attend. He is so passionate about what he is teaching and it makes me want to understand it. If you do the reading and practice problems, you will be in good shape. I would take from Bro Brau again in a heartbeat.
Brother Brau is a professor that cares about its students. If you need any kind of help, just talk to him.
Professor Brau is amazing! He is real with the students, he does not try to trick people, he wants everyone to do well in his class and in life. He is Great!
He is a great teacher, but unless you already have background in Finance or Accounting.... I recommend that you do not take this class.
Loved Brau's class! I would take him again in a heartbeat!
Great teacher and a great class but not easy

Awesome teacher! He was very straightforward about what was expected of the students and as long as you study and do what you're supposed to, you'll do fine. Listen to his lectures/watch on youtube! That's where all of his test questions come from! He's very funny and I appreciated that he broke up the long class periods with spiritual thoughts.

Overall, it was a decent class. His demeanor screams "finance bro", and he seems a bit full of himself (a lot of his side tangents involve "So I was doing my cardio yesterday, when this student came up to me and said, 'Brau, you were totally right about EVERYTHING!'") But he teaches finance incredibly well, and seems like a good person.
He was an awesome teacher. Spiritual thoughts and lots of inspirational methods. Learned a lot in the class. He posts all of his classes on Youtube so if you miss class it's easy to catch up.

Brau is amazing! He is very clear about what to except on the tests and he's such a spaz so lectures are hilarious, sometimes there's too many stories but overall he's a great teacher. If you have the option definitely take the class from him!

His lectures are incredibly entertaining. He throws in tons of random tidbits  every once in while on random things to keep the class awake and engaged and it works. You have everything you need to succeed but this class requires a good amount of review and test prep. I found it harder to grasp financial concepts as opposed to accounting concepts.

He is hilarious, fun to listen to, really clear on what you need to know for assignments and tests, gives more than most teachers to doing a good job and improving. His tests are pretty clear at times, but they also are unneededly deceptive a lot of the time. Its a weed-out class with 2,000 students in it at a time.

My favorite thing about the class from a grades standpoint, is that it is very clear what you need to do.  The only thing that really matters are the tests. If you know the material, you will do fine on the tests. If you only kind of know it, it will be a struggle. This is my favorite way to be graded, so take that as you will. Brau is a nice guy.

Brother Brau is an awesome finance professor.  He legitimately cares for each one of his hundreds of students and goes out of his way in order to best meet their academic and professional needs.  He is very clear in his teaching and provides all the resources necessary to acquire a strong foundational knowledge of finance.

Professor Brau is great. His class is structured really well, and you always know what is going on. He takes more time on difficult topics and does a really good job explaining things. His classes are over an hour, but he will provide little breaks where he talks about something else (though still relevant). He genuinely cares for his students.
Great teacher. Makes a difficult concept easier to learn. Requires attendance and studying. Genuine teacher that cares about his students.
Great teacher, fun to be in his class. One of the few teachers that actually trys to give a spiritual thought regularly. Expect to put some work into the class though.
Brau is amazing. It takes work and studying that you may not expect. Study hard and you will be fine. He is a great teacher and the subject itself is just difficult sometimes.

Professor Brau makes going to class enjoyable.  There is never a dull day where he doesn't strive to engage you as the student.  If you come to class prepared then you have a good chance to get an A.  He also provides classes on Youtube which make it easy if you miss a day.
Entertaining teacher, with a willingness to work one on one with students to help them succeed in life and in this class.

Brau is a good teacher, but the business school requires him to have a 3.0 curve, so class is hard. Brau is funny and passionate so lectures are enjoyable. He also uploads his lectures on YouTube, which is helpful. Study CONSTANTLY to do well. Take only if you have to. Spiritual thoughts are awesome. My first grade lower than an A- in 3 years.
I loved him because it was clear to see he cared more about the student than he did the material. He also did a great job teaching a large class.
Didn't explain things well.

His class is challenging but very useful. He mixes up class with spiritual thoughts, career moments, and just some fun from time to time, so sitting through the lecture is plenty entertaining. He's extremely approachable and gives killer spiritual thoughts. He uploads his classes to youtube, which makes great material to review for exams.

Brother Brau is one of my all time favorite teachers! I learned so much from him about Finance and life. He gives great spiritual  thoughts and really motivates his students to do their best. I would definitely take Finance  from him!
This class was great. I would really suggest taking FIN 201 from Brau. He is super helpful and really just there for you to help you succeed.

Brother Brau is chillest professor I've ever had. If you have to take this class, take it from Brau. You don't have to spend a lot of time on home work if you want an average grade. However, if you want to do well, you need to put in extra time studying outside of regular home work assignments.

Brau is hilarious. His head is super shiny which can be somewhat distracting in lectures but definitely a lovable dude.  Rumor has it he takes pre workout before classes and while that cannot be confirmed, take this class and I am pretty sure you will believe that as well. Study hard, get ready to be inspired, and sit next to someone you like.

Brau is the man! I eagerly looked forward to class because he makes the material so interesting. He always has a spiritual thought that motivates you to be the best version of yourself possible. If you put in the work, the class isn't all that difficult either. TAKE FIN 201 FROM BRAU!!! You'll definitely enjoy it.

Good class! Bro. Brau is very enthusiastic about the topic and does his best to help you. Take detailed notes in lecture. I would recommend attending the class and watching the YouTube videos to help solidify concepts. Also, I recommend creating study groups to study for the tests. Take advantage of the practice problems to study.
Tough class, but Brau's a good guy. He went on some very spiritual tangents, which is what I love about BYU.
Dr. Brau uses a lecture style that is fairly unique. He always covers all of the relevant material and takes time to explain concepts thoroughly. Sometimes he fills time with random tangents.

Bro. Brau is a really good professor.  He provides all his students with the tools necessary to succeed and cares about his students.  He is very clear about what he expects from everyone and what is on the tests.  If you go to class or watch the youtube videos and actually pay attention, then you will do well in this class.

It is clear that Prof. Brau cares about his students and wants them to succeed. I really enjoyed his class and learned a lot. The material is tough and required me to do a lot of practice on my own, but I would recommend taking this class from Brau.
A great teacher. Class requires alot of time

Brother Brau was a clear teacher. He was very fair and put all his lectures on youtube, which was good for me since I can't always attend class. I loved his spiritual moments in class. I really felt like he was there for me if I ever needed to talk to someone. There is no textbook but you need the MyEducator online book.

I loved that he started the first class telling what changes he had made because of these reviews. He really cares about the students, and wants you to succeed. You HAVE to keep up in my educator, lectures are put on YouTube but still go to class and use those as review. Follow his directions word for word for studying for his tests. Overall good.
This is an awesome but really hard class! I really learned things for life.

He's really funny and charismatic. He makes a pretty boring and monotonous subject reasonably entertaining. The class isn't the easiest but he posts videos of the lectures online so you can review it or even skip class.

Not my favorite class.  The lectures are full of a lot of extra information and not much practice of the actual material.  Lecture style is a little intense and the tests are difficult to prepare for.  Not much wiggle room with grades.

Brother Brau is hilarious. His class is always fun to go to. He expects you to learn a lot from the book which is not the easiest for everyone. He is fairly clear on what kinds of things he wants you to know for the tests. The spiritual thoughts are amazing.

Professor Brau is awesome and he really wants you to succeed. He provides you with a lot of resources to do well in the class, but it will be up to you to use them or not.  I loved how he gave spiritual thoughts every single class period. Overall, Professor Brau is awesome and he makes himself available for his students.
Definitely a good class with lots of material to cover, my suggestion is to study hard for the test and find others to study throughout the semester with.

Although i would have to say that the class was tough for me personally, Brother Brau did everything he could to provide the class with the information we needed to do well on tests. The lectures are long, but he does a great job at breaking up the class to maintain focus. All in all he is hilarious and definitely a great professor! i recommend him

If you don't go to class, you must watch his recorded youtube videos. If you dont watch the videos, you wont do well on the test. If you dont do well on the tests, you'll fail. Get ready to work for it

Brau is the way to go. Stop deliberating and just sign up.  That being said... the class is challenging; However, it will be challenging no matter who you take it from. It is one of those classes that make feel accomplished.

He's a great, real-with-you professor who cares about his students. He takes a minute every class for a professional development moment and spiritual thought, which captures the BYU experience. The coursework isn't crazy hard, but takes some effort throughout the semester. Just stay on top of everything and you'll be fine.

Bro. Brau is phenomenal (as he would say). He really is a good teacher. He knows his finance stuff well, and he's just a really good guy. Funny, entertaining, clear, redundant (which sometimes helps as a teacher), he's a good teacher. Take Finance 201 from him!

His lectures are very energetic and entertaining, he's very knowledgeable with the material, records the lectures so you can review them on Youtube. Because of that when a topic comes up that he's already taught, he brushes over it, expecting you to know it. Quizzes every chapter. Good teacher, have to put in the time to understand the material.
Good teacher, good class. Always able to keep you listening with all the crazy things he says.

Professor Brau is a great guy and a great teacher. He is always looking for suggestions on how to better teach the material and make sure that his students are learning and understanding what they need to in order to succeed in his class as well as out in the world. He's willing to help you with nearly anything, from course work to personal problem

Not super easy, but if you're willing to put in the work, you will come out with a really great understanding of the subject and a good grade! He wants everyone to get the 'intuition' rather than just memorize everything. He is clear, energetic, and very helpful.
Brau is not easy, but he is fair and clear on his expectations. His classes are HILARIOUS! Truly enjoyed them.

Dr. Brau does a great job with this introductory Finance course.  I took his class at 8am and he always was energetic and happy to be there, and he wants to help you learn more than just the formulas, but the intuition of finance.  Pay attention in class, do the assigned readings, and you'll get a good grade.

Brother Brau is a great professor. He is clear when it comes to writing notes on a projector of material that will be on a test,  but I think one of his weaknesses is helping students understand the why behind the equations. A suggestion would be teaching the why before writing the equation. All the components of the equation can be overwhelming.

Brau is a homie. Best professor I have had at BYU. Never felt like I was doing useless work and he gave great lectures that were entertaining and helpful. The class is graded very fairly. He tells you what you need to do. No surprises. If you do what he says you will get an A. Class is on youtube if you miss it.

I really enjoyed Bro. Brau's finance class. His lectures are very entertaining, but also packed with useful criteria. He does not teach you things that you won't need in class. You will be well prepared for his tests if you study what he tells you to. He REALLY cares about the students as is passionate about finance. Take it from Brau!

Brother Brau is tight. He is super clear and to the point. He tells you exactly what you need to know and does an excellent job explaining things. If you do what he tells you to, you will succeed in the class. He is one of the most inspirational teachers around. He cares about you.  You walk out of each class feeling strengthened.
Dr. Brau is a great teacher. He is very thorough and clear and everything he does helps you build throughout the semester. Tests are very doable if you keep up with the reading and focus in class.

Brau is a good guy who genuinely cares about his students. This class is helpful in terms of real-world knowledge, and also in terms of getting you into your respective program. Tough class, but probably worth it.
This was a hard class, but mostly because I didn't read the textbook or pay attention in class. It takes studying but you can do it.
Watch the videos and do the reading.
He does a good job of going into depth about each topic and has great knowledge.  Comes off as a little arrogant at times, but is a nice man.

He records every lecture and puts it on YOUTUBE. DONT PASS THIS UP!!! He will tell you everything that needs to be on the test. Just pay attention, whether you go to class or not I would suggest watching the videos. The work load is ok, pretty chill class if you keep up with it:)

I am an accounting major and so I didn't think that I was going to like finance. Professor Brau's teaching style is clear and understandable. You spend two days on each topic which really helped in learning how to do problems as well as the intuition behind them. His tests are straightforward and he gives  hints about the tests in lecture. Amazing!

Dr Brau is one of my favorite professors. I didn't do as well as I had wished because I was not prepared for the start of the semester.   He not only helps you in the classroom but is willing to mentor you. He often tells stories about how he helped someone outside of class with career or life decisions. What a great man! Loved his class!

For me personally, this class was an easy A, but if you are not the studying type then it might not be. Does it take work in this class if you want to do well on the test? Yes, but he gives you all  of the resources you need (practice problems, TA Help desk, etc).

He is a great professor who wants his students to succeed. Finance itself is a hard subject for me, so I struggled a lot, but the youtube class videos helped me a lot to go over the lectures that I didn't catch very well.
Jim Brau works hard to create the best class for the students. He changes things every semester to make the class better. I highly recommend him.

Jim is an extremely passionate guy.  He gets fired up and gets you pumped, too.  It was difficult for me to focus in his lectures, though, due to how often he interrupts his lecture time to talk about something  irrelevant.  I never really did learn much from the lectures, so reading the text and going to the TA help desk was key for me.

Brau loves his students, loves his job, wants everybody in the class to succeed. Does a good job despite having about 1200 students. Extremely approachable in all things course related or for spiritual or career counseling. Loves to lift weights, does body shows. Records his lectures and posts them on YouTube.

Brother Brau is a great teacher. The best part of his finance classes are his spiritual messages. You will seriously love them and they will change your life. He is very passionate about what he teaches, but he doesn't teach it too clearly. He teaches it as if you already know exactly what he is talking about.

This is a class that will take more work then is graded. Brau is a good teacher who tries to make sure all of his students have plenty of opportunities to learn the material, but makes it clear that it will take more effort besides just attending class. He also includes great inspirational moments throughout class that break up the lecture.

He really cares about your success, &does everything he can to help you not only in his class, but in preparing for your future. He's a great example of living a well rounded life & throughout the class encourages you to be career focused, family oriented, spiritually edified, and of course physically active. The course is doable if taken seriously

Love the class - he always kept us engaged by sharing stories and cracking jokes. He does a good job of explaining the concepts and posts tons of helpful material on the class website. Very accessible - the one time I emailed him about something he responded promptly, despite having hundreds of students. I would totally take another class form him.

Bro Brau knows that it's essential that students have a good understanding of finance to be prepared for the various business program and has tried his best to be clear and concise.  There is A LOT of new vocab that can be confusing.  You will have to work for an A.  There are a lot of resources available to students for extra help.

Brau really cares about his students. And he does his best to keep your attention and bring the gospel into the class. His tests are a little tricky, but if you study the material given and go in knowing there will be some extra unneeded information given, you'll be okay.
Great guy and manages to make Finance a spiritual topic.  High energy.  Truly wants feedback and seeks to improve as a teacher.
Brau does a very good job of teaching as clearly as possible and keeps it nice and simple. There are a lot of different formulas you need to know and understand in order to pass the class.
I honestly loved this class. Brother Brau goes out of his way to make sure he is clear and straight forward. I I really loved taking Finance from him

There shouldn't be any worries about taking Finance from him. He's entertaining, he gives a lot of advice, and he literally tells you everything that are on the tests. Tests are so easy, seriously just copy his notes and you have every answer. You can take the quizzes an unlimited number of times until you get 100%.

It is obvious that Brau wants to help his students and tries hard to keep them awake during class. However, his tests are challenging and there are not very many other points to balance out those scores. Also, in attempt to keep everyone wake he takes a lot of time telling stories instead of working problems that would be helpful for the test.

I took Brau's class winter semester of the 2015-16 school year. From what he's said in class, there are a few, but significant, changes this semester from previous ones. Mainly, the Youtube recordings. Every class is videotaped and posted to youtube within two days. This makes attendance optional, which is super helpful.
Talks himself up a lot, but when it comes to prepping you for the test, he does an incredible job. You have all materials necessary to succeed in his class.
hard tests, but if you study and follow his criteria, you will succeed.

Great teacher and super inspirational! Very clear in his teaching and slows down if you ask him to explain something again. Great class and would take it again. The readings and reviews are key. TA's are a great help

The class is difficult but Brau is the man. If you're going to take Finance take it from him. Pay attention in lectures (he'll straight up tell you answers on the test) and read the chapters and you'll do well.
Brau goes out of his way to put students first. He gives a spiritual thought in every class and is amazing at lecturing! I enjoyed the class!

Spiritual thoughts every class  super inspirational. REALLY wants to help students. Literally does everything in his power for their success. Only problem I had with the class was he would get distracted, and then move really fast through the material we need to know, then get distracted again. Wish he would go slower over all stuff we really need

Brau is a good, fun teacher. He explains the finance concepts well and tells us what to study for the tests. He is straightforward and doesn't try to trick you on the tests. His spiritual thoughts can be long-winded, but it makes the class go by faster.

Brau is very invested in his students and always willing to meet one-on-one and answer any additional questions. He explains concepts really well and is very direct on what he wants you to get out of the class. The tests are tough and make sure you understand the math AND concepts. Doing the math is only half of what is required.

Brau is a boss. I found his class pretty easy because I like all the business stuff. You have to go to class or watch all the lectures online if you want to do well on the tests, which are pretty much your whole grade.

Brau was hands down the best Professor I had this semester. He is extremely helpful and does everything he can to make sure you get a good grade. This is one of those classes that if you fail, it is 100% your fault. Do the work, study for tests, and you will get an A in this class.

Bro. Brau is hilarious. He has to be one of the most entertaining teachers I have had at BYU. With the addition of Youtube-ing the lectures and taking two class periods to go over each chapter, I found the material to be quite clear. The tests were hard, but if you studied and reviewed the youtube it was fine.

Brother Brau is an excellent professor.  The class requires a lot of time, and it is definitely not easy, but Bro. Brau really wants the students to learn and he does the best he can to help all of the 1500 students in the course.  I found the TA's to be helpful also.  Brau's goal is to help students learn the skills they need to be successful.

I am a business minor and out of every class I had to take for my minor this was my favorite. I absolutely loved Professor Brau. He maybe one of my favorite professors at BYU. Makes things very clear and class is fun!

Brother Brau was definitely my favorite professor that I had this semester! He has his lectures video-taped and put on YouTube which was SUPER helpful! Also he gives reviews before each test, and he lets you take the online quizzes as many times as it takes to get a 100. I definitely recommend taking this class from him
He is a great lecturer.  His active and energetic persona makes it much easier to pay attention during class. He wants everyone to succeed.

Awesome guy. You won't ever sleep in class, even at 8 am. He knows his stuff and is really clear about what you need to do and learn. He is not only teaching the material, he is building his students.

Even though Bro. Brau's style and personality isn't one that I really relate to, he is very clear about how to succeed in his class. The one major thing that really helped with this course was that he records his lectures and puts them up on YouTube. If you miss class or need a review for the test (which you will) you can go back to the videos.

Lectures are a bit long and seem terribly inefficient. He talks a lot about his family, his past, and his opinions. The actual fiance parts of the test are not too bad and easy to prepare for, the problem come when there are test questions about one thing he mentioned on time in class. Uses a lot of finance jargon in lectures and in his book.

Bro. Brau has the best spiritual thoughts ever. They could be combined into a book and taught as a religion class called "Real-world Religion."They're brilliant! But the finance material can be difficult to understand and a bit dull if it's not your major. Lots of formulas and maths. Bro. Brau does all he can to help, but it's a challenging class.

Professor Brau was a fantastic teacher, who mixed humor and inspiration with the financial content. Make sure to go to class (or watch the YouTubes) and do all the practice problems before the tests. Very helpful, I would take it again!
One of the hardest classes I have ever taken in my life.

Dr. Brau is one of the best professors that I have ever had. Each student knows that he is really there for them and willing to help in any way that he can. He is very clear in his expectations and then helps his students achieve them. His teaching is very clear and understandable. He takes two days in class to cover material difficult material.

This class was awesome and I learned so much! It is extremely hard but it is worth the battle. Super nice guy who wants everyone to succeed and he goes extremely out of the way. Ask him to walk one mile, he will go 100. Super funny. Gives great lectures and puts them on Youtube. Really hard, but worth it.
Great class. If you study the material you'll do fine. Pricey online book is essential. If you have trouble with ANYTHING ask the TAs.
Fantastic teacher. Very energetic and excited to teach.

Bro. Brau is a mix between John Cena, a finance professor, and a general authority. He has so much energy and really wants to help students succeed. Lectures are fun and he adds great spiritual thoughts and funny personal stories. Tests can be tough but during class he literally says "this will be on the test" 100 times. Super hot.  EXACTLY.
Great teacher. Very fired up and expects the same from his students.

Fantastic Professor.  Totally invested in his students.   You can tell how much he cares about your education.  Youtubes every class and puts them up for you to watch in case you didnt show up.  If you write down and understand what he writes in class you will get an A.  Finance isnt super easy though.

Brau is probably one of the best professors out there. He genuinely cares about the students, and is passionate about finance. He is very clear with what we need to know for tests. He gave a spiritual thought every class, which I always looked forward to. I had a hard time with the class, but it's doable. Finance just isn't my thing.
Literally went to class because of Brother Brau! Such a great teacher and hilarious! If you pay attention and do the work, the A is easy:)
Easy-- do the work get an A! 'nough said. Not hard. Accounting 200 was harder, IS 201 was harder, Eco was harder.

Brau is a great guy. His lectures tended to wander from the subject frequently. He was a good teacher overall, but I would most definitely watch the YouTube lectures if you want it all to really make sense.

Brother Brau loves Finance, but loves students more.  He's open to talk to anyone about anything from spiritual concerns to career and life decisions.  He's hilarious and passionate.  Warning, Winter 2016 the average was above what is required for the Business school, around a 3.4 when it's supposed to curve to a 3.0. So future exams will be harder
Brother Brau is an amazing teacher and makes a somewhat boring topic in my opinion much more interesting and manageable.
Professor Brau can be a little hard to follow during lecture, but if you read the material beforehand, it's fairly easy to grasp. He's also great at answering any questions students may have.

Expect a lot of tangents during class whether they are spiritual moments, career development, or something else.  Does really well at finding ways to show how finance looks in real time.  Reading before and after class helped solidify things more than lecture.
I love this professor. He genuinely cares for his students and their success.

I loved that he filmed all the classes and posted them on Youtube. Sometimes I just can't make it to my 8 AM class so being able to watch the class later was a life saver for me. He makes everything clear and does not teach anything unnecessary. He is a good teacher to take finance from.

He knows his stuff; however, he flies over concepts and expects you to know them or work over time to figure it out.  For some this method works but not for all!  The biggest improvement to this class would be lots of sample questions to help you understand concepts better and figure out what the questions are really asking.
Dude, Brother Brau is not just a Finance teacher but a great role model and mentor. Very hard class but if you want to learn finance... I would not even think of taking it from someone else!

It's a great class, but really hard. Brau does a great job keeping things as simple as possible, and he certain teaches as clear as possible. While you can technically skip class, if you don't watch the class lectures eventually you'll have a hard time learning the material. He's great with homework to boost your grade, but tests are super hard.
Solid class, do the assignments and go to lectures whenever you can and you'll be fine. Lectures are on youtube if you miss the class period.

Want funny? Brau. Want cut-the-crap, to-the-point? Brau. Want spirituality? Brau. Want your questions answered? Brau. Want crystal-clear expectations? Brau. Want a challenge? Brau. Want to LEARN finance? Brau.  Fin201 will challenge some non-mathy people, regardless of professor. If you have any background in math/finance, you'll rock this.

Bro Brau is a great man. He genuinely cares that his students do well in class, and in life in general. He is doing everything he can to ensure that each student has a chance to do their best. Lectures are recorded and put onto Youtube. He breaks class up very nicely so that it's not too much for too long. His spiritual thoughts are inspirational.

Professor Brau is a great professor. I really enjoyed his teaching method and the structure of his lectures. He teaches what will help us as we progress in the Business School. Some of the topics will require extra reading and studying, but it is manageable and the TA lab helps a ton. A great class and a caring professor.

His class is tough, but totally worth it. You will get out of it what you put in. The tests are ruff, but if you study you can do it. There are so many ways to get help. The help desk and TA's are essential in this class. If you don't get it, go get help. They're there to help you. Also super helpful if miss class he puts them on Youtube.

Brother Brau is a fun guy. He is always super motivated for class even at 8 in the morning. He is very clear on a lot of things that will be on the test. He also puts all his lectures up on youtube which is really nice if you remember to use it. Reading the text before you come to class is extremely helpful in making sure you are prepared.
Brother Brau is a great guy.  He engages the class, is witty, and has a pretty solid class note scheme.  His handwriting is not the best, but he puts his lectures on youtube and that helped me a ton!

Brau is a really chill professor. He is very open to meet with you and help out. He posts videos of his lectures so you can re-watch anything that wasn't clear to you the first time around. The tests are challenging if you don't study but he makes them super fair and gives a great in class review. He is a really good guy and obviously cares.

Bro. Brau is an amazing guy - very motivational and focused on the Doctrine - sharing wonderful spiritual thoughts every day. He really cares about the students in every way. But honestly he explains the material in a really confusing way during class. The book is clear though, and assignments and grading is very clear, not very hard if you study.

I loved Brother Brau. He's very clear in his teaching, easy to understand. He just reorganized the course so you spend more time on the topics needing to be taught. He teaches so you remember what you've learned beyond the class. I think that's awesome :)

Brother Brau is a great teacher.  He tells you exactly what to study and how to study for tests. He also posts his lectures on youtube, so if you miss class you can still watch it and get all the same material is if you had gone!

WATCH THE YOUTUBE VIDEOS. Go to class, yes, but if you watch the videos two or three times after and do the practice problems from class and from the TAs you will do just fine. He teaches to the test. Easier than Econ with Kearl but I would say harder than Acc with Larson. I would take this after you take Acc and Econ if you can.

Very clear. Go to class, or don't and watch the youtube videos.  Has a lot of pride in his subject of finance, as well as body building (although he could use a couple more days of cardio each week).  Likes to act cool and talk about dating and ncmos and hitting the gym and using social media and money. 45 year old provo all star? maybe.
Favorite class this semester. Was a good teacher and kept class interesting. YouTube video classes were great for review.

Brother Brau is a great teacher who enjoys not only teaching finance, but also preparing students for their careers. There is some reading that needs to be done before class. Tests are pretty straight-forward. Attendance isn't mandatory, but class is usually enjoyable and the videos can be hard to see sometimes.
He is great.

Professor Brau is hands down one of my favorite professors.  He is hilarious and makes class so entertaining.  He makes it crystal clear what is going to be on the test, and explains things very well.  The TAs are super helpful as well.  I absolutely love going to Brau's class, and I usually hate lectures, but his are inspiring and awesome.

Professor Brau is an awesome teacher. Finance is not the easiest subject, but he explains it very well and makes class fun and spiritual. His spiritual thoughts brought the spirit into class and gave us as students a break from the grind. I am very grateful for Professor Brau's help this year and am excited to major in finance.
He's one of the best business professors that I've had. Extremely helpful and answers all and any questions.
Dr. Brau makes it possible (not easy!) for anyone to survive this class. STUDY HARD and meet with tutors frequently.

Professor Brau is awesome.  He is all about helping his students succeed.  The material can be hard but if you put in the work and take the advice that Brau gives to study you will do well.  Sometimes the lectures get a little long, but Brau breaks them up with a spiritual thought and a professional development moment.
Great lectures, but gets off topic

Life changing experience. More than great as a teacher. More than great as a mentor. Respectful. He knows finance in depth, will answer any questions and solve any of them too. Explains with clarity, attending class is essential. The excel assignments are useful. These kind of people make America great.

I wish I had Jim Brau as a professor for all of my classes. He keeps us all energized and provides every opportunity we need to succeed. Most of the grade is based on three big tests and it is all memorization of finance. It is a great class, but I don't recommend taking it in your first semester of college as I did.
Brau is amazing! He will make you work for it, but when you put in the effort, you will get a great understanding of Finance!
Professor Brau is awesome. His class is very doable and his expectations are very clear. He makes his lectures available on youtube and his TAs are very helpful.

Brother Brau is a wonderful teacher.  He is passionate about what he teaches, knows his stuff and loves his students.  He is such a good guy.    I would recommend taking Fin201 from Bro Brau.  You will be uplifted spiritually and understand finance well.  He teaches a tough subject really well.  You won't regret taking this class from Bro Brau!

I would 100% recommend this professor. Even though I didn't get an awesome grade, he was amazing and always did his best to help the students. He really took the mission of BYU seriously and did his best to make sure there was something for everyone. Minimal tests and homework assignments, a fair bit of reading.

I like how straight forward he was with the content of the class. Very open and willing to help in all aspects of student life. Hardcore bodybuilder that needs to hit the gym more. He'd be great if he wasn't a finance professor. Loved the class though.
Overall, good professor. He tapes the lectures and puts them on Youtube, which is a lifesaver if you don't like going to class. It takes some time, but if you put in the work, you should be fine.

Brau is the man. He teaches all levels of Finance and so knows his stuff tremendously well. He is very good about telling you what to expect to see on the tests and does not believe in surprises. He does a very good job at going slow but usually steady pace in order to help the stragglers. I have nothing negative to say about him in any regard.

Bro. Brau the man. His enthusiasm is contagious and his love for the students is almost unparalleled. The material can be challenging but you are given all of the resources you need to be successful. I HIGHLY recommend taking Fin201 from this champion among men.

Jim Brau is the man. He absolutely cares about you. Also, he records his lectures on YouTube for us to watch later. I feel bad because I never went to class in the second half of the semester, instead watching the lectures on YouTube... But it's worth it to be there in person! He puts a lot into his lectures.
Very good lectures. The professor kept me interested in the topic and he honestly cares about the students and if they are understanding what is being taught.

Brother Brau is a great teacher, and he really does try and help you do your best in his class. He makes things very clear at the beginning of the semester on how he grades and how he makes his tests. You need to attend class, because he lets you know that certain things will be on the test! Read the online textbook, because questions come from it.

If you dont put in the effort, good luck. There is almost no homework so its easy to just shrug off material and then its too late by the time you take the exam. If you are proactive you will do fine. Lectures are uploaded to Youtube as well.
Brau was great, but he was really hard. He is super intense but hilarious. The class is pretty content heavy and expect to work really hard
He is an amazing professor but it is easy to get lost during the lectures. Fortunately he posts them on youtube. A difficult class but he is very straightforward about what will be on the test.

Beau is great. He's hilarious and  he brings an unreal amount of energy to Finance.  He is seriously always pumped up.  He's a great teacher, always looking to improve, and I love his career development/spiritual moments.  They really help break up the class and I often walk out of Finance motivated.  If you take Finance, take it from Brau.

Brau is a stud! If you have to take an early morning class, this is the one to take. The guy brings so much energy and will do everything possible to keep you awake and entertained. Gives spiritual thoughts and career development thoughts to take a mini break from finance which are always awesome. Highly recommend his class!!
Great spiritual thoughts; he tries to innovate (for lack of a better word) his classes so that he learns from feedback and he does a great job. Overall a great professor.
Really great professor. Brau lets you know what you need to do well in the class and helps you get there. The class is a lot of work, but Brau helps you get there.
Bro Brau is awesome! His class is really easy if you show up he teachers everything supper clear. Only wish we could actually see which problems we missed on the exams.
This semester was really not that hard. For me I thought the pacing of the class was a little slow with him spending two days on every lesson. He is a great guy and a professional in his field.

I am not a math person and hated accounting but loved Brau's class. He cares about his students and wants us to succeed in the real world. He put the lectures on youtube and it has been super helpful in studying for tests. He does  get distracted sometimes and spends too much time on professional/spiritual development instead of practice problems.

Prof. Brau made me way more interested in Finance than I ever thought I would be. His lectures were never boring because he's so funny and does a good job at moving through the material with breaks in between, i.e. spiritual thought and professional development. Tests are hard but doable if you take really good notes.

His class is tough, but he splits it up well with spiritual thoughts, professional development moments, and telling funny stories. I really recommend him as a teacher. He's always trying to change and improve and help his students out.

Prof. Brau is a great example of how teaching should be approached at BYU.  He may require a lot, but he gives the materials to achieve his expectations.  He videos all his lectures and puts them on youtube.  He is clear in presenting information and sharing spiritual thoughts throughout.  Would highly recommend to almost anyone.
He's a great teacher and he tells you what is on the test. His class is adjusted to learn with his tangents to help us stay focused... Great teacher and looks for ways to help the students excel.

Professor Brau is a very knowledgable teacher and especially cares for the welfare of his students. His class is meant to weed out a lot of students, but it's actually a very good and fascinating class. Tests are hard, and you will study a lot, but he films his classes (which is a huge help to go back to) and has TA hours open to help.

Professor Brau teaches very clearly and gives you all the information you need for the tests in class. He wants you to succeed. He does spend quite a bit of lecture off topic, but when he is focused, he really explains the subject well. The tests can be hard, but if you study you should do fine. He does not do trick questions, which is refreshing.

Brother Brau is very clear. If you  go to class (or watch the lectures on YouTube) he tells you what will be on the test. You can take the quizzes as many times as you want before the due date for full credit.
Solid class, however sometime not very specific and with a lot of information can get confusing. If you study you can get an A.

Professor Brau really cares about his students and does all he can to help them learn. He posted all sorts of helpful resources on LearningSuite. He is very clear about what he expects from students, grading, and exam material.
Brau is the man. He was straight forward and pretty transparent about what was going to be on the test. I enjoyed his spiritual thoughts although was often tired after class - the man is an animal!
The best professor I have ever had, but his tests are really hard and the material on the tests is much different/harder than what we go over in class and in the homework.

Professor Brau is an awesome guy. I didn't feel like his lectures were always the greatest. About 20 minutes of each class is spent talking about things that have nothing to do with finance. It's a nice break from the material, but also sometimes a waste of time. He's hilarious and very passionate about finance.
The class definitely kicked my butt, however Professor Brau was willing to help. Beware though, if you get lost it's hard to keep up!

I loved Professor Brau! He really loves what he does and it shows when he teaches. He records all the lectures and posts them on youtube so its sometimes okay to miss class and watch the youtube video later. It's important to at least watch the class lectures because a lot of test questions come from what he directly tells us in class.
It is a hard class because of the content but I would recommend Brau 100%. Very entertaining and good at explaining all the material that was over my head. This class is what you make it.
Jim Brau is an awesome professor. I highly recommend him for finance
Terribly structured class. Avoid if you can but you probably can't so good luck. Lectures are posted on youtube so I would just watch them online and not go. Study a ton for the tests!

Professor Brau is a fantastic professor. I love how is always looking to improve and loves feedback. He is definitely interested in teaching so that everyone understands. He is very clear. High energy level and so its hard to fall asleep in his class. Great Guy!

I liked Professor Brau. He has lots of energy and he knows his stuff. He also includes a spiritual or academic thought every day, which I typically enjoyed and found helpful for my personal and academic life. Lectures are posted on youtube, which was super helpful for reviewing. If you choose not to go to class be sure to watch it on youtube!

Professor Brau is a great professor who cares about his students. He does his best to make sure that students have ample time to study the material. Videos are recorded on YouTube and the lectures are very straight-forward. If you form a study group and make a study schedule, you'll be fine.  SUPER HOT.

Professor Brau was an alright teacher. The reading helped me more than he did in class. The good thing about this class is that there are TA hours everyday and not many go so if you need extra help, the TAs are there. I wouldn't take this class if you didn't have to though.

Professor Brau is a motivational teacher. He wants his students to succeed and provides many tools and resources to allow them to do that. He gives great spiritual and professional development thoughts in class that are very inspired. The use of YouTube is great, and if you do the reading and practice problems, you'll do well.
Brau really wants to help you and provides every opportunity for you to do well in the class. Its really not a difficult class if you study and pay attention to detail on the tests.

Brau is a great teacher who's always looking to be the best! He has adapted his course to go through the material more slowly and clearly. He even records the videos so you can view them on youtube for review or if you miss a class. Really cares about his students, is straight forward, and seeks to fulfill BYU's mission.
Dr. Brau is awesome, and very inspiring.  His class was not easy, but he is willing to do whatever it takes to help his students succeed.  I would take another class from him without question.

This class was awesome!! Seriously, I went in to finance expecting the worst, but Brother Brau is straight up about what you need to know.  Also, his spiritual thoughts in the middle of class lectures are much needed and much appreciated.  I would recommend this class to anyone!

Really fun professor that knows his stuff. He youtubes everything in class and puts it online to watch so attendance isn't necessary. Tests come from directly what he says in class. All quizzes can be taken multiple times until you get 100%. Tests are somewhat difficult, review the textbook before and go over the lectures again and you'll be fine.

Professor Brau is all about preparing students for success in finance and in life as a whole. Every class along with the normal lecture material he shares spiritual thoughts and professional development information. The material can be somewhat hard to understand. Extra effort outside of class is necessary for success.

Professor Brau is a great teacher. He records his lectures and puts them on youtube which is really useful for studying for tests. He spends a lot of time going over the material and is very specific about what is going to be on the tests.
Brau does a great job with finance. Combining a spiritual atmosphere with fun, engaging learning. He preps you really well for the test and all the materials are well prepared and integrated.
He was cool. Tests can be hard. lots of cramming
I enjoyed that he puts all of his classes on Youtube. It makes the class very flexible.

Bro. Brau's finance class is the best organized class I've ever been in.  Bro. Brau powers through finance, takes a break for some inspirational spiritual message, goes back into finance, breaks again to give professional development advice, then ends with finance.  He keeps you engaged helps you see how everything is relevant.  Highly recommend!

A true legend at BYU, he is inspirational, intelligent, compelling, emotional, passionate, everything you would hope for in a professor. The class is difficult, but the diligent student will find all the resources he would ever need to succeed. Love Brau and love this class!

Bro Brau is an amazing professor! Honestly, I don't think I've had a professor so willing to make their class better like Brau has. He cares a lot more about his students learning finance than just giving out meaningless grades. If you do the same as a student, this class will be awesome. Tests require time and effort, but they should. Work hard!

I have the utmost respect for Brother Brau. He absolutely loves being a professor and loves the students he teaches. His class can be a little confusing, mostly because I think he wants you to be doing reading outside of class (he treats this intro. course as a preprofessional course which I find useful). He's great but go to TAs for Q&A's

His tests are more focused on the intuition side of finance and less number crunching. If you miss class make sure you watch the youtube lesson because a good part of his test questions come directly from lecture and are not found in the book.
If you don't like finance, the class can really suck. if you like it, its great.
Solid class, love how he posts his lectures on YouTube. Great guy that knows what's up with finance and life. I'd recommend him

Brau is my favorite professor I've ever had. Absolutely hilarious, and cares a lot about his students and helping them succeed. Records the lectures so if you miss class you can watch it on YouTube (although being in class is extremely helpful).

He really cares about his students. He will go out of his way to help us succeed in the class and in life. He is really intense, he is ex military. But he is hilarious. If you want to succeed and really listen well to what he says in class, you will.
Great teacher that wants everyone to do well!!
This class is hard. It is definitely geared towards those who want to be finance majors. The review questions for tests are not helpful at all.
go to the TA lab

He's a good teacher.   He sometimes goes through the complex concepts too quickly.  All of the lectures are posted on youtube though, so you can go back and slowly understand the concepts.  His tests are pretty straight forward if you study carefully the notes from lecture and if you know how to do all of the problems.
One of the best professors I've ever had. He gives you everything you need to pass his exams. His lectures are the best!
It was a good class.  He is a great teacher and explains what you need to know in the lectures very well.

He is a mighty man and teacher. Be prepared to go through class quickly. However, if he is youtube-ing class again-utilize that amazing resource. He is going out of his way to make things more clear for students. As you put the effort in, you will see results. Study the way he tells you to study!

Brother Brau is one of the most inspirational teachers I have ever had. IF you are taking Finance, take from him! He loves the students and literally is just one of the "bros". That being said he also expects you to put in the time and pound out the effort for a good grade. The tests are HARD, the concept is just difficult, but Brau is the BEST.
I really liked how real he was.

Brau is one probably the best Prof I've had here at BYU. He is honest and so straight-forward. He cares about seeing all of us succeed and does everything possible to help us. All lectures are posted on YouTube and he practically gives you the test questions. The subject is tough. Finance can be difficult to understand but you will love this class.

I wouldn't take finance from anyone else! Brau is extremely clear and to the point. He's funny and keeps you engaged the whole time. The concepts are tricky, but he never tries to trick you or pull one over on you. Lectures are posted on YouTube and in-class questions are very similar to the test.
Great guy, knows what he is doing, would take again.

This was a great class! You need to take really good notes and review them before the tests, but he wont test you on anything that he has not gone over. If you do the practice problems which he posts and watch any class videos you are unclear about on youtube then you will do great!
Great class. You need to put in the time to study for tests, but expectations are very clear and no busy work.

Dr. Brau is very entertaining! I don't know what the other Finance professors are like but he kept me awake and engaged. Would recommend taking the class from him. If you take good notes and know them front and back you will get an A.
The class was tough, but doable. Take advantage of the TA sessions. The lectures were very confusing, but it helped to watch them multiple times.

Bro. Brau is a great teacher! He has a lot of passion for the subject and for his students. The material is a bit tough, but if you stay on top of the material and don't fall behind, you will be fine. The tests are pretty tough, so just make sure you spend enough time studying. If you are willing to put in the time, you will do fine in this class!

Prof. Brau truly cares about those he teaches! He takes notes right along with you which means he goes slow enough for you to actually take notes. Make sure you go to class or watch it on youtube and make sure that you do the practice drill problems on LS, and watch his TA reviews and you should get in the 90s for your tests! Loved this teacher!

Prof. Brau is a great professor and gives a lot of resources to succeed. There is the finance lab that's open a lot of hours each day and classes are posted online. The class is just hard because it is difficult content.
Dr. Brau gives great lectures. His style is unusually informal and relaxed. He does what he can to help out.

Brother Brau is very hardworking, keeps you engaged, and is very excited to teach finance. I would try to major in finance if he taught all the finance classes. He's a little crazy at times, but it keeps the class entertaining. Never fallen asleep. Good at explaining what you need to know, and what to expect on the test.
Brother Brau is a great professor and knows what he is doing, it's just a tough subject!
Great teacher. Taught with a careful attention to clarity of his expectations and on the subject matter. Entertaining to watch his lectures.

He is a great teacher! The clarity is there IF you do the reading prior. If you don't do the reading prior to class it will be a little bit more confusing. You have to definitely work for the grade but if you know the syllabus and actually listen to what he says you will do well.
Assumes that you already know what he knows. We don't thats why you are the teacher.......

Bro. Brau is seriously an awesome teacher. He knows how to explain concepts in a simple manner and gives plenty of real-life examples that the financial concepts he teaches would be used in. His spiritual thoughts are awesome as well. This was my first business class and I feel like I ended the semester with a better understanding of real life.

He's a good teacher and he does a decent job of breaking down the material, but you've really got to make sure you understand the concepts once you're outside of class in order to do well on the tests.
Very helpful teacher.  Clears up difficult concepts and keeps class interesting and entertaining.

He is a great professor and is always wanting to make you a better person for both in and out of the classroom. Do be aware that his tests will be getting much tougher now that he is being required to have a 3.0 average in his sections.
Class notes are key for exams, not necessarily glossary from the text.

Bro. Brau is very clear-cut: come to class, take notes, and study those notes for the test and you should have be able to get an A. The math isn't hard on the tests, but he does expect you to remember specific details from the notes. Overall, I would highly recommend taking his class.

Lectures are put on YouTube, which is helpful for review.  There were 3 exams this semester (including final) and 2 Excel assignments.  He usually curves but didn't with our class because our scores were so high.  As a student who has not had Acc 200 yet, I found it hard to keep up after the first 2 exams; I am studying Acc on my own to keep up.
Good Class to take if you want to learn about finance. Brau explains the concepts well enough that if you study you will do fine in the class.

Lectures are on youtube  or you can attend either section, so class is pretty flexible. Tests aren't easy and have some specific details from class, but if you study everything you'll be fine. Lectures are entertaining and funny and spiritual thoughts are great!

Brau does a great job teaching to a very specific group of learners. Personally, I had a hard time following what was happening as we would work through problems in class because he would go so fast through them. I also found the textbook to dry for my style of learning.  I thought the 94% A was a stretch for this class.

Brau's a great teacher who is extremely motivated to help all the students. He is willing to meet with literally anyone, even if it's not a class-related question, and really cares about his students. He's one of the most motivated, dedicated teachers I've seen, and really wants to help his students succeed. Work hard, and you should do well.

Bro. Brau is one of my favorite teachers of all my four years here. I wish I would have taken this class sooner, I just might have switched to finance! I've never had a professor so willing to share what he knows (both academically and spiritually) and one who is so invested in his students. Take this class! It will change your life for the better!

Brau is a fantastic lecturer. He really wants his students to pass, but he never sugar coats anything and warns you at the beginning that you are in for a tough semester. He gives clear instructions on how you can pass the course, but you have to be willing to put in the effort to do so.  Gives great spiritual thoughts throughout class!

He's a really good and funny dude. Biggest problem is he teaches at a million miles an hour and sometimes you are wondering how the heck he go to certain things. He can be misleading about what's on tests as well. I'm just doing this entry for extra credit.

Professor Brau tries really hard to teach clearly. He expects you to do your part by completing the readings, studying hard, and coming to class. But if you do that you will do well on the tests because his tests are very closely related to what we do in class. Also records lectures for you, and answers questions in class. He is an awesome teacher!

As in any class the tests are weighted, but not as much as many of the other classes I am in. He has really helped by posting Youtube videos of his lectures so you can go back and watch them again. He outlines very well how to tell, not what, if something he says will be on the test.
Brau is one of the best teachers I have ever had, unfortunately was not friendly at all and lets the PhD get to his head too much.
Professor Brau is exceptional!  He cares about the success of his students and goes out of his way to provide valuable learning experiences.

Brau is awesome! Finance is tough but he is very passionate about it and it's contagious. He shares a spiritual thought that pumps you up for the day and he is very clear in his lectures what is on the test. His lectures are recorded and posted on learning suite. If you watch them to prepare for test you will do well. One of my favorite professors.
Dr. Brau is a good teacher.  In class he is helpful in answering the questions of the students and takes time to make sure that the principles are clear.

Prof. Brau is absolutely awesome. He's always engaging, and you never know when he'll 90 degree change subject. He keeps you on his feet. He knows the subject matter very well, and is skilled at explaining it to an auditorium of 800 students.  If you pay attention and take good notes you will pass easily. If you don't then expect to work hard.

Brau is always super fired up in class and although he can get on a lot of tangents, he is a great teacher. Many things he says in class and straight on the test and he provides many practice problems to work on and posts every class lecture on youtube. He gives great spiritual thoughts and career developments every class that I have taken with me
He is a great teacher! If you are into numbers, generally get finance, and stay caught up on your work you will get an A. If you struggle with this subject he is your best bet to get a good grade.

I found this class especially hard. I studied as much as my friends and was able to do all the problems I practiced before every exam, but still didn't help. If you think you don't FULLY know the content, and consider yourself an average student (hardworker, yet not anywhere near a 4.0), make sure this class becomes your main priority.
Professor Brau cares about the success of his students in all aspects of life - no matter your chosen field of study. He is wonderful.
He is hilarious and makes finance class interesting! t
Professor Brau is great. I took his 8am class and loved how awake and interested he kept the class. He really tries to help you understand the material and is absolutely hilarious!

Brau's class is great. The class isnt super easy, but if you pay attention, take good notes and review the homework problems then you will do fine. There are a few assignments and 3 tests. The final is cumulative, but do-able.  Brau is also the most likeable guy I've ever met. He is a very inspiring teacher and is devoted to your success.

Jim Brau is very good teacher. He puts the lectures on youtube,  which is incredibly helpful because it helps you study the lectures. Attendance isn't required but It wold be a good idea to go. The tests require lots to study for however, in the lectures he tells you explicitly a lot of the material that will be on the exam.

Great teacher.  Lectures are interesting but I would recommend watching via youtube, you can skip a big chunk and save a ton of time.  Go to class/watch the youtubes, do your readings and you'll be set for the tests.
He's a great guy, and his lectures are enjoyable. Definitely hard to fall asleep on :) Would take other classes from him.
Hard class, talks too much about unrelated things, too much religious talk.

Jim is a great guy, he is one of the only professors where I can tell that he cares about me as a student. To start off he makes sure that all his students understand what is going on. Even if his students don't understand, he makes sure they have plenty of resources to figure things out.
Tests are extremely challenging. Use the ALL resources.

This is a good class. It's not easy, but it's not impossible. Just keep up with the reading. Do the homework and come to class and you should be able to get a good grade. Professor Brau is very strait forward in the way he teaches and will not try to trick you on the tests.
Brother Brau is an INCREDIBLE professor. He is very clear in his expectations and makes Finance so. much. fun! TAKE FIN201 FROM BRAU!

I think he likes the red hot chili peppers because he's always talking about that... But on the for real, for real, Brau makes his lectures super clear and will go to great lengths to entertain his classes.

Brau is a great teacher. I had heard mixed things about this class and his teaching abilities. However, he was even great at 8 AM. He tells you what you need to do to succeed in his class. Follow his instructions and do the drill problems and you will be just fine.

This class was easily my favorite this semester. He is engaging and funny in lectures. Subject material isn't too difficult. He even gives you some test questions. Do the reading, pay attention in class, and do practice problems as assigned and you will get good grades.

Brother Brau is a great guy, it helps a ton to read the chapter before class and then go to class (or watch the youtube lectures). Really if you put forth a modest effort it should be a pretty easy class.
Brother Brau is an awesome professor who really cares for his students. If you need to take finance don't take it from anyone else!
Interesting class. You have to work, but he is very clear about what you do and don't need to know for the test. He is definitely very open, and wants to help.
He made sure to clearly explain all of the material that was useful.  He helped students to prepare for the test by specifically telling them what could be or will be on the tests.
The class was great. He tells you what the test problems are. It's all about staying caught up in class.

I honestly really enjoyed this class. Professor Brau shows us upfront what you need to do to do well in his class. Brother Brau made finance enjoyable and doable. He told us what to study and I was able to do well on the tests. Low stress and class was entertaining
He is one of the best teacher ever

I would definitely recommend Dr. Brau to anyone interested in learning the basics of Finance and Business in general. I learned a lot of helpful tips that weren't necessarily a part of the course but that he mentioned that helped me learn how to get involved and pursue my career.

Bro. Brau definitely enhanced my BYU experience. Jim Brau wants his students to pass, so he will make his lectures as clear-cut as possible and emphasize those points that will be essential to passing the tests.  Taking Accounting first would be a good idea, because the vocabulary can be a bit intimidating to one who has not taken Accounting.

The class is great! Tests will be harder in the future but as long as you study you should do fine. His spiritual thoughts are the bomb. Prepare yourself for intensity! He records the class with Youtube and that is a lifesaver.
Good teacher, relatively easy class if you're good at math, he changed the structure of the course from the way he had taught it before so he had more time to spend on each topic which was nice.

Bro. Brau is a great professor and he knows his stuff. He tries to make class fun and interesting by breaking up the lectures with spiritual moments and professional developments. Awesome professor. Gives good lectures and he is energetic so he sounds like Jack Black from School of Rock. Class is a little difficult but Bro Brau cares about his students and wants them to succeed.

Brother Brau is an excellent lecturer and his is very passionate about what he does. I love his spiritual thoughts and his willingness to help his students outside of school.
