He tries really hard to help you understand the material in class. Gives great spiritual thoughts. You can't miss the lectures, they're really important. Overall great teacher.

The material is pretty straight forward for a finance class. Professor Brau is super motivational, and wants to help everyone understand what's being presented. The class isn't a breeze, but as long as you put in the hours to study and practice, you should do fine.

Class is recorded so it can be seen on youtube. This is a blessing and a curse. I had a hard time paying attention during class because the material was taught painfully slow. Prof. Brau can go on a lot of tangents, which slows the lecture down more.

Brau is an incredible teacher. He is always energetic due to his pre-class pre-workout consumption. His lectures are clear and concise, and his lectures contain everything needed to know for the tests, which make up the majority of your grade. Do the reading, attend lectures in person, and then rewatch online before the test and you'll get the A!

Brother Brau is awesome!  Easy class, I never actually went (they post everything on YouTube) , but even so I could tell how much he cares about his students.  It really makes a difference to have a professor who cares.  He gives you every opportunity to succeed.

Brother Brau was a great professor for me. He is a very excited and fun teacher and is passionate about teaching and helping his students. He inspires you to be a better student and to live a better life. He wants everyone to learn the material so he provides you with great resources. The course is challenging but he teaches it well.

Great professor. Tailors class to "the bros" and waters down the material to help everyone do well. It's nice that the lectures are recorded and put on Youtube. Very intense. High energy lectures, though you might find yourself bored by the easiness and slow pace of the actual material covered in the lectures. Overall, take it from Brau!

Bro Brau is a fantastic professor. I enjoyed how he wrote on a overhead projector rather than clicking through a PowerPoint. He gives you great resources like TA's, and YouTube videos of class. However, I wouldn't recommend skipping class because repetition in learning the material is essential for tests. Read, attend class, practice, and repeat.

Really funny guy! Study the lecture videos and practice problems. Extremely clear about what is gonna be on the test. Can come off a little bro-ey and arrogant, but just be chill about it and you'll start laughing at his jokes in no time.
I loved taking FIN201 from Brau. I only needed it for a management minor but his lectures are entertaining and his teaching is very clear. He tells you what you need to know for the test.

Bro. Brau was phenomenal. If you show up to class, pay attention, and take notes he will explain everything you need to know. Very good about answering student's questions and making sure that everyone is up to speed. Very energetic & invested in student's future success. Spiritual thoughts were literally more inspiring than my New Testament class.
Great prof and man. It's a ton of material so don't fall behind, or take 18 credits (bad decision). Read ahead and learn how formulas apply.
He gets super repetitive and class could be 30 minutes instead of 75. We waste a lot of time.

Fin 201 was my favorite pre-req for the business program! Bro Brau teaches what he's supposed to but doesn't overwhelm you and make you feel like an idiot with exams and hw. Everything is do-able if you put in the work. Feels like a 200 level class for sure. Don't get behind or else it can be overwhelming.

Great Class! Only problem is that the quizzes are always due before he even teaches the subject, and where I am a visual learner, reading the textbook doesn't help very much. Other than that, good teacher, interesting class
Brother Brau is very clear about expectations, and as long as you pay attention in class and/or watching the youtube videos and do the reading you will get an A.

Bro Brau's class was literally the highlight of my semester. He really wants his students to succeed. I would recommend his class to any student at byu, whether you need to take it or not. He is that good
Great guy. I liked the class and he did a great job making it spiritual and trying to help everyone succeed.
He is an amazing teacher and a lot of fun! He is seriously hilarious and does an excellent job at teaching Finance :)

Bro. Beau does about a good a job possible with such a large class (1500+ students).  He makes the subject matter seem simple and straight forward, and gives you the material that will be on the test. Not a bad class, just the tests are pretty tough.

Brother Brau loves (in no particular order) finance, West Point, BYU, his family, the gospel of Jesus Christ, the gym, and his students. You can tell how passionate he is for this class and all the students in it. He does not just care about your success in this class, but in life.

He is extremely good at breaking up the lectures with Spiritual Thoughts and Professional Development moments that allow your mind to take a break off finance for a second.  This semester he uploaded his lecutres on Youtube and that has helped me a TON! You must read and attend/watch the lectures to prepare for the tests.  The Tests are fair.

Brother Brau is very passionate about finance. Going to lecture is a must as he discusses the intuition underlying what you need to know, and then shows how concepts work in problems. The online textbook is a great resource for learning the material. It is not something that you can simply skim read, as some of the material is challenging.
Professor Brau is very energetivc and fun-loving. His class is Fin 201 class is pretty easy as long as you put a little bit of effort into it however at times he can be very hard to follow

Make sure you follow Brau's set up to study for exams. They actually help out quite a bit.  He is very passionate about Finance and will go the extra mile to help you out. In return, he expects the same.
He tells you what to expect. Be prepared to study.

Brau is awesome! Everyone loves him and can actually stay awake in his class because he is entertaining. He explains finance well and teaches the concepts simply. Sometimes lectures are a bit confusing, but overall great class.

Professor Brau is such a cool guy. He is probably the most down to earth and helpful professor I've ever had. His class isn't too hard, if you go to class, pay attention, and do the readings you'll be set.

Professor Brau is a great teacher who really wants to help you to do the best you can possibly do. He is so clear on what he expects you to know and if you attend lecture as well as review the lectures on the youtube channel you are guaranteed to do well. Take this class from him!

Pro. Brau is one of the best teachers I have ever had. He is very passionate about teaching and is extremely organized. You need to read the chapter before hand or you will be lost during class. He is a pro. I will always remember him. I would recommend him to anyone. Hard but worth it.
Going to class is very important. He takes a lot of his subject matter from his lectures and puts it in his tests.

Finance is hard for me, so I felt pretty lost with most of what we went over in class, and the tests were pretty tough.  But Brother Brau is a really good guy that tries hard to make class fun and engaging, and his spiritual thoughts are always great.  I really enjoyed his lectures and would definitely  recommend taking his class.

Brau is a great guy. This class is huge so he can't be personal, but he is very effective in keeping students engaged and awake. He gives career development tips, and his spiritual thoughts are always interesting. He does not mess around; he is not sugary at all. Don't get behind, understand the material, and you'll do well.

Great teacher. He genuinely cares about his students and wants you to succeed. He now has the lectures posted on youtube for studying in prep for finals which is really nice! His spiritual message intermissions are a great way to help you keep focused throughout the duration of the class periods. He provides lots of ways to succeed in finance.

Professor Brau is clear in his expectations and on the material. Before exams he explains what we need to know which makes it really clear. Every class and review session is posted on Youtube, so it makes going on again and missing classes easy to recover. He's very outgoing and an interesting teaching. I loved his class.
Professor Brau is amazing. He is very funny and his lecture just go by fast. He is very good at helping students remember things and prepare for the test.

Brau is hilarious. I've never had a professor that makes me laugh so much. Bro. Brau is one of the funniest people I met. I just loved his spiritual thoughts in class. He is not very clear (at least for me as an international student) and finance is not an easy class; however, if you do your readings, drill problems, and take GOOD notes you will be just fine. Great man!

He's a very engaging teacher, but I got bored with all gym and weightlifting talk. Lectures were an hour and 15 minutes, and only about 15-20 minutes was valuable to my educational learning. Professor Brau is an awesome professor who really cares about his students and strives to help students who have crazy schedules. Classes are on youtube which helps a ton for reviewing. He gives great spiritual thoughts that really help pick you up as you go through the semester.

Bro Brau is cool, but honestly I got sick of hearing about all of his accomplishments in class. Great professor! Makes the lectures interesting and tells you exactly what you need to know for the exams so there are no surprises.

Brau is a great guy. He is actually really funny and tries hard to keep the students engaged. The class can feel really long but it could be much worse. I actually thought the class was easier than ACC 200 because it was less time consuming.

Professor Brau was not just a professor that just gave lectures and give grades out, but encouraged his students to go out and be helpful to the world.  He was always willing to help you in and out of class with school, life, and career.  The best parts of his classes was doing a professional development moment and a spiritual moment.
Dr. Brau really cares about his students. He wants you to learn finance. Awesome guy.

Brother Brau is really passionate.  He is very good at going over things again and again until you understand. Brou is a Bro. You might not love finance, but you'll love Brau's lectures.

Brother Brau is a great professor.  It is clear he really cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He explains the material well and is super funny, which keeps the class entertaining. you rock Brau!

Professor Brau teaches the material well and provides ample resources to do well in the class. However, it's not just how well he teaches that makes him a good professor. Professor Brau is a total bro. He is an awesome guy who is easy to get along with. Great teacher. Fun to listen too, but the lectures aren't super clear in some ways. He definitely expects his students to understand the readings before class, as he alludes to them without explaining  the material in detail (which is a necessity, considering how fast-paced the class is)

Very enthusiastic, loves finance. Listens to students requests and tries to be as clear as possible. The tests will probably get harder in the future but if you take notes on everything he says then it is a very doable class.

GOOD TEACHER ALL DAY EVERY DAY

Brau is the best teacher I have ever had.  He has engaging lectures and he really wants you to learn the material.  If you have to take finance, take it from Brau.  If nothing else, take the class for his spiritual thoughts!
Bro. Brau is a awesome teacher!! He really does a great job and makes everything super clear. You can really tell that he cares about everyone.

Brau is a pretty good teacher. The class was pretty straight forward. Everything is on YouTube so you can basically skip class whenever. Great class and great professor. Bro Brau's lectures are engaging and funny! Make sure to go to class or watch the lectures on youtube.

Finance is definitely not my thing, but I really do like his class, and am very grateful that I took it from him. I would recommend this class to any and everyone. Definitely not an easy A, but worth any and all time put into it

Jimmy Brau is an awesome finance teacher. His lectures are interesting because he is an interesting guy. You have to do work for this class, but it is worth it. He is a great professor and life mentor.

He's a great professor. Learned a lot from him.
Brother Brau is a great professor. I really enjoyed his lectures and the material is extremely applicable to real life. Take this class!
I love finance, Brau has a lot of energy!

He's Awesome! Class is easy if you put in the effort and he tells you everything you need to study so no reason not to get an A. Youtube videos of class are a must watch before test. Professor Brau is a great teacher. Sometimes his class time is not used efficiently, but he gives you plenty of resources to succeed in the class.

Prof. Brau is personable, funny, and inspiring (in person) & very accessible online. The requirements for this class are simple and straightforward. Brau does all that he can do aid in comprehension, but you must do real work on your end to master the material

Brother Brau is really clear in his teaching. He shows respect to his students and really tries to encourage everyone in whatever area they're interested in. If you study how he suggests you study, you'll do well.

Quality Class, a little too structured and mind numbing, you just have to work the problems and you'll get the grade. study for hours and the tests will be a breeze. Listen to what he says in class and study everything he tells you to.

Bro Brau is a great teacher. He really tries to help his students succeed. He also expects a lot from his students like a ton of reading before class. Great teacher! He bends over backwards to help you. Make sure to attend class or watch the Youtube videos though, because the book (MyEducator) is very hard to understand.

Overall a great teacher. He does digress from the course material during class but I think it fits in well to the overall object of the university. Incredible teacher! Absolutely love the energy in class. Makes it fun and enjoyable and easy to learn the materials. Super good at answering questions and the youtubes save lives.   Great at teaching clearly, but the tests are pretty hard. The only way to do well is if you study like he tells you to. That's the key!! Take finance from Brau!
If you love business and want to learn, you will do well.  Not an easy class, but all the tools are given to be successful. You just need to take advantage of them.

Brau is awesome. He cares about his students succeeding but you will have to put in the work to truly understand the material.  His lectures are engaging because he is entertaining. His spiritual thoughts are the best!

Brau is the man! I loved his class and learned a ton. If you work hard and pay attention, you will do well. His inspirational thoughts were so good too!
Lots of energy during lectures. Study the material from class and do the practice problems and you will get a good grade.

Great teacher. I am not talented in math classes, but he is super helpful to these students especially. Super funny guy.

If I had an hour left to live, I would spend it in his class. That way I feel like I've for an eternity. Nah but forreal, great class. super helpful but he said that he is going to make it harder in the coming semesters

great teacher. take finance from him. great spiritual thoughts in class.

Great teacher that is really passionate about what he does. He is a great if you like someone that wants you to get the concept and move on to the next thing. Brother Brau easily one of the greatest professors at BYU. The reason why he is great is because he is crystal clear on what he expects us to know. He does youtube videos that are super helpful. He really makes class fun and interesting. He wants you to succeed

Has a hard time staying on one train of thought. He will be talking about something and then jump off track and then return to the old train, but you've lost the connection because of the change in subject.

Really intense so be prepared for that. Wants you to learn and does all he can to help. Classes are recorded and put online. I had to retake it and this was way easier than the first time I took it. Would recommend him
Class is enjoyable, he makes you want to go to class to learn and to enjoy his occasional tangents.  I highly recommend this class with this professor if you need to take FIN 201.

Not a big Bro. Brau fan. He seems to think that his way is the only good way to learn (very self righteous) and there is a lot of class waisted on spiritual thoughts and unnecessary rants. This was a really good class. It's take a lot of work but you'll learn everything you need to know. Make sure to take notes of everything in class, it'll be on the exam. Bro. Brau is human like everyone else, but he'll be there for you and wants you to do well in his class.
Good teacher, need to take accounting before.

Only thing I remember from this class is "laterally blows my mind." He is a great guy, but full of himself feels like. The class is hard, DON'T TAKE AT THE SAME TIME AS ACC 200

Class is for CFA prep for any major or student. Mostly self study. Will get you ready for the exam if you keep up on work. It is a ton of work because the CFA has so much on it. If your taking CFA, highly recommend. Bro Brau is laid back.

Brau has good intentions and means well but is a little hot headed and overly confident with an attitude of my way or the high way. Overall not a bad class though, just not my favorite teacher. I'd recommend taking from someone else

Your grade is pretty much determined solely by your test scores. The test are hard.  Brau is awesome. He shares great inspirational thoughts everyday. He has lots of energy and is passionate about finance.

The grade is extremely heavily oriented on tests and the tests are hard.  If you understand the material, you will do well on the tests.  It takes good notes from class.
Lectures are great, he explains everything really well.  The tests can be hard if you don't know the equations, but there are a lot of "softball" questions on each test too.
One tough class. Make sure to take really good notes.
Brau is a boss. If you go to lecture and pay attention, you will do just fine. He is not out to get you. Literally everything he covers in class is on the test.
Super inspirational! I wish there was an optional to have smaller classes or even labs outside of the lecture.

He posts lectures online which helps a ton!!! Go to class and take good notes, then before the test, look up the youtube lecture of the review day and take notes again. VERY NECESSARY!!! What he says is more important than what he writes!!!

Make sure to do the quizzes. They help a ton in learning the material, and then it is solidified the next day in class. Super inspirational spiritual thoughts each class period. Really wants to see you succeed.

Professor Brau is great. He is very passionate about what he teaches and is there to help you become ready to work in the real world. Attend the lectures and take good notes. I would take his class again.

I LOVE Brother Brau! He is amazing. I always strived to be at class because his lectures were amazing but I enjoyed his spiritual thoughts more than anything! I learned a great deal. Just do everything he tells you to do and you'll be fine :)
Funny in class
I loved his class!
Fin 201 is a tough class no matter which professor you take. However, Brau makes it less of a drag.
Overall a good professor. He's clarifies any questions and is very concerned for his students' success. He gives lots of good general career advice.
Great class. Loved the spiritual moments. Do the work and you'll be fine

If you already know a lot about business, this class will be reasonably difficult. You need to take this class seriously. Bro. Brau does a great job at lightening a subject that at times can be very specific, stressful, and difficult.

Brau is very interested in student success not just in finance but also in life, he has great professional development moments and spiritual thoughts.   That said, finance is a very difficult and dense subject and given the amount of time in a semester he has to go very quickly rewatching lectures on YouTube is a must because he goes fast.

Bro. Brau is fantastic.  I loved going to class just because I liked to listen to him.  That being said, the class is TOUGH.  Most of the test questions come from the class lecture, but don't expect to just show up to class.  You have to put in work outside of class.  Try to avoid finance, but if you have to take it- go with Brau.  He's the man!
Very good class
Professor Brau is great. He has a really good system set up for the class. I wouldn't take this class from anyone else.
Big class but he tries his best to help

Recorded lectures and posted them online this semester. Does not allow computers, cell phone use in class. He has a lot of energy for 8 am, so I never had a problem with feeling drowsy.
Good class. Dr. Brau is a great teacher and does a great job at teaching the material.  The class has challenging parts. Don't get behind. Find other people to study with.

This class was tough, but you will get out of it what you put in.  In my mind, Brau is the quintessential BYU professor.  Cares a lot for students, teaches with passion, and does a good job of infusing gospel and life principles into lectures.

Bro. Brau is the man.  He makes learning finance at 8am pretty entertaining. Teaches you everything you need to know to do well on his exams...  5 total actually, 4 midterms and a final... but its not as bad as it sounds.  If you're going to, or have to take finance... take it from Brau.
Good professor, great guy
He's a great professor, if not interested in pursuing a career in finance but you have to take the class I would recommend him.
Professor Brau was a great professor. His class was tough, but he lays everything out that you need to do not only to get a good grade, but to learn. If you do what he says you will learn a lot.
He is a hilarious professor, but it is not an easy class.

This is a terrifying class. The best use of your study time will be watching the Youtube lectures at double speed making sure you write anything down when he says "This will be on the test." Easy class! He outlines what is on the test. Take good notes from class and study those for the test and you will get A's
The great thing about Brau was how clear and specific he was about was about what was going to be tested. Learned lots, both educational and spiritual, definitely take from Brau

He is an amazing teacher. This year he did youtube lectures so if you missed the lecturesyou wanted to go back and watch them again you could. I suggest that when it is test time go through the youtube lectures and go through the practice problems that are on myeducator. Make sure you understand the material as you go through the class!

Brother Brau claims his tests are written straight from the in class notes. He's not lying. Take explicit notes on everything he says. Take the quizzes and chapter concepts seriously, if you understand the book you will understand lecture, if you understand lecture you will understand your notes when you go back to them to study for each midterm.

Great guy. Semester of Winter 2015 he started recording the lectures and posting them online, which is helpful when preparing for exams. Has excellent professional moments and spiritual thoughts. Explains concepts well and gives you exactly what you need to know for the test. TAKE DETAILED CLASS NOTES. Just about all info for tests comes from class
He's a great teacher.  He is pretty clear on what he expects from students as well as what will be on the test.  He won't try and trick you.  Class lectures are important.

No good feedback, he says he goes over the exam after the test, but he does not, I would have liked to see what I have done wrong in some processes. I love Bro Brau and his class.  He is a smart professor, meaning that everything he does is for a purpose. He was a great teacher. The tests were just what were in class. You can do really well in the class.
Pretty hard class, but doable if you put in the effort

Brau really helps you to see how you can apply this class to the rest of your life no matter what major you are! He is super specific about where he gets his test questions from and if you study what he tells you, you'll get a good grade on his tests! I would DEFINITELY take Finance from him!!

It's possible for any kind of student to pass this class with a good grade. Either go to class and take good notes or watch the classes he posts on YouTube. He's got a ton of passion and loves finance, so expect high-energy lectures.

Great Professor! Outlines specifically what is expected and even goes over things on the test in class. Super inspirational and actually cares about others. Very well organized and overall a great experience. It is a tougher class for those not going into business and will take a lot of studying, but totally worth it. Take very good notes.
Brother Brau truly cares about his students. The material can be quite confusing however. Understanding the intuition behind everything is essential for this class.

Professor Brau is an excellent professor.  He clearly outlines what is expected in his course.  There are no gray areas.  As for the content, reading is the most important.  I would recomend going to all lectures but make certain to go to test review days.  Not all of the material on tests are discussed in the text so take notes in class.

Awesome professor. It was a lot of work, but the tests are clear cut and if you put in the effort you can do just fine. Love his attitude towards learning and helping students for their future.

Brother Brau is a great guy who truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He is a great teacher and explains the concepts well.  To do well in the class its really important to attend every lecture, take really good notes, and keep up on the chapter readings.

Great teacher, it's a lot of information very fast. reading is VERY important!
Brau is an awesome teacher.  He brings the best finance lectures, mixed with a spiritual thought and professional development each time. He is a professor that wants success for his students.
Great man, but the lectures go fast and are difficult to follow at times.

He's an awesome guy though

Brother Brau is an amazing teacher.  He really cares about his students.  He spends a lot of time preparing  to make sure that we are getting the best possible understanding of Finance.  I like his class structure bc he breaks up lecture with the best spiritual thoughts and professional development moments. He's the best!!

He is a great guy and really wants his students to understand the material. He gives lots of answers in his lectures so be there in class. He makes you work for an A but with study groups it can be done. Re-watch his lectures on YouTube it helps clarify.

The most meaningful part of Professor Brau's classes are his spiritual thoughts and professional developments.  He has them every single lecture and most of the time they are very helpful. Brau is a great teacher.  Learn how to take his tests up front and you can do well! Just make sure you stay on top of the reading and material.

Great professor, really enjoyed the class. Make sure you keep up to date as the material builds on itself

Great teacher. May be more difficult than other finance 201 teachers, but much clearer and enjoyable in-class lectures. Put time into preparing for the tests and visit the TA's and you'll do great! Great Professor!

Brother Brau is very good at keeping his students engaged.

Bro Brau is awesome! He keeps you engaged and is hilarious. The class isn't too bad. Go to class, and 90% of the questions on the test will be straight out of the notes.

Awesome professor. If you want to make it easier on yourself, go to class and take very good notes. You'll be tested on those things. He may post them on YouTube but you'll regret not going to the live lectures.

I think Brother Brau is a great professor . Not only  because he is good at teaching the concepts, but also because he really does his best to encourage his students to become the best people they can by giving advice about what matters most.

Great teacher who no only wants students to do well in his class, but to become life-long learners and have successful lives and careers. He is very inspirational and spiritually uplifting.

He is great teacher but the subject is hard.

Brother Brau is a great professor! He is probably the most excited professor I have ever had. He shares some awesome spiritual thoughts. Brau was a great teacher. His spiritual moments and professional developments moments have really changed how I think and act. His class itself was difficult, I advise taking accounting 201 before Finance. Prepare to work.

Bro Brau is an amazing professor! He is one of the co-authors of the textbook, so he really knows his stuff. Great class, and very manageable.

Awesome class. Awesome teacher. Biggest complaint was that exam scores were not made available immediately after finishing in the testing center.
This class is awesome! Brau is definitely the best professor and makes class entertaining. GO TO CLASS. He gives out test questions. Also put his lectures on YouTube which was great.

Brother Brau is great. Very inspiring with many spiritual moments in class. The tests are tough if you don't study well for them but overall not a bad class.

One of the best teachers I've had during my whole BYU experience. Brother Brau has so much depth to him... he's just a great guy!
Great lecturer, he is really active and energetic. Cares about the students and loves to teach. Good professor.

Brau's spiritual thoughts were off the charts!! Good class, and good teacher!

Jim is such a genuine person. He loves to teach and really tries to help students succeed. He thinks he teaches clearly and that you can only use his notes to excel on tests. This may be true for some but definitely not true for me. Read the text book and do the practice problems in there to do well on the tests. I have 100% going into the final exam.

Bro Brau is a great teacher! He is extremely helpful and tells you 27 out of 30 questions on his test during his lectures. He also posts videos of his lectures on Youtube so you can re watch it later. If you go to class an pay attention to what he says will be on the test you will get an A!!

Brother Brau is awesome. He tells you exactly what to study to get A's on his tests. He inserts spiritual moments and business opportunities to break up his lectures so every one stays awake. He wants you to succeed and makes it possible to do so. Take this class from him.

Jim is the man. Sometimes he's a lot to handle at 8AM, but thats just me. Maybe you need a shot of testosterone at 8AM. Anyway, you won't fall asleep. He cares, he's dedicated, he's smart, he's willing to work with you, and you never feel stiffed or shorted in his class. All things considered, you'd be hard pressed to find a better teacher at BYU.

Brother Brau is a great guy! He has the best inspirationalspiritual lessons of any professor that I have had at BYU. He is really funny, and his class is interesting. The only thing that I didn't like about the class is that the tests were mostly conceptualdefinition based, and I like doing the math side of Finance more than the definitions.

He is very straightforward about what you need to know. At first, his personality rubbed me the wrong way, but I was able to get used to it and see by the end that he really does care about his students. If you take good notes and study what he says, you can do well on the tests.

Brother Brau is a great man, and teacher. He gives amazing advice and gets you ready for the real word in his many professional and spiritual development moments in class. That being said, It is a really tough class. I decided not to do finance because of it, but that is just me. You really need to do work in this class. Read the book, take notes.

Brother Brau talks fastly, but is very clear in his explanations. If you pay attention to the lectures, take good notes, and follow his advice you will likely do well in his class. He lets you know exactly what will be on the tests. Great lecturer. A lot of fun to listen to. Great stories and spiritual thoughts. I absolutely LOVED his class!!!!!!!
Loves BYU students, teaching finance, and inspiring others to be their best. He's extremely dedicated to the BYU aims for education. I respect him a lot.

Amazing teacher that really cares about his students and helping them learn. Really difficult to take alongside with accounting. I definitely don't recommend piling up multiple difficult prerequisites with this course. Definitely busted my chops.
Your entire grade is basically exams. Prepare well.
Great professor, great role model. Class is not extremely hard, but you need to put some effort into it.

He's a REALLY good professor, he incorporates what he calls, "professional development moments" into his lectures and spiritual thoughts which keep things interested. He's just super passionate about his class and helping students do their very best. Be sure to study the lecture videos and notes for the tests and you'll be just fine. Very do-able!
Bro. Brau will do his best to provide the best experience in finance possible for everyone, regardless of your interest in the subject. I really respect Bro. Brau.

Bro. Brau was an awesome and inspirational teacher. He has 4 midterms--including 1 the week before finals--but they aren't too bad and don't cover more than 3 chapters of material. If you attend class and do the homework, you'll get an A.
Overall good class, especially by byu standards and relation to the church. However, sometimes if concepts weren't understood in the reading it was hard to keep up in the lecture.
Go to class and take good notes.
I loved the lectures on finance and his career development section in each class. Very insightful
Dr. Brau is a great teacher. The material can be hard. If you have the chance to teach others what you're learning you will learn it far better than learning it all in his lectures.

Pro. Brau is definitely there for his students. For having 800 students in his class he is really good at being there for students. There are a lot of tests, but he pretty much tells you what you need to know in class. Only problem is that he does not post grades on learningsuite.
Brau is a great teacher who really cares about the students performance, if you follow his guidelines you will do well.
Brau is such a Bro. Learned tons in his class, but it takes time and work to get the grades you want.

Professor Brau is one of my favorite that I have had at BYU. The material that learn is hard and tough to grasp, but Professor Brau does a great job at helping you understand and letting you know exactly what you will be tested on. He also gives spiritual thoughts each class that truly are inspiring. I feel like he is a friend and a professor.

First of all, Brau is a good person. You can feel it when he speaks, which adds credibility to his great spiritual messages. His lectures are VERY clear. If you are paying attention, you WILL understand him. He's really funny and engaging; he wants you to get an A. If you do all the required work and put in some good study time, you'll get the A.

Dr. Brau sincerely cares about his students. He is a great finance professor. The online text book was a bummer for me. Quizzes online often pop up unexpectedly, so make sure you're on top of things. Use the Help Desk and take advantage of the free tutors from the Finance Society.

He really cares about the students and wants to help them succeed.  He gives you all the answers to the test on the review days.  I love his spiritual thoughts that he gives during class. They always help us refocus and inspire us.
Bro Brau is a nice dude but I felt like a lot of what was taught went right over my head and we went from one topic to another that I was left behind pretty quick and it was hard to stay caught up.

Brau is want you want in a professor. That's hard to do in a big lecture-hall class. Make sure you show up to class having already read the material, and take good notes. Even if the material can be tricky, the class structure is not. No surprises. If you think you're doing well, you are. If you think you're not, you're not.

Brother Brau is awesome. If you don't read or you fall behind in class, it's really hard to catch back up. His lectures are not confusing if you read the material and pay attention, but if you don't, it's easy to get lost.

If you're not a Finance person, this will be hard. Take Acc 200 before taking this class. Material isn't too complicated, but we go over it so quickly that you often don't have a solid clue on how to do anything. Work with TAs, attend class, try your best to understand the book. Overall a great class and a great guy, but it's no easy A. Study Hard!

I will probably never really enjoy Finance, but i felt like I was able to grasp and understand the material because Professor Brau presented it in such a clear manner. If you go to class and take notes, you will do fine in the class.

Bro B was awesome! Each class, he provided us with multiple professional development and spiritual moments. Academically, this class was tough for me. There is a lot of math and he doesn't allow you to take in formula sheets on the test. 4 midterms (30 q's each) and a comprehensive final (50 q's). He' s very specific on what will be on each test.

Brother Brau gives great lectures and spiritual thoughts. His personality is hilarious and he is very real. Whatever questions he says will be on the test, are on the test so going to class is very important. Most of the questions come straight from the notes he writes in class.
Come to class, take good notes, get in a study group that meets regularly, practice the practice probs at the help desk  rock the test!
Honestly just pay attention to what he says and you'll be fine. It's really not bad. I didn't go to class, I watched some of the youtube lectures right before the exam and did very well on the exams.

Professor Brau is a great teacher. He really cares about not only teaching his students about finance, but about making them better people and helping them get ready for careers. There are tons of resources for help when you don't understand something. It is a difficult class so you definitely have to put in the time, but it is very doable.

Brau tells you what you need to know for the exam. He takes quick breaks to give spiritual thoughts  professional advice almost every class. I took his class at 8am and always felt totally engaged. I chose to major in finance because of his class. My advice: Learn the material on your own & then let him fill in the blanks. TAKE WITH BRAU.

Brother Brau is a great guy.  The structure of the class is very clear and you know what to expect on his tests.  He's not there to trick or surprise you.  Very possible to get an A.  I personally didn't think he was the best lecturer.  I learned most of it through the book.  Probably due to a mismatch in learning - teaching style.
Brau is awesome. Always willing to help, and makes it explicitly clear what is required to pass the course. GET A STUDY GROUP ASAP!!!
Professor Brau is awesome.  There are a lot of ratios and equations to remember, and your grade is based primarily on test scores.
Brau's class was fun. Gives most of the answers to the test in class so make sure that you attend.
Brau was a great professor. Really enjoyed what he taught and definitely learned a lot.
He is pretty straightforward; gives you exam review sheets. If you give effort and study this class won't be hard.

Professor Brau has been hands down one of the best professors I have had here at BYU.  He is genuinely concerned about his students success.  His tests came directly off of the notes he would write in lecture, so if you pay attention in class you will do well.
It's not a hard class. Brother Brau is very straightforward and you know what to expect from his tests.
The best professor I've ever had at BYU! Be prepared to work, class is difficult but manageable.

Brau is the man. Loved learning finance from him. He did a really god job helping us learn the material and helping us see how it could be relevant in our lives, even if we weren't  business majors. I would say the class is pretty easy, but if you struggle at tests, then it could be difficult as tests are most of the grade.

Brau is the most organized professor I've ever had. You will quickly learn exactly what you need to do to get a good grade. The work load is average. Tests are totally easy if you do what he asks. I also really appreciate how much he cared about the effectiveness and applicability of the class. This class is an easy pitch right over the plate.

One of the easiest classes I ever took. I didn't go to a single class (just watched his lectures online at 2x speed). If you pay attention, take detailed notes on his lectures and the online textbook, you will do great! I spent about 2-3 hours total on this class each week. I think I have about a 100% in this class right now leading into the final.

Bother Brau is great at keep the class attentive and engaged. He does wonderfully with explaining concepts and giving you a heads up about what you need to study for the test. It's wasn't an easy class for me, and you really need to put time into it, but I really enjoyed being there and learning about how to apply the concepts to my life.

Class is pretty straightforward not much homework but you have to be in class to do well. Tests can are pretty much layed out how they will be in class but be careful because if you miss one little thing from class their is no chance you will get it on the test. Your grade is based almost completely on test scores

Prof. Brau brings energy to his lectures and engages everyone of his 900 kids. Understands that many people learn differently so makes all lectures available online, which was great for my buddy. The structure of his class is student-friendly. The subject is tougher but really do-able.

Bro Brau is pretty clear from the start as to what you need to do to pass his class. He's going to explicitly tell you 95% of what you need to know for the exams. That being said, I didn't find his lectures all that helpful, he doesn't really explain the concepts very clearly and I found myself having to learn them on my own.

He's a really fair teacher. Finance itself is not easy but he is very clear about what's on the test. You have to put in the work to get the A. He also gives really great insights and spiritual messages. He is probably the best teacher to take Finance 201 from. I enjoyed his class despite the 8am. It's worth it though.

Great teacher and a great man.  He cares a ton about his many students, takes professional development and spiritual thought breaks every 15 minutes in class to keep you engaged, and the chapter readings are remarkably concise and accessible.  That doesn't make 201 easy!  But it makes it as painless as possible.  Hard, but I would take it again :)

Great teacher for a great class. He let's you know exactly what you need to understand for the tests and is there to help you learn the material, not trick you. He breaks lectures up into 20 minute segments by sharing inspirational thoughts or career advice and it makes the class go by quickly and smoothly.
Pretty straight forward. Your grade is pretty much all decided on tests, but you can drop one if you go to an extra lecture thing.

This has been one of my top classes in two years at BYU. You have to work hard but he is clear and tells you exactly what you need to do to have success. If you study hard and follow what he tells you to do, you will get an A. He is very spiritually intense and his spiritual thoughts are some of the highlights of my semester.

He can't seem to stay on topic. Be prepared to understand the discussion of finance using algebraic language. He explains financial processes by saying "it's intuitive" rather than explaining the methodology.
Brother Brau is a great professor. He gives spiritual thoughts during every class period and they are generally very motivating. He is very clear on what to study for the exams.

Professor Brau will tell you everything you need to know for the exams.  Make sure you go!  He gives very lively and funny lectures and breaks them up nicely with spiritual and professional lessons.  Overall he is great.

Brother Brau is a great professor. I feel like he is really clear in the way that he teaches and his tests are relatively straight forward. Overall not to bad if you do what he says and take good notes. It you do that and study them you will do well on the test.
He was a great professor and helped explain business and financial terms.

Brother Brau is awesome! Seriously, I respect him so much. His set up in Finance 201 is really clear. 4 midterms, 16 chapter quizzes and one cumulative final. He does a fantastic job of preparing you for the midterms and gives really helpful review sheets. There are lots of ways to get help. If you work, you'll get an A.
Great class set up, and prof Brau does everything to help student be very prepared for exams, but a lot of reading on your part to understand the concepts out of class. Great class though

Sometimes it's hard to keep up with him because he talks so fast, but he does a lot of professional development moments and spiritual thoughts and they are always amazing, and they give your brain a quick break to restart the next section of the lecture.

Bro Brau is awesome. Love his energy. Finance at BYU is not easy regardless of professor because it is a pre requisite for so many programs. He is extremely straight forward. Do exactly what he says, not tricky at all. You will have to put in time outside of class to get all the equations down.

All business classes are hard at BYU but I feel like Bro. Brau tries his best to make this class interesting and he wants us to learn real thing from him. Make sure you make good notes in class and you will do fine for his tests. His spiritual thoughts were always my favorite in this class:)

Honestly the best and most useful class I have taken here at BYU.  Every teacher should follow his teaching style.  He provides career opportunities and spiritual lectures, basically times to take breaks during his lecture.  Everything on the test he specifies during lecture.  Teaches principles crystal clear.  I would take it again & again & again

Bro Brau is a good teacher, but I found his tests to be challenging. Most of the test questions come from what was covered in class. I attended each lecture and took notes, but I didn't perform as well as I hoped on the tests. Maybe  something was wrong with me, but I didn't feel that the tests were a very good representation of what I learned.
Really a great professor, but the subject is pretty difficult. It's one of those things that you either get or you don't.

The most useful things for me were reading and practice problems.  I didn't go to class often, watching the lectures on line was sufficient.  Brother Brau has a lot of energy and passion for finance and teaches it well.

Go to class. Pay your dues. Listen to lectures and take good notes. Brau knows what he's doing so listen to him. If you don't, do not expect a good grade and you will miss out on some very important life skills, personally and financially.

Brau is a solid professor.  Although I sometimes got frustrated with being expected to just memorize stuff without him really explaining it, he straight up tells you what's coming on the test, and lets you drop one if you do an easy EC assignment. Spiritual thoughts were bomb, and I liked how he broke up lecture with advice on life and career.

This class was extremely hard for me. But if you go to class and MAKE SURE you take notes then you will fine. Be prepared to study hard and practice a lot of problems. Bro. Brau however is an amazing teacher and always has very spiritual thoughts.

He is really passionate about what he teaches and is willing to help everyone. He gets bombarded with emails and still responds to all of them. The majority of the grade is tests but he tells you what will be on the test you just have to listen to what he says in class. It isn't an easy A but it is definitely doable.
He is very direct and aggressive in his teaching. It can be hard to keep up in his lectures.

Brother Brau is awesome! He is a great teacher. Really concerned about how his students do not only in his class but also in life in general. Loved his professional development moments and spiritual thoughts.

Professor Brau is probably my favorite teacher ever. He teaches well, anwsers questions effectively, and genuinely cares about his students. His professional development moments and spiritual thoughts made my day and molded me as a person.

Dr. Brau is probably the most straightforward professor I've ever had. He'll tell you exactly what to study and how his tests are. He is genuinely interested in students' success and tries his best to help students understand and apply what he teaches. He breaks up lectures with spiritual thoughts and professional development, which is nice.

His tests are not too difficult, just make sure you don't fall behind. This material is not the kind that you want to cram the night before the test. Very useful subject matter, but most of it is really only applicable in finance. Very smart and inspirational guy!

Here's the deal, if you like math, this class is cake. If you're not comfortable with math, then be sure you are in class and pay attention, and there are a lot of resources available to help you get it. Dr. Brau is awesome. He sincerely cares about you, and he'll teach you a lot of important things both within and outside of finance.

Bro Brau is a great guy. He's not your typical BYU professor. His teaching style is somewhere between that of a drill sergeant and a football coach. He yells everything, which makes it really hard to fall asleep in class. I really enjoyed his lecture style, though sometimes it was hard to understand the "intuition" behind everything he taught.

I hated this subject but Brau was an excellent teacher. I'm not exactly a fan of his loud spiritual thoughts which seem kind of irreverent, but he is VERY passionate and cares for everyone. I love the structure of his (4 short) tests, the test material is straight forward, and the lectures are posted online. Just study hard and know the material :)

Great professor.  He really cares about your success, and he CLEARLY identifies what you need to do to do well in his class.  Honestly, he over emphasizes it.  If you show up to class, pay attention, and study, you will do well.
He's a great guy and is very forward about what is on the tests.  He keeps lectures pretty entertaining.

I don't think this is an easy class. But My grade improved steadily as I got used to his test style. I think he is covering too much material in one class. It is very fast-paced, and Mr. Brau is using every minute to teach or give us spiritual thoughts or professional development. It is a great class, but I was somewhat overwhelmed.
I really like the way that the class is organized. If you go to class, you learn everything that you need to know for the tests. Study groups are a great help.

This class isn't an Easy A, but if you are willing to put in the effort, you'll get the grade that you want. The only thing you need the textbook for is to take the quiz before class. Listen to what he says in class and you will get a good grade on the test. He'll honestly tell you that 2730 test questions come from the lecture and it's true.
Bro Brau is probably the best BYU professor I have ever had. He genuinely cares about the students and wants you to succeed. His class is fair and definitely passable if you study his exam reviews.

He's a great professor.  Very entertaining. Keeps students engaged even at 8 in the morning.  Tests can be hard but everything is curved just get with a study group and do your best and you'll be fine.  He gives many opportunities to get help if you need it.

I hated the subject & wasn't a fan of how Brau was loud & not that reverent while giving his spiritual thoughts (but what do you expect from a West Point guy?) Looking back, the class was great. I love his teaching & testing structure (4 tests + final- so less to study on tests) & mapped out test guides so you know what to study. But STUDY HARD  :)

I love Brother Brau. He is genuine in his love for his students and for learning and helping us succeed in both finance and life. He is straightforward with what and how to study and do well in his class!
Great Class. Not too difficult if you know your learning style
Brau tells you exactly what you need to know to do well in his class. His lectures can be long but he breaks them up.

Brother Brau is a great teach and an even better person.  You can tell that he really cares about his students and doing everything that he can to help them succeed.  If you put in the time and effort into studying, you will get the grade that you want so your grade is essentially up to how much time you are willing to devote to the class.

He is a great teacher. He cares a lot about the students and their success. If you want to do good in the class and on the tests, take really good notes in class. Almost everything on the test is talked about during the lectures. It requires reading the textbook and studying several hours a week outside of class but the expectations are clear.

Brother Brau is a great teacher. This class was difficult because I am an athlete at BYU and I didn't have a lot of time to study and get all of the details down. If you have the time and you put in a good work ethic, you can definitely get a good grade in this class. Brother Brau explains things really well and doesn't trick you.
He was a good professor. He really seemed to be loved by his students, I personally did not love nor hate him. I learned a lot and felt it was a pretty good balance of challenging and fun.

Good class. Not to hard if you try. I would recommend going over lecture videos and notes a lot because most of the test questions come from there. Overall it was a good class and Brother Brau is a good guy.

Prof. Brau is one of the best on BYU campus. He teaches information that is important for your life but also keeps it concise.  You know exactly what to study and how to get an A.  Don't take Finance 201 from anyone else!
Professor Brau is a great teacher. Very interesting and a great lecturer. I loved his spiritual thoughts! The material is tough though and it is important not to get behind.

Jim Brau was one of the most relatable professors that I've ever had.  He is always willing to answer questions and help in any way he can.  If you want an A, go to class and take good notes.  95% of his tests are based on the notes from class.  I highly recommend taking this course from Professor Brau.  If you do, get ready to go steroid mode!!!

I wish all classes were as organized as Brau's Fin201.  You get the grade you deserve.  It's an easy A if you just take down the notes he writes down and if you're diligent with your online readings before class.  Took it the first time, procrastinated the readings, and got a D.  Took the class again, read every chapter before class, got an A.

Professor Brau is a good teacher and gives great spiritual thoughts in every class. He's a high energy sort of guy which I liked and he's passionate about his subject. You definitely need to be a good note taker in his class, if you are you'll do fine.

Brau is an amazing teacher who works hard to clearly teach all the material you need to know to do well in the class, along with giving inspirational life lessons. If you pay attention in class you will do well on the tests.

Bro. Brau is a wonderful teacher. His lectures are entertaining and full of good info. He gives a spiritual thought everyday and a really helpful professional development moment. The tests are almost completely, (2730 Q's,) based on the notes he writes while he lectures so take good notes and be sure to understand what he talks about n class.

Pro. Brau is a real great guy.  His lectures are engaging and hilarious.  The subject matter and the way he approaches it are pretty simple so if you do the reading and have basic math skills and business background, it's relatively easy.  He also states what he's going to test on in lectures, so it's pretty useful to go.
Bro. Brau is an amazing man, that doesn't beat around the bush. Go to class, take good notes and you'll do fine on his exams. Exam 3 is a bit rough, but besides that you should do well.
I have trouble with this kind of stuff and although the class was difficult for me, if i had to take it again I would definitely take it from Brau!
Brau is awesome, nice guy, entertaining lectures. The tests are hard, there are four midterms, be prepared to do a lot of study outside of class to do well on the exams.
Loved this class and loved Professor Brau.  Homework load is minimal, and tests aren't too bad if you attend class and rewatch lectures in preparation.

Professor Brau is a great teacher but don't be fooled about how easy he makes the tests sound. They require a lot of studying. The key is being able to figure out how he writes the tests, something that I couldn't do. I'm still a little surprised that I did so poorly in exams given that everything in class was very clear to me.

If you're one of those people who gets annoyed by professors who care about their students enough to teach the material like a boss and but also share life lessons, then don't take this class from Brau. You'll ruin the environment in one of the truly amazing classes on campus.

Professor Brau is a phenomenal teacher. He explains concepts and teaches in a remarkable way. He is extremely intelligent and knows what he is doing. He also gives terrific spiritual thoughts. The class can be tough if you don't study but it is definitely worth it.

Dr. Brau's class was very clear from the beginning. It is super well organized and easy to follow. He is a good lecturer and I did not think the class was super hard, but at the same time I learned a lot.  He will give you roughly 27+ out of 30 midterm questions right in the class notes. The remaining question(s) are usually in the online vocab.
If you do want he asks, you'll get an A- or A.

I wish I would have taken this class before accounting or econ!  This class teaches you how to learn.  Bro. Brau doesn't waste your time and tells you exactly what you need to know for his tests and for the real world.  The tests are based on the class notes so be there on time every day.  He cares about his students and is always willing to help.

Professor Brau is a good teacher to take finance from. Reading the book is helpful, but the most important thing is to attend lecture. Professor Brau's tests come almost exclusively from his lectures, and he is always giving helpful "Come one guys, this is going to be on the test" comments. He cares and wants us to succeed in all aspects of life.
Make sure you go to class. If you don't attend class then you will have trouble. Brau is clear and concise. He does not try to trick you at all. If you know the material then you know it.
Great professor. He is awesome and very passionate about life and inspires you do do better. I would take him again.

Brother Brau is a great professor who cares a lot about his students which is what sets him apart. He does his best to make lectures exciting and entertaining. The material can be pretty tough so if you want get an A be prepared to work for it. Pay attention and take good notes during lectures because almost everything on tests is from class.

You can't really compare Dr. Brau to any other teacher you've ever had. He's passionate about Finance and passionate about people. One of the nicest men you'll ever meet and usually very clear on what to expect for tests. He really does set you up to succeed, you do have to put in the work though. Loved his spiritual thoughts and catch-phrases

He goes over everything on the test in-class, but he only explains things once, and not in any kind of depth.  He spends a disproportionate time in-class talking about extraneous things, but his tests are based (almost) entirely on material covered in class.

Brother Brau is very passionate about... well pretty much everything. I would absolutely suggest taking this class from him but you have to read the chapters before class if the lectures are going to have any sort of value. I love how simple the class was, not easy, but simple. Tough class but a good one.

Professor Brau is the man. You NEED to take Finance from him. You will learn the principles finance and won't kill yourself studying. He is very clear in what he expects. If you go to class, take good notes, do the reading and quizzes, then you will do well in the class and actually enjoy it. His tests are pretty easy if you take good notes.

Professor Brau is awesome. He does a great job of integrating spiritual things with secular things. Sometimes, he may come off as self righteous, but he really means well. It's a big class, so don't expect a lot of help from him. Ask the TA's or get in a study group. The material is not hard. However, there is a lot. Don't get behind.

Class itself is not hard, but he never actually goes over the problems. Rather the "problem days" involve him reading the problems rather than working them out with the class which is not helpful at all.

Brau is a solid professor. The nature of the large format classes make it tough to teach to specific questions in class, but there are TAs for that. That being said Brau is very knowledgeable and can speed through things specific to his expertise, so if you are new to finance be prepared to learn a lot of new lingo quickly.
Professor Brau is full speed. He is prepared for every lecture and is good at answering questions. You will not be bored in his 8:00 am lecture.

Brother Brau is a great teacher! He is funny and really shoes how all of the principles taught are very applicable to your own personal life and future. His class is hard though. You will have to study a lot but it is worth it.
Helped me learn how to study for tests. Really didn't like how much time he spent on spiritual thoughts and professional development.
He is up front with everything and very consistent. Brother Brau is one of the greatest human beings and he really loves people.

This was a great class! I would advise anyone to take it, that is willing to put forth some effort. If you don't like studying you will not do well, but isn't that why we are in school? Brau is very black and white in his expectations.
This class is hard. Brother Brau however makes it as clear as he can to help you succeed. Always does a spiritual thought and always very genuine. Awesome Professor

Prof Brau is a great professor, but the class itself is somewhat difficult. If you don't read, and don't practice throughout the semester the tests can be challenging. If you do keep up on the studying, the tests will be relatively easy. Great class, very inspirational.

Bro. Brau is one of the coolest people of all time. He's hilarious, kind, student friendly, straight forward, always there for you and filled with the Spirit. I would seriously take his class solely for his spiritual thoughts. For the class, be a good student. Go to class, read, study and you'll do fine.

Professor Brau gives you everything that you need to do well in his class. You decided how well you do based on your note taking and diligence in reading the chapters. If you do that, you will come to learn the material and do just fine. My problem was I had a heavy semester and was spreading myself a bit too thin.
If you take good notes, learn how he test, and study effectively for tests this class is relatively easy.

Brau does a great job of lecturing simply and efficiently. He knows that most of the people in his class don't want to major in finance and so all tests test how well you understand the concepts, not how good you are at algebra. It's one of the easier Bus Mgmt pre-rec's. Do the readings, use the lab, come to class, and don't do homework on Sunday.

Professor Brau is kind of like the Duracell bunny, the man never seems to run out of energy. This a great quality as it helps him maintain a brisk pace in lecture no matter what time of the day it is. There are not many assignments in this class, just chapter readings with quizzes. Professor Brau is great! He really got me interested in Finance and now I am going to major in it! 4 midterms, and some quizes. The midterms are doable, you just need to study EXACTLY what Brau tells you do! Its that easy to get the grade you want. Plus he is hilarious! HIGHLY RECOMMEND

Brother Brau is cool, and while I didn't always like how he presented the Finance profession on a pedestal and seemingly assumed that greatness in life can be measured by accomplishments, he's still a kind man. Dr. Brau is very concerned about the success of his students. He takes time to give spiritual thoughts and career development moments. Brau is one of the most life changing teachers I have ever had. Not only did he make finance interesting, but he is an amazing man who has helped me strengthen my testimony. Hands down I would recommend him over any other teacher.

Dr. Brau has amazing lectures. He is full of energy and is specific when it comes to getting you ready for an exam. He is prompt and willing in regards to feedback and help. Professor Brau really is one of the better lecturers at BYU and he makes his class enjoyable and uplifting. Brother Brau is fabulous! He definitely cares about the success of his students. Bro Brau is the most authentic genuine guy you will ever meet! Seriously the best professor I have ever had. He spells out EXACTLY what is on the test. I wish there was more time spent in class practicing problems. Lectures can be long but I always enjoyed the motivationalspiritual moments in the class. If you put time into the class, it is not bad. Some concepts are challenging and require more effort than others.
