The hardest part of the class was all the strange vocabulary he uses to describe very simple concepts. After I figured that out i got 100% on all of the tests.

Bro Brau is awesome and a really good man! I took his class at 8 a.m (and i am NOT a morning person) and he knows how to keep you awake. Go to class and you will know what will be on the tests. Study his notes well and you should at least get a B. He doesn't try to trick you on tests. Also he is so great at responding to emails.

Dude, Bro - This class was entertaining but he tends to use a bunch of acronyms for different equations, then switches the acronyms.  Tends to be a bit confusing.  If you go to class and study a decent amount, you can get an A no problem.   Oh and I'm not a big fan of his text book.  Reading isn't very helpful but the practice problems are good.

It is a hard class. Prof. Brau makes it very enjoyable and is very clear on what to study for tests. He helps you understand the importance of what you're learning. His Spiritual moments are fantastic and inspiring. I loved the class thank you Brother Brau! If you have the "bandwidth" and study how he tells you to, you will rock the tests.

Professor Brau's class is challenging and requires you to study for all tests. I did not enjoy his constant "bro" talk and he was unwilling to help me when I asked for help. His class was pretty average if you studied and  he did a good job on his "professional moments" but his unwillingness to help was very disappointing.
Brother Brau is extremely inspirational and energetic (even at 8:00am). He structures his exams exactly like the lectures, and is always willing to offer advice!

Bro. Brau is awesome! I'm not a finance major but I learned a lot in this class that will really help me in the future. He is really invested in his students and cares about their life long learning. I took this class at 8 am but never had a problem staying awake because Brau keeps the lecture moving and is entertaining. Take 201 with Brau!

This class was hard for me but that's more because I really don't like finance or accounting. Bro Brau's class was actually one of my favorites this semester. It was at 8 in the morning but I never had a problem wanting to go because of the way he teaches. His lectures are super clear cut on what to expect on the exam.

90% of your grade come from the tests and I am not the best test taker but I attended every class and took good notes. The tests come right from class notes. This semester he posted youtube videos that I would watch right before the tests because he goes through lecture quick. Never read the book, studied real hard though and did well in the class.

Jim Brau is great. I'd recommend him to any student looking for a clear cut understanding of finance at an entrance level. More than anything he keeps you entertained allowing for a heightened learning experience. Jim Brau for President!
Great teacher, really cares about his students. If you put in the time you will get a good grade.

Brau is an awesome professor who actually cares about how well you do in the class. His lectures are specifically tailored to help you prepare for the tests, so going to class is really important. There are 4 midterms and a final, but one of the lowest midterms gets dropped if you do the extra credit. I definitely recommend him as a professor!
He is a great teacher and really helps you understand what is required of you and really helps you study well for the exams.

In my mind- this is what a BYU course should be like. He is obviously very interested in developing finance skills in student sbut even more so interested in developing students. He cares about students' future so much and it is very evident by how he operates his class. The man!

Very straightforward, pretty easy class. As long as you read the assigned chapters and go to lecture, you'll know exactly what's on the tests. He also puts YouTube video up of his lectures that are very helpful.

Brother Brau's Fin 201 class was awesome! He is a very clear teacher and gives you exactly what you need to know for each test. Just know everything he tells you know in class and you will be fine. He is a very intense, inspirational, passionate, and funny teacher. He also gives AMAZING spiritual thoughts every class!!
Very straightforward, pretty easy class. As long as you read the assigned chapters and go to lecture, you'll know exactly what's on the tests.

Brother Brau is awesome! You will love his lectures. He makes the test sound like a breeze but they can be pretty difficult. His spiritual thoughts are the best! If you put in some hard work you'll get a good grade.

Great Finance class - SUPER organized and lets you know exactly what is on the test. You WILL have to work for your grade, but if you do the readings, go to class, stay awake and take notes, there is NO REASON you shouldn't get an A. Very clear cut. I don't know why people think this class is so hard. It's not.

Brother Brau was very clear in his lectures. Take notes in class and you will know all you need to in order to pass the 5 tests. He is super intense which i loved!! He keeps you awake and loves what he teaches. Reading the chapter is very important in order to follow his lecture.
Super good teacher. One of the easiest classes I've taken at BYU. I got 100% on every test. Just study what he goes over in class and you'll get an A.
If you go to class and take the time to study you will do fine

Dr. Brau is the man. He is crystal clear in his lectures on what's important and what you'll need in the future. His tests are straightforward and right from the notes in class. Plenty of resources to succeed. You should take it from him.

Brau understands that this is an entry-level class and gives you every resource to succeed. Tests are as straightforward as you will find at BYU and he wants his students to do well, but is also required to maintain the GPA of his class at a certain level by the business school. In short, this is a business pre-req. Not hard if you put in the work.
Brother Brau puts on a great lecture for each class. His tests are always tougher than the practice problems he goes over in class. Reviewing the class videos on YouTube helps a ton before each test
Go to class and go through class quizzes and review sheets and you'll do well. Good class.
Bro. Brau is a good teacher.  The majority of the grade is his tests.  If you pay attention in class and take good notes you will do well.

Professor Brau is the man! He teaches very clearly. Lectures are posted on YouTube so you don't have to go to class but of course it helps to actually be there. Lots of work but testS come straight from notes and lectures.
I never went to class and just watched the videos.  It cuts off a lot of time.
Brau is the most clear and enjoyable Professor I have had at BYU!
Great professor! HAVE to go to class!
Brau is a really energetic teacher. His lectures keep you engaged. This class is really simple if you have taken accounting 310, otherwise there is a lot of new content. Good class.
Very energetic teaching style which is great but uses finance language that can be confusing if you have no background in business.
Bro Brau is a great guy. The class is hard, but he makes the material about as easy As possible. Lectures are a bit long
If you follow the steps he outlines to get a good grade you will
Very inspired man, and I love his personality.  He is real with you, but if you don't go to class or take really good notes, you're done.
He follows the schedule precisely. He will tell you what is important to study for the exam every time.
Great professor but he's a bit full of himself... The class is graded solely on test scores. I wish there were other projects to buoy our grades. Good professorclass.
Brau's a good guy. Wants students to do well. Clear expectations. Take good notes, do the extra problems in the online textbook, don't sleep through class, and you should be okay.

I really respect Professor Brau's organization in his class and his dedication to making his class the best he can. He is always improving his class to best fit the needs of his students. Right up front he tells you how to be successful in his class and if you follow his steps you will most likely get an A. It takes studying but well worth it!

Brau was a very inspirational and dedicated teacher. For tests, he would explicitly announce the majority of the question material in class. Not to mention he recorded the classes and posted them online so you could review. Yet, I feel he geared the class too much on the tests and not enough on the actual material.
I think the ideas could be explained more clearly. Saying "intuition" itself is not enough. He is a good professor.
Prof. Brau is an excellent individual that goes above and beyond to help each student succeed at finance. His tests cover the material that was covered in class - there are no surprises.

Brother Brau is a good teacher. He loves his students and is willing to do just about anything to help them to succeed. That being said, he doesn't lower the expectations for his class. He expects you to work hard and master the material. You have to work for it to earn a good grade. This man will you make you better after taking his class.

Best class i think ive ever had. structured so well and the goal of the class is to help you learn and get an A on every test. best ever. Bro Brau was really impressive. probably one of the greatest professors because he wants you to succeed and he is so fair and doesnt want to weed anyone out. "I pity the fool" that doesnt take Brau for Fin 201.

Brau says he is really fair and his tests are "right off the notes" but they are very hard tests. You need to put in a lot of time to this class to do well. He is a great professors and his lectures are engaging. If you have to take Finance, take it from Brau.

Great Professor.  Says that the exams are straight forward but I always had a hard time getting an A on his exams.  Math is straight forward but concept questions were either easy or something you forgot to study.

Dr. Brau is hilarius, his comments help you stay awake during his class. The is very passionate about his life and finance. Expect expressive classes. Fin 201 is hard by itself but he gives you hints of what to study for the exam. But you really need to study for this class.
way good teacher! only wants us to be sucessful in life, and will go out of his way to back that up.

I don't understand what the big deal is? Everyone acts like this guy is the greatest professor on the planet and I don't get it. He cares way more about what his students think of him than about actually teaching. He wastes huge amounts of time in class ranting about things that are not important. I came to learn finance, teach it to me.
Oh plz... he is a nice guy, but his lecture is pretty disorganized. He does not teach concepts at all.

Brau's lectures are all over the place. He wastes at least 25 minutes per lecture talking about irrelevant topics. His personality is overwhelmingly strong and annoying, and he tries to act like that. The online ebook is confusing. However, the material is not that challenging. Studying with a group helped a lot.

He is a great guy. He talks about how important to understand the intuition behind the concepts, which he never teaches. I feel like I am just learning how to memorize well rather than a great deal in finance. Great guy, but I would not take this class from him if I have to take it again.

I don't think I've ever had a professor that I've liked as much as Brau.  He explains the material clearly and efficiently, and lets you know the important concepts to study. His lectures are amazing and he's hilarious. I wish I could take every class from him!
This class takes time and effort, but is not too bad.  Take the time to study before exams and don't cram.

He is super clear and knowledgeable about finance. Go to class, study the notes, and you'll do fine. His lectures were very enlightening. Go to textbookjudge. com to hear the scoop on the textbook though!

Great Professor! My wife took this class twice from the other two professors who teach this class and I can say without a doubt that Brau is the best of the pack. I actually enjoyed going to lecture, and felt that the material was as clear as it could be to someone hearing about it for the first time. Watch the videos and read if you want the A.
Great Professor! Study the notes from class and you will do fine.

Brother Brau is a great guy. He gives great spiritual thoughts. He explains clearly, does practice problems in class so we can understand and answers every question. Just make sure you do your reading before class to prepare for lectures and take good notes and you will be fine on the tests. Final was easy if you know your stuff.

People rave about Brau, but I personally don't get the hype.  His lectures are hard to follow- and are constantly interrupted with 'spiritual thoughts'.  The textbook is online and written by him and other BYU finance professors.  The text needs work- more videos and better clarity.  I would advise trying someone else.

This class doesn't have much homework which was nice. Only 13 online quizzes that you can take until you get 1010, and they are for your benefit. If you don't like taking tests I wouldn't recommend this teacher. Test grades make up 90% of your grade. However, if you go to class and know the notes well, you can get a good grade on the test.

Bro. Brau definitely knows what he is doing.  I really enjoyed this class, but it's not the easiest class at BYU.  He changed his class structure entirely and now it's a lot better than it has been in the past.  Lots of midterms, but make sure you take good notes and get the free points on open note and book quizes and you'll be fine.

Lectures are long, but he does a good job of breaking it up with useful insights on professional development and spiritual thoughts (inspired me to not do homework on Sunday). You can tell he cares about you. He walks you through what to expect on the tests, but aside from reading through your notes, there's not a lot of practice problems to do.

Can be a good buddy but not a good professor. Tests are easy as long as  you memorize all random stuff. I learned how to memorize rather than finance. Spiritual thoughts aren't based on the spirit but on his emotion. Lectures are not organized, and his hand writing isn't readable. He worshiped his former TA, so maybe find him for help or something.
I love Brother Brau for his spiritual thoughts, but his class was confusing. I wish he would use learning suite to keep a schedule and post gradessyllabus.

Professor Brau really cares.  If he talks about something in class it is going to be on the test. Just make sure you know the notes and you will do just fine. He does professional development moments that really are helpful. Take advantage of all of the resources he gives and you will get a good grade! I recommend Professor Brau would take again
Professor Brau makes finance enjoyable. Good class. The worst part: having a midterm exam right before the comprehensive final.

He is an awesome professor.  He makes going to class entertaining.  Not an easy A, but if you do the reading and take your time on the quizzes (you can submit them as many times as you want for a better grade) then you will understand everything you need to know.
Not a fan of the subject, but thought this was a good class. Just put effort into it and you will be fine.

Brau is a great instructor but he his tests are pretty hard.  If you can understand the intuition behind everything that he teaches, you will do great!  If you just have a basic understanding of the concepts however and do not take great notes on everything that he says and writes, then the class is very hard.

Brau is incredibly inspirational. He has a spiritual thought every class period, does professional development and is just amazing. I literally teared up in his class often, more than my religion classes. That being said, finance is really tough and if you don't study consistently you'll get behind. He's very straightforward though.

His lectures were awesome! He drops some spiritual bombs on you as well during class which really help out. I like that he tells you how to succeed on his tests. If you do all the things he tells you to then you will do great in his class.

Professor Brau is a great professor. You will always be entertained In his class while still learning about finance. He tries to make the class easy and offers a ton of help if you are smart enough to go to the tutoring lab.  He can be hard to understand sometimes because he'll abbreviate terms that we are just barely learning.

This class wasn't necessarily easy but if you put in the time to study the material it can be an easy class.  Professor Brau does a great job of making sure that you know what to expect from the class and on the tests.  He is extremely fair and is an engaging lecturer.  His spiritual thoughts were amazing!

Best professor I've had at BYU. He actually cares about his students--go figure. NO GAMES, he tells you exactly what will be on the test. Spiritual thoughts are on point and actually thoughtful and poignant--again, go figure. I'd take from him again.

Professor Brau is a great guy. I loved his spiritual thoughts and professional development moments. I thought I was going to like finance, but i really just found it confusing and wasn't really interested in it. There are a lot of termsacronyms to know as well as a lot of equations you have to have either memorized or know very well intuitively.
Nice Guy!

I love Brother Brau as a teacher, he really cares about his students. It was the most spiritual secular class I have ever taken. He teaches well, he lives for the students. The only problem is the reading online that he writes. It is junk. Going to class is way better than reading. Brother Brau should teach religion too!

Don't expect this course to be easy.  But Bro. Brau is the man.  He is very good at explaining difficult concepts.  Studying for the tests is a little difficult so MAKE SURE TO TAKE GOOD NOTES, and study in a group.  He says that from day one, listen to him.  He really does want you to get an A in his course.  You do need to put the work in though

Loved the teacher, loved the class lectures, not a big fan of the subject most lessons, but definitely glad i took it. I thought it was a TON of work & took a lot of time, but it's useful stuff. Overall, I enjoyed it.

Prof. Brau is a good guy. He really cares about his students. As far as the course goes, you definitely want to go to class and keep up with the reading and quizes. If you do all this, you should be able to get a decent grade if not an A.

Brau is a good person to maybe talk to or hang out with outside of class, but as an educator, he's probably one of the worst I've had. Lectures are choppy with him always breaking them up, he's the only professor that makes you memorize the formulas and key terms of every chapter, and the reading is needlessly confusing. Take at your own risk.

Wastes so much time with his stupid "spiritual" thought. Floods your inbox with irrelevant e-mails. Text doesn't explain material well. Brau is obsessed with himselfopinions. Confuses emotions with the spirit. Take it from someone else at all costs. Hated this class more than anything, would rather take accounting 3 times than another lecture.

Worst Professor, no worst teacher I have ever had. I hated going to class because his lectures are so long, and unclear. Midterms were rough, and final midterm was 3 days before the comprehensive final. The text he and his partners wrote doesn't explain the subject well enough for the text quizzes. Brau is annoying as heck. Take at SL Center.
Dude is awesome.

I liked Brother Brau. His class was very straight forward. I just didn't do well because I didn't ever give myself enough time to read through the book. It is super important that you do that if you want to pass. Don't take this class if you're really busy during a semester. You need a lot of time.

Good Professor. If you are all about that A then you can get it here, but it's not a cake walk. You really need to be at class, take notes, and need to do the reading, but it really isn't that much. Minimal time commitment can get you a easy B, an extra hour a week will give you an A. Super helpful and provides every resource you need to succeed.

Go to class and take the best notes of your life. The reading is very beneficial but the lecture notes  life. Brau likes to yack and show off a little but he's not terrible. Just be prepared to work for your grade.

Bro. Brau is very straightforward, he wants you to pass his class and tells you very clearly what you need to do in order to pass. Read the materials, do the pre class quizzes, and take good notes. Study the in class notes, he posts them all. If you do all that you can do well in this class. If you ditch out or don't study, you won't do well.

Isn't lying when he says that what he covers in the lecture is the vast majority of what is tested.  Hard to have a relationship with everyone in a class of 800+ students but he goes above and beyond what most professors would.  Spiritual thoughts and professional development moments are great class breaks.  Not an easy class but worth it for sure.
awesome!

If you go to class and have the time to devote to Finance, you'll do well. Br. Brau TELLS YOU EVERYTHING TO STUDY. It's possible to get an A even if you're not a finance person. Grades are all quizzes and tests, but quizzes are open note and you can take them as many times as you want. Br. Brau is a wonderful person who cares about his students.
Not an easy class. Your work will pay.

Dr. Brau is a very sincere teacher. Going to his classes was more spiritually uplifting than a BYU Elder's Quorum. But the textbook is kind of annoying, and the tests are hard, like everything in the Marriott School. I'm glad I took Finance from him and no one else, but that didn't really make it any easier.

Want help? TAs always available in lab.  He is very busy, hard to get face time, though he responds to email.  Has taught this class for years, in lectures he knows exactly what material to cover to ensure preparation for stock tests.  95% of test straight from lecture. Do readingquiz before class, show up, pay attention: no reason to not get 90%+
Spiritual thoughts and Professional Development make it all worth it.  Write as much as you can in the lecture and get ready to be inspired.

Brau's class was fantastic. He is very enthusiastic, his notes are detailed and cover exactly what is on the tests. Every class includes professional development and a spiritual thought. I would definitely recommend this class to anyone taking finance.

I don't really like finance, but Bro. Brau gets me all fired up about it by the end of class!  The tests are hard, but if you put in enough studying and know the concepts well you can get an A.  His spiritual thoughts and professional development moments are super helpful.  Brau really cares about his students.

First things first, you can get an "A", if you take good notes and utilize the TAhelp desk. Second, do the MyEducator quizzes to solidify your understanding. C'mon, the guy wants you to succeed bc he even lets you drop an exam score! And last, this class was one of the most spiritual courses I've taken at BYU. His in-class messages are impactful.

The thing I liked best about Brother Brau is that he recognized this was a 200 level class so he taught to that level. It was difficult because it was finance, but it was the basics and there are plenty of ways to get help if you need it. Study the way he tells you too. and consider recording lectures and taking good notes. that helped
Tough class, but he tells you want is on the tests', so just study and put in the time to get the grade you desire.
If you take good notes in class and study the text book practice problems, you will be great and learn a lot.
He provides lots of tools to help you study. Still hard stuff.

Brau is a great teacher and really wants to help his students succeed in all aspects of their lives. This is not an easy class. A good grade is well earned. Pay attention in lectures and do all you can to practice problems and know the why(intuition). Pay attention to the smallest details as well. Short tests  costly wrong answers.

Make sure you attend class since A LOT of the questions on the test come from class. Also, get into a study group immediately. While the class was hard, Brau obviously wanted all his students to pass. If I had to take FIN 201 again, I would definitely take it from Brau.

Professor Brau is a great professor. Listen to him and take good notes. Tests are based mostly on notes but reading the book really helps. Tests are kind of difficult because they ask for details that you don't always write down. Overall a great professor and class. Love his spiritual thoughts and career development ideas he mixes into lectures.
This was a great class. Prof. Brau explains things very clearly, although his hand-writing is hard to decipher sometimes

He has awesome spiritual thoughts, and is really dedicated to his students and will do whatever it takes to help you. At the same time the course uses a lot of unfamiliar that seem to change. There are three ways to say everything and he will use them all.

Prof. Brau is an excellent teacher. I really enjoyed my time in his class and learning from him. Most of his test questions come directly from the notes (he tells you that before every test), and it's true! Truly, an excellent man and teacher. The classes are big, but he knows how to keep your attention. Great class.

I honestly loved this class. Brau cares about his students and will help you when ever you need it. His lectures are funny and inspirational. Everything he says is important, if you pay attention and take good notes you will do well.  Definitely would suggest this him as a professor! Learned so much and had a great time doing it. BEST CLASS!

He focuses on the intuition needed to understand the material and helps you apply the course to your life.  He wants you to succeed, and tells you exactly how to do it.  Is down to Earth and gives great spiritual messages every class.  The textbook is needed for reading and to take quizzes.
Brother Brau is always willing to help you and provide multiple avenues to get the assistance you need. Tests very accurately represent what is gone over in class and in readings.
this class was rough seems like it was completely tests graded. the class is about intuition. everything you learn in this class can be done on excel.
Good class. Appreciated the spiritual thought in class each day.

Bro Brau really knows his stuff.  If you go to class and take good notes, you will pass.  If not, its going to be a lot harder.  A good amount of the test covers items talked about in class as well.  I enjoyed his lectures and he answers students questions very well.

you should read text book before attending class, or you will lost. 4 midterms, quizzes (which you can receive 10 points out of 10 every time) and final. he is nice, spiritual and willing to help but what we learn in the class is not easy. however, i bet you'd better take this class if you have to!
I really enjoyed it.

Brother Brau is an extraordinary teacher. He cares so much about his students and is genuinely interested in their success. He is so well organized that if you take good notes  you'll be extremely prepared for exams. If you read the text book before hand, you'll be more apt to take good notes.

I think the only reason I didn't fail this class is because Brau really wants us to succeed.  He let us drop our lowest exam score, and gave us extra credit.  There is almost always an open lab with at least two TA's in there to help.  And he organized an entire list of personal one-on-one tutors.  Sometimes he goes a little fast though.
We had 4 midterms and the opportunity to drop one of them. He curved the class really well. His lectures are AMAZING!

Brau is an amazing professor. - honestly, I don't feel any qualms with saying he is one of  the best I've had at BYU. His class is worth taking and he teaches you real, applicable skills you will use no matter what your major. That being said, his class is not as easy as he insists it is - you will have to study quite a bit to get a good grade.

He makes fun of Econ 110 all the time saying how his class is easier, I have a high A in Econ this semester and am praying for a B in in Brau's class. He gives wonderful spiritual thoughts and is full of energy but that's were things end. Test are strait notes and zero text book so record the lectures! Has a great curve at the end of the class.

Bro Brau works really hard to make his class an experience that students can at least learn in if not enjoy. He's super clear about what's going to be on his tests, and helps you prepare for them as long as you pay attention in class. You'll definitely have to work at it, but if you put in the effort you'll get a good grade.

Bro Brau takes his lectures very serious. Be ready to take awesome notes, when he says "everything that is on the test is from the notes" he isn't kidding. Record the lectures and go back through to review the notes after the fact. He makes class interesting and fun with Spiritual Thoughts, and Professional Developments. Take this class!

Mr. Brau is so smart that his ideas go all over the place like a snow storm. It is impossible to understand his arguments if you have not taken at least 3 finance classes prior to his, because linguistically his lectures do not make much sense. You have to heavily rely on TA and other sources for a decent grade.

Great teacher-learning the principles and equations comes from the book, but he definitely says some helpful things in lectures.  Interested in financial literacy and spiritual growth of students.  He's a wonderful teacher.

Great teacher.  He incorporates spiritual and financial practicality into his lectures more that the actual equations, which I thought was great.  Most of the actual learning of equations and principles is done individually through the online textbook.  Appropriate amount of work for a 200 level class-really manageable.
Awesome guy. Gotta pay attention in class. Great spiritual thoughts. Grading is strict but fair. Very excited about subject matter. Make friends and form study groups. Don't sleep

FIN 201 is a big class, but Jim Brau has made this class really inspirational and fun. This class doesn't have heavy workload, but you have to spend extra hours studying if you really want to do well in the exams.

He is a great professor, who is full of energy and charged to teach finance. Besides focusing on secular things, he brings in spiritual thoughts that help students gain a view of the bigger picture of life.
Really good lectures and make time the just fly by. If you pay real close attention and take good notes, you'll do fine. He does a great job of testing both the vocab and concepts and formulas.
Jim is the MAN! Finance is not an easy subject, but he makes it enjoyable! Also, his tests come DIRECTLY from the class notes. SO GO TO CLASS! Get ready to crunch some numbers people.

I love Brother Brau. I missed too many quizzes because he didn't use learning suite this semester and it was easy to forget about them, so I'm not going to get an A. Overall, he's a great professor and he genuinely inspired me throughout the semester. He puts a TON of effort into preparing his lectures!
The spiritual thoughts and professional development moments are great at breaking up the lecture and are better than most here.  Classes move pretty fast so make sure you do the extra work online.
Great class. Be sure to attend the lectures. 95% of test questions are taught in class. Do the reading ahead of time. Study with a group from day one. Plenty of help to those who need it.
Jim Brau is a boss. He has more energy as a man in his 40's than I have at 23. He is always getting into it and lives in steroid mode. Do all the homework and take his advice and you'll do great

If you need to take a finance class and are not planning to major in finance, this is a great class for you! Prof. Brau does a great job of making complex finance principles applicable to your daily life, and his lectures are interesting and inspirational. Readings are essential, don't depend entirely on his lectures. Prepare to be uplifted!
Great teacher! Gives great feedback

This was a great class, but you have to go to class.  If you take really good notes from  class and then memorize them for the tests, you will at least get a 90% on them.  There are 4 midterms which is nice because they are broken up so much between chapters, but bad because you are always studying for a test.  He is a great teacher though.

Jim Brau is the most inspirational professor I've had at BYU. The content in Finance 201 is easy and intuitive (compared to my engineering classes) but Brau's teaching is often not (i.e. lacking clarity). My advice: Learn the equations in the book well.  Try solving the problems without using your business calculator.

Jim Brau is one of the most inspirational professors I've had at BYU.  The content in Finance 201 is really easy and intuitive (compared to my engineering classes,) but Brau's explanations of concepts are often not easy and intuitive. I recommend: learn the equations from the online text well.

He is a good teacher, and the lectures are really clear as long as you come to class prepared. If you don't come prepared you might as well not attend at all. In short, with enough effort success will come.

This class has so much information to remember. I do not think it was as hard as Accounting 200, but still pretty hard. If you work hard, attend class, go to lab help desks, work in groups, and study your butt off you will receive an A or B. Professor Brau is awesome in my opinion and has to be my new favorite. His lectures prepare you for the exam
99% of the test questions come from the class notes. If you take good notes and know your notes for the tests you will be just fine. Great spiritual thoughts

The class is kinda tough, mainly because you don't have a lot of homework points to pad your grade - most of your grade is based on how you do on the tests.  The tests can be tough, but Brother Brau will literally tell you all of the information that will be on them.  He is funny and his spiritual thoughts are wonderful.
If you are going to take FIN 201 take it from Brau. The tests are tough but literally the entire test comes out of his in class notes. He  does everything he can to make it  as easy as possible
Bro. Brau is an awesome professor. Very passionate about finance and the success of his students. Can be tricky but if you go to class and take notes you will be just fine.

Jim Brau is great! He's funny, he teaches well, he's SUPER nice! Very spiritual and inspiring as well. I want to take his class again and do better. I would take it with him again. The text book is online, so its cheaper and easier to use. Great teacher, great class!
Always tell what's on the test. No surprises on the test.

This class is certainly not easy by any means. You have to work HARD to get a good grade in this class. However, passing is not difficult once you figure out that the test questions come right out of the notes. Professor Brau is very passionate about what he teaches, and his spiritual thoughts are amazing. If you put in the effort you will be fine!
Brother Brau truly wants his students to succeed and does a good job of telling you what will be on the test.  As long as you attend lectures and take good notes to study from you will do great.

Loved Brau. He's a blunt goofball. So passionate about finance, and more importantly keeping the gospel number one in our lives. He kicks it into high gear for his lectures so gear up and be ready to take notes--"all answers from tests come from notes.."
Brother Brau is the best, that's all you need to know.

Prof. Brau is one of the most inspirational professors at BYU.  You have to work for his "A" but his spiritual moments help with tolerance sitting through a 1 hour lecture.  He gives you all the resources you need to be successful.  He does offer extra credit and a curve in his class.  Study well and you will be rewarded.

This is one of the most practical classes I have taken while attending BYU. Jim Brau is crystal clear and consistent in both lectures and grading policy. And to top it all off, he brings the spirit to every lecture!
He is a really good energetic professor. He teaches with clarity and simplicity. I really enjoyed learning from his lectures.

Brau's the man. I always felt on top of the world coming out of his classes. He made everything very clear. I'd suggest ACC 200 and BUS M 241 before FIN 201 to make sure you have some basic business knowledgevocab. Finance is a monster all on its own, but Brau makes it fun and straight-forward. Spiritual thoughts were my favorite part of class.

My main struggle with the information in this class was the vocabulary. I feel like we would talk about a term by one name for class and then they would be a synonym on the test. Therefore, I felt lost with the same material just because of the vocabulary.

Jimmy B is the man.  Finance is pretty tough but he makes it pretty clear and makes sure you know exactly what is on the test.  You have to do the reading and you have to study but it's not too hard to get an A if you put in the time and TAKE GOOD NOTES.

Positives: Captivating lectures, clear explanations, extremely confident with the material, truly cares about students' success, good textbook, fair tests, manageable workload, great spiritual thoughts Negatives: Moves a little too quick sometimes, very jargon heavy class where lots of words mean the same thing and that can become confusing.

Brau is a fantastic professor! Very clear about what is covered on the test. Cares a lot about his students and wants him to pass. Overall, it is just an extremely tough class. Brau tries to make it as straightforward as possible. It is not the professor that is hard, it is just simply the subject matter!! Brau is hilarious and keeps it exciting.

Brau is great.  I would gladly take another class from him if I was going into finance.   If you are not a natural genius you will not do well unless you do the homework (and understand it) before class.

Professor Brau is a high energy teacher that has the ability to answer specific questions and cover all the detail needed each lecture. Here's the key to an A-take great notes, go to every class- he literally tells you 90% of the test through the notes you'll take. I learned a lot of real life finance examples and really appreciated that.

Prof. Brau is probably one of the best teachers I have had at BYU. He's very clear with what his expectations are and will show you how to do 90% of the problems on all the tests in class. His lectures are AMAZING and his enthusiasm keeps Finance interesting. If you go to class and really try to understand the concepts, an A is definitely doable.

Brau is an amazing professor. The class is tough - finance is very complex and there's a lot of details to learn. As long as you read the chapters and go to class, you will do fine. If you don't, you will fail. It's that simple - Brau is not about the tricks, he just expects you to learn the content.

Professor Brau is very energetic, caring, and wants to help students succeed in his class and in life. He covers the material clearly and prepares students well for his tests. I thought the class was rather easy. My one complaint is that while I love his spiritual thoughts, I wish he spent less time on tangents and more on in depth problems.

Finance 201 covers a lot of information that is new to most students, but Brother Brau explains it all so well. His expectations are very clear and you know exactly what you need to do to succeed. Study the way he tells you to study and you'll do well.
Make sure that you take good notes and you will pass. The tests are exactly the class notes just make sure that you can do all the problems on myeducator and you'll be fine.

Professor Brau is amazing! He truly loves his students and he gives you the resources you need to succeed. It's difficult material, and you'll have to work a lot if you want to succeed. Keep up on the readings and quizzes, go to class, and use the TA lab. It can be a lot of material, but he helps you know exactly what to study.

Bro  B is such a great teacher!  For example, when we had a substitute I felt like I was lost and confused on the subject matter, but the next day when Brau was back it was like the clouds left and the light of clarity shone through.  I can say that he truly cares about the success, spiritual and professionally, of his students.  Take FIN 201 w B!

GREAT PROFESSOR! He has really toned down the course from years past (according to him). Gives great spiritual thoughts everyday. Gives you everything you need in order to get an A. If you know the notes from each class (1-2 pages per chapter, very strait forward) you will get an A in the class. Funny guy and very personable.
Professor Brau is great he will make you work for you r "A" but if you do what he tells you to do then you can get it.

I'll sum this up by saying that I'm an international student and after my first year at BYU I was put in probation right away. But Jim Brau has completely changed my life and the way I see college. Believe in destiny, God or whatever Jim Brau simply changed my life and he'll change yours to the better in every way. He's the epitome of faculty @ BYU

He is so enthusiastic, he makes class as exciting as finance can be. He is really passionate about his students and does a great job at making everything as easy to understand as possible. He is more than fair in grading and gives opportunities for extra credit. He has spiritual thoughts that are actually applicable and life changing. Love him

Great teacher, tries to help students understand and teaches in a clear way. If you miss class you won't pass the Tests. Lots of reading in order to understand sub topics. Just do the reading and practice problems and you'll be able to pass this class. Also takes breaks during class for professional development moments and spiritual thoughts.
Great guy. Hard class. If not a business major I would do personal finance instead of 201.

Brofessor  Braunfels is an inspiration. His class is tough, but the challenge is worth it. All of the resources are given to you to succeed, so failure is by your own hand. Wouldn't have chosen another professor, especially because of his spiritual moments.
Great Class. Good structure. Well taught.

Brau has a vested interest in  his students. He isn't looking to kill you with his tests or lectures, all he wants is that you learn the material. All of the test questions come from his lectures and the class is designed so that you can bomb a test and still do well in it. It is fast paced but extremely beneficial and I would take it again.

Really inspirational teacher. Great lecturer. Shows you how to succeed in his class. I would highly recommend reading the chapters before class if you want to do well and be able to follow along in class.

Bro Brau is a great professor that wants his students to do well.  Tests are challenging.  Even after going to every class, doing the reading, and taking good notes.  Very fun and entertaining class, best Fin 201 teacher at BYU.
Awesome class! Take good notes on everything he writes down or mentions will be on the test. This will save your life. Lectures are perfect to help you understand what you need to know.

Great professor. Super helpful. Motivated by the right reasons. He wants to help us become better people, not just teach the material. He knows his stuff and if you pay attention in class, take good notes, and follow his study advice you'll get an A... it's that simple.

Amazing! I wish that he would teach EVERY one of my classes! He tells you EXACTLY (by means of topics) what will be on his exams and that is how you know WHAT to study.  If you skip class -- you better pray to whatever deity that you pray to that you have someone who can give you their perfect notes, otherwise plan on a D+.  Plan on 5-7 hrs hwweek
Bro. Brau is an awesome teacher and is very inspiring. Go to class and do what he says to do to study for the tests. Tests are every three chapters. If you put in the work, you'll do fine.

He's an awesome guy and really funny. But the class is pretty had. He moves crazy fast through the material and if you're a slow learner you'll get drowned. It takes quite a bit of study and preparation for the tests, which are pretty hard. But if you understand the notes and readings you should do well. Just be prepared to study a lot.

Brother Brau was great! Easily one of the most enthusiastic and relate-able professors that I have had. He lays out the course very specifically and really wants you to succeed. If you want to do well then go to class and take good notes. Seriously almost everything comes out of the notes. Bro. Brau is very spiritual as well. I would take again!

Bro. Brau is a great professor. He has reduced the course work to provide only the most important things, there is no busy work. Just like any class attendance is necessary to succeed in the class and you must be willing to give it a good effort. He tells you everything that will be on the tests through lectures and provides tons of extra support.
I really enjoyed his lectures. The class is tough, but what can you expect for a business class. I think ill pull off an A.

Bro. Brau is really invested in the material he teaches and his spiritual messages are awesome.  He is extremely straightforward about what he will test on, about 95% of the questions come from the notes.  There are  always a couple questions where you actually have to do some critical thinking, but an A is definitely feasible.

Brother Brau is a great teacher. His spiritual thoughts are great and really add to the class. His tests are straightforward and as long as you go to the class and read the textbook you should be fine.
Great spiritual thoughts, lots of enthusiasm. Tests are easy, and required minimum textbook reading, only a few of the key terms as long as you attended class.

The textbook was necessary for me to understand what was going on during class, but 95% of the test comes straight out of the notes from class. Brau is a great teacher, but finance just isn't my cup of herbal tea so I had to work for a B.
Excellent Teacher that always keeps things interesting. He is very clear with what will be on the test and will give you all you need to do well. I highly recommend him as a teacher.

Bro Brau is a hard core bro. His spiritual thoughts are the best I've had while at BYU and really helped build my testimony. Take advantage of the practice problems and do the readings before class. BTW he's hilarious and I gave him the chili pepper just because I know he wants it.
This class was really tough.  The coursework is pretty heavy, and the lectures were very confusing.  Bro. Brau is a great guy, but gets off on tangents very easily.

Professor Brau is the most amazing teacher I have ever had. He is my reason for loving finance. He truly cares about his students. He is clear on what will be on the tests and loves to see his students succeed. I would recommend him over all other professors I have ever had.

I haven't taken this class enough to tell whether this class is easy or not, but I love his enthusiasm and his passion. I can feel his 'hotness' in his heart filled with love and passion as an instructor
Great Professor. I am glad I had Dr. Brau

Two words: BEAST MODE. That describes Jimmy B-loved his class, extremely entertaining, also helps you out a ton so you can succeed. I will be forever grateful that I took his class- I studied 10 hours a week outside of class and got an A. Don't expect to be any different.

LOTS and LOTS of material covered in this course. That's the nature of FIN 201. Brau covers so much and often goes WAY too fast. But with the amount of material there isn't much he can do. Be prepared to study outside of class and attend EVERY class or you'll fall way behind. HW's are super good practice and Tests can be hard.

I loved Brother Brau's spiritual messages every class! He also had a lot of valuable professional development advice. His personal finance bootcamp days are super useful, even if you're not interested in studying finance at all. This class can be a little confusing if you don't do the readings before class. Overall a great professor!

Dr. Brau really cares about the students.  He is a great man.  He loves finance but goes off on too many tangents that take away from what is being taught.  This made the course very confusing.  He needed to focus more on what was being taught.  There was a lack of practice problems.  If you are able to teach yourself, this is a great class.
His Lectures are really good but exams are tough

Professor Brau is a great guy. He's hilarious. The class isn't that hard if you read the textbook and do the practice problems. He gives lots of extra credit opportunities and teaches a lot about personal finance, since most of the students aren't finance majors. Probably one of the most practical classes I've ever taken.

Great teacher, knows his stuff, and provides every opportunity you for you to learn the material. Literally goes through the answers to nearly every test question during the review. I am not a business major but I came to class, did the reading, and got an A.
This Professor is very willing to help and tries hard to be a good instructor. However, The subject matter can be a bit tricky at times.

Dr. Brau is easily one of the best professors I have ever had. His classes are structured very well, and help to keep you attentive. He adds spiritual elements to his class, and you can tell that he truly cares for all of us as students. If you stay attention, attend class, and work hard, you can make it through his class.
The material in this class was interesting to me but I don't think Bro. Brau added to my learning experience. I learned everything I did by reading the book and working on my own.

Brother Brau is a great teacher, but his class is also very difficult. There are many formulas to remember and a lot overall to keep in mind. That being said, Brother Brau is a great guy and a great teacher. He includes bits of fun and helps you become a better person in all areas of life, not just finance.

He is an enthusiastic teacher and is passionate about the material. When he taught it, it seemed easy enough, but then I would go home and get lost in the homework. A really difficult class, even if you study hard. I recommend using the lab and getting to know the TAs. That is what got me through.
Brau is a brilliant man, but an extremely difficult teacher.
This class is difficult but very applicable to the real world.
Super cool teacher, intersting class. Do your homework. Pray before each test. A lot.

This class is used as a filter to see who will get into the Finance/Business program. It's the only intro finance class you can take but the interest doesn't seem to be in giving the students an introduction to finance as much as sifting out the students who will make it into the program.

Great Professor and genuinely about his students. Big class so easy to get lost. I'd recommend getting some friends to study with. This is a hard class to do on your own. Big time commitment! Don't take it unless you have to. If you're going to take though, go with Brau. Take notes and do all the assignments and you may make it through.
He really cares and is a very enthusiastic teacher. If you need help, he will be there for you. It is just hard to follow his notes in lecture. You will need to attend class.

I found Brother Brau a really good teacher, even though Finance is a really hard subject. His tests are hard, but if you pay attention to his review sessions, take notes during class and study hard, you should be good. He always has time to do a spiritual thought, which was always the best part of the class.
This class is really hard. It is based heavily on your personal learning outside of class. The class lectures are helpful but they do not help if you have not read outside of class. Work hard!!
This class is really hard. It is based heavily on your personal learning outside of class. The class lectures are helpful but they do not help if you have not read outside of class. Work hard!

This was a hard class. It was very intensive on self learning. The class lectures are very clean and organized, but it is crucial you learn yourself. The grade is directly related to your work effort.

Brau is very energetic and enthusiastic about all of his students learning even in lectures with 500 of them.  He's entertaining, spiritual, and a good teacher, but keep up with the textbook for each class period, because his finance 201 class is not a cake walk.

Great Professor and I enjoyed the lectures. Plan on really reading the online textbook and going to the TA lab to better understand the material. The lectures are rushed but if you read chapters before class you will better understand material. I loved his spiritual messages!

Brau is a fantastic teacher, seriously one of the best I have ever had. The material is pretty heavy but he teaches it well and understandably. Plus, he always splits up class with a spiritual thought which I loved. Like he says, if you always come to class, take good notes, and put in the time, you will do well in this class.

Brother Brau is a good teacher. He knows what he is doing with finance. It's always hard to be in a class with 1000 people, but he does a good job of managing it. MAKE SURE TO GO TO THE TA HELP DESK! I only went a couple times and I regret not going more. They help you so much! You do have to work hard in this class if you want to get a good grade.
Great class, just make sure you do your homework and also stay on top of assignments. Great material, great stuff to take to the workplace, but this is NOT an easy class. Great professor.

First...Bro/Dr Brau is great!  He's very enthusiastic & high energy (it's not a facade, it's who he is). He cares about students, learning, and his profession - FINANCE.  You can't just memorize ratios/equations.  You need to learn the intuition.  Brau teaches this.  The lectures are great & the textbook reading is necessary!

A rigorous and fast paced course.  My greatest difficulty was with his teaching style; Brau lectures a lot and solves problems very fast, making it difficult to grasp how to get them right.  Pre class reading is a must to understanding what happens during class.  Practice problems are also useful but can vague in their explanations.

Bro Brau is a great person but He doesn't write clear notes and  he doesn't teach that well because he abbreviates his notes and talks to fast. I absolutely loved his Spiritual Thoughts. Definitely read the chapter before class so you can understand. KNOW the vocabulary to understand lectures
All he does is tell war stories full of superlatives and hyperbole.  He's conservative in the gospel but sincere and well meaning, but I simply have a different personality than him.
I had a hard time in this class. He doesn't really teach. I basically had to teach myself using the textbook and TA's. Good luck
Professor Brau is great.  If you are going to take Finance 201 take it from him!  If you do the reading attend class and do all of the practice problems you will do well in his class.
Brau wants everyone to do well. It's a hard class but he will do what he can to make sure you pass if you put in the work.

Prof. Brau is a great professor. I think that he really cares about his students a lot which is impressive considering the large class size (JSB auditorium). This is class is difficult, try to learn the material instead of just doing the hw.
hard to learn, but it was worth it.
I loved taking finance from Brau! You can tell he really cares for his students and he does his best to explain concepts from the text. I really enjoyed his spiritual thoughts as well!

Brau is the man! His classes were great, entertaining and I learned a lot! He's very fair, and while I didn't find the class easy it wasn't too hard. Key is taking great notes, really putting in time studying, and going in to check answers on the excel assignments. If you need to take Finance take it from Brau! Spiritual thoughts were great too!

Dr. Brau is the best professor I have had at BYU. The material in the class is a bit difficult, but the system Brau has set up is wonderful and will get to really master the material. If you go to class, take notes, and do the homework completely and correct wrong answers, and A is very do-able.
Great focused teacher

Brau is a wonderful guy. He is very passionate about this subject. My major was shoved into the business school and it's not in any means my strong suit, but you can really tell that he loves what he does. His spiritual thoughts are awesome. I liked him as a teacher, and if I had a talent for finance, I'm sure I would have loved the class too.

Passionate, energetic teacher with wonderful lectures and spiritual thoughts. His attitude is inspiring. You will have to focus to make most of the learning happen on your own, however. If you have studied the material well beforehand, the classes do a good job reinforcing the material.

Pro. Brau is an awesome guy.  However, I felt that he rushes through material and assumes that you understand.  I did enjoy his class, but was a little let down overall.  You can tell he really loves finance, and that he wants his students to succeed.  But I felt his lectures were not the clearest.
Good teacher, passionate about subject matter, sometimes he's all over the place, but covers the core concepts very well.
Professor Brau is great. He really cares for the success of his students and also their spiritual well being. The class is hard though. A lot of time should be put into the class.
Great teacher, Very energetic and organized. Great at motivating his students.

Brother Brau is a passionate teacher and thoroughly enjoys the material.  The personal finance days were the best and really help with real-time college financial situations.  The principles taught in this class can be used even after it's over so well worth it to take!

Brother Brau is awesome! I loved his spiritual thoughts every class. Great guy. He does tend to rush through material very fast. If you don't read the text book before class you will fall behind. Finance builds off accounting and he teaches as if you've already taken it. I hadn't taken accounting yet, so it was pretty tough to learn all the vocab.
It is an excellent class, he is very difficult, but he makes it very clear what is expected, and is a great instructor.

Dr. Brau is awesome. If this is one of your first college courses, I can see how this class could be difficult... but it's really not hard. Dr. Brau is engaging and responds to emails. The textbook is GOLD. There's really no reason to complain about this class.

This class was rather difficult for me, but professor Brau made it interesting. He's a nice guy and very energetic. My only problem with him is he would  sometimes go too fast during lectures and it was hard to follow. Other than that though he's way good!

Professor Brau gives great professional development advice and will meet with you to help you with your career. He gives great spiritual insights and really cares. I think reading the textbook is essential to understanding his lectures.

Professor Brau is the man! I found his lectures to be kind of hard to follow if you don't read. If you do read and go the lectures the material is easy to learn. He is an incredible individual and his lectures help you be a better person. He gives helpful professional development insights and he is more than willing to meet with individuals.

Bro Brau is an excellent teacher.  The ideas can sometimes be difficult to grab, but you feel like Bro Brau is really passionate about helping the subject and about helping his students succeed both in class and in life.  Lecture is focused not just on passing the test, but on teaching you skills that will benefit you in any career field.
Excellent class. Bro Brau is fantastic; he does a great job of making difficult concepts easy to understand.
He's a good professor, but the class is very difficult. He tries to make it fun, however, and his devotionals are the best.

He really knows his stuff but sometimes he blows through it so quickly that it's very hard to keep up in class and grasp everything. He really cares about his students but he's not very good about answering questions in class. He is in such a hyped fast paced mood that he rarely answers questions. The textbook is very helpful & the TAs are amazing!
This class is rough but if you like the gym and really good spiritual thoughts you'll enjoy class attendance.

good guy, tough professor. The TAs are more useful to students than he is. The first 30 minutes of class are actual content useful, but you have to go b/c there are specific test questions about what he talked about in class. Good luck, take it from someone else if you can.

Professor Brau is awesome. For a large class he keeps it run smoothly. He is super helpful and explains the concepts clearly. He is very fair and willing to work with you.The midterms are optional but if you miss them their weight carries over to the final. Unless you're a good test taker, having 65% of your final grade based on a test is unwise.

Jim Brau really cares about his students. He is energetic and does not waste time teaching things that are not of use. I particularly liked the time he takes to help with professional development and teaching us about personal finance. I would recommend taking this class and any other class that Prof. Brau teaches, he is way good.

This class is not easy but it is worth it.  I learned a lot in this class but you have to be willing to put in the time.  Professor Brau does a great job of explaining the concepts and provides the resources for you to learn finance.

I don't usually rate my professor-but when I do-it's because this guy is THE MAN!!!  Anyone who gives him less than 5 stars is a serious nubcake ;) Dr. Brau should be in the running for professor of the year! SO DOWN TO EARTH. PASSIONATE PERSONALITY. FUN TO BE AROUND. MORE ENERGY THAN THE SUN. HE KEEPS IT 100. HE KEEPS IT REAL. GR8 CLASS. TAKE IT

Bro Brau is a really nice guy and very understanding of people with disabilities. I have a disability that restricts me from attending most lectures, but Bro. Brau was really helpful and understanding.
Brau is an awesome teacher but the class is really hard. I would recommend taking some easier classes is the same semester as his class if you plan to have a social life
Challenging subject and he expects the students to pick up the difficult concepts quickly.  You have to like a guy who takes pride in his school like he does.

Professor Brau does a great job at keeping class entertaining and tries to help students not fall asleep.  Although he isn't the best at clearly explaining things, I found his explanations useful.  The TAs are very helpful too.  There are a lot of different ways for you to get help.

Bro Brau is a stud. Very helpful, always got you pumped up about life and money. Very valuable skills learned. The class is not easy, but is all about succeeding in the real world and in that regard is well worth the hard work required.

Love him!  Regardless of your preference for finance, he's a fund teacher to have.  Class is work (but which meaningful classes at BYU aren't?), but not impossible by any stretch.   TONS of help from TAs if you want it.
He is a very good professor who cares about the students. The course is very challenging, but the things you learn will be very helpful in any field of study.

Brother Brau is an excellent teacher.  Make sure to take Finance from him!  He pumps you up every day spiritually and financially.  He does everything he can for his students, and the rest is up to us to take what he teaches and learn it.  He also has an awesome class format to give us two easy weeks mid-semester.

Explained things fairly clear, willing to help and be friends with students.  Good sense of humor and adds spiritual moments appropriately.  The only reason the class is somewhat hard to people is the material, not him as a teacher.  He basically outlines most of the test at in class reviews. Just take notes well, practice problems, and be prepared

Brother Brau is a really great teacher and is good at keeping students attention during class. This subject can be confusing though so be sure to read the textbook and do the homework before attending class.
Really an amazing professor. I believe everyone deserves to take this type of class from this type of professor.
Professor Brau keeps a large class engaged with his energy. He likes to use class discussion points on his test, but you need to read the material too.

Awesome class and a great professor! The mateial itself is a challenge, mainly because of the shear amount of information covered. However Bro. Brau creates a lot of opportunities to get help, and to really learn the material. His tests are really good! His lectures are enjoyable, and he does an excellent job of being engaging.

Brau is a loud, in your face, type-A personality. It is very easy to get lost in lectures as he moves extremely fast. The good news is he can write a really good textbook. Expect to learn more and understand better from the textbook than during lecture. It's an intro class with close to a 1000 students. Just know it's supposed to be hard.

Great class with inspiring spiritual insights. Do the reading before every class and the material will be clear when he lectures. Review notes, go over his slides, and  do all practice problems for tests and you will do well.
Good class, but pretty hard.
Professor Brau is a kind and dedicated teacher who was committed to teach his class even at the cost of his own declining health. And for that, I respect him.

This was one of the harder classes I've taken for sure.  Dr. Brau is good teacher, but if you're still struggling when going to classes make sure to read over the book and go to the review sections with the TA's!
I love how passionate and animated he is, it keeps the class interesting. He is a little confusing at times when he explains things, but overall a good teacher and good class

Brau is a great guy and a good teacher. He uses a ton of abbreviations so it is hard to follow him sometimes. Also the TA lab is a glorified homework checking station, so dont plan on getting one on one help in order to understand the concepts taught. The man is a spiritual giant.
Brother Brau uses a lot of abbreviations, so make sure to do the reading beforehand or you will be lost in class. Great professor. Love the spiritual thoughts. Good class.
He's a good guy.  Tough class, messy handwriting but I liked him overall.
Great class, really important to read before lectures. Sometimes tests are deceiving and labs got really crowded. Lectures were interesting, have to work hard to do well for sure.
He is so clear and looks out for his students. You will always know exactly what is expected of you. He has awesome spiritual messages during class. One of the best teachers I've had.

Brother Brau is an outstanding guy! He is very funny, animated, and spiritual. He also understands that most people in his class aren't even interested in finance. The material isn't too difficult if you do the work. However, I didn't find it very interesting nor did I think the textbook or professor Brau were always great at explaining concepts.

Pretty awesome guy, I wouldn't take it from anyone else.  Super passionate about finance and how it can benefit you.  It does take a fair amount of studying but if you put in the time and learn the material and do ALL the hw's and practice problems before the test you will be fine.
Pretty interesting class. He isn't the best at explaining concepts, but he really cares about his students, and the Ta labs are great!

Brau teaches with passion and enthusiasm. This helps lectures be entertaining. He also gives incredible spiritual thoughts each class. The textbook is where I really ended up learning everything. Class makes sense if you have already read and put in the work. If you haven't then Brau really makes no sense. Overall I am happy I took his class.
Great Class, learned alot

Professor Brau is a really cool guy.  He wants his students to do well, but is a little hard to follow in class.  The labs are INCREDIBLY helpful and his tests are doable if you put in the effort to learn the material.
Great Professor!

Jim Brau is a great professor who shows genuine interest in the learning of his students. At times I felt that he was ineffective at explaining some of the concepts in class, but with the homework quizzes it is not too difficult to internalize the subject matter.

Bro. Brau is very enthusiastic about finance.
