One con: he will never meet with you unless you are having a life problem. I had some questions about the class and he wasn't willing to meet

Br. Brau teaches well. I appreciated how he breaks up the lecture with spiritual thoughts and news. He does a good job considering the class is always huge, but I felt like a number. I would have appreciated more TA availability/help.

Bro Brau is great! He really cares about helping students and gives everyone applicable information for life. There is a lot of reading but everything is pretty straight forward. Just be diligent and work hard and an A isn't too hard.

Bro Brau is a great person and very enthusiastic about what he teaches. I found it difficult to understand a lot of the concepts during class but the textbook is very helpful. I would recommend taking ACC 200 before taking this course. Lots of time spent on homework.
Great teacher. Really cares about the welfare of the student. If you try your hardest and stay focused there is no reason not to get a good grade.
Really cool professor who is extremely interested and involved with his students. Wants you to do well and learn, so it is a challenging class. But super worth the teacher.
Dr. Brau is an excellent teacher, he is spiritual and helps us understand the material to apply not only in business but also in personal life. The tests are hard.

Bro. Brau has a ton of energy, its just too bad that a lot of his energy goes into teaching the class about things he has said before and gospel related stuff. If more time was spent on the Finance material I think that we could understand it better. Make sure to read the book before going to class it will help

Dr Brau is legit! He really knows his stuff and is very helpful in making things clear and precise. I recommend going to class as much as possible because that's where you will really learn everything. Yes they class is definitely challenging but you will end up actually learning instead of it just blowing over your head. Recommend Dr Brau for sure
fantastic professor. hard but extremly clear in everything

Pro: Bro. Brau's class has been very moving. He is inspiring. Con: Nonetheless with so many young bucks in the class, most of class has to spent at a snail pace and not enough time to go over all of problem types. The textbook is terrible. Often times, exact ways to solve problem cannot be found in the book.

Brau is a nice guy with a lot of interesting stories to share.  But sometimes I felt like he was just running his mouth.  I could've missed every lecture and just gone to get help from the TA's and done fine.  If you want a lot of interesting monologues, then take his class.  If your time is limited, you might be frustrated.

It was one of the most organized classes that I have ever attended. He would give a lecture, provide tips for career development, and would pause to give a spiritual thought before moving on to the next section. The course is not easy, but if you read before coming to class you won't be lost. Overall though, he is an excellent professor.

This class is hard, but Bro. Brau does a great job of helping students to get through the material. His spiritual thoughts are incredible. Easily the best part of the class, which is saying something.
I love his energy.  This is a very useful class not only for business but also for your everyday life.  It's not hard.  Just keep up with the readings.
I really enjoyed this class. Bro. Brau gives probably the best spiritual thoughts I've ever had at BYU. Make sure to read the textbook BEFORE class, and you'll do fine.
The spiritual thoughts are really good. Teacher enjoys teaching. However the problems aren't explained well before the homework is due.

Bro Brau is a good man who strives to inspire his students and aid their decision making.  He is always willing to meet with students or respond their emails.  Beware: he'll try to sell you on finance.  Study groups will help you a ton, the class is hard but totally manageable.  I switched to finance!
Great teacher, super enthusiastic about the material, and you learn life lessons not just straight finance stuff.  One of my best professors

Brother Brau is a great teacher. He is fun, energetic, and really puts his all into the class. He really cares about the students and wants them to succeed. The lectures were kind of hard to understand at times, and the notes went kind of fast. The reading usually caught me up to date though. I would recommend this class to anyone needing it.

This class is super helpful not just in business related manners, but also is very practical for everyday stuff. Bro B is a stud, he explains the ,material very well. But there is  lot of material, so study it from day 1.

Awesome professor, great class. Explains things very well.  Homework and textbook are online, which means reading can actually be graded (make sure you do it). I would recommend taking his class. Brightens up a dull subject.

Bro. Brau is really energetic and I enjoyed his lectures. It did seem that he assumed we all had some prior knowledge of Finance. This made it difficult to follow along when he did review problems. Also the text doesn't always correspond with the problems which in turn do not correspond well with the tests. It was a difficult class but enjoyable.

Brother Brau puts in a lot of energy into his class and I really enjoyed his lectures and spiritual thoughts. The only bad thing is that his class is harder than the other professor so you will be at a disadvantage if you apply for a program.

Brau is a spiritual giant!  I left his class pumped everyday because of his spiritual thoughts.  On the other hand the class is a beast. Expect to spend at least 2 hours on each homework assignment and to study like crazy for the tests.

Professor Brau is awesome! Finance is a hard class but Brother Brau does his best to keep things interesting and bring the gospel into his lectures. He explains things really well and genuinely cares about his students even though its a big class. The TA lab is great. I wouldn't take finance from anyone else. One of my favorite BYU professors.
Brother Brau was an amazing professor. He teaches well and makes things interesting. Definitely my favorite class this semester!
Brother Brau is a real great guy, really cares about the students. Not the best at explaining difficult concepts clearly (expects students to know the material before coming to class)

this class will be much easier if you have taken accounting 200. Brau is an excellent professor and his teaching is energetic. reading the textbook will definitely help understand the lecture. the structure of the class allows you to learn the material well and get the grade you want.
Prof Keeps you engaged but there really is no way to prepare for his exams. TA's are far too busy to help out. Get a Tutor.

I found the material to be a lot harder than anyone would admit. Unless you are good at math or have take accounting previously the tests are hard and the homework is very time consuming. However, Brau is one of the best professors I have had at BYU. He cares about his students and tries to help them anyway he can.
The only good thing about FIN 201 is Jim Brau. I hate finance, took it twice to get a better grade, but he is an inspiring teacher. The ONLY teacher worth taking FIN 201 from.
good class. Brau just speaks really fast and writes super messy so you have to get through that barrier

This was hands down the best business class I took at BYU. Take it seriously because Brother Brau not only has great professional advice and knowledge but will help you understand why you are blessed to be a student at BYU.

This class is really great! If you're decent at math and have an interest in business, you'll definitely enjoy it, especially since he's got SO MUCH ENERGY! Plus, he's got the best spiritual thoughts ever! He's a little too energetic sometimes for a 2 pm class haha but he definitely prepares you for the exams as well as real life.
Bro. Brau was awesome! The class was pretty hard but bro Brau made class as entertaining as possible. Highly recommended.

Brother Brau is an excellent teacher. He cares about you as a person and understands that not everyone taking the course is intending to be a Finance major, which is great! He has spiritual thoughts prepared fore each class period which help you stay engaged. Tough class, but manageable. It is well-structured.
Professor Brau is a great teacher and an even better guy. He cares about the students and does his best to help. Utilize the help test and TA's. Not an easy class, but doable with the right effort.
He's is really nice. He tries to make it interesting.
He is an awesome teacher sometimes hard to follow cause he goes pretty fast but he is very helpful and has awesome spiritual thoughts in every class. Also, great personal finance lectures.
Spiritually inspiring.  Great guy.  Average teacher.  Very hard to follow along in class.  Difficult class but i have alot of respect for this professor, he wants you to do well.

This class could be difficult if you have no prior accounting or time-value-of-money knowledge. Energetic lecturer, and he really couldn't make it easier to get a good grade than it is. The TA's were extremely UN-helpful, and the 2 Excel assignments were poorly designed and inconsistently graded.
Great class, useful even if Finance isn't your major.
Some of the topics may feel difficult, but he is able to teach them clearly.  Takes a little bit of work to understand, but is pretty easy if you put in a little bit of time.

Good class. I learned a lot. It takes a lot of studying on your own. The homework problems are pretty helpful but you have to master them if you want to do well on the tests. His spiritual thoughts were powerful.

He is very passionate and it can be infectious. It can be difficult because he can be a little scatterbrained during the class but the textbook is very organized. His exams are some of the most difficult, and admittedly fair, I've ever taken. Going to the help desk is a must.

I highly recommend Brother Brau. I am a pre-dental student, not even a business minor. I thought the class was challenging and demanding, but it was well taught and very well structured. The testing/grading was fair. Above all, I recommend Brother Brau because the life tips and spiritual thoughts he gives are priceless.

Professor Brau is on fire about Finance and about the learning experience for students! He cares about students personally and academically. Professor Brau is on fire about Finance and about the learning experience for students! He cares about students personally and academically. He is full of advice about careers, how to balance school, family and career and how to prosper in life. Great professor truly concerned about the of his  students!
Engaging teacher.  Loves finance with a passion and truly helps you understand the material being taught.
Very engaging. Good professor.

Bro. Brau is a solid teacher! Instead of writing down everything he writes down, it would just be better to listen and write down the concepts and what he actually teaches. He really cares about the students and wants their success but sometimes he is a little hard to follow and goes off on tangents about the Gym a lot. Good teacher.
He is a very energetic teacher.  He often hints at what information will be on the exams.  His spiritual thoughts and personal finance applications were great.

Sincere teacher, I feel his class and rating is fair.  However, he is all over the place in class.  He will just jump into the chapter without giving a clear and concise description of what is actually being studied that is not even described in the textbook.

Super good guy. Wants everyone to do well in the class. He has great stories and is really good at getting you pumped/motivated. I would recommend him if you are taking this class. Just make sure you get each day's concepts down before trying to move on.

Brau is a good teacher with a high level of energy. I felt like the way he taught was focused on using technical words and acronyms to sound smart, which was sometimes confusing and made understanding the material even more difficult than it already is.

Really enjoyed his class. Sometimes got a little ahead of himself trying to keep the class interesting but if put in a good effort on the homework and tests an A is very manageable. Definitely have to work for it. I also really liked the spiritual thoughts he gives every class

This class will be much easier if you have taken ACC 200. I felt like there is a good amount of information but the structure of the class makes it so that you can get the grade you want. Bro. Brau is an incredible professor. His teaching style is energetic and clear, though he goes a little fast in the lecture, so try to always read the textbook.

Brau is a good guy with good intentions. His daily spiritual thoughts are great. However, his teaching style simply didnt fit with me.  He wrties sloppy, talks fast, and doesnt do examples.  Every couple weeks he does an example day in which he does examples for hte past month of work-- doesnt help.  Personal opinon-i learn everything from the book

Brother Brau gives A+ effort day after day.  I don't really like his notes that he gives in class.  They are hard to follow.  Go to class because he will give you test questions from concepts discussed in class.
Brau goes steroids-mode all semester. Get Ready...

Brother Brau is a very interesting, high-energy teacher.  His class lectures are very dynamic and enlightening.  The course itself is quite difficult, at least for me, but Brother Brau does his best to explain the concepts well in class.

A very great guy with some of the best life advice I've ever been given. But the class is difficult if it's not your only priority. A great guy like I said, but the makes the class very extremely hard.

Professor Brau is known for the energy he brings to his teaching and makes learning about finance fun. He is a powerful motivator and wants his students to succeed. There never is a dull day in class.
Brau is a pretty good lecturer, he is able to keep the class awake and he always has a spiritual thought, which is nice.  He can be obnoxious at times, but overall he's a good guy.

I really enjoyed this class. Dr. Brau is a great professor who really wants his students to do well in his class. Not only does he explain things very well and in detail, but he gives many opportunities for extra credit. His class is difficult, but if you go to class and take notes, you will do very well on the exams.

Dr. Brau was my favorite professor at BYU. He is funny, energetic, explains things very well, cares about his students, keeps your attention the entire class period, prepares his students well for tests, and so much more. I learned a lot from his class, and recommend him as your finance professor.

Brau is a classic West Point, military man. I would describe his class, his teaching style, and him as a person, in one word: "INTENSE." The class will push your limits, but it is extremely valuable. Know that it's probably next to impossible to get an A without spending a lot of time in the TA lab. Awesome class.

I really enjoyed this class and I learned so much. Dr. Brau explains things well and wanted his students to succeed. There are many opportunities to get help such as the TA labs. I particularly found the Excel assignments useful because I could check my understanding. Sometimes the concepts were a little unclear, but overall the class was great!
Enthusiastic and spiritual. Really cares about the students. His notes are very hard to read sometimes, but most of the material is in the online text that is very helpful.

His notes were a little hard to read but he is very enthusiastic. May need to get a tutor or outside help since he also wrote the book you use and it is also hard to understand. Very helpful class. You learn a lot. Class isn't mandatory but it is very helpful. If you need to take this class, take it from Brau.

Bro. Brau is very enthusiastic about finance and that shows in his lectures. If you pay attention in class and ask questions, go to the lab for help when needed, and read the textbook, you'll do fine.

If you want to learn Finance, Professor Brau will not let you leave the class until you know it. He provides so many ways to help us learn it. He's one of the most dedicated teachers at BYU and keeps class lively with his gym jokes.

Really funny teacher! You WILL be entertained in his class! He prepares some powerful thoughts to share during class to give you a break from finance. Lots of information. Study tons or you won't get a good grade.

This is a challenging course. That said, Jim Brau teaches is wonderfully. He always makes time for his students even when he was deathly sick the semester I took this from him. He tells you up front what will be on the test; he teaches the concepts and builds the test around the material. The "hot pepper" is because he is that good a teacher.

Professor Brau teaches the concepts very clearly, but additional study of the concepts is required to succeed in this class.  It is a challenging course, but if you put in the time to solidify the concepts on your own time then you will succeed.

Professor Brau is a very good professor who teaches concepts very clearly. The class is challenging if you do not know anything about finance previously, but if you put in the time to learn you will succeed.
Brau was great. Loved him and attending his class, but it was a lot of work.
Is a very awesome professor and super humble considering most aren't that way.  Just needs to do more practice problems and be more direct in class instead of going over career possibilities
Great teacher.  Material learned is applicable to "real world" and will help you manage and become more aware of your money.
Cool guy, the class is harder than it should be tho, mostly because the textbook is trash.

Decent teacher with good intentions, but for an introductory finance class full of many non-Finance students, it was a bit too much. He glossed over the difficult stuff in his lectures, leaving the student to figure many of the difficulties out on his or her own; instead, he spent a large amount of time in class on "professional development".
Professor Brau is very enthusiastic. Goes off on tangents frequently, however. Class is difficult, but with sufficient effort getting an A is not a problem.

Super passionate Finance professor. Tons of energy and good spiritual messages. It is a tough subject, it's a hard class, there is no getting around it. But he is very clear about what will be on the exams and provides lots of material to prepare for it if you put the time in.
Attendance is not mandatory but the exam is based on the lecture.
Brau is a fine teacher, but listening to him talk about anything other than the material is obnoxious. It terns into "talk about how awesome I am" time for Professor Brau.
This class was hard but Professor Brau is a really great teacher!
Professor Brau is a very enthusiastic professor.

Gives extra credit to rate him on this site. Very sporadic, goes on tangents all of the time. Spends most of the time in class glorifying BYU & the finance department. Professor Brau is a cool guy. His spiritual thoughts are really inspiring and motivating. The class is difficult, there is a ton of reading. He moves through the concepts very quickly and it can be hard to understand them.

Jim Brau is very interested in the success of his students, not only in the scope of the class, but also in their future careers, etc.  He moves quickly through the material, so stay on top of the work and get help from the TA's (which work more one-on-one with the students than Brau does).  His test are doable with study.  Overall, great course!

Bro. Brau was awesome! I absolutely loved his spiritual thoughts and his teaching style. He was also funny and did a good job at keeping me engaged and not zoning out. I also liked that he applied everything we were learning to real life. He has a love for his students as well. I would highly recommend taking this class from Bro. Brau!

Great class! Super useful in life, guaranteed one day you will remember professor Brau's advices and will thank him. He is very energetic and I love his spiritual thoughts, they always motivate me to do my VERY best. Not always the most clear in his explanations, but stil worth attending. If you go to class and do the readings you will do fine.
He is a great guy and explains concepts well in class. Unfortunately the homework questions are from the textbook and the textbook often does not explain things well.

Brother Brau is great. He's "real" and knows students have lots of things going on in their lives. His class policies are strict but not hard to follow. Always looked forward to his spiritual thoughts, he had great things to say. Definitely a useful class and a great professor. Lots of resources to help you do well.
GOOOD. High recommended!! Just take it, and you will know!

Great class/teacher.  Brau has tons of energy and is super passionate about finance.  TA's are very helpful.  Brau does a really good job of teaching you what he thinks will be most important/beneficial to you and your life instead of just spitting out information.

Dr. Brau is an excellent professor.  I would recommend him for anyone.  His class isn't easy and you need to do the work, but you learn a lot.  Listen to what he says in class, take good notes, and an A is possible.
Dr. Brau sincerely cares about his students' learning both within and beyond the scope of finance. Do everything he suggests you do and this course will not be a problem for you.

Prof. Brau was very consistant in providing lecture material mixed with professional development and spiritual thoughts. He was a great example. Hard class, plan on putting lots of time in if finance doesn't come naturally.
Great professor who works his hardest for his students. Came in and taught despite having pneumonia and then whooping cough. Great man, hard class.

Professor Brau is awesome! He realizes that many students who take the class are majoring in something other than finance, so he teaches very simply and clearly. He also works hard to keep the attention of the class.

Dr Brau is awesome! He is very knowledgable and good at explaining concepts. He does a wonderful job of helping the students learn the intuition behind the formulas instead of memorizing them, which really makes the class easier in the long run! Overall great guy and teacher

Professor Brau is a great guy. I liked his class a lot. My only complaint is that he throws curve balls on the test. If you take his class be sure that you know the intuition behind everything he teaches because he will switch things up on you in the exams. Other than that it is a great class.
his class wasn't very helpful, spoke like we already knew what he was talking about. basically just taught myself via textbook and eventually stopped going to class

Bro Brau is the best teacher I have had out of any of the business classes. Lectures are great. class is fair, but its not a cakewalk. go to lecture, take good notes, and read the book and you will do fine.
Good teacher but he forgets that it is an introductory class. Loved the material and what I learned but most of it was on my own, not in class.

Brau is a very good teacher. He truly cares about the students as well as the subject. Took this class at the same time as Econ 110 and it was a little hard to handle the work load in both because this class requires a lot of personal study. Keep that in mind. Otherwise, not half bad. Really enjoyed his lectures.
Good professor.  I am only writing this review for extra credit.

Brother Brau is a great teacher. He is very enthusiastic and always very willing to help. He made a fairly boring subject interesting. Reading the textbook definitely helps clarify the concepts he discusses in class.
Hard work.  But you learn a lot of good things.
Br. Brau truly knows his stuff & tried to share his passion for Finance as well as the gospel with the class. Be ready to work hard though. The TA lab is a necessity for a good grade.
Brother Brau is a great Professor. He tries to help you in Finance and prepare you for life. Very useful
Good engaging professor. Textbook helped clear up any doubts about what was taught in class.
Great teacher. He's funny and willing to work with you if you're struggling. Like he says, if you show up to class and take good notes, you're almost guaranteed to get an A on every test.

the class is only good for getting notes for the few easy questions the exam and getting usually a good spiritual thought. the way to learn the material is to sit in the TA lab and do the reading and homework.

Prof. Brau is often funny and is passionate about finance. Overall I feel like I have learned quit a bit in the course, but I wish Prof. Brau was a bit more flexible with homework. You can't drop any homework assignments and they are worth 25% of your grade.

Go into the TA lab.  It is extremely helpful, and you can get 100% on all assignments if you go in and get them checked BEFORE turning in the assignments. GO INTO THE LAB every week for EVERY assignment.

Brau is probably one of the most dedicated teachers and individuals in the Marriott School and most likely all of BYU. Great class!

Brother Brau made the class extremely entertaining and fun to go to. The tests and some of the materials were hard to understand however
Brother Brau is a fun teacher, and does great engaging his students. Ge was a really fun professor to have. He teaches a difficult subject, so the class was a little hard, but definitely doable.

Brother Brau is an amazing guy,who really knows students. He is one of the nicest compassionate people on campus. However, his class is extremely difficult for certain learners. In order to succeed you need to be able to  follow everything that he says in class, NOT THE TEXTBOOK. There is a HUGE difference between the book and his class.
Great professor, great class. Lots of work, but not hard if you thoroughly read the book on myeducator.
This class was much easier than I expected.  Just keep doing the reading/work on time and review a bit for the test.  I wish the class had gone faster and covered the skipped chapters.
Such a passionate guy. Inspirational, diligent, helpful when needed. If you study and do your homework you'll ace this class. As far as finance goes, this is a good class.
Brau is such a great teacher. He is so willing to help and so enthusiastic every single class period.

Professor Brau is awesome! He is very enthusiastic all the time. It makes class fun. He is also very good at helping you understand the material, you just have to read before class to get a better grasp. He has powerful spiritual thoughts, and the class isn't that hard if you put time in it.

Brau is a fantastic human being and like the other comments have suggested, a very fast paced teacher. The way you will do well in this course is by reading the assigned chapter before he lectures on it. Knowing what he is about to talk about as well as some of the key principles will make all the difference.

Brau is a very energetic teacher. He engages his students and uses 100% of his teaching time. He is a very confusing teacher because of his teaching speed. I felt that I had to learn more of the class material outside of class in during his lectures. I wish Brau would teach us not expecting that we already knew it from the text book.

Brau is a great teacher who really cares about his students and their well being. His spiritual thoughts are sure to build your testimony. However, his teaching style is confusing. He talks really fast and uses a lot of abbreviations that are hard to follow. Unfortunately, the textbook is not very helpful either. This course requires a lot of work!
Brother Brau cares a lot about his students and their well-being. He cares about their learning and understanding as well. The class material is still tough and the book is not great sometimes.
Jim Brau is an awesome guy, for sure. The content is still pretty hard, and the text book this year was pretty bad. But if you go to class, you will be interested for sure.
Brau is the man. Always pumped and would do anything for his students. Responded to all my emails in the same day. Class is still hard, but much MUCH harder with a different professor.

Brau is very animated. Learned most material by myself through the online textbook and homework (which is very helpful) but he also teaches it pretty well. Make sure to attend class as a lot of test questions come from class discussion. Take him over anyone else.
Great teacher who enjoys the material and helping students do their best. The class itself requires work, and is by no means easy. Go to class, take really good notes, and go to the TA lab to do HW!
Brother Brau really wants students to learn and cares about them. He seems a little full of himself at times, but means well. More challenging class than I expected.
He is a great teacher for his class sizes. If you want help you can get it no problem.

Brother Brau is funny, and very passionate about finance. He will help you if you ask him. He does move fast and requires good notes though. Go to the TA desk and get help on the homeworks. That will also prepare you for tests.

Brau is a great professor.  Unfortunately his style wasn't the best for me.  I got behind in the online videos pretty quickly and so I was playing catchup every time we had a test.  Overall though, I feel like I learned a lot.

Brau is very focused on helping his students learn the intuition behind the material.  He wants his students to succeed and has lots of help available (mostly TAs).  Very animated, pretty entertaining, and has a love for Finance that helps students focus in class.

Professor Brau is a great professor! He keeps the class focused with random interruptions and spiritual thoughts. The midterms are hard but doable if you spend time with the TAs and do the readings. Overall a great class!! He got me interested in Finance.
Great teacher. Has a great way of explaining hard to understand concepts and applies everything to the real world and the gospel.

Great teacher. Has a great way of explaining hard to understand concepts and applies everything to the real world and the gospel.  He also gives great spiritual thoughts in the middle of class to keep your attention.  Best professor that I have had so far.

Brother Brau is awesome. He is pretty much a bro but I like him. It helps a ton to do the reading before lecture. The classes was kinda a roller coaster in the sense that it was really hard for a few weeks and then would slow down and would be really easy for a few weeks and then it was really hard for a few weeks again.
Bro. Brau is very interested in doing everything the best way. Overall, he just wants us to be the best people that we can be. Good teacher

Class was difficult. I did all the homework and reading, got good scores and still did bad on the tests. He goes very quickly through the material so you have to keep up. Midterms are hard and final is 100 Q's for those who didn't take the midterms, but it's 100 Q's for everyone. Should have a shorter option for those who took the midterms.

Great Professor! The subject matter was some-what difficult.  All the tests are based off his notes in class, which sometimes can be hard to follow.  Always starts with a prayer and has an intermission with a spiritual thought.  He is very good at keeping your attention!
The content in this class is very applicable to life. I looked forward to Brau's spiritual thoughts every day. It makes a huge difference to do your reading before class.
Brau is a good professor that provides all of the tools students need to succeed. Will they care? Good question.

Brau is awesome. He expects a lot out of you and he's pretty intense, but don't let that scare you. He makes the class interesting, and he gives you enough resources to get an A if you're willing to put in the time to do all the required reading (it's online and he grades you on it).
Brau did his best to make sure everything was applicable to everyday life - not just finance majors. He was also very engaging in class.
Awesome Teacher! It is a difficult class and requires a lot of study but it is all very useful and applicable in real life. Highly recommend Prof. Brau and his Fin 201 class.
Great class. The information was very useful and the tests are doable if you go to class. I would recommend it.
Professor Brau is super fun to learn from. I though this would be a boring class but he is super energetic and hilarious. He gives a spiritual thought every class period and I really enjoyed that.

Brother Brau cares a lot about his students. He is really good at adding variety to the classroom activities to keep you engaged. At times the material is a little confusing, so out-of-class reading is essential to receive a good grade.

Brau is a good teacher, he explains the points and will get yo started understanding the concept but it's important to do the outside reading. The class isn't too hard though the tests aren't easy. He is very high energy and engaging but at times it can be hard to follow. Overall good class.

High Energy Guy. Loved this class,but then again, I'm a math guy. He may move to fast if your not a math person, but the online text is very good, and the TA help desk is available throughout the week. Loved this class, great lectures and spiritual thoughts. Brau is a cool dude!

I really like brother Brau. He is a real good, down-to-earth guy. He keeps the class interesting and is trying to make us laugh most of the time. He shows a genuine concern for our learning and would recommend him to another.

Dr. Brau is awesome. He's very passionate, very relatable. He did a great job of keeping the class spiritual where other teachers seem to struggle. I think that sometimes he moved too fast and some of his explanations became murky. I would take another class from him, but go in knowing that a lot of your learning will be done outside of class.

Brau is the man. He is sincerely interested in helping anyone who is willing to talk to him. He genuinely cares for all of his students. He is all over the place during lectures. I struggled to follow him most days. Not happy with how he assumed I knew certain things that I didn't. He often moved on without me understanding it.

Great teacher very clear. It's a hard subject but if you take the time to do the homework and read the book it's doable. If you have to take it take it from brau. You can tell he loves what he does and loves the students. Freakin steroid mode bro!

Brau is very passionate and wants to help students succeed, but the class can be tough. You need to go to lecture and its a good idea to read the text before so lecture can fill in any gaps in understanding.

Brother Brau moves FAST, that is no lie. He talks fast and he jumps around the stage fast but he keeps your attention well. His notes are not always clear but his explanations are. He is helpful and although attendance is not counted, going to class will definitely pay off.

I really enjoyed this FIN 201 class. Brother Brau is a great teacher! He is very passionate, funny, very clear when teaching and the whole course is well structured. I especially love the short spiritual messages he shares with us every lesson. FIN 201 course isn't super easy but still manageable.

I really enjoyed this class and I loved Brother Brau's spiritual thoughts. His personal finance bootcamp was also an very interesting and helpful. He is a teacher that really cares for his students. As long as you are willing to put in the effort and go to the TA help desk, this class is doable.

Professor Brau is a nice guy who means to do good. Sometimes he doesn't teach things crystal clear, but if you read the text book and actively try and understand the concepts you'll be fine in his class. He is a fair professor and gives you plenty of opportunities to raise your grade if needed.

Brau talks really fast and is very enthusiastic! I did enjoy his class. In class he does a lot of different activities to "Keep you attention" but sometimes they can be a bit distracting. I did learn a LOT from those and the class content. Reading the text is mandatory to understand the class and isn't that difficult to understand.
great professor who really cares about your success in the class.  tells you what he expects of you to get a good grade in the class and holds you to it.

He had a positive attitude all the time and passion for his subject. However he did not go over concept clearly enough or often enough in class. There were to many break when concepts from the class were still unclear.

Bro. Brau is fair and very interested in his students. He is very approachable and easy-going outside of class. However, he can be a little intimidating during lecture if you ask questions. Overall, he is a great option if you need to take finance 201.
I am not a big fan of finance, but Brother Brau does a good job of making things entertaining and understandable. He places a big emphasis on the notes he gives in class, so don't miss the lectures.

Brother Brau is a great teacher! He works hard to explain the concepts clearly so that students can understand them, he keeps the course organized, and he effectively brings spiritual discussions into his lectures. I would most definitely recommend him to anyone wanting to take Finance and BYU.
This is a hard class. Brother B does a good job at keeping it real and he pounds the protein shakes during class. He is very approachable and will do his best to help you out.

A really enthusiastic professor for a really difficult class. He is very passionate about the subject matter and brings a lot of energy to the lectures. The subject matter is challenging, but Dr. Brau really knows his stuff. TAs are really helpful, and you are given every opporunity you need to do well.

Brau keeps class fun and engaging, and works really hard to connect with his students. He talks really fast and goes through material like crazy so you definitely have to take notes while he talks and review them later. Sometimes tested over random comments in class which is frustrating. There's better ways to police attendance. Great textbook.
Entertaining teacher that teaches exactly what's on the test.

Professor Brau is very energetic in his lectures and does all he can to keep you involved.  By doing that though his lecture structures can be all over the place sometimes.  He changes the subject throughout to "keep your attention" and that can make it hard to get into the flow of the class.  Great at helping with professional development though.
Very awesome teacher. Helpful and wants us to succeed. Sometimes he's not very clear. He goes really fast. If you read the text before class you will do great!

Tough class. Difficult material and he expects you to understand it after you hear it once.  Isn't very good at explaining things simply.  He throws out finance vocab without really explaining them and it can be very confusing. Teaches his opinion on "spiritual things" as if they are doctrine. He wants you to succeed though and tries to help you.

Brother Brau is extremely excited by his students and wants to help them the best he can.  But he will make you put in the effort to get the grade.  The tests are hard, but fair after he curves the class.

Bro Brau is very passionate about the material and he is an awesome guy. He does a decent job teaching but I found myself learning a lot by myself from the text book. Its a difficult subject so be ready to study a lot.

Bro. Brau's personality type isn't the kind I generally get along with very well but I learned a lot in his class and I loved how he broke up class with spiritual thoughts. Hated this class at first, but loved it at the end.
I learned a ton in this class and really enjoyed it. I especially enjoyed the spiritual thoughts. Professor Brau is an amazing teacher!
He's a good teacher.The TA's are helpful as well.
He's a good teacher.
For the most part, he is fair.  Finance is not my best subject, but his class is alright. I would recommend him.
For the most part, he is fair.  Finance is not my best subject, but his class is alright.
A great class. he isn't that hard of a teacher. the material is just hard.

I really enjoyed taking Brother Brau's class.  He is a great guy and he really does try to help us grow as people, especially in the gospel.  He keeps class interesting because he mixes things up frequently in order to keep our attention.  My only complaint is that it felt like every class was rushed trying to fit in all the relevant content.

Cares about his students and a spiritually enlightening teacher. When it comes to communicating finance he is lost. Luckily the text book was so good I was able to teach myself the material. He cares so much about teaching intuition that he forgets to teach foundation and basics. You can do well if you can teach yourself
He is a very knowledgeable teacher who is good at explaining things but I feel sometimes he throws a lot at you at once. Lectures are a blast through and you will learn a lot by simply attending
Brau is a great instructor and his class was easy for me to stay awake in.  you need to go to class to do well on the exams.  i would recommend him.

Dr. Brau is a way cool guy. Listening to his lectures definitely made me want to succeed. His spiritual thoughts were motivating and he did a good job of keeping sure we were paying attention. You definitely will read the online textbook multiple times. This was one of the hardest classes I've taken so far at BYU.
Brau is a great teacher and has wonderful spiritual messages. Class is entertaining but the subject is difficult.

Brother Brau is a good guy that wants his students to succeed. He's not the best lecturer and you can tell the parts of the textbook he wrote are not as clear as his colleagues' parts, but it's still manageable if you do the reading. He would make a better religion professor because his spiritual thoughts are great. Work hard and you can get an A.

Brau is really an awesome teacher. He puts in the time to teach things effectively and gives you the tools to succeed. Spend alot of time studying and in the TA Help Desk and you will do well in the class. This class will require your time and effort.
He's a cool guy, and he cares a lot about his students. I couldn't follow his lectures, though. I did better just referring to the textbook.
Great class and professor. The material isn't easy and takes some dedication. Super useful information. Prof Brau is awesome!
It was pretty easy as long as you do go to class and do the homework.  You do have to do some work to get an A in his class though.
The class is pretty easy and straightforward if you just go to class and do the homework.  It is a class you have to work/review the homework to do well on the tests, but it is very doable.
The class is pretty simple and easy if you just show up to class and do the homework.  Its just one of those classes that you have to put actually some work into if you want a good grade.

Jim Brau genuinely cares about the overall success of his students in life, but his teaching style is a bit rash and hard to follow.If you want to succeed in his class you need to put in heaps of time and effort in the TA labs. All considered, his spiritual thoughts are great.

You can't expect to get a good grade in his class without studying. He is a good teacher and cares about the students. However, he is sometimes hard to follow in class.If you do the reading before class, you will know what he is talking about. Go into the help-desk to do you homework and you will be fine.
He's a little full of himself, but he's a good guy.  I suggest to read the textbook before class and take your own notes.  Then go to class and cement what you read with what Dr. Brau teaches.

Brother Brau is a great professor!  Sometimes he goes a little bit fast in class, but as long as you read the textbook you'll be fine.  I love that he starts every class with a prayer.  It really helps!  Also, if learning Finance isn't good enough for you, his spiritual thoughts will make it totally worth it.  Almost moved to tears sometimes.

Brother Brau is an awesome teacher. He genuinely cares for his students. I really enjoyed his class. He has some awesome spiritual thoughts. I'd recommend him to anyone :) He's not super hard but you have to work to get your A and it is definitely achievable.
Good guy. It was hard to connect the concepts taught in his lectures to the homework ad tests.

Jim's best qualities: knows finance backwards and forwards, genuinely cares for his students, high energy which keeps the class interesting. One drawback: his notes are hard to read. But if you read the lecture before class, and stay focused you'll be okay. When in doubt, go to the TAs... very helpful and friendly.
This is a great class and is a lot of fun. It is hard work but everything you learn will be beneficial to you in your career and personal life!!!

Finance can generally be a tough class. Because everything builds on itself it importan that you understand and comprehend everything from the beginning. If you don't understand a concept, GO GET HELP. Professor Brau and the TAs are very helpful. Tests are tough, but Prof Brau is completely clear on what he expects and will help you do well if work

He is a great guy and I appreciate his spiritual thoughts and professional development. However his lectures didn't really prepare you to actually do finance homework or the test problems. He is good at explaining concepts, but he doesn't show you how to solve problems.

Definitely not the best teacher. He is a great guy, but I didn't learn much from him.  I had to learn everything on my own and from the textbook. The only good part about his lectures are his spiritual thoughts.  His spiritual thoughts truly are amazing, but the rest of the lecture is pointless and doesn't make sense.
Great professor! Loved his spiritual thoughts every class!  He is really interested in his students! Tests are tough but there is plenty of help from the TA's.

Bro Brau is a fantastic human being! He shows genuine interest in everyone's success. He can be hard to follow because he bounces back and forth a lot, but as long as you listen attentively you'll be fine. Also, TAs and/or Bro B are almost always available to answer questions.The class is definitely hard work, but I enjoyed it and I adore Bro B.
Brau is a great guy and is very invested in his job as a teacher.  I also like how he brings a spiritual side to every class. The material is pretty hard but he is a fun teacher who spices it up.

You know I really liked finance, but sometimes I had a hard time with the lectures.  Bro Brau is a good guy but sometimes has a hard time focusing.  He admits that he is "like one of those ADHD kids" and if you have a hard time following lectures as it is, then maybe look for someone else.

Good class. Hard concepts to completely understand. Tests are based off how well you know each topic discussed and learned. Braus a good teacher, teaches really quick. Recommend reading the chapter before coming to class.

The class is pretty easy, the only hard part are his tests: there are more concept questions than calculations. Despite this, most of it can be logically deduced. So, go to class and this class is a cinch.

Professor Brau always had a positive energy about him which was nice. He made you believe you could excel in the class with hard work and dedication which are fundamental traits we should have anyways for when we get into the real world. He had real life applications. Optional exams, with weight carried to the final if skipped. Great professor.

I really didn't like finance but loved going to class. Brother Brau is a great teacher and really brought the spirit to finance. The class is very challenging; however, the TAs and TA lab was a lifesaver and I wish I would have started going sooner.

Online textbook so that's a plus. TA Lab is open 35+ hours a week, so you have plenty of opportunities to get help. Brau is a great lecturer: strong  voice, knows his stuff, entertaining/humorous, and spiritual. Tests were tricky, but if you're doing your reading and putting in a reasonable amount of time, there's no reason you shouldn't get an A.

I had to re take this class, because i took it from another professor. I went from a F to a B-. So  i am pretty happy with the way Professor Brau taught! I thought it was a good amount of homework and practice. That he spent are time in class well. And that he spread the information out over the semester very well.

Brau is the man. He is genuinely concerned with the student's understanding of the material. He focuses on helping the students understand the intuition behind everything, rather than strict memorization. If you want to actually learn the material, take it from Brau.

Excited about class and I really enjoyed his spiritual thoughts. There were many times that I didn't get what he was explaining and he freaks you out about the test. Shows genuine interest in all his students and does a good job at keeping a boring subject really intense and exciting.
This class was great. It did take a lot of work and dedication. Brau sometimes moves really fast in class but he is great at explaining all the concepts, you may just have to ask him one on one.
Spiritual thoughts at the end of class everyday. Gotta love the gym quotes.."steroid mode bro" Cares about everybody and wants everyone to succeed. Study hard for the tests!
Awesome professor!! The class was definitely a tough one, but he is extremely fair, and his tests and homework actually match up with what he teaches in the lecture!
Jim Brau is one of the best teachers that I've had so far at BYU. The class is challenging, but as long as you do the reading and the homework you should do fine in this class.
He is super thrilled about the class, but the subject is really difficult

Dr. Brau knows his stuff and knows how to teach very well. It requires dedication for a solid grade but is very doable. Definitely gets you prepared for material studied in accounting. If I were to take this class again I wouldn't want to take it from anyone else. Great teacher.

There's help that you can take advantage of: teacher, TA's and tutors for free. The textbook is online, which is both good and bad. All information is complied nice and clean. Lectures have spiritual thoughts in the  middle to break everything up. He wants to help and see you succeed.Class is Possible, but hard. Accounting background helpful.

Dr. Brau is excited about what he is teaching, which leads to engaging lectures. There is so much offered to help you succeed in the class that if you put in the time, you will do well. He has a great team of TAs to support the class size. It is probably best to have read the chapter before attending the lecture, as lectures are more of a review.

Bro. Brau is great and very passionate about finance which I love. But the class is very fast and his notes are not clear. Make sure you use the TA lab and do the reading before class and you will be fine. Don't depend on the lectures to learn the material. Great class.

Brau is a great guy, however I felt most of his class was dedicated to talking about how good of a teacher he was, rather than explaining the concepts and the questions. He would say everything is in the text book and then you would get to the textbook and wouldn't be able to complete problems on your own. Challenging but doable.
Tough class, but he teaches clearly. Do the reading, come to class, study, and you'll be alright.
Professor Brau is super nice and a great teacher. The lectures are clear, and homework is helpful. I greatly enjoyed his class!

Brother Brau's class was challenging, but he sets you up for success.  Those who don't do well are usually the ones that don't use the resources and constant help he offers.  His tests follow very closely the lectures in class.  I ONLY WISH HE WOULD GO OVER THE HARDEST PROBLEMS W/ US IN CLASS.
have mandatory pre-class chapter reading, trust me it helps students understand!!!!
Brother Brau gives very good lectures. I like that he broke up the fast pace with a  few spiritual thoughts. I enjoyed the class.
He is really passionate about finance but his tests are way to hard for a entry level finance class.

Very spiritual teacher, but the class is pretty hard. I feel like most of the class time is to just jot down notes to study later, as there is so much material to be covered. Not enough review on the concepts learned, and the class feels rushed. Very caring and energetic teacher, and very Gospel oriented

He's a good guy, but his lectures are hard to sit through a lot of time. Not as clear as he could be explaining the concepts in class. Makes you memorize a lot of formulas that the other professors don't require you to memorize. Overall, it's a lot of work for a class that's only the introductory level. His class is a MAJOR time demand on your time

Not my favorite class and the acronyms killed me also. Some of it falls on me for not being as prepared as i should have been, but I also had other classes that were taking a lot of my time to try and dedicate that much to this one. I feel like it is also a class that should have some prerequisites as it was a little above entry level

Professor Brau is a great professor. I loved his spiritual thoughts during class. However, lectures were hard for me to follow at times, largely due to not doing the reading before class. If you put forth the effort you can get a good grade in this class.

Dr. Brau is a good guy.  However, his teaching style is confusing.  This is an introductory class but is treated like an upper division class.  You are required to memorize countless formulas.  Overall, good class but overly complicated.

Brau is a great person, but not a great teacher.  He talks too fast, uses acronyms for everything, and his handwriting is impossible to read.  The material isn't that hard, but Dr. Brau glosses over the hard stuff and instead spends class time on "professional development."

Dr. Brau is the antithesis of a stereotypical professor. He's like the jock you didn't like in high school, but super nice and helpful. Doesn't act like a PhD at all. The class is huge, but the material on tests reflects homework and can be learned on your own. MyEducator is still a little tedious.

Brau is a great guy who makes class as entertaining as a finance class could possibly be. He is really interested in the well-being of his students and includes a spiritual thought every class period. His teaching method was a little hard to follow, and not much time was given in class to understand the material. Take finance with him!

Jim Brau is probably one of the best professors that I have had a BYU. People say that he is unclear becasue they did not do  the reading before class (if you do that, and take notes in class you arre guarenteed a B). I loved this class!
He is a really passionate teacher who wants you to succeed. He talks very fast at times but he does care. His TA labs are extremely helpful.
Teaches fast and sometimes not as clearly as he could.

Brother Brau was a fantastic teacher, he really wants each of his students to do well in the course and really understand the curriculum. Very funny, and he does a spiritual thought each class period which becomes the highlight of my day. Be warned, his tests are not very easy, but   you can manage if you do the reading and review the homework.
Great Professor! Sometimes he is hard to understand but if you do the reading and go to class, an A is very achievable. The class is also very interesting and applicable.

Brother Brau is awesome! Go to class, take notes and participate.  He provides all kinds of help so you can understand, apply and pass the class. The TA lab is open every day; if you go you'll get an A for sure.

He is very unprofessional and impossible to understand. There is a lot of material to visit in class and he makes sure to spend 2 seconds on everything--accomplishing nothing. Only perks are spiritual messages. Unfortunately, I am taking this to get into the Marriott School not to fulfill religion credits.

Lots of intensity, but average teacher. He seemed jumbled at times. Spend all your time studying or doing homework in the help desk. Worth it! Hard class, but well layed out, if you put in the work you will do okay. His spiritual thoughts though sometimes were downright offensive and ridiculous. Outside Utah County, he would offend many.

Study your notes and you'll do OK. You really won't learn concepts too well in class. Instead, you'll just learn what he is going to test you on so you can learn the material by yourself later on. Awesome guy though. He cares about students and loves what he does.

Great professor if you are into Finance, Accounting, Econ, Strategy, or any form of high level business. He is very intellectual and teaches you that way. Doesn't lecture the way the questions are asked so it makes it extremely difficult to master the material. Spiritual thoughts are great.

If you are interested in finance and do the work it is an easy A. The classes are pretty useless except for the random test questions that he gives you every so often to reward you for coming.  Most of class time is spent on material that you already read and very few practice problems. Take advantage of the help desk, especially early in the week.
He is really engaging but if you get behind in the class its really hard to catch back up. Sometimes he assumes that you know what he's talking about and moves really fast through the lectures.

Dr. Brau is an overall good person but not a great teacher.  His lectures are jumbled and he takes more time talking about himself than he does the material.  His lectures are pure conceptual and he throws in a practice problem day like every 3 weeks.  The book doesn't provide many examples to help with the homework or tests either.

Great Professor, Really excited about teaching and living life.  Only Professor I have had this semester whom I believe, lives up to the spiritual expectation this school says it has incorporated into its curriculum.

Brother Brau is a great man. He does his best to teach the content clearly. However, it will take a lot of effort on your own if you want to get a solid A. He doesn't explain everything in class. Some things are only explained in the readings or at the Finance Lab. THIS IS NOT AN EASY CLASS!! But it is a great class.

Professor Brau is great. He is very excited to be at class, though the subject is very hard, he loves it. He shows that he cares and wants you to succeed. I love him as a person, just the class is pretty difficult. Keep up on the reading BEFORE class and you should do well. If not, you may be lost at some of the subjects in class.
This class is hard but if you put forth the work and effort it is managable. Go to the help desk. Professor Brau can be crazy and funny at times but he is straightforward.

Finance is a HARD subject- but it is doable if you put forth the work and effort. The TA help desk rocks as well! Professor Brau is the man! He can be crazy and funny at times but I like the way he teaches. It is straightforward. He is personable and has office hours and is willing to help. Brau's spiritual thoughts are awesome!

I liked this class. Finance is a HARD subject- but it is doable if you put forth the work and effort. The TA help desk rocks as well! Professor Brau is the man! He can be crazy and funny at times but I like the way he teaches. It is straightforward. He is personable and has office hours and is willing to help. Brau's spiritual thoughts are awesome!
Overall he is a great teacher. His assignments and tests are reasonable, and he really helps you understand the material. If you take the class, I highly recommend taking it with Brau
Overall he was a great teacher. His assignments are reasonable, and he really helps you understand the material.

Bro. Brau is a great guy.  He makes class very interesting and I enjoyed attending.  The concepts are not too difficult, but there are a lot of concepts you have to learn which makes it difficult.  Always go to the TA lab and get help.  The tests are pretty difficult, but if you put in the effort you can get a good grade in his class.

Brother Brau is a nice guy and he knows his stuff. His lectures can be confusing, though, and sometimes he doesn't explain concepts clearly. You can tell he really cares about his students, and wants us to do well. Study hard for the tests... they're long and brain-wracking!

Brau is cool, but he gives advise specific for finance majors. His advise isn't very accurate unless you're in finance. Textbook is ok. Fairly clear, but homework problems are insane and don't always cover material from the chapter you just read (sometimes you can't find the answer online). Good class, but he treats it like it's more than it is.
Wonderful Teacher. Very Hard Class.

To be honest the subject of finance is a very interesting subject and Professor Brau is a cool guy! But I had a hard time following his lectures during class and understanding some of the concepts. The T.A lab is very helpful. His tests are pretty tricky so pay good attention in class. His spiritual thoughts during class are great!

Bro Brau is the man!! One of the hardest classes I have ever taken, but he does a great job of hitting the important points and covering just enough so you can figure out the homework and assignments later on. He genuinely cares about his students and shares a spiritual thought every day in the middle of class. Hard class, great teacher. KEEP UP!

Brother Brau is awesome. He shares spiritual thoughts during class to give your mind a break and to wake you up. He understands that we have lives outside of class and makes his class as student friendly as possible. The material is hard but if you work and truly try to understand how to do things  you will be fine. P.S Take good notes!!!

I love the layout of Prof. Brau's lectures. I really like that he writes everything down so you know exactly what is important for the tests. I also really enjoyed and appreciated his spiritual thoughts. This is a hard class, but Prof. Brau makes it bearable.

Great teacher. I had to this this class a second time and Brau was by far the better teacher. He is hilarious in his lecture and works hard to make tests fair, but that doesn't mean easy. If you have to take this class, take it from him.

Brother Brau makes a constant effort to keep his students engaged through spiritual thoughts and real live data. He's reasonable in the homework's and his tests are a fair assessments of what you've learned. I would highly encourage using the TA help desk for study and homework help.
Great teacher. He really cares about his students.
He is very interesting and wants the best for the students. I just dont think he explains thing very well and he needs to do more real world examples.
Professor Brau was fun and his class is entertaining as well as presented well.  All around a good professor (in what he teaches.) He makes a boring and tedious subject bearable.
Really good professor. Love the spiritual insights.
Really good professor, love the spiritual insights!!

Excellent teacher. Shows a real love for his students and a real desire for them to progress and learn and grow in every way possible. Very humorous and engaging. Inspiring. Motivating. Blends spiritual things and thoughts in with finance and real life experiencing. Incredible style. He could teach ANYTHING and make it interesting!!! He's the man!!

Understands that not all students are interested in Finance, but that many have to take the class as a pre-req. Does his best to ensure that everyone gains value from the class both intellectually and spiritually. Teaches clearly and genuinely wants students to give their best effort. Not an easy class, but well worth it if you are willing to try.
good teacher

Jim Brau is the man! This class itself is known to be one of the tougher classes at BYU, but the way he teaches makes class easy to attend and pay attention! he clearly demonstrates how to complete problems and really focuses on the intuition behind formulas. He is also a cool guy and makes class enjoyable!
He is extremely clear about what is on the tests and if you take good notes they are easy.  Very profound insights.  I really hope you take his class because you will not regret it.

Brau is an awesome teacher, I really enjoyed learning finance from him. The class can be involved and having a good understanding of math will help to better understand the intuition behind the equations used, although its not necessary it is helpful. Overall great teacher that made the lectures enjoyable and interesting. Definitely take from Brau!
I thought Professor Brau explained things well, and helped me to learn the material

Professor Brau is a great teacher. He is really involved in the class, does his best to keep kids excited about the subject material. He teaches a lot of practical, applicable material that you will use later on in life. Take finance from him.

I really like Brau. He goes way out of his way to break up the lectures to keep people interested (spiritual thoughts,personal improvements etc). The class isn't an easy one but he keeps it entertaining and enjoyable. I would recommend taking 201 from him for sure. Really good guy

I would highly recommend Brother Brau. I personally connected with his teaching style, which I know not everyone does. The best thing you can do is read the textbook before you go to class because he then elaborates on that material (since there is more than can be covered in class). Utilize the TA's and stay on top of the homework. Great class.

Prof Brau knows his stuff.   However, he can't transfer knowledge to the students.  Lots of notes that are useless.  His practice problem days are just him putting up problems, giving us a minute to try it out, and then showing us the answer.  If you are confused about what to do, good luck. Wicked tests!

Brau is an awesome guy.  I really like him as a person, but not as much as a teacher.  I didn't like the way the class was structured.  I felt like a lot of material was left up to the student to try to figure out.  Brau is a great guy, his teaching style just really didn't connect well with me.
Great guy.  Do your reading.  He seems to care about your success, however you definitely have to put your time in studying if you have no experience with finance. Good luck!
Great guy.  Do your reading.  He seems to care about your success, however you definitely have to put your time in studying if you have no experience with finance.
Nice guy, tries to set you up for success.

Go to class and TAKE NOTES. really know the material for the test. Memorize things as you learn them, if you dont know the material iwell when you first cover it, you'll be lost when you move on to the next section. I waited until the first midterm to really learn it and ended up barely getting a C. Its doable, you just have to put in the time.
Brother Brau is a great man with a strong personality. Taking notes from his overheads can be a struggle at times, but he is willing to clarify himself if you ask.

Great professor. Really tries to engage students and does an excellent job of making the material applicable to non-finance majors as well. Gives great daily spiritual messages. Wouldn't take finance 201 from anyone else!
I am not a huge fan of finance, but Professor Brau made learning fun. He kept the class interesting and gave detailed information for what to expect on the tests.

Professor Brau really really loves finance and he makes you love it too.  His lectures are engaging and he does a great job of breaking things down.  He takes notes along with you in class.  He uses a lot of abbreviations.  Sometimes he gets a little intense.
Interesting Class. I learned a lot. He doesn't teach very good. There is a lot to cover as far as material. If you like finance then I would definitely take his class

Great Course! It is a must to attend class and complete the reading prior to class to have the greatest success. Also it is wise to use the awesome Help Desk that is provided for all your homework and excel assignments

Brother Brau was great!  I love the spiritual thoughts in his class, and even though it was a huge class he tries to make it feel like its one on one with you.  He is so energetic that it is difficult to follow him sometimes, but as long as you go to class he lets you know what will be tested and how to do it.

Brother Brau is hilarious and super spiritual, but I cannot say how many times he said, "Alright, everybody got it? Good, let's move on," when I was totally lost. You have to know his mindset or you will be struggling. His TA's rock, though. Super helpful.
Finance with some fun put in. Still pretty difficult
Finance is a pretty fun class with Brau. His lectures are entertaining and he really wants to help you succeed at life. However, with such a large class in the JSB... it's easy to fall asleep.

The spiritual thoughts were great and he is a pretty entertaining teacher, however the class is just a bunch of memorization.  The teacher is very bad at explaining the intuition behind the concepts and has a very difficult time connecting with how students learn.  Class is not easy but you can definitely get an A with hard work.

Brau is a great guy! His class isn't too bad if you do the readings and the homework. He moves pretty quickly through the first portion of the class which can be difficult.  Review the homework problems and your notes and you'll do great on the tests.
Enthusiastic about helping students and guiding them to professional excellence. The text is clear and the homework is around an 1 1/2 per week. Do the work and youll get an A in the class
It was a good class. Just pay attention and do the reading and homework and you will be fine. He's a good teacher and tries to go to the pace of students.
Brau did a good job explaining concepts.  You just need to take the time outside of class to connect the various concepts taught and really get the intuition.

He's a really kind teacher, and is looking out for his students, but he talks a mile a minute and expects you to understand most of the concepts discussed in class upon arrival. You need to know your stuff and work your butt off to get a good grade with Brother Brau.
Brother Brau is a stud. I enjoyed his class, he really cares about all of his students. Formulas can be difficult at times, but he teaches very clearly.

Brother Brau is my favorite! He's very passionate and really seems to want to help students succeed. He tells you what will be on the tests and gives you every chance to succeed. He gives fantastic spiritual thoughts every day. I love the guy!
Good professor, usually very clear. Very interested in student retention of the material. Generally very helpful.
He's a great teacher. He brings it every class. It is hard though and the tests are pretty challenging. Interesting information, but moderately hard.

The class is hard and has alot of work. I was constantly stressed about the class. The TA lab is helpful which is nice because the lectures aren't that great. Brau is energetic but it is too much sometimes. He goes too fast and jumps around. Tests are HARD!
Great guy, clear and knowledgeable. If you put a couple of hours a day to study outside of class you'll do just fine.
Definitely a difficult class but Brau works really hard to make it interesting and teach you what you need to know for his tests, which are rather difficult. Do all the work and you should be fine!
I loved this class! His lecture is really fun and interesting. His tests aren't easy so you may need to study hard. But if you study and so homework every time, you should be fine!
Lectures are fun and Dr. Brau is a great guy. He designs the class so that you have help available provided that you put the time and effort to get help. Dr. Brau makes lectures fun and dynamic.

This was a difficult class though fairly enjoyable because Brau is not your typical boring lecturer.  He does a good job of keeping things lively in lecture, though he often moves to quickly and its hard to keep up. Homework and activities help prep for the tests well.

Finance is a difficult class no matter who you take it from. Things I like about Brau are that he is full of energy making class fun, and he prepares timely, uplifting spiritual thoughts for every class. This is a guy that really cares about his students and you can feel it.

Brother Brau is awesome! Not only are his lessons very well laid out and informative, but he always takes a break to give an amazing spiritual thought. Very funny and wants you to succeed. Keep up with the homework assignments and pay attention in class and you'll be just fine.
Brau is a great professor. He makes it abundantly clear what will be on the test during each class. As long as you study exactly what he tells you to, you should do fine!

Dr. Brau is seriously the man.  He is really funny, down to earth and cracks jokes all the time.  The only advice I can give is that the class requires a ton of effort.  He teaches good, sometimes too quickly but if you study on your own time, you will do just fine.
Brau does more than teach you finance he makes you want to be a better person.

Professor Brau is really great. Every class he teaches is inspiring and motivating. He integrates spiritual thoughts very well into the class. He also is very good about teaching the material. His class is very well organized and is set up to help students succeed. He's really concerned about his students and is very approachable. Great class!

He is fun and enthusiastic teacher that i have ever met in BYU. Himself was good teacher but the the class itself was not as good as him because it was really big class over 200 students taking it at the same time so i don't personally like this kind of big class. Jim brau will make you interested in Finance for sure!

Okay, here is what you need to know about this class and how to get an A. Brother Brau is awesome, but he NEVER explains the big picture. That is what the textbook does. You HAVE to read and get the big picture before class, then go to class and let him further explain the equations, and you will do awesome! If you do that, its easy.
Enthusiastic teacher. He gets a little confusing sometimes in the lecture but overall a good teacher.

Brother Brau is a fun teacher! I liked the way he taught. Studying for tests is hard because there is specifics of what to study you have to study everything. and questions on the tests are harder than anything you do in class. BUT he is an awesome teacher and very helpful. I loved his class and I learned a lot. I would recommend him any day.

He is very energetic but not very clear at all. He jumps around from place to place and takes breaks that are irrelevant to material. He likes to use examples of himself and pushes finance in a passive aggressive manner. I didn't like the class at all.
Very Passionate and entertaining but the tests are pretty rough.

Brother Brau is a great teacher. He is passionate about his subject and shares that passion with his students. Sometimes he forgets not everyone understands finance as much as he does so there are sometimes gaps in his lectures. Overall, a solid class.

Yes, the class can be a bit challenging, you need to go to T.A. hours if you want to get good grades on the test. FOR CRYING OUT LOUD THIS IS BYU NOT COMMUNITY COLLEGE, put the time into the class and you will get an A. As in any other class.
Prof. Brau is extremely helpful. He really cares for his students. He and his TA team always do their best to provide to best help to the students possible. He is awesome!

Brother Brau is very passionate about this subject and does a great job keeping class entertaining. He gives great spiritual thoughts during each class. Class is confusing if you don't read the text before hand. Also plan on spending sufficient time each work to really work the problems in the textbook to know the material for the class.

Brau was a decent teacher. He knows a lot about finance and is good at keeping you engaged in class. He has an abbreviation for every word so it’s hard to keep up with the lessons when you’re trying to figure out what the abbreviation means. His handwriting is also illegible and all class lectures are written on the board.

Recommended for all students even if not planning to go to business school. Introduction to real world finances. Take advantage of the TA lab as they are awesome. Go to class take notes and you'll do great

Difficult class. Homework once or twice a week. Reading before class makes class useful, if you don't read class can be very confusing. The TA lab is where I learned most things. Anyone can get 100% on HW. I would spend 2-5 hours per HW assignment in order to do the full reading and understand it. Tests are hard.
His classes are the type where if you read and understand the text book, for the most part, you really don't need to come to class and he can be a little confusing in class.

I loved taking this class from Doctor Brau. He was quite entertaining to listen to and made class more bearable. He always had a deep concern for his students, more than usual, and he always had inspiring messages to share. If you need to take this class, I recommend you take it from him .

He is a very helpful teacher and is always willing to talk to his students and help those that are struggling.  His tests are more based on concept understanding than on mathematical problems so if you go to lecture and take good notes you will do fine.
I really enjoyed the class. Professor Brau is great and he makes it enjoyable with his spiritual thoughts and insights.

This is a very difficult class. Homework and class with very good notes are required for a decent grade. Reading before class is also a great idea. The TA lab is also very helpful because you can check your homework answers before you submit so you should always get 110% on homework. Brau tries to be as transparent as possible. The tests are hard.
Good teacher. Take lots of notes because the test is heavily graded on his notes.

Brau is all about helping you succeed later in life. His class may be difficult but he is more worried about you as a person. Throughout the whole course he gives life tips that are really helpful.  Plus he keeps things exciting in class-its an enjoyable experience.  Go to class, do the hw and you should be alright.

Professor Brau is super entertaining and class goes by super fast, but this is a business class so you will have to work hard. Take extremely thorough notes in class as he doesn't use slides, so once class is over the information is gone. Go the TA lab. It works wonders on your grade! But overall, I liked Brau. You just really have to work hard.

Brother Brau does a great job of being enthusiastic and does his best to keep students engaged. However, I found him to be extremely over the top. He is very intense and spends large amounts of class time on religious matters.
