Art history comes to life with Dr. Hartvigsen. His tests can have some random questions with details that arent that significant, but overall they are reasonable. He is hilarious and so so real. You dont need the textbook to get a good grade, but it would be helpful if you learn from getting the information from multiple sources. highly recommend!

Possibly my favorite GE class. It's 3 years since I've graduated and I still think about his class. 10/10 recommend if you care about art, culture, or the human experience. Plus he played us a song on his guitar and sang to help calm our stress on final exam day.

Professor Hartvigsen has great perspectives on a lot of cultural and historical topics and he is always fun to learn from. His class is interesting, but most of the grade comes from the two exams and a project, and the exams, though not hard, are all stuff from the lectures so don't miss a class.

Bruh I dont even know what was happening in this class. Every class is the exact same, I fell asleep in probably every class. The TA's grade super hard. But love the class set up of grading and tests. Otherwise i guess it is fine for a general
I LOVED this class! Prof. Hartvigsen is truly an expert in his field and he makes his lectures so engaging.

He is an amazing professor. He is so passionate about the topics that you can't help but sit in awe a/o try to write down everything he says. He helped me to find a passion for art myself. His tests are hard but lowkey fun. Make sure you know the periods, a handful of artworks from each, and can teach what you've learned in class. You'll be fine.

If you're someone who cares about GPA, do NOT take this class. You can study hard for the exams, but at the end of the day, your grade feels like it was drawn out of a hat. Classic subjective art classes. I wish we could substitute them for useful life skills classes in our GE checklist.

Go to your TAs for this class! So helpful! I did poorly on the midterm and totally turned it around by seeing my TAs about the final project and the final exam. Professor Hartvigsen is so great and clearly very knowledgeable and passionate about the subject. They don't take attendance, but a large portion of your grade is in-class assignments.

Have fun memorizing 200 pieces of artwork for the final, not to mention midterms. This class is what my grandpa would call, "a fart in the wind." Absolute waste of time and only made more complicated by a difficult teacher who obviously only cares to drag down your GPA

The professor teaches the from the sides, when he is there... he missed class 3 times and had a 90 min QA session about his personal life. TA does all the grading for every assignment and test and hasn't given feedback for any of it. The grading is based on industry specific writing that they don't teach you how to do.

WOW! I've never had a problem with professors before, and I've had some tough professors. The professor actively made it difficult to follow the course. The assignments don't have any descriptions and he orally dictates what the assignments are. If you email him about the assignment after class for clarification, he will tell you "I will not help."

The class is not super difficult if you attend class and put in time to study. Two tests, one big writing assignment, a handful of small writing assignments that are essentially graded on completion. An easy-ish A overall, and my last GE (yay!), but not really my favorite class in the world. You do not need to read the textbook imo.

The professor teaches the slides but that's it. TA does all the grading for every assignment and test. Literally impossible to know what to do to get an A, it's just subjective what the TA likes or not. Asked for clarification and got super vague feedback. Read instructions super carefully and tried to follow the vague rubric and still got docked.

Overall a pretty good class. I enjoyed the lectures. However, tests required more studying than typical GE class. What really was frustrating was getting a low grade on my final project (TA graded), which moved me from A to A-, even though there wasn't really a rubric; it just felt unfair. Just reach out to the TA beforehand before you turn it in.

Great professor who genuinely cares about his students. He was considerate and caring. I struggled grasping the concepts but I don't think that was his fault. The tests were incredibly challenging for a 200 level GE class. I went to every lecture and studied but still ended up feeling overwhelmed & confused & felt like I was guessing on the tests.

A great professor indeed, and passionate about art history. He brings the past alive and is a great lecturer. One midterm, a final, and a semester-long project. All of the work is centered around those three things. They can be hard, but think creatively, and it will be okay. Great professor!

I took ARTHC 300 (Theory & Methodology - idk why there's no option) and it was amazing. The first half of the semester is very reading-heavy, then the second half is presentations and 1 final paper. He is the nicest professor ever, very understanding, VERY good at lecturing. This class took work, but was not overwhelming in the slightest.

For a general class, this one is great. Dr. Hartvigsen made the class very interesting and for someone who doesn't love art, I actually enjoyed this class a lot. I will say it is very lecture heavy and I found myself dozing off in class sometimes. Great teacher though and would take again from him.

Wow, Dr. Hartvigsen is so good. He takes a boring subject and makes it so interesting. Lectures felt like we were detectives, sleuthing what these ancient people may have done. Weekly assignments are very light, I opted out of the textbook and am fine. The tests are all free response but as long as you take good notes in the lectures you'll be fine

Love him! His 202 class changed my life. I was an art skeptic at first taking this class as an easy ge, but throughout the semester, my world-view has changed! Dr. Hartvigsen is the best ever. So kind and funny and has an amazing testimony. Just hearing his stories and perspectives on different paintings was just amazing. Please take this class!

The lowest grade I ever got in any class in my entire college career (if that tells you anything). I never missed a class and went to every TA review, but the in-class timed tests were impossible to prepare for and were extremely hard. He seemed like a nice guy and I liked his lectures, but I would not recommend taking a class from him.

Professor Hartvigsen is absolutely AMAZING! He uses story telling to bring art works and artists alive. There are about 9 SHORT writing assignments throughout the semester and 1 longer paper/project at the end of the semester. The midterm and final are taken in-class. They typically consist of several short answers and one long answer response.

Prof Hartvigsen is such an intelligent professor and really cares about his students. You can tell he loves what he teaches about! It's not an easy class, but I LOVED it (I also love art history though). You have to go to class and take notes and pay attention to do well on exams, but I always found them interesting.

This class is awesome. Dr. Hartvigsen is incredibly kind, down-to-earth, and genuine, and a great lecturer. Really changed how I see the world and gave me a great love and appreciation for the visual arts. Plus double count for GE!

Hartvigsen is one of those people that you love as a person & teacher but not necessarily how they do grades. For example, despite him claiming that we didn't need to memorize dates, turns out we did. The class is very test heavy, so you have to memorize a lot of dates. Besides that, love him though. He's funny & has entertaining lectures.

Professor Hartvigsen was an entertaining teacher and kept me awake during the long lectures. He cared about his students and wanted to help them gain a new perspective. He focused on overall trends and important info instead of tiny details on tests which I appreciated. The criteria of assignments were often vague, but he is a great professor.

Amazing, funny, extremely kind. He made the hour and 15 minute class not seem so bad. Grade was based on 10 small assignments (basically participation), 1 writing assignment, and 2 tests (final was not cumulative). He cares more about big concepts than small minute details. Definitely recommend for a fun easy general

He's very passionate about art, music, and culture! If you want an A in his class, you've go to to class and pay attention (which was sometimes difficult for me) and none of the things he says in his lectures are online. But it was a super light workload and easy A! He's a great professor. oh, and DON'T BUY A TEXTBOOK I never opened it and was fine

I cannot say enough good things about Prof Hartvigsen! He is so passionate, his lectures are engaging, and he actually cares about you. I don't think it was that hard, as long as you pay attention in class. The exams require memorization but they are NOT super hard. He makes art history come alive! 10/10 would recommend & take this class again!

I did not like this class, I think Art History is unbearably boring. BUT I loved professor Hartvigsen. He cares so much about his students and was a good lecturer, even though I feel asleep every single class. From what I was awake for, it wasn't bad. The last day of class he brought his guitar and sang to us and cried and it was so wholesome.

Prof Hartvigsen is amazing! His lectures were very engaging (esp for an evening class) and he has a lot of passion for art/art history. The only grades you get are for 1 project, 3 exams, 1 extra cred paper, and pop quizzes. Exams are easy if you memorize names, dates, artists, and locations for 100+ works. This class takes work, but it's worth it!

Dr. H is an incredible lecturer who is hilarious and so passionate! Beware that the tests are most of the grade, and they require a lot of studying. It's definitely hard to get a solid A in this class. Besides that, I always looked forward to this class and learning about art. I would totally take another art history course with him again!

There are only 5 things that make up your final grade: 1 paper, 3 tests, and your score on pop quizzes. Tests are closed book, closed note, timed, in class, and are HAND WRITTEN. No multiple choice options! Have to know the artist, full name of artwork, date, and location for 50ish artworks for EACH test. Only 7 people have an A-, no one has an A

If you do not like memorizing things then don't take this class, but Dr. H is awesome! His lectures are super interesting and the tests and quizzes are not bad if you pay attention in class and memorize the artworks sooner rather than later.

Professor Hartvigsen is a great professor, you just have to be aware that this class isn't the easiest class if you're doing it for a GE. He's an amazing guy and I'd like to be friends with him, but his class is very challenging with over 100 paintings, dates, and artists to memorize per test. Your grade also lies solely in your test scores.

I love Dr. Hartvigsens lectures. He is so funny and loves his students. Beware of pop quizzes but mostly be ready to memorise art for the tests. The textbook is not needed but attendance is mandatory. This class is difficult but worth the fun!

Do not take this class. There are so many other GEs you can take that are easier. You memorize an outrageous number of artworks that you promptly forget the minute the test is over. If you have a photographic memory go for it, but i'm serious, DO NOT choose this for a GE!

I wouldn't say the class is easy, but you will learn so much! I was vaguely interested in the subject coming into the class and coming out it is like a core personality trait, the professor is engaging and kind and passionate about the subject. Take it!

Love his class! He's super passionate and makes the most boring art pieces interesting! Tests are very hard, but doable if you are willing to put in some time. And they are not cumulative! There is a textbook, but he doesn't assign reading & it's more for your own test review. TA's are responsive and helpful. Would definitely recommend this class!

His lectures are SO interesting and he loves to open up topics for debate. He makes you feel like your opinions and comments matter. Be prepared to memorize 80-100 pieces of art with name, date, and location for the three big tests. This is more doable than it sounds. I had to study for 8 hours for each test, but I never got lower than an 88%.

I have been lucky enough to learn from Dr. H as a student, TA, and intern. He is incredibly passionate about what he teaches and facilitates a learning environment that is safe while still pushing students to explore new ideas. I HIGHLY recommend Dr. H and hope that every BYU student has the opportunity to take a class from him.

This class was great. I am not an art history major, and yes he makes you memorize a lot of art. But….it’s an ART HISTORY class. Of course we had to memorize art. It is all worth it for the lectures. He is amazing in class. He shares his love for art and ties it into our world. His class is especially great in a troubled world.

One of my favorite professors at BYU. I really enjoyed going to classes because he is an amazing lecturer! He really cares about the students and his enthusiasm for art history is contagious. Pay attention in class so you can do well on the pop quizzes and tests. Tests are pretty hard and stressful, but doable. Memorize the art sooner than later!

If you don't get good TA's in this class, be prepared to get a lower grade. Dr. H does not do any of the grading, it all rests solely on the TA's. The tests were ridiculously stressful. They were limited to 45 mins where you had to write two essays, 5 short answers and identify 10-15 artworks from a list of 100 that you studied. Memorization heavy.

Dr. H is a fantastic prof, w compelling & engaging lectures. He changed my perspective on art history and opened my eyes to so many things. He is super funny & truly cares about his students. The tests are crazy hard tho, start MEMORIZING the pieces asap, DO NOT miss lectures if you can help it, beware of pop quizzes.
Spiritually enlightening, super fun to go to, and all around amazing. The tests were hard but WORTH IT

My favorite professor I've had at BYU. He made the lectures so fun and interesting, you could tell he really cared about what he was teaching. Also really cared for his students, always opened the class with making sure we knew we were wanted at byu. Class is pretty lecture heavy, just attend the lectures, take notes and you'll be fine!

The class is very unorganized, the TA's don't make it to their TA hours most of the time so finding help in this class was very hard to find. The description for the written assignments in this class was very unclear. would not recommend this class to anyone who is not a art major

Very kind man. He is extremely approachable and really cares about how you are doing and what he can to help you. He is VERY passionate about art and will always do what he can to help you get an A! Great teacher!
Dr. Hartvigsen was a really nice professor. My main complaint was that he didn't stay up to date to post our grades for assignments/tests. He was very caring and a great lecturer.

Kenneth is the best! Taking a class from 5-7:30pm in the summer is not the ideal, but I actually looked forward to his class. He is so lively, hilarious, and brilliant-- I enjoyed each of his lectures. He was incredibly open to making accommodations for some difficult situations I had during the term-- I could tell he truly cares for his students.
I really loved this class (albeit I am an art history major). Even though the tests were hard because of the intense memorization, his lectures were very eye-opening.

You end up memorizing over 100 pieces of art for each test. Its crazy that he doesnt cut it down so you end up memorizing 100+ names, dates, and locations to be tested on like 15 of them. I wouldnt take this class solely for the fact that I didnt feel like I actually learned anything, I just memorized and then forgot it all once the test ended.

I really liked this class. The hardest thing was that you have to memorize a bunch of paintings, the artist, and the date it was painted to within 10 years, but that's not too bad. I took the 2 and 1/2 hour class over the summer and was never bored. He helps you see and understand implications in art a lot.

His tests are too hard. We went through tons of slides with art on it and we had to memorize the name, date, place and sometimes the artist of ALL OF THEM. We were not told which ones would be on the test. I was graded very poorly on the essay and I put over 4 hours of work into it. Very hard for a general.

Fun class. Hartvigsen makes the subject interesting. It's frustrating that he won't publish grades so you feel like you're shooting in the dark sometimes. He will allow you to come in and chat with him about grades but not knowing beforehand what you're at is irritating.

I love this class! If you need to take a CIV class at BYU, take this class with Hartvigsen. I tried three other CIV classes and dropped them. He is a reasonable grader and his lectures are not bad at all. Show up to class (on time, there were quizzes at the beginning of each class), take good notes, and you will pass the class with a decent grade.

Professor Hartvigsen is a cool guy. You pretty much do the same thing every class period, go through 60+ slides while he gives some background and info of each piece of artwork. You have to memorize a lot of dates and paintings for each test, but it's doable. Don't buy the textbook.

I LOVE THIS MAN. BEST CHEM CLASS I'VE TAKEN. Not only are his lectures really helpful, he is just so genuinely kind. He is a good person. He makes his exams as simple and straight forward as he can, he asked us how many questions and points we thought the exam should have, and he even bumped up my grade at the end of the semester.
Such an amazing chem class. He is so nice & cares for his students. Go to him if need help with concepts of class because chem is hard but very doable to do well in class.

He was great.  Gen chem is hard.  His office hours are productive.  He teaches things well and isn't stuck up, when you ask questions he isn't afraid to just say he doesn't know, and he always comes back the next lecture with a real answer.  He's also young and a normal dude.

He preps his students so well for his tests. All my friends who took another 106 professor suffered and were constantly stressed. I scored a 90+ on every exam. What you see in class and on practice exams is what you get on the exam.
Try your hardest and you will succeed in Dr. Lee's class. Go to his office hours, he's happy to help and very kind!

Very humble and wants your success. He seems dedicated to making chem as stress-free as possible for his students. Homework and tests were graded in a very fair way. If you can take CHEM 106 from Dr. Lee, do it.

I love this guy so much. He is like, the best chemistry teach of all time. I would take this class again just to see Kenny every single day. Wow. Anyways, it's a chemistry class so definitely don't think it will be a breeze, but with Kenny, anything is possible. REALLY do those practice tests beforehand, do them in your sleep cause they saved me.
Lee teaches complex topics really well. Plus, this class has tons of helpful materials: Practice exams for every exam, dozens of exam prep slides, weekly review, ta hours, and more.
Professor Lee is awesome! I actually understood the material. I will say his tests are only 25 multiple choice, so not a lot of room to mess up. Overall, definitely take the class from him.

Professor Lee is a really good teacher! He really cares about his students and their success. He available for office hours and always wants to help. Chemistry is just a hard class, but he does well explaining things. We had 3 midterms and then a cumulative final. Most of our grades came from our tests, but he sends out really good practice exams.

Kenny Lee knows what's up. He cares about his students and does everything he can to help them succeed. His tests are very fair and he prepares you for them very well. Could not recommend this guy enough.

Ask any TA: Prof. Lee has the easiest exams. This guy GETS it. He's also pretty young so he's very relatable and has funny jokes. He gets that Chem106 is a tough class and he makes it very clear what you need to know and what ya don't. Significantly easier than Chem 105. 10/10 would do again.
I loved this class a lot, by far so much easier than 105. Professor lee was a great professor for 106.

I love Dr. Lee! He is so willing to meet with you outside of class. He taught very clearly and the tests were very straight forward! If you put in the work and take the time to learn the material, Chem 106 is very doable.
KENNY IS AWESOME. Best teacher to take chem 106 from for sure.
Dr. Lee is an awesome teacher! His tests are all multiple choice and super reasonable. He is very kind and explains challenging concepts well. Take Chem 106 from him.

Dr. Lee is a wonderful professor. I would recommend him to anyone taking Chem 106. He does a very good job teaching difficult concepts, and he definitely makes the class a lot easier than other professors do. He is a very genuine, caring man who values his students, and if you ever go to his office hours, you will receive his undivided attention.

Kenny's just a great guy and teacher. When asked questions, he answers them to the fullest capacity that helps you truly understand. He's humble enough that if he makes a mistake in answering a question, he'll go back and clarify (doesn't happen often). Plenty of materials to help study for exams.

Dr. Lee is so awesome and kind! He teaches hard concepts well through repeated ideas and practice questions in class. You have all the resources you need to succeed in this class. Sometimes he got behind in lectures and moved slowly, but it wasn't a big problem.

TAKE THIS CLASS FROM KENNY LEE!!! I cannot say enough good things about Professor Lee. It's for sure a grind just like 105 was but Prof Lee makes it so doable. He is super kind, thoughtful, and funny. His office hours are genuinely so helpful and I felt like he knew how to make complicated concepts simple. Prof Lee is the best!!

Chem 106 was hard for me as it is VERY math heavy. He as a professor genuinely tried his best to explain everything as thoroughly as possible. He gives the students at the beginning of the semester to decide how many test questions/ how they should be weighed, and tries to give as much grace as possible. Smartworks is also unlimited attempts

Dr. Lee is hilarious. He responds to emails quickly, teaches effectively, and is a fair grader. There is pre homework, attendance, and homework assignments. Tests are true to practice exams and he gives half points back for majority missed questions. Awesome professor, would take him again.
Great professor gives half credit on test questions that were confusing

Chem 227 is a hard class, but Dr. Lee makes it doable. He is very clear about how to succeed on assignments and cares about his students. There is a lot of homework and lab reports take a while, so try and stay ahead of the work/work in groups as much as you can.

Dr. Lee is incredibly kind, forgiving and easy to work with. He specifically asked us for advice about how this class is taught and I have full reason to believe he is actually going to implement it. 227 is far less hard than it is hyped to be and will be especially manageable if you take it from Dr. Lee.

Dr. Lee is hands down the best professor that the BYU chemistry department has. He is incredibly kind and smart! You can tell he truly cares about his students and took the time to really teach me. He was intentional and gave me the opportunity to really challenge myself. The class is a lot of work but Dr.Lee is amazing! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

I never thought I could get an A in chemistry or enjoy learning it, but this class was set up for students to succeed if they worked hard. Dr. Lee had very helpful practice tests that were similar to the tests and was very willing to help students in office hours. This class was still challenging, but very doable with him!

Everyone who knows me knows that I hate chemistry. Professor Lee helped me enjoy chemistry for the first time in my life. The class is hard, but he is so accessible outside of class and is always willing to help. I highly recommend taking this class from him. He's a great teacher and really cares about his students.

DR. LEE IS AWESOME!! He seriously is the kindest soul ever. Taking Chem 106 from anyone will be a grind but Dr. Lee explains things really well and is super approachable. There were 4 midterms and each was worth 12% of your grade, the final is 22%. Work the practice exams till you can do it in your sleep, then review the tests after!

I loved professor lee. I was in his first ever class as a professor and he did a great job. The material is hard but he does a good job at working on relevant problems. The tests are difficult but just make sure to study real hard the practice exams because they are very similar. I never read the textbook and learned everything from the lectures.

Dr. Lee is a great professor! He takes the time to get to know his students names during lecture which shows how much he cares about his students. His lectures can sometimes run too long where content isn't covered towards the end but he posts his power points after class and is reachable during office hours to pop in if you have any questions.
THIS IS THE BEST PROFESSOR AT BYU. Take this man if you can, if not, you are missing out. One day he jumped up on the table..��

If you just do what you are supposed to, you can easily pass this class. Dr. Gee is very kind and great at explaining things. I love that he ties science into the gospel. He tells you what concepts will be on the test. The course itself has so many resources to help you succeed. There are TA's, videos, practice questions, review room, etc.

Great professor but this class is managed by the department so class isn't really his own. Be aware there are 4 midterm tests and a final that's comprehensive. The homework is easy to get a good grade on since it's submitted multiple times. No extra credit is offered. If science isn't your thing get ready to work. Go to the TA labs!!

There was a decent amount of reading but I mostly studied using the TA review slides and I got A's and B's on all the tests. There's no essays in this class, just a few short writing assignments every once in a while (like a paragraph).

I am not science oriented and sometimes it's hard for my to understand. The homework and classwork is super easy, but the tests can be kind of hard. We were supposed to do reading from the textbook and apply what we learned to our homework but I didn't and I was fine. This will be an easy class for you if you consider yourself decently smart.

Prof Gee is awesome. Takes boring science topics and integrates them with interesting gospel topics. I seriously learned so much. He is super good at being specific at what is exactly on the exams. Such a nice dude who just genuinely wants to do good in this world. Much respect.

Dr. Gee was a great professor. I am not a science person at all, but Dr. Gee made it accessible and fun during this class. The lectures are super helpful. The toughest parts of this class were the tests and the constant homework, but it's totally possible to do well in the class without killing yourself, which was really nice.

Prof Gee gives really good lectures and welcomes a lot questions. Each lab is taught by a TA where you do a weekly article and lab. I never read the devotionals but always got a good grade on the article assignments bc the TA always told us exactly what to write. The last few tests and the final were pretty hard.

Dr. Gee is a very funny man and he cares about his students. The problem is that he doesn't choose the material for his tests and the class itself is a ton of unnecessary homework. I did not get a lot out of most of his lectures either. If you're fine with taking two classes for this GE and don't like science, take one of the other options.

Professor Gee is knowledgeable and really cares about his students. He does what he can to ensure you succeed in his class and it works. You still will have a decent amount of work to do as in all PHY S 100 classes, but Professor Gee makes it a great time.

I hate Physical Science, but Gee was great. He's a great lecturer and his TAs are really helpful. Tests are manageable. Helpful tip for your final -- do the practice test!! A lot of the questions were the same.

PS100 is difficult but if you are going to take it from someone at BYU, take it from Dr. Gee. He makes the class fun and bearable. The classes are large for PS100 because it is a GE; however, he makes it feel like a small class. I highly recommend his as a professor. The class kind of sucks but it is not his fault. He tells you what is on the final

Professor Gee is fabulous. He approaches his class with so much enthusiasm and energy. This course covers alot of content ground, but is structured in a way that makes it entirely possible. My only complaint was the Testing-Center hosted exam after unit, but they could have been alot worse.

This class is a flipped classroom so you do a lot of the work at home, which can be hard. However, Dr Gee is the best professor I've had at BYU so far. He really cares about your success and you can tell that he knows what he is talking about. He is passionate about his job and about helping students. If you do the readings you'll be set!!
Gee is THE one to take this class from. I was just here for the credit so I could graduate. He made the class so much more understandable and way easier. I loved him!

I liked Professor Gee, I just was bothered that he started each class with "I don't know a lot about this subject." It made me lack faith in him. However, he is super likeable and relates the gospel to class frequently.

Dr. Gee is awesome! I loved going to class just to see his demos and hear him explain concepts, they helped me learn so much more than the textbook provides. Make sure to keep up with the reading and assignments, theyre not hard at all and will really help your grade. Also lets you take in a full sheet of notes for tests which is super nice.

Professor Gee is the best! He cares for his students and is really funny. Just get ready to read about a chapter and take a quiz on it every other night. Overall test can be hard, but just read the chapter, do the lessons, and ask people for help (TAs).

Hes a funny guy but a terrible teacher, I felt like I learned nothing in the classroom and I had to reach out to outside sources to understand anything. Lots of people say its easy, but its not. Not recommended

I don't normally rate my teachers, but Professor Gee is a real gem! I'm not great at science but he is so passionate and energetic about everything that I couldn't help but fall in love with physical science. He is so caring and relates the topics to the gospel in the sweetest way. I absolutely loved him and it was by far my favorite class.

THE BEST. He understands the class is a general and the workload is super manageable. With him and the TAs anyone can get an A. If you can feel the spirit in a science class you know you've got a good one. Take this class from Prof Gee if at all possible.

I'm so glad I took from Prof Gee. From what I've heard, he's the best to take Phy S 100 from. He's super enthusiastic about what he's teaching, which made it way easier for this night owl to be in class at 9am. I'm not a huge science fan, but I had a lot of fun! If you read the textbook, do the homework, and participate in class, you'll do great.

Such a good class! Very doable, just keep up with your work and it's not bad at all. I loved taking this from Gee, even though I don't love science-he is hilarious and makes it so interesting! Very applicable to life, I find myself thinking about the physics or chemistry behind things all the time now! Take this from Gee!

Probably my favorite professor so far! He was super funny but always respectful of everyone. He made learning the material more fun. He was pretty lenient when it comes to testing and grading but not too lenient. He had a clear grading criteria and helped in every way he could.
Great teacher. Really made a commonly hated class truly enjoyable.
Good class. Easy if you put in minimal effort

Dr. Gee is passionate for science and the gospel. He loves helping students understand the material. He's hilarious. Lectures were optional but I enjoyed them and they helped for the classwork. Reading the entire textbook is required for full credit each week which took a lot of time. Some concepts were hard to learn but tests were pretty easy.

Took this as a blended class. My advice: get ahead on readings and lessons. Lectures aren't mandatory with the online format, but he does go over the classwork during them so that's helpful, plus he's really funny. Use the PS100 website to help review for exams(your TA can help you find this). Study lesson questions for exams.

I LOVED THIS CLASS!!!!!!!!! He understood that a lot of kids take it solely for the GE and made it interesting but not too hard. There was reading but you could just skim the chapter and take notes in class because he only lectured about what was important. Excellent at answering questions and guiding the class. Super funny and genuine guy.

He was hilarious and really designed his class so if you showed up, paid attention and did the homework you got a good grade. Easy to pay attention because he is an entertaining guy and really opened my eyes by connecting scientific principals to the real world. 10/10 recommend.

I procrastinated taking this class until my junior year and was dreading taking it, but Gee made it bearable and almost enjoyable. The class itself was a lot of work, but it's set up for you to succeed if you put in effort. TAs are your best friend. Tests are hard, but Gee did a good job of explaining difficult material. Lawler is great too!!

So many people that I know HATED physical science, but they did not take it from Kent Gee. He turned a class that people hate into a class that was fun and not nearly as stressful as expected. He truly wants his students to enjoy learning about science, and he is able to apply the principles that he teaches into things outside of physical science.

Dr. Gee is a really funny and nice guy. The class requires a fair amount of reading and work every week, but the tests were doable. The lectures didn't help much, and we had to do group work that wasn't effective over Zoom. Other than that, this class wasn't bad and Dr. Gee definitely tried to make it as interesting as possible.
Professor Gee was an incredible teacher. Almost reconsidered my major choice because he was so incredible.
He's a really good professor that makes the hard stuff seem easy.

I am definitely not a science student but Dr. Gee was a pretty good professor. There is a reading quiz due every class period as well as classwork to do each class period. About one test per month as well. He really tied the gospel into lectures which were really awesome!

Prof. Gee is incredible! This class can be difficult, but Gee makes sure to help you understand the material you need to know for tests. He also does spiritual discussions that relate to what we've been learning in class on test days. Lots of fun experiments! Homework isn't too bad, just some reading and answering questions.
Dr. Gee is such a funny professor! He is great at explaining content on a level for anyone to understand. The grading criteria is clear and there is a good balance of homework and tests.

Professor Gee is one of the best professors I have had. He genuinely cares about his students' success and lectures with direct correlation to will show up on the test. For all PS100 classes you just have to read the book and take the online quizzes (on the PS100 website) to do well on the test as many questions comes word for word. HE IS THE BEST!

I took Professor Gee's class my first semester at BYU and absolutely loved it. I always said I didn't like science... but this professor made PS my favorite class at BYU. He is funny, no-nonsense, and does NOT waste your time. You NEED to keep up w/the readings and the TA lab is your best friend!! Effort is required, but this professor makes it fun

Dr Gee is amazing. His lectures are hilarious but also incredibly spiritual. He has such a zest for science and life in general, and he tailors his lectures to class needs. He cares about his students and their success, and he'll take your highest scores for your final grade. Do the online practice quizzes and read the book and you'll do fine.

You have to read the entire book, but it isn't that bad. Professor Gee prepared you for the tests the best and he was the best lecturer by far and I was able to sit in lectures for two of the other Physical Science 100 Professors. I found the tests very easy and ended up with an solid A. If you have any background in science at all this class easy.

Professor Gee wants the students to learn and to pass the class, so it's not designed to break your back. The lectures are pretty funny and interesting, plus he explains things in a way everyone can understand. He always asks for questions to make sure everyone is getting it.
Professor Gee is great. The class in general is pretty easy if you put in the time.

Loved this class, even though I generally struggle with sciences. Dr. Gee tells you what you need to know to pass and will help you make it happen. He truly cares about his students and tries to make class as easy and interesting as possible.

Professor Gee is easily the greatest professor to walk the halls of BYU. He explains the material better than anyone else, is hilarious and actually cares about students. His testimony is super strong. He has a couple of great discussions about the gospel, and relates them to physical science. If you go to the TA lab regularly you'll get an A.

Brother Gee is easily my favorite professor! I have never enjoyed a science class, but this was my favorite. He incorporated the gospel into his lectures, which was the COOLEST! You can tell that he genuinely cares for each of his students, even if he doesn't know you. Plus, he is funny! I felt the Spirit stronger in this class than my BoM class.

DO THE ONLINE PRACTICE QUIZZES (on the ps100 website, they are not graded and are an additional tool) They are incredibly helpful in preparing for the test and some questions are almost exact. Dont expect to remember everything just by listening to Professor Gees outstanding lectures.

Kent is literally such a homie!! I went to a couple other Physical science teachers classes when I couldn't make his class and he is definitely the funniest and also teaches the material the clearest. I never read the textbook and easily got an A.

Dr. Gee did such a great job making this class enjoyable even though the subject matter isn't really my thing. He changes his lectures according to your feedback on the quizzes that you take before class. You can do well in this class if you do all the homework and go to the reviews.

Dr. Gee was my favorite professor this semester. He is so kind, funny, and entertaining to listen to. This class isn't too hard, everything is conceptual and once it clicks you'll do great. The TA lab is super helpful and Dr Gee loves to help any student after class, he's also just an amazing man who is very inspiring and uplifting!

Professor Gee is amazing. He is very passionate about what he teaches and really tries to work the gospel into science which was really cool. The TAs for this class are also great. The quizzes and assignments that we did really helped to study for tests, and it is definitely possible to do well in the class if you put in the time.

All professors follow the same grading criteria and core curriculum for this class. So basically the only thing the professor is good for is preparing you for the tests- honestly feel like the 1 hour TA review before each test was more useful than the collective hours spent in class. Gee is funny though. didn't round up my 89.8 to an A though!

Dr. Gee is a great choice for PS 100. He makes the information easy to understand and teaches what you need to know for exams. For every PS class, you read a chapter a night and take a short quiz that you can do up to a 100. Basically, if you do HW, go to lab & study, it's pretty easy to get an A.

My favorite class at BYU so far! Professor Gee made this class so interesting and fun to learn every unit, and explained everything as simply as he could. He is so caring towards each of his students. He made lecture so entertaining and connects science and religion in the most beautiful ways! Take this class from him!
Great professor, inspiring, AMAZING classes!!

10/10 recommend taking PS100 from Dr. Gee as a G.E. The class was WAY easy. You read a chapter before each class, but you can retake the online reading quizzes until you get 100%. All other hw gets done in the TA lab, which is once a week. The midterms are MC & 2 essay questions, but you review in class and the practice test preps you pretty well.
Dr. Gee is my hero.

Professor Gee is great! I would recommend him to anyone. He is funny, and he makes the lectures interesting. The material can some times be tricky, but he will literally tell you what is going to be on the test and what won't be. He also has good spiritual insights.

SUCH A GOOD TEACHER! He honestly cares about his students and their success. He understands how hard college is and teaches clearly. He does clicker quizzes to make sure we understand and will change the focus of the lecture depending on what we need more help on, which is impressive with such a big class. Also incorporates the gospel into science!

Amazing teacher! Every class was fun and exciting even if the course material was not terribly exciting. Dr. Gee presents in a fun engaging way that makes clear and easy sense. He is well prepared for each lecture and I wish all of my teachers taught like him. Take PS100 from Dr. Gee!!

Everyone else complained about their physical science class but it was my favorite class this semester thanks to Dr. Gee. He makes the lectures fun and interactive, he doesn't complicate the material, he tells you what you need to know for the test in a very simple/easy to understand way. Would recommend 10/10 over any other professor.
He doesnt put you to sleep at all with his lectures. He knows that he doesnt know it all so he works with us because we know less.

Dr. Gee is such a funny guy and loves to have fun while teaching. He really tries to make class exciting and often brings in lots of cool demos. Homework is very simple, tests are extremely straightforward, and the extra credit TA labs are a really nice grade boost. Very interesting class
Professor Gee is one of my favorite professors I have had at BYU. He keeps class entertaining and fun and the material is super interesting. Awesome class to take for your physics credit.
Awesome teacher

Dr. Gee is fun and does a great job teaching. It's an easy GE credit for non-science majors. Go to the labs each week and you get a ton of extra credit. Two short, easy papers, three midterms, and a final. All are manageable. Honestly, you don't really need the textbook. Everything you need to know is from the lectures.

Bro. Gee's lectures are entertaining and enjoyable. He explains difficult concepts in a clear manner, and is always open to answering any of your questions. The TA labs are very helpful and there are many ways to get a good grade in this class, including extra credit. If you need to take a physics credit and enjoy music and speech, this is for you!

This class was my favorite! Professor Gee is hilarious and makes his lectures interesting. When the test arrives you feel unprepared, but the TA reviews really help get you ready for the test. I had never taken a physics class before taking this class so I was expecting it to be a challenge, but it really wasn't too bad.

While participation isn't mandatory, if you skip all the time it'll hurt your grade.  He gives LOADS of extra credit, and the study guides for the test are thorough.  You have to study a little, but it is an easy class, and the teacher is hysterical.  The class is the BEST for the SCIENCE GE.  Take this.  Seriously. Do it.  I rate it 10 stars.

Dr. Gee is perhaps the best professor I've ever had while at BYU. He is passionate about physics and makes it fun to learn for his students. If you put in the effort, go to TA reviews, and go through the review study guides, there is no reason you shouldn't make an A. There's TONS of extra credit opportunities. Best science GE I've ever had.

Prof. Gee is awesome!  He loves doing demonstrations which make things a lot more memorable, and to be quite honest it is a relatively easy class.  He will make sure that you are set up to get an "A", and anything less is entirely your fault.  Also, he's the man!  He cares about students, tests aren't hard, classwork is easy.  Take this class.

Professor Gee is GREAT. His class is organized so that you can do your best, even if you're not great at physics. Very clear cut syllabus and schedule, just do the work and it will be okay. He wants you to have fun and learn. Demonstrations are great. TAs are really helpful. Never scared of going to class, knew I could always ask for help.

Quite simply: The best teacher I have had at BYU, funny, smart, kind, intelligent, clear, entertaining. The class was fun because of him. I didn't enjoy science prior to the class, and he helped me respect it. And getting an A was great as well. TAKE FROM HIM AT ALL COSTS!

Professor Gee is the only professor to take Physical Science from. He makes sure to prepare you for the tests (which are done by the apartment) and tries to make class interesting. If you have to take Physical Science, take it from him
He is a great teacher. He is hilarious and really tries to help us understand the material. He tries to remember our names when we ask questions. I would recommend taking the class from him.
Piece of Cake class! Excellent Prof!

I am definitely not a science person, but Professor Gee kept it interesting and worth coming to class.  He is engaging so class seems to go by pretty fast most of the time.  Great professor.  Just go to a TA lab that you want to because some are definitely more helpful than others.

He was a great professor. I absolutely do not like physics, but he was so excited about it I could help but enjoy it as well. The material wasn't difficult just time consuming and lots of repetition of problems will help a lot.

This was a super hard class- probably because I don't love physics. Dr. Gee(k) was a great teacher though. He certainly likes physics. I wasn't fond of the tests. 10 mc math problems, 10 or so conceptual (killer). I ended up doing pretty well in the class because I did all of the homework assignments. Overall, I was pleasantly surprised.
Excellent professor. Very fun and interesting in class. He knows his stuff and loves teaching it.

Is very good at explaining difficult-to-understand concepts. I got near a 100% in the class, and all I did was go to class, lightly skim the reading, do the homework, and take the tests. Good teacher!
Super cool guy. Pretty difficult class.  Going to class is fun though. Use the TA lab!

Dr. Gee is the man.  I pretty much had no interest in physics except that it is a pre-medical requirement.  Dr. Gee was able to explain things in a great way that was easy to understand.  He pretty much gives you every possibility to succeed besides just giving you the A.  He loves what he does and can be seen by how he teaches.

Gee has never taught Physical Science until this past year. He was fantastic at it. He tried to learn everyone's name, and really showed interest in the course. He explained the basics of what we needed to know, and was always available when you needed help during his office hours. He uses power point, i clicker and presentations to explain.

Professor Gee is the MAN!!!! He really cares about his students, even learning their names in the class of about 300 people.  He only teaches what you need to know.  You have to read the book to fully understand the concepts, but he will tell you what you need. He makes a boring subject interesting. We need more teachers like him.
Has a good sense of humor that keeps the class moving along and keeps us awake.  Even people who don't like science liked his class.  Absolutely amazing teacher!

Fantastic teacher and person.  He's the type of professor that makes class fun and exciting.  I never wanted to miss a lecture.  He's very smart and one of the nicest professors on the campus.  I had surgery during the school year and he offered to give me one-on-one help in his office if I needed it, even though the class is loaded with TAs.

Fantastic teacher and person.  He's the type of professor that makes class fun and exciting.  I never wanted to miss a lecture.  He's very smart and one of the nicest professors on the campus.
