Kempton is my favorite math professor Ive had at BYU. He is so kind, very passionate about mathematics, and very humble too. He loves when you come in for office hours. Taking Linear Algebra from him was the biggest positive influence for me to change my major to math. I was anxious about math prior to his class, but now Im just excited about it.

Dr. Kempton was a great professor. He covered most of the proofs on the exams and the homework in class, and he is always willing to make time for you during his office hours. His enthusiasm makes math fun and his lectures create a good environment for learning as a group.

Dr. Kempton was a very enthusiatic teacher which made lectures a little bit more exciting. Many times however we would not cover many of the harder things we had to do on homeworks in class and lectures felt slightly disorganized a times, but overall he was a good teacher.

Dr. Kempton has been one of my favorite professors I have ever had! He is very passionate about what he teaches, and he makes lectures very entertaining. Very accessible during office hours, or willing to schedule a time with you. Attendance isn't mandatory, but lectures are recommended. Lots of EASY homework (any 313 class will give lots of it).

Dr. Kempton was an awesome professor. His lectures sometimes feel jam-packed, but its tough to say whether or not he has anything to do with that considering the Math Department designs the course. I frequently visited his office hours and he was always very helpful (and very available).

Dr. Kempton is a nice guy, and he really likes the subject he teaches. He's also helpful if you go to his office hours. His lectures aren't always organized, and having a good TA helps a lot. The tests are beastly and you will have homework almost every day. Fortunately, the curve bumped me up from a B- to a B.

His lectures are engaging and entertaining and he covers the content in a clear and concise form. The class has very difficult homework and test assignments, so be prepared to put in 2-3 hours per day. The math department makes the tests and they're very difficult, but as long as you attend his lectures and actually do the homework it's very doable

It was his first year teaching, but I found the class extremely difficult. Lectures were confusing and frustrating-TA recitations are what got me through the class. HW took me hours each night and tests are harshly graded. The class is curved, but only was a little bit for us barely helping my grade. I would check out another professor.

Dr. Kempton is a nice guy. I really like him as a person. I personally had a hard time with his class. Math is a difficult subject to present in an engaging manner. I didn't appreciate his exams, they are graded extremely harshly and he is unlikely to work with you on getting credit back. I ended up changing my major because of this class.

Professor Kempton is new to BYU and teaching, so he wasn't the most organized professor. However, the real help was our TA, who would explain everything over again during recitation. The lectures were not as informative or as helpful as the recitations.
Dr. Kempton is really engaging during lecture, good jokes. Explains the concepts really well and goes through examples.
Dr. Ogletree is great! His class is super chill, but he still makes it a great environment to feel the Sprit and learn.
For the Living Prophets Class he did a really good job at sharing information about prophets and apostles that can be hard to find. As long as you show up and go to class you'll be fine.
His lectures range from entertaining to boring. If you take the evening class it was almost always very rushed. As long as you attend, you can easily get an A.

He advertises his class as very easy and it is. There is some filler work but if you do everything required you will be fine. I wasn't a fan of the lecture prep quizzes being the same as the lecture, which made the lectures themselves feel really stale.

Professor Ogletree's RELC 200 was hands down my favorite class! As an international student, I loved how he made Gospel principles so practical. I gained a much deeper understanding of family and marriage, especially the focus on building a "house of order." His lectures are total game changers. If you want a high-impact class, this is it!
He's a marriage and family therapist, so he has a lot of great real-world experience and advice on having healthy families.

He's truly the best! I learned so much from every single one of his lectures. I have a greater love for the Prophets and Apostles. You could tell he has a deep love and appreciation for the Gospel and Jesus Christ. He wants his students to have that same love and it is evident in his teaching. He is always willing to help his students.

This is one of my favorite religion classes I've taken. I always say that I don't think religion classes should be hard but rather testimony building - this class was just that. You'll have open-note 20-question lecture preparation quizzes due before each class period, an attendance quiz he gives you the answers to in class, and open-note midterms.

Brother Ogletree is one of the top 5 best professors I've had at BYU. He is fair and reasonable. He gives amazing lectures and keeps the whole class engaged the whole time. He is also SUPER easy. Tests are open for weeks at a time, with open notes and resources.

His class was amazing! I learned a lot. You have lecture prep quizzes before each class but they aren't hard. Attendance is mandatory, you can miss up to 3 classes without it docking your grade. He has been one of my favorite professors at my time here!!

He is very open to hearing from student with grades and assignments. If there is a problem with the assignment on his end, he always makes it right. His exams are very long because they are all essay questions, (took me 4-5 hours), but they are open for a long time and his expectations are very clear, so just don't save it for the last minute.
Professor Ogletree is the best, and the class is so stress-free. Just go to class and you'll be set.

Clearly cares a lot about the family and will always defend it. Lots of religious and academic content is reviewed. Weekly quizzes in class and outside of class but everything is open note and very easy. When I took it, exams were all essay questions that were graded based on content and word count. A little time consuming, but still easy.
You can tell that Brother Ogletree loves the prophets and his students.

Dr. Ogletree is an awesome professor! He always had a positive attitude and was all in when it comes to talking about marriage and families. I feel inspired by the things I learned in this class and am excited to apply them to my life.

Dr. Ogletree is awesome! He is a very funny/entertaining lecturer. I always left his class with greater appreciation for the family and with inspiration to be a better husband, son, brother, etc. The exams were essay-based, which took a long time to complete but weren't too stressful. If you need a more relaxed religion class, choose Dr. Ogletree!

Great professor, super friendly guy and loves to help his students. The class was easy, especially the exams which are more about your testimony than memory. The only reason it gets a 2 instead of a 1 is because there isn't a lot of makeup work and if you miss a few classes or forget to do the lecture prep quizzes its hard to get an A.
I loved taking a class with him

Professor Ogletree knows so much about the prophets and he shares his wealth of knowledge with the class. This class is pretty easy, as long as you try and submit the 3 midterms (open note/free response questions where you talk about the apostles), Powerpoint Project, and a few other assignments. There is a decent amount of busy work.

Ogletree was a fantastic professor. He cares about his students and has great lectures. He goes over an apostle every class period so you get a glimpse into each of their lives. His class is super easy, you just need to go to class since he does attendance quizzes you can't access outside of class. Three easy exams, all written portions.GreatClass!
Dr. Ogletree is one of the best teachers at BYU. He does a great job teaching and I learned a lot from his class, he is flexible with his students and you can tell he loves teaching.

Dr. O is a storyteller. He helps you feel like you know the Quorum of the Twelve and First Presidency by the end of the semester, which is fun. The class content and assignments on Learning Suite were a little disorganized, but if you're attending class you shouldn't have a problem knowing what to do. He is also responsive to emails.

Lectures were engaging, I enjoyed learning from Dr. Ogletree. Lecture prep quizzes and a few talks to read before class. Attendance quizzes and other assignments done in class. 3 Exams, and can take a long time to complete, scores based on word count and good content, but can use powerpoint and other notes, pretty straightforward. Would recommend.

I have taken Dr. Ogletree for two classes because he really is so fantastic. Attendance is mandatory and lecture prep quizzes can be annoying, but overall I learned so much and thought the class was easy!

Dr. Ogletree's religion class was honestly one of the most impactful classes I've taken at BYU, and what made it so amazing wasn't just the content, but the way it was taught and felt. From the very beginning, there was a different kind of atmosphere in the classroom—one that was both spiritual and engaging.

Professor Ogeltree is pretty chill. He cares a lot about his students. You will get an A if you come to class and turn in all the assignments. Overall it was a good religion class and I learned a decent amount. It could have been slightly more spiritual of a religion class.

He is a pretty chill guy in general. The class is kind of a lot of busywork. It's a medium workload, but you can really easily get 100% on every assignment. Attendance is required and if you miss only a couple days your grade will get tanked. Overall, maybe not the most spiritual of religion classes, but if you want a guaranteed A, take this class.
Just a chill guy teaching a chill class.

I love Doctor Ogletree! He is awesome. He cares about his students and the content of his class. His lectures are very engaging. There isn't much work to do outside of class, but you do actually have to put effort into the midterms which are not hard at all, just take a little bit of time. He is always willing to work with you with deadlines, etc.

The class is easy. If you need an easy religion, take Ogletree. Now, be aware of a few things. There were instances where he made fun of people who he was helping with the repentance process. I guess nothing like making fun of kids trying to figure out their life. He also only grades on word count, you can BS everything, he won't actually read it.

I really enjoyed this class, it was a great choice for a religion elective. The lectures were engaging and consistently interesting, which made attending class worthwhile. The professor's teaching style focused on personal growth and meaningful discussion. I would definitely take this class again.
He loves to ask questions and involve the class. All material is on learningsuite

Dr Ogletree is a phenomenal Professor, I would recommend him to anyone! He is so kind, caring, and funny. You can tell that he loves what he does and he really does care about the students. It's the perfect class to feel the spirit and it's low stress

I love Professor Ogletree! This was the class I looked forward to most all semester. I learned so much and Professor Ogletree always tries to make everyone laugh, feel cared about, and not be burdened by this class. He also is very willing to help and has a strong testimony of eternal families even though many aren't perfect.
Professor Ogletree is so funny! His class was very fun and entertaining. I felt the spirit so much during  his lectures. I would definitely take another class from him again.

Brother Ogletree is a great professor! I have taken a couple of his classes and have loved both of them. He has us go through the lecture slides before each class and submit an assignment, and the tests are open book open note. Overall, super easy!

He's a great professor and the class is super easy. There is a quiz due before each class based on a powerpoint that he gives you, and then you have a short attendace quiz at the begining of class (he gives you all the answers). The midterms/finals are short essays on the topics covered, and there are a few little projects.

I took this class because I heard it was an easy A. I can indeed testify that is was an easy A. Attendence quiz each class, and a lecture prep quiz due before each class. 3 tests which are all "what did you learn" type of questions. Easy class, but still learned a lot about the Prophets and Apostles so it was a win win.

He was great at combining the many Univ lessons that we had to get to the heart of what we were supposed to learn. We also didnt have to do many of the unnecessary assignments that other classes did and focused on the important ones.
Super likeable teacher. I loved his class and he is a great guy.

In my opinion it's pretty much impossible to not get an A if you go to class. The entire class is pretty much just attendance quizzes, simple lecture preparation assignments, and easy tests. He is a professor that wants you to learn, have fun, and not stress about your grades. If I had any more religion classes to take, I would take them from him!

Dr. Ogletree is full of energy and enthusiasm. He loves teaching students about families. He is also hilarious. He's well educated on families and has a simple workflow for the assignments. If you do the readings before class, then you'll be ready to relax and enjoy class. He will teach you something new regardless of your preparation.
Best and easiest class at BYU. Professor Ogletree is one of the most caring teachers at this school.
He was very easy to work with

Doctor Ogletree is great! This class was described as very easy, it is if you go to class and do all of the (super short) lecture preparation quizzes beforehand. Unfortunately I did not and paid the price. Don't take this class if you are going to skip it.
Professor Ogletree is amazing! Just show up to class and you'll do great!

Dr. Ogletree has been fantastic! He communicates clearly and provides straightforward coursework. His class is only as good as you make it, if you take the time to do the pre-class assignments and show up, it's impossible not to learn something. He is extremely intelligent, highly qualified, and puts a lot of thought and research into his lectures.

Dr. O is the GOAT! 🐐 As a senior at BYU, this was one of my favorite classes and professors ever. 💪He is a great storyteller, and has so many cool first or second hand stories about the apostles and prophets. Dr. O is very funny and dynamic, and he is very down to earth. Going to this class was the highlight of my week. Highly recommend!

Dr.Ogletree is the best religion professor I have ever had! I felt the spirit in class and felt that I left a better person. The tests are open-note, and the lecture prep quizzes are extremely easy. Class attendance is mandatory.

Professor Ogletree is the best!! He's very funny, energetic, and cares about his students. The homework was light but attendance quizzes are a must! He shares so many cool experiences about the apostles, the lectures are so amazing!

Dr. Ogletree is incredible! I have nothing bad to say about his class at all. All the assignments given were straightforward and purposeful, and there are no difficult tests, just some essay-style assignments to get you thinking. He knows so much about the lives of the people he is teaching about, and it was very engaging. Take this class!

You will have 20 question quiz before each class (you're supposeded to read 3 talks as well). 2 midterms, writing 300 word answers about every apostle, 1 final (same thing). you can do the lecture prep quizzes in class the day before.

Dr. Ogletree is awesome! His class was interesting, spiritually uplifting, and extremely applicable to everyday life! There is little homework, including reading a few talks before class, but all of it is graded very fairly with lots of help from Dr. O! I would highly highly recommend this class!
really easy and fun class

Dr. O is a fantastic professor and an even better man. He is so strong in his testimony of the prophets and apostles. He wants all to succeed in his class and it is very organized. Read before class, take a lecture preparation quiz, take your attendance quiz, and learn about the prophets. His tests are open note and low stress. He is amazing!

Great class, readings are usually conference talks. The lecture preparation quizzes can become tedious and feel a little bit pointless, but they are easly and everything in this class is open note/open book/open slides. Dr. Ogletree is very responsive, and veery passionate about his job and the content.
Professor Ogletree really cares about the students and makes lectures engaging and entertaining.
Hes just a chill guy teaching a chill class, Super fun.

Dr Ogletree is an amazing professor. There are lecture preparation quizzes before each class but they are super easy and open note. Tests this semester were all short answer so they take a while but he gives you like 10 days to complete them and they don't have to be done in one setting. Would highly recommend taking this class from Dr. Ogletree.

Everything that a religion class should be: inspiring, faith-promoting, and easy to get an A (as long as you actually come to class). Prof. Ogletree shares interesting insights about the apostles, and a lot of it was stuff I had never heard before.
Great professor. Cares about his students and what he's teaching. Even though the class was really easy I still feel like I gained a deeper appreciation for the living prophets. Would recommend!
Awesome professor! I would highly recommend taking a religion class from him!

Professor Ogletree is exceptional! There are quizzes before every class, but they are super easy. The exams are open-note but take a long time. No papers or exams in the testing center. Great religion if you are looking learn, but not challenging to get an A.
Professor Ogletree has some of the best stories and he's very flexible with his students.
Professor Ogletree gave me an amazing first religion class at BYU. He is passionate about what he teaches and helps you feel the same excitement.
Dr. Ogletree is incredible
Great teacher. Very kind, cares about the students. Daily attendance quizzes. Lecture prep quizzes and a few conference talks to read before each class. Fair grader.

Professor Ogletree is extremely kind and very willing to work with students! Lectures and assignments are very easy to understand and information on Learning Suite is easy to navigate. Only thing to keep in mind is that attendance quizzes make up a significant portion of your grade (but they're pretty easy). So don't skip class!!
Professor Ogletree is great! Every class has an attendance quiz and a pre-class reading assignment. Exams were easy. Powerpoint heavy!
Dr. Ogletree is a super chill professor, assignments are not very hard and the tests are great! He has a strong testimony of the living prophets and desires the same thing for his students!

Dr. Ogletree is an incredible professor. One of the top three religion professors I have had (The other two being Jared Halverson and Mike McKay). His class is spiritually strengthening without being academically burdensome. Even his lectures and homework are enjoyable. He does a great job of making everyone feel included. 10/10 would recommend.
This guy is the goat and the class is great. Super relaxed.

Dr. Ogletree is a fantastic teacher, he connects the principles of the class with great life stories that make class enjoyable. I learned a bunch in his class and would definitely take a class from him again. The exams require a lot of writing but its not difficult at all.

Professor Ogletree was such a great teacher for Eternal Families! He has such good and engaging lectures every week, and none of his assignments or exams were hard at all; he made it very clear what he wanted you to do.

loved taking Eternal Families from Dr. Ogletree. not a member and I felt like the class did have LDS ideals but was well-rounded enough for me to pull out things applicable to my life. I would recommend him to anyone, especially those in a serious relationship or if you don't have a good idea what the family should look like (ex. child of divorce)
Super Chill professor!! He cares about the students and really wants to make sure everyone feels the spirit and is loved. Although make sure that you go to class and listen.

I loved Brother Ogletree! He was a great professor, very kind, and very understanding about our busy schedules. I had his evening section and he almost alway let us out 30 mins early. He is a tough but very fair grader and in attendance. I would recommend him!

Great class. Super easy and laid back professor. 1 powerpoint project (takes about 1 hr) and then exams are open everything and easy answers. Minimal homework, attendance quizzes and lecture quizzes every class. I would recommend taking nightime class cause he lets you out early every time.

This guy is the man!!! He is very kind and considerate. He will always talk to you if you need help. His grading and assignments are pretty chill and you know what to do before its due. He's the best!

Dr. Ogletree is a great teacher and storyteller! I loved going to class and listening to his lectures. Before class you do a lecture preparation quiz for each lesson and I personally liked them because it helped me understand what we were going to talk about in class. Yes it was a little tedious but I personally liked it. Love Him!

Dr. Ogletree is very funny and engaging. The homework is relatively light, which was super nice. My only complaint was that there's quite a bit of conference talks/byu speeches that we had to read each week, and sometimes the material got a bit repetitive. But overall it's a great class and an easy A.

Dr. Ogletree is an awesome guy he's funny and caring. His class is also super easy. I gave Dr. O a 3 because we're assigned a lecture preparation assignment before every class, and it's based on the exact same slides shown the next day, so it feels a bit repetitive and tedious.

Brother Ogletree is awesome! He is one of those BYU professors who did not come from a perfect LDS family growing up, so I really benefited from the little things he shared in class about that. This is an eternal families class, so it's easy to feel like you're the only one who's not from a perfect LDS family, but things He shared gave me hope.
Phenomenal time
He is the best.
Engaging interesting lessons
Dr Ogletree is very kind. There's a decent amount of busywork, but you can learn a lot doing it. Pretty easy religion class overall.
Dr. Oleg tree was very passionate about what he taught, and he taught the concepts very well.

I loved Professor Ogletree's class! Every lecture made me laugh while feeling the spirit! I loved his point of view on topics covered in the class! It was clear what was expected on every single test!
Amazing class, I'd recommend saving this for one of your last REL classes - its nice to finish on an easy impactful one, don't spoil yourself to early!

Mark is a great professor, there is a reason why this class always has a long wait list. Extremely easy class, no tests. There is a quiz you have to do before class begins, but he gives you the Powerpoint that has all the answers on it. Just show up to do attendance quizzes and you'll be more than fine.

Dr. Ogletree's class is so easy! You just go to class and do the lecture exams before class and that is literally your entire grade. He shares stories about the apostles and prophets that I would otherwise never heard of and his lectures teach me new things. They can be a bit boring, no midterm, easiest final ever. Loved Dr. Ogletree! His class were super chill. The only homework is pre-lecture quizzes that are open note and reading conference talks. Make sure you go to class because participation is weighted heavily.

Ogletree is the goat! He is such an amazing Professor that understands that his class should not be overwhelming, but inspiration and educational. He helps you out a lot if you ask and if you come to class!
Great guy, super easy class, all the answers were straight from lecture
One of the easiest and most uplifting classes I have taken at BYU. Dr. Ogletree is a great professor--take his class!

This class is ridiculously easy. Dr. Ogletree is kind and respectful of students, but it does feel like this class is on auto-pilot. Not necessarily a bad thing, however. Do not regret taking this from him.

Professor Ogletree is a phenomenal teacher who you can really tell cares about the students. Honestly, he is a great professor and he made the class interesting and engaging. If you want an easy A and an enjoyable religion class I would highly recommend him.

Professor Ogletree is amazing! He is so funny and very kind. He is also very knowledgeable, and his lectures are great. The class is easy too! Totally recommend!
Incredibly easy yet meaningful course. Dr. Ogletree is a cool guy.
This was the best religion class I took at BYU. Professor Ogletree is a great guy and planned great lectures. I really enjoyed this class and would recommend to anyone!
I loved his class! I learned a lot but it was also easy. There are lecture preparation quizzes, readings, and attendance quizzes for every class, but they are open note! Very spiritually uplifting!!

Brother Ogletree is so funny! You read usually 3 talks and take an open notes quiz before each class, then an attendance quiz in class. He has lots of cool stories and I learned a lot about the prophet/apostles I didn't know before!

This class was not only easy, but it was a very interesting class and Professor Ogletree made it fun and interesting. The reading for the class wasn't hard at all and to fail this class you would actually have to try. Although attendance is mandatory, it wasn't bad because the lectures were actually fun!

Prof. Ogletree is amazing! He is very knowledgeable about what he is talking about. While he is very intellectual, he is not rude or stuck up about it. He wants his students to understand and learn as much as they can about whatever topic he talks about. Make sure you do the readings because you will get so much more out of the class!

Really great class. Quizzes before every class but they are so easy and he gives you the slides. A couple other assignments but never any stress.

Pre-lecture quizzes and pre-class reading, and attendance quizzes which take maybe 30 minutes during the week. The test is open note and mega easy. This class should be part of the religion core it is so good. Ogletree really cares and really believes what he teaches.
Great class, wants participation. Great materials on the Prophets and Apostles.

This class is interesting to learn about all the living apostles and prophet's lives, yet it is very easy and fun. Sometimes class can get repetitive with looking at the same slides for the quiz answers as are used in class. There are general conference readings and a quiz before each class and an attendance quiz each class, but not much else.
If you want to do well on religion classes take this class.. This is exactly how religion classes should be! not hard but spiritually uplifting
Dr. Ogletree's class was a great opportunity to learn about our modern-day prophets. He is engaging, funny, and inspirational.
Loved this class and would definitely recommend anyone take it from him!!

If you want the easiest religion class at BYU, TAKE THIS ONE! He has you do lecture preparation quizzes and attendance quizzes which he gives you all the answers to. If you attend class, you will pass. There is a final where you talk about what you learned, and that's basically it! Very little homework and a great professor that cares.

Dr. Ogletree really cares about your success. He wants you to learn and take something away from the course, so he works hard to share what he knows with his class. I'd highly recommend taking his class!

Started the semester with a different teacher but quickly switched to this class. I joined this class blindly, but its amazingness immediately inspired me. Professor Ogletree is a fun and passionate teacher; you can feel his energy and enthusiasm. His class is easy to navigate, with a straightforward final and no midterms. Attendance is important.
I loved taking REL 333 from Dr. Ogletree. By far the easiest class I've taken at BYU. Learned a lot about the prophets and apostles without the class being too burdensome.

Professor Ogletree is the an amazing professor! He cares deeply about his students and is so kind. He gives opportunities for extra credit and lessens the workload if it is too much. I love Dr. Ogletree so much! He sticks to the doctrine while sharing memorable stories. He cares about his students well being and does what he can to help them.

Professor Ogletree will make you laugh, feel inspired, and hopeful for the outside world. Dr. O is amazing!! He's loving, caring, and I enjoyed his lectures so much!
He's a great guy! Loved this class!
Professor Ogletree makes his lectures so entertaining while also teaching the material. He also has really clear grading criteria and not a lot of work outside of class.

Professor Ogletree is a great teacher. He has a background in marriage counseling so he knows what he's talking about. The tests were copy and pasted from the study guide and the tests were open note! He had an attendance quiz every day so you had to be at class. Super easy and entertaining class!

Prof. Ogletree is a great teacher to take Eternal Families from. He has all of the content posted on Learning Suite which makes learning the content really easy if you have to miss a day.

Dr. Ogletree is a very genuine professor who cares about his course, students, and faith. The course was easy and all you had to do to succeed was show up to class. Dr. Ogletree tends to go on a lot of side tangents but you can tell he is passionate about eternal families.
His lectures were great and you can tell he cares about his students.

Good professor overall. IMO he sometimes reinforces negative stereotypes in regard to men, women, relationships, etc.  He has a lot of knowledge but I don't aspire to have all of the same perspectives as his.

Professor Ogletree is awesome! He keeps his lectures entertaining, but also spiritual. It was also very easy and exams were straightforward if you do the study guide! I wish I could take all my religion classes with him as the teacher.

Professor Ogletree makes this religion credit a breeze. The workload is manageable, and his engaging lectures make the content interesting. Unstuckstudy AI was super helpful for exam prep alongside the provided study guides.

Very mellow professor. Wants his students to succeed and his classes won'tmake you dislike religious education at BYU.

The professor does a great job of keeping the class fun and engaging. While the tests can be tricky, the workload is manageable overall. If you attend lectures and stay on top of the material, you should be able to do well. Definitely recommend for an interesting religion credit.

Professor Ogletree is a great professor. In my opinion, exactly what a religion professor should be. Wonderful professor. I believe he truly understands how to uplift his students by not stressing them out for a simple religion class.

Great professor, go to class to get an A, easiest class you'll ever take.

Very entertaining teacher. Loves to throw in jokes throughout his lectures. I gained a great appreciation for the apostles throughout his class. just lecture prep classes and then attendance quizzes pretty much with only a few small other assignments. Chill during lecture you barley have to pay attention lol

Professor Ogletree is my favorite professor! He genuinely cares for his students and will always work with you. I always looked forward to his classes. They were engaging and were always fun. I would always recommend taking any class from him.
Great! No issues at all. It's a class that you get what you put in.

Good guy who understands religion should not be your hardest class. Wasn't the biggest fan that classes seemed repetitive of the lecture preparation since you do use the same slides to prepare that he uses to teach. But overall very good class, learned a lot.
A great, inspirational religion professor who doesn't make these classes more difficult than they should be. Will take again

Fun and engaging. I would retake one of his classes!

Great guy, enjoyable class. Would recommend.

He's a wonderful teacher! He understands the students' needs and workloads. He gives some homework so we can learn, but doesn't give too much so that it becomes a burden. Just an overall great guy. This is my second class that I have taken from him and it is what a religion class should be at BYU. I don't feel overwhelmed with the amount of homework/assignments. Absolutely fantastic Professor and Class. Engaging and funny. Extremely straightforward. 10/10

Brother Ogletree is amazing. His lectures are hilarious and engaging. I took Living Prophets from him and it was a breeze. I would highly recommend him. Professor Ogletree was amazing! He was super friendly and easy to get along with. He was also very understanding when I wasn't able to make it to class one day because of outside circumstances and made it possible for me to still get credit.

Mark Ogletree is amazing! I took his class which happened at 9am. Even though it was a morning class he was still lively and taught with such charm. Take this or any class from Brother Ogletree! Majority of the grade is from in-class quizzes, so attendance is important. There is homework regularly, but it's short and easy. I loved this class so much! He knows his stuff and has wonderful lectures, and as long as you come to class with a good attitude then you'll have a wonderful experience. Mandatory attendance quizzes, and daily reading quizzes due before class, but not very intensive.

The professor taught us a lot about the living prophets and gave us interesting content. The class was not overly difficult or complicated which is exactly what it should be for this type of religion elective. Very nice class.

This class was awesome. So much information about the prophets given. Had one of the best spiritual experiences in my life in this class. I would for sure recommend taking this class in the summer!

he's such a g, made going to his class something to look forward to and all around great guy that wants to see you do well. it's super easy too I used this app quizard for pretty much all our assignments and online quizzes and edged out an A.

Professor Ogletree is the best! The content was super interesting and the class itself was really easy. He and his TAs are easy graders. Tests are very long but go exactly with his study guide. Highly recommend!

You have to go to class every week to take the attendance quizzes, but he does them together so it's easy points.
