I loved professor Ogletree! he brought the spirit to every class and I was always so happy to be there. There are attendances quizzes so attendance is mandatory but, it is very easy to be successful in his course.

Dr. O is such a great teacher and you can tell that he loves his students. There were only a few assignments sprinkled throughout the semester, and he gave you all the answers to the test in a study guide. I would just read the assigned talks before class and he would always go through the attendance quiz with us in class.

Dr. Ogletree is an outstanding professor. He creates a fun environment and gives clear instruction with what will be on his tests, as well, he gives you the study guides and the questions directly come from study guides. I will take him again for every class possible, 10/10. For context, I'm a pretty below average student and I got an A+.

Professor Ogletree is awesome! There are 3 midterms and a final, and for some reason, the last midterm starts finals week on the same day as the final. Overall great Professor and a pretty easy class.

Honestly a top-tier class, super easy, and super simple. Also, the people who complain that he is so religious are weird because he is a religion professor!!. he cares about everyone and is laid back on assignments. cares more on you really learning than grades

He's awesome and such a great person! He has funny stories to tell and is super caring. The only thing is there are readings that can feel like busy work sometimes and some assignments can feel very time-consuming. But overall the class is super easy!

This Professor is really amazing! Class if funny and spiritual. There are study guides for exams with basically all the answers and it's closed note tests. There are only 4 tests and one small project. The professor really cares about his students and is open to helping with personal questions and worries.

I really enjoyed going to class and hearing the lectures. There were a few projects and tests. The tests were based off a study guide that was easy to fill out based on the slides. His slides were posted online if you missed anything during class. I would highly recommend this class for the Eternal Families credit.

Great choice for a religion class. He gives fun, great lectures that also promote learning and inspire you to be prepared for a family. Plus, I took his evening once a week class, and he let us out early pretty much every week.

Ogletree is the best! Looked forward to his class and loved his lectures. He tells lots of stories and they're so fun. Super easy class, completely straightforward on assignments and grading - what a religion class should be.

Not too bad of a class. About 3 talks per lesson to read and a few projects. I had it as a night class and we got out early almost every week. Test were long but the study guides had almost every question on it

Professor Ogletree is such a funny professor who cares about his students. There is 3 tests and a final and he gives you study guides that are the exact copy of the test. I took his night class and he would also let us out early every time.
Super caring and understanding of all his students. Lectures are entertaining and easy to follow. If you do the work and go to class you will get an A.

Dr. Ogletree was a good teacher.  I've had a lot of different experiences with BYU religion professors and I'd say this was a good class load wise.  I liked his stories too.  If you are looking for a seminary-like class to take for your religion class take this one.

Mark is the best!! He is an amazing teacher with spiritual and captivating lectures. Only reading homework. There are attendance quizzes for every class so dont skip class cause you'll miss free points!!
Dr. Ogletree is amazing and this is a must-take class! It is so easy, but so fulfilling as you learn about the living Prophets and apostles. If you want an easy religion class, take this one!
I loved this class. I can tell he loves what he is teaching and really cares about his students. Really easy to learn a lot of time is put into the presentations he gives.

Professor Ogletree is a great teacher here at BYU and genuinely cares about the information he teaches and his students. Not a difficult class at all, if you do the pre class quizzes it would be hard not to get an A.
Professor Ogletree is amazing and he is my favorite religion professor I have ever had at BYU. I would 100% recommend taking any class you can from him.
Dr. Ogletree is the religion teacher to take. Easy class but still substantial and informative. He makes the lectures interesting and has a fun time with the class.

This course is super easy, and I would absolutely recommend it if you need an easy religion class, and either have a testimony of the prophets already or aren't interested in gaining one. If you genuinely want to gain a testimony but are struggling, take a different professor. Dr. Ogletree, while incredibly kind and sweet, isn't super supportive.

Dr. Ogletree runs a "fast-and-furious" classroom. You are expected to read a couple talks, review lecture notes, and take a preparation quiz before each class. Lectures are energetic and insightful.

The workload is light, so this means you can actually take some breaths find some inspiration throughout the course.

Dr. Ogletree is one of the most relaxed and fun professors at BYU. He isn't negligent, but knows when to be serious and when to have fun. He is passionate about what he teaches and does a great job presenting information. Very clear expectations and it's easy to get an A if you care.

I loved this class! Dr. Ogletree is great and I really learned a lot about the prophets and apostles. Attendance is taken by a quiz each day in class, I wasn't crazy about the policy (since on days I couldn't make it I would get a 0 for the day) overall I really enjoyed coming to class and learning! Would take again!
He's a cool professor. Just make sure to come to lectures and complete pre lecture assignments.

Very funny professor! Something that I did that made this an easy A was complete the pre-class quizzes in the first week of school when everyone is doing the syllabus, its just an easy search the slides and plug the answer. After that only readings and attendance. There is no real midterm or final because of the pre-class quizzes.
One of the chillest religion classes BYU has. Just weekly quizzes and you have to read a few conference talks each week. No midterm.

Great Professor! Super funny, engaging, and understanding. Attendance is mandatory, but coming to class is worth it. Professor Ogletree nailed the way religion classes should be. Simple yet informative. Easiest religion class I've taken at BYU. 

HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

This professor was great! Attendance is mandatory because you take an attendance quiz every class period that is worth 10 points each. There are lecture preparation assignments for each day that are worth 20 points, but they are not hard. The lectures are engaging because he is sharing stories about the apostles and prophets the whole class.

He is the funniest professor ever! To make this class easy you can do all of the pre-class quizzes in the beginning of the semester and then you will only have to worry about preclass readings which are quick and in class quizzes where he gives you the answers for being present. There was no midterm or real final.
Super easy class, just take the quizzes and come to class and you'll do well. Ogletree rocks.
Dr. Ogletree is a very straightforward professor. This class is insightful, spiritual, and exceptionally easy. I loved this class!

This class was one of my favorite religion classes ever. If you just take 15 minutes before each class to do the preparation quiz and do the readings, then the class is super easy and fun. You will learn a lot of fun stuff about the apostles!

Dr. Ogletree is by far the best religion teacher. I wish he taught all religions. He keeps me entertained with his lectures and it is an easy class. There is an attendance quiz every class but he does the quiz in class.

Dr. Ogletree is awesome and very understanding when life happens. He really cares about what he teaches and knows so much about the living prophets. His class is very easy. You must take a preparation quiz before every class, but it is very clear where to find the answers. I would recommend this class to anyone who wants to take living prophets!
Just go to class and do the quizzes. You will get an A easily.
Dr. Ogletree makes class easy and interesting! His grading is super chill and all you have to do is some lecture prep and reading. Not heavy at all, but definitely fun to learn about the apostles.
I loved this class! Brother Ogletree is so kind and funny, and he truly makes class a blast. Highly recommend!

Funny guy who cares about the material. Definitely helped me develop a healthier more positive view of marriage and family. It kind of feels like his side gig, but I also took a night class so we were all anxious to get home. Overall a positive experience and not a bad guy. Some material felt a little outdated. Again, very funny.

Ogletree's class is super easy, zoned out daily and passed. Search for assignment questions in the class powerpoint and you'll get an A. Attendance was technically mandatory, but the quizzes enforcing it are easy. He boosts his ego and talks constantly, but he isn't horrible. Mostly learned that Ogletree wants to become a general authority.
Brother Ogletree is a fun, caring, and passionate teacher. I really enjoyed his class and learning facts about prophets that I never could've learned anywhere else.

Dr. Ogletree was so amazing to have as a professor! He was so accomadating and wanted to make sure we all did our work by reading, but if you did the readings (typically a powerpoint and some talks) you were well prepared. Would take again 100% he was so loving and kind!

Dr. Ogletree's class is an easy A. Why? So that you can focus on the Spirit. Do the spiritual preparation and you will love His class. He loves participation, effort, & wants to see you succeed (academically & spiritually). If you have a problem, he is SO understanding in all aspects of the word (with attendance, hw assignments, quizzes, etc.)

Professor Ogletree is really passionate about what he teaches and wants his students to love the teachings of the Prophets and Apostles as he does! Do the readings, take the lecture preparation quizzes, and go to class to take the attendance quiz and you will get an A! He's very accessible outside of class and he always has great stories to share.
He is very easy going and also very engaging. His lectures are very interesting and you can learn a lot as long as you put in a little bit of effort.

The professor focuses on the lecture topics and brings together many teachings of the living prophets. He places importance on the overall themes of the prophets and teaches in a way that showcases them. Overall an enjoyable class with an uplifting feeling after every class.

Professor Ogletree was a great religion professor. His class was very easy and required little work outside the classroom. Reading quizzes need to be completed before each class, but they are open note. This is not a very challenging course and it was spiritually strengthening, which is what I want in a religion class.

Dr. Ogletree is a very accommodating professor and super knowledgeable about the prophets. There was a fair bit of reading, but still very manageable. However, the workload might be a bit heavier during Fall and Winter semesters. Pretty much exactly what a religion class should be.

I would just point out that not every semester will be like this one, but his class was so so good. He loves the prophet and the apostles which is very clear when you take the class. His energy carried over into every lesson, and it made me excited for the class. Take Religion classes from Dr. Ogletree! You won't regret it.

Professor Ogletree is the best! He gives detailed, interesting, and funny lectures about all the apostles. I learned so much from his class and felt more connected to the leaders of the church. Work is minimal and he is so caring and kind and always willing to help. Take this class!
Brother Ogletree is amazing! I love his class and always look forward to it. He is all in on the gospel and has so much energy!
Very passionate about the gospel and the living prophets. Great lectures and I learned a lot from this class. Also its very easy with moderate reading and easy quizzes. Fun and easy class.

Dr. Ogletree was awesome. Before class, there is an open note lecture preparation quiz (or 2, for the spring term), and 3 required readings. But, he is very lenient and fair, and the quizzes were easy. He removed the midterms this term, and he made the final a single question asking what we learned from the class. Take it from him!

Professor Ogletree is a super funny guy. He really cares about what he is teaching. I was out of town for my belated honeymoon the first week of class and he helped me catch up. He told me not to worry about it while I was on my honeymoon and just to enjoy my time. Then he gave me full credit for attendance. He helps accommodate for his students.
I had a 9 am class and it was still worth it! One of the funniest professor's I have ever had
Fun, laid-back classroom environment. Repetitive content for pre-class quizzes and in class attendance quizzes. Not a difficult class.
I loved this professor!! I learned how to study from modern Prophets and it has actively changed my life!

I loved the content of this class. I learned so much and felt the spirit. The class was super easy and instead of tests we did pre-class quizzes. Sometimes the lectures got repetitive. Dr. Ogletree is easy to work with and cares about his students and what he is teaching.

Dr. Ogletree probably knows more about our current prophets and apostles than anyone I've ever met. He's very witty and has such a passion for the gospel and love for us as future church leaders. I loved his lectures and his powerpoint are golden. If you can save them on your computer, you'll be the nerdiest kid at general conference. Love the guy!

This was seriously the easiest class I have ever taken in my life- I literally have a 100%. I will say- bc it's Spring semester he did let us know it'd be much easier than Fall or Winter. Attendance is two quizzes he gives all the answers to, so two 100s a day, and the only homework are two quizzes of just fun facts on the apostles. TAKE THIS CLASS

Professor Ogletree is so nice and so caring. He is definitely a very easy religion professor, but I still feel like I learned a lot and my testimony was strengthened. He has an inspiring story and is a good example to his students.

Professor Ogletree has been one of the best religion professors I have had at BYU. He truly CARES about each of his students, and has a powerful testimony. I learned so much about the living prophets and their lives and it allowed me to connect with them.
This class was simple and easy. He was incredibly knowledgable about the prophets and cares about the students. I would recommend this class to everyone.
This class was simple and easy and he was a super happy and awesome professor. I would recommend this class to everyone!

Dr. Ogletree as a person is a wonderful man and his faith in the living prophets is inspiring, I genuinely liked learning what he taught about them. However, this class consists mostly of just going over the exact same material you already went over on your own in the pre-lecture quizzes. Incredibly easy A, but a little mundane in that regard.
Take this for a religion credit! Takes very little work outside of class, is very uplifting, and Professor Ogletree is funny and entertaining. What more could you want from a religion course?

Took it during spring semester, not bad at all. Lots of quizzes, but they are all open note and aren't that hard. No tests other than a final which was also nice. Interesting lectures and Brother Ogletree is super chill. 100% recommend if you are looking for a religion class to take.

Professor Ogletree is super insightful and is very sensitive to the spirit. He is a great storyteller, which is perfect as a religion professor. He is also super funny! It was easy to stay away and be focused. Just as long as you do your homework and come prepared to share with the class, you will do fine in the class.
This was a great class! Entertaining and uplifting without being too much homework.

Brother Ogletree is really funny and a great guy! He definitely cares about his students, but he was rewriting the class when I took it so it was pretty disorganized. You have to take preparation quizzes before class which cover the exact same material he goes over in class which makes it difficult to pay attention because it's really repetitive.
Ogletree is awesome and class is so interesting and fun!

Prof. Ogletree is an amazing teacher and professor. He is very passionate about the living prophets. The lectures were engaging and fun. He brought some amazing guest speakers. Not a lot of homework. Readings are mostly talks from general conference.

Professor Ogletree is an amazing teacher. He is so caring and takes the time to prepare very inspirational and spirit filled lessons. He is funny and just wants you to succeed. If you put in the effort and come to class you will do well!

Professor Ogletree is an awesome teacher and really cares about what he is teaching. Lectures are entertaining and it's always fun going to class. Attendance was mandatory and we would have two quizzes in class that we would take together. Overall Professor Ogletree was a great teacher and he wants to help his students succeed.

Brother Ogletree is awesome! He is super relaxed and wants to make learning fun. The course is pretty straightforward, read the lectures and take quizzes on it before class and then attendance quizzes in class. Lots of points so getting an A is easy if you do the busy work. The class is interesting and you learn a lot about the apostles!
he is so proud of the lack of nuance in his class. disagreement is not allowed.

A great and engaging teacher. Make sure you fill out the study guides for the exam as you go along with class. He bases his tests off of them. The tests are super specific so you really need the study guide, but as long as you fill it out you'll be fine. He's really nice and accommodating. Best religion teacher I've had at BYU.
I adore Prof. Ogletree, he is funny, chill, and cares about the students. His classes are super easy and he carez about what he is teaching. Definitely recommend.

Professor Ogletree is awesome! Definitely good if you are looking for a an easy credit. Very lecture style so not always the most spiritual classes, but I would say I learned a lot and he did a good job explaining complicated gender and family topics. There is an attendance quiz every class but he is happy to help you if you miss!

Dr. Ogletree was a great teacher. He emulates Christ through the way he treats his students. He motivates us to be better and although religion classes may be difficult at BYU, he provides sufficient resources and teaches so well that his courses are easy through enough determination of effort.

Professor Ogletree's class is exactly what a BYU religion class should be! Uplifting and fun, but wasn't trying to be the most difficult class we took. There's always some assigned conference talks to read before class, but nothing too crazy. All the exam questions are on the study guide. Would totally take again!
I love brother ogletree and would take him for every class if I could. Very loving and smart, knows what he is talking about and believes it.

Dr. Ogletree is probably the best religion teacher I've had.  I've taken 2 classes from him and enjoyed them both.  There are attendance quizzes during class to encourage you to go.  The class isn't hard and there are a couple of assigned readings before lecture.  He is super funny and makes the lectures relatable by sharing many personal stories.
Super easy religion class and very uplifting! He goes above and beyond

There is an attendance quiz during class that you could probably figure out from the powerpoints, but if you go to class He will go over the answers. The tests were based off of a study guide he provides and the attendance quizzes. The only complaint I have is that not all of the questions on the study guides are answered in the lecture.

Dr.Ogletree is by far my favorite professor I've had here at BYU. He genuinely cares about each and every student and does all that he can to help you succeed. In his Eternal Families class he teaches clearly and compassionately. He wants to hear our opinions and is respectful to all. He makes class fun, interesting, makes you want to learn more.
Great professor. Shares really cool insights. Cares about his students.

Dr. Ogletree is a fantastic teacher that loves what he teaches and teaches it well. He is very clear on what we are graded on and attendance is crucial. You get a lot out of his class each time! Definitely take a religion course from him.

I had an awesome experience in my Eternal Family class! Everything you need to know for the tests is on the study guides provided that you fill out throughout class. I learned a lot about marriage and how to prepare for marriage and its importance. He's been one of the best professors I've had! I would highly recommend Dr. Ogletree!

I loved taking from professor Ogletree. He makes every class fun and interesting, willing to help, not trying to make it harder than it should be. Very easy to get an A. He is one of the best professors i've ever had.
Professor Ogletree is awesome! I loved his class and thought he was a kind and caring individual. I would for sure take this class again!
He's an awesome teacher and shares cool things. The tests are just memorizations of kind of random facts but its all on the study guide.

I really enjoyed this class. He shared so many insights about our beloved prophets and apostles. The tests are worth a lot of points and can be a bit challenging. If you study you should be fine. I recommend Professor Ogletree.
Dr. Ogletree is awesome! He's super chill and has great stories about the apostles and prophets

The prophets class from Dr. O was great! Lots of cool stories and background info about the apostles. Dr. O is energetic and chill. All you have to do is come to class and it's an easy A. Reading consists of a couple conference talks before each class. Tests are the same as the study guides.

Would recommend REL C 333 and Dr. O to teach it.

Dr. Ogletree is a great professor, he takes a lot of time to prepare material and does a great job mixing the words of the prophets with stories from his own life. The lectures are interesting and there isn't a lot of busy work. Would recommend taking this class!
I've taken two of Ogletree's classes and would highly recommend! His religion classes are always entertaining. Super chill teacher and really funny!
Great professor. Daily attendance quizzes, you'll get 100% if you're there. Not too difficult. Felt the spirit. Grew as a person.
I loved having Professor Ogletree as a teacher. He always made class fun, I never wanted to fall asleep in class and he made it such an easy class to do well in.
He's nice and funny. His class is quite chill. In-class attendance quizzes, 3 talks assigned before each class. Tells personal stories which I enjoy.

Brother Ogletree is awesome! His classes are super interesting and he makes you laugh. The readings and assignments are very doable and the tests aren't hard either (the study guide is basically the test). And the content in this class is so fun to learn! Highly recommend! Take this class!!
Ogletree was a stress-free teacher and told some funny stories. The class was very focused on tests and as long as you go to class you should be good.

Professor Ogletree is a great professor. He has study guides for you to fill in during class which makes it really easy to study for the tests. The tests are closed notes so you can't use them on the test but he pulls questions straight from the study guide.

Professor Ogletree was super nice, his lectures were very entertaining, he graded assignments fairly, and being a marriage therapist, he had great insights. My only issue with him was that he sometimes tried to pass off his opinions as if they were facts or church doctrine. Overall, he was a good religion professor.
I loved this class! I'm in the ROTC program, and he was always flexible with my schedule and understanding. Not a time-consuming class... would 10/10 recommend it.

He is amazing. Not too hard and I learned a lot. I really strengthened my testimony of the prophets and apostles, but mostly of Jesus and His church! He teaches clearly and makes assignments simple but helpful. Great class.

Brother Ogletree is awesome! Great lectures, relatively easy tests (as long as you study, but there are very comprehensive study guides), and not a ton of work outside of class, just three or so devotionals to read per class. The wierdest part is the fact he asks all his students to put him on this site for extra credit, which is why I am here.

He's super willing to work with individual students and is understanding of the needs and stresses of his students. The tests tend to be a lot of memorizing, but the content is interesting and not too hard to memorize.

He teaches a good class, don't get me wrong. If you like religion classes but don't want to put in a ton of effort it's a solid class. The only thing that put me off were his tests: 100 questions each (3 midterms), all memorization.

Professor Ogletree was the best teacher ever! I am a student athlete and he worked with me every time I had to travel for my team. He as well made his class fun and lighthearted rather than busy work that no one wants to do. I definitely recommend taking this class.

Professor Ogletree has been by far one of the best religion professors that I have had. His lectures are very easy to follow, and so many points to earn easily. The course is not too difficult, and it very simple to do well in the class.
Brother Ogletree is a great professor and also really cares about his students and gives lots of real world help.

Dr. Ogletree is very kind.  He has attendance quizzes for every class period but he is willing to work with you if you can't make it.  He also gives you all of the answers if you missed one.  His exams are pretty easy, there's just quite a bit of reading outside of class.
Dr. Ogletree creates an awesome environment in his classroom to the point where you really enjoy going. Its fun but also spiritual.

If you go into this class with goals of increasing commitment to living the teachings of the modern prophets and sustaining them, YOU WILL LOVE THIS CLASS! You will leave everyday wanting to be better and serve others more effectively. You will mostly learn about what it looks like to love people like the Savior does. My favorite religion class!!!!
professor olgetree is great professor because he is accessible out of class and he is an easy going guy.
Such a great class and Professor Ogletree always made the lessons so enjoyable

Dr. Ogletree is one of my favorite religion teachers ever. He tells really funny stories and has a unique perspective on things since he works as a marriage therapist and is a stake president - and grew up in a tough family. He also gives you every question that will be on the test and they are multiple choice - so average grade is in 90s.

This class was okay. It wasn't bad, but I wouldn't say it was good either. The work was very manageable and I liked learning about the Apostles, but a lot of times I felt like we weren't focusing on what was most important, and I didn't love how Brother Ogletree interacted with the class sometimes.

Bro Ogletree is really kind and the Spirit fills the classroom every lecture. All of the assignments are easy and quick. During each lecture, he answers all of the attendance quiz questions. The midterm study guides are straightforward and make the tests a breeze. His class is exactly what all religion classes should be - easy, but spiritual.

I loved this class. I had him for Eternal Families and learned lots. I don't think your religion class should be your hardest class at BYU and Doctor Olgetree agrees with this. He holds his students accountable without requiring too much.
Tests are a little interesting but loved everything about the class, learned a lot and Ogletree is super chill and funny.

He was a great professor, the only thing I would say to be aware of are the midterms. They are long and have an hour's time limit, which can make it rather difficult if you don't study. But lectures are good and full of great information. Attendance is kind of required, other than word of the day, everything you need is found on his power points.

This class is super easy as long as you come to class and fill out the study guide while he teaches. Attendance is mandatory though. Overall if you're looking for an easy religion class I highly recommend this one.

Dr. O is a spiritual giant. He has a genuine love for the gospel and for the modern prophets and apostles. He has some amazing stories about them you'll hear from no one else. His lectures are engaging and as long as you take notes and follow along you'll do great.

I highly recommend taking a class from Dr. Ogletree. His lectures are really entertaining and he's hilarious. He doesn't make the tests easy, but I feel like I learned more overall because of that. I looked forward to his class every week.

Dr. Ogletree is the best! He is such a good teacher and I honestly learned a lot in this course. I really enjoyed going to class each week. He is very caring and understanding of his students. I highly suggest taking from him!

If you pay attention in class, take the in-class quizzes, and fill out the study guide along the way you will get an A. Professor Ogletree is a good teacher, but his humor or side-stories were sometimes not my favorite. Other than that, class was great!

I really loved this religion class!!! I learned so much about our prophets and apostles. The class was super simple and organized. You are given an empty study guide and just fill it out during the class. If you study that  guide you will get 100% on the exam for sure. The project is super open-ended and I loved how much flexibility he gave us.

Great professor, I loved his lectures on living prophets! He really gets you excited about the material and general conferences! There are in class quizzes that are easy and tests are straight-forward.

His personality is not for everyone, but I think a lot of people take this class because he is easy. I personally thought his comments were pretty insensitive and did not build my testimony. Quizzes are done in class, need to attend class. Very little outside homework. Exams are usually pretty straightforward.
amazing class I love ogletree. I have taken 3 of his classes
Professor Ogletree is awesome! He has a strong spirit and loves his students.
Good professor! The class doesn't go too deep. If you're looking to learn a lot of new stuff or get new ideas, this isn't' the class for you, but overall it's a good simple class!

Prof. Ogletree is a great guy. Pay attention in class because everything on the exams is mentioned specifically in class and you can record on the exam study guide he provides. Definitely take time to study the study guide before the exam because it's a closed note 100 question test.

I loved the way Professor Ogletree taught this course. The messages of every class was direct and precise. And I loved all the funny and crazy stories he shared in class, they are the best. He's also very thoughtful and generous with grading, and attendants is not require, so if you need a ETF credit 100% take this one!

This class is a very EASY A, however I didn't personally feel like it was worth it. Class felt like a waste of time. Ogletree is a great guy and super funny but most of the stories are anecdotal and I found myself frustrated by some of his generalizing statements. The study guide also didn't always accurately match what was on the midterms/final.
Professor Ogletree is awesome! He is always so helpful and caring. You can tell he really cares about what he is teaching.

Professor Ogletree is amazing! Attendance is super important for this class, but if you go, you will pass. He is super understanding and teaches the material using fun stories that make you laugh. Take this class from him!

Dr. Ogletree is amazing! By far the best religion professor I have had at BYU this far. He is amazing. His lectures were very interesting and engaging and I never once got bored. I also was able to really feel the spirit and learn a lot about how amazing eternal families are. His class is very easy, which I appreciated.
Good professor. Learned a lot. Not a stressful class at all.

Dr. Ogletree gives great lectures because of his preparation and attention to detail. You can tell that he truly loves the living prophets and genuinely studies their lives and teachings on a daily basis
Professor Ogletree is awesome! I loved learning about the prophets through him. He is super funny but also super spiritual.

Absolutely a great professor! It is very clear Dr. Ogletree cares about what he is teaching. The amount of effort you put into studying and applying what you learn will matter and is very beneficial. Doctrinally-based, with some opinion. There's a lot of assigned reading that is manageable, and exams are easy when you study with the study guides.

Prof Ogletree is such a caring professor. His lectures are funny and entertaining. His tests are multiple choice and there are like 2 projects to complete throughout the semester. There is an attendance quiz every class that you can go over in class. Overall pretty chill class that was really uplifting!

I loved taking this class from Dr. Ogletree! He was very accomodating with assignments when I had some things come up during the semester. His lectures are very informative and he provides a lot of reading resources on the different topics. Quizzes are easy and tests aren't hard if you fill out the study guide. Would definitely recommend!

Great professor who is more than willing to help you succeed. His lectures are engaging and clear. Much of the grade is based on attendance, which he is very willing to help with depending on circumstance. Very clearly loves the course and its students.

I really loved Dr. Ogletree's Living Prophets class. He is super fun and you learn a lot about the leaders of the church. There is no homework except for one project. Attendance is mandatory because you do attendance quizzes during class. The tests are not too bad and he gives you the study guide. Great, easy class and I enjoyed Dr. Ogletree.

This guy is such a legend, funniest professor I've had so far. Super manageable course load and very understanding. He has great insights given his background in therapy and research. Would highly recommend.
He was really funny and kept class entertaining and light during controversial topics. The tests came straight from the study guide that you fill out during each class. I would take from him again.
Dr. O teaches an awesome fast paced class! If you want to have an awesome experience try and do most of the readings.

I looove Dr O. He is genuine and wants to help you grow your testimony. The one thing I would give a heads-up on is that he tells you that the class is an "Easy A" in the beginning so I did not study much for the first test but I definitely should've. It affected my grade for the rest of the semester.
Nice guy. His lectures feel like EFY. I definitely liked him more as the semester went on.
I have loved taking Dr. O! I have taken him for two classes now. He is inspirational and has taught me a lot. I have loved learning about the lives of our prophets.

Professor Ogletree is awesome! I learned a ton from him. It was the exact class I needed this semester, because he is a very spiritual person. His class is also very easy which makes it less stressful for students. Show up to each class and you won't have to worry about getting a bad grade.
He's a great professor and great example of someone who follows the living prophets. Overall enlightening and uplifting
I took this class not expecting much, but I absolutely loved it. Dr. Ogletree is funny and light-hearted, and he always made class fun. He is eager to help you succeed in his class and in life.

He was AMAZING!!! if you want to feel the spirit and have a good time in class take Dr. Ogletree! He does attendance quizzes in class so you will need to go to class but it was by far the best religion class i've taken.
Prof Ogletree gets through what you need to know quickly and in a fun way. Not too boring, usually pretty lively and open to student comments.

Loved this professor from day one! He was super easy to listen to and I never felt bored because he has awesome stories to tell! I feel like he understands our generation very well and is funny. Not too difficult of a class if you just do what he suggests.

If you want an easy A then take this class. There's an attendance quiz for every class that often times he fills out with you and if not they are found in the slides. Most of the lectures are about the lives of the prophets and the apostles but not very doctrine based more opinion based so if that's what you're looking for this is your class.
Living prophets was such a great class! The work is not difficult so you can fully focus on enjoying the lectures and learning about the lives of the apostles and prophet :)

Professor Ogletree is a good professor. I took his Living Prophets in-person class. 
As a student Athlete, it was a great class to take while in travel season.
He had attendance quizzes which made up the majority of your grade. 
His projects are also pretty easy. Low-stress.

If looking for an easy calm religion class this is a great class.

Dr./Prof./Bro. Ogletree rocks. Very glad I took Eternal Families from him rather than someone else. Classes were filled with firm and correct doctrine. Refreshing to see. Come to class each day and study for the tests and you will do just fine.
Super easy class! I was a little disappointed as the he mostly just went through slides so not the most spiritual conducive class but if you are looking for an easy A, this is it.
The class was very easy. Not a super spiritual class, and he wasn't the most sensitive professor. But if you're looking for an easy pass, take this class.

Attendance quizzes are done in class.He provides all the slides and study guide at the beginning of the semester. His test are exclusively based on the study guides.  I loved his positive attitude and realness. He understands that it is religion class. He is not intentionally making it super hard. Great professor. Really enjoyed taking his class.

DR. Ogletree has really good lectures. Not a ton of interaction but I felt like my testimony really grew in this class. He makes getting a good grade easy if you take the attendance quizzes. The tests are pretty detailed and kinda hard if you don't study but its a pretty uplifting and easy class. I'd recommend it!
Great professor. Cares about the students. Fun and engaging class. Ideal setup for a BYU religion course.
Easy class, good professor. Show up every day, take some notes and you'll get an A.

Mark Olgetree is the BEST! He always came to class happy and energetic even if he had had a bad day! He made learning about the living prophets fun and exciting. And his class was so doable and fulfilling

Eternal Families was great with Professor Ogletree! He gives attendance quizzes every class but he will give you all the answers if you're there. There are 3 exams and a comprehensive final but he gives you study guides that have all the questions word for word! Super chill guy - really just wants you to succeed and enjoy learning the content!

I loved taking a class from Dr. Ogletree! He is caring and is the kind of professor who honestly wants you to succeed. The one thing I wish could be different was the slides. There was some information that was hard to find in the slides and half the time we skipped over a lot of slides that had test prep questions on them.

He does Attendance Quizzes based on the lectures. They r open 8am-10mins after lecture ends. The lecture slides r online, BUT it's easier 2 do the Quizzes when u go in-person. There r 3 Exams w/100 Qs each, & a Comprehensive Final w/50 Qs. The tests have rly specific Qs tho, stuff like: definitions, quotes, statistics. U need 2 study 4 those :)

Dr. Ogletree is an amazing professor and has lots of super useful information available in class and on the slides! I felt like it was a great balance between doctrinally based and research based relationship advice. Would definitely take this class again just so I could remember more of it.

Dr. O is hands down my favorite prof I've had. He's hilarious and has great stories to tell each class which made his class so much fun. There are four tests total including the final but he creates study guides for you which makes it super simple. I'm gonna miss this guy!

I loved this class! Homework was mostly readings. Tests had a good study guide for them, so if you filled out the study guides in class you were good! Daily quizzes in class on the lecture, which he gives you the answers for. My favorite religion class I have taken at BYU.
Very approachable, willing to help students, not a difficult class. Attendance is important.

Pretty good for a religion class. Not too hard so you don't get stressed and can still feel the Spirit. Just follow along the exam study guides during class and you'll be great. Dr. Ogletree tells good stories and tests are basically straight from study guides for the most part. He also likes to extend deadlines which is nice.
He is amazing! I am grateful for his testimony and faith!

Dr. Ogletree is of the best on staff at BYU. He is an engaging lecturer, and he recognizes how to best work with his students. It is clear that his vision/goal is to bring his students to Jesus, and he does it well. If you go to class and use the study guides, you cannot get less than an A.
Has great insight and great lessons to prepare you for marriage. I really valued the way he presented his lessons and the insight he shared. Really an awesome professor, definitely take him.

Each class you take an attendance quiz which he gives you all of the answers to sometimes at the beginning of class. Don't leave right after the quiz though, or he will call you out. Exams are on learning suite. He has some old-school church views, which is expected. But he tries to be unbiased and kind to students with different opinions. Easy A

Really great guy and good example. He's a marriage and family therapist as well so he has experience in teaching about families. Loved learning from him and his class is super chill, just read a few talks before class and he helps you out a lot with study guides for the tests. Only complaint is that we don't dive deep enough into tough issues.

Dr. Ogletree is funny, engaging, and really cares about the class and his students. He makes some offhand comments that seem to disagree with the material though. If you look at the PowerPoints everything is right and uplifting. Most of your grade comes from attendance, and the study guides prepare you for the tests.
He's a great professor! It's an easy class and really interesting to attend!
He is very caring and funny. He is very understanding of international students as well.

Dr Ogletree is really funny and really down to earth. His class wasn't too hard, but I still learned a lot through the lectures and the readings.  If you prefer to hear principles couched in politically correct language then this class may not be for you; Dr Ogletree teaches doctrine and doesn't pander to his audience.

I absolutely loved this class! Professor Ogletree obviously loves the apostles and prophets. He was really good at keeping the class engaged even though it was a 9 am class. One of my favorite religion electives that I have taken!
He is so caring about his students and really cares about what he does. I would say that he is insensitive some of the time and also kind of makes fun of students who think differently than him.
some of what he talks about could be said better, but the class is fairly easy and not that bad
Absolutely goated. Easily my favorite religion professor I've taken a class from. Super funny and engaging. V easy, and a totally reasonable amount of work for a religion class.
Dr. Ogletree is awesome. One of my favorite religion professors I've taken here. Attendance is mandatory, but he is very understanding and willing to help out his students. Very uplifting, easy class
Professor Ogletree is awesome! He is hilarious and so knowledgeable about the gospel. I definitely recommend taking a class from him.

Love Dr. Ogletree. Super funny dry sense of humor and really considerate of other people. He has lots of experience in this since he's a licensed marriage therapist and brings great perspective. He also is always willing to meet with students and really helped me out when I was unsure of what to do in a relationship! I'm taking his other class next

Make sure to take this class from Ogletree! I don't have enough good things to say about him. He is so funny in lectures and very straight forward about what is expected. Each class you have an attendance quiz that you will usually take together. His tests are not bad if you use the study guides he provides. I would take another class if I could!

Professor Ogletree is an awesome professor who I think cares more about us understanding the material and being present in class then anything else.  He has attendance quizzes every class, and that gives you the points for the day.  He has readings but you just have to be honest if you did them or not.  The tests are also not hard at all.

Pretty easy going teacher, I appreciated the not as stressful nature of his class compared to other religion classes at BYU. It made it easier for me personally to actually pull things that were applicable to me from the class rather than memorize. He's a funny and caring guy, would recommend his class.

Dr. Ogletree is a fantastic professor. His goals for the class are more focused on the students' spiritual development then making the class difficult for no reason. The only homework in the class is large readings. His tests are difficult if you do not fill out and study the study guides, but otherwise the class is well taught and fulfilling.

He was a good teacher. He wants you to learn and not stress about getting a good grade.He is a caring teacher and genuinely wants you to get something good from the class. I was skeptical about this class being good because of the whole eternal family class stigma people joke about. He handles is well and does not pressure people. I learned a lot.
So fun! Very openminded. I think he would be an especially great professor for non-Latter-Day Saints. Very easy going and a great class! Tests weren't my favorite, but it's not a huge deal

This was my favorite religion class ever. Dr. O is so loving, kind, & super accommodating. He has super inspiring lectures, I always learned something new & felt uplifted. This class was life-altering (and easy). Conference talk readings, daily attendance quiz, and 2 duable projects. I would 10/10 recommend this class to everyone!!!

He is very caring and understanding. His lesson were inspirational as well as funny. He doesn't always get through to the end of his lessons due to the amount of content he has, which is fine since you can access the slideshows after class. I wished his class was longer! He has great stories!
Professor Ogletree is very passionate about this class, which makes it a lot more interesting! Not an overwhelming amount of work either.

Professor Ogletree is awesome. He is surprisingly hilarious, but at the same time he makes sure he teaches in a way we can all understand. He is passionate about the gospel and made the class interesting every time.
Super fun class, Ogletree had us laughing every day. Exams were easy because he always gave us a detailed study guide. No pop quizzes or surprises. He's really funny and genuine.

Professor Ogletree is an awesome guy. He loves what he does and he really shows it in his lectures and assignments he gives out. Super spiritual and I learned a ton of new things. Great class to take.

Professor Ogletree has been my favorite professor at BYU. He was super insightful and upfront about his expectations. I was never caught off guard by any of his procedures. He was super funny and he genuinely cares about his students. He will work with you and sometimes gives you answers to test questions as an added bonus.

Professor Ogletree probably has some of the most challenging tests for a religion professor at BYU, but his lectures are amazing and faith strengthening, and he's a great, hilarious guy. All and all, liked my experience with him

Professor Ogletree was amazing! I really looked forward to go to class. His lectures never felt awkward which can sometimes be challenging especially with topics revolving marriage relations. He also really cares about his students success and wants them to do well! Would 100% take again!

He is awesome! You do an attendance quiz every class. You also have to do readings for each class but they're just talks and speeches from church leaders. I really loved his class! Super easy and informative
He was a really good teacher, a medium of everything. I would definitely recommend his class for those who are married or planning to be married, especially.
Dr Ogletree is really easy to listen too and tries to be funny, he is dont worry.
attendance quizzes everyday. given study guides for every test with direct outlines on test questions. really fun understanding guy.

I love love loved taking Ogletree's class. He has been my favorite professor here at BYU so far because he makes the material easy to understand. His class is low stress too since he gives you all the information that you need for the exams.
He does a good job at teaching, being in his class is really fun! His test questions can be pretty particular so make sure to use his study guides.
You do have to show up to his class for the attendance quizzes but he is so funny and I love him!

Professor Ogletree was amazing! He's so kind, and you can tell that he really cares about your sucess as a student.  His lectures are hilarious, and the tests are pulled straight from the slides, so as long as you fill out the study guides he gives you each class, you'll do fine :)

Professor Ogletree calls it how it is, and shares a lot of light on what truth is. He is very caring of his students and hopes the best for us, which is why I believe he makes his class so easy to get an A in.

Professor Ogletree has been one of my favorite religion professors! You can tell how much he genuinely cares about what he is teaching and always keeps class entertaining. He also cares alot about each one of his students! I would definitely recommend taking this class!

Dr. Ogletree has a great sense of humor when appropriate, but approaches controversial subjects with respect. One of my favorite professors so far. Class is very low maintenance and he is more than happy to work with students if needed.
Dr. O is the bomb-dot-com , if you can feed him with whataburger he might give you extra credit, but if not, learn about eternal families and get yourself an A whilst doing so.

Dr. Ogletree was a great professor. I liked how he made lectures light and fun. Sometimes I felt like the exams matched the study guide perfectly while others were not as "word for word". The class was relaxing and an easy A.

Professor Ogletree has been one of my very favorite religion professors! You can tell that he really cares about what he is teaching and about you. All assignments and tests are clearly outlined in class. I would definitely recommend taking this class!!!!

Great teacher! Seriously such a fun class and I learned so much. Since this class is only 2 credits there a minimal assignments. Attendance is important because he gives you a study guide to fill out during the lecture which are soooooo helpful for the tests. He also has an attendance quiz that you fill out during class.

Professor Ogletree is an awesome teacher. He cares about his students and he makes the information on the test very clear. Use the study guides and come to class to do the attendance quizzes and you'll love the class.
Super great class Dr Ogletree is a great professor who is super knowledgable and loves what he teaches and grades fairly and it is easy to know what is expected of the students
He was such an incredible teacher and very engaging!
Great experience in his class! He is hilarious and makes learning fun!

Brother Ogletree was a good professor! He is a funny guy and teaches the principles well. Sometimes he will make comments that are a little bit harsh or judgmental, but other than that, I've enjoyed this class.

I honestly expected better based on reviews. I thought the class was ok. Didn't really feel the spirit but it was also pretty easy (not much required.) Class attendance is required. HW was usually 3 conference talks, plus a semester project. If you're looking for an easy A, this is it.

Dr. Ogletree is a wonderful professor! This course has super clear expectations and you can easily succeed if you use the study guides he provides for the test and participate in the assignments and projects. It is not meant to be tricky or challenging but is still very educational and spiritually uplifting! He is awesome!

His class is really amazing, great learning and great spiritual experiences. His class is structured as such: 3 readings due before each class(~40 minutes). Attendance quizzes each class.Easy 100% if you read and go to class.Tests are 100 questions. Study guide covers all of the test. Only reason its hard is because its 100 things to memorize.

Great option for the EF credit, low stress and I learned a lot of cool things. Dr. O is super chill, cares about students, and uses a lot of scientific data along w church quotes which I liked. Would HIGHLY recommend.
absolutely one of my favorite professors ive ever had. Made me feel cared about and he made class fun. He makes everything feel so much fun and wants everyone to succeed. Going to miss having him

This was an easy class that I enjoyed going to. All you have to do is fill out and study the study guides and you'll do fine. I didn't always agree with his views, but I'd probably have the same problem with any other eternal families class so I don't really hold it against him. If you want an easy A, take it from him.

I really enjoyed learning more about Living Prophets from Professor Ogletree. I think this was one of the easier religion classes I have taken at BYU for sure, but it was still very uplifting and engaging.
Study the slides and attendance quizzes before the tests, and go to class and you should be just fine.

He has really interesting lectures and has inside information/experiences that were SO cool to experience. I was nervous for this class because of different views/opinions, but I genuinely would take from him again -- I really respect him and loved his class.
Attendance is super important and a large portion of your grade. The tests have study guides that have all the answers on them. He is super nice and really cares.

Good class if you're looking for an easy A and a bit of spiritual uplifting. Readings before every class, in-class attendance quiz (he gives you the answers). A few random projects close to the end of the semester. He tries to pack so much in every class that we never finish the entire slideshow. A few random projects at the end of the semester.
Probably my favorite religion class at BYU! Brother Ogletree really puts a lot of effort into the class and there's really not too many readings or homework and the tests aren't too bad either!
Great professor who loves his students. Not only is his class super easy, but it's very inspiring and fun too.
The best religion class I have taken so far. His lectures are very earnest and entertaining. He teaches to the study guide and tests to the study guide.

You should absolutely take this course from Professor Ogletree! He is so passionate about what he teaches, and he really loves his students. I looked forward to his class every day because of how great his lectures are. This class is both really fun and really spiritual. I learned a lot about the living prophets, and I had fun doing it.

Professor Ogletree is the best! This class is very fair and he is willing to work with you on anything. He has a super strong testimony and never misses an opportunity to share it. The lectures are so interesting and full of facts and stories I had never heard before. If you're looking for an easy and fun religion class, definitely take this one!

Professor Ogletree is honestly the best. Take religion classes from him. He has such a strong testimony. He is passionate about the gospel. I looked forward to his class because there weren't a lot of assignments. I felt like I was able to show up to class and be spiritually uplifted. He is so funny, but he also knows when to be serious.
Dr. Ogletree is such a sweet and caring professor. He really wants you to enjoy the class and not be too overwhelmed by work.

Professor Ogletree is super awesome! His class was really chill, he is always trying to help the students do well, and you get as much out of the class as you put into it. Nothing too crazy. You probs won't learn if you don't try, but it won't be stressful at all!

I have never been more excited to go to a class in my whole life. Every day was full of engaged learning and he kept things so exciting and fun. You can tell he knows what he is talking about and genuinely cares about his students and that they understand what is taught in class. Tests are tough if you don't pay attention in class.

Professor Ogletree was the best religion professor I've had. I wish I had taken this class sooner. He has a deep passion for what he teaches and really cares about students. Just fill out the study guides as he teaches and you'll do fine on tests.
This is the easiest religion class but also so insightful!

Professor Ogletree is an awesome teacher! He has a fun sense of humor that keeps class entertaining. The assignments were not too bad either. Daily readings and attendance quizzes. He also gives study guides that are really helpful for the exams.

Dr. Ogletree is an amazing person. I grew to respect and have a greater testimony of the prophets and apostles as I took this course. He is very understanding, and does what he can to make sure that people get the grade they desire. Reading consisted of a few conference talks before class. The tests require a lot of memorization of random facts.

Brother Ogletree gives very good lectures. Sometimes he will invite the children of apostles to come to class and talk about their fathers. There is an attendance quiz every class, but he goes over the answers at the beginning of class. The exams have a study guide, which are really helpful. There's one project and one presentation that are easy.

Professor Ogletree has set up this course so you get an A. Exams are relatively easy seeing as their almost the same thing as the exam guides he gives you. Assignments don't take long at all and there are hardly any of them. Lessons are interesting, funny, and spiritual.

I liked the content of this class and this was a very easy A. Dr. Ogletree is caring of his students. Organization was a bit of a struggle. I was frustrated that we had a test a week before finals, and there was no information about that in the syllabus and that we found out about it the day it opened. Study guides were given last minute as well.

Gives you all the answers to in-class quizes, need to read 3-6 conference talks a week, tests are easy if you fill out the study guide and go through it a couple times before the test, and there are a couple small projects that are self graded. Is an easy A if you put in minimal effort and pay attention in class.

Dr. Ogletree is an awesome professor who really knows so much about the prophets and apostles. He is very lively and understanding, and all you have to do is show up, listen, take attendance quizzes, and take tests which are on the same content as the study guides. Definitely take him for this class :)
Enjoys having athletes in his class and is willing to work with them.

Professor Ogletree is great! He gives you clear rubrics and study guides for each assignment (none of them are really challenging though) and he helps prepare you really well for all exams. Professor Ogletree is very enthusiastic and so so caring towards his students. 10/10 would recommend taking any class with professor Ogletree!

Professor Ogletree is my favorite religion teacher I've had so far. He doesn't give us a ton of homework before classes, just reading a couple conference talks. The tests aren't hard at all, and they are just straight from the study guide. He's also super funny and the lectures are very entertaining and make me want to listen!
Very easy class. Not much homework and easy exams. He isn't the most organized, but he is merciful because he knows that he sometimes gets behind.

Dr. Ogletree is the best religion professor at BYU. He told us that it would be hard to not get an A in his class and as long as you go to class and use his study guides that give you the exact questions that will be on the exams, you will get an A!

I loved ogletrees living prophets class. One of my favorite religion classes. We just had to participate and learn about the different apostles which was the best. Honestly every religion class should be like this one!

This was a fantastic class in which I learned a lot about the prophets and apostles. Brother Ogletree genuinely cares about his students and wishes them all the best. He is also quite funny and keeps you interested in the session. Definitely worth taking.

Dr. Ogletree is one of the best religion professors I've had. He is funny and engaging, and he has a strong testimony of the living prophets. The workload is very minimal - some reading before class, attendance quizzes, and tests that are identical to the study guides. I would highly recommend him!
His classes are very entertaining. He is super intellectual and has a sense of humor.

This class was good. Super easy and a nice break from other classes. The stories about living prophets were good, I wish there was more emphasis about learning, I don't feel like I actually learned more about the apostles than I knew before but it was still good.
Probably one of the easiest classes I've taken. The readings are all really short and the tests are just like the study guide.

Dr. Ogletree is the best. He's an engaging lecturer and is very knowledgeable. I grew so much love for the prophets and apostles of today as I got to know them more through taking this course. Dr. Ogletree is literally so funny. His class is super easy and he does a lot to make sure that you make a good grade. His tests are closed note, but they are the same as the study guide. Professor Ogletree has a deep testimony of the restored gospel and he makes that very clear through his teachings. In his time living in the Provo area, he has met many children of Apostles and was able to get some to come into class and talk about their parents and their experience growing up. It was an interesting and unique experience.

Usually, 3-4 talks of reading before each class period. Attendance is mandatory, but it is an enjoyable class! Great professor. Be sure to fill out the study guides beforehand, as the tests are highly detail oriented but very doable.

Brother Ogletree is one of the best religion professors that I have ever taken! He is such a nice and funny guy and really cares about his students success! His stories that he shares are really cool and insightful!

I really liked Ogletree! Religion classes have never been exciting to me but Ogletree kept the class entertained and he has lots of funny stories he tells, he is super chill and as long as you are attending class his class is very easy. I had little hw in this class, I would totally take a class from him again!

\Homework consists of doing three readings of talks or BYU speeches, but discussion about the homework is never had in class aside from counting for three out of the ten points for attendance quizzes. The lectures were not engaging or informative. Very traditionalist views, and honestly, I didn't feel the Spirit in class as much as I wish I had.

I took eternal families from Ogletree over summer term. Our classes were all very lecture heavy though the overall topic is very interesting so it was too difficult to pay attention. Ogletree was very clear about due dates, schedules, and his grading. He is a very funny professor and has many interesting stories to tell. He is also easy to contact

I have not enjoyed any of my religion classes at BYU until I took eternal families from Ogltetree. He is a lot of fun and makes the class more spiritual than busy work focused like so many professors here do.

Dr. O was great! He teaches so many great things in his course that are great preparation for marriage/family. I would take him again! His lectures have a lot of quotes and are really text heavy though. Just make sure you stay on top of the attendance quizzes and do the guided notes and you'll be fine.

Incredible communication. Emailed us a ton throughout the week reminding us to submit assignments and take tests. Explained content super well and overall was just super helpful and willing to be there for us as students.
I definitely would recommend him. He's a winner, and you can be a winner too.

I loved Professor Ogletree. Every time I went into his lectures I gained so much new insight. The topic he discussed in class were very engaging and interesting, and he made them so fun. I would defiantly take him again.
The professor is very ready to provide help and assistance to students. He makes expectations very clear.

Brother Ogletree is a pretty chill professor. He is super accommodating to students and will give you an exception for almost anything. Be genuine and honest with him and he'll help you out. Beware the tests though, they can be kind of brutal. The study guides help alot.
Ogletree is so awesome! Easy class and learned a lot!

LOVED THIS CLASS AND PROFESSOR! If you take Eternal Family, take from Dr. Ogletree. Strengthened my testimony, made me happy, and was as easy as a BYU course can be. He is very fair and understanding. Also his jokes had me rolling every time. Lectures not at all boring. You won't regret taking this class from Dr. O!!
He was very professional and respectful, he knew so much and made a great class experience.
Such an awesome teacher. Very funny lectures and very accommodating.

He is one of my favorite professors I've had! I always felt the Spirit in his class, and he was so funny and made learning fun. Almost all the homework we had was reading talks and they were each incredible. It's easy to get a good grade in his class and he is very willing to help you. He knows so much about families and marriage. Take this class!
He is always willing to help you improve your grade!

I have already recommended Ogletree to so many students because his class was really enjoyable. He entertained his class and was able to make each day fun for his students. He provides answers to the quizzes and provides excellent study guides for the exams.
He is awesome and so fun! class was pretty easy and I enjoyed attending. He told great fun stories all the time. I wish he was my bishop.

He is a fantastic professor!! I loved attending his class and hearing his lectures. He is very understanding of students' needs and was always offering help to accommodate them. His classes were fun, inspirational, and always left me feeling great afterward. 10/10 would take again!
This professor is amazing. Loved all his lessons.

He does a really good job of giving you opportunities to learn for yourself. His pre-class readings are good to give you info going into the lecture. More importantly, he is just a real stand-up dude. One of the most genuine professors I have ever had. He became a great friend and taught me a lot.
I loved his class. The tests follow the study guides and I never felt overwhelmed by content. I highly recommend this professor. He is funny and inspirational

Professor Ogletree cares about his students and the topics being taught! The assignments are clear and not difficult at all, as long as you go to class you get credit and will learn what you need to. He has the class set up to get an A if you want to, while also learning meaningful principles.

He is the best professor ever! This was my first semester and it was easily my favorite class. He does not give out homework. He does not want you to fail, he knows you have other classes and make life as easy as possible. This class for sure has prepared me for an eternal family of my own one day.
I actually looked forward to going to his class!! Class was interesting, engaging, and funny!! Dr. Ogletree is the best.

Ogletree is awesome! His lectures are amazing and you can tell he is guided by the Spirit. You will love going to his class. Tests are straightforward, just make sure you have all the info handy in your brain because the tests are timed pretty strictly, but as long as you pay attention to lectures and fill out the study guides, youll do great.
Mr. Ogletree teaches with passion. His lectures are inspirational and applicable to your own life. I am so glad I took his class and I recommend that everyone takes it.

Good class, I felt the spirit. It was surface level though-you could get the same experience from a seminary class and that's not what religion classes are for. Don't come into it expecting to have a religious educational experience, just a religious one. The school of Family Life has a more scientific based class that fills this general credit too

Professor Ogletree was so funny! I learned a lot from his class, and he tells great stories. His tests were a little bit difficult though. There were 100 questions to complete in an hour, and though it was opened book, they were questions that were hard to look up, so you had to complete all the lesson study guides in order to get a good grade.

He is an amazing teacher, he is clear and easy to understand. Along with him being funny and passionate about what he teaches. He also works with you to help you not only get a good grade but understand the material being taught.
Provides a lot of extra credit opportunities!

Professor Ogletree is a great teacher! He had lots of good stories to enhance his teaching and demonstrate the principles that he was sharing. He has lots of great advice, too! I would recommend him any day for an Eternal Families class.
Wonderful class! Absolutely hilarious and engaging lectures. Tests were straight off the study guides. Study guides came straight from the lectures/PowerPoints. Definitely would take again.

Professor Ogletree was my Stake President. He is a very kind person. I love his class lectures. However, his tests are too hard because they are too detailed and hard to prepare for. I could not do well in the tests if they were not an open book. Also, you have to attend his class to get the answers for the attendance quizzes or you are screwed.

Brother Ogletree was an amazing, entertaining professor. He really cared about what he was teaching us and was super easy to work with if you didn't like your scores & with extra credit. It was extremely straight-forward and tests were right from the study guides and slides he provided us. Take from him if you can! Definitely a great guy.
He is awesome! Great person and great personality. Makes the class easy and rewards participation and effort.
Prof Ogletree is so nice, so funny and so caring. If you go to class and study, everything is super straight forward. Loved his lectures

He is a very nice teacher who wants his students to pass the class. He is very flexible with the rules and forgiving when it comes to grading. He loves the words of modern-day prophets and apostles, and he teaches their counsel to the t. He loves Christ and encourages everyone to have Christ-like relationships.

He does a great job at making everyday topics involved with marriage interesting. He helps you apply the counsel of the prophets into your day to day life, helping you to become more Christlike. Whoever takes this class will enjoy it.

I always liked going to class and learning from professor Ogletree's stories and professional experience. The exams were always straight forward and he would make sure to talk about what the questions might ask for the exams. So, his lectures would follow what would be on the exams very well. He was a great professor and very kind.

Dr Ogletree is a great teacher! His class was always super interesting and his stories always helped keep everyone engaged. He wants you to succeed and is always willing to talk to you and help you if you need it. His test question come straight from the lecture slides and are sometimes open book but there is a time limit.

Professor Ogletree is a great guy, he approaches the different topics of the family with the right attitude, and has humor and personal stories that he throws into the mix that give him credibility. He is also a family counselor, so he definitely has the knowhow to teach this class! Would definitely take one of his other classes!

I took this religion class during the summer in order to fulfill a credit and while Brother Ogletree made it fun, there is some harmful information being taught that perpetuates negative stereotypes about both men and women. That being said, I do think Brother Ogletree does his best to inspire and motivate students to become more Christlike.
Professor Ogletree is a great professor, and he makes the classroom setting light and fun. There's a lot to learn from him as well.

Pay attention in his class or you'll likely miss info you need for the test/quiz. Your test may be open-book/note, however, it'll be a harsh strict time limit. He uses a lot of studies or remarks from psychology that're parallel to what LDS leaders have said. It's all interesting facts, but not the most spiritual or religious class you could take.

Professor Ogletree really wants students to succeed.  I felt truly inspired because of this.  I enjoyed the class and learned a lot because he supplements the academic pressure by going over quizzes and giving extra credit.  I would definitely take this class again!

Ogletree was easy and wanted you to focus on learning instead of stressing about grades. There were daily attendance quizzes that he would give the answers to, so make sure you go to class. 
10/10 would recommend it, honestly wish I could take it again. I also wish everyone could take this class.

Dr. Ogletree's class was perfect for a lightweight course! Lots of our exams were open book and there was very minimal homework. It was a great way to learn more about gospel truths while also balancing other classes. He made sure to make the lectures relatable and he fed off of the comments of the students, which I thought was beneficial.

Dr. Ogletree's lectures felt a lot like an institute class, in that it was engaging, personal, and focused on spiritual learning and understanding. Dr. Ogletree is smart and personable, as well as spiritually confident. His personality is funny, down to earth, and easy to relate to.

This class was what I hoped that a religion class would be-- not stressful, but a time to learn and feel the spirit. Many of our tests were open note, and there were fun projects and extra credit options. It won't change your life, but this class can be a buffer during a more stressful semester to earn a good grade without stressing.

Mark did a great job using outside experiences to connect with the learning material. He tried to make class interesting my sharing relevant stories. He expresses concern to his students in order to provide a comfortable place for them. Is very easy to work with and he will work with you in order to have the best success in class.

He was very energetic and kept the energy in his classroom positive and upbeat! I also appreciated how he was straightforward in his lectures and teachings and said things how they were, he knew people could get offended by what he said but he didnt care because he was teaching the church doctrine.

This class was very easy and you actually get a lot out of it. Dr. Ogletree will go through the attendance quizzes with you so you just have to show up to get credit for it. He will also sometimes go through the exams with you so you can get some answers before you take them (he encourages you to write down as many as you can). Great professor!
GREAT PROFESSOR! So caring about his students and is well prepared in his lessons. He makes them funny and very applicable to whatever is on the test.

Ogletree is awesome! He is a fun professor and really cares about students and wants to help us. His class is really awesome, and really focuses on what is happening with families as of now. The exams are super specific, so make sure you do all the notes and understand all the course material.
I have LOVED this class! I have learned so much about relationships and families. I now know what I want in a future spouse. He is funny and tells good stories. I highly recommend taking it!

Professor Ogletree is the BEST! He is my favorite teacher by far! His lectures are interesting and he makes everything funny. He does a good job of preparing students for exams and offers extra credit. I would recommend taking The Eternal Family from him!

Ogletree is awesome! He isn't a hard teacher and he wants you to succeed. He knows a lot about the eternal family and marriage. He helps you with the quizzes in class and other than attendance, he is very laid back and chill. He is definitely a teacher whom I would take from again.
Great teacher! I loved his class and learned a lot. As long as you show up and pay attention during the lectures you should get an easy A.

Professor Ogletree is the BEST eternal families teacher. His lectures are funny and entertaining!! He really brings the spirit into class and I gained so much insight from him. His tests are timed but he gives you study guides with all the answers on it,  just study those. HIGHLY recommend taking this course from him!!

I loved professor Ogletree! He was so fun and easy to connect with. It was very casual and a comfortable learning environment where we could ask questions if we had them. I learned so much and always looked forward to attending class.

Brother Ogletree is amazing! Only 4 tests throughout the whole semester and they are all super easy. You can tell that he really cares about his students! This class has honestly given me so many great insights on marriage. It has changed how I view relationships and how a cherish them. This is a great class to take to fill a GE.
