Brother Ogletree is an AMAZING professor! His sole purpose is to teach the fundamentals of how to prepare for marriage and family life. He is here to help you succeed and learn. I would take this class over and over again if I could!!

Dr. O is an amazing professor! Very minimal workload and 2/4 exams are open note, the other 2 he gave us study guides with all the test questions on it. Super kind and caring guy, totally understanding. Take Eternal Families from Dr. Ogletree, he knows what he's talking about and has a very successful teaching style. Pretty easy class.

This was such a great class! He is a fun teacher and understands the stresses of people's lives. I really loved how well prepared his classes and slides were. I also was grateful for how organized it all was! 10/10 recommend! You've got it!
He is really nice and makes the class enjoyable!

Professor Ogletree is HILARIOUS! I loved this class! I woke up at 5:15 everyday to hit the gym and then ride the Front Runner to BYU at 7 am! I looked forward to going to class because Professor Ogletree is so funny and his lectures are so good. I learned so much about the family and relationships. I recommend this class to everyone :)

The class was fine, but it was just very lecture heavy.  I took it during the summer semester, so that might've contributed to it, but it just felt like we went through power points every day.  I like Brother Ogletree and you can tell he cares for his students, but I wouldn't take this class again.  It is a very easy A though.

I liked this class alright. I liked that it was not super difficult, but the tests were annoying. They were super specific. Even as a student that did not miss any classes and was an active participant, I still struggled with the exams. Besides that, it was a fine class. Dr. Ogletree was super nice and friendly.

I really enjoyed Eternal Families. He is very good at telling stories and making jokes that are relevant to the material we are teaching.Sometimes it was a little rushed because of how long it was. I also didn't really understand the purpose of the unit about gender differences. That is more a critique on the material than on Professor.

The easiest religion class I have ever taken. If you are looking for a Sunday School style class, this one is for you. Nothing against Dr. O, he is a great guy, pretty funny, and passionate about the gospel. But honestly, I could have gotten then same stuff out of the Ensign and Liahona.
he is a very caring and understanding professor
Dr. O is awesome! He's firm in what he knows and believes in so that can make him seem intimidating sometimes, but he's so genuine and caring. If you're struggling, go to him and he'll help you out.
Professor Ogletree is not bad. I didn't love his class but he is fun and engaging. The class is pretty easy though so if you're looking for an easy religion credit this is it.

Loved this class, Dr. Ogletree was really nice and cared a lot about the students. The homework wasn't bad. Most of the readings weren't too long and were really inspirational and informative. Even though lectures were around an hour and a half, I felt like it was easy to be engaged in the lesson.

You will laugh in his class! He has great stories and makes class enjoyable. The quizzes are super easy. The tests are a little more difficult because they are a little longer and there is limited time, but if you do the study guides and actually study them, you will be fine.
Professor Ogletree is great! He's super understanding and as long as you communicate with him he's always willing to work with you on things

He is funny, cares a lot about his students, and is a very good guy. He wants everyone to do well in the class and gives the class all the tools necessary to do well in his class. The tests are based off of the exam study guides, the quizzes based off of the reading material and aren't too hard. Show up to class, do the homework and you get an A.

He was a really good professor who cares about his students. There is a learning project that goes for a couple of weeks but it isn't hard if you stay on top of it, there are attendance quizzes everyday and most class days there is a pre-class quiz based on readings. Tests are straightforward if you fill in the exam study guide as you go.

Seriously the best religion teacher ever! All quizzes are open book and he gives you good review sheets for exams. Farley large exams but if you review the exam review sheets its not bad at all. Overall really easy class, and his lectures are the best!

I thought he was fine and very reasonable. Tests are pretty easy if you go to class and then fill out the study guides he gives you, especially the ones that only have the test questions on them. Projects are super easy and doesn't take much time to get them done.

Heavy lecturer, most of the tests are based on his lectures, straightforward and very attendance based. He was a very good professor, slightly less nuanced than I would have liked when it comes to certain gospel principles and topics, however, overall was a very good religion professor, I would take his class again.

Tests come from lectures, but are made of mostly quotes. Two tests during finals week (one test from the last section and then the final on top of that-- I'm not a fan.) His class was standard Eternal Families, with the same controversial topics as every other professor, but he didn't do anything especially positive or negative to teach them.

I loved Professor Ogletree!! Honestly, I would look forward to his class every time. I learned so much and felt the Spirit so strongly. He is such a funny teacher and has the best stories but also knows when to be serious. He makes everyone feel loved and valued. He really helped me learn and gain a stronger testimony of the prophets and apostles.

Professor Ogletree is amazing! Every lecture was entertaining and spiritual. I genuinely loved this class. His tests are 100 questions each, which can be a lot, but they're multiple choice and his study guides are super helpful. He gives an attendance quiz every lecture, but he always points out when he's about to answer a question, though.

He's a really nice professor! Teaches very simply and concisely. Helps us out as much as he can. The only thing I didn't like was most of our homework felt like a lot of busy work. Otherwise, it was a great class!
Professor Ogletree has been one of my favorite teachers so far. He is great!!

He was funny and the class was easy enough. For how easy the class is he doesn't have to test on random quotes which made it annoying to study for since he includes so many quotes in his lectures. By the second midterm, he created a more concise study guide which made it more clear which quotes he will ask about.

Really funny and a good teacher. The only problem is that he tests like a "Guess what's in my head" teacher. But he makes up for this by making it so it's impossible to score lower than 70 percent on his exams. He's really inspirational, carrying, and funny.

Every class consisted of a Powerpoint with some stock images and he would share stories/comment on the slides that he has probably used for years now. He would sometimes open up discussions with the class but it was rare. Tests were based completely on the Powerpoints. Class was easy though, no real complaints.

Professor Ogletree is a kind and accommodating professor. I almost died during the semester, and Prof excused all of my resulting missing work, which helped me immensely while trying to catch up with all of my classes. Uses outdated statistics. Still somewhat insensitive toward LGBTQ+ individuals, but one of the better professors in the department.

Ogletree is amazing! He is really funny and knowledgeable because he was a family therapist. Every class period there is a 10 point reading quiz due but they are open reading, and none of the reading is on the test. The tests are the study guides that you fill out every class so study that and you'll do great. Go to class, you'll get points!

Dr. Ogletree's class was fun, interesting, and full of valuable information regarding concepts to keep in mind when searching for a spouse and having a successful marriage. Easy quizzes every week and interesting lectures. One thing to keep in mind is that his tests are pretty weird and include the statistics he brings up briefly about families.

Dr. Ogletree is amazing!! I am so grateful I took the Living Prophets class from him. He was absolutely hilarious and made each class very enjoyable. If you are looking for some extra religion credits and are wanting to learn more about the current prophets/apostles, take this class!

Prof Ogletree is a genuine, great guy. Class is super casual and fun at times. All assignments are extremely easy, but you have to do them. Exams are kinda tough, but the minimum grade is 70% so you'll pass easy.

Dr. Ogletree is very understanding and a great professor. He has a strong testimony of the brethren and does not tolerate ridicule or disbelief in their teachings. His tests can be tricky, but other than that the class is an easy pass with little homework.

I loved Dr. Ogletree! His class was super fun and honestly pretty easy. He relates to the course material and makes it fun to learn. All of his exams come word for word from his lectures, so it is pretty important to attend class. Overall, Ogletree made it a really easy and enjoyable class.

I would highly recommend Dr. Ogletree. I got a C because I missed around 6 quizzes and that really brought my grade down. Word of advice: do your quizzes and you'll do good! Other than that the lectures were amazing. The tests are a little harder because they are super-specific to what was taught but if you study you should do good!

Bro Ogletree is literally so funny! He's so fun to listen to and he makes going to class always enjoyable. The class was relatively easy. He gives you quiz and exam guides that make them all super easy. Just don't fall behind. I highly recommend this class to everyone. You learn so much cool stuff about the living prophets and it's really fun.

Bro Ogletree is seriously one of the best religion professors I have ever had at BYU. He genuinely cares about his students, and his lectures are very engaging and entertaining. I feel I got to know the prophets better throughout his class, and felt the spirit as well! Definitely taking another religion class from him.

Tests were pretty easy if you listen in class and fill out the study guides. Dr. O is not very nuanced when he talks about church topics/standards, which some people may not like but it was really good in a lot of ways. I learned so much about the prophet's and apostles' lives in this class.
The class was engaging and interesting. There was a decent amount of reading required for each lecture, but it was easy and understandable.
Professor Ogletree is fantastic, honestly one of my favorite professors that I've had at BYU. Highly recommend his Living Prophets class!

Professor Ogletree was hands down the best professor I have had, and is incredibly understanding. He genuinely cares for his students and wants to see ALL succeed. As long as you participate in this class, you will do very well. Professor Ogletree is seriously the BEST!
Professor Ogletree is a great guy! He wants the best for his students.
Lectures were enjoyable. If you had any problems missing assignments he was very easy to work with.

His class is totally lecture based so if you're not into that i would not suggest him. However, he explains things great. His homework is usually based on our opinions of the assignment. overall great.

He is a funny guy and a good professor. He really knows his stuff and teaches it using lecture slides, which are available on Learning Suite. Exam study guides are a must, weekly quizzes aren't too bad if you use the readings. Definitely would take Professor Ogletree again!

I loved this class!! I don't really understand most of the negative ratings for him to be honest. He did a great job at approaching challenging topics with love and wisdom. His tests are only hard if you don't take time to study for them. You can easily get an A if you study and attend class.
Lectures are very enjoyable, and overall the class was very helpful, however the tests are needlessly difficult and a bit fruatrating.

Brother Ogletree and his Living Prophets class was probably my favorite religion class ever taken here at BYU. His classes are fun and interesting and he is the nicest guy you'll ever meet. If you are unhappy with a grade just email him in a nice way and he will work with you. Would definitely take from him again.
The classes are very entertaining because Brother Ogletree is always making jokes. The class is not hard, it's a good class to take for extra religion credits.
Great professor and a super easy class. Just show up and do the work needed (which is all easy work) and you'll get an A. Highly recommend this class for religion credit.
Super easy, tests are simple if you do the study guides.

I loved this class, and Professor Ogletree made it a great experience. Tests are just on learning suite, and pretty straightforward if you study for them. The lectures are great and each day we just do an attendance quiz, so attendance matters. One big project, and that was about it. Loved him, and I definitely recommend taking it from him!
Wonderful class and Brother Ogletree is a great professor!

I loved Dr. Ogletree's class! His lectures were always engaging and he's hilarious. He really cares about his students and you can tell he really knows the material he teaches. The tests require a good bit of study time/memorization as there's a lot of material on each exam, but the expectations for each exam are pretty clear for the most part.
Good class, you learn a ton about the Living Prophets. I gained a much deeper appreciation for them as Prophets and people

Prof. Ogletree is awesome when I am taking Living Prophets from him. There are attendance quizzes but they are extremely easy and he gives you everything you need to be successful. His lectures are entertaining and easy to understand and coincide with the study guides for the midterms. Would take him again

The lectures were entertaining, the tests were completely based on his lecture slides so theyre easy enough if you take notes using his study guide during lecture. His selected readings are ENTIRELY available on the church website so save yourself some 30 bucks and dont buy it. I cant say i learned a bunch from the class but it was easy.

Oglrtree is awesome and sincerely wants students to learn these principles. He was easy to work with and cares about his students well being. There was a lot of reading, but it was mostly interesting. The tests had some random facts, but the studyguides have all the answers. If you put in bare minimun effort youll be fine.

Professor Ogletree is a great professor who truly wants his students to succeed not only in the classroom but outside it as well. He makes class enjoyable and the workload is pretty easy to maintain. If you go to class and do the study guides, you can perform well on the tests.

Amazing teacher, very interesting class learning about all the apostles. Tests were pretty straight forward facts and quotes about/by the 12 or the prophet, and matched well with the study guides. He's super lenient and understanding about circumstances though. A plus on that.

Brother Ogletree is an amazing teacher.  He is very kind, patient, and funny.  This class wasn't too hard, but you definitely need to put in the effort to get a good grade.  If you come to class prepared and you participate regularly, you will learn so much.  Definitely recommend taking this class from Brother Ogletree.

He has a simple, spiritual teaching style. The way he tests students is peculiarly specific: he tests you on very specific quotes from past Church leaders that I believe deviated from a doctrinal core more than I would have hoped for. Tests weren't hard to study for, and are nothing to stress over. A good-hearted man.
He was a fine professor. Workload was not too bad but there isn't much leeway as far as missing assignments or class.

Hello, Informanter Zero here, procurer of honest and useful ratings. This class was quite easy in terms of grading. Not much homework, weekly quizzes with study guides for them. Also, there are a couple of projects. 3 Exams total and a Final. Exams can be very specific and tough if you don't fill out the study guide during class.

Dr. Ogletree is such an amazing and genuinely caring professor! I learned a lot from this class that will be very helpful in the future. His tests are tricky because you have to memorize certain facts about apostles and such but if you use the study guides they aren't too bad! Lots of opportunity to make it up with other assignments as well.
Typical religion class at BYU. He sometimes gets distracted and goes off on tangents which can be annoying. He seems to be more interested in being friends with the students than teaching at times.
Typical religion class. He does get distracted sometimes during the lesson and go off on tangents which can be annoying.

Dr. Ogletree is clearly very knowledgeable about his subject matter and cares a lot about it. He is very friendly and made class interesting. Most of the class was really easy, but I thought the tests were hard and pointless. You need to memorize really specific biographical facts about apostles. He isn't very understanding of different views.

Professor Ogletree is an awesome, passionate teacher who loves what he teaches. He is funny and engaging and I learned so much from him. His tests are moderately difficult only because there are so many multiple choice options for each question that sound correct. Just use his study guides to study and you should be good!

Dr. Ogletree feels like a good friend. He's funny, tells interesting stories, and considers the needs and feelings of the students. The tests are straightforward, if you put in a little extra work to know the material on the study guides, you can do great on the tests. I felt sometimes like I was being tested on unimportant details.
Dr. Ogletree did a great job making the class both engaging and spiritual. Would recommend!

Brother Ogletree is a good professor. There is a lot of reading and the exams are a little more work than he says they are, but you just need to put in some extra time to review the study guides and you'll be fine.

Professor Ogletree is INCREDIBLE. I absolutely loved this class so much. All of the readings he assigned were so inspired and needed for our day and age. I felt like I received personal revelation and critical knowledge nearly every class! He gives tests but he gives very specific study guides so that you can know pretty much everything on the test
He's a very good professor and helps everyone.

Professor Ogletree was an amazing professor for this class. The lectures were super engaging and he is always willing to work with you with things. There is a lot of reading and you'll need to study a bit for the exams, but other than that, this class is really great!

Professor Ogletree is excellent. His tests are kind of hard, however if you fill out the study guides he gives you, they become much more manageable. His lectures are very entertaining and you will not be bored in class for the most part.
I loved his class especially as a non member.

Professor Ogletree was very caring and showed respect for students who needed help.The lectures were based on a lot of quotes, and the tests were based off of these quotes. You did not need to know that much specific information, mostly you just memorize the quotes from the lectures which was difficult.
This is an amazing professor! I would take this class again! I loved the atmosphere and his teaching style. He made you feel welcome and made class fun.
Honestly he was the nicest teacher I have ever had. The way he teaches is very interactive and interesting. I walked away each class feeling happier and spiritually uplifted!

Dr. Ogletree is an honest, good man. I have thoroughly enjoyed taking his class and genuinely love his straightforward, humorous teaching style. While his tests can be challenging at times, if you put in the work you'll obtain a good grade.
He is an honest man and if you are looking for an easy A it isn't this class. You will have to work a little, but the class environment is respectful and fun.

I took Eternal Families from Dr. Ogletree and loved it, so I decided to take Living Prophets from him as well. He has a very organized class and an interesting, humor-filled lecture style you can keep up with. 

You don't need to buy the readings packet since all the readings are talks and devotionals you can read online.

This class was amazing! I learned so much about the gospel and I felt the spirit very strongly in every class. There was a lot of reading and quizzes to do, but the reading was always so inspiring and intriguing!

Brother Ogletree is the GOAT. Lectures are great, his study guides every class are clear. Also, he's hilarious and I was always laughing at his jokes and humor.

A lot of people would complain about having to do a lot of readings (he provides an awesome packet by the way), but it's just material to help you prepare for a better family life.

Professor Ogletree taught very clearly by using slideshows. He used many personal examples, pictures, stories, and scriptures. His class was genuinely interesting and conveyed the material very clearly.
He was an engaging teacher! You have to show up and expect to pay attention. He gives you answers to for the study guides which help you on the tests!
I definitely recommend this class. There is a super easy reading quiz due each class time and an attendance quiz in class. Don't skip class and you'll do great!
Very flexible to help students succeed.

Dr. Ogletree's class is designed for all the students to succeed. The readings and homework quizzes are very easy to complete and should not be a cause of stress at all. He provides exam review questions for every unit which prepares you very well for the exams. He also defends the truth and loves to teach the real and pure doctrine of Christ.
Professor Ogletree is great! He's so funny and so willing to work with his students. His class has a reasonable workload for a BYU religion class.
He was fantastic, would definitely take classes with him again.

He has really fun lectures. You have quizzes before every class that are 10 questions long, they are open note and not hard. There is a project it is really simple and easy. Really cool stories are shared in class. Tests can be hard if you don't study, he gives study guides. The tests, 100 questions and you have 60min to take it.
He is a good professor. He has fun lectures and does care about everyone, but sometimes his personality rubs some people the wrong way. However, I am pretty easy going and I really liked his class.

Dr. Ogletree is great. I looked forward to attending his class each day, and because of his attendance quizzes I was thoroughly engaged. He is a great story-teller and cares intensely about the gospel. He is amicable and humorous in his teaching style.

He was super willing to help out students, as long as they were trying.  I loved that the class was based on teachings from the prophets.  The reading was good, and I actually learned applicable things. The hardest part was that he rarely covered the entire lecture, so I filled out the study guide from the powerpoints during class.

Dr. Ogletree is the best guy. He's been my favorite professor at BYU. He's a straight shooter and is unashamed to teach the gospel of Jesus Christ. He is a convert and has really cool stories. You're able to develop a personal relationship with him which was super cool as well. If you need to take Eternal Families make sure you get him!

Dr. Ogletree is funny and he has a strong testimony. Lectures are entertaining and if you take notes you'll be just fine. He makes a study guide for the exams so you can fill it out during each lesson. Exams are really memory based so you've gotta actually study the study guide.

I loved this class and it really got me thinking about marriage and really set me up for success in real life. The only thing that was difficult are his tests. His tests are way too specific on some questions though. For example one question would be between "Ye are the salt of the earth" and "You are the salt of the earth" But totally worth it!!
He is a very wise man with an ability to teach with the spirit. While you will learn a lot in this class, you will also have a lot of fun. I looked forward to his class everyday.
He a great professor and really nice guy. He very genuine when he teaches and his personality brings the subject to life.
Only religion professor I actually have enjoyed in my three years at BYU so far. Super funny lectures and aware that religion classes should have a lighter course load than other classes.

Dr. Ogletree is a great professor! I loved the class, and his lessons are OUTSTANDING. I should warn you though, his exams are really hard and don't really pertain to the subject of eternal families. They are more random trivia from the lectures.

He was very funny, and I enjoyed this class. I had a great time in his class. There are two quizzes on readings and then two for attendance. I grinded out all the reading quizzes in one sitting and I do not regret it. I do recommend. It is not a difficult class.

Dr. O is the best! He is honestly one of my favorite religion professors at BYU. You can tell that he has a testimony of what he is teaching. I can say that I felt the spirit in every single lecture (you can't say that about very many classes at BYU...)

Dr. Ogletree is super funny and gives great lectures. I loved the course, as it really helps you relate and connect more with current prophets, and I found my General Conference experience was noticeably improved.

This class and Brother Ogletree are awesome! We had small open-book quizzes 1-2 times a week, attendance quizzes every class, a couple of midterms on Learning suite, a project, a small final project, and finals. This class was honestly so easy. He isn't super lenient for BS, but if you just get your stuff in you'll do great!

The class wasn't horrible, but it felt useless. The course material is 80% fun facts about the prophets, which you were then asked to recall in pretty specific detail for tests. He did very little to engage the class, which made it very boring. He also often bordered on overglorifying the prophets, which I found unhealthy for building testimonies.
The tests are harder than he makes them out to be. Other than that, the class is easy and fun!

Professor Ogletree is the best! He is such a great guy and so inspiring. I was honestly excited to go to his class. He is so chill and you just have to study a little for the tests and you'll be fine.

Dr. O is really fun. He has clear organization for his class, and makes his expectations clear. He is very flexible if you communicate with him. His tests are straightforward (similar to the study guides) although there is always a couple surprise questions that I miss. Highly recommend to anyone who wants to learn more about the current prophets.

A lot of his class is based on memorizing the study guides that he provides for the tests. He provides the textbooks as pdfs online so don't buy them. Tests are about remembering details. He is a great professor and spends time trying to get to know the class. If you are looking a class you will enjoy and won't be tons of work, take this class.
Professor Ogletree is pretty great. The class wasn't the most spiritually strengthening religion class so I probably wouldn't take it again but a lot of people like him.

He is by far one of my favorite religion professors. Actually cares about you and is so funny! He is a very easy grader and most of it is based on the honor system. He has a daily quiz and a few assigments throughout the course. If you attend class you'll do great on the tests.

Professor Ogletree is a great professor and a lot of people like him. The class is pretty straightforward and you can get by without too much work... The projects are probably the most time consuming part. Personally, I wish the class had required a bit more deep learning outside of class so it wasn't the most impactful class for me.

Professor Ogletree is the greatest man I know. His lectures are insightful and have taught me lessons I will cling to for a lifetime. He is honest and fair, and he is very flexible and helpful in helping us complete the coursework necessary. 10/10 recommend.

Professor Ogletree is great! But don't try to cram for his exams, they are 100 questions each! You get all the answers from the study guides which are pretty easy to fill out, but sometimes questions are asked from lectures that I didn't attend. Attendance quizzes are given, making attendance mandatory to get a good grade

Dr. O is so fun! His lectures are really engaging and inspiring. There are quizzes each day in class (super short just for attendance), and the projects were very manageable. I would DEFINTITELY take Living Prophets from him!

He is so funny and still brings the spirit every time, I was able to get some answers to prayers in his class and always wanted to go. The class is so hard to fail, and it is such a good and fun environment. I've taken 2 classes from him now and I would take another again easily.

Dr. Ogletree is my favorite professor I have had at BYU by far. He is strong in his gospel beliefs and he teaches gospel principles in a way that makes them so easy to relate to. He makes his teachings memorable and enjoyable. I love going to his classes just to listen and laugh. There is a great spirit in his classroom.
One of my favorite professors! I loved this class.

Professor Ogletree was awesome! However, the class was not much of a cakewalk. The test are not open book, but he gives a really good study guide. There were three projects, but they were not too intense. I learned a lot about the prophet and apostles in this class. Professor Ogletree is extremely smart and knows the content well.

Professor Ogletree is awesome. His lectures are interesting and insightful. He knows so much about the prophets and apostles, and it was cool to hear stories about them. He's funny, kind, and chill. I accidentally missed a midterm and he opened it up for me so that I could take it. If you just do the quizzes and show up to class you'll be fine.
Pretty solid professor. You can tell he has passion for what he teaches and his class is easy. His tests are mainly just memorization of random facts but everything else is easy.
Really easy class and allows you to get stuff done really easily. Only thing really needed to be focused on is attendance and quizzes.
He is such a cool dude and very understanding. You can build a great relationship with him. If you do it makes the class even better.

Dr. O is awesome! Super fun professor with a good sense of humor and a strong testimony of the Gospel, which made this Living Prophets course really engaging. There are a lot of readings, but most are talks that you can listen to instead. Tests are very memorization based - not too hard but you definitely need to review the study guides!
He is the best! He understands that religion classes should not be your hardest class, so he has made Living Prophets as easy as possible. If you do the work and come to class you will get an A.
He was super nice and his class was so fun. he asks you to read a lot but the tests on the readings are pretty simple. i

Very entertaining and gives great lectures. He really cares about his students and his class really strengthened my testimony. I really look forward to his class and I'm so glad that I took it. Super light on homework and reading, but he tests on stuff that is basically memorizing slides, so it's hard to do well on the tests.

Honestly a super great guy. I had Eternal families with him once a week in the evening and yet he made it an enjoyable class and let us out early every time. He covers a lot of material but keeps it interesting with funny personal stories and funny videos. 
The only homework is to go over various conference/BYU speeches and do open book quizzes.
He is awesome. Teaches the doctrine. Attendance is very important but it is easy to pass if you go. Definitely conservative.

You don't have to buy the reading packet, he posts it online and encourages you just to search for the answers during quizzes. Literally gives away an A. People are so salty. Leave BYU if you don't want to hear simple, beautiful doctrine. He is so kind and caring. He teaches with such a strong spirit. Best teacher at BYU hands down.

Class is just lectures and quizzes. About 2 per week. Super easy, just take notes on lectures, quizzes are open book. Tests are not open book, so they require a lot of memorization about useless facts about prophets (i.e. What was the childhood job of President Uchtdorf?)

This class is super easy, but you have to put in a little more effort for it to be spiritually enlightening. Otherwise, it's all just fun facts about the apostles. The tests are easy but kinda ridiculous (100 questions each) and about facts that don't always seem meaningful. Lectures weren't interactive. I wasn't super impressed, but he's nice!!

Brother Ogletree is an amazing teacher! He is funny, spiritual, and just makes learning the gospel that much better! Has a heartfelt and sincere testimony! He basically gives you the answers to the study guide every class, and then those are the answers for the tests.
Interesting source material, but I wish the tests were more on principles that the apostles taught instead of exact wording and random trivia.

I'll get flack for this but I was disappointed that he would read facts about the lives of the 12 Apostles with minimum class discussion. Like I can't remember how many kids each of them have or what high school sport they played like what do they teach to help us succeed.

If you feel like Eternal Families might already be a difficult class for you (content wise), I would suggest thank the one from the Family Life college. Like everyone has said before, nice guy, bad tests. But here's the trick: just put those study guides straight into Quizlet & boom, you'll ace it. Cheers!

Doctor Ogletree is a great guy! He is really caring of his students and he genuinely wants to help his students pass his class. The reading is pretty heavy but you can skim and the quizzes are open book. I looked forward to going every day.

Professor Ogletree is a great teacher! He bases all of his lectures on The Family: A Proclamation to the World. Be prepared to read a decent amount from the reading packet. Very lenient with late work. He has so many stories though!! Most of them are funny. Very experienced and knowledgeable in his field and a great teacher to have.

Professor Ogletree's lectures were my favorite two hours of every week! His lectures are engaging and interesting and he presents information in a scientific way but tells great stories to solidify and help you understand it. I would definitely recommend his Eternal Families class to anyone. Reading quizzes twice a week that are not difficult

Professor Ogletree is very straightforward about what he expects from you from the very beginning of the class. He's willing to work with you if you are communicative and open about what you need. His lectures are fun and engaging. Would recommend for anyone trying to knock out their Religion generals.

Amazing professor. Always ready to help any students in need or any questions, even out of the classroom. He does care and has a big heart and so much passion for the Eternal Families class; it makes class so enjoyable and a great environment to learn. HIGHLY RECOMMEND! He's a funny guy too, classes are the best; especially when he tells stories!!!

Brother Ogletree is amazing! I loved his Eternal Families class. If you are like me and learn best or engage more with laughter and stories, then take his class. He is kind and respectful to everyone. He is teaching based on gospel principles and his own experience. His class is not hard, with most the assignments being readings and attendance.
Honestly just an amazing professor, I absolutely loved his lectures and him. I will take any religion classes I can with him.
Dr Ogletree is great. Just do the study guides and you will have every answer to the tests. Super spiritual lessons. Would 10/10 take more classes from him.
I loved my class with Dr. Ogletree. He is a very engaging teacher that knows his stuff! I learned so much from him.

Here's a great professor who teaches the gospel how it is, he uses the teachings of the prophets and apostles to back up what he teaches. He defends the Family Proclamation. There is an attendance quiz each class and a reading quiz due at the beginning of each class, all the questions are straight from the readings and his powerpoints.

Dr. Ogletree cares about his students and the material he teaches. He provides test study guides, which help to narrow down all the information we have to memorize for the test. My only complaint is that it is a lot of memorizing, but other than that, it's an easier religion class, and I feel it's taught well.
Mr. Ogletree is an awesome guy! He will provide you with all that you need to succeed during his class.

Dr. Ogletree is clearly an expert when it comes to family and marriage. This made it an awesome environment to learn more about the centrality of the Family in the Plan of Salvation and the Sanctity of Eternal Marriage. However, the lecture presentation was not engaging. I didn't enjoy just sitting through power points.
He gives more assignments than most relgion professors. Focused more on life facts of current apostles than their teachings. Tests are memorizing facts.
I really like Professor Ogletree. He greatly cares for his students and he makes learning fun.
He's great! I really loved the stories we heard about the different prophets and apostles. It was a really good time learning about them. Overall, a great class!

He is the MAN. Love how he teaches the truth and doesnt change his teachings to conform to the evil world today. He is hilarious, tells the funniest stories, and the workload is so easy. The readings are brief and he assigns some of the best talks Ive read. I love Dr. Ogletree!

I really enjoyed having Professor Ogletree. I think he's a funny guy and has great insight/stories to share in class. It's a pretty fun and easy class. He is very understanding and wants to help his students pass and learn.
Great class. Great guy. He is very funny and his lectures insightful. There are a lot of little quizzes. The tests are pretty tough but not terrible. Definitely one of my better religion classes.

Dr. Ogletree is the best religion professor I have had at BYU. His living prophets class is engaging, fun, inspirational, and interesting. You can tell that Dr. Ogletree not only truly knows the material he teaches, but also genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. I would 10/10 recommend taking his living prophets class.

The class is not very hard. A lot of the content is really outdated and in a class like Eternal Family that was really a detriment. Ogletree is a nice guy and is really accommodating. I would have liked the class if the reading material wasn't so old.

Dr Ogletree has been a clinical family pychologist for the past 20-30 years, so he brings an intellectual side to the class that many religion professors lack. While it is very gospel heavy, it is nice having a pychological take on relationships and marriage, and how they line up and/or sometimes don't line up with church teachings.

Prof Ogletree is a good professor with engaging lectures, but the tests are pretty difficult (unless you cheat). They're mostly direct quotes from class but he gives you good study guides and is great with extra credit if you ask.
He is super funny and tells awesome stories. Go to the lectures and fill out the exam study guides during class and you will be fine.
Professor Ogletree is great! He's a funny guy and his class is fairly straight forward. The tests are very quote heavy so that can be difficult at times but is overall not bad! Good class.

Really good class. Not too hard. Just study the study guides for the exams. The answers are not hard to find on the slides. The project was a little bit annoying to do at first, but ended up being really worth while by the end. There is also a paper that you'll have to write for this class.

Dr. Ogletree is awesome! He is so passionate during his lectures. His passion inspires you to care. I learned a lot in this class and loved it. He is also super funny. You do have a 5 page paper at the end and one project but as long as you have good content and show that you learned something you will receive a good grade so don't stress over them
I loved this class. He is super easy and entertaining.
Very good class for learning about more than just marriage. The professor is very considerate and makes everyone feel comfortable.
Great guy and great lectures. Almost no homework which is awesome. Pretty easy except the tests will get you. 100 % memorization of tiny details

I liked this class a lot! it is for sure heavy on lectures but he makes it interesting, he is a great speaker. his stories are hilarious. the class was one day a week which made it a bit longer, but most days he finished early. the material is interesting and the homework is just a couple quizzes before class and a couple of goal setting assignment

Professor Ogletree is an amazing person. His lectures are always entertaining, but be prepared for the bombardment of quotes from general authorities and others coming your way. He has good study guides, and he gives most of the answers in class. He goes really quickly through content, though, so it's hard to have a super deep spiritual experience.

Dr. Ogletree is one of the funniest professors I've ever had! He is really engaging and is overall a great teacher. He pulls all of the test questions from the "exam study guides," which can be found on learning suite. Tests are a bit challenging because you have to memorize quotes word for word.

Brother Ogletree is nice and funny but his tests are 100 questions about specific quotes meaning that you have to memorize them all. This was very frustrating considering that the tests were online and not proctored. Meaning that people could cheat and look up the answers. This ends up affecting my grade when he curves the grade on the test.

Overall really funny, but his lectures are literally him just speed reading the powerpoints (he always has more material than he can cover). His tests are literally 100 questions that are all quotes, so you just have to memorize them verbatim, which is frustrating. Also, don't buy the textbook- he puts it on Learning Suite for free.

Brother Ogletree is passionate about what he does. He's very knowledgable and fair with grading. He's not afraid to call students out for doing the bare minimum and inspires people to do and be better.

He is someone where when you enter the class, he said to expect an A if you do the stuff. The eternal families class is a hard class to teach and he sometimes brushed over the important things. He is really funny and emailed us before his personal beliefs and if we didn't agree, to change professors. He has more conservative ideas but is very smart

Brother Ogletree is one of my favorite professors I've had at BYU. His lectures are super interesting and his lessons on marriage and families are really helpful. He's super funny and even though the class is long, he makes it enjoyable. I would recommend Ogletree to anyone at BYU.

Overall the class was straightforward and fairly easy. The lectures were fun and covered both the factual and spiritual parts of the prophets and apostles lives and teachings. The readings were reasonable and applied directly to the class discussions. The quiz and exam study guides he provided were very useful. Tests were memorization heavy.

Every class was going through a slideshow full of quotes and filling out a study guide on it. Tests were done off of these study guides, and were specific and difficult. But, he is really great if you don't get the score you want. He curves tests, and I emailed him when I didn't get the score I wanted and he gave me points back.

Dr. Ogletree is a great professor and brings a great light to BYU! I took his Eternal Family class. There was a lot of information in his lectures that seemed a little redundant. His exams were pretty long and very specific to the lectures, so be prepared to memorize lots of stats and quotes from general authorities!
This is a great class to learn about the learning prophets without having to worry about a professor trying to trick students or make them do assignments just to do them.

Mark Ogletree gives great lectures. He keeps the class engaged and he is willing to work with you to get the grade you want. I would recommend his class to anyone trying to learn more about living prophets.

Dr. Ogletree is so hilarious and such an engaging professor. He is willing to help students out in any way he can! He brought in relatives of the apostles to share their experiences, which was so cool. The tests were a bit harder than I expected. They ask for a lot of specific details, so you do have to study.
This class was super awesome! interesting topics taught by an amazing professor! quizzes and tests are super clear. A few easy papers as well.

Professor Ogletree is super awesome and I enjoyed his class. He is very engaging and he makes his class fun. He has a good sense of humor and he makes everything he does interesting. He is super flexible and caring and wants to help you get a good grade in his class. Highly recommend if you need a religion class.

Prof. Ogletree is a very good professor! He is very entertaining and funny, and there isn't a lot of homework at all! The only thing is that his tests were rather difficult. They are 100 multiple choice questions and you only have an hour to take them. They also affect your grade quite a lot. But he is a great teacher who cares about his students!

As a religion class at BYU, it's not a cakewalk, but it is rewarding based on the effort put in to be engaged. His lectures are organized and well prepared. He's a funny guy, so they really are enjoyable. The tests are clearly outlined by the study guides. Dr. O is on the student's team, and he really does take care of you.

I loved Dr. Ogletree's class. He really knows how to talk to college kids. He's also SUPER funny and is a very genuine, honest guy. I loved this class so much, I want to take it again. He used lots of quotes from the Prophets, teaching us so much doctrinal truth. (This class was RelC200)

He is a really excellent teacher and helps you care about what the subject. But his tests are more quote and lecture focused. The tests were more difficult than expected because it was a lot more memorization of exact quotes.

This class is the most interesting, entertaining, and spiritually strengthening class I have ever taken at BYU. As long as you fill out the study guides during the class you will get an A, and you will love everything you learn from professor Ogletree. I highly recommend this class!!

This class is the most interesting, entertaining, and spiritually strengthening class I have ever taken at BYU. As long as you fill out the study guides during the class you will get an A, and you will love everything you learn from professor Ogletree.

He's an awesome teacher, makes class interesting, and cracks jokes. I've received a lot of inspiration because of his class, and it changed my life. The only thing that bugs me is that there is a TON of reading, and he tests on very specific quotes from the hundreds of pages of conference talks that we have to read. Besides that, he's good.

I thought he was fine. Super lecture heavy class, I never felt spiritually uplifted. Professor Ogletree is funny and is very amenable to student's needs, but I didn't find him to be a very good teacher. Just ok.
Professor Ogletree is the sweetest! It is evident that he really cares for his students and is funny. I really enjoyed the class and felt like I have gained some new insight.
I absolutely loved Professor Ogletree! His lectures are so much fun and interesting to listen to! He cares about everyone and is willing to work with you. I would gladly take this class again!

Brother Ogletree is a great professor. I have come to know more about the living prophets and I absolutely loved getting to know them better and understanding more of their backgroud. I would take the class again. He is always willing to also work with you.
He loves student athletes
Great professor
He is very organized and you always know what to expect each week for class. He expects effort and he is super fun and animated.

Literally one of the best classes I have ever taken! Professor Ogletree is hilarious and is such an amazing teacher! He cares about his students and is willing to help out! He loves the gospel and pulls everything directly from the teachings of prophets and apostles. I would highly recommend this class and the professor! 10/10

Extremely inspiring and spiritually strengthening, I would take this class from no one else. The work load is extremely easy if you know how to use the ctrl+f function, you can fill out the study guides super fast. The tests require a few hours of studying, and are the harshest on your grade, but aren't intimidating AT ALL. Two super easy projects

Professor Ogletree is great! He gives interesting lectures and this class is pretty different from other religion classes. His tests are a little rough. He asks you to memorize a lot of random facts from leaders' lives which is a bit cumbersome. Overall, a pretty chill and easy class!

He was an awesome professor and loves what he teaches! I personally enjoyed the lectures. most of the points towards your grade come from things done in class so attendance is important but I never felt stressed about homework in his class. I would totally take another class from him.

Professor Ogletree is a great teacher who really does care about his students. There are regular quizzes which are pretty easy as long as you go to class and review the readings. There's a month long attribute project and a paper that determine a big chunk of the grade. Beware of the tests, they are 100 questions long (multiple choice) and brutal.

Professor Ogletree is great at teaching the Eternal Families class. He goes by PowerPoint, so it is pretty monotonous, but he tells personal stories to keep it entertaining. He asks questions that are on his PowerPoint, so there is some discussion but not much. There are few assignments, so I didn't spend a lot of time outside of class on them.

Great professor! Helped me out a ton in class. There were a few times where I was unable to make it to class and instead of giving me a zero, Professor Ogletree was understanding and gave an eighty for no work whatsoever. Multiple times he was very understanding and helpful in the stresses of being a student.

Professor Ogletree is a cool dude, he's very clear about what is expected out of class and what his stance is on issues. He isn't very specific about what will be on tests or what they will be like, but his lectures are interesting and he tells engaging stories. most of the grade comes from attendance and quizzes straight from the reading.

Professor Ogletree truly cares about your success and wants you to actually learn from the class. On my first exam, though, I didn't expect to have such a hard time. You definitely can't take the test with common knowledge, though he has both quiz and test study guides which (if studied well) guarantee an A. Plus, he ended up raising my grade.
Great teacher, committed to what he believes. He will answer questions, but he doesn't tolerate insincere criticism.

I really enjoyed Brother Ogletree class! His lectures are really spiritual and I feel I learned a lot and am better prepared for marriage and family life. One thing I would suggest is to fill out the corresponding exam study guide in each class found in the content tab. All of the exam questions are found on the slides and in the study guides.

Professor Ogletree really looks out for his students and keeps the class in a great mood. Although covid prevented us from interacting much within the class, he gave many examples and really brought the lessons to life. He is very strong in his beliefs, perfect for being an Eternal Families teacher. I highly recommend Prof. Ogletree!

Dr. O does a great job of inviting the spirit as he teaches and does a good job teaching sensitive subjects. His tests are straightforward and all the questions can be found on the study guides he gives. This was a super fun class!
Loved Him

Brother Ogletree is awesome. He is loyal to the gospel and its principles and is very objective with all of his teachings. Everything he teaches is pretty much just straight quotes from prophets and apostles. I loved the class because it had a small work load, but I also learned. It wasn't hardwhich religion classes can be sometimes.
He is the best! I loved every single one of his classes and he is so funny! I felt the spirit and I learned a lot about families and he was just the best!! 10/10 would recommend absolutely!!

Professor Ogletree is great! He really cares about his students and the content of the class. Lectures were entertaining and we covered a lot of good material. The tests were a bit harder than I was expecting as it was based a lot on quotes from prophets and others. But, overall an awesome professor and an interesting class!

Dr. Ogletree's class is well-structured and easy enough- his tests are pretty specific though and lots of memorization of random quotes and statistics. His attitude toward women was pretty demeaning, and I feel like he joked about a lot of things that were triggering or inappropriate. But if you're a super traditional extreme Mormon you'll love him
I really enjoyed his class and would definitely recommend it to other students.

Professor Ogletree was so awesome. He was super understanding of student's issues and he really just wanted us to succeed. He was also super entertaining so I would actually want to go to class. His tests were kind of hard in that the questions are from specific people and what they said about a specific topic, but doable.
He's a great guy! His class helped me learn a lot and he is a great teacher who believes what he teaches very passionately!

I LOVED this class!!! The material was interesting, and Professor Ogletree is so entertaining. He really cares about his students, and wants everyone to succeed. TAKE THIS CLASS FROM OGLETREE!!! Attendance, quizzes, a few tests, a project, and an essay make up your grade in the class. Super doable, never had to stress about this class. Chefs kiss

Besides the tests focusing on minute details from the hundreds of pages of talks and slides, the class was enjoyable thanks to his humor and enthusiasm. There wasn't much inter-student interaction in the class.

One paper and a project focused on improving one's self were the only big assignments. The tests weren't DIFFICULT but each question focused on specific portions of quotes from the 400+ pages of talks you read. Ex: What percentage of couples in Utah get divorced in their first 5 years of marriage? The class was always silent, luckily he's humorous
Awesome guy and awesome teacher. He is very enthusiastic about what he does.
He's a great teacher and makes lectures super fun - I enjoyed going to class.

Brother Ogletree is an amazing professor and person! Super nice and understanding! His class is super chill and laid back which I loved. The quizzes are really easy and the readings are normal length. Tests are based off of lecture and sometimes feel like just random facts about the general authorities instead of spiritual experiences that they had

Every Religion class at BYU should be taught how Prof Ogletree teaches. He is the best. His classes are entertaining yet insightful. You can tell he really cares about his students. He has a lot of expertise when it comes to marriages. He was super fast at responding to emails even if they were not super important. The GOAT.
Dr. Ogletree is funny and good at getting students engaged in class. I learned lots from him without hating my life

Prof Ogletree is an amazing teacher. One of my favorite teachers thus far at BYU. He really knows his stuff and is willing to help with personal questions as well as class questions. He makes all the lectures fun and cares about his students. I would definitely recommend taking his class.

Professor Ogletree is hilarious, and so the lectures are pretty enjoyable that way. That being said, his lesson powerpoints have a lot going on, and there's a lot of reading to do, so there's a ton of content you have to go through in preparation for the exams.

Professor Ogletree is super kind and loving! It is very clear that he cares about his students and their eternal well-being. Does a powerpoint slide every class, with daily attendance quizzes that are impossible to fail. Very easy-going when it comes to grading papers, willing to work with your grade if you talk to him. 10/10 would take again!

I took professor Ogletree for Eternal Families. I felt that the way he taught certain subjects was not the best, and that the material matter used was full of stereotypes. I personally felt that I didnt learn anything about eternal families and marriage that I didnt already know, and I didnt like how midterms and quizzes were set up.

Dr. Ogletree is a good man. His Living Prophets class is inspiring and has helped me to connect to the Living Prophets and want to follow them more in my life. He is not interested in opposition to doctrine, so if you want to be controversial, probably take a different professor. Discussion is welcome, but dissension is not.

Brother Ogletree was my favorite professor this semester. He loves his students and cares about their needs. His living prophets class was very inspiring and informational. His class is very straightforward. All of his quizzes with the textbook readings were open note and his tests are just like the study guides. He is willing to help you whenever.
I have really enjoyed this class, Professor Ogletree is so funny but also teaches the material well. The tests are very specific, but he gives study guides with all the questions.
This class was great. Professor Ogletree is very funny and insightful. Homework in his classes is not hard, usually two quizzes a week from the reading. Overall great professor.

Powerpoint teacher. Get ready to sit and watch this man present powerpoints in order the entire semester with close to zero interaction with the students. He tells stories and tries to make you laugh and have a good time. The class itself is easy, Ogletree just simply isn't my desired religious teaching style.

Prof. Ogletree is one of those professors that make required religion classes worth it. He is funny, smart, and down to earth. Not a difficult class, but you still learn a lot. You won't regret taking his class.

He is a great professor; he's very funny and his lectures are enjoyable and enriching. One complaint I have is that the tests are extremely annoying; they're based on specific quotes from the lectures, so even if multiple answers are right, there's only one that was in the quote said by that specific person. Using the SGs helps a little bit.

Ogletree is honestly my favorite religion professor at BYU! He is so easy to work with and truly cares about his students success. He is so passionate and knowledgeable about the prophets. The quizzes and tests are easy and very straightforward when you follow the study guide!

Professor Ogletree is amazing. He helped not only my knowledge of the doctrine of eternal families to grow, but he helped my testimony to grow immensely. Plus he is hilarious, never a dull moment in his class.
If you go to class and put in a little bit of effort you will pass

I loved this class. I truly looked forward to going everyday and love learning what he taught. He used facts and doctrine to teach very funny and interesting. You do have to show up every class. Weekly 2 normal quizzes easy 2 attendance quizzes (answers given in class) Other 1 easy project 2 tests fairly easy 1 final paper easy

Professor Ogletree is a great professor, with hilarious and inspiring lectures, who really cares about his students. There are some readings before each class, but they aren't bad at all. The tests you DO need to study for because there are some specific questions. I just wish there would've been more room for class discussion.

Professor Ogletree is a wonderful teacher. His lectures are entertaining, and he teaches Eternal Families based upon what has been said by the prophets and apostles. He doesn't go into what could be considered "Deep Doctrine," but rather stays to what is applicable here and now. His tests are honest, and his scoring fair.

He really cares about his students. the expectations of the course are clear and easy to meet, attendance is VERY important, and he's willing to talk with students about any concerns or extra questions about the material.
Dr. Ogletree is the man. The only info you need to know is all the athletes take his class. You know what that means. Tests are all online, readings are enjoyable.

Bro Ogletree's class is super engaging and fun. I learned a lot of neat facts about the leaders of the Church that I didn't know before. There is really not a lot of work for this class and if you just show up and pay attention you'll do well on the tests.

Doctor Ogletree's way of grading and giving assignments is simple and easy to follow, which helps the focus be more concentrated on the gospel topics instead of worrying so much about points or passing the class.

Professor Ogletree is an awesome guy with interesting lectures. You can tell he really cares about his students and what he is teaching about. Go to class and take the open book quizzes and you'll do fine on tests.

He is a good lecturer and has a lot of good insights. I like his sense of humor which he shares in class. The tests are very specific, asking for specific quotes and items he mentions a few times in class. Attendance quizzes every day. A lot of reading required. Overall good class and interesting although tests were way too hard.

Dr. Ogletree is one of the best religion teachers I've ever had. You know that he's passionate about the gospel and loves the Lord. His lectures are always intriguing and I never get bored. If you review the study guides, you should get an A on the tests, not a difficult class. Seriously, amazing teacher.

He is a great teacher and you can tell how passionate he is about what he is teaching. He is engaging and has great insight into the apostles' and prophets' lives. I enjoyed the class but the tests can be pretty difficult if you don't study. If you use the study guide and memorize everything on it, you will do fine.
Great teacher and really loves the subject. Definitely worthwhile.

I really like Prof Ogletree and the content and insights that he brings to the class! The only thing that I did not like during this semester was the fact that if you miss more than 3 classes in the semester, then you can't get an A in the class. And he doesn't offer class offer zoom... even while in a pandemic.

Dr. Ogletree seems to genuinely care. His classes are interesting and he tries hard to make the lectures to include things that people may not know. He gives study guides for his tests, and although the tests are long, they are pretty straightforward and all in the study guide. Not too hard to get an A.
He's incredible. I love every class and really enjoy how interactive he is! Such an easy class and very cool learning about different apostles!

Professor Ogletree is a wonderful professor. His lectures were always very informative and a lot of fun. The lectures had all the answers to the study guides that fell in line with tests, so use them to study. Show up to class to pass every attendance quizzes (very easy). There is a readings packet, use it for the before class quizzes.

The class is mostly just him lecturing, not much room for discussion. You'll learn a lot about apostles, but it's not a very engaging format. You can learn everything from the powerpoints on Learning Suite, but about halfway through the semester, he started giving us keywords in class for attendance quizzes. This class doesn't require much effort.
Dr. Ogletree was a phenomenal professor! His Living Prophets class was both enlightening and inspiring; he truly cares about his students and will be super flexible in helping you get an A!

Dr Ogletree is a wonderful professor. His lectures are entertaining and I learned a lot. This was by far my favorite religion class. The tests are easy if you pay attention in class and he is very understanding of the needs of students.
Dr. Ogletree is an amazing professor and really loves the gospel and is passionate about what he teaches. I would 100% recommend taking Living Prophets from him if you get a chance!

Professor Ogletree is the most genuinely kind and caring people I have ever met. He strives to get to know each student, he is very forgiving as far as grading goes and you always feel his love. He is a staunch defender of the truth and makes sure we know that. He helps everyone get an A. You just need to show up, read, and take a couple tests.
Come to class and it will be an easy A and youll learn a lot
Awesome professor. Easy A. Really love WaterDog. Really accommodating.

Professor Ogletree is a super nice guy and will help you- but not the best teacher. He is a therapist by profession, so it makes sense why his classes were mostly him just lecturing at us off the powerpoint. Little room for discussion which didn't lead to a lot of spiritual experiences for me. But I did learn a lot about the prophets and apostles.

You can always tell the class is going to be easy/accommodating when theres a bunch of student athletes enrolled. Dr. Ogle tree is hilarious. Very passionate and even invites us all to his thanksgiving turkey bowl. I wish I could have given his class more time because he really cares. Take if you want a chill class from an absolute sweetheart.

Dr. Ogletree is the best. I love how he stands up for the prophets and helps things make sense. Hes very passionate and has a firm testimony. I love being in this class and how it strengthens my testimony every day. 10/10 would recommend.

Dr. Ogletree is the most caring professor I've met at BYU. He wants you to succeed in his class and does everything in his power to help you do so. His class is really easy but also super interesting so it makes you want to go. There are attendance quizzes but if you go to class he gives you the answers. Test are easy as long as you study:)

If you want a religion class where you feel welcomed and loved, do NOT take anything from Ogletree. There is no room for discussion in his classroom, and his narrow point of view is absolute truth. His tests are ridiculously difficult and he requires you to buy an expensive book that just consists of talks you can find online. Don't take his class.

Professor Ogletree is a great professor if you are looking for a traditional by the doctrine religion class. Personally I think his application of certain things can be heavy-handed and old fashioned. If you think this would bother you I do not recommend his class. The workload is pretty light with the exception of a 5-page paper at the end.

Doc O is my FAVORITE teacher I've had at BYU so far. He is so funny and makes the lectures fun to go to. I genuinely look forward to his classes every week. As long as you do the study guides, you'll be set! He's also super great to work with you if you ever need any help. Super understanding and flexible.

Dr. Ogletree was great! This was probably my favorite religion class that I have taken at BYU so far. There are attendance quizzes during every lecture, and quizzes associated with the required readings. Tests are lengthy, but strictly memorization from lectures. There are thorough study guides that will help with studying. Overall great class!

Lots of homework, but super easy and not really time consuming. His lectures are really interesting and he is a funny guy. Really genuine and wants all of his students to get an A. I enjoyed this class a lot and would recommend him to anyone!

He was a pretty easy professor. Just study the study guides and the quotes in the powerpoints and you'll be okay. He answers emails and texts super fast and is really clear on what he wants on his assignments. He does have attendance quizzes so you have to go to class. His class was an easy A if you kept up with it.

Decent orator, poor teacher. Doesn't facilitate or even seem to want discussion most of the time. He's pretty funny at times, but in a sardonic way. Easy class to blow through if you can follow instructions and use control-F, hard class to have a spiritual experience in. Kind of sad because he's a really nice guy, but the course is designed poorly.

if you take professor Ogletree's eternal families class, you're gonna learn a lot of stuff. he lectures well and the class is generally interesting. his tests just straight up suck though. They're all multiple choice, which I usually love, but they are poorly written and so arbitrary. The final had a question about the size of a woman's kidney. rip

I really loved this class! Brother Ogletree is very nice and laid back, his class was easier than my friends had it when they took it from other professors. He answers questions and texts and emails pretty quickly. This is the first class that I actually talked to the professor and not the TA. Easy quizzes and the test is exactly the study guide.

Dr. O is an amazing professor. I loved taking Eternal Family from him. His lectures were engaging and interesting, which was good because I took it during spring term on zoom. The readings were enjoyable and really got me thinking about the importance of the family. Great class.

He's overall just a great dude. Solid testimony of the gospel and really cares and loves his students. He will literally do anything to help you get an A in his class and extremely organized. I loved this class and it was a great experience to learn from someone who cares so much about eternal families.

At times Ogletree might make you a bit uncomfortable, as he is pretty stubborn in his views, but he does an excellent job of teaching concepts. You shouldn't be afraid to be honest with him. He adds interesting stories and is good at interacting with the class.

Overall this is a great class and the content is very interesting. Great lectures and stories. The only thing is that tests are very hard, it is all about memorizing quotes from the prophets. For me, that was not the best way to learn the content and I felt that I was just learning for the moment.

Awesome professor; he genuinely cares for his students, and I personally have seen students approach him outside of class and seek help for things having nothing to do with class itself. Nice guy and his class reflects it. He aims to help his students through his lectures. Which are pretty funny too.
Professor Ogletree was a great professor, but his class was very test heavy which was hard. Had a lot of good material and learned a lot from this class.

Prof Ogletree is awesome! He doesn't make the class harder than it should be like most religion professors. It's an easy A. He's Super clear. Super organized. Very fun and engaging during lectures. He's a funny guy and makes eternal families actually entertaining and informative. Very insightful and I would totally recommend this class to everyone!

If you want an A in this class, you will get it. I've known people who've had a boring time in this class, but with how easy Ogletree's was in addition to the frequent and excited stories which pepper the class, I found the class entertaining.

He is the best! I honestly looked forward to his lectures and always got a lot out of them. He explains his expectations for the course, grading criteria, and due dates really well. It's important to be in class every lecture to do well on the tests, and he really wants everyone to succeed and take something from the course. Definitely recommend!!
The class was very well organized and expectations were clear. He has everything set up for success and if you follow along you'll do really well. The lectures were also very entertaining.
Professor Ogletree was the bomb! Hilarious guy and amazing lectures. Tests weren't too hard if you pay attention in class. Recommended for everyone taking Eternal Family!

He is the best! So nice and understanding. Will help you with anything you missed or need to know. He tries to help by giving some answers to tests so it's not as hard. He's super entertaining and kind. Best teacher!

Professor Ogletree was an amazing professor! This was my first semester taking college courses, and he made everything very clear. He goes over the schedule each day and brings up upcoming quizzes or tests. Not only does he bring these things up, but he is clear as to what he is expecting from the students.
Dr. Ogletree is one of the best religion teachers at BYU. His lectures are inspirational, uplifting, and very spiritual. If you keep up with the study guides, this class is easy. I loved this class!

Ogletree does a great job teaching this class. If you put in the work you'll do just fine. There's weekly quizzes on the textbook that's open book, and 4 big exams. But there's easy points thrown in too like attendance quizzes that Professor Ogletree literally gives you the answers for and extra credit.
This professor is great. It feels like alot of busy work, but he gives exceptional lectures and the material is great. I recommend taking classes from him.
Brother Ogletree is a wonderful professor and has a lot of funny and inspirational stories. He is very passionate and knowledgeable about the family. I highly suggest you take his class if you can.

Professor Ogletree is a pretty funny guy and makes the class interesting by sharing many stories. There is a reasonable amount of outside work for the class. My only complaints about this course are that the tests are quite specific, and I felt like I was just trying to fill out study guides the entire class instead of really absorbing the content.

I enjoyed his class and would take it again. You just have to know the material for the tests, but it isn't anything too difficult and most assignments were some form of multiple choice so he can't really grade you harshly.
Really good professor. Would definitely take his class again. It was the right amount of work for a two credit class.
Really great class, entertaining lectures. Lots of reading.

The homework is a ton of reading from conference talks and BYU Speeches. There is a 10 question quiz on the reading and the questions are super detailed. None of the material from the readings is on the exams. Once you're done with the quiz you can safely let that information fall into the deep storage part of your brain.

Brother Ogletree is super understanding, respectful, and helpful to students. The Eternal Families class is not difficult, but you need to attend class to get the attendance points. For tests, if you pay attention in class and put in some studying, you can get good grades.
Great Professor! Passionate about the topic, and he makes the content super enjoyable.

I liked the class!! He is a good professor, entertaining lecturer, and I feel like this is one of the most applicable religion classes I've taken at BYU. I think I'll take another class from him in the future, and I would recommend this class for Eternal families. Not a ton of work, the only downside was we were tested on some pretty specific info

This class was a joke. All we really did was learn superficial information about prophets and apostles. Nothing really substantive was ever discussed, and the only class discussions were us answering the most simple questions. This class was honestly a waste of time and I was disappointed to have taken a class like this from a professor like him.

Lights out amazing!! Take this class with him!! Ao kind and wants you to succeed!! quizzes before every lecture, but are open book. Only 4 exams with study guides. He is so funny and the Spirit is always there.
Has strong views but is very upfront from the begging what he believes.
He is awesome! Great insights on the importance of the family. Inspiring lectures.

Love Dr. Ogletree. REL C 200 is mostly reading conference talks with him, and he'll help you out with anything. Tests are a little difficult, they're various quotes and statistics that he tends to fly through during class. But he has study guides for the exam material on every lecture that you can fill out during class.

Professor Ogletree is passionate about his subject and has lots of experience working as a marriage and family counselor, which gives valuable insights which he gives sometimes in lessons. He's entertaining but teaches what matters. There's a focus on Family Proclamation values and teachings of prophets, mixed with studies and research.
I enjoyed the class a lot and he was a very fair and kind teacher. If you need a religion credit I recommend the class.

Dr. Ogletree's class was always so enjoyable! He never failed to make me smile or laugh. The grade I got in this class was my lowest grade, just because the tests were so specific. However, I feel that all religion classes at BYU are the hardest classes. Dr. Ogletree was ALWAYS willing to work with me and was VERY quick to respond every time!!

This class was amazing! Professor Ogletree is very passionate about the family and it makes the learning in class fun and engaging. Shares stories about the topic that help us get a better understanding of principles of the family.
He is great!

I really liked Dr. Ogletree's class. Because it was Eternal Families, there was a lot of opinion and stereotyping, but if you can get past that, this is a great class for you. If you have a problem or something was wrong with the test, you can totally shoot him an email or meet with him and he will be soo understanding. Use the study guides.

Professor Ogletree is a great guy. There is a quiz due before every lecture based upon the readings and an attendance quiz for every class period, but they are super easy. He makes his lectures very entertaining and is very clear on what you need to know for tests and the attendance quiz. Overall great class.

I honestly wouldn't take this class again because I feel that there was no room for any concerns or criticisms within the topic. Professor Ogletree didn't allow for anyone to say anything negative against the Church, which didn't really affect my grade or the class, it just didn't allow for me to be able to discuss my thoughts in an intelligent way

Very interesting class, he has great lecture material that I was always intrigued about. He's a pleasure to listen to and interact with. No pressure, just the right amount of work to be meaningful.
