I would highly recommend this. Had to let a few assignments slide, like in most classes, due to heavy overall load. so didn't get an A but that's ok

Brother Ogletree is a pretty solid professor. He's very caring, has humorous yet spiritual lectures, and stands by the doctrine. His tests aren't my fav, sometimes the correct choice isn't always clear even when you've studied for the test. The readings are also a little extensive, but very relevant. I enjoyed his lectures a lot though!

A lot of the worries I had about marriage and family were addressed through his class, and there were a few times in lecture I felt like he was talking directly to me! Tests are really specific (exact quotes, statistics) and it's hard to know what will be on the them bc there's a LOT of that information. Overall rly enjoyed this class though!

I absolutely loved this class and professor! I loved going to lectures because it was always a fun environment and I felt like I was actually learning something. He gives you detailed study guides for all quizzes and exams that are super helpful. Other than tests, theres just an easy project and essay. Overall, easy A and enjoyable class.
The class is really interesting but some tests are pretty specific. He is very willing to help you out if you need it! He is a reasonable guy.

Like someone else said on here his tests were weird. 100 questions about obscure marriage statistics, or what general authority taught this, or what did so and so teach about x,y,z. Looking at the grade distribution I'm sure people had to be cheating on his tests in order to get the grades they got.
Bro. Ogletree is the man! I thoroughly enjoyed his class. His lessons were always super spiritual and relatable to what's going on in the world. One of my favorite classes so far here at BYU

Dr. Ogletree really is passionate and knowledgeable about this subject and it shows. I always enjoyed going to his lectures and listening to his funny stories and I think that the stuff we learned is very, very applicable to family life, relationships, and marriage. If you're present and attentive, you won't have to worry about grades.
He's a loving professor who cares about what he teaches and who he teaches. Get ready for the best religion class ever.

Dr. Ogletree did a lot to engage the class and turn the lectures into discussions. He was always available and gave us both his email and his phone number so that we could contact him with questions whenever needed. Dr. Ogletree is very personable and wanted each of us to succeed.

Dr. O is a cool and funny guy who told uplifting stories about his family. I felt like his tests were unnecessarily specific and had more than one arguably right answer. It seemed hit-and-miss whether or not he would actually teach test questions in class. I found some quizlets that were really useful, but was still disappointed to end with a B.

Professor Ogletree is an extremely nice teacher and tries his hardest to help students pass. There are readings every class day but they are not too long and all of the content needed is located in the powerpoints. With dedication, this class will not prove difficult.

I took his Eternal Families class. His lectures are fine but not as intellectually engaging as some other professors. He is kind and has a good personality. I really gained a lot from the attributes project he assigned.
Dr. Ogletree struck a good balance between high expectations and high love. I enjoyed this class because I knew that he wanted his students to enjoy learning and succeed.

I really love professor Ogletree and the way he set up this class. As far as course work goes throughout the semester, his class is not difficult although he does have attendance quizzes. The tests seemed unnecessarily difficult and specific and there was an abundance of quizzes in general which is kind of lame but I loved his lectures!

this class was so awesome and honestly a breath of fresh air. brother ogletree is such a sweet man and cares about your success in the class. i honestly learned alot more than i thought i would in this course and its been one of the only religion classes that ive really enjoyed so far. highly recommend!!
Professor Ogletree is probably one of my favorite religion professors, he definitely isn't an old tree that just reads doctrine and verses but he really engages his students.
Highly reccomend
Great class! Tests are a majority of the grade and overall pretty easy if you pay attention and fill out the study guides.

This was a very easy class, but a good one. Professor Ogletree is a great guy and very nice. He loves what he is teaching. The tests are 100 questions with a 60 minute time limit, so that's a little intense, but you can easily manage that. Not homework intensive.
Dr. Ogletree is an excellent professor. He is always extremely clear with what you need to do to easily get an A. And his lectures are pure gold!

Professor Ogletree recognizes that religion classes should be to strengthen our testimonies and learn more about the gospel. He is clear about his grading criteria. If you complete the assignments and do the study guides, you'll get an A. He also really cares about each student and is always willing to meet. You can tell he loves what he teaches.
Really love Brother O. Pretty straightforward and not a ton of busy work. I have taken multiple classes from him and recommend him to my friends

I loved this class and Prof. Ogletree so much! He gave amazing lectures that were super interesting and he made the class really fun! As long as you do the reading and complete the study guides, the class is relatively easy and there isn't a ton of work!

Professor Ogletree tells it how it is. He does not sugar coat anything. He is also a marriage therapist, which does give him a lot of applicable experience in teaching the Eternal Families Class. If you're sensitive towards some of the Church's views on family and marriage, it might not be the class for you.
Great teacher and as long as you go to class, you will get a good grade.

This class is so-so. It's super easy is the upside. The downside was some of the topics were outdated and potentially offensive. I can imagine students being uncomfortable in the class. I just laughed it off. Still super easy though.

His class was easy which is why I believe so many like his class. If you are just in it for the easy a then this is your class. However, I found him to be very hypocritical in the way he taught the importance of being humble to what the prophets say, but he was never open to any suggestions. He is anti-mask which goes against BYU and the church.

I really liked taking this class from Professor Ogltree. He was always very happy and welcoming towards everyone in the class. I always looked forward to attending class and left feeling spiritually enhanced each time. If you pay attention you will be fine!

Dr. Ogletree is a great professor, His lectures are always fun and you learn a bit from them. The only complaint that I have is on the tests. The tests are a huge game of memorization, Memorization of quotes isn't my strongest skillset so I struggled a little, However he provides good study sheets for the tests. Loved the class.

He is a really good professor. You have readings each week that and then you take a quiz on it but it is open book/note. You have an attendance quiz each class but he gives you the answers if you go to class. He is very knowledgeable about the prophets and has cool insights. Overall a really good class.

Dr. Ogletree has a strong personality. If you want someone that will tell you what you want to hear, you won't get it from him. He stands up for the truth and teaches from the words of the prophets. Every class was uplifting and he provides the resources needed to succeed. I highly enjoyed his class and the work load was appropriate.

Professor has everything you will ever need for his class in the form of readings, content/slides, and links. You will need to put in some extra time to study for his class if you want to do well on the exams. But overall Eternal Families was a very pleasant experience for me, and I think Professor Ogletree does an outstanding job.

Professor Ogletree was a great professor--his classes felt more like a devotional than a lecture and tests had study guides. Felt like I got to know the general authorities a lot better! There is a lot of reading, but it's mostly talks and reading quizzes are open-book so I would just listen to them and then have the talks open when I took the quiz

Brother Ogletree's class was one of my absolute favorites! You can tell that he loves what he teaches. He teaches clearly and shares lots of fun facts about the prophets and apostles! Wonderful professor!

This is my 5th religion class at BYU, and it is the best one I've ever taken. I would 100% recommend this class, and I thought Brother Ogletree did a really good job teaching it. He is an engaging teacher and a kind man. The class is not too hard. There is a lot of material to study for the tests, but if you do the study guides you'll pass easy.

Dr. Ogletree is amazing! I took the eternal families class from him, which was amazing, so I decided to take him again. He is caring, funny, entertaining, and gives students plenty of opportunities to succeed. There are extra credit opportunities and he's very reasonable. You do have to study a tiny bit for tests and there is reading, but an easy A
Gret teacher, I enjoyed class. The only thing I didn't like was his tests, just expect to memorize a lot of marginally facts to get a good grade.
Great Professor! My favorite religion prof. that I have had at BYU
Ogletree is very passionate about what he does and he cares about the growth of his students. Only thing is that his tests are very specific and ask random facts. So just take notes!

I really enjoyed this class with Professor Ogletree. I LOVE the content, and he taught in a very engaging way. I learned some much from this class and I would recommend everyone to take it with Professor Ogletree. He is chill with grading and the quizzes are all open book.

Professor Ogletree is very clear about what is expected in his course and how you will be graded. However, he is willing to work with you. If you do the quizzes, attend class, and study the study guides, you will be set. Ogletree offers an awesome perspective on the family from both a spiritual and professional standpoint. Highly recommend!
I really enjoyed the class and the content we convered. Professor Olgetree is a great guy and you can tell he truly wants the best for his students.

Brother Ogletree is pretty great. Super easy grader, willing to work on you with your grade if you reach out to him. Class is a super easy A if you study for the tests, which are basically just memorization tests of the study guide. Good time in here!

Dr. Ogletree is a great professor. I loved his passionate commitment to supporting and defending the prophets. I loved my project, I learned so much about President Nelson (you choose your own project). This class is pretty assignment heavy for a religion course but they are pretty easy/straightforward and it is not difficult to get an A

I absolutely loved Dr. Ogletree's class. He teaches in a manner that makes learning fun, tells stories, and is passionate about teaching. He truly cares about each student. At the very beginning of the semester he let us know that if we have any accommodations to let him know and was very good about that. As long as you participate, it's an easy A

Brother Ogletree is probably my favorite religion professor at BYU. He's the big 3: funny, spiritual, and easy. The attendance quizzes and the reading quizzes are easy 100%'s. The tests can be a little tricky, but you just gotta study for a few hours before and you should be fine. As long as you try somewhat and don't skip class, it's an easy A.

Professor Ogletree is amazing and I would recommend him to anyone! He is funny, a great teacher, and shares both funny and inspiring stories. He teaches the gospel in a very straightforward & respectful way. He doesn't beat around the bush and teaches the doctrine as it is! His class requires effort but he wants you to be successful and helps you!
He is the best!
He rocks!!!

Brother Ogletree is clearly passionate about the gospel. He throws a lot of details in his lectures that sometimes don't always seem necessary but, hey, now we know a bunch of stuff about the apostles! Some of the readings are a little long but they're all conference talks that are good to read anyway!

Dr. Ogletree was a really great professor! His lectures were always interesting and he tells a lot of fun stories. I really liked the content of this class too. The homework in this class is really easy and although not all of the test questions are on the study guide, it's still easy to get an A on the tests.

Prof. Ogletree was an incredible teacher for eternal families. I specifically sought him out as my professor after hearing both how good he was as a teacher, how funny, caring, and relatable he was, and that the class wasn't too hard to do well in so long as you were prepared to read his big ol' packet of talks and sources. He lived up to it all!

I have absolutely loved this class. I have learned so much, and walked away with a good grade, and a good experience. Dr. Ogletree genuinely cares about his students, and always lets you know that if you have any questions about relationships or marriage to contact him. He is also so easy to work with, and always gets back to you. 10/10 experience!

Professor Ogletree is one of my favorite religion professors of all time. He made me laugh every class while still keeping things spiritual and enriching. He has 3 tests which are based off of the exam study guides that you should fill out during lectures. There is one small project and one easy 5-page paper. He and the class were awesome!

TONS of reading to be done. Professor Ogletree is a great professor, lectures can get pretty boring but do contain some interesting info sometimes. I wish his tests would have been more on how the prophets have influenced our lives, instead of asking who is wife is and where he went to college. Tests were decently hard but doable.

He was a great professor and made the material easy to understand. You take quizzes twice weekly with no time limit and it is open book and attendance quizzes are due at the end of the day every time you have class. If you take this class with a couple friends it is an absolute cake walk.
Pretty easy class and I learned so much! Make sure to fill out the study guides because they are so helpful for the exams.

Professor Ogletree knows a lot and cared about what hes teaching, but I really did not like his class. He made so many offensive remarks and I did not feel respected or welcome there, so I chose to go all online. My mom was listening to one of the online lectures and was very offended by what she heard, especially coming from a professor.

Professor Ogletree is the absolute best!! His lectures are super interesting, and I learned so much. There are attendance quizzes, but they're super easy. 10/10 would recommend that you take any class he offers.

Bro. Ogletree is super entertaining to listen to and I really enjoyed his lectures and the homework was super easy as well but his tests were super hard. They were like 50 questions and purely quote memorization and things that he has said in class. I loved the class but I heard other professors were easier so I would take it from someone else.
He has attendance quizzes every day, but he makes sure that you receive all of the answers for it before you leave. His study guides are also super helpful for the tests!

I took his Eternal Family class, and I really liked it. He uses a lot of conference talks and was very Gospel focused. I didn't use the textbook (a book compiling a bunch of talks), but instead found the readings on the internet to prepare for class. He cares about his students and wants to help them. Very approachable.

This professor is my favorite professor! He does his classes so well, presents the facts in a realistic & caring way. He knows the importance of eternal families & wants to teach to the best of his ability. Everything he teaches either does or will apply to each one of his students, whether they get married or not. Fills everything with hope & love

WARNING: the tests for this class are hard. You will have to memorize a lot of random quotes word for word and who said them if you want to do well on the tests honestly. Beyond that, Professor Ogletree is amazing. I have tried to take as many religion classes from him as I can. He is so kind, christlike and caring. Lectures were engaging as well.

Professor Ogletree is probably the best professor I've had at BYU so far. He understands that his class is a general class that everyone has to take so he doesn't expect his students to spend all of their spare time on his class. 3 midterms and a final. He has exam study guides you can fill out. Class is super easy going. Take him!

Professor Ogletree is great. I loved his class and to be honest i'm going to miss it. It's not as tough as other BYU religion classes and he is very good at helping you out with your grade. Would recommend!

Professor ogletree is an amazing professor. His class really helps you feel the spirit and learn more about eternal families. I do not believe that religion classes should require tons of work. professor ogletree helps you understand the principles you need to know while making sure you never have busy work. amazing professor.

Professor Ogletree is amazing! I love attending his lectures and feel like my testimony was really strengthened. And his class is pretty easy so that's a plus. There's kind of a textbook for readings, but you can find most of the readings online if you really don't want to buy it.

Great professor - very thorough lectures and great information...I found this class to be extremely helpful for my own personal life. Very passionate about the material and enjoys being with us in class. I wish we did have more discussion though, it's mostly him talking the whole time.

Dr. Ogletree is a great professor. Lectures are fun and entertaining. The test questions are very specific and tests are long, but he does give you the tools to help you do well, it's just a lot of memorizing the study guides.

I really enjoyed this class! not only was it fun, but it was easy to be engaged. Professor Ogletree is on your team so he's understanding and willing to help if you need it. Study guides are everything. As long as you do those you'll do great.

Ogletree was a great professor. If you want to get a good grade in any of his classes just fill out the study guides, study them, and then get easy A's on any of his tests. His class is also very enjoyable.
I really enjoyed learning about the prophet and apostles of our day from Prof Ogletree. I wouldn't say it was hard or too time consuming. I learned a lot!

Professor Ogletree laid out the coursework clearly ahead of time. His lectures were great and I loved his stories. The class is not difficult as long as you do your work. I really appreciated that he would make himself available to students.

Brother Ogletree is a good religion professor, not one that is running a show for lecture or one that is overly spiritual. He teaches doctrine and words of the prophets. a solid professor with a healthy amount of readings and homework. nothing to crazy.

I seriously loved taking living prophets from Brother Ogletree. I wish covid hadn't made me attend class through zoom because I feel like my experience would have been EVEN better if I had the chance to attend lecture in person. I learned a lot and just appreciated Brother Ogletree's love, respect and enthusiasm for Latter-day leaders!

Quizzes based on readings, and participation quizzes each week. The lecture is interesting, so it wasn't hard to make it to class! Only one paper and a project, pretty easy grading. Good class and I will be recommending to my friends!

Really loved his stories! Pretty easy A if you're willing to do the basics. Only thing is just his tests are really not great. Be ready to be tested on lots of random things that general authorities said, where each answer could be doctrinally right but what makes it right is the person who said it. Other than that, would definitely recommend.

He is the best. He cares about his students and the course work is realistic and easy to understand. He clearly cares about what he teaches and makes class fun. I did class over Zoom and never felt behind or like an assignment didn't make sense. Course is organized well and the textbook is just a compilation of talks from church leaders.
Really enjoyed this class. Very uplifting content. Learning about the apostles and prophets is a great time! Not a super hard class.

I loved Professor Ogletree! One of my favorite professors at BYU. If you want to feel more prepared for marriage, you got to take this class from Professor Ogletree. As far as the class goes, quizzes are super easy, projects are self graded, the paper is simple, and the tests can be a bit difficult but if you study hard you can get an easy A.
Professor Ogletree is great. He cares about his students and is always available for office hours. The class is very inspirational, but not challenging.
Good professor. He knows his stuff. The readings packet is online so DON'T buy it. There is a quiz before every class, but its pretty easy. Would recommend.
Amazing professor. Class was super easy with minimal work required!

Professor Ogletree's class is great because the work load during the week is manageable. I would say that if you attend class and work with the professor this class a a pretty easy A. The tests are extensive, but professor Ogletree provides the necessary material to succeed. I always felt uplifted by his class, and would definitely take it again!

Professor Ogletree was great in the delivery of his coursework. He helped when you needed it and was easy to reach with quick and helpful responses. I felt like I was able to learn in his class while still not having an unmanageable amount of work on top of the class.
Brother Ogletree has great lectures and the tests are easy if you use the study guides.
Fun guy. A quiz before each class, a small quiz in each class, a big project, a few tests, and a paper. Not as bad as you think.
Professor Ogletree's class was good and relatively easy. The exams ask very specific questions about the study guides which you will need to fill out to do well on the exams.
Great teacher.
Brother Ogletree is the best! His class is very well organized and he's always willing to work with you. The tests are multiple choice and you only have to write 1 paper.

You can tell Professor Ogletree is very passionate about what he teaches and he knows his stuff, but there were many insensitive remarks he made that left me feeling very uncomfortable being in class. You also have to really stay on top of readings and quizes and memorize lots of information for the tests, which I found to be pretty difficult.

He is a great professor and is kind! I just struggled with the fact that most of his classes are reading off a PowerPoint, that is not his fault though.. It's the nature of the class (learning facts about prophets). There is a lot of memorizing for his tests but it's not hard. Homework is really easy.

Professor Ogletree is my favorite professor so far at BYU. He is very knowledgable and passionate about the subjects he is teaching. He keeps the lectures interesting and engaging. The coursework is not hard you just have to stay on top of it and get it done. Overall, an easy class and I would recommend it.

I loved this class! Dr. Ogletree is a great professor and I really appreciate his take on this topic. His stories are great and the lectures are always fun. The tests are a little difficult, but you'll do well as long as you review the materials and fill out the study guides.

Dr. Ogletree is a great guy and a good teacher. Compared to the other professors that I've had for religion classes, the work has been light and less annoying, which is appreciated in a religion class, which are notorious for being pedantic. However, I would say that the workload is still a little too high to focus on the amazing spiritual lessons.

I love Dr. Ogletree! I was struggling in the course, and he was willing to talk things out with me to help me raise my grade. He is the BEST! The Eternal Families class was so much fun! 10/10 would take again!
I really enjoyed this class and the information covered was very relevant to a college student's life right now. Professor Ogletree was super laid back and really easy to work with.

Dr. Ogletree is THE MAN!! Sure the exams are hefty and there are quite a few projects but he will always work with you to get the grade you deserve. I always felt like he was a homie while also being an awesome prof! The lectures were always interesting and exciting! You won't regret taking his class!

He's an awesome professor, super fun to listen to and has great insights as to how to apply the principles learned in class. The assignments and reading are all pretty easy. I feel like its easy to the point of not getting as much out of the class as possible, but its still great. Strongly recommend!

Ogletree is a great professor. I took Eternal families from him, and he did a great job with it. The class is hard to teach due to the controversial nature of the topics, but he is great at being upfront with his stance and stays close to the churches stance. Tests arent bad, grading is fair. For a religion class, its not bad at all.

Brother Ogletree is such a great professor!! His classes were always entertaining, spiritual and funny. You have reading and quizzes due before each class. 1 project, 1 paper, 3 midterms and 1 final. Really liked his class!

Great Professor, if you are will to do a little studying and go over lecture notes, you will do great. He has lots of ways for you to do well if you listen to him about where to find study guides, etc.

Professor Ogletree has organized an awesome Eternal Family class! It is very interesting and applicable to life. Professor Ogletree is very willing to help you to get the grade that you want. If you want an A and are willing to put forth some effort, you shall have success. This class is one of my favorite classes I have taken at BYU.

Prof. Ogletree is one of the profs that makes you work for it. If you're looking for an easy A religion class he is not your man, but his Eternal Families course was honestly so inspiring and helpful that I'd refer anyone in a serious relationship, or recently married, to take it even if the workload is a little heavier than other religion classes

Great Professor! I really enjoyed the class, it was relatively easy. The tests were very specific however so you do need to study for those. He knows what he is talking about and keeps the class focused on the family proclamation to the world.

I liked this class. I actually really enjoyed the lectures my biggest complaint was the tests. They were the kind of tests that you memorize a bunch of random stuff you will probably never use again and there were 4 of them. I would rather have written another paper. It would have deepened my learning more.

His lectures are the best! You can really see all of the time and effort he put into making his slides. I liked that the exams were open for the whole term. I went in early and took all of them at the beginning and didn't have much homework after that. There is an essay, but it's not difficult. Fun lectures, passionate professor.
Great class material, great professor. He's very clear about all assignments. As long as you fill out the study guides he's provided, the tests are a breeze as well. Incredible man!

Professor Ogletree was an awesome religion professor, he had really great lectures and as long as you listen to his lectures and stay caught up on quizzes then you'll be fine in the class. He's really earnest and cares about his students, and I really loved his class!

Great guy! Knows his stuff! I was engaged going into this class but his lectures made me realize I was with the wrong person. I am eternally grateful for that. Only thing is that he is a little insensitive when it comes to certain topics. Other than that I really enjoyed the class!

Professor Ogletree has been my favorite professor at BYU. He is very understanding and is willing to work with you. He lectures are fun an interesting! He has a clear grading criteria and helpful study guides for the quizzes and exams. Overall a great guy and teacher!

Brother Ogletree is AWESOME! Definitely one of my favorite religion professors by far! You can tell that he is really passionate about what he is teaching! Plus he doesn't make you memorize a bunch of useless dates and events. I really enjoyed this class being able to come and learn about the apostles and prophets! I wish we had more time in class!

I learned so many cool things about the apostles in this class. Ogletree is a very likeable professor who you can tell cares for his students. There is a quiz due before class, an attendance quiz during class, a couple midterms and a final, a semester-long project and a paper at the end. Very doable and fun class.

I loved learning from Professor Ogletree! He is very passionate about the subject material and I came away from his lectures uplifted daily. Three midterms and a final exam based on his study guides. Fill the study guides out as you read or listen to the readings for each class. One personal improvement project and one paper. An inspiring class!

Professor Ogletree is amazing and I love the lectures that he gave during class. He is an awesome guy with cool stories to share. He also makes assignments easy to pass. I highly recommend this class for anyone who still needs to take a religion credit!

I had high expectations that this class would be good, but I was disappointed how we are asked to regurgitate trivial facts about the prophets and apostles. Much of class time was getting through the material in the PowerPoint and no class discussion. Also there are 4 exams, which seemed like a lot for a religion class.
He does a lot to make the classwork as easy as possible. He just wants you to pay attention during lectures and have fun in class. Fun to listen to and gives good, entertaining lectures.

I took Eternal Families from Professor Ogletree. He's a great guy but I didn't really connect with him. His lectures felt kind of average and he had a hard time getting people engaged (no pun intended). I learned the most from the readings we did outside of class.

The class is somewhat annoying. He doesn't use learning suite enough to make it really clear what's expected. Questions are picky and not learning-enhancing. Not a hard class, but not a well-designed class either. Small changes would make it much better, and it's not terrible, it's just meh.
Entertaining teacher! If you review and memorize the study guides every week the class will be a piece of cake!

The class we super good! Make sure you read and come to class. If you don't you will miss a lot. I kinda felt like the assignments were grouped at the end and making the last week of classes hard. Take really good notes! Like really good. The tests have some pretty specific questions. He does have review notes that you can fill out during class.

Great professor, great class. He has study guides that help but only cover 85% of what is on exams. This makes exams not too easy but also not too hard. His lectures were good as he told many interesting stories. He has quizzes weekly that help keep you accountable for attending class and doing the readings.
I loved Dr. O! His lectures were super beneficial to learn about before getting married and starting a family. The class is super easy. Just do the study guides, and you'll pass!

I loved Dr. Ogletree. He was so nice and has so many good stories and knows what hes talking about. Make sure you check learning suite for assignments coming up. This class was really fun learning about dating and marriage from an expert.

This is the second class Ive taken from him, and I dont regret it. We had readings, a quiz due before class, and a attendance quiz for each class session. The exams are online, closed book and notes, and timed. He gives study guides with the answers, so if you fill them up in class, you have the answers. He is very loving, funny, and profesional.

Dr. Ogletree is a super good choice for The Eternal Family! He shares stories that are really educational as well as inspiring. He keeps the class fun by making jokes and doesn't assign too much. The tests are the hardest part of the class because you have to memorize exact words from quotes, this is why he got a 4 and not a 5.
A great teacher doesn't assign too much Hw and keeps the class simple and spiritual

Brother Ogletree is so awesome! He keeps you involved in lectures and is very inspirational. Every lecture is full of inspiring material. There is something for everyone to learn and apply! The exam questions are taken almost word for word out of class slides. Make sure to start the experiential project early!
Great class! Dr. Ogletree is a great instructor with lots of great insights. You will learn so much if you participate.

Dr. Ogletree was a good professor. I didn't super love his lectures, but he got the material across; I wish I could have focused more on listening to him than filling out his exam study guides. His tests were a little much. The projects had potential to be good learning experiences but he didn't focus on them hardly at all.
Dr. Ogletree is great and super fair when it comes to grading and the assignments he gives out. As long as you apply yourself you should be fine.

Not a fan. Pretty easy class. A few tests & a final - all memorization. I didnt like him cuz although he's a family therapist, he spoke insensitively ab potentially triggering topics. He made it very clear he didn't care if u were offended. It was alarming cuz you'd think a therapist would be more considerate. This is just an apostle trivia class.

Dr. Ogletree is a great teacher! He's been teaching religion classes at BYU for years, and understands the stresses of a student. This class takes some time for the readings, but stay on top of it, and each lecture becomes enjoyable! The grading is clear, and honestly he grades fairly easily. I would take from him again!

Ogletree was great. His lectures are compelling, but he understands this is a religion class and doesn't need to be unnecessarily hard. He was straightforward with what he expected/wanted and I appreciated that.

Great class and great professor! The workload was super manageable. Tests are almost entirely based on lecture so don't miss (there's also attendance quizzes so go to class for those too). Each lecture has an associated study guide that you can just fill out during class. Study those and you'll be fine!

I've taken Dr. Ogletree's Eternal Families class in the past and really enjoyed it, so I took another class from him. He is a really kind teacher and definitely cares about his students. In Eternal Families, he was pretty hilarious and I always looked forward to class. Living Prophets is a bit drier and more content-heavy, with more work as well.
Ogletree is really good at bringing in the spirit! A really kind man, and much more worth it being there in person.
The tests can be tricky because it's all memorizing information, but if you do the study guides you'll do fine. Grading is very forgiving. Just make sure to due all the quizzes!

Dr. Ogletree is a really nice guy who knows his stuff about the prophets. His whole goal in this class is to increase your testimony of the living prophets and you can tell he cares a lot about that. He is super awesome! The class had attendance and reading quizzes, a 5-10 page paper (easy grading criteria), 3 exams and a final. It really isn't bad

Professor Ogletree is a good human being who knows a lot about the living prophets. It wasn't the usual amount of HW i was used to for a religion class. Usually most religion classes at BYU are ZERO work. Professor O assigned a ton of quizzes, a project, a paper, and lots of tests. They aren't hard, but it was more work than most rel classes.

If you're looking for a fun religion elective I suggest taking Living Prophets with Brother Ogletree especially compared to the other Living Prophets Professors i've heard about. Not a super hard class, you have an attendance quiz per class and then also a quiz on the lesson both are open notes. 3 exams plus final. a project and a paper.
Professor Ogletree is a great professor. He is an extrovert and is funny. Love his lectures. He is personable and great. Tests are not as hard as most religion classes.

Dr. Ogletree is an awesome professor and an even better person. He really knows his stuff when it comes to the living prophets and their lives. For one of the first times in my BYU experience I got what I wanted from a religion class - Spiritually uplifting, but not as much studying as my other 3 credit classes. I would recommend Dr. Ogletree!
He is a great person but you definitely have to be aware of upcoming assignments.
Ogletree's Eternal Families class was fairly easy. It is very obvious what you have to do to get an A. The only thing that bothered me was that he often teaches his opinion as law.

I felt like most of this class was prophet trivia. I was not really a fan. I found it difficult to be motivated to do the assignments/learn. Normally, I have enjoyed my religion classes quite a bit, but not nearly as much here. I'd recommend eternal families. I think Dr. Ogletree is a really nice guy and he cares a lot. You get out what you put in.

Bro O is an amazing professor!! I loved his class and totally recommend it. He provides study guides for both the quizzes and exams, and he is always willing to answer questions outside of class. Exams cover a lot of material, but if you use the study guides you can do pretty well on them. I would totally take another class from him!

Prof. Ogletree is one of the most understanding and accessible religion teachers I've had at BYU. He gives you clear directions on all assignments and the class and tests are super straight forward. Easy A.
If you go to lectures and do the readings you should be fine. Study guides are provided. The exams can be tricky due to a high amount of fact memorization. Professor Ogletree gives good lectures.

Professor Ogletree is great! Very doctrinal and inspiring. I wanted a low stress religion class that I could still enjoy and feel the spirit in and that's exactly what Professor Ogletree's class was like. Tests were easy. Solid class.

Professor Ogletree is so wonderful! He was so willing to give me some extra help when I needed it. The spirit is so strong in his class. Quizzes and tests are pretty easy if you do the readings. He does not want to trick you, he wants you to do well. He really cares about everyone!

I loved Dr. Ogletree's class!! He was fun, spiritual, and had great stories. I learned a lot from his class and never felt bored. There is not very much homework for this class but the tests at the end of the unit can be difficult. If you complete the study guides before and study them then it shouldn't be too hard.

I loved this class!! You can feel the love Prof Ogletree has for the living prophets. There is one project and one paper, but they are not to bad. If you keep up with the lectures and readings the tests are easy. There are provided study guides. There are daily attendance quizzes that he gives the answers to in class. 10/10 recommend.
Prof Ogletree is the best! You have reading and quizzes but all are easy and not too time consuming. Tests are straight from the study guides.

Professor Ogletree is the MAN! He really loves what he teaches and that rubs off on his students. His class is about learning and enjoying, not random difficult tests. My favorite religion professor so far!

Dr. Ogletree has some really fun lectures and some really spiritual lectures. His tests however have more statistics on them than any religion class should, as well questions that require you to memorize very specific details from quotes from Prophets/apostles.

Professor Ogletree is very passionate about the subjects he teaches. My only criticism is that tests were basically just memorizing a study guide, but that is generally how religion classes go I suppose. If you are seeking a great religion professor, I think that Professor Ogletree is a very solid choice.

This is a really easy class. He tests on really specific information, but gives a study guide. I didn't love this class because he often focused on really unnecessary information (apostles weight/infertility issues/a friend's inactivity) and made it clear that he was not going to approach the gospel with any open mindedness or inclusivity.
Great professor! Pretty easy and straightforward. The lectures about the prophets and apostles are interesting and the readings are awesome. There are 3 midterms.

Prof. Ogletree is a great religion proffessor. He brings the spirit and teaches truth. He does not stray from the gospel of Jesus Christ and the inspiring facts of the leaders of the church. I learned so much. The class was uplifting and not too hard as religion should be.

Dr. Ogletree is a nice guy but I feel like I didn't get a lot out of the class. The tests were purely based on memorizing quotes from the powerpoint. Overall, I feel like the class didn't push me to apply or understand much.

Dr. Ogletree is a great professor! He is a talented lecturer and fun to listen to and I enjoyed going to class. This class isn't very tough, although you do need to study for the tests because they are mostly memorization based. As long as you do the assignments and papers you'll do well.

Brother Ogletree is awesome! The class is really easy and very interesting. There are only a couple test, and they aren't difficult. You do one project (you grade yourself), and an easy paper! He knows so much about the leaders of the Church and he is funny too!

Dr. Ogletree is an awesome guy and a good professor. Really he is an awesome choice for the Eternal Families class. He gives really good lectures with funny stories. The coursework is pretty light so I wouldn't worry about that at all if that's what you're looking for in a religion class. My only complaint is the weirdly difficult tests

He is a very fair grader and believes that your religion class should not cause you stress. It's a pretty easy A if you fill out the exam study guides which he gives you up front. There is a lot of reading but it's all general conference talks so it's enjoyable. I liked lectures and how he cared about the class subject.

He's a kind person and a knowledgeable man, but his classes did not cultivate understanding and application. The study guides and tests demanded that you be able to regurgitate quotes verbatim, and the powerpoints and lectures were so packed with information that there was little room for inspiration. I felt more like a parrot than a student.
He was a really good professor! He knows his stuff, however he focuses quite a bit on statistics and specific things for tests. His classes are interesting though.

Dr. Ogletree is a great teacher for the Living Prophets course. You have a quiz before every class, a 2-question attendance quiz, and then 2 projects in addition to the 3 midterms and final. His tests are very fair and follow the study guide almost exactly.

Dr. Ogletree is a phenomenal teacher! His lectures are always entertaining and I love how dedicated he is to the Church. He cares about his students and the course is an easy A if you just do the assignments and come to class.

Prof. Ogletree is not a difficult professor, and he cares about his students. He loves teaching about the prophets and apostles, and I learned a lot of cool things that I didn't know about them! There are attendance quizzes for each class so you need to go, but the quizzes for each class are open book and don't take long at all. Great experience!

Ogletree is a very good professor! This religion class was one of my easiest A's. Reading quizzes before every lecture and attendance quizzes every day, but these things are really easy to accomplish.

Professor Ogletree is passionate about what he teaches. He also cares about his student's success. He gives specific study guides for the tests so as long as you do those and review the slides you can get an A. Weekly work is very manageable. There is a semester long project and a final paper. They are both rewarding and not too much work!

Professor Ogletree does a great job with this class. Every quiz and exam has a detailed study guide that refers you to specific places in the student manual where you can find the answers. His lectures are interesting, he has a lot of great stuff prepared on the prophets and apostles. Always very clear with his expectations for grading.

He is knowledgeable in the subject, but he does not teach in a style that helps you learn or retain anything from class. You have to memorize word for word quotes about who said what. The exams are questions about what the church leaders specifically said and you have multiple-choices that all mean the exact same thing. Call that teaching? I don't.

Loved Professor Ogletree's class. He faces the brethren which is important for us to learn how to do as well. Really interesting lectures. He has had some cool experiences being able to interact with the prophets and apostles that were really interesting to hear about in class lectures.

Professor Ogletree is a great teacher. He knows his stuff and he just wants to help you learn it too. The work load was very manageable. Readings happened every week but weren't super long. His projects aren't difficult as he provides great instructions and isn't a hard grader. His tests are moderately difficult so do be sure to study.
Dr. Ogletree focuses on a different apostle or member of the First Presidency each lesson. The exams are fair and he provides a thorough study guide for each one.

Dr. Ogletree has been teaching for awhile and you can tell that by how smooth he is in his lectures. You have to write a 5 page paper that he claims as long as you follow the rules you will get an A on. You also have to complete a semester-long project that's not bad if you keep up on it. Pretty solid choice for religion credit. Would take again!
Great class! You get out of it as much as you put in. You can get by doing very little, but it's super enriching when you involve yourself!

Dr. Ogletree is a great professor and friend. He has a lot of insightful, relatable experiences that he shares from his own family and upbringing. You can tell he wants you to succeed. Overall great class. Make sure you do the readings and study guides because the tests exactly cover that information. There are a lot of them!
This class was basically just random facts about the Apostles. He is nice, but I don't feel that two finals and a 5 page paper are ever necessary in a religion class.

Love Professor Ogletree! I always enjoyed class (never felt like a lecture). He has lots of great knowledge, personal experiences, and fun facts about the living prophets and apostles which made class so exciting! Open-reading quizzes and helpful exam study guides. He is a caring, funny, and inspirational teacher! Would absolutely recommend!

Professor Ogletree is a very intelligent and caring professor. His lectures are well organized and very informative. He bas a great way of laying out the doctrine in a very clear and easy way to understand. He also allows for a lot of participation and discussion. It is apparent that he cares about his students and is very passionate about teaching

I enjoyed Dr. Ogletree's class. You can tell he really cares about the students and wants them to succeed, and he gives all the resources you need to do well in the class. Readings were good, lectures were enjoyable. Fill out the study guide as you go through lectures-- those are crucial to the exams.

Really awesome insights to the current Apostle's lives and personalities. He was a little weird about trying to get people to participate (it would be hard over a hybrid/zoom class...) but other than that it was a really nice class. 2x/week quiz, 3 exams, and 2 pretty chill papers.
Great Professor! A lot of the lecture is going through PowerPoint slides. He really cares about students and wants you to get an A. There are extra credit opportunities as well which are helpful.

Dr. Ogletree is great! I am super picky with religion professors, and he is great. He believes that your religion class shouldn't be your hardest class, and does everything in his power for you to pass. There are readings and a quiz before class, and an "attendance quiz" you take during class. There are unit exams but the study guide prepares you.

Took during COVID- blended. Only went to class once bc his kid got COVID then just didn't want to go back lol. Nice guy. Kinda outdated lectures. Friend/I didn't like the way he talked about gender roles. Gave us the readings for free (can use web tho). Get papers done early. Att  imp. for study guide & att quizzes then can leave. Content  inspir

Dr. Ogletree is awesome! He is soooo funny so the lectures are all very entertaining. Also he loves to give you the answers for the test questions during class. He really wants you to succeed and not worry so much about your grade and more just about paying attention and learning what he is teaching. 10/10 would recommend.
I loved Dr. Ogletree's class. Great lectures and assignments were never too difficult. Be sure to re-read the power points from class and the exam study guides to study for exams.

This professor doesn't entirely focus on doctrine. He often brings in his own opinions rather than focusing on things that prophets and apostles have taught. In addition, there is a full study guide for each lecture, so he expects you know a lot for the exam and will test you on small things like statistics.

Bro Ogletree's class was really straightforward. It is not difficult to get a good grade in this class: the papers are graded very fairly and the study guides tell you what to know for the test. My one issue with the class is that there is so much material in the powerpoint presentations that you rarely go in depth on any one subject.

Professor Ogletree has a big heart. I didn't agree with everything he said, but he provided a very open learning environment and I respect him. His tests are very quote focused which is not really where he gives emphasis in class, but overall I really liked his class. I learned a ton from the readings.

Professor Ogletree is good professor; however, he has very strong opinions on a lot of things where I think you do not need to present your opinion so heavily. Overall he is a good professor and is very forgiving with grades.

Professor Ogletree is a great professor that has set up the class to be easy to follow along with. He knows a lot about the apostles and prophets and is excited to share his knowledge. The thing that would bother me during class was that he would often take a fact from their life and create a narrative story, almost teaching the story as a fact.
Dr Ogletree is amazing! I learned so much in his class. Only one paper, super easy. Watch the lectures and the tests will be pretty easy.
Great lectures. Prof is very knowledgable and passionate about the church. The readings were online in pdf which is so nice!

Great professor, the tests are easy if you fill out his study guide. If you don't, that's too bad, they are pretty specific and it can be pretty tough. Really kind guy, you really get to learn about our prophets!

Dr. Ogletree was an amazing professor. If you fill out his study guides for the tests you'll do fine. Participate and fill out the reading quizzes and show up and you'll get an A no sweat. Some don't like his personality, but I personally loved it and if you like to joke take his class.

Professor Ogletree's class was great! I loved going to class. He made each class enjoyable and engaging. The tests do take some studying to get a good grade but it's not excessive and you just have to put the time in. Aside from that, not difficult at all and a great class and teacher!

Dr. Ogletree is one of the best religion professors at BYU. He really cares about all of his students and the grades they receive in his class. His lectures are interesting and very relevant and useful. He is passionate about what he teaches and isn't afraid to defend his morals. I would recommend everyone to take a class from Dr. Ogletree!

Hopefully this review helps out. Dr. Ogletree is a great professor and the class is easy just always fill out the exam study guides during class. His presents his opinions in class as do many other professors out there, but he his 100% respectful. If you are opinionated and vocal then take the class from someone else.

I really Enjoyed Dr. Ogletree's class. He was hilarious and had great lectures. His exam/lecture notes were a pain because you spent all class trying to fill out the sheet instead of getting the most out of lecture. His tests were the worst. They took reviewing 10+ pages of the exam reveiws at least 3 times to get above a 90 on the tests.

The lectures were very enjoyable and informative. He has quite the treasure trove of stories about each of the apostles and I loved learning about them. Attendance quizzes: simple Reading quizzes: open-book and quick Tests: difficult but the study guides help you get an A. He is very to the point and it's clear what he wants. Was a pleasure.

Professor Ogletree is a wonderful professor! You can feel that he truly believes what he is teaching. He is very clear about what he expects and the class is not too difficult if you just attend and review the study guides before the tests. I learned a lot about the apostles and prophet in this class!

Professor Ogletree is a great teacher! I felt like I learned how to be a better person in his class. He was very light on homework, and his tests were pretty easy - just memorize a bunch of quotes. I thought his classes were engaging. I would totally take this class again!

Brother Ogletree was a blast; he's hilarious, a good teacher, I always looked forward to his class and I enjoyed every lecture we had. The homework just some readings, quizzes on those reading and one semester long project that wasn't hard at all. Definitely need to study for the tests though if you want to do well. There's a study guide though :)
Prof. Ogletree blurs the boundary between culture, opinion, and doctrine. He's a nice guy, but religion classes need to stick to the doctrine.

I loved Professor Ogletree! His experiences as a marriage & family therapist brought an interesting perspective to the class. He managed to be interesting and engaging over Zoom, which is very difficult. Just beware that midterms and exams are very difficult! You need to memorize the study guides to pass, but everything else in the class is easy.

Ogletree is adorable. Nice guy, and caring teacher, but he teaches his own opinions more than anything else. You have to remember his opinions (and biases) because you'll be tested on them later. He can be too blunt sometimes about sensitive, controversial subjects. The class is based entirely on memorizing quotes from general authorities. Easy A.

I took this class through BYU Independent Study. The reading quizzes can be tough so make sure you study for those. The exams were just based off of the study guide he provides for each unit, and they were easy but make sure you study. The papers weren't bad either.

There were attendance quizzes for each class, reading quizzes, a semester-long project, a 5 page paper, 3 tests, and a final. Don't forget to do reading quizzes. I missed one quiz and it had a noticeable impact on my grade. The tests are 100 questions but the questions come straight from the study guides.

I thought Ogletree was a great choice for this class. Funny, engaging, accepting of other people's viewpoints, and very caring. He wants all of his students to succeed. Lots of memorization for the tests but overall this class wasn't too much work. Don't buy the reading packet: all of the assigned readings are online. Good class, I learned a lot.

I love Professor Ogletree!! He's the best and soooo hilarious! The only thing I would say about Living Prophets is that the tests are pretty difficult if you do not remember all of the random facts in the powerpoints. I attended every single class and still had some trouble on the tests even after attending and studying.

Professor Ogltree is a diamond. He is so knowledgable about the gospel but SO real and hilarious. I enjoyed EVERY class and learned so many useful things. There is enough work to keep you involved but definitely not hard. He cares. so much about the gospel and has many inspiring insights and entertaining stories. TAKE HIS CLASS!

Professor Ogletree is fantastic! His tests were a little hard to get used to, but after the first midterm, I didn't have a problem. He gives good study guides. His lectures provide lots more detail than I was expecting. I would definitely recommend taking a class from him, your life will be better for it! He loves the gospel and the students of BYU

Professor Ogletree is my favorite professor! I always looked forward to going to class and a big part of that was because of his humor as well as his insights and testimony. He didn't make the class very hard, which I appreciated because it enabled me to focus on building my testimony instead of worrying about getting a good grade.

Brother Ogletree is a really good guy. He cares about his students and wants you to succeed, and he's pretty forgiving and lenient with grading. That being said, the tests are a little overkill. All the answers are from his study guides for the unit but the study guides are way too long in my opinion.

Brother Ogletree is my favorite professor. He is so genuine and Christlike and funny and really helps you to learn while feeling the spirit. The course load isn't very tedious, and the bigger assignments that weren't even much more difficult actually helped me to change and improve my life.
Brother Ogletree is my favorite professor. He is so genuine and Christlike and funny and really helps you to learn while feeling the spirit.

Dr. Ogletree tackles some really heavy subjects in this class, but does so respectfully and reverently. Some of his sources for the studies he shows are a little outdated, but since I don't take religion courses for social science merit, I was satisfied with church resources he provided in order to improve ourselves for our future families.

I absolutely loved this class and this professor! Lectures were enlightening and interesting every week. Super simple quizzes every week (as long as you did the readings ;)), a paper, and a semester project. Easy Peasy! As long as you study, you'll do well!

He has a decent amount of reading for the class, largely drawing upon the words of General Authorities. He shares a lot of personal stories and anecdotes in his class, although some are rather strange and unhelpful. His tests were online, closed book, and closed note. The tests are more difficult that they should be and don't really test learning.

Dr. Ogletree is awesome. He is so knowledgeable about the Gospel and is very direct about what the Prophet and Apostles teach. His class is great and he doesn't make you do any extra work than needed. I would highly recommend to anyone! I wish I could take all my religion classes from him.
Love being a student of Dr. Mark Ogletree. He tough me things ill never forget and he is easy to work with!

You have to come to class, there are attendance quizzes, but he gives those answers to you in class. He has quizzes every week , but they are open note. His class isn't hard, you just have to put in some effort. And go to class.
Great teacher. Loved the lectures

Bro Ogletree is the teacher you want to take living prophets from. He is aware his class is a general and his goal is for everyone to get an A. His assignments are easy, including the project (which is self-graded) and the paper. You learn a lot of cool stuff about the twelve and first presidency. This is a solid choice for a religion general.

Lectures generally were entertaining and spiritual, and he gives a study guide with each lecture to know exactly what will be on the test from that day. Quiz before each class, self-graded project, one paper, 4 exams. Exam questions can be tricky with many Q's having multiple answers that seem right. Teaches doctrine, not personal opinions.

Dr. Ogletree did a great job of making this class fun and not too difficult. I didn't always agree with his views on certain topics, but he never felt like he was attacking those who did not agree with him. His study guides were long, but if you were familiar with them you did well on the tests.
Seriously he is the best professor for Living Prophets!! If you can take it from Ogletree!

He was an amazing professor who I learned a lot from. If you are looking for a professor who genuinely cares about his students and the material he is teaching, take this class. There are a lot of talks you need to read, but definitely worth it.

He gets carried away frequently during his lectures. He is fairly engaging but not everything he says is worth listening to. The actual class is not terribly hard, lots of busy work but easy to get an A.

Brother Ogletree gave "fill-in-the-blank" exam study guides for every lecture, and posted lecture slides on LS. He got off on story tangents a lot, but it wasn't bothersome. He is fair and willing to work with students. The tests were 100 questions each, but they weren't really difficult if you study the study guide.
Professor Ogletree is hilarious and is easy to work with, as long as you're responsible. Just attend class and do your work and you'll get an A.
he is a great teacher but there is a lot to do in the class. very doable.
Brother Ogletree is well organized, communicative, and wants to help you succeed! The class has a nice pace and you have all the resources you need to prepare as much as you would like.

He puts more in his slides than he can cover, so he sometimes skips stuff that's needed for the study guide. He does post the slides online. There are quizzes due in the morning, open note - you can use the internet instead of the readings packet. There are 4 exams, purely memorization of quotes and statistics mentioned in a study guide.

Brother Ogletree has a wonderful Living Prophets class. The class structure is more relaxed. This is the more spiritually uplifting religion class I have ever had. Take time to do the readings because you will grow so much. The class isn't too hard and it was interesting to learn about the prophets and apostles. I definitely recommend.
Great guy, I wish the class were a little more spiritual. There are a lot of cool facts he shares though.

Pro. Ogletree is a good teacher, I've enjoyed the class. I've learned a ton in this class. If you take the night class, he makes sure to let class out by 6:30 every Wednesday (it's supposed to go from 5 to 7). If you want the full class time, take one of his morning classes.
Amazing lecturer. He made sure it was entertaining and that you were engaged. Coursework was very straight forward and he was easy to approach about any needs!

Tons of busy work. That's the whole course: busy work. Lectures have little to no participation and the whole time is filling out study guides. 4 tests, all memorized and very specific. Dr. Ogletree is a great lecturer but needs to simplify his course, slow down, cut out the busy work, and allow the spirit to enter the classroom.
If you go to class and keep up on homework this class is easy. All tests have good study guides and it should be an A if you care at all about the class
He is a great man and a great professor.

He's a great guy and really cares about the subject and his students. The workload is super light and it's easy to pass as long as you remember to do the quizzes. The lectures can stereotype a bit at times and his tests mostly just ask for specific answers about quotes that are easy to forget.
Brother Ogletree is passionate about living prophets. During my time in his class, my testimony grew. He has a lot of assignments, they are not difficult, but there are many. Overall, a good class.

If you aren't a great memorizer, I probably wouldn't recommend the class. The course material is interesting and Prof Ogletree is really fun, but the tests are just memorizing a bunch of quotes and then being able to say who said what or fill in the blank. Not my favorite test style, but not bad.

I find him very funny and personable! This is the second time I've taken his class for credit, bc I love his style of teaching and content & bc it's easy. There's one easy paper, an easy project, and easy exams (use study guides!). Extra credit is also great! Not hard, just put some time in and everyone can get an easy A and learn a lot!

The class is pretty much entirely lecture. He does offer some extra credit. The tests aren't too hard for this class. There is quite a bit of reading, but he does split up the super long days. I think he's funny, but others might not. He really cares about his students and the class he teaches.

Brother Ogletree is a great professor and passionate about what he does. It was a pretty easy class, but you do need to pay attention and fill out the study guides to do well on the exams. At the end of the semester we had exam 3, the final, and a paper due in the same week so that could have been organized much better, but overall good class.

Super easy class: go to class to get the answers for the attendance quiz, then spend 20 minutes before each class to do the quizzes that come straight from the packet. If you fill out the study guide during class as your notes, all you have to do is study that for an hour or two and get an A on the test. He's awesome and so funny
good teacher easy class
Great man, great professor, learned a lot more than I expected!
A fair amount of work at the end of the semsester.

Brother Ogletree is awesome! He is so funny and his lectures are great. It is good mix of stories, facts and teachings from the apostles and prophets. He posts the study guides for the exams so that we can fill them out as we listen to the lectures. Tests are not bad at all if you fill out the study guides. One semester long project that is easy!
He gives PowerPoint presentations for every class, with yellow letters and a red background. He doesn't delve into the scriptures very much. He's very understanding and wants his students to succeed.
The class was informative and not too difficult. The focus was more on the content rather than just memorizing a lot of facts. Really enjoyable.
A great professor and person, knows how to teach to the understanding of the students and makes sure that everyone is included.

He was understanding in his grading. His class was relatively easy, he expressed the first day that he wanted it to be. Be sure to study the study guides for tests and you should be fine. He was very animated in class and liked to make jokes, lectures were decently interesting. There were attendance quizzes each day worth 2 points.
He loves what he does and is willing to help students.

Loved this professor so much! I always look forward to his class, and the assignments actually meant something, they weren't just for busy work. He is so funny and helps you gain a testimony. 10/10 recommend!

Professor Ogletree was great! There were a lot of readings but I never minded doing them because they were selected so carefully that they helped so much! There is a lot of memorizing for the exams, which is tough but doable.
He was great! He knows what he is talking about and is great at explaining. The tests were memorization heavy and that's my only complaint.

Dr. Ogletree is really good. Religion classes at BYU tend to be a bit too much work sometimes and this was kinda like that. The class was definitely great and Dr. Ogletree is a great teacher and is very entertaining too. I would just say that there were 3 tests and a final which seemed like a bit much and there was a 5 page paper due at the end.
He's a great teacher who knows what he's talking about and brings a good spirit to the class. Ive enjoyed having him as my teacher.
Great professor. Clear grading criteria and does a great job with the eternal families class. Anyone who has an issue with him did not do what they signed up for. Awesome experience.
Attendance is mandatory but other than that, favorite and easiest religion teacher ive had
Loved this class from Bro Ogletree. Study the study guides and show up to class and you'll do great!
Not super engaging lectures but pretty good. Overall a good choice

I really enjoyed Professor Ogletree's class! He is very honest and entertaining. The reading packet is a big help, but you can find the articles online. Attendance quizzes are administered daily, but they are very easy. Only one major paper and a project that you choose. I would take this class again, it gave me a lot of valuable new perspectives .

Professor Ogletree is seriously my favorite professor on campus. He is very caring and his class is really easy. You can find all the answers online to his quizzes. His lectures are very interesting even thought I didn't go to class half the time. I highly recommend to everyone. Even though they say this is a harder religion class, IT IS NOT!

Professor Ogletree is seriously my favorite professor on campus. He is very caring and his class is really easy. You can find all the answers online to his quizzes. His lectures that he gives is fun and very interesting. I highly recommend to everyone. Even though they say this is a harder religion class, IT IS NOT!

Brother Ogletree was the funniest professor I've ever had. I took the evening class and lectures went by quick. Attendance quiz answers were given in class and the study guides helped a lot for the tests. Wish I had him for all my religion credits!
I liked him a lot. Just make sure to do readings and quizzes before class. Helps you to better understand the material.

He's a really great professor. Lectures are interesting and the tests are easy (if you study). He is super flexible and forgiving. There are a lot of quizzes but they are open book and he has study guides that tell you the exact page number. The workload can be a bit unbalances: almost nothing sometimes and a lot at other times.
He's a great professor. But the load is a bit heavy for a 2 credit religion class, but it's BYU. He also has some really inspirational stuff for his class.

Easy class. If you're looking or something super inspiring, maybe look somewhere else. He focused more on random facts like where each prophet was born and what sport they played than their teachings, but as long as you can memorize facts about them, it's super easy to get an A.
Loved taking eternal families from him. I learned a ton and really enjoyed the lectures. It's an easy A if you go to class and do the exam study guides in class.
Really good professor who cares about his students. Coming to class and taking notes is important.
Personable, funny, reachable professor. Made a 2 hour class interesting, good pace, made studying easy with study guides, but exams were heavy on being very familiar with specific quotes.

Professor Ogletree is a teacher that I would recommend to all my friends to take. His classes are very inspirational and you can learn a lot about the apostles and prophet and yourself. His teachings connect with the students and can be put into one's daily life.

Professor Ogletree is the best, he makes a late night class hilarious and always goes fast. Is the get in get out type when it comes to lectures. He also makes it super easy to receive credit for the class but beware the small quizzes are not joke take them seriously or they will hurt your grade.

Wonderfully involved and prepared. Very organized with assignments and grades. Lots of reading and not much follow-up so you need to be on top of things yourself. Not much discussion in class, more of a lecture.

Everything was good and I enjoyed the class the most part. Until the end of the semester when there was Exam 3 and a 5 page paper due the week before the final exam. That wasn't very cool at all to leave all that to the very end like that!

Brother Ogletree is an amazing professor. He always has his students engaged in his classes and he provides everything you need to succeed in his class. He gives you study guides to help guide you in the way you should study. Great class! I would certainly take a class from Brother Ogletree again

Took the Wednesday night class and highly recommend. Though you have to sit through two hours of lecture the lectures are interesting and very funny. The tests were online and as long as you literally memorize the study guides you can get an easy A. He is a really great guy and has stories that are applicable for marriage.
Easy class and learned a lot.

Professor Ogletree is very knowledgeable and passionate about living prophets and apostles and it shows in the way he teaches! I felt that he genuinely cares about his students and is willing to help. One thing that was not my favorite about this class is that it is very information heavy and there usually is not a lot of discussion facilitated.

If you understand the purpose of school and work, then you shouldn't have any problems with this class. SO STRAIGHT FORWARD. You have exams that he doesn't post until they are opened, but you take formatted notes that he gives you which is the study guide for each exam. Go to class, pay attention, take quizzes.
Great Professor, funny, makes it relatively easy to get your points.
Use the study guides and don't miss class. The attendance quizzes are easy to forget about! Awesome teacher though. Inspired me to leave the single life.
Professor Ogletree is AMAZING! Every human should take his class even if you aren't trying to get hitched or if you're already hitched. It's just an all around really great class!

Professor Ogletree is very understanding and has a great sense of humor. He makes sure that a religion class is not what keeps you out of a grad school. His lectures were great, and he gives you many opportunities to learn beyond the assigned readings. The course load was not too heavy, and you don't need to read the textbook to get an A.

He has exam study guides you fill out during the lecture, and these are the questions most of the exams pull from. There is a pre-class quiz and attendance quiz, both are easy and have study guides. Really interesting facts about the apostles and prophets, you learn a lot about their lives and gain a lot of respect for them. 10/10 would take again

Dr. Ogletree is an amazing man. He has a heart of gold. His class is very simple. All the quizes are opened day one and he basically gives you the answers if you buy the reading packets. There are inclass attendance quizes that he gives you the answers for. He tells lots of stories. His tests are hard, just memorize the study guides for an A.

Brother Ogletree is an amazing teacher! He is understanding and wants each student to succeed. If you actually do the reading assignments, which isn't many, your testimony will strengthen greatly! Would definitely take the class again!

If you're Non-LDS, this class is going to be extremely difficult for you. I always left class feeling not good, the tests have study guides but are just ridiculously specific especially when you don't have quotes from church leaders memorized. Save yourself the strife and take it from someone else. Prof is a good guy though.
Great professor for Eternal Families. I wish there were more classes I could take from him!
Hes a great religion professor. Focus is on teaching doctrine and providing spiritual experiences, not on superfluous facts and details. Would definitely take another class from him.

Brother Ogletree's class was pretty easy and straightforward. As long as you go to class, take notes (fill out the study guides during the lectures), and study for the exams, you'll do great. He tries hard to be accessible to the students and to involve them in the class.

Attendance quizzes (they are based on his lectures so go to class and the questions are easy). Really funny and blunt, but not mean. Uses teachings from church leaders and scripture. Study guides for exams are very helpful, but some test questions are very specific and nit-picky. Open-book reading quizzes online.
He is very understanding towards student athletes or reasons beyond your control for missing class and even assignments.
Do what your suppose to and it will be easy. Would recommend.

He provides study guides for every quiz and exam. Study those well and you will be able to get an A on every test. Attendance is required or you lose a lot of points on your final. Can get ahead easily if need be.

Professor Ogletree is really cool, but the class isn't terribly interesting. It's not hard to pass, but you do have to actually do the readings and pay attention in class if you want to do well on the tests, which I did not do, because I'm lazy. If you hate the testing center, I would recommend him, because all the tests are online.

Bro Ogletree is super kind and really loves his students. If you take living prophets from him he keeps it as low-stress as possible and you really just get to learn and be inspired by the people we talk about. He does everything he can to help you do well in the class and is super reasonable. It's a chill but great religion class!

Professor Ogletree is great with his lectures and is super chill. Everything you see on the study guides is the exact same on the test so he'll never trick you or put in something that wasn't discussed in class. The only downside though is that the tests are 100 questions so you basically have to memorize a lot of facts/quotes.

Professor Ogletree was very respectful and works with you to receive the grade you would like. He is very understanding and a fun professor to be around. His class is very insightful and you learn so much. Solid 10/10!

Professor Ogletree is the man! First day of class he told us that this should not be a class that hurts our GPA, and that we should enjoy coming just to learn about the material. Daily attendance quizzes (that he gives you the answers to), three exams and a final (which he gives study guides too) and engaging lectures every day in class!
Very fair class with clear expectations. He's very nice!

This class is amazing. There is a reason why eternal Families is a required class. I highly suggest professor Ogletree as a professor, his lectures will teach you so much. This class has taught me so much!

He's a funny professor with good intentions to help. It's not a difficult class overall. The exams are frustrating because they require you to memorize quotes rather than learn principles. Example (fake) question: "John said it was good to 1) love each other 2) love your spouse 3) love the lord 4) love God." You can look up all the readings online.
