I loved taking this class! Professor Ogletree really cares about his students and tries to make every lecture great. Also whenever I had questions or concerns Professor Ogletree was very helpful.

I loved Brother Ogletree!! He is so funny and has great stories to share. One of my favorite things about the class in general was the selected readings and his powerpoints--- he clearly put so much effort into this class, yet it is so easy on the student side! He has such a great perspective because of his background and family. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

His lectures grasp your attention and provide good life skills. Make sure to do the quizzes before class (he closes them 1 hr before so be careful) or else your grade will tank. My only criticism is his tests are a little silly. They are 100 mc, aka memorize nonsense. I believe 50 questions would be more reasonable for a 2 credit class.

Super funny guy! Lectures are really interesting and fun! Tests are a little challenging but he gives you the study guides and they are practically the same questions! He wants you to succeed, and is easy to work with!

Professor Ogletree is a really kind but his lectures are a little boring. I didn't really feel the spirit as much as I had hoped to but also it was a 9 am class so maybe I was just tired. Overall, he is a caring and respectful professor but just gives a lot of busy work.

This is the second course i've taken from Prof. Ogletree & i really enjoyed it, AGAIN! His lectures are very informative & hive gives you TONS of resources to ace the class. The tests were questions that were listed from the study guides he so graciously gave us, which many professors do not do. Im graduating soon & wish i could take another class!

Professor Ogletree is easily one of the best professors I have had. He is super caring and very willing to help you when needed. I love that he does not make things too difficult, but that it isn't so easy you wonder why you even attend. Each class period you get something worthwhile out of the lesson. AMAZING guy. 15/10 recommend him.

Brother Ogletree is super chill and pretty funny/engaging during lectures. Tests and quizzes are online so it's really easy to plan around them. The tests do have a lot of content and you'll have to memorize a lot, but everything on the test is typically covered on the study guide.

Prof. Ogletree really understands what he is talking about and cares for his students. I had a difficult time in this class personally because it was only once a week and we moved too quickly through the material for me to really understand it. If you do take Prof. Ogletree's class, just make sure class is twice a week.

In this class, you're graded on attendance quizzes, weekly reading quizzes, 3 tests, a semester long project, a paper, and the final exam. The attendance quizzes are easy if you go to class. The tests are also straightforward if you fill out the study guides. Professor Ogletree cares about his students.

Brother Ogletree was the best, anytime I had concerns about a test or the test reviews, I would go right into his office and receive more help than I even wanted. The tests are word for word the exam reviews, just put in effort and you will get an A. Talk to him about the grade and he will help you out!!! SUCH A GREAT TEACHER! v accommodating!

Professor Ogletree is a super great guy, can be funny, and cares a lot about students (and the living prophets!). Awesome class, do solid, simple work and it's an easy A. Good experience 10/10, would recommend. Textbook (cheap paper version) is necessary to do reading quizzes, they are not difficult.
Professor Ogletree was nice and fair. I feel that his class wasn't overbearing but I still learned and have been able to apply what I have learned. Great class!

This class had a lot of homework for a religion class. There were 4 exams, 48 attendance/homework quizzes, a big paper, and a three month long project. But he's an awesome teacher. He is super fun/funny and leads interesting discussions. I recommend him! Just be prepared to work hard. (side note: I never used the book, just church website)

Brother Ogletree is chill and his class reflects his personality. As long as you do the readings and fill out the study guides during his lectures you will do great in his class. He told us at the beginning of the semester that this should be the easiest class we have at BYU.

Brother Ogletree is a pretty chill guy and his class reflects his personality. Pretty much the only assignments he gives are reading quizzes from the readings packets (which are open book so you can fill out the quiz as you read) and participation quizzes in class. The tests aren't too difficult if you fill out the study guides. Overall great class

Works with students and is flexible. Doesn't give a ton of papers and random assignments, has one course project and one paper along with attendance quizzes and reading quizzes due before class. Tests are also online and usually open for at least a week if not longer.

Dr. Ogletree really cares about the content of his course. He understands life as a college student is difficult and he's not there to make it worse. This man does his best to really care about his students and help them succeed. Would definitely recommend him.
Professor Ogletree is awesome, possibly my favorite religion professor at BYU. Highly recommend.

Professor Oglegree's eternal family class (RELC200) is really fun and he makes lectures worth going to! It is a normal amount of work, but he is very understanding and his quizzes are really straight forward from the readings. He cares a lot and gives a lot of story examples in class.

I would definitely recommend Dr. Ogletree's class! Lectures were great and I learned a ton. There's a lot of reading, but quizzes are straightforward and it's all doable. Do yourself a favor and write your final essay ahead of time or finals week will kill you for this class. But seriously, I highly recommend his class! It was great!

Dr. Ogletree was awesome. His class is not very hard, you just have to really go to class and then go over the study guide before taking the test. The study guides are extremely close to the test. He really just wants everyone to get an A. It's always very straight forward and he really just cares that you learn important principles.
A good, solid religion professor. Tests require preparation.

This is a class that you will definitely want to take. Grading is clear and not difficult. The class is uplifting and informative. It does not take a lot of out-of-class time and you will learn a lot. The tests do require you know some questions about the brethren that seem more like trivia, but if you fill out the study guide you will do great!

If you study for the tests, you'll do well. Great lecture content- I learned a lot and loved attending class.. He really wants students to do well. Encourages students to fill out study guide during class lectures which I was a bit bugged by as it distracts from the spirit of the message, but that's a personal preference.
Brother Ogletree is such a great professor! His lectures are amazing! You will learn so much.

I took this class and loved it. Professor Ogletree has so much experience when it comes to marriage and family, both because of his professional and personal life. I liked that he incorporated anecdotes from his practice as a family therapist and also drew heavily from his own life as a husband and father. Really interesting class!

Dr. Ogletree is awesome! You do have to read quite a bit, but it's all great stuff that is important to know for our future families. He bases everything off the scriptures and GA quotes, but also incorporates finding from secular research. I learned a lot of things that will be helpful in the future, I highly recommend taking this class!

Prof. Ogletree is a great prof who I would take again. There are a lot of little assignments due each day but they take a total of like 5/10 mins. Prof. Ogletree is caring and understanding and genuinely respects and cares for his students. Even with the COVID-19 stuff he was amazing and kept things in order. 10/10 would take again!

I took REL C 200. Brother Ogletree has good intentions, he really does. What tripped me up about this class was the inordinate amount of busy work that we had to do, and then having a final unit exam, a 5 page paper, and a final exam all due in the last week. Be ready to exert yourself for this religion credit because he'll throw some hoops at you.

He is a great teacher and his lectures are great. However for a two credit hour class there are 3 midterms, a final, a large month long project, 20+ quizzes, over 300 pages of reading, and a 5 page paper. He has way too many assignments. I would not recommend purely on the workload.

Professor Ogletree is super easy to work with, he is fair in his grading, and the class is an easy A. However, for a religion class, I felt he spent a lot of time talking about his own opinions, stereotypes, and research instead of giving time to the spirit to teach. We hardly used the scriptures. He was funny, but not spiritual at all.

He is one of my favorite professors Ive had while at BYU. If you go to class you do well on the tests. Everything is ironed out for you so you know exactly what to study, what assignment is due, & other logistics. His lectures are amazing and engaging. He makes you feel welcome, loved and essential rather than just a number in a big lecture class.

Prof. Ogletree is amazing. He loves the gospel and understands the importance of living prophets and apostles. I learned so much more about their lives from him and his stories. 10/10 would recommend taking his class. My roommate and I did all of the homework for the semester in the first week and a half of class. Great class from a great guy.
Brother Ogletree is great!! He knows his stuff and his classes are enjoyable. You feel like part of a family coming to class.

Class is simple but fun. He tries his best to engage the class and keep you interested. Attendance quizzes based on his lecture but everything is on learning suite. The tests are only tricky if you don't look over the class notes a couple of times. Nice guy, works hard and will help you out if you have problems.

Very conservative and close minded. He really confused my testimony on the proclamation of the family and what it means to be a women in the church. He is funny, but sexist. He uses his own opinions as doctrine which can be very very damaging and confusing. If you are a minority in anyway I would not recommend taking his class.

All Professor Ogletree wants is for you to be successful and get a good grade. The homework and quizzes are easy and he is TOTALLY willing to meet with you any time throughout the year if things aren't going so well and he will totally help you if you take initiative. The class was easy but really helpful. He does a great job.
Hes awesome! He is so funny. I liked how he was able to apply his own life to what he taught. I definitely recommend his class.

The most caring professor ever! The weekly quiz answers are found word for word in the book, he'll raise your grade (if you deserve it) just by texting him and asking what you can do, he always lets us know when sensitive subjects are being brought up, and even gave a kid 5 extra credit points for getting more salsa for our chili's chips party!!!!!
Brother Ogletree is so funny! Every class was entertaining and he is really nice! He is really willing to help!

Professor Ogletree is a great professor! His lectures are interesting and I learned a lot more than I thought I would about eternal families. His tests are easy if you memorize what's on the study guides. He makes it easy to succeed if you work hard!

Professor Ogletree is an awesome professor. His lectures are always engaging, and he does a great job teaching some tough subjects. He teaches clearly, and is straightforward with what you need to do for a good grade . Pretty funny guy as well.

Great teacher, has very spiritual and inspiring lessons that teach you things that are really important in life. The only problem was I didn't feel like he cared much about my grade or whether bad or good. He acted like grades were unimportant and that I shouldn't worry about them at all, but then he makes the tests way too hard and specific.
My favorite class I have taken at BYU! The class is easy and he is hilarious! Always left his class feeling edified. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
Great professor! Class is very simple. Learn from powerpoints, tests are based on memorization!

I took the Eternal Family class and it was a really insightful class. I really enjoyed learning about the inherent differences between men and women. Professor Ogletree is really funny, grounded in the gospel, and a straightforward professor. I would highly recommend taking this class from Professor Ogletree!
The class requires a lot of reading outside of class.

Test answers are so close and specific must have everything memorized for tests. I often walk out of the class feeling like he missed the mark and uninspired. He's funny. Lectures with lighter topics are good. Lectures with heavy topics were hard for me . The homework and quizzes are great, I feel like I learned the most from those.

A really funny fun caring professor. I learned principles that I will apply the rest of my life. I am very grateful for this class and the content. Classes were entertaining and enlightening. Some of the exam questions seem to come from random places. But the quizes were easy to study for and attendance although not mandatory is extremely helpful.
Professor Ogletree is a fun-loving guy and loves the gospel. He has lots of insightful experience. Overall great class.
Dr. Ogletree is so great! He is spiritual, funny, and wants all of his students to succeed.

pretty easy as long as you do the homework and go to lectures. Not a ton of homework if you keep up on the study guides he gives for the quizzes. A really fun and great professor. His lectures are doctrinally based and well-informed.
Professor Ogletree has a ton of energy. Hes an interesting guy that is passionate about the family. The tests don't always follow the study guides super close.
I loved this class ! Reading quizzes are open book and tests are super straight forward and based on given study guides. His lectures are entertaining but I also learned so much

Brother Ogletree was great! I loved how chill his class was, but I still learned a lot. I think the information taught in eternal families was really helpful. I would highly recommend taking a class from Brother Ogletree!
Ogletree is a super nice guy and teaches well. It's easy, its simple, and its exactly what a BYU religion class should be.
Had me dying of laughter every class period. He cancelled like 3 weeks of class and went to Hawaii. Study for the tests on Quizlet, the rest is easy!

Prof. Ogletree is a homie. He gets that we are stressed and religion classes shouldn't be tearing down your GPA. I took his once a week night class-- we were always out early. He is super funny to listen to, and still takes spiritual topics seriously. Would highly recommend.
A must take for this class
One of the best religion professors at byu, and one of the easiest. Really, you should take his class.

Honestly, this was one of the worst religion classes I have taken at BYU. Tests were poorly written. Pro. Ogletree's "lessons" were him telling stories, many times that had little to do with the subject, very little actual discussion. Take this class if you just want an easy, kinda funny class with no real learning, otherwise don't waste your time.

Best choice for the Eternal Families class. He's a marriage counselor for his profession, so everything he teaches is always very applicable. He also is very entertaining, but he brings the Spirit, and he focuses on what's most important. Very straightforward with grading, and if you just follow the instructions and take notes, you'll get an A.
His tests are just a bunch of random facts. Given... he does tell you everything you need to know, but if you dont memorize little details well, its not a good class for ya.

Professor Ogletree is a very nice man and did his best to make the class as stress free as possible while still giving the needed assignments. His class is super lecture heavy with very little discussion, which can be both good and bad depending on the lesson topic. There is a lot of content to study for the tests, but they aren't hard.
Honestly, the best professor I have ever had. If you show up and pay attention to his lectures, you will pass.

Dr. Ogletree is awesome! He definitely cares about helping his students prepare for marriage and how to make it work, and you'll learn a lot, but he also knows that he is teaching a required religion class and doesn't make it too hard. He makes sure you know what's going on and how to succeed. He's super funny, too!
incredibly caring, loving man. Studying for tests can be tricky.

Dr. Ogletree understands what it means to be a religion teacher. He teachers in a spirutal and funny manner. He wants things to be turned in on time but also will give you partial credit for late work. Take his class. You won't regret it.

This was a great Eternal Families Class. Dr. Olgetree is kind, caring, and passionate about the topic. He has very solid church view, taken right from the Proclamation and church leaders. I would not say his ideas or teachings are revolutionary, but insightful. I never bought readings packet, just googled the articles names from quiz study guides.

Dr. Ogletree is a kind man and cares about his students. That being said, his tests are extremely difficult because you have to try and guess what he's thinking. They are unrealistic because you either have to memorize 50+ exact quotes or write down every word he says in class to study from. I enjoyed him as a teacher, but not as a test writer.

I loved professor Ogletree. I thought his lectures were great for preparing students to be great parents and followers of Christ. He had us fill out study guides for the tests and the tests were pretty similar to the study guides. I thought the tests seemed like a lot of random general conference trivia on who said what though. Overall, he's solid!

He did a great job teaching, tells a lot of stories, the tests have clear study guides, easy opportunities to get extra credit, overall a solid teacher, he is very understanding if you miss something.
daily attendance quizzes are easy, one easy project a semester, test study guides are exactly what is on the tests, overall a really good and easy class.
Brother Ogletree is such a genuine guy. I found the class overall so easy. I really enjoyed his lectures and hes a funny guy! Exams are quote specific and online!

He will always say things like "If you miss this quiz, then there is no making it up", but he totally doesnt mean it. He is very willing to work with you via email or after class... just go talk to him. I do feel like his tests are centered too much on memorizing specific quotes from conferences 20 years ago and less on actual docterine.

I really enjoyed the class. Professor Ogletree loves to teach and is passionate about it. If you go to class, take notes, and read the talks youll get an A easy. My only concern is that the exams seem to have material that isnt on the study guides. If he were to organize a little bit his exams and his system in general, Id give him a 5.

Dr. Ogletree actually took over for my professor at the beginning of the semester. I was really worried but her turned out to be a really good professor. My marriage has even improved from his lectures. Not a ton of classwork, just a few really easy papers and a lot of great lectures. Would totally take from him again.

I liked Brother Ogletrees lectures and class. Hes a good teacher and his lectures are funny, and a good place to learn. His tests are dumb. He asks a lot about quotes from his power points and you have to know the quote. Ex. What did president Nelson say about marriage A. Its great B. Its Good C. Its wonderful D. Its amazing get it?

Brother Ogletree was very funny in his lectures and found myself laughing in every class! It makes this religion course much more enjoyable than others. Reading is technically not required because quizzes are open note. Exams are INSANE, class averages were very low on all of them. He tests you on little things hidden in his powerpoints.

Professor Ogletree is a great teacher, and I loved his lectures. The tests can be hard because you have so much that could be on there. Overall, I think he's a good professor, and I would take him again.

Brother Ogletree is a really awesome guy!! Super funny and the class is a lot of fun! The only thing that I didn't like were the exams. You pretty much just have to memorize a ton of facts and specific quotes rather than the principle so the tests can be a little tricky. Apart from the tests its a great class.

Professor Ogletree is a nice guy. He's really funny, and a good professor. I don't think his tests are good for it being a religion test. Do you want to be tested on what anyone has said about the family? I don't know. I would take him again because I liked him as a teacher, but I didn't care for this class.

Brother Ogletree is an amazing professor. His class is so much fun and easy to do well in. He really cares about his students and helps them to succeed. He is very willing to work with you to make the class fair and he works hard to make sure it does not take up too much of your time. He is very entertaining and has lots of great insights!

He gives you exam study guides to go along with each lecture, which is helpful, but you spend the entire time looking for the answers that you can't enjoy the class or feel the Spirit. The tests were super specific, you have to know exact quotes and numbers, not just general ideas. My least favorite religion class and professor.
Great class! If you do your work and show up to class you will get an "A" He is also super entertaining and his lectures are great. I would definitely take him again.

I've loved taking classes from Ogletree. You dont have to buy the book full of talks. Just google the talks or download his PDF. DO NOT BUY THE BOOK. If you just do the average work in this class you'll get an A. His tests are long (100 questions) but if you fill out the study guide you should be fine. My clear favorite religion professor
He has daily attendance quizzes plus reading quizzes. Super fun class and learned a lot. His test are 100 question and you have to memorize tons of quotes and stats to pass.

He is a really fun professor and I loved his lectures. Some of the questions on his tests are things that he said once in class and the answers are all similar so if you don't remember the exact word he used, you will miss it. That was kinda frustrating, but a great teacher other than that.

Dr, Ogletree is one of the ideal religion professors. He is a great lecturer, tells entertaining but applicable stories, and sets clear expectations. Don't buy the reading packet. You can find the readings on the quiz study guides. The only downside is his tests are a bit harder than expected. A couple questions weren't on the study guide each test

I really loved Brother Ogletree's lectures. He tells lots of stories and really tries to make the class fun. The tests were harder than I was expecting them to be. Just study your notes really well and you'll be alright. He's great, but you need to work hard!

Great lectures and really cares about students. However, no matter how hard I studied for exams, there were always questions on there that we either had not gone over or weren't very clear. I still did decent on the exams, but its a good note that there will be stuff you don't know. Other then that it was a breeze.
He is a great professor. The only downside to the class is his exams. He requires you to study things that are really not important and wants you to memorize random facts instead of class principles.

Very kind man, definitely qualified to teach the class and shows a sincere interest in the content and his students. However I did not enjoy the structure of his class. I felt it was focused too much on busy work and did not encourage actual learning. The tests were often too specific and had questions not outlined on the study guide or in class.

Great teacher! Super funny and spiritual. Only thing I didn't like was that the tests were basically memorizing random quotes and facts. Did tell us test questions sometimes. Also, if you skip class more than 3 times he take 50% off your final. Great professor though!

Dr. Ogletree is one of my favorite Professors at BYU. His class is always engaging and fun. I took Eternal Families from him and he does an amazing job at combining statistics and doctrine to really emphasize his points. The one catch with the class is that the tests are fairly specific (though they're all online). So make sure to prep for them.
Brother Ogletree is awesome. He is really funny and I enjoy his lectures. The class itself isn't bad as long as you don't forget about quizzes and such.
Honestly the best Teacher I have ever had at BYU. Clear and easy grading. But I have also learned more that than I thought I would.

Dr. Ogletree's Rel C 200 has been the best religion class I have taken so far, and I have taken quite a few. His lectures are interesting, and I felt like how he taught helped me understand more. He doesn't assign busy work and as long as you attend classes and fill out the study guides for the exams the class is relatively stress free.

Dr. Ogletree is good enough. He tries to keep his lectures interesting, and tells funny stories. He has this way of calling people out in class sometimes, though, and that makes things awkward occasionally. REL C 200 with him was pretty easy, just study well for the tests, which have specific study guides that contain most of the questions.

I loved this class! Dr. Ogletree is fun and light-hearted, but also knows his stuff. He teaches true doctrine with the Spirit. His course is very well-organized and straight forward and it's really not hard to get a good grade in this class!

Dr. Ogletree very effectively conveys the material and is both knowledgable and inspirational, as well as funny. He will virtually bend over backward to help you out and make sure you get the grade you deserve. That being said, the class often felt rushed and resources were under-utilized to maximize the potential of the material. Class was REL 200

Brother Ogletree really knows what he is talking about and the lectures have good material. Everyday there is a reading quiz and an attendance quiz but they're easy and open book. The tests are rough because they are mostly exact quotations, but he does provide a study guide for each exam.
Really nice guy and tries to make lectures fun. Not that hard of assignments and prepares you for exams.

He's a great guy and really cares for his students. There are a few assignments in the class but he makes them really easy for you. He says just to skim the readings and do the tests at the start of the semester, so you can get all that done in a few solid hours of work. You self grade your semester assignment. The exams are harder though.

Professor Ogletree is an awesome guy. He is really funny and has a quirky sense of humor and personality that makes lectures really fun to attend. He knows a lot about the family and is great at teaching it. I hated his tests. They were 100 questions and sometimes vague. Other than that everything was great.

If you're gonna take Eternal Families, take it from Prof. Ogletree!! I looked forward to going to class! There is a quiz before class everyday based on some readings but it doesn't take much time and I honestly LOVED doing the quizzes. They were super interesting. He is a very engaging teacher and the lectures were fun and spiritually uplifting!

The professor was wonderful in his teaching style. I got so much out of lectures and discussions in class! However, his tests were always so weird! I would get so much out of lecture and then the test was always focussed on memorizing ridiculous quotes and specific words that were so ambiguous that it was impossible to study for them.

Professor Ogletree is a good professor. He's funny and his lectures are fun. The only criticism I have are his tests; they're pure memorization of quotes from apostles and prophets. Other than that the class is good, the workload is very small, there's only attendance quizzes and reading quizzes which are super easy.

Professor Ogletree is a very funny professor and seems to know his stuff. His lectures are interesting and a joy to listen to. My only problem with the class were the tests; they are very memorization heavy and don't really focus on knowing the concepts. If you want to pass, you really have to memorize notes and study guide.

Professor Ogletree is hilarious and it is very enjoyable to be in class. The assignments are clear and the class in general is not too hard. The test can be a little hard but he gives study guides and gives very flexible amounts of time to take the tests. They are all online as well.

Dr. Ogletree is a good dude. He straight up told us that he didn't want his class to be our hardest class. He does his best to make class engaging and fun. His readings packet is mostly GC talks so I didn't buy it and did just fine! My only complaint is that he consistently prepares waaaay too much material than can be covered in class.

Good Teacher and nice guy! I just felt that the class was a little too much busywork and random facts and not enough critical thinking and concept mastery. We were tested a lot on memorization and not enough on important concepts/skills.

Oh. My. Goodness. I can't say enough good things about Prof. Ogletree. Every lesson I was inspired and learned so much. My main piece of advice: Don't get behind on assignments or forget quizzes because the points are hard to get back.

Dr. Ogletree is very direct and wants his students to be successful. He gives students a lot of opportunities to earn extra credit and is very clear on the assignments that need to be done in class. You fill out a study guide online and if you study (memorize) those, you will do well on the tests. He also does attendance quizzes - so go to class!

Great professor! Absolutely loved having him, he's funny, it's clear what he grades on, he provides study guides for both exams and quizzes. The unit exams caught me off guard, so just make sure to study for them!

Brother Ogletree is pretty sassy, but it makes class interesting. I loved his lectures and all the reading was great. But the tests are pretty ridiculous. He gives very specific study guides, but a lot of the questions are obscure statistics about things that just don't really matter.
Brother Ogletree is great. Super awesome guy and gives very entertaining lectures. The work isn't very hard, just keep up with it. I enjoyed the class a lot! Take eternal families from him!
Easy Easy... just do the exam study guides

Definitely not my favorite professor at BYU. But, there really is a lot of good information and insight in his lectures. Be open to the spirit and you will learn a lot about yourself, dating, and marriage. The homework is super easy, but you have to go to class to get attendance points. overall I didn't mind the class and it is pretty easy.

Brother Ogletree is seriously the best. His class is how a religion class should be--not very hard and easy to get an A as long as you do everything. He gives you study guides to fill out during class so you know exactly what is on the test. His lectures are easy to follow and he makes it entertaining and fun to be there.

Brother Ogletree is great! Class is based around open-book reading quizzes, 3 midterms, a final, an attributes project where you pick something to improve on over the semester (easy), & attendance quizzes (answers given in class). He's awesome! If you fill out exam study guides based on the ppts & study with those you'll do fine! Easy A, I think.
Professor Ogletree is great! His Eternal Families class is solid. His tests are memorization heavy, which is annoying, but bearable. Really cares about his students and tells great stories.

This was a pretty easy class. There are a lot of reading quizzes but they are all open book so they aren't too hard. The tests are on learning suite so that is also nice. There are attendance quizzes everyday so go to class.

Honestly, class is pretty enjoyable. He shares funny stories and keeps things interesting. He provides exam study guides that are based off of the slides so just fill out the study guide while in class. The tests are pretty much memorizing quotes. He gives you the page number for where to find the answers for quizzes. There are attendance quizzes.

You are required to go to class. Its a good idea anyway as the midterms and final exams are all based on in class material. Quizzes are out of class, open note, and based on the readings. He provides a study guide with all the information you should know for each midterm. Go to class, do the readings, complete the study guide and you'll do fine.

Dr. Ogletree is the kindest professor ever. He teaches straight doctrine and helps you enhance your understanding of the gospel. If you show up to class you will do great and also leave being more prepared for the future! I loved loved loved this class. Take it from him!!!!!!!

Professor Ogletree is a pretty good professor. There are a lot of quizzes (attendance and reading) but overall, he is pretty easy. However, his exam study guides are not very well written so good luck with his exams. Also, he has rather conservative opinions so just bear with it...
He was a pretty one sided guy, not bad but not great. I wasnt spiritually fed at all though. It was just information dump, all the time. Not hard, but not educational.

Professor Ogletree really cares about his students. In his class it is easy to feel the spirit and be uplifted, and you can tell that you really enjoys teaching the eternal families class. Would definitely recommend. Overall a great learning experience!

No regrets at all. Dr. Ogletree knows a lot about the class (Eternal Families). His lectures were a little too comprised content-wise, but very insightful. My favorite thing is that he focuses more in the doctrine than in the controversial issues. Exams were on learning suite, timed, and a little long, but he gives all the answers during lecture.

Brother Ogletree is a great teacher and very funny. Not a huge fan of how the class was set up. I felt like I was just filling out the study guide ferociously during class and not really getting a lot out of the lecture. Easy class though as long as you show up and do the study guide, quizzes, project, and other assignments on time.

I took Eternal Families from him. Class itself was not difficult and you do not need to put that much effort in to get and A. His tests can be obnoxious however. Very conservative but if you can get past his opinions then it is fine. As far as professors go: not my favorite, not the worst.

This class was pretty easy overall. Everything is straightforward and it's not too difficult to get an A. The attribute project is super easy and self graded. That being said, you have to take frantic notes the whole time because the tests are completely from the study guides. Also attendance is mandatory.

Hilarious. Very conservative; I was put off by some of his views in the first couple lectures, but ultimately glad I stayed. Content is practical, straightforward, fairly well organized. Refers constantly to Church authorities and topical experts, which I liked, although class atmosphere is much more academic than spiritual.
Good teacher overall, I had a great Eternal Families experience with him.

Bro. Ogletree is the best!! Just show up to class and you will be able to do just fine in his class. All of the tests are online through learning suite. There are study guides for each lecture to help you study for each test. There are quizzes but again they are online and there are study guides for them - these are open note.

1. Don't forget to do quiz before class 2. Go to class and do attendance quiz 3. During lectures, fill out the exam study guide for the test 4. Study the Exam Study Guides and powerpoints a ton and then you'll do alright on the midterms that are taken online (100 Q's for an hour)
The tests were super specific so don't expect to go into the test and get an easy A.

Dr. Ogletree is a good man, with a kind and caring heart. I learned a lot in his class but he focuses so much on memorizing 400 random questions for one 100 question test that it takes away from the spirituality of each class. All I did each class was listen to answers for each question instead of listening to the Spirit, I was disappointed.

Dr. Ogletree is a great man. He is a convert to the church and really cares about the content of the class. His grading is 3 (timed online learningsuite) midterms, 1 (timed online learningsuite) final, an easy paper, online open-note quizzes before every class, and attendance quizzes. Easy A.

You have to go to this class with a different mindset. I did not feel the spirit as much as other classes but I learned interesting facts and percentages. I did not like his tests though, because they are not open book and you have to memorize these percentages, which is not useful at all in your life.

I genuinely enjoyed this course. If you really put your heart into it, the content is relatable. The quizzes are just busywork, but the talks that the quizzes cover are dynamite. Sometimes class feels like he's reading lecture notes from absurdly wordy, cramped Power Points, but Brother Ogletree does a great job of caring for his students.

This course is not hard, but it is too much busywork. Lectures are based entirely off of him reading what is written on the powerpoint. Tests are absurdly specific, and the daily readings have no impact on anything in the course except the daily reading quizzes. The class is geared toward memorizing facts to pass a test, not to actually learn

Professor Ogletree is a good professor, and is very fair about how he teaches his class. If you show up and do the exam review guides in class and review them, you should get an A withought much trouble.
This teacher grades based on attendance, along with other fields (tests, quizzes, etc.) but he makes it okay to miss few classes if necessary. He is understanding and wants the students to do well.
Ogletree is the man. Just show up to class, do the study guides and you're all set.

Professor Ogletree is super relaxed and easy going. He's very understanding and wants his students to be successful. Attendance is mandatory but if you go willing to get something out of the lectures they're definitely worth it and I learned a lot. Fill out the study guides really well and memorize them because thats the exams.

He wants us to get As but his study guide might not include all the data he wants you to remember. He also is a little insensitive towards some sensitive topics. Professor Ogletree is still a good professor and he made the class fun.

Normally I strongly dislike religion courses, but this one was fantastic. Professor Ogletree was the first religion professor at BYU that I have taken, who actually cares about his students. His class is amazing, would recommend 10/10.
Dr. Ogletree wants you to have a fun, uplifting experience and that is what you get. He teaches straight from the Bretheren and keeps the conversation light and engaging.
Dr. Ogletree was so amazing! Attendance is mandatory, but he makes it well worth it through his funny and inspirational lectures. He is very understanding and would definitely recommend this class.

Professor Ogletree was always funny in lectures which made them easy to come to considering they were mandatory. There's reading quizzes but they are all open book and really easy. Tests are based off of lecture study guides so if you fill those out the tests are super easy. Really nice guy, would definitely take again.
His tests can be more ambiguous and really specific oriented. Memorize his study guides and you'll do great! Really funny guy!!

Dr. Ogletree was hands down my favorite professor of all time. I dont know if anyone else got his humor like I did but he made me crack up every single class period. I loved his story telling which was also really funny. While his tests weren't the easiest to study for, I for sure would take another religion class from him. What a great guy.

Professor Olgetree is funny and the tests are based purely off of the study guides which is nice. However, it was hard for me to get a lot out of this class because I was so focused on filling out the study guides each class period.

Prof. Ogletree is awesome. There are attendance quizzes in every class but he tells you the answers when you ask. Study guide is easy to fill out based on the powerpoints posted on Learning Suite. He's funny to listen to. Has a unique perspective as a convert and a marriage and family counselor
Professor Oogletree knows his stuff! Hands down the best religion class/definitely most useful Ive taken at BYU. Easy class. Fill out the study guides during lectures and you should be fine.
I really enjoyed learning about the eternal family from someone who is so passionate about it. The tests are a little hard if you don't study - but you don't have to study that much to pass.

He's a funny guy and lecture was usually decent. His tests were not skill-based at all, though. 100 questions that need to be answered in an hour; lots of really specific quotes that have nothing to do with the main point of the class. Other than that, pretty easy.

Ok, sure the lectures are usually pretty entertaining, but the tests are some of the worst tests I have ever taken. They don't test what you learn, they painfully test how many quotes and random facts and opinions you can memorize and spit out in an hour. Other than the tests the class is ok, although most of the class is based on opinion.

Dr. Ogletree is awesome! He is very approachable and wants to help you succeed in any way he can. Class is mandatory, but he definitely makes class fun. He always tells personal funny stories and jokes around. Glad i took this class with him. It gave me a break from the usual hard religion classes that i have taken.

Dr. Ogletree is a great teacher! This has definitely been my favorite class this semester. He cares about his students and his lectures are inspiring. I learned a lot from his class, and would definitely take a class from him again. My only complaint is that the tests (which are online) look for very specific answers, but not difficult to get an A

Ogletree is funny and his lectures are interesting. There is hardly any work outside of class. If you go to lectures and listen you'll do great on the tests. Very qualified to teach this class because he has a lot of experience working with families.

He is honestly the best! He keeps the lectures interesting with good stories and spiritual content. The class is also formatted well and it is very clear what you need to do in order to get a good grade. All of the tests and quizzes are done on LearningSuite!
Overall it is a pretty easy class. Show up, pay attention, and do the quizzes you'll pass. Tests are pretty easy. Lectures are not boring.

Dr. Ogletree is a great guy. There are 3 midterms and a final, all on LearningSuite. He gives you exam and quiz guides; fill those out and you'll do fine. There is one project, and you grade yourself. He has easy attendance quizzes. He gives you conference talks, etc. to read, but tells you where the answers are for the quiz guides.
I enjoyed the class. pretty easy academically. be sure to study for the tests. the classwork (quizzes and attendance quizzes) are pretty easy. he loves his students and cares about what he teaches.
Very personable and wants all of his students to do well in his class
He does a really great job of being charismatic and is willing to get onto our level as students and help us understand what we need to know about marriage.

The class is very organized and structured. There are daily quizzes and attendance quizzes but the daily quizzes are open book and open neighbor. He is straightforward with the lecture and has a great sense of humor. The tests are harder than he makes them seem so be sure to plan and study more than you think in preparation for his exams.

He was a really nice guy, but I agree with another user that his stereotyping of men/women/marriage was not always in line with my views. He also included a lot of quotes about how the ideal wife would always put childbearing before any type of professional career, and did not include any indication that doing both is possible.

This is without a doubt one of the easiest classes I have taken at BYU. There is no challenge at all whatsoever. Bro Ogletree is a super sweet guy and is definitely well intentioned, but I definitely would recommend not taking his class if you are even remotely progressive at all. He isn't super open to that.

I am currently taking Eternal Families from Professor Ogletree. He is honestly such a good teacher. Everyday we had a 10 question quiz due before each class, but it was super easy and went right along with readings. Each class was a powerpoint lesson, however, they were fun and Professor Ogletree made them super fun! Would definitely take again!

Dr. Ogletree is a great teacher. His lectures are amazing, and I was able to learn a lot from them. His tests can be a bit tough, and require a lot of study and work. But overall the course is very fair, and if you are willing to put in the work you will get a lot out of it.

Dr. Ogletree is very passionate about his subject matter. He makes the subject matter enjoyable to hear about with many personal stories to supplement the lecture. The work load is minimal, however I think it has been more in years past with a graded paper and two month long project. His exams are straight off the study guides.
Great professor. Funny and personable. Is very flexible with deadlines and exams are pretty easy.

Dr. Ogletree is so kind and caring and I love how he teaches about the family. He is clear about what he expects from his students. He is hilarious and makes class very entertaining. He understands the challenges of our lives and can really connect with his students. Definitely a religion class that isn't loads of work which is the best!

Professor Ogletee really works with his students if they need to miss class or have other obligations. He is real and his lectures are entertaining. His tests can be pretty difficult because it is straight memorization from his slides.

Brother Ogletree was extremely knowledgeable about his subject, and that showed in his lectures. He had us buy the course packet to read all the talks for quizzes, but don't buy the packet if you don't have to because all of the talks can be easily Googled. I didn't love how sarcastic he was, because sometimes his sarcasm lost the Spirit.

Prof. Ogletree is nice, and he cares a lot about families. I did not like his teaching style, and it feels a bit pointless to go to class sometimes because the study guides and powerpoints are online, but you have to go to get the attendance quizzes. The tests feel pointless as well because it's rote memorization; they don't test concepts well.

He is a really good professor! The exams are pretty tough and are a pretty significant part of the grade, so studying the exam study guides throughout the semester is a good idea. He is really funny and has a very exciting and engaging teaching style!

I loved Ogletree's class, he's super funny and he tells you from day 1 what is expected. He is very fair and forgiving and prepares his students for his tests. Quizzes are directly in the readings and attendance quizzes are also easy. I also liked how he was able to see both sides of different issues and respectfully taught sensitive issues.

This class wasn't too hard, but the tests are straight memorization of quotes from apostles and lots of random statistics. As long as you fill out the study guides and put in the time to memorize them you'll get an A. If you're looking for something spiritually uplifting for your eternal family's credit definitely don't take it from Ogletree.
He is great and an easy A, take it from him.

Bro. Ogletree taught the Eternal Family this semester. I really enjoyed this class. He makes it very clear what you will be tested on and gives lots of opportunities to prepare for the exam. His goal is not to make class hard "what are you supposed to do when a potential eternal companion asks you what you got in Eternal Family and you say F?" haha

such an easy A. looked forward to coming to it because of his lectures and cool stories. online quizzes all super easy, you don't even have to read the assigned things. Test: super easy ! one look over your notes before and you'll get an A. He is super reasonable, will give assignment extenders and make your life super easy!!! TAKE IT FROM HIM

What you have to do to get an A is pretty simple. Show up, do the study guides and quizzes, and complete it. Overall, this class was decent quality and very easy. A good religion class for someone that doesn't want a super hard one.
Awesome. I loved my experience in his class.

Dr. Ogletree is so funny! His class is super easy too! He makes study guides from each lecture and then just takes questions from those study guides for the tests! If you're looking for a good religion class that's easy but you'll still learn in, take it from him!

He's a wonderful teacher and incredibly qualified. You will learn a ton, but be prepared to move quick. He flies through the lectures and sometimes forgets what's on the quizzes and exam study guides. Most often after class I have to go back and make sure I didn't miss anything. But overall I really love him and would 100% take from him again. :)

There is an attendance quiz for every class period. If you show up, you won't have any problem answering correctly. A reading quiz is due every day too, but all you have to do it skim the reading or search the page for key words. The textbook is a compilation of the readings, but I just pull the talks up online so I can search through them easier.

Dr Ogletree is one of the best professors I've had here at BYU. His lectures are always inspirational and always entertaining. The tests are a little difficult, but this class is worth it all the way! Dr Ogletree does all he can to help his students succeed. Definitely recommend!

Brother Ogletree is so kind-hearted, stress free, and a huge goofball. He always tells stories and they are either very funny or really touching. His assignments, quizzes, and tests are super easy. The test is practically just the study guide that you fill out each class period. EASY EASY DEFINITELY RECOMMEND!

Dr. Ogletree cares about his students and he is invested in teaching about eternal families. His lectures are good, but I don't think they are the best I've ever heard. He can be a little scatterbrained sometimes. He's funny and keeps the class entertained. The class is pretty easy if you just show up, but the tests are very specific.
Dr. Ogletree is an amazing professor. easy class but you learn A LOT. tests can be hard, but just make sure you study. I would totally take another class from Dr. Ogletree.

Dr. Ogletree is AWESOME. His lectures are interesting and he is hilarious. Assignments are pretty easy. Tests can be hard if you do not really know the notes, but shouldnt be too hard if you do. I would HIGHLY recommend taking any class from Dr. Ogletree.

Dr. Ogletree is very active in working with you to get the grade you want and understands that this is a required course. The assignments were easy and the tests are based on in-class study guides that usually don't make it too tricky. He worked with me multiple times throughout the semester to make up stuff I had missed or misunderstood.

Brother Ogletree is the best! He gives a 2 question attendance quiz every day which is super easy. He also gives quizzes for every lesson but he provides a quiz study guide that tells you exactly where to look in the textbook. tests are pretty easy if you take good notes in class!

If you can show up and listen in class you will be okay. He is funny and charismatic, I always enjoyed going to class. I would suggest getting the reading packet because the study guides for the quizzes have the page number and paragraph number on it so you don't even have to read that much. The lectures were great and applicable as well!

He lectures on touchy topics (abortion, gay marriage, gender). He's correct to teach the doctrine of the church but doesn't teach cautiously at all. Not for you if you get offended easily. Other than these, he's super funny and the class is a breeze. You can get all the notes from home as they're all on LS. His online tests can be tricky

Dr. Ogletree is awesome. The class is a pretty easy A as he gives you study guides for each lecture that you fill out during class and all exams are on learningsuite. I feel the spirit often in the class and find it refreshing considering the heavy load of all of my other classes this semester. I would highly recommend this class from Dr. Ogletree.

This class is definitely the easiest religion class I have taken thus far at BYU. There is a PowerPoint posted for every lecture and a study guide for every test. All of the tests are taken online through learning suite. There is an attendance quiz during every class, but they are super easy!

Prof Ogletree is the best. I loved his class. It was super easy and enjoyable. The tests were a breeze for me. They are 100 questions and you have 1 hour to take it. I would make quizlets and then study them through like 3 times and then I was able to complete the tests in 20-30 minutes each time and get at least a 90%! He's a great guy. Take him.

This class is full of test. These tests are 100 questions each except for the final which is only 50. This class also is VERY conservative. There are lots of claims that everything he says is based off of doctrine, but lots of the quotes are to support his own opinion
Brother Ogletree is the BEST! His class is really enjoyable and you learn a lot. It's super easy if you fill out the study guides. I would completely recommend his class to anyone.

Brother Ogletree is a great guy. He really wants you to learn in his class but he understands that this a religion class and shouldn't be your most difficult class at BYU. Not a lot of homework other than the online quizzes which are open note.
Love Brother Ogletree! Funny lectures and word for word quizes from the textbook. Attendance quizes every class, 3 exams online, and a final along with a self assessed attributes project.

Professor Ogletree is a great professor. He really cares about what he is teaching. I love that he has a personal practice as a marriage counselor because it makes everything he says concerning the Eternal Families topic so much more credible in my opinion. He is kind and willing to work with hard working students who want a good grade in his class

I loved Brother Ogletree. He was super down to earth and fun to listen to. His class is pretty easy. Easy Reading quizzes for each class that are found in his readings packet. I did all of the reading quizzes at the beginning of the semester and that like 40 % of your grade. Great to talk to and get advice from out of class too! Amazing class!
Dr. Ogletree is very educated and has great insights. I really enjoyed this class, and learned so much!! I would definitely recommend this class and this professor to everyone.

I really enjoyed taking his class! He is super personable and funny, and his lectures were always well organized and thought out. My only complaint is that the tests are 100 questions in an hour which I feel is kind of ridiculous. If you can survive that, however, the class will be an easy A for you. I would register for his other classes for sure.

Prof Ogletree is a fun professor. He has interesting lectures and tries to keep his class fairly involved. There are quizzes before each class on readings and short attendance quizzes. The hardest part about this class are the timed tests, (100 questions in 60 minutes) but if you study you'll be able to come out with an A in the class.

He's a good teacher, is a marriage counselor and is pretty cool. His lectures are good and funny, he puts alot of time into them. The tests he has are difficult, meaning that the multiple choice questions are testing you on whether you can remember what a general authority said rather than the doctrine.

Dr. Ogletree is an amazing professor! His lectures are mandatory, but he is super funny, and the lectures are never boring. His quizzes are easy, and he tells you not to do the reading, and just use the quiz study guides to get the points for the quizzes. All of his exams are online, and they are based off his study guides from class. Easy and fun!

Took it my first semester and highly recommend that to ease into religion classes! Fill out the study guides, and make flash cards after every class or a study tool right away so it doesn't pile up. Take advantage of extra credit, and use control F for quiz readings online. Tests are strict memorization, and there are some surprise ?s Love this guy

Great guy. Fun guy. Lectures are powerpoint heavy. You will learn some great stuff on the current first presidency and apostles. Straightforward tests, just basically memorize the study guide. Grading of the project was a little picky--not very clear criteria--but fair. Extra credit is easy to come by. Take living prophets from him.

Great religion class. I learned a lot, felt the spirit, and was not stressed out about my grade. Just use the study guides to study for the tests and you will get above a 95%. Also extra credit is easy and the project isn't hard. He is pretty funny and I left this class with a stronger testimony and desire to follow our modern day prophets.

I thought his class was great, I learned so much about living prophets! If you are looking for an easy A 2 credit religion, this is for you. (speaking as a busy pre-med junior) all you gotta do is go to class and pay attention. tests are super easy to study for it is just memorizing quotes and random facts, he gives you super clear study guides.

Not a super hard class, but if you aren't ready to study a ton for his timed tests you won't do well. He gives you an hour for 100 questions and gives 2 exams during finals. Plus if you don't raise your hand to participate in class or if you have to leave early to make it to another class he totally takes it personally.

Professor Ogletree has good stories and a well organized class, but the lectures lag a bit and there's not much student involvement. But he gives you access to quite a bit of resources to learn about the topic, and its not an exceptionally challenging course.

Prof. Ogletree is a great lecturer and teaches with passion. He is very understanding but he does expect effort from his students. Attendance IS part of your grade. If you miss more than 10% of classes you cannot earn an A.

This was a great class and I learned a lot from Professor Ogletree. Class is quite easy. There approx. one quiz per week. The study guides for tests are filled out in class and all questions are pulled directly from the study guides. There's a paper and a project but neither take too long and are a fine trade off for the easiness of the tests.
He was a great professor who didnt waste time or words but was still entertaining and engaging.

Brother Ogletree was by far one of the best religion teachers Ive had at BYU. He didnt get caught up in the academic side of the class but rather made sure his class was spiritually enriching. His lectures are so funny. Class got out early most days (2 hour night class) and the quizzes are open book, neighbor, etc. The tests are Easy.

Brother Ogletree's Eternal Family class is super! All of the quizzes and tests have study guides that are word for word what he will ask on the test. He focuses mostly on the spiritual side of families, while at the same time he is hilarious. Would 10/10 recommend.

Ogletree is a great teacher and he cares about is students. The quizzes are super easy (open book and note) and the tests are pretty easy too, it's just that you have to memorize a ton of quotes and stats from study guides and that is all the tests are. So, the tests aren't very spiritually uplifting or anything but if you study CAN be easy.

Brother O is a fantastic professor. He so knowledgable about the family dynamic. His class is a breeze if you keep up with all your assignments, and spend a little time studying for the tests (which he gives you awesome study guides for preparation).

This class is doable, you can get the grade you want and get some insight from the class. However, mostly busy work through every class lecture and that's what you are tested on. If you're looking for something spiritually uplifting as this is a religion class, take Eternal Families from someone else.

Brother Ogletree is a good professor. He has strong opinions about certain topics. He is hilarious and very entertaining. Honestly, I felt like he taught in a way that was more geared towards the tests rather than in a way that helped me strengthen my testimony and feel the spirit. The class was fine, but I guess I just wanted more out of it.

The first, statistics-filled lectures are admittedly hard to enjoy if you have stronger opinions, but it's worth it for the rest of the class. Tests are specific, but doing the study guides before taking them helps a lot. Great class for learning about not just marriage but also essential life skills and attributes.

Ogletree is kind, hilarious, and truly wants his students to succeed. He is generous, understanding, and ensures that you grasp the material and feel the spirit. I would take a religion class from Ogletree again & again, and I'm not just saying that because he gives extra credit opportunities. He's a real one, BYU needs more professors like him.

Brother Ogletree was a great professor, I loved his lectures. He's engaging and has a lot of great insights. My only complaint would be in his tests. They're pretty tough and you're graded on how well you can memorize about 100 quotes for each test which, for me, is a big minus.

I liked Prof. Ogletree for his lectures because they were entertaining and he would give you a study guide for what was important for the upcoming exam for individual lecture. Reading was tested by quizzes and not on exams while exams tested on lecture content. I found his exams to be difficult, make sure to study hard!

I LOVED Brother Ogletree!! I always looked forward to the lectures and always felt like I was learning so much. He is so funny and makes the lectures so fun! The homework was mainly reading quizzes which were all open book. He always had the best stories and really good insight. I definitely recommend Brother Ogletree!!

Dr. Ogletree is hilarious. All of his lectures were engaging and often included funny video clips from comedians or movies. Overall great teacher. Tests are a little tricky but if you go through the study guides it has a lot of the test answers.

Now here's a man with strong opinions. Not in a bad way. However, I as another strong-opinioned person sometimes disagreed with how he presented ideas. But, I was grateful for the chance to hear another person's reasoning and found that I learned a lot from his experiences as a marriage and family counselor and family man.

This was a class I didn't want to miss because not only was the information so good, but the delivery as well. I was shaking in laughter every class and I felt the spirit so often, teaching me of changes I need to make. There are a lot of quizzes but he basically gives you the answers, you just need to study hard for the tests. Overall, LOVED IT!!

Professor Ogletree is one of the best religion professors I've had at BYU. He knows the material well, and all of his lectures are interesting and edifying. The assignments in this class were simple but literally changed my life. He also genuinely cares about his students, even responding to personal emails about life challenges. Highly recommend!

Brother Olgetree was amazing!! He will make every class session worth going to. His quizzes are all open note but the exams are not. But he does make an exam study guide for each exam and will ALWAYS go over every answer.

Brother Ogletree is one of the best religion teachers I have ever had. He's right up there with John Bytheway. He is very easy to understand and he helps you past the class. He really wants you to learn rather than just go through a class for a grade. He is always available to answer any questions and gives extra help when needed. You won't regret.
Professor Ogletree has been one of my favorite professors. Attendance is very important to him, but it's enjoyable to go.
Class was fun, but test questions were oddly specific about quotes. Other than that, a great class and would definitely take again.
Lets you retake tests. Pretty easy

Bro. Ogletree shares some really good insights and uses a fun sense of humor to keep the class entertained. His powerpoints were loading with information, however, often times he would speed through material so that he could end class early. I would have enjoyed this class more if it didn't always end early or get cancelled.

Very kind and fun Professor. He does cover a lot of material in his lectures, but his lectures are very good. He provides an exam study guide for each lecture that you can fill out as he gives the lecture.

I really enjoyed Ogletree's class. He is a caring professor who is hilarious and entertaining. His class is structured well. Midterms and quizzes have study guides that prepare you very well. I learned a lot of interesting facts and stories about the living prophets and was strengthened spiritually as I took this class.

His tests are super specific and you can't use notes even though they are online. Just make sure to memorize the study guides. Note taking is easy in this class because you just fill in the blanks on the study guide. Know that stuff well and it will work out.
He is a great professor! His lectures are great and I definitely gained so much more love for the living prophets through his teachings.

Bro. Ogletree is an amazing professor. I loved his class and loved his lectures. He is funny and is really good at make class fun and getting participation. We had online quizzes due before each class to prepare us for the lecture and then a 5 page paper and a project that we did throughout the semester for homework but all were very doable!
He is an extremely kind and accommodating professor. You can learn a lot from him and he extremely respectful of all of his student.

Awesome teacher. I thoroughly enjoyed going to class every single time. Super interesting lectures and very straightforward class. Do the readings and you can get 100 on every homework quiz. Show up to lecture and he helps you fill out every single study guide which is then what the questions from the test are picked from. Definitely recommend!

Dr. Ogletree is a great professor, and he is experienced in researching family life. His class is easy and I loved the criteria, but in lectures I sometimes struggled to feel the spirit or didn't quite agree with the way he would teach some things. Super great class, easy A, but I wouldn't take Ogletree again.

Wonderful class! I was grateful to have a fun and spiritually uplifting class that I didn't have to stress about. Overall, it was a fairly easy class. Attendance is important, but you are given study guides for everything.
Fairly easy class but he focuses on obscure details and statistics so you have to memorize basically everything for exams

Best class I have ever taken at BYU. I didn't miss a class because I never wanted to miss the amazing Spirit that was there. Brother Ogletree has you laughing till you cry, while simultaneously crying because the Spirit is so powerful and touching. My conversion to the gospel and conviction to follow the prophet was strengthened so much.

Professor Ogletree is a really good teacher and he is SO FUNNY. But also, very spiritual. This class has reading quizzes due before every class but the reading is fun and there is a study guide for every quiz and test. Tests are very straightforward but you need to study!! You will not regret taking this class.

The test are pretty difficult. It's basically a hundred questions on statistics and quotes. Everything else in the class is okay and pretty doable. He generally wasn't able to cover all the material in class so you have to study the slides outside of class if you want to do well on the test. Only four absences were allowed.

Dr. Ogletree is a great religion professor! Attendance is required for a passing grade, but it's worth going. He's sometimes a little sporadic in his teaching, but he is passionate about the topics and really wants his students to learn. Worth taking, especially if you're looking for a religion class that doesn't take up all your time.

Dr. Ogletree is hands down the best religion professor I've had at BYU. His lectures are entertaining and he grades very fairly. There are reading quizzes every day but they are open book and super easy if you do the reading. He doesn't try to make things tricky, just wants to make sure you learned the material, like a religion class should be.

Professor Ogletree is AMAZING!!! Of course there's homework but there's really not that much. Quizzes are open book and the exam questions are straight from the study guide. Attendance is mandatory but his lecture is hilarious and inspiration so definitely worth going. Favorite religion class!

I learned a ton from Prof. Ogletree. He shares plenty of real-life experience that put marriage life into perspective. He's very straightforward and he gives study guides for every quiz and exam. He makes going to class a joy and not a chore. He teases lovingly. Would recommend this religion course and this professor to every BYU student.
Great Professor , entertaining , great insights. He likes participation in class so come prepared to learn
Brother Ogletree is a great professor. His classes were funny, and you learn a lot about the eternal family. He definitely knows what he is talking about when it comes to the family.
His lectures are interesting and he always makes you laugh! Would definitely take his class again.

He's a good teacher, and gives good lectures. A lot of good insights in class. The homework is easy. The only thing that really bugs me is the way he tests. You have to memorize a bunch of quotes, and that is pretty much what your texted on with the exception of knowing a couple theories or something.

Awesome teacher. Really cares about the subject and always has fun stories to tell. 4 tests (super easy), a paper, semester long project, and 1-2 quizzes a week. Sounds hard but is definitely doable. Lectures are bomb and he is always willing to work with his students.

He is a good teacher. Really passionate about what he teaches. He makes the class fun, and uses a lot of good humor with it. He really knows what he is talking about. I would recommend this class if you want to actually get something out of a religion class.
What a guy. 10/10 would recommend. Super easy class and I learned so much about the living prophets. He is so caring and so kind. Love this professor.
Professor Ogletree is a great choice! He's so hilarious and makes every class period fun and engaging. I have learned tons from his lectures and I would definitely take class from him again.

Talented professor that seems to know all of the behind-the-scenes facts of the General Authorities. If you don't like online tests, steer clear. Solid choice of professor for a class that is pretty neat.

Dr. Ogletree teaches a great religion class. He's inspirational and I learned a lot, but I didn't have to sacrifice all my time to do very well. Projects and essay were easy; tests contain lots of details but just study and you'll do fine.
Bro. O is amazing. He is super funny, kind and inspirational. His lessons always invite the spirit. If you are having a hard time with faith this is the class for you !!!

Super easy and simple class. Provides a study guide that you can memorize for each test. Some writing assignments that arent hard at all. He has. A good energy. If youre looking for an easy religion class, this is the class to take.

Attendance is mandatory, can skip one or two days I think. Specific study guides for tests and quizzes which have a lot of specific questions. One 5 page paper, one project, three tests and a final, online quizzes twice a week. Bro Ogletree is really funny and wise and really cares about the students. Uses real life anecdotes and examples to teach

Professor Ogletree is really invested in his students and the course material and he makes course lectures engaging and funny. The biggest thing I wish had been different would have been a bigger focus on the spiritual aspect of the course.
The only thing is that in his exams, you HAVE to know those quotes that you normally dismiss. You will need to know who said what in at least general terms. But he is very entertaining.
Great Professor, interesting lectures. Very helpful study guides for exams and quizzes.

Professor Ogletree is great. He tells really funny stories. You should attend his lectures because they are funny and informative, but also because he gives you study guides for the test and answers every test question on the study guides in his lectures. Reasonable work load quizzes are open book open note.

Brother Ogletree's class was so laid back and fun. I laughed every lecture and thoroughly enjoyed his lessons, especially when he would tell his own personal stories from his marriage and family. He has an online quiz due every class, but it's only 10 questions and open book (super easy). Tests are online and you have study guides for them.
Very passionate and wants to work one on one.

Dr. Ogletree has amazing lectures. He shares a lot of personal stories and has great class activities. The tests are a bit difficult as they are 100 questions and most of the questions require intense memorization on facts shared in class.

Dr. Ogletree is a great professor! His lectures are super interesting, and touch on lots of things you may not know or learn anywhere about the living prophets. There are lots of assignments, but they are all very easy. While you have to do the work to get the grade, he makes the projects meaningful and worth your time.

I would take this class every semester if I could. I learned a lot about marriage and families that I know will be beneficial in my future. Don't miss class because you miss out on a laugh and good advise. 10 out of 10 recommend!

I loved this class! He is funny and the material is very interesting. He gives study guides for the exams that go along with his class PowerPoints. the questions for the test come right from the study guide.

I loved taking this class from Brother Ogletree! He is really willing to help his students succeed in class. Classwork outside of class is minimal (just two open book quizzes you take each week and a couple projects). His lectures are so funny and I always left class feeling like I learned something new.

Awesome class! Learned a lot about the leaders of the church. Brother Ogletree is a great professor. There is an easy paper and an easy project along with quizzes due before each class. The test are so easy if you use the study questions. If you study those you can easily get high 90's or 100%

My biggest issue is the tests. They are 100 questions of multiple choice that are essentially memorized quotes. The majority of the problems go a bit like this "Elder Holland said you will learn to be happy as you rely on a God, b Jesus, c Holy Ghost, d Your Spouse". It kinda defeats the point of multiple choice. Hes a great lecturer though.
Brother Ogletree is AMAZING and this was the best class! Tests and homework is super manageable, and going to class is a MUST. But this was honestly the best class ever!
Enjoyed the class. However, there is definitely some work involved with this class. But, if you do the work the grading is fairly easy. The midterms were a little harder than most religion classes.
Amazing professor. If you have the chance to take a class from him you won't regret it.

Dr. Olgetree's class is very straightforward. The course covers a lot of content, but I didn't feel challenged by his class at all. I wish there was greater chance to actively participate in the class through discussions.

He is a cool prof. There are a few quizzes a week that are open book from the textbook. It is like $20. They are easy. There is an exam study guide for each unit he goes through in class. Just go, fill out the study guide while he presents and then study it. The tests are online. They are just like the study guides. There is 1 essay and 1 project.

Brother Ogletree was a teacher that enhanced learning through laughter. He helped you understand and comprehend topics while still having a good time. His quizzes took a little bit of reading, but the readings were valuable. Also didn't grade too difficulty on papers or assignments. If you do your best you can get an A in this class.
Awesome class! Learned so much and it is very do able. Would take the class over again! Great teacher, you won't regret the class.

This class is super easy as long as you go to class. you can take all the tests at home and there is a study guide that looks exactly like the tests. Ogletree is super relatable and his lectures are hilarious! I would take this class again or any other class taught by him!!

I really enjoyed the content of the class, and feel like I learned good things, but I was very unimpressed by the organization of the class. He would randomly open the quizzes and tests, and didn't even tell us what he expected from our final project for the semester until 4 days before it was due. Very disorganized.

Professor Ogletree is a very fair teacher and he's clear on what he wants you to learn. As long as you do the study guides he gives you and show up for class, it's an easy A. He's really good at responding to emails super fast and you NEVER EVER have to go to the testing center which is AMAZING. Super fair, super easy class

He's a wonderful professor! His lessons are very well planned and he's always prepared and helps make this class applicable to everyone! He wants us to focus more on the purpose of what we're learning and improving than our grade. We have a paper textbook but we only use that for the quizzes, and everything is online, so it's great!

Living Prophets or REL333 was easy enough. The only homework you really have is reading lots of conference talks and taking a quiz on them every lecture. (the quizzes are open note and book). The other two assignments he gives are fairly simple and easy. Then the midterm and final were from memorization, but he gives you all the answers.
