I loved this class! I really learned a lot about the family and marriage (this was the eternal families class). He is hilarious. The class wasn't hard at all, but I learned a lot. I would recommend it to anyone!

Brother Ogletree is awesome. I appreciated how he gives out study guides for both the quizzes and the exams, and if you find the answers in the readings and PowerPoints, you will get an A on every test for sure. Just know that he can tell when you write your papers half-heartedly, so just put a good amount of effort into them and it's fine.

Profesor Ogletree is one of the best religion professors I have ever had at BYU. He lays everything before you and makes things so easy to do. His lectures are so fun and entertaining and very spiritual. Definitely take a class from him!

Professor Ogletree made class enjoyable! He is a funny guy, who offers a lot of insights into living and growing in the gospel. It's pretty easy to get an A, just don't miss the quizzes. Overall, I feel like I learned quite a bit from the class, and I love that the powerpoints are accessible on learningsuite because there's a lot of good quotes :)

The only tough part are the exams. They tend to be focused on knowing quotes from General Authorities. However, if you study you'll do well. He is also a generous grader. All of the pre-class quizzes are open book. He's a great professor.

He's a good lecturer, and genuinely cares about his students and what they learn. I personally would prefer fewer jokes and more discussion. The class is on a lot of applications (there's not much doctrine to cover, so there's more details than range of subject matter). Tests are 100 Q MC, and require memorizing wording of quotes, so know the PPTs.

Brother Ogletree is such an awesome teacher. I've taken two classes from him and have learned so much. I love that he focuses the class on learning important life lessons and not on the assignments or the exams. He is hilarious and I always have fun in his class.

Ogletree is a super nice and funny guy. He was able to keep class interesting and fun, while not being too difficult. The quizzes are open-note and easy and as far as projects go, you have a paper and a semester-long project - both of which are very manageable. He cares about his students and it shows.

Professor Ogletree is amazing at what he teaches. No matter what your marital status is, you will learn so much. His focus is definitely on the spiritual side and all quizzes are open book/note. He provides study guides for the exams as well. He makes his lessons applicable and is hilarious, keeping them interactive and interesting.

Brother O is such a great teacher! He is really passionate about the material and really wants the students to succeed in life. Attending class is very enjoyable and he teaches clearly the principles and with great humor. The workload isn't too much: a quiz before most classes and tests online. Overall awesome teacher and a better man.

Professor Ogletree is awesome! Really focuses on learning, rather than grades. You have a reading quiz due almost every day of class, but they are easy if you do the readings. Three midterms, a paper, a project and a final. Very well-rounded course

This class is fun and very doable. The quizzes are easy if you use the reading, and the tests are alright. Just make sure you memorize the study guides and be prepared for few random questions thrown in. Brother Ogletree is very funny and genuinely cares about his students. Overall, I enjoyed the class.
The class is awesome, you learn a lot. The tests are pretty difficult though, you have to memorize the study guides if you want to do well.

This guy is fun. He tries his best to get to know his classes . The quizzes and tests are both extremely doable, some studying for the tests and you are set. He has two papers but if done, will help you a lot more as a person plus they are pretty easy to write. His lectures are awesome, funny, and relatable.

This class is what a BYU religion class should be. Several quizzes a week with reasonable readings. The midterms didn't contain any curve balls and could be completed on Learning Suite in our own time. Their were two papers due at the end of the semester, but they were fun to write.
Easy class and he was super understanding with grading. Did not love his lectures and felt like what was in the tests was not always doctrine.
He is an incredible Teacher! He teaches in a very clear way and you learn everything in class. I really enjoy his classes!
I think that his intentions are good, but the tests are hard to memorize if you don't like to give religion classes your priority. Also some of the doctrine in the quizzes can be shady at times.
He is a very efficient teacher. If you come to class, do the homework, and listen you will have a very uplifting experience. He is a very easygoing and Christlike kind of guy.

Great teacher, and really career about you as an individual. If you come to class, and do the homework you will get an easy A. This class also gave you a great guideline that will prepare you to be a great spouse.

Open book quizzes were easy. Each lesson had an exam study guide but you were probably only going to be tested on 10 of the 30 questions they had. Exams were extremely specific, but could be retaken. Mandatory attendance even though you could easily find the info in PowerPoints. First religion professor I have had that I haven't liked.

I loved Brother Ogletree! I wish he taught more classes because he is such a fun and hilarious teacher! He has just the best personality. I feel like I really learned a lot in his class and it was pretty easy too. I loved this class! Totally recommend!!

Good professor. Class was very easy (as all religion classes should be), and he did a good job teaching some awkward topics, like sex and marriage. He lets you retake tests if you ask, and his quizzes are all open-book.
I had a great experience with Professor Ogletree. His lectures are hilarious and insightful. The class is also super easy as long as you use his many study guides.

Brother O is the coolest guy. He always has amazing stories to tell and always makes his lectures interesting. His exams are a little brutal because they're so specific, but besides that the class is a breeze. Loved every minute of Eternal Families with him.

Brother Ogletree is the best religion teacher I have had at BYU. He makes things insanely clear. He gives study guides for all Exams and quizzes and the questions are usually straight from the study guides. His classes are awesome too he makes you feel so welcome and you are not worried about taking a ton of notes because you have they study guide.

Brother Ogletree is super likable and really knows his stuff. He is funny and the class itself is a real good time. There is lots of participation and growth in the class. There is one 5 page paper you write. The midterms are online and he gives study guides. The HW is also easy.

Overall great teacher and great guy. Lectures were spiritual and inclusive. We had several quizzes every week but all of the answers were easily found in the readings packet. He opened tests randomly which was odd.

He has many great stories that help you take the material to a more personal level. I learned so much about myself, the gospel, and family and truly believe this class helped me in preparing for my marriage. He is a fabulous lecturer and professor and I would take an religion class from him!

Prof. Ogletree is hilarious. You can tell he is really passionate about what he teaches. There are weekly quizzes, but he usually opens them pretty far in advance so you can do them whenever. He normally just reads stuff off slides but he's super charismatic and doesn't look like he'd be one to joke around he is pretty chill.
This is one of the best professors I've had at BYU. I would highly recommend him and any of his classes. Makes class fun and inviting.

Professor Ogletree is a wonderful instructor. He is way chill, his class is an easy A, he is passionate about living prophets and respects and reveres them, he is kind to his students, easy to reach and has a good sense of humor and his class was very enjoyable. Love him as a professor!

He is a great professor, he is clear and the class is easy. You can tell that he is passionate about the Prophets and apostles. The tests are all online and he makes it very easy for you to actually learn without having to stress crazy hard about a heavy work load. 11/10

Living Prophets was one of the best classes I've taken at BYU. Brother Ogletree is very clear and reasonable in his expectations for success. I loved the lectures and found them informative and spiritually uplifting. 10/10.
Fun class. Focused on the life stories of the prophets more than their actual teachings. Def would recommend.
Too many exams for the class, never opened up assignments on time so we had no idea how many quizzes or tests there would be. Other than being a very vague class, the content was interesting.

For a religion class, he adds a lot of spirituality into the academic lectures. There are quizzes for every class, but they are relatively easy. There is a paper and experiential learning project; both not too difficult. If Learning Suite was down, he would extend the deadlines for quizzes.

I never write these reviews but straight up, Brother Ogletree is one of the best professors I've had and this class is awesome! Incredibly easy and useful as well. He does a great job teaching about the Living Prophets. All assignments are relevant and he gives awesome study guides for the tests. Easy course! Fun course.

Professor Ogletree is awesome. He really cares about his students and is willing to work to get you the best grade possible. His class expectations are really straight forward and there are very few assigments throughout the semester.

honestly, a boring and useless class overall, but was pretty easy so I kept it. Basically just reads through PowerPoint quoting what general authorities have said about various parts of marriage, some of which is pretty outdated, stuck in the nuclear age kind of stuff. It's not very hard though, so might be worth to stick with him.
Great teacher, hilarious, great guy! Loved taking his class.

I love Brother Ogletree! Living prophets was one of the best religion classes I have ever taken. I learned a lot about the prophets and apostles while it still being really easy to do well in the class. He genuinely cares about the students and if you are not doing well, he provides you with opportunities to get a better grade!!! TAKE THIS CLASS

Ogletree's class is pretty easy. Attendance is mandatory, but the classes are enjoyable. He posts study guides for each class that you can fill out when he gives the lectures. There is a project and a 10 page paper, but other than that, the class is very low stress.

I have known him since I was very little, and he has lost nothing of his quick witted humor that leaves one on the floor. He's very passionate about helping others really understand the doctrine of having a passionate and eternal marriage. Asks wonderful, throught provoking questions, and is linient enough to where I never felt overwhelmed.

Dr. Ogletree tried really hard to make classes work for his students, but sometimes it was uncomfortable in his classroom. Some subjects were up to date with what the prophet is teaching, some subjects were borderline.
Ogletree is a great professor. A great mix of hilarious and spiritual. He wants you to succeed!

I highly recommend Ogletree. He is really funny and I always look forward to going to his class. I do dislike his tests. You fill out study guides during class and then for the tests he takes random questions from them. My problem is that I feel like there is too much info on the study guides to remember. But I loved this class otherwise.
Ogletree is the man. Very funny. He just cares that you come to class and pay attention. Exams are on learningsuite and the questions come from study guides.

Bro. Ogletree is a great guy! His lectures are very specific and filled with great doctrine. I loved attending his class. Only complaint was that his tests were basically just memorizing the study guides and vomiting them up on the test.
Great religion class, not very difficult.
Mark is an amazing teacher and makes learning so fun. He is very respectful of those in his class and their time and concerns. I definitely would take another class from him.
I love Professor Ogletree, he is hilarious. I feel like I learned a lot but he really speeds through the material. The tests are word for word the study guide.
Tests are a little harsh. 100 questions in 60 min but is not impossible.

I love Professor Ogletrees classes! Just quizzes for each class, one paper, a project, and then 4 exams. The only thing I don't like is the third exam and final are both right at the end of the semester. Otherwise, pretty easy A and great class!

The BEST professor for the eternal family class. the lectures are interactive/entertaining. i always looked forward to attending this class. there are weekly online quizzes from the reading but he gives you the page number on where to find each answers to the question. the tests are also online and easy if you fill out the study guides.

Ogletree is funny and sarcastic , I liked that. He reads a lot from the slides which make his classes kinda boring. On the other hand, is not a hard class and he is always willing to help students. Allowed us to take the midterm again 'cause we didn't do well and his quizzes were super easy. Study the guides and you'll get an A

Professor Ogletree really can be a friend. He is concerned with your success, understands how it feels to be a student and will work with you. Lectures were good, but class format is so focused on filling out study guides from the lecture slides that its hard to fully appreciate them and the tests are basically memorizing those study guide.
This class was incredible!! He relates well to the students and teaches us stuff we can really apply in dating and marriage. Definitely my favorite religion class so far!
I really enjoyed being in class. I learned a lot too. Generally though, Dr. Ogletree is awesome!
Seriously an awesome teacher, he really cares about his students.
Don't really need textbook if you are good at googling stuff. Quiz is open book, notes, etc. Easy exams. Easy class. Need something easy? Take this!

The class was very applicable to our daily lives. Most of the topics were related to actual questions that people have on topics such as how to deal with intimacy in marriage, and attributes that might help you in other senses. Quizzes are simple, and if you want to save time, make sure to follow the classes filling out the study guides provided.

Professor Ogletree is a GREAT choice! You DO NOT have to be married or dating to take this class, in fact I suggest you not to be. The homework is the easiest, he gives you the answers to all the questions and where to find them in the textbook. He gives answers to study guide in class. You can retake the first exam (which are online). Extra credit

Nice man, class is funny and mostly engaging. Quizzes are easy. Biggest complaint is the tests. The questions are a lot of statistics and remembering very specific details that aren't usually all that useful. Q's would be a lot of "who said this;" every answer might be something they said in the past, but he wants you to remember a specific talk.

I assumed a religion professor would apply the balance of justice and mercy when it came to his teaching philosophy. However, when it comes to late work and extenuating circumstances that gospel principle is thrown out the door. Otherwise he's great.

This guy is SOLID! He really teaches things in a way that accurately relates them to real life. He has a great understanding of the outside world and perspectives of other religions which I think enhances his personal ideas and teaching methods! GREAT GUY

Professor Ogletree was great! I really enjoyed his views on marriage. He really supports the traditional view on marriage, and it was quite an entertaining class. I felt myself be spiritually uplifted, but at the same time I found myself laughing all the time! The tests were pretty straightforward, just memorize the study guides and you'll be fine.

Brother Ogletree is passionate about the family and it shows. He has strong traditional views, and his tests reflect that. If you read the textbook and really study the lecture notes and study guides you'll do fine. He responds to emails quickly and is willing to work with you if you talk to him. I enjoyed his class!

Really great class! He knows the subject really well and teaches it very clearly. The only downside was that we skipped a few chapters but were still tested on them. Over all great class. The study guides he gave us were really clear and fitted to the test.

Brother Ogletree is amazing!! He invites the Spirit but he is also hilarious! You have quizzes based on readings but they aren't too hard and the exams are mostly memorization but not too bad if you do what's required. Great class!! I would recommend it!!

He is a great teacher! He is very helpful, caring and understanding. He truly wants you to succeed in this class. He also responds quickly to emails. I learned so much from his eternal families class, and it was all so applicable and relevant for life. If read, take the quizzes, and study for exams you will do well! Take this class from him!
He is a good teacher. Good spiritual lessons! There are reading hw quizzes before every class and a 5 pg paper at the end that was rough, but overall a solid class.

I took Eternal Families. Bishop Ogletree is the best religion professor I've ever had. His lectures are amazing. He cares about you and your grade. He funny and engaging. All tests and quizzes are online. I really enjoyed his class
Great class and I learned a lot, but his midterms test a lot on memorization and not on topics. If you're great at memorization then you'll do just fine.

Brother Ogletree is a funny professor and makes the class interesting with a lot of stories. The class itself wasn't hard, but it went too fast and we skipped a lot of the content needed for the class.

Brother Ogletree was an exceptional person. His class was not hard. Reading quizzes come with a study guide that tells you where the answers are, so basically, the reading wasn't required if you just skim for answers. Which you'll need to do because each lesson has like 30 pages of reading. Easy A.

Good class, however in the spring term he skipped many different lessons that were usually taught in the fall and that just caused a lot of out of class work because he didnt adjust the tests to fit with the abbreviated semester.
Super funny, but his powerpoints are hard to follow. ALso very forgiving

Brother Ogletree is a nice and super funny guy, but his class is organized in the worst way. It is really distracting to fill out the guide and there is a lot of random stuff thrown in as busy work to do outside of class. Theres reading quizzes on materials that aren't discussed in class. It is a good religion class, but it was not my favorite.

Professor Ogletree is a great teacher. He is so willing to help you and wants to see you succeed. He is very engaging in this topic and very educated. I would take him again just for the easy A. Because it is an Eternal Family class at BYU, expect to have a very conservative outlook on things. He is usually very politically correct though.

Class mainly consists of going through a power point and reading quotes and filling out a study guide. Tests are very specific so make sure and really study all the quote "fill-in-the-blanks" and statistics. Overall did not learn a lot but teacher is a nice guy.

If you love reading quotes out of context from 1970's Apostles this is the class for you. Slideshows are long and not particularly engaging. Quotes are pulled to support all your favorite false doctrines about the family. Not overly impressed with any aspect of this course.

I loved taking this class from Professor Ogletree! If you want a religion professor that you can get an easy A from but still learn so much then take his class. His lectures are entertaining and he only requires one paper, open book quizzes, and a few exams that are all about memorizing answers. Take this class from him!

Professor Ogletree is a really nice guy and his lectures are upbeat and interesting with lot's of stories. I enjoyed the class well enough but always feel stressed & unsure of expectations. I took his class (The Eternal Family) during a term rather than a full semester & I felt his lectures were rushed and his class disorganized.

I loved this class. Professor Olgetree is an amazing teacher who always brings the spirit to every class. You have open note quizzes due before each class and then closed book online tests. I would take any and every religion class from Professor Olgetree. He is genuine, funny, and connects really well to us students.

Professor Ogletree is amazing. I loved his sense of humor and his view of the gospel. Eternal Family is such a awesome class and I think its great that BYU requires it. So may people need it. Take it from Professor Ogletree!
I really loved this class and he was a super good teacher. He told lots of stories and I got a lot out of his lessons.

Brother Ogletree is a great teacher! I took Eternal Families from him and he does a great job at doing his best to make the course engaging and interesting. Overall he is funny and I really enjoyed taking this class from him, and would recommend to anyone. His tests are a little challenging, a lot of quote memorization and long study guides.
Very funny guy. I really liked the class, as long as you attend and take the quizzes you will be fine!
Tests do require a bit of memorization of material. Other than that just take all the quizzes and go to class and itll be easy and interesting.

A great teacher with interesting topics and insights for his Eternal Family class. Really funny too and is respectful to his students and willing to talk with them. He offers extra credit too and assignments are not too hard. Just make sure to always be in class.

I really enjoyed taking Eternal families from Professor Ogletree. His lectures are amazing. He is really funny and has lots of personal examples from his own life and other marriages he has observed. He also gives quite a few extra credit opportunities and the tests are taken directly from the study guides. I would 100% recommend him.
Brother Ogletree was a wonderful teacher who really wanted his students to learn. He was very understanding and helpful. GREAT CHOICE! I learned so much.
Dr. Ogletree is hilarious. He basically gives you the answers to the test on the study guide. He helped me learn just out of the desire of learning. I really loved this class.
Do your assignment and quizzes and go through the study guide. The professor is hilarious and makes class fun by involving everyone. I loved the class and I really learned a lot.

Dr. Ogletree is a very good teacher. His exams are very specific for being closed book and closed not, but the study guides he gives you make them very doable. His course material is excellent and he never dodges hard questions. I definitely enjoyed his class.

The professor was approachable and helpful to students. Homework was to read 3 talks and take a 10 question quiz for each lesson, which was open-book. Final project a 5 pg. paper, easy. Teaches well, but I felt like the tests were too specific for the amount of material covered. It was a bit difficult to remember all the necessary details.

I really enjoyed Professor Ogletree's class and would recommend taking it from him. I learned a lot but never felt too overwhelmed with assignments, readings, or exams. As long as you go to class each day and stay on top of the weekly quizzes you'll get a good grade. Plus his lectures are interesting and entertaining so it's easy to pay attention.

Great Teacher, but if you miss any quizzes thing get bad quick. Also the Essentials Paper (5 pages double spaced) kinda comes at the wrong time, right when finals are coming and you've got enough to worry about.

Eternal Families Class. He covered a number of touchy subject matters tactfully and facilitated an intriguing class about dating, marriage, and family. The reading outside of class is heavy (2-3 talks/devotionals/essays, a study guide, and test between each class). Tests are quite subjective. However, I would take again in a heatbeat.

This was a great class. It was fast paced for the shorter term but it was still fairly easy. Minimal work outside of class other than test preparation and some papers. Super insightful, very helpful in understanding relationships and the importance of family and marriage.

Attendance was required, but if you talk to him he'll probably let you miss a day or two. His study guides were very helpful for the tests. Fill them out while he's lecturing! The readings and lectures can be long, but they are very interesting.

He's a very good teacher and it's very clear what he expects. He posts all powerpoints, which are important for the tests, and quizzes are open book. He really knows what he's talking about but isn't one of those religion professors that thinks he's the all that, which is great. Good man, good class.

Dr. Ogletree is a great professor. You can tell that he sincerely cares about his students and keeps lectures really entertaining. His course is very easy. There are a few open book quizzes, tests that he gives you a study guide for, and a paper. Lots of times students want a easy religion class, and this is it. Would recommend to anyone.

Professor Ogletree does a great job with this class. He definitely gears the class more towards people who are still single rather than focusing on people who are already married, which makes sense since most people in the class are single. You get as much out of the class as you put into it. Overall a good class with clear expectations.
Professor Ogletree is an awesome, laid back professor. The quizzes are really easy if you use the study guides and the tests are easy as well. He is also hilarious! Take this class!

Professor Ogletree is a great professor! He made this class really enjoyable and easy enough for a good grade. As long as you do all the quizzes and study for the exams, you'll do great. Classes are full of doctrine, but he makes it funny and easy to stay awake during his lectures.

The one thing is some of the test questions are not so much if you understand the material, it is simply if you can remember who said what... That being said the information you need to do this is provided on the study guide.

I loved this class! I felt like the professor was very passionate and knowledgeable about his material. He made the class very intriguing and exciting to attend ! Definitely would recommend this class and professor to others!
He is great at lecturing- very funny and spiritually uplifting!
Hes a good speaker but not such a great teacher. Interesting content but just jumps from topic to topic and expects you to remember direct quotes for the tests.

Great lecturer, and very enjoyable. Brother Ogletree is down to earth and real, as well as says it how it is. I felt like he respected us as students and expected us to do the same. There were a few quizzes every week that were not related to the test directly, but did help. The tests were just info memorization, but overall great class.

Prof. Ogletree was great. I had him for Eternal Family in the evening. He gave great insights in class and referenced awesome quotes about eternal families. His lectures are more info based than spiritual based, but it was a good, easy class

Quizzes and exams are VERY heavy in specific (and somewhat random) quotes and statistics. Some are good quotes from apostles about the eternal family or significant statistics from a PEW research study, but others are from loosely related personal stories he told in class or quotes from obscure people. Lots of content, but not all pure doctrine.
Very fun outgoing professor. Very knowledgeable and understanding. Every class a fun class.. highly recommended!

I really liked Professor Olgetree's class! I felt like the content of the class was interesting and overall the class was pretty easy. There is lots of readings, but it is not super important to do well in the class. That being said, I enjoyed the reading.

Bro Ogletree really is an awesome guy! He doesnt allow much discussion in class so it feels like he is just throwing tons of stats and quotes at you. The quizzes are super easy, open book and open note. But the tests are a little more difficult but he is super willing to work with you and bring your grade up. He is a really understanding guy!
Great teacher!

Quizzes are easy and open book and most of the readings are online. Tests weren't terrible. Not a good class if you're already married as he talks about dating a lot. Ogletree is really conservative and I didn't really agree with a lot of the things he talked about. Avoid taking from him if your testimony is struggling.

Getting an A is definitely possible but class discussions and tests were frustrating. There were 4 exams in a 6 week term. All with 100 questions of biased questions. Questions on the tests were ambiguous and based purely off of his own opinions. I had a hard time with his stereotypes and conservative views.

I really loved this class! I learned so much doctrine that I never knew before, and I feel like I got a lot of great advice about how to succeed in marriage. It's easy to get a good grade as long as you do the quizzes and know the study guides well for the tests.
Great Professor!
Tests and quizzes are not too difficult. Wass willing to work with you on grades/missing class etc.
Tests and quizzes are easy if you study for them! Hes super willing to work with you.
Really enjoyed this course! Took it during Spring semester and the work load wasn't too bad. Really enjoyed going to lecture and gleaning from Professor Ogletree's insights.

This professor is awesome, his lectures on the family and the importance of marriage were awesome and insightful. He focuses more on the needs of the students than the coursework. He's hilarious and keeps students engaged with his lessons.

Ogletree is hilarious! Being The Eternal Family, this class is about marriage, so be prepared to feel guilty if it's been 2 years since you got home from the mission and you're still not married. Nevertheless, he helps explain the doctrine behind it so clearly, and he does it with so much love. I loved this class so much.
Awesome professor. The lectures were insightful and I left each time feeling benefitted and like I had learned something. I would definitely take another class from him.
Funny and nice guy. I would take any of his classes again. He's easy to work with and has always been prompt and considerate when working with me.

I took his REL C 200 class over Spring semester, and he definitely made the longer class block bearable. The homework quizzes are super easy, all the answers are straight from the reading. The tests are definitely straight memorization of quotes, but if you do the study guide it will be super easy. Professor Ogletree is the man.
I really enjoyed this class! He's a professor who genuinely cares about his students. Be sure you follow the study guides for tests and quizzes and come to class and you'll do great!
Very accessible and eager to help students learn. Will require real work but if willing to do your best you can earn a good grade.

Professor Ogletree is an excellent teacher for Eternal Families! He cares about the students, answers any questions you might have, and the class is fairly straightforward and organized. 4 exams taken online, with easy quizzes due before each class, and a couple papers. I highly recommend Professor Ogletree!

Good class, fair in tests, not a lot of homework, and quizzes are open book. The class is very entertaining so is hard to not have a good time. Test are large, but if you answer the study guide provided, the test will be easier.

Bro. Ogletree IS THE ABSOLUTE BEST!! Don't listen to anyone's reviews about him being hard. If you show up, do your quizzes, it'll be the EASIEST "A" at BYU. You do quizzes together with your friends. The test are exactly like the study guide. Take it from Ogletree if you want to take the easiest class offered at BYU. Amazing guy, amazing teaching.
Cares more about students than grades. Wants students to succeed.

I did not enjoy the way Dr. Ogletree taught. He is very closed minded and he doesn't explore other opinions or thoughts. Everything is based on quotes or statistics, but there is very little research about marriage or families and how those are created. I didn't feel like my perspectives or beliefs were opened or expanded.
I loved this class. He's a great teacher and really entertains you especially about his specific topic of Eternal Families. Really good guy who will work with you.

Brother Ogletree is hilarious and makes going to class super enjoyable. There are daily quizzes but it's open book and super easy. The only challenging part of this class are the tests, which are pretty detailed and specific. But overall, I think Brother Ogletree is a wonderful teacher and really great to work with!

Professor Ogletree really helps us understand why the class is applicable to our lives now and in the future. He does a great job at working with student athletes to help them make up the things that they miss when they are gone. Sometimes he makes comments that are hard to understand from a non-mormon standpoint.

He's fantastic, and I love the stories he shares. He is very flexible with university excused absences for performing companies and things like that, and it's not difficult to catch up on what you missed. His tests are very memorization and quote-heavy, & his study guides are ridiculously long, but every test question will be on it. It's worth it!

Olgetree is AMAZING. His idea of a religion class is that it shouldn't be the hardest class you take that semester. He expects you to show up and do the work but doesn't want to see you fail. Extra credit is available and the tests are based off the study guides. Come to class, take notes, fill out the study guides, memorize them, you'll get an A.

Really nice lectures covering a lot of good content. He keeps things light and funny with the students while keeping people engaged. The tests though are a little intensive for a religion class. 3 midterms with 100 questions each in only 60 min and a 50 question comprehensive final. Good class overall though.

His tests are 100 Q using all material from his 60-70 slide long presentations per class period, you have to memorize 100+ quotes or statistics from his slides. The study guide should be everything on the test, but the answers are not always on the slides like he says they are. Quizzes due before each class period- open book. 1 Project, 2 Papers.
Very inspiring lectures. If you take Eternal Families, take it from him.
Great professor and great class! He really cares about his students and is accommodating if you mess up. Nice guy and good lecturer.
Professor Ogletree is so amazing and I highly recommend this class. You have quizzes before each lecture but they are very uplifting and easy. You receive a study guide for everything.

Dr. Mark Ogletree is a great instructor who cares about you! He offers extra credit, is very easy to work with If you communicate with him. He want you to learn and participate in class! There are daily quizzes, but the study guides tell you what page and paragraph the answers can be found! He wants you to Learn rather then play the Study Hard game
Dr. Ogletree is so funny and personable. I always looked forward to lecture and he really knows his stuff.
Dr. Ogletree is a very open and palpable instructor. Ample opportunities for extra credit and understanding to circumstances. He lays the content out neatly and encourages us to learn.
Great professor and a great guy. Very willing to work with students and his classes are very entertaining. My favorite religion teacher so far at BYU

I loved taking this class from Bro. Ogletree, he presented the doctrine in a way that really helped bring the spirit into the learning. His tests were kind of hard, but only because they were so detail specific, but if you don't do well, he raises your grade up to at least a 70. Would definitely take another class from him!
Dr. Ogletree was an amazing professor. He was entertaining and you didn't get bored in his classes. I appreciated the spirit he brought to class, and his testimony of what he taught.
Really easy class to pass and get an easy A

Professor Ogletree was a teacher for this class! He makes every class really enjoyable. He definitely knows what he is talking about. He is a kind and personable teacher and really funny. You need to attend class and the readings came from a packet that he compiled. This class is easy to pass if you do the work, and it is enjoyable.
Prof. Ogletree made class SO FUN! He is very kind and understanding to each individual student. Honestly one of the best religion professors I've had! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!!

Dr. Ogletree is fantastic! Some test questions are a little tricky because a lot of answers are very similar and specific, but I LOVED his lectures and was genuinely inspired to become a better person.

Brother Ogletree is a great professor that is super helpful and super funny. His classes are very enjoyable. His tests are difficult because you have 60 minutes to answer 100 questions so be sure that you have the study guide down. The readings aren't hard and the quizzes aren't difficult either. Overall great class!

Prof. Ogletree is awesome. He is way funny and knows his stuff about family. His class isnt really that hard. You have quizzes every week but they are open book. His tests are 100 questions in 60 minutes. They are pretty intense but if you use the study guide you should be fine.

Great class! Dr. Ogletree does a good job of making class fun and he's a super down to earth guy. I did think that some of the test questions were kinda dumb but if you fill out his study guides then you'll do well on the test.
Professor Ogletree is a committed professor who obviously puts a lot of effort into preparing this course and his lectures
Professor Ogletree is so funny and makes class so enjoyable. He gives you good study guides that are basically the test questions word for word so if you do the study guides, you'll get an A.
Great teacher. Fun and precise on what we need to know for tests. He just requires you to go to class. I would recommend the evening class, which is once a week.

Brother Ogletree is such a fun professor and makes this course actually very fun and entertaining. His lectures are hilarious! He has 2 online quizzes each week that need to be done before class. The quizzes are 10 points each are fairly easy. However, his tests are weighted very heavily but manageable as long as you prepare for them. GREAT CLASS.
Brother Ogletree is the bomb. He turns what could be boring lectures into awesome and interesting class periods. His tests can be tricky but if you study the study guide enough it should be a breeze.

Professor Ogletree was thoughtful and engaging. I often didn't agree with his views on the approved gospel lifestyle, but his was probably more church-approved, so I really can't complain. He is an entertaining lecturer, but his tests are based on material that often wasn't to be found on his slides or in lecture. That was frustrating.

Ogletree's class consists of quizzes due every class, 3 midterms, an attributes project, a 5 page paper, and the final exam. He is a fair grader and always give multiple extra credit opportunities. Attendance is mandatory. If you miss 3 you won't pass the class. But Prof Ogletree is my favorite teacher! I take him every time. He's such a goof.

Dr. Ogletree is a really fun professor. He's a family and relationships counselor, so he's definitely qualified to teach Eternal Families. There's a quiz due every day before class, but they aren't too hard. The tests, however, are super specific and harder than you would think.

I actually took RELC 200 but that was not an option on rate my professor. I took eternal families and loved it! Professor Ogletree is very knowledgeable on the family and is passionate about teaching. He really cares about his students and is always willing to work with them.

Brother Ogletree is really passionate about the gospel and made the lessons interesting. He is hilarious, but sometimes he gets mad when you leave early or talk during class (understandable); however, he is kind of pissed of the rest of the class. His class is very easy but very disorganized. Overall, I enjoyed taking his class for RELC 200.

Professor Ogletree is a great teacher. He makes lessons entertaining but spiritual as well. He caused me to reflect on myself and my personal family relationships and showed me how to improve. He's a really hilarious guy too. My only complaint is that the tests are purely based on memorization, and sometimes not even of important facts.
He's really funny and keeps the class entertaining and fun! if you do your work you'll get a good grade

Professor Ogletree is a great teacher! His lectures are funny and entertaining. There are quizzes every week that are open book so super easy! He is really accommodating and understanding of the students. I would totally take from him again!!
Great Guy! Fun Class.
His classes are the best. He listens to everything a student's needs and cares. His religion class is so inspirational and I have been able to learn so much about him.

Professor Ogletree is very passionate about the family. Tests can be difficult, but the rest of the assignments are very reasonable. I took the evening class so all of the tests were online, and open for a long amount of time so very easy to work around your schedule.
He is a really fun teacher. He is very understanding. While he is very traditional, he also is very open to other viewpoints.
Brother Ogletree is the very embodiment of the classic chivalric virtues. He is full of hope, chastity, resolution and valour. I would follow him into battle any day.

Mark Ogletree was an excellent professor, and made it clear what the focus of each lecture was. Further, the assignments were clearly explained with generous due dates and forgiving grading criteria (just follow the instructions, but no short-cuts). However, the material on the exams did not necessarily follow the content presented in class.
Brother Ogleetree was a very flexible professor and really helped me throughout my hectic schedule. Was a pleasure to have!
My favorite religion professor! His lectures were fun and amazing.
Brother Ogletreeis a very good professor that cares more about helping educate the his students than making his class difficult. High quality class and easy A.

Bro. Ogletree is really funny and very intelligent. He knows his information and I love hearing his personal stories. There is a quiz due before every class. He has really great study guides to help on quizzes and tests.
He gives a lot of good information!! He can be funny too. Just fill out the study guide during each lecture, and you will be perfectly fine!!

Professor Ogletree is the best!!! All of his quizzes and tests are online, even for the finals. So it is super nice not to have to go to the testing center. He is hilarious!! I always looked forward to going to his lectures. We don't really have a textbook, it's more like a readings packet. Professor Ogletree is very understanding of students.

The tests are way harder than you think... very specific questions about what certain people said. The first test was quite a surprise in that way and kind of ruined my chances of an A for the rest of the semester which was super annoying.

The Eternal Family was a very enjoyable class with Brother Ogletree. He always made class fun and learning was easy. Don't miss more than three class periods and always check due dates. He posts everything online and reminds you, so honestly if you miss anything, or turn it in late it's basically your own fault. Not a hard class, he's great!

Class is entertaining and educational; don't skip it. He puts effort into knowing everyone. daily quizzes prep you well for class discussion, and he offers a good amount of extra credit. However, his exams are long, and his guides for them are a little out of date. Would also be nice if the daily quiz material was more related to the test material.

Brother Ogletree has a policy that if you miss more than 3 classes then he will take 25 points off of your final exam grade. However, his lectures are so fun that you won't even want to miss anyways :) There's a quiz due before every class but he gives you a study guide that is basically the quiz, so it's super easy!

Prof Ogletree made the class lighthearted, which was nice. The tests are pretty specific, so be ready to use those study guides. The class overall was easy. They didn't have a tag for RELC200, which was the class I was in, but it doesn't really matter.
Professor ogletree is amazing! His class is so entertaining, and you learn a lot! he shows really funny videos and has some great stories. Class is super easy, not hard at all to get an A.

Professor Ogletree is a great professor. His classes keep you interested and aren't insanely difficult, however, you still need to do your work. He cares for his students and will make time to help you.

He know everyone's names, and really cares about the individual. He loves what he is talking about, and enjoys his job. He is very easy to talk to, and is very understanding to the individual. I really did love this class!

Dr. Ogletree is the best! I really enjoyed the semester. My roommate actually suggested this to me and a few others, so I think it is safe to say that he is liked across campus. The only way you will get anything out of this class is if you go to class. Class is super fun, we watched a lot of funny clips and discussed good topics.

It was hard to be inspired by his lectures because my personality was a bit different than his. The information was helpful, though, and I appreciated his perspective as a marriage and family therapist and as a convert.

Dr. Ogletree is a really funny dude. The first thing he said in class was, "I want you to laugh your way through this course." His quizzes were easy, especially if you read the talks he assigns. He gives a clear study guide for each test and gives a lot of extra credit opportunities.

Brother Ogletree has seriously been one of my favorite teachers here at BYU. He knows how to connect to the students and engage them in learning. I highly recommend him. He knows what he is talking about and is able to bring the spirit into the classroom while making everyone laugh and enjoy themselves. His class is easy, fun, and you will learn.

I loved this class. I had a lot of health problems this semester and he worked with me to get all things caught up. He is a really nice guy. Some of the things he says could possibly be taken the wrong way, but he is genuinely one of the kindest humans I've met and He truly believes everything he is teaching.

Dr. Ogletree is an amazing professor for The Eternal Family! He's outgoing, fun, and happy! He learns the students' names and really cares about you. I learned so much about all aspects of marriage, family, and any type of relationship. Owning his own practice, he's very experienced. He also provides easy extra credit! 10/10 recommend!!!

Open-note quizzes based on reading materials. Units exams based on lectures and power point materials. Also, he explains things in class about assignments that you might not otherwise know if you don't attend. He sometimes goes off on amusing tangents, but he also encourages student responses--both in- and outside of class.

Dr. Ogletree is a great professor. There aren't very many assignments and they are all doable. A quiz is due before every class but the answers are all online in conference talks. He offers a lot of extra credit and really just wants students to succeed. I learned a lot about the importance of family and would definitely take this class again.
He gave about 2 quizzes a week, but they are open book and usually you can finish them in about 20 minutes. Super funny. Tests are easy if you do the study guides!
Weekly quizzes are open book. Gives detailed study guides. Tests and attendance are a lot of your grade.
Learned a lot in his class, but his tests are really dumb, based on menial details and memorization of random things that aren't that important.

I enjoyed coming to this class every week. Brother Ogletree is very kind, and his class is very straightforward. Brother Ogletree gives good insights from his experience in his family therapy practice. A lot of good information for forming a foundation for an eternal family.

I love Professor Ogletree, he cares about his students. He gives you every opportunity to succeed. He takes attendance and there are quizzes before each class. If you do your best then you'll get a good

Brother Ogletree is really nice and he cares a lot about his students. His lectures are pretty good. Sometimes he rushes through things, but if you go back and do the study guide you'll be okay. The tests have a lot of questions that can be pretty random and specific. Study the PowerPoints.

Religion classes should be easy & just help you develop a positive relationship with the scriptures. Brother Ogletree fulfills that criteria! One semester-long project (basically setting a personal goal and abiding by it), one 5 page paper (EASY), quizzes due every class (open note, open book), 4 tests (study guides are straight forward). GREAT!
This class is awesome! Prof Ogletree really helps his students out and makes this class easy enough to focus on learning but also hard enough that you still need to listen and focus in class.
He is a wonderful man who understands the role of religious courses at BYU. He is understanding, but requires some effort.
His quizzes are word specific so you must memorize the each question which is difficult especially when it comes to his tests.
He is a good teacher, just make sure you take the class seriously and don't slack off and you should be able to get an A. He makes the class interesting.

My favorite professor this semester! Take any class you can from him. He's hilarious and his lectures are inspiring. Easy A, a few assignments throughout the semester but they're pretty easy. Reading quizzes are due before each class too but they're short. Overall great class!
He is a great teacher! Every class is super fun and enjoyable. He makes everyone feel important in class. He gives a study guide for every quiz and test.

Brother Ogletree is the man. He is a great professor who wants all his students to succeed. If you come and participate and do the homework, you will be just fine. He's super easy to contact and ask questions. Definitely would take from him again.

I really enjoyed taking this class! It was accessible outside of class with all of the tests and quizzes online which made it flexible for busy schedules. I would highly suggest filling out the study guide before the exam. Quizzes were fairly easy since it is open note.

Dr. Ogletree has quickly become one of my favorite professors at BYU. His lectures are both entertaining and informative, and it is obvious that he truly cares about his students. As a religion class, he does a wonderful job of sticking to doctrine and defending the family. He encourages us to become better people--this class has taught me so much.

Such a fun class to take! Really interesting subject material, made listening to lectures fun. Tells a lot of personal stories but it makes the class more relatable. Material on exams straight from the lectures.
Professor Ogletree is an amazing professor. His lectures are hilarious and class is fun to attend. Tests are easy if you will out the study guide! I 100% recommend taking this class from him.

His lectures are great - entertaining and spiritual. He teaches a ton of stuff that's applicable and his 2 main assignments are super helpful, not just busy work. He works with any problems you have (extra credit, due dates, using extra extra credit to previous tests, etc) Tests are hard and It's hard to focus on all study guide Q's during lectures
Dr. Ogletree was able to make the eternal family a really interesting topic to learn! I loved taking this class because it wasn't too hard and I liked the way he taught it.

I have loved this class!! Professor Ogletree is awesome. He is personal and really teaches to help his students rather than to teach content. You have online quizzes before each class but they are easy and take 10 minutes. The tests aren't hard if you fill out the study guide as the professor teaches. Overall one of my favorite professor!
I love Dr. Ogltree e is an amazing professor. I was so inspired by his class.
It was a spiritually uplifting class. There are projects involved, so be prepared to do work. The homework and quizzes are super easy if you just follow the study guides.
I really enjoyed this class!
Dr. Ogletree is super nice guy and is always willing to work with you. All tests are curved to the lowest of a 70%. Highly recommend him if you need to take Eternal Family.
It was good!
Quizzes before every class are quite easy, tests are extremely specific but he gives study guides so if you study those meticulously you will be fine.
The lectures were great and spiritually enriching. I learned a lot in this class from the lectures and found them very interesting. All of this material is helpful for the future.
He's a good professor and I learned a lot in the class. He's entertaining enough in lectures and the homework is simple and straightforward.
Really awesome professor. Very understanding and gives more than enough opportunities for extra credit. Do the quizzes and the study guides and you will be just fine. Very fun guy.
Very good teacher and works well with athletes.

Late work ok. :)

Professor Ogletree is a real gem. His lectures are hilarious and inspiring. There are a few tests, but they are all on learning suite. Attendance is mandatory but Professor Ogletree makes it a good time.

cool guy

I decided to take the Eternal Family from Brother Ogletree on a whim and I totally lucked out! Brother Ogletree's class is structured to give his students both a great experience and an A. Professor Ogletrees class is straight forward and clear. At the beginning of the year he tells you exactly what is do and what to expect from the class. There is a quiz due everyday before class, they are not hard but you need to make sure you do them

This was overall a fun class. I loved what we learned and it was one of the classes that I felt related to me, even though I'm not married or dating. Professor Ogletree is really easy-going and chill. He even let me retake a test I didn't do too well on. You don't have to do the reading and the quizzes are easy. Just a chill class!

He is by far one of the best professors I've had so far. He makes the class so interesting and fun, so it's definitely worth your time to go. He also cares about you and will help you succeed the best he can.
He is seriously so awesome. He will work with you on grades, assignments, or any concerns you have. He is willing to help your grade if you think you received an unfair score.

Great professor! Professor Ogletree has some great stories and real-life experience that makes it really useful for the rest of your life. I feel like his eternal family class will have a long lasting impact on my life/marriage. I love that for his tests, you don't have to go to the testing center. That just adds a lot less stress to my life haha.

I had Professor Ogletree in an Intro to the LDS Church class. It was his first semester teaching it and he did a great job. He really did his best to balance discussion in the class and make it open to honest questions.
Professor Ogletree is one of the best teachers for a religion class. You will not be stressed out about a grade but you will feel the spirit in every lecture. Recommend 100%
Very humerus professor and fairly easy class! Lots of extra credits as well and totally would recommend!

Professor Ogletree is an EXCELLENT teacher. He is understanding, clear on what he wants us to know, and is fair in his grading and how he tests his students. Best professor at BYU

Professor Ogletree is my favorite religion professor he is amazing. I was taking his Eternal Families class and i loved everyday day of it. The work was never to difficult. He has three exams taken on learning suite(Easy), and some small 10 question quiz's that he lets you use the study guide to take. I highly recommend this teacher to anyone!
I did living prophets from him. 10/10 would recommend. He's a great guy, tells good stories, and the class is pretty straightforward and easy.

Brother Ogletree is very approachable and chill. His lectures are full of spirit and yet hilarious. 10/10 would take it from him again. I would take rel c 333 from bro. Ogletree even if it wasn't for religion credit. It's that good.
Great class. Keep up with hw and make sure you pay attention during class for tests. You need to attend!
He is a great teacher and really lenient and easy. You still manage to learn so much though if you take the class seriously and try your best to learn.
Dr. ogletree is an amazing lecturer, he's really engaging and makes really good points. You can tell he really cares about his students and wants them to succeed.

Very funny, kind, and spiritual. Encourages participation. Gives great study guides. exams are hard if you don't study a lot. Even though he is spiritual and you feel the Spirit in his class, his tests are all trivia on the prophets, not very spiritual.
His lectures were engaging and interactive. He told the best stories from the Apostles and Prophets. Good guy. Cares about his students.

Honestly, this was one of my favorite classes this semester. Dr. O is hilarious, and has tons of good stories and advice. If you are taking Eternal Families, take it from him. Great class! He is super engaging and the class is never boring. Make sure to stay on top of quizzes and attendance is important

Pretty easy religion class. I think that he only looked at lots of issues from only one perspective. Still, not terrible, just not great.
Cool guy that really enjoys his class. Super entertaining classes and not bad on homework, but a little more than a usual religion class. If want to debate though he's not the guy to do it with.

I really like Professor Ogletree. This class wasn't the most spiritual religion class I've taken at BYU, but it was probably the easiest. Ogletree is hilarious, he cares, he is nice to a fault, and he is passionate. He is humble and enthusiastic about what he teaches. TAKE THIS CLASS FROM HIM.

Brother Ogletree is so funny. He kept the class entertaining (which was good since this was an night class) but he still invited the spirit. I really enjoyed Brother Ogletree's class. He is super chill, friendly, and loves what he teaches. He gives lots of extra credit and super easy assignments. He is super easy to work with if you do have a problem or any questions. He uses a lot of powerpoints but he is a great storyteller. I would definitely recommend taking a class from him.

I LOVED Brother Ogletree's story-telling approach to teaching. He knows the lives of the prophets and apostles so well and can just continue telling their life stories. He's willing to work with you, and the assignments are meant to make sure you're doing the needed readings and help you grow as an individual.

I really enjoyed being in his class. The Lectures were fun and entertaining while teaching us a lot about the subject. He was very bold in his statements of belief. He is a religion Professor ya know! He is very willing to accommodate your needs.

Professor Ogletree knows a lot about this subject, and it really shows. But, because of this, you might feel a little discouraged as you look forward and try to apply everything in the class to your life, because its literally impossible. Plan to spend a few hours per midterm reading his lecture slides because he doesnt get through all of them.

While his lessons mainly just follow a PPT, he always has good stories. The best part is how clear requirements and exams are. Very clear expectations, all quizzes are open book open notes, exams are timed but the study guides give you all the questions that you need to know. Class time was well spent, attendance is important

I loved this class so much! It was manageable and engaging. Brother Ogletree is seriously the best and has the best stories. He is willing to talk to you about anything and give very good advice. Would definitely recommend taking a class from him!
This class is a must-take!!!

Dr. Ogletree is keeps lectures pretty entertaining. He knows a lot about families since he is a marriage and family therapist, but sometimes he takes a lot of time talking about his own family and not a lot drawing on other sources of information. He does make sure to connect everything back to what prophets have said though.

Ogle is good guy. He is super straight forward about grades. There are a bunch of little quizzes and a lot of reading, but all of the quizzes are open book and stuff so theyre easy. He puts all the stuff for tests on his slides. If you want a spiritual experience and not super heavy load this is the class to take.

Tests are a bit long and hard, but he gives you a study guide that is basically the test. Very solid teacher. Makes class fun and spiritual and doesn't make the class super difficult to where it takes away from the spirit. Would definitely take a class from him again.

I totally recommend taking this class from him! He is hilarious and has some great stories which keep you awake in class. The tests aren't super hard if you put in some time studying and doing the study guide. He's also really laid back so if you have an issue with something I'm sure he will be as flexible he can be about it. GREAT CLASS.

Prof Ogletree's Living Prophets class was a blast. He is a fun teacher, and the material is made quite interesting. Not hard if you just pay attention, he covers pretty much everything you need to pass the tests. If you miss something, he gives pretty good study guides that give lots of good prep. He's a professor who cares more about your testimony building than just making you memorize everything. He tries hard to make you feel the spirit in class and have many laughs at the same time. I loved this class and found him to be my favorite religion professor. Class attendance does matter, but the quizzes and tests aren't hard.
Good life skills class

Professor Ogletree is a sharp guy who cares a lot about his students. The course was well-organized and well-executed. Professor Ogletree is a great religious professor, and his lectures are pretty cool. Pay attention to the stories and make sure you do the exam study guides. The class (Living Prophets) is really cool. He has a lot of knowledge about the apostles, and he's easy to listen to. I wish all my teachers were like Professor Ogletree. Wow! He is hilarious and so sincere when he teaches. I don't always like the questions on the tests, but he gives you all the things you need to know and if you study, you'll be fine. He is very relateable and easy to understand. Also, the workload is light! #PepperMyProfessor

I really Liked Prof. Ogletree and thought he gave really interesting lectures--what was hard about the class was his TESTS. He's really sweet though and will help you anyway he can to pass his class, so that's cool too.

Bro. Ogletree is a great guy and he gives great lectures. He is also willing to work with you. His class was much more academic than spiritual. Brother Ogletree was very funny and spiritual in lecture. Each class was enjoyable, uplifting, and greatly beneficial. I would definitely take his class again.

This class is great and Ogletree is a great teacher! He is very respectful and thoughtful in his lectures. Review his powerpoint to do well on quizzes and exams. He is fair and wants students to succeed so he offers extra credit opportunities all the time. Enjoyed all his lectures. Attendance is mandatory.
He was a solid professor. We went over so much material but all of it really relavent. I only say easy A but a pretty easy B.

He is a very good teacher! He has super good classes full of good doctrine. He is also super funny. The classes aren't hard. You just need to go and fill out his study guides and you'll do fine on all tests and quizzes! For sure take Brother O!
Great class, lots to learn. Dr. Ogletree is hilarious and quite flexible on the course. Take him if you want to learn about the prophets! This class had a min. 5 page essay and a project.

His lessons are a great compilation of quotes and doctrine, definitely a comprehensive look at eternal marriage & the LDS doctrine. He does bite off more than he can chew with the material he wants to get through every class period, so each class leaves a little to be desired, but overall a good professor and an easy class.

Professor Ogletree is one of the best college professors I've ever had. Honestly, I think he's my favorite. The classes are always insightful and fun, I've never left class feeling overwhelmed, and he shows funny clips in class. If you're looking for a fun religion class at BYU, then take Prof. Ogletree.

He is honestly one of my favorite professors at BYU. Though it is a religion class, it is not easy, but it's worth it. You learn a ton and he's absolutely HILARIOUS. The weekly quizzes are open note and untimed and very short, so they're pretty easy. However, his midterms are difficult. If you study hard for them, you'll get at least an A-
Everyone in the class seemed to be tense and so he lightened the mood by including funny videos in the lectures that pertained to what we were learning.

This is by far one of my favorite religion classes I've taken! Professor Ogletree teaches by sharing a lot of experience from his previous marriage therapy practice, facts, and I can always feel the Spirit when I'm in his class. I took this class once a week, and usually do the readings on Sunday as extra study.

I love Professor Ogletree. He is one of the most fun and interesting religion professors I have ever had. His lectures are great and makes the material really engaging. Beware, his tests can be difficult. They often cover a lot of really specific details. If you do the study guide you should be fine. All the quizzes and tests are online.
He was super funny. I loved going because I laughed through the whole thing, and it wasn't too hard.

I really enjoyed Bro. Ogletree's class! Honestly There is a lot of reading and it is all for your benefit! He is kind and caring yo his students. He gives a lot of extra credit. Trust me this class is very possible to get an a in if you work in it and participate! I really recommend him.

Brother Ogletree is a great Professor and I learned a lot in his Eternal Families class. Its a relatively easy class and I enjoyed his stories that came from his experience as a Bishop, therapist, husband and dad.
Professor Ogletree was such a cool teacher because he is from Texas. Other than that his class is good. I guarantee that you will learn lots from him.
He was really funny and engaging.
Really fun he is scattered tho. Take him just not evening he will change your grade or let you miss class as long as you talk to him about respectfully. Only downside is tests are confusing

I enjoyed Brother Ogletree's class. Granted, each class period includes him reading from a Power Point, but his stories and quotes from prophets are inspired. His tests were tricky for me since a lot of the questions came from random little quotes or facts from his huge Power Points. However, if you keep up with the study guides, you'll be fine.

Mark is a great guy. Homework consists of reading 2 to 3 talks and taking a quiz before class. There are some minor papers/projects. And, that's really all you need to know. I feel like this class was interesting and worthwhile.

I took Brother Ogletree's Living Prophets class and loved it, so I took his Eternal Families class and absolutely loved it! He used stories from his life to teach us about how to prepare for future family life that are hilarious but also relevant. The quizzes and tests are straight from the study guide, and the project is simple and enlightening.

Brother Ogletree is a fun person and OK teacher. His tests are pretty easy and he gives a study guide with basically everything on it. Class is boring sometimes because he follows powerpoints that he posts online, and doesn't discuss a lot. If you are looking for a fun easy A and not a super spiritually uplifting class, this is the class to take.

I absolutely LOVED taking Living Prophets from Professor Ogletree! It was a fun, and educational class! Professor Ogletree is funny, respectful, knowledgeable, and just an all-around good guy! I really enjoyed this course, and would definitely take another class from him again!

Professor Ogletree is very specific about what is on tests (directly off of the study guide) and gives you many chances to get extra credit. There are quizzes due before each class but they are open book and open note. Lectures are both full of useful information and inspired. He's funny which makes class enjoyable to attend.
I have been inspired by this professor and didn't have to stress over grades. I hope I can take more of his classes in the future.

The class has two tests and then the final. There is a 5 pg paper and also a semester long character building project (pretty easy). There are also quizzes for each lecture based on the readings of the living prophets that are in the textbook (easy). You learn a lot about the living apostles and their lives. Kinda judgmental during lectures
Loved Dr. Ogletree's course organization, very straightforward and easy to understand. Covers the life of the prophet and apostles from life till current. Great Class!
Very funny and straight forward. Take this class from him!

He is the funniest religion professor i have had. he cares a lot about the subject and wants you to learn! cares way more about you getting something out of the class vs grades. he will make an effort to get to know you and is very very easy to work with. turn stuff in on time or you will have major deductions on projects.

I love Prof. Ogletree! He is hilarious!! He makes lectures entertaining. He knows a lot about the living prophets and it gets you excited to want to learn more about them and understand them. He invites the spirit each lesson and he is very clear with his assignments and tests. Easy religion but you learn a lot and can feel the spirit.

I loved this class. Bro. Ogletree has a way of teaching that invites the spirit and also teachings us so much information. I feel much more confident about going into marriage after taking his class. Easy open book quizzes and 1 project throughout the semester. The tests were harder than I expected because they were closed book, so just study.

He is very understanding about things that are going on in your life. His class isn't hard, the tests are easy if you do the study guides. You have a quiz due before each class but they are not hard if you read the packets, plus the quizes are open book/note.
He is one of the better teachers I'v had here at BYU. Teaches well. Class is straight forward. Assignments aren't too bad. He is a solid choice.

Professor Ogletree gives you study guides for all quizzes and exams and the guides have the page and paragraph number where you can find the answer. You can miss 3 classes without it impacting your grade, but there are plenty of opportunities for extra credit. If this weren't my last religion class I would take the rest of my credits from him.

Professor Ogletree is a great professor. His classes are a lot of fun, usually. He is very understanding and willing to listen to his students' needs. I recommend filling out the study guide during class and you will be ready for the midterm and final.

It was a great class, not hard at all. The lectures were funny, and uplifting. However, the Professor was a little disorganized, which made things confusing at times. But take this class, it is not stressful at all.
Solid professor. I have nothing bad to say!
fun professor with fun stories about the people we're studying. Nice and approachable, easy exams with study guides

Great teacher who manages to keep this class entertaining and exciting. I had a lot of people tell me beforehand that Eternal Families was one of the duller religion classes to take at BYU. However, I don't think I've laughed more or enjoyed a religion class more than Eternal Families with Dr. Ogletree. I would highly recommend his class.
Professo Ogletree is awesome! He understands that you are not majoring in religion and that you have other classes so, he makes his class doable. There is few assignments and they are not very hard.
he is an awesome, hilarious and very spiritual teacher.

I loved Brother Ogletree's Eternal Family Class. He does such a good job of presenting what modern day prophets have said about the family, and presenting how we are to build our own eternal family. I would take his class again in a heart beat.
Brother Ogletree makes learning about marriage and family life fun and relatable. He does whatever he can to ensure you get a good grade (lots of extra credit opportunities)

He is one of the best religion professors I have had here at BYU. In his class I felt like I was truly learning for the sake of learning, instead of feeling obligated to pay attention for tests. His lectures were great and he always includes stories that keep you engaged.
Great class. Everything you learn can be applied to your own life. Work load is very manageable. Quizzes and exams are memorization. Prof Ogletree is caring and wants to help you succeed.

He is a great professor! Classes aren't very conducive to discussion but and worth listening. Best thing you can do is fill out the study guide and memorize it. All of it. Definitely enjoyed class and he gives you a whole ton of resources in the power points that apply to your life. He does a great job at standing by the doctrine.

Dr. Ogletree is an awesome professor! He makes class entertaining and he's not afraid to tell you what he thinks. He is the best storyteller! The workload for his class is very manageable and I have gained a lot of important knowledge and skills in his class that I will use throughout my life!

Dr. Ogletree is laid back and cares more about learning and feeling the spirit than making the class hard. His curriculum is religiously based on the prophets, research and experience. He has an interesting sense of humor that becomes more funny overtime. Warning, grades drops after 3 absences, tests are specific but study guides are explicit.

He is very familiar with the material he has to present to the class. He insists on not giving his opinion on doctrine, but will give his opinion on non doctrinal things. The class was serious on some topics, but hilarious on others. he only thing that I would change is the tests. You have to memorize 100 answers that are on the study guide.

Through all the inspiration and laughter, I definitely believe that one of Professor Ogletree's strong suits is that he is straightforward. He'll tell you how it is and he has such a strong foundation in teaching what the Brethren teach but in his own style. His teaching style is very funny and inspirational at the same time.

I don't think I could have taken this class from anyone else and enjoyed it half as much. He was able to make awkward subjects more relatable and handle hard questions with poise. He is real and I love the perspective he takes of the family. 10 out of 10, would reccomend, would do again. I went away from every class feeling the spirit.

Prof. Ogletree tells amazing stories. I never take notes in class because I'm so engaged in his lecture, usually laughing. Tests are over the power points and quizzes are straight from the reading packet (conf talks). I will be a better marriage partner because of this class! SUPER HELPFUL

Great professor, taught the material very well including the tough material. My only slight complaint would be that he used humor to cover up awkward moments and hard topics too much and tailored to a less mature audience. Very kind and respectful to students, extremely accomodating.

Dr. Ogletree does very well on basing his content on prophetic teachings and scriptures. There is a good amount reading from general conference talks and a quiz every class period. However, he is very accommodating to students that are behind. Take this class?
Professor Ogletree was great. His lectures were funny and engaging. He also helped me feel more comfortable with the idea of moving forward in dating and marriage. Would take again for sure.

He's a really good professor and helps you whenever you need it. He's fair and gives you plenty of time to finish assignments. The class is engaging and fun and I honestly enjoyed his class all semester.

Professor Ogletree is awesome! he gives great lectures and is very funny. he is very open about his beliefs and opinions. He sticks to proper church doctrines. Everything graded has a very clear study guide that translates exactly to quizzes and exams. The assigned papers and projects are fun. He is also Hot

Brother Ogletree is an amazing teacher. He has a second job as a marriage counselor. Because of that, he brings a lot of insight to the Eternal Family with real life stories. Hilarious, kind, and he's focused more on learning that assigning homework. Amazing teacher. My favorite religion teacher by far. Better than Hank Smith or Wilcox.
This class is vey informative and provides good insight on issues that might actually arise in your everyday life. His stories are interesting and the exams are all covered in his study guides.
Quizzes for every lesson, but the tests are all online and really simple. Great teacher!

Professor Ogletree was a great professor. His lectures were fantastic and he does as good as anyone can at giving you insights on marriage. Sometimes in class he skips important slides you need to go back to and read on your own for tests. In general he is great, a fair grader, and gives extra credit!

He's funny, lectures are entertaining and all the slides and lecture notes are online. Attendance is marked and if you miss more than 3 days then he takes points off of Comprehensive test. There are readings but if you use the study guides you can just skim them to find what you need to take the quizzes.
Cool professor and fun class!

I loved Professor Ogletree! He was so fun and inspirational. He always was well prepared and very engaging to the class. He knows his stuff and is very passionate about his beliefs. I recommend him for Eternal Family.
A good class. Not difficult nor time consuming, and uplifting.
Lots of Quizzes but they are really straight forward if you follow study guilds. He has the BEST stories and lectures.
