The class was great, as was professor Ogletree! My only complaints were his class study guides, lectures, and PowerPoint's were often changed and unorganized. I was often confused on what would be on the test or not. His tests were also extremely specific, study hard for them!

He's a great guy and I really enjoyed his classes. I feel like he's pretty real about every subject. He's pretty good lecturer but has some pretty difficult test. It's really just a 100 questions of memorization. If you're good at memorizing quotes and facts, then you'll do fine on the tests. Everything else is pretty simple.

Brother Ogletree is an amazing religion professor I've had at BYU. He is a good kind of challenging. He cares about his students and their spiritual growth. He is fair on his tests and is very considerate of your time outside and inside of class. I am absolutely taking another class from him! Fill out the study guides and you'll do great!

Professor Ogletree is great. The lectures are always a good time and interesting. The homework load is pretty light and the reading quizzes are easy. The only tough part of this class were the tests. If you don't study, you will fail. If you do study, you will be fine.

Professor Ogletree is the best. He's super funny and laid back and makes class fun, but I still learned tons. The class isn't that hard, but you do have to go to class. There's a lot of reading, but the stuff he picks is awesome so it isn't bad. If you do the study guides his tests aren't hard. Overall, I LOVED this class. Definitely take from him!

Bro. Ogletree is one of the best professors I've had at BYU. He has great insight for marriage and family life and is very entertaining in class. He teaches to the point and says it like it is. Class is easy enough, quizzes, tests, assignments are all very doable. Take this class from him!!

He is so awesome! Super funny, makes class really interesting and engaging. He taught the doctrine well and also gave lots of practical marriage and family prep that was super helpful. Really easy to get an A, and the readings and assignments are actually ones I enjoyed. Would definitely recommend this class!!

Brother Ogletree is a decent professor. The lectures and material are fairly interesting and easy. It was a pretty easy class with the exception of the tests, which were more difficult and had oddly specific questions (i.e. finish the exact quote). He is willing to work with you on late assignments though.

Lectures are great. He's very understanding and gives plenty of opportunities for extra credit. He understands religion shouldn't be our hardest class. Tests were basically memorizing quotes though which was pretty tough.

Prof Ogletree is an awesome teacher!! Loved taking Eternal Families from him this semester. Gives awesome lectures and is way funny. Also gives you plenty of opportunity for extra credit which is nice. There's a decent amount of reading but its really not too bad. Would recommend you take Eternal Families from Prof Ogeltree!

He is a great religion professor and teaches in a way I enjoyed. His presentations are entertaining and taught me a lot about marriage. His quiz questions and test questions can be rather difficult and really specific. Other than that, I love this guy!
Was a great class. He's very understanding and a cool guy. He'll work with you and give lots of opportunities to turn in your stuff late. The hardest part is that the tests are somewhat difficult.
Easy class, but tests are incredibly tough. The amount of quotes used is crazy, but It was an enjoyable class.
As a senior at BYU, this was my favorite class. He is so funny and makes class enjoyable yet spiritual! Would definitely take another class from him.
Favorite religion class. Lots of opportunities for extra credit. You will get an A if you even care a little bit. Super funny too.

He's a nice guy and is an easy class. He gives you study guides to study for the tests, and while the tests are fairly specific, the study guides are pretty much all you ever need. He's lenient and understanding.

He's a nice guy but not a good teacher. We just read quotes all day off a powerpoint for class and its super boring and I didn't really learn anything. Also for his tests, he makes you memorize a ridiculous amount of quotes word for word. I also felt he tries to trick you on tests and doesn't really care if you if you succeed. Don't take this class

Pretty solid class. Your standard religion course. Brother Ogletree is really nice and the course is easy enough to pass. Just work on the quizzes and FILL OUT THE STUDY GUIDE. The tests are essentially memorization of the things on the study guide.

Bro, Ogletree is a good guy, but he doesn't seem to have much sympathy for other opinions. If you are a big proponent of strictly traditional gender roles then this class will be great. If you view Mormonism within a larger framework, this class can get a little trying.

Bro. O is wonderful and knowledgable and bases everything he teaches on the scriptures and prophets, so you aren't left with some random professor's opinions for doctrine.  The only thing is his tests are 100 questions based on your ability to memorize tiny details that only come from his powerpoints -which he doesn't always cover fully in class.

Great Class!! he really cares about his students.  There are some papers but the class isn't difficult, just do your work and attend class and you will do great! He is pretty specific on tests, but he tells stories that stay in your mind so tests aren't too crazy! He is very funny, coming to class isn't hard because it is so fun!

Professor Ogletree obviously cares about the subject matter and his students. I know that a lot of people in the class liked him. He wasn't my favorite professor; at times I felt that he could be kind of close-minded of differing view points.
He just reads his PowerPoint slides to the class. You might hear the occasional funny story. Grading my own projects bothered me.

Professor Ogeltree seems like a great professor and I know a lot of students like him. Personally, I felt like there was some good material in this course, but there were also a lot of broad generalizations made that kind of made me cringe. I would recommend him, but I wouldn't mind taking this course from another professor either.
One of my favorite religion classes I've taken at BYU. Ogletree is an awesome professor who really connects with his students. It's an easy class  with great lectures.

Prof. Ogletree is a fair teacher. He has very well organized curriculum, and his assignments are very easy to do. Just make sure you show up to class and do the work assigned, and it won't be bad at all.

Dr. Ogletree is very kind, caring, and intelligent.  He has a lot of experience and it was fascinating to hear his input, along with the guidance of modern prophets.  The class was fairly simple and straight forward; but this does not mean it does not require work.  I enjoyed his class so much, I am enrolled for another next semester.

Professor Ogletree is a great professor for Eternal families! He is nice and funny you can tell he knows what he is talking about. Just remember to do the weekly quizzes and show up to class and you should be just fine.  All tests (even the final) are online which is really nice because then you don't have to worry about long testing center lines.

Professor Ogletree is awesome. His lectures are hilarious and enjoyable. The tests and quizzes are straight from the study guide he gives you. This was the easiest religion class I've taken at BYU, but I still learned a lot. He gives you lots of opportunities to improve your grade. Take a class from him if you have a chance!

Professor Ogletree is a funny, engaging professor that is a pleasure to listen to in class. The class does require attendance, but listening in class and taking notes each day (using the provided study guides) makes the tests a breeze. Not "easy" at 100 questions, but not hard either.

He is awesome pretty funny and if you fill out the study guides you'll get an easy A. The midterms and Final was online on Learning Suite closed book. But, so great not to go to the hideous testing center.
You need to do the readings and quizzes, but they don't affect the lecture. There's some really good material, but it's obscured by a lot of redundancy and the instruction is not very precise.

Super fun guy. Lectures can get boring but for the most part interesting. Only 2 papers that weren't bad at all. A lot to study for the tests but he gives a great study guide. 10 pt Quizzes due at the beginning of most classes but they're open note and open book so its all good

Bro. Ogletree is caring, funny, and a spiritual teacher. I took a two hour class from him once a week. We usually got out early. Being a two hour class it obviously got hard to pay attention at times, but he does a good job  teaching and being entertaining. Weekly reading quizzes. Occasional paper/project. Test are difficult.
Great professor! Really loved his class. Most of the readings you can just find online on church website. I wouldn't even buy the book. Use his quiz study guides to answer all the questions.
Dr Ogletree is hilarious!! The best thing about him is that he can make the awkward marriage topics funny and not awkward while still getting the point across.

I love him! He is so friendly! This class is not hard. It is seriously all about inspiring you to be a better person and helping you gain a testimony of our living prophets. It definitely helped me gain a deeper understanding of our Prophet and apostles. Amazing teacher and class!

Prof. Ogletree is an excellent teacher. He is great at making a joke, especially in boring spots. His quizzes inbetween classes are open note and very easy. He provides study guides that contain the location of the answers. However, his test questions are kind of silly; some contain two equivalent answers and, of course, only one is right.

Brother Ogletree is a great professor. I love attending his lectures because they never fail to entertain. Also, I do feel like I came away with helpful material. However his tests were not great. I felt like there were some questions that were not covered in the lecture and study guide.
Brother Ogletree is the best!  Really good at bringing in the Spirit.
Nice guy, the class is pretty easy but I didn't learn much that I didn't already know. Very approachable professor.

I have had Prof. Olgetree twice now! He is an amazing professor who is knowledgeable about the subjects and provides a stress free academic environment. Highly recommend! I wish he taught more religion classes!
It was an amazing time with Professor Ogletree! He made studying so fun and this class will be easy if you just read the package, do quizzes and study guides, and attend class periods.

Brother Ogletree was by far the most interesting religion professor I have had and I would definitely take from him again. He gives you all the study guides you need at the beginning of the semester and the tests are the same questions on the study guides. Just be sure to actually study before taking any test and you will for sure get an A

Dr. Olgetree was a great professor. I honestly enjoyed the class. He moves through material very quickly which does make it difficult to retain a lot of information. Tests have a clear study guide, but he does require you to memorize the exact wording of quotes from the readings.

This was an awesome religion class! I learned a ton, but never felt overwhelmed with the reading or assignments. All the assignments he gave were uplifting and pushed us to improve ourselves and prepare for eternal families. Plus, he has an awesome sense of humor.

Great class! Professor Ogletree is a great professor and makes the class so fun! Plus I loved the class material. He knows that religion classes shouldn't be hard, so he does a great job of making it easy, but also still have to work for a good grade. You'll get docked for not attending, but not enough to make you not pass. Great choice!

This class was really good and I learned a lot of neat stuff about the family. Attendance is mandatory and is taken every class period. There are readings between each class with an associated quiz that is open book. There are a lot of extra credit opportunities, but you can only get up to 10 points of extra credit total.
Brother Ogletree is an amazing professor. I loved his sense of humor and he makes the gospel really fun. I would take him for another class again.

Professor Ogletree is great!  The lectures were amazing and I really feel like I learned a lot.  He has a lot of stories and examples to share to make remembering lessons easier.  Tests are very detailed so make sure to study well!
Funny professor, good at what he does. Honestly it's as spiritual as you make it. If you put in the effort into the readings, it will be more spiritual. If not, it won't be.
LOVE

I have loved Professor Ogletree!! This class has quite a bit of reading but it's all interesting. You have quizzes every single day so get prepared for that. I felt the spirit every single class period.
Dr. Ogletree is one of my favorite religion professors that I've had at BYU.  He makes the class so enjoyable and the content is super interesting.

This class is the best easy A class that you could ever take. Quizzes and exams are online and questions come straight from a study guide. The quizzes are open note. Bro O is funny and he knows his stuff. This is the second class I've taken from him, and I enjoyed it as much as I did the first time. literally, the best religion professor out there!

Bro O is the best religion professor at BYU. There are online quizzes due before each class, but they are 10 questions, open book/study guide, and the questions come straight from the study guides. He even tells you where to find the answers on the study guide. Exams are all online. Attendance is mandatory, but it's totally worth it. He's the best!
He is awesome! If he taught every religion class at the school I would take all of those classes haha. Easy grader, fun projects, easy tests, incredible study guides. Basically a dream class.

This class was fun. Brother Ogletree does a good job presenting the material in a way that was meaningful yet still fun. The class is what would be expected from a 2 credit religion course. There are a few assignments but overall if you do the quizzes and use the study guides you will get an A.
Overall a decent class. Tests are 100 questions and come directly from the study guide so you have to study for that. Outside of that it is a pretty simple class.
This class is fun and helpful. It's very possible to get an A if you do your quizzes and study guide for Exams.
Phenomenal.  Would definitely recommend him.
Dr. Ogletree was an awesome teacher! He really helped us to relate to the prophets and see them as normal people! Excellent class!
Professor Ogletree is legit. Best religion professor at BYU by FAR.

Ogletree doesn't waste your time or guilt trip you or browbeat you like a lot of religion professors. There's not a lot of make-work. He's reasonable and accommodating. His tests are very specific, and there's one big paper, but everything else is cake.
He was an excellent teacher. It is not a blow off class. Expect to study for tests and work at least a little to get a good grade. Overall though an excellent teacher.
Loved the class! I recommend it to all.

Overall a great teacher! Helped enhance a greater understanding about the family and clearly is experienced in the field. There are readings assigned each week with two 10 question quizzes. Make sure to follow his lectures with the study guides that he provides, other than that you will enjoy this class.

He is a great teacher and keeps you engaged. The study guides are jumbled and hard to fill out as you go during lecture and take forever to fill out. However, if you do the study guides you will do great on the tests. Funny and relatable. 1-2 ten question quizzes every week before class. 2 papers. Typical religion type work.

This guy is so great. His religion class is set up the way all religion classes should be - easy enough for you to feel the Spirit w/out being stressed about grades. His lectures are super interesting and you can tell how much he loves and respects the authorities of the Church.  Not hard to get an A, just keep up with the quizzes for each lecture

Professor Ogletree is a funny guy. His class was a great break from scripture-based religion classes because it is not nearly as difficult. Lectures are interesting and uplifting. I wish they would have been a little more spiritual.

It's a fairly easy class. Quizzes due before class each day, 3-4 online exams, a research paper, and a long-term project where you work on a goal. You can get away with not reading because there are study guides to each quiz and exam that tell you where to find the answers. Nothing is graded too harshly. Attendance is tracked.

Professor Ogletree is funny and spiritual. He knows so much and taking Eternal Family from him was the best. It is fun and informative. He gives real life examples from his own life and makes this class so interesting. I would definitely take it from him again!
He is a great prof. It seemed like there was a bit too much busy work and unnecessary assignments. However, I thoroughly enjoyed all of the lectures and always learned something new.
He is awesome! I loved taking this class. It was pretty easy all the test are take home tests.

Professor Ogletree was so down to earth about family life. I loved his class. He is blunt and inspirational. The work he assigns is meaningful and totally  manageable. I recommend Professor Ogletree for Eternal Family.

Home boy is so funny. I loved going to his class. He's super chill and willing to help with whatever. He wants you to feel the spirit and he presents things in a very clear and straight forward way. Take a class from him!

Professor Ogletree is such a fun guy. This class is great because all the time he told us stories craziness with his family. He is also great at differentiating his opinion from gospel doctrine. He's straight up on what he knows and doesn't know. If he doesn't know something he'll tell you. No one knows has all the answers when it comes to family.

Dr. Ogletree is seriously the best! Not only are his lectures informative, but he'll have you laughing out loud throughout all of them. He has quizzes for every lesson, but they're open book and pretty easy. The study guides for the tests are super helpful, and the other assignments throughout the semester are manageable. Take a class from him!!

Make sure to attend lectures to help fill out the study guides for his tests. His tests are not given in the testing center which was a nice change. He has quizzes every class day, but if you do the reading they are not hard. His tests are not bad if you attend class and know the study guide. His lectures are actually interesting and engaging!

Professor Ogletree is hilarious and made going to class engaging and enjoyable. He is good at teaching this topic because he has a lot of experience in this field (marriage counselor and father) and he keeps the topic funny and light-hearted while also able to touch on more serious and weightier topics. Take this class from him!
He's very easy to work with if you have a concern. The tests are detail specific so if you do the study guide you'll be chillin.

Professor Ogletree is great. He teaches the material well and makes it interesting. His background as a marriage & family counselor adds to his wide knowledge base. Quizzes twice a week online, but should get full credit (answers are mapped out in reading), 3 exams, few papers, 1 project. Need to put in the work, but definitley can get an A.
This was by far my favorite class this semester.  Prof Ogletree is hilarious, there is homework but it isn't hard, and his lectures are really entertaining.

Its an easy class but midterms are online and people cheat which ruins the class average and is very frustrating. People said they didn't know you weren't allowed to use notes. Duh. The information wasn't spiritual or important because it was just memorizing facts about the apostles lives not teachings. Easy A though if that's why you're taking it.
Terrific class. Interesting and applicable to life.

What can I say? I love the guy.  Be careful with deadlines, they creep up on you. The class is a good break from run of the mill religion classes, and has really increased my knowledge of the living prophets.
He is a good choice.

Good class, pretty easy, and organization was great. I wish there had been more discussion about the things the general authorities said, and that sometimes its okay to not agree with everything they say. But it was a fine class and Dr. Ogletree is mostly a good professor
Loved taking this course! Professor Ogletree is such a happy and intelligent person! He cares about his students and his lectures are always interesting and useful.

Great class, Professor Olgetree cares about his students and really tries to help you in any way that he can. He is very personable and does activities to get to know all the students better. He has a very relaxed class atmosphere and has good lectures with great stories about the prophets that we talk about. Easy assignments, not time consuming.

Professor Ogletree really cares about his students! His lectures are really spiritual and he makes them fun with stories and videos. There are weekly quizzes, but he provides study guides that go along with the readings so it's super easy to do well. There's 1 paper and 1 project. All of his tests are multiple choice. Just memorize the study guide!

Holds the best lectures, and is funny! he keeps you engaged and learning every class, while having work that isn't overly hard for just a religion class. Loved him so much, this is the second time ive taken a class from him.
Professor Olgetree was my favorite religion professor at BYU! He keeps class fun while at the same time you are able to learn new things.

Often runs out of time in lectures. Has you grade yourself on projects, but then won't believe your grade sometimes and grades you anyways. Nice guy, but pretty skeptical of cheaters on his online tests.

He's funny and kind, but he tests you on things he doesn't talk about in class.  He gives you a study guide and access to his power points, but if attendance weren't a grade there would be no reason to attend class.  You already have to teach yourself the material to pass the tests.  He does offer extra credit, which is nice.

Brother Ogletree is so funny! His lectures are exciting and fun. He shares cool stories about the prophets and apostles that help you feel like you know them as people, not just as speakers at General Conference. Pretty easy class. It won't hurt your GPA and you'll enjoy it.

He does not sugar coat anything. He tells you his opinion which is supported by 30 years of research. He tells lots of hilarious stories which sidetrack him a little, but is hilarious and always willing to meet or chat out of class.
Great class, very hard tests though.
Great professor! He really wants you to  pass. I would take his class again if I could

Dr. Ogletree is a great teacher. However, the tests are the only way to separate grades, so its much more who said what and statistics rather than emphasizing the principles learned in class. I didn't feel like I learned anything from the test. But I really enjoyed the lectures.

Ogletree is the man! I loved his class. He's funny and teaches you what you need to know. He has had lots of experience with Marriage and Family counseling and that has allowed him to be very knowledgeable about the ETERNAL FAMILY. Take it from him
Great teacher. Focuses on material not grade.
Very engaging. Hilarious but also gives great lessons. I always leave the class feeling good.

Ogletree is the MAN! I have taken classes from him twice now and still love him. He is very good at assisting you to learn but expects you do do the learning. He is a pretty easy grader. If you have complications he is very understanding and easily accommodates. Great dude.

I really liked Brother Ogletree. He is really funny and I learned a lot from his class. He is clear on the assignments but the work load is not bad at all. Taking Living Prophets from him has been a joy.
He is a good professor, the exams are difficult, although could be much more difficult. For this course he is definitely good to take. Very respectful and did not waste your time
I loved Prof. Ogletree!

Brother Ogletree is the bomb. He is super funny and I learned a ton about Eternal Families. The workload is consistent but easy. I would definitely recommend this class as one of those easy but inspiring religion classes that everyone seems to be looking for!

He really wants his students to pass. If you follow instructions and the guides he gives, you'll get a good grade no problem. He's funny and tells lots of stories. I also really liked the reading material. I learned a lot! He isn't the most inspiring religion professor I've ever had but overall it was a great class. Plus tests are on LS!

Professor Ogletree is amazing! His lectures are very spiritual and I learned a lot in his class. He is a fun teacher and makes class enjoyable. I loved this class and would definitely recommend taking it from him!

Professor Ogletree is the man! He is hilarious yet very inspiriational. However sometimes his quiz and test questions are a little too specific. That does not mean they are necessarily hard, you just might need to study a little longer than you expect for the exams. Easy A-, but it requires work for the solid A.

Great professor! Took Eternal Families from him. The class is very well organized and straightforward. There is one project and one paper. He also  has a bunch of quizzes, but they are open book and he basically gives you the answers. Don't underestimate his tests! They are on learning suite, which is nice, but make sure you study. Take this class!

I really enjoyed Dr. Ogletree's lectures. He is really funny and he gives a lot of important information. This class is pretty easy for the most part. His tests are harder than you would think based off the rest of the class but with a little extra study they aren't bad.

I really liked this class and the concepts he taught us but it was so much extra work for a religion class. You do at least 2 quizzes every week , 3 papers, and 3 tests. I would take this class from someone else if you could.

I absolutely loved this class. He is a great teacher who really tries to make lectures good and spiritual. You can tell he puts in lots of time into preparing these lessons by finding out cool stories and small facts about the current apostles and prophet. I would recommend this class to anyone. Quizzes are open note. Tests are straight forward.

Professor Ogletree is a great professor. The class is well organized and set up to have you learn and be inspired. The class is easy. If you show up and do the basic assignments and quizzes you will get an A. Plus he can always make you laugh! Take it from him!!
I really enjoyed this class. He is hilarious and teaches great principles that will be remembered throughout my life. I would take it again in a heartbeat.
Professor Ogletree is great! He is hilarious and makes the class really enjoyable and not very difficult.
Professor Ogletree is a champion. I learned a lot in his class and the workload wasn't too much.

Funny, made the class easy, which was good. Except he's pretty traditional about the family, which can make for awkward situations sometimes when he preaches things as doctrine that are mainly just his old white man ways.

I loved going to Brother Ogletree's class. There was never a day that I dreaded going to him. He is hilarious but also a spiritual man. He has pushed me to see the importance of the eternal family. TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN!!!
Dr. Ogletree is great. He really wants you to learn and take the class seriously but he doesn't make it really difficult. His lectures are awesome and the readings he assigns are worth your time.

Ogletree is by far the best religion professor i have had at BYU.  His lectures are very captivating and interesting.  I loved his classes and he is hilarious.  He seems to really connect with the students.  Definitely take living prophets from him!

Prof. Ogletree is hilarious. You have quizzes due every day before class, but it's all open book. Tests are a little harder: he takes questions from all of the material on the study guide, and they're more specific than you think. Overall a great class and not very hard.

Brother Ogletree is a stellar professor! His lectures are very entertaining, educational, and spiritual. He has such a strong testimony of the living prophets and that really comes through with his teaching.

Dr. Ogletree was such a good professor. He is really good at lecturing and very inspiration to listen to. There is required reading but the talks are so interesting that you want to read them anyway. I would definitely take it from him again and I would recommend him to other students. I am a senior and this is the first review I have ever done.

Brother Ogletree is the man. Seriously the best professor I've had so far. He really is passionate about the material and it's obvious in his lectures. He gives a ton of chances for extra credit, but as long as you show up and listen in class, you won't need it. He really cares about his students and loves to hear our input. Take his classes!

Dr. Ogletree is great! This is one of the best Religion classes I've taken at BYU. It is the perfect balance of testimony building and academically enhancing. I had health problems come up during the semester and Dr. Ogletree was super happy to accommodate me and help me out in any way he could so that I could have a successful semester.

Dr. Ogletree is really awesome! He is funny and kind and the kind of professor that makes you actually enjoy coming to class. He is also really happy to work with you if you have issues or concerns. The class was great. Really great applicable readings and all of our tests were online. My testimony was strengthened and I feel like I learned a lot.

Dr. Ogletree's class has been a good experience for me overall. I appreciate who he is, his feelings towards his family and God which naturally affect everything about the class (The Eternal Family). He definitely has strong opinions on some things, and they affect how he presents, but is often good about not presenting his own opinions as doctrine

Dr. Ogletree's class was one of my favorite generals I took. He is extremely knowledgable and taught the material in a way that was exciting and fun. I came into this class with an indifferent attitude but left loving it. The tests are difficult, but everything else isn't that bad.
Brother Ogletree is AMAZING! This was a really easy class and really helped me in so many ways. If you really take the time to do all the readings, the class is especially meaningful :)
He is a great teacher.  Really cares about the material.  Seriously just read and show up and there is no way to get lower than an A.

Ogletree is a very engaging, understanding, and funny. He's reasonable in his expectations and makes class worth coming to. Attendance is very important for your grade, but it's not hard to come. Definitely one of the best religion professors at BYU teaching one of the best religion classes at BYU. TAKE IT!
Professor Ogletree is one of the best religion teachers I have ever had. He makes going to class enjoyable and is so funny! I have learned a lot from his class and would definitely take it again.

Prof. Ogletree is a great teacher and his class lectures were amazing. I took the class with my husband and it was really fun and informative for both of us. However, there is a LOT of assignments in this class, more than my average 3 credit classes in my major. A longish paper, an attributes project, two 100 question exams, etc.

Dr. Ogletree is a phenomenal professor. He is one of the funniest, most caring teachers that I have had. Living Prophets was an eye opening class, and Dr. Ogletree made it way fun and way engaging. The class was not hard at all, but he does count daily attendance. If you go to class and are proactive with the work, it's an EASY A. Great professor!

Readings and open note quizzes due before each class, but he makes them as early as possible, and the readings are actually interesting (and the packet of readings is not expensive). In class, he is animated and does a good job of blending his career as a marriage and family counselor with the gospel curriculum he is teaching.
Very funny. Not too difficult of a class.  I really enjoyed the course and the professor! Would recommend!

I loved Brother Ogletree!!!! He is seriously the best! His lectures were always hilarious and he brings in the words of prophets and general authorities every class. I always left class with new and helpful insights about aspects of marriage. He was an awesome teacher, I highly recommend taking eternal families from him!

Brother Ogletree is one of the best professors at BYU! You definitely want to take both Eternal Family & Living Prophets from him. He makes the lessons entertaining and cares about each of his students. I am soooo fortunate to have been taught by him!

Dr. Ogletree is a man that cares about his students, loves to teach, and is overall a great professor. It is very obvious that he is doing all he can do to make things great for the student. I hope to take many classes from him.

Dr. Ogletree is highly friendly and optimistic. He clearly loves the material he teaches. However, he often goes on tangents during class and doesn't finish all of the material. To me, it seems like he values a positive relationship with his students over teaching the material. The class is fairly easy and interesting, but not very instructional.
Professor Ogeltree is the man! He is a great instructor and outlines exactly how to get an A. Take him!!
So funny and so kind! I loved this class and Prof. Ogletree!
Gives a study guide for help on tests, which is super sweet! I would recommend doing the readings anyway though.

I LOVE Dr. Ogletree. He truly is a real gem. He's hilarious, smart, and kind. I had a really hard semester and every time I needed help, he was always extremely accommodating. He's not always the most organized, but it's not difficult in the least to catch up. I would take a class again from him in a heartbeat.

Dr. Ogletree is a cool guy who knows a lot about family life. His lectures are generally interesting and fun. I wouldn't say I learned a lot of new information but it was good reinforcing stuff I've learned at Church. He likes to make it fun and not too hard for the students. If you are easily offended, just know he can be very blunt.

Brother Ogletree's lectures were always so applicable! He makes class fun and he is able to tell personal stories which helped to remember the material taught in class. Be aware of exams asking for specifics. Overall great class, you can tell he really puts heart into his class.

I loved having Professor Ogletree. He shares alot of fun stories and experiences and overall makes a really interesting course. The work is very do-able and straightforward. I loved the things I learned in his class, he does  a great job!

He's not what I was expecting, there was a lot of joking, but it was still really uplifting and I generally enjoyed the class, the tests were a little ridiculous with questions like who said this very specific quote and that kind of thing, but other than that the class is great

Good advice, and backed up by church leaders. Genuinely cares about students. Doesn't really use LS for assignments which is weird, but doable. Study guides for tests, easy A if you study. One project (choose yourself, easy rubric to follow) and one major paper (also easy). LS quizzes before class, open note (need textbook). Attendance graded.

Brother Ogletree is a great professor! He truly cares about his students and made sure that we felt comfortable asking questions or voicing our opinions.  Weekly quizzes are minor, just a little bit of reading. Exams are more than fair, study guides have exact answers. Take Ogletree! His class is uplifting, informative, pretty easy, and hilarious.

I took Eternal Families 200, not REL 101. I loved his class, it was very educational and always enjoyable. I highly recommend any and everyone to take this class, it answered a lot of questions about eternal families. Ogletree is amazing. Just take his class already.

This class was seriously a breather! I learned new things about the apostles and prophets, but didn't feel like I was drowning. You do have readings for quizzes but they are all online and open book. He was also a life savor and had his tests online too! BLESS. Funny guy and good material. Listening to General Conference really has new light.
Professor Ogletree is an amazing professor. I would highly recommend him. He is very inspirational and gives a new light to many gospel principles. The class is not hard, but attendance is mandatory.

I love Ogletree! His eternal family class was my easiest class this semester, but I still learned so much.  Roll is taken every day (you can miss 3x), but you won't want to miss anyways because his class is always relaxed, enjoyable, and meaningful.  For every test he gives you a study guide that tells you everything on the test. Take this class!

Brother Ogletree taught this class from the perspective of a married man who has had years of experience, not only as a spouse and father, but as a professional marriage counselor. I believe he taught by and through the spirit.

I enjoyed this class. He's a pretty funny  guy. He was very willing to move deadlines for assignments to help students. There's a lot of extra credit opportunities, but there's a 10 point cap. He gives you study guides for all of the quizzes and tests. It takes a while to fill out the test study guide, but you can do it in class.

I absolutely loved Professor Ogletree! Eternal Family was such an inspiring class, even for those that aren't married. The lectures are always entertaining and spiritual. The pre-class quizzes are easy, and the readings are really interesting. The project and the paper are not hard to do, and they're fun! I highly recommend Eternal Family from him!
Good teacher, grades come from a few projects, but mostly weekly quizzes (open book) and a few tests. Generally pretty easy, but the tests are ALL tedious memorization which can be difficult.

Professor Ogletree is the best religion teacher on campus. His classes aren't super super hard but you still have some work here and there. I recommend taking him for any religion class you can. I have taken him twice now and have loved both classes.

Dr. Ogletree is the nicest guy you'll meet. His tests are oddly specific, but just follow the study guide exactly and you will be fine.  Just a note about the class: if you would rather not spend two weeks on "making the marriage decision," consider a different religion class.

He's a great teacher! His lectures were actually spiritually uplifting and apply to your life. Typical but not excess homework, which is to read 3-4 conference talks and take a quiz. He even gives you a quiz study guide so you know which paragraph has the quiz answer. He wants you to learn, do well, and enjoy the class. Definitely recommend.
Professor Ogletree is the most understanding professor I've ever had. He is beyond reasonable with work load, deadlines, and expectations. He really treats his students like friends

Brother Ogletree is so fun! His evening classes typically has a bunch of BYU athletes as well who he picks on and just makes the class fun. He is super funny but really loves what he teaches. Class is pretty much straight lecture but again, he makes it interesting and entertaining.

Pro. Ogletree is one of the best and most hilarious REL teachers @ BYU. There is a reading quiz due before each class, but it's open book. Also, he gives study guides that are nearly identical to the 4 exams. There is a simple project where you have to live by the prophet's teachings and record your progress, and then a 5 page paper on any topic.

Professor Ogletree is funny and helpful, and his class isn't hard. The readings are interesting and not time-consuming. The tests are online and straightforward. HE gives you study guides for the quizzes and the exams. He is very passionate about the lives of the prophet and apostles, and that passion translates to his lectures! Great class!

I took this class to fill the religion requirement. Professor Ogletree is a fantastic professor and he really cares about his students. Yes there is a lot of reading and yes the tests can be hard but what religion class at the Y isn't.  He was willing meet with his students and to tailor the material best help his students needs. would take again.

The Eternal Family course discusses some topics that have the potential to be a bit awkward. Brother Ogletree is as master at addressing those issues with humor and yet in a spiritually uplifting way. His experience as a family councilor gives him great insight and perspective. His wit and quirkiness makes the class very much enjoyable.

His class is super easy. The assignments and tests are clear. However, I felt that we covered way too much information in the class. Lectures were entertaining, but contained too much information. We moved so quickly that it was hard to really explore any of the concepts.

Brother Ogletree is a great religion professor!  He teaches the content in a way that is entertaining to be in class.  The homework load isn't bad (one open book quiz before every class), and the few tests you have are really easy.  I would definitely take a class from him again!

Professor Ogletree is an incredible teacher! I've never felt a strong connection to the Apostles or First Presidency, but that changed after taking this class. Studying each apostle and the prophet, learning about their lives, and reading several of their teachings has not only enhanced my spirituality, but has also given me much more knowledge.

Professor Ogletree is hilarious and makes the class fun. He tells jokes and stories and loves discussions. He gets a little mixed up sometimes. The grades are three midterms, a short quiz before each class, a project, and a paper. The quiz and midterm questions are taken directly from the study guides and the quizzes are open book.
Amazing teacher.  The lectures were my favorite part.  The tests can be tough, but go to class and you'll be fine.

Professor Ogletree is such a great teacher! His lectures are so good and always invite the spirit! He's also really funny . There are 2 quizzes each week which are super easy to get 10/10 on cause they're open book. The exams are on learningsuite and if you fill out the study guide it's pretty easy to get an A. Such a great class!

Professor Ogletree is a great Professor. I took his Living Prophets Class and loved going to class. The material is easy and the tests are too. You just have do the reading and study the study guides. I loved this class. It is one of my favorites I have taken at BYU, and I hope to take more classes from Professor Ogletree soon.

We had three 100 question midterms... for a religions course. That is the only hard part about the class. The questions are pretty specific (despite his claims that he wont ask you specific stuff) but he does give you a study guide that contains 99% of the questions, word for word. It's a big study guide though so don't take it lightly.

I loved this class. It is very good if you are thinking of getting married. I would suggest taking it with a fiance.  I thought it was funny and that he involved the students in the lectures. I didn't like that some of the test material was sometimes very specific and not very useful. But for the most part I loved the class!

Prof Olgetree's class is solid. His lectures are very engaging. The only problem I had was that lecture sometimes felt unnecessary. Exams and quizzes were online and all the materials I needed were found on LS. I seldom used notes from the lecture for the exam but rather reviewed his slides a day or two before. The attendance policy is very strict.

I LOVED Prof Ogletree's class! I wanted to come to class because every lecture was interesting & totally informative about marriage & the eternal family. He gives you the answers for the homework basically and gives you the entire study guide at the beginning of the semester. Would love to take another class from him!

Brother Ogletree is a wonderful professor that cares about his students, but most importantly, his main goal is to help all his students to learn something new each lecture that can strengthen their testimony of Christ. I love his attitude, his sense of humor, but most importantly, his love and passion for what he is doing.

Professor Ogletree is a very entertaining lecturer. You only need the textbook for the quizzes (there is a quiz for each lecture), but otherwise you will not need it. This class is extremely straightforward, if you do the work, you will get an A.
Great teacher. Easy religion credit.

Brother Ogletree is the best! There are weekly quizzes online from the reading, three tests online. one paper and an attributes project. He gives study guides for all the test and quizzes and if you follow the rubrics on the paper and project you'll do great. I learned so much from this class and definitely recommend it!

Great Professor. Bro. Ogletree really cares about his students and is very accommodating to the needs of anyone. His lectures are interesting and there is a lot to learn. He gives you study guides for both quizzes and tests, which aren't too difficult if you just look over the study guides. Loved this class

Professor Ogletree is awesome! He is very understanding when it comes to grading. He is very aware that his class isn't the only one students are taking, so the workload isn't too hard. Basically there are easy quizzes each class period, one paper, and a big-ish project.

One of the best professors I've had! He is so knowledgeable on the subject of marriage and dating. I felt like I had so many unanswered questions, and he explained things in a way that just made sense to me. He really cares about his students, and he'll make time to meet with you. Quizzes and tests are easy if you do the study guides.

Great guy. Test and quizzes a little confusing with the wording. His tests are also a lot more difficult then he makes them sound. You probably need to spend two days reviewing before you take one of his mid-terms.
He is a very good professor for a religion course.  He doesn't overload you with work but you still learn a lot.
Good class. Easy A.
Loves the students, passionate about the subject.

Brother O is great! Super funny and has really great stories. Just a test or two, reading quizzes (open book), a paper, and a semester project. Do the work and you will be fine. Not a hard class if you stay on top of things and a fun professor on top of that.
Eternal Families- Learned a ton in this class and it wasn't difficult to get an A. Great choice for a religion credit that you can easily apply to your life.
Super fun class. Learned a lot and confirmed things I already knew. Really funny and good lectures. Do the weekly quizzes and review for tests and you will be fine.

Brother Ogletree is very passionate about what he teaches, and he teaches in a way that really allows the students to apply what is learned in class.  He loves the gospel and the family and he treats sensitive topics with the utmost care.  I highly recommend his class!!

He is a fantastic teacher that does not overload you with pointless busy-work like most religion professors do. This is how a religion class you be. He is a good lecturer and keeps you engaged, but you leave feeling spiritually strengthened. The class is pretty easy and does not overbook you  making life harder for other important classes.

I loved Mr. O! He is really funny.  He gives weekly quizzes online but he also gives a quiz study guide and they are like the same questions. Also, I don't know if he always does this but all our tests were online and all the answers came straight from his exam review document. The answers are straight from the lectures so just fill it out during.

Great class! You've got to do a little bit more than show up to class to get an A but not much. He has online quizzes he gives you the answer to before every lecture so those are easy 100%. Sometimes there's a question or two on the midterms that weren't on the study guide but it's not hard to score in the 90s on his tests
Dr. Ogletree is a great professor.  Really loved the content.  The class to take if you want an inspirational, not too dificult religion class.  Not too much outside work, yet I learned a ton.

The course is easy and the professor is so hilarious. There are quizzes for each class, but they are only 10 q's, and the only thing you will have to read are talks by general authorities - it is great! There are study guides he gives you at the BEGINNING of the course, and the tests are just like them! Fill them out as you go. Tests are on LS!

Bro O is amazing! He's super funny but knows when to make things a little more serious. Quizzes and exams are all online and they follow his study guides word for word. The quizzes are even open note. There's no required reading. There is one big paper and one big project, but he's an easy grader and super passionate about what he teaches!
Really great professor. Well-organized. Online midterms. 2 weekly, easy quizzes. Provides opportunities for the students to get involved in the lecture and you feel the spirit every class.

Professor Ogletree is an amazing teacher. You can tell he really cares about his students and helps your testimony grow. There are two quizzes every week that matter a lot for your grade so  don't miss them. Study guides for the tests are helpful and if you know them well then you will get an A on the test. This is my second class from him.

Brother Ogletree is the best! I absolutely loved this class and looked forward to it. You learn so much about the Prophet and Apostles and I seriously feel like my testimony has grown exponentially. Take it from him, you will love it!

Professor Ogletree is great. He truly cares about his students and is very understanding of our busy lives. He is always willing to help. There are 3 papers and a few quizzes but they are not hard if you attend class and use the study guides.

We do a quiz before each class period. He will give you a study guide that tells you where the answers are in the packet, and they are open book, so it is very easy. You feel out the study guide for the exams in class. There is one class project and paper during the semester. 10 points of extra credit are offered.

Brother Ogletree is a fun guy that is reasonable when it comes to time commitment for this class. He sends out a very specific exam study guide at the beginning of the course. I filled in the answers as he lectured, and was always prepared for the exams. There are a couple short papers, but it is very reasonable. I learned a lot!

Bro. Ogletree is an amazing professor because he understands how to provide information in a way that is applicable. He also is really good at intertwining the gospel teachings with research done in the field. I would recommend taking this class from him to anyone!

He's super cool and  chill. Very understanding. You have to take a quiz before each class. You basically have to fill out the study guide while in class and all those questions will come up in the test. Most of the answers are in the lecture slides. All tests are online.

Ogletree is awesome! I would take him again and this class. Supposedly the class is getting harder (for when I took it) and it does require you paying attention and doing homework, but it honestly takes up maybe 1 hour per week, at the most.
Awesome teacher with really cool lectures, would definately take another class again for him. Was very straightforward on harder topics to discuss in the church, lots of good information.

A wonderful religion class. Do the pre-reading and quiz (30 minutes max) for each class, take notes on the exam study guide he provides, then study that for 30 minutes and get an A on the 2 online tests and final. Laugh your face off in class and learn fun and inspiring facts and doctrine about the prophets. Very low stress and time commitment.
Great guy. Mr. Ogletree's classes are awesome. I learned so much that I wouldn't have known before about marriage prep

A genuinely nice guy! Very understanding! Makes me laugh every class! open note online quizzes due before almost every class but he gives you the questions in advance and exactly where you can find the answer, easy 100 percent. 3 exams, all online and questions come directly from the study guide we fill out in class together during each lecture.

Brother Ogletree was so awesome! I am a student athlete and often I struggle with missing so much of my religion class. I felt like his class was perfect because I still did well even though I had to miss for traveling. And his lectures were so well prepared! This guy truly cares about what he teaches! He practically investigates all the apostles!!

Really great professor. His class structure and syllabus are so clear and that's what I really love about a teacher. You never have to wonder what is due and everything is set up in a pattern for each week. The class is easy and edifying. You basically just read talks each week and take quizzes about them on learning suite which are open book.

Such a good professor. Brilliantly does what so many BYU religion professors fail to do. He has a spiritually edifying class that will require effort from you but is so mangable. There's no reason you won't get a good grade and grow your testimony if you show up and take notes off his exam study guides. Great man.

Professor Ogletree presents the information in an interesting and often hilarious way. The grading criteria are very specific, so you don't have to wonder. Just be sure to do the reading and the study guides and you'll do great!

Brother Ogletree is great. 10/10 would take him again. He has daily reading quizzes that are open note and the study guides direct you to the page and paragraph of the answer. Tests are on learning suite, closed book, but he gives you answers beforehand. 1 five page paper on attributes to look for in a spouse and 1 project on self improvement.

Brother Ogletree is one of my favorite religion professors at BYU. His lectures are entertaining and informative. He knows a lot of the general authorities personally, and has lots of insights into their lives. I learned a lot from his class.

I have learned so much in Professor Ogletree's class on how to better myself and my future family! He is such a good story teller, and it's easy to appreciate his sense of humor. This has been my favorite class and I would suggest that everyone take Eternal Families from him!

Workload is totally reasonable for a 2 credit class - there's lot of opportunities to earn easy points (online quizzes every week, extra credit, attendance, etc) which make getting an A very doable. If you take this class seriously and do the readings, you will learn a lot!

Professor Ogletree is so awesome. His eternal families class was so I sightful and I learned so much. His lectures are so funny and spiritual at the same time. You have study guides that you fill out during class and then you study off of those for the exams. You also have a quiz that's open notes to go along with each lesson. It's so great!

His class usually ends on time. If you have questions he is very approachable, he will even give you his phone number and you can ask him anonymously your question. He provides extra credit opportunities and will consider proposals for more extra credit. Learning Suite is used as an important part of this class for the tests and quizzes.
He's friends with the football team so most likely there will be players in your class which makes for a fun time :)
Awesome Professor. Super easy A if you study the study guides well for the tests.
Easy class as long as you do the reading and exam study guides. Nice guy, entertaining and spiritually uplifting class.

Prof Ogletree is kinda a weird guy, but he's super nice and funny! I really love his class!  I've learned a lot that I can really apply into my life! Also it's fairly easy to get an A in the class if you just do the quizzes (which are open book) on time and show up to class and fill out the study guide he provides.
Brother Ogletree is the best! He really wants his students to succeed. He provides a study guide for all the tests too which is super nice!
Brother Ogletree is super chill. As long as you show up (he takes attendance) you get an A. Reasonable for a 2 credit class.

Dr. Ogletree is bomb. Seriously, his class is SUPER easy and he gives you a study guide with all the answers for the test. His lectures are actually really interesting as well and his humor is the perfect amount of goofiness ^_^ Great man.

He's a great teacher. Really funny and love to make jokes. Attendance is mandatory, but you wouldn't want to skip anyways. Easy grader and will push assignments back if you just ask. You should totally take this class from Prof. Ogletree.

Brother Ogletree is seriously so cool. You can tell he loves what he teaches and makes things fun. He seriously makes me laugh and I would recommend taking anything from him! Super easy and spiritual setting.

I love Brother Ogletree and his class! He is funny, personable, and tries to get to know his students, which I appreciated.  He is also very sensitive to his students and how he teaches the material. He teaches in a way that is interesting, but definitely with the spirit. The work is not challenging, but worthwhile. I love the readings he assigned!

I would highly recommend this class to anyone. There are reviews for tests and quizzes, which are very helpful. Brother O is a very entertaining teacher. There is just the right amount of humor and spirituality in each of his lessons. I left feeling uplifted after each class.

He's a wonderful teacher and knows so much about the subject at hand. I'm most impressed with how understanding, thoughtful and leniant he's been with the due dates of assignments. He makes himself readily available and he's just a cool guy in general. Come to class, pay attention to deadlines, do the assignments and you'll get an A.
Wonderful class. Just take it.
Wonderful class.
He was always willing to help students.  He was funny in class and taught great lessons.  I would take him again any day!

Seriously the best professor I have ever had. I definitely want to take more classes from him. He is very understanding and helpful and willing to answer any questions you have. The material is great and so useful for life, married or not. The "textbook" is just for the open book homework quizzes but it does contain a lot of great info.

Professor Ogletree is a great professor and cares a lot about his students. There are quizzes almost every class period, but they're open note and he gives you a study guide for each one. He's hilarious but also knows when to be serious. I felt the spirit in his class every time. If you have a chance, take this or another class from him!

I gained a much stronger testimony of the Apostles and Prophets in this class. Professor Ogletree is funny, caring, knowledgeable and also spiritual. Super easy class too. if you show up every class you'll get an A. He provides a study guide that you fill out during lectures, and the readings are just awesome conference talks. 100% WOULD TAKE AGAIN
Great teacher and is very easy to work with. Definitely recommend.

Study guides provided for every quiz and exam, although not everything on the exams are on the study guides. So make sure to go to class, because he'll test on some of his own life stories that are not on his lecture slides! Other than that, inspirational and funny lectures.
Prof. Ogletree is so fantastic! Definitely take his class!

Bro. Ogletree is wonderful!! This is what a religion class should be!! It's a perfect mix of spiritual things and fun/interesting facts. He's so funny and loves to have fun, but he does a great job of inviting the spirit and knowing when it's time to be serious. It's not a hard class and if you go to class and do the quizzes you'll do fine.
Technically, you don't need to show up to class, but you'll miss out on a lot of life changing lectures if you don't go.
I had a couple of siblings who had previously taken from Professor Ogletree and everything they said about him was true! He is so awesome! Definitely take from him!
Such a great professor!  Weekly quizzes but he provides a study guide. The tests are online and it's the study guide verbatim. Super fun and very entertaining!
Professor Ogletree genuinely wants to help his students! 10/10 would take again from him!
Brother Ogletree is the best! I loved his class so much that I'm taking another one from him next semester. Highly recommend!
Professor Ogletree is a great guy! He's has a lot of inspiring thoughts and fun stories to share. He's super willing to help with any questions or concerns.

Professor Ogletree was easily the best religion professor I've had at BYU. Not only is his class fairly easy (learning suite quiz before class, all tests on learning suite with answers given on study guide) but class was also super entertaining! It was really easy to feel the spirit and focus on the material. 10/10 would recommend.

He was absolutely awesome. He was hilarious and engaging, and really cared about teaching students and hearing their opinions. Im taking another class from him next semester because i loved him so much.
he is a great prof and will work with you

One of the easier religion courses I've taken at BYU! Ogletree really cares about his students. He gives you all the answers to the tests; you just have to go to class and take notes. He's funny and tells awesome stories. There are easy quizzes on Learning suite you have to take everyday but they are open note. A couple easy papers. Great class!
He is the best religion professor.  He understands exactly what students want in a religion course.  In addition, he is always willing to help and makes class entertaining.

Professor Ogletree is very funny and makes the topics fun to learn about. He has quizzes twice a week, but they're open book and the answers are straight out of the readings. The only drawback is that his exams are very specific and the questions can be confusing, or the answers may be very similar.

Professor Ogletree is the most caring and knowledgeable teacher I know. Take RELC 200 Eternal Families class from him and you will learn so much! The lectures are very interesting and engaging. He is willing to help any student with their questions and concerns.

Class was always super fun to go to worth it because you learn a lot. You have to go to class and sign the roll for attendance but its an easy class to sit through. You have readings and quizzes for each class but they are easy and have study guides you can fill out which in turn are the questions on the quizzes and the tests. Awesome teacher!

This was a great class.  I did abut 2 hours of homework a week, but it was all inspiration, so I loved it!  If you did the reading and paid attention in class, you would get an A.  It's a great class.  Ogletree is funny.  It was a low stress class that I learned a lot from.

I took this class as an incoming freshman and it was perfect to get accumulated to college. He has open note reading quizzes for each lecture and he provides study guides that show exactly where the answers are. Study hard for the tests but the class is a breeze. He also cares about his students and wants them to succeed! Take this class

I don't know how someone wouldn't love Dr. Ogletree! His lectures were both spiritual and entertaining. I felt the spirit every single class. The bonus is that its not a very hard class- He gives you a study guide full of test questions. There is a lot of reading, but it's not necessary. He is so knowledgeable and passionate about the family. DO IT

Professor Ogletree is super funny in the class. His lectures are great because he shares his personal stories with the class. He tries to get the students to participate in class as well. There is a lot of reading homework you do on your own and quizzes to go along with it. If you work, you'll do just fine.

Take from him. Great teacher who's relatable & not as spiritual as other teachers. 3 tests and a final. He gives a study guide that is very specific. If you know the study guide, you will do fine on tests. Quizzes on LS for every lecture but all due at end of semester. Not timed, open note and book, easy. 2 papers, personal and feelings based. Easy

Professor Ogletree is the best, he isn't your typical try too hard to be spiritual teacher, he relates to the more normal BYU students, not too proper, but knows how to relate to our college lives and and our age group.

He's probably the nicest guy on campus. That being said, his tests are very specific! You cannot get buy with just understanding the concepts, you have to know who said what word-for-word. There is so too much content on his slides in class  and he doesn't get to it all. I would suggest not taking this class from Ogletree.

Ogletree is FOR SURE one of the best professors on campus. He understands that religion classes shouldn't be the hardest. He is super funny and real with all his students. He is willing to work with students to make sure everyone passes. The lectures were a blast and there was a lot of class participation. MUST TAKE FROM HIM at BYU!!

He is AWESOME! By far one of my favorite professors here. He made the lectures inspiring and extremely interesting. This was his first semester teaching Eternal Family. He is also REALLY funny, so be prepared to laugh. His class helped me prepare for marriage better than anything else. This is a MUST TAKE class here on campus--and take it from him!
He's a great professor, knows his topics very  well, is willing to help with anything students might need, related to class or not.

Lectures are interesting but not very spiritual. If you read the powerpoints, it wouldn't be necessary to attend class: he doesn't say anything new (although attendance is mandatory). He's fun but lazy in creating tests. They're worded to confuse and don't test you on what matters. Doesn't test on readings, so you can just do them for enjoyment.

Phenomenal professor. He is passionate and helps his students understand the role of the family in God's plan of happiness. Brother Ogletree is super entertaining and you will look forward to his lectures. He inspired me to be a better spouse.

Bro Ogletree is pretty funny, but not that spiritual. He often got angry at the class because not enough students did the reading, so discussion was lacking.. but he got so angry that it chased the Spirit out. He once let us out twenty minutes early because he was too hungry to keep teaching. Easy A, but take it from someone else.
Dr. Ogletree is a cool guy, but I didnt find his class very informative or inspiring. The readings were good, but the discussions on them were lacking.

Of all my religion professors, he has been the least spiritual. His tests are ridiculously specific, and he gives you so much reading that you either spend a ton of time studying or just skim and don't get much out of it. His lectures are entertaining, but not very inspiring. Wish I had taken this class from someone else.

Loved his class!! He really cares about the students! His philosophy is that "your religion class shouldn't be your hardest class at BYU". He really engages his students. He is hilarious. All he teaches comes from words of the prophets and apostles, its legit stuff! You always leave class knowing more. Helpful and Inspiring!

Brother Ogletree is the best!! He is humorous but also I felt really inspired taking class from him! Homework is just reading a bunch of Conference talks so it's awesome! Tests are online and study guides tell you exactly what to study for. Lots of online open-book quizzes, so it's an easy A! Learned some good stuff too!

Bro. Ogletree is absolutely fantastic! Fun professor and very easy to connect with. I actually loved doing my homework for this class because all you do is read conference talks and BYU Devos from the apostles. Lots of opportunities for extra credit! Do your homework, come to class, and if you don't sleep, you will get an A for sure!!

All reading quizzes open-book, not timed. Lots of reading, but good readings. If memorize study guides (5 pages each test, single-space, tells you page #s where answers are), should do very well on tests. Tests timed. Be reasonable about Attributes Project. I set too high goals, regretted it, held to your goals for grade. Fun interesting class.

Bro. Ogletree needs to overhaul this clas and redesign it. There are way too many readings for a 2 credit class. He also jumps over so much content in class and just wants to tell stories that will not strengthen your testimony of the apostles. The tests are also ridiculous. Questions ask you to remember the exact wording of some random passage.
Class was a peace of cake. What was hard were the tests. Use the study guide! He loves football so he loves the football players, but I had no problem with that!

Take this class from Prof. Ogletree! Classes are fun, informative, and spiritual. You have about 20 quizzes on readings, but they are all online and all due at the end of the semester. You do one paper on attributes for a spouse and one paper on an attribute you work on through the semester. The exams are online. The class is easy but uplifting.

come to class- its fun and attendance is part of your grade. can find all the answers to quizzes by googling... dont have to do readings. Tests are harder than you would think- fill out the study guides and read over the slides- especially the things in red that are bolded. Class focuses on dating, NOT marriage, so do know that.

You cannot go through BYU without taking this guy's class! Bro Ogletree cares about the students and is willing to adjust the schedule to fit the students' needs. You feel the spirit every class period. His assigned readings are great and don't even feel like homework. He's hilarious too- don't think I've ever laughed so much in a religion class!

Seriously the best professor @ BYU. Understands that religion classes shouldn't be as hard as physics classes - grades fairly. One of the easiest classes I've taken here, & I could have probably gotten an A without showing up, but he makes you actually want to go to class. He is so funny and you love what he teaches; my testimony has grown so much!
awesome teacher!!! Brother ogletree is so funny and nice and helps people make good grades in his class!I highly recommend him for everyone

Ogletree is a BYU Religion must! You feel the spirit in every class, he interacts with the students, and you can tell he cares about each student. His Marriage and Family Class was one of the few classes I took that allowed participation. It's a very easy class if you do what he asks you to.

Bro. Ogletree is a great professor. I learned so much in his class, and it is already helping me in my relationship, even before marriage. The readings he assigns are fantastic.  Really entertaining and energetic. You have to do some work to do well in the class, but it's still pretty easy, and the assignments were beneficial & definitely worth it.
His class was so good.  He is an easy professor, but you still learn a lot.  He is very funny and genuinely concerned about his students.  I loved his class.

Best professor at BYU. Cares about the students and teaches with clarity. I wish I could have his class every day because I feel like every time I go, I learn a ton. He is very entertaining and you will learn and feel the spirit each class.

Best professor at BYU, hands down. He has an enormous passion for marriage and family matters and has a great wealth of knowledge and experience to share. All his tests and quizzes are meant to teach. He his very entertaining, but at the same time is is a total scholar on the subject of preparation for marriage. Best class at BYU.

A wonderful professor! His lectures were extremely entertaining, assignments were fair, not too many, he cared about making the class enjoyable, has lots of experience to draw from, and the class is very stress despite there being a lot of learning going on. Excellent professor!

Bro. Ogletree is awesome! He's a great teacher and he wants you to do well. My favorite class I've taken. Bro. O believes that religion classes should NOT be your hardest classes so he's pretty chill. Material is awesome and it's well presented. He really know his stuff.

Don't buy the books, he posts everything you need online. Great, entertaining lectures and surprisingly, you learn a lot. Open-everything quizzes, 1 easy paper, class attendance, and tests determine your grade. However, the whole class feels haphazard. Tests with ridiculous typos and poorly worded questions, just learn the study guides in depth.

Professor Ogletree is so sweet! He is an amazing teacher and is super funny. I looked forward to going to class every time. Even though it was pretty easy, I learned a ton, and it was all practical. I got married right after finishing his class and it definitely helped. Take his class!

Brother Ogletree is the best teacher I have ever had! He genuinely cares about each of his students and tries his hardest to help everyone understand the concepts. Plus he is hilarious! I learned more in this class than any other class I have had here at BYU and am so grateful I got Brother Mark Ogletree as a teacher. PS: His books are great!!

YESSS!!!!  Professor Ogletree is the man!!  He is so great!  Out of all the religion classes I have ever taken, this has been my favorite.  He is hilarious!  Plus, he straight up tells you he had hard religion classes at BYU when he was there, and hated it.  So he designed his class to be super easy.  I'm serious, this is the best prof ever.
He is great. Just stay up on the study guides. They are real long, but his entire test comes from them. You will enjoy his lectures. He has great humor. This is a must take for marriage prep.

Best Professor at BYU, hands down. He loves teaching, and students love him. I learned more in this class than I learned in any of my classes combined last semester. He is hilarious, and he cares his students. He doesn't  make things overly complicated and goes out of his way to help students. He is also ridiculously smart.

I LOVE Brother Ogletree!! He is hilarious and really cares about his students. The study guide is long, but it's not that big of a deal as long as you work on it every week. The tests were easy! All I did was fill out the study guide and did the quizzes. I read through them once or twice and aced the exams. I LOVED THIS CLASS!

Such a great class. Really worthwhile. Ogletree is hilarious and so fun.  Really nice and lenient. Some of the quizzes are busy work but Ogletree works with you so they're easy.  Tests are so easy. Class really strengthened my testimony.

I LOVE this class. Brother Ogletree's marriage and family class is hands down one of my favorite classes I've taken at BYU! He is funny, spiritual, and uplifting, and I feel like I am learning so much in his class that will help me be a better person! Plus, his class is the EASIEST class you could take!

Best religion class I've taken here!  His classes are always enlightening and fun - time just flies.  He tells you exactly what's going to be on his tests and he listens to class opinion (assignment being too long or due too soon, he'll shorten the requirement and have it due later).
Great Class! Great Professor!
Great Professor.  Spiritual and Funny.

I have done 2 semesters of school and this is by far the hardest class I have ever taken. His goal is for the average grade to be a C (his words not mine) and the tests are very hard. I had to study around 6 hours for each one to average a B. The questions are impossible to prepare for because it applying what you learn. Their worded very poorly.

Dr. Petersen is great! If you don't know much about biology, it can feel like a lot of content to wrap your head around, but meet with the TA and/or do group studies and you'll be okay. If you're familiar with high school biology, it would be a breeze. He makes lectures pretty fun, and is accommodating with students' needs.

Professor Petersen's class can feel long and challenging, especially if you don't know much biology going in, but he makes it very doable. He drops your two lowest quizzes, homework, and exams, which helps a lot. He's a great guy and actually pretty fun.

Dr. Showalter made what was described to me as one of the hardest classes I would take my favorite from my first semester at BYU. You do have to put in the work outside of class to really grasp all of the principles, but Dr. Showalter encourages working in groups and giving up to 2% overall extra credit which really helped.

Dr. Showalter is my goat. To do well in his class, you have to read everything he assigns and complete every extra credit assignment. If you do this, you'll be fine. If you skip the readings though you're super cooked.

Dr. Showalter is amazing. Don't get me wrong, his class is difficult. 65% of your final grade are exams. He is really friendly and try's hard to make challenging concepts easy. We had a small class size and he would bring us snacks, and refreshments once a week. He really is a great professor even if his exams might be a little difficult.
really nice guy. I personally think he's just too smart to teach. He doesn't really explain anything and cannot seem to say a single sentence without mumbling. its just a very disorganized class.

Prof Showalter is a great teacher who makes a tough class manageable. He provides ample resources like extra credit and practice exams. Utilizing Unstuck AI and the free textbook can really help stay on top of the content.

Such an interesting and useful class! I wish this class was a GE because of how applicable it was. The exams are HARD. You really have to know your stuff to do well on them. Prof Showalter is good, but most everything I learned was from the text book, so get ready to read. Luckily the text book is an awesome read and was easy to understand!

Professor Showalter, a respected expert, teaches a rigorous course where lectures closely follow weekly readings. Online quizzes, though minimally weighted, are essential for exam preparation. Exams make up 65% of the final grade, with the final exam alone worth 35%. Exam averages generally land in the high 60s, demanding significant study effort.

Showalter is very knowledgable about the material and provides engaging, helpful material in class. Because of the large class sizes though, working with TA's outside of class is THE MOST HELPFUL THING YOU CAN DO. Do not avoid textbook readings, do all of the assignments, and study hard for the exams and you should get a solid grade in this class.
