His tests are difficult. I did not spend enough time reviewing. Review your notes after every lecture and do the reading. Overall, I loved his class.

I absolutely love this class!!!! I can not speak enough for how valuable, real-world this class is. Probably my favorite class out of the entire MKTG junior core. Bond shows up to class everyday with a smile on his face and so much gratitude towards his career and his students. Would take again!!!!

Bond is a great guy! Nice, genuine, caring. Outsources most of his grading to his TAs, and their grading varies by section. Seems pretty unfair given my semester we had a way harder grader as a TA than the other sections. Generates his curve through an average between all sections. Tests were super tough. Nothing in the gradebook all semester.

Prof. Bond is amazing!! My only complaint was that the TA's grade SO harsh and for what? We are literally seniors taking this class just to be able to graduate and they're giving us C's for no reason at all and with very little explanation. If I could rate the TA's a 1 I totally would. Very frustrating.
BEST class ever. I have never been so interested in any lecture before. Bro Bond is fantastic and is such an awesome guy. HIGHLY recommend!
Professor Bond is AMAZING! I loved every lecture! He is a very difficult grader but an amazing teacher! Tests are difficult and be sure to know the reading well but it is possible to do well.

Professor Bond is a great guy and can be an entertaining lecturer. The class overall is not great. Tests are super hard and there's no study guide. TA reviews aren't helpful and basically just recommend memorizing everything. It feels like more of a generic business strategy class than a marketing strategy class. Shouldn't be a required core course

Bro Bond takes everything you learned in Billeter's, Elder's, and Madden's class and combines it in Marketing Strategy. Every lecture is super helpful and inspiring, and he gives you time to finish tests at your own pace. On top of that, his experience in industry makes his cases and project feedback extremely valuable. Definitely would recommend!

Professor Bond is awesome. His class is super interesting, and he always does new cool things to help learn the important concepts. The info really seems applicable to the job field. The only thing that was tough is that there a just a few assignments and the instructions aren't always clear on those.

Professor Bond is really invested in this class and his students. I didn't do well on the midterm and he reached out to me to see if I needed help. Really great professor and very energetic during his lectures even at 8 am. His exams are VERY hard, and he's a tough grader, but you have a group project that will make up for it if you do well.
He is one of the coolest professors, but his tests are stupid-hard and specific. The class itself is easy but his tests are hard to do well on. Take from other professor 100%

Great professor with real-world experience. He provided strategies and tactics and showed how to apply them in a way that was useful in practical application and not simply theoretical. Not a research professors, so he really dedicates himself to his teaching.
Avoid this class. He is just terrible at explaining. The TA's were good though. But there is lack of structure for this class.

Professor Bond is AMAZING! I would recommend him to anyone and take a class from him again. He is so insightful. Granted his class is quite difficult. His exams are difficult, but he makes himself available to review your exams and has exam reviews with the TA's. Take marketing from Professor Bond!!!!

Professor Bond is a super nice guy - funny, gets to know his students, and knows his stuff. The class moved a little slow. There are only a few assignments and tests, and they are graded EXTREMELY picky. I'm usually an A student, but I couldn't ever seem to figure out what he was looking for. Get a good company to do your group project with.

I love Professor Bond but this class killed me. I'm a straight A student but I barely managed a solid B in this class. The group project is a great learning experience and lasts the entire semester. The exams were tricky and accounted for the majority of the grade in the class.

Class attendance is a must. Not a hard teacher or grader. Exams were a bit tricky. I studied for hours each day, finishing an exam thinking I did well but got 75s.. Nice guy, very willing to help students. great TAs. highly recommend. lots of reading, and lecture notes. exams are 75% lecture 25% book, but 75% of lecture is already in the book..
Very engaging lectures.  Nice man.  Very competent in his field.  Tough tests!  Fun projects.  Loved the class.
One of my favorite classes so far. Brother Bond is a good professor and he cares about his students. Although tests were tough, this class was rewarding!

Bro Bond is a great guy and teacher. I enjoyed his class but didn't feel like he prepared his students for the exams very well. For the first midterm there was a TA review where they just went over his class slides and what they guessed would be test. Poor test review, no practice problems, lots of memorizing slides. HW was easy.
Awesome guy.  Highly recommend his class.

Mike Bond is the frickin man! Loved his class and he gave us a clear understanding of what retail and CPG looks like from an insider's POV by way of GMROI, AC Nielsen, etc. I left with awesome tools, confidence in the market and how to own the PnL. Make it a part of your MBA.

Really love this class. Excellent teacher, very applicable knowledge going into any industry. Do the readings, pay attention in lecture, and you're going to have a blast. He is as clear as can be, and teaches you several valuable skills to understand SO many useful things. Favorite class since accfin 200. Tests are 75% in class and 25% book. Easy.
I really loved this class. Professor Bond is the best teacher I've had at BYU. He loves the material and loves to teach. The tests are pretty difficult, but there isn't a huge workload.
Great lectures but don't be fooled. The tests are tough and you need to memorize the material/understand the concepts. Homework is generally easy, just get it handed in on time.

Best class I've taken at BYU. Bond is a professional and you should take every opportunity to have a class from him. The material is tough, but Bond is not. He is super clear and wants to help you. Go to the TAs for help and do the extra credit! Loved this class!
I'll summarize my comments into a few words: TAKE HIS CLASS!!!!
Great professor!! First semester teaching, straight from the industry. Missed class a few times, but NOT BY CHOICE! EVERY lecture is great. Highly recommend any course from him!
One of the best professors I've ever had. Tests are slightly challenging but he gives incredible lectures. Gives lots of feedback on work and helps with career advice. Just take his class.

Just came from industry.  An incredible teacher.  Very engaging, awesome powerpoints.  He does not teach strictly toward the test, but I feel like I have a very good understanding of the basics of marketing from this class.  Few assignments, two midterms and a final.
Super fun class. He is really easy to talk to and really helpful. All in all, he is one of the best ASL professors I've had.
Mike was so fun and made learning about the Deaf World easy and enjoyable. Used fun activities as well as reading and lectures to help students learn

Dr. Diede is a very good guy, but his class structure is lacking. Almost every lecture involved him asking if we had any questions about the textbook and then just rambling. He didn't really teach anything. For this reason, you'd think his exams would be pretty laid back, but they're pretty specific on stuff he never taught. Exam high was an 80%.

I would recommend taking from Professor Diede if you are able to understand textbooks and teach things to yourself easily. His lectures weren't very helpful as far as learning goes but he did give a lot of hints about the exams. Many students stopped showing up to lectures and just studied the slides and textbook. Very intuitive tests.

Are you considering the athletic training program? Don't apply until Diede steps down. He doesn't communicate his expectations and blames students for his own abysmal organization. He doesn't teach anything. Grading is months late and lacks rubrics/explanation. Exams frequently have errors, contradict previous exams, or test things he never taught.

His tests are very clear and not confusing and honestly, I found them pretty easy as long as you do the textbook readings. He gives helpful hints in lecture for his exams. Not a great lecturer but a great person. Anatomy is a hard subject but having straightforward tests really helps. He also gave points back on every exam.

As others have pointed out, Diede's lectures have no structure or clarity. I usually feel like I've lost brain cells after sitting through class. You're better off skipping class and reading the textbook. His grading is also super arbitrary and unclear, as are instructions for papers. Avoid taking any of his classes if at all possible.

Dr. Diede is a super kind and fun professor who cares about his students a ton, just doesn't teach very clearly. The quizzes and test are all based off of a textbook and very rarely does material from lectures show up on them. He has fun stories and loves to answer questions, you just have to do all your learning outside of class.

Professor Diede is so kind. Anatomy lectures are ALWAYS really long and tend to get boring, but Diede worked hard to make them interesting. He's not my favorite lecturer, but he's effective. TA reviews and practice tests were really helpful for the exam. He gives points back for questions that over half the class misses. He cares about his students

Diede loves his students but is a bit of a rambler. I mostly taught myself the class content with the lecture slides and textbook. He is very good at giving out what's on the exam and the tests aren't too bad either. Not an impossible class but definitely bring gum to lectures to stay awake!

Dr Diede is super super nice, and makes lectures really interesting. He'll hint at test questions and give you ideas of what to study. He kind of tends to hop around in lectures and they can be hard to follow, but if you go to the TA reviews and study hard for exams, you'll be totally fine!
This class is a tough one no matter who you take it from. I really enjoyed Dr. Diede, he prepared us well for the exams and was a fair professor. He answered questions and was really entertaining.

Dr Diede is the nicest man you'll ever meet. But his class has no structure. The info you need to know is mostly NOT on the powerpoints and he jumps topics a lot during his lectures, making it hard to take effective notes or follow the lecture. You can do fine in the class but it can be very frustrating.

Dr. Diede was a great lecturer for Cell 220. This class is tough to begin with, but he made lectures engaging. Make sure you listen well, take notes, and study the slides for the exam. The grade for the lecture portion of the class is made out of 4 exams, but this is the same for all cell 220 classes. If you can, take it from Dr. Diede!

Professor Dide makes anatomy not a nightmare, sometimes he loses his thoughts in stories, But he is not tricky with the exams and he is always willing to give points in order to have better grades. He literally says what will be in the exam. He is a really nice professor.

I love Dr. Diede! The lectures were a tad unclear at times but he's such a lovable guy it's easy to forgive haha. The material in this class is so rich by itself. I hope he gets to teach more, I think he'll get the hang of it pretty quick. TA reviews were SO helpful for exams!

Dr. Diede is the best professors I have had at BYU. I took him for CELL 220, but that wasn't an option.  Anatomy is a very difficult class with hard concepts, but he explains everything in a way that is easy to understand. On the exams, he doesn't trick you and offers hints, like a joke made during class. He also is very clear on what to study.

*actually took CELL 220 from him*. One of the BEST professors I have ever had. If you are taking anatomy-take it from him. The slides/content are standardized across all CELL 220 professors but he makes the content digestible and straight-forward, regardless of the difficult nature of the class. He really wants his students to do well and it shows.

Dr. Diede really cares about his students, can be really funny, and is a super good guy! He also can be a really great professor, but is super disorganized. I have taken 4 or 5 classes from him that have been required and have gotten an A in all of them. Easy classes, just disorganized. But do the assignments and you will easily pass.

Diede is a great guy. Has a lot of knowledge and is a pretty good teacher when he gets down to business in the class and teaches. But he is just so disorganized. I hardly ever knew what was going on in that class. There was little structure. And as such, it took a while for class to even get going sometimes.
Fantastic teacher. Very knowledgeable. Pretty chill dude. Took a basic jogging class from him and I loved it. Take the class from him.
BEST TEACHER EVER!!!!
good guy. not a great teacher. not organized but really cares about students.

Entertaining.VERY DISORGANIZED.  Got annoyed wen no 1 knew where to find n wen to turn in assignments...even though it resulted completely from his lack of organization. Acts as though hes willing to help but wuld rather Not be bothered. Athletic training is an awesome major but unfortunately hes over it.. still half decent.n im sure he'll improve.

He is great! He has a lot of passion behind what he does and has a strong testimony of the gospel which made me look forward to this class every week! I took the blended in-person and online version of this class which made the readings a little much at some points but once you find how to listen to them as you go about your day it isn't so bad.
I had him for eternal families and he was really amazing and a really good professor!

Professor Goodman brings an interesting perspective on the family, he incorporates modern social science with prophetic teachings to show how they support each other. He also covers sensitive topics regarding gender, family roles, and sexuality with great care. Fantastic professor and fantastic class!

Brother Goodman is an amazing religion professor. I have had him for both mission prep and eternal families. I would recommend him to anyone. You will strengthen your testimony as you learn and participate in his class.
He's a genius and very caring at the same time.

I did not have any expectations going into this course, but was very pleasantly surprised. This professor is amazing. He is extremely accomplished despite facing serious hardship. He is also one of the most loving and caring people I have ever met. He explains the concepts very well. He is an amazing professor and an even more amazing guy.
Professor Goodman is incredible, take this class!

Brother Goodman was very respectful and sensitive to the topics taught. I appreciated his main focus on prophetic teachings and principles, with supporting statistics and social science. Great instructor he really cares. Learns your name before the first day, you have to go to class though and I didn't love the format. Great lecturer though, great suggestions super helpful for preparing for marriage life. Discussion posts were weighted heavier than I liked I missed one and missed a 1.5% of my final grade.

Professor Goodman is probably one of my favorite professors I've had. You can feel of his love & goodness before he even speaks. He truly cares, which is shown in how he learns everyone's names prior to the first day of class. He is also very wise and spiritual -- wish I could take more religion classes from him!
An amazing professor who really understands his subject and cares about his students. I would highly recommend and I have to others in person.

Brother Goodman really cares about his students and provides lots of opportunities for you to do well. His lesson outlines are a lot of work - so be ready for 3 pretty hefty assignments. Otherwise, reading is pretty light and the in class discussions are amazing and spiritually strengthening.

I really enjoyed this online class. It had a lot of good material and was set up in a way that was easy to follow along with. As long as you do the reading, the quizzes are easy and the exams are based on the readings. You can tell that Brother Goodman really cares about his students. The TA was also very kind and helpful.

Brother Goodman was a great professor. He gives a lot of resources to do well on exams and on papers. He is also very responsive to my emails, and would usually get back to me within a few hours of me sending them, even if it was an email I sent in the evening or on the weekend.

This online class was surprisingly enlightening and spiritually uplifting! I found it to be a little tedious, but it was worth it because you can tell that Brother Goodman and the TAs care about you. My only complaint is that there is a lot to read, but you can get through it because it is interesting.

Professor Goodman is awesome! If you are preparing to serve a mission, I would highly recommend his class. It is definitely more work than your typically Mission Prep class, but it was so worth the effort! Make sure to attend class, because it does count for your grade, and his lectures are so inspiring!

Professor Goodman is amazing! There is a project and one 6 page essay but if you pace yourself you'll be fine! One quiz and a discussion or an analysis assignment per week but it's so doable.  Really the only thing is make sure you fill out the exam study guide throughout the semester everything on it is what is on the midterm and final exam!!
He was really good and gave information from studies that he completed. He was very knowledgeable in his area of study. I learned a lot from this class

Brother Goodman is a great professor. I am not a fan of BYU religion classes in general, but he is a good one to take eternal families from. The work is minimal, but there is HW every week. Usually a response in a discussion board. A few papers and 2 tests. Show up at class and listen and you should do great.

Professor Goodman is an excellent instructor who makes complex topics easy to understand. His lectures are clear, engaging, and well-structured. He's always available to help and provide useful feedback on assignments. I appreciated the real world examples and how they encouraged class participation. I would highly recommend his class!

I highly recommend taking this class! Brother Goodman has a background in social science and therefore has tons of insights to research and information as it relates to the delicate topics and information that we learn about in this class. You will not regret taking this class!

Brother Goodman is a wonderful professor, who loves each of his students and helps them accomplish their goals. He is really understanding and will answer questions that you might struggle with. It is usually a blended course, but is always willing to help.
Best professor at BYU! So kind and respectful. Definitely recommend taking Eternal Families from him.

I love Professor Goodman. He gave great insights and he clearly cares for all his students. I was having a hard semester, but he reached out to students and wanted to see how they were doing, not just in class, but in their lives in general. I'm so grateful I took his class. He is an incredible professor and an even more amazing man.

Based solely on the class: it's boring, repetitive, and the tests ask you about specific things in readings from months ago. 
More importantly, this class is not a safe space for LGTBQ+ individuals. It simply can't be with the content that the school makes the class use, but mike does no good in trying to make it an accepting space for all.
My favourite prof!

I loved having Brother Goodman as my professor in Univ 101. I really enjoyed his humor and wisdom. It felt like he went above and beyond to help students feel as if they had an advocate and friend in him. I'd highly recommend his Univ 101 class because he doesn't assign much busy work as well, focusing more on what students actually need.

I absolutely LOVE Brother Goodman!! I don't know if I would have survived Eternal Families without him. He is so incredibly knowledgeable as well as compassionate about sensitive issues. The course itself is good, with some of the assignments (primarily the essays) being kind of therapeutic tbh.

Brother Goodman is intentional and careful about how he teaches specific topics, being sure to convey love while doing so. He has interesting and profound viewpoints that I trust because of his background on the communications board for the Church. He makes each student feel special.
Amazing Professor and class. It was well organized and I felt the reading was applicable. I took mission prep from him and was happy to be able to take eternal families as well!

I did the hybrid method going to class once a week. Participation on that one day was a big part of each weekly quiz. Bro Goodman has good energy for the subject. I liked the balance of stats, spiritual content and personal examples.

Brother Goodman knows the Eternal Families class extremely well (since he created it) and there is a lot to be learned. There will be quite a bit of reading and some long term assignments but you won't be shocked by the difficulty of anything from this course.
A little harder than what I wanted in a mission prep class. Super awesome and nice guy though!

Prof Goodman is super awesome! Lessons are really engaging, and learn a ton. The outlines take a bit of time, but that's seriously the only work you do outside of class so would totally recommend him.

I loved this class so much! However, I did not know that it was half online, half in-person. Next time, I would not do that because I struggled with the online material. However, Brother Goodman was amazing! He is truly a passionate person! Mid-term and final are pretty challenging but not quizzes, and there are extra credit opportunities.

Love this guy. Had a great conversational teaching style, extremely good at explaining sensitive topics, approachable, funniest guy you'll find in the religion department, gave him perfect gradings all the way. All stuff is due Saturday so if you're like me and taking way too many credits but want a religion class, pick him.

I wish that every religion class was taught like this. He cares about you, he teaches the content so well, and this is the most wholistic approach to teaching the Eternal Family. I wish he could teach all of my religious classes.
he was awesome

Brother Goodman is an amazing professor! His lessons are engaging He is knowledgeable and his experiences are inspiring. Listen to his warnings about he lesson outlines- they take forever and are really tedious, but once you fall into a grove with them their cake. Overall a pretty easy class, just stay on top of it.

Professor Goodman is super kind and is an inspiring teacher. You can tell that he puts a lot of time and effort into his lessons and his assignments. There is a good amount of reading each week but they are all very good and go along with his lessons. I really enjoyed taking his class and his tests are very managable.

If you want a good mission prep teacher, I highly suggest Goodman. He really knows his missionary stuff after being a mission president and teaching at the MTC. I feel so much more prepared for my mission now than when I started. You are going to have to do some pretty in depth teaching outlines but they will prepare you SO MUCH for your mission.

Love brother Goodman. He approaches tough topics with a lot of compassion. You have a quiz and short response each week, and then a final and midterm. Only bad thing, there's a long paper due at the end. It's an easy topic but will take a long time. There are good quizlets online for the exams.

Brother Goodman is amazing! If you are looking for a mission prep teacher, I can't suggest Goodman enough! He has a TON of experience with everything related to missions and is very passionate about it all. Work is not too bad the only thing is that the lesson outlines WILL take longer than you think!
Bro Goodman is the best! I have taken class from him twice because he is just the best. I really feel like he cares about each of his student individually (he memorizes everyones names).
Professor Goodman was a great teacher and made the class enjoyable. He made lectures very entertaining while also describing the content in good detail. Work outside of class was very manageable
Brother Goodman is very kind, and deals with difficult topics in a sensitive and understanding way. I would definitely recommend taking Eternal Families from him!

Brother Goodman was such a good professor! He was able to teach some really sensitive topics with a lot of compassion and you could really tell he cares about what he teaches. The only homework are listening to a few talks every week but other than that there isn't much outside of class work!
Such an amazing profesor. He will get you to do the work but it is so rewarding. He will change your life.

Professor Goodman is so, so nice. His teaching style is a little lecture heavy, which is not my style as much as it makes participating and engaging in the material a little more challenging. But if that's your style and you're looking for a kind, inspired Professor who helps you get through just fine, then he's a good option.

Professor Goodman is GREAT!!! TAKE HIS CLASS!! He has minimal work other than the outlines, which can take up to hours to finish, but we only had three of those throughout the while semester, get those started early, and youll be fine.

If you struggle with topics relating to eternal families, Brother Goodman is the right professor for you. He knows how to be caring and sensitive. If you let him know your personal struggles, he will help you get through the class with a positive experience. He will also talk to you individually about your questions.

Mike Goodman is one of my favorite professors at BYU! He presented challenging material in a very loving and sensitive way that I really appreciated. His lectures were engaging as well. He gives a clear study guide for the weekly readings as well as the lectures, so you know exactly what to focus on. I would take any class from Brother Goodman!

Professor Goodman is by far the best professor I have ever had. I had him for mission prep, and I learned so much from his lectures and the stories he would tell. He has helped me feel so prepared for my upcoming mission that I feel like I could skip the MTC and just get chucked straight into teaching people. He truly cares for the students too. :)

The professor is very passionate about the class subjects and it shows when he's teaching, because he'll get very excited talking about something that sometimes he couldn't fit all the subjects in one class.
Is not a bad thing, cause every class was very spiritual!
Brother Goodman is truly one of the best. There is never a dull moment when in his class. He makes the lectures so engaging and positive. I highly recommend to anyone going to BYU.

Professor Goodman was amazing! I had him for eternal families and I was not expecting much from the class. It turned out to be my favorite. His online assignments are not difficult and his lectures are inspiring. Make sure to attend class and do the readings and you will do fine.
He is so nice and cares about his students
Brother Goodman's lectures are amazing! There is a bit of required readings throughout the semester but everything is doable!

Brother Goodman is a wonderful person. He cares about who he teaches and what he teaches. He is a pro at what he does. You are in great hands if you decide to take his class. I took it right after I got married and it taught me so much about the many things that we're changing in my life. One of the best classes I've taken at BYU.
Good prof, good class. You wont regret taking it!

Brother Goodman is really really good. Teachings using doctrine and stats to back it up. Semester project and essay are good reflections, grading pretty easy. Some readings, but well worth the time to do it. He is aware of sensitive topics in the family and teaches in a way that shows compassion but also teaches the doctrine. Highly recommend him.

Mike Goodman provided great spiritual insights and lead a relatively easy class. The only things to be aware of are lesson outlines due throughout the semester. They are not difficult if you manage your time well, but they do include a lot of material. Besides those, the reading is easy and study guides are provided for midterms and finals.

Brother Goodman is an amazing professor! Eternal Families can be a difficult class that covers some heavy topics (at least from my perspective), but he did a good job teaching with compassion and empathy throughout the semester and respected students when they disagreed with him. Definitely take a class from Brother Goodman if you get the chance!

Brother Goodman is an amazing professor. I learned so many great things! I would say that his tests seemed to be a bit harder than anything else, besides the lesson outlines. The lesson outlines are long and very time consuming, but ultimately so rewarding! He really is a great professor, and he you can tell he cares for his students.
This was a blended course, but he was very straightforward about the material. The course was very time consuming but he was very understanding if some things needed extra time.

I loved Brother Goodman and this class! I highly recommend taking this class if you are considering going on a mission or have a mission call. Brother Goodman is an excellent teacher and cares so much about all of his students. There are some pretty heavy lesson outlines but they teach you so much. Start early and they aren't as bad!

I loved this class and honestly learned so many things I didn't know about the Gospel. The only thing I would recommend for students taking this class is to get started on the outlines early because they took me FOREVER but they were very beneficial to my learning and they aren't hard if you balance out how much time you spend on them every week.

This is my second class that I have taken from him. He is an incredible man with great stories and insights. He is one of the founders of this course so you are in for a treat if you take it with him because you will learn things that you wouldn't be able to from any other professor.
He is a great professor, very engaging and cares for those he teaches.
He's the best! Super engaging class. I took a blended class so half of the work was online. I wish it was all in person because he's such an engaging and nice professor!

He is an amazing professor. I took his blended class which in my opinion is awesome. It was once a week for 50 min and then some online reading and a few assignments. the readings weren't too bad.  His lectures were inspiring and got to the point in 50 minutes. My favorite teacher so far (I'm currently a freshman). Very good class - Austin Frodsham

Brother Goodman is amazing! He teaches the principles of Eternal Families and connects them to relatable life experience. Attending class was always a positive experience. The assignments are based on your personal takeaways from the class.

Honestly one of the coolest religion professors I have had! I like his way of teaching and he shows a lot of care about what he teaches. Tests are not super hard, and homework during the semester is easy!

I love Brother Goodman!!! He taught very well and clearly! This mission prep class was incredibly helpful. Barely any assignments, there are only three big assignment/projects due every three weeks. You write out different teaching methods for the missionary lessons. Not that difficult, just time consuming but very helpful for learning to teach.

This was a great class. I loved coming every day, and he aways taught amazing lessons. The lesson plans were some work, but honestly not bad. Besides the lesson plans there is little work. I am so much more prepared and excited to serve a mission.

Brother Goodman was a great teacher! His lectures were really great and I learned many gospel topics more in depth. One thing that was really hard for me were the lesson outlines. I feel like they were really repetitive. I think it is a great idea but I feel like it was just a little much. It just seemed hard to do them right.

Brother Goodman is very clear about what you need to do every week. His lectures are amazing and he has a talent for keeping everything neutral and spiritual. This class is not just for married people. Brother Goodman knows his students by name before class even starts and shows genuine love for each one.
Professor Goodman is my favorite professor! I love his lectures and I can feel the spirit in his class more than any other.
He is such a nice professor, and you can tell he is passionate about what he is teaching. The course was a half online half in person class.

Brother Goodman is probably my favorite professor at BYU! He knows what he is talking about and is very passionate. He always does a personal check in halfway through the semester to see if you have any questions or concerns. He has two projects that are relatively easy as long as you do it. I 100% recommend
 taking a class from him!

Very caring, but spends too much time on what we already know and doesn't get to the main material. 1 midterm, 1 final, 1 paper, 1 project. Tests are MCQs and 3 out of 4 options seem right, but tests aren't weighted very heavy. Your grade is really padded by participation. You can get an A, but you might not love the class.

Brother Goodman is very fun and knowledgable, which made lectures very engaging. He shared interesting stories and data from his research on marriage and family. I loved how he gave concrete suggestions on how we can strengthen our marriages and families. The workload was not too heavy, and it felt applicable.

Overall great class, the professor is very insightful and has great lectures. Follow the study guide every class. You write lesson outlines from Preach My Gospel but you have three weeks to do them. Use your time wisely.
Class is very insight full. There are a couple bigger projects but he gives you three weeks to do them. Use the tree weeks don't procrastinate them. Teacher is great and always has amazing stories.

He is an amazing teacher and person! He offers insights into the mission field that other professors don't! He was a mission president so he knows what makes a successful missionary and what doesn't. I would recommend him 1000/10. The outlines are the hardest but they an absolute necessity on your mission.

Brother Goodman was truly inspirational. He wrote most of the course for eternal families so he is the one to take it from. He has a ton of church experience and knowledge. One of my favorite classes I've taken at BYU.
teaches clear and concise, always to the point on topics.
If you want a religion course where you can be happy, focus on the gospel, and not feel like you need to stress over ridiculous amounts of schoolwork... This is the spot.

His lectures are very engaging, I found myself wishing they were longer. This class was blended, so it did have a lot of reading, but the readings are usually interesting and valuable. I had a hard time with the exams for this class, but if you are good with memorization you will be fine.

I would definitely recommend in person because this professor is someone who you want to just sit and listen to. But blended was still uplifting and not too much work. There is one big project, but you set your own guidelines and it's uplifting. He's very open to answer questions in class or office hours, nothing is too deep to discuss.
Brother Goodman is so kind and respectful. He makes class very engaging and I learned so much! The lesson plans definitely required a lot of time and effort but they will be useful on my mission.
Brother Goodman is so nice and caring. His lectures are pretty entertaining and he is meant to be a professor. I didn't love the exams, but class was good.
Goodman is the BEST! This is the second class I've taken from him and I loved. He goes out of his way to memorize everyone's names and makes learning fun!
Great teacher, took the online blended class so LOTS of reading. Would take the class again just be ready to read a ton.

I loved his eternal families class. He has a sociology background, so it was fascinating to learn about the statistical sides of the doctrine that really show how beneficial it is to follow the gospel of Jesus Christ. Really sensitive about touchy subjects. He was very interesting, and the homework was not bad. It was time consuming though.

He was so awesome. He really cared about his students and will check in with you if he knows you're struggling. You do need to go to every class period because not only do you need the info for tests, but there's an attendance quiz. But the assignments while you need to actually spend time thinking about them aren't hard. 10/10 recommend

I love Professor Goodman! He is such a fun, caring professor to take Eternal Families from. He ensures the class is a safe space for all from day one. He brings the Spirit into class so strongly, and I am so glad I took this class from him! A little bit of homework for this class, but Professor Goodman gives great feedback! Would highly recommend!

Bro. Goodman's class was fine. Not very hard, and he is a nice guy. I personally didn't like the way he engaged with some more controversial topics, but other people in the class seemed to really enjoy it. There was a lot of reading, but the tests weren't too bad. Some of the projects/assignments felt like busywork, but again, not hard.

This class does require more work than most religion classes (there are 3 projects that take about 7-12 hours each) Besides the heavier workload this class is really fun, the lectures are entertaining and have lots of fun stories in them.

Brother Goodman is incredibly kind and encouraging. He loves missionaries and I was excited to tell him my mission call once it finally came. He's truly understanding towards students who decide not to serve.

Attendance is self-reported. There are 3 large writing assignments (the lesson outlines) that take forever. Each one took me minimum 7 hrs.
Brother Goodman is the best! This was one of my favorite classes this semester. I feel so much more prepared to serve a mission. I will definitely be taking another one of his classes in the future!
Brother Goodman was a great teacher. He did a great job of teaching the material in an understandable way and his class helped me feel more prepared for my mission.

Brother Goodman is the BEST! His mission prep class has truly been one of my favorites this semester, and I plan to take an eternal families course with him after my mission. Outside of class, there are some super easy and interesting quizzes, and a few bigger lesson outlines, which will be SO helpful in the mission field. I love Brother Goodman!!!

Brother Goodman is one of the most spiritual men I have ever met and I am so glad that I took his class. He does do mission outlines that take a bit of time, but he gives you weeks to do it and it is really helpful. His lectures are inspiring and hep you learn about being a missionary.

Brother Goodman is amazing. I had such a great experience in his class. There are three big lesson plan projects that you have to complete, but he gives you ample time and is very open and honest about expectations. He is very caring for each student and is a joy to be around.

His class motivated me to go on a mission. I was kind of back and forth on whether I wanted to serve. However, every time I left his class, I left feeling the Spirit so strongly and felt like I learned so much.

He is the nicest guy and cares a ton about his students. He does give more work compared to other mission prep classes. I would 100% recommend him but be prepared for 3 big projects during the semester.

This man is awesome. Makes religion classes feel like a good learning opp and not another class you are required to take. Goodman cares SO much about his students and wants you to learn and have a good time. You cover a lot of sensitive topics but he is so good about addressing them and he has an amazing eternal perspective that changes the game.

Professor Goodman is a fantastic teacher - he makes even the drier material engaging. The course has a lot of reading, but his lectures and use of unstuckstudy ai really help solidify the concepts. Highly recommend for an insightful and respectful learning experience.

The professor has a clear passion for the subject and creates an engaging learning environment, even in an online format. While the course can be challenging, the professor's personalized approach and helpful feedback make it worthwhile.

Brother Goodman is amazing! So kind, strong testimony, has great energy, and does a great job of making mission prep simple and praticable. Plus, he's an MTC branch president so he knows what's up. The out of class work is making outlines from the first three lessons in PMG to use in the mission field, plus canvas assignments that are pretty quick.

Professor Goodman was my favorite professor because he is so sweet and you learn so much! He never announced deadlines on easily forgetful assignments so I lost quite a few points on those because life got so busy. But he really is the best person you can learn and receive advice from!
I really enjoyed this class! I took the online version because I was doing a sport during the time of the class. He accommodated all of my needs and was super kind and quick to answer my emails!

Brother Goodman is the best man. He is so intelligent and you learn so much in this class. I am preparing to serve a mission in august and this was the best class to take for that. We had 3 outlines due over the semester that took time to make but it's an assignment you can use on your mission and will be so helpful.
Brother Goodman is awesome! He has some awesome ideas on home and family! Get ready to read but overall I super enjoyed the class!

This is a great class, especially if you are looking for an all online option! The weeks are focused mostly on reading and then small quizzes and assignments. The hardest part is the tests which focus mainly on memorization but you get a really good study guide to help!

I loved the online version of Eternal Families. Online religion classes are always more work than the in-person classes but you learn so much more. The entire course could be skimmed through if you didnt want to put in the work (dishonest but it could be done). Professor Goodman is a great guy and really loves his job and the students.

I have a lot of respect for Professor Goodman after being in his course this semester. We covered some very sensitive topics and he handled the discussion with an incredible level of respect and understanding. I was inspired by his teaching style.

Professor Goodman was an amazing professor and I really enjoyed his class! His assignments were pretty consistent and the same throughout the whole year. His tests are pretty easy if you make sure to fill out the study guides he gives you. He is very knowledgeable and I feel this class really did prepare me to become a missionary!

he is such a good guy he explains difficult topics in respectful and informative ways that have really helped me better understand and have a new view on some things. a ton of reading for the blended version so be prepared for that but he is so nice and cool and i love him you should take from him.!!!
Great professor truly cares about what he professes, lectures were always entertaining! Overall very relaxed class, do the assignments and you will do well.
Professor Goodman cares for and respects his students. He wants everyone to succeed. He teaches the doctrine simply and clearly.

Brother Goodman has great lectures that are very inspiring and informative on both easy and difficult concepts. He cares about his students and provides every opportunity for them to succeed. There are a lot of required readings and the two tests require studying, but the class isn't too difficult.

Brother Goodman was SO good for mission prep. I loved how in depth he went and the energy he brought to class was always so good! His stories and life story is so interesting and I really enjoyed hearing his perspectives on class topics. I feel much more prepared for a mission having taken this class. (tip: outlines do take 8 hours! plan ahead.)
Brother Goodman was an amazing religion teacher! You can tell how much he cares for his students and loves the course he teaches!

Brother Goodman is the best! I really enjoy his teaching style and the class material. It is clear he cares about you as an individual from day one. He is engaging and it is clear he cares about what he is teaching. I took the course as a blended class and my only regret is that I didn't have more in-person lecture time. Highly recommend!

Brother Goodman was fantastic. I really loved the lectures, felt like the material and content of the course was all very clear and easy to understand. I thought there was a great flow and the course was easy to understand despite being online. Brother Goodman is experienced and understands how to connect with his students, even if online.

He genuinely seems to care about other people. Mid-semester, he reached out to me directly so I could voice questions or concerns about the course material. 200 C isn't the most engaging class, but it's genuinely better with him.

Brother Goodman is SO AMAZING. I learned so much from him this semester, both from the content and the type of person he is. He's so patient and Christ-like, and genuinely cares about each of his students. He emailed us individually halfway through the semester to check up on us and ask if there was anything he could do to help us in the class.

One of the best teachers! He has such an amazing story and I learned so much from him! I knew that I could go to him with any question or concern and he would be able to answer it in such a Christ-like way. You do outlines of the missionary lessons that are a little time consuming, but you are actually going to use them so it is worth it.

I love Brother Goodman, he is the sweetest! I had him for Mission Prep and though I loved this class, just be aware that he has lesson plan assignments that require a lot of outside time to work on. As long as you put effort in though he will give you a good grade so they are not stressful except for the amount of time they take to complete.

I really loved Brother Goodman! I took his class online and even though it was an online setting he would reach out to me and check up on me throughout the semester. It is just required readings with a quiz and discussion board every week with one project and paper due at the end of the semester. I would totally take him again!

Super awesome teacher and very nice. At times I feel like the class was boring but overall good for anyone planning on serving a mission. Very minimal work except for outlines which you get a few weeks but take a long time. Overall a very easy and nice 3 credit religion class.

Attendance is required, weekly assignments, two big final projects, and the final, itself. One of the projects was a paper 5-7 pages in length and the other was a semester-long project. Goodman is AWESOME, but I was having a rough semester when I took him and this class was one of the more stressful ones for me due to its weekly workload.

Prof Goodman is the actual GOAT! If you are at all interested in serving a mission, this class is the way to go. Sometimes the class goes off the topic BUT it is actually the best because he shares the coolest stories, prioritizing students over hard timelines. Make sure you get in the rhythm of the weekly assignments (super easy). 100% recommend.

Professor Goodman is awesome! He has interesting lectures and really cares about his students. Sometimes he goes on tangents during class answering questions or sharing other things. There's one paper and a semester-long project. Some reading is assigned, but this class isn't too difficult when it comes to workload. Would recommend!

Brother Goodman really cares about the students and the topic he teaches. The class isn't very easy, and myself along with some others have talked about how many times it feels like there is overlap in what is being taught in different units. Overall he's a great teacher and fun to listen to, but don't take this class if your schedule if heavy.
Interesting lectures, I learned alot, I took this class online and thought it was manageable.
A lot of homework but great class and great teacher
He was lit

I loved Professor Goodman! He inspired me and it was one of my favorite religion classes. I felt like I learned something new and mind-blowing in each class. However, the tests were hard and not very clear. There was lots of work for three main assignments that I spent hours on. This class definitely required me to work hard.

Brother Goodman is great! Super nice guy and very understandable when I had to make up some assignments because of health issues. The online class is pretty chill, a lot of reading and videos to watch but that makes sense because you're not actually attending class.

This class was amazing! For anyone going/thinking about going on a mission, I highly recommend it. There can be a decent amount of work at times but never unmanageable and assignments can be used in the mission field. Dr. Goodman is an amazing professor! His lectures were always engaging and he is a very caring and thoughtful professor.

Professor Goodman is a really good professor.  He is very kind and cares about his students. His class has a lot of quizzes and can be pretty reading-heavy. Overall I really enjoyed his lectures.  He is funny and keeps the class interesting.

Brother Goodman is very passionate and knowledgeable about what he teaches. There could have been more classroom engagement. He was able to teach the topics clearly, but was hard to feel the spirit and he never taught how to apply what we were learning. The course is easy but frustrating because it often feels like busy work.

DISCLAIMER: I have no idea what this class is like in person, but the online version is terrible. The lessons each week are repetitive and boring. If you were raised in the church you already know everything that the teachers have to say. None of this is good ole' Mike's fault, but the class still sucked.
Though it was an online class, Professor Goodman created opportunities for spiritual experiences. The tests are extensive and specific. He provides a study guide so make sure to use it.

Professor Goodman was insightful and moving during class sessions. The stories and testimonies he bore will stay with me through my mission and I am beyond grateful to have received him as my mission prep teacher.
His lectures get kind of boring and he goes over class time a good bit. Easy and can be interesting sometimes though

Brother Goodman was very kind and willing to help. The online format of the class meant that there was minimal interaction with him or other students, but if that's what you like then this could be the class for you.

He was awesome! Attendance wasn't "mandatory" per se, but for the weekly quiz, you get up to 4 points (out of 9) deducted if you didn't attend class that week. He was very kind, loving, and approached everything in a very professional manner! Very easy grader, as well. As long as you complete everything, you will do great in the class.

I loved this class. There was a lot of reading and videos, but if you actually answer the required reading questions you should do ok on the tests. They were a little harder than I thought but overall class is great.

I love brother Goodman's class! He uses doctrine and statistics in his lectures, which was really interesting. He gives study guides for his tests, and we have weekly quizzes based on the readings and lectures but they aren't hard. There are also either discussion posts or short written assignments due each week.

Great teacher and class! The work is easier but his test are kind hard. You have to make sure you do ALL the reading and watch all the videos to do good on his test. It was a bit to much reading in my opinion but besides that he is a great professor and I would take again!
If you need help knowing what a mission is like and some tips and tricks to serve a mission, take Brother Goodman!!!
Brother Goodman is so kind and such a good guy! I learned so much in this class!

Brother Goodman is the greatest! He really cares about his students and creates a welcoming, non-judgmental environment. It is clear that his goal is to prepare his students for a future in the gospel. He gives clear instructions on what is expected from various assignments. I recommend this class to anyone planning on serving a mission!

Brother Goodman is an amazing lecturer and sets clear expectations for readings, assignments, and tests. He gives opportunities for extra credit. I would prefer having more opportunities to interact with other students in the class in small group discussions, but if you prefer to mostly learn by listening to the lecture than it's good.

Brother Goodman is the best. He truly cares about his students and creates an atmosphere that invites the Spirit. He gives you test questions in advance to help prepare for the midterms. I really enjoyed learning from him, and recommend his class to everyone!

Brother Goodman is so kind, but I wouldn't take a class from him again. It was super lecture heavy. He would give us a couple minutes to ask questions every once in a while, but I really did not get to know people in the class because there wasn't time to do so. Great guy, just not my favorite style of teaching.
I thought it was a good class that had a nice balance between academic rigor and feeling the spirit.
Brother Goodman's class was really engaging and interesting but there was too much work for a religion class.
For it being a religion class, the workload was pretty high. And the exams include a lot of very specific questions from talks that you have to practically memorize.

I was left wondering where a couple questions on the quizzes come from, but majority of the quiz grade is attendance/participation. And where ever the quizzes lack, the tests make up for it. Seriously not bad. Do the assignments, don't forget to take quizzes (@ me), and you'll be chilling.

I highly recommend Professor Goodman. He teaches clearly and concisely and invites the spirit. I learned much and I would take another one of his classes again in the future. There is a semester-long project that takes about an hour a week. Other than that there is a light workload. Take this class!

Took this course online so I do not have a lot of personal experience working with this professor but the class was pretty easy. There is a big project but as long as you spend an hour a week on it's fine. Most other assignments are small and besides 2 points on the weekly quiz is mostly easy grading so long as you put in some effort.

Brother Goodman is one of the best professors I've ever taken a class from. My only complaint is that because this class was blended we only had 1 in-person lecture with him, and had to do the rest of the learning on Canvas. I had heard great things about the course and Brother Goodman but he far exceeded my expectations. Take this class from him!

This is a great mission prep class. Brother Goodman is a great teacher and has a lot of interesting stories. There are a few lesson outline assignments that are the bulk of your grade. They aren't necessarily difficult, but they take a lot of time, so don't procrastinate. Overall, I enjoyed this class and I think it helped me prepare for a mission.
Anyone who wants to take mission prep should take from Brother Goodman! He is amazing at teaching and is so kind. I love Brother Goodman!

Professor Goodman is a fantastic professor. I always felt the spirit in his class. Course work is given through Canvas. He gives you all the questions you will be tested on in the midterm and final at the beginning of the semester, and you fill them out based throughout the semester based on his lectures and Preach My Gospel readings.

I don't know why he has such a high rating. There was so much busy work in his class. He lectured the whole time and there was RARELY times we talked to our neighbors or even asks students questions. He gives a study guide but its like hidden in his lecture that he never finishes so the tests were very difficult.
Phenomenal in every way. Very in tune with the Spirit and delicate with tough and difficult matters. Has the right balance between spiritually focused and academic requirements.
He is a fantastic teacher and will do anything in his power to help you get an A. Just study the study guides for the exams and you will do great. His class is enlightening.

Professor Goodman is a great lecturer, supportive teacher, and an expert in his field. I really enjoyed the class. however, there is a lot of busy work, readings, and a lot of writing. You will have a short 2 or 3 page analysis assignment every other week and a long final paper. Mine ended up being around 10 pages. Great class, but very busy

I did every assignment in full and on time, but somehow lost a point here and there leaving me with an A-. I believe that I deserved an A for the work I put in, so I have been left somewhat frustrated with this outcome. Nonetheless, I have a lot of respect for Brother Goodman and he does a great job at cultivating a spiritual environment in class.
Great professor. Class was intuitive and clear. Workload was minimal. You can tell he cares about students and the course work. Would take again from him.

I loved Brother Goodman! The only textbook we used was Preach My Gospel. He's super spiritual and taught me a lot! The tests are just like the study guide, so memorize that and you'll do fine on the tests.

FanTASTIC professor. It was a blended class so it was a bit more than the normal workload on your own but he was great at covering sensitive topics and so incredibly understanding/open to others opinions. Exams are based on the study guides you create so as long as you stay on top of it you will ace it. He will throw out unreasonable test questions
This was one of the better religion classes I've taken. Some of the topics were a bit outdated, but I still it was an easy class.
This professor was super helpful if I had any questions or concerns although it was a fair amount of reading due to it's online style.

Brother Goodman is a phenomenal teacher. I took his Eternal Families class and the amount of passion and love he has for the subject and his students is unreal. The only downside to the class is the tests. Sometimes questions can be super vague.

Brother Goodman is an exemplary professor. I had him for Mission Prep and then waited to be able to take Eternal Families through him (that is the only other class he teaches as of the time I'm writing this).

I LOVE Brother Goodman's lectures, I always come away from class feeling my gospel understanding expanded and feeling excited.

I LOVE Brother Goodman. He is the kindest person and clearly cares about each of his students. I did a blended course, but wish I had done the whole thing in person as the classes were so good. I always left having learned something and felt the spirit. I absolutely recommend his classes. The class takes work, but is totally a manageable workload.

I really enjoyed taking this class with Professor Goodman online. The class was organized very well and he was a very fair grader. He would throw out any questions that too many people missed or any questions that seemed unfair.
Didn't like his humor or teaching style. I felt like he didn't interact with the students effectively.
Super caring and good teacher. Sometimes gets sidetracked and doesn't cover all the material.

Brother Goodman is one of those professors that you KNOW really cares about his students. He wants everyone to succeed, he takes time to hear students' perspectives, and handles difficult topics with so much respect. He is one of the best professors I've had at BYU and I know I'll continue reading his articles even after this class ends.

Taking Mission Prep from Brother Goodman helped me so much in preparing about my mission and I would 100% recommend! In class, he balanced explaining logistical aspects of missionary work (submitting papers, the MTC, and being in the field), learning the doctrine of the Church, and giving students opportunities to practice teaching.

The class was structured well and He seemed to truly care.  Even though it was online, he made it clear that he was always willing to talk, especially about controversial material.  Sometimes assignments were time consuming, and the exams were a bit more difficult than I expected, but all in all it was super doable and a good class.
Course website was confusing and hard to follow. Assignment information was sometimes vague. He was very nice, just sometimes hard to follow.

Professor Goodman is one of the best professors I have taken a class from at BYU. He is so caring about each student individual and is always fair. He will alter discussions based on the direction and questions of the class and will only test and quiz you on things that were covered. Extremely open to discuss any question. Lots of writing homework.

Brother Goodman is an outstanding professor, and I absolutely recommend taking his classes. With that being said, steer away from blended courses. Online coursework is extensive and far more labor-intensive than traditional in person classes. I accidentally signed up for the blended course and regretted it. His in person lectures are incredible.
Brother Goodman truly cares about his students and the content he teaches. He is knowledgable and kind. Easy to communicate with. Highly recommend.

Brother Goodman is amazing! He really prepares his mission prep students as best he can for serving missions and I know I've learned a lot from him. The hardest things in the class are the chunky lesson outlines we have to do, but besides that, it's so easy and fun. He is a great, fun teacher.

Brother Goodman was an amazing professor! I took his mission prep class and I feel so much more prepared for my mission. He has you create in-depth outlines for the first three missionary lessons. They are a pretty big chunk of work, but they truly help you understand each lesson. Beyond that, Brother Goodman is so caring and gives amazing lessons.

If you attend class and do the readings and do your homework your effort will be rewarded. Brother Goodman does a great job at teaching doctrines and how it relates to actual studies not just what the world is saying about difficult topics.

Wonderful experience so far. Exam questions directly from reading and lecture questions each week. Takes time to ensure everyone feels at ease in the classroom. Very knowledgeable and open to discussion. Short writing/discussion board due each week.

Amazing professor. His story is inspiring and helps students feel welcome and involved in class. The outlines are long but I think they aren't that bad. Just set aside some time and it's OK. Midterm and final are incredibly easy. Questions drawn from a list shared with the class. Spirit is very strong in his classroom.

Took Eternal Families online, so didn't really interact with the professor, but the course was organized. Every week, there's readings and reading quizzes. There are also a couple of short papers, discussions, and two projects, but they are all pretty easy to do.

Bro. Goodman is an incredible prof. Even as a member, I learned new gospel concepts every class. I only saw him once a week as my course was blended, but I would recommend taking it in-person to experience more of his lectures. Midterm & final aren't easy, but fine as long as you stay on top of weekly Learning Goal and Required Reading questions.

Brother Goodman is the best! He is super passionate about the Gospel and really helps you prepare for a mission. The Missionary Outlines are long but really help in learning how to teach friends. Go to the lectures, they're awesome and necessary!
Just make sure to do the quiz after every class and the writing prompt every Friday. Also, start the lesson prompts early

Brother Goodman is awesome. One of the kindest men around and has amazing lectures. He really cares about his students and is extremely passionate about the material. Had really great insights about topics that can be difficult to address. I wouldn't ever take eternal families from anyone else.

Brother Goodman is credible and a leader in the Church. He tends to tell you that too much though. It wasn't uncommon to finish every other class period having heard him say how old he was as a mission president, how many times he's translated for apostles, and how many times he's had cancer, only to run out of time for the rest of the lesson.
Loved the lectures! Be sure to start the mission outlines early and work on it progressively. Also, if there are any problems be sure to email, quick to respond and very accommodative.
I absolutely loved Professor Goodman! He is hilarious and you can tell he really cares. You have to create 3 huge outlines on mission lessons, but if you put time into it, you will be fine! :)

Awesome Guy, Terrible classwork. You have to write 3, 9+ page mission outlines. While there is adequate time given, they take a lot of time. Also he has 2 tests, one midterm, one final. Also you are required to teach 4 times for 10-20 minutes.

He's a good guy, don't get me wrong, but he is not the professor for me at all. The outlines make me actually depressed and the class feels unorganized and messy. The outlines though, BRUTAL. Compared to other mission prep classes this is way harder (heard from friends).

Brother Goodman did a great job of showing the joys and challenges that come from serving a mission. He did a wonderful job of bringing the Spirit into each class. I feel that much of what I learned in this class will bless me on the mission.
I LOVED him! I learned a lot from that call and felt it was not a class I was stressing about. You always knew what you needed to do and he was always to help if you had any questions.

One of the best religion professors at BYU. He broadened my perspective on some topics we don't talk about a lot in the Church, but he always used scriptures or quotes from Prophets and Apostles to back up what he taught. Overall a great class and his tests are easy, he said the analysis assignments are harder than the tests, but they're easy too.

If you've been worried about taking eternal families at BYU because you've struggled with some of the ideas of the family proclamation, lgbtq+ issues, etc, I would recommend Brother Goodman. The class was still kind of hard for me, honestly, but I think that Goodman's class is the best that they can do at BYU. He's (generally) very respectful.

Though this was an online class, I really enjoyed it. Mike was available outside of class and was just a REALLY good guy. You can tell he cares. I also enjoy the grading. The grading is clear and if you do what is asked, then you get the full credit, unlike some other courses I have taken.

I love Mike Goodman. He's extremely fair with expectations and grading, and delicately teaches even often awkward subjects. He's extremely respectful to students and to different points of view. He teaches all the material and never tests on material that he hasn't taught. Homework is reasonable. Take every course you can from this professor.

Brother Goodman's class was the best religion class I have taken at BYU thus far. He is kind, caring, and empathetic of his students. this class is often known for its difficult topics and challenging discussions but Brother Goodman was able to respect everyone's views, expand on them, and testify of Jesus Christ.
Professor Goodman is awesome! He genuinely cares about his students and is sensitive to their concerns. The course material is also presented clearly.
I did the online version of the class. It was boring but easy. Lots of reading and watching videos.

Professor Goodman is one of the nicest professors I've had. He cares so much about what he teaches, and he just wants to help his students become better people. The class has lots of homework because it was blended. There are some projects you have to work on throughout the semester, but they're not bad. He made this class so enjoyable!

Brother Goodman cares so much. He knew my name on the first day and took time to get to know me personally. His lectures were amazing and he handled tough subjects very well. The work outside of class was easy, just time consuming. If you study well for the tests, you will do just fine. It's pretty straighforward.
I had a lot of fun during classes. Things were clear and nice.

Brother Goodman is fantastic! He is incredibly kind and smart and really knows his stuff. He addresses hard issues in a delicate but clear way and is very open to conversation and feedback. His Eternal Families class is the best, and everyone should try to take it from him.

Brother Goodman is hands down one of the best professors at BYU. You can tell he genuinely cares for his students and about the content he teaches. If you want to truly learn the depths of the Gospel, feel the Spirit and actually take away something from your mission prep class, take Goodman!!!
Really understanding and caring professor! There are weekly writing assignments and a midterm and a final, the workload isn't terrible. You get out of this class what you put into it.
It was a great and flexible option to take online. I have no complaints.

Professor Goodman is an amazing professor who always has so much to share. Not only will he plan useful lectures about important concepts to understand for mission service, but he is always willing to go off topic to answer questions. Very friendly and very understanding.
He is awesome. Get ready for a spirit filled class with lots of reading. I learned so much from him and he has such a sweet soul. Please go take his class. You'll love it.

Professor Goodman is a good professor and man. He is prompt to return emails and WANTS to get to know you personally. I can tell he was a mission president because he listens like one! He is very mindful, thoughtful and helpful. I didn't have any problem with his class, but any class on canvas is going to have LOTS of reading.

I really enjoyed Professor Goodman's class. He cares so deeply about the topic that he teaches and thus the lectures are given with love and care. Exams are pretty easy because you have all the content on the study guides!
Mike Goodman is super fun!!!
Took this class online and LOVED IT! So much to learn and ponder and definitely strengthened my testimony!!
I really liked Professor Goodman! His lectures were interesting and I enjoyed all of them. There were a lot of readings though and he would refer to them on the tests.

I took it online. Not too bad, although he wasn't eager to grant an exception under extenuating circumstances. I had a surprise work trip and was going to be in an out of airports the week an assignment was due. I asked for a 24-hour extension. He granted it, but only after I gave enough details to prove I wasn't lying.

Dr. Goodman is a wonderful professor. His lectures are so engaging and he's so sincere and passionate about what he's teaching. Deals with sensitive subjects in a very loving and open way. For the blended class, though, there were SO many readings. A lot of work, but GREAT professor.
Great Teacher

Very solid choice for Eternal Families. Lectures are engaging and Brother Goodman will often adapt lecture topics to student questions. Weekly homework/readings outside of class are normal for a religion class. Midterm and final are multiple choice through Proctorio. Brother Goodman clearly knows and loves the course concepts and is accessible.

Brother Goodman's lectures were engaging and he did a good job addressing sensitive topics with love and respect. However, I did feel like the lectures were too drawn out. His data was also super interesting to learn about-- clearly very knowledgeable and well researched. The reading was relevant and enriching, although there was a lot of it.
They way that he teaches involves the students being able to apply topic learned in class to their lives.
Efficient with his time and phenomenal lectures

Professor Goodman will expect you to work hard. If you do this, you will have amazing results. The hardest part of the class for me was the lesson outlines. These require 4-6 hours more or less of work. This class will prepare you for the rigorous life of missionary work, and you will take part in a deeper study of the doctrine of the gospel.

I enjoyed this class. It was not my favorite religion class that I have ever taken. It might just be the topic of eternal families. Families are so nuanced which makes it hard to teach. But the material was informative which I appreciated!
I love Brother Goodman. I took this class after taking his mission prep class and was not dissapointed.

Good teacher, only complaint is that all the writing assignment prompts can be answered clearly in a sentence or two, but there will be a huge word count minimum that'll make you write fluff or repeated sentences until you hit the word count. Obviously just a nitpick, other than that he's great.

Professor Goodman was a great teacher. You could tell that he knew his stuff and is very experienced. He made the class interesting and as long as you kept up on work throughout the week it wasn't overwhelming at all.

This class was very helpful in preparing me for a mission. It's not overwhelming just a few out of class lesson outlines, but those are from Preach My Gospel so they are very helpful for a mission. If you're looking for a great mission prep class where you'll get a good grade take this.

I took Professor Goodman's online course for The Eternal Family, and I think he did a great job structuring the class to not be overwhelming while still hitting all of the necessary points for our learning.
Professor Goodman is the best!! Super meaningful material and really awesome person and teacher.

Teaching ability is amazing! I really did not enjoy his tests.  They were online and proctored which in my opinion is entirely unnecessary.  The tests were mainly based on the readings that we did and he never gave us the correct answers to check ourselves.  The questions were super specific. But the rest of the class was a big hit!
Great professor! I took the online class and it was pretty straightforward. Lots of reading, but I felt like I learned a lot from them.
Some papers that were long for no reason, but other than that, the class was pretty easy. Professor Goodman is really nice and responsive.
Tests are heavily based on the reading, but Brother Goodman provides really decent study guides so you know what to study.

I loved Professor Goodman, his energy is contagious ive never seen the man not smiling unless he was talking about something he cared about and became emotional. I got so far behind in the class and professor goodman worked with me until i was passing. He really does care about us all just succeeding and becoming well prepared to serve a mission.

SO ORGANIZED!! Professor Goodman is the greatest teacher I have ever had. Engaging, spiritual, and brought depth to every topic. His soft-spoken and calming nature reminds me of Bob Ross. Fantastic professor, always backs up his claims with sources and will respond to ANY question you ask.

Brother Goodman is an amazing professor in class. His lectures are some of the best I have seen at BYU. I did feel that some of the projects in this class were excessive and way too time consuming near the end of the semester when we are trying to prep for finals and everything else.

I really enjoyed learning from Brother Goodman! I took Eternal Families from him and I was apprehensive about the class at first. But, he was so caring and showed a real interest in all the different sides of discussions. In addition, the class wasn't super heavy in terms of work load. There is a semester-long project, but it was fun! Great prof!

I would recommend Professor Goodman for anyone looking to take Mission Prep or any of his classes for that matter. He cares for each of his students and even has your name down before the first day of class. He teaches amazing content and there are great opportunities in the class to better yourself.

Brother Goodman is an exceptional instructor. Every time he walked into class, the spirit instantly filled the room. He made sure to check up on each person individually. If you had any questions or concerns, he would work with you individually to make sure you were getting the most out of the class. Would 100% recommend to everyone.

Brother Goodman is incredibly caring and supportive to all students even online. The class gives you all your assignments at the beginning of the week (with everything due Saturday). You can go through at your own pace! A few big papers, smaller ones throughout each module. Great course material and lots of opportunities for extra credit!

Brother Goodman is so kind and you can tell he really cares about what he's teaching. He also genuinely cares about his students. I took his online course and it was engaging but very easy to get an A.

Professor Goodman is a really kind and considerate. He cares for his students, and even beyond learning your name. He understands the material he teaches, and his background makes his testimony all the sweeter.

Goodman is also an academic researcher, and shares a lot of what he knows which can make the lessons very interesting. Take his class!!

This class was great. Even though it was an online course, professor goodman made sure we knew that we could come to him with any questions and concerns. The class was very engaging and relatively easy. There are lots of videos that you can just watch at 2x speed to save time. Set up for you to succeed and to be spiritually uplifted.

I took brother Goodman's eternal families class online, I enjoyed the class especially because took it with a lot of other difficult classes during the same semester and I was able to work at my own pace and on my own time. His grading criteria is very clear and there are a lot of small assignments, but they are really straightforward
Amazing professor really cares about the students and their opinions.
Super chill online course. you do have to write two papers at the end, but totally doable!
he is a great professor
Great teacher and a really good class. I learned a lot during this class and grew a ton. I would recommend Brother Goodman!

Professor Goodman is genuinely the best religion professor at BYU. You can just feel the spirit every time you enter his class. He cares so much about the gospel and his students, which you can just see by the way he teaches. If you work hard then you'll get an A in the class.
