If you want to do well and feel the spirit everyday, take this class!

I really enjoyed taking this Mission Prep class from Brother Goodman! He doesn't give a lot of homework but attendance is mandatory as you get points when you attend class. Tests are pretty easy as long as you do the required reading and the learning goals. The only thing that took most of my time in this class were the outlines which are long.

Brother Goodman is an amazing teacher! He made me feel much more ready for my mission and way more excited to serve. He does a good job of teaching things plain and simple. Most of the workload comes from the 3 teaching outline assignments you have to do throughout the semester but overall the workload is not too bad. Course is very well structured

Brother Goodman is an awesome professor. He cares about his students and has a passion for what he is teaching. I would definitely take another class from him. The work for the class is very easy. You have to do three missionary lesson outlines that take a decent amount of time (but not bad at all because you have like 2 weeks to do each one).

Dr. Goodman shows a lot of concern for his students and you can tell that he cares about their success. I took this class online, and even though I thought there wouldn't be a lot of interaction, he did a good job of reaching out to his students. The course was pretty easy. A couple time-consuming projects, but nothing too crazy.

Great teacher. He is passionate about missionary work and will be very good at working with his students to help them with what they need. You have to do 3 lesson outlines which are 6-10 pages long. They are pretty easy but they take a lot of time and i dont know how useful they will really be in the long run.

Brother Goodman was a fantastic teacher for REL C-200 (Eternal Families). He was involved in designing the course, and with his spiritual knowledge combined with his social science background he was able to do an exceptional job teaching course content. The workload is standard for a BYU religion course.
Brother Goodman was overall a really good professor. He has a project that you will need to plan out throughout the semester to complete well.
Brother Goodman is one of my favorite teachers here at BYU. He is funny, enjoyable, and makes leaning eternal doctrine understandable and easy. Definitely want to take other courses from him.

Brother Goodman was a great professor and I highly recommend his class. Super easy religion credit while learning some great concepts. He cares about all of his students and shares really cool experiences. He does deviate from the lesson a little during lectures, but overall great class.
Dr. Goodman is well-versed in all things gospel. He knows every student by name (100's of them) as well. Class was pretty easy to follow and do well on tests. Would totally recommend.

He is very fun and entertaining while also bringing the spirit into class every day. He genuinely cares for each of his students and helps us all to do our best. Always willing to answer questions (about the topic of the lesson or not), and always gets me excited to go to class.

Goodman might be my favorite professor ever. He's so sweet and cares deeply about all his students. He memorized all of our names and faces BEFORE the first class. He's a little on the harder side of MP. Professors, but it's 100% worth it. I thought I was ready before, but I feel WAY more prepared now. I'd run through a brick wall for this man.

Goodman was great. He gives all test questions before you take the test, so if you take notes, you will have answers and will know exactly what to study. This class is work, but so worth it. Pay attention and don't procrastinate and you will be fine. Outlines are worth a lot and take a long time so don't procrastinate.

Amazing teacher for eternal families. Funny, cares for the students, and he explains the doctrine thoroughly. The readings each week are roughly 3-4 hours so it isn't too bad, just don't do it all on Saturday night.

I've taken a few online classes throughout my time at BYU, but Bro. Goodman has been the only one who has actually been helpful and shown his love for his students remotely. He is so good at checking up on his students and getting to know them individually even tho he has 100s of them. The class was also very inspiring and I learned a lot!

Professor Goodman was awesome! I took this calss online during spring term and the workload wan't super heavy. There's one paper we have to write, a midterm, final, and weekly quizzes and analysis assignments. Not super hard, just stay on top off the units.

His online class was great! I really enjoyed what he said in his video lectures and learned a ton from the readings. There were, however, a LOT of readings! I feel like a better person after taking this class, but I had to work for it. Would recommend to anyone with enough time!
Honestly one of my favorite professors and favorite classes I have taken at BYU. Brother Goodman was super helpful when I needed assistance due to a 2 week internship abroad. 10/10 would take again

Very respectful and actually cares about the students!  He reached out to me to see how I was doing and if there was anything he could do to help. When I asked about an upcoming project I wanted a head-start on, he was very proactive and helpful in sharing info with me.
I felt really comfortable discussing a variety of topics in this class! Brother Goodman taught in a way that was very respectful!

Fantastic online class, there's a good amount of work but it's not overwhelming, mostly conference talks and videos (with a little bit of reading). As long as you do the work and study for the exams (just review the questions he gives you from the learning questions), you'll do just fine.
He is super nice and helpful.  He directly reached out to me to see how I was doing, which made me more comfortable with the course.

Professor Goodman is by far one of the best professors here at BYU! You can tell he cares about all of his students and wants them to succeed. The only difficult thing about this class was that it is self-paced for the most part so if you procrastinate everything until the last minute, it is easy to fall behind.

Definitely take notes for the Reading Guide Questions and the Learning Guide Questions, those will become so helpful when you study for the midterm and final!! Key to this class is pacing yourself and studying as you go over time. Professor Goodman is a great teacher and super responsive when you need help or are having an emergency!
Professor Goodman truly cares about his students. He doesn't try to make material overly hard and is extremely respectful when discussing some pretty controversial topics.

He is the most caring and supportive professor that I have ever had. He constantly tells us that he is cheering us on and he shows it in many forms. He is so quick to respond to questions and doubts. His content is powerful and spiritually uplifting. The grading rubrics are clear and easy to understand. Please take a class with Brother Goodman!

Brother Goodman did an amazing job making his students feel safe in this online class. We tackled some topics that are deemed controversial and no matter the topic, Bro. Goodman made everyone feel respected, offered support, and didn't apologize for the truth. He made adjustments to the class to make the course load easier near the end. (Score!)
Lots of the reading was very repetitive. I felt that the same quotes were used many times and the readings got boring fairly quickly. It wasn't a horrible class though.
I really enjoyed this class. It was all online which has its ups and downs, but I think Brother Goodman did a great job of making it work for everyone, and he was very easy to receive help from.

Brother Goodman is a really sweet professor. This was an online class but he made it clear he cared about all his students. The homework is really straightforward and easy. If you have done the reading the tests are not too bad either. I definitely recommend him!

Mike Goodman is one of the best teachers I have ever had. I took an online version of his class during Spring Term which meant double the speed of work, but it really enjoyed doing the homework each week. I HIGHLY recommend this class!

He's great! Really cares about the students success and is involved which I have never had in an online class before but I appreciated knowing that he cared and wanted me to do well. Not a hard class, if you do the assignments you will get a good grade.
Professor Goodman has great lectures and excellent class organization. Highly recommend taking this if you're looking to get some religion credits done spring or summer term!
Professor Goodman was awesome! Lots of conference talks to read, but it is manageable. It is clear what is on the test. A bit of work, but that's expected because I took it Spring Term.

Professor Goodman is so passionate about what he teaches. Watching his lectures is engaging and life-changing. I would have loved to take the class in person because of this. It was a great online class overall, but lots of reading. At time the content is a bit redundant (ie you watch in a lecture the same thing you read in the required readings).

Professor Goodman is the best! I took this class during the spring term so the course load felt a bit heavier because of how quick the term is but he does everything to make it manageable. I was struggling with a family crisis this term, and he was patient and genuine with me. If you are considering taking from him do it!
Professor Goodman truly cares about his students. I loved the lectures and they weren't too overwhelming.
Great professor who really cares about each student and wants them to succeed.
Professor Goodman is amazing! I would take him again in a heartbeat. The lectures aren't super long and the work is doable. Loved him and he is very forgiving and wants you to succeed.

Professor Goodman was an amazing teacher. Only one big paper, due end of class. Just over 2% extra credit available. Amazing self-taught lectures that drive the spirit. Very light coursework compared to any other religion class. Would absolutely take again, or anything taught by him. Clear HW instructions. Decent amount of reading, but beyond fair.

Very solid class to take online. Lots of reading assignments to do so get ready for that. Analysis assignment (600 words or so) paper due every week. He provides a very generous +2% extra credit too. Overall very solid class and inspirational lectures. Some lectures can get a little long, but the 2x speed exists for a reason.
Brother Goodman provided me with a compelling and meaningful experience. I would recommend taking needed religion courses with him.

I am always hesitant with online religion classes but Professor Goodman did such a great job making sure all his students were taken care of! The class was easy, but I walked away feeling like I learned so much. Every so often, he reaches out to the students individually and asks if he can help them in any way. I recommend taking him!

Brother Goodman was a treat to have as a professor, he is able to effectively teach difficult topics in a fun way, and he is overall a very caring person who truly cares about his students and their well-being.

Professor Goodman is a very kind and personal professor, he learned each of his students names and faces within the first week of class. His class is on canvas, so make sure keep track of when things are due. Tests aren't like easy religion tests, you do have to do the readings and study a little beforehand, but other than that, his class is great!
He is one of the most caring teachers I know and is very passionate and knowledgeable about what he teaches.

Had him for Eternal Families and is an amazing professor! Don't underestimate the class as it is slightly more work than other religion classes I've taken, but so worth it as it's actually interesting! He's very vulnerable in class and highly respective of diverging opinions and questions. 10/10 would take again.
Absolutely phenomenal professor. Very caring and understanding! Highly recommend taking a class from him.

Brother Goodman is an incredible teacher and excellent storyteller. I have loved taking classes from him as he is so loving and caring to each and every person. The workload is really well-spaced as well and never takes too much time. I plan on courses from him in the future!

I love Brother Goodman! He is so kind and happy, but more than that his class is so helpful. From talking to friends taking Mission Prep from other teachers, he may be a little harder. However, I feel so prepared to go to the MTC. His lectures are amazing, and I learned so much. I would absolutely recommend him.

Professor Goodman is a pro at what he does. He has tons of life experience, as well as experience teaching and preparing missionaries. I felt much more confident in my teaching skills in addition to becoming familiar with preach my gospel. I know you can say this about most religion courses, but my testimony is definitely stronger after his class.

Professor Goodman is amazing! He is passionate about the gospel and I learned so much from him. Every lesson was engaging and I always looked forward to attending his classes.
There are three longer lesson projects to do, a midterm, and final. There's also weekly canvas work that is important to stay on top of but isn't hard or time consuming.

Professor Goodman is the best! He is so knowledgeable about the gospel. His class isn't hard but there are 3 10 page outlines throughout the semester that are definitely time consuming. Tests are not hard. If you are looking for the easiest mission prep class there are probably easier teachers but there's no one better than Brother Goodman.

Brother Goodman is certainly one of the best professors I've had in a BYU religion class. He gave amazing stories, and he went out of his way to ensure that students succeeded in his class. The tests are very difficult, but he curbs them, and he also tells us which types of questions will be on the tests.

I love Brother Goodman! He is seriously the best teacher ever. His lectures are so inspiring and always invites the spirit. I look forward to going to his class every day. He believes in what he does so strongly and genuinely loves it. The most caring teacher.

Dr. Goodman teaching Eternal Families was honestly incredible. He was the chairman of the committee that made this course. Definitely a spiritual giant and very friendly. He learned all of our names before we went to our first day of class. The homework and course load is not very difficult and is often somewhat inspiring.

Never put off the lesson plans. My grade would have definitely been an A if I had done them for an hour a day every day until it was due, which would have also helped my personal relationship with God. (As of now, my grade is unclear.) Other than that, this was a fun, relatively easy class. I plan to take another class from this professor.
Really great professor, insightful lectures that were also spiritually strengthening. 3 ~10 page outlines due throughout the course of the semester, but other than that not much work.
He is an amazing, loving, and effective professor.

Professor Goodman is an amazing person and professor. Even during an all-online class, I could feel his love and desire to help students succeed. I highly recommend this class for anyone but especially individuals that are preparing to get married. There are a lot of quizzes and a decent amount of reading but it's all doable.

Brother Goodman is an awesome gospel teacher. He has a great understanding of the gospel and always teaches with the Spirit. He is not afraid to answer tough questions and is able to do so in a powerful and loving way.

Brother Goodman was the perfect teacher before I serve my mission. He made everything exciting and made me want to serve more and more everyday. I definitely recommend this class if you plan on serving a mission.
I loved Brother Goodman's class. You can tell he loves the gospel and is so passionate about it which makes learning easier. I would definitely take this class again he is so understanding.

He cares deeply about the gospel and his students. He teaches in-depth doctrine as a foundation for his students to teach from as missionaries. Assignments include short reading for each class + a short quiz, and 3 large personalized outlines for the first 3 lessons. If you come to class and don't procrastinate the lesson outlines, It'll be great!
Great professor, always was open to the Spirit. Teaches well. Online readings can add up but just do them throughout the week and you'll be fine
Professor Goodman is amazing. His lectures are the best, do not take a blended unless you have to because his lectures are amazing!
Prof. Goodman lives up to the hype, literally he is the most inspiring person. from day one I knew it would be my favorite class and it was! a truly spiritual experience every day.

Brother Goodman is a great guy motivated by a desire to see you succeed in his class and then in the mission field. He prepares you well for the midterm and final as long as you go to class. The major time-sink is the 3 lesson outlines so don't procrastinate those.

Great and inspirational professor! His lectures were great because he told meaningful stories and skipped over monotonous information that everyone already knew. There's a lot of reading, but you''ll enjoy his class and learn a lot!

Professor Goodman is extremely invested in his students and wants to provide the best experience possible. If you communicate concerns and needs with him he is very understanding and will always respond in a timely manner. He does expect a lot of work from his students so be prepared because his classes are not gimmes.
Professor Goodman is an excellent lecturer, and his love for the students really shines through.

Professor Goodman was a brilliant, kind, understanding, and knowledgeable teacher! I really enjoyed his lectures, and I learned a lot of doctrine that I hadn't before, since I didn't grow up in the church. His own experiences made me feel comfortable opening up about my experiences in discussion posts and such. He's also got a great sense of humor!

Brother Goodman grew my testimony through his doctrinal knowledge. I will never regret taking his course as I know it has prepared me to better serve the Lord. However, BEWARE. His missionary outline assignments make the coursework load more like a 3 credit class-- they take HOURS. Plan accordingly and you will be blessed by Brother Goodman:)

Professor Goodman was a phenomenal teacher! He really cares about what he's teaching and wants his students to understand the eternal importance of eternal families. I recommend him to anyone looking to that an eternal family class. His lectures are very informative and he's got a great sense of humor.  100% recommend!
He is one of the best religion professors at BYU. 100% recommended. He creates a safe space in the class for everyone!

There are a lot of weekly readings, and the tests are based off of them pretty heavily so you'll have to do them and take decent notes. But overall I really loved the content of the class and I learned a lot from Professor Goodman.

The professor is very fair. He seeks to help his students learn but won't sugar coat content too much. He is very kind when it comes to curving test and making corrections in the course if something is confusing or was not taught clearly.

Brother Goodman is a wonderful professor and you absolutely won't regret taking a class from him. He is very knowledgeable about the family, and he has learned important spiritual truths that you won't be able to learn besides in an Eternal Family class. If you have to take Eternal Family for a religion credit, I highly recommend him.
Brother Goodman was an amazing professor. He genuinely cares about his students and his course content really is not that difficult. I would take this class again or another class from him.
Great professor. I felt like I learned something new each lecture and his exams were feasible. Most of the grades come from the weekly assignments and projects. Highly recommended for this course.

I highly recommend Brother Goodman for Eternal Families. He cares about his students and what he teaches, and I actually grew spiritually, not just checked off a box for religion. There are some hard topics we go over in class, but Brother Goodman handles each one with nuance and compassion and does all he can to create a safe space.

Bro. Goodman is a great professor and always makes efforts to uplift his students. There are three lesson outlines throughout the course that take a lot of time, but overall are actually very easy and are very beneficial for helping you prepare to teach on your mission.

Prof Goodman was amazing! It is obvious how deeply he cares about the material he teaches. He also takes the time to get to know all of his students. We had a very large class and on the first day he already knew all of our names. I am absolutely going to be taking more of his classes in the future.
Loved Eternal Families through Brother Goodman! Teaches with love and the spirit, and is caring towards all his students!

We had readings, a discussion, and a quiz that was due each Saturday night. The required readings were interesting and thought-provoking. There is a semester-long project and then a big paper, but it's totally doable. The only tricky part was filling out the study guide. It's easy to miss things during lectures & they aren't always on the slides.

Loved Brother Goodman's Eternal Family Class! He has an amazing spirit and cares deeply for all his students. The class by design covers controversial issues, Brother Goodman does a fantastic job teaching these principles and is aware of the different opinions people hold regarding these topics.

Super awesome guy. I took him for mission prep freshman year and wanted to take him again. He brings a great perspective and makes his classes very individual and discussion oriented. He does a great job at keeping everyone engaged in the topic and didn't make any of the eternal family topics awkward. Beware lots of reading and tough tests!
Mike is a great man. I learned a lot from his class and enjoyed it a lot. It is an easy class and would recommend it to everyone.

Brother Goodman is an amazing teacher, you can tell that he truly cares about all of his students. His mission prep class took away a lot of the fears I had about serving and helped focus on the joy of the gospel, I highly recommend him!

So glad I took mission prep from Brother Goodman! I felt like I learned so much from the lectures. There were 3 outlines that took me about 12 hours to do apiece, but you have three weeks to do each one. But they really helped you know what is in the first three lessons that you will be teaching investigators.

Professor Goodman was amazing!! I had him for my mission prep class and I feel so prepared heading into the MTC. You can really tell how he cares about his students & I would take another class from him if I could. The class had 3 big (10ish hour projects) plus some smaller readings and assignments, but overall was very doable for 2 credit class.
Professor Goodman is great and teaching. He is always conscious of what he is saying and very considerate of everyone in the class no matter what the topic is.

Brother Goodman is AMAZING!! He really focuses on the goal of this class which is to be prepared for a mission. His lectures are interesting and enlightening. Assignments consist of quizzes for each class and lesson outlines. The outlines take some time but are not hard. Questions for the tests are provided beforehand. I would 10/10 recommend!!!!!!

Brother Goodman is a great teacher and mentor. His Mission Prep class is easy and participation based, however there are three big projects (lesson outlines) throughout the semester. If you don't procrastinate them, it'll be a great experience. If you do procrastinate it sucks.

This class was blended, which was super helpful with the busy schedule. I love how much he is passionate about research and teaching doctrines from The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. The class always went over time by ten minutes. Teachers like Professor Goodman tend to do this. Fantastic class overall.

Great professor and very knowledgeable about gospel topics! He loves and cares about his students and is so inspirational and insightful. I learned a lot from him, especially details about gospel topics that are often confusing and hard to understand. The lesson outlines are time-consuming and extensive, but helpful in the long run.

Bro Goodman is a great teacher! He's enthusastic about the material and shows that he cares for others. His lectures are easy to follow and very engaging. He's good at explaining less well-understood concepts in ways I hadn't thought about. There isn't much assigned homework. The biggest things are the lesson outlines aside from the PMG reading.

This is such an amazing class! Brother Goodman is honestly the best teacher I have ever had. You are almost guaranteed to get a good grade in this class. There are 3 Mission prep outlines that are slightly annoying, but the average grade is an A, and every mission prep class has to do these.

If I would have you know 2 main things, they are these:
- Homework load is fairly heavy in the blended class
-You do have to study the study guide for exams

That being said, Dr. Goodman is a great man. You come away regularly from studying, doing online work, and attending lecture with new insights and personal revelation. Loved him and the class!

Brother Goodman has been one of the most influential teachers I've ever had. His lectures were great and spiritually uplifting and I feel way more prepared for my mission after going through his class. (one word of advice, start the outlines early)

Brother Goodman was an amazing professor. His class is very simple and the workload is very easy. He gives you a study guide for the tests and they are very easy. The only thing that takes time is the lesson outlines. You have to do three of them and they will take a lot of time, but thats the only  hard thing in the class.

He is an extremely respectful person and makes this course really easy. I did a blended version of the class which I think made it easier for me. But Brother Goodman is by far my favorite religion teacher. His curriculum was really easy to follow on canvas. The every week assignments aren't worth a lot so it's okay if you miss a couple assignments.
Amazing Professor. Would take this class again from him if I could.

I loved Brother Goodman's class! I looked forward to his class every time. I will admit that the lesson outlines caused me a ton of stress. The outlines themselves weren't that bad once I actually got started on them but I definitely stressed about them all semester. Overall an amazing class and super inspirational and motivational!

Brother Goodman was a good teacher and the class overall was a good experience. But holy crap the lesson outlines take forever, and the exams absolutely suck. All the options for every question are the same, and they are completely based on the reading out of class in excruciating detail, no open book. I had never failed an exam before his class.

The most amazing professor I have ever had. Dr. Goodman covered sensitive topics with love and willingness to answer any and all questions. Willing to meet outside of class and help in anyway he could. I consider him one of the best professors I have ever had (best religion professor for sure!!)

Brother Goodman is the best of the best! He draws on research studies to give context to things and draws on his personal experiences. I am always super excited to go to his class. He is such an angel human! I wish that his classes had more lecture days, He's just so amazing!
Brother Goodman is a great professor! He truly cares about each of his students and is always sure to put his students first.
He is a great professor that really cares about the students. He is very knowledgeable in his field.

Brother Goodman is a super sweet guy who really cares about his students and this class. However, I felt like there was too much work for a 2 credit religion class. There was a ton of reading and on the quizzes every week you had to put whether you read all of the readings and filled everything out on the reading guide.

I love Brother Goodman! He makes an effort to reach out to every student. He will remember your name and truly care about you. His class provides uplifting spiritual insight to the family as well as scientific research. Clear expectations on what to do for assignments. There is a reading and lecture study guide. Take his class!!!

Brother Goodman is really awesome. Great combination of evidence-based discussions on social issues and a strong testimony of the gospel. If you attend class and do the readings and assignments on time, you should do very well in the class.

I'm glad I took eternal families from Professor Goodman. He did a great job explaining difficult subjects using real stats (and I did my own research, it matched up to his). I appreciated that he backed everything up with facts but still kept it spiritual. There wasn't much busy work, everything was done to help us understand the concepts better.
Professor Goodman is a great man and it shows that he truly has a testimony and believes in what he's teaching.

Brother Goodman is an amazing professor! You will not regret taking a class from him! He very clearly loves what he does and he makes sure every student feels appreciated. He teaches with passion and in a way that everyone can understand. He truly wants success for all of his students.

Professor Goodman was INCREDIBLE. Taught the material in an amazing and accessible way, always explaining things thoroughly and drawing on his personal experience to give value to what he taught. He took the time to learn ALL of our names in our class, which shocked me. Projects were great and geared towards personal growth. 5/5

Professor Goodman is amazing! He is respectful and he cares about his students. Lectures are great and discussions are engaging. He breaks down concepts and tells you the why. There are weekly readings and questions to keep up with. He tells you exactly what's on the exams. Easy quizzes and only two large projects throughout the semester.

I love professor Goodman! I always left class feeling like I learned an important life lesson. The spirit is strong in his class. The workload is a lot for a blended class. Tests are hard and worth a lot but there are only two. It's obvious, but don't turn in work late; you lose 30% of the points each day something is late. Overall, I recommend!

Professor Goodman was amazing!! I highly recommend his class, especially for mission prep!
He definitely makes you work. In retrospect, it was not THAT tough. 
He's super kind, super fun! Makes lectures entertaining. I learned so SO much from his religion class. Take him!
Professor Goodman was the best professor I had. He was so good at teaching and really made me feel the Spirit every time I went to class.

He is a great professor, although the class is more difficult than it should be. The weekly quizzes are only 2 questions and focused on principles/concepts. Exams are based on readings. There is a semester long project that requires at least an hour a week and a 7 page paper about your family and what you plan to change in the future.
He is a great professor and very passionate. I enjoyed his class but felt that the work load in the blended course was a little intense for a 2 credit class.
Professor Goodman is an amazing professor. He really helps you feel the spirit and is easy to follow in lectures. Make sure to stay on top of his assignments or else it is very easy to get behind.
Amazing Professor for RELC130

AMAZING! Take eternal families from him! He helped create the class and has so many great ideas and insights! Very clear what is expected, very simple assignments each week. Come to class and you will love it!
Brother Goodman is an awesome professor who cares for everyone. I always looked forward to his class where the spirit could be felt and uplifted me. I would definitely take other of his classes.

I took his mission prep class before my mission. From then, I knew that I wanted to take the eternal family from him too. Despite getting a good grade in the SFL version of this class, I took it to be in a class from him again. He legitimately cares about everyone. He is the best teacher I've had in the entirety of my life. The hw is easily doable.

Goodman is amazing at teaching and helping us to learn how to be an effective missionary. We do lesson outlines in the class that are a lot of outside of class work heavy, but it is for the best and the way we are taught is so inspiring and allows us to gain confidence in ourselves as we prepare for upcoming missions.
He really cares about his students which is good! I feel the amount of work and details you have to put in is too much for a 2 credit class. Overall a great professor and good at teaching.
Brother Goodman is a great statisticians and teacher. He focused on the doctrine of the eternal family and included studies that added depth. He is loving and caring. Highly recommended.

Prof goodman is incredibly loving and inspiring, even by religion prof standards. Class extremely fair and expectations are set early in the semester. I took the blended class so it was pretty heavy on readings outside of class. Class was amazing I would 100% take it again.

Prof Goodman is an incredibly loving professor. He uses good data constantly to cross reference facts which I love considering some prof do not use good data. I took the blended course so it was pretty heavy on outside of class readings, but he makes it very clear what you are going to be tested on. Class was extremely fair.

I really enjoyed this class and the lectures were filled with care and with the spirit. Brother Goodman has so many super cool stories and experiences. He was a mission president so he knows what is best to actually prepare you for a mission. This does make the class a bit more work than most other religion courses, but it's all beneficial.
Brother Goodman is the best Mission Prep professor. I learned so much from him. His class is pretty easy and he makes sure to help you get a good grade in his class.
Brother Goodman is always helpful. He will reach out to students personally to get to know them better. His tests are well-structured and always according to the study guide that he made.
I really liked his lectures! I really appreciated his perspective on the LGBTQ+ community. He is an incredibly loving man who wants the best for his students.
Dr. Goodman clearly cares about his students and the course material. I enjoyed his sincerity and jokes as he taught.

The outline of his class is simple: A powerpoint and a few readings per week. These are used to answer a study guide for the midterm(s) and/or final exam(s). He literally lets you know the questions he will ask in his exams. He also gives a writing assignment each week based on that week's unit are not too long (Around 600-700 words in length)

Brother Goodman has been one of my favorite professors of all time! He has so much knowledge that he teaches in a caring manner. The class touches on a lot of sensitive topics and he is extremely careful to address the issues and peoples' concerns in a respectful and sensitive manner.

This is an awesome course! Dr. Goodman actually wrote the curriculum for the original "Eternal Families" class, so you're getting a great perspective. Word of advice, pay attention to, and pick wisely for, the "Attributes" project. It's worth a lot of points and you have to stick to it the whole semester.
Clear study guides and expectations. Very well rounded for a religion professor.

Professor Goodman is one of the kindest and most inspirational religion professors I have had. You can tell he really cares about his students and give really great lectures. I enjoy coming to his class every week, and with the exception of lots of reading, his class is very relaxed and easy to keep up with. I would definitely take again!

Brother Goodman provides an incredibly fun and loving environment in a class that covers difficult topics. The class is super clear and the path is set to how to get an A. Not a cake walk religion class like some, but you will get what you give in this class.

Best religion professor at BYU. Strong testimony but is also a social scientist with acredited research. He really knows his stuff and is an incredible professor. I wish that I could go back and take all religion classes from him!

Bro Goodman really loves Jesus Christ, the Eternal Family, and his students. The class he teaches offers in-depth insight into all aspects of the family: theology, best practices, current research/findings, and practical preparation. This can be a very MEANINGFUL class--if you choose. The work is relatively easy, and it's not hard to get an A.

Brother Goodman is an amazing mission prep teacher. His class is very interesting and his lectures are engaging and very helpful. I feel like i learned so much and he is such a talented teacher. The only hard homework were 3 outlines throughout the semester. They take time, but he recognizes effort and it is very possible to get 100% on all 3.

Best religion professor I've ever had. Very caring, great lessons, I would love to take another class from him, I think everybody should. He's a social scientist so he includes studies to back up his lessons, which I thought was fantastic. Felt the spirit strongly. HW is weekly reading and two large assignments due at the end, (essay & project).

Professor Goodman was great. I'm glad I took REL130 from him. Super helpful, easy to talk to, quick to respond. The class is SO easy, HW load super light other than 3 lesson outlines you make from the 1st 3 lessons in PMG. But those are going to help me a ton on my mission so I'm very grateful for them. His lectures are awesome, super informative.

I learned so much in Professor Goodman's mission prep class! Amazing lectures! He does have a good amount of work compared to other religion classes, but every assignment has a purpose and helps prepare you for a mission, so I didn't find the workload unreasonable or unmanageable. He truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed.

Professor Goodman is amazing. There are a lot of sensitive topics covered in eternal family classes but he handled them beautifully. The class has clear expectations and you need to attend class to do well. Exams aren't hard if you do the reading and pay attention in class. I felt the spirit every class!

I love Professor Goodman! I always looked forward to his class and I was always able to feel the Spirit in his classroom. I learned so much from him. There are three outlines throughout the year that took a lot of time. I was told by some RMs that they don't use outlines like this. However, what I learned in this class is priceless.

Professor Goodman is amazing! My mission prep course has given me some of the most spiritual moments of my life. The outlines are really long and take a long time, but if you start early and spread them out, they are very doable.

Professor Goodman gives AMAZING lectures and leads great discussions. He is the nicest guy and super willing to work with you. His course is really nicely laid out but get ready to read. There will be quite a few weekly assignments but they are manageable.

Mission Prep was one of my favorite classes. The work is pretty easy. There are three Lesson Outlines that end up being around 7 pages and take up a lot of time, but the work itself isn't hard. Professor Goodman is super friendly and understanding. I highly recommend his class for anyone, even if you aren't totally sure if you'll serve a mission.

He's an amazing person who cares for his students and puts in effort to learn everyones names and checks in on how they're doing. This was a blended course I took so it was 1 hour a week of in person class and the rest was done on campus. Put in the effort and you'll learn a lot and do well.

The Eternal Family curriculum covers a lot of difficult-to-grapple-with topics (LGBTQ+ issues, suicide, divorce, abuse) and he handled them all very elegantly and sensitively. He gave space for everyone in his class, and never belittled anyone for their comments. If you stay on top of your reading and pay attention in lecture, you will  do great.

Professor Goodman taught me A LOT more than i expected to learn. He makes great effort to learn all his students names and check up on them. He is kind and loving. One thing i think could be improved on is the required 200 word count on the weekly analysis assignments-It causes for wordy answers that don't mean much after the first 100 words.

although there is a lot of homework and the tests are a bit lengthy, it is pretty straightforward. On top of that, everything that you will do for homework will relate somehow to your mission so it is not a waste of time.

Amazing teacher! You can tell he really cares about his students and he loves the gospel! There are 3 hefty mission outlines that tend to be 8-15 pages. I learned a lot from the outlines, and the 3 practice teaching lessons! Loved the class!

Brother Goodman is probably the sweetest Professor on campus. He cares so much about his students and wants all of them to succeed. He gives you a study guide for the midterm and final, so the tests are easy. Most of the time spent in this class is the lesson outlines. They are not something to take lightly and are worth most of your grade.

Bro Goodman is respectful, kind, and cares deeply for his students. Not a lot of work is given in this class; only 6-10 page lesson plan projects that you are assigned throughout the semester. These are difficult but he gives you a lot of time and I recommend doing a little each day. GO TO THE LECTURES! He gives great lectures filled with stories.

Brother Goodman is a great teacher who has a lot of knowledge to share about going on a mission. This class prepares you very well if for a mission if you do the reading and don't let deadlines stress you out. Stay on top of your work and this class will be a breeze.

Professor Goodman is AMAZING! Although it may be a little harder than some mission prep classes, it is simply because He prepares you SO well. You make 3 lesson outlines that are just a little time consuming but other than that not too bad and they prepare you! Other than that the midterm and test are exactly like the study guide!

Professor Goodman is an amazing teacher!! You will have to do work outside of class for a good amount of hours, but if you are preparing for a mission he will help you get to exactly where you need to be before going out in the field.
I loved Professor Goodman! He genuinely taught me so much more than I thought I could learn about the Gospel. The lesson plans are hefty, but worth it! Take him for mission prep for sure.

Professor Goodman is the nicest guy! I love that he makes an effort to know everyone's names. His class is really helpful if you plan to serve a mission. Be prepared to put in a lot of homework time. The lesson outlines he has us create are not easy! But they are worth it. What you put in is what you get out :)

I love Brother Goodman! He is very kind and teaches by the Spirit for sure! I loved this class and didn't find it too difficult and pretty transparent. The only thing I found somewhat difficult was the organization because assignment dates changed and you have to message Goodman and the TA on Canvas (no email). I have a bias against Canvas though.

Had a lot of great lectures with lots of opportunities to strengthen testimony and feel more prepared to serve a mission. Though the tests were unexpectedly difficult and quite a bit of project work, he made kept me engaged the whole time and shared many awesome stories.

Great Professor. He really cares about everyone in the class and desires for everyone to do well. There is a decent amount of homework every week, but none if it is hard. You just need to study for the Midterm and Final and you'll be good.

Brother Goodman is an excellent instructor. He handles the complicated and often controversial topics of the Eternal Families class with incredible care and clarity. He is sensitive and mindful of the different beliefs of others, and teaches the doctrine clearly and effectively. As a senior at BYU, he has been my favorite professor.

Good class if you don't really care about getting an A. Amazing lectures! Felt the spirit strongly during class! However, this class is super challenging. Challenging because a mission prep class should not be this hard. Work load is a lot. This class is more like a 3 credit class not a 2 credit class.

Good class if you don't really care about getting an A. Amazing lectures! Felt the spirit strongly during class! However, this class is super challenging. Challenging because a mission prep class should not be this hard. Work load is a lot. This class is more like a 3 credit not a 2 credit class.

Professor Goodman is so interesting to listen to and learn from. He really cares for all his students and every assignment we have is very meaningful. There were readings every week but they are enjoyable and he is really willing to work with the class so he doesn't give too many assignments.

Professor Goodman is an amazing teacher. This class was hybrid which was nice because it was flexible. Canvas is very organized so it is really clear what assignments you have to do! Not too much homework just some outside readings but definitely attend the lectures. He taught me a lot and I looked forward to the time I had in person each week!
Brother Goodman is honestly one of the best and most fair professors I have taken a class from. He is kind and is easy to work with. I suggest taking the blended course. It is very easy and flexible.

Professor Goodman is awesome! His lessons are wonderful and in-depth and he makes sure that he is super clear on ideas that can be confusing. He is always willing to answer questions. Bro. Goodman is an amazing teacher; his lectures are fantastic, his tests and projects are fair and actually feel helpful, and you can tell he really cares about his students. Only caveat is that the lesson outlines were a lot of work, but they were helpful so it was worth it in the end.
He is such an amazing professor! The lesson outlines are a lot of work, but they extremely helpful and the spirit is always in class! Loved loved loved that class!

Brother Goodman is amazing! If you take his class you will learn so much! His class is pretty easy. He grades fairly. He gives two tests a semester and they are not hard if you study. The hardest part of this class was probably the lesson outlines. You have to create three missionary lesson outlines from Preach My Gospel but they aren't hard.

Brother Goodman is seriously the greatest professor ever! His lectures are amazing and he's incredibly fair with how he grades. He only gives out a mid-term and final and the reviews are useful. There are a few big assignments (missionary lesson outlines) which take a lot of work, but they're useful for your mission because you actually use them

Brother Goodman was my favorite professor this semester. His class had short readings before every class and easy quizzes after class. I just answered the learning goal and reading questions every lecture and the tests were easy. The outlines are tough, but he gives you a lot of time to work on them. I recommend him to everyone.

Brother Goodman is probably hands down the best teacher I have ever had. He loves the class so much and is so entertaining to listen to. His expectations are clear so you're never left wondering what you need to do to do well in the class. He is a spiritual giant with so much passion for his topic. I loved learning from him!

This is a tough class, there are 3 big assignments, a midterm, and a final. Brother Goodman is an incredible professor. He explains concepts so that they are easy to understand and he makes you excited to serve your mission.

Each week I looked forward to going to Bro. Goodmans class. His lectures don't feel like lectures and more like inspirational devotionals/lessons. How he presents material is entertaining and I've been able to apply everything I've learned from him.
Brother Goodman is an awesome Professor and he teaches very well. I just wish we had more class time to listen to his lectures!

He is one of the most organized professors I have ever taken. Not only that he teaches you things that actually matter and tells you why. He is such a smart man but never comes across as smarter than you. To describe him a couple words it would be Humble, genuine, and an inspiration. Highly recommend attending in class as often as possible.

Eternal Families Class - REL C 200. Great lectures, readings every week but they are always really inspirational readings. He makes the classroom a safe place for the sensitive topics that he covers. If you are on the edge on taking it or not, definitely take!

I missed a few of the teaching discussions at the beginning of the semester and that hurt my grade but there is lots of extra credit opportunity. You will find a more caring and genuine Mission Prep Teacher.

Brother Goodman was the most amazing teacher. He was so kind and very respectful to delicate matters. Ive never had a teacher who thought so much about what he said so that he felt like it was said well and in line with what the Spirit wanted. He was respectful to each student and aware that everyone has a different background. Take his class!

Bro Goodman takes a different approach to Eternal Families than other professors because of his extensive research on the LGBTQ community. He has a detailed study guide for the midterm and final. Theres a large project due at the end of the semester. He associates most gospel principles to how they fit with the LGBTQ community and it is insightful.

Professor Goodman likes having a high class average, but at the same time he makes you work for the grade. There aren't many homework assignments, but the important ones are very lengthy, so don't plan on doing them in one night. He's an ex-mission president, and really tries to make you as prepared as possible for a mission.

I absolutely loved Brother Goodman as a teacher. I looked forward to going to his class each week. The lesson outlines were long, but I always felt good when I finished them, and never felt I was graded harshly on them. This class really helped me feel prepared to serve a mission! Get ready for a great teacher who cares about you!

I love professor Goodman! He inspires me each class. The spirit was always present and he pushes his students to get out of their comfort zone. If you want to push yourself and prepare to become a missionary I highly recommend taking his mission preparation class. We are required to teach for credit and create lesson plans.

Take this class from Professor Goodman!!!! You will not regret it. I'm not even sure if I will be serving a mission, but this class was amazing for learning the doctrine and for life prep in general. I feel so much more prepared for teaching the gospel regardless of what I choose. DO NOT procrastinate the lesson plans, if so they will be very rough
Just make sure to turn things in on time! He is a great teacher and does his best to help any student in difficult circumstances. He is clearly passionate about what he does.

Professor Goodman is such an amazing professor. I loved learning from him, and I could tell he really cares about his students. The tests were pretty easy, but the three outlines he had us do took a lot of time. Great class!
He is SO caring and sets you up for success.
I always really looked forward to class with Brother Goodman because he is very good at teaching difficult doctrine in an understandable way. I understand The Fall a lot better because of this class.

Brother Goodman is the best. He is so supportive and understanding. His class is easy if you do the workread from Preach My Gospel, take notes in class, and do your outlines. As long as you do those things, youll get an A. Mission Prep with Brother Goodman is the perfect balance of easy but hard enough where you really learn.

I absolutely adored Brother Goodman and I wish he could teach all of my classes!! He is the perfect example of a professor who truly cares about his students and their lives. The missionary outlines we have to do are hard work but I found them SO worth it. Brother Goodman is simply the best PLEASE take his class, you won't regret it !!!!

Professor Goodman is incredible! Such a kind hearted, respectful, fair teacher. There is a little reading each week and 2 quizzes based on honesty. There 3 major assignments, but honestly pretty easy overall. Tests are also very easy if you use the study guide. One of my favorite classes and it has prepared me so much for the mission field.

2 quizzes a week that are on class and PMG readings. 3 Lesson outlines throughout the term that are quite long and take some dedication to get done. Besides that, just a few teaching opportunities and simple note taking in class for the midterm and final.

He is definitely my favorite teacher I have ever had, he is so caring and willing to help you with everything and he wants you to get an A so bad. The only tests are the midterm and final which he gives a study guide for!

Professor Goodman is a very wise instructor who talks about Gospel topics in an amazing way. He challenges His students to open their minds and change their perspectives on important topics. I loved learning from Him and I feel better prepared to serve a mission. I would recommend everybody to take Mission Prep from Professor Goodman.

I had him for Mission Preparation and he was the absolute best! He is a really inspiring teacher and made the class easy! Since it is mission prep he doesn't really focus on grades rather than having the spirit in the class. There are three master outlines you have to make which take time but other than that there isn't much work at all.
truly just a great guy and prepares you for a mission extremely well. he is also aware that we are humans and we will struggle. he helps us know how to endure hard things

Goodman cares a lot about his students. He includes lots of his own personal experiences as a mission president during class, which is super helpful in terms of preparing for a mission. Overall, this class is easy, you only have to submit a short class insight twice a week and complete three lesson outlines (8 hours each) for the entire semester
Brother Goodman is wonderful! His lessons were very interesting, and he responds quickly to emails. He really cares about each individual student.
He is a great professor, I would definitely recommend this class, just be warned that there is a lot of homework for being a religion class but it's managable
Bro Goodman is an amazing teacher. He's very entertaining and he tells you exactly all the things you need to know for all the quizzes and midterm.

I loved this professor but found that it was hard to pay attention and I felt that a lot of the assignments that were given were pretty uncomfortable. I wish that I didn't have to write so excessively about thoughts and feelings that I could express in few words.

Brother Goodman is such an amazing professor and he really cares for his students. The 3 lesson outlines you have to do are long and take time but really helpful. Other than that though his class is super fun and easy. Such a great class!
Brother Goodman is an amazing teacher that gives great insight into serving a mission. His class is very informative, and he gives you all the material you will need to succeed on tests and midterms.

Best class I have taken at BYU and best professor! This class is not hard, but teaches you more than any other class you will take. Brother Goodman inspires you to be better. He is friendly and has a very untraditional family, which gives him a unique perspective. I will probably take this class again when it is not online because it was amazing!

He is SO nice. For a guy with like 400-600 students, he sure knows how to be personal and reach out. I got an email from him asking how I was doing and he said some things that were totally personal to me. No copy and paste. And on my 8 page essay (which I made way longer than needed) he left sincere comments all over it from HIM, not the TA.

This was by far the best religion class I have ever taken! Brother Goodman had such interesting insights and taught in the most loving way, even in teaching difficult topics. It was genuinely so fun to participate in this class and I learned a lot. It helped me become more open minded and think in new ways. It also strengthened my testimony A LOT!

I honestly felt that Brother Goodman's name suits him very well: he is a good man and taking the eternal family with him has been an amazing blessing. The Family Proclamation final project was very inspiring and my favorite part of the class. This was also all online and the quizzes and assignments are easy to pass so long as you do them.
He did a great job making students feel like they mattered in his class. The material was fast and extensive, but he made deadlines and assignments clear.

I loved the Eternal Families class. It was very well structured with powerful material. Bro. Goodman is a good teacher and is very responsive to questions. Be careful to study the syllabus and know when things are due. I accidentally missed an entire Unit due to an oversight and wasn't allowed to turn it in when I realized.

Professor Goodman is a very inspirational teacher, from his background, to the discussion he promotes with his questions in the modules, and the material he has put together to help you learn the doctrine of the family. His teaching methods are very clear and build off one another. My views and value of marriage and the family has changed for good.

He was a great professor, was super caring, and is passionate about what he teaches. I took the class completely on-demand and I regret it because I wish I could have taken advantage of it if it were in person.

Really compassionate professor. Was super impressed by his genuine care for his students. He was open to all kinds of opinions and was very respectful of opinions that might not be standard church answers. Loved it!
Loved this class! If you do your homework it's not that hard at all. Would totally take it again. Bro. Goodman also gives great lectures!

Professor Goodman is a great professor! I felt like he really cared about how we were doing as students. I took this class online, but even so Professor Goodman made a point to reach out to us to see if we needed help and to make sure we knew we could ask him anything. Highly recommend!

I just finished his Eternal Families online summer course. I really liked the structure of this course. The workload was manageable, with the majority of it being readings, short quizzes, and analysis assignments (answering questions from unit material). Brother Goodman is very caring; he reached out to me to see how I was doing. Great course!

Brother Goodman is a phenomenal teacher who cares a lot about his students. He is always willing to work with you and help you improve. The class is a lot of work but he really prepares you for the tests and is a pretty easy grader.

Prof. Goodman cares so much for every single one of his students. He plans the course to make sure you understand the principles. His study guides are the most comprehensive you have ever seen, but dont forget to do the extra readings because thats where he pulls test questions from. Theres a lot of papers but they are super short.

Brother Goodman was a great teacher and super understanding when it came to assignments. I wouldn't recommend taking the class as a spring or summer term class, as I don't think he lightens the load but just doubles the speed of the class. However, if I had taken this class as a full semester I have no doubt that it would be a 5.

I wish that I would have been able to take this class in person because Professor Goodman is so chill and insightful. The units have a bit of reading, follow-up quizzes, and analysis assignments. Overall, nothing too stressful. If you want to enjoy the class, I would recommend taking it during a fall/winter semester rather than spring/summer

He is good at teaching, has a really well organized, thoughtful, and deep course. I would definitely take another class from him if I wanted to learn something new about the topic. Maybe it was the lecture on demand method, but it was harder to feel the spirit in his class, I still learned a lot though. He is great at taking feedback

Brother Goodman is a fantastic professor who really cares about each individual. This class was taken during the summer, and as such, was a little faster than fall and winter. Even with it being quick, it didn't ever feel like we were assigned work for no reason. He gave help on quizzes, midterms, and finals often which was helpful!

Dr. Goodman is a really good guy and is one of the better online instructors as he seems to really understand how online can be different than in-person. Had a very straight-forward schedule where everything was due on Mondays that helped me to remember to turn in my work. His tests can be challenging, but if you study the material you will be fine

This was a pretty easy class. I took it in the summer so it was very fast paced. The quizzes were very easy if you read the material and watched the videos. You will get an A if you put effort in and stay caught up!

Professor Goodman is a great teacher and really does what he can to help students succeed and do well in the class. I put the work in and got an easy A. His tests are also very straightforward which is nice.

This class honestly helped me so much to prepare for my mission. Brother Goodman is awesome, the TAs are understanding, and it was nice to get to know my classmates through discussions. Don't procrastinate though, otherwise you've got a lot of work to do at once. But if you do a little every day, no biggie.
Professor Goodman is an incredible person! He teaches extremely well and has enhanced my experience as a student!
I enjoyed this class. Professor Goodman was a good teacher.

Brother Goodman is my favorite religion teacher at BYU. . He is actively involved in each student's success and seeks to develop an individual relationship with students. He is transparent and open to feedback about adjusting the course. His best qualities are his inclusiveness and his sensitivity to social issues in the Church. Incredible teacher.

Professor Goodman is great. The class structure is very clear and easy to follow. It's clear that he cares a lot about each of his students. There's a decent amount of papers, but nothing too bad. The tests are pretty straightforward if you follow the learning objectives that he gives.
Great curriculum. Very good layout. Not too much reading, but it covers everything!

I took Eternal Families with Prof. Goodman and it was such an amazing class. Even though I took it fully online I still felt so supported and loved. He was always available to help and the lectures were truly life changing!

Professor Goodman was a great professor for REL C 200: The Eternal Family. I really enjoyed learning more in his class and the videos and lectures were great. This was a completely online class because of COVID, so there was tons or reading and videos, it was doable if I worked on it throughout the week though.

THE BEST!!!! Take eternal families from him! I was not really looking forward to this class because the marriage topic is scary but I have a whole different perspective!! Do the work and you'll be fine! The lectures are super interesting and insightful.

Professor Goodman is a great teacher! I took the Eternal Family Course. I took it during summer semester and it was all online so the content took me around 5-10 hours a week to complete. I would not recommend taking this class during spring or summer since it is so fast paced and not online. Other than that he is a great person and teacher!

While I thought Brother Goodman was a pretty good professor, I was not a fan of the assignment format for the online class. The weekly analysis assignments require you to answer 3 prompts at 200 words each. The prompts, however, were vague at best and always felt like busy work rather than a way to show and deepen understanding.
I loved taking Eternal Families from Professor Goodman, it was really enlightening and I learned a lot!

This was a summer class, so there was a lot of material and homework since there wasn't as much time. A lot of the videos weren't actually Brother Goodman teaching, and it would've been nice to have more from him since he's such a good teacher! I learned so much and always felt the Spirit while doing the lessons.

Professor Goodman is just the usual religion professor. It is not a class for those who are not LDS or who are liberal in their doctrinal understanding. It is a fundamental, conservative, 1950's understanding of family. Only the last week was spent on topics that are actually helpful in family life. The entire course was the law of chastity, etc.
I've taken a few religion classes and the one from professor goodman was the best so far. Its pretty easy and I enjoyed the content and the flow.

Professor Goodman did an amazing job handling sensitive subjects. The class was quite a bit of work with quizzes, weekly papers, and readings; but he graded fairly. The midterm and final are simple as long as you complete the study guides. Overall, one of my favorite religion professors!
I loved Professor Goodman! He is the most caring professor I have ever had. He was very straightforward with what he expected from us. I would hands down take another class from him!
My class was fully on demand, but the criteria was clear and I had plenty of time during the week to finish everything.

There was a lot of work and a paper every week, but he is a really kind and understanding professor. He tackles sensitive subjects with grace and always does really well explaining hard stuff. There are only 2 tests the entire semester, but they kinda suck. If you read everything you are supposed to, ( and there's a lot), you will do ok.

Truly a wonderful teacher to have as a religion teacher. He is very understanding and helps you out as much as he can. He focuses on helping you out more than just grading. The lectures are always fun, but he gives a workload that isn't too hard but stretches yourself.

Brother Goodman is one of the best teachers I have met at BYU. I would take his class again because I now understand how he tests and grades. He will make you work for the 2 credits by regularly exceeding the 6 hour per week workload. Hard, but worth it to be taught by Brother Goodman.
He was a fantastic teacher, and made the topic so interesting.

Honestly, he is just so engaging. He has exceptional knowledge of the gospel, and was truly inspiring, but also knows a lot about the world. Very intelligent and engaging. Take this class. Show up and you'll love it.

Brother Goodman wants to help everyone succeed. This class (Rel C 130- Mission Prep) was super helpful. Prepare to spend a lot of time doing the lesson outlines. There are only 3, but they take about 8-10 hours if you do them well. I imagine they will be helpful on the mission, so I'd say it was worth it.

Brother Goodman is the best! I learned a lot about the gospel and this class really helped me prepare for a mission. Brother Goodman knows a lot about the gospel and gives the best lectures where you learn a lot and feel the spirit. He also answered a lot of my questions. Other than the lesson plans, this class is really easy.
Loved his class. Bit more work than anticipated in a religion class.
The online class with Canvas. Possible to do in one day (workload is due weekly) but if done 20 min a day, it is easy. Test are from readings and projects require some reflection.
Very good teacher. Even though the course was online, it was clear he cared about us.

Brother Goodman is a great teacher and really cares about helping you have a better understanding of gospel principles. His tests are easy because they are literally straight from the study guides. Just make sure to do the study guides as you go along the class or you will have a ton of work to do before the tests. Very insightful class!

He was a wonderful professor who taught me a lot before my mission. I would 10/10 recommend. Such a kind man with lots of experience in the mission field. He'll make your life as easy as possible. Keep track of the learning goal and required reading questions as each class happens, it'll save you lots of time and hair loss if you do this!!

Brother Goodman is a really good man, and I don't just say that because of his name! He is really friendly, caring, and genuine! You can tell he really loves the gospel and he really cares about his students! He also knows a lot about missionary work because he used to be a mission president! He goes into deep doctrine at the end of the semester.

Professor Goodman is fantastic. Most people get an A in his class and the daily load is very manageable. Tips: The outlines are time-consuming, but you will get an A as long as you provide detail, personal stories, and open questions. His exams require studying, but the answers are obvious on the slides he provides so long as you look over them.
Brother Goodman takes very difficult or confusing concepts and makes them easy to understand. He teaches with such a strong spirit. His class is awesome.

This man should have already been translated, but he's here teaching mission prep at BYU. Truly, we don't deserve him. His lectures will change your life if you let them. The outlines take around 8 hours each to do (not joking), but there are only 3 of them, so iF yOu sTaY oN toP oF iT yOu'LL Be FinE. lmao.

This class taught me more than any other religion class I have ever taken. Brother Goodman is an amazing teacher. He really makes each person feel cared about. He teaches about missionary work and the gospel in a way that is fun, inspiring, and spiritually powerful. I would recommend this class to anyone thinking about serving a mission. 10/10!!

Brother Goodman is an awesome guy and he genuinely cares about his students. We showed up on the first day of class wearing masks (covid) and he knew all our names already just by what he could see of our faces. He was a mission president in Thailand and loves to talk about that experience. Get ready to put some time into your lesson plans though
Amazing. I learned so much and thoroughly enjoyed this class.

Brother Goodman was the absolute best! I had him for Mission Prep, and I'm definitely looking forward to taking more religion classes from him. He has a lot of Gospel knowledge and I always leave the class with more spiritual insight than I started with. He very obviously cares about each of the students, and the course work is not bad at all.

Brother Goodman is an amazing mission prep professor! Since he was a mission president, he knows the best material to prepare you with to feel confident going out into the mission field. It's not hard to do well in his class, and there is nothing out of the blue on quizzes or exams.

Super nice and the best lectures! He provided additional insights into doctrines that were awesome! COVID made it hard, but he tried to learn the students names. The class was easy, with a super easy quiz for each class, and then three outlines that were time consuming, but manageable and not too much considering how little other work there was.

I got a B+ in one of his religion classes last semester but I still chose to take him again because he goes into the right amount of depth for each topic and really knows his stuff. If you listen and are in tune with the spirit, you will love any of his classes!

Brother Goodman is very passionate about what he teaches, and makes it personal and applicable to his students. There are a couple heavy assignments that take a lot of time, but he gives you plenty of time to do them. Not only will you leave better prepared to teach others, but your own understanding will be increased. Highly recommend.

I had Brother Goodman for Mission Prep last semester, and now just finished a semester in his Eternal Families class, and he is incredible! Not only is he really caring and respectful, but he is very passionate about what he teaches, and you can tell he loves to do it. I learned so much, and though it takes a bit of work, it is so worth it.

Brother Goodman really loves his class and the gospel. He is super caring and fun. He puts so much effort into each class and I have learned a lot. He does tell you basically what is in the midterm and final, but the questions are very specific to what Preach My Gospel Says, so definitely study.

Brother Goodman is the absolute BEST teacher I have ever had. He loves his students so so much. His biggest goal is for his students to be ready to serve a mission and to come closer to Christ. He teaches with awesome humor and genuine love.

The class was very very work intensive. By far the most work intensive religion class that I have had at BYU. Brother Goodman is a very good man, that makes the class worth it. He did a great job teaching difficult subjects in a difficult time. I am better off as a result of this class.

I love Brother Goodman. He teaches great lectures that give you plenty of things to take notes about. The online quizzes are not hard because he gives you the questions beforehand. Make sure you put effort into the lesson outlines. They count heavily towards your grade. I will take classes from him in the future because he's so good.
The workload is way too heavy and guidelines for the semester project are very, very stringent. Would not take this class ever again

Brother Goodman is honestly an amazing professor. I took his eternal families class and learned way more than I thought I would. He is sincere, honest and very experienced in what he teaches. He answers every question thoughtfully and is very open to all opinions and viewpoints. He doesn't make anyone feel bad about what they think.
I have really enjoyed taking a class from Brother Goodman! He is such an incredible person and truly cares about all of his students.

Brother Goodman is a wonderful professor. He cares a lot about his students, and is very respectful on the way he approaches sensitive topics. However, the course workload is very high for a religion class. It will require you several hours every week, including essays, tons of long readings, and long projects.

Prof Goodman is incredible. He knew my name before the first day and consistently keep class lively and interactive. His one-liners are unforgettable and he really helps prepare you to serve a mission. He has so much experience and insight from his life. He has so much material I could take this class three times and still learn something new!
Awesome!

I took Bro Goodman's blended class, which I really enjoyed. Of course, my favorite part was attending his lectures, which were always amazing. There were tons of readings in the class and a lot of the material repeated itself, but Bro Goodman's lectures were worth it. He was really good at explaining complicated matters in a simple way.

He's so an amazing professor and always cares about his students. If you are there for his mission prep course it will prepare you so much and he makes you do outlines, though they may take a lot of time to complete, they will definitely help you for the mission, plus, every week he asks at the beginning of the class, to say our names, & callings.

Brother Goodman is an awesome teacher!! Our class was half in person and the rest was on demand. He's so good at making you feel loved. He was a ysa bishop and a mission president so he relates to the students really well. Canvas was set up really well with clear deadlines. As long as you take the time to do the assignments you'll do great!
Loved this course. Brother Goodman is an amazing teacher and I learned lots!

I liked Brother Goodman a lot! He was fun and sincere and his class layout was nice on Canvas. However, he didn't appear on a lot of the video lectures, so I hardly ever saw him, which made me sad. But, it was a solid class and I would definitely recommend taking Eternal Families from Goodman!

Brother Goodman is very knowledgeable of his field. His class is well organized and the due dates of things are very clear. The tests are fairly difficult however and require a lot of preparation. There is not much homework throughout the week which is nice. Brother Goodman is fun, entertaining, and caring of his students.
Professor Goodman is a great professor who cares about his students. He required a semester-long project that was a bit of a pain, but other than that it was a great class.

Brother Goodman so clearly cares about his students and their future. It's really nice to have a professor who wants us to succeed so much. There are a few big assignments, but the TA's are merciful like he is. I forgot to turn in a few things so my grade suffered, but that's on me. 100% would recommend.

Brother Goodman is so awesome! I loved his class, and I wish he taught more classes so I could take him again. I learned so much in this class. He is caring and respectful. His expectations are clear. Take his class!

Eternal Families with Brother Goodman has been the best religion class I've taken at BYU. I've actually felt a desire to change after several of his lessons and he's a very kind, thoughtful individual. I've also never seen someone so adept at teaching college students about such controversial topics. Only bad thing is there's way too much reading.

Brother Goodman is great! He's incredibly nice and is a fantastic teacher for a mission prep class. The outlines he assigns take some time, but should be really helpful in the mission field. This class is great, and I would definitely recommend it.
I really liked the course. It focused well on families but was not overbearing. Nice class to fulfill a religion requirement.
Professor Goodman is such a great kind professor! He expresses understanding and compassion for everyone. His lectures were great and he always encouraged questions so students understood everything.

Professor Goodman is awesome. I could feel the spirit a lot during his lectures and I really felt like his class helped me better prepare for a mission. The outlines are quite a bit of work if you want to do well on them (so make sure to start them in advance!) but they were definitely were useful and not just busy work. Such a great class!!!

Brother Goodman was an amazing professor for mission prep! His lectures had captivating stories, were inspiring, and really taught you how to be prepared for your mission. I was amazed at his knowledge and experience. He was a mission president and knows what he is talking about! Listen and follow what he says and you will do well in the class.
