Professor Goodman was very helpful in answering any of my questions and concerns! He gave very clear instructions as to what we need to do for assignments, and had a clear calendar for the future days as well. It was on the easier side, but had a good amount of work.

Pretty solid professor for Eternal Families. Everything was online so you could do the coursework on your own time. There were a lot of required readings for the course and it sometimes got tedious. Other than that, pretty easy/interesting religion class.
Brother Goodman is an awesome Professor and has really good insights. However, this class is a TON of work for a religion class. By far the most time consuming religion class I've ever took.
Awesome professor, super kind and open, really knows how students feel.

I loved having brother Goodman as my professor for my class. He really deep down cares about each and everyone of his students. he memorizes each students face and name so when in class and you have a comment he calls on you by name and makes you feel really special and important. I would take him again for sure!

As a person, Professor Goodman is amazing, which is also reflected in him as a teacher. There are only three major assignments that take a lot of time and effort, but they truly help you prepare for a mission! So, don't skip out on those. He is such a warm and bubbly person that he just makes you smile.

Professor Goodman is such an amazing teacher. He really cares about what he is teaching and about the students in his class. All the projects assigned honestly are very helpful in understanding and living the material taught. I would highly recommend this class if you are looking for a meaningful learning experience.

Bro. Goodman is an awesome religion teacher. I took him for mission prep and I really felt like he cared about us and wanted us to be successful on our missions. I definitely want to take another religion class from him when I get back. Watch for his tests and outlines though, they aren't super hard if you put time into them.

Professor Goodman is the most amazing human being ever. I left each Mission Prep class feeling so inspired and spiritually uplifted, which really helped me get through my tougher classes. His lesson outlines do take a lot of time, so be sure to start early on them. Really do your best on them too because they can be valuable tools on missoins.

I wish I could pick more of these. Brother Goodman is all 3 of the tags I selected, as well as hilarious, an amazing lecturer, and inspiring. Every time we met, I was reinvigorated for my love of missionary work and the gospel. He really does do everything he can to prepare his students to go out and teach the gospel.
Mr. Goodman is an excellent professor who cares deeply about his students. Work will be required but the benefits of taking his Mission Prep class are well worth it.
very nice guy

Was a good class. Learned a lot AND was not ridiculous with work or weird assignments like some other religion courses. 10/10 would take from brother Goodman again. He's a good lecturer and you feel like he actually cares about you when you take his class.
Just a few big assignments, but nothing too crazy. Really great lectures, just make sure to take notes for the study guide.

This was my second time taking from this Professor. I took his Eternal Families class and loved it so I then took Mission Prep. He makes you put in your work, although He isn't a tough grader. He is really interesting and I learned tons from him.
Professor Goodman is a great guy who is very passionate about the gospel. Hes very kind and a great teacher

This class was super helpful to prepare for my mission! Professor Goodman is an awesome professor and what he expects in his class is clear. You have to make 3 different outlines, which are a lot of work. But if you do a little at a time, it is no problem. Other than that, the class is easy and I definitely feel more prepared for my mission.

Lectures are engaging and enlightening. Daily and weekly assignments were fair. The lesson outlines required too much work and was brutal. Exams required memorization of concepts as well as remembering events in class. Graded fairly just not fun to study for.
Professor Goodman teaches the gospel so clearly and brings a great Spirit in the room. He makes the class a safe place where any questions and comments can be made, and he teaches at our pace.
Overall good guy. Cares about students and about what he teaches.

Brother Goodman is the best! He is so kind and teaches this class so well! He teaches you from preach my gospel and makes his lectures interesting and entertaining! I would highly recommend taking any of His classes! He really helped prepare me for my mission!

I love Brother Goodman! I feel so much more prepared for my mission after taking his class. His class is not about busy work. The assignments he gives are helpful! That being said, you do have to put in the work. He shares amazing stories and experiences. He knew my name on the first day of class! He really cares and wants everyone to succeed.

He is amazing and makes his lectures very interesting. Im never bored and he makes all of his students laugh! The outlines take multiple hours to complete but I see how they will be very useful so its worth it.
Brother Goodman's mission prep class is a little more work than most but it's definitely worth it in the long run and will get you prepared for your mission!

Brother Goodman is an excellent lecturer and his course is organized efficiently. The midterm and final are organized in such a way that you need to come to class and pay attention. He gives you the questions that could be on the test and you come to class to find their answers. His grading is fair and you can tell that he cares about the students

Brother Goodman is caring, but some of us fall outside of those he cares about. There's no doubt that he is %100 devoted to the Church teachings, doctrines, and policies, but if you're a woman looking for a class that will deepen your faith and encourage you to feel the love of God, do not take this class.

Brother Goodman is one of the most genuine professors I've ever had; I adore him! He teaches with the spirit and loves his students. I had a mix of online/in-person classes. In-person lectures were awesome! Online work was manageable throughout the week and not super time intensive or difficult. If you can take from one teacher; it should be him!

A very balanced class. Blended class set up which allowed for us to be involved in person and over zoom. The set up on canvas was very orderly, this was because he helped establish the criteria for the class when it first became an actual class. He is hilarious, and has a very good way of explaining the gospel in a very personable way.

This 2 credit religion class (Eternal Families) was more work than either of my 4 credit classes this semester. Professor Goodman cares and will make tests fair (he'll even take out questions just because a lot of people missed them) but class is more trouble than its worth. Always runs out of time in lecture. Take it from someone else.

The homework and tests took away from any sort of spiritual benefit that I could have received from this class. His assignments were ridiculously heavy, and I routinely spent more time doing homework for this class than my other classes. The tests were difficult and any answer could have been argued as correct. Would not recommend to anyone.
Brother Goodman was incredibly inspiring. I always looked forward to his lectures because he really gives amazing insight. I am looking forward to taking more classes from him in future semesters.
He was an extremely caring person and passionate about the class.

I've taken Prof. Goodman for both mission prep and eternal families - both were great. You can tell he really cares about his students and loves what he does. The class is well-organized and he's super clear as to what you need to do to succeed. Everything you need is given, and it's the easiest but most satisfying A you'll get in a religion class.

I loved coming to this class. Having it in the mornings meant that I could start my day off with a spiritually uplifting experience, reminding me of what I enjoyed about seminary. He does have three large projects due every three weeks, however with good planning it can be done easily. I enjoyed doing the projects, and found them to be very useful.
Great class and teacher. The midterm and final are hard if you don't do the readings but other than that its an easy class that I learned a lot in.

I loved the lectures in this class, but there is too much work for a religion class. I think the work makes sense according to all the material, but I would rather just sit and listen to the professor.

Required religion classes shouldn't be super hard and should be uplifting and Brother Goodman does an excellent job at both. I took the class through a blended course and I felt that both the online and the in person assignments were easy and doable. There's two tests, a midterm and a final that require some studying, but other than that it's easy

Brother Goodman was the person who created this class, so he understand and teaches it better than anyone else. I think his class normally involves a lot of discussions, but I took it online so I didn't have to deal with that. He really cares about his students, and wants you to get an A. Tests are a big part of the grade, but if you study it's ok.
Did a good job of teaching online. Lecture heavy but well done
Mike Goodman might be my favorite religion professor that I have ever had. He cares and he is knowledgeable. The class did require a lot of reading but I felt that it was a great course

10/10 would recommend to anyone. I loved listening to his amazing life stories and he always gives great advice. The material is easy to follow and he does a great job explaining the doctrine of the gospel.
Really great professor, enjoyed the class so much! Would take again, easy tests and quizzes.

Brother Goodman is an excellent man who is very caring. The class was interesting, and he approached difficult topics with clarity and compassion. Make sure you do the readings and quizzes (they are weighted heavily on the grade).

Prof Goodman is amazing! I learned amazing stuff in this class! In the beginning of the class he said that his goal was to make you more prepared going into your mission than some going out. Stay on top of the reading and the outlines will kill your soul a little bit so do them in advance. Other than outlines, pretty simple and super enlightening!

Bro Goodman is awesome. He was a mission president so he knows a lot and he really helps you to prepare for a mission. He will teach you a lot of stuff that is good to know for the mission and he really cares about his students.

Brother Goodman is so funny and loving, but his tests do require a decent amount of studying. His projects that he assigns are long, but really helpful for a mission and they're easy to get a good grade. Brother Goodman is a convert, a return missionary, and was a mission president, so he has great experience in the mission field.
Dr. Goodman is a great professor and he really cares about his students. In my opinion there was an excessive amount of reading and essay writing for a two credit class though.
He cares more about my development as a person than my grade in his class which creates an environment for true learning.
he was a fun and respected guy

I have taken two classes from Brother Goodman, and I adore him! He teaches clear doctrine that is centered on Christ without inserting his own opinions. I seriously wish I could have him there to give me advice moving forward in life. His class isn't necessarily easy, but do the work and study and you'll be fine.

Mike Goodman is an amazing teacher who genuinely wants his students to leave his class as better people. This class isn't for those who struggle to remember to do little repetitive assignments or procrastinate, because the two weekly reading attendance checks and 8 page lesson outlines will definitely come as a surprise if you aren't ready.

Brother Goodman is a fantastic teacher because he knows just about everything you need to know to serve a mission. He has a true testimony and is passionate about serving the Lord. The lesson outlines took lots of time outside of class (there are three to do), but doing them helped me to become more prepared to serve as a missionary. Solid choice!
Brother Goodman is the best!!! He is so nice and willing to work with you, and knows everything about the gospel!! 100% recommend taking a class from him!!

I really liked him as a person. He was very fun, and liked to get to know his students. But most of the quizzes and tests focused mostly on the reading, as opposed to the lectures, which is where I went wrong when I focused mostly on taking notes from the lectures.

I cannot say enough good about Brother Goodman and this class! He does not assign busy work, and I think you might say he assigns a bit more than the average religion class, but he is incredibly reasonable and approachable. Every lecture is spiritual and mind-expanding. Learned things I will be applying forever.

Professor Goodman is the best professor I've had. Engaged the students & answered questions. Overall, great material and inspiring lectures. Online coursework is easy to do and spiritually up-lifting. Midterm/final use only the questions on the study guide. I'm taking another class from him next semester. Highly recommend.

Brother Goodman was an awesome professor. He made lectures interesting, spiritual, and inspiring. Outlines are the biggest part of your grade so don't procrastinate like I did!!! If you are getting ready for a mission or can't figure out if you want to go on one, you should take this class.

Professor Goodman was awesome. He kept lectures interesting and cares a lot for the students. Outlines are a big chunk of your grade so don't procrastinate like I did on them!! If you are preparing or still figuring out whether or not to serve a mission, this is the class for you! You will be grateful you took this class!

Proffesor Goodman is a great teacher. He is caring, forgiving, and spiritual. He has a very powerful testimony and great insights. I enjoyed his class and it make me excited for missionary work. He does however require 3 very long lesson outlines. This was the only hard part of the class. I think there are easier classes but Goodman is incredible.
He was such a good teacher and taught with the gospel and had the best stories! The outlines are kinda time consuming but was knowledgeable and will help for teaching lessons

All you had to do to get an A in Brother Goodman's class was take notes and he even told you exactly what to take notes on in the reading and lectures. His midterm and final were almost word for word with the study guide. The only hard assignments were the lesson outlines but you have three weeks for each of them. Overall, I loved this class!

Brother Goodman is one of the sweetest men on the planet. There is a lot of work in this class (the course was blended between in person and online through Canvas this semester, and that may have contributed), but it is still a great class.

Brother Goodman does a great job of being accommodating and is very straightforward in the way he teaches and grades. You can tell he wants you to succeed and is very accessible. You just need to make sure you show up to class-the more you put into it the more youll get out of it.

Professor Goodman is the best Eternal Family teacher. He pretty much wrote the curriculum for the class. He is outstanding at explaining how living the gospel can look many different ways. He has amazing amount of respect for students and their personal opinions. I would 10/10 recommend!
Brother Goodman is great, he focuses a lot on the spritual side of things which is great. During the semester you take a lot of attendance quizzes, and only have a few projects. Not too bad at all.

Brother Goodman is really an amazing teacher! He is a great lecturer and he really brings the spirit into class and helps you understand the topic. He has great insights and a lot to teach! The only thing I didn't like was that the class was blended with online material which was harder to engage with and could feel like busy work sometimes.

Brother Goodman was awesome for mission prep. He knows so much about the gospel and about how to be a good missionary. His teaching discussions he had us write are very useful and not too hard as long as you don't do it the night it's due. Spread it out! His readings are usually 2 or 3 pages from preach my gospel with the most being like 8 pages.

Professor Goodman was hands down my favorite teacher. His kindness, caring demeanor, and heartfelt lessons left me feeling uplifted and spiritually fed after every class. The material I learned has really helped me understand the Gospel better and will definitely help me on my mission. I strongly recommend taking him, you won't be disappointed.

I enjoyed this class and really learned a lot. Brother Goodman is very sincere and very entertaining in class and teaches concepts very clearly. The tests were pretty rough honestly but if you do all the assignments you'll end up with a good grade.

I LOVE professor Goodman! He really cares about all his students and gives amazing lectures. I really feel as if my testimony was strengthened because of his class. He always answers my emails in a very timely manner as well! 10/10 recommend.

Brother Goodman is very kind and the class was extremely organized, with no surprises throughout the semester. However, the four outlines we had due during the semester take a LOT of time. So be prepared to put effort into those!

I LOVE BROTHER GOODMAN! HE IS SO CARING ABOUT HIS STUDENTS. THE WORKLOAD IS PRETTY USUAL, WITH ABOUT 4 HOURS OF HOMEWORK OUTSIDE OF CLASS. THERE IS A LOT OF READING, ALONG WITH SOME OPEN NOTE QUIZZES, AND ONE FINAL AND MIDTERM THAT ARE CLOSED NOTE. HE DOES HAVE ONE LARGE PROJECT. HE WROTE THE COURSE AND IS PASSIONATE ABOUT THE TOPIC!!

Professor Goodman is a fantastic teacher. The spirit is really strong in his class and I learned a lot. However, the workload was a lot more than I expected. I took the course when it was half online, so this may have increased the workload. Even with that, I enjoyed the class. I just had to put in way more work than I thought I would.

He was so passionate about what he taught. He was super caring about his students and would be willing to help them. He will work with your situation. Readings online were long and took a while, but the criteria for assignments was obvious and made it easy to get good grades.
Lots and lots of homework and reading but solid class and not too hard.

Prof. Goodman is a really good teacher and very enthusiastic in his teachings. One heed of warning is that you will have to do multiple long missionary lesson outlines that can take hours to finish. As long as you stay organized and on top of the class, it is easy and very spiritually fulfilling. This class really helps prepare you for the mission.

Brother Goodman is a good dude and teaches a good class but you HAVE to pay attention and HAVE to get things done. Just because its a churchy class doesn't mean you can coast by. I thought that and then I didn't pass. GET. STUFF. IN. ON. TIME.

Brother Goodman truly cares about teaching you the gospel. If you go to class and pay attention it's not too hard to get a good grade. You do 3 missionary outlines that take a lot of time but they help you prepare for your mission.

Professor Goodman is a great Mission Prep teacher! I think that some of his assignments are more time consuming than maybe other mission prep teachers but the assignments were useful in preparing for a mission not just busy work! He is a really nice professor and I would recommend him to anyone but just let them know it is some work, but useful!
Outlies are very long, don't procrastinate them! Other than the outlines the class in very simple and very helpful for preparing you for a mission.

Brother Goodman was very good at preparing me for a mission. If you do all your work and show up to class you will get an A. 3 lesson outlines are the majority of out of class work, but if you don't procrastinate them, they aren't that bad.
Professor Goodman gives good lectures and is a super nice teacher, but almost all of his homework is busy work. You can expect this to be one of the hardest religion classes you've taken.

Brother Goodman was such a great teacher. I took his mission prep class and I really feel like I am ready to serve! The class is not hard if you pay attention and don't procrastinate. There are a couple of hard things he had us do, but I feel like they really did help me prepare for my mission.

This class is a must at BYU even if you are not serving a mission! I have learned so much from Professor Goodman and can't wait to go to every lecture. Mission outlines are hard but in the end they are so worth it. I would take this class again in a heartbeat if I could. Even if you don't take Mission Prep, take any class by Professor Goodman.

This class is very educational AND spiritual. Brother Goodman is fun and he cares so much about the topic, making it enjoyable. IDK why people are whining about the test and workload. Make sure you study and put actual effort in, just like your other classes. Make sure you have time management skills and after that the class will be fun!

Professor Goodman makes the BYU religion requirement such a burden. Apart from in person class, you will spend 4-5 hours a week with online modules. He makes you do a personal improvement project for 2 hours a week. I expected to grow spiritually from my BYU religion classes, but Professor Goodman just made me hate them. So much unnecessary info

I loved the lectures and discussions but his test were awful. Super specific based from the readings. For example, if you read a talk the the speaker gives a list of points, you better memorize all of those points in the exact order that they were given. Also, memorize the exact wording he has on his slides, his questions are very specific.

Professor Goodman is an awesome guy and very humble. He is kind and understanding of student's situations. That being said, there is a significant amount of reading and the tests can be detail oriented. 60% of the tests come directly from the study guide so that part is easy, but some of the smaller details were difficult to catch.

You know those religion classes at BYU that are way harder than they should be? Well, this class is the epitome of that. He made a smaller workload for Spring semester and that included one 4- page paper and one 7 page paper. He also had two tests that were ridiculous. That doesn't include the other 3 or 4 projects he took out for spring.

I took his mission prep class through BYU Independent Study. I was able to finish in a timely manner and I got an A, but it was tough and the questions on the quizzes and final exam were very trivia-esque. Make sure you take good notes and write everything down.

Decent teacher for a terrible class. Nothing has ever made me question my faith in this church more than an in-depth analysis as to why the patriarchal oppression against women is divinely ordained. Don't forget, if a woman cannot be a mother in this life, it's impossible to have a fulfilled or happy life :) Just pretend to agree, you'll get an A.

I loved everything about Brother Goodman except his tests. They have very obscure details on them and I found them very frustrating. Because the class went online I am sure people cheated on them. I also felt the first month was wasted on things that everyone knows. But he brings the Spirit and interacts well with the class. Solid choice!

I had so many questions about the gospel that I both did and didn't know I had answered by Goodman. He has a really cool perspective on things that make them, especially the church/gospel, make more sense. Very willing to help those that put in the effort. Do watch out for the assignments though, I didn't expect so many assignments for a REL class.

- Brother Goodman was an awesome teacher, just be sure to fill out the study guide he gives as the semester goes on. Don't forget to do the quizzes!!! You need to attend lecture to be able to gain the full points for the quiz.

I took Mission Prep & lovedddd it. Best class at BYU so far. First day of class he knew each of our names, you could tell how much he cared about us. The only 'real' work is the outlines for lessons/discussions- they take a lot of time but are worth it & help a ton in the mission field! Quizzes are easy. Exams are just memorization from PMG.

I'll be honest, I did not have the same experience as many of the others reviewing Brother Goodman. He is a great guy, but there was very little I gained spiritually from the very specific test questions and the outlines we wrote that had to be done in a VERY specific manner. Good lectures, but that's about it...

Professor Goodman is THE best religion professor at BYU. I took his class in the summer and I do not regret it. He truly cares about what is being taught. His class is like a discussion and all opinions are welcomed. There was weekly work, application project, research paper, midterm, and final (none of it was difficult) TAKE THIS CLASS! Easy A!

Brother Goodman is so amazing! I loved taking his class. One problem I had with him, though, is the fact that we had to do lesson outlines which took HOURS to complete. That is about the only homework you do besides quizzes and reading, though, so not too horrible, just takes a lot of time.

Professor Goodman knew exactly how to cater to the individual needs of his students. He has amazing personal experiences from his own mission and serving as a mission president that he shares to bring a strong spirit to the classroom. Three lesson outlines that take a lot of time to do, do not procrastinate! Tests and daily quizzes are easy.

Please please take eternal families from him!!! This is literally what he has spent most of his life studying, so he knows the subject inside and out and knows how to teach it. Lectures are incredibly interesting; homework and papers are enjoyable and not too hard. He handles the tough subjects with tons of charity. What a good man !!!

This was a great class. Very different from other religion classes that I took at BYU. I would totally recommend this class and professor. There are a few hours of reading each week, out of a PDF file of conference talks. You also get a chance to directly apply learned principles from class.

IF YOU'RE TAKING ETERNAL FAMILIES TAKE THIS CLASS FROM HIM. So different than any religion class I've ever taken. Goodman is the perfect balance of making things spiritual, but also discussing real problems and answering tough but valid questions. Not a lot of reading, I could sit in his lectures all day. Discussions are life changing, seriously.

He promises that you will go into the MTC more prepared than people that are leaving. He kept his promise. SUCH A GOOD CLASS!! He is an amzing teacher! Don't procrastinate the outlines, they are killer! But they are so helpful!! There are reading quizzes from PMG reading everyday at home, so just remember to take them. He is one of the best!

I can't rave enough about Professor Goodman. You know those rare professors that just make you feel warm inside because they're SUCH good people and SUCH good teachers, simultaneously? This was the second class I took from him. Take it!!!

Dr. Goodman is a fantastic scholar and entertaining lecturer. Coursework for his Mission Prep class includes 3 major Outlines (on the lessons in PMG) and daily online quizzes (easy to miss, don't forget). Would highly recommend as his class will grow your testimony in ways you won't expect.

Brother Goodman is always so happy and he knows every student by name before the first class, which shows he really cares. His lessons are amazing! He has just the perfect amount of fun and spiritual! For mission prep, there was a little quiz after class (very easy). We do fill out a few mission outlines which are beneficial, but also kinda hard.

By far my favorite professor at BYU. I've taken his mission prep class and his Eternal Families class and both were amazing. He gives amazing lectures and truly cares about each of his students to the point where he learns everyone's names. There are daily quizzes and doing the reading/assignments are important but still, the most solid professor.

Brother Goodman is a nice guy, but beware of excellent reviews. At first his mission prep class seems like it won't be too bad, but all of the sudden, you find out about the outlines. Those too seem fine until you start them. They are long and tedious and the rubric is extremely subjective. Take this class only if you want to do a LOT of work.

Brother Goodman is one of the most inspirational professors I have had at BYU. He genuinely cares about every student. He actually has everyone's name memorized even before you meet him the first day. This class changed my life both because of the material and because of the way that Brother Goodman taught by the spirit. Highly recommend.

Professor Goodman is one of my favorite professors that I've taken from at BYU. Every assignment was something I could apply in my life, not just busy work. You do have to read a lot, but it's worth it because the material is so good. He's very kind and an amazing teacher! I would highly recommend taking this class from him.

Brother Goodman is the best! I would take this class again and again if I could. There is a lot of reading, but its good stuff (not too boring!) He is super caring and gives you the test questions in the study guide. Fill that out as you go and you will be golden. Lectures made it easy to be in class for 2 hours :) But make sure to take notes!

Professor Goodman is the best REL teacher I've had. He's a great person, and he know how to teach very well. He is super spiritual, and very inspirational. He wants the students to succeed, so he doesn't do hard tests or quizzes. A little bit of studying will easily get you an A in the class.

Exceptional class with an exceptional professor! Bro Goodman's goal is to prepare you to be a better spouse and parent. My mind was blown every single class. He's on the church correlation committee and has a PhD in family sciences so he knows his stuff. Remember to do the quizzes on learning suite because they can quickly hurt your grade.

Simple class that has a lot of good insights into marriage and family, would definitely recommend! Prof. Goodman is very nice and an insightful professor. After- class quizzes check attendance, but you can still miss several classes without it impacting your grade much at all. 1 midterm and 1 final that are very easy

Brother Goodman is very caring. I went through some personal emergency circumstances during the semester and he was very accommodating. He offers very clear grading criteria, do the readings and actually prep with the study guide.

Most worth-it low grade I've ever gotten. Brother Goodman is absolutely amazing! His class changed my perspective on everything surrounding marriage and many controversial issues. Projects work on improving yourself and are very reasonably sized. Definitely take Eternal Family with him!!

Amazing professor and good friend. He cared so much about everyone in the class, and I constantly found myself fascinated by the lectures. I got the opportunity to talk with him a lot and go much more in depth on all the subjects which was truly a blessing. This was an awesome class. Tests weren't my style, but he explains what they'll be like.

Best religion professor ever! He knew everyone's name on the first day of class! He truly cares for his students and is much more concerned with learning than tests and busy work, He will test because he has to but the biggest thing is the semester long project, focused on strengthening a specific quality. So sweet and caring!

He is a rare find. Such a remarkable professor because he knows how to work his classroom in a respectful manner that gets the material across but still allows student participation and insights to be shared. He truly wants us to take what we're learning and apply it and he did a phenomenal job in his efforts to do so.

Brother Goodman is seriously one of a kind. He teaches so clearly and precisely. Even topics you feel you know about he will bring in to a new light. He encourages questions and you can ask any of the "hard" ones. He knew everyone's name on the first day of class, and that's just an example of how much he truly cares for each of his students.
Brother Goodman is a great teacher. He has well-made powerpoints and explains the doctrine in clear terms

Brother Goodman is hard. 40% of test questions are taken from tangents discussed in class. The other 60% are direct passages in Preach My Gospel that you will need to memorize. He has daily class quizzes that are online for 12 hours after class, don't forget to do them. Still a good professor, not an easy A. The 3 outlines each take several hours.

Amazing and inspirational class, he makes the class worth it. He prepares well by giving online quizzes every class with questions directly from Preach My Gospel. He has 3 really long outlines that take multiple hours each that really decide your grade, but they are doable. More work than most mission prep classes but worth your time!

Great teacher! I took mission prep from him and I feel like I know the gospel a lot better now. I am more confident in my teaching. The class was pretty easy, he gives you 60% of the test questions that are found in PMG . He also gives 3 lesson outlines throughout the semester that aren't bad as long as you start on them early.

Brother Goodman respected students and wanted the best for them. He gave great lectures that made me feel the Spirit, and I loved class time despite not loving our large preach my gospel outlines we had to make. Brother Goodman is a very nice, intelligent, and spiritual person though and I'd definitely consider taking him again.

He is the best religion teacher I have had and has the most inspiring and amazing lectures. He is super funny and has a great sense of what the class needs to learn each day. Be prepared to do extensive lesson outlines but they go along with the lesson material, so just keep on top of them. TAKE HIS CLASS! YOU WILL LOVE IT!!

Brother Goodman is seriously my favorite teacher ever bc he is such a funny and kind person. He really prepares you for serving a mission. The tests and quizzes are easy. The only thing that was hard about this class was the outlines. If you don't procrastinate writing them, they aren't hard at all. Definitely TAKE THIS CLASS.

I loved Brother Goodman, he was one of my favorite teachers. I took his mission prep class, used what I learned on the mission, felt like he he was invested, knew what he was talking about, and the classes were always spiritual. Now I'm going back to take his Eternal families class. But be careful, do your outlines early, they're killer.

Brother Goodman is a great, spiritual guy, and I'm glad I took this class from him. Before going into his class, you should know that the majority of your grade resides on 3 huge outlines. If you do them the night before, you can still probably get a B, but you'll be miserable. His tests are also very memorization-based, so watch out for that

I took Bro. Goodman's mission prep class over 2 years ago and I just felt like I needed to come write him a great review. He is an amazing, spiritual teacher. He cares about his students and doesn't concentrate so much on making a HARD class, but rather, a class that helps the students learn the doctrine and have fun while applying it. He's great!

Brother Goodman is an incredible teacher and honestly, just a wonderful man.  His lectures are spiritual, he's hilarious, and he's so aware of his students.  The tests were extremely doable.  The only thing is there is reading for every class and a quiz, but you have a study guide so you know all the answers.  Honestly, TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!

I. LOVE. BROTHER. GOODMAN. He is hands down one of my favorite people I've ever met. He had everyone's names memorized before we came to class and was always extremely caring and kind. My mind was constantly blown during discussions, and I learned SO SO much. Brother Goodman is my hero. If you can get into his class, TAKE IT. You won't regret it.

Professor Goodman is one of my favorite teachers ever! He really helps you prepare adequately for a mission. You will put in extra time in homework with the outlines you make for the Preach My Gospel lessons, but if you are seriously planning on serving it is worth it

Brother Goodman is an exceptional religion teacher. He's not afraid to discuss difficult topics in class and makes class a safe environment to do so. He cares a lot about his students. He sincerely wants to help you grow spiritually and cares more about that than memorizing doctrines and facts. His class is enjoyable and a great learning experience

Mission Prep from Brother Goodman was hard. But also it was so worth it. I have taken mission prep classes from other professors and sources and have never felt like I got very far. This class taught me true doctrine and how to teach it. His lectures are inspiring and he is witty. Be prepared to work, but it's not busy work at all.
He is an amazing professor that really cares about his students! He brings the spirit everyday and really blessed my education! I would take any of his classes!

Bro. Goodman's Mission Prep class was wonderful! He creates an atmosphere that really encourages and answers questions. He focuses more in class about the practical side of serving a mission, and when he does teach about the lessons we will teach from Preach My Gospel, he really covers the controversial or potentially confusing aspects; I loved it!

I cried when I had to leave this class. Brother Goodman cares enough to push you to learn. Do well on the first outline!! I didn't because I only finished 3/4 of it, and that made the end of the semester tough. Know everything on the study guides! And go see your old tests. The outlines are a ton of work, but you can actually use them on a mission

Quite a bit of work for a Mission Prep class but man does Brother Goodman prepare you well! Great teacher with amazing stories and genuinely cares about every one of his students. The outlines are long but other than that the class is painless and a very easy A.
Bro. Goodman is an awesome teacher and knows his stuff. 3 long outlines for missionary lessons, but other than those this class was pretty easy. Get ready to teach short lessons to your peers.

If you're taking mission prep, take it from Professor Goodman.  I learned SOO much from him. His class is a perfect mix of spirituality, practical application, and participation. He's a great lecturer, and really cares about the success of all his students. I am much better prepared for my mission now!

Professor Goodman knows his stuff. His lectures are so insightful and inspirational. He's easy to understand and very approachable. He cares about ALL his students and he goes the extra mile to help them succeed in his class. I always left the class with a new positive outlook on life. Participation is key but not hard, & you can easily get A.

Best teacher ever, felt the spirit almost everyday of class. Left the class way more prepared for my mission. Over half of your grade is from easy quizzes you take every day of class. The other half are lesson outlines which take time to write but they're worth it, and then the midterm and final which are semi easy.

Absolutely take this class from him. Lectures are amazing and workload is minimal- weekly online open book quizzes, a semester long project that only requires a couple hours a week. Tests are memorization, the study guide is a lifesaver there. He is the right balance of spiritual and educational. Seriously loved him and learned so much!

I learned so much from Brother Goodman. His outlines are challenging, but he doesn't grade them really hard, and you learn so much from making them. His lectures always left me amazed and I learned the doctrines much more deeply. He memorized everyone's name before the first class, so I felt like he cared about me. Tests are easy if you study.

Great professor! Loved his lectures. Only thing that was annoying were the test. The study guide is 140 quotes. Some were mentioned in class, but the majority are just from the manual. His test do not test you on what you learned in the class. Just if you can memorize 140 quotes.

Brother Goodman is by far the best religion teacher at BYU. He is very understanding and kind. He doesn't try and force his opinions on you but gives you the tools you would need to apply the principles in the class.

Great teacher, very spiritual, has great insights.  We did a lot of teaching, which was probably the most helpful for me.  Just show up and participate and you'll get an A.  I would recommend buying your own mission prep manual, marking it, and taking it on your mission.

If you are considering going on a mission take this mission prep class from Goodman!  He prepares you to hit the ground running from day one of your mission. He requires you to make 3 lesson outlines, but these are exactly what you will be using on your mission. His class is instructional and inspiring. He is a great man.

Brother Goodman tells you on the first day how to do well in the class. Participate. Listen. And DO THE OUTLINES. Although they're time-consuming, they prepared me so much for my mission. Despite what he says, it is possible to get an A on the outlines if you do them the night before, but you'll miss out on a huge spiritual opportunity. Loved it.
Loved taking the Family and Marriage course with Brother Goodman. His lectures really helped my life and gave me a much better perspective on things.

Awesome professor! Weekly online open-book quizzes which come straight from the reading, a couple projects throughout the semester that you need to spend at least 2 hrsweek on. Midterm and final come from the weekly quizzes and class discussion so go to class. He has the students memorized and he knows if you are there or not. Lots of extra credit

This was a hard class for me, but I feel so much more prepared for my mission because of it. I felt motivated and inspired after every class, and the spirit was always so strong. There is a lot of outside and inside class preparation and work you have to do in order to pass, but it is so worth it if you want to have that extra boost before you go..

My favorite teacher. He is awesome. He really cares about all of his students-even knows every one by name on the first day of class. If you are going on a mission you definitely should take this class. There is a good amount of work, but it is not busy work, it is helpful work in preparation for your mission. Highly recommend him.

Absolutely love this class. Even though I didn't talk he still knows everyone in the class by name. Weekly quizzes and other assignments that really aren't that hard at all. A few major assignments that do take some time, but if you prayerfully do the assignments and study with intent, the class is rather nice.
Love Brother Goodman, great teacher. Truly cares about his students and his class isn't tough. He wants his students to have an A.

Great class, take notes, always show up, and read the textbook because it is the source of almost all text questions. 3 hard writing assignments but if your smart there no big deal.  Highly recommend.

Brother Goodman is the BEST religion teacher I have ever had at BYU, and I would recommend taking ANY classes you can with him! He is very spiritual and truly loves and cares for all his students. He will work with you. For mission prep you are required to do outlines which take time to do but will teach you so much and are SO helpful! Take it!

It was amazing to show up the first day with Brother Goodman already knowing your name. He provides great insight. He does have a few small papers for you to do but they are no more than a page long. Take any class from him!

Brother Goodman was an amazing professor. He genuinely cares about all his students (he learns your names before the first day) and his class was both enlightening and productive. He's a convert so he brings some interesting insights to a mission prep class, and it still applied to me even though I'm not going on a mission. Loved it!
Best teacher I have ever had. I feel extremely prepared for my mission now. I wouldn't recommend any other teacher for a mission prep class more Brother Goodman.

Professor Goodman is INCREDIBLE!!!!Not only did he bring the Spirit into class, but he helped me feel much more prepared for my mission! He has everyone make outlines (which take time)but if he can tell that you tried you will get an A. If you want an A you will definitely get one. He is extremely humble, charismatic and approachable. Great man.

LOVED THIS CLASS. Literally changed my life. Goodman is the best prof I have ever had. Whatever you do, TAKE HIM. He is AMAZING. Spirit is so strong and I learned so much. There's a bit of work but it is so rewarding. The quizzes are a breeze and the tests are taken right off of the quizzes so it's an easy A. DO IT. IT WILL CHANGE YOUR LIFE.

Bro. Goodman was super nice and made you feel very welcome to ask question and make comments before during or after class. Most of the class was powerpoints and discussion. The tests were easy. He cares more that you gain something from the class than being able to pick te right answer on the test. Overall awesome, I definitely recommend him.   =)

I would highly recommend Bro Goodman as a teacher.  He knows his stuff and helps you understand it very well.  If you do the work you will get an A, and theres not an overwhelming amount of work either.  Great class with a great teacher and I learned a ton while enjoying the course.
Dude, this guy is totally number one!

Bro. Goodman is great and teaching LDS Family and Marriage. The coure requires attendance and you have to work at it. If you work smart, do all of the assignments, and pay attention in class a good grade is not difficult to obtain.

Bro. Goodman started out the class saying he will only ever share things that he has quotes from prophets to back it up - not true. He also repeatedly told us how much his degree doesn't matter, but he seemed to bring it up a whole lot. He types out exact formats for projects like we don't know how to use Word ourselves. Very disappointed with him.

After 3 years I've never felt the need to rate any of my professors, but after having such an amazing class I thought I would. Brother Goodman is the best religion professor I've ever had! His assignments are not hard and he makes it possible to be successful! I agree, ee stretches you without stressing you out :) TAKE THIS CLASS!

Brother Goodman is an excellent teacher! He tells you exactly what you need to do to get an A, and he stretches you in his class without stressing you out. Easy A, but still a very interesting class. He's always happy, always helpful, and knows what he's talking about. Attendance is mandatory though, so make sure you show up!

Brother Goodman is an incredible guy. On the first day of the semester, he opens up all the quizzes so you can take them all at once if you want. They're easy if you do the reading. As for the outlines, they're pretty time consuming but it's definitely worth it. It's obvious that Goodman loves his students because he's so helpful. Loved him!

Mike Goodman is the best. I can't explain in words how grateful I am to him. Taking his missionary prep class was a life changing experience for me. It was hard at times (outlines took a while), but he was always helpful whenever I asked. He is the greatest teacher on campus. Take any class you possibly can from him! :)
He is the best teacher I had at BYU. He changed my life.

Class is interesting. He is very helpful and respectful. A little too much work for a religion. He gives you a review sheet for 70% of the material on test. The other 30% is class discussion(these are why I gave him a 3 on easiness and not a 5. They are very tricky, many questions seem to have 2 right answers and they come from student comments too

Loved this class! Did not want to take it at ALL when I first registered, but needed the credit.  I ended up loving it because it's not at all what I thought it would be like.  It's all about your own development and this professor does an awesome job at teaching the stuff.  Way easy & not much outside work involved
Awesome Teacher you'll love him

Best teacher I could have imagined for a missionary preparation class. Incredibly fair and loving to his students. Plus, he is a convert that went on to serve a mission AND was a mission president. His insight is perfect and class is amazing. Best class I've taken at BYU by far.

Bro. Goodman is amazing, and the best religion professor I've had at BYU. LDS Marriage and Family is an incredibly informative and great class that everyone should take! His assignments aren't difficult, and the tests come straight from his study guides. Take this class from Bro. Goodman!
This class was awesome! Brother Goodman is a great teacher. Take this class from him if you can. The coursework is not too difficult, and class was always interesting and very helpful.

(LDS Marriage and Family) He gives a ton (15-30 pages) of reading every class period. He never goes over it in class, but that is the whole exam. His exams are tricky. His classes are really informative and applicable (at least the last half of the semester). He is an overall good teacher, but not one to take lightly.

Superb Mission Prep class.  Brother Goodman is teaches well and shows a love for his students.  Helps teaching skills tremendously.  Allows students to succeed if they work hard.  Good insights on mission because he has been an investigator, missionary, and mission president.  Great teacher.  Everyone that I talk to enjoys his class

The class was very interesting. But I found Brother Goodman to be unnecessarily rude and condescending in a one on one setting. Also, he takes so many comments that you end up learning more of other peoples thoughts than actual doctrine.

Great class.  Rarely teaches his opinion even though it may seem like that.  He always has quotes from prophets and apostles to back up what he says. Only midterm and final and a few easy assignments.  I learned a lot and would definitely recommend taking it from Bro. Goodman.
well i really liked him, its very easy, just follow the study guide

I felt this class was more work than it was worth. If you want your cookie-cutter, run-of-the-mill Mormon Marriage class, this is for you. I'm more a liberal thinker myself, and walked away thinking that good ideas rather than pure doctrine had been pounded into my head.

I agree that this class felt like EFY. The reading is great but the teacher was just hard to handle. We talked most of the classes about modesty and the For Strength of Youth pamphlet and spent one day talking about raising kids. This was a Marriage and FAMILY class. And the test questions were dumb in my opinion.

GREAT teacher! Really cares about the students, and class is a lot of discussion. My husband and I took this together and we really got a lot of stuff out of it that we could use in our personal lives. This class made me think. Tests are easy if you get a bunch of people together and pool all your quiz questions and answers to make a study guide :)

I've never disliked a professor like I do him.I don't know how ANYONE could ever like him. He is probably the most arrogant and prideful man I've ever met. He loves to talk about himself and how great he is. I learned nothing except what the manual with prophetic quotes taught. Don't take from Goodman

By far the best class  I have ever taken while here at BYU! And Professor Goodman is an awesome teacher! The spirit in his class in incredible! He uses powerful and meaningful quotes in lectures, that really help you understand the concepts. Yes, there is quite a bit of reading, but the tests are exactly like the study guide. TAKE THIS CLASS!!!  :)

This has been the most amazing class I've taken at BYU. I always look forward to going to class.  There's not alot of work and the tests are easy.  You read alot from the manual, but it is so good that it's not even a burden.  He has an incredible way of making every class so worth while!!! Take this class from him!!! He's AMAZING!!!

I don't know how anyone COULD NOT love his class!!! Prof. Goodman is one of the greatest professors I've ever had, and by far the greatest religion professor I've ever had. He is kind, helpful, and has a lot of life experiences to teach from. I found him very credible and worthy to instruct. He's awesome!!!

This class was easy, but painful.  I found that the class periods were useless.  Every day felt like another day at EFY, with no new insights, and slides and slides of quotes from the manual.  The manual WAS interesting, but you don't have to take the class to read that. I took it with my fiance and we both dreaded it.  I would avoid Prof. Goodman.

Wonderful class and fantastic teacher! I had this class once a week, late in the the day for almost two hours but I loved it! Once you're in there you get hooked. He knows what he is talking about and is very knowledgeable on the doctrine. I highly recommend taking this class from him.

Brother Goodman was an amazing teacher last winter semester. He really cares about what he teaches and I wish I had paid better attention. It's still an easy class but you'll WANT to listen to what he says, especially because he is funny. I highly suggest him for LDS Marriage Prep. Good luck! (though with him you'll probably not need it)

He is a good professor, and knows his stuff when it comes to Marriage and Family, especially doctrine of the Church. He backs up most of what he teaches with quotes from General Authorities.  He is also very interesting and brings the Spirit every class.  There is some busy work, though. Overall, I would recommend him for this class.

Good teacher.  All of his tests come directly from the quizzes that you take weekly on blackboard.  The trick is to take the quizzes multiple times because there are about 20 questions that the quiz chooses from.  The assignments are straightforward and it's an interesting class.
Marriage and family prep.  I loved the class.  It was easy but you learn quite a bit.  If you are involved in the class then you will enjoy it and get an easy A.

Nice guy, but that's all. If you want to have an interesting teacher that makes this subject fun...don't pick him. Also, you do a good amount of busy work. The tests are easy, but all you do is memorize quotes. Get used to a billion quotes and his opinions if you take him.
Great classes, very well explained. Not flexible to special circumstances. Hard grader.

Whoever doesn't like Professor Goodman has some serious issues. He is one of the best professors BYU. Tests are ridiculously easy and his classes are so well grounded in doctrine I don't think he ever gave us his opinion. Ignore any negative feedback on this professor because I seriously think those students didn't attend the class or know the prof

I don't care who you are, everyone should take this class. You learn more about yourself than anything else. You find what you can be compatible with and Bro. Goodman rocks in his teaching! His class was one I looked forward to going to every time. He's just incredible and ties in singles, dating, and married to what they need to hear.

Brother Goodman is awesome. He has a strong testimony and knows his stuff. Very fun and helpful. You have to make outlines that take a lot of time and he expects detail, but its not too bad. Tests are a bit too detailed.

Awesome teacher. I took this class in preparation for my mission and I feel like I am as familiar with Preach my Gospel as I could possibly be. The only difficult part of the class is that you are required to make lesson outlines once every two weeks.
His test are so detailed in things that does not matter. He gives homework that is just waste of time,well in general the class is useless, it wont prepare you for the test.

I had brother Goodman for Mission Prep and he assigned us a lot of work that didn't seem necessary.  His tests turned out to be difficult because he asked such detailed questions.  He is a really nice guy, but I felt like he made the class harder than it needed to be.  And it is true, he did have a lot of typos.

Do everything you can to get into this class.  Prof. Goodman is incredible; on the first day of class he had everyone's names memorized.  It doesn't matter if you are married, single, dating, or engaged.  He presents tons of great quotes and novel insights.  I often left class in tears because I was so touched.  Attendance is necessary!

I had Goodman for Marriage and Family, fall semester 2007. I pretty much can't stand the guy. He honestly thinks that his opinions are doctrine and he thinks he is there to change you and your opinions. Quizzes/tests   at times contain so many typos and errors that you can't even understand what he's asking. Worst religion teacher I've had. Period.

Second half of D&C with him was fantastic. He is so knowledgeable and so upfront about what is and isn't settled for sure within the church. It's  refreshing to not have religion teachers fishing for answers just to look smart. Required 2 papers and readings but best teacher in any subject I've had so far, I love this guy!!

AMAZING! He is very personal and willing to work with you  one on one and counsel.  He is extremely knowledgeable on the subject.  The only things that take time to are the few projects, but they are well worth it.

BEST teacher at BYU. extremely effective. extremely clear/fair. Tests are very simple. Frequent quizzes (but easy), anf a few assignments (also easy). Everything is very interesting. Easy...but fun and valuable A. Every man should be like this guy! He is the best teacher/example. All will love him.

His class SO worth it. If you're married or ever want to be, take this class from him. He knows his stuff. The discussions are always good, and he's pretty funny too. You have to do more than is assigned for the projects to get a 100 on them, but the online assignments are open book and you can take them as many times as you want. Exams are easy.

Br. Goodman is worth your time if you want to have great classes every time.  If you study his study guide *well*, you'll do fine on his tests.  The requirement to read 30 min every single day and the journals help you absorb the scriptures better.  Plus, since he helped develop the next iteration of the course manual, you get more insight!
Bro. Goodman is a good teacher but has a tendancy to go on tangents.  You will learn a lot in this class and it is worht your time.  Watch out though, the tests are kind of poorly written.
One of the most uplifting classes I've taken.  however, you do have to read 30 minutes of EVERY DAY in his class.  he has you report on it twice a semester

Brother Goodman is so kind and helpful!  I learned so much about the pearl of great price.  The weekly journals are not too bad and the tests are very fair.  I would reccomend him for any religion class.
Best Pearl of Great Price Teacher...

Brother Goodman is the best religion teacher I have ever had.  He is not like the other BYU religion professors—he actually cares about you and knows what he is talking about.  He even learned my name.  You have to work hard for your grade—he is firm but fair.  I would go out of my way to take him again.

Professor Hansen himself is a nice guy and a competent philosopher. His tests on the other hand, are the worst, and the grading is very tough as well. Luckily, he curves the tests a LOT so that everyone doesn't fail them. This class would be great for someone who's really into deep philosophy. Otherwise, it may not be worth the chance of a GPA dip.

Beware of his tests, the first exam I had it curved by 40%. This class isn't easy, took it as a GE and there's probably an easier option out there. Was really insightful and answered questions to the best of his ability. Be prepared to spend lots of time outside of class studying and doing the readings.
Favorite professor I had at BYU. His lectures are fantastic. It's not an easy class, but you'll learn a ton and engage in fantastic philosophical discussions.

Unfortunately i loved this class, but it's not worth the GPA dip. exams are 80% of your grade, and there is no way to get your grade up with the insanely hard exams. There is some reading, but it is totally doable. While i loved the content in this class, and I do think he is a good professor, the absurd grading makes me say dont take this for a GE

Hansen is a really caring guy that loves philosophy. Readings for every class, short quizzes on them before the lecture of class. That's the only homework. 3 tests plus a final at the end, all worth 80% of your total grade. Come to class, take notes on lecture, and you will succeed. Tests are heavily curved to the school average.

This class was difficult, but Hansen taught in a way that made the content bearable and as easy to understand as possible. You can tell he really enjoys the subject of philosophy and he's very approachable with questions about the content he teaches. If you have to take 205, for sure take it from Hansen (also utilize the logic lab!!!).

Hansen is one of the best professors I've ever had. He's passionate about phil, entertaining, explains hard concepts really well. This actually class inspired me to get a phil minor! Only complaint is that his expectations for the essays are kind of a guessing game at first, but you catch on. I'd definitely take a class from him again!

You may be surprised by how sharp and hyperactive Prof. Hansen is, but that's why his lectures are so great. He has an incredible mind and explains things with exceptional clarity and depth, but he is a rapid, blink-and-you'll-miss-it lecturer. READ AND MAKE NOTES. If not, you'll be completely lost. There are also lots of impromptu quizzes.

He is an excellent lecturer who explains concepts clearly. Expected an easy A, but I bombed the midterms (got only 91% in both exams) ending a bad grade. However, he gives amazing lectures, so you should take his class if you don't care about your grade and really want to learn.

Hansen is one of the most intelligent people I've ever met in my life. He knows philosophy really well and can respond to most comments on the spot. Yet, he sometimes feels scatterbrained. Highly recommend if you're serious about philosophy. If you're taking him for a GE and don't care about the class, find someone else.

Hansen was engaging and his lectures were interesting. You have to read the reading several times before class to do well on the quizzes. If you are bad at writing you won't get a good grade: lots of papers. Hansen was accessible outside of class and willing to help out students. Passionate about Philosophy, each lecture was an amazing experience.

This class is a philosophy history class, so expect a lot of reading. But, compared to other philosophy classes I have taken, Hansen does a good job of condensing the reading so you just read the parts you need. He is very intelligent and good at explaining concepts in an engaging way. For sure, one of my favorite philosophy professors.

Professor Hansen is superrr good at explaining concepts in an engaging way, he just moves fast which can be hard. Your biggest help for this class with be the many TAs that can break down concepts for you. But Hansen is by far one of my favorite professors! He really knows his stuff.

Long and confusing readings. Quizzes are unfair because he expect you to memorize word for word quotes. They are pop quizzes and proctored. Some of the answer choices arent even obvious even if you read the whole thing. Criteria for exams not clear, but still harshly graded with unhelpful feedback. Not an easy A.

Lectures are disjointed, with no analysis of the (very difficult) assigned readings, and tangentially related anecdotes. Attendance would have been useless, were it not mandatory. Grading criteria was arbitrary, and Hansen made no effort to explain the difficult concepts we were studying. Nice guy, but teaching a class means actually teaching.

Dr. Hansen was a wonderful professor whose class was enjoyable, challenging, and thought-provoking. He is an excellent orator who clearly thrives on being able to engage with his students, so the virtual nature of this semester's class made it more difficult, but engaging nonetheless. He is also very caring and accessible.

Professor Hansen taught all over the place. Sometimes it was hard to grasp the concepts. The essays for his class were hit or miss on grading. The grading instructions were not very clear. That said, it is a class about intense philosophical subjects. Maybe choose another class if you want an easier GE class. It was engaging and frustrating.

Hansen is great, I learned how to write insanely well as a result of his class, but it was definitely not easy. I took him because I really loved how he spoke. I recommend recording his lectures and re-listening to them when writing essays--he is the perfect orator. (+ he is handsome) get ready for 5 1,000 word 500 word 250 word exams.

Professor Hansen is a terrific person and teacher. You can tell he truly cares about students experience and wants to help you learn. Facilitates nice philosophical discussion during class. You have to write papers for any philosophy course. One of the best professors at BYU and a nice asset to the philosophy department.

Readings are long and sometimes are difficult to understand, but he explains everything in class! Dont underestimate the papers! His grading is fair, but you really have to understand the material and take several hours to write them! He has something against LeBron James, and that literally was my only problem with him last semester lol!

He is a fun caring professor but tests were just a bunch of essays. Your grade is basically how you can write rather than what you know. Tough grader so it's very hard to get an A but fairly easy to get an A- or B.

Hansen is the most caring professor I have ever had. I had to miss class because of an illness and he kept checking in on me to make sure I was ok. He worked with me and helped get get everything done. He is very smart but open-minded. He makes you feel valued as a student and a person.

As a PhD Student, Hansen demonstrates his intelligence by explaining complicated philosophical concepts with great ease. He welcomes open class discussions and entertains the counterarguments of all students (sometimes the class gets off course).He also points out the strengths and flaws in all theories. He has an apparent wide range of knowledge.

hansen is a kind and very understanding professor. Encourages in-class discussion, never makes a student feel dumb with whatever comment they make. If you put forth effort and go to him with any questions youll get a good grade

He does NOT teach doctrine. He has his own interpretations, only focuses on Isaiah, misses the mark, complicates everything. I leave feeling more confused. Class is him lecturing on things way beyond core beliefs. The class quizzes are hard because they are based off of his intrepretations. I have not felt the spirit and do not recommend him.

Brother Harris is incredible! He is super spiritual, kind, loving (he loves everyone so genuinely and knows our names!), and knowledgeable. He teaches well and is fair with quizzes (important to be in class for these), exams, and assignments. I learned a lot, felt the Spirit, and had a great time in this class! 1000% recommend!

Brother Harris was interested in his students lives and really took the time to nurture us. He learned our names extremely quickly and graded super fast (with feedback!). I'd totally take this class again. Quizzes are a substantial part of your grade and you need to be in class to take them fyi!

Professor Harris was awesome. At times a bit corny/childish for my liking but I thought he wanted to get everyone involved and seems like he cares about students. He makes an effort to remember names. He was really nice and his messages were overall great. Sometimes the quizzes at the end of class felt overkill but otherwise it was a great class.

Professor Harris is always prepared for class and open to discussing different viewpoints. He is also very accommodating to individual circumstances but also holds a high standard for his students. I would recommend him to any other students.

Brother Harris is the best!! I learned so many new insights from the scriptures and always looked forward to his class. He genuinely cares about his students and is very quick to help. Take this class!!

I loved Bro Harris and his class! I feel so much more confident in analyzing scripture and feel that my testimony greatly increased because of his lectures and the testimony he shared. Lots of opportunity to earn extra credit and to do well. You'll learn a lot!
He is so good!!
He is very friendly. He gives interesting lectures and encourages student participation.
Greatest religion professor at BYU. Has some of the most novel takes on scriptures. Really makes you think
Brother Harris is a very kind man who creates a classroom environment that is spiritual, not stressful!

Although I'm just a sophomore, it's hard to imagine having a better REL teacher than Brother Harris in the future. He knew everyone's name by heart in the 30 something person class. He gave consistent extra credit opportunities. His class is easy if you pay attention. He tries to call on every person at least once. The class is very spiritual!
He's really funny and the work is not difficult. He has great lectures.
A fantastic professor who will make you view the scriptures differently than ever before! He cares deeply and wants you to succeed.
He is a GREAT professor! Makes your scripture study SO much deeper!!

Brother Harris is amazing!! We had to write 5 essays throughout the semester but they were really chill and fun to write. He is good at giving helpful feedback on the essays. His lectures were fun and engaging and he always made sure you were paying attention. He cares about you and how you do in his class. He just wants you to succeed!

Bro. Harris's class is super chill. You get out of it what you put into it. He helps you with the quizzes at the end of every class and is very clear with grading criteria for essays. He wants you to feel the spirit and doesn't want you to stress about your grade. No midterms just essays, quizzes and a final exam. Bro Harris is an amazing human!

For REL 250, not 275. Was a super fun and engaging professor. Participation quizzes about that days' class, and a fun essay project. Super easy class, but really amazing and educational lectures. Awesome insights and loves to get to know everyone in the class personally.

Brother Harris is by far the best religion professor that I had at BYU. His class was my last religion class and I am kinda sad that I can't take another one from him. His insight into the scriptures has strengthened my testimony and made me more excited to read the scriptures. Straightforward quizzes and the final was open note and open scripture.

THIS GUY IS AWESOME. I did not want to take a religon class and was struggling with a few perosnal things but Brother Harris turned a class that I dreaded into a class that I enjoyed going to. 100/10 would recomend that you take his class. Work load it normal and tests are easy ( if you pay attention in class) and the discussion is powerful.

Brother Harris was my favorite BYU religion professor. He teaches very simply and with brimming passion. You can tell he loves the topic and he will for sure make you love it as well! He has a very unique take on the scriptures and offers clear explanation for his stance.

Brother Harris is great! He cares about his students a lot, and he will help you out with anything. His lectures are great, and he knows how to break down complex concepts into simpler terms. Definitely take his class!

Loved his class! He dives deep into the scriptures and makes sure everyone is able to understand. He's super participation centered and checks in on everyone for thoughts on the topics. We wrote a paper every week but only one page. Also took a quiz after every class. The quizzes aren't bad if you're paying attention during class. Would take again!

MacKay is good, nice guy and he doesn't dock you points as long as you turn in HW on time. That being said this class is busy work, so if you like griding out busy work and responding to AI chat threads go for it. Also don't buy the textbook you don't really need it.
Very managable workload and great lectures. Attendance is mandatory but honestly was never a problem because they were all pretty interesting.

The online course is purely busy work. Like literally only busy work. If busy work doesn't bother you, this is the course for you. I got 100 on every assignment that I turned in. It is a LOT of busy work though- especially for a religion course. There's def other religion options that are way less work. But if busy work is your thing, go for it

The class was really easy, but I didn't get any responses from him the entire semester. He has great content and the class is set up well, but there wasn't much communication. It would be nice to have more access to external help.

I will preface this review with this: If you haven't taken an in-person class with Dr. MacKay, you should do that ASAP. He is the best religion professor in the department and he is wicked smart. This class is easy and straight forward. It is very assignment heavy but they are simple and engaging. No tests, fun, engaging and enjoyable. Mike = GOAT

I've never written a review before, but students need a warning. The workload is insane—8-9 assignments weekly at a minimum, including creating PowerPoints, recording lectures, writing essays, quizzes, and more. And that is in additino to lectures, videos, and text book readings. Take a different course if you can.

Mike is super nice, very intellectual & compassionate, especially in personal conversations. That said he is so inaccessible outside class, and this interfaith class was mostly just him and his guest talking together. Textbook readings were not helpful. But generally I became more interested in interfaith and aware of opportunities for it!

Engaging professor with a wealth of knowledge. Interesting assignments and projects, but a lot of work upfront. Definitely worth the effort - Unstuck AI really helped me stay on top of the workload. Solid A grade, would take again.

Canvas was used inefficiently, group "discussions" were a waste of time, and the material itself was great. I wish professors at BYU would all get on one page when it comes to Canvas. They each use it differently and many use it poorly.

He is the best! I took the blended World Religions course and it was a LOT of weekly assignments and work, but there were no tests or crazy projects. They were fun and engaging most of the time, and the material was very interesting and important to know.

Probably wouldn't take again. Took his survey of Christianity class. Very disorganized, didn't grade anything until the last week of the semester, and didn't respond to my emails. Needs a TA. I enjoyed the projects we did, but I got tired of hearing him label us as "mormons" and debating whether or not we're a Christian religion. Easy credit tho

I was waitlisted four separate times before I finally got into this class and it didn't take long for me to find out why! He is an amazing professor and handles these topics with such respect and love for all people. I walked away from this class with such a rich understanding of other religions and how we can work together in unity!

I actually took 393R which is an interfaith religion class. I would 100000000% recommend that class to anyone and since he's the only one who teaches it right now I would recommend Mike as well.  Is really good at helping you learn for yourself. Super disorganized and causes a lot of confusion but is the chillest when it comes to grades.

Great content, great professor, TOO MUCH BUSY-WORK. If you want to spend more time on a 2 credit class than your major and general 3 credit classes, this is the one for you. Can't complain too much about the class aside from that.

This class is straight busy work but it is super easy to get an A. The subject matter is also intriguing. I think the issue is it was a well-designed course but then I would bet the department probably stepped in and said "you know what this needs? MORE busy work." No beef with the professor, he's fantastic. Very good class. No tests.

Fantastic professor. Definitely take world religions from him. He emphasizes learning about the religion through experience and not just reading or lecture. No real exams or major grades. Just lots of small assignments each week. He is also understanding and flexible. I took the blended course and I liked it.

Favorite religion professor. Cares more about you learning to respect and love people from different religions than about memorizing everything there is to know about other religions. Very experiential learning, like one time we went outside and just did yoga for class. Do the assignments and you'll easily get an A.

Wow! The very best. Assignments on Canvas were so interesting and did not overwhelm me. But, class is what I was impressed with most. He is a really caring guy with a million interesting things to say. Don't list to the haters, they actually love him, they just don't like homework.

Great guy, bad class. He recently changed the course structure and it's awful. Most of the assignments themselves are good, but when joined with 5 or 6 others each week it becomes way too much. Lectures are mandatory but are not helpful or enjoyable at all. He shares a lot personal philosophy and tends to ramble.

No final, but he makes up for it with HOURS of assignments each week that are repetitive and sometimes busy work. I spent more time on this class than my senior major classes. Attendance is graded, but lectures are unorganized with lots of rambling. He has a great perspective, but other professors can give you that too with better class structure.

In Fall 2022, his class was so interesting. Class was about right for work load and he is so helpful. If you get behind or struggle with attendance he still helps. I focused in on the most important parts of the Restoration, but then he enabled us to explore things I've always wondered about. Game changer for me.
I have never wanted to be more engaged in world! Some work, all doable and interesting. He is always kind. Will work to help you.

On the fence? TAKE THIS CLASS. This was the best class I've ever taken at BYU (I'm a senior). Easy to get 100% on Inquisitive quizzes (it provides you with the information to get it right) and no tests! But the real reason you should take this is you will learn and grow so much.
