guys please take this class from brother skinner!! he KNOWS what he's talking about and does such a good job of explaining the concepts. i actually found i could do fine by just completing the lesson & class work, and not having to read the textbook. he is very funny and makes class very engaging. the class genuinely wasn't bad with him teaching it
Awesome professor. Great lectures and a caring teacher. Would definitely recommend.

Professor Skinner is an amazing professor who genuinely cares about the success of his students.  I have had him for half the semester so far, and he has been able to make a difficult class fun and easier to follow the material.  Phys 100 is not fun in general if you're not into science at all, but as long as you put the time in, you'll do well.

Professor Skinner is the way to go for PS100, but prepare yourself for this class. One professor writes and controls the whole course. The tests she writes are SO hard to understand. Professor Skinner tries his best to prepare you, but you have to put in work. TA labs are so busy & it's so hard to get the help you need. At least he makes class fun.

Dr Skinner makes this GE fun. He tries to be funny and keep things light which I always appreciated. This class in general sucks if you're not interested in it. Lots of exams and they are long. Don't buy the textbook or read it, trust me it's not necessary.
GEO 101 isn't worth taking if it's not from Brother Skinner. Show up to class every day and you'll get an A. Bottomless jokes and dinosaur pictures.

There were a lot of readings and a lot of homework but it very manageable. Go to the TA labs-- they are your best friend. PS 100 is just kind of a hard class itself but Professor Skinner made it so much fun. Our class even accidentally shot a hole in the wall of our classroom. I would 100% take a class from him again. Study hard!
If you take GEOL 101 for a GE take it from Skinner. He is super easy and funny with lots of extra credit opportunities!
DEFINITELY TAKE IT FROM HIM. He's hilarious and makes lectures way fun. The essays aren't hard at all, just ask your TAs what they're looking for. The tests are hard though!

Great professor and a funny guy. I took geo 111 from him. Mostly worked with the TA in labs. Labs were difficult but the lectures were engaging and fun. Pretty easy as well for most of the assignments.

Professor Skinner is a fun professor and makes learning exciting. If you fill out a detailed notesheet for the exams based off the TA review slides and understand practice test questions, you will do well and probably get an A. If you turn in assignments on time and stay on top of work, you can easily get an A. About 3 hours of homework a week.

The class overall is easy, so I do recommend taking him. However, his two TAs were not helpful at all, and one of them was rude. They rarely helped me or never replied to my emails. The professor never replies to your email either. So if you have a question, make sure to ask him right after the class.

The class overall is on the easy side. But I disliked his TA choice this semester because one was ignorant and the other was unhelpful. It's also impossible to reach out to the professor, and the TA and the professor rarely reply to your email, so I had a hard time reaching out to them.

He understands that most people are there to fulfill the general. He did a great job at making lectures entertaining. He lets you have a cheat sheet for every exam, including the final, which was a lifesaver. Exams were still sometimes tricky so make sure you can apply the content! Take PS100 from Skinner!!!

Probably the coolest proffesor I've had at BYU. For the content itself I was never a big fan of science so the some of the concpets were a bit difficult to grasp. It was overall a moderately hard course for me but make sure to utalize the TA labs. You only have to get a 90% for an A so thats nice but the exams are pretty hard at least for me.
Great professor! Learned so much about rocks and he is so nice.

Very disorganized class but an easy A. The whole class did horrible on the first midterm, but he ended up curving it and making the future tests easier. Go to whichever TA lab has the easiest grader, (Dr. Skinner will probably tell you which TA that is). If you're doing bad in the class and communicate with Dr. Skinner he'll give points back.

I was really nervous for this class, but I found it very enjoyable. With any class, you have to put in the work to get the grade you want! Bro. Skinner makes lectures very engaging which makes it easier to learn and understand the material. The assignments are the same for every class and not bad, just don't procrastinate! Read the textbook!

If anyone says anything bad about Brother Skinner, ignore it because clearly they aren't fun people at parties. If you like Science, Dad jokes, and dinosaurs, then this is your class. Seriously, take ps100 from him and you'll never regret it! He is very knowledgeable on what he teaches and is passionate about sharing what he knows!

Prof. Skinner's class was great. He preps you for the exams really well and lets you have a cheat sheet when you take them. I never read the textbook and missed class probably once a month and did fine. Definitely not a hard gen ed.

I did not like Brother Skinner's class. He's clearly passionate about the material, but his lectures were scattered, disorganized, and most information in them did not show up on exams. I wanted to like the class, but felt like I had to teach it to myself. He's funny and clearly loves what he's talking about, but it was difficult not to get lost.

This is a good GE class and I recommend! It has homework but manageable. The only downfall is the midterm & final are weighted heavily (60%) & tough. He lets you take a sheet of paper of notes & that's super helpful. He also has a textbook for the class (it's like $90) I (and others) didn't get it and we were perfectly fine. He is a nice professor!

Brother Skinner - Master Skinner I should say - is ...wow. Yeah he's a lot--I love it! He makes this GE WORTH taking. He is so passionate about Geology, but doesn't expect us to be. Yet, because of his passion, I have also come to be so excited when I see rocks and fossils! Definitely a manageable amount of homework, but there's still homework.

Professor Skinner makes this physics class engaging and manageable. While there's a lot of work, the TA lectures and unstuckstudy AI are super helpful for studying and acing the exams. Take this class if you can - it's challenging but worth it.

He's a great teacher, I wouldn't want to take this class from anybody else. He has a sence of humor and lays things out how they are so nothing is a surprise in tests or quizes. Homework isn't easy but it's rare and interesting. I had no interest in geology before this term and now I have a hard time not identifying rocks as I walk around.

Wow. Every single class was fascinating. It is one of those courses where even though it is difficult to memorize information, I felt like I still enjoyed learning the material. He treats every class like an important production and makes it very interesting. One of my most engaging professors, you definitely won't ever be bored in class.

Hilarious teacher. Understands this is a GE class but lectures were typically boring. About 60% of your grade is exams and the other 40% are easy assignments. You do get a sheet of notes front and back for the test which saved my life. You don't need the textbook. The only reason I got an A- is because of the curve on the midterm.

Sometimes professor Skinner is a little much and I didn't find him super funny. I didn't find the lectures interesting and the homework and slides were all at least 10 years old. It doesn't seem like the course has been too cared for in a while.

I am NOT a science person but Brother Skinner made it actually enjoyable for me! He knows that it's a GE, so not everyone will like the subject. He is hilarious & knows his stuff! There is a LOT of reading, but he brings it to life in the lectures! Take good notes and study them. He also does amazing exam reviews since there's a lot of info!
Only take this class from Bro. Skinner. Trust me he is worth it.

Professor Skinner is the best professor I've ever had. He genuinely cares about his students and their success. If you have to take physics at BYU, take it with Skinner and you'll be fine, even if physics is tough for you.

Brother Skinner is the best teacher at BYU, he makes a boring class interesting and makes class time worthwhile. He wants you to get a good grade and is very entertaining. If you take Physical Science please take it from him.

He is pretty funny and can explain complicated terms in simple words. He did take forever to get back to us on grades, specifically the midterm and midterm corrections. I took the class in SLC which was not as hard as the one in Provo (so I have heard).
He is a beast of a teacher and I loved him. He made the class good. The hardest part was that the tests accounted for a lot of the grade.

This Professor made learning fun and easy! The class is set up to help you succeed with TAs, labs, and reviews in class and outside of class. It does have a chapter of reading and associated quizzes due before every class, but I got by with just skimming the material. I LOVED Brother Skinner and would highly recommend taking his class
Take from Randy. I am fr.

Go to class, do the lessons, attend lab and you'll do great! I'm not really a science person but got an A through. I didn't read from the textbook a ton, but paying attenting and participating with help! Highly reccomend Professor Skinner!

The class is HARD unless physics and chemistry are your thing but Skinner is great. There's a chapter of textbook reading 3x a week plus 9 short essays. TA lecture slides are very helpful, and he goes through the test and tells you what topic you need to know for every single question before you take it. Funniest guy, please take him for PS100!
Seriously the funniest dude I have ever met. Lectures are pretty important but not mandatory. There is a LOT you are graded on but they adjust the scale so it all works out. Great dude, great class.
Brother Skinner might just be the funniest person at BYU. He is incredibly engaging and an excellent teacher. He really knows his stuff. If you're taking PS100, TAKE IT FROM HIM YOU WONT REGRET IT!

Professor Skinner is very funny but what I appreciated most was his awareness that it was a GE. He shared his passion for his work but was fair with the amount and detail of the homework. I never used the textbook but got by just fine. Studying before his tests is a must. Take good notes and don't skip class!

Loved him but hated his class. He makes really funny/edgy jokes but geol103 still sucks. He is extremely unorganized, and tests are super difficult, the class average on the exam was 67, hw was difficult because its way more complex than what was covered in class and I ended up teaching myself the material. Field trips are extremly inconvenient too

Professor Skinner is the best teacher I've had at BYU. And I hate science! The info is hard but he does everything he can to make you succeed! I've never understood science better than I have in his class. He is funny and makes lectures fun but still productive! Slides are well organized and everything is easy to follow along.

Professor Skinner is hilarious! I can't say enough about him. My class was lame and never laughed at his jokes but I was laughing all the time. He is super knowledgeable and somehow includes dinosaurs in every single lecture, which is hilarious. He is super caring and gives PLENTY of extra credit. Easy A, especially if you gift him a rock

Professor Skinner made one of the toughest subjects one of my most fun classes in all of college. His humor and knowledge combine to make some of the most entertaining but educational lectures you'll have. His tests are very conceptual, so study and understand the material to do well. Even crammed into a term he made the workload very manageable.

I was super nervous to take Physical Science but Professor Skinner helped me through the whole thing. I stayed after class every day to clarify what was being taught. He is very accommodating and willing to help in any way. It is best to read the chapter before you go to class so you can ask the necessary questions.

Brother Skinner is hilarious. If you are a science major like me, this class will be a breeze. If you aren't, it might be less intuitive but he explains things really well so you're in good hands. The structure of the class was chef's kiss. Weekly quizzes were online and multiple attempts. The textbook was helpful too. Take it from Skinner.

THE ASSIGNMENTS ARE ALL 100% if you do them!!! They feel hard but just guess and you'll still get 100%. He never told us that hahaha. Also I would pull up the study guide and fill it in during class because he talks about a lot that's not on the test. He is super funny and a great teacher that is very experienced

Skinner's lectures are the best. I attended all three Fall 2022 professors throughout the semester (Skinner, Ireland, Ware), and Skinner's were my favorite. Ireland was also fantastic; both were far better than Ware. Skinner never had boring lectures, and he made things very easy to understand. You can't help but love Skinner!!

Professor Skinner was the best! I took Life of the Past and enjoyed it so much. Each test we were allowed one page of notes front and back which helped a ton. He teaches it so well and you can tell he knows so much and enjoys teaching it. I took it as half of my physical science credit, I highly recommend!

he is more of a comedian than a teacher. never really learned much from him,I taught myself physical science through the BYU PS website and the textbook. TA reviews aren't much helpful especially the final review (just the same exact review slides from previous units combined. dumb. hated every second of this class especially the classwork and labs

Professor Skinner was hilarious! He allowed a full page of notes on exams, so they weren't too bad. The test reviews were super helpful for preparation. My only complaint is that I sometimes felt like the lectures were a little disorganized/way more material than we actually needed, but the test reviews were helpful in sorting the info we needed.

Easy class with at times entertaining lectures that often ended a few minutes early. My only complaint is that he often shut down questions if they weren't necessary to pass the class, so for anyone actually interested in the material and not just trying to survive a general, that could be frustrating.

Lectures don't feel too long because he's a nice guy and makes a lot of jokes to help the time pass. Explains things well and helps students succeed. Skinner does a great job preparing students for the exams. Before each exam, he'll look over a paper copy and tell the class the things they need to know. Take PS100 through Skinner.

So entertaining, shares fascinating stories during lectures and is really engaging to learn from. Not many assignments, allowed us to use notes on the midterm and final. Even recorded all classes on zoom so that you didn't have to come to class.

Skinner is amazing. He is funny, has good lectures, and really cares about his students. The midterm and final. were both weighted very heavily. He had mercy on me and rounded my grade which was super clutch. Not a super hard class, just wasn't prepared for the final. Would take Skinner again.

Brother Skinner is the best teacher that I've had at BYU (I'm a senior), and I love his sense of humor. Very accommodating teacher, who makes a hard class (in theory) easy, with the many aids that he has for his students. If it wasn't for Brother Skinner, I may have got a C if I was lucky, but I ended up with a very generous A-.  God bless Skinner!

Definitely the easiest GE I've taken at BYU; you're allowed a full page of notes on the midterm and final, and usually you can find the answers to the quizzes in the slides. His humor definitely isn't for everyone and, in my opinion, sometimes it crosses the line. You can definitely succeed without buying the textbook.

SO FUNNY! I don't like science but he made the class enjoyable. I sat in the front which was fun, especially during experiments. If you do all the work, you'll get an A. The TA's were awesome as well. Take this class from him!

Literally the easiest class I have ever taken in my life. Professor Skinner will literally not allow you to fail the class due to how easy he makes everything. He did a Midterm and Final review where he went over every single question and what you needed to know AND we got to bring in a full page cheat-sheet to the tests. Take this class!!!

Skinner is one of my favorite professors I've had. He is so funny, kind, and caring. His lectures are engaging and he covers everything you need to know for the tests. If you do the reading and listen to the lectures you'll pass. Reviews for the exams are super helpful, and he is super willing to work with you if you have extenuating circumstances.

Funniest guy. Explains things very well and is more than happy to answer your questions. TA's definitely help[ed, but he made sure we were aware what was going to be asked of us on each exam so we were prepared

Professor Skinner has been my favorite professor that I've had so far. He makes class enjoyable and is very personable. He makes things very engaging and interesting and has a great sense of humor. Tests are difficult so I wouldn't recommend slacking off or not taking the class seriously, but I would definitely recommend Professor Skinner.

He's a super engaging guy with entertaining lectures. My TA was so amazing though that I attended hardly any lectures and as long as I went to her review and studied, I got at least a B+ on exams.  Take this class, ESPECIALLY over other Geology courses, GEOL103 is a lot more well-rounded as opposed to just studying rocks.

Literally THE BEST PHYS100 professor at BYU. Physical science is the WORST GE class at BYU. Luckily Prof. Skinner makes it interesting and really easy to understand. This is the first time I ever really felt I understood physical science well. He also loves experiments and blowing things up. 10/10 would recommend.
Professor Skinner is caring and funny. His lectures were fun to attend and he made the content accessible. I would not take PS 100 with someone else.

Professor Skinner is the only reason I got an A in that class. Without his mercy and understanding and kindness, I would have done poorly. There was designated "joke time" each class. It was awesome! He offers some extra credit sometimes and if you talk to him about your grade, he will do his sincere best to help you. Take Professor Skinner!

I absolutely loved PHYS 100 from Skinner. I was actually going to drop his class before the first day due to too many credits, but decided to show up the first day just in case... ended up LOVING it and dropping a different class. Learned a lot. Tells you everything on the test, just take good notes on review day. Lectures are incredibly funny.

This is my favorite class I've taken at BYU. Professor Skinner is amazing, funny, and was great at keeping the class engaged. We had joke time every class at half the hour which was such a smart way to take a break from the lecture and refocus our minds. There were 4 midterms and a final, and a pre-lecture sort of thing was due before every class.

Amazing Professor, just teaches really hard material. The tests are pretty tough but he does a lot of reviews to help. There are a lot of assignments but it is structured very clearly and the assignments give you 5 chances on each mult. choice question. If you need the PS credit I'd take Geo100 w Skinner or study the quizlet and test out of PS100.

Skinner is the man. I hate science but he made it pretty interesting and is absolutely hilarious. Just do the readings and you'll be fine. He also lets you bring in a page of notes into the testing center so that was awesome. Take this class from him!

I am not a science person, I actually hate science and was dreading this class. Professor Skinner made it fun! I'll be honest, I didn't do much of the  reading, and I procrastinated every assignment. Luckily, the tests were open note and internet. He also went through all of the questions on the test the week before. Funny guy, definitely recommend

This man is an absolute legend. Took the class at the Salt Lake Center once a week. 1 homework assignment each week with like 2 questions and an open note quiz with 5 multiple choice questions (you get like 3 tries on each quiz). Tests are open note and online. Before each test he tells you exactly what to study. I hate science but this was lit.

If you go to BYU and are wanting to get your Physical Science credit done in an easy way then take it from Skinner. He is the coolest teacher I have had this semester and you can tell he really cares about his students.

Professor Skinner was hilarious and such a good teacher. I went to the first lecture prepared to drop the class (too many credits) and I enjoyed his class SO much that I dropped a different class instead. You learn a lot of material, but Prof Skinner makes it manageable and fun. Easy class, but worthwhile and will keep a smile on your face!

He's super funny, and does a lot of experiments to try to keep the class involved. He really cares about the topic, and knows a lot. Take this class from him! Tests are straightforward, and he allows a page of notes for them. There's reading to be done before each class, along with a brief pre-test, but it gives multiple tries so it's easy.

Professor Skinner is the best. He is hilarious, engaging, and makes you love physical science. He is not only willing to help his students, but wants them to succeed. I would take this class again in a heartbeat. Definitely take physical science from him!

Prof. Skinner is the funniest teacher I've ever had. He's passionate about the material, but also makes it entertaining. We read a chapter of the textbook and answer questions about it every other day for homework. There's four midterms and one final, but you get to use an 8.5x11 sheet on notes on all of them.

For PS1000, all Profs. follow the same material, same tests, and TA's grade. TAKE PROF. SKINNER! He makes the class so entertaining! He teaches you only the bare minimum and doesn't answer complicated questions, so you'll never be confused about what's on the test. He reads test questions aloud before the exam and answers classwork questions.

Bro. Skinner is the best teacher for this class. He is so entertaining which makes the lectures worth it. For the class itself, there is a chapter and classwork due per class which usually took an hour or two, but you get used to it as the semester moves along so it wasn't bad. The tests were quite difficult but Brother Skinner prepares you well.

Skinner is great and his lectures are super entertaining! Take this class rom skinner!! The tests are fairly difficult but they are the same no matter who you take it from, so enjoy class time and take it with skinner!!
This guy is funny. His specialty is geology, but he knows the content he covers. I would definitely take another course from him if it is possible.

Science is definitely my least favorite subject, however, I was always excited to attend this class because Professor Skinner is hilarious. He makes the subject so fun, but he also teaches everything very clearly. He teaches so that even people who don't understand science can understand his class. Definitely take this class from Professor Skinner.

Brother Skinner was a ton of fun. His class isn't too hard and he made lectures very entertaining. It was exactly what I hoped for from a GE- interesting but not too much work.

Ok Professor Skinner is the absolute bomb. His lectures are interesting and clear, he provides so much test prep, and he is so understanding. I took his class during a really hard time mentally and he was so open to work with me to get my grade up. Take his class. Take his class. Take his class.

Professor Skinner loves his students. Period. He always has a joke and a smile on his face. He's willing to answer any questions and simplify the material to a level of understanding. Professor Skinner is hilarious. He makes every lecture entertaining by cracking jokes the entire time. He really tries to make sure that his students are prepared for each test. The tests are hard!!! If you go to the TA review sessions you should do fine on them.

Professor Skinner every positive trait I look for in a teacher, you are well prepared for tests, the classwork and textbook readings are very manageable. He is entertaining in class and very caring and honest with students. Best teacher I have had yet :)

He wants his students to do well in his class. He is not sneaky and if he feels that the practice tests don't reflect the actually test he will upload additional reviews to better prepare his students. Super funny and has lots of energy. I wish he taught all my classes

TAKE PHYSICAL SCIENCE FROM HIM! He explains everything you need to know--never more and never less. He gives you an extremely clear review of what will be on the tests. All of the tests were open note and open book. He's a funny guy and super understanding. Definitely recommend taking him!

I REALLY do not like science, but I can't say enough good things about this class. Brother Skinner went in depth to answer questions that I had, and gave access to all of the power points. The homework isn't hard and he helps you as much as he can without actually doing your tests and homework for you. He's a real bro and one of the best profs at BYU. Take him and you'll be glad you did.

Brother Skinner is so funny and keeps things interesting. All the professors for this class have the same tests, so lectures are the main difference. Professor Skinner makes the class seem really intimidating on the first day, but it's totally doable! There are weekly quizzes on the reading but you have unlimited attempts. Skinner is the best! I visited other prof lectures and his was def my fav. SO funny. Class was hard at first but once I figured out how to study it was manageable. Just listen to what the others have written here: take Skinner for Physical Science 100. I was always laughing and made this class somewhat enjoyable. You'll be happy you took this GE from him.

I loved Professor Skinner, I am so glad I had him as my choice for a Physical Science teacher. Pretty interesting lectures. Brother Skinner is hilarious and I loved going to lectures (you get points for going to class). He was clear and very helpful, really prepared you for tests. Skinner was an amazing Professor! I really struggled with science in High-School, but things made a lot more sense in his class and he made you get excited about it! Randy Skinner is an excellent teacher. Each of his lectures are very informative, engaging, and hilarious. It was clear throughout the semester that Mr. Skinner cares for his students in the way he helps each one of us understand the course material.

BROTHER SKINNER IS AMAZING! The funniest, best professor I have ever had. He explains things so well, it's still a difficult subject, but he makes it a lot easier! He's a great guy, has straightforward tests and helpful homework. TAKE HIS CLASS YOU WON'T REGRET IT! Seriously the best class!

Cant imagine taking PS100 from anyone else. He knows PS100 sucks and tells you that from day one, but he makes it the best experience possible. Gives you a LOT of tips for the tests. I dont think other professors help you out like he does. And super funny  Ive laughed out loud every class.

Randy Skinner is the BEESSTT! I am not good at science and finally enjoyed the material and started to understand it. He does not make his class too hard and does all he can to get you extra help with test correction and being a very kind grader. Take this class from Skinner!!

Brother Skinner has a gift for being entertaining. He made GEOL 101 seem like the most exciting thing. He shares many stories and also "joke time". Professor Skinner is awesome. Super easy going professor who really knows his stuff and is passionate about what he teaches. Professor Skinner is the best choice for this class. There is work, but it is not difficult. He is funny and tries to make class entertaining. He's seriously the best professor. He's hilarious and makes lecture super entertaining. Seriously my favorite professor at BYU so far! He makes class interesting and prepares us for the tests. No surprises! 10/10 would recommend.

Brother Skinner is definitely the best teacher to take Physical Science from. He is super funny and will help you out throughout the way. Would definitely take this class again by him. He does points back for every test and his final is literally the study guide with just a couple more question.

Dr. Skinner, you are a nutter. No one else on planet Earth could love this planet as much as you do. That being said, TAKE THIS CLASS. He makes groundwater and rock names memorable. Bro. Skinner is a riot. The class period is fun and very interesting considering that you are studying rocks. This man gave me a love for geology. It's a little work but an A is very doable. TA review sessions were awesome.

He is SO funny! Half way through the class you have joke time - good thing to look forward to. PS100 is a miserable class if you dont read the book. Pro. Skinner really cares about his students. If you are not a good test taker, then you will struggle in this class. If you are, then this class with be a breeze. Skinner makes it fun.

His lectures made you excited to come to class because they were funny and really helped understand the textbook.  I would definitely consider taking other classes even though I'm not very interested in the subjects he teaches just so I could have him again.
Great teacher! Very funny!!

Bro Skinner without a doubt has to be among my favorite professors at BYU, 103 is a must-take (also a GE phys science).  3 reasons to take this class: 1. Joke Time every day.  2. Incredible knowledge about the subject, but he explains it in a way anyone can understand 3. Tests are easy to prepare for; reviews helpful.  Fossils, Field Trips, Love it

Dr. Skinner is great! His lectures are in depth and interesting. Skinner also includes pictures of dinosaurs and has joke time in every lecture. Class also sometimes lets out early on Fridays. My TA is Dylan and she is awesome as well! She really knows what she's doing and breaks it down so it's simple to understand. HIGHLY RECOMMEND BOTH!

I'm not a geology or even a science major, but I had this guy for physical science and loved him. He is hilarious and his lectures were always really interesting. I almost took a random archaeology class from him last semester just because I liked his class so much.

Very organized, enthusiastic and funny. I'm not interested in geology, but Prof. Skinner made it easy to understand. The tests are straightforward and if you read the material it's easy to keep up with. He's a very good professor, I'd recommend him.

Dr. Skinner is so funny. I am not a science person, and even though this class was harder for me, he ried to make the class as fun as possible. He does not make the test, however, the head for the course does, so the tests are sometimes hard because they are different than the class content. But other than that, great teacher!

Dr Skinner's intro to Geology class is great. It's a great way to fulfill part of the physical science GE credit. It's easy, entertaining, and interesting. I felt like I learned some important things during the semester, while at the same time not being required to spend a large amount of time I didn't have on the class. Highly recommended.
He is hilarious! He explains things well and keeps the class entertained at the same time. Take from him!

He will be your favorite teacher at BYU no question.  Funniest teacher on campus, and makes everything easy to understand.  Show up to class, and you can get an A.  If you took any science classes in high school, this will be a cake walk.
AMAZING TEACHER! The best teacher for ps 100 hands down. Way funny and kept my attention along with helping me learn the material. I just dont like science that much.

Skinner was such a great teacher, he makes so many jokes and actually helps you understand the material. You take easy quizzes in class for attendance points. The tests were really hard for me, I'm not a science person. The course is hard, teacher was great.
AWESOME AWESOME AWESOME! Best teacher at BYU HANDS DOWN. Made the study of rocks interesting! You do have to read the textbook a lot though...
SO FUNNYY!!! Pictures of dinosaurs all the time, and all the quizes are open book. Made me pay attention in geology, which I never liked.

Such a funny guy! Dinosaurs are mentioned ever lecture, and he is entertaining enough to keep you awake. If you have to take Physical Science, take it from him, but be sure to study hard and pay attention.

Professor Skinner is hands down the best teacher I have ever had. He keeps you entertained at all times and never fails to present a great lesson. I highly recommend this class to anyone, even if Science is not a priority

Bro. Skinner is the king. He's awesome and cracks me up like crazy. Joke time every class half way through! I hate powerpoints, but he makes his fun! The class is a dept. class, so tests are ridiculously hard, I mean ridiculous. But he's the best professor to take it from! Funniest guy ever!

Master Skinner is great.  Tons of fun.  He is a very generous teacher.  The class itself is hard no matter where you go since all PS 100 teachers have to use the same tests and homework assignments, but it is also do able.  Just study hard, and then take what you don't understand to the TA lab.  The lab rules!
Great Professor! Made the material very interesting. He's down to earth and so hilarious. Made class super fun!I recommend him to everyone!

Brother Skinner is the best professor I have ever had at BYU. IF YOU'RE TAKING PHYSICAL SCIENCE, TAKE IT FROM HIM! You'll be glad you did. He is way funny, makes lectures fun and interesting, and tries to make principles as clear as they possibly can be. I would very highly recommend him. Oh, and we had joke time everyday in class! So awesome!

He is awesomely rad and very funny. He really kept my attention all through the lectures and tries hard to make difficult concepts easy to understand. I am a good student (A student) and I did very poorly in this class, but it's a required class and a department class so you HAVE to take it. So take it from SKINNER!

I LOVE Brother Skinner. If you read the textbook and go to class, you will do well. He makes geology interesting and understands that people taking that class aren't geology majors, so he tries to make it entertaining. Quiz for every chapter, a few out of class labs, and three exams. Bring him dinosaur cookies and he'll love you. Take his class!!
Amazing teacher who realizes that everyone just wants a professor who is a real guy. Really funny dude. Bring jokes for joke time. Power points are fun. Made class interesting

JOKE TIME! Possibly the most boring text I've ever read, but the professor is hilarious. In what class will you get "Far Side" comics in the middle of the exams or random dinosaur slides on EVERY powerpoint.

Best professor on campus hands down.  I took his class 3 years ago and wish I could take it again!  Such a fun guy, and makes the class so interesting.  Not hard at all...come on people, we're in college.  Do the reading, go to class and I don't know how you couldn't get an A.  Can't recommend him highly enough.

Professor Skinner is so funny! He understands that not everyone in PS100 loves (or even likes) science, and makes it as easy as possible for us non-science lovers. There is joke time and a dinosaur in every lecture. If you have to take PS100, take Skinner.
He makes class fun and interesting.  He has alot of energy and helps me concentrate by being so intertaining while at the same time teaching.
Professor Skinner is extremely entertaining and keeps the class fun and informative.

This guy is hilarious...bottom line. I took him during the summer and it was great! Online quizzes, two midterms, four labs, I think three homework assignments, and the final of course, which was comprehensive but easy because he used alot of questions from quizzes or earlier exams. As long as you keep up on everything, it is a pretty easy class!
this guy is the bomb! no question about it..

WONDERFUL!! Great lectures, fun demonstrations, even a hillarious evil laugh. The tests are do-able if you attend the lectures. Attendance is taken by iclickers and daily quizzes. Do the reading and the labs, and you should do fine.

Entertaining. 2 midterms (150 points each), final (300 points), 14 online quizzes (15 points each), 4 labs (15 points each), 3 homeworks (15 points each). Curves tests to highest score (if the highest score is a 98%, everyone's score will be raised by 2%). Told us on the last day that our lower midterm score would be replaced by our higher score.

He is great! I took his class as a block class- two hours three times a week adn I loved it. I looked forward to his class everyday because he was so funny! He makes identifying rocks interesting. He is a teacher that knows how to teach and still makes class fun. Take his class, you will love it!

I am a senior and Randy Skinner is the best Professor I have had at BYU. His class is extremely informative, engaging, and fun. I tried this class out from other professors and I emphatically state that Professor Skinner is the best.

This is the best teacher for PS 100.  I had him in the summer, and I had such a wonderful experience that I became a TA for the course...just so I could try to bring fun and joy to teaching science.  If you can, TAKE THIS COURSE FROM HIM!!! You will never want to miss class because he may blow something up! ;)

DR. SKINNER IS THE MAN!!! his class is awesome! It's super easy and lectures are more like stand up comedy hour than anything.  There is joke time every day that usually lasts 5-10 minutes.  His tests are pretty easy and he prepares you very well with good review sheets.  Fun class, and an A is definitely achieveable

Professor Skinner is Awesome! he keeps you awake if you have a morning class. His personality is hilarious, he teaches and entertains at the same time.  He even has a 5 min. "joke time" to liven things up.  Great teacher. Easy class, hard tests! Study!

This class was amazingly fun.  I would definitely recommend taking the fieldtrip class (102) over the regular class because the fieldtrips were awesome.  I didn't know anything about geology before and I found I really enjoyed it.  Brother Skinner is very enthusiastic and was always really fair and willing to help.

Brother Skinner is an amazing teacher.  He always kept me laughing and interested.  I love science because of him.  Being a music major, I wasn't very excited about this class, but now I really love it thanks to him.  Any class that he teaches, I highly reccommend it!
nice gneiss!

The best dang teacher in the world!!! He stopped the lecture half way to have "joke time". Fun lectures and his comments were just hilarious. I always got a really good laught in class. I wish I could take all of my classes with Bro. Skinner. A lot of reading and some serious studying for the midterm and the final.

Bro Skinner Rocks!!! (No pun intended). His lectures keep up to speed so it isn't draining. There are 14 online quizzes that are timed (20 min). Kind of hard if you don't do the reading before. You go on a fieldtrip, kind of fun. 4 Lab assignments and 3 homework assignments. I turned some of mine in late and was barely docked points. I Reccomend!
Take this class over spring or summer! It is way more interesting and fun! Open book tests and papers during the semester take away stress, but the final is closed book. Still worth it.

I LOVE SKINNER! He is seriously the most hilarious teacher ever!  I hate science but I always looked forward to Skinner's class.  Quizes are open note/book and lectures are very easy to follow.  This class is so fun!!! I wish I could take it again.  I would suggest taking this class fall semester so you can see what he dresses up as for Halloween!

Best teacher by far!!!  I mean, what other teacher stops class half way through for joke time?!?! Class is fun and he always keeps you awake.  this class is very easy.  for example one quiz the answers were in caps lock.  Highly recomend this class for fun and count for 2 easy GE's.
Took field trip class, fun class, unique way to learn concepts. He is a very fun teacher. Clear and understands students' life well. Highly recommend him for those taking 101.

awesome teacher. he made class so much fun. i looked forward to it every week. the field trips were sweet. open book tests, only problem is that the final was closed book, so you had to prepare accordingly. geology 101 rocks! no pun intended.

The field trip was quite funny, he tried to say anything interestingly and with different impossible funny stories.  Most of the questions in the final are based upon how much you pay attention, only few questions are really found on the book. Anyway, he's a great teacher, and you will have no boring and day-dreaming moment in his class.

Amazingly hilarious teacher.  He's a mix between Jack Black and Chris Farley.  The nicest professor I've dealt with and understands the roles of teacher/student/GE very well.  In other words, he knows you're probably not taking the class to be a geologist, so he makes the content fun, understandable, and on our level.
great professor. super funny. takes a boring subject and makes it way fun to learn about. if you attend every lecture and do your reading you can get an easy A. recommended for geology.

Bro. Skinner is by far the funniest professor I have ever had.  He makes a boring subject interesting.  There is joke time every class period.  Very helpful and fun.  Best way to go for a GE science credit.

Brother Skinner is a wonderful teacher.  He is fun and understands that it is good some days to get out of class early.  We had a break half way through class for joke time.  I wish my class was still going, he was so fun and he is fair in his grading.  If you don't like geology, take this class!  You will like it by the time the class is over.

Brother Skinner's class has to be my 3rd favorite class I've ever had at BYU. He is so funny and really cares about his students. He is the first teacher outside of a religion class that I felt used the gospel in the classroom as well as he did according to the subject matter. I loved going to class! Take Geo from Skinner!

Great guy, but his lectures never helped with the tests.  The rest of the class figured that out too because attendance went down probably 40% during the semester (but this is a GE, so that could be it too).  Funny guy, easy to pay attention to, but you can get a B without ever studying or going to class. The papers & quizzes help.

Brother Skinner is the best teacher ever.  He is hilarious!!  He makes the class easy, though you still learns a lot.  I looked forward to going to his class.  He is an awesome guy.  I highly recommend this class, especially in place of the physical science.

Brother Skinner is by far the funniest professor at BYU.  I HATE science with a passion, yet I looked forward to going to his class each day.  He is a great teacher, really clear, not difficult in any way.  If you have to fill a GE science take GEO 101 from Skinner!

Bro Skinner is the best teacher ever!  He is super funny and you will learn a lot!  He is very clear and the class is not hard.  I don't even like science, but I would recomend this class to anyone!!!  We had joke time every day at 11:30.
THE BEST TEACHER EVER!! I would definitely take his class again. It was a stress releiver for the rest of the week. I recomend him to anybody that asks. Take the feild trip section. It's great.
I can honestly say, best teacher yet at BYU

I took the block class which is 6 hours each time, but the class goes on field trips and it is an absolute blast! I highly recommend taking the block class and Brother Skinner is GREAT!! Don't slack on the papers, that is the only reason I got an A-.

WOW!  What a great teacher.  Comming to his class was so much fun (even though the material could the soooo boring).  I've recommended this guy to so many of my friends.  He is one of the best teachers I've ever had.  Make sure to ask him about "joke time."

Dude, this is the awesomest guy EVER! Class is ALWAYS entertaining, and even the tests were pretty funny. Interrupts class every day so we can have "joke time" and has never given a lecture without mentioning and showing pictures of dinosaurs. Dude, this guy's the best teacher ever!

Prof Skinner is a blast. Daily joke time and dinosaurs... ahhh, I never got tired of it. The class was what a good GE class should be: not too intense but gives you a good, broad background of a science. I really enjoyed it. I'm only mad that I didn't take the Summer term Geol 101 (which is strictly field trip based). HIGHLY recommend.

Skinner is the man!  I usually ditch the majority of my classes but this guy makes you want to be there.  He can make the most boring topics incredibly interesting.  Plus, he's a complete riot.  You have to work to do well, but by no means is it a hard class.  I'm now actually interested in Geology.  Coolest teacher at BYU!

Bro Skinner is seriously one of the coolest teachers I have ever had at BYU.He is so funny.I didn't really have an interest in geology but he subbed my Phys Sci class one day I decided I wanted to take his class to fill one of my general electives.He even made the topic interesting. Highly recommend

Great teacher! He makes class enjoyable to come to. You will do well as long as you read and attend lecture. The tests are comparable to the weekly quizes in difficulty. The labs aren't bad either. Joke time is great, he doesn't take himself too seriously, and the dinosaurs each lecture are funny.
This guy is a stud! Awesome class hilarious, and gives you a little bit of eye candy to enjoy during the lessons. Mmmmmm

By far the very BEST course and teacher at BYU!  He made an extremely dull subject very interesting!  Bro. Skinner is also one of the FUNNIEST people I've ever met!  Take the class where you go on field trips and I PROMISE it will be one of the best experiences you'll ever have at BYU!!!

LOVED THIS COURSE!!!  Prof Skinner is amazing, witty, and he knows his stuff.  He knows it's a boring course for most people so he makes it fun to go to.  Also, quizzes and tests are easy - handles it how a GE course should be handled. Learned a lot!
Randy is hilarious and he makes boring Geology exciting.  Super easy class; you just have to take online quizes about every week. (The tests aren't too bad either.) You have to get this professor!

Makes a boring subject extremely interesting.  Had all the notes online, even though you wouldn't want to miss a class because he is so hilarious.  He has joke time every day and I swear he gives out more extra credit than any other teacher.  Easy A.
The material in this class is boring, but the professor is not.  He really tries to make his lectures interesting and he succeeds!  It's an easy class, but I still learned a lot.

Skinner is, in fact, the bomb diggity. I never read the book more than three or four times and have an A. It's a 101 level GE course, and he knows it. Use the book's website to study for quizzes and tests. He's the man.

So you'd think Geology 101 would be boring, right?  Wrong!  This is the most entertaining class I've ever had.  Skinner is awesome--he explains well, tests fairly, and keeps everyone rolling in the aisles!
Great teacher.  He knows this is a GE and treats it as such.  So it's an interesting easy class.  Only down side is he says "acrost" instead of across.  Shows the Idaho in him.
THIS GUY IS AWESOME!  VERY VERY FUNNY!
Very funny.  You never have a class that you don't laugh in.  Watch for all the ways he'll sneak dinosaurs into the lessons.  Pretty dang good teacher.
he is an excellent teacher and it totally funny. Everyday we laugh in his class.
Brother Skinner is probably the coolest professor I have ever had! He is a great teacher and is very engaging and interesting. Plus, he talks about dinosaurs a lot!
Dr. Lewis is a very effective teacher. The course was very logical and insightful as presented.

Dr. Lewis is a great teacher. He cares about his students and makes that very clear. The course is perfectly outlined, it follows the same pattern all semester and there are no surprises (other than occasional in-class quizzes). Usually 2-3 hours per homework assignment and the homework is harder than the tests. One of my favorite teachers!

I liked Lewis a lot. Class during lecture seems super easy but he writes a difficult exam. Go to test reviews (sometimes the exam is like it and sometimes not). He lets you take in written notes, Id write equations and examples of the more obscure concepts on there. Book isnt very helpful.

Really solid instructor as he is very clear in his lectures. His exam reviews are a must! You will not do well if you don't attend them. Willing to explain concepts whenever available too. Very understanding too!

Favorite of the Big 3. Dr. Lewis is excellent. Lectures were very clear with helpful examples. Tests were very fair and exam reviews were extremely good. This is how every engineering class should be modeled. I  so highly recommend Dr. Lewis.

Dr. Lewis is an inspirational man who is interested in the success of his students, but he also wants to squeeze his students and make things difficult for them. Class is three times a week, and each night you have homework,  and many times that homework takes 5+ hours. His class was much harder than Dr. Hecker's.

Dr. Lewis and Sister Stewart were great. They always wanted to help and genuinely cared about the success of the students. The class was very well organized. Tests were timed which was a bit inconvenient for me but they were open book which made them very doable. Looking over the book example problems was helpful and will help on tests/quizzes

Such an awesome professor, there are a few fun field trips outside of class that really helped build my knowledge of the subject material. Definitely take advantage of the sheet you can take to the midterm and final, it honestly saved my grade. And don't forget to do the quizzes before class.

The most funny professor I've had yet and I'm a junior. The course has four midterms and a final, so not the most convenient, but being a GE it is simply the universal structure for all PS100 classes. I attended the TA reviews and only studied for about an hour for the tests and consistently got A's on them. Not too bad. An A is 90+ and A- is 87.

This class was a little bit harder than I expected, but really not that bad, the TA was just kind of strict on grading. His lectures help with the assignments but they're not mandatory so that was nice. Only one midterm and a final which was awesome, especially if you have some harder classes on top of this one!

Professor Skinner is a super funny guy and makes science fun to learn. All the grading is done by TAs but they're very helpful and will work with you. Make sure to do all the assignments because every point helps.

Professor Skinner has entertaining lectures and is always cracking jokes. He has hard tests and the overall class is difficult but he makes it feel more manageable. If I had to take another science class I would take it from him again. The TAs are also helpful.

Class is like getting taught by Jack Black. He's a fun teacher. To get a good grade, do your preclass work in the TA lab and ask the TA's to walk you through the problems you missed after your first attempt. Easy A if you do that

They also give you the chance to test out of the class in the first week. Ask the TA's for the Midterm review slides

Randy Skinner is such a funny professor, and I was always laughing in his class! This class was so hard though, and there were 4 MIDTERMS + the final. I honestly did not like this class at all, but Randy Skinner definitely made it more enjoyable!

guys please take this class from brother skinner!! he KNOWS what he's talking about and does such a good job of explaining the concepts. i actually found i could do fine by just completing the lesson & class work, and not having to read the textbook. he is very funny and makes class very engaging. the class genuinely wasn't bad with him teaching it
Awesome professor. Great lectures and a caring teacher. Would definitely recommend.

Professor Skinner is an amazing professor who genuinely cares about the success of his students.  I have had him for half the semester so far, and he has been able to make a difficult class fun and easier to follow the material.  Phys 100 is not fun in general if you're not into science at all, but as long as you put the time in, you'll do well.

Professor Skinner is the way to go for PS100, but prepare yourself for this class. One professor writes and controls the whole course. The tests she writes are SO hard to understand. Professor Skinner tries his best to prepare you, but you have to put in work. TA labs are so busy & it's so hard to get the help you need. At least he makes class fun.

Dr Skinner makes this GE fun. He tries to be funny and keep things light which I always appreciated. This class in general sucks if you're not interested in it. Lots of exams and they are long. Don't buy the textbook or read it, trust me it's not necessary.
GEO 101 isn't worth taking if it's not from Brother Skinner. Show up to class every day and you'll get an A. Bottomless jokes and dinosaur pictures.

There were a lot of readings and a lot of homework but it very manageable. Go to the TA labs-- they are your best friend. PS 100 is just kind of a hard class itself but Professor Skinner made it so much fun. Our class even accidentally shot a hole in the wall of our classroom. I would 100% take a class from him again. Study hard!
If you take GEOL 101 for a GE take it from Skinner. He is super easy and funny with lots of extra credit opportunities!
DEFINITELY TAKE IT FROM HIM. He's hilarious and makes lectures way fun. The essays aren't hard at all, just ask your TAs what they're looking for. The tests are hard though!

Great professor and a funny guy. I took geo 111 from him. Mostly worked with the TA in labs. Labs were difficult but the lectures were engaging and fun. Pretty easy as well for most of the assignments.

Professor Skinner is a fun professor and makes learning exciting. If you fill out a detailed notesheet for the exams based off the TA review slides and understand practice test questions, you will do well and probably get an A. If you turn in assignments on time and stay on top of work, you can easily get an A. About 3 hours of homework a week.

The class overall is easy, so I do recommend taking him. However, his two TAs were not helpful at all, and one of them was rude. They rarely helped me or never replied to my emails. The professor never replies to your email either. So if you have a question, make sure to ask him right after the class.

The class overall is on the easy side. But I disliked his TA choice this semester because one was ignorant and the other was unhelpful. It's also impossible to reach out to the professor, and the TA and the professor rarely reply to your email, so I had a hard time reaching out to them.

He understands that most people are there to fulfill the general. He did a great job at making lectures entertaining. He lets you have a cheat sheet for every exam, including the final, which was a lifesaver. Exams were still sometimes tricky so make sure you can apply the content! Take PS100 from Skinner!!!

Probably the coolest proffesor I've had at BYU. For the content itself I was never a big fan of science so the some of the concpets were a bit difficult to grasp. It was overall a moderately hard course for me but make sure to utalize the TA labs. You only have to get a 90% for an A so thats nice but the exams are pretty hard at least for me.
Great professor! Learned so much about rocks and he is so nice.

Very disorganized class but an easy A. The whole class did horrible on the first midterm, but he ended up curving it and making the future tests easier. Go to whichever TA lab has the easiest grader, (Dr. Skinner will probably tell you which TA that is). If you're doing bad in the class and communicate with Dr. Skinner he'll give points back.

I was really nervous for this class, but I found it very enjoyable. With any class, you have to put in the work to get the grade you want! Bro. Skinner makes lectures very engaging which makes it easier to learn and understand the material. The assignments are the same for every class and not bad, just don't procrastinate! Read the textbook!

If anyone says anything bad about Brother Skinner, ignore it because clearly they aren't fun people at parties. If you like Science, Dad jokes, and dinosaurs, then this is your class. Seriously, take ps100 from him and you'll never regret it! He is very knowledgeable on what he teaches and is passionate about sharing what he knows!

Prof. Skinner's class was great. He preps you for the exams really well and lets you have a cheat sheet when you take them. I never read the textbook and missed class probably once a month and did fine. Definitely not a hard gen ed.

I did not like Brother Skinner's class. He's clearly passionate about the material, but his lectures were scattered, disorganized, and most information in them did not show up on exams. I wanted to like the class, but felt like I had to teach it to myself. He's funny and clearly loves what he's talking about, but it was difficult not to get lost.

This is a good GE class and I recommend! It has homework but manageable. The only downfall is the midterm & final are weighted heavily (60%) & tough. He lets you take a sheet of paper of notes & that's super helpful. He also has a textbook for the class (it's like $90) I (and others) didn't get it and we were perfectly fine. He is a nice professor!

Brother Skinner - Master Skinner I should say - is ...wow. Yeah he's a lot--I love it! He makes this GE WORTH taking. He is so passionate about Geology, but doesn't expect us to be. Yet, because of his passion, I have also come to be so excited when I see rocks and fossils! Definitely a manageable amount of homework, but there's still homework.

Professor Skinner makes this physics class engaging and manageable. While there's a lot of work, the TA lectures and unstuckstudy AI are super helpful for studying and acing the exams. Take this class if you can - it's challenging but worth it.

He's a great teacher, I wouldn't want to take this class from anybody else. He has a sence of humor and lays things out how they are so nothing is a surprise in tests or quizes. Homework isn't easy but it's rare and interesting. I had no interest in geology before this term and now I have a hard time not identifying rocks as I walk around.

Wow. Every single class was fascinating. It is one of those courses where even though it is difficult to memorize information, I felt like I still enjoyed learning the material. He treats every class like an important production and makes it very interesting. One of my most engaging professors, you definitely won't ever be bored in class.

Hilarious teacher. Understands this is a GE class but lectures were typically boring. About 60% of your grade is exams and the other 40% are easy assignments. You do get a sheet of notes front and back for the test which saved my life. You don't need the textbook. The only reason I got an A- is because of the curve on the midterm.

Sometimes professor Skinner is a little much and I didn't find him super funny. I didn't find the lectures interesting and the homework and slides were all at least 10 years old. It doesn't seem like the course has been too cared for in a while.

I am NOT a science person but Brother Skinner made it actually enjoyable for me! He knows that it's a GE, so not everyone will like the subject. He is hilarious & knows his stuff! There is a LOT of reading, but he brings it to life in the lectures! Take good notes and study them. He also does amazing exam reviews since there's a lot of info!
Only take this class from Bro. Skinner. Trust me he is worth it.

Professor Skinner is the best professor I've ever had. He genuinely cares about his students and their success. If you have to take physics at BYU, take it with Skinner and you'll be fine, even if physics is tough for you.

Brother Skinner is the best teacher at BYU, he makes a boring class interesting and makes class time worthwhile. He wants you to get a good grade and is very entertaining. If you take Physical Science please take it from him.

He is pretty funny and can explain complicated terms in simple words. He did take forever to get back to us on grades, specifically the midterm and midterm corrections. I took the class in SLC which was not as hard as the one in Provo (so I have heard).
He is a beast of a teacher and I loved him. He made the class good. The hardest part was that the tests accounted for a lot of the grade.

This Professor made learning fun and easy! The class is set up to help you succeed with TAs, labs, and reviews in class and outside of class. It does have a chapter of reading and associated quizzes due before every class, but I got by with just skimming the material. I LOVED Brother Skinner and would highly recommend taking his class
Take from Randy. I am fr.

Go to class, do the lessons, attend lab and you'll do great! I'm not really a science person but got an A through. I didn't read from the textbook a ton, but paying attenting and participating with help! Highly reccomend Professor Skinner!

The class is HARD unless physics and chemistry are your thing but Skinner is great. There's a chapter of textbook reading 3x a week plus 9 short essays. TA lecture slides are very helpful, and he goes through the test and tells you what topic you need to know for every single question before you take it. Funniest guy, please take him for PS100!
Seriously the funniest dude I have ever met. Lectures are pretty important but not mandatory. There is a LOT you are graded on but they adjust the scale so it all works out. Great dude, great class.
Brother Skinner might just be the funniest person at BYU. He is incredibly engaging and an excellent teacher. He really knows his stuff. If you're taking PS100, TAKE IT FROM HIM YOU WONT REGRET IT!

Professor Skinner is very funny but what I appreciated most was his awareness that it was a GE. He shared his passion for his work but was fair with the amount and detail of the homework. Loved him but hated his class. He makes really funny/edgy jokes but geol103 still sucks. Professor Skinner is the best teacher I've had at BYU. And I hate science! The info is hard but he does everything he can to make you succeed! Professor Skinner is hilarious! I can't say enough about him. My class was lame and never laughed at his jokes but I was laughing all the time. Professor Skinner made one of the toughest subjects one of my most fun classes in all of college. I was super nervous to take Physical Science but Professor Skinner helped me through the whole thing. I stayed after class every day to clarify what was being taught. Brother Skinner is hilarious. If you are a science major like me, this class will be a breeze. If you aren't, it might be less intuitive but he explains things really well so you're in good hands. The structure of the class was chef's kiss. Weekly quizzes were online and multiple attempts. The textbook was helpful too. Take it from Skinner.

THE ASSIGNMENTS ARE ALL 100% if you do them!!! They feel hard but just guess and you'll still get 100%. He never told us that hahaha. Also I would pull up the study guide and fill it in during class because he talks about a lot that's not on the test. He is super funny and a great teacher that is very experienced

Skinner's lectures are the best. I attended all three Fall 2022 professors throughout the semester (Skinner, Ireland, Ware), and Skinner's were my favorite. Professor Skinner was the best! I took Life of the Past and enjoyed it so much. Each test we were allowed one page of notes front and back which helped a ton. he is more of a comedian than a teacher. never really learned much from him,I taught myself physical science through the BYU PS website and the textbook. Professor Skinner was hilarious! He allowed a full page of notes on exams, so they weren't too bad. The test reviews were super helpful for preparation. Easy class with at times entertaining lectures that often ended a few minutes early. Lectures don't feel too long because he's a nice guy and makes a lot of jokes to help the time pass. Explains things well and helps students succeed. Skinner does a great job preparing students for the exams. Before each exam, he'll look over a paper copy and tell the class the things they need to know. Take PS100 through Skinner.

So entertaining, shares fascinating stories during lectures and is really engaging to learn from. Not many assignments, allowed us to use notes on the midterm and final. Even recorded all classes on zoom so that you didn't have to come to class.

Skinner is amazing. He is funny, has good lectures, and really cares about his students. The midterm and final. were both weighted very heavily. He had mercy on me and rounded my grade which was super clutch. Not a super hard class, just wasn't prepared for the final. Would take Skinner again.

Brother Skinner is the best teacher that I've had at BYU (I'm a senior), and I love his sense of humor. Very accommodating teacher, who makes a hard class (in theory) easy, with the many aids that he has for his students. If it wasn't for Brother Skinner, I may have got a C if I was lucky, but I ended up with a very generous A-.  God bless Skinner!

Definitely the easiest GE I've taken at BYU; you're allowed a full page of notes on the midterm and final, and usually you can find the answers to the quizzes in the slides. SO FUNNY! I don't like science but he made the class enjoyable. I sat in the front which was fun, especially during experiments. If you do all the work, you'll get an A. The TA's were awesome as well. Take this class from him!

Literally the easiest class I have ever taken in my life. Professor Skinner will literally not allow you to fail the class due to how easy he makes everything. He did a Midterm and Final review where he went over every single question and what you needed to know AND we got to bring in a full page cheat-sheet to the tests. Take this class!!!

Skinner is one of my favorite professors I've had. He is so funny, kind, and caring. His lectures are engaging and he covers everything you need to know for the tests. If you do the reading and listen to the lectures you'll pass. Reviews for the exams are super helpful, and he is super willing to work with you if you have extenuating circumstances.

Funniest guy. Explains things very well and is more than happy to answer your questions. TA's definitely help[ed, but he made sure we were aware what was going to be asked of us on each exam so we were prepared

Professor Skinner has been my favorite professor that I've had so far. He makes class enjoyable and is very personable. He makes things very engaging and interesting and has a great sense of humor. He's a super engaging guy with entertaining lectures. My TA was so amazing though that I attended hardly any lectures and as long as I went to her review and studied, I got at least a B+ on exams.  Take this class, ESPECIALLY over other Geology courses, GEOL103 is a lot more well-rounded as opposed to just studying rocks.

Literally THE BEST PHYS100 professor at BYU. Physical science is the WORST GE class at BYU. Luckily Prof. Skinner makes it interesting and really easy to understand. Professor Skinner is caring and funny. His lectures were fun to attend and he made the content accessible. I would not take PS 100 with someone else.

Professor Skinner is the only reason I got an A in that class. Without his mercy and understanding and kindness, I would have done poorly. There was designated "joke time" each class. It was awesome! I absolutely loved PHYS 100 from Skinner. This is my favorite class I've taken at BYU. Professor Skinner is amazing, funny, and was great at keeping the class engaged. Amazing Professor, just teaches really hard material. The tests are pretty tough but he does a lot of reviews to help. If you need the PS credit I'd take Geo100 w Skinner or study the quizlet and test out of PS100.

Skinner is the man. I hate science but he made it pretty interesting and is absolutely hilarious. Just do the readings and you'll be fine. He also lets you bring in a page of notes into the testing center so that was awesome. Take this class from him!

I am not a science person, I actually hate science and was dreading this class. Professor Skinner made it fun! I'll be honest, I didn't do much of the  reading, and I procrastinated every assignment. This man is an absolute legend. If you go to BYU and are wanting to get your Physical Science credit done in an easy way then take it from Skinner. He is the coolest teacher I have had this semester and you can tell he really cares about his students.

Professor Skinner was hilarious and such a good teacher. He's super funny, and does a lot of experiments to try to keep the class involved. He really cares about the topic, and knows a lot. Take this class from him! Professor Skinner is the best. He is hilarious, engaging, and makes you love physical science. He is not only willing to help his students, but wants them to succeed. I would take this class again in a heartbeat. Definitely take physical science from him!

Prof. Skinner is the funniest teacher I've ever had. He's passionate about the material, but also makes it entertaining. For PS1000, all Profs. follow the same material, same tests, and TA's grade. TAKE PROF. SKINNER! He makes the class so entertaining! Bro. Skinner is the best teacher for this class. He is so entertaining which makes the lectures worth it. The tests were quite difficult but Brother Skinner prepares you well.

Skinner is great and his lectures are super entertaining! Take this class rom skinner!! The tests are fairly difficult but they are the same no matter who you take it from, so enjoy class time and take it with skinner!!
This guy is funny. His specialty is geology, but he knows the content he covers. I would definitely take another course from him if it is possible.

Science is definitely my least favorite subject, however, I was always excited to attend this class because Professor Skinner is hilarious. I took this class online, although it was optional to attend in person or not. Pretty easy general.

Super chill class. Lectures were made interesting and if you pay attention and take notes, you will do fine. Also, the textbook is very helpful for studying.
Brother Skinner was a ton of fun. His class isn't too hard and he made lectures very entertaining. It was exactly what I hoped for from a GE- interesting but not too much work.

Ok Professor Skinner is the absolute bomb. His lectures are interesting and clear, he provides so much test prep, and he is so understanding. I took his class during a really hard time mentally and he was so open to work with me to get my grade up. Take his class. Take his class. Take his class.

The teacher is so funny and tries his best to make you want to be in his class. This class is just a hard general, for those of you who dont like science or have never taken any hard science classes. Professor Skinner loves his students. Period. He always has a joke and a smile on his face. He's willing to answer any questions and simplify the material to a level of understanding. Professor Skinner is hilarious. He makes every lecture entertaining by cracking jokes the entire time. He really tries to make sure that his students are prepared for each test. The tests are hard!!! If you go to the TA review sessions you should do fine on them.

Skinner was a great professor to take PHYS100 from. His lectures were entertaining, and he gave lots of helpful exam hints in class. Professor Skinner every positive trait I look for in a teacher, you are well prepared for tests, the classwork and textbook readings are very manageable. He is entertaining in class and very caring and honest with students. Best teacher I have had yet :)

He wants his students to do well in his class. He is not sneaky and if he feels that the practice tests don't reflect the actually test he will upload additional reviews to better prepare his students. Super funny and has lots of energy. I wish he taught all my classes

I REALLY do not like science, but I can't say enough good things about this class. Brother Skinner went in depth to answer questions that I had, and gave access to all of the power points. Brother Skinner is so funny and keeps things interesting. All the professors for this class have the same tests, so lectures are the main difference. Pretty interesting lectures. Brother Skinner is hilarious and I loved going to lectures (you get points for going to class). He was clear and very helpful, really prepared you for tests. Randy Skinner is an excellent teacher. Each of his lectures are very informative, engaging, and hilarious. It was clear throughout the semester that Mr. Skinner cares for his students in the way he helps each one of us understand the course material.

BROTHER SKINNER IS AMAZING! The funniest, best professor I have ever had. He explains things so well, it's still a difficult subject, but he makes it a lot easier! He's a great guy, has straightforward tests and helpful homework. TAKE HIS CLASS YOU WON'T REGRET IT! Seriously the best class!

Cant imagine taking PS100 from anyone else. He knows PS100 sucks and tells you that from day one, but he makes it the best experience possible. Gives you a LOT of tips for the tests. I dont think other professors help you out like he does. And super funny  Ive laughed out loud every class.

Randy Skinner is the BEESSTT! I am not good at science and finally enjoyed the material and started to understand it. He does not make his class too hard and does all he can to get you extra help with test correction and being a very kind grader. Take this class from Skinner!!

Brother Skinner has a gift for being entertaining. He made GEOL 101 seem like the most exciting thing. He shares many stories and also "joke time". Professor Skinner is the best choice for this class. There is work, but it is not difficult. He is funny and tries to make class entertaining. I've never enjoyed going to lectures more than in this class. If you pay attention in class and do a little studying before tests you'll get a good grade. He's seriously the best professor. He's hilarious and makes lecture super entertaining. Seriously my favorite professor at BYU so far! He makes class interesting and prepares us for the tests. No surprises! 10/10 would recommend.

Brother Skinner is definitely the best teacher to take Physical Science from. He is super funny and will help you out throughout the way. Would definitely take this class again by him. He does points back for every test and his final is literally the study guide with just a couple more question.

I love Skinner! I took this class to fulfill the other half of the physical science credit and was surprised with how hard the exams were. Great guy, hard exams!

Professor Skinner is AMAZING! Skinner is HILARIOUS! I always came out of his class smiling. He made the difficult material understandable. TAKE THIS CLASS! Skinner is a fantastic professor. I absolutely love Professor Skinner!! If you need to take Physical Science, TAKE IT FROM HIM. He is my absolute favorite professor at BYU and he is super hilarious and realistic. Easily one of the best professors that I have ever had! He is awesome and funny! Does a pretty good job teaching the material, but you definitely need to do the required reading assignments to get a good grade. If you give a decent effort in this class, you can get an A.

Absolutely, 100% would recommend Master Skinner. He's hilarious, has joke time every class period, and teachs material really well. He can be rough around the edge, but you love him. I loved him. TAKE THIS CLASS.

Master Skinner keeps his lectures entertaining. We sometimes fell behind in the schedule because he takes many questions from students, which I found helpful, but the class felt rushed catching up. Very entertaining guy, especially since you're talking about rocks. Not much bonus (LICK THE ROCKS!) but assignments are pretty easy and some are fun! Go to TA reviews for tests, I would have had a hard time without them. It's an easy A if you put in a little effort. Book isn't necessary, just helpful sometimes.

Easy A. Mostly. You still have to study. Concepts are clear and in the text. Skinner's lectures are very funny. Since all PHY S 100 classes have the same homework / tests / etc., the workload in this course would be the same from any other professor. However, Bro.
