Bro. Skinner is absolutely hilarious. He stops class halfway through just so somebody can tell a joke. His lectures are interesting and he puts up all the slides online. However, he does have a lot of valuable information in class that he doesn't say on the slides. Also, GO TO TEST REVIEWS!! The TA would base his review directly from the exam.
skinner is way funny and makes the class fun for his students.

Mr. Skinner is hilarious and explains concepts very well. He expects you to learn a lot and his tests require some critical thinking, but they are very passible if you are willing to study. Wish I could take this class again!
Awesome teacher take this class from him!! don't bother from anyone else

Awful class, but AMAZING professor. He's both completely hilarious in lectures & extremely informative. The testsHW are the same for all Phys. Sci. classes, so no luck there, but Skinner does a terrific job at explaining the concepts & keeping you wide awake in lectures. Plus, there's joke time. The best Physical Science professor, hands down.

By far the most funny professor I had at BYU!  He actually made learning about rocks entertaining.  If you are looking to take a GE be sure to take this class from him.  Go to the TA reviews for tests and you will be golden.

Honestly, Skinner has been my favorite professor so far. HE MAKES CLASS SO INTERESTING. Seriously. He had me laughing all the time and I'm not a laugher. He teaches the material clearly. His classes always had higher test averages than the other PS profs. Plus it's 90% for an A. Very doable. Don't take this class from anyone else. Promise.

"Master" Skinner is the best. I wish he could teach all of my classes. He's hilarious and loves what he does. Essays aren't tough. He gives extra credit for those who are willing to go outside the box.

Professor Skinner makes class enjoyable.  He is full of energy and wants to engage his students.  The class takes some work, there is a lot of material covered,  but if you're willing to do it, it's not hard to get a good grade.

Skinner is AWESOME! I thought I was going to hate geology , but he makes it interesting. Plus we have joke time! I took it as a block class, so it was hard to keep up with all of the work. He wasn't very good at putting grades in on time and his tests were a little tricky. Study and go to class and you will get an A! Take this class from Skinner!

LOVE Brother Skinner. He was really engaging and hilarious. Turns out I didn't even need this class, yet I have no regrets. Do the reading, and you'll get the grade. The tests were a little difficult, but very manageable.

Professor Skinner is a really fun, friendly guy who cares about his subject and his students. He helped me realize how cool geology is. BUT the tests are really hard and sometimes confusingly worded, which made me lose points I don't think I should have lost. The book is good but WAY long and has so many facts to keep track of. Do the reading!

Skinner is funny, but his tests are hard. He makes geology interesting, but the real learning occurs when you read the book. One of his TAs was not helpful at all at test reviews or entering grades, but the other one was more helpful. Hopefully you have a good one. Fun class, but not a cakewalk.

Brother Skinner is one of the most generous people ever! If you have a lousy grade in his class, go talk to him! I did, and he totally helped me out way more than I deserved. Also: his lectures are the best, because A) he makes geology interesting, and his class is one of the easier ones to stay awake in,  plus B) joke time and dinosaurs.

Skinner is the best PS 100 teacher.  Funny, willing to help.  The class no matter the teacher is difficult, mixture of physics, chemistry, and geology.  First test was hard bc I didnt take physics in high school but it gets easier if you know your chem.  Do the reading! just do it.  Do all the HW and try your best on tests you can pull a A no prob.

Skinner is awesome! He is super super funny, and makes it really interesting.  But don't underestimate how hard the class is, just because it's level 100.  You DO have to read the textbook along with the lectures. Do the practice questions in the book. Go to the TA reviews.  As long as you're reading the chapters, tests aren't bad.

TAKE PHYSICAL SCIENCE FROM BROTHER SKINNER! I have 0 interest in science but his lectures are so fun I kept on going to class. The tests and homework are the same no matter who you take from and are no big deal, just take notes, read the book, you'll be fine. Brother Skinner is a great guy! You will not regret taking his class.

Skinner is funny and knows his stuff. PHY S 100's tests and curriculum are written by the department, so the tests and grading scale is the same for all of the teachers.  Skinner prepares students the best to excel in this class. Take copious notes and go to the TA review sessions before tests to do well on the tests. You must read the text book!

I took this as a block class, and it was interesting, but moved kind of fast.  Quizzes and assignments were easy, but I thought the tests were kind of hard in comparison.  But he offers a ton of extra credit, so it's not too big a deal.  He's also super funny.  We stopped class halfway through for a 10 minute break and a designated joke time.

Bro Skinner was really funny. We had a designated joke time and also a 10 minute break in the middle of class. He was reasonable and as long as you do the reading, you should do fine in the class. Going to class really helps, but it's not completely necessary. Really enjoyable class.
I took this as a block class and it was great and not hard at all. Master Skinner is pretty funny and made rocks somewhat entertaining.

Brother Skinner is AWESOME! he makes the class interesting. the class was fun to go to - and you have clicker quizzes everyday so attendance is pretty mandatory.  The tests aren't bad if you go to the reviews.

This was my favorite class all semester. I don't have an interest in rocks, but Brother Skinner was such a good teacher that he made me interested in geology. Joke time was amazing and if you pay attention to lectures and skim the book, you should do good on the quizzes and tests.

Skinner is the best! His lectures are always interesting, funny and sometimes explosive! He takes extra time to explain science to people like me who hate the subject. If you have to take Physical Science, take it from Skinner.

Great professor, terrible class! Tests are departmental and tough, but Brother Skinner is a fantastic professor! He makes the otherwise boring material fun to learn! And joke time in the middle of class is a HUGE bonus!

Nice guy I'm sure, but I can't handle awful comedy. If that's your thing I'm sure you'll love it like the rest of these people

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!! If you have to take physical science, you should take it from Skinner. He is hilarious, keeps you on your toes, and is always up for some good jokes. I didn't even read anything assigned but just went to the review sessions taught by the TA's and I got an A or B on the tests.

Brother Skinner is pretty much the best. If you're stuck with taking Physical Science with the rest of the none science majors, Skinner will make it not only bearable--but you will find yourself enjoying it. If you're taking Physical Science, TAKE FROM SKINNER.

Bro. Skinner is without a doubt the best physical science teacher there is. He is entertaining and loves to make the class laugh and enjoy themselves. He teaches concepts well and tests are based on applying those concepts. Review sessions are key to success in this class. Take from Bro. Skinner!!

Skinner is the BEST prof I have ever had. If you are debating between teachers, TAKE HIM! He is hilarious, entertaining in lecture, &  passionate about what he teaches. The tests are kind of hart but manageable if you study. He has joke time every day & I never leave class without laughing! GREAT CLASS. I have no interest in rocks but loved geology

Although a little cynical about graduating, freshmen, and overall life he is one of, if not the funniest professor I've ever had. Loved this class and this professor! I wasn't really expecting to like it as much as I did. Professor Skinners lectures are filled with important info in the most fun-filled class time EVER! He's amazing!

Professor Skinner is a fantastic and incredibly funny teacher. He makes learning fun. I began this class with a little apprehension and little knowledge of Geology and finished it with a great deal of knowledge and enthusiasm for Geology.

Skinner is the best professor for Geology.  He makes the material interesting. However, the class is pretty disorganized. It took me a little while to figure out how things flowed which hurt my grade some.  Skinner makes it interesting.

SKINNER'S THE BOMB. I'm not huge in geology, but this G.E with SKinner was the best decision i ever made. He is so freaking funny and really keeps class exciting. Okay. So here's the thing. I don't care if you've got no interest in science, or if you already got your gen ed out of the way...You need to take a class from Skinner. Hilarious and easy going, yet extremely knowledgeable and cares about your learning. I learned more about the planet than I could have imagined beforehand. Extremely proficient at explaining absolutely everything. You don't have to go to class to do well, but almost everybody does since it's so entertaining. Made me want to major in Geology

BEST CLASS I HAVE EVER TAKEN. Take Geology from Brother Skinner even if you don't ever need to learn anything about Geology. It will change your life and make your whole semester better! Brother Skinner is the funniest most easy-going professor here at BYU and I regret not taking a class from Brother Skinner until this semester!

in lectures he will tell you what will be on the tests. is hilarious and lectures are fun. you will remember this guy long after you leave BYU. class itself is very basic and easy. read and go to lecture and you'll be at an A. an A= 90% and above. its great

Dr. Skinner, you are a nutter. No one else on planet Earth could love this planet as much as you do. That being said, TAKE THIS CLASS. He makes groundwater and rock names memorable. Bro. Skinner is a riot. The class period is fun and very interesting considering that you are studying rocks. This man gave me a love for geology. It's a little work but an A is very doable. TA review sessions were awesome.

Great teacher! Very funny!!

He is hilarious! He explains things well and keeps the class entertained at the same time. Take from him!

He will be your favorite teacher at BYU no question.  Funniest teacher on campus, and makes everything easy to understand.  Show up to class, and you can get an A.  If you took any science classes in high school, this will be a cake walk.
AMAZING TEACHER! The best teacher for ps 100 hands down. Way funny and kept my attention along with helping me learn the material. I just dont like science that much.

Skinner was such a great teacher, he makes so many jokes and actually helps you understand the material. You take easy quizzes in class for attendance points. The tests were really hard for me, I'm not a science person. The course is hard, teacher was great.
AWESOME AWESOME AWESOME! Best teacher at BYU HANDS DOWN. Made the study of rocks interesting! You do have to read the textbook a lot though...

Professor Skinner is hands down the best teacher I have ever had. He keeps you entertained at all times and never fails to present a great lesson. I highly recommend this class to anyone, even if Science is not a priority

I LOVE Brother Skinner. If you read the textbook and go to class, you will do well. Amazing teacher who realizes that everyone just wants a professor who is a real guy. Really funny dude. Bring jokes for joke time. Power points are fun. Made class interesting

JOKE TIME! Possibly the most boring text I've ever read, but the professor is hilarious. In what class will you get "Far Side" comics in the middle of the exams or random dinosaur slides on EVERY powerpoint.

this guy is the bomb! no question about it..

He is great! I took his class as a block class- two hours three times a week adn I loved it. I looked forward to his class everyday because he was so funny! He makes identifying rocks interesting. He is a teacher that knows how to teach and still makes class fun. Take his class, you will love it!

I am a senior and Randy Skinner is the best Professor I have had at BYU. His class is extremely informative, engaging, and fun. I tried this class out from other professors and I emphatically state that Professor Skinner is the best.

Professor Skinner is Awesome! he keeps you awake if you have a morning class. His personality is hilarious, he teaches and entertains at the same time.  He even has a 5 min. "joke time" to liven things up.  Great teacher. Easy class, hard tests! Study!

This class was amazingly fun.  I would definitely recommend taking the fieldtrip class (102) over the regular class because the fieldtrips were awesome. nice gneiss!

Bro Skinner Rocks!!! (No pun intended). His lectures keep up to speed so it isn't draining. There are 14 online quizzes that are timed (20 min). Kind of hard if you don't do the reading before. Took field trip class, fun class, unique way to learn concepts. He is a very fun teacher. Clear and understands students' life well. Highly recommend him for those taking 101.

awesome teacher. he made class so much fun. i looked forward to it every week. the field trips were sweet. open book tests, only problem is that the final was closed book, so you had to prepare accordingly. geology 101 rocks! no pun intended.

great professor. super funny. takes a boring subject and makes it way fun to learn about. if you attend every lecture and do your reading you can get an easy A. recommended for geology.

THE BEST TEACHER EVER!! I would definitely take his class again. It was a stress releiver for the rest of the week. I recomend him to anybody that asks. Take the feild trip section. It's great.
