Amazing professor and amazing guy. I learned a ton in this class, and it was my favorite of the Fall of the IS junior core. He's entertaining and tech savvy in every way. I aspire to be like him in a lot of ways. You will love this class!

Prof Schuetzler is great, super passionate about what he teaches and cares about the students.

I didn't personally do well in the class because I got behind for personal reasons and just didn't do some of the assignments or study well for the tests, but he gives you the resources you need to succeed, and I don't think it's unreasonably hard.
This class was hard to understand and keep up with but Professor S does a wonderful job at explaining those concepts. Such a nice professor who is willing to work with you and help you succeed!
This is such a hard class. But I wouldn't recommend anyone else to teach this class. Prof S does a wonderful job. Just make sure to study hard and pay attention in class.

Prof S is awesome! His lectures are pretty interesting, entertaining, and even hands-on. I was always engaged in his class. He also makes videos to explain concepts that are really helpful and actually pretty funny too. Overall great class, great professor, and great concepts. You'll learn a lot and have some fun.
Schuetzler is awesome. Super nice and fun and has awesome videos.

I really enjoyed his class, he connects very well with his students and makes the content very interesting. His tests were a bit trickier, but he provides plenty of material to help you prepare. Was active with responding to inquiries from students. He was developing the course so I anticipate future semesters being even better!
LOVE LOVE LOVE DR. SCHUETZLER. He is the funniest professor I've ever had. He teaches his content really well and prepares you well for his tests - just work hard!

Genuinely such an amazing professor. I had a huge assignment that I wasn't able submit because of a stressful situation and he went out of his way to grade it personally. His lectures changed my perspective on the Book of Mormon and significantly grew my testimony. I loved everything about this class and will be recommending him to everyone.

I loved how excited he was about the content, which in turn made me get excited. I also liked the many spiritual stories he shared, made me want to do things to have spiritual experiences like that as well. Also provided many opportunities to discuss together topics we learned etc.

I love Brother Sharp. His class is not only intellectually enlarging, but also so spiritually uplifting. He taught me so many things about the Book of Mormon that I didn't know before and had so many insights that I loved to hear. I would definitely take a class from him again, he is incredible.

I was not very familiar with the bible before this class but I felt like it was a great blend of historical insights and also super spiritual. I learned a ton. I am taking another class from Bro Sharp this summer.

I loved this course. I have had brother Sharp before in another religion class, and I immediately wanted to take another class from him. He is the best religion teacher ever. He is super funny, a great teacher, and is super kind and understanding to all of his students.

On his mid-semester review someone wrote, "closest thing to zone conference" and it made him very happy. So if you like that style of class you will like it. I thought his lectures were boring, lots of random personal stories that felt more "inspirational" than educational. If you aren't paying attention the tests are pretty hard and worth a lot.

Attendance is graded but he also gives out a study guide that has the test questions on it so as long as you attend lectures and take notes of the things on the guide then it's not difficult. He gives great lectures and makes it a very uplifting experience.
Don't skip classes, many questions on tests are only talked about in lectures. Study guides are helpful and similar to the tests. Lectures are somewhat boring.

Lectures with Brother Sharp were always so entertaining, spiritually uplifting, and intellectually enlarging. It is necessary to attend lectures because all the information needed for the midterm and final exams are given but not always in the slides. Brother Sharp really cares about his students and always listens.

I cannot stress how much I loved Professor Sharp's class. He was able to engage with students really well and his stories were so inspirational and really brought the spirit. (Plus he gave great insight) The only homework is pre class readings and a discussion post each week along with a semester long Book of Mormon project which isn't too bad.
He knows what he's talking about.

Dr. Sharp is a very engaging teacher, masterfully balancing a great sense of humor and serious teaching moments throughout his lectures. Attendance was important to get the info needed for tests, but not critical because some of it could be figured out just by looking at class slides. But go to as many classes as you can because they're so fun!
Very inspiring and explained expectations clearly in the beginning and throughout the course. He shares great stories that are insightful and entertaining.

Bro Sharp is awesome!! I learned so much about the New Testament. He's great at keeping his class in line with BYU outcomes. Knowledge, good story teller, and interested class! Tests are little challenging and long, but if you fill out and memorize the study guide, you'll do well! Attendance is required too!

This man is the most amazing professor on planet Earth. He knows how to teach the gospel and not overwhelm students with test questions and quizzes. He gives a study guide throughout the semester that has all of the test material on it so you can fill it as you learn it! I LOVE HIM!!

the perfect mix of spiritual, intellectual, and stories. he is funny, smart, genuinely so friendly, and an incredible teacher. i learned SO much about the book of mormon. no complaints, highly recommend!
Super, super funny and entertaining teacher. He always told great stories each class and would help our testimonies grow exponentially over the course of this class.

Prof Sharp is super caring and tells great stories. However, he talks really fast and skips through slides in lectures so it was hard to get the answers for the study guide. I always felt lost in class because he moved through the slides so fast.
Funniest teacher I've ever had! Super chill class, definitely take this class
Brother Sharp is just the best. He is really funny, and also equally super spiritual. I've learned a lot about the Book of Mormon from him, and I would definitely take a class from him again!

One of the best teachers at BYU. He is so funny and teaches so well. He has never taught a lesson where I didn't feel the spirit. Tests are open scripture. Assignments are easy. One semester long creative project due at the end of the semester

Brother Sharp is amazing! I enjoyed his classes and video lectures each week and loved learning because of him. It is obvious that he loves teaching, and he makes listening so easy. Take from this man! He is the absolute best, and you will not regret it.
A great professor! I loved his lectures. Not too many assignments, to be honest. Mostly just listening to Brother Sharp, which I did not mind at all.

Professor Sharp was AHHHHHMAZING!! There were 1-2 assignments a week but they were very short. Most weeks there was only a discussion board. His lectures were very entertaining. This was a summer course so it went by a lot faster than expected but it was still reasonable. he WANTS you to succeed and he is such a good teacher. TAKE THIS CLASS!!

Ryan Sharp is such an amazing man who knows his stuff. I gave a 2 for level of difficulty, which doesn't mean that it was easy; it just means that the work seemed fun and engaging. He is extremely funny and has great stories.
You learn a lot, you feel the Spirit, his stories are interesting and really memorable, he's just a nice dude and the class is really easy. Just don't forget to do the assignments lol

He is so amazing! No tests, easy assignments and easy A. But even better I learned so much through his assignments! I thought I grew so much and you get to pick out of his provided material what you want to read for his pre class readings.

AMAZING I took his eternal families class and it was so uplifting. No test but coursework is based on helping you grow and understand. Super easy to make an A just complete the assignments. Doesn't take too much time and I learned so much from the preclass readings that you can pick and choose what you read. I loved him!

He is so kind and his class was great! super good religion class, tests weren't too hard, and just weekly assignments/readings. He says the tests will be in the testing center, but they weren't. He is just a genuine guy, and you can tell he really cares about his students and likes his job. Definitely recommend this for an easy religion credit.
Great level of difficulty for a two credit religion class! Also good for LGBTQIA+ students looking for religion credit.
I really enjoyed his class. It was an environment where I learnt a lot, yet did not need to put in too much time. Would suggest!

Professor Sharp is great! I loved his lectures and felt like he was fair in his grading. The work load is pretty light with only one midterm and final. Homework consisted of weekly readings and a discussion board post. We also had one project but you have the whole semester to complete it. The only down side is that attendance is mandatory.
Brother Sharp is amazing! I learned so much and felt that he truly cared about his students. He is more than willing to work with you! I would 100% take another class from him.

By far my favorite religion professor so far. He told personal stories at the end of nearly every lecture that always brought the spirit and helped me in my personal life. I looked forward to going to class specifically for those short stories at the end of each lecture.
I love this guy! Unfortunate, this class was extremely difficult for me because he goes at such a fast, unorganized pace. I desperately was trying to keep up and understand what was going on.

Brother Sharp is very charismatic and has created an environment that I believe is the ideal religion class environment at BYU. His class focuses on the changes we can make individually. I would take another class from him in a heartbeat...he gets it!!

Professor Sharp is the best! His lectures are inspiring and he's also just a funny dude. The homework isn't too bad for this class, just readings due before class and a weekly discussion post. He also values feedback and changes his class based off of what his students say. Overall would definitely recommend!

Professor Sharp is the best! I have learned so much more about the Book of Mormon after having done many solid deep dives into certain stories throughout the book. Dr. Sharp does a great job to point out unique details that further validate the truthfulness of the Bofm and you can tell he loves studying and teaching

There were so many "Aha!" moments for me in this class! While I appreciated many of the insights in class, the thing that was most helpful were the tools for studying the Book of Mormon on my own.  My testimony was strengthened a ton. Favorite religion professor!

Honestly crazy easy class but if you are trying to learn anything, this is not the professor for you. I am going into my senior year and this is by far the most pointless class that I have ever taken. The tests were online but he would pretend like he was going to make them in the testing center. Find someone else
Tests were in the testing center a bit ago but mine wasn't this semester! Truly an inspiring class!

This class was great! Instead of stressing to memorize facts, we were able to dive into the material and share our personal reflection. You can tell that he spends a lot of time preparing his lectures and the pre class readings. Exams we straight forward if you used the study guide. Almost everyone I knew got an A in the class. Amazing storyteller!
Such a nice guy, good lectures, literally the hardest test I have ever taken
His lectures were amazing, but the tests were terribly difficult.

This was what I wished every religion class was like. Brother Sharp's lectures were incredibly inspiring, he was super responsive to questions, and he literally told us what would be on the exams. He gave a study guide and also let us use our scriptures/notes on the exam. He cares way more about spiritual growth than he does about grades. 10/10

Brother Sharp's class had a very unique and different perspective that I liked. He has study guides you can fill out in class to prepare for the midterm/final and allows you to write notes/content in your Book of Mormon for tests. You get to choose what you want to do for the semester-long project as long as it connects to the Book of Mormon.

Love Professor Sharp! His lectures were super spiritual and he told amazing stories that make you want to be a better person. There were online discussions due every week and an open ended projected due at the end of the year. Midterm and final were online and open scripture.

Brother Sharp had wonderful lectures and I learned a lot about the Book of Mormon in this class. I loved how he often told stories and tried to connect with us as a class. While the midterm and final have very specific questions on them, as long as you do the study guide, they are a breeze.

I LOVE Bro. Sharp. He was super kind, sincere, and caring. His lectures were super interesting (I learned so much about the New Testament) and funny, but tests were randomly specific about little things. I thought tests would be more about doctrine, but they focused on little events and specific verses. Not a biggie though, I'd take him again.

I took the Book of Mormon class from him. Lectures were awesome and he is a great storyteller. Get ready to learn super specific things about the Book of Mormon though. There's not a ton of room for personal revelation but I walked away knowing more about the facts and intricacies of the book than I'd ever figure out on my own.

Sharp's lectures were awesome and his class really brought the Spirit. Tests were challenging. His study guides are fill-in-the-blanks that can be hard to catch/subjective even with access to lecture slides or asking him for help. For tests, there were lots of questions that weren't on the study guide, so if you didn't write it down, you're cooked.

very little busywork and his lectures truly helped me to grow my testimony so much. He is so inspiring and I genuinely felt the Spirit almost every single lecture. exams were open scriptures and all the notes you take in your scriptures, so get a journal edition new testament and take notes in it! I loved this class so much!! take it with Bro Sharp

You can tell Brother Sharp cares deeply for his students and ensures that they are spiritually edified by his class, not stressed by it. He makes it very clear what will be on the test and the rest of your grade is essentially attendance and a semester long project which you get great creative direction on.
Brother Sharp was one of my favorite professors this semester. He is the gre

Fun and engaging lectures. He will often spend parts of class trying to address questions, sometimes telling a story, and will try to connect with the students. Clear grading criteria. Attendance, in-class engagement, and note-taking are key to success. Do the study guide, and your life will be a breeze.

Loved the class! His lectures were engaging, easy assignments, and he lets you choose between a multiple choice exam or an essay exam. I took the multiple choice exams and because he lets you write notes in your scriptures and then use them on the test, I got 100% on both exams (I just wrote everything from the study guide in my scriptures!)

I LOVED this class. Bro. Sharp gives really interesting and spiritual insights to the NT, and does everything in his power for you to do well. Take notes directly into the study guide that he gives and you'll do great. He talks fast but you really only need a few points from each lecture, and they're in the study guide.

Key to success: open the study guide in a google doc and then take notes on the questions during the lectures. The exams are based on the study guide. The final exam was difficult for me so I barely ended with an A. Bro. Sharp is kind and I love the stories he shares. He does speak quickly though.

Great lectures, fast paced but interesting, lots of note taking. His tests are tough if you don't use the the New Testament he allows you to use during your tests as a means of copying down the study guide that is given. In other words if you're willing to take a few hours before the tests to copy down a bunch of notes it should be a fairly easy A.

Bro. Sharp gave such amazing insights in his lectures. Although he can go really fast at times, I definitely felt the Spirit in his class. He gives two options for exams: essay/written or multiple choice.

Ryan Sharp in an incredible lecturer here at BYU. He always provides incredible insights on the scriptures and does well in explaining doctrine through the various stories that he shares. He does go through his lectures pretty quick so make sure you have the study guide open and that you pay attention or you are likely to miss an important detail.

Professor Sharp was an incredible teacher. His lectures were far and away the best I've had in college, and he has a gift for being able to both pack in information into his presentations while also telling fascinating stories. Definitely recommend.

Make sure to attend class, they're pretty engaging and spiritual. The semester-long project is pretty easy. The study guide for tests are detailed but make sure to take notes during lectures to prepare in advance.

Professor Sharp is an amazing teacher! He really cares about the students. Even though he goes a bit fast in lectures, all his slides are online and his tests aren't too hard. He tells amazing stories that really express the principles that we were talking about. If you need to take a religion class, take it from Professor Sharp! He's amazing!!

Brother Sharp is beyond amazing, so in-tune with the savior, conscientious of his students, and shares stories that bring such a special spirit and make class interesting. Only two exams that are totally doable! His lectures were so inspirational and allowed me to learn so much about the Book of Mormon I now feel so prepared for my mission.
Brother Sharp is by far one of the best religion Professors I have had here at BYU. Each class I felt like I learned so many amazing insights as well as some pretty cool Biblical facts!

I really loved Brother Sharp. He has very engaging and fun stories to tell. Required readings of a couple chapters for each lecture but very doable. A BoM project that you do over the course of the semester but it is nothing to worry about. I would take another class from him in a heartbeat! Such a phenomenal teacher!!

Brother Sharp's lectures are so engaging! He shares both spiritual and humorous stories during his lectures, and the learning objectives are always very clear. Tests are open scripture, and there is an option for either multiple choice or free response. I highly recommend taking his class!

All you have to do is show up, write the study objectives in your scriptures,& complete the short assignments weekly. He is clear on what he grades you on and when you can just listen. His 3 projects are open-ended and easy if you choose something you enjoy! Even with a heavy schedule, you can get an A in this class! I want to take it again!

Love Professor Sharp, the only thing I wish was different about the class is that the lectures always felt so rushed. I found it hard to keep up with taking notes and remembering the main ideas for the test.

A lot of students thought he went too fast in lecture, but I found that it helped to keep me engaged. In other classes I get distracted and then I miss material because I'm not focusing, but Professor Sharp's lessons are interesting, inspiring, and always leave me feeling closer to Christ. He's a wonderful storyteller and I like his sense of humor.

HE IS THE BEST! Very easy to get a good grade in the class. Tests are open scripture and you can write your notes in the margins. HIGHLY recommend taking this class if you are looking for an easy and spiritually growing religion credit. Im not the smartest and I still managed to get an A
He's the BEST!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! I LOVE Professor Sharp. He taught us SO well and incorporated hilarious and inspiring stories!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I loved Professor Sharp so much that I took him twice, for BoM and NT. If I could take him again I would. BEST lectures and very manageable course work. We have an attendance quiz and reflection post each week, and a couple projects throughout the semester. Don't let the projects scare you, they're 100% worth it.
Brother Sharp is awesome! His lectures are really interesting/entertaining. Hes reasonable and has a clear grading criteria, as well as study guides for the test. Solid choice.

He was really kind and understanding of his students. He has a final project that you work on throughout the semester, but it was really fun and such a good experience. He let's you write notes in your scriptures to bring for the midterm (there's only one) and for the final.

Amazing professor. Was pretty easy all semester. No complaints. We had our tests online and they weren't proctored. Just fill out the study guide in class or work with others on it and you'll get an A.

Going to Brother Sharp's class was uplifting every single day. The workload is not difficult and I believe it is very reasonable for a religion class. His stories are great, multiple times he had me laughing one minute and nearly crying the next. If I can, I will definitely take his class again. Highly recommend Brother Sharp.

Sharp is easily the best professor I have had at BYU. He shows passion for what he teaches, and makes everyone feel welcome. His class is super easy; basically just show up and take notes on the lecture and you'll get an easy A. The outside of class workload is very little. I would definitely recommend taking 211 or 275 from him!

Sharp is great! Great lecture and class structure. Big thing I didn't like: even after paying attention in every class, I would still find that I would be missing information for his study guide and since he never addressed those things so it was a super frustrating to try rlly hard, go to all lectures, and still miss a lot of points on the exams.

This man is an absolute legend. Definitely take any of his classes if you get the chance. They're pretty easy, but you actually learn a lot of cool things! He knows how to do religion courses the right way. Attendance is important. Tests would be tricky, but he gives you all the questions and answers during the semester. All in all, 10/10. Love him

I LOVED Brother Sharp, he obviously loves his students. There's a good amount of pre-class reading, but they are really amazing! Lecture isn't mandatory because he uses slides, but I absolutely loved going to class and wouldn't miss it for the world. They were very inspirational classes that helped me get through the semester.
Just as a religion class should be. Super meaningful lectures. You learn a lot but don't have to stress too much about grades. Loves his students. Absolutely recommend.

The reason this class was easy was because of how amazing Professor Sharp was at teaching. I genuinely felt inspired and uplifted after every class. He cares deeply for each student. I learned so much about the New Testament this semester. He is there to help you succeed. I highly recommend this class to anyone!

Brother Sharp is genuinely one of the kindest, most personable professors I've had here. However, I felt the class only skimmed the surface of a bunch of familiar stories, rather than diving deeper, so I didn't feel like I actually learned anything new. In the few instances that Brother Sharp did analyze a specific topic, I quite enjoyed it.

Brother Sharp is the greatest storyteller there is. His lectures were really impactful and inspiring. That being said, don't sleep on the midterm because it was extremely difficult and reliant on memorization of little facts. That would be my only critique however. I would suggest taking this class to anyone.

This is for LGBTQ+ peeps trying to find a good religion professor. Bro. Sharp is great. It's a good mix of academic and spiritual. The focus was on Christ and God's love. He's not preachy or judgmental. We had one or two lessons where he explicitly mentioned queer topics and he handled it pretty well, just showing his love and God's for everyone.
Professor Sharp had cool lectures an often gave touching personal stories. Cool dude!

TAKE ANY CLASS FROM HIM! Super easy A class, chill, funny, and spiritual guy. New Testament taught like interesting theology class, not seminary. U choose 10 hr semester project, super easy. Tests can be a bit difficult but study study guide and write notes and will be fine. Allows you to write any notes in scriptures for test. Highly recommend!

This class was an absolute delight! Every time I attended, I felt like he truly cared about the students and wanted them to do their best. He is funny, kind, and very approachable. I would take this class again in a heartbeat!

Professor Sharp was a great professor, and if you like religion classes that are mainly focused on the emotional and spiritual sides of religion rather than the intellectual side, you'll love his class. My only negative feeling about the class was that it felt like seminary at times, which some people do like, but it's just not my cup of tea.

WOW. Sharp was one of the most engaging and spiritual professors I've ever had. He genuinely cares. He also doesn't force masks on anyone's face, which was nice (he doesn't ever wear one). You can tell the gospel is everything to him, and he's a kind, funny, smart, and caring man. He knows the Book of Mormon well, and believes in it fervently.

He is a very good religion teacher who was able to make the class load light, so that we could focus more on actually learning from the Book of Mormon! I looked forward to his lectures every day that I had his class.

I LOVE Brother Sharp. His classes were always filled with the Spirit, and he shared so many amazing stories and experiences. The class was easy: a midterm, final, and final project. He wants you to succeed, but, more importantly, he wants you to grow your testimony.

Although Brother Sharp does not teach to my learning style, I was still able to enjoy his class and succeed. He is very generous in his testing style, and he has very engaging lectures. They move pretty fast, but he makes sure you know what you need to for exams! I would recommend taking his class, especially if you like fast-paced lectures!

Took BOM. Loved his stories and I felt the spirit. Layout of class: Whole time is him lecturing, sometimes was a bit rushed. Has a study guide that is very helpful on tests. All tests are open BOM. Every week have to report on if you did readings and was attentive in class. Every week write 250 words on what you learned. Final a bit hard.

My favorite religion teacher at BYU. His lectures are truly so powerful and inspirational. His class is definitely more spiritual-based, rather than all historical facts-based, which I loved. Would definitely take another class from him, given there was not a single time I left a lecture without feeling uplifted. stop reading and TAKE HIM.
Sharp is great. Tests are a bit too specific regarding certain things he says in the lectures. Pay close attention.
Brother Sharp is such an amazing professor. He really invites the spirit and cares for each of his students.

Brother sharp is fantastic. He's a great lecturer and helped me learn a lot. He gave us the choice to take either a full multiple choice or a full essay test, depending on what would be better for each of us. Stellar class, enthralling lectures, daily reading, weekly attendance. 10/10 will take again.

Professor Sharp is amazing. I think he gets looked over because he isnt as well known as some of the other religion professors, but he is the most genuine person youll meet. His lectures are stellar and he truly cares about every student. I took RELA 275, and it was far easier than the religion classes my friends were taking. Please take him!!

Brother Sharp really does care about you as a student and your success. I always looked forward to attending his lectures. When he spoke the the spirit just entered the room. He shares really cool insights. Answer the questions in the study guide each lecture and write the answers in your copy of the BOM & you should be able to do well on the test!

I decided to do one year of school before going on a mission, and this class has definitely made that choice worth it! I understand the Book of Mormon so much more now, and my testimony has really grown. Brother Sharp is a phenomenal teacher and person who has inspired me to be better in my own life.

LOVED THIS CLASS! Lectures were so inspiring - honestly this was the only class I looked forward to going to in all of my years here. You will have to keep up with the readings and going to class to pass (I got an A- and would have gotten an A if I went to one more lecture). Honestly I 'm not even upset; I learned so much & felt the Spirit daily.

I loved Brother Sharp! He knew the balance between homework, lecture, testimony sharing, and storytelling. His teaching really invited the Spirit, and he was always upbeat. I would 10/10 recommend him for any religion courses.

Taking a class from Professor Sharp is a must do! Every single one of his lectures was super interesting, engaging, and testimony building! I learned so much from the New Testament that I really cherish and will never forget. Professor Sharp is the best! He has definitely been one of my favorite professors at BYU.

Bro Sharp is such an amazing person and professor! This class was my first religion class, and he made it better than I expected. His lectures always bring the spirit, and they coordinate with the exams perfectly. The assignments were always meaningful and never felt like a burden, and he helped me better utilize the Atonement and scriptures.

I really enjoyed Professor Sharp's New Testament class! It definitely pushed me in ways I wasn't expecting, since we had to cover a lot of (similar) material across the four gospels, but I can definitely say that my testimony is strengthened because of the class, especially the project, and I really liked that he was so aware of us as students!

You do not need to worry about your grade or the test. If you fill out the syllabus then you will rock the exams. He is super fair and understanding. Take this class if you want to grow spiritually because as the semester goes on you will come to rely on that spiritually enriching hour in your day.
Very easy class and Bro. Sharp is a fun and interesting teacher.

Brother Sharp is an outstanding lecturer. Even so, sometimes the class is a little disorganized and fast paced so it becomes difficult to keep up with the information you need for the test. So, preparing well for the exams often requires team work and looking at public quizlets. It's an easy-ish class, but not that easy, you know?

Professor Sharp was my favorite professor at BYU so far. He is so funny and makes class so fun. I looked forward to going to his class. His tests are super straight forward because he wants you to succeed. HIGHLY recommend.
The BEST professor I have had at BYU! His lectures were so good that I never wanted to miss a class. The assignments are helpful and interesting so they don't feel like busy work. 10/10
Great professor. Take his class.

I love this professor. He gives you a study guide that you can follow along as he teaches and it helps with the test a lot!! He is a good teacher and the classes were interesting! I would recommend him to anyone!
I have never loved a religion class as much as I loved this class with Brother Sharp. His class is funny, spiritual, and educational all at once. I cannot recommend any class with him enough!

LOVE BROTHER SHARP! I had to stop wearing mascara to class because I always got teary eyed in his lectures no joke. He is so caring and you can tell he is so passionate about the Book of Mormon. The assignments were easy and honestly fun to work on. Brother Sharp was my favorite professor this semester. He's the best.
Brother Sharp was absolutely amazing!! The class was easy and he was so great!! He really made an impact on my life and am forever grateful!! TAKE FROM PROFESSOR SHARP!!!

Brother Sharp is awesome. Very spiritual, knowledgeable, and funny. His lectures are just that. Even though he posts the slides, I would attend the lectures because they're just wonderful. Look up quizlets to fill out the study guides before class - he talks very fast during lectures so it's hard to get everything down during them.

I love Prof Sharp. He is an incredible teacher who really cares about his students. Tests can be a bit tricky, but not to bad if you study. He is great at ministering to the one. His lectures are interesting, and the class is an uplifting and loving environment. Highly recommend.

Brother Sharp is honestly the ideal religion professor. He has a good balance of humor, factual education, and spiritual enlightenment, His assignments are straight to the point and the workload is very manageable. There's a project that you work on throughout the semester and that's basically the hardest thing.

I could not recommend Brother Sharp enough! His classes are very spiritual. Unlike other religion classes there is not a lot of 'busy work.' His grading criteria is very clear and he genuinely wants every student to succeed. Tests are very easy and study guide is clear! Definitely take his class!!

I genuinely felt I learned a lot in this class. Bro Sharp was great, and understood that the priority is spiritual growth, so assignments weren't hard. Gives you a study guide for midterm and test and most answers come from lecture.
Couldn't recommend him enough. Brother Sharp is great.
Brother Sharp is such a great professor. He is so caring and wants you to succeed. There is a decent amount of work for the class, but very reasonable for a two-credit religion class.
Brother Sharp's class was honestly life changing for me! He really balanced focusing on interesting new insights into the Book of Mormon with powerful spiritual experiences. I LOVED this class!

I absolutely loved Brother Sharp. I signed up for his class last minute, and I'm very grateful to have him as a professor. You can tell he loves and cares for all of his students, he wants them to do well. He tells very inspirational stories. His lectures are engaging and he is just hilarious. Would definitely recommend this man to anybody
Loved this class. Bro Sharp is an amazing lecturer, and his class is very-well formatted. Literally just answer the study guide questions in class and you will crush the exams.

I absolutely loved Brother Sharp's class. He has incredible lectures and he lets you know in lecture what's going to be on the exams. There's a midterm and final and as long as you pay attention to lectures you'll do fine.

One of the best Religion Professors I have had. Really good at addressing difficult topics and building faith. He provides a study guide of exactly what is on the final and those questions are discussed in class. Easy to follow, very engaging.
Really great religion professor - tailors lectures to what you want and listens to feedback. Great blend of history and spirituality. Take the class you won't regret it.
Brother Sharp is the best religion professor I've had, he is caring, compassionate, funny, and real. He knows how to teach in such a humble way.

Brother Sharp was absolutely amazing! I can honestly say that I felt the Spirit every day in class. He does such a good job of balancing academic teaching and also making it a comfortable, light-hearted, and peaceful environment. I would 200% recommend him to anyone looking for a great religion professor!

Brother Sharp is hands down the best religion professor I've ever had. His classes are really enjoyable, it isn't homework heavy (mostly just outside of class scripture readings). He has clear grading criteria and really helps you have a spiritual experience every class period. PLEASE TAKE BROTHER SHARP!!!!

Bro. Sharp was incredible! I definitely recommend him for anyone. He's kind, his tests weren't bad (as long as you do the study guide), and he honestly makes an effort to get to know all of his students. Take from Bro. Sharp!!

Took as an online class. I have no significant complaints, I just didn't really feel the Spirit a ton. Felt like the class was more about coming to intellectually understand the scriptures than about actually strengthening your testimony. Especially early on it felt more like a literary analysis class than a religion course. But nice guy for sure.
The lectures are interesting and engaging. He gives you a study guide foe the test that is exactly what you need to know and you can use whatever notes are in your scriptures. GREAT prof.

Brother Sharp is the best religion teacher I have ever had. He is genuine and really cares about his students and truly wants everyone in his class to succeed. My class was on-demand so I was never in person but I still felt the spirit strongly every single lecture. As long as you go to class and take good notes you will get an A. TAKE HIS CLASS.

Amazing and inspirational lectures. I took this online but Bro. Sharp was always willing to be in touch with his students. It was an easy A for me with a lot of opportunities to access spiritual sources. I would strongly recommend taking the essay exam because he gives out the questions a week before. I prepared well and got 100% on all of them.
Amazing professor. Easy class with meaningful assignments. The tests were a lil interesting, but you can use his study guide which helps so much.

I had the most amazing experience with having Professor Sharp as one of my Religion teachers this year. I've struggled with my grades this semester, and he's been so helpful in helping me get my grades up. His lectures are easy and informative, and the work is very easy to do. Definitely take one of his religion courses if you get the chance!

Take Brother Sharp for all of the religion classes he teaches; he is amazing! I've taken him twice now and both times I've had amazing experiences in his class. The typical scripture reading followed by a 300 word discussion on what stood out to you each week. Tests are open scripture and he gives you the answers word 4 word in each lecture!

The amount of help and support given to me this semester by this professor was unimaginable. For most of this course I wasnt going to be even close to passing. However its because of his unparalleled support and faith in me, along with crazy amount of mercy, was I able to do it. No doubt, 100% recommend this wonderful professor.

Professor Sharp is one of the most amazing religion professors I have ever taken a class from. His main purpose for teaching is to enlighten you and to help you grow your testimony. While there are weekly assignments and a big project, Professor Sharp is not out to get you. He is there to help you succeed in his class! I wish I could take more!

This class was really great! Average reading for a religion class, but the tests were really difficult if you didn't have really good notes in your Book of Mormon and tests were worth like 60% of the final grade. Brother Sharp is really funny and I loved watching his lectures. I wish I hadn't take it on demand though.

For an on-demand class, Professor Sharp managed to make the class feel incredibly personal and engaging. He clearly cares about everybody and wants you to succeed. Projects don't require much effort and participation assignments make up a significant portion of the grade. It's hard to gauge how he would teach live, but I'd probably take him again.

I really enjoyed my time in this class. Even though the lectures weren't live, Brother Sharp does a great job of helping his students feel the Spirit. He shared some great stories from his own life that made the lectures much more interesting. I could tell he cares for his students even though it wasn't in person. Great option for a religion class!

I took this class on demand, but professor Sharp structured his lessons so the it still felt like I was learning and getting a lot out of the class. There is a weekly digital dialogue and participation quiz that are super easy!
Brother Sharp was great and helped me dig deeper into the Book of Mormon. His tests are easy and his lectures are entertaining.

Professor Sharp's lectures are filled with stories and doctrinal applications. Never a boring lecture. Tests material is specifically defined in lectures and on a study guide. Expectations are clear. Graded mostly on participation throughout the class. Very good class! Would take him again in a heartbeat.

Honestly a 10/10 experience. I've only had one other religion professor close to as good as Professor Sharp is. He's just really tuned in to what we student need in our lives right now, and honestly his class is a strength/blessing rather than a burden.

This class was awesome and Brother Sharp is a really good professor! He gives way good lectures and the coursework is reasonable, I really even enjoyed doing some of the assignments. Super inspirational and awesome professor all around

Brother Sharp does a great job at balancing historical and intellectual info about the scriptures with the spiritual and application side. He's not one of those professors who makes you memorize the scriptures. It is reading heavy, but his tests and assignments are very straightforward, and his lectures are always interesting and uplifting.

I think Prof Sharp actually saved my life. I received so many answers to my prayers in this class. Grading is so easy. Tests are incredibly straightforward. One of the best and kindest professors at BYU.

He knows his stuff about the scriptures. He taught me so much about the New Testament and Christ's ministry. He lets us use our scriptures on the tests so take notes in your scriptures! I have so many annotations now its great

having the class on demand meant allowed me to listen to all the lectures at 2x speed, which was really nice. 90% of test material comes word for word from the study guide, which he gives at the beginning of the semester and answers all the questions during lecture. Bro Sharp is awesome, funny, and his lectures are engaging and inspiring.

Brother Sharp is super great about making it very clear what will be on exams so students know what to expect and don't feel like they're in the dark. If you're taking a religion course, take from Brother Sharp! He really cares about his students and is always willing to help students with schoolwork or just to have someone to talk to.

Prof. Sharp is the best professor at BYU! A spiritual powerhouse! Even though the class was on-demand it never ceased to amaze me how strongly I was able to feel the spirit. My understanding of the New Testament has changed completely. He is literally the best teacher I have ever had.

Dr. Sharp is an amazing teacher. I felt the Spirit a lot and always left a better person. There were just the right amount of assignments and the workload wasn't unreasonable. I love how he uses scriptures in his lessons while also incorporates his own personal experiences along with quotes from prophets. He is super funny and always made me laugh.

Prof. Sharp is a nice guy who clearly cares about his students and teaching material. The class is fine, and rather easy. He lets you take notes in your Book of Mormon and then use the Book of Mormon on the test. I wasn't a fan of the learning projects he did on top of the lectures, and he also tends to go over on lectures.

I took this class on-demand. It's harder to do a religion class without participation, but Brother Sharp did really well. He focused a little more on the historical side of the Book of Mormon rather than the spiritual side. Tests were open scriptures. There's a 10 hr project, but it's super flexible, so I really enjoyed it.

His philosophy is that feeling the spirit and understanding the principles are more important than stressing over the grade, so he nearly outright tells you what to write down during his lectures. Just keep the study guide open and fill it out while you watch the lecture. His class was one of my favorite and least stressful this semester.

I LOVE bro sharps class! He is so inspirational and cares for his student amidst remote learning. I liked how the exams were open scripture. The class consists of weekly lectures, digital dialogue, and a semester-long project, and 3 learning activities. TAKE HIS CLASS!!
If you're signed up for Bro. Sharp's class, you're gonna have a great semester. He lets you take open note tests. He made me tear up several times this semester.

Brother Sharp shared wonderful thoughts in his lectures. He also introduced us to great resources that help me to ponder the gospel more deeply and receive revelation. He gives out study guides that you can fill out during lecture, and allows you to write notes in your scriptures for tests so the tests were pretty easy. Great professor!!

Easy A, I learned a lot about the Book of Mormon from this class. You can tell Brother Sharp really cares about his students, and he's got lots of great stories to accompany his lectures. This class was on demand, which I hated, but I can't imagine how great Professor Sharp must be in person. 2 midterms, semester long project, weekly assignments

Prof Sharp is amazing, and his lectures are so inspiring. Don't be afraid of the semester long project! Studying before the midterm and final took me about 4 hours each time, but he tells you exactly what is on each!

Absolutely amazing teacher! It was a fantastic class even though it was on demand. Cant imagine how it might be in person! He cares about the students and wants us to succeed and helps us grow spiritually and develop tools and resources to continue to learn in the future.

I LOVED this class! Brother Sharp is amazing!! Super spiritual class and I learned a ton! Fill out study guides as he lectures and tests will be easy. There are weekly reading quizzes, digital dialogues, and a 10 hour project. Not bad at all. This has been my favorite religion class at BYU so far. Highly recommend!!

Bro Sharp makes this class pretty easy. All you need to do is watch lectures, do the digital dialogs, and a couple other assignments. There is a project, but grading is not strict. Tests generally follow study guide pretty well. Great guy, learned a lot and was not too difficult of a class at all.

This class was easily the best experience I've had in a religion class. Professor Sharp is super good at teaching. Very clear what you will be tested on. If you watch the lectures, you will pass. There is a semester long project that requires 10 hours. Anything you want. Super easy. Highly recommend.

Brother Sharp is an amazing professor. He is able to invite the Spirit into each of his lectures. He provides study guides on the midterm and final which were super helpful. The test questions come from the study guides. He wants the success of each of his students.

A lot like Anthony Sweat (take his class if you like Prof Sharp). Digital dialogues each week are rather long but easy points. The tests arent hard by any means, but sometimes the questions feel a little different that what you studied in the study guide. Easy to get an A, but hard to get 100 on the tests. Hes AMAZING! Definitely add his class

Sharp is an amazing teacher so much that I plan on taking him next semester for another class. It consists of pre-lecture readings, two lectures each week, a self evaluation quiz each week saying you did the readings and lectures, a semester long project, a midterm, and a final. In lectures he tells you what is on the final basically word for word.

He makes it clear what will be on the test and they aren't too hard. His lectures are spiritual and entertaining. He's willing to work with students when things come up. Course was on demand but well structured (didn't demand too much but prevented procrastinating to the end of the semester). I hope to take more courses from him in the future

Professor Sharp is AMAZING. I took it on demand, but it was incredibly structured with pre-recorded lectures and weekly assignments. He perfectly balances learning, feeling the spirit, and getting a good grade. He gave study guides at the beginning of each term that literally have EVERYTHING on the test and he bases the lectures around them.

Brother Sharp is absolutely amazing, he is hilarious, keeps his lectures interesting engaging. If you watch the lectures, and fill out the study guide as you go, it is an easy A. He literally gives you the answers in the lecture. He loves the gospel and his students and you can tell! Def would recommend any class taught by him

Brother Sharp's class changed my life and how I live the gospel everyday. I took his class this past summer and I think about his class often and I will never forget the impact he had on me. If you're thinking about taking his class DO IT! Easy to get an A as well he obviously cares more about how much you learn than your grade. Love this man.

Brother Sharp is a professor that I love for his seeming care and effort. The Lord loves effort, so I think the Lord loves Brother Sharp. I appreciate the straightforward structure of the class. He offers everything a BYU student could want from a religion class.

This class has honestly been life changing for me. Brother Sharp had a great balance where I was constantly gaining new insights into the four gospels while also having powerful spiritual experiences. My ability to understand the scriptures and my love for the Savior have both increased dramatically throughout this semester. Best religion class!
Brother Sharp is such an amazing teacher! He is such a great example and shares lots of real-life examples. His assignments are meaningful and I feel the spirit in every lecture.

I met Bro Sharp when he was my 9th grade seminary teacher. He's still my favorite professor to this day. His class is currently on demand with the whole pandemic situation. But it is very straight forward. There is a study guide for the midterm and final with EVERYTHING you need to know on it so take good notes in your scriptures during lectures.

I took this class on demand. Each week you have to watch two lectures, read two sections of the BofM, and submit a reflection on the week's assignments. Prof. Sharp's lectures are a good mix of story and lecture, but I always struggle to balance writing in my BofM & filling out the study guide while watching the lecture. Despite that, I recommend!!

Seriously the best! There is a great balance of academically focused and feeling the spirit. The lectures are amazing, the tests are manageable, and his assignments are focused on helping us study the scriptures. Because of this class I am planning on serving a mission and am so excited! 10/10

Ryan Sharp is an all-around good dude. His class was detailed so there is a lot you ca learn. However, he gives an extremely detailed study guide for both tests. He's super clear about how he'll grade assignments and there really are only a handful of major assignments. Once a week there's a short essay and he lets you make your own final project.

Honestly this guy stands out as a professor. I had him for my on-demand Book of Mormon doctrines class and didn't have real face time with him, but his lectures were uplifting, funny, entertaining, and edifying. His workload is sooooo light and you have to be trying to fail this class. Makes it easier to focus on learning and enjoying the material

Professor Sharp is seriously the best. I took this class online and was worried I wouldnt get the full experience, but I felt the Spirit during every single lecture and it always felt like he shared exactly what I needed to hear. It is definitely one of those classes where you get out what you put into it. Great story teller, too!

He really cares about his students. More important than that, though, is that his class is very easy. You are allowed to use your Book of Mormon and any notes you put on it on the tests. As long as you take notes on what he says, you'll get easy 100s on the tests.

Such an amazing teacher!! He makes class interesting but also very spiritual and tells lots of personal stories to help you understand concepts. Assignments are easy, mostly just a weekly insight journal on what you read that week. Such a great guy. I never talked to him face to face but I could feel his love for me and all his students!!

Bro Sharp is the best teacher I've had at BYU. His lectures are both interesting and spiritual. He gives u 75% of will be on the exams and they're open scripture. Digital dialogue on class every week so you have to attend but its worth it and super easy. One project that he gives you all semester to work on but its easy as well. Best teacher &class

Professor Sharp is such an amazing teacher. I was afraid of having religion classes at BYU be strictly academic without any spiritual insight whatsoever and he flipped that. Easy grader and gives you every opportunity to do well.

Brother Sharp is the BEST religion professor I have ever had. His lectures were so funny yet so spiritual and I learned so much. Tests are open book so as long as you take notes in your scriptures it's an easy A. Would recommend him to everyone!

Brother Sharp has found the perfect balance of emphasizing the need to understand and live the gospel and the need to accomplish work for the grade. I loved his lectures and his stories. His class is spiritually strengthening and intellectually stimulating. I would recommend him to anyone!

Brother Sharp is amazing! He is really interested in each student's experience and will listen to any feedback you have. Class is really entertaining and he teaches really amazing things about The Book of Mormon. This class really changed my experience with scripture and taught me how to study religion more effectively. Tests are open book!

Professor Smith is very caring and inspirational. His lectures are never boring and really engaging. His classes always taught me something new. He lets you know what exactly is on test and scriptures are allowed to be used during. Good class and amazing professor.,

The "textbook" is The New Testament, and pdf(s) of portions of Books/commentaries that he provides in Learning Suite. You can't miss the weekly self-report that you did the reading and participated, attended class, etc. That is a large portion of the grade. I thought Professor Sharp did a great job of having a scholarly approach+spiritual.

He is a great religion professor. It's no harder then it should be, he leaves you uplifted, and just a great guy. He does test directly from lecture, so make sure you are there. But tests are open not, so write in your scriptures.

TAKE THIS CLASS FROM HIM! I wish I could take it again from him. Every day as we finished class I would turn to my friend and say "Wow". He has great personal stories, fantastic insights that really helped me understand the BOM better.
Brother Sharp is good at connecting the Gospel of Jesus Christ to everyday life. His lectures are both informative and inspiring. However, "this man loves himself some trees."

One of the best classes I have ever taken, PERIOD! You learn so much, the assignments and project are easy, and he always shares cool personal stories to end class that bring the Spirit on an incredible level. Plus, you can take your marked scriptures into exams!!! It helps you learn how to truly study and search the scriptures. TAKE HIM PLEASE!

Such an amazing class. You learn a lot without having to worry about your GPA getting crushed. Cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Attendance taking, digital dialog, 3 learning activities, BOM project, and syllabus quiz. He made it fun and taught well. Would rate him as one of the BEST religion profs. Take from him if possible.

Professor Sharp did a great job teaching the New Testament this last semester. He always goves you the study guide that you need to know for the test and makes his lectures fun and interesting. I loved his New Testament class and Book of Mormon class.

Brother Sharp is such an amazing professor. His lectures are amazing. The way he tells his stories are amusing, but he always ends them so that they are spiritual. He knows how to teach. I would 100% recommend his New Testament class.

Brother Sharp's New Testament class was my favorite religion class I've ever taken. He's extremely funny and caring. His class isn't too hard, and he accepts late work. His tests are open scripture and writing notes in the scriptures is allowed.

Professor Sharp is an amazing teacher. His lectures were incredibly spiritual and inspirational. The tests are the hardest part but even then its open scripture. Make sure to take notes during class. He pretty much gives you 90% of what is on the tests the beginning of each class. The project is easy. Weekly digital dialogue and quiz but its easy.

Absolutely loved Dr Sharp! Every class was a spiritual bombshell of awesomeness. It's all about the gospel, yet every lecture, Dr Sharp brings something up in a way that I've never thought about before. My scriptures are filled with amazing notes and insights from the class. The assignments are easy and it's more about the learning than anything.

I LOVE BRO SHARP! 2 tests: midterm and final, open scripture (with notes you wrote in), one project that's 10 hours through the semester, three learning activities, and weekly readings/reflections. Hs class got me through the semester. Really cares about his students. I even had spiritual experiences taking his tests, if that tells you anything.

Love him! 1 midterm and 1 final. Fill out the study guide during lectures and that's exactly what's on the test-no trick questions and very clear. One 10 hr project of your choice throughout the semester. Wkly digital dialogues on what you liked from lecture. Wkly quizzes on your honor asking if you read/went to class. A no stress religion class!

I think the best thing that I can say about my experience in Brother Sharp's class is that I feel like I really learned how to study the scriptures and I truly came to know my Savior. I had so many wonderful experiences and am so grateful I took this class!

Brother Sharp has some of the best stories ever, however, at times his lectures could get dry. There was also quite a bit of reading for this class, and the tests were hard. That being said, Brother Sharp really does love all his students and wants them to do well. Self reporting quiz each week, 3 learning activities, project (easy), 2 tests.

Brother Sharp is the best religion teacher I have ever had at BYU. He's a jokester but knows how to switch gears and bring the Spirit into EVERY lecture. Attendance is mandatory, but I always looked forward to going to his lectures and was genuinely sad when I couldn't go. And if this isn't enough to convince you, his tests are open scripture :)

Brother Sharp is kind and caring. He is aware that his class is only a 2 credit class and that we have many other classes, so he never bombards us with work. His tests are open New Testament and he gives you a study guide that you can fill out during his lectures. His classes are inspiring and I LOVE coming to class.

This class is not difficult, but you'll learn a lot and have some great spiritual experiences. I really enjoyed this class because Bro. Sharp realizes that you have other classes as well, and wants it to be a class where you experience personal growth and have meaningful experiences, not to just take a test and get a grade.

Great man. He cares about you as a student and despite the fact that he has thousands of students he's willing to help you as much he can. Loves the gospel and makes learning about it an interesting and spiritual experience. Also pretty funny.
Fantastic professor, great stories and memorable lessons!!
I really love him, he brings the Spirit, tells lots of personal stories and really cares about all of his students. There are weekly assignments but keep up to date on those and you will be fine.

Brother Sharp is the best!! He is so passionate about the gospel and cares about his students. He tells the best stories and I always walked out of class feeling spiritually uplifted. He lets you take your scriptures in for the midterm and there is a Book of Mormon project throughout the semester that is fairly easy. Take a class from him!!!

Brother Sharp is the best religion teacher I have ever had the opportunity to take a class from. He relates to his students and creates an environment where everyone can share their thoughts and feelings. He loves the gospel and his testimony has strengthened me. I feel a deeper love and understanding for the New Testament because of this class

Solid class. Amazing lectures, clear expectations, and you can tell he is passionate about the gospel. Learning about the Book of Mormon from an academic perspective has been eye opening and has changed the way I study.

I LOVE BROTHER SHARP! This class is EXACTLY what I thought a religion class would be like. I have learned sooo much about the Book of Mormon and have felt the Spirit in every class. He tells us in class specific things that we need to know for the test. Easily my fav class at BYU so far! 10/10

This class feels like a high school seminary class. It's unbearably surface level. Dude loves himself some trees

Took him for New Testament and he's probably one of the best religion professors I've had!! He cares a lot about his students and is willing to work with you if you can't get something done. We had weekly assignments of just writing about lecture/readings for the week. The midterm and final are open-book and super easy!

I LOVE BROTHER SHARP! Hands down best religion professor. Don't want to sound dramatic, but I wanted to cry by the end of class because the spirit was so strong. Just do the assignments, go over the powerpoints, show up to class, and it's honestly an easy A. PUT NOTES IN SCRIPTURES from class and powerpoint since you can take it to testing center!

Brother Sharp is amazing at incorporating his own, relatable experiences into factual and historical narratives about the New Testament. He is engaging and will not test you over material you didn't learn. Not too much work outside of class, but there is one big project. Since it lasts the whole semester, it isn't too hard to complete.

Ryan Sharp has amazing lectures. They are funny, spiritual, and help students who are struggling. I however hated this class. If you are extremely organized and turn dozens of things in on time, but are terrible at exams, you WILL get an A. ///This is the class for you///. I am disorganized but good at exams and I did terrible in the class.

I loved having Brother Sharp as my professor this past semester! He was amazing and really personalized the scriptures for me. I am taking another class from him next semester as well. Don't miss out on taking a class from him. As long as you attend class the tests are easy!
Class was easy and I got a lot out of it. Bro. Sharp is funny and truly inspiring.

Bro. Sharp is awesome! Really cares about students individually! Class wasn't too hard but you have to understand the scriptures fairly well since the tests are open BOM, its not surface level questions. His lectures are amazing and I came away inspired.

Brother Sharp loves his students and what he does. He tries really hard in all of his lectures to have an environment where the spirt can be. As long as you take notes in class and read the scriptures his tests were super easy (also he allowed ALL exams to be open scriptures sooo...). His lectures are engaging and interesting and uplifting.

Super fun class! You don't have to go to all the classes, but it is extremely helpful to do so, just make sure you get the notes. Professor Sharp is super funny and caring, you can tell he cares about his students and understands the scriptures well. I learned a lot from him and his class.

Such a wonderful man. He doesn't want his class to be one that students need to stress over. It's intellectually enlarging, while still being very spiritually strengthening. Sometimes he would rush through lectures in order to cover everything, but I'm sure he'll work on improving in that area. Not too hard, but go to class to learn from Bro. Sharp

Professor Sharp is amazing! As a non member, it was tough at times, but I was able to learn a lot. He knows how to teach and bring the spirit into the classroom at the same time. I loved him. Will be taking another class from him next semester!

Professor Sharp teaches really insightful classes! My New Testament class was both scholarly and spiritual and the tests were open book. He speaks really quickly during the lectures, but if you pay attention you'll get a lot out of it!

Brother Sharp possibly taught my favorite class this semester. His lectures and stories were very inspiring and I learned so much about the Book of Mormon that I didnt know before. His assignments might be a littke time-consuming, but they arent anything that cant be done. He prepares you very well for the tests. Easy A if you do what is asked.

Professor Sharp is an amazing professor and friend. He genuinely cares about his students and his lectures are SO good. Tests are open book so my scriptures now have so many new cool insights. So led by the spirit. He is the BEST>>>>

Pro. Sharp knows the doctrine he is trying to convey and he can teach one principle in three different ways all in the same class. He wants everyone to succeed. He is your biggest supporting in learning the material. If you show up to class and take/write in your scriptures the tests will be easy and the tests are the hardest part of the class.

Brother Sharp is amazing. Really wants his students to do well. His lectures were very inspiring and my testimony was strengthened so much because of this class. Not to mention, he's also hilarious! Take this class!

I loved Professor Sharp's class so much! He really cares about his students and does everything he can to help you succeed. Tests are open scripture (and open notes in scriptures). Super nice guy. Real easy A. Just show up and take notes in scriptures. Exams are open-scripture and essays are super easy. Honestly one of the easiest classes I have ever had.
Very good at explaining the scriptures. Tests aren't too hard, and you can use the scriptures. He really wants all of his students to do well.

In all of my other religion classes at BYU so far I felt as though I was studying the material solely from an academic perspective and I rarely felt the spirit. In Prof. Sharp's class though, I learned so much as we took an academic approach to the New Testament, but he didn't let that distract from the spirit, and I truly feel closer to my Savior.

OKAY SO I USUALLY DONT DO THIS! but holy crap! he is the absolute greatest religion professor. You do have weekly assignments due Saturday night, and I would forget. SERIOUSLY thats the only thing. he is so inspirational and he loves to teach this subject. every lesson I felt the lesson so strong and is the reason I am starting my mission papers!

Bro Sharp is an incredible professor! He combines both spirituality and contextualism to give a good balance to the New Testament. Very clear in his grading, and simple, meaningful assignments (no busywork). Engaging classes, and great insight. Would recommend him to anyone. A professor who really wants his students to succeed and grow.

Great guy, allows open book and even the journal edition for the midterm and final. You can tell he loves teaching about the gospel and working with his students. He also has great stories. The powerpoints are long, but he will always post them. Assignments are not intensive. Just one big BoM project of your choosing to work on the whole semester.

Class moves too fast. We didn't cover all the material for the midterm, so he sent a power point with 60+ slides and then we were tested on it. Very annoying. TA was nice, and responded quickly. I don't normally post on here but just wanted to say that Brother Sharp is unlike any other professor I have had. I am honestly a better person because I took this class
This class is exactly what I hoped religion classes would be like. I have learned a ton about the New Testament and have felt the Spirit every class. It is the perfect balance. 10/10

I loved this class. Brother Sharp is really good at balancing historical context with spiritual insights. He goes deeply into the material, but allows you to use your scriptures (and notes) on tests so it is manageable. I learned a lot and would definitely take the class again!

BEST BYU RELIGION PROFESSOR! I've taken two classes from him. I feel the spirit every day and you learn some really cool stuff. Tests/assignments are easy so long as you take notes in your scriptures which you can take into the testing center! Highly recommend.

I can honestly say that this class has been life changing for me! I wasnt looking forward to religion classes when I first got here but this class has made me love them and never want to miss a class! He is the best religion professor I have had at BYU and does a phenomenal job of teaching the scriptures in a way that is really engaging.

Seriously the best religion professor out there. Do NOT take this class from any other professor. He is the BEST. He is so funny &so caring &made learning the New Testament awesome. I seriously had a whole new conversion with this class. Best professor on BYU campus. His classes are very inspirational and he wants us to succeed and become better people. He loves his job and he loves his students. Take his class, you wont regret it.

I LOVED Professor Sharp. His lectures were incredible, and he gave me so many new insights into the Book of Mormon. He tells you exactly what to expect on the tests and they're open book, so it's super easy, and if the class GPA is low, he raises everyone's grade. He's genuinely interested in helping us strengthen our faith and passing the class

TAKE BOOK OF MORMON FROM HIM!! Professor Sharp is a great professor and I felt like I learned a lot from this class with out it being too difficult. He lets you use your Book of Mormon on tests and there is one large project due at the end of the semester. Readings self reported.

A lot of people will say that Sharp is a great guy but he gives impossible tests. & they were right about one thing: Sharp is a great guy. He is funny, engaging, and passionate about his job. Brother Sharp was the best religion professor I have had. He really cares about his students. He bore a powerful testimony every class period and was able to make class intellectually enlarging without overwhelming us. Amazing class!

This is my second class from professor sharp and it is been a great experience. I have enjoyed the readings and his lectures really are incredible! He really tries to help us get more out of our own scripture study.
Brother Sharp is a great guy with great stories. He gives you every opportunity to pass with flying colors.

Brother Sharp's class was an answer to my prayers! I had been struggling with my testimony and found my faith strengthened in every one of his lectures. I wasn't born into the church and nor have I attended seminary or institute. His class is very lecture heavy, and covers a ton of information. Brother sharp created an environment very conducive to the spirit. No matter what mood I entered his class, I left with an increased love for the savior and an increased energy and positive outlook on my life.

Bro. Sharp is funny, but there's two exams for the whole semester, which I wouldn't mind if I'd gotten decent grades on them. Also, there's important stuff due every Sat, and there's almost no mercy if you miss one of them

Brother Sharp does an amazing job at bringing excitement into the Book of Mormon. His lectures were great and I felt the spirit in each class. You can tell he really does care about his students. He compiles a list of "to knows" from each lecture that can help you study for the exams. I would take this class again if I could.

Brother Sharp is awesome, his lectures are inspirational, and he cares about his students. He brings the people of The Book of Mormon to life and makes them so real, I would recommend him to anyone who asks.

This class was the best mission prep I could have ever hoped for! I learned a ton about the Book of Mormon and my testimony of the restored gospel has increased so much. Bro Sharp has a gift to help the scriptures come alive! So glad took this class

Brother Sharp could very easily be the best religion professor a BYU Student will ever have. Not an attribution to say lightly! He's incredibly genuine & loves his students. Professor Sharp is the man! He is almost unknown by students but he is awesome. He combines humor, spirituality and deep analysis to create a fantastic learning experience! If you do your readings and go to class you will get an A. He gives you the test topics for every lecture and lets you bring your annotated scriptures into tests.

LIFE-CHANGING! Every single class there was some new insight from the Book of Mormon that would blow me away! Brother Sharps teaching style is so authentic that it made me want to come to class. If you want a class that will Stimulate your mind but also help you feel the Holy Ghost, this is it! FAVORITE CLASS AT BYU!

This class was an absolute blessing for me this past semester! Brother sharp was so committed to helping us learn from the Book of Mormon but also to establish an environment where we could learn from the Holy Ghost directly. Even though there were regular assignments it always felt like I could get an A. I LOVED this class and highly recommend!
Incredible lectures, hilarious, and reasonable with the work load. Basically another Hank Smith!

I absolutely loved this class! Brother Sharp seriously blessed my life. I always enjoyed and looked forward to going to class. This course is awesome! His work load is not unreasonable and I learn very well in this environment. Because I know he cares about me as a student, my desire to participate is increased and has led to greater growth. Favorite teacher at BYU!
Too much homework. This is the classic 2 credit class with the load of a 3 credit class. Make yourself a favor and don't take it from him.

Brother Sharp learned my name and remembered it. I loved his enthusiasm for the gospel and his example of gospel living. It was such an amazing experience to have been a part of this class. He is one of the great ones!

I would take another class from Bro Sharp in a heartbeat! He knows the scriptures inside and out. Whenever a student asked him a question he knew where to turn in the scriptures to find the answer. I looked forward to class every day! We had a lot of information thrown out way but I liked it because there was always something new to learn! LOVE IT!

Brother Sharp was my favorite professor this year. He changed my thinking of the scriptures and was simultaneously inspiring and inviting. His class was such a safe learning environment. Take this class!
Professor Sharp is the best teacher I have had! He loves his students, He loves his work, and the spirit guided our classes. This class motivated me to want to be better.

I LOVE BROTHER SHARP! He was a great professor to have starting out my freshman year at BYU. Im grateful for all he taught me about the Book of Mormon and how I became a better person. I hope to take another class from him next semester.

My final grade was right on the line and with Dr. Sharps willingness to curve the final I was able to get an A. I have to say that I felt the Spirit in this class more than any other religion class I have taken. Highly recommend

This is my last semester and I definitely saved the best religion teacher for last! Professor Sharp was great at keeping us interested and engaged even though we were in a large classroom.
