He is a very good religion teacher.  The best I have had so far.  Very spiritual, but makes you laugh too.  The tests are pretty easy if you pay attention and read the assignments.  Outside class assignments not hard at all.  Highly Recommended

Great teacher, highly recommended. He lets you know exactly what will be on the tests- and you can present your point of view on questions you don't think were fair,etc. One of the best religion teachers I've had.

He came and taught for Bro. Robinson and I was astounded!  I enjoyed his lecture so much that I attended his 8 o'clock class even though I was never registered for it.  He has a great love for the gospel and you leave his class feeling the same.

Brother Esplin is a great teacher.  He makes the course really interesting and makes it easy to learn.  His tests are easy as long as you pay attention in class and he is genuinely interested in finding answers to questions (related to the class or not).

Excellent teacher! The class is pretty easy, and you learn a ton. It is about the best I can think of so take it! He gives 2 tests and a final, a short presentation that is really nothing, and a 10 pop-quizzes of which only 7 count. Just read and be fine

He was a great lab professor. Depending on whether coding is your strong suit or not determines how easy this class is for you, takes time. Probably the least difficult of all junior core classes. Lloyd is amazing though, explains things well and willing to take the time to sit with you and debug and understand code.

Dr. Lloyd is a very caring professor. He is endlessly patient with his students, many times sat with me in lab longer than anyone should have to to help me debug code. Cares a lot and very willing to work with you if you have issues.

Took it Spring; he taught both the lectures and the labs. His exam review sections are very helpful, covering all the most likely missed concepts and details in the exams. He is also super accessible outside of class; you can knock on his office door anytime before 6 pm, and he'll help. 20 people in total; 11 got A, 2 got A-; class avg is 92.75.

He taught the lab portion, and the class is organized very well. The labs can be difficult, but we are told what to do in such a clear manner that they don't feel unmanageable. I already had some C programming experience, so these labs did feel fairly simple for me which may not be everybody's experience. That said, most students got an A in lab.

Scott Lloyd is the ideal engineering professor: highly experienced in the field, and deeply concerned about student progress. Very approachable both in and out of class. The projects can be difficult, but he'll stick around for hours and hours helping students through their issues.

The structure of this class is difficult, so the professor can be the difference between passing and failing. The class starts out as difficult. It is essential to do the readings, these are a huge help in understanding the material. By the time I got to the tests, I was able to perform well on them. This is a passable class, just takes effort.

Had him for ECEN330 as well: very kind and willing to help. He knows a lot, but I feel like it is hard to follow how he solves ECEN problems when he teaches and offers help: also, lectures are a little boring. The classes weren't hard though, and the labs were very interesting. He is a sweet person, and always offers to help (And he knows names :)

In both 390 and 323, Dr. Lloyd is both caring and sympathetic to students. He often stays well into the evening to help students struggling to finish labs. Goes above and beyond to make sure we can make the progress we need to. A genuinely kind individual, and has some good industry experience to back up his teaching too. He's here for the students

The class itself is pretty much just self-guided. His weekly lectures were not super helpful in terms of the class, but good to get some weekly inspiration. Not super helpful in lab sessions, though. Willing to accommodate and work with you, though. I think he would be better with other classes, but struggled with this one due to its unique nature.

This class is hard for the wrong reasons. The questions on homework and the tests are confusing (and sometimes the "correct answers" and just wrong), you only get one chance on the homework so there aren't any second chances, and there's no late policy so if you miss something you just get a 0. This class needs some major restructuring.

I'm not sure why there aren't more reviews here, because the general consensus among ECEn 330 students was largely negative. The lectures felt wholly unnecessary, and the labs were graded based on a coding standard that was ridiculously harsh. There were questions on the exams that not a single student answered correctly, and yet they never curved.

He would spend an hour talking about personal achievements and stories, and then the last 30 minutes would be a quick skim of the homework. His lectures were incredibly boring and most of the students would be on other websites. His tests were ridiculous and, when combined with other Junior Core classes, added way more stress than necessary.

Dr. Lloyd is super great + caring. Spends a bunch of time popping into the lab just to see how we're doing and help us with our code, which you don't get from every professor. His lectures aren't always exciting, but he always starts out with an experience from industry or a cool example of embedded tech, etc. Will def take from him again if I can.

I took ECEN 220 twice from him, (had to drop it the first time cause of life stuff), but both times he was just as consistent and incredible. It was during Covid and he was determined to help us learn despite the grim state of the world. Go to him for help, pay attention, and do the HW. He will help you grasp the EE/CE fundamentals!!

Professor Lloyd is a great guy, teaching a hard class. I took it during COVID, so it was all online, and it was his first time teaching it. It felt like he was still getting the hang of things with the lectures. But, he often stayed after to chat, and was always available for help. Very nice to talk to. He has lots of knowledge and experience.

Lloyd is the nicest professor. His lectures get a little boring at times, but he is always available and excited to help you, even outside of class times. I had trouble with certain concepts and he met with me over zoom for about an hour to help me understand. The class itself is tough, but Lloyd is a good choice because he wants you to succeed.

Dr. Grimshaw is super funny and friendly. He is a great teacher, and his course is very well designed. I have no idea what happened in 2021 to tank his reviews so badly. I wouldn't have wanted to take this class from any other professor!

He's for sure a funny dude, and he teaches really well. I had a hard time paying attention because I already knew how to R code since I took the classes backwards. He's pretty picky about how things look in the code but he's super nice and I had great TAs.

My biggest complaint with Dr. Grimshaw was that the instructions for some of the HWs and projects were pretty ambiguous and I didn't really understand what the grading criteria was. Honestly other than that he taught really well and I feel I learned a lot and he is super caring and willing to chat in office hours.

His teaching methods were effective (at least for me), and there were always great resources to learn the material. We would do a short textbook reading before each class, and then class was usually review. 60% of the grade is tests, but they're pretty easy if you know the material. Overall, I loved his teaching methods and his willingness to help.

Dr Grimshaw is really great, he taught programming in a flipped way so we started off with data visualization, and he gave us the frameworks of the code, which was nice because you could see progress in your coding early on, then over the semester it lessen until you are programming by yourself. If you do the hw you will be prepared for the project

Dr. Grimshaw is a great professor and did a great job teaching R programming. He was very effective at covering general concepts in R as well as specific applications of those concepts. Assignments are due once a week and are quite easy as long as you know the material and avoid procrastination. Overall, great professor and great class!
Dr.Grimshaw is most respected professor. He teaches concept clearly and his exam is based on the homework.  even if the homework looks hard, you can get a help in the stat lab.

Dr. Grimshaw is incredible! He makes concepts digestable and balances examples, coding time, projects, and lectures really well. I liked that there were no exams and instead were projects. He makes it interesting and relevent. I greatly enjoyed  his class and would take him again!

Prof Grimshaw is super respectful and caring! I was able to go talk to him outside of class hours many times and he helped me so much! The class was super fun, we had one homework assignment a week and they usually didn't take to long if you knew where to find the stuff in the notes. Lectures were entertaining and he always made sure we understood!

Professor Grimshaw is very passionate about what he teaches. He was available to students who needed extra help and the work load was very manageable. His lectures felt a bit hard to follow at times, and sometimes he reacts poorly when students answer/ask questions, but he really means well and at the end of the day I learned a lot from him.

4 years of school, and I cannot say I have ever had a more uncaring, stuck-in-his-universe professor than Dr. Grimshaw. His HWs are derived from the book, plus a few additional problems. He will NOT help you understand the latter before or after HW submission. Exams are engineered to fail (e.g., 40% average on Exam 1 for my section). Not worth it.

Do you want a professor who teaches clearly, helps you with assignments, and wants you to learn? THEN DONT TAKE Grimshaw. He is the worst professor Ive ever had at BYU. Ask a question in class be belittled in front of seventy other students. He somehow made a 1.5 credit class that is an introduction to programming difficult.

The class is somewhat hard. The final is ruthless, but he said there wouldn't be a curve, but I ended up getting one somehow. Think he is nicer than he acts sometimes. I liked the lectures. You just code in them and he explains stuff. Makes you turn in your class notes for a grade which made me pay attention. Didn't like the course material much.

I have mixed feelings about Dr. Grimshaw. He can be a nice guy, but his grading is tough! His class is HARD. I had no coding experience going in and it felt like I was drowning. Hw took forever. Go to the TAs for help! The final seriously had the most insane time limit! I liked the project though. This was definitely a tough class and a lot of work

Do not take any class from this professor unless it is absolutely necessary. The worst professor I have had to deal with during my college experience. I thought these comments were harsh until I had him myself, and I would say these comments are too nice now.
Prides himself on being a "ruthless" grader without being clear on material for important grades such as the final.

Dr. Grimshaw seems like a nice person, but I hated him as a professor. The hw is doable if you go to TA office hours, but the project rubric is very vague. The final exam had a very strict time limit and he expects you to not do well in it. Take this class from another professor if you can.

Try to avoid taking any statistics classes from him. He made me afraid to ask questions in class which is really odd considering that professors are supposed to help students when they don't understand something during a lecture. Also, his instruction on the final project was very vague and not clear at all.

Tbh, I don't think I learned much from his class. He expected us to write all the code that he wrote in class for participation so I was busy trying to type out all of the code that he wrote during class and I couldn't really pay attention to anything else which made it harder for me to learn about what the code is supposed to do.

Do what you can to avoid taking this professor. He's passive aggressive in the way he responds to questions in class and his tests are subjectively graded. If you have 100 percent in the class leading to the final it likely won't be enough for an A. The final has a crazy short time limit w/no curve. He doesn't care about you or your success.

I really liked how clear and easy to understand his code was. He did a good job of explaining what he was doing in class. What I didn't like was how poorly the projects were designed and explained. I felt like most of the students really didn't know what they would be graded on, and he was pretty stubborn about making any adjustments.

Terrible Class. Belittles students and seems to take pride in being the smartest person in the room. He almost seems to like how it is difficult to get an A, and doesn't seem like he actually wants students to do well.

Class was difficult because he expected ALL of us to understand everything as it was. He was pretty unwilling to offer clarification which is strange because most professors are happy to do so. Final is extremely hard and this class in general caused a lot of unnecessary stress for it being a 1.5 credit class. I really did not enjoy this class.

His projects were not clear at all, he basically expected you to read his mind to know what to do. TA's never really knew what he wanted either, so they did not help much. His tests set you up to fail as he does not expect you to finish all the questions or answer them to the detail you want due to his short time limit. Don't take him if possible.

I understand that this was his first semester teaching it and all but his homeworks and mini projects were not a clear reflection of what was being taught in class. They would contain questions more complicated than what he taught and he would gloss over the most important functions during class with little explanation.

Do you like having a professor that tells you what he expects from you? Do you not enjoy getting yelled at when you ask a question in class? Do you expect TAs to show up to office hours and not cancel them the morning of their shift? Do you want to actually learn coding? If yes to any of these questions, take this class from someone else.

Dr. Grimshaw seemed nice at first but a lot of his "niceness" was only surface level. He occasionally lost his cool and was pretty passive-aggressive when students tried to ask questions to understand projects (and other innocent questions) better when he honestly had provided very unclear instructions for the project.

Dr. Grimshaw really know what he's talking about, but I like him because he doesn't just give away the answers. You have to do the work yourself to figure out projects and homework and I have learned so much. He definitely gives you everything you need to succeed, it just depends on how you use it!

So Dr. Girmshaw tends to be very polarizing, personally I liked him a lot. He's not going to baby you and he expects you to put in the work to understand concepts I know a lot of people struggled to understand how to do the projects he assigned us... but I feel like most people were being pretty dramatic. If you put in the work you will learn a lot

If you want a class where you try to figure out what your professor wants you to do rather than receive clear instructions, then Dr. Grimshaw is your guy. If you want to know what's expected of you for projects, this is the worst class you could take. Not even the TA's know what's going on. It's ridiculous.

This is the type of class where you're expected to be able to read the professor's mind when it comes to expectations. Grading, projects, and homework are not clear. It's the type of environment where it is unnecessarily difficult to get an A. R is a very useful and interesting, and this class does not make it enjoyable.
Most Unclear professor ever even the TAs are confused about how exactly he wants the projects done He just assumes you know what he wants.

I thought his teaching style for this course was appropriate. He tends to follow the textbook a bit, but since he doesn't record his lectures it's nice to have something to fall back on. It was useful and worthwhile to run through the code together in class. The final is challenging, but if you do well on the HW/project your grade will be fine!

I love to code and R is actually really easy. Well, it is until you get to the homework that you have to teach yourself how to do. He is unclear about how to get a good grade in his class and seems to expect failure from the text of the syllabus.

Professor Grimshaw is a unique professor who can be quirky but is really genuine. He is always willing to answer questions and be kind to students! The class is him coding and explaining what he is coding, and if you follow along and take notes you will learn a ton. He also follows the book extremely well so if you miss anything you can find it!

Does not know how to teach, His lectures are him just coding and talking about code, not actually teaching. The quizzes have nothing to do with the lectures and you have to learn everything from the book. He also does not seem confident in anything he does. Do not take stat 123 from him.

First time teaching a "corona class" via Zoom. He just read the textbook to us. Grading criteria was super vague and he didn't answer questions clearly. Lectures were useless but required. He did not convey material well. Maybe he is better in-person, but I will not take another class from him to find out.

Most of the grade is class attendance, tests are really easy and you do them as a group. There is some theory homework and a theory test that are actually pretty hard. This class has some cool applications that you learn, you don't really learn the intuition behind these applications though.

I have very mixed feelings about Grimshaw. I learned more real application with statistics from this class than I have from any other stats class. On the other hand, he is the most intimidating and stubborn professor I've ever had. His policy of no help on theory homework is ridiculous and kept me from truly being able to grasp the concepts.
He cares more about baseball than your success as a student. Expect to not understand or know the theory by the end of the course.

If you like feeling terrible about yourself, take this class. If you like teachers making you feel like an idiot, take this class. There are no TA hours where you can get help and his theory is absolutely ridiculous. He "teaches" theory on Friday and expects you to do difficult homework with 0 assistance. Postpone graduation to take Prof. Heaton.

He struggles to know the impact that his stubbornness and belittling attitude has on students. His grading techniques for homework and tests are based off of his attitude and what he wants. Just be prepared if your best efforts or good comments in class are shut down. Don't let his intimidation or poor grading stop you from succeeding in life.

Dr. Grimshaw is a STATS professor that actually teaches you (unlike many stat professors). He teaches so clearly and really focuses on application. The final is pretty difficult because it has to deal with theory, but the other assignments and tests aren't too bad. Take classes from him, seriously.

Dr. Grimshaw's class has been one of my favorites. For each unit, we pull real data. It is a cool experience, and everything we learned in class can directly apply to a real life job. Despite the massive work load, it was well worth the time. Dr Grimshaw can be impatient at times, but he is always willing to help students.

Absolutely worst professor ever. Super degrading to students. If you ask him even clarification questions on the homework, he just says to "follow the instructions" even if the instructions are confusing. He continually makes the students look foolish with the most arbitrary things.

I really love taking classes from Professor Grimshaw. I have taken several classes from him and he is consistently one of my favorite professors. He is a great teacher and is always willing to help if you don't understand something. You can tell that he really wants his students to succeed. Definitely take from him if you get a chance.

I really disliked this class. Dr Grimshaw's self-deprecation was, at times, uncomfortable and counter-productive. He spent days on the simplest concepts and rushed through the tough stuff. In my personal interactions with him, he was often abrasive. Try to avoid. The only redeeming factor of this class is that I really enjoyed the textbook he uses.

This was an easy class for the first half and really difficult for the second for me. He knows his stuff inside and out but spends a lot of time teaching things that you don't need for the homework or tests. The grading was often difficult to understand and therefore mistakes were difficult to fix or learn from.

This class was tough. The grade scale was weird (96 is cutoff for an A, 93 for A-) and your hw assignments will not all be 100% because there are some problems you can't ask for help on. However, he does curve the tests a lot, and having an open book portion of the midterms was nice. Great guy, knows his stuff, and is inspiring, but tough grader!

Dr. Grimshaw's class was really difficult, but I felt like I learned so much and it was really beneficial for my future. His tests are tough but he weights most of your grade on the open book portion and curves your score a TON. As long as you work hard and do your homework you will do well.

I appreciated Dr. Grimshaw's practical and career-oriented teaching approach. Many aspects of the course, like the mini-projects and group project, are geared towards performing actual analysis. That being said, Dr. Grimshaw can be a little intimidating - I certainly didn't feel comfortable commenting in class for fear of correction.

Dr. Grimshaw is very bright, and this course has amazing material with lots of real life application. That being said, the work load is absolutely unrealistic (WAY too much) and he isn't very open to questions/concerns (he makes me feel really dumb when I ask questions or make comments, in or out of class). Take it from someone else if you can.
He's a funny, good man but not my kind of teacher. Crazy load of work and grading is difficult on top of that. I would take classes from another professor if possible.

Grimshaw's lectures are vague and lack direction. Get ready to spend all of your time with the TAs because you will have no idea how to do the homework without their help. His tests are ridiculously hard, but he's merciful in grading them. This class is all advanced math and equations so if you like that, then you'll survive, otherwise avoid Grim.

Dr Grimshaw knows his stuff, but as far as communication and respect for students goes, he is blatantly lacking. His respect for student questions and comments is very low, and his teaching style is an odd-ball collection of personal notes with no reference material for the students. His grading style is quite strange with arbitrarily shifted scale

He is alright at teaching, but has a weird grading system. It goes something like this: if you get over 95% on the homework and 85% on the "mini-projects," then you automatically pass with a "C." If you fail to meet one or the other requirement, you fail. This system almost failed me for getting a D on one of the mini-projects.

This guy is just another professor who wants to prove to you that his field is not just a stepping stone for your career.  Every semester, his grading criteria changes drastically with weird experimental systems. You can expect an easy, objective class up until the project, which depends on whether he likes it and you follow his unwritten rules.

His "code" to calculate your grade makes it difficult get an A. You have to get at least an average of 90% on regular homework and 85% on his 3 mini-projects. If you do that you get at least a C. You then need to do well on a three part group project and get at least a 90% on his final to get an A. Easy if you want to get between a C+ to B+

Lectures were pretty helpful, and he was especially helpful with coding in R.  Tests were reasonable, as was the workload, but he did bump up the workload towards the end of the semester with more mini-projects.  He gives weekly homework that can sometimes be boring and tedious, but for the most part, it helps in the learning process.

Everything in this class is about application. He actually teaches you how to do things that you can use in your field. His lectures can be really entertaining. He tries his best to respond to questions and help his students. The Stats lab is a must for help.

Whole class is focused on application.  The first class I've taken in college where everything is something that could be done in a real job.  Lectures are very entertaining and helpful for the homework.  If you've listened and done the homework the skills for the test and final project are easy.

Professor Grimshaw has got to have two personalities. I knew students who he would practically ridicule in public for no reason. I also knew students that he adored and would favor. Be wary. His homework problems aren't terribly bad but you can expect to have projects where he won't give you no direction and you may end up with a bad grade.

Very energetic and knowledgeable. Homework makes up the majority of the work, which is a lot but the tests were based off of homework problems, making you extremely prepared for the exams if you do the homework. Helpful whenever I needed to talk.

This class wasn't easy, but Dr. Grimshaw would take massive amounts of time to talk to me when I needed clarification or help. You have to do your end, but he and the TAs will try to help you succeed. Also, I loved his emphasis on R - very useful statistical tool.

Dr. Grimshaw's lectures were really enjoyable -not because I love math, but because he's really entertaining and explains things clearly! The class isn't easy, but he is very willing to help you. There's 1 homework assignment each week, as well as a group project and 2 individual projects. I highly recommend taking this class from him!

Grimshaw. This guy is an enigma. Dr Jekyll-shaw is absolutely hilarious in class, passionate about the material, and genuinely made me love statistics. I loved him. He is literally one of my favorite teachers. Mr Hyde-Shaw appears during one-on-one interactions, and the dude is scary. He absolutely HAS to be right. Not understanding, unfair grader.

Lectures are very well prepared. The assignment you should know are very time consuming but you learn a lot. He didn't give us nearly enough time for the first midterm. He also wasn't very helpful for the project. Lectures were extremely useful.

Seriously, One of the BEST teachers I have ever had at BYU, hands down. I hated statistics, and actually failed the GIANT non-honors class two times previously before this. If you want a teacher who genuinely cares about you, take this class. We had raffles everyday to win prizes (and money), and the hw was easy! You won't regret it, seriously.

Energetic. Tells a lot of interesting stories. Good sense of humor. Definitely keeps you awake, which is especially nice for the 2.5 hour night classes. One big project in the class. 3-4 hours a week of homework. Not a bad class.

Dr. Grimshaw could condense his lectures to 15 minutes and get across everything he wants to, but he pads them up to 1:15 minutes with a lot of fluff.  I got very frustrated trying to sift through all his pointless stories and histories to find what was actually important.  If there is another teacher for this class, take them instead
Pretty good teacher, good sense of humor to keep you awake. The other ratings puzzle me; he isn't the best but I enjoyed the class.

My semester he did not show up to class all semester, nor did he make it to his office hours. Basically he didn't do his job. He showed no interest and was kinda a jerk when you tried to talk to him. Right now he is the only one teaching this course, but if you can, take it from ANYONE else.

Got an A barely while i took online independent version of this class.Tests are constructed so easy, no need to attend midterm review as long as you memorize formulas.Tests straight from homework,project grade is what determines your overall grade.Nice professor with no interest on helping students.Has to attend meeting all time no more office hour

Not have enough office hours-one of the TA is so good and the other is completely useless-Grades rely mostly on class projects and homework.Tests easy,but required lot of memorization.Homework takes as long as from 4 to 10 hours each-weekly homework.Sometimes rude when students trying to ask him question or help.Easy B+,A depends on projects.

Don't let Dr. Grimshaw fool you into thinking he's not a brilliant guy- he is. His highly organized style of presenting and teaching is a huge plus. The several exams are manageable if you study. They do require some memorization of formulas. Workload: 10-25hrs book report; 1-2hrs homework per week, 5-15hrs on final project. Highly Recommended.
He is extremely helpful, if you ever need help, he has an open door policy and is great at explaining things. Lecture time was kind of worthless, but he's entertaining at least.
He is very animated and excited in class so he isn't boring.  He tells WAY too many stores though so it waste a lot of time, but he is helpful if not crystal clear in his teaching.

Dr. Grimshaw is easily one of my favorite professors - he is very nice and super helpful.  He has an open door policy, so he is very approachable if you have any questions.  If you have the chance to take ANY class from him, do it!

Prof Grimshaw has amazing intellect and it was cool to be taught by him.  My sister knew him when he was in grad school and always had a crush on him.  She's jealous I got to have him as a prof all semester

Great teacher. It's nice that he gives you a real world view on music and how to be applicable in a very competitive industry. If you are a good sight reader, you won't have a problem. For me it was a fairly easy class. Lots of homework, so don't fall behind on that.

Extremely easy to work with, very knowledgeable, very experienced! Always has the greatest metaphors, and his musical ideas are unique and creative. Truly a master. He expects a lot, bu it's because he wants his students to succeed. And he's one of the finest accompanists around!
Awesome teacher! I always walk out of lessons motivated to work really hard. He has high expectations so you can't be a slacker.
He is a great teacher and not as scary as some of the other piano professors are. He's strict, but within reason and is very enjoyable to work with.
Brilliant and inspiring.  Very demanding but will do everything to help you succeed!

A musician of the highest caliber and wonderful teacher.

Scott Howell is so qualified to teach this class. He really cares about how hard the students work and just wants us to succeed as missionaries.

Professor Howell is very caring and direct towards all of the students. He makes it very clear what assignments are due when and when you have to fill out classwork. He prioritizes attendance and participation.

I enjoyed being able to hear from converts and service missionaries. His class made me feel more prepared to serve a mission. The spirit was so strong in his classes.

Great class! Make sure you do the assignments on time and you'll do great in the class. Also attend the lectures because Brother Howell is funny and you'll learn a lot of small things in there that you just can't get from the homework

Scott Howell loves his students and loves what he teaches! He sets you up so well for going on a mission and I feel more prepared than I did walking in at the beginning of the semester. You learn so much and he gives you assignments and deadlines to help you get in the missionary mindset!
good teacher, did it's job

He was an amazing professor. He made me feel really prepared to serve my mission. If you participate and show up to class, you have nothing to worry about. His assignments are fairly easy and pretty straightforward and really help to set you up for your mission.
Professor Howell is a great mission prep teacher! There is a lot of work outside of class but it does prepare you for the mission so as long as that's your goal I highly recommend!

Bro. Howell is so awesome! He is very respectful and knowledgeable about missionary service, is great at explaining helpful skills we should learn before going on a mission. I learned many things I didn't know before. He has in-class reflections to keep you focused, mandatory attendance, no tests, many assignments. You can tell he loves this class!

Professor Howell is the best Mission Prep teacher!! I feel so prepared to serve a mission and have learned so much. He is so kind and so caring, I highly recommend you take this class from Professor Howell!

I felt like this course was good but also a lot of reading and a lot of extra time out of class. I felt like professor Howell's lectures were good but also very long winded at times. He couldve done better about keeping his points more concise and going over the principles more simple.
Great teacher he did a really good job at teaching and making the class enjoyable.
I thought he was a great professor. Everything seemed fair and the lack of tests made it so that as long as you showed up and tried to learn, you probably should be fine.
I always learned a lot in every class, and I loved how you could always tell he was passionate and excited to teach.
This professor does not assign any midterms or a final, but there is always a lot of homework to do every week.

I really liked hearing Professor Howell's stories from being a mission president. I thought that hearing from return and current missionaries was a real benefit from the course. I think that taking a more doctrinally based religion course at the same time would be really beneficial as a student since this class is based more in real-world examples.
Super easy, but doesn't seem super helpful either.
This professor has great knowledge of what is expected of missionaries and how best to help them prepare for their mission. His experience is valuable and provides a good learning experience.

Brother Howell said at the start of the semester that he hates busywork, but we sure did a lot of it. We met only twice a week but there were 7 homework assignments a week, due at strange times. The assignments were usually short and I did learn a lot, but the class felt more stressful than it should have given the material we covered.

I absolutely loved this class and Brother Howell! I came in unsure, but his teaching helped me better understand the course material and real-life applications. He created a supportive, non-pushy environment, and hearing guest speakers added a lot to the class. I'd definitely recommend him.
He is amazing!
He's amazing. The kindest human being on the planet

I loved Professor Howell's class. I feel like he gave us a lot of really useful information about preparing for a mission. I learned a lot of things in this class that I would not have learned if I hadn't taken it. I definitely recommend this class for future missionaries. You learn how to teach lessons!
Super nice and understanding! Would definitely take his class again.
His teaching style was relaxed and he is very open for participation in class.
Very nice.

Brother Howell was a really good professor and he had really good insights. He also really cares about missionaries and missionary work. The assignments at times felt like busy work but were manageable and not too hard. Through completing the homework assignments you should be able to do well in the class!

work-load is very manageable and not difficult. Lots of assignments but they are usually short. The grade is basically participating. Very good class to take before a mission to get you well prepared and excited.

Scott Howell is a professor I definitely would take again. His class is simple and easy with limited out-of-class work. He provides many opportunities for extra credit and structures the class well for preparing for a mission. Make sure you set reminders in your phone for assignments as there are multiple due a week.

Brother Howell is awesome. He gives a lot of great advice and resources for preparing for your mission. There is a good amount of busy work, and some of it may not feel very helpful, but overall I think this class prepared me for my mission. Make sure you tag all of the scriptures and everything in gospel library because it was helpful for me!

Brother Howell is super caring and really loves his students and missionary work. The class is fine, a bit of busy work but it's really easy. I think I could've prepared the same for my mission without taking it, but it's helpful.
This class was awesome! Super easy, but honestly a lot of busy work. Brother Howell is the nicest guy though! He really cares about his students and missionary work.

Brother Howell is very caring and a great person. he used to be a missionary president, so he knows missionary work very well, and has great advice and tips. He's passionate about what he does! I took the 2-hour lecture once a week, but if I could go back, I would change to 1 hr lectures 2x a week because the lectures would seem long some days.

Very kind and good teacher, but lots of unnecessary homework. Class is super informative and interesting. However, I wish it was more focused on what we were learning then just filling in the in class survey.

Great Teacher! Will get you somewhat ready for your mission, but the classes are worth it. Make sure to make good use of all the resources he gives you. Is not the best technology wise, but usually has TA's that cover the difference. Probably the best mission prep teacher here
Professor Howell is great in his lectures and supportive of his students. Very light grader and does not make the class stressful at all.
He does an amazing job preparing you for your mission! There are many assignments but it doesn't take very long to complete them. Highly recommend him for a teacher!
He is very caring and you can tell he both knows what he is talking about and cares about the students learning and wellbeing. He genuinely wants to help and is a great professor to learn from

Brother Howell did a great job at compiling all he wanted to teach us about missions and our mission preparation process. I loved how he celebrated mission calls in our class, and was always enthusiastic and excited to teach. I would recommend getting the schedule of when things are due down and reaching out to your TA if needed.

Brother Howell is an amazing teacher.  His lessons are always very planned out and intentional.  He doesn't assign any work without a clear purpose behind the assignments.  All of his lessons are very applicable to daily life and can be transformational if you let them.

Honestly one of my favorite classes! Brother Howell is legit the best. The class is really easy but also really helpful. There aren't any midterms or a final, which is super nice. There are times when it just feels like a bunch of busywork, but if you put the effort to do it, you can get a lot from it. I feel SO much more prepared for my mission!
Really good but a lot of work
A good amount of work, but most of it is stuff you have to do to prepare for a mission anyways.
I took Scott Howell's mission prep class. He is a great professor and cares a lot about his students. There are quite a few of assignments but they are all super useful if you're going on a mission!

Professor Howell is very caring and wants the best for his students. His assignments are to help you be more prepared to be a missionary and serve and the love the members around you. There is homework each week, but it is pretty structured and you can stay on top of it. Make sure to check canvas daily to make sure you aren't missing anything.
He sometimes had trouble with technology, but it was remedied by his TA. Sometimes things felt like busy work, but I know that it will benefit me in the future!

Brother Howell is an amazing professor who always invites the Spirit into his classroom. I feel much better prepared for serving my mission after taking his class. The course is very well organized. There is a lot of homework, but it was purposeful and meaningful. He offers extra credit and responds promptly to emails. I really enjoyed this class!

He is such a positive and funny professor which makes coming to class enjoyable. He has a lot of expirence with missionaries and definitely knows what he is talking about. Weekly assignments take up a good chunk of time but are helpful if you are going on a mission very soon.

This is the best religion professor you could have at BYU. He has helped me with an issue I've had this semester and it has helped me greatly. Sometimes the assignments feel like a lot but if you work on them for about half an hour to an hour every other day then you should get them done easily.

Brother Howell does all he can to help prepare us for missions in this class. Because of that there is a lot of homework, but there is clear purpose behind it. As long as you do your best in the class you will be able to get the grade you want.
Brother Howell is such a caring porfessor and you can tell he wants to prepare you the best he can for your mission. However each class felt overloaded with material and very rushed.

Professor Howell is a very caring and kind professor, but the class felt very based off of his opinions and personal experiences, rather than preparing students for their own missions and unique experiences. More of checking off boxes than actual learning. No exams, lots of reading.

Brother Howell is amazing! His course honestly made me feel prepared for my mission. There was a good amount of work, but it felt meaningful and I could tell it was for our benefit. Everyone wanting to serve a mission or even just thinking of serving should take this class!
Great class! very chill.
Awesome class! I feel so much more prepared for my mission

Brother Howell is an amazing professor and has a very structured, well organized class. He is respectful of his students and shows support and care for all of them. He is very funny as well! While there is a lot of work involved, none of it is overly complicated and is fairly self-explanatory. I would highly recommend taking a course from him.

Amazing class! Very easy, only reason I will not be receiving an A is because I skipped one too many times. I feel much more prepared for my mission. This is what a religion class should be like. Only focused on you relationship with God and not memorizing scriptures or facts.
Brother Howell makes sure you are learning and growing spiritually, and if you do that then you will pass the class easily
Brother Howell is the best! He truly loves his students and wants them to succeed.

Scott Howell is awesome! His class is very easy to manage and he is super understanding about make-up work and stuff like that. Brother Howell is also a super good teacher and his lectures are fun and engaging. I love this class and think it is an amazing way to prepare for a mission and get an easy religion credit.
Brother Howell was amazing. I 100% recommend him.
Great class! It goes a lot more in-depth than your typical stake/ward mission prep class.

Brother Howell was amazing!! I seriously learned so much in his class and feel a lot more prepared for my upcoming mission. There are a lot of weekly assignments and you read basically the entirety of Preach My Gospel throughout the semester, but it was honestly so worth it because it really prepares you for the mission. I would highly recommend!
I loved brother howell! If you don't take mission prep from him you are missing out! he is amazing!
His class is so fun, and he's made me really excited for a mission! Just a lot of assignments and many of them felt very redundant.
Catapulted my preparedness to go out on my mission, would highly recommend!!

He's great, very much gives off dad vibes. He has lots of experience from bein in the field and as a mission president. His class is very energetic and helpful for preparing for a mission. He's not my style of professor really, but it was fun to be in his class anyways. Plus, there are no exams.

Brother Howell is actually the sweetest!! He really makes sure that you are ready for your mission, and I'm so glad I was able to take this before leaving! He teaches with lots of passion. We had lots of content to cover, but his deadlines are the same every week (Tuesday and Thursday at 10:30 pm--to match the missionary schedule which is precious)
As long as you submit everything on time you will do great!

He did have us rate him on here, haha. Overall he's been a good professor, I feel like he really has prepped us well to go on missions. I didn't really vibe with him so I won't take him again, but he was very clear and the online assignments were very easy to find. He put a lot of value into opportunities outside of class which I appreciated.
Scott was the best! just make sure to submit on time.

Professor Howell is amazing. He is caring and will get you excited about your mission. This class has lots of reading. Expect to read all of PMG and AML. Take notes and show up to class and you'll do great!
He was an amazing mission prep teacher that got me excited and prepared to serve a mission!
Super kind and smart!

This class was great! We did things that will help me a lot on my mission such as getting familiar with all the apps we might use and tagging scriptures to easily find during lessons. Some of the work felt less meaningful and more busy, but overall, I learned a lot about being a missionary, and I feel like it will help me transition to be one.
Loved Brother Howell! He is the sweetest human and really wants to help you prepare for the mission! This class definitely helped me feel more prepared!!

This class was really good and I feel like it has prepared me well for my mission. We spent a lot of time in PMG and AML which are really important for missionaries to be familiar with. Attendance was required and we has an in-class assignment to complete as we listened to the lecture as well as a few other easy weekly assignments.
Scott Howell's testimony was inspirational! He showed tons of resources that will hopefully be helpful on the mission.

He is so sweet, I love him. There is a fair amount of coursework that needs to be completed, so just make sure you stay on top of everything. He is super helpful and understanding for any extenuating circumstances.

I loved taking Mission Prep from Brother Howell. I would highly recommend taking this course if you are planning on serving a mission or even if you are just thinking about it. I got lots of insights from this class and things that i will take with me not only on a mission byt for the rest of my life.

Brother Howell definitely puts you to work but it is all beneficial things! I took him for mission prep and I feel more prepared now to go out than I ever have before. He does a good job of kind of giving you a reality check of how missionary work really is. I'd highly recommend.
Brother Howell is great! mission prep is an amazing way for future missionaries to get a feel for what the next chapter of their lives are going to be like!
Cares a lot about preparing you for your mission. Great teacher. Would take again.

There is a lot of busy work in this class. You read all of PMG, AML, and watch all of the safety zone videos. My favorite thing was the tagged scriptures for this class. I think they will be very useful on my mission.
Brother Howell is an amazing person. I learned a lot of things that will help me on my mission. There is a lot of busy work, but overall I love this class!
Super chill class. Not hard at all.

The class is really great and the professor is amazing. I don't know how helpful this class was. It often felt like busy work and I thought there was more work than there needed to be for a two credit class.

Professor Howell does an amazing job teaching students about how to be effective missionaries. I learned a lot about the resources I have available to me and how to be effective on my mission. I also gained a greater understanding of how important missionary work is.

I loved Brother Howell. He made his classes fun, and the homework was pretty easy; there was just a lot of it each week. His class was my favorite class, and I think it was so helpful for me. I learned so much.

Professor Howell is a fantastic mission prep teacher! He brings a new perspective to missionary work that I really appreciated because he teaches about both the spiritual and the technical sides of missionary work. There were no tests, we used PMG & AML often, and Prof Howell often drew on his experience as a Bishop/Stake Pres/Mission President.

Brother Howell is actually the best!! He is so kind and sweet and keeps class interesting. He's really funny and is also able to communicate the importance of missionary work and teaches using the Spirit.
He is the best!
This class is great and really helps to prepare you for missionary work in the field.

Brother Howell is an excellent religion professor. His classes are structured with the student in mind. He is kind and loving, and he knows the doctrines he teaches very well. He is always able to answer questions about the gospel. The assignments are not busy work, but are meaningful and have purpose.

This class was really good for preparing for a mission. It's very similar to other mission prep experiences I've had, but something I liked is that you read the whole Preach My Gospel throughout the class, which I think is super useful.
Professor Howell really cares about his students and loves to teach. I really loved the energy and spirit in his class every day.
Great class, great professor, especially if you're planning on going on a mission
Great class!!

Professor Howell is AMAZING! I looked forward to every class. You really do get what you put into this class. Lots of assignments but they help you break down what you want to do anyway (reading PMG, practicing lessons, etc). He truly wants you to be the best missionary possible and I feel much better prepared to go after taking this course.

Brother Howell is THE BEST. The assignments were easy to manage and very helpful spiritually. Class was my favorite to go to and he had a ton of inspiring lessons. He is also the kindest human and cares for his students immensely.

Brother Howell is very caring. I usually felt rushed in the in-class activities (we did only have 50 minutes) which stressed me out but was probably good for me. I learned a lot in his mission prep class.

Brother Howell is genuinely amazing. You can tell how much he loves his students and his job. I took him for mission prep, and I would highly recommend it. It really prepares you for being a missionary and being invested in the work and doctrine.

Brother Howell's lectures were engaging and very informative about missionary work. The homework did include a lot of tagging scriptures, which could get tedious. However, all the homework had clear ties back to preparing us to serve missions. All around a great professor.

Brother Howell's lectures were really engaging and included a lot of good tip and tricks for serving a mission. Be prepared to use gospel library a ton, several of the weekly assignments include tagging a bunch of scriptures which can get tedious. Everything did have a clear purpose to prepare us for a mission. All around a great professor.
I loved his class, he is super nice and I feel like he really prepared me for my mission!

This class is super easy. It is just busy work, and no tests. Definitely helped prepare me for my mission. Not a stressful religion class in the slightest. It was also fun to meet people who were getting their calls at the same time.

Amazing professor and class! He really cares about preparing us for our missions instead of just giving us meaningless busywork. He is one of the few religion professors who cares more about us learning by experience than reading a bunch of random stuff.

Brother Howell is an exceptionally knowledgeable teacher! He does assign quite a bit of work, but all the readings are very insightful and definitely prepare you for a mission! For some of his lectures, he invites special guests such as converts or missionary companions to come and speak so that you get the real deal!

Brother Howell is very passionate about missionary work, and it's evident through the time and effort he puts into organizing the course. Sometimes it might feel like you are doing a lot of busy work, but it is all meant well and will help prepare you for missionary service if you have the intention!
Great class and great professor! I loved getting to serve food at the mtc, it was great opportunity. I would definitely take this class again from him, he has great tips.
Lots of homework, but it doesn't take long! Bro Howell is super amazing and truly cares about missionary work.
You need to stay on top of assignments since there are a lot. But they are easy and don't take very long.

Brother Howell is a funny professor who cares about his students. This class was a great mission prep class and helped me do everything that people had told me to do before my mission. I basically got credit for something I already needed to do! Lots of homework but it doesn't take long. A good 2 credit class!
Lectures are great and engaging! Brother Howell genuinely cares about his students. His class is not difficult to get an A in and it's easy to stay ahead because of the way he organized the course.
Brother Howell's lectures are very interesting and useful. He gives a lot of homework, but all of it was relevant and useful to me. I learned so much about being a missionary in this class!

Bro. Howell was amazing and I would take his class again. He cares about his students and loves to communicate with you if you let him. Sometimes we would get off track but would mostly pick it up in the last 5-10 mins. The assignments are at weird times, but does help you later as a missionary. Overall, really good professor and class.
He really cares about you having a good experience in the class. Heavily participation based in class. Mostly discussions with peers.

Professor Howell was great! He genuinely cared about his students and I really appreciated how approachable and invested he was. Occasionally, class would get a little off track or we wouldn't cover everything planned, as he would lose track of time. Overall, a very positive experience, great information for those planning to serve a mission!

Brother Howell really does care about his students. It feels like there are a lot of assignments for the type of class it is, but everything is well structured and you get a lot out of it. There are a lot of readings, but there are also a good amount of hands-on activities. Would recommend.
such a wonderful class and professor.

He gave us a lot of advice on daily missionary life and brought in a lot of visitors with great spiritual stories and helpful advice. We spent a lot of time on Preach my Gospel outside of class. We didn't learn much about actually teaching a lesson, except for a monthly practice lesson. We mostly learned about good resources to turn to.
Brother Howell is really awesome and cares about all of his students! A great mission prep professor!

Class are interesting and Brother Howell teaches earnestly and sincerely. There are a lot of different homework assignments, but once you get used to the weekly rhythm, they're pretty manageable. The assignments also rely on a lot of personal accountability but are rewarding if you put in the work.

Professor Howell is a good teacher! The class had a lot of reading but mainly Preach My Gospel and Adjusting to Missionary Life which was helpful. There also weren't any tests which was nice to be able to just focus on the content. I didn't feel that his class really focused on how to actually teach other people the lessons but I still enjoyed it.

This class was awesome! I feel really prepared for my mission after taking it. We read a lot out of Preach my Gospel and we were exposed to a lot of awesome church resources! Would recommend taking this class if you can before your mission!
Awesome teacher! Great Class!

This class is very flexible to the student and gives you the opportunity to choose varied levels of commitment to the class. It is great for mission preparation, but there is a lot of accountability on you as the student to actually put in the work.
He cares a lot about his students.

He is an excellent professor who is always willing to help students succeed. His teaching style is clear and easy to follow. He is approachable and easy to talk to, which makes the class environment comfortable. He also provides valuable insight for students preparing for future missionary work.
Howell is clearly so caring and loves all of his students. This class has a lot of necessary busy work, so just stay ahead and go to class and you'll be fine.

Professor Howell is really sweet, and you can feel how much he loves the gospel and missionary work! Class was easy to get an A in as long as you stay up to date on the assignments which there are a lot of. None of the assignments are hard, just somewhat time consuming. He did an awesome job of familiarizing us with mission resources and teaching

So great! Not hard. Very helpful if you are planning on serving a mission or just interested. Worth your time!!! Professor Howell cares about his students and wants you to succeed. A lot of work but none of it is hard.
This guy is the GOAT. Very easy class, but very helpful as well. I'm headed out on my mission in less than a month or so and I actually do feel much more prepared having taken this class!
Great class

I really liked this class!! I feel like you really get what you put into it. I didn't love the in class reflections, as I felt that it took away from getting deep into topics that were important. I loved the speakers that he brought in. This class had some busy work, but I loved going to class and it made me want to serve a mission! I reccomend!

I took mission prep from Brother Howell and he was great. The weekly assignments can take a combined 1-2 for the week but they are so helpful. He has you reading all of Preach My Gospel and other mission materials. His lectures are Christ focused and are aimed to give you resources on your mission. We also did micro teaching lessons, and service!
Professor Howell is amazing! He is very engaged and cares about all of his students. Be prepared for a lot of reading, annotating, tagging scriptures, and short online quizzes.
He is such an engaging teacher. The work outside of class is manageable. I would definitely take again.
I literally love this guy. He is so kind and you can tell that he cares about all his students. This was a really good class to take to prepare for a mission.
Brother Howell is an amazing teacher and really knows what he is talking about! There is a good amount of work but it is all really easy and helpful for a mission!
Love Prof. Howell.

He showed us that he cared about our growth as missionaries and as people. I do wish that he didn't spend more time than needed on some topics during lessons because he ended up rushing toward the end of class so that we could get the answers for our In-class Reflections. I liked that he had us read PMG and Adjusting to Missionary Life.

He showed us that he really cared about our growth as people and missionaries. It was nice that he brought in speakers and had us read in Preach My Gospel and Adjusting to Missionary Life. I do wish that he left time for questions during our lessons and that he didn't spend more time than needed on certain topics and then rush at the end.
Professor Howell is amazing! This class has made me way more excited to serve.

He's a good professor, there's quite a bit of homework for this class, it's generally pretty easy but a touch tedious at times, just show up to class and finish the assignments and you should be fine in this class.

Professor Howell is a great guy and very clearly loves what he teaches. Despite that, class structure is more often than not pretty messy. I think the best part of this course is the three opportunities you get to teach and reading PMG. There is a lot of assignments in this class and many of them will feel unproductive for preparing for a mission.

The assignments outside of class seemed a lot more useful for preparing for a mission than what we did in class, even if it was very time consuming. The in-class reflections made it feel like we were constantly in a rush and didn't really leave room for anything spiritual. Brother Howell is a really nice guy, but I didn't love the class structure.

There was lots of what may considered busy work, but it is easy to get an A if you turn things in on time and attend class. Professor Howell is a great teacher, and he structures his class in a way to prepare us to be missionaries.
Super nice guy, lot's of reading PMG and AML and at least 3 assignments a week. I definitetly feel better prepared to serve a mission this summer after taking his class.

Brother Howell was a great professor and I enjoyed his class. He was always kind and easy to work with. However it is lots of busy work and at times I left wondering if what I was doing was the most impactful for preparing for me mission. His grading is very fair and if you show up to class and do every assignment you will easily get an A!

He was a really great teacher that worked hard to help us to become ready for our missions. The homework is all readings or videos (for the most part) so it's pretty easy, and all the homework assignments are things that are relevant to your mission preparation.

He is very kind and fun and makes every class entertaining and informational. His material was incredible. he answered every question and made everything feel comfortable and enlightening. the spirit is strong in his class, and you can feel his genuine love for you. He does give a good amount of work, but it is all very easy and doable.

He's a really good professor and cares about his subject and students so much. You can feel the spirit in his class. The work load isn't bad and he offers like 4 whole point of extra credit and opportunities to make up 2 missed class attendances.

Brother Howell provides so many useful resources for missionaries, including a Gospel Library Notebook full of useful information! If you are planning on going on a mission after a semester or two of college, I would highly recommend this class. The class itself consists of weekly readings, assignments, and daily attendance/in-class reflections.

Super fun class! He prepared you well for an upcoming mission. There are a fair amount of assignments each week, but you can do them all really fast. He was a funny person and genuinely cared about each person in class.
He always went over class time and didn't respect our time. Easy great class with a few assignments a week. Wish he went over PMG more in class. Great nice guy, just loved teaching you can tell.

Brother Howell is the best!! There are a lot of assignments and readings from Preach My Gospel and Adjusting to Missionary work but it is so worth it! Definitely helped me prepare better for my mission!

Brother Howell really cares for his students. The only reason I gave him a 3 is he has way too many homework assignments for a 2 credit class. Because of the amount of assignments I felt like I was unable to ponder the things I was learning because I had to quickly move onto the next assignment. His in-class reflections are also unnecessary.

This class was fine and easy, but I wish we did more preach my gospel, microlessons, and having the missionaries/converts come speak because those were the best days! Most of the time we just did an insane amount of busy work, which may be helpful for my mission, I have yet to find out. Be aware assignments are sometimes due at 10:30pm or even 9am.

This class was very spiritually strengthening and helped me prepare for my mission! There is a good amount of homework, but it all ends up being super helpful if you are planning on serving a mission.

Professor Howell was an amazing mission prep teacher! You can tell he really cared about his class and students. I would be wary that some of the assignments are busy work. Also, no final or mid-term.

You can tell he really cares about what he teaches. To me, there was a decent amount of busy work in the homework assignments. I didn't always learn something useful in every class, but the class wasn't difficult. He doesn't grade very harshly.
He's a great teacher and cares about every student
I loved this class so much! It was very engaging and the teacher was great!
Amazing professor! Brother Howell is so kind and engaging! I absolutey loved this class

I loved Brother Howell! After this class, I felt so prepared for my mission and excited go into the field. There is a decent amount of work, but it is enjoyable because it is all related to things you'll do on your mission.
There's quite a bit of homework, but it is doable.

What a good professor! I took this class for mission prep, and I learned a lot about the mechanics behind missionary work in the field. Not always the most missionary-based teaching lessons, but you learn a lot of rules of the field! Some of the homework felt like a lot of busy work, but nothing was too hard!

This class was great! It does require a decent amount of time, both inside and outside of class, but the homework is easy and very helpful. I learned a lot about missions and picked up many valuable skills and resources for my mission. We even got the opportunity to tour the MTC outside of class.
Lots of busy work but great class and funny teacher, easy work.
Professor Howell cares about his students, and the assignments take time, but are not difficult. Lectures can be long.
Brother Howell is an exceptional teacher! You can tell he really wants the best fro you and wants you to succeed on your mission. I would most definitely take him for mission prep!
He really helped prepare me for my mission. Taking this class makes me feel more confident in my knowledge to serve a mission.

LOVE LOVE LOVE Brother Howell! Definitely one of my favorite professors here at BYU. He is so caring and puts so much time and effort into ensuring that we will be the best missionaries out in the field. His classes are soooo helpful and increased my confidence on deciding to serve a mission!
Brother Howell was really fun and I genuinely learned a lot about missions from him! I feel well prepared to serve and am glad I took the course.

Brother Howell is an AMAZING teacher!! He is so kind and genuinely wants to individually know all of his student. He prepares you so well for your mission and really wants you to succeed. He is also a super adaptive teacher and is constantly altering the class to make sure it prepares you the best it can!! 10/10 PLEASE TAKE THIS CLASS!!

Overall, this class made me feel prepared for a mission. However, I would not take it as an easy religion class. There was a lot of busy work, some of the assignments were hard to keep track of, and a strict attendance policy. It's an easy A if you can keep track of things and show up every day. If you're going on a mission, take it from him!
Super realistic class for outlining exactly which tools you'll need for your mission. Almost like an extended MTC.

this class was so beneficial in helping me become more prepared and ready to get out into the mission field. There is a lot of assignments but they are all useful. some of the things we do like using gospel notebooks and tagging stuff can be a little bit confusing.
I loved this class for preparing for my mission! He was very helpful and inspiring! He loves the Gospel and he loves his students!
The professor is very humble and thoughtful! He's well-versed in all things missions, and I learned a lot of unique and very useful information in this class!

If you truly want to prepare for your mission, Brother Howell is the best professor to help you get ready!! He helps you become familiar with Preach My Gospel, Gospel Library, and all the other resources you'll use as a missionary. Homework in this class can be a little heavy at times, but none of it is busy work!

Brother Howell is an awesome teacher! There was a lot of homework for this class which seemed unnecessary at times but overall it was a great class! I feel a lot more prepared and excited for my mission after taking a class from him!
great teacher, class is fast paced but definately managable

Professor Howell is SO amazing! I have never had someone get me so exited for my mission. I also haven't learned so much amazing things ever in such a short period of time. He is always filled with the spirit and so loving to his students. I am so grateful I was able to take mission prep with him this semester. I feel so prepared for my mission!
Super easy pre-mission class. Loved Brother Howell
Professor Howell really knows what he's talking about!! This class had a lot of assignments but I felt like all of them were relevant and helpful.

I LOVE BROTHER HOWELL. He is the most genuine and caring guy. Every single time I went to his mission prep class I left feeling more and more excited about my mission. I would recommend this class to anyone who is even thinking about serving a mission. The class is awesome and so is Brother Howell.

Brother Howell is awesome! His lectures are interesting and definitely helped me feel more prepared for a mission. There are a few assignments a week, but none that took over 45 minutes. And there are no tests! Definitely recommend.

Professor Howell is such an amazing teacher! You can instantly tell he cares about each of his students and wants what's best for us. He has us teach lessons on zoom to each other, which has helped my confidence in being able to teach others increase/better prepare me for my mission! If you're wanting to serve a mission, take mission prep from him!
There is a lot of PMG readings, but they are so helpful. I feel so much more prepared for my mission!!!
He is great! He puts so much effort into the lessons and the resources he shares.
Great teacher helped me to feel prepared to serve a mission
Good professor who really loves what he teaches.

He was the best!! The assignments were super easy and easy to understand. Class was very engaging and interesting, and the Spirit was super strong each class. I highly recommend taking this course right before your mission!!
Great class was very fast paced but so is missionary life!

You will get an A in this class. Professor Howell brings in many guest speakers that are enlightening and spiritually strengthening. There are multiple assignments each week, which mostly contain readings out of Preach My Gospel and Adjusting To Missionary Life. The work is very manageable and will actually help and prepare you for your mission.

Loved this class and Brother Howell. Definitely feel way more confident about going on a mission. Recommend to anyone thinking about serving a mission. Brother Howell brings in recent converts and mission president as guest lecturers which is super helpful!

Professor Howell was a great Mission Preparation teacher! He was very passionate and taught varied lessons that kept things entertaining. There are a lot of assignments throughout the week, but they are all relatively easy. If you keep up with marking things in your Gospel Library App, there is no end-of-the-semester stress at all!

Scott Howell was an amazing teacher for Mission Prep. He was super uplifting and created an environment that was awesome for the class. There was a lot of homework, including reading assignments. But it's a super easy class to take. Attendance was mandatory, so that is something to think about.

Some weren't as bothered by it, but he interrupted people way too much, and I thought there were so many opportunities to feel the spirit, but he lowkey ruined them. The class itself was a nice stress reliever, lots of mini assignments that do help you prepare for a mission. But if you're looking for more than the bare minimum, he's not for you.
Super nice guy, he cares about all the students and the work is fairly simple. good mission prep.

Brother Howell is a very loving professor and helps his students grow closer to Christ! He is clearly devoted to his job and works hard to switch things up to make class relevant and enjoyable for his students.
This class was SO helpful in preparing for a mission! Bro Howell cares so much about missionaries and wants you to succeed both in his class and the mission field!
I LOVED this class. Such good preparation for my mission!!!

Brother Howell was one of my favorite professors I've had at BYU! He is so genuine and just really wants to support his students and prepare them for the MTC. He also listens to feedback and tries to make the class as engaging and exciting as possible. Highly recommend you take this from him if you are even considering serving a mission.

I loved Professor Howell's class! There was quite a bit of homework, but it helps with a lot of the requirements given to you before you get to the MTC, like the safety zone videos and reading through preach my gospel. Professor Howell gives you a lot of resources that you are able to use on your mission, which is nice.

This teacher is a very caring teacher and makes his lessons very relatable. I am more confident to go on my mission because of this class. I would recommend taking this class during the week for two classes for 50 min instead of 1 class for 2 hours.

I loved Professor Howell! The mission prep class that I took was so helpful and I feel so excited to serve a mission. I will say that there is a bit of homework, but I feel like all the homework is so beneficial and helpful. And there are no finals! The lectures were so awesome and I loved learning about missionary service.

I really liked this class. I feel like it was an accurate representation of what is done on a mission! Sometimes this class was a bit work heavy, but it wasn't busy work which was really nice. I appreciated the constantly consistent due dates for assignments, and you could tell that he really cares about the gospel and the power of missions!

I learned a lot in his lectures. The assignments weren't bad at all and were easy to complete. There was lots of good tips and prep for a mission from his class. Overall, a great teacher who does his best to teach and prepare his students.

Bro. Howell is a really sweet teacher who ensures you have resources that will help you for your mission, which I loved. However, many assignments weren't as spiritually building as I had expected. If you want to know about mission resources, this is a great class. However, it can be lacking in learning to love God and who you will be serving.

Brother Howell is an amazing professor he was so kind and so spiritual. There is a lot of homework but it is really easy and helped me prepare for a mission. Attendance is mandatory. I would highly recommend taking his class!
He was awesome! I loved his course, and I feel like I was able to follow everything easy. It is a lot of assignments, but they are all super easy and genuinely fun to do! Would take again!

Brother Howell definitely cares about all of his students and wants them to be successful missionaries. He gives a lot of practical tools (or best practices) in his lectures, but not a lot of in class time spent doing role plays or asking questions. Brother Howell is great at responding to emails and accommodating students needing excused absences.

Professor Howell is a great guy; he's super spiritual and has a very strong testimony. His mission prep class does not have any exams and the only thing you are really graded on are lots of small homework assignments. Expect about 2-3 hours of work per week. I definitely am more ready for my mission than I was before this semester.

He cares a lot about his students. The class was easy if you stay on top of the homework (weekly PMG readings, adjusting to missionary life readings, Christ-like attribute readings, safety-zone video watchings, and others), but not super spiritually strengthening. I have a ton of resources now for my mission. But not much class discussion.

Brother Howell is the best mission prep teacher! I had a lot of nerves about serving a mission and while they didn't completely go away, this class made me feel much more prepared and excited to serve. The work load is no more than a couple hours a week and since it was stuff that can help me be a better missionary it didn't feel like homework!

Sometimes Howells lectures are a bit over the place, but they are out of pure love for his students and wanting to teach them to be better missionaries. There are no tough grades in the full course, practically attendance and completion get you a 100. I feel so prepared to serve now having taken his class.

The class was great for upcoming missionaries or people even just on the fence. You learn important information. The work doesn't feel like busy work because you know you will use this on a mission. His wife is the best and she came in once and it was awesome!

This is the funnest class. Especially if you are preparing to go on a mission it is super helpful. You get so much insider information and start preparing your scriptures and apps and things already for your mission. It is also so easy and there's no final.

You know that he cares and wants you to succeed. It really wasn't a very challenging class, but attendance was mostly mandatory. If you miss a couple times it shouldn't effect your grade too much. A handful of weekly assignments but not very time consuming and you can get ahead on them which is also nice.

He is super nice and his class does prepare you really well for your mission. He really knows what he's doing, but I often feel he puts too much emphasis on the wrong aspects of being a missionary. I wish he focused more on personal conversion and teaching us what a mission will look like on a more detailed and day by day scale.

Professor Howell's Mission Prep class was amazing. The homework may seem like a lot at times, but it is really just preparing you for a mission. He gives you amazing tips and scriptures to use on a mission. I would 100% take this class again, I learned so much.

There is a larger workload with the homework that you are expected to complete each week, but it is not enormous or hard. Mostly just requires thoughtful reflection upon readings. The course is very well set up and all the homework you are expected to do is very clear.
take this class

Brother Howell was a great mission prep teacher. Weekly assignments help you get to know the resources you will use as a missionary. This class gives you a great headstart for your calling as a missionary!

He was a great teacher and the only thing that this class requires is consistency. It's not too hard, you just have to show up and submit things on time or your grade will take the hit of the century.
