He is a great teacher and really helped me in my preparation to go on a mission.  The classes were always spiritually centered and he shared a lot of great messages.

Brother Howell is an amazing professor! I took his mission prep class, and I can definitely say I feel much more prepared to serve. We practiced teaching lessons, read from Preach My Gospel, and tagged/linked many scripture and videos in Gospel Library to use later on our missions. . The homework isn't anything crazy either

Super chill and sweet guy, I felt a lot more prepared for the mish after this class. Also I had this at 8am so I don't remember much about it other than the vibes (which were good). Be on-time to class, you'll have attendance quizzes to complete within the first couple mins.

Brother Howell is amazing!! If you pay attention and put in a little bit of work, you will grow and learn so much about yourself, who you are, and who you want to be. It is a fantastic class! There are a lot of assignments, but don't worry; they take 10-25 minutes at most.
I love Brother Howell!!! He helped me prepare for my mission so much! I am now so excited to serve and with all of his tools I know I am ready!

Brother Howell is an awesome professor and really helped me prepare for my mission. The assignments were pretty easy and you can mostly work ahead as much as you want. Honestly as long as you turn things in on time or email him you'll be fine. He provided so many amazing spiritual experiences and I'm grateful for the effort he puts in!

Brother Howell is very caring, puts a lot of effort into lessons, and even brings in speakers. However the assignments aren't related or helpful to mission prep per say, and I don't feel super prepared to start my mission. I would have liked if we got to practice teaching a bit more and if he prepared us more beforehand on how to teach a lesson.

Howell is awesome! He has no finals in this class and instead all his assignments truly help you prepare for your mission. They can be just busy work at times but overall he does well prepping his students!

Professor Howell was a great mission prep professor. He gave us tons of scriptures to tag for our missions which was super helpful. A lot of his assignments did feel like busy work and it was an 8am so that was tough because attendance is required. Preach my Gospel and Adjusting to Missionary life are required.

Pros: 
- Lots of guest speakers like Mission Presidents and recent converts
- Read Preach my Gospel front to back
- Visited the MTC

Cons:
- Lots of assignments, most of which were good, but some felt tedious, a waste of time, and unimportant

Random: 
- Monthly zoom classes online to practice teaching missionary lessons
- Attendance is mandatory

Brother Howells class is amazing. He was a mission president previously and he is so passionate about missionary work. Being in his class makes me excited to go and serve my mission. Coursework consists of a few weekly assignments, reading preach my gospel and watching safety zone videos. He is so kind and positive! take from Howell!

Dr. Howell is very kind and cares about his students. The content we spent class time on didn't always feel as spiritual as it could have. It was on occasion tedious. I did appreciate went guests came in and spoke to us-- these were the best learning experiences.

Brother Howell is amazing! He was super helpful with mission prep and gave so many good insights. Attendance is mandatory but the classes are so interesting. There are many opportunities to teach in a group setting which was very fun and helpful!

Brother Howell was a really good teacher. I enjoyed his class and I feel like he did really help to prepare me for the mission. There is a lot of assignments and lots of reading PMG so be prepared, but they are good things. Some are a little tedious but if you really try and take the assignments seriously you'll find it helpful.

Brother Howell is a really awesome teacher for Mission Prep, he is incredibly expierienced and knowlegeable for all things pertaining to missionary lessons, and demands. That being said, he has a lot of assignments, but if you put your mind to the assignments and actually try to learn his material, you will be confident heading to the MTC

Helped me feel more comfortable and prepared to serve a mission!! He taught a lot about how to utilize different tools for missionaries. There are quite a few assignments each week, but they don't take too long and are beneficial for future missionaries!!!

Professor Howell was such a good teacher for my mission prep class! I feel a lot more prepared to serve. There isn't too much homework, and it is all pretty easy. The only thing I would say is somewhat tedious is we have to read the whole PMG, which is definitely worth it, but I just got behind, so I recommend staying on top of the readings.
Very passionate about the material and cares for students.

Professor Howell is an incredibly strong professor with a strong knowledge base, both spiritual and practical. He is a former Mission President and served in this capacity recently, so he is very familiar with the ins and outs of missionary life. He believes in you the whole way through, and will teach you to believe in yourself.

Brother Howell is my favorite professor. He taught me so many things that you would never learn in a Sunday school class. I genuinely feel so prepared to serve a mission now. The assignments are long but there are so many that if you miss one it won't affect your grade at all. I have told all of my friends to take mission prep from brother Howell!!

Brother Howell is so kind and you can tell he deeply cares about you and preparing you for your mission. He helps you put resources in your Gospel Library notebook and has roleplaying for teaching lessons. I learned so much and I feel so ready for my mission now! And his class is always filled with the Spirit, it's the best. I love him!

I love Brother Howell! This is one of those classes you will get out of what you put into it! He is very loving and always invites the Spirit. He always considers others and has us pray for them before each lecture. He is seriously the BEST!!! It is a lot of busy work but if you do it thoughtfully, it prepares you so well for the mission!

Brother Howell is one of the most understanding helpful professors I have ever had. So many students come into this class having little to no desire to serve a mission and they leave the class with a mission call. You learn a lot in his class and it's an easy 2 credits- along with being much more prepared for your mission and just a life of service

Very organized class and laid out materials very well. Lots of reading each week but not too difficult to get done and cares about students a lot. Every class was inspirational and I felt so much more prepared to go out into the mission field after taking his class.

Brother Howell is an AMAZING professor. If you are debating whether to take an easier mission prep teacher or this man, take Brother Howell. You will read all of PMG over the semester, Adjusting to Missionary Life, and watch safety zones plus set up your gospel library with things you will actually use on the mission. This class blessed my life.

I loved having mission prep with brother Howell. I learned so much about what to expect on a mission and feel a lot more prepared through the class. I think the only piece of advice that would make the class better is if we taught practice missionary lessons in person by renting a room.

Overall, I liked Howells. He has a lot he wants to teach you, and moves fast. Lots of 'work' but not difficult. Decent amount of reading and note taking in and out of class. A few group activities and cool guest lectures, and field trips (MTC tour, volunteering opportunities). Good luck and I hope your mission is great.
Very engaging and helped teach Gospel Principles. I feel significantly more prepared to serve the Lord than before this class.

Brother Howell's class was super helpful! It got me so excited to serve a mission. There is homework every week, but it doesn't feel like busy work because it will help you on your mission, ESPECIALLY in your studies. You are required to do an attendance quiz for class, but he is flexible about missing class, as long as it's a legit reason.

Professor Howell is very kind and was super helpful in providing an idea of what to expect from missionary life and teaching resources to use on a mission. My favorite part was the visits from converts, which really helped to see multiple perspectives and what makes a good missionary.

Brother Howell is a great teacher and teaches the class with a lot of passion. There are a lot of assignments, but they are just reading, preach my gospel, or watching videos. Overall, it was a super enjoyable class, and I highly recommend taking it from Brother Howell.
It's a super great class. There's not a ton of work, just a couple of little assignments per week. The professor is super nice and very energetic about the course!
Brother Howell has such a sweet testimony and will really help you feel the Spirit as you prepare to serve a mission! You will get out what you put in, so go in with all your heart.

I really enjoyed this class and felt that it was worthwhile. A word of advice: Do your assignments in a timely manner! Most things are due at 10:30 pm. and you will lose significant points if not submitted on time.
He is such an amazing teacher and truly prepares his students for going on a mission. He also has such a gift for connecting with his students and bringing the Spirit into class.

I took this class to prepare for my mission, I can say without a doubt that this class has prepared me to be a better missionary. In class we had the ability to teach lessons to one another (be teachers and investigators) this gave me a different perspective of things I would need to do different on my mission and eased my anxiety about my mission.
Sometimes lectures feel a little useless but they're cancelled out by the times when they are SO GOOD, this class is so helpful!
No stress class, but extremely helpful for my preparation for my mission to help me see what mission life looks like and what is expected.

Material is organized well in Canvas. You will read all 13 chapters of Preach My Gospel in-depth, practice teaching doctrinal principles in pairs, and tour the Provo, MTC. Highly recommend the class to any prospective missionaries. The tools, apps, and scriptures given will be a huge help on the mission. Professor Howell is a great guy.

Prof Howell was amazing. I feel so prepared for my mission because he made us record and mark things on our Gospel Library and PMG that we can take with us. Everything we did was to help us become the best missionary we could be. I would 100% take this class from him again and highly recommend. Do the weekly assignments on time and you'll be good.

Brother Howell is amazing! He has such a strong testimony and he is very knowledgeable about missionary work and how to help you best prepare for a mission. He is very kind and loving and wants all his students to succeed.
There are a lot of small assignments in this class but if you stay on top of them you'll learn and feel better prepared for your mission.

Brother Howell was the best! He gave a lot of good advice, and I felt the Spirit so strongly whenever he brought in guest speakers. He was super caring, and he wants all his students to be the best missionaries they can be! We always had a couple of assignments due every week but as long as you do them, the class is pretty chill!

Brother Howell is so compassionate. The love that he has for each of his students is so clear. Brother Howell's lectures are spiritual and powerful. If you take his class, be prepared for lots of work outside of class, and make sure your attendance is near perfect- it is a huge part of your grade.
Super amazing and caring professor! Homework is honestly fun to do and will obviously help you in the future. Really enjoyed going to his class every week.

Professor Howell was great! It's clear he's very passionate about missionary work. I do feel as though I didn't get that much more prepared for the actual mission through his class. We had lots of guest speakers, who were very interesting and great to listen to, but there was a lot of outside work that mostly felt like busy work.

I took his Mission Prep class and I loved it. There are lots of little assignments due every week, such as Preach My Gospel readings (which can be super long sometimes), or watching the Safety Zone videos. There are no tests or midterms, so as long as you keep up with the assignments you're good. Bro. Howell is very spiritually uplifting and great!

Brother Howell is amazing. If you're considering a mission, take his class. He provides many scripture verses to tag in your Gospel Library and you'll read all of "Preach My Gospel." Attendance is mandatory but worth it. Hearing where classmates are called is my favorite part. Brother Howell makes everyone feel important and loved. He is a light!

He has worked with SO many missionaries and is so qualified to teach this course! He is enjoyable to listen to and gives you so much information that you will actually use in the field. There's a lot of homework, but it is all super easy and very useful. You will have a head start on your mission if you actually do all the work.

The class is easy with lots of assignments focused on Preach My Gospel, adjusting to missionary life, and reading scriptures. It adds tons of annotations, but honestly, reading PMG, the Book of Mormon, and building spiritual habits daily would prepare you just as well. It's an easy A and gives you a religion credit.

Brother Howell was super great! He brought many different speakers into our mission prep class that were super helpful and insightful. He also was quick with grading and responding to emails. Attendance is mandatory (you can only miss two classes) and there is a lot of homework to do, but it is all very helpful and it is not just busy work.

Professor Howell's class is so great to learn about the mission experience and how to prepare for a mission! Whether you know for sure you want to serve or are just considering it, I would recommend taking this class!
He was a mission president so he gave really good insight, I feel so prepared for my mission
Enjoyed this class and learned a lot.

Bro Howell was a great teacher and helps you feel as prepared as possible to start the mission. There is a decent amount of weekly work from watching videos and reading chapters in PMG, but it was always manageable. We tagged about a million things in gospel library and used canvas, both were semi-confusing at times, but overall would recommend!

Brother Howell was a great mission prep teacher! His experience as a mission president definitely helped him be an effective teacher. However, the organization of his canvas course confused me at first. You also have to read a chapter from Preach My Gospel every week, and sometimes, the chapters are kind of long. Overall, it was a great class!

Brother Howell's class is AMAZING! The class is a lot of work, but I actually feel prepared. Prepare to read all of Preach my Gospel, watch all of the Safety Zone videos, have guest speakers, learn best practices, etc. Probably the most practical class I have taken at BYU. Fair warning though assignments are due on Sundays.

TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!!
If you're going to take mission prep he's your best option. My 3 roommates all had different mission prep professors, and after comparing we all agreed Brother Howell is the best.
I'm starting my mission after this semester and I am SO GLAD I took his class. He really prepares students for their missions.
Brother Howell is so good a bringing the spirit to class. I really appreciate how thoughtful he is with his lesson planning, he really loves his students and wants them to succeed.

Professor Howell is amazing! He gives you a jump start before serving a mission like reading Preach My Gospel, touring the Provo MTC, service projects, etc. He assigns a lot of busy work, but nothing was hard or time consuming. Even if you aren't planning on serving, this class was so uplifting and his lectures were never boring. Plus no exams!

An easy grader. As well as it is very easy to get full points in class. Perusall (which is there auto grading software) is super finicky. You have to mess around with the platform to get your 100/100.
I enjoyed this class. It was fun and engaging, and it increased my excitement to serve a mission!

This was a great class! Brother Howell was very effective at teaching the spiritual as well as the practical  parts of serving a mission. The assignments we do all serve a purpose and are things we may already have been doing to serve a mission. You should end up with a good grade if you complete all of the assignments.

This class was insightful and helpful in preparing for a mission. It is not hard to get a good grade if you turn in assignments on time and attend class. You can tell that Brother Howell loves his students and wants them to succeed.

This was literally the best class ever!! I was on the fence of whether or not to serve a mission, and this class has given me some real-life experience of what to expect as a missionary, both how to prepare, what to expect, and what to look forward to. It has been incredible!!
Take Mission Prep with Brother Howell! Everyone says this and I agree. He gives a little more work than other teachers but it is the best prep you can get at BYU for a mission!
He does assign a lot of work such as Preach my gospel annotations and scripture tagging which take up a lot of time, but they are useful for the future. Overall he's a great professor

The professor genuinely cares and wants to provide you with the best resources to support you while on your mission. I enjoyed coming to this class! Attendance is mandatory. There are a lot of assignments, but none very hard
a great professor that cares about how his students are doing. Some busy work assignments

Brother Howell very obviously cares about his students and missionary work! The homework is really easy and super essential for mission work! Just make sure you do the assignments and go to class and you will get a great grade!

Brother Howell was awesome! Super sweet and was very passionate about mission prep. The other thing was that his canvas was a little confusing and there were a lot of assignments due Tuesday and Sunday.

Best mission prep class! You will learn about so many resources. Brother Howell puts in so much effort and truly cares about his students. He knows his stuff and wants to prepare us to be the best missionaries. No midterms or finals. Just attendance quizzes and weekly assignments prepping us to be good missionaries.

Brother Howell is a great teacher! You can tell he is passionate about missionary service and cares about both his students and the missionaries he teaches at the MTC! I really liked how he showed us many resources that we will be able to use on our missions. I enjoyed his insights and stories! I would have liked to practice teaching lessons more.

Professor Howell is so amazing! You can tell how genuine he is, he really cares about all of his students and what he is teaching! You are lucky if you get to take a class from him. Mission prep specifically was an amazing class. I feel so prepared for my mission. He puts so much effort into each class and you can tell.
I had an amazing experience! For sure take if you're questioning a mission!
I took mission prep with Brother Howell. He was amazing and assignments were easy. There were no mid terms or finals.
Brother Howell is amazing!! I highly recommend taking his mission prep class. It is an easy credit and also helps you feel better about going into a mission.

Professor Howell is an awesome professor. I loved his class. He brings in a lot of guest speakers (which I personally really enjoyed). If you show up and do your homework, you will do well in this class.

This professor is amazing! He is so kind and respectful. He is willing to work with students. I love, love, LOVED this class. There are no exams, only projects and homework. Participation matters, but it's so worth going to class. I can genuinely say I feel so prepared for my mission. I'm so glad I took this class.

Brother Howell's mission prep class is great and also super easy! No midterms or final, just a steady flow of weekly homework, but it's all purposeful. He's really good about bringing in recent converts or nonmembers so we can hear about their stories. Overall a super easy class that's good for preparing you for your mission.

I loved Brother Howell's class. There were no big projects but just a manageable stream of weekly  assignments. It is a bit more work than a normal 2 credit class but I feel like it really prepared me well for a mission. I think you could pass pretty easily doing very little but I also got a lot out of putting some effort in.

Brother Howell is an amazing mission prep teacher! There are no midterms and finals and because of that I think I got a lot more out of the class. If you take mission prep, take it from Brother Howell!

I loved Professor Howell's class, it prepared me for my mission very well. There is an emphasis on loving others and  representing the Lord the best we can by loving and serving people we teach. Lots of assignments, but all worth the time. He can talk a lot and  interrupt students, but this is because he cares and is excited to teach his students.
Super great mission prep class!! 100% would take again. The work load was very doable and everything had a purpose.

Brother Howell was a great teacher! His class had a lot of work and there were a few times when things felt like busy work, but for the most part he did a great job of giving us assignments that were actually really helpful. Attending class is mandatory and there will be a daily quiz that you have to take to prove you were there.
Brother Howell is awesome! He is ready with a joke every class. Attendance matters a lot so make sure to go to class. Overall he is a great professor and I would take his class again.

He is a very engaging professor that enjoys offering students experiences to help increase there learning, whether its bringing in converts and giving us the chance to hear their stories, to mission presidents with pieces of advice for us, to being able to teach lessons with classmates so that we can experience what it's like.

Brother Howell knows what he talks about, and gives us all the resources we could possibly want. But, I feel he sometimes tramples over students, saying that their questions are "irrelevant", and is not the most considerate person. I think a different class would have been better testimony wise, but now I have resources to teach with I guess.

Brother Howell was an amazing teacher who prepped the entire class for each and every mission regardless of where in the world we are headed. This class was helpful to find tips and tricks, and scriptures that will help us on the field. We were required to read Preach My Gospel, Adjusting to Missionary Life, and other helpful materials.

He is amazing and loves what he teaches! I always feel the spirit in his classroom. He is very kind and understands that we are busy college students, so he doesn't give hard assignments. There are no tests, just lots of readings from Preach My Gospel, the scriptures, etc. A very manageable class and nothing felt like busy work.

He was a great professor! We did have a good amount of assignments each week, but they were all geared towards preparing us for our missions, so it was worthwhile. He brought in engaging guest speakers such as converts, past mission leaders, and his wife to share insight as well.
Loved his teaching! Not a lot of work and lots of great opportunities to learn more about the spirit.

I had an excellent experience in his class. He is very caring, respectful and shows concern for all his students. It was not a difficult course, but all that is asked is that you participate and attend class. Each assignment is beneficial and there is no "busy work".
Howell was nice you can tell he really cares about missionaries!

It feels like a lot of assignments, but each of them helped me to feel more confident in deciding to serve a mission. I was introduced to so many new resources, learned how to teach and strengthened my testimony.
Brother Howells class is so fun! He brought in recent converts, past mission presidents, and even brought his wife in to give lectures to our classes.
Learned a lot and prepared me well for my mission. Puts a lot of effort into his lectures and wants to get to know you personally.
Good Professor! Would take again for this class!
Brother Howell was awesome! Super kind and caring! Some things in the class were a little unorganized but overall great professor!
Great professor, just not my favorite

Professor Howell frequently interrupts and walks over students. He knows what he is talking about and you will learn a lot but it all feels very intense. I feel like he is teaching us to recruit people to the church, not to love the people we are teaching. His style is one of the reasons that many people don't like mormon missionaries.

Brother Howell is an amazing professor, and I would totally take his class again! I took a Friday morning course (2 hours) instead of a twice-a-week course. He taught really inspiring lectures; we heard from recent converts, created a mission study journal, studied PMG, and he helped me feel so much more prepared for a mission!

This class is very insightful, he is very passionate about Missionary work and it's great. It's like pre-MTC, you will read and annotate Preach My Gospel, record thoughts in a journal, take an MTC tour, and do service. He doesn't sugarcoat things either, he acknowledges that missions are very difficult and you will have struggles on your mission.

Took UNIV-101 with him, such an amazing Professor. He genuinely cares about each of his students like no other. He is hilarious as well, and knows just about everything about BYU and campus activities. I have learned so much from him. I don't think I could have chosen a better professor for this class, 100% recommend taking any course from him.

Awesome class, awesome teacher. Absolutely helped me in my decision to go on a mission. He was so genuine in his lessons, and so willing to listen to students. I'm so grateful for Brother Howell and his support for missionaries!

Get ready for a lot of assignments, but they are all pretty easy and can be done well in advance if you're on top of things from the beginning. Brother Howell is incredibly kind and caring and has an infectious passion for missionary work. It was through this class that I became excited for my own mission and now I can hardly wait to get my call.

Brother Howell was excellent at preparing us for the mission. He had us read through Preach My Gospel throughout his class, and did a very good job helping us to be aware of available resources. There are a lot of homework assignments so you need to stay on top of things, but none of them are very difficult, they just take some time and thought.

While Brother Howell's class is filled with exorbitant amounts of busy work, the class is well worth it for how awesome the professor is. Brother Howell truly loves every individual who takes his class and wants all of us to be successful missionaries.
Lots of work but he spends lots of time with assignments and in-class lectures. Nothing is just busy work. He cares for his students and the process.

He is very in tune with the Spirit and really cares about his students. I feel about as prepared as I could be for my mission. He really covers all concerns or questions you could have about a mission, and everything that would be helpful to know.
Complete assignments and you will be fine.

Professor cares about every student and wants future success for every student as well. There is a big focus on Canvas assignments, keep up to date on your readings and annotations to make this class easier.

Professor Howell is a very considerate teacher that is fully committed to teaching the gospel and increasing the spirituality of his students. His lectures are engaging and the content is very beneficial for those about to leave on their missions. I would definitely recommend taking from him.

Brother Howell's class is so good and has truly prepared me for my mission. I just didn't like his personality in general... Definitely just a personal problem. He's very kind and genuine and other students I've talked to in class adores him. So even though I wouldn't take a class from him again, I will always recommend him for this course

Brother Howell was such an understanding professor and gave his missionary prep students incredible opportunities like serving lunch at the MTC. We didn't have any tests and our homework was very clear. Involves reading in Preach My Gospel (your textbook) and taking notes about it for most assignments. Great teacher for this class!

Bro. Howell is an amazing professor who cares about his students and is always willing to help! His class got me excited to serve a mission and helped me feel more confident in my ability to do so. I always left his class feeling the Spirit.

Listen, I am a rate my professor junkie. I know what's up. And I can say with full confidence that if you are looking for an inspiration, easy but thought provoking, fun, and SPIRITUALLY UPLIFTING class this is the one to take. His testimony is powerful and I have been forever changed through his LOVE for missionary service and Jesus Christ.

Scott Howell assigns lots of small assignments, but all of them are worth it. I cannot think of a single homework assignment I felt wasted my time. I am grateful I was able to have him as a professor.

I was a little skeptical of if I would like Brother Howell at first, but as the semester went on I started to like him more and more! He really cares about his students and about the subject he teaches. You study most of Preach My Gospel which is really helpful mission prep.

Brother Howell is an amazing professor for Mission Prep. I feel so much more prepared and ready for my mission than I did prior to taking the class. He helps you tag scriptures and prepare a missionary journal, all things you can use on your mission. It is a lot of work, but only if you procrastinate and have to do it all at the end.
Brother Howell was super informative and I feel much more prepared to serve a mission. He knows what he's talking about.

I LOVED taking mission prep from Brother Howell! The assignments were meaningful and useful. He definitely helped us feel more excited to serve. His assignments are easy, and when turning them in he simply asks if you did it (he's big on integrity). Make sure you actually do them on time because they can pile up. He'll check at end of year.
I learned a lot, and he was a great professor. The professor was easy to talk to outside of class and very supportive.

Take this class!!! His mission prep class is amazing, he is an incredible man who genuinely wants us to succeed and do well on the mission. He brought the spirit to every class and had lots of guest lectures from converts or RMs that were so good!

Amazing teacher who will inspire you and bring the Spirit into the room whether you are thinking about a mission or not. Very easy grader just make sure that you do the work periodically throughout the class, like you're supposed to. Easy A and you'll love his lectures. Less of lectures honestly and more of just conversations and chill slides.
greatest teacher of all time!
Makes sure you do a lot of work, which while helpful, makes it feel like a 3 credit class and then some.

I love Brother Howell. the spirit was always present, and I learned so much about missions. we had the opportunity to tour and serve in the MTC, and it was such an amazing experience. He taught in a way that showed he genuinely cared and loved all his students. I would take this class again. This was definitely my favorite class all semester.
AMAZING AND SPIRITUAL

He's a very good professor! He cares a lot about his students! Incredible preparation and tips for my mission! However, do not procrastinate! The assignments and work will pile up and leave you scrambling. Overall, amazing class and professor! Super great spiritual insights and great for mission prep!

Brother Howell is an excellent professor. His class is never boring, and he makes them fun to be in. Sometimes more homework than you'd expect but easy to stay on top of. Brother Howell is fun to be around and makes the class entertaining. Definitely one of the best religion credits I have taken here at BYU.

There are a lot of assignments that he stacks on the same day, but they generally don't take that long to do. He is genuinely trying to teach you how to be a good missionary and to keep those skills after your mission.

Loved this class. Love Brother Howell. There was a lot of work in the class but Brother Howell is very understanding and all the work is necessary and very good work to help prepare for the mission. Loved it.

Brother Howell loves missionary work above all else. While I may not have loved all of the assignments we had, I could tell that there was a distinct purpose behind them. If you put in the time, you'll definitely be well prepared to start your mission and have good perspective going into it.

Scott Howell was an AMAZING mission prep teacher!!! He truly cares and one thing I really like that he does is that he invites recent converts and recently returned missionaries to talk to the class. It's really helpful to hear from recent converts on what they like and didn't like about their missionaries. Howell is such a sweet teacher!

Mission prep with Brother Howell is the best! So many great resources and discussions. He is so loving and experienced. My favorite was when recent converts would come to talk about their experiences with missionaries and what they did wrong/right. This class is easy if you care to put in the effort (there are quite a few weekly assignments).
Brother Howell is just so Wholesome!! You can tell he really cares about missionary work and he does a good job getting you ready.

Brother Howell was a really great teacher for mission prep. He and his wife were mission presidents, so he has a lot of real-life experience and advice. I admit it took me a little bit to warm up to him, but once I did, he was really amazing and I can see how much he cares for his students and how passionate he is about missionary work!

Brother Howell is the kindest person on the planet earth! He is willing to listen if you have a problem completing an assignment on time and will work with you. COMMUNICATION IS KEY with Brother Howell. He is super funny and knows how to keep the class engaged while teaching. I will recommend EVERYONE to take Brother Howells class.

Professor Howell is amazing! His assignments aren't difficult and not overwhelming if you stay on top of your work. He is so kind and very understanding. You can tell he loves the gospel and cares about all his students.

This class was the best! If you do the work, you're guaranteed an A. The assignments in this class were definitely doable--I spent about 1-2 hours per week on homework. Brother Howell is one of the most Christlike people I know, and I thoroughly enjoyed every class I went to.

Brother Howell is a super great mission prep teacher! He cares about his student's and gets super excited about teaching mission prep. The class basically consists of reading prepatory content for your mission including preach my gospel. Super helpful for preparing for your mission. And added bonus... no final exam!
He is a super funny and friendly guy but also serious about learning what you need to know!
I love this class and it really helped me prepare for my mission!

This is a great professor. He cares a lot and this class will definitely help you grow. A few things, though: a cut off for an A is a 95 and you'll have around four assignments a week. Attendance is 25% of your grade, so if you're late a lot or like to skip class, I wouldn't take this from him. Not difficult work, you just can't slack.

Brother Howell was a great teacher. The way he had the assignments on CANVAS organized made it very clear when assignments were due. He was also responsive to emails, and is just a very nice and enthusiastic guy that makes you care about the gospel.
Brother Howell was a great teacher. He was very clear on when different assignments had to be done, responsive to emails, and was very enthusiastic about the subject he was teaching.

I was excited to take Bro Howell's class. However, I was disappointed. I liked the study journals and how the class was set up. But he seemed a little aggressive/condescending He often interrupted the converts that he brought in to talk to us. It was not always rude, but it felt awkward at times. I'd take again, but was not my favorite teacher.

I really liked this class! Brother Howell is a fantastic teacher and his classes always went by so fast. One thing that I loved about him was how much he cared about his students. I feel like I am so much more prepared for my mission because of his class.

Brother Howell is very experienced with and passionate about missionary work! He teaches about a lot of good practices for missionaries. We also learned about good resources to use when teaching. Instead of a final, we worked on a mission study journal all semester. There are a lot of assignments, but they are not difficult.

It was good to be in PMG and other missionary resources so much, but I feel like it was really lecture heavy. Bro Howell has a lot of good insights, but I wish there would have been more time for us to have class discussions and participate, especially concerning the purpose of the class.

Professor Howell is an amazing teacher! The workload is not awful (two relatively easy assignments each Sunday, Tuesday, and Thursday) and he is so caring and loves his students very much. If you want to succeed on your mission, take his mission prep class!
Brother Howell is awesome! I feel the spirit so strongly in his class. The work is easy, no final.
Brother Howell was an amazing professor! He was very fun to watch and listen to in class, and is very caring and passionate about what he teaches! I would definitely recommend taking him!
No exams! Your final is a journal that you work on all semester. Beware of falling behind! Keep up with assignments and you'll be fine.

Bother Howell is an amazing Professor! If you're looking for any easy class that will still be intellectually and spiritually enlarging take this class! No Exams and not too heavy of a workload. Brother Howell truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Nothing but good things to say about him.
He is so kind. I loved being in his class.
The best professor!

Brother Howell was super passionate about his work. Yes, you'll have quite a few assignments every week, but they don't take too long and never felt like busy work if you're preparing to leave on a mission. Would recommend!
He's a pretty epic dude.
Great professor! Showed a strong passion for missionary work and helped the spirit be present in class. Lectures were very casual and work was easy but meaningful. Would definitely recommend!

Very passionate about missionary work and preparing you to go on a mission. The class is very light work and every assignment is designed to help you. One of the most spiritually uplifting religion classes I have taken at BYU.
He helped me prepare for my mission and helped me be excited to go on my mission!

He has you do a lot of assignments online but they are super easy. (This was for mission prep) All the things he has you do really prepare you for missionary life and help you understand the things you will be teaching.

Pretty good teacher, but some of his practices and assignments bugged me. For example, I didn't like how writing notes in our personal mission study journal was part of the grade for most assignments.

I loved taking Mission Prep from Brother Howell! He was totally considerate and caring to all of the students in the class, he made assignments instructional, and you could tell he genuinely cares about you. I definitely recommend this class!

I loved taking Mission Preparation from Brother Howell this semester. I found all his assignments to be helpful, and I can see myself using everything he has taught me on a mission. He also genuinely cares for each of his students, and makes a great effort to learn your names. I loved this class!

Brother Howell's mission prep class is fantastic and so helpful. I have recommended him to everyone wanting to take mission prep at BYU. He is caring, loves to teach, and always says he loves us. After taking this class, I am a better person, and I feel it is worth your time. There are quite a few assignments, but they are not complicated.

I LOVE BROTHER HOWELL! His lectures are so inspirational. He is always eager to help you fill the spirit. I always left his class feeling better than when I entered. There is a good amount of work, but it is fairly easy and mostly graded on the honors system, and there is no midterm or final.

Brother Howell is super awesome and has made me feel more prepared than ever to serve a mission! He keeps class fun and enjoyable, while helping us feel the spirit and grow closer to our Savior. You do have a fair amount of homework weekly, about 1-3 hours, but it pays off and prepares you immensely for serving!
Super easy but great class!

He is an amazing professor and really invites the spirit into his classroom so well! There are a decent amount of assignments but they're relatively easy and are so helpful for the mission! He really cares for each student and is so funny, would highly recommend him to anyone who is preparing or even just considering serving a mission!
Easy class. You will get out of the class what you put into the class. Everything is based off the honor system.

Scott Howell is an exceptional instructor. BYU's finest. He is able to teach and explain things very clearly even enough for a fool like me to understand. He is passionate about his work. He's not in for the money, he's in because he cares about missionaries and wants to make a difference. SO very inspiring.
Brother Howell is so awesome! He has a lot of amazing feedback that will actually help you feel more prepared for a mission. He is so kind and understanding as well.

He was almost condescending about certain things and a little aggressive which I felt was unnecessary. I wish he would've done more spiritually strengthening things for this course rather than have us read a bunch of chapters that we will read on our missions. He did do a good job at showing us what resources are available to us though.

Brother Howell gives a good amount of assignments, but they are all super easy. The format is the same every week, so you're never blindsided by assignments you didn't know about. Most importantly, it's clear how much he loves his students. Super inspiring class that's great for mission preparation.

Brother Howell was great; his classes quickly became my favorite. He always put me in a good mood, and he really invited the Spirit to our classes throughout the year. As long as you are accountable for doing your assignments, you will learn a lot.

Brother Howell was the best mission prep teacher I ever had. Although he gives you a good amount of assignments every week, none of it is busy work and it will only prepare you immensely for your mission! He was awesome and I hope I get to have him again! He provides such wonderful opportunities to grow your testimony.

The professor really cares and teaches effectively. The class is attendance mandatory and has a small and easy homework assignments three times a week due at 10:30 pm ("Missionary Time") but it wasn't a problem for me. I would have preferred more practice with planning/ giving lessons but I learned a lot in this class other than that.

Brother Howell cares deeply for all of his students, and has a passion for missionary work that is hard to beat. He's great to talk to after class if you have the time, and is willing to help students out with any technical issues they may be experiencing.
There's not a lot of clarity of the topics being presented in class and it doesn't really feel like there's an organized plan.

I loved Professor Howell!! He is adorable. He is one of the most caring professors and truly cares about what he is teaching. His lectures are slightly disorganized but always enjoyable. He has some great advice to his students and  always makes you feel better after his class.

Excellent Class! I feel much more prepared to go on a mission now that I have taken it. Main assignments are annotating Preach my Gospel, adjusting to missionary life, watching the Safety zone videos, and a few projects/field trips (MTC tour was amazing)

Brother Howell's mission prep class was very easy and informative. If I'm being honest, I found the homework assignments the most meaningful/enriching part of the class. Attendance is definitely mandatory, but if you show up and do the homework, you should get an A.
Best mission prep professor! I learned so much that will help me on my mission. I feel a lot more prepared to serve!

Professor Howell is the sweetest professor I've had so far. He is so passionate about missionaries and he wants to help you strengthen you faith! There are a few little assignments each week and one bigger project due on Sunday nights but they are so simple and will help prepare you to be a great missionary in ways you haven't thought of!
He is so kind! I love how his homework helps you grow if you make a diligent effort. Plus, he has service projects to serve feeding missionaries at the MTC, which is amazing.
hes amaing!!! take this professor for mishion prep you wont regret it. He prepared me so well and is the msot caring professor I have. He is so enthusiastic and cares SO much about his students.

Professor Howell is easily the best professor I have ever had. He cares so much about his students and there preparation for there mission. He cares for all of his students so much. He is the best of the best!!!
Brother Howell was so amazing! He's so nice and caring. There was homework but it was manageable and I feel so much more prepared for my mission. I would definitely recommend!
He's a really good professor. The weekly assignments aren't bad and you learn a lot about how to be a good missionary.

Professor Howell is such a nice guy. Although the class has a lot of homework and set deadlines, he always explains what's required for out-of-class assignments. He is also quick to respond to emails if any issues arise.

Professor Howell made his class so engaging. If you are wanting to serve a mission I highly recommend you take his Mission Prep class because you will learn so much. He gave a really light work load and there are no tests. The homework that you do have is all very enjoyable because it is all material you will be using and studying on your mission.

There are not enough good things I can say about Professor Howell! He is so kind and you can tell he really cares about each of his students. The homework is super manageable and there are no tests so this class is very easy. He does an amazing job at preparing students for the mission field and getting them excited to serve! I loved this class!
Great teacher. There are around 4 or 5 assignment due each week but it's easy stuff. There is no final.

Brother Howell is very passionate about missionary work! He shares a lot of helpful practical resources for missionaries. There are no exams, but there is a mission study journal you work on all semester. It is an enjoyable class with not too much work and a lot of helpful information.

Brother Howell is so funny but also caring and inspirational- his mission prep class was awesome! There are a lot of assignments but they're all super easy. Mission prep was a great class and I'd definitely recommend taking it from Brother Howell!

Brother Howell is such a funny guy! I was in his mission prep class, and it was super easy and super helpful. Brother Howell has so much experience with missionaries and missionary work and he is perfect to teach this class. Attendance was graded, if you are more than 3 minutes late to class you don't get credit for the day.

His class can be a little confusing to follow, but I tend to have a hard time with Canvas so that may be why. Overall, it was a very good class! He brought in recent RMs and converts to talk about their experiences and that was so great!! He's definitely the one to take missionprep from. You'll watch SafetyZone videos, read PMG, and prepare well!
Professor's lectures were great and the homework is not very hard.
He was great. You just need to show up and do the homework. There's a lot but it's the easiest homework ever and should not be a problem in your studies

Brother Howell provided a lot of useful information and resources. His homework assignments were useful and worthwhile. His teaching style could sometimes be disorganized or sporadic, but overall his lessons had a clear point.

Brother Howell is a great mission prep teacher! My only complaint could be that this class had more reading and work than I thought it would be, but it honestly isn't too bad and is manageable as long as you don't procrastinate it. Overall, an amazing professor and I would totally recommend taking this class from him!
Very clear guidelines for the class. Not meant to hurt your GPA. Professor Howell really just wants to prepare you for your mission.

Brother Howell is a great mission prep teacher. His lessons and assignments are simple yet effective in helping the students come closer to Christ and prepare for missions. I have heard stories of other mission prep teachers giving huge tests, but we never had those in his class.
Brother Howell is very respectful and cares about the students. He taught the class in a very effective way.

Professor Howell is very nice. You can tell he cares a lot about Missionary work. He does have a tendency to interrupt people but it is simply because he is excited. His Canvas is nicely organized into weeks, making it easy to find what is due when. The assignments aren't very hard but there is a kinda steep late penalty so don't forget to do them!

The class was very focused on preparing you for the day-to-day and purpose of a mission.  It wasn't doctrinally heavy, which was a bit disappointing for me because I was hoping for a more spiritual approach to mission preparation, but it was good at preparing you mentally and giving you an idea of what missions are like.

Professor Howell has an obvious love for missionary work which is really contagious, so I loved that about his class. He also gave me so many resources for my mission that really prepared me to serve. However, I wish that class would have been more focused on the Savior and that there would have been chance for discussion, but that wasn't provided.
Great professor, I felt the Spirit all the time in this class. There is a lot of busy work, but it prepares you well for a mission.

This was my favorite class. I felt the spirit so much. Brother Howell is the nicest guy and he truly loves you and wants to best prepare you for your mission. There a bit of work, but its totally manageable and its stuff that will prepare you the best for your mission. Would definitely take again!
there is a lot of busy work, but it does prepare you for a mission so it is worth it.

Brother Howell is a wonderful mission prep teacher. He really knows his stuff and has lots of in's with the MTC. Attendance is mandatory and you will lose some points if you miss even just one class. But it is good!

Really loves missionary work and is probably more excited than I am that I am serving a mission. Super awesome guy, really fair with the work load and just wants us to be the best possible missionaries rather than assigning assignments just for the sake of it. Not a hard class and definitely feel way more prepared then I did before. Def recommend.

This class was the most spiritual class ever. Professor Howell loves his students and has so much wisdom to share. He cares less about course work and more that you are progressing towards your goals. The assignments are easy, if you read them, you get credit, no tests. This class has prepared me for missionary work more than anything else!

Professor Howell was great and showed us lots of new resources. I really enjoyed this class, but I do feel like we focused a lot on technology and the technological side of being a missionary rather than learning about how to develop a Christlike character or practicing teaching lessons. We did a little bit of that, but I wish we'd practiced more.

Professor Howell was amazing! Out of all the mission prep I've done and the classes I've taken in my home stake, I feel like this class prepared me the most for my mission. Brother Howell helped us prepare spiritually, but he also taught us about safety, logistics, and gave us incredible resources to use on our mission.
He clearly cares and loves all of his students

Professor Howell is the best missionary preparation teacher I could have asked for. He was so helpful and made my desire of going on a mission grow so much. The material you cover in that class is so helpful and everything is amazing. There is a little bit of reading per week but maybe an hour tops.

The content of this course was really good but I didn't love Brother Howell as a teacher. He shared a lot of helpful information, but I often found his behavior in class to be standoffish or even rude. He was very strict about not being late to class, but he himself was often late and I found that among other things to be very hypocritical.
This class keeps you organized and  helped me prepare for my mission. Lots of tedious assignments, but ultimately will help you prepare. The lectures are required.
It always felt like he was rushing through the content and had his own agenda. He didn't show much compassion for the students and felt very disconnected from what it is like to be a student.

This Professor is really good about preparing you for a mission.  He really cares that you will succeed and doesn't make class to difficult.  He's a little funny and a really nice guy.  I would recommend taking his class he was awesome.

I love Brother Howell! Great sense of humor. I loved reading from PMG (the textbook lol) and hearing stories first-hand from freshly baptized converts about their missionaries and new RMs. He focuses on serving like Christ, and his big thing is building a Mission Study Journal to take to the MTC and in-field. Be on time to class!

I looked forward to going to this class every time! Brother Howell was is very experienced and has so many interesting stories! He brought in lots of guest speakers as well which was very helpful! Not a lot of homework, and all assignments were easy!

Brother Howell was such a great teacher. I learned a lot from his class and have started to feel prepared for my upcoming mission. His class wasn't too hard and definitely prepares you for the mission.
Bro. Howell was such a good teacher!! I loved his class. As long as you work on your journal a little bit every week you will be just fine!
He genuinely cares about his students and wants you to succeed. The ultimate goal is to prepare you for a smoother transition into becoming an effective missionary.

This class has really helped me feel prepared for my mission. We covered everything the handbooks can't teach you about being a missionary. We built a study journal that you are supposed to take on your mission, and we recorded so many tips from convert and RM panels that were helpful. Brother Howell was a mission prez so he knows what's up.
This is a great class to take to prepare for your mission! Easy but affective in helping you learn.

I LOVE BROTHER HOWELL!! Seriously the best professor I have ever had. There is never a boring day in this class, he is always joking around with us and makes class so fun! The workload is very light but I still felt like I got a LOT out of this class!! He really helped me prepare for my mission and genuinely loves his students. TAKE HIM!!!!
He is very kind and understanding and is willing to work with anyone.
He was great, a lot of things to do out of class, but worth it
Brother Howell was such a caring professor who really loves his students. With that being said, he can be a little blunt at times but it is because he cares for your future as a missionary of God. :)
I learned a lot in this class and felt more prepared to serve a mission!

Brother Howell is absolutely incredible!! He is so so kind. Every class I felt the spirit so strongly, more than I do in church sometimes. This class is very flexible, which I really enjoyed. He doesn't rush through things to try and cover all the curriculum, instead he just lets the spirit guide. He made going on a mission seem much less scary.

If I had not already received my mission call before taking this class, I don't think I'd be going on a mission anymore. I never felt the Spirit in Professor Howell's class- in fact, I mostly just felt annoyed. Too much busy work and he's incredibly judgmental towards people who he deems as less than his too-high standards.
Little messy in slide shows but super fun and easy.
The lectures were simple and enjoyable. All of the assignments were fairly easy and beneficial. Super chill religion class to take

Brother Howell was an amazing professor! I took this class thinking I wasn't going to serve a mission, but Brother Howell made this class interesting and comforted my concerns that he did not even know I had. I always walked out of this class feeling good and inspired about mission work. I recommend taking mission prep from Howell!

I took Mission Prep from Scott Howell. He does not have any tests. Your grade in the class is based on your completion of the assignments. The whole purpose of the class is to prepare you for a mission rather than to challenge you. Assignments can sometimes take a bit to complete, but they are never that bad.
Brother Howell is the goat, he is super friendly and always makes class engaging and fun.

The class was kind of all over the place, and there was never a set lesson plan Brother Howell is an amazing person. You can tell he truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. There are a lot of assignments, but they are super simple and easy to complete. Attendance is done by a quiz and access code at the beginning of class.

Professor Howell would always talk to me after class and make sure I'm doing alright with all my classes. If he forgot somebody's name, he'd never do it again; he always cares about every student. If class attendance wasn't part of the grade, I would still go: there's nothing more uplifting than a Friday morning with the legendary Brother Howell.
I would recommend Scott Howell's Mission Prep course. If you're willing to put in the work, you can get a lot out of it.

Professor Howell's mission prep class is a lot of work, but super helpful. The lectures can feel disorganized, but engage with the material and use tools like unstuckstudy ai, and you'll learn a ton. He's a caring teacher who wants you to succeed.

A lot of work, but definitely worth it. Professor Howell creates a great class environment - he's super knowledgeable and caring. For study prep, I found unstuckstudy ai really helpful alongside the free textbook.
I loved Dr. Howell! I learned a lot without being overwhelmed. An easy, worthwhile class.
He's super caring of his students and wants everyone to succeed! The assignments are easy but there are multiple per day outside of class.

Scott Howell was one of the best teachers I have ever had for a class. His mission prep 130 class was super easily, but he taught it so well so you learned so many important things. You have to read and annotate 90% of the Preach My Gospel book and make a mission study journal which is kind of a lot, but if you do it over time it is extremely easy.
Super respected and caring. Very straightforward about what is due as well as when exactly it's due.
He is a really good professor and the class was overall pretty easy. There is some busy work but it's not hard and his classes are engaging and interesting.
Be sure to take notes in this class and go to the professor if you ever need help- he is very understanding and kind.

Extremely kind and understanding, and willing to work with you and make accommodations. Lots of reading and annotating in the class, but it gives you so much experience and so many resources to help you prepare for a mission! Prepare to work, but I totally recommend.
Brother Howell cares a lot about missionaries so it can feel like a lot of work at times but it's because he is trying to prepare his students as much as possible!
He is very lecture heavy and the classes have nothing to do with the homework but they are entertaining.
The nicest professor ever!

Taking the class was 100% one of the best decisions I've ever made. Professor Howell knows his stuff, and he wants to help you. I took his Mission Prep class, and it wasn't easy, but it shouldn't have been because becoming a missionary isn't easy. So he helped prepare all of us and gave us some of the best tips you can't hear anywhere else!

I loved this class! We read Preach My Gospel, Adjusting to Missionary Life, and other missionary resources. It was super inspirational, helped me learn the ins and outs of a mission, how to best prepare myself, and I feel much closer to Christ after taking this class. I would recommend this class to anyone, even if you aren't sure about serving.

Professor Howell is always open to questions. Never hesitate to ask him for help on something because he is willing to help you. Go into this class with an open mind to do what is required, and enjoy the lectures. It is a very lightweight, spiritually filled class.
Brother Howell's class was amazing! I learned so much and was provided with many tools that will help me as I head into my mission in a few weeks.
love him he was such an amazing teacher he was so fun
He is really funny and super nice! He is such a great professor!

Brother Howell is a good teacher who does a nice job teaching the concepts and providing ways for us to absorb the material. That being said, there is a lot to do in this class, and it can sometimes sneak up on you.
He was a wonderful teacher who would stick around after class and talk to students. Very understanding and kind and I would absolutely take him again if I could.

I thought the teaching style was great especially for missionaries who are going to go out and serve. Something that was great about the professor was that he really cares about missionary service. I liked the way he taught. There were some challenging assignments in the class, but overall it was a good learning experience.
Brother Howell really cares about his students and wants them to get good grades. There are a lot of assignments but they aren't hard and really help prepare you for your mission.

He's good at teaching, and if you follow along you'll be in good shape for the class. The type of assignments/ projects make sense considering it's a mission prep class, but the caliber of work/ assignments is way more than any other 2 credit class I took. I didn't put as much effort into the class as I should have, and so my grade kinda got owned
Professor Howell is very passionate about missionary work. He is a great teacher that will help and inspire you for your mission.

Brother Howell is the man, he is experienced in the gospel, in missionary work, and as a teacher. You can tell he loves his students and wants us to improve and be great missionaries. He organizes his lessons and the homework very well. It was a pleasure taking his class, I hope to see him in the MTC!

Experiential learning is Howell's teaching style. Most of the work for class you do outside of the classroom, but it is not busywork, but assignments designed to help you practice what you need to do for the mission. This was an extremely practical course that has been a ton of work but I'm glad I took. Howell takes a lot of guesswork out of stuff.

I loved Brother Howell's class. He is genuinely trying to help us each prepare to serve. Lots of inspirational guest speakers from new converts to RMs. There is a lot of work for a 2 credit course. However, almost all is graded by competition, and getting an A is easy. Low-stress course. No tests or exams. Be 5 min early. Never late.

Brother Howell is incredibly caring and loving. There is homework that you do not want to procrastinate, but the workload is manageable. It is nothing too crazy. It is awesome content and Brother Howell is such a great professor and person in general.

Brother Howell is a great professor for Mission Prep. He wants all of his students to truly learn what it looks like and what it takes to be a missionary. He wants to see you grow, and with this class, you can.

This professor clearly wants you all to succeed and he is so willing to work with you to make that happen!! If you are looking for an easy religion credit, this should definitely be the class to take. It gets you easy religion credit AND you learn so much while your testimony is also being strengthened. I loved this class and so will you!

Brother Howell is a great guy! I learned a lot in this class that is very applicable to missionary life and I feel like it prepared me really well for a mission. There is a lot of homework, but I really enjoyed it all because it added to my scripture study and didn't feel like work.

I loved Brother Howell! His class not only made me feel more prepared to serve, but made me really excited to go. He eased a lot of my nerves about serving a mission. The class itself wasn't difficult at all, as long as you stay on top of work.

The content is good, but there is a lot of busy work every single day. The amount of work that is assigned gets tedious and not much of it is truly important or meaningful. The actual in class lectures are not terrible but get extremely repetitive and boring.

This course was very helpful in preparing for a mission, I would recommend this course if you are planning on going on a mission. I got to tour the MTC, hear from many returned missionaries, and heard from many recent converts. The professor gives great lectures and always made sure to put all he had into each class.

Professor Howell is great at his job. He's very understanding, organized, makes class fun, and helps his students feel the Spirit every day. I'd highly recommend taking mission prep from him. Lots of great field trips.
I loved Brother Howell. Very open to criticism and wanting to improve. So loving and Kind. I recommend him to all. His Mission Prep course was super helpful and an easy A.
He is verry nice and really works with you. He wants you to succeed. He gave us many cool assignments that wasn't all just reading.

One of my favorite religion classes EVER! Brother Howell truly cares about each student's success and is willing to help if you're eager to work. Multiple readings are due each week but nothing too long. Attendance is mandatory, but you'll love getting to know him and his wife in class!

I love Brother Howell! I took mission prep during summer term and absolutely loved it! You will definitely have work but it's really nothing too crazy. I feel like this class has really helped prepare me! I highly recommend everyone take it!

Brother Howell was amazing!! I took this class in summer term and absolutely loved it! There will definitely be work but it won't be anything too crazy and it does help you prepare a lot! I highly recommend this class!!

This professor only wants you to succeed and he will work with you to make that happen! This is also a great religion credit that is way easier compared to the other ones, so if you're looking for an easy religion credit, take this one!

Shockingly tech savvy professor. He puts long hours into making the course great. Sorta heavy workload but manageable if you stay on top of it. Genuinely useful missionary preparation, especially the tags in gospel library. Great guy. Try to be his friend early on in the course.
Loved this professor. Made it seem like he cared a lot more than just teaching the material.
He is awesome and helps you feel the spirit throughout the term, a decent amount of work though.
He was awesome, it was a super fun class and I was able to learn a lot.
He was good. Heavy class load but super good mission prep.
He was a mission president and he was an awesome professor and gave amazing insights into missionary work.
He is very energetic and does a very good job at keeping us alert. He is very faithful and radiates the spirit. Very inspiring and motivating for my mission.
Hes awesome just be ready to do a lot of homework and note taking.
Good teacher. Hilarious wife.

I thought Brother Howell was a great teacher. He cares about his students and even tried to make the class easier because of previous difficult ratings. He loves his students and his job. A lot of assignments and busy work but all around good class.
Brother Howell was great!! He is so kind and caring and it seems like he really really wants to be there and he wants us to succeed in our missionary work

Mr. Howell did a great job teaching mission prep. His class was fun and he made the content easy to learn and retain. His testimony is so strong and his knowledge of gospel topics is so wide and such a valuable resource. His class made me so much more prepared and excited to serve a mission.
he was absoulty amazing, just enough challage that the class is perfect
Professor Howell is a very knowledgeable and loving teacher. You could tell he put a lot of effort into his course and listens to the feedback from his students to create the best content possible.

Professor Howell is great. Overall, the class has really helped me feel prepared to serve a mission. There are a lot of assignments, but no exams. Some of the best parts of class were when we got to hear from recently returned missionaries and recent converts. Highly recommend because it really does help you feel prepared to serve!
Spread out the work, but other than that it was a good class.

Maintaining University accreditation is important to this professor, so there are a LOT of assignments that take a long time, often feeling like busy work to me.  Professor is very willing to work with you on some things.  Due to the number of assignments, managing the class homework is nearly impossible -- I may have missed 70 assignments.
Professor Howell cares for each and every one of his students. He teaches great lectures and shares a lot of inspirational stories. I highly recommend the class
He is chill.
He lectures the whole time and is so prideful it makes it hard to listen a lot. The stuff is meaningful if you get past that.
he's a nice enough guy
Amazing professor!

Brother Howell is a great teacher. The class consisted of many assignments but all of which were fairly easy. It uses Preach My Gospel as an outline and is a great way to prepare you for a mission. I would definitely take it again.
Great teacher!! There are a decent amount of assignments but they are easy and not super time consuming!
Very nice professor and would take again.

Brother Howell is an amazing person that knows everything about being a good missionary. His classes are always lectures, and they are always super uplifting and awesome. Attendance does count so always show up and participate as much as possible to get everything you can out of it.
I love Brother Howell. His mission prep class helped me prepare for a mission so much. As long as you stay on top of your work, you should do well in his class.

Brother Howell was an amazing teacher that really helped me prepare for my mission. He brought in examples of new converts to teach us how to be the best missionaries that we can be. Brother Howell was also super entertaining. I loved having him as a teacher because he really cared for all of us.

Brother Howell, did a great job at teaching he makes class more exciting by bringing in new members and recently returned missionaries to learn from. Does give a good amount of homework, but each assignment is meaning and will be useful in future missionary service. Defiantly would take this class again.

I loved this class!! Brother Howell gives amazing lectures (sometimes there are guest speakers). There is a lot of homework but it's managable; as long as you stay on top of it and not procrastinate it's an easy class. I recommend this class to anyone but it's a better use of your time if you actually plan to serve.

Professor Howell was a great teacher! most of our work you had to do outside of class, and they we would come into class and talk about it. I thought this was a great class and perfect to prepare us for a mission.
Brother Howell was great! He greeted us with a smile every morning, and was always clear on the assignments we would be expected to complete. Overall a great professor.

I love Brother Howell and mission prep! Most of the learning is done outside of class and it really depends on your effort. It isn't a lot, especially once you get into a rhythm. You self-grade almost everything, which gives you a chance to grow more Christlike in integrity, and being honest about your assignments and attendance is such a blessing.

Professor Howell is amazing and truly cares about each of his students. I felt like there was a good amount of work, but it wasn't difficult and it was also during the condensed summer term. Our main homework was studying Preach My Gospel. There were no tests, just a study journal that was also our final, so make sure to work hard on your journal!

I took his mission prep class over the summer. Genuine caring guy, super hilarious, and wants you to learn. The workload was fairly light but is only as hard as you make it. I highly recommend this class and this professor.

I took his Mission Prep course this summer, and I loved it! Brother Howell totally cares about us becoming our best selves and gives great encouragement and comments on assignments. Just make sure to read Preach My Gospel and to proactively fill out your Mission Study Journal!
I absolutely love him with my whole heart and he made me want to serve a mission more than i ever thought i would want to.
He was a really great teacher and the class was engaging. Brought a lot of guest speakers in and it was a really fun class.

Bro. Howell was a great professor that taught the mission principles and preparation in an amazing way. He cares deeply about the students and makes funny comments. Classes were boring sometimes and somewhat repetitive but I would highly recommend his class.

Brother Howell is a truly caring professor. He teaches because he wants to, and wants his students to succeed, especially in mission prep. He took the time to get to know us, help us feel the Spirit, and learn Preach My Gospel in the best way we could. I feel more prepared for a mission because of what I have learned and experienced in his class!

Scott Howell was a really good teacher that wanted to prepare us to serve missions. Although there was a lot of reading it was well worth it. He used a lot of good examples to teach and brought in guest speakers to help him teach. Each class period was full of good information and was spiritually strengthening.

I loved Brother Howell's Mission Prep class it was very inspiring. I was unsure whether I wanted to serve a mission but now I am so excited to be able to. Brother Howell has so many great insights to missionary work! I think that anyone who is planning or considering to serve a mission should take this class from Brother Howell!

I love Professor Howell's teaching style! He brought in so many converts and recently returned missionaries to share their stories and they each inspired me in different ways and made me more excited to serve a mission! This class is the perfect class for anyone leaving on a mission soon!
This class was so good and I learned so much from it. He brought in different people to talk to us and to learn from and overall it was an amazing experience.
I loved this class and loved brother Howell. This class can seem like a lot but when you put your heart into the work you will see the blessings. I left this class feeling inspired every day.

I'm a freshman taking the Missionary Preparation class in Summer term. Brother Howell taught over 100 students and made sure to invite lots of converts throughout the term to share their conversion process. The class was graded in 4 main sections at 25% each. I love Brother Howell!

Brother Howell is an excellent teacher and the class is great if your preparing to go on a mission. There is a lot of homework and you are expected to always be on time to class but its all to help you become a better missionary in the future. Would definitely take again just make sure you don't get behind.

Very good instructor for mission prep. Having someone who teaches at the MTC and this course enhanced the learning experience. He was able to see what missionaries were having difficult understanding or were just never taught and be able to cover it in class.

Brother Howell was an amazing teacher. He was really good at making each class engaging and intellectually stimulating. I did summer term with him which might have been why our class was pretty easy but overall, it was a super fun class and I loved going!
He was such an awesome teacher!

I absolutely loved this class and Brother Howell!! 
Be prepared to have time consuming work but it is worth it! Brother Howell is so passionate about the Gospel and Missionary work that it makes you want to be serving a mission right now. You can feel the Spirit so much during his classes especially during the convert and return missionary panels.

Good amount of Homework each week, assignments due dates a split up throughout the week. Likes to have cute funny missionary jokes. Make sure to keep up in filling out you Mission Journal, and to record your assignments in the designated page in your journal. Assignments will say how long each takes but is a rough estimate, still takes a while.

I loved Brother Howell. He used love and good works to share his opinions and insights on our topics. A lot of the actual work was outside of class and in class we would talk about how we can become good missionaries.
Really amazing class! He does a great job at preparing people for missions and I can always feel the spirit in his lessons!

He is the sweetest guy! So caring and understanding but also expects things from you and will push you! So grateful I took this class wish I could take it again right before my mission again. It is so helpful I feel so ready now!!!

Professor Howell really sought to prepare students to serve a full-time mission. The workload would be quite easy/average in a fall/winter semester; I took it in the summer, so it was double the work in half the time, but still very manageable. Mostly graded on completion/participation. Engage meaningfully and you'll feel prepared for a mission!
