Brother Howell is an amazing teacher! He know's what he is talking about. Classwork wasn't too hard, but it still made you think. He is also very accommodating. I had to miss the first week of the term, and he helped me to make up the assignments I missed. His lectures are inspiring, and chock-full of great information. Highly recommend!

It is an incredible class and the mission journal is a valuable resource that is a product of the class. It takes a lot of time outside class to work on, but the work is spread out evenly so it is easy to keep track of.

Professor Howell is everyones best friend. He seriously cares about your grade so much and although the homework takes time, it isn't only engaging and super helpful, but it is super easy. Almost everything is self graded but there is a final at the end where you show everything you've done so you do actually have to do it. Take this class!!

After this class I felt a lot more prepared for a mission. You do a lot of reading in PMG and have a study journal that if you keep up with it is super easy. If you plan to serve a mission, I definitely recommend this class. Brother Howell is awesome and has some great insights.

Professor Howell taught me everything I wanted to know about going onto the missionary field, and taught us things that will help us have a step up on our missions. The work we had to do was somewhat a lot to read, but so interesting to read and learn about. He was easy to talk to if you had a question, it was a spiritually enlarging class for sure
This class was super cool and super helpful. Reading through PMG was super awesome and listening to recent converts and returned missionaries come in and talk was a super cool experience as well.
It was defiantly harder than a two-credit hour religion class should have been, but he really cares about his students and wants us to be prepared for our missions.
I have loved Brother Howell's class! He does an incredible job of preparing us for our missions. I feel more confident in myself and my ability to teach the gospel effectively out in the field.
I had him for the summer term so the class was in a shorter time but he gives a lot of homework. Most of the homework is based on participation and whether you did it or not which is nice.

a lot of projects you have to do outside of class. 2-3 hrs usually for each (but you can bs them). Semester-long journal you have to keep. did it all the day before but it took me 7 hrs. Lectures were all over the place. I do not feel anymore prepared to serve a mission before I took this class from him. He is nice & a good man, just a lot of stuff

If you are looking to prepare for a mission, take this class. My confidence increased 10 fold because of this course. He creates a wonderful class environment where the students can rely and learn from each other. I was told not to take mission prep because it wouldn't help me. That's far from  the truth. I learned so much and feel more prepared.

Brother Howell was a great teacher! He was very nice and although the lectures felt very disorganized at times, I learned a lot. This class has a lot of work, but it's not graded very harshly so as long as you stay on top of it you'll be good.

TAKE MISSION PREP FROM PROFESSOR HOWELL. I absolutely loved his class. There is a decent amount of work but it is so helpful and will definitely be using what I learned on the mish and in life in general. He is such a caring, funny, amazing teacher and teaches you so many useful things. He wants you to get an A and is just an amazing teacher.

SO kind and caring! He reached out personally to check in to see how I was doing several times throughout the class. There is a little more work than other religion classes, but you learn so much and I was actually so interested in what he taught! He also sometimes brings in treats to class. Exams are online and open-note. Stress-free class!

There is a lot of work outside of class but honestly it's doable and not too bad. He's super knowledgable and I feel really helps you get ready for a mission giving you a lot of important and valuable information. I would definitely recommend taking his class
Fantastic man!! He has such a big heart and is so caring. Very helpful for people deciding to serve a mission. TIP: Stay on top of your Study Journal!! Catching up is a PAIN
Professor Howell is awesome! It's a little more work than other religion classes, but the exams are easier and he makes class super fun! 10/10 recommend

Professor Howell is very kind and honestly makes an effort to connect with his students! Personally, I think this course was a bit homework heavy. You will read a ton of Preach My Gospel and are required to take notes on each reading. There are attendance quizzes everyday, but they won't break your grade if you miss one or two.
Lots of reading Preach my Gospel. (It's the basic outline of most of the class) However, I learned a lot from it! The projects were also short was was REALLY nice.

Brother Howell was a great professor and had so much knowledge to share with us. That being said, I feel like the class focused more on the practical side of being a good missionary as opposed to the spiritual side. We spent a lot of time reading from PMG, which is great but as a missionary we'll be spending hours studying that each week.
Brother Howell is incredible at teaching the material, and you can really tell that he loves his students. :)

He is a great professor lots of good stories. His canvas organization was a little frustrating at times. Tests were online and very easy, feels like a long assignment open everything but neighbor. Kind of a lot of assignments but they are easy.

Really kind and genuinely cares for his students. His teaching style wasn't for me as most of his lectures felt rushed, so I would not take from him again. I would recommend his mission prep class as an excellent source of information and preparation. There are a lot of different assignments that have arbitrary due dates, so pay attention to canvas
Professor Howell was great! I loved his class. Some of the assignments were tedious, but overall I really enjoyed this class.

He is a good professor. He obviously cares about his students, but sometimes his tests felt like they came out of nowhere. I would highly reccomend looking over the study guides before lectures. Even with those tests, this was a very easy, yet spiritually enlargening class.
Brother Howell is amazing and such a good teacher! He teaches the important things you need to know before serving a mission and I would take another class from him. The textbook is PMG ;)

He is a good teacher and always willing to help. His Missionary Prep class was excellent! He focuses on what a missionary needs to know. It can feel work-heavy at times, but being a missionary can feel like that too.
Brother Howell is an amazing Mission Prep teacher. He really knows what he is talking about. The class isn't too hard, but sometimes it did feel like there was quite a bit of work due.

Professor Howell cares about what he teaches. Although there are a lot of assignments, they can all be legitimately helpful if you put in the time and effort. You will get out what you put in. He can occasionally be kind of a character in class, but he knows what he is talking about and will prepare you very well for a mission.

I recommend this class! Professor Howell has a lot of students, but I can tell he cares for each of them. The class generally follows the same schedule from week to week, except for when he plans something that seems kind of random. I loved learning more about the living prophets and apostles, and this class helped me do that!
I really enjoyed Brother Howell's class. He made it fun every day and taught me so many valuable things before my mission. I would highly recommend him as a mission prep teacher. He is the best!

Scott is awesome! He uses a lot of love and care and you can tell he wants us to love the prophets as much as he does. He is a great teacher who loves his students. He requires a lot but makes it all attainable.

Professor Howell was an amazing professor for mission prep! He is very loving and caring for all of the students. At the beginning of the semester, he made an effort to learn everyone's names and did so within a few days. There are lots of PMG readings, but they aren't too bad and are necessary to prepare for a mission. Such a wonderful professor!
Great Class and Great Professor!

Brother Howell cares about and loves his students so much! He really brings the Spirit to the classroom every lecture. He is sure to make days in the classroom personal and intimate by sharing stories that are near to his heart.

Professor Howell is a very great Mission Prep Teacher! He has a lot of energy and he really cares about the class and the students.
 The only thing I would be wary of is that there is a lot of assignments. They aren't hard, it is mostly just reading and watching videos. But if you consistently turn them in late, they can hurt your grade.

Brother Howell truly cares for each and every one of his students. There were lots of assignments and readings but they were easy and straightforward. Each assignment has purpose and never felt like busy work. You get out what you put into the class. 

Highly recommend Brother Howell's class!

Professor Howell genuinely cares about his students learning what it takes to become great missionaries. He was funny and encouraging which actually made me excited to go to class! He brought in a lot of guest speakers which was super interesting and informative. As for actual work, there was a good amount of reading and projects but all was easy.

Mission prep with Brother Howell was great! It was very enlightening and I think it will help me a lot as I go into my mission. However, the course was very heavy with small assignments and projects every other week (though not difficult, but time consuming) so much so that it was hard to put enough focus/care into each individual assignment.

I loved this course! The requirements are very straight forward and I knew exactly what was expected of me. The exams were clear, and required minimal preparation. More about having a spiritual experience and interacting with the material than memorizing quotes and dates. Brother Howell cares! A great guy and you can tell he is passionate.

Super great professor and truly cares about his students. He requires a bunch of reading outside of class, but the assignments are very well done and I learned a TON about our Prophet and Apostles. The midterms/ final are tedious, but doable.

Brother Howell is a wonderful person, but comes off a little strong. There is a lot of homework for what you might think is an easier religion course, and sometimes it can be difficult to follow where he's going with things. I love the guy, but it was pretty intense. For each day late 20% of credit is lost on assignments, which was rough.

I took this class not knowing if I wanted to serve a mission. Bro Howell immersed us a missionary's life through the amount of homework. I decided to not go on a mission, and it was hard for me to stay caught up once it didn't apply to me as much. Take this class if you're super excited about going, but it was intense for someone on the fence.

TAKE THIS CLASS! Brother Howell is the best! I left every lecture feeling spiritually invigorated, like after a good devotional. He always taught with the Spirit, scriptures, & the words of prophets. Assignments took me about 5hr/week but were easy. Your grade is based on your effort. This class isn't about memorizing; it's about growth & learning.

This class legitimately strengthened my testimony of the First Presidency and the 12 Apostles. It's a lot of reading but if you're plate is full you can just read the minimum requirement (15 minutes) and comment on a few things. The readings were good though! Attendance is also SUPER  important as he has a little quiz with a new entry code daily.

I loved Brother Howell! He had so many great missionary tips and tricks for us. He emphasizes being on time and/or early, so make sure you aren't tardy for his class. Also make sure to take good study journal notes for the midterm! After taking his class I feel much better prepared to go and serve a mission!

Brother Howell is amazing. He is extremely passionate about what he teaches and very energetic. He was a mission president so he knows his stuff. A lot of the class revolves around a study journal you set up, so be prepared to write in that a lot. There are also a lot of assignments but none of them are too hard, and it's worth it.

Brother Howell is super nice and cares a lot about his students. In the mission prep class, you receive a lot of extremely helpful information that's really good to know before your mission. My only complaint is that there were SO many assignments. It just felt like a lot of busy work for a class that's only 2 credits.
Cares a lot about students and their learning!

Brother Howell is an awesome mission prep teacher! He is funny and engaging in class and I always looked forward to it. It is a little heavier of a workload for the assignments but it isn't difficult and it primarily readings from Preach my Gospel, Saftey Zone videos, and a few projects. The work is helpful and I would recommend taking this class!
Scott was great! This was definitely one of my favorite religion classes.

I loved Brother Howell! His class was just what I needed to start my day! Brother Howell truly does care about you and it shows! Work load is heavier but fairly easy, mostly just a lot of readings out of Preach my Gospel and a few projects. Only downside to this class is you have to be there on time to receive full attendance credit.

Brother Howell is amazing! I love the class and I thought that it really helped to prepare me for a mission. There are a lot of projects, but they are not harshly graded. You have to put effort into this class.
Class was organized well and very informative

brother howell is AWESOME!!! he is such a loving professor like he genuinely cares so much. take this from him!! but just be warned the class is honestly a lot of work. but it's all so applied to missionary service so at least it serves a purpose!! it's not hard to get an a, but just be prepared to have a lot of assignments. :)

This class is seriously so helpful to take before a mission. Brother Howell gives so many helpful scriptures, talks, advice, tips, and assignments that help you grow as a person and prepare to be a missionary. As long as you stay on top of the Preach My Gospel readings and bigger projects, this class will definitely help you grow spiritually.

This class was great! There was a fair amount of homework assignments to do throughout the semester but they were all really easy to do and very straightforward. You could also work ahead on a lot of them too! Loved the things I learned in this class and the Spirit that Brother Howell brought to the content! Would highly recommend!
He is such a nice genuine person. He wants everyone to be as prepared for their mission as possible. There is a lot of homework, it is not hard, just time consuming.

Brother Howell is the best!! He really cares about his students and wants to help them succeed! The assignments were all simple and not too hard.  I learned a lot from him and would definitely take another course from him.

This was a good class. There were readings that you needed to do at the beginning of the week as well as a few other assignments. There was a lot of good information though and very doable. Easy to get a good grade as long as you show up and do the assignments. Very chill

Brother Howell clearly has a love for the gospel and missionary work. There can be a lot of assignments but they aren't too hard and are graded pretty easy. I definitely think this class helped me prepare a lot for my mission

Professor Howell is clearly very passionate about missionary work, and truly loves his students. There are a decent amount of assignments, but they are super valuable and important, especially if you are for sure planning on serving a mission. I feel much more prepared about my service and confident because of the work he assigned.

I love Brother Howell! He is very passionate about missionary service and you can tell he genuinely cares about his students. There are a lot of little assignments but the grading is easy so you don't worry much about your grade. I have enjoyed his class so much. It has not only prepared me for my mission, but made me so excited to serve.
Professor Howell is so passionate about his teaching. He loves the prophets and apostles. He loves Jesus Christ. Sometimes the class feels a little disorganized.
Professor Howell is a great listener and clearly cares about his students. He has a firm and strong testimony of the Prophet's words.

Love him so much! He will make you feel so loved, heard, and important. He will know you by name within the first couple of weeks. He is not only super passionate about what he teaches, he really knows his stuff. The homework load is reasonable and I really enjoyed doing it. If you have questions about literally anything, stay and chat after class.

Scott Howell is an AMAZING professor! I took Mission preparation with him, and I learned so much. Participation and attendance are mandatory in this class (but honestly, you'll want to come to class!) Be ready to be inspired. Note that there is a lot of Book of Mormon and Preach my Gospel reading in this class, but it is very manageable! One exam.

Brother Howell is a nice guy with lots of stories and experiences from the mission field. Overall, I feel that this class prepared me for a mission, but a lot of the material felt kind of redundant and obvious, like most of the material covered in the SafetyZone videos and online material. This felt more like a 3 credit class than a 2 credit class.

He is super funny and random, so classes were really fun. The class was pretty helpful for specific practices as missionaries. There are classes where you practice teaching your small group, and there were several guest speakers that came to talk to the class. Overall, I liked the class, and I learned a lot without it being too stressful.

Brother Howell is the easiest religion professor I have taken at BYU. No papers and easy homework assignments. He is very passionate about the living prophets and apostles and has some amazing stories. Highly recommend this class to anyone looking for an easy religion!

Brother Howell is a great teacher, you can really tell he teaches with the spirit, and was very passionate about the class materials. I loved going to class and hearing him talk on the living prophets. You can tell he cares for his students and is very understanding

Brother Howell is a great professor, you should definitely take him if you are taking RELC130. The hardest part about his mission prep class is the study journal, but if you stay on top of it it's easy.

This is a religion class with the rigor of something like a physics class. There's a lot of homework and a lot of it can't just be BSed through. While I didn't enjoy that part of the class I do think it was really good preparation for my mission. Don't think this class is easy but it is really useful if you are considering going on a mission.
Great teacher! Highly recommend Brother Howell and his class! Great opportunity to learn more about our living prophets!

Great professor with fun lectures. This was my class where I could come to relax and be edified. He's a very spiritual man as well. You can get 100% on pretty much everything if you do it. If you do the work, you'll get an A.

Professor Howell is very passionate about what he teaches. I respect the intention of the assignments, although there is a lot of busy work. I loved the lectures when we can listen, and learn about the prophets and apostles. I did not like the attempts to keep us engaged. I prefer small group discussions instead worksheets with tons of questions.

I liked Bro. Howell, but this was harder than it needed to be. Tons of busy work, and class time felt very scattered with lots of random things thrown together. Each assignment had a good purpose, just wish there were less! Great guy & really cares about preparing you for real mission situations.

This was a really good class! Brother Howell just loves his students and you can really tell in the way he interacts with his students. I would take this class again but there is kind of a lot of reading for the class. The assignment are pretty easy you just have to know that there's a lot of reading for some of them. But loved the class!

This is one of the worst religion classes I have taken. Expect to do three or more assignments before every class. There were lots of projects where he required you to spend 2+ hours doing activities. Attending class was mandatory, yet it felt like a waste of time. Didn't prepare me for a mission at all.

Brother Howell is so kind. There are quite a few assignments, so it takes work to stay caught up, but all of the assignments were fulfilling and absolutely worth my time. Brother Howell gives wonderful lessons and valuable tools to prepare you for the mission. We had service opportunities, panels with guest speakers, and other great assignments.

Professor Howell loves the living prophets. I enjoyed the readings for this class. Each week, we would study the current prophet or member of the quorum of the Twelve Apostles. We would read a short biography on them, their most recent general conference talk, and their most recent posts on social media.
Professor Howell was super caring and so passionate about missionary work!!

Brother Howell is great! He cares a lot about his students and the Living Prophets. It is multiple assignments every week, which can get slightly busy for a religion class, but they are all really cool and interesting to read and learn about.
He's seriously so amazing and cares so much about his students! If you are about to go on a mission please please take his Missionary Prep class!
Super accommodating to your needs. Very sweet guy who genuinely just wants you to learn and succeed.
A good blend of spiritual and practical preparation for any mission. Incredibly useful to take if you are or are considering serving a mission.

I loved Brother Howell! I learned so much in preparation for my mission. There was a lot of assignments for this class, but none of them were particularly hard so I didn't really mind. You need to attend class everyday and be on time.

Brother Howell is the best! He has a degree in education, so he really knows how to structure a class to be most beneficial to learning. All of the assignments are interactive and engaging, and there was never a traditional or boring lecture. The workload is light and Brother Howell always told us way ahead of time what to expect. Take his class!

Professor Howell is amazing. His class was so easy, but so applicable to life. I would for sure take his class again. You do the work outside of class and then in class you go over it a little bit and he shares some great stories.

Brother Howell was an INCREDIBLE Mission Prep teacher! He teaches a lot from Preach my Gospel and Adjusting to Missionary Life. SO helpful to start immersing yourself into those resources before your mission! He puts so much thought and love into all of his lectures and assignments! If you do the work, you'll benefit immensely from this class!! :)
I loved Professor Howell's class! I really felt that he adequately prepared me for a mission. He set his expectations very clearly and didn't have assignments that snuck up on you.

Brother Howell is an amazing professor, one of my favorites, and is focused on building your testimony. There are a lot of assignments for this class. However, I wouldn't say it's more than any of the other religion professors I have had. I would highly recommend to take a class from him to anyone!

There are so many assignments in this class-about 8 a week. They are not super hard but just time consuming. I felt like all of my learning took place outside of class within the assignments and time in class with the professor wasn't super beneficial. You get a grade for attendance though so you have to go. Class is doable, just assignment heavy.

This class is a super easy A. A lot of the assignments are redundant but they're not hard. He is really passionate about what he is teaching which can be fun for lectures. He does have attendance quizzes which I would say is the hardest part of the class.

He is one of the most spiritual individuals that I have met. He loves the gospel, and it shows. He wants you to succeed in the class, and you most likely will. He loves you and will work with you. 100% would take his class again.

This is a great class to help students understand and prepare for their missions. I learned so much. I love the assignments, every single one for them is beneficial to preparation and for strengthening your testimony. I had so many incredible spiritual and intellectual experiences! He is a great lecturer and genuinely cares about your well-being!

I loved this class!! We have readings before every class that you have to annotate online, but they are very easy and relevant. This class helped me feel more confident about preparing to serve a mission. Brother Howell wants you to succeed and is a good lecturer. Attendance is required but the class is not hard overall.

The layout is amazing, very clear. All assignments are beneficial and helpful. As long as you show up to class and put in effort you with end with an A+. Brother Howell is such a caring person who truly cares about each one of his students. I really recommend taking this class if you are preparing for, thinking, or deciding on serving a mission.

He is very kind and enthusiastic! He loves missionary work. Just like high school seminary, you will get out what you put into it. If you put in effort it will be so helpful and spiritually enlarging, otherwise it will feel like a lot of easy busy work. Don't worry about your grade, he is an easy grader and very accomadating.

He is very kind and genuinely cares about the students and the material he is teaching. There is not a significant homework load, though there is usually homework weekly. I thought the class was interesting though and there wasn't any studying to do for the tests.

He means well, but he drove me a little crazy. Interrupted his guest speakers and students. Felt like he brushed off comments if it wasn't the exact answer he was looking for. Class always felt generally unorganized and you never knew what to expect. Plus SO MUCH busy work. Some good spiritual and insightful moments though.

Brother Howell was the best-spirited professor I've ever had. He is very kind and energetic in class, and he always has engaging lectures. I loved Brother Howell and learned a lot from his class in preparation for my mission. I will say there are a lot of projects and readings that often act like busy work, but overall it's an amazing course!
Brother Howell is amazing!! Even if you aren't going on a mission, or are considering a mission, please take his class!

Prime example of what religion courses at BYU should be. Was very uplifting and no pressure. You are required to do 2 hours of service at a food bank(or other service of your choosing) which is so much better than a final project/paper. MUST TAKE

Brother Howell is a super caring guy who is clearly passionate about missionary work. He assigns a pretty good amount of work, but it is all very easy and he grades generously. Mostly, he just wants you to be the best missionary you can be, and his lectures reflect that.
He cares a lot about his students and what he teaches, but has a lot of reading. Not complicated stuff tho.
The teaching style was engaging, however, I wish we had focused more on the spiritual preparation for the mission rather than the skills and rules regarding the mission.

I love Brother Howell so much! His class was amazing and the perfect balance of work for a religion class. He has had such an impact on my testimony and I promise you will not regret it if you take his class.

Lots of assignments and projects for a 2 credit religion class, but they were good things to do to prepare for my mission. Everything was basically completion you just had to do it. Attendance is mandatory so if you struggle getting up in the mornings choose a later time. Brother Howell has a lot of experience with missionary work.

Brother Howell is very kind and understanding, and it shows in the course. I wouldn't say anything is particularly hard, merely a decent amount of coursework, so be ready to read a lot. Assuming you put in effort, then you will be rewarded with a good grade.
Professor Howell did a great job of providing and emphasizing resources that will be used as missionaries. Professor Howell also made sure to know how much he cared about you.
Brother Howell is such an amazing teacher. He cares so much and is so passionate about mission work. He makes me excited to serve and you need to take this class from him.

Professor Howell was a great teacher. His classes were interesting and most of the grades were from homework. The quizzes and exam are open note and very easy. The lectures were something that you personally would benefit from, while the homework also allowed you to learn about the Apostles. Also, he brought snacks for us to eat in class sometimes.

Brother Howell was awesome! He loves missionary work and taught about the real things you would see as a missionary out in the field. The assignments for the class were not hard, but you have to stay on top of the study journal.

It was an ok class, but there was a lot of homework that I did not gain very much from. There were a couple of days that were good but I did not get as much meaning out of this class as I did from my other religion classes.
Brother Howell is the best! He is so nice and fun! He shares his testimony in word and deed! He prepared us so well for missionary service!
Professor Howell was great! He is passionate about preparing you to be a good missionary.

Professor Howell is fantastic, he is very passionate, and his lectures are awesome! That being said, he does assign many small assignments so there is a lot to keep track of and do, but the work is generally useful and uplifting.

Brother Howell is so awesome. I took him for Mission Prep and I really think the things I learned I will take and use to become a better missionary. The assignments are very easy but stay on top of the study journal. Shouldn't take more than 1-2 hours per week or less.

I really liked Brother Howell. He's super excited about missionary work and his excitement is contagious. We initially started with a pretty big workload, but he lowered it by a lot. Lots of Preach My Gospel readings. The lecture is more focused on intellectual mission prep. Doctrine mission prep is done for homework.

Brother Howell was a wonderful teacher and certainly helped prepare me for a mission! His class has a lot of projects and many assignments, but if you put in a good amount of effort you're going to learn a lot and you'll do well in the class.

He's very passionate about what he teaches. You can tell he really loves missionary work and it helps you get excited about serving a mission yourself. Sometimes this class felt like more work than it was worth. None of the work was hard, just lots of little things to remember, and not all of them felt as useful as some others.

I was hesitant to take this class, but am so glad I did. He didn't simply go through PMG, but actually gave advice/skills I will use on my mission. Easy class that prepares you well. You get out of it what you put in. He is strict on being on time(to practice being on time as a missionary) and you can miss two classes before it affects your grade.

Brother Howell is the best!! After taking his class I feel so much more prepared for a mission because of all the little assignments that have helped prepare us! He is very passionate about what he does & gives wonderful insight every class & I feel that I have learned a lot!! Lots of little assignments but are easy points if you keep up with them!

Brother Howell cares a lot about his students and making sure they're prepared for the mission field. He does an excellent job providing opportunities to feel the Spirit. I often felt that the lectures were a little disorganized and all over the place, but I still learned things despite not having flow. The mission journal you'll make is great!

Mission Prep was an above average class. Some of the activities I found fun while others I found boring, but I think the best thing you get out of the class is a mission journal which you write in throughout the semester to take with you on your mission.

I had a great time with Brother Howell! He is super engaged in what he does and goes way out of his way to make mission prep and awesome experience! Always check Canvas for notifications/assignments because he gives out a lot of little assignments that can be forgotten easily if you neglect them. Overall a great experience!

Brother Howell is amazing! He really cares about all of his students. I am so glad I had him for mission prep. I feel much more prepared and excited to serve. The assignments we were given with the specific purpose to get us ready for our missions. Thank you Brother Howell!

Bro Howell was a great professor! You could always tell how much love and enthusiasm he had for missionary work. There was a lot of outside of class work, but it wasn't graded harshly and I always learned a lot.

There was definitely homework but nothing was challenging and it was all very reasonable! This class is amazing prep for a mission and Bro Howell is very in tune with missionaries as he works with them in the MTC and served a senior mission recently! He really cares about our sucess.

I love Professor Howell so much! We're besties and he was so enthusiastic about missionary work. The class was so great and I will forever be grateful that I took it before going on my mission because I have learned so much good stuff about how to be the best missionary I can be. 10/10 would recommend!
Lots of work but nice teacher.
Brother Howell was a great teacher. He taught the material well and made the class involved int he discussions.
Good class, lots of out of class assignments but great preparation form a mission
I loved this class! Brother Howell is amazing, and I really enjoyed this class.

He is really passionate about what he teaches. He loves and has a testimony of the prophets and apostles. He is a fun teacher and even gives out treats in class. He's all around a great teacher. I highly recommend him.

If you love in-class discussions for religion classes this class isn't what you're looking for then. Very easy, a guaranteed A if you come to class and do the HW assignments. There are a few in-class assignments that I didn't favor because they were more like busy work to me. Overall, Professor Howell is a great guy and is always willing to help!

Brother Howell is amazing! Seriously, if you want to be prepared for a mission, this is the way to do it. We covered every chapter of PMG, did service, practiced teaching lessons, learned about family history, etc. I had about 2-3 hours of work a week, pretty easy stuff and I always enjoyed the coursework.

I loved my mission prep class with Scott Howell, I always look forward to attending to this class!! All of the assignments and and activities are relevant and prepare you for your mission. Overall I totally recommend you taking this course!

My roommate took mission prep from another professor at the same time I was in this class and while she had more spiritual lectures, I feel like Bro. Howell focused on preparing us for the technical side of mission work, which I am really grateful for. He is very spontaneous in class and it always makes being in class very enjoyable.

This mission prep class is really good at helping you understand what missionaries will have to go through in the field and better prepare you to think like a missionary. Honestly, while there is quite a bit of work, it is easy and overall manageable. He's a pretty easy grader too which is nice.

Brother Howell is such an amazing teacher!! I would 100% recommend that you take a course from him. He is so kind and caring and always puts his best foot forward when it comes to students. He has his assignments and lectures planned out to help you in the ways that you need and it always benefits you.
Good professor. Average BYU religion class. Fair amount of reading.

Professor Howell is one of my favorite teachers! He is caring and always willing to help! He is a mission president so he knows what is the most important for you to learn before your mission, and sends you out into the field with lots of tricks and ideas on how to be the most effective missionary possible!

Brother Howell's mission prep class is really fantastic. I enjoyed my class with him and hearing about other mission prep teachers I would completely recommend him over any other. Brother Howell really cares about actually preparing you for a mission and so his assignments are VERY useful even if there are a lot of them (but they're easy).

If you are looking for a class to help you be the MOST prepared for a mission this is the class! I have already filled up a notebook of good tips, scriptures to memorize and best practices to implement on the mission. You read preach my gospel and all of the assignments are to help you (no filler homework) he is very willing to help with grades too

This class includes a lot of panels and opportunities for others to share their experiences, which was my favorite part. You learn so many helpful tips, but also are able to really feel the power of missions and how they have changed the lives of those around you.

Overall, brother Howell was a great professor. I think my favorite part of class was the convert panel when we got to hear the conversion stories of several recent converts and how the missionaries did (or didn't) help them. One thing that was hard about his class was all the reading. It felt like a lot, but it was still doable.

Professor Howell was an amazing professor! His lectures were always entertaining and insightful. He makes sure they are fun while also covering necessary material. After taking his class I feel more prepared to enter the mission field and no longer like I am walking in blind. Just be sure to stay on top of the work and you will do great.
Professor Howell is great! There are definitely ups and downs to his teaching, but the class is easy and fun! It's a great way to prepare to serve a mission or know if a mission is right for you!
This class was so easy and got me hyped for missionary work! Brother Howell is hilarious and is very passionate about what he's teaching. I would recommend taking this class.

Professor Howell is an amazing and loving professor. He truly cares about all the students and has their best interests at heart. The course has a doable amount of homework. It is not difficult at all, but teaches you how to prepare well for the mission. I highly recommend his class! :)

He had a lot of good things he tried to say, but he had a hard time getting it all out in my opinion. He also assigned a lot of homework, and I was not prepared for all the assignments and projects we had to do.
Scott Howell is a professor that has the students best interests at heart. He truly cares that his students are prepared to go on missions and strives to inspire them.

A good class with a good teacher. It is easy to get an A in this class. If you want an easy A and the religion credit, take this class from Brother Howell. If you want to get well prepared and get more out of a mission prep class, with better preparation that you can take on your mission, I bet you can find a different professor.

Brother Howell is a great teacher and demonstrates his love for the material in his lectures. The homework was online and very easy with clear grading policies. He wants you to learn and interact with the material, so the midterm and final were open note and internet. Attendance is self-reported daily and there's a 2-hour service requirement.

Professor Howell cares a lot about his students. He wanted all of us to succeed in preparing for our future missions. He has lots of projects, but they aren't bad, and they really help you learn the many tools needed for your mission. I would recommend taking him!
great professor 10/10 would recommend!

Brother Howell is great, but a bit disorganized. I learned a lot, had fun, and didn't have to be at all stressed about my grades and tests. Tests are infrequent and open-world and he even provides where to find the answer to each question. I feel like the test actually helped me learn! Some really fun assignments. Best mission prep teacher ever!!

If you thrive in a classroom environment with organization and structure this class is not for you. Everything we talked about was very random and not connected. There were a lot of busy work assignments.
Brother Howell is an incredible religion professor and will truly prepare you for a mission. There is a lot of reading but it is well worth it.
This was a great class. Homework is simple and meaningful assignments. Bro Howell cares a lot about his student. Attendance is required with a quiz within the first 10 minutes of class.
Love professor Howell! would definitely take this class again

Brother Howell is an amazing professor and truly cares for his students. He loves God and loves all his students. I enjoyed coming to class and was inspired every time. The workload is not hard and it is an easy A. It may seem like busy work, but he wants you to be the best versions of yourself spiritually.

Brother Howell is enthusiastic about missionary work. This class focuses on the logistics of serving a mission more than it talks about the actual Gospel, but everything is tied back to Jesus. The homework load is light. The projects aren't very time consuming. Attendance is mandatory and you can't be late to class.

I LOVED Brother Howell! He is super engaging and invested in the students. He really is determined to help you prepare for your mission and he provides lots of good tools to make you a better missionary. There were a lot of small assignments but nothing too big. The midterm was open note and I think the final is too. Attendance is mandatory.

Brother Howell was very understanding. I broke my leg while taking his class and he was one of the only professors I had to visit me in the hospital. He let me stay involved through zoom, and he really cares about missionaries and his students.

Brother Howell is the best! He is so funny and you can tell he cares about all of his students. All of the assignments are very relevant to preparing for a mission and as long as you do the work, you'll get a good grade
I loved taking Mission Prep from Professor Howell. He was a mission president in the past so he has lots of valuable input and experience. He is also really caring and enthusiastic about his classes.

He is a very organized and well thought out professor! Attendance and being on time counts for a lot in this class, but other than that it was not a difficult class. I wished that all resources in class were available outside of class for easier studying, but most of them were. It was overall a great class that I came out of feeling good with!

Brother Howell had a variety of lectures and guest speakers which made all lectures super engaging. He never gave busy work. He also sets up so many amazing opportunities for students to serve in new unique ways.

This class was very informative, and Brother Howell was a great teacher. There are a lot of small assignments, but Brother Howell and the TAs will work with you! This course is meant to help you teach others about the Gospel of Christ. This is achieved. My advice: set up your study journal as soon as possible!
Bro. Howell really cares about young people! He knows what missionaries realistically need in order to be prepared which was really helpful.

There are a lot of reading and out-of-class assignments, but they mainly come from Preach My Gospel and AML. I would definitely recommend taking this class if you are trying to decide whether or not to serve a mission. Brother Howell does a good job explaining what missionaries do daily and how their lives change throughout the mission process.

His class lectures are all over the place which makes it hard to do the in-class assignments in a meaningful way. I didn't feel like I learned that much that I didn't already know. That being said, I can tell how much he cares about all his students, and the convert panel he does is amazing.
He tries to make assignments meaningful and makes class fun. He states his goal is to "have every student leave my class with an A". One recommendation, stay on top of your journal.

Brother Howell was really fun! The assignments were mostly busy work but you could easily get them all done the Sunday before the week and not have anything to do for the whole week. Classes were really spiritual and I learned a lot about becoming an effective missionary. If you plan on going on a mission this class and teacher are really helpful!

He is a fantastic teacher, and he loves teaching. He wants us to catch the wave of the gospel, and I definitely caught the wave during Living Prophets. This class helped me understand why I need to follow more closely to the Apostles and Prophets, also, learning about their backgrounds strengthened my testimony of each of their callings.
This class was great! Brother Howell provides experiences that will greatly help one to prepare to serve a mission and genuinely cares about his students!

He is a great professor that cares about His students, wants the best for them, and wants to help them become the best they can be. He has high expectations for you but they help you grow and become the best you can.

Brother Howell was so kind and passionate about preparing us to serve missions!! The class work was very straightforward and organized in a way that encouraged spiritual growth. I left this class feeling much more prepared to serve a mission than I did before! There was a decent amount of homework, but it was never overwhelming or stressful.

I love Brother Howell! He does tend to be a little all over the place during class, but his canvas is super organized so that makes it really easy to know what you're doing. Some of his projects feel like busywork. Mostly the class made me genuinely so excited for a mission and feel prepared! Plus you actually read preach my gospel which I loved.

Brother Howell is amazing! He really cares about his students and I have learned a lot about the prophets in his class. He is clear about why he is teaching this class and wants all students to gain a better testimony of the prophets.

Great class! Lots of busy work compared to other religion classes but I learned a lot. Professor Howell is very enthusiastic about whatever he is talking about. He has you make a super detailed study journal which I thinkg will be super helpful on the mission.

Brother Howell injects such fresh energy and insights into this subject. Class is structured to promote learning and thinking. Not heavy on memorization and testing like many other BYU religion courses.

Brother Howell was great! There are a lot of assignments you have to do throughout the week, but they're all super easy and don't take a lot of time at all. You have attendance quizzes so it's important to go to class, but overall the class is super easy and helpful if you're trying to decide whether or not to serve a mission.

This professor enthusiastically aims to inspire others to serve the Lord but this class feels very disorganized. The professor would teach very different things to his classes which makes the exams more difficult than they should be when they're referred to as being no stress worksheets. Be prepared to take notes on everything he says in class.
Awesome Professor! The class does have a decent amount of readings but if you are preparing for a mission they are necessary.
His class was very useful without being too time consuming. Highly recommend!

I really enjoyed this class. Professor Howell is very kind, passionate about missionary work and really wants his students to do well in the mission field. There is quite a bit of projects, but they are not hard to complete in one sitting. I would definitely recommend taking Professor Howell's mission prep class if you want to serve a mission.

Brother Howell was a great teacher overall. It was easy to get a good grade in his class. There definitely were a lot of assignments and homework, but it really has prepared me to serve a mission so I loved doing them. He cares about what he teaches and he loves his students.
This is an easy class to get a good grade in if that is all you care about, he isn't my favorite lecturer, and he bounces around a lot, there is quite a bit of reading but it not terrible.
This class has been my all time favorite religion class yet! This class focuses on learning and testimony building which is a breath of fresh air. I highly recommend taking any class from him!
This class was great! I did not find it stressful at all, and I learned a lot about how to be a better missionary and disciple of Christ. You can tell he really cares about all his students!

Professor Howell has been one of my favorite religion professors at BYU striking the perfect balance between valuable real-world knowledge and fun facts about the Prophets and Apostles. The class has quite a few assignments but they are all very meaningful and graded very fairly allowing anyone to succeed as long as you attend the lectures.

Very good professor, with a very lightweight workload and very informative lectures. Each project and test takes no longer than 2 hours to complete, and I've never spent more than 3 hours a week on this class. For those seeking to be spiritually edified without having too much work or stress, this professor is the one for you.
I really liked him; he was really nice. There are quite a few extra credit opportunities. There is quite a bit of busy work but it's not hard, just takes time. He brings treats sometimes.
Bro. Howell is a great teacher who is super enthusiastic about missionary work. You get a bunch of assignments, but they are all actually helpful for preparing to serve a mission.

He is so passionate about the gospel and wants everyone of his students to succeed. He is super caring and loves all of his students, and you can totally see that in the way he teaches. Attendance is mandatory, and as long as you complete and submit assignments on time, its really easy to get a good grade.
Brother Howell is a great religion professor, I felt I actually learned and was prepared for a mission. He is kind, and super caring. His class is easy and low stress!!

Do not miss class! Attendance quiz every day. No resources or help if you miss class. Be on-time, quiz closes 3 minutes after class starts. Emergencies or Commitments that you made before registering does not excuse you. Only 2 absences allowed per semester. Most assignments are computer graded, points get taken of and no one can tell you why!

Brother Howell is awesome! His mission prep class is amazing and definitely gave me a better understanding of what a missionary does and should do. He's very caring and wants students to be successful. The assignments are simple and can take some time, but they are applicable and not just busy work. I'd totally recommend!

Brother Howell is AWESOME! He loves all of his students and wants only the best for them. He is so passionate about missionary work and I feel more spiritually/emotionally prepared for my mission by taking this class. The classwork is super easy, just busy work (very managable). You have to be on time to class. Loved the study journal for the class

Brother Howell is awesome! He's so caring and funny, and the class is really well organized in Canvas with everything laid out. He also is really good at sending out reminders for events and projects, even sending personalized messages if you forgot about something or missed some points. Really great guy who cares about the Lord and his students.

Best religion class I have taken. The work was mostly all online and it did take some time. But it was not difficult in the slightest. Really helped me feel prepared to serve a mission. Bro. Howell was is a very understanding and caring professor. Probably my favorite class this semester. Highly recommend.

I loved professor Howell, he is such a genuine man and wants us all to succeed as we prepare for a mission. His mission preparation class is very manageable and gets you to set goals to become a missionary before you are out on your mission. Definitely recommend to anyone wanting to take mission preparation!

The class is a lot of easy busy work, but it can be good preparation for a mission if you take it seriously. Also, everything is posted on Canvas, so you can also get ahead on assignments, and the professor is super friendly and caring.

I LOVE PROFESSOR HOWELL!!! He cares so so much about the students, he's hilarious and extremely humble. He is constantly asking for feedback and ways of becoming better, even after years in the discipline. Whatever the class, I recommend it. He will change your testimony, his love for the Savior is infectious! :)

I loved his class. It wasn't just another religion class where things are super busy and it tries to drown you along with all your other classes. He does an excellent job at allowing room to learn and feel edified, while minimizing stress. He is also very understanding if you miss an assignment or something.

I love Prof. Howell! This class was great I'd just say it was more homework than necessary. Too many projects for me. He did say he is going to make it less difficult for the future so look out for that! Other than that this class preps you well for the mission field, has lots of great key principles, and Prof. Howell loves and cares for everyone.

Brother Howell is amazing! He's met a lot of the 12 which helps him to teach this class and what they are like! The readings for assignments were super interesting and he always made sure that we weren't doing busy work while doing assignments! If you want to grow your testimony and not worry about your grade take this class!

Brother Howell is extremely understanding and caring in and out of class. No tests besides the final. There are a few projects that are easy but a bit time consuming. A lot of PMG reading assignments and safety zone videos but you will have to watch them in the MTC anyway. Class participation is also very important.

He is a really good professor who really cares about you in and outside of the class and is extremely understanding. The class is pretty easy with no tests besides the final. There are a few projects that aren't difficult but are time consuming. There are reading assignments & watching safety zone videos which you will have to do in the MTC anyway.

Brother Howell made an effort to not go over the material we read and discuss other things in class that expounded and enriched the personal reading we did. At times it seemed easy to believe that there was a lot of homework, but within the context of learning about the apostles and prophets, the reading and assignments didn't feel like busy work.

Brother Howell is amazing and funny! This class is super insightful! The projects are interesting! Resources are helpful and engaging! And lectures are uplifting! Howell is genuine, caring, and real. Take this class if you are preparing for a mission and you won't regret it!

Professor Howell cares about all of his students and truly is an amazing, loving guy. His homework is usually just readings from gospel library that are from the course you're taking. I took Mission Prep and was just reading preach my gospel or adjusting to missionary life. Super kind and is definitely willing to work with you!
Love how much Brother Howell cares about each student. Would definitely recommend for a religion class. All the homework was beneficial to my learning and very manageable.
I enjoy every lesson from brother Howell. I did learn a lot from him and his lecture was very uplifting.
Great teacher! I loved this class and learned much from him about the living prophets.

Brother Howell is so nice and really cares about his students! He really does all he can to make the class experience meaningful and connective for everyone. He is super flexible and takes time to help everyone do the best that they can in his class. His class is really straightforward and I learned a lot!
He is such a good teacher! I love his enthusiasm and love for each of us. The Tuesday night assignments always got me, but if you're aware of due dates then you'll be totally fine.
Lots of work outside of class. Loves his students and I love this man

Amazing professor, super funny, and awesome to take a class from. I wasn't super prepared for the final since there was a lot of random stuff he said during class, but the rest of the class was super easy and fun!

Professor Howell was amazing. His focus was clearly on the student's learning and progression more than anything else. This was seriously one of the most influential religion classes I have taken at BYU. I think all religion classes should adopt his style!

Class is mandatory, but his lectures are incredibly uplifting and spiritually strengthening. He truly cares about his students, and while there is a good number of assignments, they are pretty simple (just a matter of doing them). I love that this class is focused on spiritual learning over academic rigor.

Professor Howell is a particularly excellent and experienced Mission Prep teacher, especially given his background of being a mission president. He knows what missionary work is about, and what works!

Professor Howell's class was good. He is willing to work with students on the homework load and he never wants to give us too much work, which is really nice. You can tell he is passionate about the teachings of this class and he is personable. if you take this class and do the assignments, you will easily get an A.

He was a good guy. The class I think was relatively easy, but that allowed for more discussion. The one thing I'm not as big of a fan of is how often he changed due dates for assignments. I prefer a pretty structured stuff with timelines set in stone, so that threw me for a loop, but overall, the class was a good experience.

Brother Howell is a very good teacher. This class is a good class to take shortly before leaving on a mission. Brother Howell does care about his students and taught me so much. There are some big projects in this class, but they are spiritually strengthening and they aren't unmanageable. I loved this class.

Great class! Professor Howell was approachable and wanted us to succeed. The work wasn't too difficult, but was designed in a way that allows you to engage with the material and gives you opportunity to get a lot out of it. The assignments were straightforward, and as long as you do everything and put in some effort, you can do well in the class.

He is the best professor ever!! He cares so much about our success as missionaries and always helps us to feel the spirit! He taught me so much about missions and I can't wait to experience it for myself. He always brings snacks too. Stay caught up in your study journal and it will be smooth sailing! And give this man a raise!

Best professor I have had at BYU so far. Super kind, you could tell he really does love his students. Class was not overly difficult and the workload was manageable. Tests were not too hard either, open note and open internet.
Brother Howell is a great professor. He does give out a lot of busy work however and it is a lot for a two credit class. If you keep up with all the work though you should get an A.

Brother Howell was phenomenal. You can tell how much he truly loves mission work, and he wants everyone to succeed. There's plenty of assignments, but they're not too hard. Just keep up on your journaling and you'll do great. He brings snacks to class too!
Hands down favorite teacher

Professor Howell is great he cares about his students and the class is not very hard. As long as you put in the work on the projects and keep up with the study journal you will be fine. There are a decent number of assignments but they are not hard.

I loved Brother Howell! I took him for mission prep and after taking his class, I feel so prepared! Classes were always enjoyable and he'd even bring us snacks every so often, which is a plus! You can tell he truly cares about the work he does. You can also tell that he loves every single one of us which made class even more enjoyable to attend.

Brother Howell is the best! He was so caring and kind and he made sure that we knew what to expect from every assignment and test. He did everything he could to make sure you succeeded, even extending due dates for everyone. He invited us to learn and share about the living prophets and to seek our own witness. Awesome class!

He is absolutely wonderful and very kind and considerate of his students and situations. I haven't felt the Spirit as strongly in any other religion class. Highly recommend. Just make sure you look at his emails and do the assignments and let yourself learn

Brother Howell is such a great teacher who will get you excited for missionary work! His lectures are always engaging and he has such a great energy and enthusiasm. The workload isn't hard and there are only a few readings a week (you have to read all of Preach My Gospel, AML, and SafetyZone, but like what were you expecting?).
Brother Howell is caring and really listens to students' difficulties with the class. He's not afraid to change assignments to help students get the most from the homework.

Professor Howell was super great! He was super nice and really cared about his students. He definitely wanted students to succeed and develop a love and appreciation for the prophets. He had a few assignment each week that were a little bit busy work, but they were pretty easy and fast. Tests are super easy and are open note! I would recommend him!

Brother Howell genuinely cares about his students, and values their feedback. He strives to avoid giving busy work or meaningless assignments, and he has a strong testimony of the restored gospel of Jesus Christ.

I love Professor Howell! He's so caring and takes time to learn his student's names and learn about them. He has experience with missions (mission pres and works at mtc). He's definitely good about giving real and up to date advice for missions. No tests except the final, and he gives a comprehensive study guide. 2-3 hrs hw/wk. Highly recommend!
Good class, but didn't always stay on topic.
Professor Howell was very in tune with his students, he honestly cares, and his class enriched my life with what I learned! I would highly recommend.

Of the religion courses I've taken, you can tell he cares about you having a spiritually enriching time- not about you writing papers. I think Brother Howell is a good teacher and he often extends deadlines or takes off parts of assignments to lessen the load which is so kind. Good bit of assignments due each week, but they don't take a long time.

Brother Howell really knows what he is talking about. He has a lot of experience, especially for missionaries who will serve state side. The reading can kind of feel like a lot at times but if you stay on top it it's not bad. In class he goes above and beyond to make students feel loved and will bring treats to class.

Brother Howell is the most caring professor who wants all his students in mission prep to become successful missionaries.  The projects, activities outside of class, and Preach My Gospel readings are so inspired. In class, the spirit is so strong. This mission prep course does not do role play, but rather prepares you in unexpected spiritual ways.

I love Professor Howell! He does a great job in prepping for assignments. Each week we would analyzed the biography and some talks of each living apostle and the prophet. These weren't too long and were always interesting. There is a midterm and a final, but he prepares you very well for them and makes it stress free. You can feel that he cares!

Super nice guy but at times the class was easy enough that it almost felt pointless. Times when you ask yourself "I really had to come to class for this?", but like I said super kind and he was always caring and obviously knowledgeable about the topics.
Brother Howell is great. He's interested in his students' lives and he loves the prophets and apostles. He does have a lot of assignments for a religion class, but they aren't too hard.

He was a great religion professor. Lot's of personal stories and experiences he has had with the apostles.
He actually listens to the students. At the beginning of the year he asked how we were doing. Everyone commented on the amount of HW so he reduced how much we had.
Good amount of readings but not terrible, and they are typically interesting.
Brother Howell is a great mission prep teacher! Different than a lot of other mission prep classes at BYU, but very uplifting and educational. I had a great time in his class :)
Brother Howell was super awesome! Super easy and such a fun class. Would definitely take again!

Brother Howell is so caring! He is passionate about missionary work, and he loves to make it fun. Because he was a mission president and is currently serving as a district president at the MTC, he really knows his stuff and all of the newest developments happening in the Church and with missionary work. His class is easy and straightforward!

I absolutely loved professor Howell! He is the first professor at BYU that made everyone feel seen and cared for. He learned all of our names and constantly checked in with his students throughout the semester. This is also the first religion class that I've taken at BYU that I felt the Spirit in during every class. I cannot recommend him enough!
Brother Howell was a great professor who cares about his students. Based on the nature of the course, there was lots of reading outside of class.

Professor Howell is a great guy and truly cares about his students. His passion for missionary work is contagious. The class itself was easy, as it's mostly busywork type assignments. As far as prep for a mission, I think you largely get out of it what you put into it. Overall, I'd recommend.
Cares a lot about students and willing to help with whatever you need. Provides a lot of good sources for mission prep.
He is an amazing professor, if you have not taken a class with him I would highly recommend it.

I felt like class was a waste of time and there were tons of busy work assignments, but they were graded really easy and it is easy to do well if you complete everything. Brother Howell is really nice and funny, but I didn't learn much about living prophets in this class. He kind of just got up there and rambled and showed us random videos.

Brother Howell is SO sweet and truly cares about his students. If you put in the work you can seriously see your testimony grow in his class and develop attributes of a good missionary. He is super knowledgable as he was a mission president and works as a branch president in the MTC. I can't recommend him enough!

I don't know where to start with Brother Howell. He's so funny and you can tell he really cares about his students. He brings snacks in all the time. I always felt the spirit in his class and never felt too stressed about the assignments or tests, which is exactly how it should be in a religion class. The only two exams were online and open note.
Funny guy. Pretty laid back. Easy final.

Brother Howell is an amazing guy. I've recently decided I am going to serve a mission, and I am SO GLAD I took this class in preparation. He goes over so many things you wouldn't even think about, and teaches you so many great missionary practices. He is a great grader, and wants you to succeed.

Brother Howell was such an amazing teacher! He always kept the class really engaged, he always brought treats and is very funny. The homework that is assigned is to help you prepare for your mission, everything has a purpose and will help you in the future. I would take this class again because of Brother Howell and what he teaches.

If you are thinking about taking a class from Brother Howell, DO IT!!!! I loved him and his class! He is such a fun professor and I love what he teaches. I looked forward to his class everyday and felt very well prepared for my mission after taking his mission prep class. You will love him! The class is also really easy and you will definitely pass
Not too difficult of a class, and the professor was great.

Brother Howell is an incredible guy, I loved learning with him this semester! With a pretty tough schedule this semester I was happy to have a really easy religion class. Which is exactly this class is. The only thing I would say is that sometimes lectures felt disorganized and a little chaotic. Sometimes felt like a seminary class.

Brother Howell is awesome! He's one of the most caring religion professors I have ever had. Funny guy and he genuinely cares about the gospel and the way that his students interact with the gospel too! Easy grader and his assignments are meant to help us strengthen our faith in the Savior!
Dr. Howell is a great professor! He cares about the students and will adjust to any accommodations you may have or need.

Brother Howell is amazing, nearly every assignment he leaves a genuine comment. Their is a constant stream of Homework but its not difficult and without it I don't think I would have gotten nearly as much for the course. This class isn't and easy A but Brother Howell wants you to succeed. Take it if you want to grow your testimony.

Overall the class was good. Just know that there are numerous readings every week, and much of the grade is based off of projects. However neither of these things are particularly difficult they just take time.

Brother Howell is a gem. I was in a smaller class of about 50 and he learned all of our names! As long as you are in class and complete the assignements, you should get an A. I will admit that there were a lot of weekly assignments from this class, but I just did them all on Sunday which took me about 2ish hours (4 hours if there is a project).

He has a lot of experience within the church and tells a lot of stories about that. Sometimes it comes off like he is bragging, but he really isn't, he just wants everyone to love the Apostles as much as he does. He has a few groups projects that you do in class, they are fairly simple. The homework is really worthwhile and I enjoyed doing it.

Brother Howell was awesome! He was a former mission president and now is a branch president in the MTC. He really cares about his students and strives to have a personal relationship with them. His grading was very easy, as long as you do the work you should receive an A.

I really liked Brother Howell and his class format. There were only a couple assignments as week and an occasional project. He's a really kind guy and  was a mission pres and is currently a branch president in the MTC, so he works with missionaries everyday. I feel significantly more prepared for my mission, He's a must take professor.

Brother Howell is an amazing professor.  Some people say that his lectures are't as substantive, but those are just the try-hards.  He always focuses on bringing the spirit over everything else and it is the most important.  He really listened to the students and when complaints were raised he would actually adjust his curriculum.  Fantastic!

Easy class, really kind professor. If you want a religion class for credit and a good grade then this is a good pick. The assignments are really easy and about what you would expect from a class about prophets. The lectures were a little lacking sometimes but Brother Howell is super nice. I learned most about the apostles through the homework.

Bro. Howell is an awesome person who cares a lot about his students. Rel333 is an easy class with lots of busy work assignments. You will learn about the apostles if you apply yourself in doing the homework assignments, but Brother Howell rarely taught about the living prophets and apostles in class. I had just hoped to get more out of this class.
Take from Brother Howell. The best professor at BYU! His class is not stressful and the homework he gives will help you. It is not busy work. You will enjoy this class so much.

If you want a professor who knows your name and genuinely cares about you then take from Brother Howell. Brother Howell is one of the kindest professors I have ever met. He does not believe religion classes should be difficult or burdensome. Brother Howell has a genuine love for his students and the prophets. He also brings snacks to class!

Professor Howell is so kind, funny, remembers your name and leaves very thoughtful comments on your work. In his Living Prophets class, the work is super manageable and interesting. Some assignments felt more like busy work, but you could honestly crank everything out at the beginning of the semester. Overall, amazing class and professor!
He's so awesome... take him!!!!!!!!

This class was really enjoyable. Brother Howell was really good about showing us different resources to use as a missionary. The classes often felt rushed because he was trying to share so much information with us. He also brought us snacks which definitely gives him some bonus points.

Brother Howell is one of the kindest people I have ever met. It's one of those classes that can be pointless if you put in no effort but if you're willing to work for it, can be very rewarding. There is a lot of reading which sometimes felt like too much. Brother Howell is a good friend to have in your corner!

Brother Howell really does care for all of his students, and we can feel that. He's always there with a smile, and the class wasn't really hard (got an A- mainly because I forgot about some assignments)

If you ever have the chance, take a class from Professor Howell! He is the most caring and inspirational teacher I have ever had. I had mission prep with him and feel far more excited and prepared for my mission than I did before! There is so much useful information in his lectures and the homework is easy and helpful. I love Brother Howell.

Brother Howell makes everyone, regardless of background, identity, or how they fit at BYU feel loved. I've never had a religion teacher preach the gospel of Jesus Christ through their lessons and acts as an individual quite like him. His class was incredibly easy, assignments are straightforward, and he will often extend due dates to help the class
He's awesome

I had Brother Howell for mission prep! I feel very prepared. He has some easy assignments over perusal and tells you exactly how to get 100% on all of your assignments. STAY ON TRACK WITH THE STUDY JOURNAL. I would complain only that it's nearing the end of the semester and I have NO IDEA what will be on the exam. He learns everyone's names :)

Brother Howell is a really good professor who care a lot about the students and the material that he covers. Always willing to listen to student's opinions on assignments and make changes. Has really good lectures. Not a lot of homework or tough homework, but sometimes it feels like busy work.

I loved this class. It is often hard to find a religion course on this campus that is more enjoyable than it is stressful, but I honestly wish every religion course was like this class. TAKE THIS CLASS!

Professor Howell is a great teacher and has a deep testimony of living prophets. The readings were insightful and helped me understand our current church leadership more deeply. Sometimes the homework was a bit busy work-ish. Overall, the class was fairly simple. Professor Howell showed tremendous care for our learning and growth.
Professor Howell is a good professor, but I do think he gives to much homework for the scope of the class. He genuinely cares about the students and accepts feedback well!
He's an excited teacher and does projects instead of midterms which is really nice! The only test you really take is the final and he provides a study guide for it.

Professor Howell was one of the best teachers I have ever had. I've never had a professor that I felt cared about me so much. In his mission prep class, he gave great lectures and I felt so much peace and joy while participating in his class. The class itself requires effort, but it has an easy workload. Take this class--you won't regret it!
Very wholesome and if you do the work then you get the credit.
This class was great! Participation definietly matters, but overall was pretty easy. The professor is really nice and willing to work with his students!

Great teacher who really cares about you not just academically but as a person. Class is interesting and fun and very inspirational. Helped me a lot to decide that I wanted to serve a mission and how to prepare for it.
Loved him, kind, accommodating, easy A.

He is the most caring and understanding person in the whole world. He wants you to succeed in every part of this class and in your future. There is quite a bit of homework, and it can be pretty time-consuming, but it is 100% worth every minute!

The material wasn't very difficult, but he still made it a priority to make sure that everyone was understanding. He is really funny and it's so obvious that he cares. He is a very relaxed grader. If you do all of the work, you'll get 100% and he isn't super strict about late deadlines as long as it's not all the time.
Great guy and focuses on Gospel of Jesus Christ. That is vital

Even though this class was fairly easy, I would not recommend it. 
There are a lot of assignments and in class quizzes/assignments that are stressful and were not always conducive to learning. 
He has a strange obsession with Elder Gong. 
He made some inappropriate comments in class about LGBTQ+ members. 
His tests are made to trick you.

I absolutely loved this class and it was seriously my favorite class to go to! There were a lot of readings but if you are preparing to serve a mission or deciding whether to serve, it is all reading you would probably be doing anyway. Professor Howell is such an awesome teacher; you can tell he cares so much about his students!

His class is very clear. He makes it easy to get a good grade as long as you are willing to do a little reading. He respects his student's opinions and is willing to listen to their suggestions on how to do better. Exams are open book and he is very clear about what will be on them. He has a lot of love and respect for his students.

Brother Howell was a great professor and he was very supportive and encouraging, asking students to do service and read, but not usually asking them to respond with how they felt if they are not as interested or comfortable with the spiritual aspect. There was a lot of reading to do outside of class, but otherwise homework was usually very light.

Originally did not enjoy the class, but it grew on me the more I kept going. Prof. Howell loves his students and is very helpful with personal situations.
