The class is easy but has a decent amount of outside work to do. He tries his best to avoid busy work and as such sometimes changes the material or assignments. Overall, great class to take.

Lectures and assignments were pretty easy and spiritual actually. Usually religion courses have felt more busy and frustrating, but much of went on in the class was pretty enjoyable. He's such a nice guy and cares a lot. Tests were open note. If anything to complain about, there's just more assignments than i wouldve thought but they really easy.

Professor Howell is great. However, sometimes I felt like the lectures were a little all over the place and jumbled. He did bring the Spirit often though, and had many cool fun facts to share. He is very kind, and there's not too many assignments. He is very open to feedback, and truly loves the Gospel.
such an amazing professor, he truly cares about each student and takes the time to get to know them. The assignments and exams are not hard they just take some time. Definitely take this class.

Brother Howell is a very happy and compassionate teacher! Class was spent discussing prophets, and there were only a few homework assignments each week and they were easy. Tests were open note and not a stress. Oh and he brings treats to class! :) My only complaint is he randomly called on people in class to read/talk, but that wasn't too bad.

Brother Howell will be the professor that cares the most about you! It's clear he loves his job and the students he teaches. he wants everyone to succeed, and he makes it very possible to do so. There is a lot of reading involved, but just do it and you will get credit for it.

Brother Howell clearly cares about his class and what he is teaching. He was super willing to listen to what the class needs and make adjustments to the assignments to fit our needs. Brother Howell clearly cares about his students. He knows a lot about the living prophets and did not make the material too difficult.
Loved this class. He is very kind and passionate about missionary work. Most of the learning in his class is just reading and taking notes on Preach My Gospel and other resources.

Brother Howell is AMAZING! His lectures are really spiritually uplifting and you can tell he loves his job. There are some readings, but you get a lot out of them. Best mission prep teacher one could ask for. :)

Brother Howell is awesome! His assignments are very clear. There are quite a few, but they are not very dense. He shares his personal experiences with the prophet and apostles and by the end of the class, I felt like I knew them better myself. He brings snacks to class and knows everybody's name. He is so funny and makes class so fun.
Very easy to talk to and friendly! Lots of readings, but not very dense. Everything is open note and he prepares you very well.

So funny and always has snacks. You can tell he genuinely cares about students and preparing them for missions. He goes through PMG in an easy and entertaining way. I would definitely recommend this class to anyone who hasn't served a mission.

Professor Howell cares a lot about his students! The course can feel like a lot of busy work for a two credit hour class, but if you want to take Mission Prep he's really passionate about preparing his missionaries and the homework is super doable!

I love Brother Howell! He is so kind and funny. He shows the best and most spiritually uplifting videos. We rarely do role plays (which I'm fine with haha) and he always brings us food (our class starts at 12pm). He is seriously the best mission prep teacher and he made me want to serve a mission even more than I did before taking his class.

Great guy, one of the only professors that knows me by name. Very easy class with not a lot of time commitment. He brings snacks too. He is very genuine in wanting to see his students happy and succeeding. Great teacher. Would recommend to anyone to take this class.
Professor Howell makes learning about the Apostles fun and enjoyable. He brings snacks to class and makes each student in his class feel so loved!!
Solid professor, its not a difficult class but you definitely get out what you put in.

This was a good class. It doesn't feel like it adds too much on to your plate. The class is very structured on canvas and if you do the assignments you'll get an A. Tests are easy so this isn't a religion class that is going to be harder than your 4 credit classes ;) Definitely recommend for the content and ease of the class.

Professor Howell really cares about his students and the topic at hand. Assignments are consistent and easy. Be to class on time and participate and you'll get an A. Lectures are somewhat scattered but filled with fun things!

Brother Howell is kind and understanding. He is a very spiritual guy and his love of the gospel, as well as for the twelve apostles, is very evident. His class is easy but you'll learn a lot about the apostles.
Amazing professor! He always made sure that each assignment was clear and easy to understand. He also tended to extend deadlines.

SO AMAZING. Every class is like a devotional, always felt the spirit, homework is reviewing PMG to help get familiar with it before the mission. All of the work is worthwhile and helpful for a mission. He is so kind cares about all of his students easily the BEST person to take mission prep from.
Howell is the best! He genuinely cares about each of his students and really cares about what he's teaching.
Absolutely amazing and very understanding. Highly recommend!

This was the first religion class at BYU that I've enjoyed (and I'm a junior- this was my second to last one too). Brother Howell is so kind. He cares about his students and is a great professor. He is also so funny and would bring us treats. It'd be hard to fail this class. You will get an A if you do your work and try. 10/10 - take this class!!!
Great professor, cared for our learning.

His lectures were very entertaining, sometimes a little crazy, but he's awesome! I had him over spring and I never got bored in the 2 hour classes. He did focus more on english speaking missions and first world countries but he still prepares you well for wherever your mission will be. He also always brought food, he cares a lot about his students!

Professor Howell definitely does his best to prepare you for the mission. There's a few projects and a study journal which are a decent chunk of your grade but the expectations are clear. In class he'd often have the intention of doing a lot of group work but would get caught up talking. He's a former mission president who emphasizes technology.

Brother Howell has prepared me for my mission more than anyone else could have. He is the most helpful, fun and loving professor I've ever had at BYU. No busy work, all homework has purpose and usefulness. If you want to genuinely become prepared for your mission without having to do a ton of work or write papers, this is your guy.

very sweet and helpful.always had snacks. Makes you feel more prepared for a mission and teaches a lot of cool tools to use on the field. Very understanding and willing to work with you. Easy grader, somewhat busy work but its easy and beneficial. Loved brother Howell 9/10 recommend

Brother Howell is great and he really cares about his students. Since I took mission prep, he is really focused on us developing our skills and gaining more knowledge. There's a lot of readings and quizzes but they are the easiest thing you will ever do.

Prof Howell really cares about his students and is very passionate about what he teaches. Attendance is mandatory but he makes class and lectures very engaging. He is an easy grader but you learn a lot from his class. I would take a religion class from him again. He brings snacks too so

Professor Howell is a 10/10 teacher. I would take all my religion classes from him if I could. The grading and expectations are clear. Took during Spring- lectures, group activities. You will have to keep a study journal (clear criteria). Be ready to use technology as well.

Brother Howell's lectures are great, he does a very good job of keeping them interesting and on topic. It's easy to see that he genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed in class and in life. He clearly lays out what is expected in class and for assignments. Defiantly would take a class from him again.
Brother Howell is great! He cares about his students and will take the time to talk to you individually and help you out. Definitely take his class!

Brother Howell really wants the absolute best for his students. He wants you to feel the spirit. He wants to prepare you for a mission or just to serve in your future. He is super in tune with the spirit and motivates you to become a ready and excited missionary.
The class is very hands on. Lots of reading and easy lecture. 10/10 recommend
Scott embodies the goals of BYU and uplifts every student in his class. Kind, loving man that wants his students to succeed. Projects can seem long but are always worth doing.

Brother Howell is such a sweet man. He truly cares for his students and does everything possible for you to succeed. I would recommend this class to students who want to serve a mission and even those who don't!

Take Mission Prep from Brother Howell! He truly loves missionary work and cares for his students, especially by taking the effort to know everyone's names. The assignments and projects are SUPER easy. The main goal of the class is to spiritually strengthen yourself!! Just remember to keep up with your study journal :)
Brother Howell likes to have fun. Looking at our assignments/projects, it kind of looks like a lot but it's actually all very doable and he doesn't grade harshly at all.

Brother Howell is so kind and super helpful. He really loves all his students and want them to succeed and be better missionaries, not only as a full time missionary, but also as a member missionary. I would definitely take his class again to learn more about the gospel.
Brother Howell truly loves his students, and he loves the Gospel of Jesus Christ. I'm grateful that I had the opportunity to have him as my professor.
He is great and he really cares.

Take mission prep from Brother Howell! He cares so much about his students and I really felt like everything we did was applicable and purposeful. At the same time you will get an easy A and feel much more prepared to serve. No midterms and the final was online.

Professor Howell is amazing! This is the second class I've taken from him. There are lots of reading assignments and several large projects, but he explains the projects really well. If you put in the time and honest work and come to every class, you can definitely get an A in this class! It's a good elective religion credit.
I loved Brother Howell's mission prep class! Every lecture was so fun - he often brought food :) Take his mission prep class! It's so fun and so good!

Brother Howell is INCREDIBLE! Please take him for Mission Prep, he cares so much about all of his students and literally brings food to every class for his students to have. He makes you feel like a kid again and takes stress off your plate. If you do the assignments on time with good effort you'll be fine. Keep up w/your study journal too!

Good class, great professor. I feel that the entire goal of the class was exactly as stated: to prepare for missionary service. Professor Howell was always willing and available to help. Although the class was fun and relaxed, the spirit was present in most every class period.

Brother Howell has really good intentions but his lectures are very unorganized and there is a lot of busy work. Still an easy A though. The class may be better with 50 min classes. I took it in Spring so classes were 2 hours long.

I had Brother Howell for mission prep and I'd say he was a great teacher! The class was just what I needed before leaving on a mission and I learned lots of great practices and tips from him. The homework was straightforward and doable. We often did group work in class. He's a cheerful guy and he cares about his students. I would recommend.

I loved having Brother Howell as my Mission Prep Professor. He really cares about all of his students and truly wants the best for each student. Everything he taught us was extremely helpful in preparing us for our missions. He also brought us snacks almost every class which was a plus.
Brother Howell was excellent. He taught the material very well. The class was very enjoyable.
Really fun class with lots of student involvement and discussions. Loved it! No complaints.
Great teacher with a very hands on approach. Covers the material quickly but thoroughly. Is really focused on preparing you for a mission the best he can.

I LOVE BROTHER HOWELL! He knew each of his students by name and made me feel truly cared for. His stories and lectures made me excited to serve a mission! Brother Howell is one of the most inspirational and kind teachers I've ever had and if you can take his class, DO IT! The grading was easy and the content was super interesting too!!
Excellent class, excellent teacher, easiest A. What more do you need to know?

Professor Howell seems like a pretty cool guy. The lectures were nice and insightful. The overall class did not feel nearly as intense as the Isaiah, New Testament, and Life of Christ classes I took before this. His goal in this class is to get you familiar with the apostles to some level much like what he has experienced in his own life.
Professor Howell is great! The readings were long but not unreasonably so.
Professor Howell is amazing! I loved his class and would 100% recommend it to anyone.
A good amount of reading, but the reading isn't difficult. 2 Reading quizzes associated with the readings, and if you go to class you'll get an A.
I loved Brother Howell! This class was great for feeling the Spirit and learning about the apostles.
Professor Howell's class is the best! My favorite that I've taken. Felt like a seminary class and all he cared about was you building your testimony.

Brother Howell is an awesome professor! He's had many experiences meeting general authorities, making him a great person to teach Living Prophets. The class is mainly based on attendance of lectures and completion of the weekly reading & quizzes. No tests, just a big assignment related to watching General Conference. His lectures were scattered.

He was a great guy, but I've had better religion professors. The format of the readings was good and very doable. His lectures were dry and he isn't very organized in his thoughts. He did have some good things to say and I am sure there were some students who needed to hear those things. With that being said, this class didn't do much for me.

This was a great class! It was just the right balance of work versus actually helping you feel the spirit and grow as a person. He focuses a lot on taking invitations from the 15 apostles and applying them as personal SMART goals. Not a hard class but one that makes you think and grow.
Professor Howell is such a great professor! It is easy to see that he truly cares about his students and the topics he teaches. He is also hilarious and makes class enjoyable and fun.

Brother Howell emphasizes true learning and experience over memorizing and testing. This has made the class very meaningful for me. He is very helpful and easy to get ahold of. I've developed skills in this class that will positively affect my future.

Brother Howell is AWESOME! This course was blended, so we only met once a week, and it was so worth it! Good readings, quizzes were open-book, lectures were uplifting, inspirational, and encouraging. I learned so much about the prophet and apostles and felt the Spirit in every class period. HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend!
Professor Howell is a good person but I would say he isn't the most organized and there can be times where we didn't have time to cover the material because it took so long to get started.
If you are looking for an easy religion credit for once, this is the class to take. Professor Howell is very kind, and learning about the prophet and apostles is very uplifting.
You can tell Brother Howell loves and cares for the missionaries he prepares. He was so funny and there was never a dull moment in his class:)

I absolutely loved Professor Howell, he is a funny guy! His class was so manageable, especially since all of the work is online and can be completed whenever you have time throughout the week. Professor Howell really cares about his students and wants them to get out of the most they can. 100% recommend this class :)

Bro. Howell is one of my favorite professors I have had! I can tell that he put his heart and soul into this course. He was recently a mission president and has useful experience that can relate to all. Every time I went to class, I left feeling more uplifted. He's always smiling, and makes the time to get to know everyones name. 10/10 recommend!

Loved this class with Bro Howell! He brings personal experiences and fun insights about the apostles that most of us would never know otherwise. He helps us to recognize them as the divinely appointed representatives that they are while also allowing us to see that they're humans with difficult pasts and silly mistakes behind them just like we are.

Brother Howell is an amazing mission prep professor. He teaches in a way that excites you to learn about missionary work. The homework is easy and understandable. Brother Howell prepares you adequately for learning about being a missionary. This was one of my favorite classes this semester. I highly recommend taking his class.

Scott Howell is kind and fun. He designs lectures & coursework around the class's needs and understands students' individual needs (very flexible). He's passionate about what he teaches. He goes out of his way to provide cool opportunities for guest speakers, service opportunities, outside of class events, and cares most about our overall learning.

Brother Howell is the best! His class was my favorite I have taken at BYU so far. I learned so much in his class and the coursework never stressed me out. You basically read about an apostle or the Prophet once a week, have an easy reading quiz, and then do an attendance assignment in class. Brother Howell is fantastic and very knowledgeable.

I had Bro. Howell for mission prep. I've grown more in his class than in any other at BYU. Bro. Howell is sweet, fun, and excited about missionary work. He is also the newest faculty member for the mission prep classes, so we have all the new and updated curriculum and resources for missionaries to use. I wish I could take his class again!!!!!!!!!!

If you want to learn how to do modern missionary work, he is the best possible professor you could hope for. He was a mission president sometime around 2020 so he's right out of the field, and knows exactly how it works. He teaches you the truly important things you won't get from other professors. He's also the most caring professor I know.

He is a really energy-filled professor. I took his mission prep class, and he did a really good job of facilitating bonding between my classmates and I. I think that the class was a great help in my preparation to serve a mission, and it wasn't a hard class either.
Super fun professor who made Mission Prep a blast!!! Recently came back from being mission president, so he knows q lot about missionary work in this new digital age. Highly recommend

Brother Howell cares so much about all of his students! I always looked forward to going to his class, and it was crazy how the time flew by every day. There's not a lot of homework but he was a very effective teacher, even though we were his first mission prep class he has ever taught. If you can take a class from him, I would highly recommend it!
I love Professory Howell! He always keeps tabs on his students and shows he truly cares.
Bro Howell is very nice and funny but I felt like his class could have been organized a little better and been a little clearer.

Brother Howell is really nice and cares about his students! You can tell he has a testimony and loves the gospel. Best religion class readings I've had. I would 100% take this class from him again.
That being said, the class wasn't very organized. We focused more on the apostle's lives than their teachings and class was a bit scattered.
Went over an apostle or two each week and it was cool to learn about each of them a little bit more.

I highly recommend this religion class to BYU students. Brother Howell does an excellent job organizing the course layout to help students strengthen their testimony of President Nelson and his apostles. I always found it enjoyable attending the class and felt the Spirit in each lesson. If you're looking for a good religion course, take this one!
Brother Howell is an amazing professor. I loved this class and the content so much! Great lectures, simple readings, simple course material.

Keeps the class simple. Each week you read about 1 or 2 of the 15 apostles/prophets, have a quiz on what you learned, then make a plan to apply one thing you learned. Not a difficult class, but you can take a ton from it if you put sincere effort in. Much more about changing as a person than learning difficult concepts. He's extremely kind.

Brother Howell is awesome! He has had lots of experiences with the apostles so very qualified to teach the class. He follows the spirit really well, and creates an environment to learn. I think this is the last time he is teaching this class, but if he does in the future, for sure take it from him!
He really cares about the students.

Professor Howell is extremely kind and loves to serve his students. He must be protected at all costs! This class was almost ridiculously easy, but this is a personal choice of his because he wants our motivation for the Living prophets course to be learning and accepting invitations from the living prophets and not earning a letter grade.

I loved him as a teacher! He was super funny and entertaining. I love his style of teaching. He really prepared me for my mission. I love how he emphasized mission scriptures, advice, mission purpose, and adjusting to missionary life in his lessons.

Scott Howell is a great teacher. I feel very prepared for my mission. The class was easy but very helpful. He is funny, out of pocket, and a good guy. He is very knowledgeable and didn't give too many assignments. Every project is worthwhile and not too time-consuming.

Brother Howell is a little crazy--he always planned for more than we got done--but the lectures were engaging and the projects were impactful. A LOT of the class is focused on technology and social media. I recommend taking this class if you're a missionary going stateside especially!

Brother Howell is very qualified to teach Mission Prep being that he was a mission president himself. He is enthusiastic about missionary work and I always left his class feeling uplifted and learning a new strategy to use on my mission. He really cares about his students and wants them to be the best missionaries they can be. I loved this class!

Brother Howell was very kind and was always there for his students. if you ever needed anything you knew that he would be there. He is a very fair grader and just cares about his students. If you show up to class and participate and do the easy weekly assignments you will get an A without a doubt. He knows what he is teaching and is very good at it

I really enjoyed taking a class from Brother Howell. He cares about his students so much and wants to make your class enjoyable. Assignments are fun and easy and he prepares you well in advance. He is the best religion teacher I have had at BYU.
Brother Howell is incredibly understanding and kind; his lectures are always spiritually strengthening and enlightening. The course load is not heavy or unmanageable. Take this class from him!
He is awesome. No exams. Once a week mandatory class + weekly readings. Always learned something.

Attendance is mandatory since the class is blended and is only once a week. Readings are weekly with weekly quizzes that are open book and fairly easy. Overall very engaging class and you learn a lot about the apostles of the church.

His class is pretty easy, but you do get points for going to class. We had a lot of outside work (readings, quizzes, projects), but they're all fairly easy and don't take much time. Brother Howell is super supportive and just wants us to be the best missionaries out there. It's a great class, but you have to put in the work to make it worthwhile.

He is super kind and caring and never has any intention of offending anyone. He loves the prophets and apostles and is super passionate about teaching. He encourages us to watch general conference and gives us an assignment to read/watch all of the conference talks of the apostles in the most recent conference and he asks us to report of each talk.

Professor Howell is an amazing professor. His class is so easy to get a good grade if you just do the assignments (that are so easy). He does a general conference report and then quizzes on the apostles, that's it. You get points for attendance, so you have to go attend. Overall, easy and laid-back class.

Professor Howell did an amazing job at following and teaching by the spirit. His love for the prophet and apostles is amazing and I admire him for it. I learned a lot about the prophet and apostles, things I didn't know before. I loved reading all the readings that were given, great class, great professor.

By far and away the best religion professor that I have ever had! His lectures leave me edified every single time. He cares about our spiritual well-being and is less focused on making the class difficult as other religion professors seem to do. I would recommend to every single student at the university.

Cool guy, really focuses on the development of the students, and takes guidance from the Spirit to address a certain topic. The class is really straightforward, and it is interesting to learn more about the living prophets and apostles. Amazing professor!

Brother Howell is an amazing professor for Mission Prep! He really knows what he is talking about. His excitement for missionary work is contagious. The work load appears very heavy, but it is easy, fun, and enjoyable. Put the effort into Brother Howell's class. You won't regret it. Brother Howell gives so many unique opportunities to his students.
Not a difficult class at all. Show up to class and do the readings and you will get an A.

Professor Howell was a very easy teacher and his class was not difficult. The assignments were easy and was an easy grader. Attendance was mandatory, and lectures sometimes took a while to get to the point. However he was a very kind, understanding, and caring professor.

He has you read a decent amount, but honestly it is super easy. As long as you read what you are supposed to then you will get an A + on all the quizzes and there are no tests. So overall super easy class and you can get a good spiritual boost to your week!
If you go to this class with a good attitude and try to get out as much as you can, it will be a nice changeup from the rest of your schedule.
He was super kind, had neat experiences with the apostles, and I felt the spirit every class!

I loved taking this class from Professor Howell! You can tell how much he cares about learning about the living prophet and apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. He is always wanting to hear about experiences from the class and loves participation! It is the perfect religion class to take!

I cannot recommend Brother Howell enough. His class is what a religion class should be. He is caring, fun, and so inspired. Taking his class has been the highlight of my time at BYU. His class has been one of the only classes that I've taken that I have seen inspire real changes in my life. Take his class! Your GPA and testimony will thank you.

Professor Howell is amazing. Makes class super easy and a safe place. It was one of the best classes I have taken. He is passionate about his work, and it really feels like he is transferring his passion to his class. Would highly recommend taking anything from him.

Brother Howell is an amazing person and professor. I love his class. The course is blended, so we only meet on Fridays. The reading isn't difficult whatsoever, and the classes are interesting and fun. I love this class and Brother Howell and would recommend that everyone should take this course from him.

Brother Howell was the best religion teacher I have ever had! He is so thoughtful when he teaches, and the course material is interesting and built my testimony. The class is extremely fair for religion, and is the perfect religion class to take when you have to take other hard classes with it.

Professor Howell is an amazing religion professor. He really cares about his students and the material that he is teaching. He has had some amazing experiences that make this course really interesting. Professor Howell is also very willing to help struggling students. 10/10 would take again.

He is very caring, genuinely interested in his students, and very passionate about this class. Over the semester, he adapted the class and coursework based on our feedback. There are easy weekly quizzes. One note- he talks about how he isn't arrogant but he does unintentionally come off that way sometimes. Great professor and easy class!

Take Living Prophets from Brother Howell!! He genuinely cares about all the students and about the class building your testimony. It is not a difficult class, you just have to show up. This is one of the best religion classes I have taken at BYU.
This was a great class to learn more deeply about the prophets and apostles and more closely follow their counsel. Brother Howell is so caring. You will love his class.

I loved Professor Howell. He really wanted you to learn and apply the things you learned into your life. This class helped me to be a better person. He is very kind and gets to know you by name! defiantly recommend taking a class from Professor Howell.

He's really nice and genuinely cares about his students. It was a little disorganized at the beginning of the semester because it was his first time teaching the class, but he listened to our input and it was much more organized by the end.
Professor Howell is a kind man who cares deeply about his students success.
This was a great class to learn and feel the spirit, but not spend too much out of class time. I would take this class again!

He will individually pay attention to every student. I haven't seen that from most other professors. It was really needed one day for me and I really appreciated that he humbly acknowledges that he is still learning too with all of us.

I really respect Prof. Howell, he obviously cares so much about us. I loved that he was willing to work on the class structure. Unfortunately, I felt like a lot of things weren't working. There was a lot of reading and invitations that you had to accept from the apostles to later be graded on. If that sounds good, you might like this class though.

He is a great teacher and has a lot of experience coming to know that the Prophets and Apostles are God's mouthpieces on the Earth today. This semester was a test run class, and he was very willing to work with the students to make the best experience he could. The teaching is often done through slide show lectures, and shared personal experiences.

Brother Howell is a sweet, caring instructor. He responds to feedback and made changes to the class after surveying the class. He often gives out snacks or school supplies, you'll leave almost every lecture with something extra! You should expect to read about the lives of the apostles every week, then do a short quiz. There's a quiz in class too.

Brother Howell is an incredibly caring and humble man. He knew my name on the first day of class which was so impressive. You can tell he has a very strong testimony and that he was more concerned about having the spirit guide the lectures than getting through the slides. Great class. I would highly recommend.

Prof Howell was great, you could tell he really cares about each one of his students. The class itself was really easy, he didn't require too much. The only thing I would say is his lectures were not always super engaging or exciting for me. It felt like a lot of tangents about prophets/apostles lives, which weren't super helpful for my learning.

Professor Howell is a kind man. He has a good class and continues to try to improve it. He keeps everyone entertained and even brings snack sometimes. Only critic, and it is a minor one, is that he could exercise more humility or humble speech when it comes to him talking about his life flexes, followers on Instagram, accomplishments, etc.

This guy is the best!  He is super flexible and wants to improve and refine the class and his style of teaching! The class was heavier in content and assessment at the beginning of the semester, but after midterm student ratings we discussed what to change to make the class better. Made lots of little improvements to the class.
Take class with him

I was honestly so impressed with Brother Howell! First off, he is very caring and appreciates and uses feedback. He initiated a midway evaluation to get feedback on how the class was going in a way that we would feel comfortable giving our honest feedback. He quickly adapted and focused on giving us a spiritual experience. 10/10 recommend!

The professor is fine, the content material over the course gradually lessened over the course of the semester because the amount of work at the start was unreasonable (the professors decision) which was nice. Everything was open note, so as far as difficulty it's just the time to do it, but not intellectually challenging.

Professor Howell has such a genuine and kind heart. He's always concerned about our well-being. Because he has worked closely with the apostles before, he was able to share insights on each individual and provide better insight into their backgrounds. The class itself was overall very easy. No midterms only one final (very easy as well)

I loved this class and Professor Howell! My understanding of and testimony in each of the 15 has grown immensely! Every week I left feeling inspired and filled with the spirit. Brother Howell asked for feedback and actually listened. He seemed to know everyone's names and read every short answer and discussion post. Very personable and kind!
Super awesome professor. He was genuinely interested in our lives and put his heart into his lessons.
You must take a class from Bother Howell! He is so caring and has such a fire of a testimony!! I also promise that if you do the assignments you will 100% get an A in his class.
Dr. Howell was a great teacher. He really knows his stuff. The course can feel heavy at times since he usually only teaches graduate classes, but he is humble and willing to work with the students.
Awesome guy! Any issues I had with the class got fixed part way through the semester. Is really willing to listen to student feedback and change things when necessary.

This class was pretty easy, there is one reading to do per week with an open note quiz at the end of the week. Professor Howell was also very caring about the students in the course. The class was a little disorganized at times on learning suite but he was understanding and worked to fix issues when they were noticed.

Prof Howell is great, really tries to make it easiest for the students. I had this class once a week, and there was a weekly quiz that was really easy, but required a password so you need to go to class. The only homework I had was reading the ensign about an apostle and a conference talk from them, and then just a quiz about it. Good class.

Professor Howell is a really kind man who is very concerned with how his students are feeling and if they are overwhelmed with the workload. He made changes in the middle of the semester because students were struggling.

The pacing in class was kind of slow, but the homework was really insightful and engaging in and interesting but not hard way.

Professor Howell made REL333 (Living Prophets) my favorite class this year. He cares so much about each of his students and will work with you on grades. Doesn't want to stress us with workload and his homework readings and quizes are easy, and very cool to read. My testimony of our Prophet and Apostles grew so much. 100% take a class from Howell!

Professor Howell is a kind person. He cares about what he is teaching and tells awesome stories. He has had some awesome experience and shares them to add insight to your life. The class itself is not hard as long as you keep up with it. If you do what it requires, it is rewarding. Professor Howell is amazing. Take the course!

This is the best religion teacher I have had because he focuses more on having us change our lives and inviting us to change and become better disciples rather then asking us religion questions that we probably wont need to know for the rest of our lives.

Brother Howell was a great professor. He asked us what we liked and didn't like and he actually made changes according to what we said! He wants to make it the best class possbile. The class was mostly based on changing YOU. He had us make goals and then report on our improvement. I feel like I changed a lot and I am grateful.

It took me a little bit to get used to him, but he is a great professor and a great person. Homework isn't busy work, but homework is really when I would learn the most about the prophets. In class, we go over the material and learn a little more about the prophet/apostle as a person.

This has been one of my favorite courses at BYU. Brother Howell has a lot of experience and knowledge to share about the prophets and apostles, I left every class feeling uplifted. There is a lot of focus on personal goals and impressions from General Conference. Brother Howell's first priority is the learning and progress of his students.

Professor Howell is so awesome! He cares so much about the students and has a lot of experience and cool stories working with the 12. The class was easy - just do the readings and you'll be fine. He's making/has made a lot of changes to the class though so it might be slightly different in the future. Overall, great professor, great class, 10/10

Professor Howell was great. The course was a bit unorganized, but that is to be expected seeing as it was his first time teaching the course. Taught more by your peers than Prof. Howell (he still chimes in, but it is group presentation heavy).
He is the absolute best. Take him, Take him, Take him.

Brother Howell is a good professor but he does not teach a lot, he lets the students to teach the classes. I feel that we needed to be instructed more by him, he did not really shared doctrinal points or teachings that would be thoughtful, I feel that I was taught just by my classmates.

Professor Howell is great! The class is well structured, and you have ample time to complete assignments. There is a fair bit required of you each week, but I think the benefits of no tests outweigh the cost of weekly assignments.

Bro Howell really cares about students growing their knowledge and desire to follow the prophets. Most work is participatory and geared toward growing spiritually, which is what a religion class should be.
He is great. It was a easy A if you went to class and he created a wonderful learning environment.
This is an amazing Professor. I honestly learned so much and I always looked forward to going to this class.

Professor Howell has a very personal connection to teaching about the living prophets, and it shows in his class. He has a very innovative approach to structuring a class and is willing to try new things, which is fun but also led to some confusion and inconsistency in the syllabus. The class was not very difficult, and I got out what I put in.

This class if really great for learning how to apply the teachings of the prophet and apostles in your life. Different set up than most classes just because their is no specific text like with book of mormon or d&c.
Super easy class. Student-led presentations each class, and no tests.

The lectures were great, Brother Howell shared beautiful experiences he has shared with many of the apostles and the prophet, it was great to hear them first hand. There were a lot of things to keep up with, but the weekly quizzes were open note so it is very possible to get 100% on everything. You're expected to keep a weekly reflection journal.
Really great guy. Lectures were good and he definitely knows his stuff. Best religion class I have had. He also made me write this.

He has been the only religion professor I have taken but from all the horror stories I have hard from other classes he is super cool! His class is not hard at all, isnt too much work, but you end up learning a lot more then you think.

Professor Howell has been my favorite religion professor at BYU. This is the second class I've taken from him and he does a wonderful job. Realistic and practical homework assignments that don't leave you stressed or anxious. He's easy to talk to and willing to work with you. Great professor!

Howell's class was interesting. Deadlines were changed and the schedule was never set. The quizzes often had difficult and niche questions about the apostles. I felt like the student lead lectures were an interesting touch, but he didn't teach the majority of the class. However, there was no final or midterm.

I love Brother Howell! His living prophets class started off a little disorganized, but it got increasingly better throughout the semester. Honestly, it was a super easy course, and he just genuinely wants to help you gain a stronger testimony of the leaders of the church, and he cares more about that than making it difficult to get a good grade.

Professor Howell was pretty disorganized, adding/removing assignments and quizzes throughout the semester, which made it really difficult to keep track of the classwork. I did like the student-run classes, almost every class period was a group presentation, but this professor interrupted students constantly (often to talk about himself).

I love Professor Howell! This is the second class I have taken from him. The quizzes could be kind of long, but they were only once a week so it was manageable. Plus they were open book. His lectures always feel heartfelt and spiritual, and that is what I look for when picking religion classes.
This class was okay for the religion credit and I did learn a lot about the apostles but overall it was very lecture heavy.

Brother Howell cares about what he teaches, that's apparent, but the classes were taught almost entirely by students who were repeating what we learned in the required reading. It almost felt like sometimes he just wanted to tell random stories about how he knew the apostles and if you didn't have a connection to one, you were lesser.

It was always a treat to show up for Brother Howell's class. He wanted to make the class as spiritually uplifting as possible, but understood the stress of being a student at BYU, so nothing was too crazy difficult in the class. He is very fun and you can tell he really cares about his work and his students.

Professor Howell really cares about his students and wants very one to leave with a strengthened testimony. He is great at taking suggestions from students and implementing them into the course. The only thing I would change is the organization. The course had a lot of moving parts with unclear expectations.

Brother Howell has a strong testimony of the Living Prophet and Apostles and he was able to help me build my own testimony and desire to follow them! This class is not very hard but does it does take time to read about and familiarize yourself with the apostles. Class is an opportunity to learn from one another and has strengthed my testimony tons!

Brother Howell is the best! He is a super kind and fun person. I love hearing all his stories and experiences with the Apostles. This class was really easy and fun. The quizzes took me a while to get through but they are easy and open book. I have learned more about the apostles than I have ever before. You get out what you put into it.

Dr. Howell has been one of my favorite religion teachers at BYU! He is very passionate and has a knack for inviting discussion and deep reflection. He is very spiritual and did well inviting the Spirit. In particular, I really enjoyed his personal stories and insights into the apostles. I would definitely recommend this class!
This class was very informative and I really got to know each of the apostles. Each student helps present once in a lecture but it is super easy. Definitely would recommend this class!

The quizzes on the apostles are all based in arbitrary facts, lectures were just regurgitated material or prof Howell telling random stories, and it felt like we lost of a lot of profound learning to jumping through hoops for a grade. Luckily, the subject is inspiring and prof Howell is taking a lot of feedback to make the class better.

Brother Howell is a very nice man with good intentions. The class is an easy A. You get out what you put in. Each person is assigned a group and an apostle that they prepare a presentation on and present on one class period. Every class consists of a song, prayer, teacher comments, and a group presentation on one of the apostles.

I liked Professor Howell's class and all I learned about the apostles. It was super easy and required little work. I liked the set up of the class because it was made up of readings outside of class and then peer presentations given every class period. You were only required to present once a semester which was very nice. Overall would recommend!

Very surfaces level and no depth to what we learned. No real flow. Made it more about himself then the brethren. I would have liked to see more doctrine taught or things focused on building a testimony of the brethren. I don't feel I progressed at all in my testimony from this class, just from the readings. He's kind and loving though

Brother Howell is a very kind man. I genuinely think that he wants the best for his students. I will say, his class felt unorganized at times and sometimes we would spend half the class discussing what seemed to me as random things. I didn't get as much as I would have liked to out of this class, but I am still grateful I took it.

He is fun and engaging, but his classes provided absolutely zero. We had to read before we came to class, and class was simply a regurgitation of the reading. Not just like he covered the same material, he had students giving PPT presentations on the reading, so it was *literally* word-for-word the reading.

Brother Howell's Living Prophets class was great. Most of the material is taught by your peers, but Bro. Howell also has some sweet stories. Nearly all of your course work is just doing a weekly quiz on some of the stuff taught in class. Quizzes are open-book too. No mid-term or final exam. Probably the easiest A of my 3 years here.
I really enjoyed Brother. Howell! He really knows what he is talking about. He has lots of interesting stories and the class work is manageable! I totally would recommend taking his class!
My favorite religion class so far. Such an amazing teacher and loved the setup for the class.
Changed things up a lot mid-semester but the class is easy and uplifting and he has a lot of cool stories.
Professor Howell actually is one of the nicest professors and the class is pretty simple. Just do the assignment on time and be ready to daily reflection on each of the apostles

This class is a very low-stress religion credit! Brother Howell doesn't have any tests, just one group project and open book weekly quizzes. For the group project, you present about the life and the most recent conference talk of one apostle.

Brother Howell is a great guy. This was his first time teaching this course and he is very open to feedback. He's open to changing things up. This class was a bit repetitive but, I really enjoyed the reading. Class is super manageable and not stressful and meant to strengthen your testimony. If your looking for a relaxed religion credit take it.
The class was fine, but because it was the professor's first time teaching that class things were changed around in the middle of the semester, making knowing what you needed to do really hard.

Great lectures- very inspirational! Quite a bit of reading outside class in the Ensigns, social media posts, conference talks, etc. Very manageable class. Prof Howell knows a lot about what he's talking about and values student input!

He is seriously such an amazing guy and its a really good class to take from him because he has lots of experience and often knows the people we talk about. Totally managable amount of work, take him if you need a fun and simple religion credit

Brother Howell did an awesome job making it a good religion class that didn't stress me out. He cared a lot about our feedback and even changed some things mid semester based off of the ratings a suggestions we gave. He might interrupt you when you are giving a comment, but don't be offended, he is trying to work on it! Loved this class!
This was an easy but repetitive class.
Professor Howell loves this class so it was fun to take it from him. Sometimes it was hard to pay attention in class but I thought the readings and assignments were good. I would take from him again.

I loved Brother Howell. It was such a laid-back religion class that I felt like I could actually enjoy it! There were a few readings every week, but they were very minimal. You really could just go to class and enjoy learning about the apostles and prophets.

Brother Howell's Living Prophets class might just be the best religion class I have taken at BYU. This class is at that perfect sweet spot that so many religion classes struggle to find. It manages to be spiritually invigorating without requiring hours upon hours of work. No midterms or finals. Just some quizzes and a project. I loved this class!

Howell is the best religion prof I've had. His class is like all religion classes should be-- it's low pressure, low effort, and actually gives you a chance to feel the Spirit without having to worry about taking notes. The weekly open-note quizzes are repetitive and no fun, but definitely beats the exams and essays you get in other classes.
Love him! He's super smart and knows what he's talking about. He's a little sporadic, but if you can put up with lesson plans going off the rails, you'll absolutely love him.

Brother Howell really tried to make his students feel loved and gain a testimony of the living prophets. His personality can be a little intense, but it's all out of love. Really loved getting to work with others and always supporting fellow students in class instead of just listening to lectures from the same guy.

Professor Howell is hands down the best. I wish I could just take this class over and over again! I learned so much about the apostles and prophets and I was always so excited to come to class and learn. There is a decent amount of reading and a couple videos to watch each week, but it is manageable. Quizzes to test understanding, take it from him!

Professor Howell was awesome. He is fun and really loves to talk and share amazing experiences with the living apostles. This was the best religion course I have taken. One open note quiz a week on a specific apostle and some reading about that apostle. He tries really hard to keep the class on low stress for the students and the TA was awesome.

Brother Howell was awesome! This is probably my favorite religion class that I have taken so far. I learned a lot and felt the spirit. He has a lot of cool stories and will go off on tangents sometimes but overall he is great. I would definitely recommend taking this class.

We go over an apostle each week and a different group will talk about that apostle's recent talks and about their overall life. There are a few weekly assignments. There are no tests and the workload is very light. He can talk a lot, which can get boring but he usually has great personal experiences with each of the apostles. Good class!

Professor Howell is uniquely good at encouraging his students to reflect on the things they are learning. He is highly knowledgeable and genuinely cares about the success and growth of his students. He draws on his vast topic knowledge to add thoughtful insights to the material.

Brother Howell is so caring and loves all of his students. He always tries to make his class not one you worry or stress about, and is very relaxed and accessible. It is not hard to pass his class, and it is a very spiritual one that I always feel inspired by after attending. He is so knowledgeable about our prophet and apostles and so kind.

This was the easiest class from BYU I have ever taken. Still, I feel like I learned so much about the apostles, and I felt spiritual uplifted every class. This class helped me feel more prepared to receive personal revelation and understand the talks at the April 2022 general conference, which is invaluable to me. Brother Howell is amazing.

I would go to class hoping to be uplifted by the spirit and, due to Professor Howell's comments, I would leave each class feeling angry and discouraged. Professor Howell also added assignments in the middle of the semester and some assignments were on Canvas twice, so I had to guess which quiz was the correct one or waste my time taking both.

Professor Howell has been my favorite religion professor I've had at BYU. I felt the spirit in every lesson. He assigns a perfect quantity of meaningful work to be done outside of class so that the homework left me feeling inspired but not burdened. I'm taking another religion class from him this semester. 10/10 would recommend
The best religion class Ive taken so far at BYU. Hes led by the spirit and you get a lot out of the class but he also makes it very fun and interesting. Will be taking classes from him in the future.

Professor Howell's Religion classes are just as they should be. We learn a lot and the work load is very reasonable. We self-report on a lot of things and there are no tests, only projects. Expect a weekly quiz of some sort. Great guy, definitely recommend!

By far my favorite religion professor! I always have a difficult time in all of the religion classes I've taken, but I really felt the spirit and learned a lot from Brother Howell. You can tell he really cares about his students and follows the Spirit while teaching. Also, because there are no tests, I felt I was able to feel the spirit and learn.

Brother Howell is an amazing religion professor. His class taught me the doctrine of the Book of Mormon powerfully. He focuses on each student actually putting in effort and gaining a stronger testimony for themselves. Taking it gave me new resources to learn and study the gospel that I would have never had before. The work isn't too hard at all!

Brother Howell is so caring and cares about his students! I loved attending his class and the great smile and spirit he brought. There are no tests in the class, only a few projects that are not hard. Attendance is mandatory, but if you are missing because of a "good" reason, just talk to him! You will get out of the class, what you put into it!

I love this class because Brother Howell cares more about you feeling the spirit than memorizing trivia for tests. This class provides a relaxed spiritual retreat in the middle of a stressful school day. He does talk a lot and tends to interrupt students a bit, but if you just roll with it the class is a great experience.

I did not gain anything from Brother Howell's class. He goes off on tangents that have nothing to do with the lecture and when he asks for participation, he only lets the student talk for 10 seconds before he cuts them off and keeps lecturing. He often made fun of students and was disrespectful to their thoughts/comments.

Brother Howell is my absolute favorite professor I've ever had. He doesn't do midterms or finals, instead there are projects that aren't difficult. His lectures are extremely spiritual, sometimes he goes on tangents but the tangents are always super spiritual. He really cares about his students, and he doesn't make his class impossible.

This professor rarely gets class participation, is unorganized, and goes on tangents. He also frequently interrupts students. However, if you are looking for an easy A, there are no tests and all quizzes are open scriptures.

Prof Webb is probably a great guy, despite not interacting with him for the entirety of the semester. If you don't care about having a relationship with the professor, his online class is the one for you! I didn't love his skewed grading scale (threshold for an A- was >91%, less than that was a B+) but not a hard class if you do the work.

I did this class online. Trust this review. It is the second most unorganized online class I have had. you never get taught by Professor Webb. Getting assigned a Ta is confusing and takes forever. Canvas page is beyond confusing. And despite getting a 94.74% in his class, I got an A-. This class made the semester a whole lot more frustrating.

Professor Webb's class is definitely challenging, especially at first when the assignments and presentations feel overwhelming but trust the process! If you're willing to put in the effort, you'll walk away with skills that are super valuable for your career.

He expects that we have a fundamental understanding of supply chain, which is not a part of the accounting curriculum. Heavy on group projects, there are no other assignments other than two midterms. Does not allow laptop or phone use in class for note taking. No supplemental materials to help you grasp the concepts briefly presented in class.

Great at teaching applicable skills that you will actually use. Presentation and project heavy, but always has clear guidelines to follow and always available for help. Textbook supports what he is teaching. He loves his job and presents the material well.
Scott is a weird dude. He picks favorites pretty openly and does random things a lot. His class doesn't really have to do with Logistics, it's mostly a presenting class.

Class is basically a few massive projects. You need a 95 for an A, and since projects are rarely perfect, it can be hard to receive an A in the class. The final project was very vague and was graded hard for how unclear it was. The most time consuming out of the Junior Core. Exams are impossible to prepare for a can screw over your grade easily.

Get ready to present. This class will be 1-2 hours of outside class work one week and then 20 hours the next haha. Webb is a good guy, and he grades fairly. Sure, some of his projects will have you trying to find a needle in a haystack. Sometimes, you won't be able to find the info you need. But it was through the research I learn so much.

Worst teacher I've had at BYU. He is a required class for GSCM, so not much anyone can do about it. His final project is a complete waste of time and is insanely hard...
He just doesn't teach much, and has so many group projects but doesn't tell u how to do them. Really disappointed in his class.
I like Webb as a person and he gives good advice for presentations, but we learned very little about actual logistics. When I did my internship, I felt underprepared for most practical aspects of it.
Will never respond to you and avoids students

I really enjoyed this class! Most of it was online so it's hard to accurately grade a teacher's style, but when we had in-class presentations they were awesome. He teaches concepts through games and not only were they really enjoyable, but they made perfect sense. Fun class! Not too hard at all.
This was a boring online course and everything is on Quizlet. I feel like I didn't learn much but it was definitely easy.

1 term class. If you do your reading and homework, it's an easy A. If you just wing the quizzes and tests you will really struggle. But the homework is easy and it's not a lot of reading. Class was really fun and filled with interesting activities.

Sadly, GSCM 305 is only offered online, so be prepared to read so many boring business articles (not all of which you will understand). This class is just reading and memorizing, and despite finishing it about a month ago, I don't think I could tell you much about global supply chain. It is pretty easy though, just time consuming.

The class has a great set up! We met once a week to have super interactive lectures/games that taught supply chain concepts. The readings are interesting enough and are often supplemented by videos which are much more engaging than simply reading would be. The professor is cool too- approachable, intelligent, and very passionate about GSCM.

Prof. Webb was a really nice guy and his class was very structured and easy going. The TAs made the class self-paced. The class is only weighted on a few things, mostly a midterm and a final that are pretty straightforward, especially if you go to TA review. 95 is an A so watch out for that. Overall easy class, great TAs and Prof.

If you are taking global supply chain get ready to just read articles from outside sources/videos from YouTube. This man does not have a good system set up quite yet in the way he has his course set up. Some of the articles are very hard to read/understand if you don't have too much of a business background.
95 is an A, which can be frustrating, and there are not that many resources to help you learn. Could be more, but it feels like a class they just needed to spend less money and time on

This class is brutal. Instead of learning logistics, I essentially learned how to present which is a good skill but is not the main point of what the class should be. Be prepared to spend dozens of hours working on ambiguous group projects that will be graded subjectively. He also makes the class too competitive between the different groups.

Didn't learn logistics, only how to present. His tests are super hard and aren't anything like the review material he provides nor is anything he teaches us. His class harbors competitiveness between groups and rankings within the class. Not an accommodating teacher and does not give good feedback. Be aware, TA's have a big say in your grade.

If you're taking this class it's probably required anyways so idk why I'm doing this. Professor Webb is awesome. This class was a little experimental so it was kind of all over the place, but I think it will be good in the future. I was dissapointed with my grade, but it's okay. I'm glad he teaches here I really think he does a lot for the program.

Dr. Webb is legit. This logistics mgmt class was very interesting. It has caused me to see the world differently. He cracks down on you during big presentations, so be ready for that. He holds students to high standards, and offers constructive feedback. He seems really serious (he is), but he also is really kind and willing to help out.

Dr. Webb is amazing. There's really nothing bad to say about him. Unless the class has changed since I took it in Winter 2018, you won't need the textbook much. He had us read a case before each class, then discuss it. You will have to purchase the cases. Topics cover supply chain strategy. I thought I was going to get an A but somehow got a B+.
Brother Webb makes this class fantastic!
He's the best! Take brother Webb's class and you won't regret. Kind of wish I could take it again.

I'm not too interested in logistics, but Webb made this class great! Everyone says the projects are hard and bluestar and john deere are hard, but they really aren't that bad. I really enjoyed the class and it isn't as hard as everyone says it is.
This class was a huge letdown. Lecture was recitation from the slides. Professor wasn't clear in his teaching. Class is basically run by the TAs.
Could have learned more from 20 minutes of google searching and watching some youtube videos.

Not a difficult class. You'll read a case before most class periods, but if you don't read you can still contribute to the class discussion. The class project is developing a strategy to start a company and take it global. The rubric is simple, but he expects you to include other topics discussed in class (not on the rubric) to get above average.

Brother Webb is amazing and he really wants you to succeed. I had a lot of fun in his class. Remember that it will be tough, in his own words "I am preparing you all to be executive and to think like executives". That is the reasoning for the difficulty of the class, and I appreciate that and all of the tough projects.
Scott Webb is great!
By far, the funnest class I've ever taken. And the class title was 'Logistics'.
Chili Pepper.

Dr. Webb is a great lecturer.  He really does make every class interesting. An A is hard to get (starts at 95%), but below a B is almost impossible if you try your best. Group projects are difficult, but my groupmates were motivated and hopefully yours will be too. Tests are open-book, but hard. I doubt you'll dislike the class.

Webb is a fantastic teacher. He has very high expectations though, it is almost impossible to get an A. That being said he has structured the class so that as long as you show up you can get a B. Start all of your projects as early as you can.

I love Scott. His classes are really driven off of external thoughts and definitely not the traditional lecturer. Very fun, happy, and willing to help. You need to try hard to get an A but easy grader lower than that. Group work is the name of the game with him, so most of the time you're graded just like your peers, but he's just an awesome guy.

Great professor, I really enjoyed his class. Second time I've had him and I would take him again. Super hard to get an A, but almost impossible to get below a B. He knows his stuff and class is always worth attending. He bring lots of real world experience. No busy work, but some really big projects and presentations. Lots of  interesting cases.

Webb is the teacher that takes something super boring and teaches it so well that you wonder if that's what you want to be when you graduate. Work with your group and you'll do well. It's a unite or fail kind of thing but he is one the best teachers I've had at BYU.

Dr. Webb is an amazing professor. I took BUS M 468 (Logistics) from him and ended up loving the class. His projects were ridiculously challenging and require a lot of work and team effort. But when it comes to actually grading, Dr. Webb is very fair and understands his students. You will learn in his classes.

Dr. Webb will tell you the truth, whether it is good or bad. He is very frank and honest, which I appreciate. He has hard projects but he is pretty helpful if you go to him. He doesn't care about grades, he just wants you to understand the concepts. He is all about preparing you for the real world when you have a job. Great teacher!

Little bit more difficult of class due to the general ambiguity of the assignments. He tries to prepare you for real world work, which is very accurate. He uses interesting group activities to teach principles which is fun. The project is really time consuming so make sure you start early in the semester. Textbook doesn't help very much.

Very good class. He uses a lot of group activities that are pretty fun and interesting. The tests are not bad if you study and pay attention in class. He always does a jeopardy review before the tests that help A LOT! The final project is a doozy if you wait too long. Good overall class.

Two tests, difficult, but curved.  Attendance is not mandatory or graded.  Class is interesting, and there are a lot of activities to help students learn. Webb knows his stuff, and is a good teacher. He is a tough grader for presentations. One big group project. Very little homework. If you try, he will not give you below B-. Tough to get an A.

Professor Webb is an awesome teacher! He will spend the time to talk with you and make sure you understand things. His class is actually interesting and the things he teachers are the basic and most fundamental things you should know about supply chain.  A+ teacher!

Professor Webb is legit. He's really nice, easy going, and a straightforward/logical person. He doesn't try to trick you on the tests/final, and always does great review sessions so you know exactly what you need to study on the test. He has great hands-on activities/games to portray class concepts too. Great teacher, great class!!
Awesome teacher. He knows his stuff, and extremely nice. He also was in the military so you take him seriously. Overall a great teacher. I would recommend him to anyone.
Dr. Webb is extremely helpful and you learn a ton in his class.  Some assignments can be difficult.  Don't be late--he used to work in the military.

Took it Spring; he taught both the lectures and the labs. His exam review sections are very helpful, covering all the most likely missed concepts and details in the exams. He is also super accessible outside of class; you can knock on his office door anytime before 6 pm, and he'll help. 20 people in total; 11 got A, 2 got A-; class avg is 92.75.

He taught the lab portion, and the class is organized very well. The labs can be difficult, but we are told what to do in such a clear manner that they don't feel unmanageable. I already had some C programming experience, so these labs did feel fairly simple for me which may not be everybody's experience. That said, most students got an A in lab.

Scott Lloyd is the ideal engineering professor: highly experienced in the field, and deeply concerned about student progress. Very approachable both in and out of class. The projects can be difficult, but he'll stick around for hours and hours helping students through their issues.

The structure of this class is difficult, so the professor can be the difference between passing and failing. The class starts out as difficult. It is essential to do the readings, these are a huge help in understanding the material. By the time I got to the tests, I was able to perform well on them. This is a passable class, just takes effort.

Had him for ECEN330 as well: very kind and willing to help. He knows a lot, but I feel like it is hard to follow how he solves ECEN problems when he teaches and offers help: also, lectures are a little boring. The classes weren't hard though, and the labs were very interesting. He is a sweet person, and always offers to help (And he knows names :)

In both 390 and 323, Dr. Lloyd is both caring and sympathetic to students. He often stays well into the evening to help students struggling to finish labs. Goes above and beyond to make sure we can make the progress we need to. A genuinely kind individual, and has some good industry experience to back up his teaching too. He's here for the students

The class itself is pretty much just self-guided. His weekly lectures were not super helpful in terms of the class, but good to get some weekly inspiration. Not super helpful in lab sessions, though. Willing to accommodate and work with you, though. I think he would be better with other classes, but struggled with this one due to its unique nature.

This class is hard for the wrong reasons. The questions on homework and the tests are confusing (and sometimes the "correct answers" and just wrong), you only get one chance on the homework so there aren't any second chances, and there's no late policy so if you miss something you just get a 0. This class needs some major restructuring.

I'm not sure why there aren't more reviews here, because the general consensus among ECEn 330 students was largely negative. The lectures felt wholly unnecessary, and the labs were graded based on a coding standard that was ridiculously harsh. There were questions on the exams that not a single student answered correctly, and yet they never curved.

He would spend an hour talking about personal achievements and stories, and then the last 30 minutes would be a quick skim of the homework. His lectures were incredibly boring and most of the students would be on other websites. His tests were ridiculous and, when combined with other Junior Core classes, added way more stress than necessary.

Dr. Lloyd is super great + caring. Spends a bunch of time popping into the lab just to see how we're doing and help us with our code, which you don't get from every professor. His lectures aren't always exciting, but he always starts out with an experience from industry or a cool example of embedded tech, etc. Will def take from him again if I can.

I took ECEN 220 twice from him, (had to drop it the first time cause of life stuff), but both times he was just as consistent and incredible. It was during Covid and he was determined to help us learn despite the grim state of the world. Go to him for help, pay attention, and do the HW. He will help you grasp the EE/CE fundamentals!!

Professor Lloyd is a great guy, teaching a hard class. I took it during COVID, so it was all online, and it was his first time teaching it. It felt like he was still getting the hang of things with the lectures. But, he often stayed after to chat, and was always available for help. Very nice to talk to. He has lots of knowledge and experience.

Lloyd is the nicest professor. His lectures get a little boring at times, but he is always available and excited to help you, even outside of class times. I had trouble with certain concepts and he met with me over zoom for about an hour to help me understand. The class itself is tough, but Lloyd is a good choice because he wants you to succeed.
Lovely professor, great class. 10/10 would take again.
He's cool.

This man is incredible. He clearly loves his job and the subject that he teaches. He will bend over backwards to help any students. He is creative, interesting, fun, funny, and passionate about his subject. Not an overly difficult class. Lots of reading but he's one professor that will pretty much do all he can to help you succeed. Loved it.

3 tests (that are much easier than you'd think), lots and lots of reading, 3 mini essays (like 2 pgs max) and tiny quizzes online on occasion. Overall, a much better GE than I was expecting. Plus, Prof Miller is HILARIOUS and you can tell he loves his students.
Creative! In Asian Literature, you have incense-smelling contests, drawing contests, and read a lot. And he makes it a lot of fun.

Professor Miller is a great teacher. He likes creativity and encourages you to have fun on the paper and in presentations. He uses a different selection of readings each semester, but you should expect it to be a lot of reading. As long as you read the stories and understood them you'll do really well in his class.

Prof. Miller is one of my favorite teachers of all time. I am sad it took me until my last semester to take a class from him. His grading policies are completely fair and are aimed at helping students learn. This is the first class where almost everything I did felt useful and valuable in my education. I loved his class. He is awesome!
Take him.  Not difficult.  Keeps things interesting.  Could use more Japanese in class.  As long as you have an intellect and use it, this class is no problem.

Professor Miller was an awesome teacher!  I had him for Comp Lit and UNIV 101 (film).  Our film class was very easy--just go to the Int'l Cinema twice a week and discuss it in class. Comp Lit was a bit more challenging, but as long as you do the reading and show up to class and do a bit of studying, you'll know what to expect. Great and funny!

I had professor Miller when he taught at Colgate University (many years ago).  He was such a great prof.  I still think about his classes and try to emulate his style now that I am a teacher.  He is clear and concise style and he cares about students.  Emphasis is on learning, not on busy work.  He took us on a FANTASTIC semester abroad to Kyoto.

This class was a synch.  It really helps you on youor great works projects and is an easy A.  Scott Miller is very kind and you can tell he not only cares about you, but likes caring about you.  Oh, and he gives you food.

Scott's artificial intelligence product building class gave me the most practical hard skills of any course I've taken. He stays current on industry news and regularly shares relevant resources with the class. Grading is fair and he's genuinely invested in student success. Highly recommend.

I loved this class with Scott. He is so quirky, and it makes class amazing. If he finds something interesting and applicable, he will prepare an entire lecture based on it. My only qualm was that he let a TA take over the latter half of the course with storytelling, which was fine but seemed excessive. I missed Scott's lectures/discussions.
Scott is super chill. All you had to do was show up to class and do the assignments. He is a super smart guy and is super humble and kind. He is very approachable and easy to talk to.

Students would come to him for help, but he shrugged them off by saying, "This is supposed to be a hard class." Even when there was miscommunication about one of the tests, he didn't seem to care-- And then wanted us to give him a good review. The entirety of this class is memorizing the entire textbook for each test. Textbook is king, good luck.

The tests are quite long (50 question midterms, 100 q on final), but if you study the textbook, make flashcards, and memorize them, you should do well in the class. His lectures didn't help much, but they were entertaining and I just watched them online. The work on canvas for the blended course was all busywork and not very helpful but whatever.

The material wasn't difficult to understand but 90% of the class was teaching yourself the material. The professor would just read the textbook and then share some personal examples The tests were very different from the homework material so it was difficult to feel prepared for the tests. He seemed like he didn't care if we failed or succeeded

Professor Rackham is pretty funny. I liked his lectures. He uses a lot of personal examples that a really applicable and it helped to solidify concepts in my mind. He is very clear about his grading and what is need for the test. I didn't think the tests were too hard. It is a lot of memorization through, and some common sense.

Professor Rackham is amazing! I took the online/in-person blended class that meets once a week. There was a fair amount of busy work, but it was manageable. In class, we would review concepts from the textbook, listen to stories, and discuss real-world applications. His lectures were very engaging. I strongly recommend taking Professor Rackham!

If you take the Hybrid class then it is fairly easy. It is just some assignment's to complete each week. Tests are hard but all marketing tests are hard. I liked him as a teacher and thought the class was easy except for the tests. You don't need to go to class. You can just watch the recordings if you want.

Professor Rackham is really good at explaining marketing in the real world. He's very fair on his grading All the TAs are very prepared also to help us on the test. for all marketing classes at BYU, there's not very many materials to study for the midterms and finals. But Professor Rackham was very good at helping us prepare the best he could.
