tests are like 70% of your grade but you spend 110% of your time doing the homework and everything else under the sun. You have to really take it upon yourself to learn. I think every lecture I came out of I had whiplash. She had to cover so much material and didn't spend too much time on the difficult concepts

She is the best of the Chem 105 teachers. Her lectures are clear, and the homework assignments are accurate representations of the test. It's definitely a hard class and takes time but it's your best option. The readings aren't necessary. She gives a lot of filler points just for participation.
She's an okay teacher, just goes over the slides. She didn't do anything to make the very hard concepts any clearer.

Best class I have taken at BYU. Dr. Smith cares about teaching and takes lots of time to ensure she designs the curriculum to maximize chances for success. Assignments were graded strictly, with the understanding that they could be redone for full credit. There was one final project and a final exam along with weekly HW.
Dr. Smith is by far the most influential professor/teacher I have ever had. The class is difficult, but very enlightening and engaging. I would absolutely take another class from her.

CHEM 105 is meant to be a tough course, but Dr. Smith was a wonderful professor for it! Talking to all of my other friends taking the same course from different professors made me even more grateful for her. The lectures were very clear and easy to take good notes on. Every class came with iClicker quizzes that were easy points.

Dr. Smith deserves all the praise that she is getting in this thread. In a class with as horrid a reputation as Chem 105, she was awesome! If you got the grit, it's totally doable. The lectures are engaging and uplifting and she answers any question so feel free to approach her! Just apply yourself and you're guaranteed an A in my book.

I thought Dr Smith did a good job teaching chem 105. The exams are long, taking me about 4 hours and are difficult. Do the problem sets over and over again and read thru the lecture slides and iclicker quizzes as they are most similar to the exam. Recommend over preparing for the exams and overstudying, play your cards right and you might get an A.

Professor Smith did an amazing job at teaching chem 105. She kept all the students engaged in lecture by relating what we learned to real life and the church and also did a bunch of cool demos in class. Her tests are difficult, but she gives partial credit for answers that are close. I felt like I really understood the concepts she taught.

I really love Dr. Smith. Chem 105 is really difficult, but I think she's the best option. She does her best to set you up to do well, but you'll still have to study a ton. Going to her office hours was always helpful, especially for reviewing exams.

Dr. Smith is an amazing professor and teaches really well. The hardest part is that tests are weighed about half your grade. 
You will do just fine in this course if you do all the homework and decent on the tests. Get a tutor, use Youtube, and listen in the lectures and you will pass the class just fine.
This class is really, really hard, but Dr. Smith is really good at showing that she cares.

Dr. Smith is the best professor I have had in my entire college career. She knows what she is teaching and makes complex course material not only easy to understand but actually interesting! She is such an inspirational person and is accessible outside of class also. She truly wants her students to succeed and believes there are no dumb questions.

Dr smith goes very fast on lectures and the in class quizzes can be annoying. Says in the syllabus that you are expected to do problems 100% correct on exams that you have not seen yet, hooray premeds. She was ok with a 71% class average on the exams and said they were 'normal'. Test covered content we talked about maybe one time. Not a good time.

Good teacher, however very test heavy and content on the test can sometimes be from small details mentioned one time in lecture. In class IClicker quizzes makes attendance mandatory and cannot miss class. Its Chem 105 so I mean the class is going to suck no matter who you take it from.

The most amazing professor! I would take every chemistry class from her if I could. She is very smart but understands how to teach and connect with students. Chemistry is always going to be a lot of work, but she makes the class genuinely enjoyable and her passion for the topic is inspiring. The lectures can go a little fast but it's manageable

Dr. Smith is really great, she was so willing and ready to meet with students outside of class and go over tests or just answer questions. She took the time to remember her students' names, which is really impressive in a class the size of Chem 105. Tests were so difficult and you need to make sure to study really hard for them.

Dr. Smith is a solid choice. I am not a huge fan of her lectures (she goes fast with her slides) but she does explain things very well. Be sure to use her and the TAs as much as you can, especially the TA test reviews. Her tests were difficult but she will go over them with you after. The class and tests are curved, which really helps.

CHEM105 is a hard class, but you should take it from Dr. Smith if you can. Her lectures teach you everything you need to know. I never read the textbook, just did the HW and lectures and did fine on the tests. Final replaces your lowest midterm! and about .5% extra credit. She also lowered the A to 92%, A- to 89%, etc... I learned so much from her!

She's super nice but that doesn't mean she's a good teacher. She cares more about the quantity of material covered rather than the quality of it. The majority of assignments were pointless busywork. If you want to do well in the class it would honestly be better to just read the textbook and not go to lecture, but she grades attendance so it sucks

CHEM105 is hard but Smith is amazing. She's very passionate about chemistry, which comes across in the lectures. She's also fun; Fridays are explosion days, and she did a handstand for us before finals. She cares about the students; often she has a "mom" vibe. She takes lots of questions during lecture and usually runs out of time. Great professor!

Dr. Smith was definitely one of my favorite professors! Her attitude is contagious and her lectures were fun. The course was very difficult though and you definitely earn your grade. There is a lot of homework which isn't worth much of your final grade. But if you stay on top of the work, go into her and your TA, you should be fine.

I've rarely taken such a well structured class. Plentiful study guides, practice problems, practice tests, and TA reviews. Has an answer to every question. Makes difficult concepts easy to understand. Tests are straightforward and easily passable if one studies. Significant homework load, but worth it. Would recommend to anyone.

Dr. Smith is an incredible professor! Chem 105 will always be a hard class but Dr. Smith provides the best possible course to help her students learn. If you want a good grade in the class then do all of the homework and study the slides really well. It's hard but there are as many resources as you need to learn everything!

Dr. Smith is really caring and great at explaining concepts to her students. Great TA's will really help your grade. There's up to 0.45% extra credit for a lot of work, but she has very generous drop policies, including that the final can replace the lowest midterm. Would take again. I stopped reading the book and did fine.

CHEM 105 is what it is but the best bet is to take it with Smith. Good teacher, nice, blows up lots of stuff in class. She might be one of the only to give extra credit, though it amounts to only like 0.5%. The drop policy is generous. Iclicker quizzes, listen in class & do the homework. Get old edition of the book, I didn't even use it however.

Brilliant for those who are naturally gifted at math and chem but not so much for those who aren't. Her lectures move quickly and she often prioritizes getting through slides rather than explaining it thoroughly. If you don't have good self-discipline and are not willing to teach yourself a lot then maybe wait a bit. Exams are quite ridiculous also

Dr. Smith is an awesome professor. CHEM 105 is a hard class, but she organized it very well for you to study. as long as you keep up with the homework, work hard, very hard, you will be fine and get what you deserved. btw, she have some really cool demos. choose her and you won't regret!

I took Chem105 as a Freshman, and though I had heard it was a difficult class, was not impossible. Dr. Smith did a very good job at making and posting slides, and gave great suggestions on how to keep up with the coursework which I appreciated. She often gave demos which were entertaining. It is doable if you keep up on hw, class, and use the TA.
Chem is tough no matter who you take it with but Dr. Smith did a good job explaining concepts in class

Dr. Smith is amazing. Chem 105 is a hard class and be prepared for a lot of work, but Dr. Smith is very clear and organized about what is required for the class and is willing to help. Go to the TA reviews for the tests and just study, study, and study. Dr. Smith gives you all the tools you need to succeed. Take smith!

TAKE SMITH. Chem is hard but she is GREAT. She prepares you very well for exams, & all the homework & quizzes are SO helpful in reinforcing concepts. Talk to the TAs, visit Smith in her office hours, go to the chem tutorial lab, & don't forget to do the homework daily. This class takes tons of time, but Smith is the best professor to take it from.

Chem 105 is HARD, but Smith makes it clear & manageable! Tons of homework, but once you're past the first week or so you get into the swing of things. Stay on top of the hw or you'll fall behind. Do hw in the chem tutorial lab & go to ALL TA reviews. DEFINITELY take this class from Smith, & visit her office hrs whenever you can. She'll always help!

This class has a lot of homework and reading. The reading is beneficial to the lectures and the homework is beneficial to the tests. While she does talk kind of fast during lectures, all chem105 teachers talk fast so you cant fault her. This class is extremely hard but not impossible if you put in the time and effort.

Worst professor I've ever had. Knows material really well, but rarely takes the time to actually explain anything. Homework is either very difficult or busy work, and the exams are nothing like her practice exams. Never finishes covering lecture material but still expects students to complete homework on things she didn't have time to teach.

Shes not good at teaching the material. Just goes through it quickly rather than focusing on trying to teach us the material. I really feel like Im teaching myself a class that Im paying for. Shes not the best to reach out to and her tests are ridiculous.

Definitely the hardest class I have ever taken. Smith was good but her tests are ridiculous. She moves super fast and sometimes cares too much about how much material she covers instead of the quality.

Dr. Smith moves through her lectures really fast. There's a lot of homework (assignments due every day) that's mostly time-consuming rather than difficult. There's some busy work which is annoying. Overall though, she is a good professor. Your TA will also have a huge impact on your grade in this class. Pray you get a chill one.

Student started seizing up in class and the teacher wouldnt care and continued on with her lesson. Cares more about going through the slides QUICKLY rather than teaching the concept. Take any other chem teacher than her.

Absolutely fantastic professor, truly understands the material and brilliantly reduces it and simplifies it for you to understand. Genuinely cares about the students and somehow keeps lectures decently interesting and easy to follow. Class itself and material still takes a lot of work, but if you want to survive, take it from her
Dr. Smith is the best professor I've had at BYU. She is passionate and engaging in her lectures. She moves fast but is easy to understand. Do the homework and you will be well prepared for the tests.

I don't understand why students complain about this class. It was by far the easiest science class of my curriculum, much easier than physics, calculus, or computer science. She does a great job preparing students for exams. If you know how to study and don't have a problem with middle school math you'll do fine. I didn't open the book once.

Dr. Smith is a great professor. Class is very interesting and engaging. She prepares the students for the tests really well. The Chem 105 course has so much material to go over. There was so much material that she had a hard time giving enough time to a couple units. But, she is very organized in her teaching methods which helps in comprehension.

She keeps lectures interesting, but this course is just designed to be really hard so she has lots of info to cover and doesn't always keep a good pacing. She does lots of in-class demos and likes blowing things up. I-clicker quizzes in class everyday (kind of how she takes attendance) and there's homework due every weekday.

Chem 105 is a tough course, regardless of your prof. Prof Smith is great, explains the material really well, gives you lots of resources to be successful. I did most of my learning in class and by completing homework assignments. She does get sidetracked at times and doesn't always cover all the lecture material.

Chem 105 is very HARD! The class is a TON of work and you have chemistry every day. The tests are some of the hardest tests I have taken. Keep up on the homework and make sure you are doing all the homework and practice tests. Smith was a pretty good teacher she just moves very fast! Chem 105 is just one of those classes you have to push through.

Loved her class! I love chemistry, but I had to work hard for a good grade. Luckily her lectures are great and if you do the homework you'll be prepared for the tests even though they are hard. Just hope for a good TA! Also, she blows something up/ sets something on fire like every week during class, so get your Instagram ready for a good time!

Get ready for a ton of work. Chem 105 is basically designed to weed out those not committed enough to get into some tough programs. She is very clear what she expects from us, just do all the work, participate in labs and you'll be good. Lectures can be repetitive of the textbook. Exams are v tough. Good luck

Great professor, tough class. Do the extra credit that is offered. MUST attend class. Try not to skip more than a few problem sets and Smartwork quizzes- missing a lot damaged the grades of students who received great scores on the exams. I mostly referenced the textbook for explanations of difficult concepts. Allowed to bring notecard into exams.

Yeah Chem 105 is a hard class. She is a good teacher though. Her powerpoints were very helpful. My advice is to not fall behind, and honestly truly work all of the smartwork and problem sets and you will be prepared for the test. She would give us 3x5 notecard for each midterm and final, which was cool. The class average for the final was a 65 haha

Awesome professor. The course itself is rigorous, but she has everything organized to a T. She is very organized and very clear in teaching. You are exposed to the material multiple times. If you don't invest yourself in the course you probably won't get much out of it, but I have never felt like I have known chemistry like I do now.

Dr. Smith's lectures are amazing! Chem 105 us a hard class, but she explains the concepts clearly and recitation helps you solidify your knowledge. She planned the course in a way that really helps you learn the concepts. Her tests are hard, but if you do the assignments, study, and work hard, the class is definitely passable!

Dr. Smith makes herself really available. She understands that the material she teaches is hard for a lot of students so she is very wiling to help. This class is not impossibly hard, but it does take 1-2 hours a day of study and preparation. Dr. Smith uses her own tests, that can be tricky but overall if you know the material you will be fine.

LOVED HER! My favorite Professor at BYU thus far. She's very good at teaching, made chemistry interesting, and made a lot of real life connections. If you put in the work this class is totally doable (if you took AP, it's a breeze). Grading is very fair. The only way you won't do well in this class is if you don't try.
Professor Smith is an excellent teacher. She communicates very well. The class material itself is just very challenging. Form a study group and attend tutorial labs!

Dr. Smith is an incredible professor. Her curriculum is the most organized of any teacher I've known. She gives tons and tons of opportunities to learn and relearn the material so that you get really good at it. If you stick with her schedule and put in the work, you will pass and you will feel great about yourself. It's hard work, but worth it!

Dr. Smith is hands down the best chemistry professor at BYU. She is very helpful and very good at explaining things. Chem 105 is notorious for being one of the hardest classes at BYU, so be prepared to work. Her tests are not easy, but she prepares you well. I strongly recommend her to anyone planning on taking this class.

Professor Smith is amazing! Her lectures were very helpful, and she was always willing to re-explain difficult topics. The practice sheets are beneficial, however the tests are still pretty tough.  She is very generous though and allows students a 5x8 note card (front and back) on every test.

Chem 105 is the hardest class at BYU. No curve and a 94% A, but if you have to take it, take it from Smith! She is the most organized of the Chem teachers. She has organized power points that I would go over after each lecture, rather than reading the book. KNOW the practice sheets like the back of your hand! Tests are hard, but you can do it!!

Doctor Smith is an incredible teacher. If you're taking Chem 105, take from her.  Yes, she assigns tons of work (the same as other teachers, but her material is probably more intensive) and her tests are hard, but she teaches very clearly and provides you with everything you need to get a good grade.  If you took AP Chem, don't expect an easy A.

Dr. Smith is an amazing teacher! This is my second time taking Chem 105 (the first time I got a B-) and Dr. Smith is infinitely better than other professors. She gives you every possible chance to succeed. Extra credit from doing labs, replaces one of your midterms with your final grade if you score higher than one of your midterms.

Stacy is a great lecturer however expects you to spend 21 hr/week on ch105 alone. She told whole class a curve would show at the end but on last day, after reviews were due, she informed us there would be no curve and the final would have  10% lower average than midterm.  If married, 12 cr+, church calling, or have a job, don't expect A.

This class has some really difficult tests and a lot of homework that comes with it. The nice thing is the homework balances out the tests so even if you bomb the tests you can still make out with a decent grade. Prof. Smith is really good in lecture, but the material is still really difficult.

This class is really hard, but Dr. Smith makes it enjoyable. The tests are like death, but she gives you lots of tools to use. Also, uses a lot of demos. Seems to like blowing things up as much as I do. We also had homework every day, but it was all doable. The book was terrible.

Dr. Smith is the best chemistry teacher I've ever had. She explains so clearly, is so willing to help, and helped make chemistry my favorite class. Dont  take CHEM105 from anyone else!! Do each of the practice sheets on time and rework them in preparation for the exams. This is a very difficult class, but with Dr. Smith, it is very possible.

Dr. Smith is a great professor. She is always organized and prepared. There are 3 assignments due online per week and three worksheets turned in online. There are 3 midterms, which are open-answer and pretty hard. Attendance is mandatory in order to receive I-Clicker credit. The class is hard, but I would recommend taking it from her.
Very good teacher.  Lectures are clear, well organized, and very well presented.  Tests are straightforward, but tough.   Do the Practice sheets every day on time and you'll do great.

She is hands down a great teacher. She puts a ton of effort into each of her lecture slides and is always patient and willing to help you understand the concepts. If you have the ability to take her class, do.
She's a great teacher that is very fair and clear and fun.

Professor Smith is an engaging, energetic, passionate teacher (and she blows stuff up all the time). You can usually learn the material from lecture, but you'll want the book on hand while doing homework. There's a lot of homework (online, written, recitation, and i-clicker quizzes for every lecture) but if you do it all you'll be totally fine.

Dr. Smith is AMAZING. The best chemistry teacher on campus by far. There is a lot of work to her class, but if you do it you wont be left behind. In class she does a better job of explaining the reading from the text and also gives real-life examples for clarity. The set up of her class is to help students learn and apply. Favorite professor by far

Dr. Smith is excellent. Her teaching is very clear, and she's easy to approach. There's a lot of homework, but little of it was busy work. Everything we did in the class was designed to enhance our learning, and Dr. Smith made a variety of useful resources available to the class and easy to access. Overall, it was awesome!

CHEM 105 was a super hard class, but if I had to take it again I'd probably take it from Dr. Smith. She really cares about her students. Despite the class size (100+), she knew many of us by name. And she does a great job at giving prompt feedback.  Tons of homework, spent some time in the lab each week, but all in all the class was a good one.

Chem 105 is a hard class regardless--it's a four credit class. But Dr. Smith was just this super cute 30-year-old professor who's interesting and entertaining. Plus she  learned our names. Smith was easy to follow and her lecture slides guided the content. Asplund (our sub) was also good, but he's more famous for humor than his clarity in teaching.
Dr. Smith is a great professor who speaks very rapidly but teaches very clearly.  There is a lot of work, but the schedule is very clear and if you follow it there is no way you wont do well.

Dr. Smith is fun professor but overall she does not really teach what is on the tests. Yes it is understood that CHEM 105 is hard no matter what, but she barely focused on what the test problems were on. Really know the online quiz questions, that will help you the most.

Dr. Smith is awesome. No matter what Chem 105 is going to take a lot of work. It's a 4 credit class. But she creates incredible powerpoints and resources to help your study. This was her first semester teaching, and I was amazed at her performance. I HIGHLY recommend her.
The class is just hard no matter who you take it from. Dr. Smith is very nice and very helpful. Take it from her or from Asplund. They are both GREAT!!!

She's really nice and she will remember your name. If you go ask her for help she's very understanding but this is not an easy class. Although many resources are provided for you. All the chem105 classes have the same tests and they are all multiple choice. No assignments are given out of the book other than reading.
Dr. Smith is very enthusiastic about chemistry. She is helpful and fair, just do the practice problems and you will do fine. Tests are all multiple choice, no free response.
Stacie is the most incredible person in the world. She is so cute and fun and I just wish she was my mom. She made learning so fun. Not to mention she has the best style! Love you Stacie!

Stacie is a wonderful instructor. She is one of the best nurses I have ever met, and I look up to her tremendously. She was always helpful and patient, but at the same time helped us do all that we could to learn. Especially being in a clinical setting, I was grateful to have her. She's brilliant and kind. Such a fun clinical with her.
Sadly, this was the worst classroom experience I've had at BYU. I often felt that students were not treated with much respect. The class material is interesting, but I'd take it with anyone else.

Professor Pratt is very intelligent and has a very clear class structure. He is very fair and thoughtful about the assignments he gives you. Exams are all on Excel which I liked. You do have to do a lot of studying in 410 to get the material down but it is still a great class, I really enjoyed learning the material.

He can be intimidating, but he really cares about students, always open to give advice on how to improve in the class. This class requires a lot of time to work but is very interesting material, and Pratt does a good job a teaching hard concepts

Professor Pratt can be a little dry, it's true, but if you actually engage and participate in class you will really enjoy his lectures. The HW assignments are easy, so people walk in over confident for the tests. If you want to get good scores, pay Close Attention in Class, then go home and Review all your notes 1-2x and you'll do well.

Least favorite professor I have ever had. Makes you feel dumb when you ask questions even though he doesn't explain things clearly. Super full of himself and the tests are super hard. Be ready to spend lots of time on cases. And don't ask pratt for help on anything because he doesn't care.  Do yourself a favor and take it from Iverson.

Honestly, thought this class was pretty good. HW has answers in the back so youdon't have to worry about your grade - however I noticed most kids wouldn't even do the hw because they just wanted to finish ASAP. I took the tests pretty prepared and others thought it was tough but IMO, they had been cutting corners the whole semester... overall 9/10

Professor Pratt is unwilling or unable to help you if you're falling behind in class and don't understand the material immediately. Textbook and slides aren't much help either. Exams are worth 75% of your grade.

Makes you feel like an dumb if you ask a question in class. He is trying to rush through so much material that he won't slow down or go back when you don't understand something. Textbook is not much help, his powerpoints only make sense if you understood the lecture, so basically all you have is your notes to help with assignments and cases.

Imagine a parent explains to a 6 year old how to ride a bike. The child has never seen a bike before in person, not even a picture. The parent draws a stick-figure-like picture of a bike and explains in words how to ride the bike. Then the parent gives the child the bike, without training wheels, and expects the child to be able to ride.

Great guy that teaches a dry, tough class. Tests are harder than you think. Group case study projects take a lot of time/work, start early. He's not afraid to tell you that you're wrong but he does it in a totally respectful way. I have no complaints about him, he is just strict. Hard grading and zero late work policy. Don't take 401/410 together

Professor Pratt is an amazing FIN 401 teacher. He is honestly my favorite teacher I have had at BYU. The workload for this class is very big, but manageable as long as you don't get behind or procrastinate. Professor Pratt is an excellent teacher and offers lots of help with office and TA hours. I would definitely recommend taking from him!!

I enjoyed all my finance professors, but I think Prof Pratt refined the way I approached finance the most. His class had 3 test, 5 cases, and problem sets. There was no great way to prepare for the tests or cases or to control your grade. I loved him as a professor and enjoyed going to his class and hearing his lectures.

Dr. Pratt is one of the smartest and best professors in the Marriott School. If you like professors who always tell you good job, and don't correct you when you're wrong then you probably won't like Dr. Pratt. He doesn't hesitate to tell you if you are wrong about something, which for me was nice, since I like to know when I'm doing something wrong

Professor Pratt is a solid professor. The class material wasn't particularly fascinating to me, but he did a good job explaining it and keeping my attention. Our tests got progressively a lot harder, which was frustrating because you never knew what difficulty level to expect. His homework is reasonable and prepares you pretty well for the tests.

Professor Pratt is a great teacher, probably my favorite last semester. He teaches in a way that is easy to understand and doesn't use monotonous power points slides.  He is very careful when answering students questions, and doesnt hesitate to tell you when you are wrong. ( He isn't mean about it, and it is hilarious at times).

It's up to you to keep up & write notes; no slides. The tests are 70% of the grade w/ virtually no study guide & little guidance as to what to study. He basically says, "Just know it all" which is crazy, since you had to take your own notes & it's impossible to listen & take notes on every single thing. He's not too helpful if you don't understand.

I LOVE Dr. Ashby. Amazing teacher. Very engaging, open, and efficient when covering topics. Slides are sometimes word-heavy but she provides great examples. For a large portion of grade we made a study plan (how we can more efficiently study) but it felt a lot like busy work. If I could take another class with her I 100% would.
She was so kind, and really cares about her students' thoughts and opinions on discussions. She tries to explain everything she teaches to the best of her abilities and wants her students to succeed.

Literally one of the sweetest professors. Isn't afraid to admit when she doesn't know an answer--in fact she'll often research the answer and bring it up next class. Very knowledgeable and understanding.

Dr. Ashby is one of those professors who deeply cares about her students and does everything she can to help them succeed. The class content wasn't too bad, you have a literature review paper due at the end of the semester which is most of your grade along with presenting your findings.

Dr. Ashby is who to take your Neuro writing class from!  Every assignment helps you to prepare for your final lit review paper.  She is very clear on how she grades (and how you can do well in the class). The lectures are valuable and you learn a lot if you participate.  I've had few other classes where I learned so many directly applicable skills.

I actually took PSYCH 375 Cognition from her, and loved it! I was scared to take this class, I thought it would be super hard, but I actually enjoyed it so much. Her lectures are very engaging and entertaining, and if you go to the review sessions the exams aren't bad. I would highly recommend taking Cognition from Dr. Ashby!!

I absolutely love Dr Ashby. Her lectures were engaging and fun. Her tests are challenging but definitely doable; all the material is covered in class. She clearly loves teaching and cares a lot about the students. If you have the opportunity, take a class from her.

I've never been a fan of writing, but Dr. Ashby made this class doable. She cares a lot about her students and is very willing to go over your writing and give you feedback before you turn it in. Most of the class is writing a 10 page literature review and then presenting on it at the end of the semester.

Dr. Ashby is a multi-published neuroscience writer who freely shares her experience with students. I've learned a lot from her this semester, both about writing a literature review and about preparing for grad school and conferences. She was accessible outside class and reasonable/flexible with assignments/schedule.

I have never written a review, but I had to take the time to do it for Brother Taeger. I 100% recommend his class. I have taken Brad Wilcox class (which I loved as well) but for me, this class was more engaging, and I took more out of it. He genuinely gets you laughing and you will know more about the gospel by the time you leave his class.
as a not religious person, I LOVED this class and am actively trying to take him again. There is no way wilcox is better
Incredible insights about the gospel of Jesus Christ and an extraordinary ability to convey the material.

Literally the easiest religion class I've ever taken! Bro.Taeger is pretty funny and his lectures help me relate the gospel in ways I hadn't thought about. There's only one project and if you go to class to get the study guide answers, the exams are super easy.

I did learn some things from him in class. He can be funny at times, and while the workload isn't overwhelming, it feels a bit heavier compared to other religion classes I've taken. The class is mostly lecture-based with very little discussion, but one upside is that it's easy to work on homework for other classes while he's talking.

I LOVE BROTHER TAEGER SO MUCH! If you get the chance to take any classes (especially BOM) from him take it in a heartbeat! Not a difficult class at all, just a little bit of study, but I took so many great lessons and teachings from his class. Talks about difficult topics in an open-minded way, and leaves lots of room for discussion.

I want to take every class Brother Taeger offers! He has a very unique and engaging teaching style. He focuses less on bullet point doctrine and more on how we can apply it in our lives. He made the scriptures relatable and come to life. I never stressed about his class and genuinely enjoyed going! He is hilarious and I highly recommend.

Amazing teacher, engaging and funny. About 30-45 minutes of homework per week. There were a few midterms and a final but if you go to class you'll have the exact study guide you'll need. There are also quizlets with the answers if you miss a class. Takes a few hours to study for the midterms and final and you can get a 90-100% easily.
Amazing lecturer. You will learn a lot in this class and be spiritually uplifted. If you study the study guide for the exams you'll be fine. Take a class from Brother Taeger if you can!

Dr. Taeger is really good at what he does. He is entertaining, funny, and connects everything to the source material well. 2 midterms, one final, one essay on a chapter, and a reading/writing assignment before class, and a writing assignment after. Homework took me about 20-40 minutes after every class.

One of the best, if not the best, religion professor i have had. His lectures are super engaging and he is always trying to make things connect back to the students. Tests are also really easy if you just do the notes he provides, which are the test questions.
BEST RELIGION PROFESSOR EVER LECTURES ARE GREAT AND THE COURSE ISNT TOO HARD TAKE ANY CLASS HE TEACHES HES SO AWESOME

Incredibly approachable, funny, and humble. Deeply cares for students and encourages questions. His thematic teaching is life-changing; he makes you want to be a better person. 
Only con: The homework. Writing 200-word essays on narrow end-of-class comments felt forced and tedious, like "connecting random dots."
In spite of this, 110% recommend.

Definitely one of the best professors I've had so far in my 3 years at BYU! Spiritual high at the end of every class. Workload is about what it should be, probably even a little lighter which is nice. The tests are some of the most low stress I've ever taken. I didn't ever want to miss class because it was so uplifting and applicable to my life.

This is the guy to take NT from. Very funny and really open-minded as far as religion teachers go. The study guide for the tests is a list of questions that he answers explicitly in lecture. If you come to class and pay minimal attention, you will get an A. 20 min of hw daily. Honestly best prof at BYU, take his class.

His lectures were absolutely amazing. Pulling principles from the scriptures and applying them to our lives in exciting new ways. A good amount of pre-lecture work to do, but set your schedule and keep with it and you'll be fine. Only those little things before each class, then a bigger project and the tests

Brother Taeger was AMAZING. His lectures are so engaging and deepened my understanding of the scriptures. His readings and assignments are repetitive, but simple and easy to do if you stay on top of them. Paying attention in class is so important because he gives you all the test answers in a study guide to write down. You get out what you put in!

Literally gives you all the answers to his tests, and the lectures are super funny/spiritually enlightening. He's not just a robot to regurgitates all the same stuff you've heard in other classes. Highly recommend, will detinitely take another religion class from him.

Brother Taeger is so funny and great to learn from! The workload was pretty light in my opinion even for a spring term class, but if doing a good amount of reading is challenging for you, you do have to read all four gospels in this class. He gives you the questions on the tests ahead of time too so you can fill the study guide out during lectures.
I have taken better classes in the religion department. It's not horrible but
Such a fun professor, I loved going to his class. Workload is super light and tests are extremely straightforward. One of the best classes I've taken at BYU for sure.

Prof Taeger is the best religion professor I've had at BYU, and its not even close. His lectures are hilarious but also so spiritual and enlightening. He doesn't just monotonously read the same stuff you hear in every class, his perspective and teaching style is super fresh. The workload is incredibly light, and exams are incredibly easy.

Amazing lectures, one of my favorite religion professors I've had. I learned so much about the New Testament. He's super strict on not allowing late assignments, but nothing is hard in his class, just a quick write-up after each lecture. Use Quizlet to study for the exams.

Loved Bro Taeger, want to take another class from him! Has testing center exams, but gives you the answers to the study guide in class. Super chill, did a fun march madness tournament. Great lectures, super fun stories and made it interesting. Studied for every test for like an hour and always did really well. Def recommend!
Great workload for a religion class! As long as you go to class and study for the midterm and final, you'll do great!

Bro. Taeger is what a religion teacher should be! His lectures are very well thought out, and made me think super hard about my discipleship. It was also the easiest religion class I've taken to this point. There's journals and readings every class, but they're super short. Only one writing assignment, and midterms are based on a study guide.
Amazing lecturer. Incredible analogies. Not hard. Meant to be spiritually strengthening and intellectually enlarging.
One of the best professors at BYU. Tries really hard to get to know his students. Has a super funny sense of humor. Is sincere and real and brings the spirit to class

Taeger has a preaching/lecturing style that resonates on new levels. He says things like they are, he preaches from faith, and he is deliberate about connecting with students. A little inconvenient with some of the assignments, and the tests take maybe like 30 mins of studying + coming to class. 
But he is the most authentic best lecturer I've had.

I loved how much his lectures focused on Jesus Christ. I could tell the reverence that Brother Taeger had for the New Testament, and appreciated that he focused on the inspiration of the gospel without turning the scriptures into a textbook. Very light homework and easy tests.

One of the better lecturers I've taken a religion class from. Nice guy who cares about the material. There is an assignment due before every class, and another one due after every class. They're very easy and mostly graded on completion, but pretty annoying. You're bound to forget one. Besides that there are a couple tests and a paper or two.
He is one of the best religion professors on campus. His lectures inspire me to become a better teacher and better person generally.
BEST PROFESSOR EVER! Truly feel the spirit in his class. Left some class periods with tears in my eyes (and I'm not normally a crier). Looking to take every class I can from him.

I loved Dr. Taeger! His lectures are really great! I always felt enriched after his class, and his tests are very easy. They are literally just the study guides. He is just such a nice, funny, and lovable guy too!

He is one of the best professors I've ever had, especially for religion. He makes the lectures interactive. The homework is always consistent and you know what to expect with his grading. He's super chill, but you can still learn a lot from the homework. You really take away what you put into this class. Also he is so funny. Very funny.
Great Professor. If you come to class, he gives you all the study guide answers

He is the kindest teacher ever, and he cares about the students and will help the best he can. He truly understands the doctrine, and he does all the homework online, so it's super easy, and because class is mandatory, you can do it in less than 30 minutes. The tests are fine if you take notes in class, and homework is even easier with those notes.

Brother Taeger is the best professor I've had at BYU. You will feel the spirit in his class. His teaching style makes it really easy to follow the lectures and he's super friendly and easy going. If you keep up with the assignments, attend lectures, and use the study guide as a base for your notes, the exams won't be difficult. Highly recommend.

BEST CLASS EVER!! I love Brother Taeger. He is the first professor I've had that I feel genuinely cares about our learning and is funny!! He is passionate about what he does, and he doesn't make anything difficult at all. Attendance is mandatory, but for how easy the assignments are, I felt it was reasonable. His tests are easy too.

Brother Taeger is one of the best professors I've had. He is a spiritual giant. I will say, attendance is necessary to get a good grade in this course. There are two assignments due before each class and two after. Each takes 20 ish minutes. Simple, but the assignments arre based off the lectures.

Loved Taeger's lectures & learned a lot from the class, however this class is way too difficult. His tests were ridiculously hard & the questions felt more like trivia for the Book of Mormon. Tests were 45% of grade.  
Tests were ~40 questions, but each worth 5 points. I would study for a week, and still did poorly.  Assignments for every class day

Brother Taeger is an amazing professor. His assignments are simple and easy, one before and after every class. His lectures are incredible. I always felt the spirit so strongly, and I learned so much from him. Highly recommend!

Very kind, knowledgeable, and funny. His class was very easy as long as you read the assigned reading, and he loved to hear what you had to say. He really helped make the content understandable and gave us insights that were really spiritual and self-applicable. Tests were very easy as long as you study. 10/10 would absolutely take him again

Not one religion professor at BYU that is easier than Taeger. He gives you all the answers during class from the study guide. One short paper and 3 exams including the final and midterm. Each of these tests took me  max 20 minutes in the testing center. That's how easy this class is. One of the funniest yet spiritual professors teachers I know

I love the way he teaches his lectures; it's inspirational and definitely the highlight of my day. He is hilarious, spiritual, and knowledgable in gospel doctrine. You do have to show up to class, and show up on time. He starts quickly, and test questions are based off lecture presentations. He is also willing to answer questions outside of class.

Dr. T is quite literally one of the best religion professors at this university. He teaches the doctrine in a way that is profound but easy to understand. He knows his students and it's easy to see how much he cares. He teaches with a broad understanding of other faiths and how they tie in. I would take every religion class from him if I could.

Bro. Taeger is hands down the best religion professor I've had at BYU thus far, and I don't expect that any other will top him. It's not what he thinks, but how he thinks. I always leave the class feeling uplifted to the max and realizing I've got a long way to go as a human being and as a spiritual being. He wants you to learn, not do busy work.

Brother Taeger was an amazing religion professor.  This class taught me so much about the Book of Mormon and I was able to regularly feel the spirit in class.  If you have the chance to take a class from him I would definitely suggest you do.

He strikes a great balance between inspirational and humorous. There was a time when I missed a midterm and he let me take it in his office. Go to his office hours when you have questions. He is very willing to answer them and will talk with you until he feels like you are satisfied.

Professor Taeger is a really nice guy who knows his stuff. His classes were interesting and the workload was pretty light. He literally gives you the answers to the tests during lectures, so as long as you show up to class you should be good. You can really see his love for teaching and the New Testament in his lectures. Awesome class!

Brother Taeger is super nice and makes it easy to succeed in his class. Every week, we had 4 assignments, but they're all short and based on the readings and lectures. Tests are straight from the study guide, which is straight from the lecture, so you'll want to go to class. I never spend more than 20 minutes in the testing center for his class

Idk what to say about this man except for that he is the GOAT. Literally such a spiritual giant with so much knowledge that he is able to boil down in a way that is easily understandable. Workload was very manageable and easy while still maintaining a level of difficulty that stretched you to learn in a good way. Definitely recommend taking him!
Literally my favorite professor I've had at BYU!!! Super easy but I've never learned more in a class- especially religion. Will take all classes I can from him.

Brother Taeger is the best religion professor I've found at BYU. I've taken all my religion hours (and more), and he's the only professor I've taken multiple times because he teaches so well. His lecture style really makes you think harder about the gospel. His class is not complicated nor very difficult. Take his class!!!

Would 100% recommend Professor Taeger! Classes and tests are very straightforward, just attend classes because he literally says the study guide answers during class. Even though it's based on LDS teachings, I learned a lot about the BOM and applied values and morals in everyday life so very food for thought and philosophical but super fun.

Best religion professor there is! I wish I could take all my religion classes from him! Class is very straightforward, very few assignments. Tests are easy to prepare for. His lectures are amazing and he teaches the New Testament in a powerful but not overbearing way. Definitely take your classes from Brother Taeger!
Professor Taeger was very kind and his lectures were different from any religion class I've had before. They are kind of like inspirational sermons. The tests are easy if you go to class and study.

This is an awesome class! The tests are very straight-forward and he gives you all the answers. He digs into the philosophy behind religion during class and I have learned a lot about the New Testament!

One of the best professors by far. He is so funny and spiritual at the same time, and studying Matthew-John was so amazing. Definitely take a class from him. Easy workload and still very spiritually enlarging class.

Amazing class!! It isn't the easiest Religion class, but it's not super hard or lot's of work either. Brother Taeger finds the perfect balance of offering a course that is spiritually enlightening and uplifting and a course that is challenging without feeling like busy work or over the top. The tests are word for word from the study guide, so study

He is an excellent professor, willing to work with students. His lectures are actually applicable, and it's clear he wants you to learn in ways that actually matter and not just fill you with random facts. His course is super easy, and had a genuine impact on me.

Brother Taeger is the best. His lectures are amazing and spiritual. He walks the spiritual and intellectual line very well. I learned a lot about the New Testament and was spiritually strengthened daily. Focus all of your studying on the daily study guides. If you are at all interested in religious philosophy, take this!! Easy A and interesting!

Professor Taeger is awesome! His class is structured so you don't have to worry about tests and assignments and can instead really get into the New Testament. He designs his class so you can think about and apply everything to your own life. I really enjoyed this class and highly recommend taking it from him!

I loved Brother Taegar he is very caring! His lectures were always very interesting. He gives a study guide before each class with the exact questions that will be on the exam. As long as you go to class it is very easy to get an A!
absolutely amazing professor if given the chance take his class!

Couldn't recommend this Professor enough. He had very clear expectations with assignments and tests. They were all easy and his lectures were amazing. First professor that actively talked about wanting our well-being as people and offered his office hours for that. He knows his stuff and wanted us to be spiritually uplifted by his class.

Bro Taeger is awesome, his lectures were fun to go to (even at 8am) and he made class interesting. Only hw is a small 250 word journal write after each lecture. Tests were super easy because he gives a study guide and all the answers. Same test questions as the study guide. Loved this class!

TAKE THIS CLASS. Brother Taeger is amazing and changed the way I viewed the gospel. He is the best professor I have had. He is caring and knows what he is talking about. I got so much out of this class. Can't say enough about Brother Taeger!

I absolutely LOVED this class I can't speak highly enough. Brother Taeger teaches in such a relatable way, bringing the spirit to every lesson but also adding humor and lots of student comments. After each class, you write an essay on what you learned. Exams are based on questions answered in class, so if you show up and take notes you'll be fine.

This was probably the best religion class I have taken at BYU. Brother Taeger is so knowledgeable and a great lecturer. He is everything BYU religion professors should be!! His homework is clear and helps his students succeed. I would absolutely take this class again.

Professor Taeger is the best religion professor I have ever had! I love his style of teaching, we truly learn the stories and he makes it applicable to our lives. Every class, I feel uplifted and the spirit is so strong. The tests aren't difficult, multiple choice, and I actually really enjoyed doing the assignments after class! Take his class!

Amazing teacher. It is your standard Ancient Scripture intellectual-focused lecture, but then he ends every lesson with an inspiring section focused on us and the Savior. The tests are simply multiple choice questions that he gives you word-for-word answers for on the study guides
I really liked Brother Taeger! He was super interesting and funny but still spiritual. The class is pretty easy as long as you go to the exam reviews and ask questions.

Bro. Taeger is one of my favorite religion teachers I've ever had. He is such a funny guy, and he makes every lecture both engaging and spiritual. You have to go to class to complete the daily "focus texts," but they are basically journal entries and don't take too long. Don't hesitate to take from him if you get the chance!

Brother Taeger is a solid choice for religion. I really enjoyed his class!! It's super inspirational and I learned so much. Tests aren't hard and you can use scriptures. I didn't love doing the 250 word journal each class, but it was like the only hw so I can't complain really. Focus texts are awesome and I love how he uses stories too. Great prof

I would love to take all the classes he teaches. His class is very insightful, inspirational and funny. It is quite impossible to fall asleep in his class. Everyone is welcome to share whatever in his/her mind. Not much homework. All the homework and exams are super easy.

Brother Taeger is the GOAT. His lectures are absolutely amazing and insightful. He creates an environment where everyone is invited to share and contribute to the conversation and it was fantastic. His assignments aren't very hard as long as you really dive into the scriptures. Can not recommend this course enough. He is the absolute best.
One of my favorite teachers! I struggled for the tests even though they are open Book of Mormon so I got an A- but I still remember what I learned from his class so it was worth it!

I took Dr. Taeger's class 5 years ago and I am writing a review now because I still think about his "focus text" (short thought-provoking sermons that he gave at the end of each class). Very relatable. Best religion professor I had and I think that was his first year; probably even better now. Workload was very manageable.
Brother Taeger is the best! His class went deep into doctrine but also managed to bring the spirit. Loved his class, brother Taeger is really fun and energetic!

I only had one complaint but it was a pretty big deal for me -- his daily journals are based on his "focus texts" -- sermons he gives in the last 5-10 minutes of class. 300 words shouldn't seem like a lot for a journal, but for something so short and vague and potentially unrelated to the reading, I found them actually hard to write that much.
Great professor would take again! Loved his lessons good balance of doctrine and spirit. Tests are easy as long as you go to class and take notes.

I absolutely love Dr. Taeger! I left every single class having learned something new He is super funny and very easy to talk to. He offers such an interesting perspective and insight all while inspiring his students. There are daily journals, attendance is a must but class is worth going to anyway. Highly recommend you take from him.
I loved going to his class. He gives short sermons at the end of every class which always left me pondering after class. I learned a ton from him.

Brother Taeger is AMAZING! No matter what class he's teaching, you must take it from him! He teaches differently than other professors. He's a storyteller. Every class he tells a story related to the scriptures that's both thought-provoking and incredibly spiritual. He not only wants you to succeed, but he genuinely wants you to be a better person.

I LOVE Brother Taeger. I took Religion 121 and 275 from him and I thoroughly enjoyed both. He's funny and makes the scriptures come to life. On top of the scriptures we cover, he usually has a focus text or some sort of mini-lesson that he weaves into the lecture. The bi-weekly journals can be annoying sometimes, but his class is so worth it!

Brother Taeger was one of the best professors I had. His lectures were so interesting and there wasn't a lot of work involved. I loved going to his class twice a week, but you do need to show up, you only get a few excused absences in his class. You write a journal entry on the lecture and do some quick homework on a few chapters assigned.

Brother Taeger is probably the best religion professor around. His lectures are hilarious and he genuinely cares about his students. He allows the BOM in tests and as long as you take notes during lectures, you'll do just fine. Just know where to find people and events! Super awesome class, I highly recommend taking him, especially for a 100 level.

I loved this class. Taeger's lectures are incredible. They encourage you to take personal meaning and added so many new perspectives to my view of the gospel and the Book of Mormon. The homework isn't bad and tests are easy if you go to lectures. I would absolutely recommend this professor and I will be taking any other class that he offers.

Brother Taeger is an amazing professor, and I was so glad that I took his class. His lectures are enjoyable and spiritual. I looked forward to the class, and I felt like I gained a better understanding of the Book of Mormon. He is very passionate about what he teaches which enhances the lectures.

Brother Taeger is an amazing professor. The majority of your grade is based on self-graded journals after each lecture. Tests only make up a small part of your grade, and they are all open book, so I would recommend writing your class notes directly into your Book of Mormon because he tells you in class which verses you may be tested on.

Brother Taeger is amazing! I would 100% recommend taking BoM from him. His lectures are always very interesting and you learn a lot. Homework is pretty standard. If you pay attention in class and take notes in your BoM you'll be fine on the tests.

My favorite religion professor by far! His class is simple, yet you learn so much! If you are lucky enough to make it into his classes, then you are truly blessed. There are biweekly assignments that take 20 minutes and are easy to get 100 on. One paper, two midterms and a final, but you can bring in scriptures to all tests.

Probably one of my favorite teachers I've ever had! His teaching style is unique where he focuses on reading from the texts. He uses a good mix of what Bible scholars & LDS leaders have said about the scriptures which really enriches the learning experience. I left class every day feeling inspired! Take good notes & you should do well on his tests.

Brother Taeger was the single best Religion teacher I ever had at BYU. His style of teaching is different, but very effective in teaching you gospel truths. He focuses on the text itself more than the principles, so you really get a good grip on what's actually in the scriptures vs speculation on what they mean.

I loved taking the second half of Book of Mormon from Brother Taeger! I failed miserably with the first half, but with his class I was amazed at how much I learned! We were allowed to bring our scriptures into the tests and you were encouraged to take notes in them. I can't wait to take Christ and the Everlasting Gospel from him!

Brother Taeger was a great professor, easily one of my favorite at BYU. You have to take notes to do well, but it is very doable. His lectures are insightful and inspiring; I felt the Spirit every class. If you get the opportunity, I highly recommend taking a class from him.

Taegar's focus texts literally changed my life. Also, he tells you test are completely on lecture, and whenever he repeats himself, pauses, or writes something on the board, you write it down and know it for the test and you are set. This man is phenominal, but oh, I don't think he is teaching at BYU after this, so sorry kids. Easy A if you keep up

I struggled with this class.  Brother Taegar gives great lectures, but is not at all helpful.  His tests are obscure and totally based on your ability to take notes based on what he says in class.  He is not helpful and refers all questions outside of doctrinal debates to someone else.  I would look for another Book of Mormon class.

Brother Taeger is a super great professor! He gives wonderful insights during lecture. Lectures are crucial because you take specific notes in your scriptures that you use on the test. Yes, the tests are hard, but they're open scripture and all multiple choice. Brother Taeger teaches in a unique and inspiring way! I always left class in awe :)

Taeger's class seems easy when you are just looking at the syllabus, and it is, except for the tests. The tests are open book, but some of the questions seem impossible. I did well on everything, always did my reading, went to class, went to reviews, and still could not seem to get an A. The tests are just too ridiculous to do well in the class.

Brother Taeger is the man, one of the best preachers I've heard. I really appreciated how invested he was in the students. My understanding is that this is his last semester on assignment to BYU, but I sure hope he comes back. He made religion classes good!

TAKE THIS CLASS. Brother Taeger is hilarious and I actually enjoyed 9 AM class.  I learned so much about the Book of Mormon and just about general life from him. It was amazing each and every day and he had incredible class discussions. Bottom line: take it, you won't regret it.

An amazing teacher I loved going to class. His focus text have helped me grow spiritually, and I learned how to apply the scriptures and gospel principles more to my daily life. The class requires a journal after every class (20 journals out of a possible 28), reading the scriptures (maybe 8 chapters a week), two exams, and a 2800-3000 word paper.

Bro. Taeger is AMAZING! Seriously, best religious prof. at BYU hands down. Two exams--midterm and a final. Go to the review & study what he tells you to & you'll get an A. I studied about 4 hours for each exam. His focus texts are INCREDIBLE. I've never felt the spirit so strongly in a class. Super funny & willing to help. TAKE A CLASS FROM TAEGER!

The wonderful thing about Taegers, is Taegers are wonderful things. Professor Taeger makes the Book of Mormon real and relevant to everyday life as a member of the Church. His lectures are inspiring, and I would definitely recommend taking a course from him.

Taeger teaches in a way that lets you think about the BoM and the gospel in a new light. His tests aren't easy if you don't come to class, but if you do and know the things he tells you to you'll be good, he doesn't throw curve balls on them. Bottom line, he is a very intelligent and spiritual man who has a gift for teaching and loves his students.

Bro. Taeger's class is incredible. It's not difficult, there's not a whole lot of outside work, and the tests aren't too hard if you study the way he tells you to in class. Pay attention to the syllabus and you'll be fine!

I really enjoyed taking Book of Mormon from Brother Taeger, his lectures are amazing and I often left class feeling the Spirit and uplifted. However, I have on complaint, his tests are way too difficult. For that reason I wouldn't take another course from him.

I absolutely loved my class from Taeger. I spent the entire semester feeling so uplifted and enlightened from his lectures. As long as you went to class and paid attention, you can pass. He held review before the tests that were super helpful. Take it from him!!

Brother Taeger definitely knew what he was talking about- he's one smart cookie. But he usually got on long philosophical tangents that took up most of class, so we really didn't spend a lot of time on the BoM. There aren't a lot of assignments, but his tests were more challenging than they should've been, and there's lots and lots of memorization.

Brother Taeger is by far the best religion professor I've ever had at BYU. His class is very manageable and it is very easy to get an A if you go to lecture and complete his reading. Exams were pretty straightforward and he was always willing to address hard questions, his class was very inspiring. Wish I could take all religion from him!!

Brother Taeger taught my first ever religion class here at BYU, and did a great job. He loves the art of teaching, and has the ability to really bring the Spirit through his lectures in an insightful and deep way. He often gets off on tangents that, while often are very interesting, do not relate much to the material- but only to answer questions.

Brother Taeger does things a little differently, and I was a little off put by that at first, but have come to absolutely love it! His focus texts are incredible and he's a seriously skilled speaker. He keeps the class atmosphere totally open, and makes sure he answers any and every question. I found the tests to be pretty easy if you study.

This class was fun and spiritually uplifting. Brother Taeger cares about his students and wants us to learn and succeed in his class. I now understand the Book of Mormon a little more in depth. The homework is easy. Obviously read the Book of Mormon and also a small entry on a really good lecture he gives for the last ten minutes of class.
Great teacher and really interesting. Homework is interesting and spiritually uplifting. He tells you exactly what you will need to know on the tests. Only have a midterm and final (not cumulative)

I learn something new and feel the spirit every time I go. He is an incredible teacher. Really cares about his students and is willing to help. He is humble but absolutely genius and amazing at teaching. Loved this class.

I really looked forward to Brother Taeger's class. He  delivers the material in an way that encourages introspection and growth. Journal assignments are easy and help you apply what you learned. The greatest teacher I have had at BYU. Overall, a great course. I would take his class again in a heartbeat.

Wonderful teacher who is not afraid to address hard issues. He creates an environment of openness and trust. "Need to knows" for tests are given, and if you put in the time to learn it and attend class you will get an A

This is the most amazing guy on the planet.  LOVES HIS STUDENTS.  Hialrious, makes the class easy. "tells the kids what they need to know for the test so they can just focus on the doctrine" Tests are easy and he's powerful.  Probs a future general authority.
Great professor. Favorite teacher I have ever had in any setting. I recommend his class to everyone.

Brother Taeger is one of the best religion teachers I've had at BYU. I looked forward to his classes every day! He has a gift for involving the students and making me feel like what I said was valued. Some people say that his tests are hard, but they are easy in the sense that he tells you EXACTLY what to study for them. Focus texts were amazing!

Hands down, take this class. Brother Taeger's lectures are amazing. The homework is very manageable (reading the BOM, weekly journals, 1 paper). The 2 tests required a lot of preparation, but they're doable and fair. I wish I could take every religion class from Prof. Taeger!

Tom love brother Taeger! His lecture is interesting, especially with discussion . He likes to debate with student so it's fun to watch . I learned a lot from this class. All you need is to learn the slides carefully  and do the journals.  And it's college so everyone must work hard to get A :P

Brother Taeger is a super nice guy and a great lecturer but the tests are frustratingly hard and the lectures don't prepare you for them. To get a good grade in the class, you have to know every slide extremely well and the amount he wants you to know is overwhelming. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS unless you are ready to start studying from day one.
HUGE disconnect between lectures and exams.  Attendance is mandatory, but does not help you prepare for the tests at all.

Bro Taeger is incredible. If you want a Book of Mormon class where you are going to have deep insights and good class discussions, Bro Taeger is the professor for you. His lectures are always engaging and he loves getting input from the class. Homework is not bad, just reading and journals. For tests MEMORIZE his slides and you'll do well.

I loved Bro. Taeger's classes!   He's funny, but not inappropriate and he gives incredible lectures.  We do a lot of discussion, and its always meaningful and spiritual.  He only gives one test other than the final and it's pretty hard, but not impossible.

I LOVED this class.  Bro. Taeger really cares about the students and is willing to work with students..  I always looked forward to class, because he makes religion fun.  I'm not the type who likes to do a ton of outside class work and Bro. Taeger doesn't require much besides 350 word weekly journals and one paper.  Take this class from him!

GO TO THE TEST REVIEWS!! Saved my final grade for sure. I didn't go to the midterm review and I got a 70%. I went to the final review and got a 96%! Taeger gives incredible lectures- ones that leave you inspired and filled with the Spirit. Go to class, there are daily journals and you can miss up to 8.  Study the powerpoints!

his lectures rock! Honestly, i wish i could take ALL my religion credits from him. Everyday i leave his class and i feel so enlightened. There are write-ups about what was talked about in class every day (you can miss up to 8), one paper, a midterm, and a final. Just give it the same respect you'd give any other class and you'll succeed.

Taeger studies homiletics and story, and thus lectures with the best. His "focus text" approach to evoking emotional responses in students is superb. The classtests are not difficult; they ARE tricky (ie all the answers seem like they COULD be true). You can't "logic" a test, but if you actually study what Taeger tells you to (the slides)... EASY.

I respect Brother Taeger a lot.  He is very sincere and genuine.  I really enjoyed the lectures, especially the "focus texts" he does because they are truly inspiring.  He tells you what to study for the tests and wants to help you more than any teacher I've ever met. I am a significantly better person because  I took this class.

Taeger is the coolest teacher ever, but his tests are killer. I got a 50% on a midterm I studied 15+ hours for. They were so nitpicky! Journals everyday, so if you're like me and skip, you're in trouble. He's really spiritual, and I loved his lessons, just not his tests.

Brother Taeger is awesome. His lectures are unbeatable. He is really insightful and it helps that he's young and can relate. That being said, the tests were ridiculously hard. The average score on the midterm was a 75%. He did curve it, but it seemed like the people that actually got above a 75 were RMs. Daily journals, so don't miss class!
He is a great teacher and the lessons are awesome. The fact that he's younger makes him super fun.

Loved this class! Her lectures are to the point and full of a lot of interesting stuff. I found it easy to understand; I aced almost every exam. You get multiple tries for every homework assignment, and she drops a midterm, so it's really easy to get credit. I highly recommend her if you're looking for a low-stress yet informative class!

Sister Reynolds is great, her lectures were very applicable to the quizzes and the exams. She drops your worst exam in the class (out of the 3, not including the final) which really helped me get a good grade. The online quizzes and homework had 3 tries per question and two or three tries if you miss a question, so it's easy to get full credit.

Professor Reynolds is very knowledgeable in biology and she cares for her students. She keeps lectures interesting. However, attendance is required. The tests are brutal. DON'T take if you're not a Stem major. Definitely go to TA sessions for extra help.

Great Professor, I loved her class. You can tell she loves what she teaches and cares a lot about students. Has clear expectations to help you learn the material but is also flexible and works with students to meet them at their level.

TA's are the goat, literally so helpful. Attend the TA reviews! Very lecture heavy, don't take in the evening if you're trying to stay awake. Sister Reynolds is great but could get distracted easily or ramble. The class was fascinating, just make sure you're prepared for the exams. All mc which was nice.

Dr. Reynolds is a fantastic professor and is always willing to go over material if you don't understand. There are lots of opportunities to boost your grade, and extra credit is offered. Do the readings, and the Exam reviews, and you will most likely do very well. TA reviews are VERY useful with some hints on what will be on exams.

Professor Reynolds is a bit goofy and likes to talk. Following her lectures was a bit tough, but the class was simple enough review of high school AP bio. The tests were easy. I didn't really read the textbook.

Great class, great professor! She's easily distracted, but so caring. The TA's are nice and provide more than enough help for any exams. The tests are tough but she drops your lowest score. I would recommend this class to both Bio majors and nonmajors.

I took this class as a non-science major just for a GE and it was so worth it. The class itself was super easy. The TAs were really helpful and outlined everything we needed to know for the tests. Professor Reynolds can get a little off topic in class, but she is super nice and takes time to answer all questions.

Her lectures are pretty all over the place but she sets up the class for you to succeed. She drops the lowest score from you three midterms and lets you know exactly what to study to prepare for them. If you just study for a little bit before tests and go to the TA review then its a pretty easy class.

She was good and a nice person, however, given her rather scatterbrained way of conducting lectures, I learned more from reading the textbook provided than the lectures, or going to class. The tests are challenging but fair, and if you study well you should have no issue. However, the tests are weighted to about 70 percent in this class, so beware.

Sister Reynolds is SO nice and caring, but I would highly recommend not taking this class from her. She is very scattered, and I ended up learning more by teaching myself than being in lecture. She is also impossible to reach by email which was tricky. Two assignments every week & 4 (fairly simple) tests total. Do the reading & go to TA reviews!!

I was orginally going to take this class in person, but the professor was actually terrible. Glad I took it online, there are tons of TA's and easy help. There is 4 midterms and they are hard. If you study hard they are doable, but hard. Overall a pretty good class!

AP bio but easier. She is funny and laidback, but obviously not as professional/knowledgable as most BYU professors. Take this class from her if you want an easy A while taking Chem 105. Take it from Professor Jenkins if you actually wanna learn. TA's tell you what's on the tests. There are two assignments due a week and readings. Tests are fair.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Not enough words to describe how difficult it was. She talks faster than you can take notes and rambles a lot. TA review material is completely irrelevant to the actual exams. You'd be better off just filling out C for every problem than trying to study, because none of it will be on the test. Nice lady, terrible professor.

Professor Reynolds is one of the most caring professors I've had during my time at BYU. She's so enthusiastic about what she teaches.

There is some homework, but it is very manageable. The tests are tough, but if you study it is a pretty easy class to ace.

For both STEM and Non-STEM majors, I would highly recommend this class for a BIO GE over BIO100. I took it my senior year and felt that the class was very straightforward. Tests were fair and hw was not too hard but still great practice. She is nice, posts slides, and focuses on the most important info, although she is a little scatterbrained.

Professor Reynolds really does care about her students and wants to help them receive the grade they deserve. She's willing to go over the test with you and offers extra credit. I took this class Spring 2023.

Professor Reynolds really cares about her students. She is really understanding with grades and does a good job at preparing you for tests. The TA was also a huge help and did great at explaining. Do the readings before the class!! I've noticed that those who have a general knowledge of the material before coming to lecture do way better on the tests. Professor Reynolds was a very kind and compassionate professor. You can tell that she really enjoys her job as a teacher! Remember to just do the readings, I would have done way better lol.

She was so awesome!! She cares so much about the students and really wants them to succeed! She made the workload very manageable and really tries her best to prepare the class for the exams. I would love to take her class again!

This was her first semester at BYU and honestly I loved coming to her class. Material can be difficult but her awesome TA helped me a ton. Professor Reynolds cares about her students and wants whats best for them. She doesnt curve any tests because her tests dont need to be curved to get a good grade. 10/10 would recommend!

Very knowledgeable and caring—she learns students' names even in large lectures and takes time to answer questions. She is a very smart teacher. I learned a lot in this class. You do have to go to every class. The quizzes we do as homework are helpful. You should study for all the tests. Study the packet she gives you well. It can be very hard to know what to study. Study your old tests and go to the TA lab.

I enjoyed her lectures, you can tell she really cares about her students and loves nutrition. Some of the TA's grade kinda harsh but its not too bad.

Professor Parker is awesome! This class was one of my favorites this semester! Each class you need to answer a question to get attendance and in order to do well on exams you need to do your readings/questions and go through the class slides and notes. Overall I didn't find it too hard and honestly a super amazing class

Professor Parker is the best!! She is so sweet and very passionate about nutrition. She genuinely cares about the students and she wants you to succeed! She provides everything you need to succeed and the TA's are also helpful if you need extra help. I learned a lot about nutrition from her and this class motivated me to make healthier decisions!

You may think a Nutrition class is for you because you're a gym bro or you track your macros... you thought wrong. Don't take it if you're interested in nutrition. This teacher offers 0 extensions, help, time outside class, extra credit, you name it. She will wreck your GPA. Textbook beliefs, against supplements, organics, alternative diet etc

She is so kind and genuinely cares! Its a hard class with lots of memorization but its doable and the best option for nutrition. Just STUDY before exams, its all from the slides. I never did the reading and I was fine just pay attention in class.

I would not recommend taking NDFS 100 from her if you are not planning on majoring in nutrition. Professor Parker is super kind and supportive! She always posts announcements about the upcoming week's assignments. Lots of tedious busywork and readings. Professor Parker is about as kind as it gets. She cares for her students, so much so that she will learn everyone's names.
