The SMART project is a weekly one hour time commitment, and it inspired me to be involved in YServe. His puns can sometimes be annoying, but I can overlook it. Overall great professor!

Tyler Griffen is by far one of the most inspirational teachers I have ever had. Lectures are amazing and he doesn't assign a huge amount of unreasonable homework for a religion class. He is very understanding of a students life and schedule.

Brother Griffin is amazing! He teaches the Book of Mormon in a way that allows you to learn and grow so much and the homework is all about growth too, even the tests are a spiritual experience rather than a bunch of memorization. 2 tests, 2 papers, and 1 project. He is amazing- I would recommend him to anybody and everybody.

Brother Griffin is a fantastic professor! In short here is what the class consisted of... Reading your scriptures each night, a personal project (that you work on each week), a form shared each week and attending each class. Staying on top of these things each week and staying focused in class will earn you an A. I highly recommend this class.

Brother Griffin is AMAZING! His class seriously changed my life. He has incredible insight and background knowledge of the scriptures and their cultural context. The tests are extremely specific from his lectures, but tests are open scripture so just take detailed notes in your scripture margins and you'll be fine. Best religion professor ever.

For a class called "Principles and Doctrines of the BOM" it was way too much opinion, and not enough principles and doctrine.  The tests were based purely on what he opinionated  in lectures, and was not backed  up by clear scripture, modern or ancient. It was still an easy class with the way he has grades set up, but I never felt the spirit there.
TAKE HIS CLASS, IT WILL BE A LIFE CHANGING EXPERIENCE. He is probably the best religion professor on campus.

Brother Griffin is the best. I love this man so much. He was so nice and caring. I felt the spirit so strong in each of our classes. The class is easy, it's mainly based on your own effort to study the scriptures. I will definitely take another class with Brother Griffin.

Brother Griffin was the best teacher I've ever had. I actually looked forward to coming to his class in the morning. He really cares about his students. He really makes you think. I felt the Spirit so strongly in his class. The tests were open scripture. The TA reviews are a lifesavers. They basically give you the test. I plan on taking him again.

I love how Bro Griffin teaches New Testament. It really is a spiritual experience first, and a college course second. The tests are easy if you go to class and pay attention-- which isn't hard to do since his lectures are so uplifting and interesting. All assignments are meaningful if you put time in! Would take again for sure.
Brother Griffin is the best!  He gives wonderful insights to the Book of Mormon, and really emphasizes personal growth.  Fabulous teacher!  Take him!!

The content in the class was great! I loved learning from the Book of Mormon! However,  the grading was terrible. The TAs were very harsh. Also the tests were very subjective I thought and they had content which we did not cover in class.
My favorite professor at BYU so far. A real genuine man with amazing insights on the Book of Mormon. I learned so much from him!

I absolutely loved this class - Wow. I actually felt sad to not be coming back to this class the following semester. Every day I left feeling inspired and loved, and Brother Griffin is an amazing teacher. The exam is hard, but it's open Book of Mormon so take good notes in class and you'll be fine. I would definitely take another class from him.
He was a great teacher. I learned a lot from his class. He is willing to work with you if you need it.

This is by far one of the best professors I have had. He is crazy inspirational and I've cried from the spirit countless times from his class. His grading is clear and he really admires the use of agency in class. I would definitely take one of his classes again.

I also had him for Doctrine of the Book of Mormon. He's awesome.  He is sincere and caring.  He is an amazing and entertaining teacher.  You can feel the Spirit strongly and you also learn a lot about the scriptures.  It's an awesome class from an awesome teacher.  I'd recommend his classes to anyone.

You wanna laugh? He's the man. You wanna cry because of some emotional story? He's the man. You want your mind blown every lecture? He's the man! Prof. Griffin is by far one of the best professors I've ever had - so willing to work with you, teaches really well, has a terrific sense of humor and knows to be serious. Take his class - no regrets!

Taken one class, Teachings and Doctrine of the Book of Mormon. Walked in with very low expectations, expected it to be just reading and some discussion - I leave this class every time inspired and uplifted.

Best teacher I have ever had. He shared so many amazing insights into the Book of Mormon that have changed my view of the Book of Mormon and has changed my life. The class is not hard and he is very reasonable with grading. A must have for all BYU students.
He's the best.

Brother Griffin is amazing. I've never felt the Spirit more strongly than in his class. He is not preachy and sincerely wants his students to succeed. Tests are easy if you just show up and take good notes in class. You'll do well. I look forward to his class every day and would recommend him to anyone!

I have read the B.O.M. three times until now, and Brother Griffin is still teaching me new things. He gives inspirational lectures and he doesn't like to give busy work. He is somewhat a hard grader with his papers. However, he is very considerate and wants to help his students succeed. I have an A in the class, and it's possible for you to too.

I am a returned missionary and am currently taking Brother Griffin's Book of Mormon class. I love it. Brother Griffin has great insights that have expounded my understanding of the B.O.M. His class is always very spiritual. Even though he grades papers harshly, it's easy to get an A. He is great and really cares about his student's success in life.

Awesome teacher! It's like your favorite seminary teacher, but better. He is insanely knowledgeable and loves to share cool insights. He honestly cares more for his students well being than simply teaching the course(his TA's talk more about papers than he does). He always drops puns and keeps the class awake and alive. Just take the class and see.
He changed my whole view of the Book of Mormon. I wish I could just sit and ask him questions for hours. He seems to know everything. He is so genuine and cares most about teaching his students.
A very inspired man, I had some of the greatest spiritual experiences in that class.
Amazing professor. He really opened my eyes to the doctrine and principles of the Book of Mormon
Amazing teacher. Best teacher I have ever had.

Dr. Griffin is really inspirational. He expects a lot of work from you, but the class is worth taking. I learned a lot from the class I took and would take him again. Not an easy A, but not worth avoiding either.
Cool teacher but really hard class.

Brother Griffin honestly changed my life.  I looked forward to every single class period and was always sad when it was over!  Such a kind and Christlike man.  All of his tests were spiritual experiences for me!  Take any and every religion class that you can from him!!!!!!

I absolutely adored Brother Griffin and his kind personality. He was always very willing to help a student, and even let those who failed his tests to come and make test corrections. His tests are a bit difficult though, as it seems you need to know exact details from his lectures. But overall, hands down, favorite religion teacher I've ever had.

Brother Griffin is an AMAZING teacher!!! Super inspirational, all while helping you to understand the scriptures better. As long as you do your pre-readings and take good notes in class, you will be fine.

I enjoyed Brother Griffin's class because it was so uplifting, but it was unnecessarily difficult. There was a research paper, that was toughly graded and the tests were specific to exact details from lecture, which made it really hard to get an A. I put all the necessary work into the class and it wasn't enough. It was a good, but hard class.

Bro Griffin is a solid teacher. He taught me a lot of new things about the scriptures and provided great perspective and insight into the stories and characters of the New Testament. The class isn't too difficult, just two tests, a project, and weekly reading in the scriptures. You get points for attendance so you don't want to miss a lot of class.
Nice guy, tests are pretty hard.

LOVED Brother Griffin! Best Book of Mormon class ever! His assignments helped me to develop a life-long habit of reading the scriptures. Attendance is mandatory, and there is a big semester-long project but you get to pick what it is and you only have to work on it for an hour each week. TAKE HIS CLASS, you won't regret it.

Brother Griffin is a wonderful professor! His lectures are amazing, I definitely learned a lot from him -  both spiritually and academically. He cares greatly about his students' opinions, and never claims he knows everything about the church/gospel. The work is definitely manageable, just make sure you take notes in class and do the assignments.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!! Literally, Bro. Griffin is not just a teacher, he is one of the best men on earth and a true friend to his students.  I left his class feeling I could take on life and learned so much EVERY time. My husband and I took his class Wednesdays and it was the highlight of our week! 1 paper, 1 semester project, 1 midterm-take him!:)

Awesome lectures. He invites the Spirit so easily. He can get cocky at times and thinks he knows everything. You have to do a weekly digital dialog which was a pain. One paper, one semester long project (basically whatever you want that's related to BM). Tests easy. Would take from him again!
He rushes through every class, his tests have nothing to do with what he tried to teach and he grades everything harder than a chemistry class. Seriously hardest class i've taken at BYU.

He emphasizes that he doesn't want to preach to you so as a result, you won't get much of a spiritual experience in class. He expects you to learn through the impressions of the Spirit, but it's hard to do so when he's rushing through lecture and not taking time to clarify things.

Do not take this class if you are looking for a comfy religion class. He is a nice guy and a good teacher however, the semester long project, tests, and accumulated work of the class are ridiculous for only 2 credits. Wouldn't take him ever again. I had a 94% when I took the final and it dropped to a 85%. Class average for the last test was a 76%

Brother Griffin is by far the best religion teacher I've had at BYU, as well as my favorite teacher of all time. He truly cares about his students and is always willing to give extra help if it's needed. If you want a spiritual class, look no further. There is a bit of work but it's not too hard and your grade will be fine if you stay on top of it.

MOST AMAZING PROFESSOR! He prepared me not just for the exam, but for the rest of my life. He had AMAZING insights into the scriptures and helped me become better connected with the scriptures. I have NEVER witnessed a more powerful teacher of the gospel. Even if you don't take the class, I highly recommend just sitting in on one of his lectures.

I really liked his class. I learned about the Book Of Mormon, and he never had us do extra homework. We had 1 midterm, 1 final, 1 paper and weekly participation quizzes online. The only thing si that you have to go to class to get a good grade on the midterm. He lets you use your scriptures on the tests, but you have to write everything down always

Professor Griffin is an inspiring man. He clearly has a great knowledge of the gospel and is focused on helping students know the most important things. If you go to class, tests are easy. I was inspired.
Great teacher with awesome insights!

If you want a religion class that inspires, educates, and leaves you with knowledge gained, take a course from Brother Griffin. I have taken REL 121, Rel 211, and Rel 212 from Brother Griffin, in addition to interviewing him for a project. He is amazing, his knowledge and humility are remarkable, and class is always a pleasure. Take his class.
The best teacher ever! If you are an ESL student talk to him for help. He'll let you ask question on the test for clarification.

Bro Griffin is a phenomenal teacher. However, I felt that this class required way too much time for a simple religion class. There was a semester long project, a 4-5pg essay, and two mid-terms. If you are going to have a pretty full semester, I'd find another Religion class to take.

He is by far the best religion teacher at BYU. I have upmost respect for him and his ability to teach. His class really is easy as long as you are willing to take time to read the scriptures and grow spiritually. There is one paper as a research project but it isn't difficult. Class is on participation for presence and reading. Midterm & final exam

Brother Griffin is the best! He finds deeper meaning and application in everything! The tests are fairly easy and open scripture. There is a semester long project but it is totally doable! Would love to take every religion class from him! Your success completely depends on how much effort you are willing to put in!

Very inspirational class. Lots of little assignments when forgotten can be very detrimental to your grade. Making a zero on one assignment brought my grade down from an A to an A minus. Tests are difficult but open scriptures. I loved going to lecture, but the work required for a two credit religion class seemed a bit much to me.

Brother Griffin is a great teacher. His lectures are very thoughtful and insightful. His class is very focused on the individual, with homework assignments based on goals you set for yourself at the beginning of the semester. Tests are open Book , so if you pay attention and take notes in the margins you'll be golden. Gained lots of great insights.

Brother Griffin is great. Super humble and good teacher. I would take another class from him. What you're graded on is super straightforward, you just need to make sure to keep up with homework since it's every week.  Tests are "open-scripture" so take notes right in your scriptures- I got a big version of the BOM and it was AWESOME.
Go to class and attend review sessions.

This is easily the best Professor I have ever had. It is not that he has a greater understanding of the scriptures but his way of teaching made things so clear! The course is set up very reasonably and I can say I am a legitimately better person. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Really fantastic teacher who gives context to the scriptures that makes them much more relatable. Don't forget to do any of the little assignments, that's why I don't have an A. He really does want his students to do well and he doesn't want to kill grades. Share notes to study for tests and go to the TA reviews.

Bro. Griffin is amazing, his class changed my life! There is some work, but it's all designed to help you grow spiritually. He is a very fair grader and his tests are open book so take ALL of your notes in your scriptures! One of the best classes I've ever taken, just phenomenal.

It's a lot of homework but it was never busy work. Although it's not an 'easy' class per say, I learned more about the Book of Mormon here than anywhere else. Bro Griffin is one of the most knowledgeable people of the Book of Mormon and it was perfect for before my mission. HIGHLY RECCOMEND

Brother Griffin was an incredibly inspirational teacher, one of the best religion teachers I've ever had. He has such a genuine love for all the students, and helps you understand both the intellectual and spiritual sides of the Book of Mormon. I would definitely take a class from him again!

Really helpful in deepening my appreciation for the BofM. This is my third class from Bro Griffin and love his teaching style - for me, I really felt the spirit each class while be instructed intellectually as well, though not lots so choose wisely. He can answer any question you have. He follows the spirit in changing his lessons. Inspirational.

Bro. Griffin was an amazing professor!  The spirit was present in every lecture.  He provided interpretations to the scriptures that had never crossed my mind.  My testimony truly grew from this course.  He does love cheesy jokes though. :)

Brother Griffin is one of my favorite professors at BYU. So funny & helpful & kind. He really makes the scriptures come to life & become more real & meaningful than they have been in the past. This class isn't as easy as you might think it is, it's more like a real class than a religion class, but totally worth it. Take good notes!
Best teacher I've ever had. I am a better person for taking his class.
Amazing, and super easy class. Just show up, take notes, and you will get an A or B.
Man, this guy changed my life! He is amazing. There is a lot of work but totally worth it.

Teachings and Doctrines of the Book of Mormon with Brother Griffin was my absolute favorite class this semester.  My scripture study has improved tremendously because of his class and I feel like I got to know the Book of Mormon on a whole new level because of him.  He recognizes this is a 2 credit GE class and teaches/grades accordingly.

Excellent classes, full of great puns (don't need to remember), tells you what's on the test (even has a review session). Take notes during class on things that sound important and you'll do fine. I don't know how he did it, but Professor Griffin made his class my favorite class. Not like me; I'm a Math/Science guy. He makes you work, but wonderful
He honestly saved my semester.
The most amazing and wonderful and inspiring teacher I  have every had. The classes he teaches are perfect, and he is amazing. Please take his class.

Take any class you can from Brother Griffin! For this class students were asked to study 30 mins from scriptures daily and  do one semester long project on whatever would bring you to Christ. Basically if he says it in class it will be on the test, and since the finals are open scripture take ALL your notes right in the margins and you'll ace tests

I love Brother Griffin! He loves the gospel and the Savior and the Book of Mormon and does an excellent job portraying that and inspiring his students to feel the same. He balances secular and spiritual information and knowledge exceptionally well. There is quite a bit of work but it is all worth it. Tests are open book--so take notes in your BoM!

This class opened my eyes to things I'd never seen before in the Book of Mormon. It was a great class, and Brother Griffin is always willing to help and go the extra mile to make sure you understand and get a fair grade, and if you missed something you can talk to him about it. All in all, this was an amazing experience. Highly recommend.

He has a kind warming spirit, and he sets expectations on day one. If you want to grow spiritually, improve your life,  and life others around you, than take his class. You can turn his hw into busy work or you can have it inspire you. If you want a real religion class with someone who really loves you. He's the man.
Professor Griffin is amazing. He actually bothers to learn your name and cares about you individually. If you write down every lecture copiously, you will pass the difficult tests.

I LOVE BROTHER GRIFFIN!!! :) Totally turned my testimony around, and taught me soo much. I found myself wishing that I could have his class every single day just so that I could be uplifted by him more often. He's made me tear up a couple times with stories. Tests aren't super easy but definitely doable, and he curves! TAKE HIM PLEASE!!

Great teacher! He really helped me prepare for my mission. He has great stories and analogies that really helped the scriptures come alive for me. I would recommend this class for all incoming freshman, or anyone on campus! Awesome professor

Brother Griffin did such an amazing job teaching the class about reading the scriptures more in depth and reading between the lines. I learned so much from him and would 100% take any class from him. He tells personal stories that relate to the scriptures we are reading about and helps further clarify the concepts we need. Only 2 tests total!

I'm about to take my 3rd class taught by Brother Griffin. He is such a wonderful teacher and brings the Scriptures not necessarily alive, but makes the history real and the spirit strong. Tests were hard for me, easy for some though. Open Scripture tests and weekly reports on attendancereading done online. Overall sweet guy who really cares

I've had a lot of amazing religion professors at BYU, but I'd dare say Bro. Griffin is my favorite. He's so nice, & his lectures are full of the Spirit. Each assignment, test, quiz really adds to the learning experience, which is something I can't say about every class. Open-scripture tests are great. Take whatever class you can from him.
He is amazing. Take any class you can from him.

Professor Griffin taught me how to read the Book of Mormon.  His teaching style is very inspiration-oriented and even in big classes, he lets people participate a LOT.  His tests are tough, but they're open-scripture and if you just take notes in your scriptures, you should be fine.

Most inspirational teacher on campus, hands down. He focuses more on insights then doctrine. I left each class feeling uplifted. You can use your scriptures on tests, write everything he says in the margins. The 11-hour project is kind of a drag so pick something you're really interested in. The research paper isn't hard either.

I took this class from 5-6:50pm and still loved it. Open-scripture test, about an hour and a half of homework per week plus reading. Take lots of notes in class.  Brother Griffin is INCREDIBLE. I wish I could take every single one of my Religion classes from him.

He's fun to listen to and will explain things if you ask him. Usually tries to be clear even without asking. Tests are easy if you take notes from his lecture, especially since tests are open scriptures. Definitely my favorite religion teacher - wish I could have him for every religion class.

Really fun teacher!  Not hard to get an A, just do weekly forums and the reading.  A lot of the tests are what he goes over in class, so attendance is important.  If he writes it on the board, write it down.  All tests are open scripture, which is awesome, though some questions are very specific because of it.  I learned so much and loved the class

He's just great! No need to worry with his class, you're in safe hands. Very, very little chance of you failing if you hand in everything, he's not a hard grader, and with all that, his class is still one of the most spiritual I've been to on campus. Really engages the Book of Mormon in a way that everyone takes something from. Wonderful!

Loved Brother Griffin! He really loves the Book of Mormon and tries to pass that to his students. The only text is the actual BoM and he dives right into it. The class is also super easy with one midterm and final (both open-book), and an enjoyable semester-long project. Definitely would recommend.

I love this guy and his class. Will keep signing up for his classes because he brings the spirit and brings so much insight. Weekly 250wd summary of what you learned that week and pre reading before each class. A semester long project of your choice-1 hour each week. His tests are open book and if you write down EVERYTHING he says you'll get an A.

If your looking to have a class that you don't have to worry about look no further. Bro Griffin is more interested in your testimony than your grade and he makes that very clear. His assignments are centered on helping you grow as a person. truly cares about students

AMAZING professor! Bro. Griffin made class fun but was still spiritual and I learned a lot.  Take good notes in class and you'll be fine.  He only has a few tests and they're not awfully hard.  From my experience and what I heard from others, he's by far one of the best religion professors. I would definitely take this class and more from him!!

Bro. Griffin's lectures are wonderful - my advice would be to buy a new blue soft cover BOM, take it to every class, mark all the verses he mentions and take as many notes as you can in the margins. You'll be prepared for open-book tests. There's no quizzes on reading, which is nice, but there are a couple time-consuming projects. DONT SKIP CLASS!

Favorite professor at BYU by far!! Brother Griffin is seriously fantastic! I grew so incredibly much during his class! There is a lot of work, so be prepared for that. There are weekly quizzes and a semester-long research paper and project. Get your paper done early!! Despite the work load, Griffin's worth it!! I'm taking him again next semester :)

Bro. Griffin is so spiritual and really opened my eyes to many things in the Book of Mormon. You can tell that he cares about the academic success, but more importantly the spiritual success of his students. An A is possible in the class as long as you pay attention in lecture and do all of the assignments. Everyone should take a class from him!

New Testament was my third religion class with Bro. Griffin. He is inspirational and extremely knowledgeable about ancient scripture. He completely changed my approach to the New Testament and my testimony grew because of it. You have to attend class and take good notes, but the tests are open scripture (and notes in them) and assignments are easy.

This was an amazing class! It  was not difficult at all! The tests are tough but they are open book. Just do the reading and go to class and you will get good scores. He understands its a two credit class and will not to overload you. You write one paper and read a few chapters before each class, its very reasonable!

My absolute favorite professor at BYU! I always came out of his class feeling refreshed and inspired. He keeps lectures entertaining & throws out a lot of punny jokes.  You'll have a semester long project, but it's easy. Tests are open scripture so take notes in the margins! You'll have a self quiz every week too, so lots of point opportunities.

Brother Griffin is awesome! I absolutely LOVED going to class! I learned sooo much. He only has two tests- a midterm and a final. They are both open scripture, so of course the questions are pretty tough. If you take notes and pay attention in class, you should be fine. He loves telling corny jokes and is just an overall great guy. Take him!
Griffin is a fabulous professor! I cannot wait to take the second half with him! He always cracks the best puns. Tests are challenging but open book. If you take your time you will do fine.

Brother Griffin might be one of the most inspirational people I know. I've taken his classes for three semesters now, I just can't stay away. His grading procedures and weekly assignments are a little bit confusing but once you get the hang of it you're fine. He'll remind you of deadlines, and he's incredibly spiritual. Take his class!

Tests have lots of trick questions. If you miss class you're not going to do well. Doesn't always have the nicest approach to controversial subjects. Tests are open book, but that doesn't mean you'll pass.

AMAZING. LIfe changing class. I learned so much about the New Testament and the life of Christ. I feel like a I actually learned and built my testimony rather than just memorizing things for test. Seriously, take this class. Its not hard to get an A, yet you learn so much!
Brother Griffin does a really good job inviting the Spirit. I got a lot out of his lectures, and many gospel truths were made clearer for me. I definitely recommend him.

You can tell that he cares about his students. He is energetic, listens to students, and is willing to help anyone who asks for it. His tests are challenging; I took notes in every class, but I still found many of the questions confusing. Definitely use a Quad and not just the Book of Mormon, as it can save you on tests.

Such an amazing teacher! Always was able to find and show very insightful comments on the doctrine of the Book of Mormon. Extremely fair grading, he's clear with what he expects from you. Very enthusiastic about the gospel! You'll never regret taking a class from Brother Griffin!

Tyler Griffin is the BEST teacher I have EVER had, religion or not. His class is spiritually enriching and full of laughs. I don't think I have had a teacher that has helped me love the scriptures more! He really helps you understand and connect with the people and concepts you are studying. I would take this class over and over again.

He lets you use your scriptures on tests, so just take all your notes in the margins and you are guaranteed an A on the exams. There are weekly assignments and readings for every class, but they aren't hard. He does a great job of inviting the Spirit to class.

An amazing man that I learned a ton from. His lectures are amazing and interesting and I learned so much every day. He is unclear about what is on the tests. Just pay good attention in class and take good notes and you will do well.

In all my years at the University I have never had a teacher with such a confusing syllabus.  I can't tell you who many times students talk on the discussion board about what is due and what's not.  The assignments aren't hard but because there are so many assignments, it is difficult to keep it straight.  He needs to revamp his syllabus.

Brother Griffin is a phenomenal teacher. His lectures will leave you feeling inspired to change the world--or at least yourself. Solid character, honest, and caring. You definitely don't have to show up to pass the tests, but, if you don't, I hope you've a good understanding of the scriptures. Honestly, the tests are a breeze.

He requires too much homework for a Religion class worth 2 credits.  You'll have to write a digital dialogue once a week, weekly readings, a research paper, midterm and final. His lectures were fine but his best lectures were when we were running out of time and he finally would stop with the fluff and just teach the doctrine and how it applies.

Brother Griffin is the most inspirational professor I have ever had the opportunity to take a class from. He focus on changing you as a person and helping you feel the spirit every class rather than a grade. He knows the scriptures so well and can answer every one of you questions. TAKE HIS CLASSES! I always left his class feeling so happy!!!

Brother Griffin is one of the most amazing men I have ever encountered and even in a huge auditorium it's not hard to recognize the incredible love he has for each of his students. I've learned more about the BoM than I thought I could;he's just so knowledgeable and really invites the spirit. No question, I'd take many more classes from him.

Brother Griffin is insightful and after every class I wanted to go home and read the scriptures and share everything that I learned! He's spiritual but punny and I am always captivated during class - sometimes I notice my mouth open because I am shocked by how the scriptures can unfold! Griffin made my experience fantastic!

Brother Griffin is an amazing teacher! His lectures are clear and he goes deep into doctrine. The bad reviews on here say there is busy work, but that is only to keep track of your progress throughout the semester. The work he gives is beneficial and he cares a lot. My testimony of the Book of Mormon has been greatly strengthened. Take his class!

He is probably my favorite human. Amazing professor and great lecturer. He cares SO much about the gospel and about his students. There are more assignments that other religion classes, but all of them are assigned with the intent for spiritual growth. Much more focused on spiritual well-being than giving a grade. I've taken 3 classes from him.

He is the best Book of Mormon teacher BYU has. Great projects, easy reading assignments, and overall an easy course. Couple that with the fact that Br. Griffin is a talented orator and fantastic BOM scholar, you learn a ton and you don't have to worry too much about grades (if you do the work). Take it from Griffin!

I took both 121 and 122 with him, and I absolutely loved it! his tests aren't bad at all if you go take good notes *in your book of mormon* in class. buy one just for this class and mark it up as he lectures. I loved the feeling I had every day we had class, too, I always looked forward to it and never dreaded the work. Work load easy.

By far the best teacher that I have had at BYU. Cares about the students and explains doctrines in a way that you will understand. You will get a good grade as long as you do the assigned work. Tests are very fair and not too difficult. Take notes from class in your scriptures!

I took New Testament from Brother Griffin and thoroughly enjoyed his lectures. Brother Griffin brought the New Testament to life for me, and although I don't regret taking his class for this reason, I did find myself somewhat frustrated with the unpredictability of his tests. A helpful review session was available, but some questions were obscure.

I took Brother Griffin for both my Book of Mormon classes and was SO impressed at how he made the stories come to life without deviating from the doctrine.  He is absolutely hilarious and very punny.  He is also very willing to listen to any testing concerns. The only problem I had was the online writing assignment constantly glitching out.

By far my favorite religion teacher.  He loves the subject and deeply cares for students.  If it were up to him, he wouldn't have grades, but the department forces him to comply with their averages.  Tests are open scripture, 11 hour project is demanding, and so are weekly readings.  But Brother Griffin is so worth it.  You won't regret your time.
Great professor! He really knows his stuff! Try to take a class from him if you can!

Bro. Griffin is legit!! He is a great teacher and really loves what he does a lot. All you have to do is read the scriptures and such before hand and you're good to go. The 11 hour project is a duesy, but if you do it, it really pays off.

This has been one of my absolute favorite classes this semester, and Brother Griffin one of my very favorite teachers. I was always scrambling to keep up with notes. However, if you're looking for an easy A this class probably isn't for you. There's weekly assignments that are pretty time-consuming and his test are hard. Still, I loved this class!

Brother Griffin is definitely more of an "EFY" type teacher. He is very passionate and focuses a lot on application, but I wished he would have provided a little bit more support for the way he interpreted the scriptures. His use of quotes from general authorities was pretty minimal and I felt like he was often preaching his opinion.

You will not regret taking this class. Br. Griffin is one of the most inspired and spiritually in tune people I have ever met. Very little work outside of class, and if you go to class and the reviews the tests are a breeze as it is very direct in what you should know. Favorite professor of all time.
Easy A. Great teacher. Take this class and you will NEVER regret it.

Get a new cheap BOM for this class. Write every single thing he does on the board and reference he makes into the margins. Then circle around the number of each verse read in class. Attend TA reviews, definitely. Im not a huge fan of the Griffin, he seemed to be in sales mode all the time but freshman seem to eat that up.

One of the best religion professor I've had. Every lecture is another spiritual high with so much scriptural insight I had never thought of before. My love for the New Testament deepened because of the spirit he invites. Class from Brother Griffin can change your life.

Griffin is amazing!! Highly recommended. There wasn't a single day I attended lecture without feeling extremely uplifted by the spirit. His knowledge about the scriptures is great. Not very difficult to get an A. There are quite a few small assignments, but they cushion your grade. Key to succeed on exams = attend TA reviews. They give away answers
Griffin is a great teacher. Take his New Testament class.

Professor Griffin is INCREDIBLE! By far my favorite professor up to this point. He is so spiritual and can answer almost any question without needing to look it up in the scriptures. He teaches things about the Book of Mormon that I would have never even thought about. Take a class from him if you ever get the opportunity!

Absolutely amazing teacher!! I learned things about the Book of Mormon I never imagined I could learn. He is a funny guy, but he always has the spirit in his class. The work load is a little tough and his tests aren't easy, but I would highly recommend Brother Griffin

Easy class, not a lot of work. The spirit is really strong in class. All tests are open scripture, so write all your notes in the margins, especially cross references. Get started on the research paper as soon as possible and read ahead in the scriptures.

Brother Griffin is so awesome! He is an unbelievable professor who teaches with the Spirit and honestly loves his students. His love for the Book of Mormon is infectious and I gained so many new insights into the scriptures. If you have the opportunity to take from him jump on it! He is seriously a phenomenal professor
I really enjoy his class. His insights are fascinating

Brother Griffin is an incredible teacher. His prides his class on being as hard as other class at BYU and not getting an easy A. But his class is INCREDIBLE! I would recommend taking it from him. His insights are so powerful and his class is super spiritual. Tests are open book.

Okay Griffin is a great teacher and all. However, if you want to keep your GPA up, don't take him. His tests, even with the Book of Mormon, were so hard. I never missed a class and I could not believe how poorly I did. Just be prepared to be in the testing center for 3 hours. I only could give it an 1 hour and 1/2

Truly the greatest teacher I have ever had. He wants everyone in the class to succeed, and is less concerned about your worldly grade than your personal integrity and honesty. If you want the A you can get the A. He would love for you to get an A! Infinitely more important however is his heartfelt desire to help you grow closer to Jesus Christ.

Such an amazing professor. Definitely my favorite class! Go into the class with an attitude of humility, and your strengthening testimony will allow you to succeed. I honestly found the tests pretty easy, as long as you took detailed notes in class and did all your assignments (easy points!). I have such a great love of the Book of Mormon now!

Great class, super spiritual, but it was a little too hard to achieve an A. The tests would get to the point where many were easy, but lots were purposefully hard and it seemed like the spirit of the class was compromised because of it.

Brother Griffin in an INCREDIBLE persom, knows his stuff well, and really teaches with the spirit. Not only my testimony of the Book of Mormon gr, but my knowledge of it and my love for it increased ten-fold. Make sure you do NOT miss an assignment, easy points! Tests aren't bad, but be willing to sit in the testing center for 3 hours to get an A

I have had Brother Griffin for 3 classes and they are by far the most incredible classes at BYU. He is a brilliant lecturer. Yes, his tests are hard, but it is not impossible to get an A. Tests were not stressful because they were open scripture.

Great guy but tests are insanely hard. Never missed a class and did all of the readings and homework and just about failed the final and midterm. Not easy to get an A. Really nice guy but I would not take the class again.

Brother Griffins lectures are amazing. My testimony of the Book of Mormon grew so much and I gained so much understanding on principles that I've had questions on for a long time. The tests are difficult, but they won't kill you. I would strongly suggest taking class notes directly in your scriptures since tests are open scripture.

Brother Griffin is an amazing teacher and he always able to hold the student's attention. Just stay caught up on the weekly assignments and research project. Be warned that the tests are pretty hard, which sometimes makes it difficult to get an A.

Although Brother Griffin is an amazing lecturer and he excels at bringing the spirit into the class, his class in ruined by the difficulty of his tests. The fact that they are open scripture would usually be relieving, but in this case it really isn't helpful.

His tests are INSANELY HARD! I studied rigorously, went to every class period, and did all the readings. And yet I failed both he midterm and the final. Great class, but he's a horrible, horrible test maker.

Bro. Griffin is easily my favorite professor at BYU. He brings the spirit into every class.He is very understanding of personal circumstances and willing to work with students who need help. The key to doing well is taking detailed notes and copying them into your Book of Mormon, which you can use on the tests. I loved every minute of his class.

I did not like Brother Griffin as a teacher. His tests are very difficult and are designed to test how well you can read the Book of Mormon while taking the test. He makes it much harder than it needs to be. I wouldn't recommend him.

Brother Griffin is an incredible at lecturing and bringing in the Spirit, and his weekly assignments are pretty easy. The tests however, are incredibly difficult, as they are very ambiguous and cover much material that wasn't discussed in class. Prepare as you will for the tests, but it really comes down to how well you can read the scriptures.

Brother Griffin is amazing. His class is one that I will greatly miss and I would take any religion class from him. Having said this I think his tests are way too hard. I only missed two classes, took copious notes, and went to TA reviews, but I couldn't do well on his tests to save my life.

ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC professor. highly recommended!! It is very common for Bro. Griffin's lessons to bring tears to the majority of the class's eyes. Every class is a spiritual feast. You CANNOT go wrong with him.

TAKE HIM! Bro. Griffin was the NICEST, most sincere teacher I've ever had. He was very well versed with the gospel, but taught it in a way that was easy to understand. He was encouraging to every comment, and related them easily to the lecture. I felt the spirit in every class period! I will take more classes from him in the future!

Everyone seems to really like Bro. Griffin but he wasn't my favorite. His test were RIDICULOUSLY hard and there is basically no way to prepare for them. They are all open scripture but that really doesn't help. At all. It could be worse but it sure as heck could have been better.

A great and easy class. Bro Griffin is endearing and so sweet. Weekly online journal-type submissions, 1 midterm, 1 final(both open scripture), 1 semester-long project, and class attendance wasn't mandatory, but helps you in the end. Write your notes in the margins of your scriptures! Tests aren't easy, and you'll need them.
He is awesome!! Truly an inspired man who teaches with the spirit. WONDERFUL guy, GREAT class. HIGHLY recommend him!!

Loved this class, highlight of my semester! Take this prof, the rest make you work too hard! Two tests, open book(of mormon), one project that you are supposed to  do an hour a week. I didn't and caught up at the end of the semester, still got an A. do it right tho. Great class!!

I would highly recommend taking BOM from Bro Griffin. His tests were difficult for me, and held me back from getting an A, but I think it's important to remember the value of learning from an inspired professor like Bro Griffin far exceeds the value of a 4.0 GPA. I'm taking from him next semester, and hopefully again in the future.

Bro. Griffin is an AMAZING teacher!!! and super easy... all you have to do is show up and read and you get an A. plus he is an amazingly inspiring person  and I would suggest take his class 100% of the time that you can :)

Brother Griffin is so inspiring! He always brings the spirit. Absolutely amazing teacher,I learned so much about the gospel. TAKE BOM from him!! Easy class, 1 midterm daily BOM reading 1 little essay, and a year long "project" that really helps grow your testimony. I loved the class so easy! Only annoying thing is that a 94 is an A so I got an A-.

After seeing this class highly recommended on RMP I have to say I was disappointed. He's a good guy but he talks the whole class and you're responsible for everything he might say on a test. Tests are open scripture, but I would say only 50% is scriptural and the rest is his view on application or very specific historical facts. Not easy.
Phenomenal teacher. Easiest class I've ever taken, and a huge testimony builder. Take this class, even if it means re-arranging your entire schedule.

BEST PROFESSOR EVER. I want to take all the religion classes I can from Brother Griffin! He brought the Spirit to class every day and helped me grow my testimony so much. He really has a passion for what he's teaching and his testimony is rock solid. Really cares about the students like no other professor. Take his classes if you can!!!!!
Brother Griffin is the best and is truly interested in you succeeding and doing well. Take his class and get to know him. He is amazing.

Brother Griffin is such a wonderful person. He has a great love for the scriptures and the Gospel. His tests are open book and you can write notes on the sides but are still somewhat difficult. Just make sure to write as many notes as you can and attend study sessions. If you want to  learn more about the BOM, definitely take this class from him!

Brother Griffin was awesome!  He is a very engaging teacher who obviously cares about both who and what he teaches.  He has a recurring set of assignments, as well as a few larger projects, with strict a no-late-work policy.  I was surprised by the difficulty of the midterm; don't blow his tests off and take good notes IN THE MARGINS of your BoM!
Brother Griffin is an amazing teacher. His stories are so inspirational. I left class every day newly committed to do and be better.

BROTHER GRIFFIN IS INCREDIBLE. Take any religion class you possibly can from him!!!! You will NOT regret it. He is seriously an amazing teacher. You walk out of class every single day with a stronger testimony. He doesn't focus on the nitty gritty details or try and trick you. He focuses on the doctrine and the spirit. I loved his class so much!!

Brother Griffin is a fantastic teacher! I have really looked forward to his insightful lectures, and I really appreciate how he treats the course more like a Seminary or EFY class than an academic course. Definitely going to take another class from him. Highly recommended!!

Bro Griffin is my absolute favorite religion teacher at BYU. He reminds me of John Bytheway,everyone I talk to in my class adores him. I learn so much in his class, really insightful and he really knows how to engage you and help you see more than just the black words on the page. Notes in scriptures. My 3rd time having him. He's THE  BEST!!!

Griffin's great. Reminds me of EFY classes, which really relate to life and offer great insights. Griffin really cares about having spirit in class and has his lectures down pat. He does involve students in spiritual discussions and insights. Tests are pretty fair. Class is exciting. I always feel better after going. Do it.

Bro. Griffin is an amazing person and teacher. His classes are extremely interesting and uplifting. He loves class discussion and interacting with his students. His honors class requires a fair amount of work, but he allows scriptures on his tests and they are very straightforward. He truly cares about his students and wants to help them learn.

Bro Griffin is AMAZING. Seriously you will NOT regret taking this class from him.  You will look forward to this class every week. It is the fastest 50 min of your week because he is SO interesting.  Write all your notes in your BOM for open book tests.  He lets you self-grade for attendance, pre-reading, and weekly forum entry but be honest!

LOVE Bro. Griffin. He is such a good guy, and he has a genuine love for the Book of Mormon. He wants you to grow spiritually, so even the tests and assignments are meaningful, and they are not difficult. Write down all your notes in the book-- my copy of the BoM from his class is now one of my most precious possessions.

I adore Brother Griffin. I wish I could take all of my religion classes from him. He's so peppy and smiley, and it's virtually impossible for me to lose interest during his lectures. He has the most insightful information, and the most spiritual classes. Take anything from Brother Griffin!
Great teacher.  Really cares about his students and helping them come closer to Christ.  Only includes academia because it's required by the university.

I would suggest buying a new Book of Mormon, and mark it with every single thing he goes over. You can use your Book of Mormon on the test. The TA review was amazingly helpful as well, but probably depends on the TA. Brother Griffin really did a good job inviting the spirit and the spirit did a great job teaching! :) Wonderful class!!

I typically hate ALL religion classes at BYU. Brother Griffin is the very first teacher that I felt actually taught worth while information that I found interesting. He is also the first religion professor i have been able to respect. I highly recommend him for people that want to learn interesting and meaningful thing, and have a medium-hard class

Bro. Griffin is the BEST. He treats the class like a place where you can learn to be more like Christ, not like its a class you need to know facts for tests. There is one midterm and one final, both are open scripture. Just set a reminder on your phone to do the weekly hw which is so easy. Take good notes, GO TO THE TA REVIEWS and you'll be golden

Bro. Griffin is awesome. He's smart, spiritual, and caring. GO TO CLASS, pay attention to the points he makes, write notes in your scripture margins, and DON'T FORGET TO DO YOUR HOMEWORK. I'll admit, the take-home final and semester-long project were a little too much work, but they weren't that hard, just took a while. Highly recommend this class.

Brother Griffin is a fantastic teacher.  I took both Book of Mormon courses from him.  In fact, I planned my 2nd semester around him.  If you are looking for an easy teacher for religion, you're taking the class for the wrong reasons.  If you pay attention, you can learn a ton and be spiritually uplifted all at the same time.  Take Brother Griffin!
Great lectures, just have to take lots of notes for tests. Pretty uplifting.

Griffin is a good lecturer if you're into a sort of EFY style of teaching. I've taken quite a few courses here at BYU, and there's definitely too much work required for a 2 credit class. Tests are open scripture, but it's not much help. You have to be in class in order to get the answers and usually it's just something he says in passing. He's ok.

It's a lot of work for a 2 credit class. He means well and he's a great guy, I just felt like the take home final, the semester long project, and the final in the Testing Center was too overwhelming for a religion class. You grade yourself a lot, and if you're like me, you'll be really harsh on yourself. Class time is great, out of class time isn't

I loved this class! Bro Griffin really helped bring the spirit every day and make the Book of Mormon seem like a new adventure. The homework is easy, just make sure you don't forget to do it. Tests are simple if you go to class every day and write notes in the margins. TAKE THIS FROM HIM!!!

He really brings the scriptures to live in a really engaging way. Never uses powerpoints, no homework other than reading and commenting on a forum every week. Attend class, do all the forums, go over your notes before the test and write them in the scriptures, and you'll do really well.

Bro. Griffin is fantastic teacher.  Classes are always spiritually enlightening and he's very good at pointing things out that life-long church members may not have noticed.  I would recommend his class to anyone.

I LOVE Bro. Griffin. I learn something and have my testimony strengthened in every class period. The tests can be hard, but you can make up for it if you read and attend class...which is basically worth just as much. I wouldn't be surprised if Bro. Griffin is a general authority someday. Truly amazing man!!

Bro. Griffin is great. He has a great spiritual insight and I ALWAYS learn something. Tests are open scripture and can be challenging (read: 2+ hours to take) but just write EVERYTHING in the margins of your scriptures. Daily reading and scripture study are equal to midterms so make sure to do them and mark them in Blackboard! Highly recommended!!

Brother Griffin is amazing. I've had both NT and BOM from him and I've learned so much. The tests can be a bit difficult but they are open scriptures so just write your notes in the margins and you're good. He loves his students and he always remembers my face when we pass on campus.

Brother Griffin is one of the kindest and most passionate teachers I've ever met, he cares so much about his students and is a very engaging professor.The big tests can be somewhat difficult, but if you put the effort into"trying a little harder to be a little better," you will succeed in his class and learn to love the Book of Mormon so much more.

I learned some pretty incredible things about the BOM from Bro Griffin. Teaches by the Spirit & yet provides much doctrinal insight. I understand why some think his class is hard, but if you take time on the tests & dig deep in to the scriptures for the answers, you will do well. Stay on top of his requirements & you will succeed! Take good notes!

There is a good amount of work to do weekly for this class. A lot of it is self-graded and the tests are open book. I absolutely loved Brother Griffin's class. You can feel his love for the scriptures and that made me want to develop my own for the scriptures. He honestly cares for his students and wants them to become a little better everyday.

Very good teacher, very knowledgeable. He is able to make the Book of Mormon come alive.  You will be aloud to take your scriptures into the exams with you, so make sure that you mark them in class and take notes in the margins.  Also be sure to always participate in the discussion forum on Blackboard

I loved his New Testament class! He really knows his stuff, does his research and yet teaches is a very respectful manner. Cheesy jokes, but if you can get over that and listen with an open mind each class, you'll get SO much out of this class (beyond  the cool facts and storylines)
Great professor. He has great insight and great understanding of the Book of Mormon. He makes it so that you really want to understand and read the Book of Mormon.

Brother Griffin is SERIOUSLY amazing. Every day of class was extremely interesting as well as uplifting! He knows his subject so well and really cares about the students. I've never enjoyed a class more. TAKE HIS CLASS AND YOU WILL NOT REGRET IT!

I. love. this. class. with Br. Griffin of course. Seriously, I looked forward to this class basically every day. I felt so uplifted and inspired to be a better person. Never struggled to stay awake. The only thing I didn't like was the self-grading stuff, esp with the final exam and semester-long project. I'd take another from him though.

Brother Griffin has changed my life. He has deepened my understanding of the scriptures, taught me how to better apply them to my life, and brought an abundant and sweet spirit to every class. He brought up some cool historical and academic perspectives but always taught the doctrine and focused on the Savior. Very doable work load. Take him!
This class was extremely easy but also extremely annoying. It's nothing more than a long, boring, and brainless EfY class. I would never take a Griffin class again.

I loved coming to Brother Griffins class! He teaches by the Spirit, so if you can open your heart you can't help but leave each lesson ready to work a little harder to become a little better! He shares great insights and all the assignments really helped me grow and make the scriptures become "mystory" :) Take NT from Bro Griffin!!

Bro. Griffin is a really nice guy, who has a strong love for the scriptures. However, I didn't like his class at all. He taught like a seminary teacher, and there was a lot of busy work, such as weekly discussion board responses. His tests are extremely hard, despite being open-scripture. No feedback on anything, so no idea why we got what grade.

Brother Griffin is a really great teacher, and I was always able to feel the spirit through his lessons. It does require some effort because you have to do things like write weekly reflections and post comments on a discussion board, but really it's just easy points. I highly recommend taking his class, and I absolutely loved it.

Brother Griffin is nice, I just never really clicked with him. If you are forgetful, you can do a lot of damage to your grade as you have to report your own attendance, pre-reading, and weekly reflection. Don't bother taking notes on paper, write everything in your scriptures. I got a 99 percent on the final because it is open scripture.

Brother Griffin is AWESOME! He teaches extremely well. I always feel the spirit in his class. He does require a lot of work, but it makes the class easier to pass if you do it and all of the activities really helped me with my spiritual growth. There's only two tests and they are open scripture. He keeps his lectures interesting. I recommend him.

Brother Griffin has some nice gospel insights-I enjoyed his lessons and the readings. What is ridiculous about this course is the way it's organized. There is A LOT of busy-work and a lot of it you grade yourself. I understand this is a religious class, but  you don't get any feedback. I expect more logical structure from a university level class.

Lectures were good, but,other BoM teachers are just as good.  This class is crazy! There are 2 finals, both really hard, and takes about 5 hours total if you're fast. you'll have to write a minimum of several thousand words in essays for this class as well. Its hard to feel the spirit when you're stressing over tons of assignments and tests.

Brother Griffin knows his stuff, and is super in how he goes through the Book of Mormon. You practically dictate your own grade with attendance and scripture readings, but the spirit is always strong and I know I am a better person. Loved this class!!

His tests aren't easy, I find I'm forgetful so the weekly online readings and such were a bit of a problem for me (and he has gotten more strict on accepting late stuff.) BUT forget grades! I can say with 100% surety, this class made me a better person. I would recommend this class to anyone. I felt the Spirit in every single class.

Wow! This class was wonderful. Every lesson was full of the spirit and taught the personal application of the scriptures we were reading as well as the historical background. I not only learned a lot, I feel that I grew as a person. Brother Griffin truly believes AND lives what he is teaching.

Brother Griffin is the single best religion teacher I've ever had. He is one of the funniest men I know and he has a gift for explaining the Book of Mormon stories. Take his class and you will not regret it. I promise!
If you've read the other ratings on Brother Griffin, you've heard how amazing this dude is. Take his class. Promise you won't regret it (:

Brother Griffin is amazing! I feel the spirit so strongly in his class and I never find myself falling asleep. He really knows how to connect with his students. There is hardly any work in the class, only reading and a short reflection every week. His tests are open book of mormon, and there are only 2 the whole semester. Take his classes!!!!!

He is a very engaging speaker. Most of your grade in the class comes from self reported attendance and readings, with only a few minor projects throughout the semester. His tests are a bit hard though, even though they are open book, but not open note.

Brother Griffin was by far the best teacher I've had at BYU. My friends and I decided he is the current version of Nephi. He is a wonderful teacher and ALWAYS brings the spirit into every class lesson, I never missed any of them. The workload isn't hard at all if you pay attention in class. Take every class from him as possible!
He is an amazing guy, but his tests are open scriptures, which makes them reelly hard. You have to take every minute detail in class to do well on the test, which I think are hard.

Like everyone has said, Brother Griffin is great. He's insightful, profound, and knowledgable. However, I was constantly frustrated with his TA. I always did the work within the guidelines and never received a good-enough grade. Other than that, I recommend this class.

Bro Griffin is really great! He really made the Book of Mormon come to life and his tests weren't very hard. Attendance is mandatory though and it's necessary to take good notes and study. Pre-Reading and Attendance is self-graded and so is part of the final. Things can get primary-ish sometimes but it's fun!

Brother Griffin is one of the most wonderful men I've ever had the privilege of being in the presence of! He loves his students. He loves the gospel. I feel the spirit every day. It is the only class I refuse to skip because I love it so much. All the work he gives is for your benefit. Take a class from him!!

Class is easy and you learn new concepts and insight EVERY day. What more could you ask for? Attendance and participation accounted for daily. Tests are open scripture with any notes, etc. you may have included. His main priority is to help you become better--if possible, he'd do away with tests. Cares for and loves his students. Totally sincere.

I LOVE Brother Griffin!!! This class literally changed my life. Go to class and take notes in your scriptures or transfer them over into your scriptures because the tests are all open-book. The tests are straight forward and he goes over everything in class. He truly teaches with the spirit and teaches principles in such an incredible way! Love it!

Really amazing teacher, he really cares about his students and the material. COME TO CLASS and take all your notes in your scriptures (including cross refferences mentioned in class) b/c you can use them on the test.  I would highly recommend taking this class.

Although I dislike almost everything about intellectualized religion in a classroom setting, I recognize that Brother Griffin is a skilled lecturer and explains scriptural concepts in out-side-the-box ways. For BOM 1 at least, he makes you write a couple of short research papers and do a big semester-long project, so be aware. Not  an "easy A."

I felt the spirit in class all the time, it was great. Take all your notes in your scriptures (I had a set specifically for class) because they are used for tests. The tests took me 1-2 hours and I still got Bs low As. He's a great teacher though and I learned a lot.

He is so nice and so into the scriptures. It is great. He can teach you to see so much in the scriptures and enjoy them a lot more. I loved his class and I'm taking NT with him now. Take him, he's fabulous.
Brother Griffin is absolutely the greatest. Take from him for SURE! He will change your life!

Take it from him!! He is more than willing to talk to you 1 on 1 about anything, and out of his 900 students or so, he will likely remember your name. Brilliant man both in the gospel and in life. Would highly recommend.

BROTHER GRIFFIN IS AMAZING!!!!!!!! Seriously, if you want to be focused on learning and really feeling the spirit, he's the man to teach.  I hope I will get to have the chance to have him as a teacher again.  He is as brilliant as ever but also one of the most humblest man I have met. Take his class!

Brother Griffin cares for students, that they learn the Gospel. The class wasn't OVERLY academic; His focus is more on students' personal relationship with Doctrine than remembering names and dates.  This class was empowering, looked forward to it each week. Honestly doing assignments means there is a LOT to do and the exam was not the easiest.

Amazing teacher! Don't listen to people who say it is not academic, I learned so much and I loved the class! He is so inspirational and entertaining. I would recommend switching around your schedule to get him as a teacher!

PRO: Easy A, Essentially "College Seminary", Tries to focus on testimony building.                       CON:  Little academic study of the book of mormon.  Feels like sunday school at times.  Not what I was looking to get out of a college level class.

Hated this class! Griffin loves the gospel and his students, but his teaching style is too primary class for me. I wanted deep doctrine like my Isaiah class where I would get more out of the scriptures, but instead felt like I was back in seminary. LOTS of busy work to keep up with, but it's all self graded/participation stuff.

Brother Griffin is really, really helpful. I did not like his T.A., she was difficult to work with. Brother Griffin on the other hand is the most amazing teacher. I always felt the spirit in his class and it is fairly easy. Choose Griffin!

I enjoyed Brother Griffin's BoM classes. I took both halves from him.  His lessons were always inspiring and he really cared about his students. If you don't take a class from him, I would suggest at least sitting in on one.  I enjoyed the way he would discuss a story and then dive deeper into the lessons in that story. Such a great guy!
I learned so much about the Book of Mormon from him!!! And it was so interesting. He is very enthusiastic about teaching and that makes it fun.

I would stay away from this professor. He's brand new and he doesn't know what he's doing. For the final he tried to do a self graded written test that was poorly written, unclear, and frustrating. If you want a real professor, stay away.

Bro. Griffin is AMAZING! I learned so much about the gospel every day. He's super helpful and really loves his students. There is a lot of little busy work but it's worth it. I would take another one of his classes in an instant! Probably one of my favorite classes so far!

Bro. Griffin is a nice guy, really. Honestly though, I was bored to death in his class. It was taught like a High School Seminary class but with a bunch of random things thrown in to try and make it college level. It wasn't for me, but I could see why some kids liked it. Just be wary.

Brother Griffin is great. He's really funny and approachable. You can tell that he really cares about his students. The only thing is that it's very EFY style, which is fine if that's what you like. I certainly enjoyed his class, but it's not for everyone.

If you miss seminary, take a class from Brother Griffin. He's so sweet you just want to hug him after class, and you can tell he loves his students. He focuses on having the Spirit in every class and helping you learn the gospel and build your testimony. If you read, do the reflections, and go to class you will get an A.

Seminary style, he teaches like an EFY teacher. You'd have to try very hard to not get an A. Class attendance mandatory. Reading before each class. Tests are vague and open ended but open book. Most points are from reading and attendance. A semester long project is required totaling ~15 hours.
THIS MAN IS AMAZING! he is hilarious and helps you feel the spirit every day. super easy tests. just dont forget to do daily attendance relections! definitely taking new testament from him :)

Brother Griffin is the best!  Before this class I was always kinda self-conscious about my church knowledge.  Now I feel like I truly know how to study the scriptures on my own. He knows the scriptures so amazingly well, and it shows through his teaching.  He is definitely not preachy, like sometimes happens with religion professors.

Bro. Griffin is amazing! He focuses on trying to get the class to feel the spirit over learning lots of different facts. My only complaint is there is some busy work with attendance, and discussions, but it's really easy and only takes a minute. I would highly recommend this teacher.

Brother Griffin's class has been one of the biggest testimony strengthening experiences of my life. I enjoy the Book of Mormon so much more. I felt the spirit every single class and was so sad if I ever had to miss. I hope to one day be able to understand the scriptures as fully as he does. Can't wait to take New Testament from him.

Book of Mormon classes are amazing. This class is very straightforward but the lectures are amazing and I almost always learn something new or see something from a new perspective. There's also not TOO much work assigned that it would make studying miserable, but enough to get a fair grade.

I love Brother Griffin. He is hilarious and he is sincere and he made me love to the BOM. His class is very structured; there are several things you need to remember, like daily reflections (for attendance) marking your reading online, discussions, papers, but everything is outlined in the syllabus so don't let that turn you off. He is AMAZING.

Wow, this guy is amazing. I took his class last semester and it was really spiritual and awesome, and this semester... I'm stuck with a teacher I don't like as much and I haven't learned as much about the BOM. TAKE CLASSES FROM HIM!! He's great!

I have gone to other BOM classes, but his is my favorite. I have never fallen asleep in class and the things he teachers are profound and uplifting that the whole time you are captured by the spirit and understand things like never before. Tests are not hard just  take good notes and listen.

One of the best religion classes I have taken at BYU.  If you go to class everyday you will ace the tests.  He has great lectures and keeps you entertained with cheesy, but funny, jokes.  Easy A, and a great testimony builder.

He is basically the best teacher at BYU! His lectures are so great and he really cares about helping you love the scriptures, not just passing the class(even though he's interested in that too).  He drops test questions that more than 50% of people miss & he gives out random free extra credit.  All his work is easy points!  He's amazing!  Take him!

First, while his tests are open book, they're intense. I spent more than 2 hours taking the final. The work isn't difficult and while it can be useful, some days it just feels like busy work (turn 100-300 words on blackboard after every class for attendance). Overall not bad, but not my favorite class either. His jokes are <i>super</i> cheesy.
Good teacher, but the lectures are pretty boring. I would recommend this class though.

I love this man! He is so great and I'm taking from him again. Very few complaints about him. His midterm is a little tricky so be sure to study his study guide. Very helpful and is a perfect religion teacher.

The dude is the best! Most of the test questions are what we discuss in class, so go to class! Class always great though. The Spirit is always there when he teaches and his jokes are superrr cheesy, but hilarious! he'll have like 4 or 5 jokes lined up ready to go

Ummm... I love him. I wish he taught every class on campus. I feel like doing his homework is a privilege. I never think of it as another thing to do.  I always think of it as a chance to study Book of Mormon. He makes every class interesting and his jokes are seriously hilarious. I'm so excited to take 122 from him.  He is so amazing. :D! Take him
Brother griffin is da bomb but his tests are pretty rigorous! He is a great teacher and you feel the spirit everyclass. He makes the Book of Mormon come alive and really effected my life.

This class has a TON of busy work. Make sure you don't fall behind in the daily reading quizzes and discussions. I like Brother Griffin. He is a great guy, just makes you do a lot of busy work. All in all, a good class.
Brother Griffin really cares about his students and loves to crack cheesy jokes. I would  recommend him to anyone. Take his class!

Brother Griffin is amazing as a teacher and relates very well to us and has a love for the scriptures I loved being there to his classes and would not miss one for the world! His tests are pretty ruff though im talking 80 question 2 hours long! But still great class learned alot

Brother Griffin is absolutely the best teacher I've had! He brings in all aspects of the gospel and and helps me to fit them into my life. I'm so impressed with his character, teaching abilities and spirit.
Definitely my favorite teacher. Take him if you have the chance!

Bro. Griffin is the greatest teacher I have ever had in my entire life. I am captivated by every single lesson he teaches. I learned so much in his New Testament class that when the next semester's registry came, he was the first person I signed up for. Pay attention and enjoy his lectures and you cannot get anything less than an A in his class.

I LOVE BRO. GRIFFIN! He is right up there with religion teachers Parker and Bott! His New Test. class helped me learn things about myself and our church that I had never thought about. If you're unsure who you should take Rel 211 from, this is your guy! He makes you work for your grade but nothing outlandish or undoable.You want to be his student!

I love Brother Griffin!  Book of Mormon was my favorite class, and I learned so much!  He really knows how to apply the Book of Mormon to our day and our lives.  It really makes you think and want to read.  Brother Griffin did a great job at making class fun and a great place to learn.

Brother Griffin is a wonderful teacher, he really tries to bring the spirit into the class while also teaching about the gospel. He does a great job balancing between the two. His also the happiest teacher I have ever had and it makes me happy going to class. I highly recommend him.

I LOVE Brother Griffin!  One of the most spiritual and loving teachers in the world.  He always brings in great insight, and I wish his class was longer.  Just do the reading and pay attention in class.  There are short quizzes for the reading, but they are easy, and you can use your BoM.  If a question is weird, email and he'll give points back.
BEST CLASS EVER!! Take this class from him you will grow spiritually and learn to love the scriptures. A lot of EASY busy work but so easy to get an A. Tests are a little long but not too bad!

He is my favorite professor; class always goes by way too fast. You have assignments which you just need to get into a habit of doing they aren't too bad. He is really into applying the scriptures to your life which i have really enjoyed. He is funny and is all about your learning. He really wants you to succeed.

Bro Griffin is a fantastic religion teacher. Unlike a lot of religion teachers at BYU, the class for him is about his students' spiritual growth- not just assignments and memorizing facts. There are quite a few easy online assignments, but you get in a habit of dealing with those. Highly recommend him. Wonderful religion teacher.

Bro. Griffin is a good teacher, but DO NOT take this if you're looking for a non-time consuming 2 credit class. His reading assignments are many and mandatory, as is attendance. His tests are super-easy and open-scripture, so that's a bonus. There are just LOTS of little mundane assignments that don't do anything but give you a chance to miss point

Brother Griffin is one of my favorite teachers of all time. He makes the scriptures so clear and we have fun learning them. He puts more of an emphasis on the spiritual learning than memorizing names and dates. The class is inspiring and entertaining. I wish it was longer than just 50 minutes. I'm always disappointed when it's over.

Griffin is the man! He made Book of Mormon my favorite class this semester! You never want to miss a day of class because this guy gets you on an unbelievable spiritual high everytime to come. Jokes are hilarious sometimes too. Take his class!
He truly is my favorite teacher this semester! I'm very upset he's not my 122 teacher next semester!  He's awesome!  He's fun and spiritual: a perfect combination!
Professor Griffin is one heck of a religion teacher. He is increadibly knowledgable about the gospel and teaches it in a way students can understand. He makes me want to go to class and learn!
Amazing teacher! taking his class next semester for RELA 122

Brother Griffin is awesome and super understanding, if you have any questions, feel free to ask him! He's hilarious too! Pre-class quizzes are easy and he just makes you ponder about the life you are living in right now. Very inspiring class.

Professor Griffin is the most interesting, caring, and thoughtful teacher I have ever had.  His class is so amazing  and I walk out every day feeling like I want to do more.  If you have any doubts or ideas about who you want to take, forget them and take him!
He is absolutely amazing. To think that this is his first year of teaching, you would never be able to guess it. I love him!
He made me love the gospel like I never did before...

Outstanding teacher. You will not regret taking him! Work might seem like a lot at first but it is simple, maybe 15 minutes a day at most. Teaches by the spirit, always disappointed when i see class is over.

Brother Griffin is a fantastic teacher. He brings great insight into the Book of Mormon, and he's always engaging. I feel the Spirit in each class, and we are always in the scriptures. His expectations are very clear - attendance, readings/short quizzes, one discussion post per week, midterm, final and a semester-long project of your choosing.
This guy rocks. He teaches things in such a way that is easy to understand, but it is really profound as well! I love his class.

This guy is the best BOM teacher ever! He is super funny and makes class super interesting. It's the most spiritual class I've ever attended. Everyone in class is so in tune with the Spirit everyday and leaves with a burning in the bosom. He asks deep questions that get you to really ponder. Just great overall!
He is an excellent teacher. He's a captivating speaker, and knows the Book of Mormon very well.  Also, he has a lot of relevant and interesting information.  And he's funny.

Calc 1 (math 112) is gonna be a pretty tough class regardless of which professor you have but Dr. Jarvis was great. He is very smart and passionate about math and teaching it to his students. Really great guy if you're taking this class Dr. Jarvis is the man

Coach Jarvis is amazing. His lectures in class are super straightforward and he incentivizes asking questions and emphasizes clarity, making sure no one is left behind. Even if calc doesn't come easy to you, he really works to help every student succeed. Definitely take him if you can.
